Review: It was late evening when we , a family of 3 , checked-in . Front office had 3 persons manning the counters, ,2 girls and a man. Smooth transition to our rooms on the 6th floor, 601 and 607 respectively. The rooms were neatly laid out, had wooden flooring, recently polished and shining and was definitely over 250 sq.ft in area, had a large King bed, a seating area with a coffee table and 2 chairs, a work-desk ,and the mini fridge, wardrobe with safe and ironing board + iron. Bath was tiled at length and the shower cubicle was larger than normal, so bathing was a pleasure.One noticed the quietness and calmness of the location. The hotel has 2 towers and the Restaurant was located in Tower B. We had dinner on two nights there which was extremely well-done. Chinese food is recommended, and the 'Gorkha' beer was pleasantly refreshing with the meal.The swimming pool  was clean and not crowded. We hired a taxi for sightseeing to Patan and Bhaktapur. was indeed breathtaking. Must bring a good camera for a trip to Nepal. Checked out after 2 nights. A lovely stay with experienced Management and trained staff.

We had a very nice stay at Akama . Went here with my mom , dad and grand mom for Pashupatinath Darshan . They rooms were so neat and the service was at par with any other hotel . The staffs were so courteous that not only myself , even my parents took a note of it and appreciated them . On the way back from Pashupatinath darshan even when we were half an hour late , they made fresh breakfast for us and served all four of us. The cleanliness is no less than a 5 star I must say. The location is also central and all important landmarks of Kathmandu are located between 3 to 6 Kms . This is just 3 Kms from Pashupatinath temple as well.  We found the food also great . It's just that a few things mentioned in the menu were not available. But whatever was served was great.

Hey you! Yes, you! If you are struggling to choose a hotel a hotel in Kathmandu (like I did), then you should absolutely read this review. In short, stay at Akama. Their prices are very competitive compare to North American hotels, and the room/service/staff were stellar. Choose this hotel; you won't regret it.Liked  · The free breakfast was amazing. So many delicious continental and Nepali cuisines to choose from! And fresh fruits and freshly squeezed watermelon choose. I ate better here than I do at home! The room service food was also quite decent (except one milkshake that wasn't cold, but that is a minor issue). The rooms were amazing; they were very clean and comfortable. They were not too small, and the bathrooms were clean and fairly well maintained. The laundry service was well done, and I felt my clothes had been treated with respect and care.The staff were incredible and extremely courteous; they were extremely accommodating and flexible. There were also very adaptable with us changing plans and extending our stay due to the airplane crash in Pokhara. I would personally like to thank Mr. Surendra, Mr. Raju, Miss Palpasa, Miss Bandana, Miss Kabina, and Mr. Binod for their exceptional and supportive service during our stay. In fact, all the staff I met were stellar in their service.The hotel, unlike many in Kathmandu, was also inside it's own exclusive compound with private security, and was very clean. Felt much safer here than in other parts of Kathmandu.Disliked  · A  milkshake was lukewarm, but honestly that is a small gripeRoom service food, while usually good and tasty, can be much more expensive than in other places in Kathmandu. Generally, I recommend going elsewhere to eat if possible, simply due to food prices. The cleaning service, while good, is expensive. I recommend doing your own laundry if possible.The toilet paper was very fragile compared to most toilet paper in North America (again, a minor gripe; these bathrooms have bidet hoses).Overall, this was a practically perfect hotel to stay at. If I ever come back to Kathmandu, I am staying here!

Whenever i called for something, phone was answered almost within seconds, and help came within less than 15 minutes. Sangrol, you are just amazing person man. Your greetings forced me to stay one more day, I had planned to stay just one day, and I came to check out next day, and I had just thought of extending, but had not decided, the way you greeted made me to decide. Thanks for your amazing service. I just forgot to note down the names of other staffs at reception, but you guys are just amazing, not less than Sangrol. You guys are gems of Akama. Please keep it up. Anisha, I afforded the expensive food at hotel's restaurant just because the way you talked and serviced. I felt like I am your friend more than guest in the hotel. Other restaurant staffs were more than amazing too, just couldn't remember names. Food was very tasty, and the quality service that I received made food more tastier. As far as I could note names, Bibas, Dipesh and Shubhakamana, Thank you for your service at the restaurant. Cons (Seriously need improvement): 1) Room temperature adjustment was difficult, I tried increasing temperature, I turned into heat mode, but the temperature didn't increase more than 21 degree Celsius. I just returned from an amazing trip to Nepal! (please see my review on Earthbound Expeditions as well as You Can’t Steal My Happy) While in this lovely country I/we had the great good fortune to stay in 4 hotels through out the land.. with 5 total nights spent at Hotel Akama in Katmandu. The hustle and bustle of the city is very quickly left behind when you arrive at the front steps of this lovely “non-chain” hotel .. bright marigolds and smiling faces greet you as you are welcomed in with a fresh juice drink. I found the entire hotel to be fantastic.. spotlessly clean, the rooms very very comfortable with plenty of space, well working AC, perfect firmness mattress and lots of electric outlets to charge devices (you’ll need a 3 prong converter).. There is a conveniently located ATM machine on property as well providing easy access to local currency. The weight room is well outfitted and the pool lovely and clean.. breakfast each day is fantastic with a neat combination of local food options as well as more standard fare.. Including delicious made to order omelets. The restaurant Chow Bella offers beautiful city views and delicious food as well. I found the employees of Hotel Akama to be especially helpful.. always smiling, always willing to provide whatever service needed. They assisted in finding and booking massages, locating a store that sells luggage and booking a taxi to get there (I bought a lot of souvenirs!), providing extra water or hot tea, always ready to assist with luggage and offer any answers to any questions at any time. I felt so very well taken care of by everyone at Hotel Akama! On my last day I was greeted and thanked personally for staying there by several .. what a special touch! Thank you Binod, Kabina, Bibash and Bandana for all your excellent care and concern!!! I am thankful for our stay at this lovely hotel and certainly recommend it to anyone looking for a good centrally located lodging option! Katmandu is a VERY busy city with A LOT of traffic.. given this, I don’t think its possible to get away from road noise as a result.. also.. due to the nature of the traffic.. “going out for a walk” is not really a pleasant option)

I did not have much interaction with the night staff but they too somehow knew my name everytime I walked through the lobby: Raju and Anoj. Thank you all.4. The Indian/Asian restaurant: Mayush, and Kishor they are the foundation to the well running machine. Attention to detail!!!! All of the staff knew my beverage and food preference because of them. Its the small details that makes everything so much more special. I cannot begin to thank you guys for just helping with creating special dishes for me. I cannot forget to mention Khadka- our driver. Truly a place you want to stay at!Brian Sayles

I recently stayed at this hotel for work, and had a very good experience. The staff are very friendly and helpful. They great you at the door with a welcome drink and a smile. The bedroom was big and clean. We used the conference hall facilities for 3 days and had no problems whatsoever. It was very easy to communicate what we needed and the hotel obliged without any issues. The hotel has some nice facilities like a swimming pool, a steam room and sauna, and a couple of good restaurants. The hotel is also in a convenient location (it is only about 15 minutes by taxi from the airport).

we had 3 different visit to hotel akama during our tour to Nepal. every time we went for check in we fell like we are in our home. all the staffs were good but kaushila is among the best. she helped us to track our missing luggage from airport & took extra care of us during our every visit. hotel location is little far from happening town but the ambiance of the hotel is very nice. breakfast was good as well.

Hotel is a nice property but little bit far away from the happening area of kathmandu. Staff is courteous but little inexperienced. The surrohndings are not too good so better tonopt out for higher floors

A most amazing experience as we were completely floored by the warmth and hospitality of the team at the hotel! A special mention to show our appreciation has to be made to Mr.Deepak Dhamala (F&B manager), Mr.Umesh Shrehtsa( Front Office Manager), Ms.Sumitra ( Front Office), Ms.Sharaddha(Front Office), Ms.Kaushilya (Front Office), Ms.Bimla (Front Office), Mr.Manoj ( Concerige), Mr.Nawaraj ( Restaurant), Ms.Shivani (Restaurant). Needless to say, the whole team went out of their way and were genuinely glad to welcome us! We really feel a wrench in leaving this beautiful hotel and hope to come back again soon!This hotel will really go places and we wish them the very best! Kudos to the team!This hotel is highly recommended for those who wish to have a truly unforgettable experience of warmth, hospitality and friendliness!

The best hospitality provided by all staff. Very nice hotel. Good room. Best service. Excellent food quality. I must say worth for money you pay. Very good swimming pool with sauna and steam facility.

No doubt.. hotel is amazing with full of facility and amazing hospitality .. located heart of the city... I definitely recommend this hotel for use... Mr Umesh is very helpful...: Thanks to Mr umeshRegards Amit

One of the best hotel in kathmandu for family and group. We have enjoyed alot at coffee shop and poolside all the staffs are friendly. Breakfast met expectation. Especially Front Office staffs (Kiran and Avishek) were really good and very helpful. Best hotel I would recommend in Kathmandu.

Hotel is accessible for disable people, they can arrange accessible cabs. All the staff are really caring and friendly. The hotel is situated at a bit outskirts but very much accessible from all parts of the city. Had a nice and comfortable stay here.

We stayed 3 nights during our Nepal trip at the hotel Akama. It si a new Hotel and very clean and functional. The staff is very prepared this thanks also to Mr. Deepak, the director I think, a very professional and nice person. The kitchen is very good, the breakfast was very varied. Our room (701) very wide, clean and bright. The pool is very well kept, the gym well equipped. We  thank agami Mr. Deepak for his availability and hospitality. Thanks Sofie & Patrick

We organised a multi-country meeting at Akama last week.  Not only were the conferencing facilities first rate, the staff was extremely attentive and responsive. So we were able to concentrate on our work and leave the rest to them.I must also say that they were particularly helpful with the special needs of some of the participants - the hotel is different ability-friendly. The rooms are clean and comfortable. Going in and out for a short 2 day meeting was a breeze.Thank you Akama.

our Paradise group were staying at akama hotelit was great stayed and enjoyable  with hotel facilities, nice breakfast in restaurant,good housekeeping services and all the staff are very friendly.sepcally kiran,raju shankar and kaushal jee for good rate and f&b deepk jee are very helpful.diffenetly l will recommend to everyone this hotel for the accommodation.

Quiet, very friendly and meeting the need beyond expectation.  Very respectful to the guest.  Night time manager Umesh Sheresta was wonderful in making sure our stay was comfortable and pleasant.  I highly recommend this hotel.

I was stay at akama hotel with my tour from indonesia at june 9 2019. I arrived maybe at 5 pm. Arrived at there, there is a little shop that we can buy some shirt or shawl. I go to my room to check the baggage with my brother and one porter. His name was kiran. I has talked with him and i talk many thing with him. He knew many thing about indonesia. And he knew too about indonesian football club. He said there was a player from nepal that playing at persija. Hahaha... thats my journey at nepal. Because i only this night stay at nepal and tommorow afternoon i will go to KL. Thank you.

I Stayed at Akama for eight days during their soft opening period in May 2019. All staff were enthusiastic in making sure my stay was enjoyable and that is was. My room was excellent, great bed, quality linen, excellent in house TV WiFi  entertainment, great bathroom amenities, timely room service both food beverage and turn down.  There was a lot of training happening in many areas for all staff  which is great to see to set the required standards. Even though occupancy was low  I made sure i tried all available services. The spa and sauna was still to be completed but from what I saw it will be a treat to use, big and well appointed. There is also a well equipped Gym which would suit all fitness needs. One of the best features would have to be the outdoor pool and grassed seating  area where you can have breakfast , snacks, lunch, drinks or dinner away from the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu city.The menu in the restaurant  covered Nepalese, Indian with a variety of western continental dishes. All meals I had were very extremely enjoyable, full of  flavour, good portions and well presented.A big thank you to Front office Manager Umesh Shrestha, Food and Beverage Manager Deepak Dhamala and Kiram for their great service and wonderful conversation.Looking forward to my next visit..L

Recently spent two weeks in Kathmandu and stayed at the Akama.  The room was very comfortable and spacious, and the staff could NOT have been more friendly and helpful.  They were absolutely outstanding.  The breakfast buffet had good variety and the food was very tasty.  I would definitely stay there again, and strongly recommend it for other guests.

A group of us stayed at Akama Hotel. its wonderful for family trip, Business trip or group stay. Wonderful atmosphere, large comfortable rooms with 2 large double beds and a bathroom with both a spacious rain head shower. Hotel staff is exellent, very helpfull, very calm, especially i would like to write the name of them like Mr. Umesh ji, Manager of Akama, salim, shankar, sumitra ji & yes food was excellent,  Mr Deepak (F&B Manager) superb man, he was very helpfull in arranging stuff for our group beyond his limit.thanks to everyone looking forward to visit again.thanks

Very satisfied with how they provide great hospitality from the entrance unlike previous hotel we have been to. Very polite and  helpful staff. The deluxe twin room room we stayed in was very clean with comfortable bed. First class buffet breakfast. Amazing decors which reflected both Buddhist and Hindu Architecture. Would definitely come back next time and try out the restaurant and dip in the swimming pool.Thank You Shova and Purna

Great hotel ! Amazing decor ! Amazing staff ! Good breakfast buffet and the rooms are spacious/ clean and quiet ! A little outside Thamel which give you a more local feel, grocery and place to eat right around the corner. Loved it ! Try the hotel restaurant MOMOS ! Great pool and outdoor patio. Definitely recommend! Way worth the price ! It’s a 5 start hotel in feeling .

I stayed in this hotel for 3 days in Feb 2019 and loved it. The hotel is brand new and built with your comfort in mind. The staff are lovely and willing to go the next step to make you happy. It is a rare find. Recommend it with all my heart

Overall service of Akama is very good. Employees always serve with smile and efficiency. Room is comfortable supported with all necessary requirements. Location is easily commutable from all prime areas of the city and very close to the airport. The dinning hall is great with quality food and excellent personalized service! Really it is a Great Stay in Akama.

After staying at a horrible  hotel in New Delhi ,this hotel made me feel very comfy. All staff are very helpful and sincere. Rooms very clean and decoration is good. There isnt much variety of food but they are very delicius . I highly recommend this hotel.
We stayed for two nights and they were very helpful.Room service prepared tea for me the next day as I couldn't drink coffee.The response from the restaurant and the reception was great.

Highly recommended hotel, very elegant and tasteful decoration, very well integrated. Suddenly you realize that the lamp is temple bells or cylinders.Large rooms with very comfortable bed and high quality bedding.Spacious shower tray that gives you a fantastic rest after the route.Very friendly staff eager to help.Restaurant with excellent Nepalese and Indian food. But it also has Western options. They make you pasta right away. Highly highly recommended

Super hotel...nepal jaye to esi hotel me rukna...bahot maja aayega...pure nepal me kathmandu top city hai...hotel staff bahot achha hai...hotel me rukne ki maja hi kuch alag hai.. ...........hotel ka food bhi achha hai ...aap kathmandu jaye to akama me hi rukana

The service was very good and I was glad!Bijay at the reception was also very kind.Dinner was delicious, and the hotel itself was very clean.However, there wasn't much to eat at breakfast.We had dinner on the rooftop, and the view was beautiful.The hotel also arranged for a taxi for us, which was very reassuring.I was a little concerned about the distance from the center, but it was close to the airport.Thank you!

The rooms are spacious, everything is done for the comfort of guests and above all, the staff takes great care, whether for personal requests or for the seminar. I have never been so well received! Excellent stay, I recommend it without hesitation!

Very nice place to stay💖 If I can come again next time, I would like to stay in this place again. The staff is very friendly and the restaurant is delicious. The room is clean, well-equipped, and the sheets and bedding are very comfortable. The hotel looks very luxurious in the area, and the lobby is also very bright. There are small shops around, and it is also very nice to walk around and see the residents. The hotel is in a good location, and it takes only 20 minutes by taxi from the international airport. Bijay, Sagar, Sumatra, Sunil, and Kabina helped us a lot during my and my mother's short two-day stay. I hope everyone works smoothly in the hotel and is in good health.

Thanks to all the hotel staff for making us feel at home, with special mention to Sangreul, Kabina and Nishan. Fabulous food, very varied and of great quality. Beautiful facilities and common areas. Amazing rooms with great views on clear days.

We stayed 3 nights in this hotel. Kind and friendly staff. Spacious rooms equipped with every comfort, apart from the non-opening, fixed windows. There were 3 of us, but the third bed was not as comfortable as the others, it was an extra bed, shorter than normal. The pool area is also nice. The breakfast was plentiful, buffet style, but a little lacking in fruit and cheese. The location of the hotel is far from the thamel area.

I stayed at the Aloft, Kathmandu during a recent visit. I was staying there with my family, and it was a very pleasant stay. The reasons we chose the hotel were that the location was great, the indoor pool allowed us to use it even in the winter and the rooms looked brand new. Upon arrival, we were taken to the lobby, where the reception desk seemed very small, but we were quickly shown to our room. The room was perfect as such, the views were great and the bedding was perfect. The only drawback was that the bathroom door wouldn't unlock easily (got locked in twice) and after one showers, the water easily spreads everywhere on the floor. But truthfully, these are easily fixable problems. The breakfast menu was really good. The omlette in particular was excellent and we really enjoyed breakfast every morning. The location of the hotel was absolutely perfect. Everything is a short drive or walk away. The staff was super friendly and ready to help. In my eyes, there is only one drawback at this hotel. The hotel really needs to tie up with a proper taxi agency and provide cars upon request. We found the back and forth a bit too much with the concierge desk. It left me irritated. I understand that hotel taxis are expensive and thus not apt for every customer, but we just expect a brand like Aloft to have taxis available with them at all times. All in all, it was a great stay, we really enjoyed the hotel and it's facilities and the staff was absolutely top notch. If I ever go back to Kathmandu, I'd only want to stay at Aloft, Thamel again. P.S. - The mask discipline of the hotel staff is absolutely perfect. Not once did I spot a staff member with their mask off.

Me and my partner booked a room at Aloft without much expectation as our 31st evening plan was last minute and Aloft was located at the perfect location. We booked a normal deluxe room which was on offer at that time and it included breakfast as usual. Check in was really smooth and staff at the reception were friendly and helpful. Once I checked in to my room I was really surprised with the amenities and attention to detail. Since we both worked at 5 star hotel in Melbourne for past 7 years We are usually not easily impressed but Aloft was 10/10 in terms of Service, cleanliness, location and amenities and is of international standard. We would highly recommend Aloft for anyone planning to visit Nepal or even if you are looking for staycation☺️

I stayed in this hotel on  business trip but because of some local laws of Lockdown I had to stay for more than a week. The hotel is taking good precautions for Covid. Sanitzers are kept at every possible place in hotel and staff is adhering covid guidelines.I felt this as Covid safe hotel. During my stay I found most caring and consistent staff ever seen. Anywhere you go in hotel they make you feel like a family. The rooms are well cleaned and housekeeping staff surprises you with towel arts and personalized notes. Food is good and most importantly the chef's are innovative and cooks personalized dishes for you.

I loved this hotel. The location in Thamel was very convenient for access to the local travel agents,to the shopping, and the sights.  The food was really enjoyable and delicious. I ate my three daily meals there and I  loved their wine selection, the rooms were clean, spacious and modern,the bed was wonderful for naps and the much needed deep sleep, but above and beyond all else it was the staff. From the front door coming in out of the chaotic Thamel precinct, to the people at the check in desk, especially the manager who really went out of his way to make sure I had a valid and confirmed booking at Tiger Mountain Lodge in Pokhara, to the chef who mixed with the patrons to make sure all was up to their needs, to the excellent laundry service I really cannot say enough about this hotel. I had the name of the service desk manager but I have misplaced it so if per chance he reads this note I again give you my very sincere commendation for how you helped me during my time at your hotel. In fact I felt so secure and content here that I really had to push myself to leave. Everything just came together so well.

Bear in mind Aloft is a Marriott Hotels brand and is therefore somewhat cookie-cutter and soulless but they do a decent job of making it un-stuffy and welcoming.   On the plus side it means staff are well trained and facilities are on point. This specific hotel is relatively new and therefore in good condition. Staff are welcoming and friendly. Of note is the generous distribution of hand sanitizing stations - every counter, every table, even inside the lifts (so you can sanitize after pressing the buttons. Breakfast spread has a generous variety of Eastern and Western items and is good quality.  Rooms are clean and spacious with plenty of amenities including a large screen TV and an ironing board with iron. The bed is super comfortable with high quality linen.  Housekeeping staff is brilliant, special shout out to Radhika on the 6th floor for her towel sculptures!Location at the heart of Thamel is of course perfect for tourists and shoppers. Hotel itself is attached to a brand new and modern shopping mall which is not yet fully occupied but has bars, eateries and perhaps most important to foreign guests, a NCELL kiosk to buy or recharge a local sim card.  Beyond is Thamel proper, plenty of dining and shopping options and vendors are broadly good natured and open to bargaining a bit.  Don't be too tough on them though, Nepal was closed for almost 3 years and many businesses have barely survived so your dollars/pounds/euros are sorely needed.To die for feature: The views, especially North facing from higher floors.Bit puzzling:  The pool is indoors and therefore dark and the whole place smells strongly of chlorine. Not at all inviting. Puzzling because its on the top floor and could easily have been open air.

This was my second time staying at this gem of a property. We were very skeptical considering the current pandemic, but we felt more safe at Aloft than at home. From the moment we stepped inside the premises, they made sure to adapt all safety measures from sanitizing our shoes and luggage to temperature check and contactless check in. Overall, It was a perfect staycation and an escape from the mundanity. Also, I would like to add that they have the most amazing pillows and we had the best sleep. Thank you Aloft!

I applaud General Manager Vikram and the entire team for running one of the best hotels I have ever stayed in. They are warm and welcoming and oblige all needs and requirements. The facilities are great, the hotel is sparkling and everyone from reception to the bartenders provide service with a smile and a serious willingness to make every guest feel special.

Came to Aloft for a one night stay after trekking and were overall disappointed. Some of the positives - everything was clean, staff was friendly, and it was in a great location! We had room 526 and upon walking in it was dreadfully hot. We thought that it was because nobody had stayed in the room for the past few days, but after being in it for an hour we realized the AC was malfunctioning. It would turn on, then turn off 30 seconds later, so after returning from dinner we called the front desk to fix it. After the repair man came, it worked for about one hour (long enough for us to fall asleep) but then quit working for the remainder of the night. My wife and I both woke up sweating in the middle of the night and struggled to sleep from 12am-6am. It got so warm in the room that we opened the door to the hallway in the morning to get some cooler air as we were getting ready. Upon checking out we told the front desk about the problem again so that they could get this resolved for future guests. Overall we were disappointed with Aloft because of the lack AC in the room leading to it being too hot. If you get room 526 over the next few weeks I would suggest asking for a room change, unless you like your room between 23-25 Celsius.

My spouse and I have had the privilege of staying at the Aloft in Thamel on two recent occasions now.  We found the convenience to restaurants and entertainment in Thamel makes the Aloft an ideal choice.  The rooms are as comfortable and clean as anyone should expect from a Marriott property.  While comfort and location are important, the reason why we will be returning next month is that the service is simply as top notch as any five star hotel or resort we've ever visited.  The staff are very well trained, tremendously prompt and thorough in addressing any request you may have.  It's a minor detail, but in my most recent visit I was surprised to see they still remembered my name, despite having only stayed overnight a couple months earlier.  I want to give particular kudos to Unami, an attendant who graciously went above and beyond in his service on both stays.For a budget/mid-range hotel, the Aloft surely does feel like hidden value for the price.  I'm looking forward to my next stay in a matter of weeks.  And for anyone coming to Kathmandu for a few nights of tourism and looking to stay somewhere central, I highly recommend this hotel.

Just spent 8 nights in the Aloft  as a last minute booking because Nepal went into complete lockdown due to Covid-19 and the airport closed .First impressions were amazing, everything is so clean and new compared to the oldness of the city outside. The staff were all great, all very friendly, well dressed and extremely polite, a true credit to the hotel. The restaurant was very clean and the food was amazing. At breakfast, the chefs would cook whatever eggs you would like and deliver them to your table, nothing was too much trouble.The rooms, like the rest of the hotel, were clean, spacious and modern. On the top floor is a well equipped gym which overlooks an indoor swimming pool.All the staff were amazing, they made our stay very comfortable, would love to go back again.

My opinion is that this hotel is 5 star hotel. Cleaning is perfect, you can find in the room everything what you need for travelling. The plugs are international, decoration is so modern, all texture is high quality, Breakfast is like brunch. you can eat whatever you want. Lunch and dinner has got both modern and traditional food. All staffs are so polite and speaking English very well. They have got live music in lobby some night.   And has got a lot of different restorant in same building. I really love it, If I go to Katmandu again, I will stay this hotel again.

A fantastic hotel right in the heart of the city where all the action is, the Aloft hotel is very well maintained which makes this an ideal choice for people who are planning to go on a  trek or returning from one and looking for an oasis to rejuvenate for a few days. It's not just the great location but the wonderful staff working here that make this hotel unique, The courteous customer service starts right from the very top and a big shout out to Jatin Shrestha the Director of Room Services whos calm and reassuring manner keeps everything flowing smoothly in the hustle and bustle of their daily hectic activities. I wish I had taken down the names of all the folks here who made my stay memorable but I do have to mention the few who's names I do remember Sabina Majhi, Sujan Khadka and Kamal Malla at the WXYZ bar you all do an extremely good job to keep the drinks going conversation flowing and recommending cocktails with an unique twists to capture the local flavor, also,  I do have to mention Yamuna Tuladhar from House Keeping such a wonderful human being who takes great pride in making sure that the room is spotless when you get back from your daily activities. A big thank you! For the rest who's names I have not mentioned, I apologize but your faces and friendly manner cannot be forgotten. Thank you!

The staff at Aloft Kathmandu looked after myself and the rest of the trekking group I was with so fantastically whilst we awaited repatriation flights .  Nothing was too much trouble and in spite of the turbulent times the rooms were spotless, the food was delicious and the service wonderful.  The staff and wonderful new facilities made the situation so much less stressful and my extended stay in Kathmandu as enjoyable as it could have been.

Stayed here a couple of times between treks. Had a wonderful experience.Perfect location in Thamel, very walkable, reasonably priced, very comfy room, delicious breakfast with a vast spread of various cuisines.Thank you Hom Nath Lamichhane for your amazing hospitality and service - you were extremely helpful and went out of your way to help us with bookings, concierge services, help around Thamel, airport pick ups, recommendations, and more . Truly appreciate your efforts.Would highly recommend this hotel to others.

We couldn't have been more impressed than we were with the Aloft. We stayed at the Marriott Kathmandu as well, and though it was excellent, the Aloft wins the battle,particularly for its unbeatable location in the heart of Thamel, the most engaging area of Kathmandu.  Another reason is the exceptional assistance of employee Kryschel, who took amazing care of us during our short stay. We had a late evening flight, and he was happy to let us stay well beyond our 4 pm late checkout for just a small additional fee. It was so nice to be able to go out and have a great farewell meal in Kathmandu, then come back and shower and relax before heading to the airport for a 1 am flight (and not have to pay for a full extra night!).The hotel is much more comfortable than Alofts in the US. Our room was borderline luxury, with great toiletries and very comfortable beds. The breakfast in the restaurant was the equal of the one we had a the much more expensive Marriott. The upstairs indoors pool is sort of strange, but overall, the facilities are nice, and the hotel is attached to a lovely shopping mall.Also, the hotel was happy to arrange transportation for us to the airport.  When we return to Kathmandu, we will be staying here.

We really enjoyed our stay! I remembered when they were building this hotel four years ago and to see the final result it’s amazing. Especially to have Marriott’s quality service and rooms in Kathmandu is an added value to the city and for the casual traveler who wants to discover a new city with some standard luxuries. The staff was overly helpful and friendly, they went to extra mile to assist. The rooms are perfect for a citytrip and are very comfortable. Definitely recommend it!

Very Special thanks to Kiran (FnB) & Jatin for making this week long family trip and stay at Aloft Thamel Kathmandu worthwhile.Kiran from the restaurant has been very very nice & ensured that breakfast and food served was great & served fresh/hot . He also ensured that the problems we faced during our stay were resolved.My family stayed at this hotel in the 1st week of September 2022. I booked the hotel being a titanium member with Marriott, and with certain expectations from a 5star Marriott property. There are a lot of areas for improvement, specially with the customer service representatives at the front desk and the facilities that the hotel provides itself.Jatin is another special representative at this hotel who actually understands customer service and the value of resolving problems faced by loyal Marriott patrons .

This is a lovely new hotel located in a busy part of Thamel. My room was on the corner of the building so there were large picture windows on two sides, affording a great view over the city, and the blackout blinds were pretty efficient. I have only held off on giving five stars because the soundproofing mentioned in the features is definitely not in evidence. There was loud music coming from some nearby clubs and bars that could be heard from the room.I ate at the hotel one evening and the meal I had was excellent, as was the extensive breakfast buffet. I would definitely recommend this hotel for a comfortable stay, if not a typically Nepalese one - it's part of an international chain but all the (very friendly and helpful) staff seem at least to be locals.

Stayed here for several nights as part of a Gate 1 tour.  Many shops within a 10-15 minute walk from hotel and there is also an adjoining mall.  Staff very helpful and courteous. Rooms large and very nice and new.  Large flat screen TV, refrigerator, iron and ironing board and large walk in shower with rain shower.  Also kettle with complimentary coffee and tea and two one liter bottles of water provided each day.  Also complimentary bathroom amenities - no wash cloth so bring your own if you use one.  Beware the floors in the shower were very slippery so be very careful not to fall. Breakfast buffet was also good. Would definitely recommend this hotel and would stay here again if I ever return to Kathmandu.

I had arranged for a group of 7 friends and their spouses to stay in Aloft Thamel earlier this month while they were here on a holiday. They enjoyed their time in Aloft, liked the food, loved the location, and were quite appreciative of the transfer arrangements. Their flight into Kathmandu was diverted due to bad weather and they were to attend a dinner at our place. When the flight finally came in, more than 5 hours later than the original schedule, Aarya Khanal from the transfer team made sure that they came directly to our place from the airport. And most of my friends would want to stay at Aloft Thamel whenever they are here next.

We spent three nights at The Aloft. Our room was spacious and very nice with a view of the valley and foothills. But the real highlight here is the staff. Every staff member from the outside security to front desk to restaurant to housekeeping was extremely friendly and helpful. They made us feel welcomed. The location of the hotel is good, in Tamel, not far at all from the Secret Garden and maybe a 15 minute walk (on some bustling streets) to the Durban Square. The hotel is also connected to a sort of mall and (don’t scoff), there’s an Indian restaurant in the mall called Malabar that was excellent and inexpensive. There’s also a casino on the underground floor of the mall connected to the hotel — we just ignored it and we didn’t notice any crowds. Again, we were. Wry happy with our stay here and grateful for the top notch staff!

We are frequent visitor at aloft & we enjoyed our lunch buffet at the nook restaurant. the menu was exciting and each one of dishes was unique and delicious. We especially enjoyed the Chinese section which had exemplary dishes and thanks to Mr Shailendr, the Executive chef who served us some wonderful Chinese dishes with extreme politeness and had great suggestions. The fish made by him was outstanding the Chinese food is one of the best ones I've had. The overall service is great and everyone is polite especially thanks to Mr shailendr has smiling faces and are well spoken.we shall return here for sure for more such lovely meals

We celebrated my sister’s birthday at Aloft. I must say we were pleased by the ambience, helpful staff, amazing food and the most of all - the delicious cake that was custom prepared on our prior request.It indeed was a memorable experience.Keep up the good work!

I am so happy to share that my breakfast having  with my friend in kathmandu at ALOFT - I respective service by Rebecca on the way was a great with excellent. It was a politeness. I am very grateful for the experience of her serviced.  I also feel grateful to be able to collaborate and cleanest with restaurants and  sweet Music for the behind ears. Thank you whole management and her team for organising this special place. Keep doing well Thank you once again everyone!🌼😊🙏😘🇳🇵

Loved it here. The best stay in Kathmandu! Location wise, its in the middle of wonderful Thamel and only 10 mins taxi ride away from Swayambunath temple (monkey temple). I stayed in Guest Room with a king bed. It was clean and spacious, has amazing shower (after a long day out, this is bliss). Amazing buffet brekkie too. Great selection and they are slightly varied from day to day. The best part though, is the service. Special shout out to Hom Nath L!! He is super friendly, attentive, helpful, reliable and would go above and beyond to help you with your needs. I had an issue with a parcel that a friend has sent to the hotel, i had to leave and would miss the delivery. I panicked, but Hom offered to speak to both parties and organise a solution which alleviated my stress and anxiety! Hom also helped with negotiating taxi fares as well when organising rides for me. I really appreciated this as a tourist. Definitely stay here on your visit and say hello to Hom! You’ll feel taken care of and can feel at ease on your holiday!

I celebrated my birthday at Nook restaurant by Aloft. This place is great! Atmosphere is chill and cool and the staff here is also really friendly. Incharge Chiranjeevi Paneru and Rebecca Parajuly, they know what they’re doing and what they’re talking about, and you can tell making the customers happy is their main priority. Food is also pretty good, thanks to Chef Chiranjeevi Raishaili. Ms. Melina Pasang was our server and she served the food really well and lastly for their prices it’s 100% worth it.

We spend 4 nights in the Aloft Thamel, Kathmandu during our recent trip to Nepal staying for 2 nights each, in the Savvy Suite and the Breezy Suite. The latter was one of the largest suites that we have ever stayed in. It was huge !!! The facilities of the hotel are modern, very efficient. But all these pale into insignificance when you experience the service and attention that you receive from the entire team at the Aloft. Right from check in, to in room facilities and culminating in the dining experiences at the Nook Restaurant, it was just such a delight. Shepherded expertly by the General Manager, Mr. Vikram Singh, the entire staff at the hotel made you feel special. The Nook restaurant, where we had our breakfast and dinner, was fantastic both in its array and quality of food and the service that the team rendered - the manager, Kiran Moktan, Srijana Twanabasu, Tujan Koju, Prayash Thapalia, Tekraj Shreshta, Karuna Ranjit, Pasang Lhamu, Roshani Shrestha, Saroj, Umesh and many others. Thanks guys for creating such an unforgettable experience for us. May you scale further heights and keep delighting your guests.

Kishoe and Radhika, the house keepers taking care of my hotel room were very friendly and made sure the room is clean and hygienic. The small-talk/conversations with Kishoe brightened my day and made my stay at Aloft more at home. A big pat on their back for a job well done. The service team is great.

I recently visited at Aloft hotel to celebrate new year eve with my friends which was yesterday. I most say that it was an amazing experience. Layout and decorations were beautiful and they had prepared Indian cuisine which is my favorite. Food was so delicious that i still remember it’s aroma and taste. F & B staffs were kind and helpful as they helped us to find a table in the last moment with a courtesy and a sweet smile. Every experience that I encounter there was so great that I can’t even describe it in words. I really recommend everyone to visit Aloft hotel to make best memories and experiences.

Overall the hotel service was great. it was our first stay. i would suggest extra tap for foot and hand shower and room could be bit bigger with extra sofas. These guys are doing great with their work especially Saugat, Pratima, Arjun, Gaurav, Aamush, punam, Shiba, Pushpa, Mamata,Aayush Manandhar, Surya, pabi, ajay,Yagya. Wish everyone good luck and would love to visit again in future.

the room is high quality with nice service and an abundant buffet.I am especially grateful to Roshan Shahi who has cared for us on this journey.The only thing I should advise the manager that is staff training.Cause before I went to have a lunch buffet, I asked three front desk attendants and got different answers about lunch starting time and price.Finally, I still had nice lunch  😋

I checked in 28Dec2019 for a 6 night stay over New Years Eve on a Bonvoypoints stay and was upgraded to a VERY nice Suite Rm. I am a lifetime titanium Rewards member and spend 150+ nights per year in hotels. My 5th trip to Nepal. It was way cool to see a Marriott property in Thamel Kathmandu. Combination of Nepalese kindness and Marriott hospitality created an awesome stay. Wi-Fi was good. Nook Buffer was awesome. Money exchange across the street. Rooftop pool bar view of KTM was great. Hot nice rain head showers are awesome. Plenty of water pressure. Outlets universally flexible and plentiful and convenient. You will be happy to stay at the Aloft Thamel. One complaint - in both rooms (512,622) the shower doors open/swing the wrong way and not able to turn on the shower without getting soaked with cold water.

I could not reccomend the team at this amazing hotel enough! Even during the nightmare of COVID-19 they have been incredible and could not have done enough for to accommodate myself and the other 14 on our trekking group. The food was second to none, every single room! The rooms are spotlessly clean. It is very open and spacious so even during lockdown we were not constricted. Thank you so much for all your team has done, the most friendly and welcoming staff members we have met in the last 4 weeks of being in Nepal! ❤

I have stayed in this hotel many times and the most recent one was on the 9-10 September, i stayed in room 432. I am very pleased with the accommodation and the service given by the hotel staffs. I was greeted by Sumit Gautam upon reaching the hotel via the hotel shuttle services. He is very professional in his work and shows extreme diligence. He is well equipped with vast amount of knowledge in Thamel when asked for directions and informations which i personally felt that he is sincere with his work and display excellent capabilities to grow and excel in his career. His graciousness and sincerity have left me great memories of my trip and would love to come again to the same hotel and be serve by him in the many future trips to Kathmandu. Thank you for bringing me utmost satisfaction during my many trips and accommodations in Aloft Kathmandu Thamel.

I spent 8 nights in the Aloft during the COVID-19 pandemic lockdown, we were transferred to this hotel and it was amazing, after trekking through the Himalayas this was a much-earned treat. The facilities were brilliant and the staff second to none, they were so accommodating and understanding in what was a very difficult and confusing time was. Vikram the General Manager arranged regular health checks for all guests and looked after our welfare. The personal touch you get from this hotel is outstanding!The gym facilities are brilliant and there’s always someone on hand, which is brilliant when you want a workout organising. I stayed at this hotel at reduced resources and it was still 5*, so I would love to experience it when they are running at 100%I have just one regret, I never got to have that cold Everest Beer in the pool overlooking all of Kathmandu, unfortunately the pool was closed due to government regulations, understandable given the circumstances.

Everything is satisfactory except one thing i.e. somehow they have some issue to send a maintenance person in the room to help us with the AC to operate and they also want to operate the AC temperature of your room from their end. The AC setup is complicated. When we woke up in the morning the AC was in heat mode and the weather was getting sunny/hot. We tried to change the mode but nothing was working. The cool mode option was not coming. We (along with 2 kids) were boiling in the room and called 3 tines to the reception in 45 minutes to send a maintenance guy in our room to fix the setup. Nobody came in 45+ minutes and we left the hotel after that for day tour. We came at night, called reception again to srnd a maintenance guy in our room to help us with the AC set-up and again the same offer i.e. whether it's OK if they try first from their end to control the AC temperature from their end !!!!!!! I still don't understand what's the problem to send a maintenance guy in first go?????

Perfectly located with a very good cost-benefit.Our room was impeccable clean. Bed, linens and towels with great quality.  All amenities available. Modern and nice decoration. Although the hotel was very busy, our floor and room were very quiet and we could really rest.Breakfast is served in a very spacious area with quality options for every taste.

At Aloft Kathmandu Thamel, the event management was superb, particularly thanks to the remarkable efforts of Anju Kunwor and Samrat Jung Thapa from the food and beverage team. Their exceptional dedication and professionalism were evident throughout the entire event. From the initial planning stages to the execution on the day, Anju and Samrat went above and beyond to ensure everything ran smoothly. The hotel's location in Thamel was convenient for all guests, and the Sankalan Hall provided a spacious and welcoming atmosphere for our event. The catering overseen by Anju and Samrat was outstanding, offering a delicious variety of dishes that received high praise from attendees. The accommodations were comfortable and well-equipped, adding to the overall positive experience. Thanks to the exceptional service provided by Anju Kunwor and Samrat Jung Thapa, our event at Aloft Kathmandu Thamel was a resounding success, and I highly recommend their services for any event in Kathmandu.

We really enjoyed our stay at Aloft Kathmandu Thamel. Above all, every member of their staff was friendly, respectful, helpful, thoughtful, and professional. This has been the theme all throughout from check in, breakfast, housekeeping, gym, spa, pool, and bar. A few things that stood out - all of which they did without us asking: courtesy call to check in if everything is ok, organizing our toiletries during housekeeping, helping us use the locks on the gym lockers, and replacing a spoon that I accidentally dropped on floor. The whole property was spotless! And everyone was just such a pleasure to interact with. Food is also top notch! 100% recommend this place. I rarely write reviews, but I feel that they deserve one! Shout out to Yangchhen! Thank you to the whole staff. This has been such a phenomenal experience. We hope to be back!

Was in the property in January , perfect location right in the downtown area very well maintained, great service standards. The team was presentable and responsive.The hotel is big with number of dining options the roof top bar is very well designed with breath taking views of the city.

This was my third time staying at Aloft, and as usual, it was an incredible experience! The staff is incredibly kind and attentive, everything is clean and maintained, and the food is great. Tekraj Shresha and Rebecca are wonderful servers who go above and beyond to make sure I have what I need. They work so hard and are always happy and nice when I see them. Tsunami  (and everyone at the front desk) are so helpful and give the best customer service. I had two stomach bugs on my last trip (from eating outside of the hotel) and everyone at Aloft knew I was sick and did everything they could to make me feel better. The manager (host) made me a special dish for my stomach, and everyone kept checking on me. I love this hotel so much and will continue to stay at Aloft. The wonderful staff really make each trip special, comfortable, and extremely enjoyable. Thank you so much to everyone for all you do :)From Lauren Albert

Outstanding service from the airport pickup to the moment I checked out.Rabin and Cryschal on reception gave me a super warm welcome. Rabin took extra special care for me and upgraded my room which was amazing! Facilities are really clean. Bar in the evening had live music and great cocktails. Frozen cold glasses so if you wanted no ice your drink was still super cold. The hotel did everything for me. They booked my Everest flights and rebooked when weather was bad. They helped and negotiated with taxis when needed and gave me local tourist attractions information.The hotel had many little touches from the welcome cookies on arrival to small personal touches and hand written thank you note from staff! They were amazing!!Loved every min of my stay!

we stayed at aloft from 19th june 2023 to 21 june 2023 we really had a good experience staying with this property.location of the property is excellant.the breakfast buffet tasted delicious thanks to all the chefs.Special thanks to the house keeping staff Radhika, Kishore and suzan they provided the services whenever needed and their work was excellant.overall rating to the property 5 on 5 :))wish to visit again

The ALOFT Thamel is a very comfortable hotel located in the centre of Kathmandu adjacent to shopping and restaurants. My room very comfortable and well looked after by Gaurav and Mahilea and rest the housekeeping team. Views from the rooms are exceptional with the city spread out leading to the mountains. The restaurant is good and serves a range of local and international dishes. There is a small (25mx8m)  but usable swimming pool on the 8th floor colocated with a spa and gym.The hotel has a Lobby and a pre-lobby so when you're making arrangements to meet, you need to specify which lobby!

If you're thinking of staying in Kathmandu, then Aloft is the best place you could have. Had recently gone for my Toastmasters International Conference and must say everything was beautifully organized. The management was very polite and humble and catered to even the smallest of our needs. Given all this, the food was delicious and had a rich variety as was expected after such an experience. People like Rebecca and many others were always there to assist us and mind you don't you ever skip their breakfast as it is the most sumptuous one you can have in the morning (they even have a section for people who might be health conscious as well🙂). Even the wifi is top-notch, didn't have to worry about the network even once. You'll go to the reception at 3 AM, they would be there for you.Overall I can say, my experience was amazing there and whenever I might think of going to Nepal once again, Aloft is the go-to place for me. Thank you Aloft Kathmandu for making this trip of mine so memorable and would cherish it forever.

I am writing this review after staying in this hotel for 42 long days. I visited Nepal for an official visit and while staying in this hotel not once did the staff let me feel that I was away from home. The location and amanities of the hotel are very good but what makes the stay even better is the good quality service you recive from the staff. I want to thank all the staff (it's a long list) from F&B (including Chefs), House Keeping, health club, reception and everyone else who have gone out of their way to make sure that my stay in their hotel is very comfortable.Ramita,Rebecca, srijana, Kiran, Saroj B, , karuna, , Saroj L, Melina, Tek Raj, Sabina, pasang, Roshani, Priya, Nikita. Chef Kedar. Sabin, Roshani, Datta Ray, Devendra, Kabita, Samita.Thank you all for all the efforts you have put in to make this a memorable stay in Nepal. I would love to come back to Aloft on my future trips. ☺️🙏

Ordered a chocolate cake today for Father's day all the way from US. Awesome cake, looked amazing and most important, parents said they loved the cake and it was delicious. Would recommend again and will order again from Aloft.

I stayed overnight at Aloft and had a pleasant experience. Had a wonderful stay. The room was clean and staff at the hotel were very receptive and welcoming. The breakfast was great and had multiple options. Rebecca parajuli, one of the host for breakfast was brilliant. As soon as we arrived for breakfast she knew exactly how to look after a guest and she was very helpful in explaining how the breakfast buffet worked. I have had a fair experience of star hotels in Kathmandu and by far Rebecca is one of the staff who I’ve come across is very impressive. If you need a nice hotel with good breakfast and wonderful staff in thamel then Aloft is the one to pick…Sunny

Had an excellent time in the Aloft hotel, a special thanks to General Manager- Mr. Vikram and his amazing team for memorial experience. Food and services are great, will recommend everyone. Employees gives personalised services and go beyond to cater our needs.

This is a cheerful pro-guest property which does not use the word No for any guest request. Staff go out of their way to make you comfortable. Although there are hotels with more stars in Kathmandu, the great location in the heart of Thamel and the staff’s attitude makes it a wonderful place to stay. The secret is the staff and the flexible policies. Compliments to the GM for running a friendly home away from home.

I was been staying since long time here in aloft Kathmandu thamel I had a great experience, specially WXYZ bar team like kamal, Sabina, and sujan,sajan are amazing.  I really like a great hospitality and feel like own home. Also I enjoy good signature cocktails of sujan and kamal. 我在aloft 酒店住了很长一段时间，他们有 很好的wxyz 酒吧团队，特别是Kamal ,Sabina,Sujan ,Sajan ,他们制作了很好的鸡尾酒，他们成为了我很好的朋友，让我有在家的感觉。

I stayed at aloft kathmandu for a week on a business trip. What a wonderful hotel. It has a great location in thamel with lots of restaurants in easy walking distance. The hotel is new and the rooms are very comfortable. I had a corner room 619 which was great. The bed was very comfortable. There was a refrigerator and coffee/tea with hot water heater. The shower was the best with plenty of hot water. Lots of English language channels on TV The staff were so very helpful, calling taxis, giving advice about where to shop and eat. The gym was also excellent with new equipment. Two treadmills, two ellipticals and two stationary bikes. Also a full array of weights. I didn't use the pool but many people with children used it. Gym and pool were indoors. I can't imagine staying anywhere else in Kathmandu. Breakfast was also great. Lots of choice and was included in the price. I highly recommend this hotel.

I stayed in this fabulous hotel during a business trip from 21-24 November 2023. The renovated hotel is located in the Thamel area, surrounded by money exchanges, local restaurants, and souvenir shops. The room had a comfy bed with art-style decoration, providing a good night's sleep after our meetings each day. However, the food options were quite limited, mostly featuring local dishes. What made the stay even more memorable was the assistance of the very kind hotel staff, especially Hom Nath Lamichhane. With his help, we were able to arrange a wonderful trip around the city with a polite driver and a convenient car, visiting Boudhanath, Pashupatinath, and Swayambhunath (Monkey Temple). He provided recommendations throughout the journey, making it an exceptional experience for my friend and me.

We stayed here second time. Very good hotel, clean, good service, breakfast superb, location center of Thamel. All hotel staff very friendly, very helpful. Specially Rebecca when we had our breakfast, she makes us feel like home, very professional, very kind, helpful. Fresh croissants, fresh dosa, large variety of breakfast choices Definitely we will choose this hotel again for our next trip . We highly recommend this hotel everyone

Excellent hotel, in the vivid centre of Thamel. Hotel is very clean, nice rooms e.g. Very suitable for business, if you appreciate comfort, a large, clean room and perfect wifi. If you want to experience 'real' Nepal, better book a guesthouse at a much lower price. This is a large ''international' hotel with fitness, swimming pool e.g. Very friendly and correct staff in all departments, excellent kitchen and buffet (evening and breakfast). I stayed for 18 days (low season, July), so tried all of it. A special shout out to the restaurant staff: Amita, Karuna, Srijana, Roshani and Melina for their services and making me feel at home.

I just completed my fourth trip to Kathmandu, Nepal; a city with which I have fallen in love. On my first trip I stayed at an off-brand hotel that was nice, but that’s exactly how I remember it... nice. On my second and thirds trips I stayed at the Fairfield Kathmandu. This was a better property and it served its purpose, but Fairfields can only rise to a certain level after a while.On my fourth and most recent trip I stayed at the brand new Aloft Kathmandu. This was my first stay at an Aloft and they did not disappoint. The rooms were spacious and clean, all in my party had a good view, and the food was delicious. The proximity to the Thamel district is amazing (just stepsaway) and access to all is at your fingertips. However, what sets this property apart from all of the others where I have stayed is the hospitality.Everyone at the Aloft was so eager to please and genuinely made all in my party feel like family. From their warm greetings each day, to their willingness to go above an beyond, this is what Marriott service should be all about. Specifically, Sonee, Sabina and Karuna in the Nook resturant were superb in their service and conversation: always willing to share about their local culture and sights to see in this amazing city. I’m not sure when my travels will take me to Kathmandu again, but there is no other option for me than the Aloft Kathmandu. You should take my advice and check it out if you have a chance.

I have stayed in Aloft hotel many times and since first stay my experience is getting better and exceeding expectation after every trip just because of the Team working here for making the stay most comfortable and wonderful.  After such long stays all the faces of Team working here is so familiar that everyone looks like a good friend. Everyone here working hard with pure dedication to services to make the stay most memorable even in such hard times of Pandemic. When you return back and the people here talk so nicely and enchanting that it uplifts your mood. The rooms, cleanliness, safety, security, food all is awesome. I would sincerely give my special thanks and appreciation to Mr. Sunami and Mr. Dipesh at reception, Mr. Deepak Chef in Kitchen, Ms. Sony and Ms. Rebecca in the nook, Ms, Radhika from House keeping and all others who always greeted and served with Smiling faces. Wish you all the very best and see you soon The Aloft family. You are doing an amazing work, keep shining.

in my case.... I fully enjoyed my first stay here. I happend to watch the chef to put the plate combined with details and this says enough for me without tasting. This man, loves his job. And you can see and taste it. My compliments. Serving the table, outstanding to my point of view. Polite, timing, I enjoyed. Certainly a place to come back to. (Also because I won a game of pool😁)

Nice people and place. We liked the service provided by Suresh, Roshan and Rajesh. Would recommend this place. I would recommend this place. Check in was quick and easy. Housekeepers were also professional and the phone service is 15 out of 10.

My Parents’ Stay at Aloft Kathmandu 3- 8 February, their Review:1. Smile is most contagious and could be seen in All of the staffs… one of the most courteous employees.2. All the staff were willing to walk the extra mile to make sure that our needs were addressed.. e.g. Chef Deepak and his team ensured our special vegetarian dishes as requested on Tuesday fasting.. Also our thanks to Mr Sabal and Ms Rebecca in this regard..3. Front desk staff Ms Sharmila and restaurant staffs like Mr Sabal and others ensured our breakfast was available even after 10.30 am during our early morning temple visits.4. Housekeeping team of Kishor, Radhika and Chanda were excellent at their craft!These are a few names I could remember and I must say that everyone at Aloft was alike and ever ready to make you feel that you are at your home in Kathmandu which started with the check in through Ms Sharmila. The food was delicious throughout, thanks to all the Chefs and their support staff.Overall a great team at Aloft led by a pro-active management..Only drawback is the absence of a hand showers in the bathroom.

An excellent stay at the Aloft. I would like to pass on a special thanks to my housekeeping team on Floor 5 for room 519 -  Jiten as well as Kishore/ Ayush who have provided excellent service. Also to  all at the front desk team. Please try to sort out your card payment system on new AMEX cards with your bank as cards issued from mid 2022 including AMEX/ Bonvoy  and AMEX/ British Airways are not working on any of your systems including $ machine

The food was fresh and delicious, and the best part was that the chef sent us a dessert they had created that day. We were delighted. My dining experience at Aloft,Katmandu  was truly exceptional. From the moment we entered, the welcoming atmosphere and attentive staff made us feel right at home. Specially    'REBECCA' she was very friendly & helpful too all of my friends. Thanks to Rebecca for make our dinner special.

It was great experience staying in Aloft  hotel in thamel, beautiful 😍 thehotel is  very clean, fantastic staff and great service, Especially house keeper Subin Kc, he is awonderful person, everytime when we entered the room, he created something with towels, what an artist 🎨 👏. Thank you Aloft team for making our stay 🙏 wonderful. We will be back again.

We came to Aloft after climbing Everest. A great, new hotel with good food, rooms and service. The manager was also very helpful regarding anything you needed help with - even flights!- Norwegian adventurer

This is a fantastic hotel located in the heart of Thamel within walking distance to everything in Kathmandu. The amenities and service are too notch and the room had a spectacular view of the city. The nook restaurant food and also room service food were excellent and Chef RoZan made sure we had everything we needed and that the food was 10/10! Highly recommended. Overall a great stay.

I stayed in Aloft Kathmandu during June 2022. Situated in the middle of the Thamel area, the entire city is easily approachable from the Hotel. The hotel itself is located in a commercial complex which has multiple high-end shops, restaurants and even a cinema hall. While staying in this property do roam around in the markets for great finds.The property is extremely clean and very well maintained. The staff is very helpful and friendly.The room was well lit and nicely furnished and offers great views as well.The only point of improvement seems to be the lack of hand-shower in the bathroom.The Hotel is multiple restaurants/cafes/lounges. I enjoyed all my meals in Nook restaurant. They offer a good variety of food and taste was also quite nice.In addition, the hotel has an indoor swimming pool, a spa and a casino. Do enjoy these amenities if you decide to stay there.I thoroughly enjoyed my stay and would love to return sometime.

This hotel is fantastic! The people who work here - front desk, concierge team, restaurant and bar staff, housekeeping - they're all so kind, friendly and professional.  Everyone went out of their way to help me, from getting to places I needed to be to organizing a COVID test for travel reasons. I felt so welcome and at home here.  The rooms are very clean and new.  The pool and gym are great.  The food at the restaurant and the bar was excellent.  It's a great location for exploring Thamel and is close to the airport.  And it's very good value for money.  I would never stay anywhere else in Kathmandu.  I so look forward to returning to this hotel again soon.

Excellent Quality of Services, enjoyed to eat the very good and typical food coocked by Aloft ' s chefs team , pleased to stay in  confortable and High quality of roomsas well.Thanks to all the team for the Excellent welcomingI also had the chance to test a delicious mocktail based on red fruits prepared by Étienne.Great job everyone

Excellent service excellent staff very hard-working Very satisfied with our stay. We recommend all of our friends to stay here at this Also, mentioned the housekeeping staff is so helpful very you know hard-working they come to your request anytime and they’re very good ( aayush.s rosni , Radhika , sujan, riya, dipreshan Punam ) I appreciate their service. 👏🏼👏🏼👏🏼👍👍

Excellent location in the heart of Thamel, popular shopping and entertainment district.  Awesome service from arrival to departure. Very professional staff, helpful, patient and friendly; they go above and beyond to make your stay comfortable.  Rooms are clean with modern furniture and all amenities. Breakfast was tasty and incredibly varied. Cleaning personnel were always eager to help. Special praise for Sajan, Robin and breakfast crew, including Medina, Rajani, Avinaya and Prayash. Give your staff awards!

Overall a good stay. However the kind of price they charged for the airport pickup didn’t justify the service being provided. The car reported late. I had to wait at the airport and look for the driver. The welcome experience at the airport was disaster. The driver should have been waiting with a paging board instead I had to call the hotel to find out the driver and then managed to trace him. This was really sad.

An excellent Hotel where you have a wonderful view over Kathmandu.  The Breakfast offer is fabulous and the Dinner Menu encludes meals from local to international. And all the crew is sooo friendly! Our special thanks to Sujan and his team from the bar. They really made our evenings. Sujan is such a "shaker"!

Extremely well located hotel and an extremely well intentioned staff. They went out of their way to cater to my tantrums, especially Sharmila at the Front office. Staying here is a no brainer. The clean rooms also add to the charm. The only place where I feel they can improve is their service during breakfast, there needs to be a manager on the floor who can direct the resources better as they are hard working, yet a little scattered. Keep it up!

While we were in lockdown in Nepal the management and staff at the Aloft hotel made a tough situation far more bearable. Wonderful rooms, lovely food and while the pool was closed the gym kept us all sane. I would highly recommend staying at this hotel which is ideal for the city centre and close to airport.

Overall, great experience at this hotel. The concierge desk can get almost anything set up and done that you can think of (shout out to Amish, Suresh, Mahish, and Rashan). They set up shuttles for us every day, gave us recommendations for local shops, and helped set up shipping when we over-bought. The Nook was also fantastic, serving a wide range of dishes in the morning and providing quick and easy room service. Being greeted warmly every morning by Medina and Anu made all the difference to our stay. This is also one of the best and well-maintained hotel gyms I have seen in a long time. Very thankful for this game-changing amenity!

This is my sixth time here. I enjoy the polite staff, the great service, the rooms are very comfortable, and the three different size conference rooms we needed were available and worked out perfectly. Thank you to the concierge team Ravi and Bijay! Thank you to Rebekah the manager upstairs.

I stayed in Aloft Kathmandu from 27 Dec 2019 to 3 Jan 2020.It was a really pleasant stay and I have to compliment Room boy Sabim K.C. for doing a good job.The room was immaculate whenever he was rostered for my room/floor.Not just Sabim, several of the Aloft Kathmandu team went above and beyond to make sure I received what I needed.Food, housekeeping, security, front office and overall service was very good.Thank you for this experience.I look forward to staying in Aloft Kathmandu again.

I stayed in Aloft for 3 days and must say that the rooms were neat and clean with amazing hospitality and food. A special mention for Mrs. Radhika Kishore who made sure that our stay was memorable and went over the board with all the decoration for our anniversary as well.I will surely recommend people to visit this beautiful hotel once. You will not be disappointed with the service and the location because this hotel is at the centre of Thamel, close to every tourist attractions. You will find cafés, restaurants, garden of dreams within the walking distance of the property.

Thank you Aloft team for the wonderful time. Food was yummylicious and hospitality was of  impeccable quality. Our special gratitude and best wishes to staff members Kiran, Srijana and Rebecca for your commendable services.

It was awesome! We were able to stay at the Savvy Suite, and the room was absolutely splendid. Extreme key well kept, fantastic views of the beautiful city of Kathmandu and 5-star amenities. The staff and service was extremely prompt and everyone at this hotel was incredibly helpful with whatever we needed and their positive approaches left a wonderful impression. The wide array of food at the restaurants were delicious, and I highly recommend that you come and feast at their breakfast buffet, Nook. Kudos to Mr Vikram Singh and the rest of his team!

Aloft was an extremely comfortable, quiet, and convenient  place to stay in Kathmandu. The entire staff was pleasant and very welcoming. Avishek, Rahim, and absolutely everyone I interacted with during my stay was very kind and helpful, including all the people who work in the front desk/lobby and at the lovely Nook restaurant. I can highly recommend Aloft!

Excellent dinner at. Nook Restaurant. Ms Sony really knows her job, explained and made delicious suggestions for an unforgettable dinner. All the staff around were also ready for assistance, congratulations

We spent two nights while passing through the region. The decision to stay was based on previous reviews.Positives+ Handy location, easy to walk+ The utterly fantastic staff who are quite frankly some of the nicest and most helpful team in hospitality and I compare this to premium five star hotels+ decently sized rooms+ great club room with snacks+ 2 items free on laundry (why don’t more hotels do this)+ Tye utterly fantastic food. I’m generally quite cynical about eating at a hotel but in this case, you would be missing out. It’s not cheap but neither is it expensive relative to western equivalentsNeutral- some burn in on the TVNegative - The awful bathroom design which makes it impossible not to wet the floor. It’s just a poor design Despite the negative , the quality of the people means full marks in my book

I stayed here for four nights. This is lovely hotel and far superior in every way to the Aloft properties in the US. My room was excellent--I didn't want to leave. The hotel is well-staffed and each person I encountered was attentive and responsive. Breakfast is included and you will have more choices that you know what to do with. The made to order omelette was a good choice for me. This was an excellent property and I strongly recommend it.

Situated in the center of the busy Thamel area, the property is walking distance to shops and other attractions.Quiet and peaceful insides of the property contradict the busy streets. The property has the only heated pool in the neighborhood presently, fairly sufficient gym, excellent shower and good rooms.A well spread buffet breakfast and a fairly priced menu. Staff are pleasant, well spoken , welcoming and go the extra mile to comfort the guests, especially Roshni, Mamta and Amush.Highly recommended.

I had been there for morning breakfast..and i had delicious breakfast and i really like masala dosa..i.e made by hem ghale chef and the staff are professional and efficient .breakfast was buffet with many choices.i would like to mention one member of the restaurant that stood out in her friendliness and kindness ....Rebeka , she made me feel welcome and even especial . I would definitely recommend this hotel if you are visiting Kathmandu .

Great service plus the wonderful dinning environment. I enjoyed every meal there. Special Thanks to Umesh, Rebecca, Rajani for the warmest welcoming smiles. And tanks so much to the best chef Bindu always makes me very lovely  and delicious waffles, you guys make my staying at Aloft so beautiful  and full of positive energy to start a busy day.

The location of this hotel is the best, everywhere is walkable in the Thamel area. The hotel is attached to the Chaya Center mall. Room is small but very comfortable. Walls are very thin, I can hear my neighbour. Also I can hear nearby noise from surrounding night clubs. My room shower glass panels wasn’t joined properly and it causes flooding shower. The staff were kind and change room for me.Breakfast is plentiful and tasty, all the kitchen and wait staff are kind and friendly.The concierge services are good, getting a taxi and helping with bags are no problem. Well done Team ALoft !!!

It's a great hotel with spacious rooms right in the center. Everybody was extremely friendly and helpful. "Hom" at the concierge booked several tours for me and everything was well organized. A very unique experience.

"I want to give a huge shoutout to Sanju, the incredible waitress at the restaurant.  She went above and beyond her duty to make my family and me feel welcome and happy. Her exceptional service and warm smile made us feel like royalty!We were so impressed with Sanju's attentiveness and kindness that we ended up eating at the hotel for three consecutive days! She remembered our preferences, made personalized recommendations.Sanju's dedication to her job and passion for making guests happy is truly remarkable for her outstanding service.If you're looking for a exceptional dining experience, look no further than Aloft Kathmandu thamel and ask for Sanju! She'll take care of you like family.

"I had really great stay at this awesome hotel. The location is superb and the rooms are really comfy. I throughly enjoyed setting in outdoor area. Breakfast has a large variety  restaurant  server  sohan who was very attentive always knowing my preferences and serving me at table. I am glad I choose to stay here will definitely stay here again thumbs up.

We stayed in this hotel for 4 days in July. Situated in a convenient and most happening location in Kathmandu. Easy access to souvenir shops local restaurants museums and shopping malls.Staff in this place is very friendly and helpful. Bar near the lobby is a must visit place if you’re staying in this hotel. Sujan and Anil rendered us a very good service by making different types of cocktails. Also at the reception sukitha sylesh n her colleague ( sorry I can’t remember her name)  Were very helpful.Please keep up your good work. All the best Aloft Thamel Kathmandu

The best hotel located in the heart of Thamel… Kathmandu. Very modern and vibrant ambiance. Rooms are spic and span, spacious with mountain view. Staff is extremely courteous and very helpful.  They know exactly how to take care of their guests. Food is delicious with a wide assortment of vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes. I would highly recommend this hotel for those who want to experience an impeccable hospitality.

I have stayed at Aloft Thamel with my wife for 2 nights ( 5th & 6th Sep 23). It was a very pleasent experience for me.  My Room no.was 223 with a very beautiful hill view. Room was very cozy and supper clean. Bed was very comfortable. Lots of food options nearby. Staffs are vey frindly and always greets you with smile specially Suresh was spectacular. Brakfast was good so many live stations, you can see you food is cooking im front of you.I have enjoyed my staying here very much. I will surely come back again.
