It was a great stay in the hotel. My 3 Star is for, I had to wait for the room as the room was not ready. I went to Nook restaurant and inform in the hostess desk that we will seat out side but no one came to my table and I went my self to hostess desk for order and payment. When we went to the room birthday set up was ready but cake was missing and for the cake I had to call twice and wait for the long time which made my day little sad.But Mr. Sunami was very welcoming and when we were comming down the elevator his smile made me happy. Thank you so much for such smile and always keep the same.

Indeed the hotel has a very luxurious stay, rooms are pretty good to have an outside view of the city and all services are very comfortable. The house keeping staff were easily approachable and very friendly. During my staff i was able to interact with Suraj, Radhika, Kishore and Dipesh they all were very supportive. Wish the hotel and these staff good luck!.

Great ambiance and staffs are very much cordial. I mostly like the sate of the art gym facility with fitness trainer Rabi always on his toes to help. Rooms are very comfortable with sufficiant natural lighting and amazing hill views to the north west side. Aloft KTM will be my first preference everytime I am coming Nepal.

The service is pleasant and helpful, really friendly and accommodating staff in the lobby, restaurant, gym, and other places. You get a decent breakfast with multiple options, but some food can be spicy for you if you are not used to it. Order cheese or plain dosa to experience new if you are from Europe or Americas. You must try shrimps on skewers in the Nook restaurant as an afternoon snack to explore a new taste.The hotel is conveniently situated and allows for easy exploration of the district. After walking through the mortars of shops nearby relax in the gym are which offers a sauna. There is a warmed swimming pool on the top floor, but I explored is way too late so I didn’t try it. The room was very much ok for my 1-week stay. They provide enough water every day. Nothing much about the beds, I slept pretty well every night. Special thanks to Dipina in the restaurant.

I have been to Kathmandu a number of times since 1977.  The City and Valley has changed dramatically over that time.  The Aloft was a welcoming and very comfortable way to reacquaint with my Nepal friends and the changing Thamel neighborhood. Everyone on the staff was professional and specifically helpful with my "Reentry".  Kamal in the Lobby/Bar/Lounge was great with a hospitable blend of professional and personal care and attention. Interesting to watch him handle the mix of trekkers, business travelers, and tourists from around the world so easily.      My housekeepers in Room 722 , Gourav and Pushpa always had a great comfortable room to return after long days.    Get up for Breakfast!!! excellent prep and delicious.  Great Variety.  Rebecca and all the servers were always helpful.  The buffet of nepali specials and other varieties tasty.  Front desk staff very knowledgeable about the lay of the land, and the best way to get around.   As an Architect whose firm works for Marriott and many hotels in USA,  I woul d love to relocate the whole staff to NY!   This hotel is a wonderful experience.

Stayed here in April 2024 with family.The location is perfect for Kathmandu. It’s next to Thamel, and also centrally located enough to be close enough to the airport and most tourist sites.Hotel staff are very efficient and friendly…everyone from the reception desk to bellhops to restaurant team.Rooms are decent sized and have comfortable beds. The built-ins like the desk and closet are well thought out and placed. Shower is nice and strong, and especially welcome after a long trek. Lots of power sockets as well.One issue I have with the room is the bathroom is not fully enclosed so the light from that area streams into the room, if one occupant is waking up earlier. It would help to have another power switch for the toilet/shower area. Breakfast at the restaurant was decent…can’t expect more. Staff there are helpful as well. Only one other complaint is that the lobby bar was frightfully expensive…I think we paid 6000NPR for 5 beers. Ouch!!!

In early December I stayed at the Aloft Kathmandu.   I was there for a couple of days after being in the mountains for a little while.   When I arrived, I was sick with a sinus infection and head cold.   I was well taken care of.  Rozan, one of the chefs, cooked me comfort food, like chicken soup and pasta.   It was such personal service.  I was also assisted with great service by Roshani Shrestha.   Thank you for a wonderful stay.  I will stay again and again.

Can not recommend this place highly enough. During the COVID-19 lockdown we were marooned in Kathmandu for a couple of extra weeks after a trip to EBC, we spent the last 8 nights at the Aloft, where they gave us a warm friendly welcome, the staff were absolutely amazing and really took care of us in what were difficult circumstances . The hotel is modern & immaculately looked after with fantastic facilities and panoramic views of Kathmandu. The food was excellent ant the kitchen staff went out there way to keep us happy. The bar Was well stocked with friendly knowledgable staff looking after us. I would like to thank all the staff from management down for Giving us such an enjoyable stay in what are unprecedented times. Stay safe

I'm very happy with the food & beverage, service & support at the Nook restaurant at Aloft hotel. All the members & staffs are very helpful and friendly. I would visit again and recommend all to visit this restaurant ☺️. The food was very delicious and I would like to specially thank to chef Mr Anil Bhandari, chef Pusbnam , Kiran Moktan, Umesh KC, Dinesh  Sahani and beautiful Rebecca Parajuli for making such a delicious food and beautiful service.

I am in a living hell. The noise  in this room is horrific. We stayed here 2 weeks ago prior to a trek and had a quiet, clean room with good meals. Upon returning from our trek we are here again for 3 nights. We were given a room on the other side of the building and not only can we here the thud of music from the nearby club, but there is an event directly below our room creating an unbelievable amount of noise. We can barely hear each other speak, let alone get any sleep. What a ghastly end to our adventure. I  will never use this hotel again.

Clean room, spacious as well. I am regular guest at aloft and enjoy staying at aloft Kathmandu. Their hospitality is top notch. Staff having great attitude towards the guest. Food is delicious. Breakfast is always great because of staffs that make us special. I would like to thank manager Saroj n team members srijana, Annu, rajani, luitel, anis and sabal for their great hospitality.

From the moment we arrived, our experience has been outstanding . The staff all go above and beyond to make our stay memorable . In particular Yamuna Tuladhar and  Aadity maharjan whos attention to detail, professionalism, customer service and hospitality was exceptional. The hotel itself is 5 star, well maintained and of the highest standard . The staff tended to our every need while making us feel at home . We would recommend this hotel to all and we will definitely be back. We appreciate the service !

My stay at Aloft was very pleasant, especially the staff at Nook restaurant are very hospitable and attentive. Anu and Pasang, umesh, Ramire and sirjana provided our entire group with excellent customer service. thank you aloft.Highly recommend to consider your stay here

After exhausting expeditions in Khumbu region we can’t wait to come back to Aloft, where you can finally rest and recharge. Excellent breakfasts, very friendly staff. Special thanks to amazing Chanda, Santosh & Sabin for their perfect service and art. Highly recommended, and see you next year!

Food is very goodItems are tailor made on requestStaff at restaurant are very polite. Ms. Sanju at restaurant is very kind enough to serve tailor made Indian dishes.Comfortable stay. Should include South Indian dish coffee to attract more customers

The moment you step in to the hotel you feel at home due to highly courteous and extremely helpful staff, be it the front desk, housekeeping, restaurant etc. Housekeeping staff leaves you amazing with nice messages. It is so difficult to single out any one, they all are stars who earnestly ensure that stay at the hotel is extremely pleasant and comfortable. Pabi Samita is one of them.Another one at the restaurant is Rebeka who ensured that despite close to kitchen closing hours I could get what I ordered. Thank you.Keep up the good work always.

Lovely atmosphere...vibrant, inviting and cool.Loved the food and the hospitality from Kiran Moktan and Sony Gauchan. The staff is well trained and polished.The see through kitchen is another mark of transparency that speaks volume about their confidence. The ambience truly uplifts your mood and sets the tone for few hours of relaxed gourmet experience.Aloft certainly has a standard f its own and stands tall in its segment.It has an assortment of dishes, ranging from Asian,  Indian to Continental. Look forward to visiting this amazing restaurant again.God bless and Best wishes

I like Aloft Kathmandu because of its great ambience and most importantly the way the wait staff and the rest of Aloft treat us. I would like to mention the name of one bahini, Rebecca Parajuki, who was very friendly and professional.  I was amazed when Rebecca bahini sang a Sabjn Rai song, Guransako fed muni, so beautifully. Kudos to you Rebecca bahini. May you go far in life. My best wishes to Aloft as well as you strive on your journey of giving quality services to us. Thank you.

I am plat elite and stay at Marriotts all over the world. This has to be the best Aloft globally. It feels better than any W I have stayed in as well. The rooms are chic, the breakfast buffet in the restaurant is terrific, the club lounge is nicer than most properties with great hot snacks and extensive wine options including Nepalese as well as food choices.

We have been staying in this property very often & we find the location of the property, rooms , services, food & all most everything top notch. Special mention of Mr Robin, jatin, Nilima, Shewta & Roshan who are extremely helpful. Mr Saroj & Shama of lounge are very focused on customer satisfaction. Over all excellent property & almost every individuals working there are customer focused !

I have stayed here a number of times and the beds are comfortable, showers hot, internet reliable and fast. The hotel is in a central part of Kathmandu that is within walking distance of most tourist attractions and business districts (imo). Breakfast buffet is worth the premium. Plus the staff have great towel origami skills - special shout out to Roshni & Guarav for creativity here!

The hotel is very new and staff were friendly. Tried their morning buffet breakfast and they have chinese food. Very international choices. I also tried their ala cart dinner, ordered their chicken briyani rice. It was delicious! As i did my research that i could change money in the lobby and their rate was good.Their room was spacious with all the amenities of shampoo and soap dispenser inside the bathroom. Their hair dryer is good quality and nice to use. Only that their electricity will trip a few times, and recovered within minutes.

I had a very comfortable room with a view over the city and an excellent hot shower. The breakfast buffet was varied and plentiful. Hom Nath Lamichhane at reception was able to organise a private car to my accomodation in Chitwan and return which was most appreciated.

Location: Aloft is located in Thamel, easily accessible by car, walking distance from everything, last minute shopping before a trek, restaurants around. Bazaar not too far, Tibetan bookstore around the corner. There are nicer hotels but not in the heart of Thamel Service: I stayed in this hotel since it’s opening in 2019, not only compared to other Aloft hotels where there is not service, but with hotels in Kathmandu, the service is exceptional. And so surprisingly, when we got at the reception for checking, Sunami recognized me after 3 years. The staff changed a lot but the service is there and people are so kind.The rooms are nice and clean, I like the view on Swayambhu. I rather not have the ones on courtyard. And I don’t like the shower head, when you turn on the water you get shocked by cold water.Their breakfast buffet is clean, good and a lot of choices. It is the most important meal for me in Nepal. Because during the day, if I can’t find an adequate place I rather not eat than fall sick.

10 days business trip in Kathmandu, hotel staying experience fantastic. Aloft locates in center of Thamel where has a good access to all kinds of food and surveillance.House keeping team Radhika and Riya Kabita and Ayush M gave good service.

Originally I stayed at this hotel for a work trip and liked it so much I went back with my family for a Kathmandu holiday. I am about to head off there again and will be most certainly staying at the Aloft. The hotel is perfectly located on the edge of Thamel for daytime shopping and night time dining. The hotel has excellent facilities and the rooms were clean and comfortable however it was the staff that made these stays so enjoyable. From the welcoming staff that greeted us at the airport, to the helpful reception staff, the friendly and entertaining bar and restaurant staff.  All the staff we encountered were helpful, friendly and did everything to make our stay perfect. A special thanks to Suraj and Vimesh in the restaurant who quickly knew our preferences for dining, to Anil, Kamal, Sujan and Sabina behind the bar who entertained us each night with their bar expertise and knowledge of all things Nepal. And finally Geshu, Simran, Shweta and Sunita on the front desk who helped with organising tours, sight seeing and all our admin needs.

Lovely place. Right in the heart of Tamel So you can walk the bustling narrow chaotic motor bike ridden uneven streets straight from your door Pack a mask. Air polluted and very smoggy Lovely food Nice indoor pool with lovely views over the city. Fab at night Hot tub and sauna on bottom floor next to gym.  Pool on top floor. Can’t be outdoors. Air too polluted Great room. Like any good quality city hotel room

The room temperature control was (16C) freezing in winter. I tried changing the temperature, but the thermostat control was locked and could not be changed. When I informed the staff at the reception and maintenance, I was told all rooms were centralised. How ridiculous is that? After I complained, the temperature was 32C.  Any request to the guest relations placed always requires a reminder call twice minimum.

We stayed for two nights for a family visit. I had mixed feelings for the hotel. The rooms were decent. Most of the staff were good and professional, especially Anwesh from Nook and Saroj from the club lounge were very professional. For the price, it was decent. Recommendations would be that Managers should lead by example. Don't judge people too quickly. We were greeted somewhat unprofessionally by the Nook Manager. Her attitude and demeanor weren't that professional. I think that's why some staff behaved that way. I brought it to their attention, and it was fixed later, but being professional means not judging people right away. Also, rooms do need some updates. In one of the rooms we stayed in, the shower was leaking through the rest of the bathroom floor. Overall, not a bad stay. Good location. Family friendly. Good pool and spa.

Hotel located in good location and linked to a shopping mall so you can have other food options. Although Resturant are also limited in the mall. Room is acceptable with good size working desk and bed. However some part of the room seems worn and may need some “refreshment”.Hot water is good and powerful.

Awesome place to stay with family. Also, the food taste is very good and 100% Indian feel.Special recommendation for Ravi, Suredh, Bijay and Anish (Restaurant).I would recommend thst if you visit Kathmandu, do stay at Aloft as it also on the most happening street of Nepal which is Thamel, Kathmandu

My stay was a great experience. Hotel staff was really helpful and nice, especially Front Office team, Yangchhe, Muskan, Amy, Sunita, Barsha. When you headed out check taxi prices, directions, and other information with concierge, they’re also helpful to better manage your tours. Highly recommended.

An excellent hotel and restaurant! Delicious meals of any origine, be it western or local dishes. A perfect service by the staff. All members of the team were always of assistance and help when needed and particularly Ms. Rebecca, the R&B Supervisor. Many thanks to all!

We were there from the 7th Sept until the 10th Sept so a short stay however during our stay from the moment we stepped into the hotel we could feel ourselves at home. The warmth of the customer service and the quality of service offered were par excellent. We look forward to come back to this new home of our in Nepal. I congratulate the management for creating and offering this ambiance and hope this will only peak over time. Thanks and Regards, G S Kumar

The location is nice but challenge with the staff and services. To talk about positive staff is the Concierge team which is very good [Suresh, Nikhil and Roshan]The front office team has lot of staff and talk nicely but I suppose they don't take proper action and everybody don't follow same protocol.Worst is the restaurant service and staff over here need to understand hospitality and to service clients. They are not busy but movi g everywhere without paying attention to clients. They don't come and ask you about services and neither pay any attention. I should say one of the most horrible services and staff which any property of Marriott can have from all the properties of their which I have visited.I would recommend if location is not a problem then try properties like Dusit Princess or Radisson or Yak and Yeti (recently renovated)

Stayed a week. Very helpful staff, Bijay, Rosihman, Rismav. Very friendly English service to Chinese. Keep up the good work. The restaurant menu had essentials and made my travel in Kathmandu easier. Brought my own vegan milks, recommend other guests with dietary restrictions to well prepare for yourself. Gym was nice with good sauna and steam room. Good luck~

Aloft by Marriott in Kathmandu exceeded my expectations in every aspect. A heartfelt thank you to Chef Suraj for creating a delightful birthday cake on January 1, 2024 – it added a special touch to the celebration. Equally commendable is the exceptional service from Chef Saroj and Prayag, who graciously accommodated a very late breakfast on January 2nd. The overall experience was elevated by the attentive and friendly staff, making it a delightful stay. I highly recommend Aloft for its outstanding service and culinary excellence.

The big corner suite was very spacious and comfortable.  Best bed and linens I’d had in two weeks of traveling.  The Aloft brand is not known as a 5 star luxury chain, but the service at this hotel was as good as I’ve ever had.  The workers were young, enthusiastic, smart and anticipated every need.  A special shout out to Sumit. Ravi and Dawa Loma!

Great modern hotel with very friendly staff. Everything was excellent (as usual from Marriott bonvoy). Especially to name is the concierge (Hom) who out in great effort to accommodate our wishes (eg car rental) ! In addition the security man at the entrance (forgot the name sorry) and the receptionists were amazing! Overall great experience and happy to come back!

We had our 25th Anniversary hosted in Aloft on 19 oct 2023. From the start,the Aloft team professionally arranged everything from food, events and room for us, so our event would go smoothly. We are very grateful to Ms.Samriddhiji for taking the lead.food was awesome and the venue arrangements were perfectly set. It was great experience. One of the most memorable days of our lives.thank you.

Embark on a gastronomic journey at the Aloft buffet, where a sumptuous spread awaits to tantalize your taste buds. Indulge in a plethora of mouthwatering options, from fluffy pancakes and golden waffles to freshly baked pastries and artisanal breads. Savor the savory delights of crispy bacon, perfectly scrambled eggs, and an array of breakfast meats, all expertly prepared to perfection. Complemented by a selection of refreshing juices and aromatic coffees, the breakfast experience at Aloft promises to be a delightful culinary adventure you won't soon forget.

Rajiv Shrestha, Chef made excellent grilled salmon+ exotic masala dosa as always. Great food.Rebecca Parajuli ever energetic  supervisor and other team members, including Ramita Magar and Srijana Twanabasu exceeded expectations in all aspects.👍 Special appreciation for Rebecca for her professional articulation and prompt response all the time.

My personal thought that we felt while having our program at Aloft Hotel was worthwhile. The concierges were really helpful and active.Thanks to Mr.  Abhinav and his entire team Mr.Anwesh, Mr.Parash, and Ms. Sandhya.The food was delicious and had many options from veg to non-veg, salad to desserts and everything. Our gratitude towards Chef Kedar. Thank you for your hospitality.

We had an amazing dining experience at Nook, Bal krishna and Ramita were so hospitable and courteous. Special thanks to chef Anil and Gaurav for the delicious food. Don’t really remember the name but the bartender at WXYZ was so great on customer engagement. Thank you team Aloft for the wonderful experience.

We had organiz cocktail dinner at this hotel. The banquet staffs we very helpful, the service provided was upto the mark. Very efficient and qualified staffs. The appetizers and dinner was very tasty and mouthwatering!! Enjoyed the hospitality, food and venue! Would always love to come to you guys for all events. Keep it up, Cheers!!

I went to have lunch with my family it's called nook restaurant. We had a different cuisine.it was delicious. Our table server was umesh he was very attentive friendly also miss anju and kudos to her team members rajani,medina,Melina and Amita. Chef's Bindu,Saroj,bikash and kedar.they made delicious food which we love and we'll visit again and will recommend my friends to go there also

Had a pleasant stay at aloft for 3 weeks. Very helpful staff on every floor. From the concierge to the lobby to the hotel restaurant. Almost every staff would greet you by name. I was very well taken care of throughout my stay here. Special thanks to Mr. Saroj from the concierge who contacted me regularly to check if I'm having a pleasant day. Thank you for making me feel at home. Hotel is clean and well kept. Wifi speed is fast, for those who are looking to work from the hotel room. Food was fantastic with a mixture of local and European/American delights. You can also get a good view of Kathmandu city from the sky lounge. Truly fantastic. Would love to come back soon to this beautiful city.

Just went on a short trip to Kathmandu and the experience at Aloft was awesome. Would like to thank Mr Roshan P Biyay, Mr Roshan S and Mr Manik for the hospitality. Not only were they very attentive to my needs, they were also very helpful and friendly. Thank you for the excellent service!

From the beginning, the interaction with Ron sir was good, he felt us feel comfortable out there. The hospitality over Nook was very good, also the buffet was awesome. Good place N environment 😍🥰... Love to visit next time again.

I visited with my friend the hotel has nice place the service for the kitchen it was amazing specific chicken biryani and butter chicken masala .specialty Sirzana I like her service she’s a friendly and kindly . When I back to Nepal  I will come back again .

We had an amazing time at Aloft Kathmandu. Overall service from all departments were excellent. The staff were very attentive and polite. The unfortunate was there is no small playground and the pool depth suitable only for adults and there was no swim safety ring available at the pool, we were trying to search the safety ring by walking around the Thamel streets even at the mall connected to the hotel but no luck. We stayed for 5 nights and our 4 yo daughter couldn’t enjoy the pool. Other than that we loved our stays coz of the kindness of the staff. We would like to stay thank you for the Housekeeping& Nook team who’s always look after us during our stays at the hotel. Special thank you to Arjun Tamang& Saugat Bajracharya from the Housekeeping and also Medina from Nook restaurant for helping me with the birthday preparations for my husband’s birthday! Well done guys!

Very professional staff with a warm welcome. Room was well cared for by Pratima and Aamush, and I was welcomed by name each morning at breakfast. Great location in the atmospheric Thamel district with lots of narrow streets, small shops and lively crowds. Lots of good restaurant options nearby, but the hotel dining is excellent also.

I really enjoy my stay at this hotel, the staff are helpful and welcoming, great breakfast range and very comfortable. Not just that, Gaurav and Aditi really made my days, I figuratively smile when I came to my room after long days at work, there is always cute towel art waiting for me (see photos). Simple gestures that made me want to stay at this hotel whenever I came to KTM. Well done, thank you!

Aloft Kathmandu is the only place where you can get best deals in Thane, Centrally located best property in Thamel, just few minute away from the tourist center. Most of my clients accommodate here. All of my clients are very happy with their services and meals. Friendly staffs. Delicious food.

Best location at the middle of the busy thamel. Accessible to anything and anywhere! The bar area is hip and fun, you can use the billiards or have pre-drinks before exploring the city at night at arms reach. The service and facilities are 5 star! Well done to the team - notably Kiran, Rebecca! I will be back on next trip to Nepal!

One of the best hotel experiences I have ever had , all the staff worked so hard to make sure everyone was happy . Nothing is too much trouble from the waiters to reception to laundry. The rooms was spotless and to a very high standard .I could not fault the hotel or staff in anyways, and on my next trip back to Nepal I will be booking in there without any doubt.

One of the best hotel in Kathmandu solely because of the location. If you want to enjoy the nightlife and not to worry about the hassle of commuting, this is the hotel. The iconic market of Thamel at walking distance, you could not ask for more. The overall hospitality is good, comfort of having a shopping mall inside the hotel is added bonus. The hotel food in itself is average with breakfast options (below average honestly-but not complaining).

The hotel is located at the heart of the tourist area and ease access to the shopping centers and local market. The hotel is clean and staffs were wonderful from the start to the end of my stay. The rooms were spacious with loft rooms and good internet connection. Some of the hk associates did great work during my stay at Aloft. Those were Aayush Shakya, Pushpa, Aamush, Sabin, Gaurav,Mamata, sakuna, Shiba, Punam. Good luck to everyone.

A very fun and a joyful new year event with buffet dinner for new year 2021. Enjoyed fully. Good music, verity of 5 star food and top service. Would like to thanks miss Rmita M. She made sure the glasses were filled and plates had tasty foods. With some hidden food platters. Happy with service.Would recommend highly.

We went to have Saturday lunch at Nook Restaurant. Mr Manager, Saroj BISTA had arranged us buffet  which was ultimate. His team was awesome, special request steak was perfectly cooked by Hem chef. Thumps up to the team. Had wonderful time at Aloft. Thank You once again.

There is aloft nook restaurant, we found Nepali manager Kiran  at dinner he make us satisfied for food and behaviour. At breakfast Also Bist bro and waiter Rebecca make us fully satisfied at food in nook restaurant. Test Also delicious. Environment was so Nice .we love it 😋🥰ABDUL RAHMAN (BRUNEI) and faimily

What a great hotel! enjoyed eve with lots of joys.Had nice sleep, food was delicious. 2023 morning was awesome. Awesome hospitality, nice and friendly staff.. especially foods, Indian food are so delicious, would like to thank Mr, Chef Anil Bhandari for his great food and good hospitality at nook restaurant..Will surely visit again..Thank you chef Anil and all the aloft team.

Ordered a cake for father's day and was very happy with the service provided. Very helpful staff and the cake was delivered on time. Cake was fresh and very well received. I would definitely recommend them and will be using their service again in near future.

A wonderful breakfast spread at The nook. Very well laid out. Catering to the taste of tourists from all over the world. Rebecca was at our service and she served us very caringly with a sweet smile.The rooms are also very comfortable.     We will visit again

A very good, clean and quality hotel. Visited and stayed there prior and after our Everes Base Camp trek. A very comfortable place to stay, spacious rooms with all amenities, staff very helpful and welcoming and accommodated all of our needs.

We had a group dinner at the restaurant in Aloft Thamel, Kathmandu. The restaurant is very nice and clean, and the food served was both hygienic and tasty. I was in Kathmandu for work and was not disappointed.  I had access to the lounge where  Sunita, Amita, Nikesh and Ruby were very polite and did an excellent job making me feel at home. I came for Axis program such a wonderful day and there was a guy Aashish from f n b service who fixed the technical issues and great service from all the f n b service team. Thanks samrat, Dipesh and thanks many to Aashish. Enjoyed a lots nea by chaya Devi complex within tourist hub areas.

Hotel was on great location with great vibes,had to be one  of the great hotel. The swimming pool on top had great view of dharara.the staff were really professional. Like to thank samrat from service and not to forget sabita from housekeeping who really maintain cleanliness in event.

I stayed in Aloft Thamel for a business trip and found the hotel to be comfortable  amidst the hustle and bustle of Thamel. There is a small mall in the complex but many shops are closed .If you want to hang out late at Thamel then this is a good choice .Overall, a good property

The hospitality at this hotel is outstanding! Our housekeeper Radhika Pramish is the sweetest! She  took such care in our room! Her special touches everyday made us feel at home!! I would come back here without hesitation!!

Everything was wonderful from the check in experience, to the food in the onsite restaurant, to the room, to the great room service from Mr. Sunami. The pool and gym on the top floor were beautiful. I'd definitely visit again.

Worth Staying as it’s location is very central. A combination of modern hotel in an older developed part of Kathmandu. The food at the only restaurant is very very good. The food charges are very reasonable. One must stay at least once during their travel to Kathmandu.

After 27 years of staying in Marriotts all over the world, this is the best (considering price, quality, location, and food).  It was the hospitality/staff that really took us by surprise. FIRST time this has happened in Nepal (and we live here).  The general manager, Vikram, repeatedly checked to see if all was well with us and with the other guests. This was a holiday week and surely staff was short but Vikram and team went above and beyond to make sure the guests were happy.  We also enjoyed Anil at the lobby bar taking the time to talk to us about his village.  He is a very pleasant and ambitious young man who is making a way for himself and his family. The facilities are way above what one should expect at Aloft (as opposed to a JW or higher level Marriott). The infinity pool, the pool table, and the views were great.  A new mall with a movie theater is attached.  And the hotel is next to Thamel, the live music and tourist area for Kathmandu.  This hotel is worlds ahead of the Fairfield, a nearby Marriott property. Usually I like to comment on an area for improvement but we (5 people (2 kids) in 2 rooms) couldn't think of anything.  The rooms are a good size, well planned, and very comfortable.  Great place for families; great place for couples.  Food at breakfast was terrific.  The expanded lobby area is great for games and playing pool.  A new rooftop bar is under construction.  We can't wait to return to this hotel for another "staycation!"

I booked a stay at this hotel, instead of the cheaper Fairfield by Marriott that was nearby, only because of the great reviews praising the hotel. This is just a standard Aloft hotel but priced at the levels of a Westin or Sheraton for this region. IF you keep your expectations moderate you might enjoy a stay here.LOCATION: The biggest plus point (or minus point, depending on the way you look at it!) is the location - right in the heart of happening(and chaotic!) Thamel district. Close to tons of bars, cafes, and restaurants.DINE + DRINK: The lobby-level Bar is quite cool. The rooftop bar was closed during our stay. The breakfast was a wonderful affair thanks to Chef Prakas and Chef Suraj who whipped up an excellent selection of local dishes specially for us!ROOM: We stayed in Room 622, Which was a Suite room, so this review is based on that; VIEW: Super random view of the random side of the city. The lack of windows in the living room almost made it claustrophobic; SIZE: Spacious enough for 2 adults and came with a separate living room(Windowless!!) and a bedroom; AIR-CON: Perfectly functioning cooler that helped in setting the perfect room temperature; BED: Comfortable bed that played the expected part of putting me to sleep; BATHROOM: Stand-in shower; TOILETRIES: Good spa quality cosmeticsFACILITIES: Very good Gym with a good range of weights and Cardio machines. They also have an indoor swimming pool and spa on site.SERVICE: Friendly staff that took care of all our needs with a smile and made us feel pampered and well taken care of. Special Shout out to SURAJ at front desk and KIRAN the F & B ManagerHOW WIRED YOU WILL BE: Free high-speed Wi-Fi that works well all over the property. Big Plasma TV screen dishing out a wide variety of channels spanning sports, news, music, movies, and  entertainment in multiple languages

I recently spent a few days at Aloft in Kathmandu and enjoyed my stay.I had arranged an airport pick - up but the flight arrived a few hours late. I was concerned that the transfer would have left, however they were still waiting for me which I appreciated. During the ride to the hotel, I was given information regarding sites that I wanted to visit, and soon arrived at the hotel.Check - in was fast and efficient and when I entered my room, I was very pleasantly surprised with the panoramic views of the distant mountains, through the floor - to -  ceiling windows on two sides.I enjoyed the indoor pool on the 8th floor, not feeling like using the gym, I could have a nice relaxing swim instead. I did not have enough time to try the massage at the spa, however that will be on my list next time.I had a walk around town and returned to the hotel a little late for dinner. Rebecca greeted me with a smile and seated me, and when I explained that I had some stomach issues she patiently went through the items on the menu, one by one to ensure I didn't upset my stomach any further.I had wanted to try some local food, but we decided to be a little cautious and went with just the momos and pasta. Rebecca explained to the chefs that I was trying to avoid anything spicy, and Anikesh took care to ensure the momos and dipping sauce were just right for me. For the pasta, Rozan managed to make me feel like I was sitting in an Italian restaurant, and I was relieved that the dinner helped soothe my stomach. I thanked Rebecca for her extra attention, and during our conversation found out that she is the F&B supervisor. I made a point of returning the next night, knowing that I would be in good hands again.Breakfast is served buffet style, with an assortment of local and international foods. There was a decent crowd for breakfast, but never seemed too busy. Omelettes are made to order, instead of waiting, Anu and the breakfast team will bring the omelette to your table when it is ready. I was in a rush to catch my ride on my last day and since I missed breakfast, Anu offered to get me a breakfast box to take with me.The hotel is centrally located in Thamel, and was hosting various teams who were on their way to the mountains. I will be returning to Kathmandu in a few days, and plan to visit Aloft again.

The interior is very modern, and the room comfortable, although there were a couple of snagging issues, which will doubtless be sorted out in due course; the fuse blew when I used one of the sockets, which turned out to have been wrongly wired, and taking a shower flooded the adjacent toilet floor. That said, the bed was palatial and very comfortable. The views from our upper storey window were excellent. We tried to visit the Skye lounge, but found it still under construction. The pool next to it looked wonderful though. Our flight early the next morning was too early for us to assess breakfast.It is very well located in Thamel, and the local shops and restaurants are yards from the door.

I had to move from my once favorite Thamel Hotel and chose this one upon recommendation. Perfect experience! Great rooms, perfect internet, nice swimming pool. Staff very helpful paying attention to details! Good breakfast buffet. Little example: trying to handle a filled cup of coffee and other stuff causes the staff racing for you to take the cup to your table!

From the perfect picturesque view from the rooms to the fabulously courteous staff ,there is no way this hotel doesn't deserve a 5 star. Not to forget, Lokesh, Badri and Susan have been the cherry to the cake in making our trip a success, I wish I could remember the name of everyone who were in contact with us but sadly I dont!!but..everyone was amazing! I would definitely come back with more time!A must visit is highly recommended if travelling to Kathmandu.

Came to aloft through recommendations and the experience here was amazing. We had a family dinner at nook and the people there were lovely. Good food, great place and the best in hospitality. Definitely dropping by soon to try everything this place has to offer.

I generally stay at Hyatt but gave this hotel a try because it's new and I.heard is good location. Very bad entry approach and not 5 star, cannot call it 5 star, they are cheating. If this is 5 star Hyatt is 7' star, Very low standard And lair to call it 5 star luxury.

this hotel best in thamel we did not wish such good hotel and services inside the buidling and everyone take very good care of my family \look forward to come bak again good room interonnet and twin bed also

We stayed here for a few weeks and are Titanium members for SPG , the staff were most amazing and took care of us very well. A memorable experience and every detail was taken care of , a brand new property and couple of small things hopefully get added by our next trip

Aloft Kathmandu offers an indulging F&B options... Had a terrific dinner with a bunch of expat friends at Nook that offered GREAT FOOD and kinda relaxing ambience.. and yes the menu is indeed extensive--we loved it! initially was not pretty happy with one of the service staff at Nook (even local guests are guests, we pay for the service!!) but the delicious Aloft gastronomy overshadowed it. Pretty much touched with the humbleness of one your talent Laxmi Basyal who was professionally attentive and friendly. Give her a kudos! All in all, a perfect destination in K-town!! Looking forward to more gastronomic engagements in the future. And yes, one should not miss the city view from the 14th floor- it is just breathtaking! Thank you Prithivi Pande ji for coming up with such a lofty property! A very very enjoyable experience!

I don’t know where to start with this review. It is rare that I am overwhelmed by the hospitality a hotel provides but Aloft Kathmandu Thamel has gone above and beyond. I travel a lot for business so I am pretty well-versed in how anonymous and procedural a hotel stay can be, especially for a chain. Not here. First of all you would never know that the hotel has only been open for two and a half weeks. There are a few punch list items that are being worked on but nothing that will affect your stay. The rooms are spotless, the views are fantastic and the staff is incredible. Second of all, the service is so good that we changed our plans to come back to Thamel and stayed here for our final night in Nepal. The GM is extremely approachable and provided us with amenities that may not even be offered to Platinum members (which I am definitely not). If you want a hotel that is in the middle of everything but also removes you from the hustle and bustle, this is the place. I wish that every hotel made me feel this welcome. Without a doubt in my mind, I would stay here again.

Had an excellent 4 course lunch consisting of salad, excellent mushroom soup, sautéed salmon with vegetables n a sweet an excellent coffee to boot. Pretty impressed with the quality of food, presentation and staff. Hear a roof top tapas restaurant will open soon, can’t wait to try this out.

Wow! Flawless service from the first minute of our arrival till departure. We enjoyed beyond our expectation. Can't wright more. They are just great!I really appreciate to Lokesh and Deepti for their genuine hospitality who made sure that we are comfortably accommodated. And kept asking if we need any more assistance. There is also a gentleman called Rabi who helped us with our luggage. What an amazing job he did, Supperb!We met Ramita and Roshani at Nook restaurant. Huge varieties of choices and delicious food too. Ramita, I really want say a big thank to her. She is very attentive, prompt responsive and enthusiastic person. She is a star! I would not forget one more person who serviced our room and She is Pratima. Honestly, Her personalised and keenly focused service impressed me lot. Great Job! Keep it up Pratima.There is an officer at the entrance (Can't recall his name) who gives an honorable salute while you go in and out. Salute him!Sunami and Bibek also assisted us thanks guys.The Hotel Location is very convenient, most of the Malls are nearby infact one is just inter connected. Close to airport. Walking distance to King Palace museum, good restaurants and street markets too. We will definitely stay again at Aloft whenever we visit Kathmandu.

Situated in the city center, it's close to many of the tourist attractions. However, I was there for the Duke of Edinburgh International Awards. And the interiors, the cleanliness, the amazing food and the helpfulness of the staffs is what really caught my heart. I really liked how mirrors have been placed as decorations in the hallway and the hall. And the chandeliers with golden paint on the ceiling really enhanced the look of the hall.  The interior decoration is just amazing. Also, another thing I really liked was the outdoor bar. The food too was great! I really liked how there were so many items to choose from and every item was made with equal delicacy. Everything was great! But there's one thing I would like to let the team know of that was bothering me a little, and that is the temperature in the hall was quite low, but I think that's something that can be improved and ignored after looking at all the amazing services they provided. I am really impressed by this new place in town and I am definitely going back. Also, I was looking for a place for my wedding reception, I am definitely considering the place!

it was my short one day visit for Duke of Edinburgh's International Award, Nepal 's second edition of the Adult Volunteer Conference 2019 .Love the hospitality, staff was so nice and gentle, of course i love the food. I would certainly visit more.

I had a fabulous weekend at this brand new property situated right in the heart of Kathmandu. The bed was super comfortable and had the most spectacular views of the city. The hotel staff went above and beyond to make my stay flawless. The breakfast spread was quite elaborate and scrumptious. I absolutely loved their minimal interiors with a pop of color. All in all, My stay at Aloft was a memorable one. Thank you for a brilliant stay!

Aloft is the best place in the Kathmandu valley to organise any kind of business conferences, seminars and more. The hospitality is the best part of it. All staffs are friendly and very helpful. The food served here are incredibly tasty and healthy. 🙂😊

I recently visited this place to attend the conference and found extremely stunning.This hotel is located at the heart of the Kathmandu City where you can have easy access to the cultural heritage of the Kathmandu Valley. Hotel has great food to taste along with clean, friendly staff and beautifully decorated alley of the rooms with flowers.Highly Recommended.

I had this opportunity to attend a conference of The Duke of Edinburgh's International Award Nepal at Aloft Kathmandu.I must commend on the professionalism of the staffs of the hotel. I had a lovely time thanks to good food, excellent service and hospitable ambience. Looking forward to visit Aloft Kathmandu in the near future.

Amaziingggg interiors, food and service. Great hall for conferences at the heart of Kathmandu.Right next to it, is one of the newest malls in the city which lots of local shops that sells local products, movie hall and the hub for all the party-goers.Visited here for a conference and I was very impressed with the place.

I have just stayed at the very recently opened Aloft Hotel. It is well positioned to walk around the district of Thamel - the Garden of Dreams, for example, is within  easy walking distance. The rooms are very comfortable. The service is excellent. Nirmal could not do enough to ensure that I had a good breakfast every morning. I was there for business and we were one of the first to use the conference facilities which were very good. The staff responded positively to all our requests and we had an excellent workshop.

I visited Nepal for the first time  and couldn’t have asked for a better stay. Will surely be coming back to aloft on my next travel to Nepal. The property is new and staff is very helpful !  Made my stay blissful

Fantastic hotel. All new and where everything works wonderfully. It is located in the Thamel area, so everything is close. Hotel staff super friendly and very helpful. Excellent reception. Clean and spacious rooms.The breakfast is fabulous.... There is everything with chefs who cook for you.The gym is open 24 hours a day and the lounge on the H floor is excellent.On floor H there is also the indoor swimming poolIn short, a new hotel (it opened in 2019) where everything works perfectly.

The hotel is located right in the middle of the city and is therefore ideally located for all the attractions in Kathmandu.Delicious breakfast buffet with a wide selection, a club lounge for status members right next to the pool on the top floor and really nice rooms.When checking in, there was a suite upgrade for platinum status and breakfast was included.Very friendly people in the lounge, reception and concierge team.We had a very nice stay

All the hotel staff are friendly.There is a casino in the basement of the hotel. The minimum bet for baccarat is 1,000 rupees.For breakfast in the club lounge, they will make you an omelette, but the selection is very limited, just bread and yogurt.The breakfast on the lobby floor has a wider selection, but overall it wasn't very tasty.There is an outdoor space next to the breakfast restaurant where you can smoke. There is also a smoking area on the club lounge floor.The room only has a fixed shower.There is space to spread out your suitcase.The toilet flushes well, so there was no clogging.The location is convenient, and I think this is a recommended hotel in Kathmandu.

Centrally located hotel / clean / very friendly and helpful staff. I was particularly welcomed at reception by Robin and the other team members. As a woman traveling alone, everything was explained to me. I felt good and safe at all times.The breakfast consists of a large buffet (Asian and European). I can recommend this hotel to everyone.

Very good stay at Aloft Kathmandu. Hotel located in the tourist district of Thamel so easy to go out to dinner or do your last shopping trip on foot. Spacious, comfortable and bis rooms. Soundproofed. Thank you to the entire Aloft team for their welcome

Extremely good hotel and restaurant. Food, very good! Great service. In addition to the rooms.The services of chiranjivi anish and good made by chef deepak, everything is very good! This food is not easy in Nepal, so I highly recommend it! They are to be congratulated!

Luxury hotel near Thamel. Excellent rooms with air conditioning, wonderful large beds and a super nice shower.A bit pricey. Drinks in the restaurant very expensive.Staff were friendly and attentive. Breakfast buffet very good.Hygiene was top notch.

Thanks to Aloft Kathmandu Thamel for making our stay very pleasant before and after our Everest Base camp Trek with Life Himalaya Trekking. The hotel and the room were very clean, the bed very comfortable, the shower hot and the included breakfast very complete. We ate at the restaurant several times and it was delicious. We went to enjoy the Hammam and dry sauna after our trek. The staff is extraordinary, helpful and smiling. A huge thank you especially to Muskaan at reception and Anish at the restaurant.

We stayed for three days at this exceptional hotel in Nepal.It is 15-20 minutes from the airport. The rooms are modern, clean and spacious.The restaurant in the hotel offers all meals from breakfast to dinner.We met Miss Rebecca who manages the restaurant. He recommended some delicious dishes to us! I ate a kebab prepared by the exceptional chef Saroj! Rebecca is super helpful, friendly and very kind.Thanks again from everyone
Great hotel, very friendly staff, the breakfast leaves nothing to be desired and the service is perfect. The view from the pool is sensational, I have to say the hotel exceeded my expectations.

Hotel in the central area (Tamel), with excellent breakfasts and very kind staff. Clean and with spacious rooms. Parking and swimming pool. Gym, casino, it's near a shopping center. Also excellent when returning from a tour in Nepal. To visit!

We stayed 3 nights in this beautiful and brand new hotel. Ideal location for visiting Kathmandu. Modern, clean and functional rooms. Breakfast with a wide choice of products. Friendly, helpful and pleasant staff. Truly a beautiful environment!

The atmosphere was very pleasant, the staff was attentive to my needs Radhika Gaurav and Sujan were very friendly during our stay, the rooms were very comfortable, the areas were clean, the assistants were also very attentive to us

Very friendly staff, reception, restaurant, Housekeeping… all very attentive!Varied breakfast and dinner buffet.Located in Thamel, good location, with ease of shopping, and leisure in the surroundings.A contemporary, urban and accessible hotel.

The staff and the rooms were very pleasant. Breakfast was freshly cooked every day and we were even able to store our luggage for free during our trek. Hom in particular gave me tips for Kathmandu at reception. Very nice!

Great hotel with all comfort in the middle of the Thamel district in the center of Kathmandu. Between many restaurants and shops. Near the airport and Durbar Square. Breakfast is perfect, staff very friendly and helpful. Excellent rooms with wonderful beds and a beautiful view of Kathmandu.

My wife and I spent 15 days in late Nov and early Dec 2019 at Annapurna and are pleased to say we were delighted with the experience. We had several family members with us as we had arranged for a wedding reception for our son. All family members reported how happy they were. The rooms were well-appointed and comfortable. And the service was always excellent—the staff at all levels and locations were always friendly and smiling and professional and went out of their way to make our stay pleasant. We can give every member 5 stars.The restaurants and bar at the Annapurna were also excellent. We had breakfast there every day and a few dinners and cocktails. All were always excellent.And a special thanks to Muni Rana who handled the arrangements for the reception. He decorated the facility, helped select the menu and assured that all preparations were completed, appropriate, tasteful and successful, even the last-minute changes we had to make. He is very professional and very talented. We were lucky to have him as our adviser, and are confident that the Annapurna is also lucky. He’s a terrific person. Not only is he talented, but a delight to work with.In conclusion we have nothing but good things to say about the Annapurna, its facilities, and especially about its staff.

I have been to this property since 90s and have made this hotel my home in Nepal. I love everything the hotel offers to the guest from food to all the amenities. I love their food served in Indian restaurant with live Gazal in the evening. I feel so happy to see this property well maintained and standing still till the date which shows the dedication of the management in maintaining the property so well. The staff are extremely helpful and do their best at work. Really loved visiting this property and will visit again soon. "BYE NEPAL BYE ANNAPURNA"

Amazing service as I had stayed in Kathmandu for lectures at one university. Room and surrounding very clean. Food at the nearby restaurant was very good and the waiters very patient and understanding.  Helpful, friendly  and swift staff in the hotel. Homely feeling!

The hotel is ok.I visited in December and it was cold. To my surprise there was no heater available and on enquiry I was informed the heaters are not available which was a setback. The location is nice and so is the Breakfast menu. I liked the Live music in the restaurant.P.S. The business centre is expensive and not adequately provided for.

Had consulted the F&B team including a tasting dinner to finalize a Muglai menu for around 650 guests. Very happy to report that the hotel staff layout out an excellent starters and a great meal. Excellent service and food. Got very positive comments from our guests and that Iowa’s most important.Congrats. A real 5 star performance

The entrance and the building of the hotel gives Nepali touch and is one of the best 5 star hotel in Kathmandu, Nepal. The hotel is situated in Darbaar Road, walking distance from Narayan hiti Darbaar. The street is one of the happening street with showrooms of all the brands.   The hotel offers good variety of breakfast and has good infrastructure.  Recommended for family and business stay

A best sample of good hospitality.Clean room.Good services for 24hrs.Mr.porodko was stopped here for 3 days and he appreciate the services and the behaviour of every staff over here.Club lounge staff Miss.Anju Shrestha and Miss.Samjhana Gurung they are very nice with their behaviour and services. He enjoyed the trip a lot. I would like to recommend this Hotel to all who want best hotel with best services and best environment.Thank you☺️

Stayed with family for 4 days. Club house rooms are excellent and highly recommended with excellent add-ons such as beverage, breakfast at the lounge. Baby friendly and good service. Highly recommended if you are opting for club house rooms.

This is my third time staying at the Hotel Annapurna, first in 2015, then in 2019, and now. I come to Kathmandu to work with the Early Grade Reading Program, and I always request to stay here. The place is beautiful and historic, with wonderful and convenient rooms, incredibly friendly staff, and a fabulous variety of restaurants. The pool is absolutely beautiful, and the gym is well stocked and convenient. I definitely recommend it, for business or for pleasure.

Hotel is a bit dated but the rooms are large & very comfortable with all the modern amenities. However what sets this hotel apart is the amazing ladies on reception who go out of their way to assist with a lovely smile.Looking forward to returning to amazing Nepal soon hopefully when the refurbishment to this wonderful hotel has been completed.

My first time in Nepal...so was a little apprehensive. This hotel is an old property, but in a Amazing location in the middle of Kathmandu... the staff is very courteous and always there to help. Had a meal at their indian restaurant, the food was excellent. Their casino is very basic but functional !!Will recommend !!

I have reviewed this hotel several times in past as I need to travel to Kathmandu frequently due to my business involvement. However, this trip was special for my wife accompanied me.She enjoyed every minute she stayed in the hotel.Shristhi and Dibya were very helpful to her.

We were not even guests at the hotel during the earthquake but they saved us like messenger of god they provided us with shelter, food, blanket, pillows water and everything. Can never return what they did for us..a real heritage hotel for hospitality..wish they recover the loss they had during the disaster very soon..god bless all

I have been travelling quite a lot around this world, but I can say that this hotel has won the palm for the worst hotel ever been in! congratulations to the hotel... cause it is very difficult to get this level! Honestly I think this hotel still works with his image of 30 years ago, without improving the rooms. People in Katmandu believing this is a 5 stars, but this is a 0 stars... In the rest of Nepal, any guest house, lodge is better in terms of confort. We stated three days in two different rooms: both had humidity smell (no windows opening and clim and heat did not work), bathroom in a dramatic bad shape (very surprised with the previous comments as we only had a little soap in our bathroom), not hot water the last day, do not speak about the noise as you can only sleep between 23h and 3Am ... Reception is always suspicious about what needs to be paid .... missing a bit of diplomacy for a so called 5 stars ...One good point: the restaurants and the bar: great food, good service, nice peopleSo in conclusion: run away from this hotel or visit the room before booking as from other comments it looks like some have been repaired and updated. even though i asked for a better room the last day I di not get it, so very very disappointed, and sad that such a hotel plays with its historical shining days

We stayed in da club house where we were given a warm welcome by da staff.our room had a view of the garden & the pool.very clean room,towels were changed more frequently than required :) AC was working well,no mosquitoes,bed spread was very clean & staff were responsive to all our requirements.The Chinese restaurant serves delicious food one must definitely try a meal there.Breakfast buffet at the club house & at the coffee shop were decent.They had good variety.we were given complimentary cookies which were very tasty.we wanted to buy some while we were leaving but cudnt as they required to be ordered 2 days in advance.So future guests while u read dis & if u like da cookies definitely order in advance.We were given farewell gift packs of some Ayurvedic stuff.overall we were very happy & content with our stay.

Having stayed in the Hotel on a previous visit, my wife and I chose it as a place to relax for a few days after a trekking holiday with our children, 15 & 11 years old. The Hotel itself is adequate as a five star in Kathmandu. However we had two major issues. Firstly the pool was used for most of the weekend for swimming lessons, meaning that the children found it difficult to use fully. This came to a head on Monday when we returned from a few hours out and then found that the lessons started again at 4pm. The hotel manager did try and resolve this, but if you want to use the pool, it can be a major issue.The biggest issue was our final bill. We were told that Wifi was USD2 per room per day. We ended up having the equivalent of 5 days worth. This turned into USD50 on our bill plus 10% service charge plus 13% VAT. We had to check out at 5 am and the on duty manager said that the USD2 related to the discount on offer for this service not the amount per day. At that time of the morning I had no option but to pay and get to the airport for our flight. This I view as an unacceptable deception that would prevent me from staying there again or recommending it. Every other Hotel, Hostel, Teahouse we stayed in had wifi either free or USD1 for the whole stay. I would be happy for the management of the Hotel to rectify this, should they choose.A great holiday in a great place spoiled by Hotel Annapurna grasping at money.

I was in a room, number was 2058. When I arrived there in hotel, saw there's no mini bar in the hotel. I asked them about it and they told me that there is no such option in our hotel. Also there were no freezer in my room. I asked them about it and they were agreed to change it. But when I checked my colleague's room, saw there is a freezer in his room, that means there were a lack of trustworthiness. Also there were a hall room in the 1st floor which was crowded always. Also you will find a community center just beside pool and garden. That is always full of people with marriage ceremony, with noise, songs etc.So, my observation is this hotel is not up to the mark as per price. Also for room service, you will not find much options so on breakfast.Sorry,i need to write it because you have an opportunity for developing these. Rest of the things like attitude of staffs, service etc are good.

As I write this review, news of the devastating earthquake in Nepal has rocked the world. With hundreds dead and thousands injured apart from the  irrecoverable loss to the magical annd historical legacy that this awesome country has, my heart goes out to all those who have lost their kith and kin and I silently pray for God to give them patience to live through tough times.I had the privilege of visiting this enchanting and mesmerising Himalayan kingdom just  month ago. The trip was meant to be a regular family sojourn albiet by the end of the second day me and my better half had fallen deeply and madly in love with this magical land.We were staying at the Annapurna on Durbar Marg, and contrary to expectations this has been one of the stays where you pay five star but you get an aged property where the only thing to write home about is the location. Imagine staying in a luxury hotel with pedestal fans to cool your tempers down. The AC dosen't work when the electricity goes, (which is more often than not) and even when it does it cannot cool on its own and has to depend on good weather or the sun going down (expect ACs to work only when its either cloudy or dark outside). The food quality (not its exorbitant prices) is also a saving grace. The in-house restaurants both Indian and Chinese serve great food and are a must-try. Room service was bad (with the team either not turning up or having no answers to our AC problems), house keeping got on our nerves, pestering us to let them do their cleaning bit. We had them ringing bells evey hour making us feel embarassed especially when we had issued instructions of letting them know when we wanted their service. The Managers were polite and tried to be hospitable when we took our issues to them but when you have the basics disfunctional there is only so much that you can do.Thamel, the local shopping bazaar is close by and public transport is very easy to get as soon as you step out (do bargain with the taxis). Try avoiding the breakfast at the hotel since there are better more economical options nearby (Himalayan Java Coffee and Hot Breads). All in all a very average experience with most parts not working as well as one would expect from a hotel of this stature and tarrif. I strongly suggest you explore other options before you decide to go with this one.I also sincerely hope that Nepal recovers soon from the aftermath of the deadly disaster and bounces back to its magical self sooner than later.

Last month we went to nepal, the 1st day we stayed at yak&yeti which I liked then flew to pokhara. After 3 days we came to Kathmandu and yak&yeti was not available, so we stayed here. rooms were too small the interior, small bed. It wasn't pleasant at all..

We stayed here two weeks before and two nights after the earthquake. The hotel is billed as a five star but does not match up to a four star western hotel. It is very plush (in the lobby and restaurants) but some of the rooms eg on the ground floor to the left as you come in the main door, are a bit basic. Wifi was an extortionate USD14 per diem! You can get round this by sitting near the business centre and asking a kind person behind reception for the password, when it becomes free.There are two restaurants - Indian and Chinese. We could only use the Indian one after the earthquake and that was not up to its usual standard needless to say. The fact that they managed to supply meals in what had become a disaster area was a measure of their resolve.Breakfasts, again before the event, were excellent in the "Coffee Room" the only slight downside being you had to go out in the open to reach it and could get wet if it were raining.Didn't try the pool but it was popular so must have been okay.All this could be academic if the hotel has to close down because of structural damage - check before you book. I must say that the hotel seemed to come through the earthquake with relatively little damage but I am not a qualified structural engineer.

Since I go to Kathmandu every year for climbing since more than 20 years, I have tried out most of the 5 star properties there but I always come back to Annapurna because this is the best place to stay. It is absolutely centrally located yet very quiet and peaceful inside. Has a huge swimming pool, great bar, absolutely fantastic food and the most hospitable staff and manager possible. Most of them now know me by face. The breakfast menu is endless. The rooms are big and plush. Everything is just the way it should be. This is my choice each and every time. This time when I went they had full booking for heritage rooms so I booked myself into the Club room and what a grand luxury it was. The complimentary evening snacks was just too good and I did not need dinner at all after that. Wifi was free too at the Club room. Thank you everyone and I shall keep coming back again and again

My sister and I stayed here in March 2015 (pre-earthquake) and we were happy with the accomodations.  the rooms were clean and spacious, and our first room was very good (at the back of the hotel, overlooking the pool).  Our second stay the room was in the front, overlooking the parking lot.  This room was OK, not as good as the first.  The breakfast here is exceptional, with something for everyone and very good quality.  Excellent coffee and service too.  I would not list it as 5 star, but for Nepal standards it was definitely very good.  The negatives (which were common in Nepal) were that the power shuts off periodically, and some people complained about hot water for showering.  I did not have this issue but I showered before 7am daily.  The wifi was free near the "business office", but was very sketchy.  The bar downstairs had excellent selection and decent prices.  The Indian restaurant was so-so, our meal was borderline ok.  Hopefully they weathered the earthquake well.  If so, I would recommend this hotel

Good hotel inside the city and nearer to the Historical Lord pasupathi nath temple.Rooms are good and spacious. But the service to be improved not a great service . Restaurant serves very authentic Indian dishes .

It is 30 years since I have stayed here, and it still has charm in a greatly modernised Katmandu.I appreciate the friendly staff, attention to detail, even if service is sometimes a little slow!Above all, the location is great.

For a third world country, the Annapurna made Nepal easy. The front desk was more than helpful.  The housekeeping staff were the best. The coffee shop was a little slow at refilling my coffee cup, but that was offset by the variety of breakfast foods.  It was a wonderful experience. The hotel was in a great location, not luxurious but very good. I don't think I'd want to stay anywhere else.  It made my first, maybe last visit to Nepal memorable. I would recommend it.

Excellent business hotel with good rooms, facilities and restaurant. The Indian restaurant plays live Hindi songs and serves good sumptuous food. The staff are courteous and the hospitality is top notch. The exclusive club lounge is great for informal meetings.

Good Hotel. The main advantage of staying in this hotel is that the hotel is on Durbar Marg. The only good place in whole kathmandu. Breakfast is good but the main problem was1. Poor wifi. For upgrading you have to pay extra2.

This is my first experience in this hotel. This hotel rating is five star, but it is not fit for even 3 star rating. During my stay, some party was going on and there was unbearable music noise coming. Inside my room A/c. was not cooling and when I complained, I was told to keep the windows open. This hotel needs an uplift to rate as "five star".

I recently spent a few days at this nice establishment. The staff in general were courteous and friendly, apart from the reception who appeared to be rather aloof, due to pressure of work, perhaps. I paid a bit more for the room but there were no views apart from a dilapidated dirty building with  lots of noise ,being the only external visual object, reminding one of the Berlin wall before its destruction. The promise was that the guest would be greeted with chocolates and flowers in the room. Neither was present and seen. 2 days before my departure I discovered fleas in the bathroom. This was reported to the staff who did not place any weight to my concern, whilst I was present there.The friendliness of the Nepalese people , however, made these problems insignificant. The management of the hotel should try and take heed of the constant requirement to keep standards and values and do what they say.

L'Hotel si trova nella zona centrale di Kathmandu, a pochi passi dal vecchio Palazzo Reale.La camera "DELUX" non era sicuramente all'altezza, un po' datata che avrebbe bisogno di una ristrutturazione.Per il servizio ristorante, bisogna uscire dall'albergo e andare in una struttura adiacente con incomprensioni del personale sul servizio da dare agli ospiti.Ci è capitato di ordinare delle pietanze che ci sono state addebitate nonostante la convenzione solo perché avevamo scelto da un menù non previsto, senza che il personale fosse a conoscenza della nostra convenzione.Comunque per chi ha la convenzione, la scelta del menù è molto ristretta (2 antipasti, 2 primi e 3 secondi).Buona invece la colazione.

The hotel is located on a main shopping street opposite the entrance road to the Yak and Yeti Hotel. However, unlike the rather soulless Yak & Yeti, the Annapurna is a human size hotel with lots of local events going on in the hotel and at the magnificent Pavilion in the grounds by the swimming pool. We stayed for three nights before going up to the mountains and for three more nights on our return. We watched at least two weddings that would have put Bollywood to shame with all the elaborate floral decorations and exotic lighting provided by the Annapurna.I have stayed here in 2005, 2008, 2011, 2012, 2015 and now in 2018. Each time the hotel offers great service and comfort. I have seen all the progressive improvements to this older building and each time they have been for the better. The rooms are clean and comfortable and the breakfast in the Coffee Shop is fine although I do still miss the large upstairs breakfast room which is now a conference hall! All the hotel services are efficient, friendly and helpful. There are two shining stars in the hotel too. These are the Indian and Chinese restaurants where the food is truly excellent. Durbar Marg is only a ten minute walk from Thamel. the Royal Palace, and the Garden of Dreams. The hotel's airport transfer service has always been excellent and I consider Hotel Annapurna home from home when I am in Kathmandu. It is a mature, local hotel providing top class services. It is not all glossy shiny metal and glass and full of trekkers. It has its very own character and is in a class of its own and should definitely be placed much higher up in these review listings.

I first stayed in the Annapurna in 2003 at either end of a trek. Since then, I stayed here twice in 2008, once in 2011 and again in 2012. This year, 2015, we stayed for four nights on each side of another special trek to assess damage caused to schools in the Solu Khumbu by the earthquakes. Eight nights is enough to confirm my opinion that Hotel Annapurna is still one of the most convenient full service hotels to stay in Kathmandu. It is close to Thamel and has an excellent Indian restaurant, albeit with a limited menu caused by the Indian Government blockade on fuel and food coming into Nepal. Breakfast is served in the excellent Coffee Shop. Lunch and evening meals are also available here. We had several meetings at the hotel and prompt service ensured plentiful coffee and biscuits, etc., whenever needed. The bar is quiet and very nice with friendly staff. There is a large (unheated) swimming pool and garden area which is great for relaxing.Our (corporate) bedroom was comfortable and efficient with a kettle for tea and coffee and also a minibar if needed. The housekeeping staff are all helpful and friendly. It might be helpful if I mention here that some of them do tend to chat loudly outside some bedroom doors early in the morning! Its nice they all get along so well but not so nice for those of us guests who are tired and need a lie in some mornings!Once again, we were met at the airport by the efficient pre-booked transfer service provided by the hotel and again on departure, a car was supplied at precisely the correct time. For a touch of genuine Nepalese hospitality, the hotel is simply great. It is in the centre of local banquets and functions and is used by many local business people too. It has a warm atmosphere that is not shared by its equally well known and much larger counterpart across the road! I will always recommend Hotel Annapurna and will stay here again if I return to Kathmandu.

I stayed here for the first time on many visits to Kathmandu. The location of the hotel on Darbar Marg is one of its best advantages. 10 minutes from the airport and surrounded by shops and restaurants.Please select the rooms in the ground floor near the Chinese restaurant as it is connected to the main lobby. Rooms are carpeted with an LC TV, tea coffee maker, phone and toilet amenities. The house keeping staff are extremely efficient and warm.The swimming pool is big and the deepest end is 5 feet with well maintained water.The bar is cosy and offers a good variety of drinks including beer. The Indian restaurant serves awesome food and so does the Chinese joint.Airport transfers are offered by the hotel in their Toyota vans. Overall, good hotel with great staff.

I wasn't going to write this review given the circumstances, however given the hospitality of the hotel's staff during a very very terrible time I thought otherwise.  As one of the only hotels open in the area after the earthquake they helped many people such as myself who were now without a place to stay.  The hotel staff stayed to take care of the guests.  They made sure two meals were served.  They also made sure we were all outside during the aftershocks that seemed to never end.  I cannot say enough about this staff.  It was a terrible time for everyone but they continued to make sure we were safe.  No one said a word when most of the guests took their beds outside to sleep, or when weary travelers wandered in from the outside to make a bed out of the many chairs and couches in the lobby.  They made sure there was always water.  Thank you.

I visited Kathmandu for business and my organization booked the Hotel Annapurna for me. The hotel staff were polite and efficient and the room was dated, but clean and well maintained. What made my visit unique is that during my stay, the first earthquake occurred. The hotel staff really worked hard to make sure that all guest were safe and cared for, even while they worried about their own homes, families, and friends. I will always be grateful for the understanding and kindness that I was shown during this time.

Since I live in Kathmandu, I haven't actually stayed as a guest at the Annapurna. However, I have many friends who have stayed there, both before and after the earthquake, and everyone speaks of the excellent hospitality and good service. Perhaps this is due to the manager's having spent some time at the famed hotel management school associated with Cornell University. On my own, I visit the Annapurna regularly for the Rotary Club meetings that are held there every Friday. We always have a buffet breakfast to go along with the meeting, and the selection is excellent. In fact the breakfast buffet offered at the Annapurna Coffee Shop is famous throughout Kathmandu.

We stayed at the Annapurna only because we had decided to stay at the Fish Tail Lodge at Pokhara and the Lodge belongs to the same group. The hotel was suggested by the executive who took our booking for Pokhara. I would have preferred to stay in any other hotel, but this. This is not a bad hotel at all, but it is old and even the attitude is ancient. From rules about visitors to employees who look at you suspiciously with no manners of hospitality, the hotel can become a prison for a guest. It is dull and lifeless. They don't know the word bargain and they may even kill you for a dollar or two. I was wrongly billed for a bottle of water and when I asked whether they could remove  hundred rupees from the whole bill the lady at the reception argued for over half hour. This after we paying over Rs. 60000 for our stay and food. Let me remind you that they don't care for any review in tripadvisor. I may stay there again, but only if I don't find a better choice in Kathmandu. The hotel with this attitude will become a relic soon if it has not become one already.

First of all I must state you get what you pay for,  cheap it is not! Having said that it is an excellent place to stay at the start and end of a trip to Nepal. Location is great for shopping and not too far from the Thamel area either which is a fifteen minute walk away. Rooms are very well appointed with nice touches everywhere,great complimentaries, comfortable beds and well stocked minibar.Breakfast is very comprehensive.
