Das gesamte personal war super freundlich und konnte perfekt Englisch. wir Checkten dann für 1nen Tag in einem 3Mann Zimmer ein. Das Hotel machte im Empfangsbereich einen super Eindruck.Zimmer war sauber und das Bad auch sehr sauber.Nun zum negativen:1. Ein 3 Mann Zimmer Gebucht. Bekommen haben wir ein Doppelzimmer mit einem klapprigen Klappbett dazu.2. Bei unserem Aufenthalt über diesen Tag hatten wir mehrfach Stromausfälle. Zwar kein Weltuntergang aber einfach nervig.3. Als wir die Badewanne sahen, freuten wir uns schon auf ein heißes Bad jedoch blieb es dabei, da hier Warmwasser ein Fremdwort ist.4. Die Fenster würden wir als Papierfenster bezeichnen. Man hört sogut wie alles von draußen.5. Das Gratis Wlan wollte jedes mal nach verlassen des Bereich eine neue Anmeldung UND wir bekamen nur Zugang für 2 Geräte was auch sehr unschön war da wir ja zu dritt da waren.Resultat: Für das Geld was hier aufgerufen wird bekommt man absolut nicht das geboten, was man sich noch unten an der Rezeption erhofft. Deshalb blieben wir auch nur 1nen Tag und wechselten dann für die restliche Zeit das Hotel.Von uns gibt es somit KEINE Empfehlung für dieses Hotel.
ホテルスタッフやドアマンは笑顔で挨拶してくれます。部屋も清潔です。ホテル内の中華レストランを利用しましたが美味しかったです。タメル地区やダルバール広場へも徒歩で可能です。ホテルの近くに日本料理のレストランがあります。

The Hotel is located in Durbar Marg, which is the best location to be in. I had stayed in this hotel several years ago and had a pleasant experience. However this time the experience was completely different. I had booked the hotel through an online portal. Upon checking in I was given a room in the old wing, which was very small. The corridors of this wing had a stale and musty smell, which could be due to the carpet. The staff though polite were always overwhelmed by customers requests etc.. so one had to wait for any request to be serviced.The hotel is now ageing and is in need of refurbishment to bring back it's former charm. I was disappointed with the room I was allotted, and could not get the room changed as the hotel was apparently full. While making a booking please ensure the room type and size.

i was there for the conference with my all team from the office. The conference was very successful. Regarding the room we stayed on the heritage type which was ok. Being a Nepali participant we thought that the service would be biased but the staffs over there didn't made us feel that way. They were very humble and service oriented. Our lunch was served at the Banquet hall and dinner was served at Ghar E kebab and we enjoyed the variety of foods. A perfect place for vaccation, work or whatever it is as it serves the best service in town.

We were highly impressed by the warm hospitality of Annapurna Hotel.The Club Rooms were very nice and modern - service extended by all staff at the Front Desk was very warm and hospitable- truly the real Nepalese taste.Will definitely come back again and again.

one of the best hotels that I had stayed in kathmandu.Its rooms were fabulous.Service was too good.And the food was too nice. during evening time they even have some light music which to create a nice mood and vibe.

I stayed 5 days recently in this hotel. The location is central, within walking distance to Thamel area. Since the conference paid for the room and all meals (not sure how much), I am not able to comment on value for money. The room was average quality, and there was no view from my room - only saw a big wall.  It has 3-4 floors, and I liked being able to use the stairs for going up and down. I also experienced noise of disco music in the night.  In early December, the room air conditioner was set to heating, and it cannot be regulated from inside the room, I was told.  There are several restaurants in addition to the coffee shop. The breakfast offers variety. Hotel service was good.  But one annoyance is that wi fi facility is given only for two devices, and you have to log off and wait for some time before enabling another device. Moreover, speed is of average quality.The wake up service is good with a couple of reminders. They also arrange early breakfast if you check out early morning provided you book it the previous evening.In sum, I was happy with the stay although I cannot say there was anything special.

Strategically located in Durbar Marg and near all the important places.At the same time,seems to have an air of dignity,peace and quiet.Very good services re Bar,restaurant and especially the coffee shop.Breakfast in the mornings is simply wonderful with all kinds of options-Indian,Chinese continental and varieties of tea and coffee.The Jasmine Green tea is particularly good.Rooms are well equipped with all facilities and wi-fi is very good..Another special for discerning liquor lovers is the huge wine store next door.It is one of the biggest in Asia and every possible variety of drink is available.Near also to the main shopping places like Ason where woolen goods and trinkets could be bought at bargain prices

Our flight from Kathmandu to New Delhi was cancelled so Air India put us up in Annapurna- and we loved this hotel!Pros:• Centrally located right in the middle of the trendiest street in Kathmandu. Surrounded by a myriad of shops, bars and restaurants. • We stayed in the business wing, and I found the rooms absolutely lovely especially with the long sofa by the window. The beds were super comfortable. • We ate our breakfast and dinner buffet meals at The Coffee Shop and the food was delicious and service fast and friendly. I loved the grilled vegetables, mutton, paneer, and vanilla cake with chocolate chips in the icing. Cons:• The WiFi system is annoying because it doesn’t remember your username and password and whenever you turn on your cell or laptop you have to input it again. Once connected the speed is OK.

We were 36 people from 16 different countries stayed for five nights in this hotel. It was a nice stay no doubt with almost all facilities of a good hotel. Breakfast was good with variety of choices from Nepali, North and South Indian and Western cuisine.  We also had lunch here for at least 3 days and I must say food was also good  in comparison to foods in other famous restaurants in Kathmandu. Location wise it was it was beautifully placed near some landmarks of Kathmandu and Thamel, the shopping area for the tourists. A swimming pool was also there, however we had very little time to enjoy some free time. Only thing, I was not satisfied with, that was the two tiny meeting room. They were really small to accommodate all of us.       I may stay here in future if ever come to Kathmandu.

I stayed here on business and the stay was perfect. The hotel is centrally located and close to shopping centres and tourist places of interest. The restaurant is awesome and services are perfect. True value for money hotel

I have stayed at Hotel Annapurna many times. Tried the Heritage room, Delux room and also the Club room. The Heritage room works fine but is a bit smaller than the others. I prefer the Delux room which have a sofa-like place at the big window. The Delux room also works better if you will have friends visiting your room during your stay since they will have a nice place to sit. The Club room is one class better than than the other two, like flying Business Class. Some food is included in the price and you don't need to eat it in the ordinary restaurant since there is a high class dining place on the Club room floor. This is also where you eat your breakfast, if you want... The feeling at the breakfast if you have the Club room is that you have your own cook that takes care of you. Over all the highest standard on all surfaces and details in these rooms.The service is excellent at the hotel, but dont forget to put the "Do not disturb" sign on your door handle unless you want the house keeping personnel to knock your door a couple of times per day. Internet is included in the price. Not super fast but it works ok, and you can connect two devices per room.The staff at this hotel is very friendly, and I have never had any problem with them. I reccomend this hotel, and will most probably be back here many times more.

This is an older hotel located in the heart of Kathmandu.  We spent 3 nights here.  The location is excellent, the rooms were clean, the water hot, and the staff was very attentive.  Breakfast in the coffee shop across the entrance was always very good with made to order eggs and a nice buffet.

We stayed there for 3 Nights 2 + 1 and stayed in Club room and the ambiance the rooms have is awesome and staff is quite friendly , helpful and sober must day very well spoken and all the service are well offered and in nice manner. Cleanliness is GOOD.

Stayed for 4 nights during our trip to Kathmandu and we enjoyed it. The super deluxe rooms at Ground floor was clean and cozy.  Good Wi-Fi coupled with courteous staff in particular the house keeping team made our stay comfortable.Good bar but expensive and service of the Indian restaurant needs to be improved.The location of the hotel is great as shopping streets are nearby.

One of the most conveniently located hotels which have all varieties of cuisines makes it a comfortable place to stay. The staff is courteous and very efficient. Wi-Fi connection is excellent. The bar stock is also elaborate. Slightly expensive but worth the money.

We stayed in the Annapurna for one night due to an overbooking at our 4 star hotel which frankly did not cut the mustard anyway...So it was a blessing to enjoy time at the Hotel Annapurna. It has a great swimming pool complex with free towels and health club.... We enjoyed a great meal in the hotel restaurant Ghar E Kebab, even if service was a little slow the meal was worth waiting fro Drinks are expensive as it is a five star...here's a tip the drinks are cheaper in the bar than the restaurant so buy there and take them through!Rooms are comfortable without actually reaching the 5 star status expectancy.  Location is not too far from Thamel and bit further to new Road and it is close to the Royal palace and about 25/30 minutes because of traffic to the airport.Food in the coffee shop was pretty good be it for a snack or the buffet breakfast!Used the business centre computer for one hour at a cost of just £2.25p and the broadband was quickOverall I would be happy to stay here as and when we next get to Kathmandu!

I stayed at annapurna for first time.it was recommended by my freinds..me and my freind checked in around evening at 8 pm.when we enter lobby was full of other arrivals three staff were at reception attaining all the guest so smartly...same time they attained us. I booked through internet, deluxe room.checked in to deluxe room.i went to the room and saw there was some diffrence in room, the picture i checked in internet was diffrent than room i was checked in than i called to front desk and asked the lady regarding category than she told that is the same room which i booked.later on i came down and show the picture to Ms. sapana than she told that the same room i was booked. Than she showed me heritage and deluxe room...than i was cleared she was right. But the room where i checked in i felt not so comfy than Ms.Sapana showed me another room with garden veiw. I felt that room was excellent than she offered me to change but i felt so bad like at busy time i am shifting to another room they again need to clean the prev room i used but she request me to change if i was comfortable in new room shown than i shifted. I am so happy that i choosed annapurna where staff are ready to serve and helpful all the time. She was just awesome. Not only that she helped me to booked at fishtail lodge with best rates.

On an official trip to Kathmandu, I was booked into Hotel Annapurna.  I really admire the staff at the hotel for the hospitality exhibited.  The hotel is also safe and secure.The rooms are quite neat, practical and maintained well.  There are options available within the hotel itself on food.  The complimentary breakfast spread is nice as there are many options.  Room service, including laundry and house keeping is good.It is near the old palace and with all needed facilities / amenities around the hotel - ATMs, Restaurants, Banks, Travel Agents, Money Changers, Shops, etc.  I feel it to be one of the best hotels in Kathmandu in a good locality.

Kathmandu is a place I' d like to go back to. And Annapurna is my hotel of preference to stay. The location is perfect, being bang on the durbar road with lot of shops and bars nearby. The building is quaint and gives an old world feel. Pros: rooms are spacious and comfy. Low noise levels in the room. Good air conditioning. Bathroom spacious, clean and neat. Staff very polite, warm and friendly. Food, particularly the breakfast with its spread is quite lovely. Nice pool.free wifi available. Well stocked bar. Most of the things you need for a comfortable stay available.  Cons: the gym is pretty small and lacks sufficient equipment. Rates are on the higher side, though much lower than yak and yeti or radisson.

It's the best hotel of Kathmandu. From Location to facilities foods to hospitality. Everything is of high quality. This is what we call  "professionally maintained". Huge property, star rating 5 easy access. Good food. It's right on the Durbar street surrounded by malls food court and taxis. Well behalf ed staff, fast check in, and check out. Overall 1 of the best property I ever visited. And very much safe also for family visitors. Special thanks to the waiters of the Kebab something (Restaurant). they use to help us to choose different mughlai dishes. Only the live band singers of the restaurant are odd. The only thing that can be compromised ie the size of the bathroom.

I am happy to see everybody here, especially happy with the service of Ms. Sapana and Narendra who helped me to make my stay comfortable and enjoyable.i stayed in Deluxe and club room, they are nice.I wish to come again as hotel is very nice and staffs are very good.I wish there happy ness god bless them.thank you

Das Hotel ist günstig gelegen und vor 20 Jahren sicher als luxuriös durchgegangen. Die Zimmer sind großzügig und sauber, das Frühstück reichhaltig und das Personal zuvorkommend. Für die Verhältnisse in Kathmandu eine gute Wahl, wenn man etwas sauberes mit zuverlässiger Stromversorgung und relativ sauberem Wasser sucht (zum Zähneputzen etc. bekommt man täglich zwei versiegelte Flaschen). Es gibt einen Pool im großzügigen Garten aber in den habe ich mich nicht getraut (bei der Wasserqualität in Kathmandu meidet man lieber jede unnötige Berührung damit).

The Experience in Staying at Hotel Annapurna, Durbar Marg, Kathmandu is just - EXCELLENT. I have been staying in this Hotel for the past 10 years and not even once I had any chance to complain. The Front Office, Room Service, Food, Cleanliness, Breakfast spread, Wifi network, Transportation is one of the BEST in its class. I stayed from 1st September 2014 to 6th September 2014 and now I am again travelling to Kathmandu, Nepal from 18th September 2014 to 22nd September 2014 and again staying with Hotel Annapurna, Durbar Marg, Kathmandu.

my first stay in this hotel and found very magnifique. staffs are the asset of the hotel. rooms are well maintained with vip amenities. now onwards i will stay in this hotel and would suggest to my friends as well in germany. front office staffs and the duty managers are excellent in their work

Hotel Annapurna is a classic hotel,  probably one of the oldest and best located hotel in the heart of Kathmandu. If you want a modern setup ...look somewhere else.  But if you wish to experience the spirit of the old world Nepal...this us the place for you.  Being an old hotel,  the facilities are a bit run down but adequate to make your stay comfortable. The rooms vary in size and bed types,  so be specific in stating your requirements. The air-conditioning needs improvement. I had to request for a table fan for a comfortable night sleep.  The bathrooms need better ventilation. The beds are comfortable and so are all other things of the room. The breakfast though ample could have more variety.  The best part of the hotel is the super courteous service and house keeping staff.  Extremely helpful. However the reception staff needs to be more friendly and smiling. Would stay here again due to its location alone

We stayed for 2 days in the hotel in our way to Pokhara.The room was good abd so was the food.Hotel Staff were well behaved and helpful.Ambience was good.The gym was not well maintained and when i went in the morning around 7.30 no support staff was there.Gym was not well equipped.Swimming pool was well maintained.Over all nice stay.

This hotel bills itself as the 'Number One Address' in Kathmandu- a Five Star property. It does have a nice marble lobby.  However, the rest of the property reminds me of something you'd find along old Route 66.  Windows hang randomly open, curtains sailing in the breeze, allowing the smoke and dirt of the city directly inside.  The rooms are small and dark, and adorned with garage sale quality furniture. The plumbing does not drain well, and most members of our travel group can't get water hotter than tepid.  A few rooms report bugs. The location is ok - you're close to the Thamel district. The hotel charges $4/hour per device for Internet access, which is outrageous, considering download rates and the fact that most places include it. Is this hotel unlivable?  Certainly not. However, at best this is a two star hotel. Are there better in Kathmandu?  There's the rub - I don't know. This is not an 'experience' or one-of-a-kind hotel.

Hotel Annapurna is an old property with unassuming exteriors but endowed with a bit of old-world charm and warmth. I have stayed here many times and have enjoyed it always. Advantage is its location that is right in the center of the city, markets and malls. There are international chains like Pizza Hut and KFC and bustling city market right outside the entry gate to the property. Rooms are good sized though a bit dated. Furniture, carpet and upholstery look faded even stained with spots, and has perhaps not been changes in decades, though their upkeep is good. Hotel has only three floors and is well maintained in terms of cleanliness. One disappointing issue is that free Wi Fi is limited to one device. You cannot run your mobile and laptop together unless you buy additional Wi Fi connection. Or you must learn from the front desk how to log-off from one device and log-on to other. Breakfast buffet in the Coffee Shop is superb, has a good variety of quality items and trays are quickly re-filled. I can check in this hotel just for the stuffed kachauri, Idly, Vada and Nariyal Chutney they prepare! Room service food  however needs improvement. Hotel employees on front-desk and elsewhere are very polite in a genuine way that is very typical of Nepalese people in general. I would certainly recommend this hotel.

I stayed here for a week on business in Kathmandu. It's supposed to be one of the nicest hotels in Kathmandu. The amenities are great but given the rooms it seemed overpriced to me. It is in a central area of the city, Durbar marg, near the Royal Palace and within walking distance of Thamel. There are also several restaurants and clothing shopping on the same street. The hotel lobby and grounds are nice. There's a pool area with lounge chairs. The fitness center was basically a room w/ a treadmill and two weight machines. The loadshedding made it difficult to run bc the lights would go on and off.There's also 3 restaurants -- the Coffee Shop, Ghar-e-Kebab, and a chinese one. The Coffee Shop breakfast had a good variety of American/European/Nepali food (omelettes, boiled eggs, fruit, yogurt, cereal, sausage, idli/sambar) but was very pricey ($10). Ghar-e-kebab was some of the best indian food I've ever eaten and the ambience is great with the singer/musicians. The room was clean and sufficient for my needs but pretty lackluster for the price. The bed was comfortable. The desk and chairs were fine. The room wasn't very big... just large enough for the bed, an arm chair, coffee table, and desk. There was a flat screen tv w. a couple of English channels. The closets were large. The room decor was dated and felt a little worn. The bathroom was older as well with this wallpaper that looked like brown composition notebook paper. Housekeeping came every day and there was turn down service. Again, everything was clean but the room was just in need of an update. Wi-fi was expensive ($12 for 24 hour period) and not included in the price. I did use the business center to print and wasn't charged. One odd thing that kept happening was it sounded like someone was ringing the doorbell but no one was ever there.

Dear Friends,I was at Kathmandu, Nepal for a business trip from 28th Feb 2014 to 3rd March, 2014 and stayed at Hotel Annapurna which is a five star property but this Hotel does not have any noticeable thing to be called a five star excepting its location which is heart of the city.Its a very big valley and almost nil snow fall so the days are generally not very cool excepting when you have rains there. Medium woolen are good enough. The rooms and the toilets are small and communication facility such as wi-fi etc. which is limited to one person per room which is ridicules.Its Casino is just hopeless and shabby, food is ok.Besides above I visited Pashupati Nath temple, Syambhu temple and Basant Nagar which is old and ancient Kathmandu and Thamel which is shopping paradise for foreigners.The city lacks the basic infrastructure, small airport (the only international Airport in Nepal)  most roads are in very bad shape, though some widening of roads is going on, and lot of electricity shortage. even proper taxis are very limited.Not a bad place for going once, casino lovers will find this city very attractive and cheap one can easily pass 5-6 hours time in 4-5 thousand local currency which includes food and drink and few stage shows. Since I could not go for any tracking expedition so no idea of this place infrastructure and facilities related to this.Any ways worth visiting at least once.Bye Happy travelling.Rajeev

We had heard of the famous Hotel Annapurna many times during our stay at Kathmandu and we got a chance to stay with them for one night as our flight got cancelled and they booked us two rooms at Annapurna for my family of four. The hotel is located near to the airport in a very posh and comparatively nicer and cleaner locality.As we entered the hotel we were stunned by the beauty of it. The lobby was big and grand looking with high ceilings and traditional decor.Upon arrival we asked if they had connecting rooms or adjacent rooms but they apologized saying that all their rooms were booked due to the cancellation of all the flights from Kathmandu that day. They only had two rooms available and one was in the ground floor and the other in the first floor. We took that offer as all we needed was a place to stay for one night.We were quickly checked in by one of their friendly staff Rojina, who also gave us vouchers for dinner. Our breakfast was complimentary. She also said that they'll inform us about our flight as and when the airline updates them.The rooms unfortunately weren't as well kept and grand as the lobby. It definitely showed age. It's sad to see that the rooms of such a huge and landmark hotel weren't in its best condition.The hinges of the main door of the room in the ground floor wasn't working properly. The bottom most hinge was very loose causing the door to wobble. The mesh of the drain hole in the bathrooms of both the rooms were dirty and the mesh of the drain in the ground floor had come out of its grouting. The ground floor room had no carpets so the floor was much cleaner. However the first floor room had carpeting which was shabby and smelly. The rooms severely lacked maintenance supervision. The rooms looked drab.The staff however, were really nice and friendly. The house keeping service was quick and prompt. Dinner was in the form of a buffet that was arranged in one of their halls for the passengers of the cancelled flights. Most of the food was vegetarian and Indian. It was really good. The staff were helpful as well.Before we turned in for the night we asked the front desk staff if there was any update from our flight yet because other cancelled flights had informed their passengers about the next day's flight. We were worried that the airline may have forgotten us as there were only the four of us from that particular airline. They called over their hotel representative Mr. T. P. Gurund. He was a very calm person and talking to him made us feel more comfortable. He told us to calm down and that he expected the airline to contact him early tomorrow. He also told us to be ready early in the morning as we may have to leave at a short notice for our morning flight. He said that he won't be there in the hotel the following morning but added that if anything was there we could contact him.The next day we got up early and still received no info from the airline. Doing a bit of our own research we found out that the flight would leave in that morning at about 10. We contacted the staff who immediately called Mr. Gurund. He promptly called back with a positive reply as he contacted the airline. We couldn't thank them enough and they told us that they could arrange a vehicle from their hotel to drop us off to the airport at 7am. We immediately ate breakfast.It was served at the Coffee Shop. I think that the restaurant was a bit small for the size of the hotel. Also, we had to go outside the hotel to reach the restaurant which is a bit of an issue during the rains as we experienced. They did offer us an umbrella though. The spread was good and had many options. Taste wise it wasn't anything special. We immediately left the hotel and reached the airport in their car which was very clean. The driver was also a very friendly and professional person.Overall this hotel is pretty average. The rooms showed age and is in need of renovation. The food was okay. The highlight is the staff. They were extremely friendly and hospitable. They comforted us when we needed comforting and helped us when we needed help by going out of their way. Thank you Rojina and Mr. T P Gurund.I don't know if all the other rooms are like this. If they are, I don't recommend staying there for the price that you have to pay which may be a bit expensive when compared to the other hotels in the area. There are many other great options. But in our case, since our stay was free I'm nothing but greatful to the lovely staff and the hotel.I kindly request and urge the staff to properly maintain the rooms because bad rooms are such a shame to this wonderful property.

From the welcoming staff to the delicious pool, to the 5-star restaurants, you cannot find a better oasis in central Kathmandu than the Hotel Annapurna. I cannot fathom ever wanting to stay elsewhere.

I was there on a business trip and my colleague tripped over the unnecessary 3 steps that the lobby has without any conspicuous marking. I had a chest infection when I arrived ("Khumbu cough") and the hotel staff had me seen by the staff doctor, filled my prescription, and examined me closely when they saw me in the morning.  This included the maids cleaning the rooms and the men replenishing the water bottles in the room. The breakfast room staff got me coffee without asking, and the chef making my omelette knew exactly how I liked it. The guard at the front saluted on the way to breakfast and upon my return. To tell you the truth, I kind of got used to it. I began to salute back. I stayed for 12 days including the first part of June,  didn't see any rats in the bar, and wouldn't have cared if I had. The staff work amazingly hard to keep the place spotless but Kathmandu is Kathmandu, and maintaining exacting standards in the middle of organized chaos is difficult. All of which means the staff make this hotel something special.  I felt like royalty, surrounded by loyal subjects. (Yes it was a delusion and I am over it but it was nice while it lasted) I did not find it noisy, had plenty of time to sleep and recover. Even got used to having the hotel barber give me a shave every morning. The food was excellent and the service superb. Easily the best hotel I have stayed in in Kathmandu.

And the service there is wonderful and welcoming.  The coffee in the mornings can't be beat!I wanted to stress, though, just how wonderful the service there is. I stayed at Hotel Annapurna for two nights before our Trek and one night post Trek. The rooms were dated but clean and the beds were comfortable. There was adequate hot water with both shower and bath facilities. A kettle with tea and coffee available as well as bottled water. Free wifi was available in the room as well as the foyer and coffee shop but at times dropped out. The coffee shop was within the hotel grounds and a short walk from the hotel.  The coffee shop provided breakfast, lunch and dinner with a good variety of foods.The hotel provided a money exchange service  that was available 24 hours a day. The hotel was central with four ATM machines available in the street where the entrance to the hotel was, making them very accessible. The Garden of Dreams and the Museum were within a short walking distance from the hotel as well as the tourist shopping mecca in Thamel where all types of trekking equipment could be purchased as well as souvenirs. The hotel also provided a service where a bag of personal items could be left until one returned from the trek. The hotel also could advise one in getting a reputable taxi to take one to other attractions if needed. Staff were friendly and helpful and could speak English well. A daily room service was also provided. I would stay here again if ever I returned to Kathmandu.

This is a clean and well maintained  restaurant in an upscale hotel.lots of vegetarian  choices are also available. The service is fast and efficient. Try the honey lemon tea. The various  thalidomide they have gives you a chance to try several standard combinations of  food items.

The hotel is little old but sufficiently maintained. The best part is its location with a range of restaurants and shops within a short walk, as well as a 15 minute walk to Thamel. Worth to pay little extra for a room on their club floor for access to breakfast and evening hours at their lounge. A big thank you to staff especially Kushal Nakarmi who was so helpful and super friendly. I would definitely stay at the hotel again.

Location of the hotel is very good. The street in front of the hotel is clean and loads of branded shops and good restaurants are there. Service was good. They have money exchange option in the reception though rate is not the best. Room was little old and smelly with the old carpet in it. Otherwise, it was clean and AC worked fine. Bathroom was clean too with all the good amenities. The breakfast was very good with many options. Overall, good experience but seemed expensive compared to their service and room type.

Buen establecimiento ubicado excelente,  personal amable, atención al cliente excepcional,  dispone de muchas facilidades y la comida es muy buena. Le falta renovación pero aún así,  las camas son cómodas y las toallas de algodón excelente

Large hotel in a convenient location, 5 minutes from Thamel.  The facility is run down.  Rooms are spacious and clean, but the beddings are not the most comfortable.  Bathroom shower sometimes turn hot and cold.  There is no business center.  Free WiFi is available.It is popular with large events (weddings) so if you have a room that faces the event area (as I did), then the loud music in the evenings could be unbearable.

Yes, the location is great. Shopping haven, Thamel is at walking distance and so is the Royal Darbar. The hotel is surrounded by a variety of cafes and numerous options to dine out as well.Yes, the food is also very good! Breakfast time was my favourite due to the various options available and the lovely ambience. The bakery outlet of the hotel has sumptuous treats for those with a sweet tooth. The evening 'musical treat' at the Darbar restaurant was also good fun.Rooms are clean, spacious, and well done. Staff is extremely helpful and polite. All in all a great and enjoyable place to stay. Would love to have the opportunity to stay again.

Annapurna is one of the old hotels in center of Kathmandu valley. The best location to move around with shopping area near by like Thamel is walking from this hotel. Hotel food is good including breakfast and lunch. The rooms are little old and require renovation especially bathrooms. The hotel has Swimming pool, halls for meeting and very well secured. Overall good experience and will love to stay again

This hotel is my favourite place to stay at Kathmandu. It has an old world charm. Staff are very polite. Especially Ms Anju who is in charge of Club Lounge and breakfast is very cooperative and friendly. She is a good asset for the hotel. Good staff members are essential in every hotel.

Posizione molto buona, servizio buono e rapido. Ristoranti con un servizio di alta qualità. Il rapporto qualità-prezzo è buono. L'hotel ha bisogno di ristrutturazione. Per fare colazione, devi andare in un altro edificio. La colazione è ricca e completa, con un servizio impeccabile.

I stayed there for 3 nights as a part of large group. It's location is fantastic and on main durbar marg. The rooms are well maintained although it's an old property. The food is tasty. The hotel staff is very cooperative especially at reception. It has a good hall for group function. I strongly recommend it.

Recently visited this hotel on my 5 day trip to Kathmandu and I must say this hotel provides good ambience and good food and good service to INDIAN guests. This is a must do hotel if visiting 5 star property. Staff is courteous and friendly. Breakfast was particularly good and tasted North Indian. Bathroom and toiletries are clean and well stocked.

Stayed in the hotel for two nights during a conference.  From the time of registering until check out, all staff at all touch points provided an excellent and courteous service.  Very friendly and always smiling.  Food at the Indian restaurant was very good.  Quality of the room and bathroom was very clean and of a very high standard, as for toilet amenities – all that was needed was available.  The unlimited wi-fi was greatly appreciated and most importantly with an excellent signal.

A nice hotel to stay with very friendly staff, spacious room, good breakfast spread and excellent location at the heart of the city with plenty of food joints within walking distance.  However, washroom complimentary items has scope for improvement. Sleep quality is good. Has a nice pool for a swim.

Gutes Mittelklassehotel mit allen Standards aber der Service besonders im überfüllten Frühstückssaal ein wenig zu unaufmerksam und unfreundlich. Die Sauberkeit ist mit unseren europäischen Vorstellungen nicht an allen Stellen vergleichbar. Als Urlaubshotel für längeren Aufenthalt eher nicht geeignet, aber am Beginn oder Ende einer Nepalreise mit Besichtigung der Altstadt und Bhaktabur zu empfehlen.

The reception and concierge staff were extremely helpful, and pleasant and friendly. I particularly appreciated help with getting my taxi and knowing how much was reasonable for what I needed. Finally, I enjoyed the different Indian meals I ordered each night.

I go often to the Annapurna and I find this hotel a very pleasant place, in a convenient part of Kathmandu. The professional competence of the staff is well-known, and the Hotel facilities are excellent. They recently added more space to the gym and the Coffee Shop is always very good. The restaurants are famous and in the Ghar-e-Kabab I always find the best Indian/Nepali food available in the city.Let me add that they are also able to let the customers feel "at home", like in a family. Recently I had some health problems and three managers of the Hotel asked me about my illness and offered their helps. It was really important to feel their protection and their care for me.So, I would say that Hotel de l'Annapurna in Kathmandu is not only an important Hotel, in which you can really “breathe” the Nepali tradition and history, but also a place in which Nepali people are showing their kindness and warm ability to let you feel at home. For all these reasons, my very deep gratitude goes to all the people who work in the Hotel Annapurna: their professional ability and their kindness are just amazing.

Everyone very helpful and professional! The location is ideal and has all the facilities. there are lots of shops around the place. The location is central and able to reach different places in walking distance.

We were upgraded to the superior rooms, which were beautifully laid out with high quality finishes and luxurious bathroom with bath. Rooms had unlimited wifi as well. The service at this hotel was also fantastic. We had previously stayed in another hotel which was meant to be similar standard, but was sadly lacking.

Restaurant haut de gamme avec cuisine indienne et groupe musical. Les plats sont préparés avec soin et avec le souci de la présentation. Le service est omniprésent. De l’assistance pour prendre place sur son siège jusqu’à l’approvisionnement permanent des verres et des assiettes tout au long du repas. Attention, les spécialités indiennes sont particulièrement épicées !Une carte des vins très bien achalandée. Le rapport qualité prix demeurant correct.

We stayed here as part of a travel deal package twice . Before and after a trek. Ist visit we were put in a room next to the CEO office on a floor full of offices. We were continually woken up be knocking and using of a door bell next door. Our room did not have a smoke alarm, we could see where it was and reported this to reception.Our second visit we were put into a room with a partly glazed window that faced an alley way which was used by service staff who we could hear talking. We paid the tour organisation extra for an upgrade and will be giving this feedback to them as we were given on both occasions the worst rooms in what they call a 5 star hotel. I willInclude photos of the tv, the shocking state of the bathroom. I would not recommend this hotel to anyone as part of a package as you will end up in sub standard rooms

Very nice hotel,good service.i was here for conference and i like it.breakfast was good,lunch was ok,dinner at GEK was good. Bed was comfortable too.front office service very goodChinese restaurant was also nice.Aperfectstay in unknown place

The hotel is conveniently located in the heart of the town, about 20 mins from the Airport. The rooms are nice and clean and the staff is helpful. The food was yummy. The breakfast spread was decent too, though not top of the line.  It boast of the biggest swimming pool in the town and a good fitness centre. The bar is tastefully done and very nice. There are a number of bars/restaurants in the vicinity. Avoid the shady bars in the neighboring Thamel.

Hotel muy agradable y muy bien situado, cerca de las zonas históricas y turísticas de Katmandú. Nuestras habitaciones un poco ruidosas frente a un parking, por lo que les recomiendo tengan en cuenta a la hora de escoger habitaciónEl desayuno excelente, así como los restaurantes del hotel

Comfortable stay.Good hospitality. Affable and courteous reception staffs. Variety in food. Delicious, specially Indian and Nepali cuisines. A spacious hall for meetings and conferences. Shops nearby.

I stay in this hotel as it was near to the exhibition. Position is good as it is near to a main avenue. Hotel itself is nothing special and nothing wrong. I just fell for the quality and service provide i pay too much.

Visiting Annapurna during out visit to Kathmandu was like going bak in time. A name one can associate with history. The people welcomed you back with a hospitality , which was really warm and welcoming. The location of the property is great. One steps out to the hotel and is right there in the most known street in town. Very close to theRoyal Palace and also the Markets. the location was really great. Had a real good stay here.

its best luxury hotel in Kathamndu, Kathmandu is capital city of Nepal. and its in the middle of kathmandu city. Hotel Annapurna is best hotel with best hospitality, frindly behavour, my client was very happy

Last june, my wife and i arrived in Katmandou. We had choosen that hotel to secure a pleasant arrival in Nepal, and had plan to stay only 2 nights. For personal reasons we were forced to stay (7 nights) and we still enjoyed that very welcoming hotel. We really were given every thing that we could expect from that standard of hotel : a great service, carrying staff, nice rooms, very good breakfasts, and in addition a great swiming pool, top quality bar and restaurants.

The rooms were nice. The food was excellent, especially north indian preparations were very good.The service was good and the staff was cooperative and courteous.The hotel is centrally located and easily accessible from the Airport.

Muy bien posicionado en el centro de la ciudad adolece de modernidad.Parece que no lo han modificado desde los 70´s.Camas cómodas.Baños anticuados limpios.Las chicas de recepción muy secos.Piscina buena.Recomendable por la ubicación. Se va andando a todos los lados.

The hotel isn’t luxury, but it doesn’t make any false promises and is a good place to stay. The staff were responsive and helpful. The breakfast is included with the stay and was delicious every time, with a variety of Nepalese options and an omelet bar. The carpets were a little dirty but our rooms were comfortable and provided with all toiletries and commodities.We stayed for two days and had no major complaints (:

Very near to the Narayanhiti Palace, the room is ok with normal facility, looks like a little bit old, the room door height seems a little bit less than other hotels,  but the swimming pool is very nice and the decoration of the hotel is characteristic. Before entering the room area, we need use room card to open some door, makes room area more private and safe

Had the chance to stay at Annapurna for a couple of weeks. The people were friendly and food was good. All facilities were available in hotel. Very busy hotel and nice place to witness Nepalese marriage ceremonies alongside their music very often.

Due to a conference presentation I am visiting this hotel.Since it is practical to stay at the conference venue I ask them to reserve a room for me .They called me up and informed me about an available room but when I went to register they said that room has been given another costumer who became sick!Good luck if you happen to stay here

Visited 2 times. Stayed in Heritage room. LocationFine place to visit,Centrally located,Gr8 parking space,ServiceHelpful staff, Well managed hotel, Great services,FoodWonderful restaurant, Good café, Decent food variety, One of the best western breakfast. AmenitiesFacilities clean, Good conference hall, Good facilities,RoomGood amenities, Spacious rooms,

Its good in budget and admosphire is soo good .Service is on time room also good.Find the hotel is too easy and its near market .hotel staff is also familer they always ready to help and groceries are like new in hotel.

Had one of the worst experiences in a so called 5 star hotel of Nepal. The entrance, lobby, poolside etc all look good, but the rooms are small, cramped, and dirty. Not clean at all. If you ask for a choice of rooms, they simply decline, without reason. Food is not of top quality and very over priced. Would suggest to search nearby places for better deals and hotels. Found live cockroaches in the bath. Also the pool facing rooms have bikes honking early in the morning. Not a suggested stay.

It's time to give credit where credit is deserved.Hotel Annapurna is fantastic, the staff are exceptionally friendly and welcoming.It's always a pleasure to stay there when I am in Kathmandu on business with my colleague.I was asked during check-out if I could make any recommendations and I genuinely could not think of any improvements. The staff are fantastic, the hotel is fantastic.Looking forward to being back. Thank you for your kind hospitality.

Fui por motivos de trabajo. el ambiente y el personal son muy agradables. EL restaurante de comida china estupendo. El buffet de desayuno espectacular y el pub muy agradable para descansar un rato por la tarde.

Its always a pleasure going back to the same hotel again. You are familiar to the staff and the staff also recognise you; with a welcome smile.I believe, you would never go wrong if you choose to stay Annapurna as I would do for my every visit. Of course, there are options available and a few could be better than Annapurna, but for me, its " don't look any further".I love the staff ( don't want to write a few names who are really special to me).

I was stranded at Kathmandu airport on 20th April 2018, I had left my pocket book at Delhi airport, all my contact nos. etc was in there. I had no place to go no wifi , got a cab came to Annapurna Hotel, no booking , Asked to meet the reservation Manager to get a trip advisor rate though I did not have a booking. Ms. Sarita Rana met me and went on to complete the checkin formalities with a fairly decent room rate. the stay of 3 nights and 4 days was fantastic. the food excellent and the breakfast to feast on. Very courtesy staff .hospitality to the "T"  rooms comfortable , could have been a bit bigger but hey last minute it was like palace.great hotel

At a stone's throw from the NarayanHiti Palace, Hotel Annapura has an excellent ambience. It has very good facilities for both business travellers as well as for those on leisure trips. I visited a few hotels in and around, and Annapurna stands a class apart. It obviously is also expensive, but worth the money. It's located half an hour from the airport. The entire Durbar marg on which is stands is a road with lot of activity - shopping, tourists, etc. A replica of the Pashupatinath Mandir in the lobby is a beautiful thing in the hotel. The hotel has restaurants including a Chinese one, coffee shop, business centre, conference hall, swimming pool and many other facilities.

I had stayed in this Hotel during my recent TRIP to Kathmandu,  was little unsure about this one since I have never stayed here before.  Checked the websites, but still had my own doubts.  But I was in for a surprise,  the Hotel was well maintained and had all the facilities.  From the front desk to the house keeping the people were cordial and offered all the support.  Only one suggestion the Travel desk can have more options.

Worst 5 star hotel anywhere. What kind of star hotel asks for 100 rs parking charge when we have come for a wedding in their own premises. Worst staff, such rude guards as if they are not being given salary and their only income is this parking charge.
ご存知の通り、カトマンズは安宿がたくさんあり、そこに泊まることが旅の醍醐味でもあるとおもいます。その中で、このホテルは、繁華街から歩いて5分くらいのところにあります。停電にもすぐに自家発電が付き、暗くなるのは30秒程度です。設備などは、古さを否めませんが、カトマンズでは高級の部類に入ると思います。

A lovely hotel located in the heart of the city - right on the arterial Durbar Marg. Lovely places to hang out nearby. Thamel is walking distance and you can even stroll to the Narayanhiti Palace if you want to do some sight-seeing. The staff are really courteous and very helpful with tips on what to do in the city. From lounging around the lobby I realized that its quite a hang out spot for the rich and famous of the country!

Location great - friendly, efficient and helpful staff - bedroom adequate, but nothing special - the hotel is hardly new!  An excellent Indian restaurant with a limited wine list, where again the service was very good, and the staff went out of their way.

I stay there for weeks and never disappointed. In post durbar marg. Lot of eating options enarby on the road. Good road for shopping and eating.Staff is very nice. Great buffet breakfast Nice property.Overall great experience

hotel Annapurna is located right at the city's heart with lots of shopping and eating options available right around the corner. the hotel is pretty impressive and the staff is courteous and very helpful. i came here on a business stay but there were a lot of tourist staying as well. the hotel has a bar, and three restaurants, Chinese, north Indian and a coffee shop. rooms are comfortable and spacious. the general ambience of the hotel is very regal and gives a great feel. the property in itself is pretty and gives a lot of options to indulge.

I was in Kathmandu for business. I was staying at the Annapurna hotel.The entrance is impressive and you receive a warm welcome from the staff. The building is somehow outdated, but probably that makes is quit different as "up-to-date and cold" hotels.The location is excellent. At the entrance the taxi drivers are waiting for you and can bring you to all places.The breakfast was good with much Indian/Nepalese or Asian food, but for an European there is even so much. You will like it.The room was quite large. So after all.

Great hotel and good location-walking distance to Thamel! Furnishings ooze comfort and luxury. Great ambience and good food. Spacious rooms to chill out. Breakfast spread was good as well. Efficient pick up from the airport.

stayed the hotel  first they gave good room but after 3 night they changed the room it vas very bad not supply even soap or any accessories staff was not helped much have to ask each and every things  so have to consider about rooms before stay

Sono stato 3 volte in Nepal, la prima volta nel 1984, l'ultima a marzo 2018, sia allora che oggi l'Annapurna hotel e' tra i migliori hotel in città, situato a durbar marg vicino al palazzo reale, a pochi passi da Thamel e durbar square, credo sia il posto migliore dove soggiornare. Una piscina pochissimo affollata, una colazione ricchissima e 2 ristoranti di qualità, wifi ovunque, stanze confortevoli e un personale gentile e attento. Io e mia moglie siamo stati 8 giorni magnificamente.I was 3 times in Nepal, first time in 1984 and since then the Annapurna hotel was one on the best hotels in town. At that time I did't have enought money to stay there thow I used to eat in the luxury restaurant that costed as a economy restaurant in Europe. This year I eventualy was a guest of the hotel with my wife and we were very happy of the complete service (brekfast, swimming pool, room and reception) I do recomand this hotel, maybe not the most modern but with history behind and situated in the best cetral area in Katmandou.

The Annapurna has long been one of Kathmandu's leading hotels.  When I was doing research in eastern Nepal in the early 1970s, the Annapurna was far beyond my financial means, but I welcomed the opportunity to stay there several decades later.  While other hotels may have overtaken the Annapurna at the top of Kathmandu's hotel list, it is still very good: well informed and helpful staff; nice rooms that may not have been significantly improved since the good old days; and a great location in the middle of town.  The bathroom functioned well and the bed was reasonably comfortable, and the breakfast was acceptable.  We enjoyed out short stay, but we hope that the Annapurna will find a way to improve its rooms and reclaim its place at the top of Kathmandu's list of fine hotels.

Cake was pretty good. Ordered a 2 pound chocolate cake @ Rs. 2,500 ..price seemed to have risen but the service was quick and did the job of surprising my Valentine 😀. Annapurna has been among my favourite place to dine and for cakes. Quite a regular customer there. Looking forward to visit soon.

While my preference for Kathmandu had been Crowne Plaza Soaltee, however this business trip made me stay at this Hotel, and i didn't regret. It was a great stay at this hotel with decent room size (i stayed at ground floor), friendly staff and excellent location. Ghar e Kebab for sure is one of the yummiest restaurant for indian bar b que cuisine in whole Kathmandu. The bar is also nicely arranged for hang outs etc. The only thing that needs improvement is their gym (very small and not well equipped). Overall 9 out of 10 and this would surely be my preferred place to stay moving forward.

A great hotel that looks beautiful on the inside, with friendly staff that make the stay that much better. The rooms are spotless and a good size, with two separate restaurants of two different cuisines, as well as a cafe, available on site. The hotel is always buzzing with life and activity because it's rather popular with hosting engagement and marriage parties, as well as hosting other things like talks, but I've never heard one once inside the room, so that was never a bother.

This is my 2nd business stay in this hotel and the experience wasn't good this time.The hotel is pretty well prepared with the infrastructure limitations of Kathmandu. There were numerous brownouts during this winter/spring season, the hotel's generator kicks in shortly (within 10 secs). Which is good and reassuring. The water supply ran out in my room one night. After calling housekeeping, they discovered that the water pump had failed and they brought in another pump. Water supply restored 30-45 mins later.The one that bothered me most is one they could not rectify: the last 2 nights of my stay, there was cigarette smoke smell wafting into my room through the ventilation or a/c system. Turning off the ventilation only reduces the amount of cigarette smoke smell, it still wafts in. You don't want to leave the windows open because of security, it's cold outside at night (7-10 degs celsius) and dusty outside too. My room was pretty far from the smoking rooms so I suspect one of the guests near my room in a non-smoking room was smoking. I spoke to the hotel staff both nights, but it never got resolved.I didn't sleep well those last 2 nights and I thought it was terrible for me health-wise. On the street, you could at least wear a mask to filter the dust, I don't think those dust masks will filter cigarette smoke that's stuck in your room.Until they resolve this, I will stay at another hotel my next trip to Kathmandu.

Suddenly one day the hotel´s courtyard was full of police and military. A police escort drew up. A delegation from the Ministry of finance were to hold a meeting at the hotel. Effective arrival arrangements, smooth, correct, secure. At the same time the hotel´s ambience is friendly, almost familiar. We had great help in planning activities and make them happen. It seems to me that most members of the staff knew our schedule day by day. Always available. Always friendly and considerate. Hotel Annapurna in Kathmandu has what I would expect of a five star hotel. A plus is the central location and 3 restaurants with different specialities. However, it is the staff who makes the five stars shine brightly.

Although the building itself is old, the room is well renovated and comfortable. The hotel with tradition and staffs have warm hospitality! The holy Annapurna shrine in the center of the lobby adds magnificence too. I'm sure I will stay here  if I have a chance to visit Kathmandu.  Please be noted that the casino within hotel premises are currently closed for the renewal construction.

I am revisiting this landmark property of Kathmandu after 30 years. Located at the heart of the city in Durber Marg, this hotel is one my all time favourite. In last 40 years I have travelled to 50 odd countries around the world and stayed in umpteen number of properties. Keeping that experience in mind, this property remains on the top 10 of the list of my liking. We were picked up from the airport by the trained team from the hotel. The property appears to have been refurvished recently keeping the old flavour intact. The open space with round boulevard, the well decored lobby all remain as before. The check-in was smoothed and we got warm welcome from the staff. We booked deluxe double room and was allotted Room No 2928 in the 1st floor. Room was quiet large with 2 separate queen sized bed. You have all required modern amenities like safe, fridge, coffee making facility. The modern attached toilet has bath tub with Bioteque toileteries. Great option.

We stayed here for two nights before and again after our 9 day trek.  Our first room was on the club floor and had a musty smell.  Fortunately when we returned from our trek we were given a Hermitage room for two nights that was much nicer, very clean and bright.  Breakfast is located outside of the hotel at The Coffee Shop.  The buffet was quite substantial and the wait staff attentive.  On the morning of our early flight to Lukla we were given very nice “breakfast to go boxes” which we ate at the airport.  We had dinner twice at the Arniko Room as it was very good and once at the Juneli Bar when we first arrived after a late flight.   This hotel is located close to the Thamel area where you can find rooftop restaurants and all kinds of shops.  Since our flight home departed in the evening we enjoyed spending the last few hours hanging out by the pool.Kathmandu is an amazing city and the Hotel Annapurna is a nice place to stay.

The hotel is centrally located and is within walking distance of most attractions and the shopping centres. The food is good and there is a good choice on offer for all meals at the main restaurant and coffee shop.  Facilities for the conference for which I was staying there were good, but could be better.  The rooms are small, but facilities are good.  The staff were happy to arrange a couple of excursions to visit old Kathmandu and provided good advise on shopping.

I stayed here at the end of a three country work trip and when I arrived I was so grateful to meet so many kind staff members. I dined in their signature restaurant alone each night and was treated like a princess. The housekeeping staff were incredibly wonderful also. The rooms are very quiet and that’s no small feat in bustling Kathmandu. I highly recommend this hotel for many reasons!

First, the location of the hotel is excellent. Nothing can beat this. It is like right in the hub of Kathmandu with shops and cafes all around. Second, staff is great. Housekeeping was one of the best in the recent times. Very thoughtful. Check in was a bit of an issue (which was resolved with intervention from the manager) but check out was smooth. Their restaurants are some of the best in town and I covered them separately. Their travel desk (operated by Yeti Travels) is pathetic and must be avoided. This was one bad experience during the entire stay. Even though the hotel was quick to inform that the desk is run by a third party but they should be concerned because it damages their own reputation as well. Taxi are always available 24 hours outside the hotel gate and are a much better option. I would surely stay here again when ever I come to this wonderful country again.

Seemed like quite a popular place for tourists and conventions when I was there in October. The good: great location in the heart of Durban Marg. KFC is just next door if you have a craving : ) The WiFi is decent, better (faster) than Hyatt. Rooms are clean and decent.The bad: no heating in rooms, only A/C, so be aware during winter! The walls are pretty thin, and the doors don't fit very well, so if someone's smoking in the corridor, the smell wafts into the room, especially if you turn off the A/C when you're cold...But overall, for Kathmandu, i would recommend this place.

I visit Nepal often and have been staying at this hotel. I find it very conveniently located to Airport and Darbar Marg. The staff is very polite and helpful. Rooms are very comfortable and rooms with view of pool or mountains are an added advantage.

I love to stay at Annapurna whenever business brings me to Kathmandu. The room and the bathroom are clean and neat. I would surely advise the management of the hotel to change the old bathroom fittings with the new modern ones.Very courteous staff, good food, efficient room service and charm of old era - all at one place, Annarpurna!! Please expect me again in February, 2018.

We stayed in the Hotel Annapurna. Everything was great! Nice bedrooms, great swimming pool and gym, very good Indian restaurant. We liked especially the staff. They were helpful all the time, especially a guy called Hari at the Coffee shop. I had a wonderful breakfast and a nice afternoon in that Coffee shop, the cakes were amazing !

My husband and I have been at Hotel Annapurna for 2 weeks. The hotel staff and restaurant staff are excellent. From check in to check out excellent. Our rooms were cleaned excellently every day.. we could see, from our room, the pool being cleaned early every morning, as well as the public areas, lobby, stairwell. Kathmandu is a dusty city, but you would never know it at this hotel. The hotel has great restaurants, but during a 2 week stay, we naturally ventured out. Mezze and Sams One Tree are within walking distance, good food, great service. If We return, we will definitely stay here again

The hotel stands on two gigantic pillars: HERITAGE and LOCATION. These two pillars aureate, unshakeable and dizzyingly tall, making the Hotel a great to be in. The Hotel is on the most prestigious avenue...the Durbar Marg itself; very centrally located with market place, eateries all around, including its own arcade.At the same time, it has a resort feel even though its in downtown...its sprawling and has a calming effect.The heritage comes through in its structure, its layout, its feel...if one is in a heritage city than a heritage hotel is the place to be in, right!But the hotel doesn't rest on its location and heritage. Except for one person at the reception, who kept frowning at me, coz he thought am leaving without checking-out, as I was escorting my wife out, who was going earlier, staff is really efficient, positive and full of warmth.Food too, is excellent. It provides for luxury hotel sophistication with street-food taste!But there are some concerns and perhaps, coz of the old structure. The room is well appointed, but is smallish, though not small; AC makes terrible noise; ventilation in the bathroom is not there, so smell doesn't leave us; the bathtub is so damn' narrow that one has to lie-in sideways to fit!Yeah, but will I go back to same hotel. Yeah, absolutely!

Katmandu sartlarinda fena degil..ancak otelin bir su aritma sistemi sorunu var.musluklardan 10 dakika boyunca camur akiyor.renk biraz daha acilinca dus alabiliyorsunuz..yemekler guzel..personel guleryuzlu ve yardimsever

I am standing in front of the Annapurna hotel awaiting a professional colleague for a meeting inside the 5* hotel. Without any warning--sign, verbal hand signal whatever--staff start to pressure hose the sidewalk with water.Leaves and dust fill the air, others also try to jump out of the way. The staff seem oblivious. Then the start to spray the lone tree in front, and as people walk underneath they are of course showered from the dripping leaves. This continues unabated for a full 15 minutes

This my 3rd time in nepal i went solo after my viste to  island peak. u need this hotel  to do a 5 stars relaxation super professional staff verry friendly  room was verry clean confortable verry safe great swimming pool  i miss u annapurna staff alot specially reception staff  and the redt bar 😘😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍😍I adore nepal.

Een mooi hotel met erg schone en ruime kamers. Vriendelijke mensen en erg goede restaurants. Een heel fijn verblijf gehad en genoten van de luxe. De bedden liggen ook  lekker en het internet is snel en goed. Een aanrader.

We were a party of 4, wanting to enjoy a good Indian dinner in Kathmandu. Famed Annapurna Hotel's restaurant is the place, we were told. So, there we went. Not only did we find the Indian dinner very disappointing both in terms of freshness of products (I probably should not have gone for the prawns!) and cooking altogether (such an overstated poor and basic cuisjne!) ... but the wine list happened to be the most obnoxious rip-off we've experienced in our travels, ever!The good thing about this dinner experience is that I will never repeat it myself. Maybe others can just avoid it in the first place.

This is one of Kathmandu's best hotels situated in Durber Marg near the former Royal Palace. I live half-time in Kathmandu have a pool membership at the hotel. It is definitely one of the best pools in town and the  poolside patio has  comfortable seating and lounge and excellent drinks and food service. The Hotel offers fine dining in its  Indian  restaurant and its restaurant featuring a Chinese menu. Both serve delicious and expertly prepared  food and feature attentive and congenial service. The hotel coffee shop has a hearty breakfast buffet and a good selection of dishes for lunch dinner or a snack in between meals .I've stayed in the well appointed and comfortable rooms here and i recommend you consider the Club Rooms  or Corporate Deluxe Rooms for extra comfort, space and special quality service. Room service is prompt, just like you want it to be!

Nice rooms excellent location enough space specially swing pools garden is amazing nice breakfast wide choice friendly staff always smiling the tall man Hari is outstanding care you alot amazing place I ll visit again when I come to Nepal....

Hotel Annapurna is very strategically located on the Durbar Marg very near to the palace. Durbar Marg is a very happening place with the very good shopping  and dinning options . The Hotel casino has closed down after the earthquake struck Nepal. The casino at Yak and Yeti is at a stones throw distance. The popular Thamel road is  in close proximity. The internet facility is very bad and needs improvement. The staff is very nice and cooperative. The hotel needs to gear up cleanliness and the housekeeping facilities.

We worked with Sonny in order to arrange our week long stay with Annapurna in the executive suites. The stay was overall pretty good with some possible updating needed to some of the rooms but overall very enjoyable. The staff was pretty attentive to the needs and requests of our group. We ate at the Kebab Restaurant downstairs and felt it was overpriced for the quality of the food. Once again though the higher management attempted to address any issues that the party had with any of the restaurants. The best poolside in Kathmandu and apparently they will be adding to their fitness center as well. To wrap it up the service was great, rooms were clean and orderly, and the restaurants needed a bit of attention. They were not nearly on par with the sister hotel Jagatpur Lodge that had some of the best service and food out of any hotel we have stayed at.

I have stayed at Annapurna many times in the last two years and never regretted my decision. Very courteous staff at all levels, excellent service. They go the extra mile to make your stay comfortable.The 3 restaurants have different ethnic menus with excellent selections.Great location. Walking distance from the palace and Thamel.

Before booking Hotel Annapurna, i read lot of reviews and few reviewers mentioned that it's old property. Yes, it's 53 years old property but that does not impact quality of  stay.  By far, best services I have ever received from any hotel across the countries I visited. Service staff was very attentive, in fact they come to room twice a day to check if we need water bottle/tea/coffee. Hotel is located at Darbar marg which one of the posh areas of Kathmandu.Thamel is just 1.5kms away and Narayanhiti Palace Museum is 200 meters away. Good restaurants and shopping options are just outside hotel.Because this property is established since last 53 years, it is very well-known in Kathmandu and no direction needed when you hire a cab.Worth to mention, breakfast has wide spread of vegetarian options.Totally loved it and will definitely go back if I will be in Kathmandu again.

Visited Kathmandu in August 2016, stayed one night in Annapurna hotel. Food was average, rooms were old and tired but still clean, but the toilet needs polishing. The location of the hotel is perfect as shopping is right across the corner street. Staff was great and accommodating. They have ghazal nights at the restaurant which was quite entertaining. Ensure that WiFi is inclusive while making the booking. Overall good experience. Special thanks to the security man outside for lending us his umbrella on a rainy day :)

Il mio voto è una media tra le due esperienze che ho avuto in questo albergo dove ho passato 3 notti. Le strutture generali dell'albergo sono di assoluto livello, un po' datate come stile, ma in ottime condizioni e piacevoli. Lobby, business center, piscina, ristorante, bar sono di livello per un albergo di questa categoria. Le note dolenti però sono per le camere, dove le categorie standard e deluxe sono invalutabili. Ho visto 3 stanze al mio arrivo, deluxe, tutte in zone periferiche: la prima stavi a stento in piedi, la seconda puzzava di muffa, la terza era sopra l'impianto centrale di condizionamento, praticamente eri sulle ali di in 767. Se volete pernottare in questo albergo partite dalle Executive o, meglio ancora, per le Club, quelle che alla fine abbiamo scelto noi.

The staff & food were the best but the hotel itself is very old and unclean. Felth smell is very where. The internet is disconnected regularly.Nothing to do in surrounding area.Has 3 restaurants. I liked Indian and Chinese.

This is one of the premier properties of Kathmandu. It is a charming property and reminds of the old 70s/ 80s luxury property. Like the ones you see in the old movies. Despite the old looks its looks very charming. I really liked it as it is different and not like all the new luxury hotels. The service is great. There is a very quick response and your requirements are met. The staff is a mix of older staff and new staff and then mix works pretty well.The restaurants do very well and are packed almost every day. We tried both and the Chinese one was better in terms of taste. The best part of the hotel is also its location. It is at the center of the Durbar Marg, Kathmandus main shopping and F and B street. Its lined with all kinds of eateries and shops so a great place to stay.

The hotel is at the middle of the city, and easy access to other spots in Kathmandu. I found two Juma Masjids in walking distance -  Kashmiri Masjid which has a Darga in it ( I had to find one without Darga [ie. shrine] ), so in another 100 meters,  I found Nepali Juma Masjid, without Darga. The poolside restaurant offers excellent food ( I had my dinner there)  I was not so impressed with the Heritage room as expected. room size is average, the furniture was not of the so called "Heritage" style and quality. Good ambience, quite and clean. CS team and room service are great.

The hotel is located in the heart of the city. And perhaps the best known road of Nepal (Durbar Marg). Incase you get tired of eating inside the hotel, plenty of options are available just adjacent to it. "The Coffee Shop" serves the food throughout the day. There are also plenty of options available inside the hotel. Like a dining place with live Ghazal or having food watching live match on a giant screen or a pool side meal is also available.KFC, PIZZA HUT, MOTI MEHAL are within walking distance. In case you want to hire a cab, travel desk from  "YETI TRAVELS" is available inside. Which offers a better competitive option in comparison to the taxi fare in India. Proximity to the Airport also helps (5kms).Overall a very satisfying stay.

It was my maiden trip to Nepal and Anna Purna was a recommended place by my travel agent. Though it is a treasure island of heritage structure, poor house keeping, dingy or foul smell all over rooms and fitness centure, has set us off. The only thing that was good is the food at the Indian Restraurant

Stayed here for four days for a work conference during first week of August and was impressed. Staff members were gracious, responsive and very capable. My room was one of the older ones on the first floor. It was fine for my purposes (comfortable beds, small desk, spotless (though tub was nicked and I thought initially it was not), AC very good, excellent shower water pressure and plenty of hot water, etc.) Rooms on renovated floors are substantially bigger and fancier though I assume more expensive  Outdoor pool is large and appears well-maintained. Morning breakfast and buffet lunch options were terrific-- staff there excellent too. On my first night, I sat in the formal restaurant listening to  three terrific Nepalese musicians and ate a delicious and generous plate of appetizers (pressed cottage cheese wrapped around mushroom, onions) and drank a large local beer (Gorka?) Staff made me feel welcome even though I wasn't eating a big meal. Lovely atmosphere. Conference rooms were excellent and varied options.

This was my fourth visit to the hotel in past year and a half. When a frequent business traveller as I return to the same hotel, there has to be pretty good reasons for it.Rooms are good. Washrooms need modern bath fittings. The buffet breakfast is very good. The room service is excellent. The ever smiling and caring front desk officers relax you when you return tired after a long days work. Shrishti, you are awesome!!

I stayed at this hotel twice in a matter of one week. First time room was at the ground floor and was not of good quality at all. I could find some flying objects in the room. Second the room was on third floor and it was good and well maintained. I always advise to skip rooms on the ground floor. The service is good but needs lot of refurbishing.

That was my dream travel, I was very excited. Hotel annapurna is in asia  P O Box 140, Durbar Marg, Kathmandu 14229, Nepal. I love to visit it in very near future. And suggest every one to visit once in your life time

The location of the hotel is really good. There are so many shops and restaurants for the tourists. The service of the hotel is really good. They greet the guests with a warm welcome and they are always there to serve the guests. The breakfast was really nice. The hotel is well maintained.I would love to stay there again in future. Really really had a great time there !

This was my third stay in this hotel. Was greeted like a family member by the staff. The room, while comfortable, could have used a coat of paint. Breakfast is nice although is very repetitive. For the purpose of my stay in Nepal this hotel meets my needs

In heart of the beautiful place Kathmandu, Cool place to relax, happening place near by to chill out. Ideal place for family and equally good for business meets etc. Courteous and friendly staff (from Top to bottom). I would like to take name of Ms. Dibya Shree for her commitment towards customers and the Hotel. Best Staff among all !! All the very best to her.Hotel is very beautiful, great food, nice swimming pool, good ambience. The bestest place to stay in Kathmandu. I have stayed here for over 50 nights and love to stay every time on my visit to Kathmandu.

The location of the hotel is really nice. There are so many shops and restaurants for the tourists. The service of the hotel is really great. They greet the guests with a warm welcome and they are always there to serve the guests. The breakfast was really nice. The hotel is well maintained. They have completed 50 yrs while i was in the hotel with my daughter. Received a small token of love from them which  was really sweet of them. I would love to stay there again in future. Really really had a great time there !

The Hotel is truely very beautiful & also secured.The food is very good and specially Shanti,who was in reception was very kind.I was there for 2 nights & I must say it was a very pleasant stay with excellent hospitality & services.Looking forward to visiting again.

Right at the centre of the city close to the palace and the happening areas, but in a calm and serene location. The hotel has a great swimming pool and other open spaces to take small walks. One of the best Chinese/ Oriental restuarant you can find in Katmandu. Breakfast at Hotel Annapurna is also very satisfying.

Minging toilet, carpet and smell in room. Bed was hard so I couldn't roll over and fart comfortably. Aircon was very old, smelt like dust, gave me a nosebleed and sounded like an airplane taking off. Overcharged us by pretending that paying cash upfront would mean we get a special reduced rate. Realised that online the price was half of what we paid. Asked for hotel to refund us what we overpaid and they simply said no. I hate them all. Everyone has told me that people in Nepal are among the nicest in the world, not in this hotel. They are not genuine and have took advantage that we're English and travelling.

Old property, they need transformation if they call them self 5star. Noise rooms, all the time you will feel that you are in the market.Very bad breakfast, you ask for anything they will deny. Their masala chai is good.Pool side is excellent.

Firstly the hotel itself isn't the issue Though it's an older buildingIt's not been maintained well  It's the staff who are rude and absolutely horribleNoisy corridors smells of cigarettes So many functions so it's noisy and smells constantly The main manager Deepak was rude and not helpful at all Gym was smell The pool was dirty and not cleaned for days I would never stay here

nice hotel not too far from the main tourist area of Thamel in Kathmandu. Food is above average with a good (not great) chinese restaurant  and slightly better Indian restaurant within it. Breakfast is good and the main bar has a nice feel to it. the whole place actually feels a little tired and badly needs refurbishment which I believe is on the cards. The swimming pool is amazing and huge! main downer for me was the poor wi-fi- which requires constant signing in. if you are there on business, this is pretty irritating . all in all though,   a good hotel, nice staff generally and facilities that are pretty good. I liked it.

The hotel is very best and serves the best nepali hospitality.really amazed and fell in love with the city. The hotel has very nice staff specially Mrs Dibya Shree Bhattatai, Guest Service Manager and whole staff of hotel, who coordinated with us during our 20 days stay. Our international players from worldwide enjoyed their hospitality.And about me , See I want come here Again n again n again. Best wishes to allThank you and RegardsParwinder Manhera CEO, APL

Excellent place to stay. Been here many times. Feels very relaxed and comfortable. The ambience, front office staff specially madam shristi and Shanti, and all service staff are very courteous and welcoming. Food quality is awesome.Wonderful experience to be here.

Very beautiful hotel, great location, courteous and helpful staff. Within walk-able distance to many authentic and multi-cuisine restaurants. Close to two big shopping centers and branded outlets. Best in house Indian restaurant makes it feel like home cooking. Highly recommend for short or long stay.

Property not new, but had basic amenities. Good enough for a business trip. Thamel is about 15 minutes walk from hotel. Has good restaurant, handicraft shops nearby. Swimming pool and compact gym is also there.

This hotel is not a typical back packers hotel and rather caters to businessmen and families.  The place is rather spacious however, rooms are budget type.
