The bathroom has good hot water supply which was to my surprise.The service is courteous however, a bit slow in Western standards.The breakfast is served at the coffee shop with a large variety of food but lacks good quality.The bar has good service however, the Chinese restaurant is average or perhaps below average.The hotel has a sister property called Fish Tail Lodge however, I didn't have time to visit the Lodge.

It is centrally located making it easier for conveyance. Rooms are well decorated with most modern amenities. With full of cordial hospitality it enriches a pleasant stay always. Quality of food and promptness in services is helpful for all to carry sweet and positive experience back home.

Great location,  and wonderful staff - very attentive to details .Enjoyed very relaxing swim after  all day struggle walking and driving  through the dusty city . The Annapurna offers a perfect oasis in the middle of the busy capital city .

This hotel is located in the prime area,with good open space. Rooms are big in size and well maintained.Swimming pool is big in size n well maintained.variety of food with delicious taste. Flawless transport service from airport to hotel. Reception staff is excellent n prompt in service. Overall its worth staying.

Stayed at this hotel for 2 nights during a business trip. Overall a great hotel with comfortable rooms, clean bathrooms and standard facilities, including a large swimming pool and gym. The breakfast spread is good and offers Indian, Oriental and Western choices. There are restaurants in the hotel which offer good Chinese and Indian cuisines. Location of the hotel is perfect - right in the heart of the town with several shops and restaurants near by. Thamil (popular hangout area for tourists) is at a 10-15 min walking distance and offers many more restaurant choices.  Point of note is that this hotel is a local hotel and not part of an international chain like Hyatt or Marriott. The hotel will be going renovation around end 2017, so please check on availability before booking.

Нас сюда поселила авиакомпания, когда была задержка рейса. Мне повезло, попался номер люкс. Ну все супер просто. И чай, и халат, и тапки , и рабочее место, и комфортная температура, и приятный запах. Один только минус, интернет платный. Вроде 15$. Бесплатный есть в холе. Кормят по королевски. Не знаю Скока это стоит все, но было круто. Спасибо. Если вернусь в Катманду, то только к вам!

The din and bustle of Kathmandu can be experienced directly from the hotel. The very location of the hotel in Durbar marg makes it a preferred place for business travellers. With many shops around the hotel including food joints, souvenir shops and  brand outlets, the accessibility quotient is high. The hotel amenities are good. The people factor is less customer centric and more formal and bureaucratic.

Good quality hotel. The front office team was very helpful in managing the group reservation, made Internet available on the first day for all and made all the arrangements we requested. Breakfast is good and restaurant options varied.

Every time I come to Kathmandu I try different hotel to stay . This time I have chosen Annapurna for a day stay .The review is as followsAirport pickup - flawless very fast , easily identifiable and they have communicated the fleet in charge no in mail . It was easy for flawless pickup Checkin - lighting speed and I am able to checkin in 5 minutes Rooms - the rooms are highly spacious with master lighting and ac console near your bed to control mood lighting , ac temp and don't disturb etc . Telecom - it is little cumbersome to identify the exact service from the contact booklet and it is suggested to keep a plycard of key nos like reception , house keeping , travel , room service else we have to scroll the booklet which is little outdated .The tv are outdated one ie LCD management can upgrade all the TVs to UHD or full HD TVs which can add quality value to the service they offer.Room service - very clear and fast and the taste of food were really good 😊. Pool - very big one and you should have quality time to spend on this .Party hall - massive party hall and can facilitate bigger functions Coffee shop - you have to walk out of the main building and it is annexe . Big one . Lot of variety  to enjoy They have small shopping outlets , spa etc . Bigger parking and massive complex of land space . Real heritage stay Good hotel to enjoy with family and friends

Purpose: I stayed in the hotel for 4 nights and had two small dinner events (one in the banquet and another in the restaurant)First impression: Horrible due to the unprofessional front desk staff but the Guest service manager Ms. Dibya made up to it. She didn't only sorted my issue but also tried her best to make my stay better. Professional like hers are what bring the difference so specially mentioning her name.Facilities: Good, I have stayed in other hotels in Kathmandu too so this one is good if not the best.Food: Perfect except for the breakfast spread which is annoyingly limited.All in all I would stay again only due to the professionalism and customer orientation of the said Guest services manager.

One of the worst five-stars hotel I have ever been to . They have a lousy internet service, Lousy views, very loud music with horrible sound insulation . The facility is really old and claustrophobic very low ceiling and very dirty pool . The rooms aren't clean you will always find dust and maybe even some rust . The furniture is very old although they have updated the operating system of the room trying to make it smart . Food is the only good thing in this restaurant and location for sure.

I booked online and could only get a 'Club' room although it was unclear what additional benefits this involved. The booking staff were excellent throughout and very helpful in arranging pickup from the airport and a car and guide for later in our stay. However, reception staff are surly almost to the point of being rude. The room was tired and lacking in charm. It had a view of a huge marquee that had been put up for a meeting and the swimming pool was empty. We only had one set of towels in the room and had to call reception 4 times before they eventually appeared.The location of the hotel is good, right by the National museum and Thamel but there are many other hotels to choose from and therefore strongly recommend trying others first as the Annapurna offers nothing special.

One of the oldest hotels in Kathmandu, Annapurna delivers all the basics of a 5 star hotel and leaves no room for complaints. Does it leave an impression or is there an extra ordinary service or incident to recall and cherish ? - No. Another good hotel like in any other city.!!

I stayed here for 2 nights before a week long trek, then for 6 nights for business on my return.  I had absolutely no complaints until now - clean, large and well accommodated room, friendly and helpful staff. I ate almost every meal on the premises with no complaint BUT ... on the Saturday afternoon/evening I had to vacate my room - which as I found out on the Friday is directly beside the "party area" because the music (EDM) was so loud it was driving me crazy.  A $17.50USD gin  and tonic in the bar was almost worth the expense to escape the noise, but after a prolonged 2 hour dinner with the same intent I returned to my room for the same soundtrack. This is a business hotel, I have emails to get through and 18 hours of flying/travel tomorrow.  I don't mind this music when I'm "in da club" (actually listen to it a lot)  but NOT when I'm paying over $100USD and night and WITHOUT PRIOR NOTICE!  I feel ripped off, cranky and tired.  A call to reception assures me the music ends at 9pm, and without wanting to sound like a cranky old person, please Annapurna let your guests know so they can make other arrangements.  I am travelling alone but still would have planned an evening away from the hotel had I known. I really hate to spoil an otherwise great experience with this but it has left a sour taste in my mouth.  Make sure you request a room with EVEN NUMBERS unless you want to drop a few pingers and get in the mood while in your hotel room.  Some warning next time Annapurna, I've spent a LOT of money at your hotel and expect a bit more consideration.

Temiz odalar,güleryüzlü personel iyi tarafları.Odalarda internet çekmemesi,olmaması enteresan.İnternet sadece lobinin bir kenarında. Kahvaltı biraz zayıf olsa da Avrupa'dan 5 kat daha iyiydi.Şehir merkezinde olması artı.

Been to this place many times in Kathmandu and as beautiful as always, Nice and beautiful hotel with big rooms and bath rooms. Service is par excellence. Hospitality is very good, Budget hotel in Kathmandu, Food is also very good.

I didn't stay at the hotel but went there to catch the bus to Pokhara which leaves at 7am. I went to their coffee shop to have a cup of coffee while I waited and saw that there was a buffet breakfast for the guests so ordered tea and served myself a tiny bowl of yogurt. When the bill came it was 750 rupee which is outrageous when you can get tea in any cafe in town for 100. The tea was 375 rupees and the yogurt was 400! When you know that you can get a decent meal n town for 200 rupees, I felt scammed. When I complained, the breakfast manager  offered no apology. He also did not produce an itemized bill which I found odd. He was surly and haughty and made me feel like I was cheap for finding the price excessive. He finally backed down and offered 100 off the yogurt which wasn't much considering I could have had  a big dinner for the same price. I'll never go back and hope management will realize their prices are scandalous and their staff unwelcoming, unprofessional and cold. While he was trying to project an air of polished indifference, he came off as inflexible and churlish. Time for some customer service training .

I have stayed here before also, but this time I was allotted room in heritage wing. Room is small but nice. House keeping and laundry is prompt. Food in Ghare kabab is good. Breakfast in coffee shop can be improved. It is not very fresh and lacks authentic taste in Indian vegetarian. Pest control service is really effective and perfect. There is full life in lobby and a happening place. Wi if is complementary but slow and you need to log in again after couple of hours. I stayed for three nights and stay was quite comfortable.

I always stay in Annapurna, which is minimum of 3 times a year. each visit averaging 3-5 days. I write this to bring a few things to their attention. This time I got a room viewing the coffee house. The water was super dirty. I complained the first day. I finally got a room change on the 3rd day, still the water was not very clean. The excuse given was that they use bore well water in Nepal, which is acceptable, but I guess they need to check their water quality. I got my welcome fruits on the 3rd day. There was no coffee cup or hand towel in the first room, I was allotted (which meant that probably they did not do a thorough check before they gave the room to me). Otherwise, location is great. Hopefully the pool and fitness room get refurbished soon.
風塵僕僕從印度來到尼泊爾，安排住在德爾安納普爾納酒店，接待大堂豪華高雅，房間漂亮乾淨，住酒店有含早餐，wife 在大廳是免費的，回房可要付費的又，酒店周邊都是商店街，是在鬧區市中心。

I have recently stayed in the Annapurna hotel for my last business trip. As a frequent visitor i normally stay at the Radisson or Hayat and this was my first stay in Annapurna. It was a comfortable stay and the stand out was friendliness of the staff, It is centrally located in t Darbar Marg that is the upscale shopping area of Kathmandu. I was initially checked in the Deluxe room but since my room had frosted windows an I like my sunshine, I changed into a Club Room. Positives:The change was smooth. Room was decent sized, clean.Iron and safe deposit box available with a bath tub. Good supply of round the clock HOT water. Friendly staffBreak fast was not a huge spread but it was good enough for me.Room service timing was goodNegatives:There was a party hall beside my room and the music was clearly audible. Was ok for me but may not be ok for those wanting some quiet time.Ate at the restaurant below. Food was OK but service was slow. I was the only customer and i had to remind them to get my bill after waiting.Air conditioning was not up to the mark but thankfully weather was cool All in all it was a decently good stay. The swimming pool was under maintenance so could not try it.

Hotel is located on a wide road, with a huge parking lot entrance to its beautiful and vibrant lobby. The hotel is abuzz with tourists, army officials, office goers, business clients et al. The hotel has a to and fro shuttle for airport transfers, which is good. You can locate a placard calling out 'Hotel Annapurna' at the arrival terminal and head straight to the representative.Wifi: Complimentary wifi is offered for your stay with a user id and password available at the reception. They will proactively give it to you. The speed isn't much - 512kbps. It is good for basic emails. High speed internet packages are available on wifi at a price from the reception.Rooms: Pillows are pathetic. I hated them. They are thick and hard; and considering that sleep matters to me the most, the first two nights costed me a bad headache in the morning. Had to continuously ask the reception and housekeeping attendant to get me a soft pillow or anything that is thin for my neck. A soft pillow came to my room after 2 nights of torture. Please ask early on, if you are a soft pillow person. I stayed in a double bed room which was large with a spacious bathroom attached. Toiletries, towels etc are provided. Hot/Cold water in shower and washbasin is available. Room lights are easily controllable from a small panel on the side table of the bed. Now, downside is no one will explain the lights and the panel to you. If you are lucky enough to see it, you will be able to control the lights easily. Quite user friendly. However, I didn't locate the panel at first, kept trying to find the switches for the lights on the walls. These remained switched off for the first 2 days of my stay and I used the side table lamp only. Complained a couple of times about lights not working to the reception and to the housekeeping attendant while leaving the room. Nothing was fixed while I returned by late evening. Well I finally figured it out on my own! The panel is a good step. All lights within the reach of a hand.Spa: Didn't visit the spa so won't comment on it. Services are available from 8.00am till 6.30pm. Placed just outside the hotel building.Restaurants: Service is crisp and staff is attentive. There is a Bar, a Chinese restaurant, an Indian restaurant and a Coffee shop. Chinese restaurant is not really an authentic chinese; but food is good. Indian restaurant has beautiful live ghazals being sung, and the music leaks out into the lobby through its open doors and will make you want to go inside! Coffee shop is outside the hotel building, but within the fence. It has good momos / dimsums available. Food is good everywhere. Breakfast in coffee shop is good with Indian, Oriental, Japanese and western options. Fresh fruits, canned juices, idli, sambhar, momos/dimsums, sauteed greens, fried rice, baked beans, tofu soup, okayu (japanese), porridge, eggs to order, sausages, bacon, croissants, tea cakes etc.Annapurna seems like a business hotel, lacking in personalised, warm, at ease service. But then, who needs it, when you will stay out of the hotel all day. Most of your requests will be attended to, albeit with a straight face.

Habitacíones espaciosas y tranquilas si se visita en invierno son un poco frias, tienen para regular la calefacción pero no funciona ya que lo regulan desde la central del hotel.La atención del personal muy buena.El desayuno tipo bufet esta muy bien.El hotel esta centrico, a pocos metros de la parte antigua.Tiene wifi gratuito en una parte del salon.

I was in this hotel for 6 nights. This premises was kind of peaceful compared to the crowd of the city center, even though it is a very popular place for meetings and weddings at its hall rooms/conference rooms/pool side space. Being a hotel of 50 years old, rooms are not that fancy. But they are comfortable and clean with all amenities you might need.Staffs are really nice and helpful. Room service was excellent. Food was probably the best in Kathmandu. Because of my meetings taking place in the conference room of the hotel, I spend almost a whole week inside the hotel; but did not feel suffocated! I enjoyed my stay.

This Hotel clean and convenient for restaurants and beauty shop outside hotel , change money  but  no WiFi free in the room and Feb 2017  Pool still underproduction . Breakfast is okay, Stuff - Soap, Shampoo is Quality.

Had lunch at the Hotel Annapurna Cafe and Bakery and it was excellent. The hotel is very upscale with many Western amenities. It has good food and Western style service. It makes for a great place for a meetings while having some good food.

A warm and friendly stay, in a high functioning and safe business environment.  The staff were polite and helpful and the restaurants served great Indian food and the bar was a relaxing refuge. A decent pool exists and an efficient and trustworthy travel agent operates within.

The hotel has a very Vintage looking exterior . However its modern facilities inside. Right at the hear of the Action on Durbar Marg. Rooms are well maintained and ample toiletries are provided. Our request for a King size bed/Smoking Room was so well accommodated. In fact the Breakfast(included in Room rate) is such a good spread both for Vegetarians and Non Vegetarians. They make your preferences so easily serviced.They have a great Indian food restaurant as well. We really enjoyed our stay as -There is no disturbance and your privacy is well respected. The staff is very endearing & hospitable.

The team at this hotel is what makes it outstanding. I have stayed in many five star hotels with similar decor and amenities but it's the staff that made the difference. There were lots of times, the team went the extra the mile, like keeping the bar open for myself and my friends and family, to providing us with extra toiletries or the fast room service. The stand out moment though was when I was feeling very unwell on the last day after check out (due to a meal I had OUTSIDE the hotel the previous day) and my wife asked if we could get a room to rest in until our evening flight. Seeing that I was visibly unwell, the hotel manager was very accommodating and let us have a complimentary room even though we offered to pay. A noble gesture to say the least. Thank you.

Hotel Annapurna Kathmandy is on the Durbar Square Road of Kathmandu. It is ideally located . The most happpening place of Kathmandu, Thamel Square and Thamel Street are very nearby. The hotel rooms are very quite and the rooms are very spacious. Except for the fact that  when there is any function on the lawns, there is so much disturbance in the ground floor rooms. The staff are courteous. Excellent place to relax

Have spent many holidays in Kathmandu, stayed at Annapurna for the first time.The hotel lives up to its old school charm. Very warm staff, also gave us free access to the new year party. Amazing location, walking distance to thamel and the castle, great breakfast spread and well appointed rooms

By Chance we got an opportunity to stay here in Hotel Annapurna for one night as our AI Flight got terminated. But after spending 3 nights Radison it was a great experience. Food was best,Service was excellent and staff was very frotel is classy and the stay was amazing. In fact,It remove all pain for Raddison and i recommend this Hotel if you are in Kathmandu with Family.

Service is excellent at this hotel, from front office staff, doormen to the bar staff.  Always with a smile and very helpful and accomodating. It's obvious they have been well trained - a hallmark of a good hotel.The property itself is very comfortable though the decor needs a bit of a refresh (especially in the rooms).Lots of dining options (including Chinese and Indian) though we preferred to venture out. The internet access is a bit of an issue, as they are still issuing coupons which can be a bit tricky (need to login everytime you come back to the hotel).

A convenient hotel which is suited well to the business and tourist traveller - well appointed rooms accompanied by good service. A very good Indian restaurant in the lobby also a Chinese. Relaxing pool area with well stocked bar - what more do you need!

This is a very good place. Perfectly maintained and very nice and warm staff. They take care of you well. Lacks local food options though. But can take care to give you nice International option for food.

Stayed here for two nights at this 50 year old hotel. Though some upholstery and carpets may need change urgently, a very iconic hotel on the busy central district of city. Staff are very courteous and helpful. Breakfast was adequately sumptuous. Definitely value for money.

You'll get a very friendly welcome and excellent service at this hotel.  There are several dining/restaurant options on-site, but also many within easy walking distance.  This hotel is also close to many of the main attractions in the city.  The rooms are clean and of good size.

This was the first hotel we stayed in during our Nepal-India trip. While it is classed as 5* it is probably more 4*. The rooms are comfortable and clean, the overall feeling is it needs a little freshening up. We enjoyed having snacks and drinks for dinner in the bar and the waiter was very helpful with suggestions. On the second night we used the Indian food dining room - service was very slow but the live music was an enjoyable bonus.

hotel is five star very ancient building,modern fecilities are made avilabale,god rooms are on back side of the hotel,staff and recption are very nicelocated in center of city with market and malls are around

What a sweet spot.  Beautiful grounds.  Centrally located.  Clean rooms. ..nice lobby.  Beautiful pool;  not heated. ..Polite staff. ..Just checked in.  So far so good. ..Hope there's a cold, crisp glass of white wine for me in the lobby!

This hotel is located on Dubar Marg - the high street of Kathmandu and is walking distance to Thamel. Rooms are clean and comfortable with lot of dining option in and around the hotel. In the evening one can pass time by walking on Durbar Marg, visiting the casino or going to Thamel for dinner. Service at this property is good. Value for money property.

I went with my friends and stayed for 2 days and Had good time .Rooms were Neat and clean and staff was also Helpful.It has large and Attractive Swimming pool .Food is also freshly cooked and Tasty.If you are Fast Food lovers ,Outside the Hotel you have Pizza Hut and KFC..

Annapurna is a modern international hotel well located in the central area of Kathmandu.  It is set back from the busy road, so relatively quiet.  The reception / front desk service is first rate, and the rooms are well-fitted and comfortable.  There's a large and attractive swimming pool behind the hotel.  Breakfast is served in the adjacent coffee shop and is an extensive and eclectic buffet.  So far so good!  Only complaints: the bedroom carpets needed a bloody good clean, and the air-conditioning appeared only to do "cold" - as it can be quite chilly in Kat in the evenings, a bit of warmth wouldn't go amiss.  (I had two different rooms, and these problems existed in both of them).

Good hotel with two great restaurant choices, breakfasts were good too.Location is good and central to most things, relatively close to the Durbar Square and the local markets. Also a walk to Thamel.If a non smoker ensure you get a non smoking room

Let me just say that I have never slept here, as I live and work in KTM. But I use this hotel to hold my workshops, so I know a lot about the venue from a business perspective. One word: Awesome. While the building is rather old - the first 5-star in KTM - the staff make any visit enjoyable. They are great!

カトマンズ観光のために４泊しましたホテルは３階建てです、宿泊した部屋は新しくモダンな感じがしました。館内にはインド料理と中華料理のレストランがあり、朝食は玄関を出たところの別棟のレストランで頂きました朝食のメニューは豊富で満足しました、特に自家製のヨーグルトが美味しかったですホテル前にはタクシーが客待ちしていますので、バクタプール、パタン、パシュパティナートなどへ行くときに利用しましたダルバール広場へも歩いてけますスタッフはいつも笑顔で対応してくれます、玄関のドアマン兼ガードマンが出入りの度に敬礼してくれました

The reception was quick and answered all the questions quickly. The food was excellant and the rooms, though small was clean and presentable. The pool was nice. A little shallow but hey, it's not the olympics.

I landed in this vintage hotel running a temperature and with a bad cough.The hotel staff was very kind and dosed me with honey lemon drinks ,warm salt water gargles etc so that I was soon feeling recovered enough to continue with my work. Thank you very much for your kindness !! .The location is good you can do your shopping and eating out without  wandering too far. But definitely  the hotel is old and will need some refurbishment soonThe Chinese restaurant is good. I recommend the honey potatoes, a new dish for me .This was not my first stay and hope it wont be the last.

This vintage hotel is centrally located and is a great place to put up. I started for 8 days in April with a room overlooking the swimming pool. The hotel is surrounded by interesting cafes and gourmet restaurants and shopping markets. It is easy to hop into a cab and go to Thamel or any other landmark around. Also, do try the Chinese restaurant on the ground floor!

Beautiful hotel in a good area. Book online for a good price. There is a bit of a humidity problem and a corresponding moldy smell in the hallways and rooms. Seems like a common problem but the Yak and Yeti Hotel (across the street) has dealt with it somehow. The breakfast is good, but can get a little boring after a few days. The main highlight of this hotel is the staff. They are AMAZING! They are very polite and attentive and went above and beyond on quite a few occasions. I had to change rooms due to noise. I did not get a response to a phone call, only when I went to the front desk was my issue resolved, and quickly. The housekeeping staff was also meticulous and sweet. I felt like the Annapurna was my home due to the level of care taken. The concierge is an angel. His smile will forever be in my mind.Shopping tip: 5-10 minute walk: Walk out the main gate and turn right. Keep walking (pass the fancy shops and a KFC) till you get to a stairs overpass cross the stairs and veer left and you'll be in a local marketplace. Good prices and bargain hard. Think 25% less.

Centrally located .. Very friendly staff .. Good food wid various options including a fine dining restaurant with live indian music . Coffee shop and the cake shop serves U one of the best cakes and pastor ties in katmandu . Location of the hotel is very central where the main road of Katmandu Darbar Just at a minutes walk

I recently stayed at hotel annapurna during my visit to kathmandu. The hotel is seemingly a 5 star but the services are not at all unto the mark ( may be by nepalese standards) The hotel lobby is unimpressive and quite small like a street path. the rooms are too small to even breathe, forget about stretching even. The restaurant spread is below average and costly and not worthy of it. The only plus is a big and well maintained swimming pool and the location of the hotel. The property is very near to narayanniti palace and the central market place.

My buddy & me stayed in this hotel for 4 nights (12th - 16th Sept 2016).First impression wasn't too good as there were no porters to help us with our luggages (as we arrived pretty late - around 10pm) & the room given to us was right at the end of the corridor with window frosted up as room was facing some water tank outside.What impressed me later was the hot water shower - so powerful 😄 and the bath towels were huge!! Then there is this lobby on same floor as our room designated for smokers like me!All in all the 4 nights stay at Annapurna Hotel was pleasant and I called it home whenever we came back tired after sight seeing or shopping. Staffs were pretty friendly and we even had a complementary breakfast at the smoking lobby one morning!! Not a bad choice after all 😊

The reception was rather cool when we arrived, but the rest of our 4 days stay was greeted with warm smiles and "Namaste"! Room has all the basic amenities of a modern hotel including plenty of hot water.  No fear of electricity cuts as the hotel generator clicks in within seconds of a glitch. A short walk from the hotel and you are in the hustle bustle of Thamel. What I enjoyed most is having our breakfast served every morning on the balcony above the pool (on request, of course!)  What I liked least was the wifi, which is only available for 2 phones per day.

I stayed in this hotel during my last business trip to Kathmandu & enjoyed there. The hotel is very clean but bit expensive. Evening candlelight dinner with Hindi songs by artists was memorable experience.

We stayed at the Hotel Annapurna off and on for 3 weeks.  It was a home base.  The hotel is close to the shopping district.  The hotel is great for setting up drivers and tours. Service was excellent. Very accommodating with the fuel crisis. Beautiful country!

One of the few well established hotel in Kathmandu. Nearby tourist hub of Thamel shopping streets, all in one tourists must visit place. For the comfort of tourists, the hotel can arrange travelers need for various tours such - cultural, trekking, spiritual, leisure and more.

Attend a program for mover and seeker, ambiance inside the banquet hall was excellent, area inside the hotel was cool, reception area was upto the standard, the service staff were attentive, hi tea was great. Where as on the other hand there was frequent problem in sound system. Which was quit unexpected from the property like that where as need to pay for parking in five star property 😀😀😀

Viaje junto a mi hijo que tenía un año de no ver, él andaba de mochilero y deseaba premiarlo en un lugar cómodo, efectivamente recibí por lo que pague, el hotel en sí es muy bonito, limpio y el personal amable adicionalmente que está perfectamente ubicado

We were here for about a week the warmth of hospitality and care, that touched all of us the most. Besides the quality services and facilities, the cordiality of the staff is the main attractions of hotel Annapurna. I am sure if any of us come back to Nepal we will surely stay here.

I stayed at this hotel with my wife in the month of July.The locality is very good but rest all worst.Even being a five star hotel very rude staff. When asked for any directions or site seeing point they did not have any suitable response.All room boys and security watchman just seems to be in wish of great tips.If you call Taxi inside the lobby taxi charge horribly high.Nothing gr8 about this other then locality.Lack of maintainable and cleanliness.Nowhere near to be called as five star category.

I resign my loneliness to design my life with Kathmandu. Its' awesome scenario in temple fragrance in every room which I like very much. I think Nepal can be a real flavor of frequent traveler. Don't forget to travel Pokhra, lake, its mountain.

First time stayed in this Hotel. Never expected such an experience. Old rooms, having low head room inside the room. Very old Bath  though spacious. Room is dingy , low in light. Not enough space to move around inside. House keeping no response. Bathroom amenities not maintained. Just lip service. Location is huge advantage nothing else. Free WiFi too slow, again just namesake free. Free Breakfast - Daily same spread ! Quality and Taste is ok. This is my first and last stay. Not felt value for for money
ホテル入り口からもセキュリティーもしっかりしており、スタッフも親切で素敵な笑顔で接していただきました。ルームサービスの女性たちも笑顔で接してくれ細かい配慮もしていただきました。次回もうかがいたいと思います。

Located in the heart of Kathmandu near the king's palace, they feature variety of themed restaurants, the pool side features contemporary cuisine. Staff are very friendly, weather was amazing by the pool. The hotel is active and feature various local bands & cultural music.

Business takes me to Kathmandu often. Courteous and very helpful staff of Annapurna compel me to go there.I get something more, extra and better every time I have stayed here. The staff - at the front desk, at the coffee shop, or at any of the restaurants are all good.I don't think i would ever have the need to look for another hotel. I dont think i will get bored or fed up with Annapurna.Great work, keep it up?

Prime location, easily accessible. Good choices of food and approachable staff. We were the only people in the dining room , so it appeared less busy. As the room does not have natural ventilation it appeared a bit dark , decor could be improved. Food was fantastic though which was more important for us as it was a special occasion. Perhaps dinner time would be more attractive for visitors as the room would be well lit and certainly would have more hustle and bustle.

If you are looking for the following 1. Good location. It's near the Thamel district, within walking distance and there are plenty of eating places nearby 2. Access. The roads leading to the hotel is wide as there are a lot of narrow roads like those in Thamel which could be a problem for cars to access especially during raining days. Something one might consider. 3. Facilities. Most facility one would expect in a hotel like pool, gym, F&B. Gym is a bit small and under-equipped, otherwise doable. Only downside i would mention here is the internet speed is slow by international standard but otherwise i would think it's normal by local standards. I hope it would be upgraded to fibre connectivity rather than through a local wifi service provider. Overall, a good option for business traveller.

When you first arrive at Annapurna Hotel, you are greeted royally, with the sense that every guest matters to the staff. Nothing really changes through the course of your stay.I was in Kathmandu on business for a week, and decided to try a heritage property in lieu of the more traditional American choices like the Radisson or Hyatt. Annapurna is more centrally located, too, which made it a good choice.Pros: amazing and attentive staff, airport transfers, club lounge with breakfast and cocktail hour, spacious rooms with good bathroom amenities, beautiful swimming pool, classic bar, excellent Chinese and Indian restaurant on property, good security, pretty lobby.Cons: no real fitness Center (or one that would be vaguely on par with a US hotel chain), no real "hot" showers, wifi was extremely slow (less than 1 Mbps), too much ambient light in the room for a light sleeper.I would certainly return to this hotel but only for a family vacation. As a business traveler, I prioritize a good gym, and Annapurna simply doesn't have one.

Wonderful hotel with excellent facilities and best location. Best part is breakfast and the availability of different restaurants.  Live music in the Darbar e khas is another feature of this hotel. It is at a walking distance towards Thamel.  For those looking for western food Pizza HUT and KFC both are just around the corner.

The hotel is spread on a vast land in the heart of durbar marg. The hotel stay experience is exquisite with absolutely quality rooms, great service, spacious interiors, quite a few sit out locations inside the hotel, lovely coffee shop, beautiful swimming pool and royal facade.  The surrounding is the happening area for shopping and hosts a few malls too. The distance isn't much to the core shopping areas of kathmandu for authentic local shopping. All in all it's a great stay point and an amazing hotel to make your stay comfortable.

The hotel ambience is very nice. Rooms are spacious enough and clean. Free wi-fi is only available in the ground floor. In room it is paid. Food is ok. This is at a center space where you can walk out and have some shopping also. The staff are kind and cool.

Dont get me wrong. The hotel is nice and is great to stay. I have been a regular there and have always stayed there whenever I visit, Kathmandu, which is often. But Last time I was pretty unimpressed. The check out took way too much time than required. There was no clarity among the staff about payments. Second, I had asked for Shuttle at 11.30 am. They said 12 would be fine and I said okay but I was kept awaiting till 12.30 pm. The shuttle driver, when asked about delay mentioned that the hotel staff did not inform him. I almost missed my flight. However, location wise its good. Staff okay too. Walking distance to Thamel. Pool clean and nice. Wi fi speed is decent.

I stayed in Annapurna on a business trip in May'16. Though the property is slightly dated but it is wonderfully located in upmarket Durbar Marg. Thammel is also just 5 minutes walk from here. What I liked most about this Hotel is that the service standard is very good. I only had breakfasts in this hotel and no major meals so I cannot comment about food in restaurants but breakfast was reasonable, nothing fancy. Overall a good experience.

Very good location in the heart of the city, accessible and surrounded by restaurants and shopping facilities. Nice rooms and food, and above all, lovely friendly staff that makes you feel at home. I highly recommend it for Kathmandu visitors.

Room was good. Food was very nice too. Have a great pool. Can go with children. Right in the heart of the city.Nice place to organize an exhibition. Staff is warm and courteous. Have a shopping area just outside the Hotel

Located in the city center surrounded by restaurants of different tastes, a stone's throw from the palace museum and a 10min walk to Thamel this is a nice play to stay. The courteous staff will greet you every time they pass you. The rooms are very comfortable. The breakfast spread at the adjoining coffee house though has all you would get in a European spread differs in taste and quality. The swimming pool is nice, fitness center modest and wi fi signal average. But the overall feeling is good.

This is the hotel where I have stayed at least 6-7 times during my visits to Kathmandu. The hotel is centrally located in Durbar Square which is also a good place for shopping or just walking around. The hotel staff are very courteous and the food, especially Indian dishes are very good.  The Indian restaurant Ghar-e-kabab offers a great ambience at night with live soulful music and a romantic atmosphere. The Chinese restaurant Arniko Room also serves good food.

Went for 2 weeks and used Annapurna as base when we were in Kathmandu so had 3 different rooms.Good central location, close to Thamel & garden of dreams. The hotel is very clean and most of the staff were extremely polite. The rooms are large, comfortable beds and have everything you need. Sounds lovely but do not be tempted by a room that overlooks the lawn. There is a huge generator that starts up randomly at all hours and is very loud. Breakfast in the cafe was excellent but very expensive to use as a cafe, Plenty of choices and much cheaper outside of hotel.

Hotel is old but clean. Location is good, you can find lots of shops right besides the hotel. Staff service need improvement, they are not friendly.I woke up early with a loud noise as they are doing some construction near my room. Lack of amenities. They need to add some room items, like sleeper, iron and board.

Altes ehrwürdiges Hotel, das allerdings schon etwas in die Jahre gekommen ist. Merkt man in der Zimmereinrichtung und vor allem im Badezimmer. Nach und nach wird es renoviert. Freundliches Personal, stets hilfsbereit. Allerdings insgesamt für das was es bietet zu teuer.

Went for a business trip to Kathmandu and stayed 3 nights in Annapurna Hotel. A decent hotel with good restaurants. Will definitely recommend for family and business. All their staff were very friendly.

This property was earlier a Taj property. It us quite centrally located. The staff is very courteous and helpful. Please do not make the booking through any website. Calling the hotel directly will help you getting better rates. They have a restaurant where ghazals are performed every evening. It was a perfect ambience for couples enjoying their dinner. The breakfast spread was also good. Indians will feel at home at this hotel

The hotel is located in the heart of the city, 10 mins walk from Thamel. It is very easy to get to. The rooms are comfortable but the bathroom could do with some renovation. If your stay is over the weekend and your room faces the lawn, I advise you to change it because high decibel of noise from a banquet and other possible parties.

Executive room facing the event area was great. The bed was a bit had but after a busy day, it really didn't matter. Everything in the room worked well. However the location next to this event area wasnt perfect. The new year's music continued until 01.00 and the next night's wedding disco also quite late. But again being tired after a full day of activities, all this didn't really matter. What mattered, however, was the slow serving of coffee in the morning during the early breakfast. The person in charge  of serving coffee showed what he thought of being asked to serve coffee quickly. Being in a hurry because of one's business didin't really interest him; a customer wasn't right.

Not a 5 star hotel at all. I checked in here after staying at the Hyatt for 2 days to experience a more centrally located 5 star hotel. Have to tell you the hotel is dated. Bed is as hard as a rock, the pillows a joke and the room smells of musty smoke. When I checked in at 2:30 I was asked what time I was leaving the next day. I was told that check out was 11 but I could stay until noon. Wow, thanks and to top it off I was asked if I would like to "rest" in the lobby and wait for a room. After I said no I was given some junky room. I'm sure the manager will respond and tell me I can email him personally and how sorry he is my room was not up to standard. Don't bother. And as a trip advisor reader don't make the same mistake I did and stay here. You will be staying in am overrated relic of the past. AVOID THIS HOTEL.

Hotel Annapurna located in the heart of Kathmandu is an excellent choice for people who would like to discover this mystical Himalayan Country starting with the Durbar Marg and the Royal Palace, which has now turned into a museum. The hotel has the best of ameneties, courteous staffs and excellent cuisine to offer to the guests. The rooms are spacious and has a great ambience. Due to its location, you can cover most of the tourist destinations on foot. A great stay at one of the best five star property of Nepal.

This is a fabulous location for any business meeting or event. The facility can accommodate a large group. We had several 100. The staff is very professional and goes out of their way to accommodate you. In my individual case the hotel was a safety net. My flight had been canceled after having spent the better part of the day at the Kathmandu airport. I was unable to reach my local colleagues. I remembered that the Annapurna had a shuttle service to/from the airport. The airport was chaotic and the airline provided little support. I was fortunate to locate the van in the midst of the confusion of the cancellation and took it back to the hotel. They were able to accommodate me and I was then able to make alternative plans.

One of the well known and preferred hotels for business travellers (yak & yeti, new Radisson being the other frequent choices) - besides other more expensive options. Ideal location. Has very good food in its Indian restaurant and a decent enough coffee shop to start your day. Choose min deluxe room to avoid rooms some of which can be aged. Definitely needs improvement at front desk and in service levels at the desk. Front desk staff makes a sincere effort to be freindly but need to improve on efficiency and speed. Room was not ready at 3 pm when check in time is  2 pm. After waiting for 40 mnts, room was still being done when I reached there ~ 4pm and the explanation bias last guest checked out late !  Did not understand the logic of not providing drop to domestic terminal as long as guest is availing airport drop service only once. Can be noisy due to weddings, at times.

This hotel has made my dream come true and it has been fantastic.Star 1 - Nice staff and the amazing service.Star 2 - The room where so good the bed where really soft.Wish - Fix the smoke smell in the room. For the hotel has no smoking policy so it's just smells smoke in the entire room

We decided to stay here our first night when we arrived to Kathmandu and wanted a good standard hotel. Got picked up at the airport, which was complementary (note that transport to and from the domestic airport is not complementary).Came here as a family and had to take two rooms, but it was possible to open the doors between the rooms so it felt like one room.The rooms are kinda old though and was a lot of smoke in the walls, but the beds were really nice. We slept really good.The breakfast was really good with friendly staff and the option to get your eggs as you wanted them from the cook standing at the buffée waiting for your order.Never had time to try the pool or the restaurants in the hotel.So a nice hotel with a good location, but I guess you can get a better hotel for that price.

This is a very comfortable hotel, conveniently located to walk to a bunch of places in the vicinity. The rooms are extremely comfortable, well stocked, good restaurants and a really large breakfast buffet spread. The staff are extremely courteous and make the stay very comfortable.

Happy Vibes, Warm and Welcoming Staff!!Meals are upto the mark!Breakfast Buffet at coffee shop was good but dinner in resto was tooo good!! Loved the hospitality.The casino was closed, during our stay. Will be visiting again, soon.Mayank Agrawal

We visited this Hotel last year, the quality of the food served was very good, service was very fast, would definitely recommend this hotel for Good Indian food. This hotel is situated on the most happening Road of Kathmandu, Durbar Marg.

Great hotel... good food... superb breakfast buffet... accommodating staff... cozy bar... clean rooms !  Staff was very so helpful loading and unloading all of our luggage... and stowing it in before we left the country.

Stayed 2 nights at Hotel Annapurna after spending time in the villages.Cleanliness, facilities, staff attention were all good. This hotel is obviously one of the better ones in Kathmandu. I surveyed but did not use the "fitness room" - it's quite small, but on the plus side, opens to the pool area, which is quite nice.Stayed in a twin standard room, which had everything I need, and decent sleep quality. The view from my window is not good (looked into a fence), but not a big problem for me. Good options on the cable TV too!Buffet breakfast had a good selection, including fresh fruits and an eggs station - both which I very much appreciated. Check in and out with no fuss. A word about WiFi - paid in-room, free in lobby. Free WiFi doesn't seem to be big in KTM! ;) Overall, a good hotel option for Kathmandu, and I will definitely stay here again!Recommended.

I stayed at Hotel Annapurna, Kathmandu from 16th to 18th Feb.Best part is the location, right on the darbar marg and all shopping places nearby. Good lobby and ambience.Rooms are average in terms of layout, space and facilities. Services are also average. Breakfast has a wide range and will suit most of the visitors.The worst part is the paid WiFi and its very very costly...not good for business visitors...

Stayed from 25th till the 28th of Feb, 2016. It's situated bang in the centre of Darbar Marg, so you can pretty much move anywhere you want easily.The Deluxe rooms are comfy and spacious, with adequate lighting in every corner (something which many of the other 5 star hotels lack !). Spacious washroom, again with ample lights everywhere (specially on the basin, super useful for shaving). We had business meetings for 2 days which were planned as discussed, so no issues there.The breakfast at the buffet was decent, wide spread, but not overly tasty and not bad either. Had continental lunch one of the days and it was tastier than expected. Heck, was downright yummy. :)Definitely worth a 2nd visit.

No need to think twice, just book this one and enjoy your stay here. This hotel is the oldest 5 star in heart of Nepal with pleasing interiors, well maintained, neat, noise free, and damn centrally located. They serve great food in all restaurants. Front office managers are so professional that they make one feel like at home. Mt very special thanks to Ms Sapna at front desk, Mr Rakesh and Mr Shiv at coffee shop, Mr Manish and Mr Pavin at Ghar e kaba restaurant. I was able to attend 8 business meetings so comfortably in my suit room and room service plus house keeping kept on stuffing us with complementary tea, coffee, snacks and time to time room settlement that my every gust felt honored visiting me here.

When you make a deliberate choice to visit again, its only because you have a satisfying experience in past. Great Hotel, Great staff, great hospitality. I had an occasion to visit their Chinese restaurant this time. Anita was simply beautiful, gorgeous and ever smiling. Keep it up, Anita.Sapna and Shrishti are the true front office executives. I adore them.

For an Indian from the country's south, the name was a natural and though I was in a different land, the comfort of the familiar architecture, name and ambiance was reassuring. For a hotel that is established and that which appears to be doing very well, the finesse in guest relations is way too below. I think I can distinguish between a firm demeanour with a professional interaction and a prejudiced approach almost bordering on contempt, and this was quite rude and unpleasant. But like a true Indian, I preferred to be understanding and gave them the benefit of doubt. For all I knew, it was perhaps their culture or perhaps this attitude was put on to handle guests, or exclusively meted out to Indians.The rooms are clean. We had to specifically ask for the airconditioner to be kept on. Being accustomed to being given at least one bottle of drinking water even in an entry level room in any hotel in India, we had to ask for water here. Bargaining is the name of the game that appears here. Even for a bottle of water. But one is expected to come with some free flowing money and actual let it flow all around the place. The restaurant is very nice and the breakfast we had was a big spread of a variety of local cuisine in addition to the Indian dishes.If one goes with an open mind, and with no expectations, and be happy with what is extended and accept the same without comparing it with any other similar sized or class or hotel anywhere else, this could be a good place. Stayed for two nights in January, 2015.

Just last week our stay was excellent and I recommended my guests from UN to stay here. Although welcome was nice, our rooms were allocated in the third floor heritage rooms which we categorically requested to book in new wing. This request was made personally when made reservation. There is even mixed up of bills with foreign colleagues and despite informing them in night the same mistake was done in morning, At the end I could not get my receipts and I rushed to airport as it was getting delayed. Unfortunately I missed the flight and wait long for next flight. This gave me very bad memories. Although front desk cashier is very kind but young land from office could understand what is the problem and show a kind temper-which is not acceptable in hospitality sector. This time my guests were disappointed so I am! A bad dream!!

One of the best hotels in Kathmandu, we stay for 3 nights in the hotel, Clean room good and not small . Great location middle of city , close to Thamel 10 mins walking. Nice food & breakfast. Helpful  staff who makes your life easier in Kathmandu.

Staff is very very  pleasant. Location  of  the  hotel is in the  middle of  a modern  city  life  of Kathmandu.  Very affordable  for  all business travel expectations. A must stay  if you want a comfortable city stay

Despite the fact that it is the 5 star hotel i think it does not meet all the requirements but the hospitality of the staffs is just great in compare to other hotels which i had encountered in my past.Also the hotel is situated in kings street you can easily find many outstanding places and locations to hangout.

Stayed 5 nights after a trip to Lhasa. The city is still dealing with the aftermath of the April, 2015 earthquake, but it had a great vibe. My kind of place - just the right combination of grit and comfort. Hotel was great. Personnel were very helpful. Restaurant had a great ambience. The bar and breakfast were also nice. Only rap I had on the place was the fact that taxis inside the hotel gate were 3 times the cost of taxis waiting just outside. Even the concierge quoted us prices that were way above market. I think there must be some scheme between the hotel and taxis that are allowed inside the gate. Anyway step outside and save some cash. All taxis are not metered - each ride is a negotiation, but I found them very friendly and reliable. You'll quickly get a sense of proper payment.Loved the location - kind of an oasis between Thamel and Durbar Square. Easy walk to Thamel and delightful but longer walk to Durbur Square via Ason. The walk along Siddhiddis Marg is like stepping back in time 2,000 years. Go see Durbar Square and adjacent Freak Street (just to the left as you enter, there's a great shop selling various metal statues, drawer pulls, etc - by the kilo! Good deal. See Boudhanath Stupa (expect a lot of earthquake damage at all these places), Pashupatinath Temple with it's Crematoria. The Crematoria was a moving experience. Skip Swayambhunath Temple - what a shame to see the squalor they've let this become. Absolutely filthy (and my bar is low on this).  Great view of the valley at sunset though. Watch out for the monkeys! I got my bag pick pocketed by a pair. Funny time! I would also skip the other two Durbar Squares - we did Patan, but so many hawkers made it uncomfortable. We paid a taxi $60 usd to drive us up to Nagarkot for sunset. Maybe 90 minutes each way, with some nerve wracking turns, but fun to get out of the city to see the countryside. Climb the Nagarkot Tower to view sunset light up the far off Himalayas. It was hazy on our day, but still enjoyed. Stop for a beer at Club Himalaya on the way up or down. Take the mountain plane early morning with Yeti or Buddha airlines. For about $250 per person, you get up close to the highest mountains in the world - best part of the trip for us.Eat in Thamel - so cheap it's laughable. We had great meals at Camino and Rosemary. Can't beat the vibe at laid back OR2K and Places. Perfect place to wine down. We're coming back!

After trekking to EBC and returning to KTM my tour company had me booked into a guest house in Thamal which I stayed at before departing for EBC. That place had no hot water, power would be switched off from 7pm to 10.30pm so there was no way I was going back there having spent 11 days freezing in the mountains with no shower.Stumbled across this hotel by sheer coincidence. All the airline offices are in the same street, so I was at Thai Airways and even ate KFC next door and in a moment of complete frustration, I told my guide I'm staying at this hotel. I did a walk up and to my surprise the room rate was very good. The room is enormous, modern, new bed, clean sheets, air con and heating, new tv, clean and just all round perfect.In the scale of other hotels globally it falls behind in terms of age of hotel but for the location it's 5 star. It's close to two shopping centers, lots of great cafes serving coffee, a KFC, airlines, NCell, massage etc

We have no words to say but really appreciate the hospitality bestowed on us (my wife and myself) par excellence. Our heartfelt thanks go to the following:1. Coffee shop team Mr. Shiva and his colleagues for the wonderful breakfast.2, The front office team and Mr. Atam Prasad Khanal for his best services.3. Gharr e Kabbah Chef Teji Alam Khan for his excellent cooked dishes as per our requirements and to all his team.Honestly speaking, we have never  come across such a hotel where we were honoured as special guests and a part of their family.  Indeed, we highly recommend every couple who is visiting Nepal to stay at this hotel and enjoy its ambience and food.They even arranged for us the airport pick up and drop without any additional charges.  The area surrounding the hotel is best for local shopping, the Ason, Indira marg and Thamel are walkable distance.  You need to see the King's palace which is a must but remember it is closed on tuesdays and wednesdays.  The security at the hotel is THE BEST.

Hotel un peu suranné (mais je crois qu'il est en voie de réfection) mais de très bonne classe, très propre, belle piscine (mais un peu froid quand nous y étions pour s'y baigner) accueil courtois et très sympathique, chambres agréables, literie confortable et très propre, petits-déjeuners sous forme de buffet très divers et à volonté, pour tous les goûts occidentaux comme asiatiques. Bref, on s'y est bien sentis et on y retournera certainement.

Bon accueil dès l'aéroport. Chambres propres mais un peu veillotes. Avons eu une fuite au niveau du lavabo de la salle de bain qui a été réparé tout de suite. On nous a même surclassé dans une chambre supérieure pour 10 $ de plus et petit déj gratuit en dédommagement. On en demandait pas tant !Bonne literie, avec couette. Serviettes de bain moelleuses.Petit déj sous forme buffet très varié et bon.Room service impeccable. Tout le personnel est au petit soin et toujours souriant.
ネパールだと高級ホテルです。全体的に設備が古いですが、手入れが行き届いています。バスタブにお湯をためようとすると茶色く濁っていましたが、タメル周辺はわりとそうなのかもしれません。立地は良く、ショッピングもナイトライフも楽しめます。

会議で２泊使用しました。現地での価格は高いのかもしれませんが、日本のホテル価格のイメージであれば全く手ごろ感があります。朝食付きでも手ごろな価格でした。朝食では卵料理を作ってくれます。コーヒーもおいしかたｔです。３階の２面が窓のある角部屋で、プールもみえました。広さは十分で、バスタブもあります（お湯が出るまでに毎回１０分くらいかかりましたが、出てしまえばOKです。最初はお湯が茶色でしたが、まあ慣れたらそれはそれで、普通なのでしょう。）。毎日お水が２本おいてあり、夕方にはベッドの用意がなされ、枕元にお水がおき直されてあり、小さな心遣いです。私はシルクエアーで荷物が空港に届かなかったのでショックに陥っておりましたが、このホテルのスタッフは皆ホスピタリティにあふれており落ち着いた滞在ができました。客層は欧米人と日本人でした。朝早くから皆さんハイキング、トレッキング、バスツアー、飛行機でのエベレストツアーなどに出かけている様子。私は元気を出して、市場や寺院を見に行きました。つながれない牛がいるので？？でしたが、皆さん餌を買って与えるのですね。神様のお使いとしてあがめられているのだと、後でわかりました。部屋のタイプはいろいろあるようで、私の部屋は古いようでしたが、とても清潔でした。街を歩くとエコなホテルがたくさんある様子でしたが、この５０年の歴史あるホテルに泊まる価値はあると思います。門番さんやガードの人がいつも敬礼してくれたり、もなさんナマステと手を合わせて挨拶してくれたり、かつ英語が通じるし、安心な滞在が約束されます。

Angeblich das erste Haus an Platze. Insgesamt ok aber im zumindest im Zweiten Stock in die Jahre gekommen und mit reichlich Investitionsstau. Preis Leistung nicht angemessen. Pool im Innenhof gross und sxhön, Lage nahe Thamel gut. Inhouse verschiedene Restaureants insgesamt aber hohes Preisniveau

Nos hospedamos en este hotel por asignación de la agencia. El hotel es grande, comodo y practico. No tiene pretensiones y es un hotel estándar que cumple para descansar, aseo y primeros alimentos. En ambiente agradable. La ubicación es difícil describir, he salido a explorar a pie y he dado con algunos lugares de interés, decir de Katmandú que es una urbe bulliciosa y con calles populosas y "laberínticas". Los principales puntos de interés de la ciudad no están demasiado lejos pero por la urbanización propia lo ideal es utilizar transporte o hacerte de guía. En lo personal Katmandú y alrededores me han gustado mucho! Y volvería encantado. Hay bastantes cosas que ver y alrededores que explorar y se puede volver por la noche al hotel, incluso viajando a los fabulosos pueblos en las montañas con vistas increíbles en los atardeceres sobre los Himalayas. La cantidad de colores que adquieren esos glaciares son tan variadas que vuelve uno a Katmandú con la sensación de éxtasis.

Passages avec differents trek au Nepal, acceuil tres sympa grand professionnalisme un hotel a recommander wifi uniquement dans la zone de reception l etablissement est tres propre et au centre de la ville a cote de l aeroport. Tres bonne implatation pour depart vers trek

Das Hotel Annapurna bietet für Geschäftsleute ein spezielles Stockwerk mit eigener Rezeption und Business Lounge. Dies trennt den Gast vom Trubel mit Konferenzgästen und Touristen. Das Restaurant mit dezenter Livemusik bietet sehr gute Speisen in angenehmer Atmosphäre und sehr freundlicher Bedienung. Preislich gibt es interessante Alternativen in Restaurants in der unmittelbaren Umgebug.

I spent almost two weeks here and enjoyed my stay. Although my bedrooms (2) fell short of the 5-star rating that the hotel advertises, they were comfortable, well lit and quiet. The hotel has a pleasantly busy feel to it, with extensive public areas and agreeable decor. The staff are efficient, friendly and helpful, breakfast is excellent, and there's a good large clean swimming pool in a pleasant garden area. My only real criticism would be with the choice of restaurants for dinner; all were a bit disappointing for one reason or another -  music too loud in one, another over-priced, and the third, uninspiring food. However, there are lots of reasonably-priced restaurants nearby. All in all, highly recommended.
設備は古いですがまぁまぁ清潔で、アメニティーも揃っています(品質は日本の方が断然良いが)。接客もよく気が付いてくれてとても丁寧でした。カトマンズの中では歴史があってそれなりに格式のあるホテルなのではないかと思います。タメル地区に徒歩圏で、周辺のお店も遅くまで開いていて立地はとても良いです。

stayed there few months before , the hotel price was reasonable , service was excellent but the food was not that great , still good hotel to stay for few days , but the kathmandu city is beautiful  city .

Perfectamente situado, muy céntrico en Kathmandu.He estado recientemente en dos ocasiones, buenas habitaciones, las más sencillas mejorables sobre todo en cuanto a los baños, la siguiente categoría de habitación, mucho mejor, el servicio perfecto, la atención exquisita.Un defecto, el wifi en las habitaciones es carísimo......., por suerte, es gratis en el lobby (aunque va a pedales.....)Un perfecta elección en Kathmandu, siempre y cuando no seas mochilero y te lo puedas permitir.

très bel hôtel : entrée en marbre et situé dans le quartier des grandes marques pour les magasins.chambres très propres et grandes avec plein d'accessoires notamment dans la douche : peigne, brosse à dent, rasoir; etc...hôtel un peu bruyant malgré tout mais de très bonne qualité.nous n'avons pas testé la piscine extérieure.l'eau coulant dans la douche est parfois de couleur marron claire...

旧王宮殿の通り（ダルバールマルグ）に面しており、どこに行くにもとても便利。ホテルの後ろの通りにはトゥクトゥクステーションがあるし、横の通りにはマイクロバスのステーションがある。いずれもバス停みたいな表示はないので人が集まっているところで行き先をその辺にいる人に聞くと教えてくれる。ホテルは少々古いが快適。アメニティも一通り揃っている。セキュリティは客室の入口にも扉があり、キーがないと部屋への通路へは行けない。その割には掃除係がしょっちゅう出入りしたりして・・・フロントのサービスや接客は申し分ない。FAXやコピーなどの対応もスムーズ。WIFIは有料。１日５００Rpくらいだったと思う。街中のべんりなホテルである。

朝食が種類豊富で豪華でした。タメル地区にも近く、夜１０：００頃までやっている店も多いのでショッピングしてからホテルに戻っても割と安全。近くに美味しいモモの店やギャコクの店があって、食事に行くのに便利。wifiは有料。ホテル内にはギフトショップがあり、値段もさほど高くないので、買い忘れがあったらここを利用してもいいかも。YETI　トラベルのカウンターもある。ネパール一大きい旅行会社なので、相談もできる。両替のレートもさほど街中とかわらない。ただし、大型ホテルなので中国人の団体がいます。

Best hotel in KathmanduUpon arrival at the hotel, we received a warm welcome by the front desk staffs. We were warmly welcomed by the director of this hotel. We are absolutely stunned by it's tasteful furnishing in the room. Mine especially is a corner room, 1055, besides having more space (quite a large room by the normal standard) it has 1 wide window panel which make the room look bright and of course it comes with stunning view of the swimming pool. Bathroom has nice detailing of amenities and also best is the coffee in room and there was also a complimentary nice wine, which is a big plus to their hospitality, I have never seen a mini bar so stuffed with varieties of drinks. Room is squeaky clean and bed is so comfortable. I have 1 single bed and 1 double bedThey also have an extensive room service menu, which is quite surprising, as most of the city hotels I have been in Nepal have very limited choices. We booked our stay in this hotel entirely because of the good Indian restaurant and Gazal, which it the talk of town, even taxi driver know about it when we told him to send us to Annapurna Hotel. We got some Indian food and nice wine. The food taste at their best quality and freshness. I had the best lamb in Nepal. We have never tasted before so nice good food. I am so impressed with the housekeeping, when they get the chance to clean my room, they will know where to arrange stuffs that I leave lying on the bed. I wish I have a maid like this. Taxi stop just few walks away from the hotel, right on the main road. surrounding the hotels are good cafés for food and pastries. GPS works really well here if you need to get to a destination by foot and they are actually not that far away if you have the stamina to walk.if you are coming to Kathmandu, you gotta stay in this hotel for sure, if not, at least come to eat at their Indian & Chinese restaurant.That aside, it's a great hotel that I would highly recommend.

Great location, excellent service by the front office team, both during check in and check out. Food at Ghar e Kebab was excellent, live Ghazal made the dining experience even more pleasant.Rooms are very averageThe toilets are clean; bathtub isn't too wide for an adult to take a shower

This was my first visit to Nepal my friends recommended to stay in this hotel, and indeed it was a very good suggestion.I stayed in annapurna club room for 3 nights and really enjoyed the stay. Room were new with modern amenities. breakfast served was very personalized and good. i could only try one evening cocktail as i was out other days. staffs are very polite and courteous overall very nice stay and looking forward to stay in future.

The team spirit of Hotel Annapurna is excellent.Front Office Team is very cooperative and well behaved.Ghar e; Kabab is beauty of Annapurna in respect of Indian Food being cooked by the Chef.Also the team of Ghar e Kabab is well behaved and cooperative.Arniko Room another beauty of the hotel in respect of Chinese Food.This hotel is like my home...............................a home away from home.I wish all the success to the entire team of Hotel Annapurna.

Location was very convenient, room was clean, and service was excellent.  What one would expect of a five-star hotel in Kathmandu, but not Paris.  The coffee shop included a breakfast (part of room cost) buffet, and the lunch menu offered "western" options. Definitely caters to the European/North American business traveller.

The hotel is smack bang in the middle of Kathmandu.  The 'Corporate Executive' room on the ground floor was large, with an enormous bed.  At this time of year don't need the hum of the air con, and I splept with the window open.  The swimming pool is great, a full 25m stretch.  The staff are friendly and very helpful.  Beware though, of mis-understandings - I was surprised to be offered a blackberry pastry - turned out to be Black Forest cake. For the tourist traveller I would recommend getting up early, before sunrise, and wandering around the streets as the city comes to life.  Plenty to see just around the adjacent streets.   This is not for those seeking 'traditional' Kathmandu - there are modern malls and restaurants, but there is also museums, and the gorgeous Garden of Dreams within walking distance.   Just like any hotel anywhere I suppose.  Clean, comfortable, has a great pool and really nice beds.  All I want.

Located on Durbar marg, the upscale market area of Kathmandu, and 10 min walk from the tourist Thamel area, this hotel is on one of the best locations . Fantastic location!However , the service has much to be desired. Food very average.Rooms are functional and not Posh as expected of a 5 star. Nothing really bad to avoid it. Well worth staying if you are looking for good location ; but don't expect it to be Hyatt style

I didn't stay here but used its main restaurant, which specializes in Indian fare.  I enjoyed an excellent dinner here.  Food was first-rate and the staff were all highly attentive and pleasant.The wine list is a rip-off but nothing that one doesn't find in this class of hotel in this part of the world.  But that still doesn't justify the prices charged!If you want somewhere really good to eat, which is not excessively expensive (for food), this is it.  If you are seeking guidance as to its strengths or weaknesses as an hotel, sorry - read someone else's comments.  Oh, by the way, the prices in the bar are ridiculous too - even for domestic beers.

Just spent 3 nights at this hotel. The staff are nice enough but the hotel is no where near a 5 star hotel. I'd say 3 star. The location isn't too bad ( just a 5 minute walk to the popular tourist spot of Thamel ). The staff are friendly and can all speak good English. There is wifi at the hotel but not free. Which I was disappointed at as most hotels now provide free wifi in Nepal. They charged about £10 for 24 hour access. Although there is a ' buisness centre ' with a couple of PC's in which we used for free. The breakfast was good. Nice selection of food available for all needs.The rooms though were not what I expect for a 5 star hotel. The bed was comfy but that's about it. The bathroom was very poor and we hardly had any hot water. Luke warm at best. I wouldn't stay at the hotel again. We have another night booked in Kathmandu in a couple of weeks and we have decided to try somewhere else. This is a very expensive hotel and I don't think it's worth the money at all. I would spend it somewhere else.

Once again I just have to write a few words about this wonderful hotel that has become our home every time we visit Kathmandu.We have just returned home after a longer stay in Nepal due to my husbands work there.This time I discovered that the hotel we love so much also supports the work of a wonderful organisation called Smile Nepal. This organisation takes care of homeless children in Kathmandu.Hotel Annapurna provides the organisation with good food for a healthy meal every single day for the street children in the Thamel area. The  children come to the hotel once a day, all year and get a good meal  at no cost :-) thus providing them with the most basic of needs to survive. They also provide a health check about once a month for these kids.I was also told that the hotel supports another organisation called Maiti nepal, an organisation which works to help protect Nepali girls and women from crimes like domestic violence, trafficking, child prostitution, child labor and various forms of exploitation and torture.The hotel helps by participating in the  rehabilitation of some of these women, and teaching them a trade at the hotel,  sometimes giving them employment when possible.To me this speaks loudly about the generosity of this hotel, a hotel which gives something back to the weakest members of its society without bragging about it. Thanks again to all the wonderful staff for another great stay at you hotel, and for showing me an entirely different and heartwarming side of your hotel :-)))))

I stayed in this hotel for the first time and the experience was wonderful. The location of the Hotel is excellent with easy proximity to the important tourist locations. Mainly the Club room staff is very courteous and make you feel as privilege customer.

I stayed in this hotel after 5 years. This time I am in club floor thier new property which is very nice and modern with all the facilities. They serve breakfast in the separate lounge evening cocktail is very good. Special thanks to club floor staff ashma, samjhana, anju, shristi grishmaa and anju for their hospitality. Keep up with the same service level.

This hotel is probably one of the most expensive hotels in Nepal. We have decided to stay here as Hyatt was fully booked. We were given a standard room first. It was like a 2 star hotel room. They were helpful at the reception though and upgraded our room to a deluxe room. They tried to charge extra $30 the next morning. That was another argument that I needed to make. They waived the charge at the end. They wanted to charge extra $15 (per day) for the internet even though it was stated as free on the website. I had to argue with them once again to get it free. It was a challenge to get regular 4-5 star facilities at this hotel. There are some positive sides to the hotel though. Employees at the reception were helpful. I believe they are used to similar guest reactions. Breakfast was also good. Location of the hotel is excellent. I believe they need to lower room prices as anyone would expect better quality for the amount paid.

We stayed at this hotel on 3 occasions recently. Each time the staff looked after us well and all our meals were taken at one of the hotel's restaurants. On each stay our room got better, with our final checkin giving us a lovely suite overlooking the grassed area and pool. We have nothing but praise for the staff, service and food we experienced while staying there, but would advise anyone to avoid the gift shop opposite reception at all costs.We purchased a number of items, all of which we found out later were so much cheaper elsewhere. e.g. T-shirts that we paid US$10 for, we found exactly the same product for US$2.50 elsewhere. We were also charged $100 more than the quoted price on a necklace, which wasn't discovered until we returned home and checked our credit card statement. Add to this the exchange rate we were given, which was very poor. Unfortunately we were in a bit of a rush as our driver arrived early and we needed to leave for our next destination. With the charged amount in rupees, we were unaware that we had been overcharged.We realise we should have been more diligent at the time, but everything else about the hotel was good and we didn't expect to get ripped off.We did email the hotel about what happened but received no reply.

This was my third visit to Annapurna to attend a business meeting held in the hotel. The hotel offers comfortable rooms, smiling service and two excellent restaurants as well as a coffee shop. I stayed in 2057- which was quiet, the wi fi worked, amenities were very good and the mattress excellent- very comfortable sleep. This is a deluxe room- and worth it at about 110 USD. I do not recommend the standard rooms on the ground floor near the lobby. what really stood out were the two restaurants- we had business dinners and I especially liked the Chinese restaurant which also had healthy steamed offerings. Breakfast every morning at the coffee shop was unremarkable- the Indian fare on offer is unrefined and avoidable. But with fruit and an omelette - no major complaints. The gym is basically a small room crammed with machines- overlooking the pool. However the treadmill works, there are basic weights and a couple of other machines on offer. Located a 7 minute walk from Thamel on Durbar marg- it is easy to nip into Thamel for different kinds of food or shopping. I would not stay here on holiday as the hotel lacks old world charm or modern sophistication - but will certainly be back for business.

Deerwalk's executives have been staying at Hotel de l'Annapurna whenever they visit Kathmandu and all of them have commended the great service provided by the hotel. Rudra Pandey, Executive Chairman of Deerwalk, has this to say on the experience: "I am thankful to the entire crew of Hotel de l'Annapurna for the excellent hospitality that they have been extending toward me and my colleagues."

I was here for my new year eve in club room. I was so so dissapointed by one of the reception staff. It was so unwelcoming and he was kinda rude too..  Later being a club room member i was taken to club room reception. And every single bit was just good.. Staffs and all receptionist was vey nice and looked after very well.. The reception staff for 1st floor need to be changed to be worth 5 star..

It is a gorgeous hotel, with amazing Rana architecture; a jewel filled with lots of antiquities, great art, lovely shops, a library with a great collection of historical and cultural books and even a Koi fish tank. The name Rana was given by the then prime minister to Bir Narsingh Kun­war. The Ranas ruled Nepal between 1846 until 1953, and all the rulers of the lineage were named “Maharaja” and “Shree Teen”, while Rana kings were named "Shri Panch" and "Maharajdhiraj".  The first ruler of the dynasty was Jung Bdahir, who modernized the State and codified many laws. During the Rana reign gorgeous residences and palaces were built as a proof of their power and magnificence. The Baber Mahal Villas was one of those palaces and was built and is currently run by descendants of the longest ruling prime minister of Nepal, Maharaja Chandra Shumshere Rana.I stayed at the Chandra Suite. A 41 square meters room with queen bed, hot tub, spacious family room with smart TV and Netflix subscription, complimentary water, tea and coffee and a great minibar. The price is just unbelievably cheap for what you get, only U$162 per night, breakfast included. I checked in at 3 pm really tired after a long day, took a shower at 5 pm and then walked into the corridors of the wonderful complex of shops and restaurants. The complex known as Baber Mahal Revisited was renovated in 1997 and 6 courtyards were turned into a gallery of sophisticated shops, restaurants and gastropubs. I finally, had dinner at the Mul Chowk Restaurant, a lovely restaurant in the main courtyard shaded by a Rudraksha tree, with a great terrace and a selection of continental and Asian food. I had the breast chicken fillet with spinach and mushrooms, a complete delicacy, with a glass of Chardonnay. Then I had another glass of wine in Bawarchi, one of the oldest restaurants and bars of the complex, offering Mughlai Indian Cuisine, which also has a lovely rooftop with great views to the city.

I stayed longer at Baber Mahal Vilas than I had intended as I tested positive for covid   2 days after I arrived and so had to isolate in my room there for 8days until I tested negative. The hotel is a beautiful oasis in the middle of increasingly noisy and busy Kathmandu. The location was great for me as it is close to the government ministries where I had meetings and also very central for reaching other parts of the city. I did not want the noise and hassle of staying in Thamel. BMV is part of the beautifully restored Baber Mahal Revisited complex with shops and 4 restaurants so it was nice to have a choice of places to eat within walking distance once I was out of isolation. It also has a nice courtyard so that I could meet people out of doors (good in times of covid).The hotel itself is small and the rooms large and nicely furnished with very comfortable beds. At the start of my stay it was cold and so they provided an extra heater as well as the AC unit (which can heat or cool) but by the end of my stay the weather was much warmer and I appreciated being able to open all the windows in the room. The hotel moved me to a room with a little balcony when I was isolating so I could sit in the sun without leaving my room.  All the staff were very friendly and helpful, the breakfasts were excellent - great scrambled eggs and cappuccino! The hotel has some building work going on which could be noisy during the day, but it was wonderfully quiet at night. All in all a beautiful, friendly place to stay. I recommend it highly and will definitely stay there next time I am in Kathmandu.

The manager took such great efforts to arrange a PCR test for us at the hotel.
