A certified clinic sent a technician to take oral and nose swabs in the lobby within the 24 hr time frame required to fly. The manager also went to great lengths to ensure we had the correct paperwork and stamps regarding covid restrictions for the airport. I'm truly impressed as the flying rules changed during our stay and the hotels guests are from various countries with various rules. The airport transfer and covid testing through the hotel made my trip so much easier and pleasant. All the staff were nice, attentive, and no concerns about covid procedures while I was there. The rooms and property are beautiful and a peaceful oasis in the chaotic city. The food was tasty. I would def. stay here again if I am in Kathmandu.

We booked a last minute trip to Kathmandu for a long weekend and saw a lot of good reviews of Baber Mahal Vilas. They were spot on! Exceptional service from start to finish in a lovely setting. I’d go as far to say that I’ve never had better service in any hotel! The staff must be commended as they looked after our every need, they even gave us a phone to contact them if we encountered any problems when out for the evening. The complimentary upgrade was much appreciated to a stunning cosy suite. One of our best hotel stays, we’ll definitely be back!

Amazing hotel, beautiful old/traditional style structure with gorgeous rooms. The staff and the service were really good and the location is very much accessible by cabs. It is away from the loud touristy areas yet close which is wonderful and peaceful.

The hotel felt very homely with great decor ans set up with rooms in stately Royal style. However some of the rooms were very dark and could have had better lighting. The staff treated us very well catering to all our smallest needs and even cooking some light dinner for us one evening. Would help if the guests were given a free pick up from airport for their safety.  Some more space around the premises would make it less claustrophobic

Baker Mahal Vilas is well worth a visit.  Each room is unique and beautifully furnished.  Bathrooms are modern and clean.  Location is good and central only 15 mins drive from the airport and 10 mins taxi ride into Durbar square.  We  stayed in the traditional suite rooms and found them very comfortable.  The hotel was quiet on our visit so not much noise pollution from other guests though I imagine this could be an issue in some of the rooms during busy periods.  Having said that, staff were very welcoming and flexible and went the extra mile to make sure all was well.The Baber Mahal complex has a range of shopping outlets, an art gallery and various restaurants including a very good French alfresco place. It is self contained and you wouldnt realise you were in the heart of busy Kathmandu. We stayed 2 nights and felt thoroughly rested.

Baber Mahal is the peak of relaxation in Kathmandu. We were warmly welcomed by the incredible staff and given a tour of the entire facility, which extends so much beyond simply the hotel. Connected to the hotel are a series of restaurants and boutique shops which we explored for several days and could have continued exploring for several more. Our room felt like a palace bed chamber and the staff treated us like royalty. This is my top lodging recommendation in Kathmandu not only to see all of the local attractions, but also because Baber Mahal is its own attraction which you’ll enjoy spending many days exploring.

This hotel is truly a hidden gem! My trip got unexpectedly extended by 2 days to accommodate better weather for a helicopter tour of Everest Base Camp. The hotel staff went above and beyond to ensure I had everything I needed and would have the same room throughout to not have to move anything. If it’s your first time in Kathmandu, do yourself a favor and book this hotel. You will immediately feel at home and have the help of the nicest people should you need anything at all. Special shout out to Sudikshya! She was absolutely phenomenal and greeted me every single morning with a smile and made sure I was taken care of. This was an unforgettable stay all around, and I will be coming back for sure!

We used the hotel as our home base as we had several excursions planned over several days. Rupes was indispensable! Each time we returned it was like coming home. The bags we had left were placed back in our rooms and the welcome back smiles from everyone was heartfelt. Rupes organized all reservations, taxis and must see places. The rooms were beautiful, comfortable and all one could expect. The property, with the diverse shopping, dinning and services made it so easy and comfortable. Highly recommend Baber Mahal Vilas!

I knew I had chosen a great hotel by the pre-arrival communications.   They contacted me right away and offered up whatever travel services I should need.  They were always there to answer my questions.   The hotel was magical with all its history and unique features.  The room was clean and well-adorned.  I felt completely safe too.  The staff was wonderful - whether it was my spa service, my breakfast, dinner with Folk Dance Show at the Nepalese Restaurant onsite or strolling the hotel grounds...   staff was always friendly and offering assistance.  Anyone going to Kathmandu should stay here...   you will not be disappointed !!   It is an Oasis from the busy city...   and you are made to feel like royalty while there !   HIGHLY RECOMMEND

Amazing boutique hotel , very typical architecture, rooms. Service is over the top , very warm and efficient.Only « minus » - no view from the room, but that’s a given when you are in Kathmandu, unless you sleep on a roof…Location far from Thamel, à taxi will cost you 350/450 npr to go there , it will take you 10-15 mins.

I thoroughly enjoyed my stay at this hotel and would unequivocally give it the highest possible ranking for its exceptional comfort and distinctive character. Our three-night experience felt like a true embodiment of a boutique hotel, aligning seamlessly with the finest traditions seen in the United States.As a Heritage hotel, it not only offers luxurious comfort but also boasts a rich history that adds an extra layer of charm to the entire ambiance. The meticulous restoration work has beautifully revived the essence of its heritage, creating a visually stunning and historically significant atmosphere.Positioned adjacent to a variety of shops and restaurants that open to an interior courtyard, the hotel's location enhances accessibility to local amenities and contributes to a charming overall setting.The room, featuring a spacious layout and a balcony, was a delightful retreat. The added touch of the room opening to the library on the second floor added an element of sophistication and tranquility to the overall experience.While the staff was friendly, it's worth noting that such warmth is expected from the hospitable people of Katmandu. Overall, my stay was exceptional, and I highly recommend this hotel to those seeking a perfect blend of comfort, history, and boutique elegance.

We stayed at Baber Mahal  Vilas during late November 2023 in suite N. 302.The whole property is beautiful with its traditional architecture, the suite was ample, nice decorated and well appointed located at the roof top   next to a nice terrasse with flowers and even an Himalayan bees  honeycomb .There is also an small shopping arcade with nice shops and restaurants, Location is calm and yet close to points of interest. We ate many times  at the hotel either via room service and at its Indian restaurant, the food was good but the service must be improved  since there were mistakes all times. The included breakfast was a bit small but still  appropriate with the best coffee of our whole month trip  ,the staff serving it was very attentive and efficient, also the rest of the staff at the front desk.  Definitely we could come back.

We booked a traditional room for our last night in Nepal (March 26) before returning home. This property is a hidden treasure encapsulated in a rather anonymous neighborhood.  We settled in room 203 which was sumptuously furnished, surprisingly large and with a  very comfortable bed. Staff was charming and cheerful and very helpful to arrange for us a light breakfast one hour before usual opening time, given we had to leave early on departure day. We had dinner inside the property at Baitak nepalese restaurant, where we could enjoy a traditional dance performance while dining. After dinner we explored the vast internal courtyard which extends in virtually an infinite maze of hallways, buildings, shops and stairs to end up having a drink at one bar which is somehow off-map, inside the complex but not belonging to the property. Even if our room was a bit noisy (we unfortunately clearly heard other guests chatting and dragging luggage around while probably leaving for a night flight) we regret not having stayed longer. Maybe it’ll be for another time?

This is the best place I stayed in Nepal. An interesting quirky hotel, that has a lot of charm and history to it. The rooms were clean and the hotel felt calm from the chaos of Kathmandu. The owner/manager was highly professional, gave us time after the checkout time to recover from a tour and organised a taxi for us. The staff were all attentive and proffessional. It's also connected to a really nice set of courts that have shopping and food in case you don't feel like heading out fully in to the streets. Would definitely recommend.

An absolutely beautiful property at the heart of Kathmandu. The building itself is gorgeous and rich in history. You'll be able to visit 3 unique restaurants on the property and be surrounded by very courteous and helpful staff. If you're in the city, you must stay here.

We had a great experience at this hotel the room was very nice big and confortable the amenities and decoration are very nice too. The hotel was owned by a ministry so it’s quite luxurious and it is very well connected to 4 restaurants and many beautifull stores so you don’t have to go out to have a Pleasant dinner or have a great lunch at a Chinese or Indian restaurant. Or to buy souvenirs . The staff of the hotel does everything to make your experience unique they are always talking care of your needs . We need a very early breakfast because we were going to the Everest mountain by helicopter and they helped us with everything. Also a late check out because after that tryp we wil go to the airport and the staff help us with it. The rooms also have some fruit and cofee and tea and a table to do some business work which I love because even I was on vacation I had to work by zoom. This hotel  is beautiful the four rain at the entrance with the fishes and at the topOf the Roof the poll where lovely . The staff is unique and we will stay there for sure again . The buffet of the morning is fine and also the hotel  has a spa where I took a lovely massage .

My husband and I had a remarkable stay. The service was top notch, the staff was cordial, friendly, and helpful. We both eat vegan, and they graciously provided us with soy cappuccinos that were very delicious and a good breakfast. My only regret is that we did not spend enough time around the property which was so relaxing, peaceful, and lovely. It was a very unique place with an interesting history.

Very beautiful rooms, even more helpful staff, great area with shops and couple of restaurants. Pure luxury. We stayed in a suite, had some roomservice, a super clean bathroom, with super hot showers (which is very nice in winter).

Well-appointed hotel with great amenities and several restaurants to choose from within the complex.Immaculately presented and very attentive staff were always on hand to take our orders, answer any queries, provide directions or arrange a taxi for short trip downtown.The hotel’s manager Prabin was ever present, always smiling and nothing was a problem for him.We were lucky enough to be given a tour of the complex during which he explained it’s interesting history and spoke enthusiastically about the hotel and future plans.A great place to stay!

We used this absolute gem of a hotel as our base for a 2 week trip to Nepal, staying 3 different times.  Rupesh was so attentive, extremely helpful and nothing was too much trouble. He took us on an interesting tour of the property with told us about the history of the hotel when we arrived.  He had wonderful suggestions for what to see and do and where to eat.  All the staff were wonderful, always smiling and it felt they were  genuinely happy to help and make our stay the most memorable they could. The hotel is such a unique property with many different restaurants, we had delicious evening meals at 4 of them. My room was beautiful, so clean, a wonderful bathroom with a fabulous shower.  It is an oasis in the middle of Kathmandu. I hope to return to Nepal and would not think of staying anywhere else.

Staff all genuinely friendly, helpful, and fortunately for me spoke excellent English. Room (Heritage suite) was awesome with private balcony overlooking courtyard. Breakfast was a good start to the day. Lots of nice touches throughout to enjoy or relax in. Pool makes for a refreshing dip when hot, although frigid. Sauna and steam room both nice. Massages at the spa were heavenly. Adjoining restaurants offer plenty of options and, again fortunately for me, have lots of vegetarian choices. Perhaps most important, tourist attractions to the north and west are quite walkable with minimal life-risking street crossings thanks to pedestrian bridges over the busiest roads. Heading east appeared to be much less ped friendly, unsure on south. The gym equipment is quite dated and limited but still serviceable for a quick workout.

The thoughtful service of all the staff was exemplary. They upgraded our room on our third visit, remembered how we like our coffee in the morning, stored our luggage, helped us with directions and even offered us a room while we waited for a late evening flight. The hotel provides a quiet and elegant oasis in the middle of bustling Kathmandu, most welcome after a day of sightseeing in this fascinating city. I can’t recommend this boutique hotel highly enough.

Baber Mahal Vilas is totally different from any 5 stars hotels in Kathmandu. There is charm and history and all members of the team at all levels are helpful, kind, smiling and proud to be part of the property. The building was a part of the residence of a former prime minister. The place was given back to the family who restored and remodeled it in remembrance of the different traditional architectural styles. It is a kind of elegant complex with some interesting hops and boutiques as well as good restaurants (Chez Caroline and the charming Baithak with very good regional dances some evenings). If you want to have the feeling to travel without sacrificing your comfort, this is definitely the right place. Some will prefer to stay like the major part of travelers in Thamel with its many shops and restaurants but Thamel looks very touristic. However, reaching Thamel from Baber Mahal Vilas is fast. Anyway the points of interest of Kathmandu are dispersed and consequently there is no location really better than another one.

We had the best time staying at Baber Mahal Villas. The hotel is part of a complex with many restaurants and shops to explore. All the of the rooms have a unique design and are very comfortable. The staff are incredibly friendly and helpful. They helped us organise an airport transfer and also a driver to take us to the UNESCO sites. We loved it so much this was us returning at the end of our trip. Thank you Baher Villas for a wonderful stay in Kathmandu.

This is the most beautiful, intricately decorated hotel and impeccably clean. The staff are warm and welcoming, nothing was too much trouble, especially for the reception staff (Sweety in particular) the  food was all delicious and I loved the shopping side of the hotel. The rooms were incrediblely clean and spacious, and if I could, I'd give this place more than 5 stars, I would! I hope to go back one day and couldn't recommend it more. Thank you for a wonderful stay ♥️♥️♥️

GREAT EXPERIENCE HERE!My boyfriend and I had a 12 hour layover in Kathmandu and weren't sure what to do with ourselves. After hearing the rave reviews about this place, we went over to see if they happened to have a room available.  The counter staff could not have been more nice.  He let us know that the hotel was booked but that he would check and see if one room was available.  Turned out, it was, it just needed to be cleaned, and since it had a quirky layout, he showed it to us first to make sure it was okay (I kinda liked the layout and was happy for whatever room they had).We had a wonderful lunch at their French restaurant (they have 4 restaurants) with a really sweet server helping us out there as well.  When our room was ready, the counter person found us and let us know.The hotel itself is quirky and charming.  It's like a whole little village in addition to a hotel, complete with different shops and restaurants.  It was just what my boyfriend and I needed for our respite in the middle of long travel.  To be honest, it was so great that I almost wished we were staying a few days longer!  Wonderful experience, nothing bad to say, highly recommend.

Stayed at the Baber Mahal Vilas for the start and end of our tour through Nepal in October.  A beautiful oasis  in the huzzle and  buzzle of Kathmandu. An architectural gem with beautiful, clean rooms, comfortable beds and amazing shower and wet room  (the handwash basins are works of art!). There's a nice inner courtyard with a koy pool to sit and relax. Prabin Pudasaini, the General Manager and his entire staff were very welcoming, helpful and proactive when  help and local expertise were needed. All were very friendly, patient and very attentive and quietly efficient. They  even sourced a local simcard for me. The food, especially breakfast was very good with a great variety. The attention to detail was impressive. Baber Mahal Vilas is the perfect base or springboard for activities in Kathmandu or onward travels in beautiful Nepal. I couldn't think of a better place and unreservedly recommend staying there!

We truly enjoyed every minute of our stay at this Charming Heritage property. It is a beautiful boutique hotel filled with antiques and memorabilia, and yet homey and comfortable. The facilities have modern upgrades including lovely bathrooms, beds, and AC. We especially liked wandering the attached and charming Baber Mahal Revisited shops and restaurants. Our favorite restaurant was Chez Caroline. The hotel restaurant was very accommodating to our special food requests including cooking our own oatmeal and quinoa. We want to thank the Food and Beverage manager, Raj Kumar Thapa for that. It seemed like all of the staff went out of their way to please. Our special thanks to the manager Prabin who was there to oversee every part of our stay including arranging a wonderful car and guide for sightseeing. We enjoyed spa services and the rooftop pool. We look forward to visiting again!!!!

I stayed here on and off over a weeks visit to Nepal. Not only was the place immaculate and luxurious, but the staff was the best I've ever had the chance to meet. This place has everything you could want: wonderful rooms (I stayed in 3 different rooms over an 8 day period) lots of different and diverse restaurants and shops. I can't rave enough about the people who work there to make you comfortable and happy.The dinner with entertainment is great fun and a cultural delight.

Baber Mahal Vilas is a beautiful quiet and peaceful hotel in Kathmandu. The rooms are beautiful, the employees very helpfull and kind and the food is delicious. There was also a nice place where you could sit outside to have your breakfast, lunch or diner or just to read a book. So we certainly will return😀

I stayed three nights after trekking to the Everest Base Camp and around the Kathmandu Valley.  I was looking for calm relaxationand a touch of luxury and found both, plus very friendly people.  Hari in reception welcomed me with a big smile. He became my go to person for any questions and was unfailingly kind and helpful.  Each morning I had breakfast on the terrace and chatted to Ram, the polite and friendly waiter, who took an interest in my travels and answered my questions about his life in Nepal.  I looked forward to seeing both of them as I went about my day.  Baber Mahal Vilas is more than a hotel, it is a community.  There are also small specialist shops and three other restaurants adjacent to the hotel.  I felt particularly relaxed and welcome in the French restaurant courtyard where another friendly waiter (whose name I failed to record) greeted me whenever I walked past.

I have stayed here more than 10 time and and reviewing this on my 10+ stay . This is my second home whenever I want to relax its top prioritize place on my list . I feel very comfortable with whole setting of this hotel . Friendly staff delicious food and outstanding breakfast.I have experienced almost all category room from which I  got to experience all set of diverse culture and heritage carrying atmosphere. The rooms are really nice, both in terms of comfort , cleanliness and in terms of giving you a picture of Nepali culture and heritage. Every detail seems to have been thought of brilliant design, which creates a truly relaxing and interesting atmosphere . My favorite spot is in main courtyard in front of koi fish pond . I can stay an hour long watching those fish .and coming to the best part . Swimming pool here is to die for . Very clean .Steam and sauna is offered when ever we will to go and is within the package . No extra charge are added for that . And coming to my third favorites , their library . They got best book collection. Not a book reader but there collection got a great history book which definitely caught my interest on . Highly highly highly recommended ❤️❤️❤️❤️ ♥️. And Thankyou for token of love

The personnel is committed to make you feel home and solve any issue or request you might have. Literally the best concierge I’ve had in any hotel around the world.Property concept being an historic place nicely rebuilt, integrated with a small shopping and restaurants area, mixing different architectural and decor styles, makes it a very special place.Close to the airport and around military areas makes it even more safe, not a concern in Nepal, though.

We felt warmly welcomed the moment we arrived. Our large room was beautifully furnished, clean, and very comfortable. Original and historic artwork, photographs, paintings, and sculptures adorn the walls throughout. There are numerous facilities to make use of around the spacious hotel including a library from which I borrowed to read the spectacular "Ladakh" photobook in our room. The buffet breakfast had a good variety of food, and the one evening we ate in was likewise, a very good buffet. Overall I would say Baber Mahal Vilas offers a classy experience away from the hubbub of Kathmandu.

Wonderful place to discover culture & history of Nepal Facilities are amazing & room is wonderful Breakfast & dinner are simply delicious, don’t miss dinner in this hotel..!!! All is done for perfect holidays but what you could not find anywhere else is staff’s attitude to take care customers. They make all for you to feel at home. Anything you need, they have solution with very reasonable price.  Don’t hesitate to walk from hotel to Thamel (city center), you will discover a beautiful city with incredible nice people. Thanks to every staffs & managers make our stay a perfect time for new year.

We booked the whole hotel for a conference of three days and could not have been happier with our selection! It's a boutique hotel that could easily be the stage of a Wes Anderson movie due to the beautiful and detailed combination of different architectural standards.The managers of the hotel, Sanish and Rupes are extremely helpful individuals. Overall the staff of the hotel is very nice. They fed us so well! The food was also beyond our expectation. The complimentary airport pickup helps a lot as the airport in Kathmandu can be a bit messy at times. The rooms were also very nice and gave us an at-home-feeling. We loved our stay and hope to be back!

Having stayed here at the beginning and end of an amazing motorcycle tour around Nepal I can not begin to describe how wonderful it was. The hosts as well as the staff were amazing in attending to every imaginable aspect of our stay. The hotel is beautiful in that it exists in multiple different architectural styles which marry beautifully to show the history of Kathmandu. The reception and catering staff were beyond amazing in every aspect of making our stay a delight.  Thank you for making my stay in Kathmandu so memorable.

Excellent place. Fantastic service, and centrally located. We have been there a couple of times and never ever were we disappointed. Yummy Nepali food served in the in-house restaurant along with three more different restaurants in the hotel itself. A must stay place in khatmandu.

We stayed at the Baber Mahal after our Everest Base Camp trek. From the moment we got there, the staff did everything at their disposal to keep us comfortable. The rooms are gorgeous, as is the rest of the historic property. The pool is small (and cold), but wasn’t crowded when we used it. The spa is also small, but the massages are amazing. The surrounding shops and restaurants have excellent options. Would highly recommend to anyone!!

I came here first in October 2023 and it was a delight to return. The ambience is luxurious, friendly, courteous and helpful. I brought colleagues both times to ensure they were comfortable but also wowed by the decor and history. Having a choice of 4 restaurants meant that we could choose different styles of eating over several days and we loved the French one, in particular, where the food is very unusual for Nepal. This hotel complex is an oasis of calm - and luxury - in Kathmandu, where I feel looked after as a special guest. Thank you Rupes Karki and your team!

It was my 3rd stay in Baber Mahal, it’s amazing place. It’s 15 min walk from the center which makes it nicely separated from busy Kathmandu, yet very close to everything worth seeing. Staff is fantastic, friendly and very accommodating to anything you need. The place is absolutely unique, where else could you sleep in real Nepalese palace? It’s worth mentioning that breakfasts and coffee is great.

A grand exquisite hotel in the centre of Kathmandu very near the Supreme Court of Nepal and the other Government buildings. The rooms are beautifully decorated and provide utmost comfort. The service is fantastic and the staff are very courteous and warm. At the entrance of the hotel, there is place known as the Mulchand Chowk wherein the best Restaurants of Kathmandu are located. I had take two rooms. One was a suite and the other was a twin room. Both a beautifully decorated.

I travel quite extensively in five star hotels and this is not only the best value it also has a charm that is unsurpassed.The rooms, staff and food were all exceptional.The food was wonderful both buffet breakfast and dinner.

We arrived at Baber Mahal Vilas after completing our trek to Everest Base Camp. We booked this hotel cos we wanted to pamper ourselves after 12 days of being on the mountain. Our room, the Chandra Suite, was beyond amazing. However, the journey started the moment we got out of our cab. We were greeted by Pravin, the manager. Instead of showing us to our suite, he took us on a tour of the area. Explaining the history of the place & the significance of many of the items & paintings on display. He also showed us the 4 restaurants in the complex, which aren't linked to the hotel, which we had very easy access to. When we saw our room, we were gobsmacked! We've had suites before, but this room was really grand. Something you'd expect to see at Versailles or Buckingham Palace. The buffet breakfast was a great way to the morning. The puris were perfect & extremely hard to resist a second order 😋. The spa is a major bonus. The massage sessions we had undid most of the damage from the trek. This is definitely a place my wife & I will revisit on our next trip to Kathmandu.

Having travelled the world over many years, this hotel has to rank up there as one of the most wonderful experiences. The hotel I discovered is legendary in Kathmandu amongst the locals, it is steeped in history. There is a selection of room grades from I will say standard (which is anything but) to suites. At least five restaurants on site, all serving different styles of cuisine. As is the custom, save the best until last, the staff are absolutely beyond words, nowhere have we encountered better. I would love to name them all but that would be impossible, so I can only name those whose names I have (Sudikshya, Abhipsha & Sweety). Very highly recommended.

The Baber Mahal is an excellent place to stay. Everybody; reception (Rupes Karki - Manager Reception and the Ladies), bar, restaurant, housekeeping, management, etc., etc., are doing their utmost that you will have a magnificant stay. You have a need (taxi, visit a location, etc.; they will help you. We felt realy at home! Keep this top level service quality. The location is very quiet in a hectic Kathmandu. Thank you!

We stayed with Babar Mahal Vilas for few days. The time we arrived at airport, the Mgr of the Hotel, Prabin, already making sure we were well taking care of. The moment we arrived, we are greeted with warmth and welcoming. Prabin was extremely courteous and showed us around the hotel. His staff were very friendly and helpful. Three of us had two rooms. The rooms are very spacious. Sitting room, king size beds, big bathroom and very nice decors. Sometimes it felt like we were in a palace. Prabin upgraded us to the suits and they were Stunning. That was very very nice of him. The amenities are all there. Workout room , swimming pool, shops and restaurants are all within reach. The foods at the restaurants were fantastic and very good. We tried all 5 restaurants in the hotel. The breakfast were delicious.One thing I must mention, the staff at the Vilas were simply wonderful. Felt like family, Rupesh, Meela, Sweety, Minju and many more were so attentive and helpful. They became part of our family. They are special! The Babar Mahal Vilas is the place to stay next time you are in Kathmandu, Nepal. 5 stars all the way!!!Best Regards Koushik, Bob and Kenny

Such a unique hotel with an incredible history.  Restaurants and shops within this complex add to the ambience and experience.  The service is second to none and your requests are met with courtesy like you have not experienced.  We started our 16 day exploration of Nepal here and ended it here. Highly recommend!!!

Smiling and courteous staff made my wife and I feel like their most welcomed guests.  Hotel property is a visual delight fashioned from historic architecture, surrounded by a labyrinth of boutique shops and dining, all within a few steps.  Rooms are exceptionally clean and comfortable.  The breakfast buffet offers ample variety.   Room service delivered a smashing late evening dinner.  A special shout-out goes to Sudikshya and Abhipsa at the front desk for their professional and friendly service that made our stay at Baber Mahal Vilas so extra special.  Why anyone would choose to stay anywhere else in Kathmandu is beyond me?

Breakfast and staff in breakfast areas are not up to 5 star standard. Manager and staff there are not welcoming, their rare smiles looked cold and forced. Food items were not fresh,  not replenished regularly and not kept hot. Croissants were stale and hard. Breakfast place is far from the rooms and problematic to reach when it rains. The shower head does not work well. TV worked half of the time and require hotel intervention every time which was annoying and time consuming. Decoration with photos of people who the hotel  has no idea about makes it look strange and more of an imitation than authentic about history or heritage.

I cannot imagine a better place to stay in Kathmandu. Other high-end hotels in Kathmandu want to make you feel like you're back home. Baber Mahal makes you feel like you're in 19th century Kathmandu with air conditioning and high speed internet. A truly unique experience and a unique property.

Loved the interior and exterior of the villas. The villas has utilized each and every corner in optium possible ways Both food and rooms were par excellent. They served us authentic royal rana thali set. All staff members were polite and cordial.

Wonderful staff of the hotel. The hotel itself is amazing which opens a window to the history of Nepal. This is truly a heritage hotel of Nepal.  It is clean with a nice breakfast. Lovely fishes in the center of the hotel yard  calm your mind. I am grateful that I met Abhipsa, Sudikshya, and Sweety - they are excellent managers working at the registration. They are are very helpful to support anytime and talk about their culture and traditions. I really enjoyed my stay at this hotel with distinct architectural style.

A very nice boutique hotel. The rooms are spacious and comfortable. The thing that really made the hotel good are the staff who could not have been more helpful or thoughtful up make sure I had a nice stay. As soon as there were any small problems, they ensured a solution was found immediately. The hotel is part of a small complex that has excellent restaurants and interesting shops. The only downside for me was the gym being currently closed for renovations.

I had a completely pleasurable, relaxing, engaging experience at Baber Mahal Villas. From the charm and delight of the buildings to the perfect, helpful, gracious, friendly, diligent staff, to the comfort and elegance of the well appointed, tasteful rooms, to the several restaurants and interesting shops, Baber Mahal Villas literally has it all. I loved it so much that I brought friends back the night after I checked out, so that Rupes, a superb, knowledgeable member of the management team, could give them his fascinating tour and explanation of the history and appointments of the buildings. It was great fun, and my friends even got to see a traditional Nepali dance selection from the larger program I enjoyed the night before. If you’re looking to enjoy a slice of Nepali history and culture and stay in elegant surroundings full of story, character, and charm, then Baber Mahal Villas is the place for you!

This is really one of the most beautiful and interesting hotels you will find anywhere.  Everything is extremely well done, the staff are courteous, and the ground and building feel wonderfully historic.The staff is also extremely kind.  For example, Rupesh was very generous and helpful throughout our stay.  Highly recommended.  Not to be missed.

Not just a home, but the felt more like a royal stay. This property was not nothing short of magical for me. I remember when we arrived in the property, we were welcomed beautifully in nepali traditions. Our room was beautifully decorated for my special occasion, made us felt more than welcome. Staff was extremely polite and they gave us a nice tour of the property. Food was delicious and the property had historical significance and a heritage. Loved the personal touch of arrangement of towels, bottle of water and bath-rob before my swimming pool session. Thanks for the amazing stay, looking forward for another soon trip and stay !!

Wonderful staff and service, the rooms were top notch. Everything you need is on site, including multiple restaurants, shops,  gym, lounge etcDefinately coming back! Wonderful pleasant and competent staff. Great place in the heart of KMD Nepal

Dear Baber Mahal Vilas Team,I had an exceptional stay at your establishment! The hospitality and gestures from your staff were truly outstanding. I thoroughly enjoyed every aspect of my visit, from the beautifully appointed rooms to the delicious cuisine. Baber Mahal Vilas made my days truly memorable, and I can't wait to return. Thank you for providing such a wonderful experience!

I had a pleasure staying here three nights before and after a motorcycle tour in Nepal. The property was wonderful but more importantly the staff and manager were incredibly attentive. A great experience overall.  Wonderful breakfast on site as well as several restaurants within the property.

It was a very nice, comfortable and good size room. We used the steam & sauna on a regular basis. They accommodated  our various request to full. Really nice management & members of staff. We would prefer to stay here if we had a choice compared to a hotel chain.

I have been going to Kathmandu for years and there is no other place I will stay.  The beautifully restored old building and the period decorations give the place a regal feel.  Pay up for the bigger rooms and you won’t be disappointed.  This place is a relaxing treasure in the middle of Kathmandu.

Amazing ! Beautiful, historic and full of character. Every corner of this building is filled with soul. If you are someone who is intrigued by history and is looking for a place which is drenched in history and is luxurious, look no further.The staff is extremely helpful and courteous, maybe one of the best in the industry.This is a must, must stay in Kathmandu.

Have rarely raved about great Nepali food but Jyunar surpassed it . It was an amazing meal. Everyone who served us were so attentive and super efficient, thank you all for the amazing experience.Thank you Prabin for organizing and making it easier to book and dine. It was handled perfectly. Appreciate it!I cannot wait to bring back friends here for the great food, phenomenal service and the ambience.

A gorgeous hotel walking distance to the busy streets of Kathmandu. The rooms were wonderfully done and it felt as if you were in a palace. There were also lovely gardens and a pool (although it was too cold when we went!) the hotel backs onto a courtyard with wonderful restaurants and shops. It’s in a quieter area as well but easy to get to the main city. I’d definitely recommend. Oh, and my partner RAVED about their breakfasts - sausages, eggs, bacon amongst other things. Highly recommend going here.

After doing a EBC trek, Baber Mahal Vilas was the perfect place to stay.  I have been to Nepal trekking several times.  I have stayed in places like the Yak & Yeti, Hyatt Regency and other nice places.  Baber Mahal Vilas was a clear step above them all.  The manager and staff are super attentive.  The dining is among the best in all of Kathmandu.  It's a bit more expensive than most places, but well worth it!

I thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Baber Mahal Vilas. The staff are extremely friendly and couldn't have been more helpful. Alot of thought has gone into designing and furnishing the hotel, which has beautiful character and an interesting history. The rooms have lots of interesting decor features and are very comfortable. Availability of a spa is a treat. It feels like an oasis in the middle of the bustling city. Great food options. We will definitely be staying here again.

Due to last moment change of plan I landed at this property and had very nice experience here. We arrived at property and took a tour of whole place which was nice and had sauna late night and later had royal thali for dinner which was good. Room had everything a guest required and was very clean. Personally I like the clean pond full of koi fish in their courtyard. I would definitely recommend this property to anyone.
Very nice, simple and friendly staff (shyam especially), beautiful property, clean rooms. Only issue was the construction noise in adjacent property. Easy approach. Customized breakfast menu. Enjoyed

We had a great time as a family. Very tasteful decor in Victorian era and comfortable suites!Central location makes it close to most places of attraction.The staff at the reception were excellent.  Sweetie, Sudikshya and Rupes thank you for making our Stay comfortable.  We certainly will visit again.

Mr Varun Rana and his staff took personal care of my wife and I during our stay at Baber Mahal. The staff is polite and very helpful and the property is very well maintained. My best wishes and blessings to Mr Varun Rana and his staff, keep up the good work! Th. Man Singh Kanota Narain Niwas Palace Hotel Jaipur

The rooms are just amazing, the staff is very friendly and always willing to help. They will also extent the sun deck so in future the stay at the pool will even be more nice. the historical background of the house makes it a special experience to stay there. The feeling is more to be a private visitor of this place than a hotel guest. in the complex there are also some shops with exquisite things like the nepali books, which I buy everytime. it was my 25th time in Nepal, a new experience and I hope to come here back again.

I have had 6 comfortable, easy days in this unique boutique hotel in Kathmandu. I love the concept of the architecture of the building. There is a colonial style wing, a Nepalese wing and a Tibetan wing.I stayed in the Nepalese wing and was very comfortable. Everything in the room worked as one would expect and require from a well run boutique hotel.The staff are amazingly helpful and friendly.The atmosphere is calming and relaxing.Well done to the team, you run a good ship!

An awesome oasis in Kathmandu! Very supportive and friendly stuff in a fantastic palace ambience ! I felt cozy in my comfortable, beautifully equipped and decorated room. Just the perfect place to stay in Kathmandu for a really very fair price!

An excellent hotel offering comfort and style. Staff go out of their way to ensure your stay is enjoyable.  Food was good and reasonably priced. Breakfast was excellent with choice of Nepalese or continental foods. Rooms are well equipped and comfy

Beautiful hotel set amongst the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu. After a day out it was so lovely to return to such a beautiful, peaceful location. Staff were all so lovely and make us feel welcome from the start of our stay, right through to the moment we left. Rooms were beautiful and perfectly clean and stocked. Absolutely would recommend and will certainly return if we visit again!

Everything was great! The location, food, room… room was clean and confortable, wifi was good, breakfast full of options…I had a personal problem during my stay at Baber Mahal and all the staff made everything to help me! I had to mention Rupes, he made our stay the best! Its a place to feel home and defenetly I will come back!!!! Best option in Nepal!

I cannot recommend this hotel highly enough; impeccable service from airport collection through to drop off. I am unable to fault the staff, rooms, food and amenities. Maybe the pool was rather cold but it was winter!Five stars.

We had a very good stay at the hotel, with excellent service from Rupesh. Actually the stay was made good thanks to Rupesh he went out of his way to make sure all goes well. There were a few hiccups from the hotel side and other staff, specially with the safe boxes... but It was fixed and rupesh did his best. I definitely plan to return. Love the architecture of the hotel!

Best place to stay in Kathmandu. Friendly staff and beautiful property with spacious rooms and amazing food options. Staff are very accommodating and professional. 10/10 would recommend. Special shout out to Sulav at the front desk and Director of Operations - Mr.Prabin Pudasaini for making sure my stay was comfortable and felt like home.

Beautiful rooms, interior decoration and grounds. An amazingly refurbished Palace for guests to feel very special. Lovely staff, sumptuous surroundings. Several good restaurants in the attached courtyards, including Nepali, French, Continental and Indian.

Definitely one of the best and safest hotels in Kathmandu. Excellent service and recommendations for visiting the city, and beautiful historical and luxury hotel with many facilities. The staff was always extremely kind and available.

During my extensive world travel I stayed in many boutique hotels, Baber Mahal Villa was one of the best boutique hotel, I ever stayed!Nice complex, nice room exceptional and helpful staff. Breakfast was plentiful. Reasonable taxi ride to all major attractions.

Such an incredible boutique property on a VIP road...absolutely amazing staff ..specially Sulab and Bikash...🎊🌸🎊They are very spontaneous and efficient. The place have some amazing restaurants and the all over vibe of the property was made me felt excellent. ❤️It's on of those property 1 should never miss to stay...100 % recommend

Comfortable beds, food is solid from the hotel buffet (never thought I’d say that). Top end gym for a hotel. Solid service from staff like Yujan and several others. Solid option is you’re looking for a modern hotel.               …………………………………………………………

Intimate dinner with private terrace view and amazing service. We had plenty of time almost four hours. The location and the back drop is amazing. The villa was amazing. Thanks Rupesh karki (FOE)jr for making this happen. We will come back again.

We stayed two nights at Baber Magali Villas and it was very nice. The rooms are large and well decorated. The breakfast was nice. The staff was very welcoming and helpful. The place is quiet and offers a nice break from the busy city. A good option in Kathmandu.

This is a wonderful hotel. The staff are amazing and ready to help in any way. The building is beautiful and unique with all the various courtyards. The French restaurant is exceptional. I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone wanting to get away from it all.

The Baber Mahal is a beautiful hotel and a unique place to stay. We were only there for 1 night and thoroughly enjoyed it. The staff were very friendly and welcoming, and many thanks to Rupesh for kindly accommodating us with our departure. I hope to return to Kathmandu for a longer stay at the Baber Mahal.

I spent a few days at the Babel Mahal and thoroughly enjoyed my stay. The staff were friendly and very helpful, the room was lovely with ample hot water, not a given in Nepal, and the breakfast was great. The Baber Mahal is a beautiful, peaceful property in the middle of very busy Kathmandu!

Such a delight and a real gem in the heart of Kathmandu. Offers charm, royal heritage and comfort. I love the curated surrounding shops. Spacious rooms and wonderful amenities. The library is precious and the books are part of the owners' collection.

The hotel was very comfortable and staff very helpful and friendly.  We had a standard room with spacious en suite.  The room was also spacious and the bed extremely comfortable.  I would recommend Baber Mahal for a relaxing stay in Kathmandu.

I was fortunate to have a sneak preview of this new hotel just opening in Kathmandu where I am living. I didn't stay there (but 100% would). 13 rooms on two levels built around in an internal garden. Each room is of a different architectural style and overall the hotel conveys elegance, peace and beauty in a city wrecked by concrete, traffic, noise and glass. Bathrooms looked fantastic, I lay (feet off the duvet) to test the mattress - firm but very comfy. Swimming pool on the roof, each themed room is equipped with TV, fridge, etc. You can't buy class, and the family (who also own Barber Mahal revisited) have an aesthetic and spiritual understanding of architecture and what would best suit the needs of the sophisticated, weary traveller. Our group were served tea, coffee and sandwiches. It appears the tradition of service is alive and well. We met and talked to the architect and other family members. There is no comparison with the smart, adequate but colourless chain hotels. Here everything from the hinges on the windows to the doorknobs on the wardrobes is thought and beautifully presented. This hotel is about individual style, grace and aesthetic charm with each room having its own unique character. The hotel, given its owners and location is infused with a sense of history (family portraits, etc.). There are various soothing water features. A fixed menu, but the Chez Caroline restaurant is a minutes walk through the courtyard to shops.etc. Can't wait to find a reason to stay there when it opens very shortly. Well located.

Stanze e albergo di altri tempi...Pulizia molto elevata e accoglienza eccellente. Cortesia assoluta e comfort con rapporto qualità/prezzo elevato. Location forse un po’ lontana dal centro come unico piccolo difetto. I taxi però costano così poco che diventa marginale. Cena in albergo forse un po’ parca come ristorazione. I 4 punti di trip advisor però li merita tutti.

I am delighted to report that I have now found my new home from home in Kathmandu!  I stayed at Babar Mahal Vilas' purely by chance (my regular bolt hole having mixed up my dates). I was their first staying guest and Tino, Gaurav and the team treated me like royalty.  This fabulous boutique hotel has been designed to perfection, blending culture and comfort in the most charming way.  The rich history of Nepal intertwined with that of the host's family adorn the walls making you feel both at home and yet a privileged guest.      The rooms are spacious and very well appointed. The highlight for me, apart from the service was the nights sleep I had. A wonderfully comfortable bed and amazingly quiet as Babar Mahal vilas is tucked away from the usual cacophony of Kathmandu.  I sadly didn't eat dinner at the Hotel but the breakfast and lunch I had were delicious with fresh, tasty ingredients. I travel regularly to Kathmandu and I will make sure I book well in advance to ensure I do not miss the opportunity to stay at Babar Mahal vilas on every trip.  Thanks you so much Tino and I look forward to seeing you all soon!

Hotel molto ben curato econ personale molto gentile e disponibile nell'ambito di un complesso restaurato con varie boutique. Il posto tranquillo e riservato ha camere spaziose e ben curate, pulite e dotate di ogni confort. Possibile consumare i pasti in tre ristoranti con cucina nepalese, indiana e internazionale.

This is my favourite hotel in Kathmandu. Converted from the various supporting buildings, cow sheds, stables, guards' quarters of Baber Mahal, a Palladian style palace  that was home to the foremost of the Rana Maharajahs that ruled Nepal for 100 years until 1950. The conversion is tasteful, inspired and combines modern luxury hotel standards with the ethos of a bygone era. Each room is individual, the decor relies on Nepalese arts and crafts but there is always that hint of Victorian/Edwardian grandeur that the Ranas captured. The restaurant does a good breakfast which can be eaten either inside or in the little courtyard next to the Bar. At least one dinner should be eaten in Baithak, the First floor restaurant which serves a traditional Nepali Thali meal. This comprises a variety of meat curries, vegetables, daal, rice, bread and some of the indigenous "achars" which I would broadly translate as 'chutney' but that does it little credit. A friend whom I introduced to the hotel recently and who is averse to spicy food, thoroughly enjoyed every dish. Any review of Baber Mahal Vilas which made no mention of the staff would be a grave dereliction of duty because they are wonderful. They capture that clever balance between courtesy and attention to your needs which, whilst not obsequious, still makes you feel that they enjoy looking after you. From the very excellent Operations Manager Prabin Pudasaini down to the restaurant waiters, they manage to do what a true boutique hotel should do and make you feel that your stay, no matter how brief, is a visit home. My only regret is that by sharing this with others, I may be making it more difficult for me to book rooms in future!

When my work require constant travel I opted for the ubiquitous chain hotel - Marriott, 4 Seasons etc as I knew what I would be getting. Now that I travel for leisure that simply isn't enough. When researching Kathmandu I came across Baber Mahal Vilas. I was not going to pass up a chance to stay at a Rana Palace much less one still owned and operated by the Rana descendants. The staff is wonderful, the food excellent and the service always gracious - that alone would be enought to stay. But the real star is the hotel - culture, art and artifacts in every corner. I spent hours just wandering around the vilas, every corner brought new discoveries. Newar, Buddhist and Victorian influences abound. A must stay when in Katmandu.

I stayed at Baber Mahal while in Kathmandu on a business trip. Despite being here for work, it felt like being on a fantastic holiday. All the staff really made everything they could to make our stay special, including offering an upgrade to beautiful rooms when they were available. In general, all the rooms are incredible! Special design, clean, comfortable, quiet... And the hotel in itself carries a piece of history of Kathmandu, which makes it really special. There are plenty of shopping and dining options nearby, as well as an art gallery. Momos at the hotel are the best we tried in town. Cannot recommend this place enough, and I will surely come back on my next trip to Nepal!

I really enjoyed my experience at Baber Mahal Vilas. However the rooms need a bit of an update and some slightly nicer finishes. Curtains, shower curtain and lighting seems cheap and ruin the beautiful features of the property. Staff are super attentive and amazing and made the experience memorable. Managers are on top of things too. Just that the owners should engage a proper design person and invest a bit of money to finish the interior of rooms properly. It’s a bit of a letdown. Also the big bungled brass bolts and locks could be modernized with magnetic key locks. Small things do make a difference.

Beautiful art work spread all over the property. nice and spacious rooms with good internet connection.Breakfast is somewhat limited in options but the staff is friendly and the premises are very clean.

We got an upgrade and had great and big rooms. The shops and restaurants in the immediate vicinity are very nice. The breakfast was great, actually the best during our stay in Nepal.The beds are great, we slept like a baby.The hotel organizes a transfer to the airport on request. The driver was there on time.I left my iPad at the hotel. The hotel manager took care that I got the device back. Super service!

I love taj mahel it is so beautiful i love that place and this hotle is also very nice i visited at taj mahel and mall that place is so nice i like it all can take hotles in tgis hotel plz beacuse it is very nice hotel in service.

I stayed 4 nights in this 13 Room/Suites Hotel and highly recommend it to my fellow travelers. First and foremost there is the charm this Hotel exudes. Owned by  2 Rana family ( check them out on Wikipedia!!) descendants they have managed to incorporate some of the Nepalese culture into the Hotel. From some of the interior decoration, to the traditional dress worn by staff to the excellent food offered in the restaurant ( which may not look like much).  The dinner I had there was very special!!!!  The staff of the Hotel was out to make my stay as comfortable as possible. And they did! Friendly at all times, helpful and respectful! My large room had everything I needed, was tastefully decorated and very clean. The bathroom was well appointed. The Hotel also is centrally locates !!I loved my stay at the Baber  Mahal Villas!

As first timers in NEPAL Kathmandu was our first stop and we were mind blown as we entered Baber Mahal Vilas as it exudes culture and traditions of history from ends of the country. Our experience was absolutely wonderful thanks to Prabin Pudasaini  who helped us with showing the place explaining the rich history it holds and managing our whole stay with the helpful staff. The food options in and around are quite a lot if you walk around Baber Mahal revisited. It’s a quite, cozy luxury stay unlike what the busy hotels offer. Lucky we chose this, already dreaming about going back.

Four night stay. Boutique hotel set in the grounds of a grand restored palace.The hotel offers a peaceful escape from the hectic city and as soon as I arrived I knew I had made a great choice for my visit to Kathmandu. My ground floor room was large and well designed. The room contained a comfortable twin bed, writing desk and large wardrobe, as well as flat screen TV and small lounge area. The bathroom had a large walk in shower. The room was very comfortable and clean. The hotel it self Is like stepping into Nepal’s royal history. The hotel has a small bar and restaurant along with library , spa and small rooftop swimming pool. There are also several small terraces for relaxing. The hotel rooms look out on the central courtyard which has a beautiful water feature. The staff were all fantastic and very accommodating.  Staff were always smiling and ready to offer any assistance required. The hotel also organised a tour for me and gave me helpful tips for my daily sightseeing. This was greatly appreciated. The breakfast had a small but adequate selection of cereals, fruit, breads and juices set up and the staff would cook your eggs, bacon, tomatoes, hash brown and chicken sausage according to your preference. This meant the hot food was always fresh and made to order. The breakfast staff were great. Its nice when staff remember your drink and food preferences from the previous day and you are welcomed in the morning with a genuine good morning. Thank you. Great stay and would and would highly recommend.

When i visited this property i was amazed with the great history preserved by this hotel and with the great ambience. Baber Mahal Vilas is a quaint family-run boutique property set in the existing architectural haven of Baber Mahal Revisited. In an effort to portray the distinct architectural features of Nepal in an blend of architectural design, the property shows 4 distinct styles.

I'd have been delighted with this place if it was 50% of the price. At $200 a night though, you'd expect towels that weren't obviously very old and yellowing, bath robes, dental kits in room, full breakfast buffet, English speaking, well trained staff on hand at all times, a big pool (instead of a tiny one that you can't do laps in) and a quiet room (ours was on the ground floor near reception and so quite noisy in the morning. It's basically a boutique 4 star hotel at 5 star prices. But it's a nice place.

I have been to Kathmandu at least 10 or 11 times and always stayed at the Radisson and the Crowne Plaza and once at the Hyatt but this time decided to take a chance and try something different. I am usually not one to deviate from name brand hotels but decided to try this boutique hotel that received very good reviews from quite a few websites. We stayed at Barbar Mahal four nights in the month of July. The nice points are that the villas are clean and in a somewhat more serene area than Kathmandu's usual offerings.. The villa comes equipped with a nice small size pool and a small gym that looked functional.   The flaws with this accommodation was that the back up generator does not fully do its job. The air conditioner turned off two nights in the middle of the night and sadly woke me and I had a hard time getting back back to sleep. The internet at this establishment is very low quality and I had some business to take care of that took me 2 hours rather 30 minutes due to the snails pace of the internet connection. You also have to re-log into the internet every perhaps 20 minutes.I would not stay here again because I have to be able to be online and like it cool when I sleep.  Breakfast was redundant after 3 days and I purchased my own cereal rather than having another masala omelette or a mediocre pancake. ( NO cappuccinos and no lattes just french pressed coffee which I found annoying,)The rooms were nice but the amenities were substandard.and I dont appreciate paying slightly more than $100 a night without the ability to keep the room at an acceptable temperature. Not a great value.  I do have to mention that the staff is very nice and professional and try to be helpful but it does not make up for the lack of a good hotels basic amenities. This hotel is fine if you are touring but not if you have to conduct business,   Also hotel forgot a wake up call one day. Thankfully it was not a travel day. . Nice place but not worth $100 a night.

First impression coming to the hotel with beautiful  smile and a warm welcome by front office team and food and service was nice . Would highly recommend  others to visit once and staff were really amazing  specially Rajat,Manish M,srijana,nisha,and nabin .

I have stayed three nights total, it is a very good hotel with welcoming staff that offer good services, the two different rooms I had were clean, the food/drinks were good and I had a good massage.I have appreciated the fact that it is close to the airport.

We had such an incredible stay here. The hotel is beautiful and the staff are amazing and made us feel very well looked after. The facilities are great and it is very easy to get around Kathmandu to see some of the tourist attractions. 10/10!

A real gem in a great location.I Arrived here after a mix up with my hotel bookings for a conference and I’m so glad I did!The hotel is part of the old palace and so beautifully renovated. All rooms are different, with unique style and character and the little touches make it stand a head above the rest.  The staff are just amazing, they couldn’t be more helpful polite and friendly, I felt truly looked after, a feeling that I was not ‘just another guest’ (which I was of course). Always smart and obviously well-trained. The guest services manager went above and beyond.If you’re looking for a friendly, unique experience in Kathmandu then look no further than the Barber Mahal vilas

המלון ממוקם באזור שקט, מזמין, אין עומס אורחים, המללון מפפוזר בבנינים נמוכי קומה בסגנונונות שונים, מספר מסעדות טובות פזורות בחצרו, בריכת שחיה קטנה, חדר אימונים קטן וחמוד, חדרים גדולים ויפהפיים. פשוט מעולה

I live in Pokhara & always stay at the baber mahal on my way in & out of Kathmandu. It is without a doubt a completely unrivalled Institution in the city. The hotel is beautifully decorated with impeccable attention to detail.  Whether you’re starting or finishing a trip or just spending a few days in the city it’s the perfect oasis in an other wise crazy place. The rooms are each unique & delightful in there own way. Creating a tranquil getaway from the hustle and bustle of the Kathmandu streets. The staff are all exceptionally helpful & professional making each visit here a Complete delight. They go above and beyond in making sure you have a fantastic stay , attentively meeting all of your needs. There are many little places to relax in this boutique such as the bar , the roof top pool , the spa or even there library. All have a private , quiet , tranquil feel.There food & drinks are excellent & the overall hotel is faultless in its cleanliness. I recommend all friends and family to stay here on route to us in Pokhara & everyone has loved it over the last couple of years. My husband and I will continue staying here ! An absolute must for a truly special stay in Kathmandu !

I stayed a total of 5 nights during my travel to Nepal in two different suite rooms with a balcony each. I instantly loved the intimacy, love for details and individuality of the hotel. During my last three nights, some construction work was ongoing but should be finished very soon, otherwise the compound is very quiet. The suites are spacious and very well equipped with all you require. Food was also very good. Only the breakfast selection was a little bit poor as I enjoy local breakfast and the hotel offers Western breakfast only. If I come to Kathmandu again, I most probably would opt for this place again. Thanks to the staff!

An excellent small hotel with a very nice and polite personnel. Good breakfasts and dinners. A good site, close to Thamel and Durbar Square. We had a nice and clean room with very good service. Nice Himalaya view from the hotel rooftop. I recommend asking hotel manager about assistance in organization of your tours. He was very helpful to us and the price we got was competitive. Picking up and dropping off the taxi in front of the hotel. Good price and very kind service. I would recommend this hotel to everybody.

Like many people who used to live in Kathmandu I sometimes now avoid it as too crowded, polluted, concrete, all the charm gone, etc.. I would fly in and fly out to Pokhara or Chitwain or Nagarkort. This time I knew i had a month or so for business and had a bit of a middle class rather than backpacker budget and saw the wonderful Baber Mahal Revisted (used to be horse stalls for the Rana family series of shops now had a hotel decorated in various traditional Nepali styles (Newar, Rana, and Mustang) and booked three nights. I ended up staying the month! I stayed in several of their lovely rooms, enjoyed the rooftop pool and sauna, and enjoyed the in house room service, laundry, and they even connected me to a trekking guide I worked with on several treks. I LOVED coming home to this place after tooling around Kathmandu all day and the little touches made it feel like home: once I admired some grapes and the staff member asked me if I would like some in my room! WOW. I love all the staff and they obviously enjoy their work. They have a new chef with experience cooking Nepali and Thai dishes who will take requests. World class.

The Baber Mahal Vilas Hotel was my first choice when I planned to travel to Kathmandu and Nepal.  I spent 12 days  there and enjoyed every moment and learned so much about the culture of Nepal.I was greeted on arrival by Prabin Pudasaini who graciously received me in the traditional Nepali way with a scarf and a dab of red on my forehead and had my room ready for me. When I woke up on my first morning I was greeted in the breakfast room by Raju Adhikari who gave me an extensive tour of the property . The people in the dining room - Subodh/ Niruta/ Sarina/ Manoj/ Sushil- were all incredible in assisting me and guiding me with what to eat -  The care and assistance from the team was heartwarming, They could not have been more helpful and made me feel truly at home. The reception desk is run with the utmost efficiency by Shreeya/ Aartee/ Sujan who truly assisted me in a multitude of ways form changing $ to making phone calls to locals to answering little questions - The service of a very well run establishment. Ranee/Rajmati/Keshari/Santu/Sisam/Bibek took exquisite care of my room and the packages I purchased from my shopping expeditions to Patan and Bhaktapur   I had a wonderful conversation. with Jayesh Rimal  the General Manager who could not have been more helpful. After a packed afternoon of shopping one day I had the good fortune to speak to Varun SJB Rana who is the Director of the Hotel and he complimented me on some of my purchases of metalwork from a workshop in Patan.

This hotel is a must stay. The décor and atmosphere is traditional Nepalese guesthouse. Definitely not just another hotel!  The complex is in fact a converted stables of the former Rana noble family. The rooms are spacious and the décor is quaint. Great bathroom and shower. Service was excellent with very friendly staff. Located in a relatively quiet area in Kathmandu. There are four restaurants connected to the villa complex. All serve good food ranging from Indian, Chinese, International to traditional Nepalese. There are also a range of boutiques. Definitely worth the cost.

This is a lovely hotel with very friendly staffThere is a pool and areas to sit and dineVery quiet area yet near shops and restuarantsThe rooms are big and beautifully decorated and the menu in the restaurant is varied. There is an area outside for drinks and there is a lovely pond in the garden area

I stayed at Baber Mahal in September of 2018. The managers, butlers, housekeepers, etc. made me feel like I'd gone to another time. You don't see service like this in many places in the world. It is incredibly quiet and off the beaten path but in the heart of the city. I recommend it to anyone.

Traumhaft schönes Hotel! Super individuelle Anlage mit sehr schönen Zimmern. Sehr gepflegt und sauber. Personal sooo freundlich aber nicht aufdringlich. Chef ist ständig zugegen und immer für ein Gespräch bereit. Frühstück einfach genial. Nichts pompöses und unüberschaubares - individuell und fein! Abendessen lecker! Das beste Hotel auf unserer Indien/Nepal Reise.

No hot water for over two days, the service is excellent otherwise. The breakfast was quite ordinary but still very good in Nepal standard. Most of staffs are very friendly. Just not the best compare to 5 star hotels.

The Baber Mahal combines luxury with class, taste and history to produce a unique hotel, and their staff is both highly efficient and friendly. The hotel is in a complex of shops and restaurants which offer the best of Kathmandu. I hesitate to recommend them so highly, lest others take up all the rooms, but they certainly deserve the highest praise.

We stayed at Baber Mahal for 10 nights and could not recommend it enough. The hotel is authentic and we were always very warmly welcomed by the staff when we returned to the hotel. The staff went above and beyond to make our stay enjoyable.The room and hotel amenities are excellent - comfortable bed, good wifi, great massage spa, clean and spacious room, gym facilities, rooftop pool, and delicious food (Nepali, Indian and French restaurant within the Baber Mahal complex). Hope to visit you and the team again, Prabin. Sophie & Paul (from New Zealand)

This hotel is beautiful, it’s full of art and beauty, everything is clean and elegant, spacious rooms, comfortable beds, great showers, excellent service, delicious food, beautiful rooftop and pool, amazing spa, helpful staff.It’s full of good vibes and feels like home,I highly recommend this hotel.I stayed here twice and will always do!

Stayed here for a couple of nights primarily on business, trying out a new acco .Positives :  Well trained English speaking staff. Above  average service. Spacious room & bathroom. Comfy bed and  good  antique furniture. Decent rooftop pool. Trendy restaurants next door. For my meetings the location was also central. Overall quiet n peaceful.Drawbacks - Breakfast options limited. No view from the rooms. My room lacked a full length mirror. Laundry might take 2 days.Seemed 10-15% overpriced compared to other KTM hotels.Overall , if you have a thing for leisurely Heritage hotels with good service this is the ideal. Hence popular with westerners i felt.

Having stayed at several other luxury properties in Nepal, including the Hyatt Regency in Kathmandu, this hotel was a cut above the rest. Incredible service, friendly and helpful staff, outstanding restaurant (great Nepali cuisine), clean and classy interior, and my list goes on and on. I've stayed at many a luxury hotel all over the world and Nepal definitely has a dearth of them. Had I known of this property earlier, we would have stayed here for the duration of my trip in Kathmandu. If nothing else, this property isn't sufficiently marketed on international travel websites which is a shame. From my own perspective, it should be very highly recommended!!

I had only a night stay here but was still made to feel at home and very welcomed.  Service was excellent and staff was extremely accommodating. Architecture is so charming, one would not be disappointed with their stay here.

Lovely boutique hotel with character.  Elegant, quiet, friendly, comfortable, beautiful boutique hotel with impeccable service.  Rooms are of three different historical styles and you can choose.Everything was just right.

I started reviewing this property at 4 star but ending up as 5 star and the 5th star is for extraordinary customer delight by employees a very rare in current world conditions. I forgot my credit card at the front office and reached airport, received call from Eliza she came all the way to deliver card to me. Thanks a lot ElizaNow about the hotel it's located at the centre of Kathmandu but at a very calm place having normal room and suits which will make you feel very special entrance of the hotel may not give you comfortable feeling but it has got 4 restaurants 35 shops in the property, spa swimming pool everything is available in house. Spend 3 days min and enjoy spending enough time inside the property

Amidst the tired, beaten-up and quite frankly, mold stricken contemporary ‘luxury’ hotels of Kathmandu (and I have been a guest in most), rises up a new kid on the block christened ‘Baber Mahal Vilas’. A quaint boutique hotel which ‘Represents’ Nepal’s traditional architecture and matches the luxury hotels in KTM in tariffs (a tad lower actually) but knocks them out of the park in terms of quality of service, standard of rooms and overall guest experience.The rooms are spacious and well appointed, on my compliments to the owners, they divulged that we got the tiniest offering in terms of space! I only believed it when we got a tour of the rest of the rooms. The staff is well trained and their attention to detail is most impressive with a special shout out to house-keeping. I had to call out my mother’s name just to make sure she wasn’t around knowing what condition I left the room, with our wedding clothes all over the bed to what it was when we came back. I think the people who would most associate with this specific detail are my friends who grew up in tea-gardens. A special mention to the duty managers at the reception on all those late nights when we wanted taxis in the middle of a hailstorm. I think it’s time Uber sets up shop in Nepal. The hotel neighbors the ‘Baber Mahal Revisited’ complex, a hidden gem, dotted with amazing restaurants, bars and a shopping complex and a rather expensive hair salon! I mean either that or my wife lied that she only got her hair washed and blow-dried.In conclusion, I am fan! thank you guys for rescuing our week in KTM. Cannot wait to be back!

We booked a last minute trip to Bhutan and needed a Kathmandu hotel en route. Aman hotels recommended Baber Mahal Villas and it was wonderful. The team could not have been more helpful and welcoming. Rajiv immediately and efficiently confirmed our booking as well as arranged airport transportation. We also had a few hours in the morning to explore and the hotel was happy to negotiate with our taxi driver and add it to our room. We had a wonderful lunch in the outside courtyard, delicious food, attentive service. When we departed, I left a jacket in the car. Rajiv once again provided exceptional service by retrieving the jacket. He arranged a drop off with our return flight through Kathmandu. Manoj brought the jacket and waited at the airport to get it back to me. The kindness of everyone was so appreciated. Our only complaint was that we didn't have more than one night at Baber Mahal Vilas. We will definitely stay there again when we return to Kathmandu.

What has been created here is nothing less than perfection, a real taste of erstwhile Nepali royalty comes to reality when you take your first step into the hotel.Tasteful decor and a surreal ambience contributes to an era that is to be treasured.Virat & Varun you have created something that any Nepali would be proud to call a suiting tribute to the Rana's of Nepal.A must stay at place in the beautiful city of  Kathmandu for an enriching experience.

This Beautiufl a former Rana Historic palace turned into a Hotel is BEST BOUTIQUE HOTEL THAT I HAVR EVER EXPEREINCE IN NEPAL a great Hospitality beyond excellence amazing staffs & Great owners its a pride of Nepal additional benefit of staying here is attached Shopping center with many hand made  Beautiufl nepalese creative shops along with the restaurants Bars &  beauty salon I would Highly recommend it to any fellow travelers & love to Visit again any time soon . Thank you Babar Mahal villas for making my stay utmost

Excellent hospitality . Stay was so pleasent and soothing special thanks to sulab at the front desk for making making our stay so comfortable ,  will visit again to Nepal and will certainly stay at this place❤️ will recommend to everyone visiting kathmandu

I'm staying with you this coming April; I have some questions.  I've tried using the contact function on your web site and by emailing 'info@babermahal.com'.  Neither has worked.How can I contact you?I am very much looking forward to staying with you this coming April.  The rooms and the location look lovely, especially theNewa Ghar.The room is located on the second floor looking out into the main courtyard. Situated on the roof top of the property it reflects a standalone ‘Ghar’ or home in midst of undisturbed views of the mountains around the valley . The room is located in the Newari section of the property with a quaint terrace, and blends with the traditional décor of Newari culture. The indoors of the room features intricate hand carved wooden columns separating the bedroom from the living space.Features:•	Room Area: Approx. 400 to 500 Sq.ft.•	Bed Type: Double BedAMENITIES•	43” LED TV with HD Cable•	24 hrs. Hot/Cold water•	24 hours electric backup•	300 Thread count sheets and micro fiber pillows•	King Coil Chiropractic Mattress with memory foams•	Air conditioning•	Stocked Mini Bar•	Video Library•	Free WiFiThanks very much.  This will be my first trip to Nepal; I think your hotel will make it wonderful.

We booked a traditional suite on booking for three days, at a very interesting price. Upon arrival we were offered an upgrade to the Royal Suite, a spacious mini apartment with a separate entrance. Beyond this appreciated surprise, the stay was very positive in all respects. Comfortable bedroom and bathroom equipped with everything necessary for a luxury stay; breakfast on the terrace of the main restaurant also within the Baber complex (a well-done renovation of an old English structure from the early twentieth century). Even my celiac wife had no problems. One evening we had dinner inside the complex at the Indian restaurant and it was an overall good quality dinner.Logistically it is in the central part of Kathmandu and is convenient for various trips both to/from the airport and to other tourist attractions.Compared to other modern hotels that we had evaluated, it is definitely recommended for the atmosphere and the quality/price ratio.

What style! What a beauty! So much enchantment and surprises in this magnificent period hotel. Special mention for the bedding, the front door and its closing system which holds a big surprise and the sink.

Charming and comfortable boutique hotel, set in a period complex which includes a courtyard with selected quality shops and restaurants. For example, we went to the Indian one, very good and authentic. Thanks to Sulav who accompanied us to visit the entire complex.

We were super happy with this authentic hotel. It doesn't look like any other hotel and that in itself is wonderful. All rooms seem to be different and beautiful in their own way. It feels very cozy to be in the room and the hotel. The staff are very nice and helpful spec. the young girl at the reception who was always smiling.
