We were not so enthusiastic about the breakfast, it can be done better and the four restaurants were not the best we have tried. The Indian one is the best of them all (however, we were not on the Nepalese one) The hotel also has a fantastic location with walking distance to almost everything. The hotel staff were also very helpful when you had to get hold of a taxi or an Uber. We would choose the same hotel next time.

Very authentic, clean, high quality hotel. Everyone is nice, a small island where you can find everything!With great restaurants and shops. Breakfast was found in different locations every day, we enjoyed the variety. If we wanted to be busy, we were in the Thamel district in 10 minutes.

An oasis in the middle of the busy and caotic Kathmandu. A special thanks to Rupes Karki and his whole team for all their help in making our trip so special and welcoming. Very spacious rooms, super comfortable beds. Great restaurants and atmosphere. We will be back.

I’ve stayed in the Baber Mahal twice over the past three months when in Kathmandu for business. I tried a few hotels and settled on this as my favourite. It’s quiet (which is something in Kathmandu), the rooms are spacious and comfortable, the staff are super friendly and overall, felt like a home away from home.

Great! Here's a review of Hotel Barahi, located in Thamel:Hotel Barahi, nestled in the vibrant Thamel neighborhood, is a delightful hotspot offering a blend of warmth, elegance, and hospitality. The ambiance exudes a welcoming charm, with tastefully decorated interiors that create a cozy atmosphere for guests to unwind.The restaurant's culinary offerings are a highlight, featuring a diverse menu that caters to various palates. From authentic Nepali delicacies to international favorites, each dish is thoughtfully prepared using fresh, locally sourced ingredients, ensuring a memorable dining experience.The service at Hotel Barahi is exemplary, with attentive staff members who go above and beyond to cater to guests' needs. Whether it's recommending dishes, accommodating special requests, or providing prompt service, the staff ensures that every visit is met with utmost satisfaction.The staff member Captain supervisor Sunil and  the front office sanskritee helped for my dinner which made my day they were very generous and mainly sanskritee recommend me this place which I found out to be one of my best experiences.Overall, Hotel Barahi in Thamel stands out as a premier dining destination, combining delectable cuisine, inviting ambiance, and exceptional service to create a memorable experience for patrons. Whether you're a local or a traveler exploring Kathmandu, a visit to Hotel Barahi is sure to leave a lasting impression.

It’s a very beautiful heritage hotel with a very friendly staff and also with a great hospitality.the location of hotel is really peaceful and pleasant and me and my guest were really impressed with the hotel, all the staff and the management.thank you so much for making our stay beautiful.

A lovely hotel with a terrifically friendly staff (especially Rupesh!).  This is truly an oasis in the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu.  There are several dining options and numerous shops.  We highly recommend.
The place, suite and services are amazing,  a special thanks to Rupes for his help and attentiveness throughout our stay, he really went out of his way to make us feel right at home. 100% recommend!

What an incredible place to stay! A beautiful and relaxing setting.  We simply loved the property which felt like a tranquil oasis in busy Kathmandu. The staff are all super helpful and friendly. The location is not really walking distance from much so prepare for a 5 minute taxi to the tourist area/Thamel.

What a charming hotel. Nice rooms, nice breakfast, very friendly and helpful staff. We have been there several times, each time in a different room. All very spacious, clean and cozy. The restaurants in the complex are fine. Nice shops. Small but well-maintained swimming pool. Recommended.

Relaxed stay on edge of Kathmandu with fantastic staff & chilled vibe. Great facilities with 4 restaurants onsite. Super breakfast and staff are brilliant. Pre-arrival communication was excellent (I changed plans due to trek) and Rupes the front desk manager could not have been more accommodating.

This is a little paradise in the middle of crazy Kathmandu.The place is wonderful and very quite, rooms are very well furnished, the team is kind and very professional. The food is good.And you’re close to all the main places of Kathmandu.I warmly recommend!

V good hotel, lovely food - loads of choices and above all - amazing staff - front office, reception and kitchen/restaurant. One of the front desk staff - Rupesh was amazing- extremely customer focused and he went extra mile to make our trip v. memorable

I had a delightful three-night stay at Baber Mahal. The premium services and satisfying breakfast and dinner made my experience enjoyable. Hotel staff were very polite, and they helped me with the taxi before I left.

This hotel is absolutely fantastic! All of the staff are super friendly and helpful, and they really know how to take care of their guests. There is a lot to see and do at this hotel, so you won’t be bored if you just stay inside the hotel. The price for this hotel is very generous, probably the best hotel I’ve ever stayed in for the price. The breakfast is really good, they have different room types to choose from, each with it’s own unique style and taste. The staff can also suggest you places to visit, and even help you to arrange professional tour guides and rides, so you don’t need to look for things to do on your own. There is also a sauna and steam room, which are hard to find in Nepal. Within the complex, there are several restaurants and nice shops. I came to Kathmandu as a solo traveler, if I had stayed anywhere else, my experience would not have been the same. This hotel helped me arrange almost everything and I really enjoyed my time in Nepal.

The place has a very nice vibe the people are so helpful and welcoming, Dip the guide is very knowledgeable and great.The team was very cooperative to create an nice memory for my wife birthday. Definitely would go again

We loved the history behind this hotel, the Nepali welcome, the beautiful rooms, the shops and restaurants around, the folkloric dance, the attentive staff… EVERYTHING about this hotel was excellent!! Loved our stay here!!

We booked a nice hotel for our last night in Nepal This is a stunning hotel complex lots of Nepalese history and historical references and architecture away from the hustle and bustle Some building work is going on but the noise is  not too badOnly negative comments would be the pool area has no shade cover where the loungers are, the only other option is a small table with an umbrella and two chair’s slightly up from the pool. More shade by the pool should have been provided Rooms are stunning very olde worlde with chandeliers and old padlock to get into your roomWe went to one of the four restaurants for dinner. We opted for the European restaurant(not owned by the hotel) I chose the stuffed chicken breast it was tough and chewy (even my husband agreed it was not very nice) very disappointing and blood around the bone, the mashed potato was cold - it wasn’t worth the money, but the mushroom risotto was very tasty. The drinks were very expensive 800 rupees for a glass of wine. Overall the restaurant was over priced for what you were given. The disappointing thing too was the outside seating was full of smokers and as the expanding windows were all fully open the cigarette smoke can straight into the restaurant where we were eating. We complained to the waiter to no avail.

2 netter i en rolig oase i Kathmandu. Et fantastisk sted. Super service, nydelige omgivelser og et sted for å finne roen. Var der med min sønn som en del av en reise i Nepal. Hotellet er helt i toppen av de stedene jeg har vært på. Få rom på hotellet (som jeg liker), «alle» som jobber der «kjenner» deg på navn. Skal jeg tilbake i Nepal, kommer jeg garantert til å ha noen netter her.

We picked this hotel because we wanted something authentic and not a large, 5 star typical hotel.  We wanted something more personal and that would help us experience the culture. The hotel, the building, is pretty and historic.  Even one of the local guides commented that it is an important, historic building.The complex was nice because in addition to the hotel, there were 4 additional nice restaurants (French, Indian, local and international mix and Nepalese).  We ate at 3 of the 4 and were pleased.  In a country where it can be taxing to travel (haggling with taxi drivers, etc.), this was a great convenience.  There were shopping opportunities as well, which my wife enjoyed (convenience, nice quality).The best part is that the staff was lovely and attentive.  They were plenty and always helpful and pleasant.  We stayed in the Presidential Suite, which I expected to be larger.  I do not know the size of a regular room, so keep that in mind when booking.A complaint is that the noise was unpleasant.  Insulation is not sufficient.  We could hear noise from the hallway and courtyard, which woke us up at times.Location was in a quiet area away from the chaos of other parts of Kathmandu.Breakfast was ok.  Great for one day but on the boring side for an extended stay.

Hotel histórico, foi renovado mantendo as linhas antigas. Hotel muito central, com parqueamento para as motos. Quartos amplos. Bom pequeno almoço buffet. staff profissional, muito dedicado e genuínamente amigável. Perfeito para uma estadia curta de uma noite.

Lovely staff and wonderful boutique hotel to return to after spending time in the magnificent and enticing vibrancy of Kathmandu. Centrally located to all plcaes of interest. First choice when I return.

Hotel scelto nel nostro viaggio in India e Nepal  con il tour operator indiano Prem Viaggi, costo superiore alla media ma ripagato completamente. Accoglienza, cortesia, assistenza, ottima colazione. Camera molto bella con ampi spazi e bagno comodo. Location silenziosa e confortevole che si addice al tipo di viaggio. Consigliatissimo!

Nous n’avons été une nuit dans cet hôtel mais il est magnifique. Il y a des boutiques et 4 restos et tout le monde est super accueillant et gentils.Les chambres sont décorés à l’ancienne, car c’est un ancien palais. Il était en rénovation donc un peu de bruit mais ça a été. Le petit dej était top et franchement la déco entière de l’hôtel est magnifique. Je vous recommande fortement cet hôtel.

The Barber Mahal Villas was booked for us as part of a motorcycle tour with a company called 'Two Wheeled expeditions' - see my review on them on Tripadvisor - and from the moment we arrived it was clear that they could not do enough for us.Flight times meant we arrived later than the other members of the group so the staff continued to carry our luggage while another escorted us to the dining room.\The rooms are old world colonial style, and genuine with it not reproduction, but superbly comfortable.  The breakfast was simply wonderful and freshly prepared and the staff are so attentive that the tea cup is never empty.As we were travelling on motorcycle we had suitcases to leave behind and they were collected and locked away before we left and the bag we took with us was whisked away to the support truck before we could even try and lift it.10 days later we returned and were greeted with 'Welcome home', presented with a Tibetan prayer scarf and adorned with a Hindu chakra on our foreheads.  The luggage was in the room before we were BUT once the management learned that my girlfriend and I were the first pillion team that the company had escorted they upgraded us to a suite!Kathmandu is a wonderfully interesting place to visit and this hotel is a great place for a base.  I will return and would recommend it to anyone.

Hôtel calme et dans un petit havre à l’abri de la trépidation de Katmandu. Belle architecture  et deco de style colonial. Chambres spacieuses et décorées avec goût. Literie excellente. SdB parfaite. Service très attentif et souriant. Bar sympa . Très bon buffet petit déjeuner. Le seul bémol, est que le restaurant manque de charme , et d’originalité dans les plats. Mais ce défaut est mineur, dans la mesure où dans la galerie juste à côté on trouve deux excellents restaurants.

Can't recommend this hotel highly enough!It is my GO TO every time I visit Kathmandu, Rooms and bathrooms are spacious , luxurious, clean with super comfy beds and pillows , restaurant is great and room service is available too.House keepers are professional,There's also "evening service" where they come to make sure that everything you need is available and your room is clean and all perfect.  You will literally be treated like a royal. The hotel smells good, full of art and beauty wherever you go.Staff are so sweet and professional, special thanks to the hotel manager Mr. prabin, who is always caring and welcoming.And many thanks to all the people working there for the amazing hospitality.

We paid top dollar, over $300/night for an underwhelming experience.  Note: you can book the "presidential suite" for less, but my friend booked on a website that charged an extra $50 per night in fees.  Nonetheless, at $250 per night, this hotel is expensive for Kathmandu while delivering at best a 3-star experience. The hotel - The hotel appears to have been a beauty at one time, but in present day its best described as shabby and lacking care & maintenance. It needs updating and a good scrub to match the elegant and pristine presentation on the hotel website. The inside of the hotel is DARK throughout, including both of our rooms. The rooms are reasonably clean, but the rugs are dirty --perhaps housekeeping lacks a vacuum cleaner and doesn't take the time to shake them out. The balcony connected to the room was covered with dust and construction debris.Additional failures for a "five star" hotel -- toilet paper dispenser fell apart; paint peeling off the bathroom wall; old bath towels. On a positive note, the hotel has a pleasant library with comfortable seating and lots of books about the region. The hotel site includes several nice shops and an ATM. The food - the hotel breakfast was average and similar to breakfast at lower cost "guest houses" in Kathmandu.  The Indian restaurant on site had premium pricing with below average food. The spinach paneer was inedible, and the other dishes were just okay.  Service was VERY SLOW for a near empty restaurant with only one other table occupied, as well as a large rat roaming the upper shelves.  Stay clear of this place. The location - you'll need to take a taxi to shopping districts like Thamel and tourist sites. There is nothing interesting in walking distance.The service - with the exception of the booking issue, the service was FRIENDLY and HELPFUL.  Booking issue - We booked a presidential suite with two beds, however our room only had one bed. We were told the room with two beds went to another customer and there were NO rooms available with two beds.  After a lengthy stalemate, my friend offered to pay for a separate room, at which point the manager offered a separate room at no charge. That was the right thing to do and should have happened immediately.

The staff are gentle, professional, personable, and nothing was too much trouble and the rooms exactly what we were looking for: Authentic, spacious, luxurious and set in the traditional Nepalese culture of yesteryear.We look forward to staying again

Having just stayed at the Baber Mahal Vilas I can thoroughly recommend staying there! Rooms are fantastic, beds give you a great sleep, staff are very attentive and friendly. General Manager, Prabin, is amazing, nothing is too much trouble for him and his staff!! Food was lovely and everything is done with the most amazing Nepalese smiles that make you want to be able to stay with them longer! I will definitely be back!!

We stayed here before and after our motorcycle trip in Nepal. Couldn’t ask for anything better.   The staff is amazing and helpful the manager Prabin  went above and beyond. Would highly recommend staying here

Outstanding hospitality! We had enjoyed the hotel, food, wine and service. Beautiful place, you can stay all day long at villa’s restaurants, shops, in the pool and watching fantastic japanies fishI highly recommend the place! Thank you!

Wonderful boutique hotel, quiet oasis (even more quiet when they finished the construction works which are done during daytime ;-), stylish rooms, fine breakfast, very friendly staff. We really loved to stay there.

A unique place to stay in; the architecture, the interior design and the helpful and courteous staff across all areas. We were greeted and taken into a tour around the area to get familiar with the different facilities and to know about the history around the hotel which makes it stands out in comparison to other hotels.Rooms were comfortable with nice space. The message service was amazing. The gym is tiny though; only couple of machines and dim.The proximity to couple of the best restaurants in Nepal was a great plus. You can choose from 4 different cuisines. My favorites were the French and international, also, received great reviews in general and highly recommended. I wouldn’t say the same about the breakfast; quite limited that I had to skip altogether or TV channels. If I knew, I would have brought my own entertainment. Wifi was tough to connect to and not stable. All of these were not a deal breaker for me or my family but areas of development.There is a construction going on to expand the hotel capacity. it gets a bit noisy during day time. This should be completed in few months. so if you are spending your day out all the time, it shouldn’t be a problem.With regard to proximity to places of interest, you will need to take a taxi anyway so it doesn’t matter. I would recommend obtaining a Nepali number to get access to ordering taxi online - if you want- and ordering your food and grocery if need be - again not a deal breaker, just a way to improve the stay further-For us staff and place were the absolute best.

We spent 3 unforgettable days in this hotel with a typical Nepalese decoration. The staff is charming and attentive! A quiet pool with a view on Kathmandu! The room are very nice and quite! Ideal for couple and family

Can’t say enough wonderful things about this place. Post/mid Covid, we had an amazing room with a balcony and sitting room. Even better was the attentiveness and kindness of the staff. I can only hope to make it back to stay here again. Highly recommend this oasis in Kathmandu.

Baber Mahal Villas is such a beautiful & luxurious hotel. It has a history and a wonderful mix of architecture that work so well together. We were here for 3 nights and felt at home. All the staff members are friendly and go out of their way to help you. All the food options are amazing, especially the royal thali for dinner is definitely a must try! I will definitely return back here if I am back in Nepal. We had a wonderful stay here, Thank you for the kind hospitality!

Thank you to the Baber Mahel Vilas team for the excellent hospitality! I loved my stay here and look forward to staying here again in the future when I visit Nepal. The food at Jyunar was tasty and I will miss having the royal thali. Baber Mahel went above and beyond to get me a much needed massage after trekking. The property is beautiful, peaceful and very clean and the staff is friendly.  I highly recommend staying here!
住了三晚，体验非常好。环境优美，每个房间都有尼泊尔特色，服务非常热情。水电网供应都不成问题，提供瓶装饮用水。最后一天一个同事生病了，酒店经理特意请附近药店送来了药，特别感谢！

It was a pleasure to stay at one of the most beautiful hotels in the world!!! The hotel belong to a family who renovated the place as a boutique hotel. Special friendly staff and excellent dinner with a show of dancing Nepali style We Defendly will come back in the future

The Baber Mahal is a beautiful and friendly hotel with its own little village of boutique shops and cafes. It is extremely well run and the staff are an absolute joy with only their clients' best interests in mind. If you are visiting Khatmandu I an highly recommend the Baber Mahal Vilas.

It was a family holidays during Christmas 2019 and our stay in Baber Mahal vilas was awesome.. the staffs were very helpful in every ways.. the baber mahal vilas restaurant manager Mr. Gopal Nuepane is a very humble man who catered to our needs especially to our food preparation. The staffs in the restaurants helped to prepare the type of food especially lovely fried rice though it was not in the menu for my daughter. The waitress Niruta Thapa was very friendly with her humble smile all the time... it's a beautiful heritage hotel... makes one feel like home.. very quiet from the hustle and bustle of town ..a lot of things to see in there and walk around within the hotel vicinity... the staffs upgraded our room to heritage suite...with large terrace. Good for kids. Beautiful handicrafts though very  expensive. One  must never miss the creme brulee and strawberry tart in the French restaurant Chez Caroline... overall a lovely stay in the Baber Mahal Vilas..

Peaceful in the middle of the city, well designed, great service. great staff, royal touch and feelnice food, it was 40th anniversary of our parents and they really made it a royal and memorable celebration

Hospitality services were exceptional, beyond great. I stayed there three nights with a friend and will never think twice about staying there again if I ever visited Kathmandu again. The place is authentic and interesting, they have three main buildings, each with a unique story behind the design. They offer a variety of choices when it comes to food, there is something for everyone. I highly recommend this place for anyone visiting Kathmandu. Hats off to one of the best staff I've encountered my entire life.

The staff was so helpful with any requests we had and were exceptionally polite and accommodating. The hotel rooms were beautiful and the grounds made for a relaxing respite from the rest of the city bustle.

One of the most special trips. We were celebrating our first anniversary and had the pleasure to stay at this unique boutique hotel. The rooms are exquisite and clean with a traditional feel and look, the restaurants are just perfect, there is a shopping arena around the hotel with cute shops.The staff and management on the property  are extremely helpful, polite, attentive, experienced and service oriented. They will go out of the way to make your stay perfect.We truly enjoyed and cherish our stay at this property and will definitely visit again.

I LOVE BABER MAHAL! My favorite place in Kathmandu. Property is clean and with tons of charming character. Manager was super nice and very helpful with getting us around town. They provide free airport pickup. They even let me borrow some rupees before I could get to an ATM. Rooms are adorable with local handcrafted furniture. Lots of restaurants and boutique on the property. I would definitely stay here again.

One of the best places I have ever stayed at, not only because of the wonderfully renovated historical venue but mostly because of its outstanding service. Our experience visiting  Kathmandu will always be remembered positively thanks to our stay in this unique place. Their operations manager is one of the most professional individuals I have ever encountered in this industry; he ensured to arrange everything exactly as we wanted. We can't recommend this place and team enough!

We had an amazing stay at Baber Mahal Vilas.  The staff, rooms, food and overall property is spectacular. It was the best hotel for our whole 2 week visit in Nepal.  It’s a much needed refuge in busy streets of Kathmandu. The property is even better in person than the photos show. The massages at the spa were a bit pricey by Nepali standards - but well worth it. They hit every pressure and tight spot in the body after a long week trekking.  The hotel is quiet, historic and a short car ride to all the attractions of the city. There are 4 plus very delicious restaurants onsite at the hotel plus many high end and beautiful shops. You feel like you are part of old history (and royalty) while you are here.The hotel manager, Pravin, went out of his way throughout our stay to make sure we enjoyed our visit. He even drove us to the airport on his scooter at checkout given the heavy traffic.  It made for a memorable and exciting end to our journey. My only complaint was that I didn’t stay longer... it was a real sanctuary.

What a place🌟👍Just best ever! If you go to Kathmandu stay here. PP the manager is so accomodating and knows all about Nepan an excllent host can not find any better🌟🌟🌟🌟Just go for this place its just greate🥇🥇🥇🥇

The Vila is beautiful and completely different from other hotels we stayed in during our trip through India, Egypt and Nepal. But the Vila's biggest asset is its staff. From the welcome drink to the tour of the entire property, and the service at the hotel's 5 restaurants, everything is done with a happy smile. In the morning after breakfast my wife had a serious health issue and the Operations Manager, Prabin immediately organised a car to take her to a nearby hospital. The Duty Manager, Upesh, accompanied us all the way, acting as an interpreter and making sure my wife received prompt treatment. When my wife's health deteriorated further later in the morning, Prabid arranged for us to visit a private hospital where we received a consultation with a specialist within 20 minutes, allowing time for us to catch our flight to Kolkata later that day. As visitors in a foreign country we would have been lost without them. Baber Mahal Vilas ranks up with the best hotels we have stayed at all around the world. It has style, ambiance, and amazing staff. I highly recommend it for a welcome break from the westernised hotels - and the chaotic traffic in Kathmandu.

My stay was an amazing experience! The most friendly and politest staff I ever met! The manager is always around you and cares for any needs! The hotel itself gives you a palace-feeling and staff treats you like a queen or king! They make your stay a memorable experience!!!! Highly recommended hotel!!!!

An oasis of old world Nepali charm, the Baber Mahal Vilas Boutique Hotel is set amongst a larger complex of shops, cafes and restaurants all in keeping with the architecture of what was once a palace. The hotel is in a quiet location, convenient to downtown Thamel and is comfortable, well appointed and run by very efficient and friendly staff.

There’s no toilet amenities, room was too close to each other and we could hear the commotion in the kitchen where loud music was being blasted! Found a hair in my breakfast and food quality was just so-so.

This hotel is stunning.  It is a work of art while remaining comfortable and unprecious.  The onsite restaurants and boutiques are amazing.  The staff could not be more gracious, even when you turn up covered in filth from two weeks trekking.  Pure elegance.  I cannot wait to return.

Spent three nights staying in this beautiful hotel. The hotel arranged our collection from the airport, which we couldn’t fault. Our welcome, the room, quality of furnishings, staff, on site restaurants, rooftop, bar e.c.t were wonderful. The hotel is small, full of charm and a retreat from busy Kathmandu.There’s a cash machine and taxis available just at the end of the road. Fridge in room, snacks, iron, ironing board, kettle, toiletries, bottled water e.c.t. Good air con, white cotton bedding and what appeared to be a 15tog duvet.Tv with a large selection of English films and you tube.I would definitely recommend this hotel, my only criticisms are the WiFi is hit and miss and the pool is absolutely freezing. Thank you to all the staff!

This boutique hotel offers a quiet Oasis amongst the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu. The hotel it’s self is part of the adjoining palace that belonged to the old Prime Minister of Nepal. The building architecture is stunning and features all the comforts one would expect from an upmarket hotel (pool, spa, gym, restaurant). The staff where very accomodating providing great advice on what to do and see and the hotel manager allowed me to check-out a little later so that I wasn’t hovering about in the lobby for hours.I would highly recommend this hotel.

A heritage property, the boutique hotel lived up to and exceeded every expectation.  With distinct architecture and interiors in different sections of the hotel, one can spend a very long time just exploring the history of this venue itself. But even more lively than the property are the 40 people who go out of their way to make you feel at home in this unique place. From the moment you step into the hotel to the tone of your departure, the staff are ever observant of your smallest wishes and will go out of their way to help you. It's the little things during our stay at the hotel that will remain with us for a lifetime. Whether it was the evening tour of the Revisited area by Sujan, or the midnight masala tea and cappuccinos, or the proactive take- away of dry fruits when we were leaving coz  kids had enjoyed them. This resort is not to be missed of you're going to Kathmandu, and if you can book yourself a Heritage suite (lovely) or a Royal Suite (even better... with each suite unique in its decor, you will not want to leave the hotel ever.

Barber Mahal is a beautiful, tranquil oasis in Kathmandu.  The staff could not be more attentive, thoughtful and responsive.  They even watched our plane circle Kathmandu before landing to let the driver know to wait for us to clear customs.  We had a beautiful suite, they arranged a city tour guide and driver for us and made dinner reservations.  Breakfast was delicious.  It was a lovely introduction to Kathmandu.

Petit hôtel par la taille, grand par la qualité, dans un cadre magnifique, des chambres raffinées et un accueil superbe au calme. Mérite ses étoiles. Le resto Caroline dans l’hôtel, vaut le détour. L'ensemble fut magique.

We were staying in Kathmandu for three nights and tried to get a room in an upscale hotel but most were fully booked. We decided to try Baber Mahal and I’m so glad we did. This hotel is more our style: quaint, intimate, cozy and personal. Our room was kauzee kotha which is the only room with a large balcony. It is directly above reception but it was quiet and we never heard other people. The first night the kitchen door was squeaking; we could hear it and knew it would bother us but when brought up to staff the problem was addressed and we had a great nights sleep. The breakfast is limited but the lattes and cappuccinos were outstanding. We didn’t eat dinner there but there are other restaurants in the complex so we didn’t need to eat there. We did have a driver so getting around wasn’t a problem but it’s necessary to take taxis everywhere. We didn’t mind being outside the city. The staff is wonderful and the room was very comfortable. Worth the stay

Baber Mahal Vilas is a peaceful and wonderful oasis in chaotic Kathmandu. The hotel staff is very professional and super kind and made us feel home. The large rooms have beautiful designs in a building with impressive architecture. Thanks a lot for the pleasant stay!

We were trying to decide between BMV and Dwarika where had stayed on our last visit. I am very glad we chose this one. While not as opulent as the latter , I much preferred it. The rooms are lovely but the outstanding feature is the staff. They simply can’t do enough for you. We were completely bowled over and can’t wait to come back again.

We travel to Nepal extensively and have stayed at a wide range of hotels. Baber Mahal impressed us quite a bit. The beauty and quality of rooms rivals Dwarika's Kathmandu. The Rana style is a nice change from the busy streets of the city. The shopping and dining within Baber Mahal is wonderful. You can spend your days out in the city and enjoy quiet, restful evenings strolling the property and dine in a different area each night all week. The breakfast included with our room was good and offered continental options as well as a few traditional choices. One note: my husband always orders an omelet and he could not say enough wonderful things. It made his top list of favorite omelets! There is a lovely open air pub off of the lobby that makes a nice stop for a cocktail or coffee before heading out or back to your room after a long day. We had the Singha Suite. Plenty of room to spread out, get work done, sip tea on the balcony overlooking the main courtyard, get a good night's sleep on a nice firm mattress, and tip toe out to the pool next to our room for sunrise. The bathrooms are particularly large and clean. Only lacked a hairdryer and I suspect I would have requested one. Overall, the staff went above and beyond to see that we were comfortable and well cared for. I will be back!

Very nicely built hotel with history and culture reflecting. Wonderful hospitality from staff and big thanks to Prabin. Food from French restaurant was yummy as well. Highly recommend to all. We just enjoyed our stay and looking forward to come back again.Love from Australia and Nepal

I loved this boutique because it was beautiful, quiet, comfortable and nice room. The staff was very helpful and professional. There are many nice places to stay in KTM but this is special because it’s also historic! The history makes it an extra cozy and interesting.

We needed to go to Kathmandu for a wedding. Not having any idea of where to stay we had to use the ratings and location near the centre.Baber Mahal Vilas was our choice.Never having been to Nepal before we didn’t know what to expect. The place is wonderfully chaotic, the people are friendly and welcoming.The city is overload.The Vilas provide a peaceful refuge from the chaos.The staff are attentive, nothing is too much trouble.We can not recommend the Vilas highly enough!If you can get a room stay there!

Beautiful histotical property refurbished with great taste. Excellent service and attentive staff. Rooms and suites with all kind of amenities and a great shopping arcade. Excellent restaurants and refined ambiance. Quiet location in Kathmandu.

We stayed 4 nights. We picked BM vilas given the raving reviews on TA and other travel sites. We were on a long trek in nepal and stayed at the new Marriott just before moving to BM. BM is a very small intimate hotel, rich heritage and takes pride in their history. Grounds are well maintained. Hotel is beautiful and considered luxurious by local standards. Staff are extremely courteous, especially the young chaps at the restaurant and bar. Chef Ramesh often drops by to greet us. It is a very quiet, calm hotel, indeed once stepping outside to the road the blast of traffic and noise is rather rudely shocking.And that was why we came for (or so we thought) a good quiet serene luxurious quality place to rest from our trek while we continued long day hikes. We slept very poorly in fact. Frangipani is the worst room in even worst location. The hotel is very small and compact. The room is adjacent to the main hotel entrance on one side and the gift shop/ yard on the bedside. Anyone who enters/ exit the hotel has to pass by our room. Practically there is no view despite having long large windows we had always to keep curtains closed or we’d be looking at the guards or anyone who walks by. Entrance to the room is 1m from the gift shop so the corridor clearance is in too close proximity. What kind of rest the hotel expects the guests to procure, I really don’t know. Bathroom window is adjacent to the parking lot outside next to the gate. At anytime in the bathroom we can hear the conversations of guards or drivers. We are up early for hikes so sleep about 9.30pm daily, but the location is disturbed by people who pass the corridor because it is the only walkway to the rest of the hotel.  We are not the complaining sort so we put up with it considering everyone has been so friendly and it’s a beautiful hotel. On 3rd night at 4am we are woken by the incessant chatter of the staff on his mobile phone for no less 30mins outside our window. Had to finally knock on the window to get his attention to shut up. At 5am staff arrives to work, some people starts singing. I’m frustrated enough to get out from bed and walk to the hotel gate and just ask whomever to shut up. The room is simply too near the hotel gate, guards chatter very early and even in their soft tones the chatter can be heard when we are trying to sleep.  As reiterated we came here for an oasis of rest and frankly it’s the worst sleep nights of our two week trip. There’s only 3 hotels more luxurious and pricey than BM vilas - Hyatt regency , Dwarika and Marriott. But the quality of experience in total is really poor, unfortunately to say. Food is good, staff is very accommodating but nothing solves for a bad room in a bad location which I believe the hotel should be aware of before. It’s simply insensitive to put guests there. Pool looked muddy and not maintained so we didn’t use it. Gym is very small and has no air conditioning (bad miss, especially on hot days) and not well equipped.Other minor issues included a mail from hotel saying they will avail me a SIM card upon check in , this was not given. Check in was also a little uncoordinated as the reception staff wasn’t there. The other minor issue is emailing the hotel to ask for sightseeing recommendations (we are already staying there) and not getting a reply. We went with another agency instead.Overall, not what we expected and not how we intended to write such a poor review but these are facts the hotel should strive to improve while claiming to be 5-star. Sorry it is not.

Just perfect! This traditional place will welcome you with so much serenity and warm smiles. Staff are very attentive and True to the definition of customer service. Rooms are clean, adequate water supply at shower and admirable toiletries. The Private pool at roof top is great for selifes! 🤩Food and beverages served are as well palatable. Nepali set was superb! Kudos to Mr. Prabin and team. May you all continue to exceed expectations through esteemed quality service. Till our next visit! ✈️ From Philippines and Egypt with lotsa love! ❤️

As a constant traveler, I can say the service in this hotel was by far the best I have ever experienced. To say that the staff was warm and welcoming would be an understatement. They went above and beyond to ensure our comfort. They treat you as if you are the only person in the hotel despite being fully booked. The hotel itself is absolutely beautiful with comfortable beds. I would recommend it to anyone staying in Kathmandu, whether for one day or a month!

The property had a historic feel and it was a very unique experience. There are a lot of picturesque spots that you can find around the property and it is a fun place to explore. Everyone from the manager to the housekeeping staff was very courteous and helpful, they put in a lot of effort to make sure that our whole group's stay was comfortable and they exceeded our expectations. I personally stayed in the suite and it was great! There was a familial touch to the services provided by the hotel.

We stayed at the place for 2 nights and got undivided service from the staff. From tailoring the menu to meet our dietary requirements to guiding us around the city, everyone did a brilliant job. Additionally, the rooms were exceptional and the entire property carried a historic feel. Will definitely recommend this over conventional 5 star properties to anyone who is planning on visiting Kathmandu.

The place is awesome. The rooms were excellent. The staff was very courteaus, specially prabin. The food was awesome too. Babar mahal is in the city. That makes it more accessable. Chef ramesh was also very courteaus. It is a must visit property in kathmandu.

We had booked this beautiful property for 11 couples for a 2 night visit to Kathmandu. Seeing the reviews I had high expectations. But I must tell u that Baber Mahal Vilas totally exceeded my expectations. Mr. Prabin and his team was one the most courteous teams i have ever come across. The property is so beautiful that u have to see to believe. Full Marks. Our group was totally floored. Highly recommended for people & groups looking for boutique, exclusive & quality experience.

extreme good service , have a drink on the top of the roofeverybody take care about you, every wish will be fulfilledvery good food, try the Asian foodManagement always ask for assistancegood tips for excursions

Wir waren 3 Nächte im Baber Mahal Vilas und durften wundervolle Gastfreundschaft und Service pur erleben. Der Manager Prabin und sein Team kümmerten sich rührend um jeden Wunsch, so wurden sehr verlässliche Fahrer und Guide organisiert, um die Sehenswürdigkeiten zu entdecken. Auch das Abholservice vom Flughafen verlief pünktlichst und angenehm. Beim inkludierten Frühstück bestellte man á la carte, um keine Lebensmittel zu verschwenden. Wir bekamen aber jederzeit nach, wenn wir noch Hunger hatten. Den Spa-Bereich mit den Massagen etc. haben wir, bis auf das Schwimmbad am Dach mit schönem Ausblick, aus Zeitgründen leider nicht ausprobiert. Jederzeit wieder! Namaste!

Meine Frau und ich haben eine drei-wöchige Nepal- und Tibet-Rundreise gemacht und in dieser Zeit über 7 Nächte im Baber Mahal Vilas übernachtet, von dem wir total begeistert sind.Nach der trubeligen Anreise wurden wir im Baber Mahal sehr freundlich mit frisch gepresstem Fruchtsaft empfangen und sind sofort in eine Oase der Ruhe eingetaucht. Das ganze Anwesen und die Räumlichkeiten strahlen eine liebevoll gepflegte Ruhe, Eleganz und Leichtigkeit in historischem Ambiente aus, die uns direkt bezaubert haben.  Das Zimmer war außerordentlich geschmackvoll eingerichtet, mit einem äußerst bequemen Bett, in dem wir tief und ungestört schlafen konnten. Prompter Zimmerservice und gut funktionierendes W-Lan waren selbstverständlich. Das Frühstück bietet eine schöne und wechselnde Auswahl an kontinentalem, US-american und lokalen Speisen. Wem das nicht ausreicht, der erhält vom Küchenchef (der die Gäste jeden Morgen persönlich anspricht) individuelle Wünsche erfüllt.Das Personal ist von menschlicher Wärme, Hilfsbereitschaft und Freundlichkeit geprägt, so dass wir uns dort außerordentlich wohl gefühlt haben. Auch die vielen Einrichtungen wie ein schöner Außenpool, die Sauna, sowie die benachbarten Restaurants und Geschäfte, laden zum Verweilen ein.Wir haben weltweit schon einige der besten und höchstklassigsten Hotels kennen gelernt, und können das Baber Mahal Vilas uneingeschränkt für einen außerordentlichen Aufenthalt auf höchstem Niveau empfehlen.

I stayed in Barber Mahal for five nights last week and it was the highlight of my trip.  I almost never write reviews for hotels but I am making an exception in this case because the hotel was exceptional.  The grounds were magnificent, harking back to an earlier era of royalty.  The room was spacious, clean, and comfortable and the patio was great.   The location was also very good--close enough to walk to the tourist areas but far enough away to provide some quiet and relaxation.  Most impressive however was the staff.  They could not have been more friendly and helpful.  I cannot recomend this hotel enough.

Great staff- the managers Raju and Prabin were very helpful each time I came back or re-booked over a two week period. The breakfast and lunch staff was great as well. Excellent location, like an oasis to return to on a hot day. Great with two bottles of water each day. Wonderful facility and really nice and helpful staff.

Wir kamen an und wollten unsere letzten beiden Nächte im Baber Mahal verbringen. Primär haben wir das Hotel wegen des Pools gebucht. Der war allerdings so dreckig, dass man nicht mal den Boden sehen konnte. Auf Nachfrage wurde uns versichert, dass der Pool am nächsten Tag fertig gereinigt und sauber sei. Dem war nicht so. Eine Dienstleistung anzugeben und diese nicht zu erfüllen geht meiner Meinung nach garnicht. Das Frühstück war leider auch nicht sehr gut und das Hotel im gesamten so enttäuschend.

As a true this hotel is outstandingand in peace zone where you can have a relax with your family .for sure i like to come here again and service is outstanding ,room is a bit ok but it can be improved.

This hotel is an absolute gem in Kathmandu.  It’s a quiet respite from the hustle and bustle of the city and features wonderful Nepali decor and antiques.  The staff was extremely warm and welcoming throughout and really made us feel like valued guests.  I absolutely plan to return next time I am in Kathmandu.

Excellent rooms, helpful staff, nice place to visit. Located in a little distantce from center, could not hear any traffic noice at all. Small shops inside the garden area were a nice surprice, nice handcraft from Nepal.

Wir waren insgesamt 4 Nächte in diesem exzellenten Hotel. Am Anfang unserer Reise und am Ende. Als wir wieder ankamen war wie nach Hause zu kommen. Das Personal ist unglaublich freundlich und engagiert. Die Zimmer sind wunderschön. Wohnen wie ein Rana. Wenn wir wieder nach Kathmandu kommen, übernachten wir sicher wieder hier. Namaste Babar Mahal

We stayed 3 nights, people were lovely and mostly very helpful. Food good, rooms nice. Had to run water in shower for at leat 5 minutes before warm. Happy with our stay but definitely not 5 star standard.

The hotel is very atmospheric, filled with memorabilia and the rooms are well appointed and charismatic. The staff are all very helpful and welcoming (as we found throughout Nepal) and the food is great. If you like beautiful characterful hotels this is perfect.There is a small niche shopping/dining centre adjoining. It is a small quiet and friendly hotel in the middle of hectic Kathmandu.

The hotel is beautiful, confortable, quiet and the staff is spectacular!!! Great service. Room was huge and nice. Food, very good! The manager wrote me a WhatsApp to send me tips to get to the hotel late at night. He was Sonics and helpful. I definitely recommend this hotel and I would come back without hesitation.

I cannot hold my breath to describe the beauty and class of this amazing property. Whole theme and service is just out of this world beautifying the meaning of hospitality. I am very impressed with the service standard they provided however i have experienced for food but planning to stay to experience even more magnificent experience from them. Every designs has got some ancient touch and reflects the history. Uniform of staff to decorations on wall are really touching with the theme. Very to share these information.#HIGHLY RECOMMENDED

I stayed here with my adult daughter in the first week of March for 5 nights. It's a small property with beautiful architecture and thoughtful details with the ambience of a palace museum. The staff were friendly & polite. We stayed in the historical suite which came with a huge terrace overlooking a lovely courtyard. If outdoor space is important maybe also consider a room with a small balcony instead. The terrace had little privacy as the workmen in the construction building next door can see right into the terrace as well as all the staff & guests walking along the first floor. I would have given this property full marks if not for an incident in the booking. I had nearly cancelled my booking at Baber Mahal as on the day I booked (in mid December 2018) I received confirmation of the rate which matched the rate quoted on their website. Later that day I received another confirmation with a rate that was nearly double of that quoted on their webiste. I did not pick up this discrepancy until February 2019 when I was double checking all my bookings. (Kathmandu was just one of 4 destinations on my itinerary & I had booked many flights & hotels on the same day in December 2018). I emailed them & they confirmed the error. I wondered though, why did the hotel not notice the error & corrected this themselves? Would they have charged me the higher rate if I didn't pick their error? I found this experience rather alarming but the actual stay itself was fine.

Nice classic rooms, provide a room when taking a late flight out for changing and showering.  The staff is friendly, food is fair.  The shopping area and restaurants (not linked to the hotel) is perfect with nice terraces and good food so one can relax after a busy day in Kathmandu.  Luxury rooms, good beds and linnen.  Really a hotel to go back to when in Kathmandu.  We paid $140 per night for a classic room (2 persons).

번잡하고 시끄러운 카트만두에 이런 숙소에 머물  수 있어 감사했습니다다른 사이트에 비해 비싼 가격으로 잘못 예약을 하여 취소하려고 하였는데 정책상 취소가 불가능하였고, 호텔에서는 그대신 방을 업그레이드 해주셨습니다. 체크인을 기다리는 동안 호텔과 상점 곳곳을 안내해주셨고, 일하시는 분께 이곳의 자부심을 느낄 수 있었습니다. 세심하게 신경써주신 덕분에 편안한 하루를 보낼 수 있었습니다. 호텔 내 가구와 인테리어는 흡사 네팔의 왕궁에서 하루 자는 듯한 착각을 주기도 하였습니다

Arter 14 days traveling around in Nepal I wanted some luxery before heading home. After looking trough many places i found this pearl. It used to belong to the King, but now its been transformerd to a boutique hotel, where you feel like a king.Many different kinds of style and architecture, all with good material and a perfect touch.I stayed in one of the royal suites, the Baber suite. A wonderful bed, a shower you can dream about and art and details which stuns you.You can wander around in the area and buldings for a long time, eat fantastic food and shop in stores you (for sure) dont find in Thamal or Pokhara.This stay is worth looking forward too!

Baber Mahal is an absolute dream. The place is very stylish and you will see that in everything, from the wonderful architecture to the helps who are dressed in beautiful costumes. My room was perfect with the best shower I had in Nepal and a very comfortable bed, I actually overslept haha. The location us also very nice, just around the corner of lively Thamel and you will find th st you don't necessarily need to go anywhere as Baber Mahal has 4 restaurants with different cuisines and a small shopping area almost like a little village. Great service as well, 5 star plus!

The property is a magnificent palace like mansion converted into a 5 star service hotel. The staff (excluding no one) are professional in all aspects and ready to help you in all your queries. The Suite I booked offered all 5 star amenities and would say that this place carries international standards. Breakfast is made to order rather than the usual buffet and that is something I like because there is no unwanted waste. Well done guys and keep it up!

Love staying in this hotel. It was an amazing fine. The hotel was beautifully designed, I love the way the sunlight filters into the rooms. Showers were hot, bed was so comfortable.   And there was heating in the rooms. Wonderful helpful staff.  And the location is superb. It was an oasis in the midst of Kathmandu.Anna

At first glance the place is very nice and the staff is wonderful. The bed should be more comfortable. The place could be cleaned more thoroughly and rooms given air purifiers for all the dust. The shower at the bottom of the glass also has lots of mold. The food provided by the hotel and it's restaurants is not very good. The Indian was flavorless even compared to what we get in the States, the Nepali food was not as good as other places in Nepal, and the continental was very bad. On my way out I was charged $20 USD for a car that was no better than a local taxi when I had a nice car for that amount on the way in. I would not be so harsh if this place was not listed as a 5-star hotel and charged European and American prices like it was a 5-star. In my humble opinion it should be a 3 or 3.5 star. The history of the place, boutique style, and customer service give this place huge potential if other issues can be addressed.

Very nice boutique hotel with great architecture and excellent service. We stayed here for two days and it was a wonderful experience. It is  old Rana haweli that has now been converted to a hotel. The breakfast is fresh and delicious,

We stayed here for 2 nights while in Kathmandu and found the property to be absolutely gorgeous. Rooms are big and beautifully decorated. The staff is beyond helpful and would arrange whatever transportation needs we required at the drop of a hat, including handling reservations to other upscale restaurants in the city. The hotel is also attached to a network of other restaurants and shops in a charming traditional complex of alleyways and plazas. Breakfast was fantastic and will accommodate any special requests that guests may have as well.There’s a little room for improvement in the housekeeping department though. For instance, one day we were only given one fresh towel and had to request a hair dryer and kettle, standard items that are usually just in the room in the first place.A minor irritant we had was a staff member speaking loudly on a mobile or radio at 4am outside of our room. And once coming back from a late evening dinner, there was no sign of security which was odd, though the hotel is located in a completely safe area. Our wonderful driver, Gurka, insisted that he walk us to the lobby just to go the extra mile.All in all, would absolutely recommend and return again though.
서비스가 너무나 좋고, 부티크 호텔의 매력답게 방이나 빌라 자체가 아름답고 아기자기합니다. 아침 식사도 과하지 않고 맛있습니다. 위치가 아주 안전하고 택시로 주요 관광지에 편하게 갈 수 있는 거리입니다.

For my second visit in Kathmandu I decided to choose a boutique hotel this time to change of the big usual hotels.The buildings are very nice with différents styles.The room is ok, but very dark. I spend a bad night because of the isolation (I could hear all the small noises).The breakfast was so disappointing... I am allergic of cow milk, I was asking for soya milk and they didn’t have!Sorry but this hotel is too expensive for the value to compare with my big experience of hotels all over the world...

We stayed here after having stayed at a nice hotel in Thamel, and Baber Mahal Vilas was by far our favorite. It offered a true oasis from the city and was the ideal place to relax and be pampered after trekking. We didn’t find any need to leave the property at all, between the hotel amenities and the shops and restaurants in the adjoining complex. Though the hotel spa didn’t offer facials (they specialize in massage), they were able to recommend another spa just a few meters away.The architecture is beautifully restored, and the rooms are done in a very traditional yet modern way. The staff went out of their way to make us feel at home, and any time we called down to reception they were at our door in an instant. The hotel restaurant has a somewhat limited but delicious menu- we had the Royal Thani set for both lunch and dinner because it was so delicious. The car service was very accommodating and on time too. Highly recommend!

We were pleasantly surprised by how quirky the hotel was. The room had an old yet modern feel to it which is a combination very ideal for a boutique hotel. The staff were very helpful and attentive to our needs even down to providing a hot water bottle on a chilly night even before we asked. There are quite a few restaurants and shops within the resort and all have  authentic feel to it. Would definitely recommend staying here.

We were amazed at the beauty of Baber Mahal Vilas and the relative quiet considering it is located in the heart of a big city. It isn't in the city center but only about 10 minutes away by taxi. So overal a great location. The staff were very friendly and helpful and we loved the spacious rooms.

Excellent service, elegant ambiance, attentive staff. This hotel gives me a sense of being in another world, away from the hustle and bustle of life. Better than big hotels that are commercial and quite universal in style.

KathmanduWonderful hospitality633145239A warm welcome and a wonderful room. Surrounded by restaurants this is a comfortable place to stay with a lovely rooftop pool and terrace. Thank you Prabin. The car provided by the hotel also was a definite plus.

The highlight of my trip to Nepal was definitely staying at Baber Mahal!A little bit off the beaten path, but absolutely worth it. We stayed in the Frangipani room, which was absolutely beautiful - the bathroom in particular was gorgeous. The entire hotel is historically charming and the background of this Mahal is very interesting - there is a book in each room which describes the family background in detail, and more information is available in the lounge area too.Breakfast on the terrace was lovely.The staff were so helpful and friendly too, beyond outstanding in terms of service. 100% recommend!

We stayed 3 nights in this hotel, It is a unique boutique hotel on several levels. It is built around a former palace,  It is connected to an area with good restaurants and boutiques. Our room was a good size. We had to run the water for about 10 minutes before it got hot. Breakfast was marginal - eggs to order and 5-6 other things, including raw bacon. One morning, breakfast was served on the roof patio. Overall, we really liked the place and would recommend it.

Great, fantastic, phenomenal, excellent, superb, amazing, wonderful, astonishing, was very clean, good service, weird area, hard to work out where we were in complex, food was all good. Very comfortable

This lovely hotel is beautiful, quiet, and the staff is superb. It is literally a world away from the gritty city of Kathmandu. It’s connected to great restaurants and boutiques with curated wares, all in a former Rana palace complex. I can’t say enough about the great experience I had, staying there for four nights on a recent trip to Nepal.

Wir hatten zu verschiedenen Zeiten für ein bis zwei Nächte diese wunderbare Oase der Ruhe und Entspannung in unserem Reiseplan. Exzellent der Service und wunderbar delikates Essen in ansprechendem Ambiente. Absolut empfehlenswert als Oase in Kathmandu.

The staff went out of their way to ensure that our every wish was fulfilled. I was expecting a larger property but soon got used to the boutique nature of the hotel. The farewell dinner, or should I say, banquet was the highlight of our stay.
호텔이 크지는 않으나 아기자기하면서 이국적이고 아름 답습니다.가구가 정말 아름답고 호텔 전체가 박물관이라 느낄정도로 고풍적입니다.직원분들도 친절하시고 바로옆에 있는 음식점들의 분위기도 좋습니다.와이프의 만족도가 높았고 다른 여성분들도 좋아하실거 같습니다.

I spent a week in Kathmandu, staying at the Baber Mahal Vilas. Kathmandu is a fascinating city, with much to see. However it is one of the most chaotic and noisy cities to which I have ever been (and Nepal was the 132nd country I have visited, so I have been to lots of chaotic and noisy places). What a special pleasure, therefore, to return each afternoon to the peace and tranquility of the Baber Mahal Vilas. The property is everything a boutique hotel should be -- full of character, wonderful and helpful staff, attentive service. When I encountered a small problem (no hot water), it was immediately fixed. In addition to the hotel's own Nepali restaurant, it was great having three other places to eat, all very good, in the adjoining part of the complex. I would recommend the Baber Mahal Vilas to anyone going to Kathmandu, whether on business or for pleasure.

A quelques km du centre ville, un lieux"style colonie des Indes" super bien entretenu.Personnel intentionné et super gentil. Chambres spacieuses et propres.Prix approprié pour le type d'endroit.Service du petit déjeuner un peu lent.

I stayed here for the first time this month and it was fantastic. Only 2 years old but a long time coming, a boutique hotel only 15 mins from the airport and within the beautiful Baber Mahal complex. Must visit.

BMV is beyond! I hosted a yoga retreat and both my guest and myself felt liked after and completely pampered. It’s my favorite in all of kathmandu!Go! You will not be disappointedThe staff is wonderful and the accommodations- gorgeous!I have nothing except praise for this lively boutique hotel.

We stayed at the Baber Mahal Vilas for our first trip to Nepal . Exceptional service throughout the hotel from all team members , nothing was too much trouble . Standards throughout the hotel were exceptional and what made our stay extra special was the friendliness and helpfulness of all the team . We will definitely be staying here again on our next visit !!

We had the pleasure to stay at Baber Mahal for 2 nights after a hectic trip to Pokhra. We are quite well travelled and wouldn't hesitate to say that it was one of the best experiences we've had, from the property the rooms to the amazing service we got. We felt as if we were home in this picturesque property. We had the opportunity to see a few rooms and they all are done very aesthetically and with great taste, we were put up at the Singha Suite and we were delighted, the Royal Thali is a must try and also a nice evening stroll at the Baber Mahal Revisited site.They only serve Nepali and Indian food but quite delicious i would say. A special mention to their Manager Prabin who assisted us and made sure we had a memorable stay, will definitely revisit and would highly recommend. Haven't added pictures as they might not do justice.

Fantastic experience Great service - nothing was too much of a problem , from the security men , to reception staff , to the manager - all very helpful and welcoming .Great hotel - central to the main city and close to the airport .Overall complex is amazing with boutique shops and restaurants.

After 10 days trekking I was looking forward to this experience and it did not disappoint. Warm hospitality, personal service, delicious food, wonderful room, great facilities and amazing location. I was personally met by both Prabin the Operations Manager as well as Rajin the Assistant Operations Manager. They were both charming and professional. This is a terrific and beautiful boutique hotel. I loved their breakfast and dinner and never felt the need to leave the property. All the staff were smiley and friendly. It is a unique property in a unique location. I stayed in the Baber Suite and it was amazing. You will not be dissapointed here. If I ever return to Nepal, I will stay there once again. Thank you Baber Mahal!

From every level, the stay was memorable due to the fine authentic interior and exterior designs and the care taken by the staff. The property had a lot of historical features all over. Absolutely wonderful

We spent a good 6 nights here and loved every bit of it! The staff are fantastic and very attentive. Clean, well kept, almost royal like hotel. Quaint and unique. The courtyard has a selection of restaurants.Pool isn’t very big though, so we never used it. Breakfast was fairly basic but just right and good. Overall very good and highly recommended if you are looking for a relaxing time in a busy city.

This place is extraordinary. Kathmandu is lovely, but, perhaps, a little chaotic. This thoughtful, beautifully designed, yet, extremely comfortable place is wonderful. Every detail is thought thru. The sense of a home is wonderful. The service/friendliness is unique, even in a country known for this. After a short but, rigorous motorcycle trip on hot and dusty Nepal days, this place was just what was needed. My first thought as I walked into the courtyard was simply wow. It was so clean and the temperature dropped 10 degrees. They were very patient with my motorcycle addled brain and brought me a cold sparkling water and got me to my incredible room within minutes. I immediately jumped into the rooftop pool steps away from my room, which felt like my own house. They brought me 4 more bottles of sparkling water. I was thoroughly cooled down and immediately slept like a baby in an extremely comfortable bed.the next four days were wonderful, unfortunately, I developed an impacted tooth. they assisted me in finding a doctor and securing a prescription for antibiotics. Part of service is knowing what people need. what I needed was to be left alone, and they did with great thoughtfulness. Checking in on me, to make sure I was ok, but, not too much. They brought me everything I needed and treated me like family.I feel like I found a new home, there will surely be no other hotel for me in Kathmandu.

Wonderful and attentive staff. A beautiful and quaint bed and breakfast-feel hotel. It is centrally located and right next to some really great shopping. Was my fourth trip to Kathmandu and definitely the best place I've stayed.

Excellent ambience ..Great restoration of old world charm Attention to smallest detail Very friendly and helpful staff Great food Very well appointed impeccably clean rooms Lovely chandeliers Integral part of a lovely colonial style sprawling boutique shops and eateries

This is a wonderful escape from the hustle & bustle of Kathmandu. You enter an oasis of hospitality and warmth. We recently celebrated our 10 year anniversary and the boutique hotel and staff were absolutely amazing! We highly recommend Baber Mahal Vilas. Thank you to the Manager, Staffs, Restaurants for making our stay so wonderful.

I adore Baber Maher Villas and Baber Mahal Revisited. It's a formerRana Palace, and there are historical plaques all over as well as portraits and art. The restaurants offer a great variety, the shops are lovely (it's nice to walk around and not be harassed nonstop), and the rooms are beautiful. The rooftop pool is small but pretty. The only thing REALLY lacking is the gym. No treadmill, no A/C...not even really any lights. I highly recommend this place.

I love Baber Mahal Vilas! Such a beautifully designed, historical boutique hotel. The rooms are all gorgeously designed, each with it's own historical story and theme. The staff at Baber Mahal Vilas are not only professional and attentive, they are simply the nicest people - so caring and always trying to make guests feel welcomed and comfortable.  Rooms are spacious, clean, and have the essentials. Whatever you need, the staff at the Vilas literally bend over backwards to make it possible and ensure your stay is memorable.I stay here every time I come to Kathmandu. I can't recommend it enough! I think it is well-located in the city - not to mention, there are several (delicious!) restaurants and shops in Baber Mahal Revisited compound.Keep up the great work, Baber Mahal Vilas! See you again soon!

Well located with quaint little shops and restaurants within walking distance. An oasis in chaotic Kathmandu. Would highly recommend it. All the rooms seem well located. The pool is a must try. Rooftop.

this small hotel is nice  but not ideal. it is far awy from downtown. in a review we have not forget that we are in a poor country. the hote is a hotel in the 3.world. but the prices are very high. service peple are very friendly.

Amongst the hectic, dusty city of Kathmandu lies this dream of an oasis, a restored former palace (of sorts!) with a lovely selection of rooms and an equally lovely warren of alleys, restaurants and places to escape and relax.We stayed for two nights and absolutely loved it. Momos are super tasty and the breakfast staff are hilarious!

It's amazing how it felt you entered a relaxing bubble that took you away from the hectic city life! Immediately entering Baber Mahal a calm feeling swept over me. Not only is it a stunning place, but it almost felt like you were staying at a museum with all the historic images and history of this space. The owner did a fantastic job renovating the space and still appreciating its history! I would highly recommend people staying here, or at least visiting the space! Worth it!

Anjila was brilliant - and all staff excellent, Savina was great too - lovely and quiet sanctuary after hours on the road in Kathmandu. Would recommend this place to a tone Passing through Kathmandu. Book now.

Wir waren während unserer Nepal Rundreise für mehrere Nächte in diesem Hotel untergebracht. Wir haben uns hier sehr wohl gefüllt. Die Zimmer sind sauber und das Personal freundlich. Lediglich morgens beim Frühstück fehlt es etwas an Koordination. Man hat den Eindruck als wären Sie noch nicht richtig wach. Könnte aber auch daran liegen, das Teilweise zum Abendessen und Frühstück die selben Personen bedient haben.Im Gesamteindruck ist das aber eher nebensächlich. Das Hotel ist vom Flughafen gut zu erreichen und liegt sehr Zentral in Kathmandu, sodass von hier aus alle umliegenden Sehenswürdigkeiten gut erreichbar sind (wir hatten einen Fahrer der uns gefahren hatte).

ネパールの名家であるラナ家の邸宅を改装したホテルです。ネオクラシカル、ムスタン、そしてネワールという特徴ある3つの様式のお部屋を有する小さなブティックホテルです。上品で洗練されたデザインの建物及び内装に思わずうっとりしてしまいました。小さな中庭も美しく、屋上のプールも素敵でした。全体的にとても綺麗で掃除も行き届いていますが、残念ながら用意されたタオルは湿っていて、とても汚れが目立ちました。また、お湯は5分くらい蛇口を開けっ放しにして初めて出て来ます。無料のWi-Fiは素晴らしく早いです。朝食は毎日少しず違う物が出てきて楽しめました。もちろん美味しかったです。スタッフの方は皆さん親切で、ベタベタし過ぎないけれど気にかけてもらえている感じがあり、とても好感が持てました。タメルの喧騒から離れているため、ゆったり静かに過ごすには最適な場所です。インテリアがとにかく素敵なので、また泊まりに来たいです。

A really lovely little oasis in Kathmandu. A real boutique hotel in every sense of the word. Interesting, lovely but individually styled rooms, surrounded by boutique shops and restaurants. A good if limited bar, with a good Indian restaurant upstairs, but some of the bar staff need a bit of extra training. Nice, helpful staff, and Ravij Shrestha - the Assistant Operations Manager - is a knowledgeable and helpful member of the team. Food of a much higher standard than we experienced in Bhutan - thanks goodness!  The place is steeped in history, and the restoration job is wonderful.

I have to steal this title from another review because it is true.  Pricey but well worth it after a day out in the hecticness of Kathmandu and nearby locals.  Very friendly staff and 4-5 very good restaurants within the complex.  Our room was great, upstairs on the top level with a lovely patio.  I would definitely stay here again.

Bella esperienza in un complesso molto ben curato e confortevole . Personale disponibile e cortese. Location appena fuori dal caos della città . Questo è il punto di forza e di debolezza perché per uscire la sera è necessario prendere un taxi . In ogni caro nel complesso sono inseriti due buoni ristoranti che rappresentano un’ottima soluzione dopo una giornata di visite e camminate .

Classico boutique hotel di fascino ma scomodo e un po’ isolato. Bella la suite, fredda d’inverno nonostante il condizionatore andasse a 30 gradi tutto il giorno. Personale gentile come sempre ma non il massimo dell’efficienza (ad esempio se tieni spenti sauna e bagno turco come pensi che gli ospiti possano usufruirne?). Colazione abbastanza scarna e tempi d’attesa biblici. E freddo nonostante una stufata elettrica. Infine si è lontani da tutto e prendere ancora il taxi la sera per andare a mangiare anche no

Very clean room in traditional style. Heating (/airco) which can be very pleasant in wintertime. Amazing patio-garden en super-friendly staff! Same-style shopping mall with restaurants just next door. About 4dollar taxidrive to the main city center and Thamel.

This is a fantastic boutique hotel located in a quiet residential section of Kathmandu. It is a former Royal Palace. There are only 13 rooms, all decorated in a different style. The service is fantastic! Very attentive staff willing to help with anything.We stayed in the Baber suite, which was a wonderful large two room suite. Bathroom is modern and very comfortable.I highly recommend this hotel has the rooms are unique and wonderful. The staff is the best of any hotel I stayed at in Nepal. Location is good in a quiet neighborhood. Relatively close to the airport.

Excellent service. Nice warm inviting staff. Stayed at the Barber suite after our 5 day camping hiking trip and felt pampered the minute we walked in.  Stayed at another big hotel in Nepal before our hike and I much prefer this hotel. Loved it.

The staff are quite remarkable: professional, discret, always available, helpful, caring and gracious. The architecture of the hotel is absolutely stunning; very interesting to visit the whole complex. The rooms are well appointed, very quiet an comfortable. The roof top pool, work out room and spa are all greatly appreciated. Finally, it is only 10 to 20 minutes from the airport depending on time of day.The complex has a variety of restaurants, which is why the hotel limits its menu. It could prove useful if there were a few more items to select from. The hotel provides a good clear wi-fi signal, but their provider has, at times, its problems.

This was our "basecamp" as we traveled all over Nepal and Tibet and had to return here three times over 10 days.  Each time, we were treated so warmly. It is a charming and impeccably clean hotel and the staff is very professional always looking to accommodate one's needs. And the PLUS is all the shops and eateries within the courtyards connected.  You do not have to go far for a lovely evening.  I used the gym and the pool while there.  Stay here -- you wont regret it.

What a lovely stay my adult daughter and I enjoyed at this elegant, quiet, beautifully decorated old-style charm boutique hotel. We loved our Newari style room, with a very comfortable bed, a beautiful library, and a room at the rooftop level. We loved sitting on the roof terrace, and enjoyed being next to the small rooftop pool, where we had snacks from the delicious Nepali restaurant. In addition to the quality of the food, we were served by kind professional staff. We loved browsing through the wonderful, high quality shops that are part of the premises. As we stayed here during our last day and night after a jam-packed exciting week in Nepal, we were so happy to just relax in the hotel. Highly recommend this hotel and would certainly stay there again if we are lucky enough to visit Kathmandu again!

The beautiful charm of the Nepali people grace this recently opened boutique hotel.  A quiet space within the Kathmandu hub of busy, complex traffic patterns and crowded buildings is a rare find.  This is a wonderful place to stay if you've seen the city and are ready for a needed respite with attentive service.  I come to Nepal annually to help in the hospital and this luxurious hotel rivals others with similar old world charm.

So grateful for a place that allows me to feel comfortable and relaxed. A small, intimate bed and breakfast that caters to accommodating its visitors. The architectural layout was fantastic as well as the art Napaly art objects placed around the location and in the rooms. Best: the woman at the front desk and manager set up all our excursions into town, we were able to select breakfast items off the menu and create our own meals (which were amazing), they supplied as much bottled water as we asked for, they dropped everything to help us find and print an India visas and any supplemental material we needed for our flight. Adjustments: the internet was a little slow but "Big Deal" in a 3rd world country that is just installing water pipes for the second half of its residents and has NO freeway in its capital, what do you expect? Really, I had NO issues with this place and the staff made me feel right at home. I was sorry to leave. I will try adding pictures later

I cannot find anything bad to say about Baber Mahal Vilas: the historical building is absolutely beautiful complete with a gorgeous rooftop pool, the service is a level you are rarely going get at a hotel anywhere in the world, and the food is delicious! Away from the crazy Thamel tourist area, it's a peaceful oasis that is a short taxi ride to do whatever you want, or stay close at the great little boutique shopping and restaurant complex that is an extension of the hotel grounds and has some of the best rated restaurants in Kathmandu. You can tell that it is family run, because the staff all treat you like family. Please do yourself a favour and make your stay in Kathmandu magical with a stay at Baber Maha Vilas. Thank you so much for making my trip so perfect, I can't wait to come back and stay with you again!

A beautiful, intimate and luxurious boutique hotel that offers three distinct styles of rooms and suites in the heart of Kathmandu. My husband and I stayed in the Baber Suite in the "Rana" wing of the hotel. It was an incredibly comfortable, spacious and luxurious suite complete with a period bathtub and a very large and comfortable shower area (side by side). The entertainment systems were state of the art complete with a Bose soundbar (which is very handy while having a long aromatic bath). We loved the rooftop pool and I liked their intimate sauna and steam rooms. There is also and excellent spa and gym on offer.We were especially impressed by the personalized and discreet service. Since the architecture is very harmonious and accurate to its style, one may have to walk across open corridors to access some parts of the hotel. Although very beautiful and never more than a few feet at a time, this can be an inconvenience if its pouring....not here!! Someone seems to magically appear with an umbrella as you cross these corridors, and then disappear with a smile.The hotel is itself a part of the larger "Baber Mahal Revisited" shopping and entertainment complex. This gives residents access to the best shopping and dining options around (especially useful during the monsoon season...that's when we visited). Highly recommended when you're in Kathmandu for a few days. This hotel can turn monsoon into a joy :)

This place is a heritage property, - very classy with an attached quiet shopping area. Four restaurants within hotel and shopping area. We noted the hotel staff have a simple genuinely cheerful approach to their job and attended to our calls very promptly. We tried out the Nepali dress, arranged by hotel and took pictures, staff was very helpful. Very impressed with the 'culture' of this hotel and the experience, will go again.

for our pilgrimage to pashupatinath we chose to  stay at baber mahal vilas hotel.service was excellent,to the extent they had even arranged for our visit to the temple and a panditji for our spiritual needs.rooms very good .thnx to mr rana for our rudrakhsha beads.planning to come again early next year and will stay at this place. .location is convenient and central to all main areas especially thamel.

My husband and I spent our last night in Kathmandu at Baber Mahal Vilas. We did not do anything except stay within the vicinity of Baber Mahal and the surrounding complex and did not regret it. It was such a reprieve from hectic Thamel and a fantastic way to rest before our flight home. We stayed in the Singha suite, which was spacious and elegant with its own huge balcony. The rest of the property was also exquisite and it reminded us of Chijmes back in our home (Singapore). The food was also fantastic and we had an elaborate Nepali thali for our lunch. The staff was also so friendly and so kind to allow us to stay until our night flight for free. They went out of their way to make us comfortable e.g. found me a brand new toothbrush, absorbed the high cost of the airport transfer because of the election road ban and also decorated our room for our anniversary. What an absolute gem, perfect stay.

We were fortunate to be invited for a dinner with the Rana's, the family who restored and runs the Baber Mahal Vilas.  We had a full tour of the property and every class of room.  The hotel is completely magical.  This location is an oasis in the middle of the hustling, bustling, dusty city.  After seeing the hotel, the lovely shops within the property, and spending a delightful evening with the family, I would like to return just to stay at this hotel.
