Every modern convenience has been thought of while keeping true to the traditional Nepal style.  The blended styles of architecture throughout the complex are surprisingly and successfully integrated in a happily balanced coexistence.  The artwork throughout the facility is also outstanding.  There are family portraits identifying their family heritage as part of the royal family of Nepal dating back for centuries and there is outstanding modern art that takes off on the tradition in amazing ways.  There are also 3 restaurants on the property.  Even if you can't stay here, definitely come and dine and take a look around.  Highly recommended.

Whilst being given my tour of the hotel post the smoothest check in I have ever had!, I was told I wouldn't feel the need to leave the property at all during my 4 day stay. As I drove to the airport at the end of my trip I realised that had indeed been true.The staff was so attentive and prompt that I didn't need to pick up my room phone once to call for something, and the rooms made you wish you never had to leave. There is a sense of serenity that this gem evokes in you, despite being pretty much in the city centre of Kathmandu. The history, legacy and loving attention to detail in every tiny aspect embraces you with such warmth - I'm still feeling it despite long being back to my city life.So whether you're a traveller, writer, thinker, life-liver, decision maker, et al, if you have the good fortune of travelling through Nepal, I can't imagine anywhere else you'd rather stay. Thank you BMV team for sharing with me your home. I'll be back soon enough for more.

We stayed for 4 nights at this exquisite hotel in the Singha Suite.  It was a delight!  The rooms were comfortable and the service/hospitality was top notch!  The building has an old world charm and transcends the feeling of peace and tranquility.  It's heaven when you step inside after dealing with the hustle & bustle of Kathmandu.  The fact that it is connected to lovely restaurants and small boutiques is another plus point!  The only major improvement it needed was consistent wifi connections.  I had to get a new user/password everyday to use it.  A minor suggestion, a full length mirror in the room would be a huge plus....especially in the suites.  Overall, it was a lovely experience!!

I approach this review with a modicum of trepidation, as this is a small boutique hotel that may simply not wish to become over-burdened by guests.  But for the discerning traveller, who appreciates Nepali history and culture, there is unlikely to be a better bet in this wondrous city.The whole establishment oozes class, and is tucked away in a serene environment away from the city noise and dust.  So tranquil a location is it, that the predominating sound is that of birdsong.  The rooms are impeccably and tastefully designed and appointed, built around a central courtyard and cooling water.  There is a roof pool, a library (of all things), and a restaurant where an exceptional thali is available.There is history aplenty here in the design of the buildings, the accoutrements, the layout of the establishment, and the sense that the hotel is preserving a heritage and a tradition.  But for me the highlight is the rooms - very well thought out oases of luxury and comfort, with little touches of elegance.Nepal is a developing country, officially ranked as "low income". This hotel cannot be said to be consonant with abiding poverty, but as a rich and diverse country, my Nepali friends react with vigour against the its characterisation exclusively in terms of poverty.  Baer Mahal is a case in point: it won't be for everyone, but, for those whom it is for, it will absolutely suit them down to the ground.

This Hotel exceeded my expectations. The staff is the most helpful and courteous. Rajii the assistant manager took care of whatever was needed and Eliza from the front office was always there to assist me. Great place to stay !!!

The hotel was perfect. Located in the beautiful and quiet (priceless in Kathmandu) Baber Mahal Revisited, the staff was flawless. The pool is a real plus in Kathmandu and the restaurants are really good. If you are planning a trip to Nepal, don't even think about another hotel than Baber Mahal Vilas

For the past week this hotel has looked after my parents and exceeded all expectations. The team have been marvelous and my parents, who have never been to Nepal are sold on the kindness and quality of the staff and levels of comfort afforded to them. The rooms are gorgeous and the roof top pool is amazing. I have popped in an out all week and have been welcomed like a guest and was always made to comfortable by all the staff there.The property is gorgeous and feels like a home from home. It is a little away from everywhere but don't let that put you off, its a short taxi ride to Thamel / Patan. I'll be recommending it for all that come to visit.

Probably the best hotel in Nepal. People are really friendly and helpful there. You can kill your daytime staying in the roof top swimming pool. Also you can have really delicate Nepali food in hotel. The room is spacious and old classic，very impressive.

This hotel is brand new, and when I stayed there was not even officially open.  Hence there were a few things that weren't quite ready yet for full operation, but I still found my stay to be a wonderful oasis from the busy, dirty city.  The staff was very professional, yet personal and quite interested to hear all of my feedback on what they might do to improve.  I stayed in three different rooms in two separate stays, from the most luxurious to the smallest, all of which were quite beautiful.  The rooms basically all face the small courtyard and it was surprisingly quiet, with the exception of the room directly across from the reception desk (after hearing my feedback on the noise problem in this room, they immediately insisted on moving me to one of the nicest suites).Rooms are all decorated in traditional Nepali/Newari furnishings.  Bathrooms were quite nice, hot water no problem though it took some time for it to arrive (likely to change when the hotel is full of guests).  The property is small so there is a feeling of intimacy.The hotel is directly connected to Baber Mahal Revisted, including the wonderful restaurant Chez Caroline.  There are a few lovely small shops there, with some jewelry and men's and women's clothing as well as Nepali paper, handicrafts and traditional carvings and brass objects.  It's nice to wander through at your own pace.I did have a number of suggestions for them - many of which they were already in the process of implementing (for example, the espresso machine was en route from Italy), so I don't want to list them here as I think they'll be corrected soon.  I'll be quite interested to stay in this hotel again and see what the final version is like.  I'm guessing it will be very successful and likely full most of the time.

This is my second time staying at this particular hotel and it is truly worth your time and money. From the moment you enter the reception area you will be given an excellent experience with cold face towels to refresh you after a long day of travelling and refreshers while you are waiting on your keys. All the workers are friendly and respectful, and everyone in the staff will do their best to accommodate your wishes and ensure that your stay is comfortable. The whole property is tidy and clean, and the rooms and bathroom are luxurious and comfortable to be in - and if you don’t feel like going out for food/drinks, the room service and hotel restaurant offer a wide verity of options and from my own experience they were quite delicious. And the view you get from the infinity pool and restaurant area is truly breathtaking. To anyone wishing to stay at a reasonable priced luxury hotel close to the city’s main tourist district, this is the place for you and I highly recommend everyone to try it out 🫶

It was a great hotel to stay at, and we definitely enjoyed our time there. The service was excellent, and the staff were very friendly, ensuring that any concerns were promptly addressed. Breakfast was outstanding, offering a wide variety of Nepalese and continental dishes, all freshly made each day. The service during breakfast was both friendly and efficient, just like the evening meals. One thing that could be improved is making sure that people coming from abroad are assured that the food is safe and clean to eat. There were doubts about consuming, for example, dairy products in Kathmandu, as a general observation.Our room was truly comfortable and well-lit. The air conditioning allowed us to maintain a comfortable temperature. The rooms were cleaned daily, and we were provided with fresh towels, which was perfect to see.The front reception desk were very friendly and able to help with nearly any concerns we had.In summary, it's a wonderful hotel located in the heart of Thamel, making it easy to walk to shops and restaurants.

Very clean and relaxing hotel. Staff always friendly and helpful.The Biscuits in the rooms are amazing.Pool on the roof gives a great view of the city.Breakfast is a large selection of different items for any taste.Luggage can be stored here over a longer period of time if you go on a trek from Katmandu.Only one minor thing is putting ordered items on the rooms. Does take longer than it normally would. Especially if you want to split  the bill on multiple rooms.

My recent stay at this hotel was a truly delightful experience. The room was impeccably clean and exuded a sense of coziness that made it feel like a home away from home. The décor was tasteful, with a soothing color palette and plush furnishings that invited relaxation.The buffet was a gastronomic delight, offering a wide array of delicious dishes that catered to all tastes. Each meal was a culinary adventure, with an impressive selection that included both local specialties and international cuisine. The drinks menu was equally extensive, featuring everything from fine wines and craft beers to refreshing cocktails and non-alcoholic options.The highlight of my stay was undoubtedly the beautiful swimming pool. Surrounded by lush landscaping and comfortable loungers, it was the perfect spot to unwind and soak up the sun. The pool itself was pristine and inviting, with crystal-clear water that was just the right temperature.Service was outstanding throughout my stay. The staff were incredibly attentive, always on hand to assist with any request, no matter how small. Their warm hospitality and professionalism truly enhanced the overall experience.I left feeling thoroughly refreshed and pampered, and I look forward to my next visit.

Thank you sharada ji for great hospitality.My stay at hotel barahi was nothing short of spectacular. The hotel boasts an excellent location right on the beach, offering stunning ocean views from the rooms. The staff was incredibly friendly and attentive, making sure every need was met promptly. The rooms were spacious, modern, and impeccably clean, with comfortable beds and a balcony that provided a perfect spot for morning coffee.The resort amenities were top-notch. I particularly enjoyed the infinity pool, which was a great place to relax and take in the scenic beauty. The on-site restaurant served delicious meals with a wide variety of options for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. The seafood dishes, in particular, were a highlight. Additionally, the complimentary breakfast buffet had a fantastic selection of fresh fruits, pastries, and hot items.

Hotel Barahi Kathmandu has scored a four from me for the following reasons . 1. Staff  : The staff are extremely friendly and helpful. Their attitude is always positive with a smile on their faces . Checkin was a smooth process and also entry into our room . 5/52. Location : This is the best location if you want your itinerary to include Durbar Marg and Thamel . It’s bang opposite Garden of Dreams and it’s a beautiful location. 5/53. Swimming pool: This infinity swimming pool is designed well but the drawback is that it is surrounded by the restaurant. Hence if you do not want to be the focus of strangers ogling at you while you enjoy your swim , this is certainly not the place for you . It’s not a private swimming area as its visibility is open to all .2/5 4. Rooms : Rooms are well maintained and quite comfortable . Views from the rooms are also great. There is a coffee press on the room which is a unique feature for f Hotel Barahi . It comes with detailed information on its usage .Finally I was asked by the staff in an email on anything that I would like to have included in the room when I arrived. I did mention that as it was Father’s Day on Sunday , I was checking in with my daughter on Saturday . There was no small token of a cup cake or anything else for Fathers’ Day .?Also when we checked in and went to the 7 th floor to enjoy the brunch we were told that as it’s fully booked we were not allowed to have the brunch . This should have been informed by the team earlier then I could have booked the brunch . I presumed that as Hotel guests we would have priority over the brunch . As we were refused from the special brunch on Saturday after checking in , I give the rating as 1/5 . Breakfast was a your good with attentive staff and tasty food . Well all in all it’s a great location but not very cheap .

It's my 9th visit at hotel barahi which always be memorable. From the day one Ranjan was looking after my table which makes me feel special guest also the Service of Ranjan is always unforgettable. Tonight I had Himalayan Trout wich was so good and the way Ranjan clean whole bone of fish on the the table looks so professional. I recommend every one to visit Hotel barahi at thamel.

Located near the heart of Kathmandu valley, hotel Barahi provided a great experience. The meeting rooms were well equipped with a stable wifi connection and the staffs ensured that all our requirements were promptly met. The hotel’s restaurant served a delightful selection of dishes during lunch and snack breaks. Praiseworthy professionalism and attentiveness from the staff during the 4 day meeting. While I can’t speak from personal experience,the features and services outlined by the hotel make it an appealing choice for business travelers. Thank you so much for the service Hotel Barahi Team, will definitely visit again!!

I usually don’t write reviews but I just had to after my wonderful stay at Hotel Barahi Kathmandu. I stayed after a trek and would not hesitate to book again. First, the hotel is immaculate; it is cleaned, well looked after, the rooms comfortable and modern with perfect beds for a night’s rest. The hotel staff are incredible and kind; You get a warm welcome whenever you step inside, housekeeping staff are incredibly helpful and thorough, and the chefs and waitresses seem genuinely happy to see customers. The buffet breakfast offers delicious options including fresh pressed fruit and vegetable juices, fresh salad bar, bread/desserts, and a variety of cooked foods. I have to make a special mention to Shiv who made my stay 10 out of 5 stars. He warmly greeted me and welcomed me to the hotel, suggested activities within the hotel (including a buffet brunch on the weekends) and happy hour at the bar, and would go the extra mile to ensure a happy and comfortable stay. Thank you so much Shiv! You are doing amazing work - the hotel are very lucky to have you.

One of the best places to eat and drink coffee, with a distinctive view of the Royal Palace the location is great in the heart of the KTM, thamel  area is just a few minutes away. Mr. Bijay Gupta&  ms shree devi  were  very welcoming and helpful, and they  answered most of our questions with open arms. Thank you so much being helpful and nice to us

Lovely hotel, located within easy reach of Thamel and the historic sites. Rooms are large, the beds are comfortable and I particularly liked the Cafe Press and home made biscuits in my room. I asked to change rooms as the one on the major crossroad was too noisy but we were moved quickly and with minimum fuss. The food in the restaurant was very good, I can highly recommend the Tali, beautifully prepared by Chef Sambhu. Our server, Kashmir’s, was very helpful and took obvious pride in her work. Overall a lovely stay.

It started with warmest welcome from the staff, the checkin was smooth as butter, the rooms and bathroom and every amenities are on point, starting from slippers to robes to tea and coffee and even if there is something which is not there in the room, they’ll provide you ASAP, every staff carries a smile and a dedication to provide the best, the view from my room was beautiful too!, the location of the place is perfect too, just walking distance from the local market!“No” is not a word I heard in my 3 days stay at this beautiful propertyThe food and buffet service is impeccable, as tasty as it can be, and they will always makre sure to fulfil your each and every request related to your taste and preferences, they’ll even entertain your special request.My stay, along with my family, was as good as it can be, this trip to Nepal, was made even better by The lovely and polite people at Barahi, I’ll not say they are people, they’ll take care of you like a family!!! (Please note, exceptions are always there, as situations are different, but then they will make sure to give you the best!)

Hotel Barahi is at the center of Kathmandu city, everything is accessible in a walking distance. Staffs here are friendly and helpful, from reception to restaurant staffs are polite people. Thought of mentioning few names ,Urmila,Bishal and Dipesh who gave me a great experience at their restaurant.Highly recommended for business trip and for family too .

Our second stay at Hotel Barahi kathmandu was absolutely wonderful! The cleanliness exceeded our expectations, and the staff, including Chef Mahesh Bhandari, were incredibly attentive to our needs. Chef Mahesh's attentiveness towards our child's dietary preferences ensured he could enjoy his meals and ate well throughout our stay. Manager Nabin was exceptionally friendly and welcoming, adding to the overall positive experience. A special shoutout to server Dipesh for his continued excellent service and recognition of our family from our previous visit. Without a doubt, we'll be highly recommending this hotel to all our friends and family!

In continuation to my Title would like to mention that this hotel and its Staff Members will make you feel like home. From Check In to Check Out every thing was so so perfect .I was there with my family and friends for Celebration of the 50th Birthday of myself along with 3 of my friends (SRKS) . We had arranged for Buffet Lunch for our guests. The F&B Manager - Mr Gaurav take good care of us and ensured that all the arrangements for our Party and Lunch was top Notch. His team was on their foot full time to take good care of our Guests. Even the Head Chef was present to hear to the guests needs and took care of them.Thank you Mr Gaurav and your team for all the help and support.The food , Lunch and Breakfast was amazing. From Indian to Continental to Chinese , every variety was there and was stupendous.Thanks to the front desk team who were always smiling and helping our guests. They ensured a smooth check in for our guests and kept all the rooms ready as per our requirement and request.Thanks to the sales team of Barahi - Special Mention for Priya mam who was the first point of contact for us. I coordinated with her from India for all the accommodation and other needs , and she patiently took care of all my requests and guided me to the best of her abilities.Once again Special Thanks to Gaurav Sir and Team Hotel Barahi Thamel for the complimentary cake provided from their end for our celebration and for making our stay a memorable one.I would recommend anyone known and unknown to me to definitely stay with them , whether for Business or Leisure, this is a perfect place .Location was perfect as two minutes walk to thamel and 5 minutes walk to Durbar Marg and the hotel is easily accessible from any part of Kathmandu. Lovely location . Last But not the least - Do make use of their Roof Top Infinity Pool. It is just amazing.Thanks once again Team Hotel Barahi. Will definitely come back again. Thank you.

Hotel barahi was the good hospitality in Nepal .   The way they welcome and treat was very nice room was too comfortable and room service was quick and food was too delicious .  Captian Ranjan was after us looking at dinner which service was amazing . .

This Hotel in Kathmandu is a beautiful boutique one of the kind hotel with extra ordinary services and hospitality. Right from the word go , the GM Mr Roshan was there with his team to help you with all your queries and support you all through out the stay.The Breakfast spread was quite healthy & lavish.The Rooms & the Bed were very comfortableThe Service was always with a broad Smile ☺️The Chef Mr Ahmed was always there to help you choose your cuisine.Ms Sanskriti helped us book our trip to Chandra giri hills, which is worth a visitA Big thank you to all the Team of Barahi Hotels for being so kind & considerate, looking after their guests.

The hotel is beautiful , with very sumptuous rooms and stunning views across to the mountains surrounding Kathmandu.The seventh floor rooftop infinity pool sits alongside the restaurant and the buffet breakfast and especially the service , is amazing . I was served impeccably by a lovely lady , Deviyani Sharma and could not have been looked after any better , wonderful service. Thank you .We had dinner in the restaurant the previous evening and my favourite Nepalese dish , Bhutuwa ( lamb / mutton) was excellent as was my wife’s noodle soup. We discovered a liking for some local beers , especially Ghorka Craft amongst others and had a lovely evening atop the 9th floor roof terrace bar overlooking the pool and streets below with the backdrop of Kathmandu night lights across the City . A wonderful relaxing luxury stay .

My stay at this hotel was wonderful from the day I arrived. It is a brand new hotel, design and decoration is beautiful and cosy, also the rooms, with quality linen, pillows, towels and original amenities made of typical wood. The location cannot be better. All shops, restaurants and night life is a step far away.The restaurant, located on the roof top, offers a nice view of the city, when not cloudy. All waiters and chefs are very nice and attentive to all our needs. Specially, I would like to thank Mr Farhan Ahmad and his team for providing me with tasty and delicious gluten free meals during my stay. I hope to be back soon! Thank you for everything!

The hotel was amazing! We had a terrific experience. The room was beautifully decorated and comfortable, the infinite pool and the restaurant had great views, and the staff was always very welcoming and kind. The location of the hotel is also great.

As always Barahi is one of the first priority hotel in town.   All rooms were sold out at Barahi so me and my wife were staying at Marriott hotel. But  the food made by chef shambhu  and service by Ranjan pulled us 10 min walk from Marriott to Hotel  Barahai to have dinner and also to celebrate my  birthday.      Thank you team Barahi always prefer to be at your hotel but my bad I was late to book the rooms before.   Anyway thank you Ranjan for your extraordinary service which make my birthday more special.

The hotel room is spacious, with good coffee. The restaurant is perfect. With very good view, great service. There is a wide variety  of food in buffet. We celebrate my mum’s birthday here, they offered a complimentary cake and sing birthday song to celebrate with us. RanJan is so nice, handsome, and give us fantastic services. He also taught us their languages, we had lots of fun dining in the restaurant. Highly recommend to dine in the restaurant and stay in tho hotel.

In terms of service: Firstly, the front desk reception service is very enthusiastic and better than five-star service. Secondly, we arrived at the hotel at 10am and made our check-in arrangements, which surprised us greatly. Thirdly, sitting in the lobby eating, he noticed our movements and promptly handed us hot towels and juice. In terms of location: In Tamil district, opposite Dream Garden, it is very close to various popular check-in points, such as Kathmandu Palace Square and Pattan Square. In terms of rooms: the room is very clean, tidy, and fully equipped. The decoration style is very innovative. I really like  Sanskritee Lamichhane,because she is very enthusiastic and sincere

I recently came to Barahi with my cousins for a swim.. The cost was Nrs 2500 per person with unlimited buffet (Appetizer, lunch and dessert) .. The appetizers and the dessert were good.. The lunch was okay.. The infinity pool is great with a good view but the pool had too much chemicals in them so swimming was difficult to do for an extended period of time.. The service was great .. Would like to thank Devyani Sharma for her hospitable service … Overall a good weekend for a swim with family and friends..

I had the most delightful stay at this hotel! From the warm welcome at check-in to the impeccable cleanliness of the rooms, every detail exceeded my expectations. The staff (Gaurav, Deviani, Sanju, Bishal, Manish, Bini, ..) were friendly, cooperative and their attention to detail truly made my experience memorable. The amenities were top-notch, and the central location made exploring the city a breeze. Without a doubt, this is now my go-to hotel for future visits. A perfect 5/5.  😊

Rupesh Bastola at Barahi Hotel provides exceptional service with a warm and welcoming attitude. His professionalism and attention to detail ensure a delightful experience for guests. Rupesh goes above and beyond to cater to guests' needs, making their stay memorable and comfortable. His dedication to hospitality reflects greatly on the hotel's reputation for excellent customer service. Highly recommended!"If there are specific aspects or qualities you'd like to highlight further, feel free to let me know!#rupesh bastola

From the moment we arrived we were looked after,  service in all areas has been faultless Food is fantastic, facilities and room excellent and the friendly and warm staff made our stay very worthwhile. The hotel is close to many of Kathmandu’s attractions and you will be guided by the staff to ensure your tourist experience is faultless. Having stayed in another 5* hotel nearby we would say there is no comparison. For couples, try the candlelit dinner it is a great experience! The head waiter and head chef are wonderful!

I really like the hotel barhai kathmandu new hotel . It is located in the prime location on thamel where shopping , exploring new foods and music genre is nearby .I have stayed in other proprety of Barahi in Pokhara and Sarankot mountain lodge as well . They never missed to welcome you with smile and warm hospitality. 1 problem I faced in my stay is, I requested for room cleaning while I was about to go for strolling thamel. But when I returned the room was not clean . I had to wait in restaurants until cleaning finished. This was disappointing.I really like the choices offered in the breakfast with 360 view of ktm city and royal palace view . Room is spacious ,with varieties of amenities .Overall , I enjoyed my stay in Barahi hotel .The service in the restaurant is very prompt. They are ready to help always . The few staff I would like to name Is Bini , dipesh, bishal , Sanjeev and sunil .Special thanks to Asst manager MR. lhakpa for assisting me in my stay here at Barahi . I will definitely come again and recommend others .Cheers .

Came here for a family brunch. Barahi was running a limited brunch setup with absolutely delicious culninary menu ranging from international to local cuisinses paired with an amazing ambience and view of the royal Narahiti palace, not to forget an amazing service from a friendly staff . Love it and look forward to the next promotion from Barahi.

Me and my friend recently dined at the Barahi Hotel's dinner buffet, and it was a great experience. The buffet had a wide selection of tasty dishes, from soup to desserts, all well-made and flavorful.Our server, Keshiya, really stood out. She was very attentive, friendly, and quick, making sure we had everything we needed. She checked in with us often to ensure we were happy with our meal. the food was excellent, I would definitely recommend this buffet for a wonderful dining experience.

I had a great time. The staffs were very attentive they had taken a good care of all my needs. The environment was very welcoming. The view was also mesmerizing. Thank you for the service.  special thanks to Bini , jharana, sanju, Gaurav ji and manish ji.

The customer service in this hotel has been exceptional. Room service was very quick, all staff were very helpful and polite. The hotel itself is very beautiful and visually pleasing. The food and breakfast buffet was the best i’ve tried in a hotel so far. There was a huge selection of breakfast menu and all staff were very attentive. I would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone.

Hotel staff is very generous. Specially breakfast times, every staff member is very cooperative and take utmost care. Jyotsana helped me a lot in choosing breakfast and made me available requested dishes on time. It was really a great time staying at Hotel Barahi

Fabulous visit to Barahi Kathmandu Hotel! The rooms were comfy and well-stocked with local coffees and biscuits. It’s also a hotel committed to reduced plastic use. Sunil served us delicious Mustang Aloo in the cool hotel rooftop bar - I highly recommend this dish. The potato is seasoned with a blend of spices (relatives of the onion family) found in the Himalayas. Yum!

Hotel Barahi Kathmandu exceeded all my expectations with its impeccable service, luxurious accommodations, and breathtaking views. The staff went above and beyond to ensure a memorable stay. The hotel's dining options are outstanding. The restaurant offers a diverse menu with a wide array of delectable dishes, each prepared with the finest ingredients and presented with flair. Whether it was the sumptuous breakfast buffet or the exquisite dinner, every meal was a culinary delight. The service in the restaurant was top-notch, with attentive staff who were always ready with recommendations and a smile.

Great customer service, from the front office, room service to F&B. I like their flexibility in the kitchen, during dinner they made me a soup that I requested which isn’t in the menu. Same for breakfast, you can ask them to make you fresh juices. Bijay from the F&B is very friendly and helpful. Thank you for making our stay wonderful.

The food there was absolutely delicious, with a wide variety of options to choose from. The rooms were comfortable and well-maintained, providing a cozy and relaxing atmosphere. And let's not forget about the exceptional service provided by Bijay Gupta, the server. He was incredibly friendly, attentive, and went above and beyond to ensure your dining experience was nothing short of exceptional. Overall, it sounds like the hotel hit the mark in every aspect. 😄🌟

Amazing service and the team that oversaw breakfast were kind and helpful. Divyau Simrik was also lovely to deal with at breakfast and very pleasant. The front lobby staff were amazing and the security team were always smiling and happy to help, especially the girl that often worked at the front reception area

We had a pleasure to have dinner at Sky Deck restaurant in Barahi hotel. Not only the food was fantastic, the service made it extra special. Kashmita is a wonderful host and server, and made sure that our experience was wonderful. Moreover, head chef came over to greet us and specially made sure that we enjoyed our food. The overall experience was simply wonderful and I really recommend this place for everyone.

A trip to Nepal after a long long time and checking into Barahi definitely is what a tired traveller needs. Right from a smiling welcome at the reception to a smooth hassle-free check-in, a beautifully laid out room with great views all around, you think you have your day made. Top it off with a rooftop dining space lined up by an infinitely swimming pool which gives you a clear view of the city and the mountains in the backdrop.All this and much more was what I experienced when I was there last week alongwith my friends. We had been planning for this trip since so many months and that means so many changes. But all these changes were accommodated by the hotel with the least bit of hassle. Moreover, the support received from Mr Gaurav deserves special mention as he ensured that we were pampered with focussed attention for all our needs.Thanx to the whole team. I look forward to visiting Barahi the next time I visit Kathmandu.P.s.: would it impress you that the hotel is a 2 minute walk away from thamel and it's hot spots, scores of eating joints if you plan to eat outside or simply to go clubbing while choosing which lounge/club to go there? I was!

Excellent hospitality and special effects by a team consisting Manish, Bishal, Anil,Urmila, Kashmira and Dipesh who made a very special occasion ‘Golden Jubilee Anniversary’ a memorable stay here. The rooms are neat and clean and charging points and usb are provided to give easy excess. The restaurant at 7th floor gives beautiful view of the city eating next to infinity pool.

Hotel Barahi was fantastico hotel in Nepal.  Service was really Nice and food was to good . Service of restaurent was totally amazing molo was delicious .    Service by sannita bini qnd rqnjqn was never fogeratable .Thqnk you rqnjqn qnd your teqm

My recent buffet breakfast experience was truly memorable. Waitress Jharana Lamichhane provided exceptional service, demonstrating thoughtfulness and attention to detail. She remembered our preferences and created a welcoming atmosphere with her warm smile and genuine care. Additionally, Chef Mahesh Bhandari Chhetri's friendly presence added a delightful touch to the morning, engaging in pleasant conversations. I highly recommend having breakfast in the restaurant for a memorable start to your day, thanks to Jharana's outstanding service and Chef Mahesh's friendly demeanor.

I recently visited Barahi Hotel with my children, and we had a fantastic time. The food and beverage service was excellent, offering a great variety of delicious meals that catered to both adults and kids.The swimming pool was a highlight—clean, well-maintained, and perfect for family fun. My children loved it!

Hotel is clean. It is on a great location, closed to many souvenir shops. Restaurant : food is delicious. Services is great. Waiter and waitress are always stand by to assist us at anytime. Specially captain Sunil and Chef Shambhu, they introduce new food to us and care to all customers in the restaurant.

Such a comfortable stay. Love the coffee in the room - not instant, can be brewed by french press. The staff are also really nice and helpful especially if I have to book a taxi. They are also helpful when we organized a meeting in one of their meeting rooms.

Food is fresh and tasty. Head chef Shambu is very courteous and seeks feedback. The way he arranges food is mind blowing lyk beautiful. The breakfast buffet has wide variety of foods including Indian breakfast varieties such as Kachiri, Idli, Poiri, Paratha.The service staff is friendly. Shardha, Kashmita, keshiya are awesome.

We had a very excellent dinner. Our very friendly waitress Ms Kashmita guided us through the menue and made excellent suggestions we had a very tasteful dinner. We would highly recommend this restaurant. We had the best nepali food for first time after landning the country. Loves the night View with best food

We were greeted with  wet towels and water immediately we checked in. Hotel is at the best location in Kathmandu where you can view Narayanhiti Royal Palace, Kaiser Library and Thamel the attraction for  tourist. In addition to the prime location, the hospitality that we have received at the hotel restaurant is just amazing. Mr. Farhan (Cluster Executive Chef) is very polite person and he greeted us with full smile.If you want to have good cuisine, just leave it to him. He will suggest some mouth watering dishes.

This is one of the newest addition to the list of hotels near Thamel and we were glad to have selected it for our stay after 12 days long EBC trek for relaxation. Starting from concierge to room service to table service at the breakfast and even maintenance, we experienced excellent service. If definitely consider staying here again in future and would highly recommend it to me family and friends. Some of the folks that helped make our stay pleasant are: Manoj, Susan and Simran at the front desk and Mahesh, the chef

Wonderful hotel, very courteous staff (not pushy, just well trained). This applies to reception, waiters and everyone else as well.In the middle of Kathmandu, it is also a relaxing experience in the evenings to have booked this top hotel with western standards. The large rooms are clean and are fully cleaned and everything is refilled (including a fruit basket).Absolutely recommend it.

I had a great time here.The staff was very friendlyYou can enjoy a nice meal at 7 th floor and then you can go to the sky bar at 9th and have a drink with a view of the city.Rooms are very clean, sometimes they clean it 2 times a day.They make you feel like home

shanti rasali was really amazing as she provided us with amazing service and had great hospitality. Nabina Panta, Yanzi Sherpa were really really good and respectful with the service. They treated our items with respect and made sure we were well taken care of

Great service, sumptuous food, wonderful ambiance. Superb customer services by Sharda, Rupesh & Chef Sambhu. Keep it up guys! We loved totally. Bhatua mutton was the pick of the dish and beer was perfectly chilled. Cocktails were served with perfect blend

Breakfast at hotel barahi was amazing. They have wide range of selections of food there. Chef shambu was amazing and explained me about all the food in the breakfast and simrik who served me at breakfast was very attentive. It was a great experience

The rooms are very pleasantly decorated with nice amenities. With my room however there was some street noise (traffic, loud people) filtering through. The breakfast on offer was very comprehensive with a lot of variety and choice. It was also great that real coffee, including cappuccino etc were served. The staff in the lobby was very welcoming and helpful, so were Divyani and Jharna who were serving me at the breakfast table. The hotel is also very well located for those who want to explore the Thamel area and other attractions in Kathmandu and the valley. So overall a good and positive experience.

We checked in around 6pm and being too weary to leave to hotel , we decided to go to the Infinity rooftop bar/lounge for a drink and to decompress after our travels. Our server Bini was so sweet and took such good care of us, and the snacks we ordered were very tasty. Excellent service, tasty food enjoyable atmosphere/music and awesome 360 views of the city of Kathmandu! May edit this review with more detail as we continue our stay :)

Staffs are friendly. Hospitality is extremely good. Bijay Gupta has been very friendly, checking out on us, making sure that we are comfortable with our stay.Food at breakfast has wide spread of choices. Guest room is superb, with enough lighting, toiletries. I will recommend my friends this hotel.

We find barajı hotel a best hotel to stay at Kathmandu. We travelled to Kathmandu from Pokhara on June for a short trip. And we stayed at barajı hotel during our trip. Ambience was top notch . Especially, one of the chef name, Ram chef was very nice and experienced. During our dinner, we got the chance to meet with him. He was so easy going that he explain the dishes to us in very hospitable manner and offered us his one of the special dish also. The dish was very good . Our whole family were impressed by his personality and nature. Again, our family are planning to visit Kathmandu in December so, we will for sure stay at barajı hotel only and also will be glad to meet Ram chef agin and try his food .

Hotel Barahi in Kathmandu, Nepal, offers a delightful stay with well-appointed rooms and attentive staff. The on-site restaurant serves delicious Nepali cuisine, and the rooftop terrace provides stunning views. While some areas might benefit from modernization, overall, Hotel Barahi provides a pleasant and memorable experience. The staff's warmth adds a personal touch, making it a standout choice for a comfortable stay in the heart of Kathmandu.

We decided to celebrate a very special birthday dinner at Barahi this evening.We have always trusted Barahi for its excellent hospitality....This fact was reiterated today with the staff at Barahi putting in their heart in making us comfortable as we dined amidst one of the best sights Kathmandu has to offer.Lakpa, Bijay Gupta and their colleagues were very attentive, warm and courteous.Thank you Barahi for the beautiful team who enhance your brand further and help raise the bar...Best wishes

Just stayed at the Barahi Hotel in Kathmandu, was a wonderful experience! Great location, close to Garden of dreams.  The rooms are lovely and clean. You look out to the Royal Palace and Garden of Dreams. The breakfast buffet is the best we experienced in Kathmandu. A broad selection of local and international dishes, fresh fruits and juices, eggs made to order. And great service along with an incredible view. It is right in the entry to the Thamel. I would highly recommend it and I would 100% stay there again.

Lovely rooms, very clean hot. Restaurant served lovely food and staff were very attentive, particularly Sanju sharada. Cocktails were delish too. Great view from the restaurant and pool over the city and a welcome respite after the chaos of the prior tour. Would highly recommend.

Excellent ambience.Very pleasant,and attentive staff.Sunil is very hospitable giving personal attention.He charms people with his knowledge about food and local sightseeing places.Dining here has been a great experience.Food is yummy.

Stayed for 3 nights. Enjoyed excellent quality and variety of food all days. Staff at reception and restaurant are very quick and provided  unparalleled quality of services. Location of Hotel and ambience is excellent. Will surely recommend to family and friends. If I have to recommend one person out of all staff always ready to serve guests, he could be Mr Ranjan from restaurant. In short notice , he could manage arrangements for 16 of us despite fully reserved restaurant. Best wishes for continued growth.

We had an amazing stay in the hotel. The hotel is extremely new, the pool has magnificent views over Kathmandu, and the breakfast was the best we have had in our trip to India, Nepal and Tibet.Most of all the service was 11/10. The people in reception (like Rusha for example), in the restaurant (like ram Singh, or the person in the bar whose name I forgot), or in security (like Mahendra).Congratulations on a very well run hotel.Rodrigo

We had an amazing celebration and the staff was extremely helpful and kind. The food was also awesome. Thank you Sunil vai and his all team for great hospitality also good food made by shambhu chef.good views and good food we really enjoyed recommend

The hotel is situated right at the entrance of main market Thamel area. This is a big advantage so you can go walking for the Thamel area. The breakfast spread is good but tends to get crowded sometimes. For some strange reasons they seem to forget your order so we have to keep on persisting with them for coffee or tea as they are quite busy. They same to say yes but forget about your order. Also the bath  towel at swimming pool were finished at the end of the day and had to go back to my room wet. People where to busy organising dinner and did not bring towel in spite of waiting for 10 minutes. We requested them to bring some cutlery in our room but they forgot about it. Also the swimming pool closes at evening 7 which is a big disadvantage. Overall I would definitely recommend this on a medium budget. But please don't keep too much expectations.

Reviewing on Barahi hotel kathmandu I had best experience as we were here to celebrate our sister bride to be. We were mesmerized by the hospitality and customer care. Especially Ranjan Lamichhane F&B was the best employee of Barahi Hotel he made us feel like we were at our home. The customer care he provided was one of the best that we got 😇

Lovely Nepalese meal, great service from Sharada. Menu has variety but we chose the Nepalese snacks and curries, very satisfying. The wine list was also extensive and asking for extra spicy we had custom made curry was delicious! There is also a great view from the dining room

A much needed day by the pool at Barahi Hotel, Thamel. A beautiful infinity pool overlooking the ex palace as well as some beautiful gardens.Excellent brunch on a Sarurday. The staff were very friendly.A special mention to Sunil Pakhrin who made me feel very welcome. Chef Shambhu proudly showed me the brunch spread and looked after my needs whilst at the table. A glass of wine, brunch and use of pool was perfect after a long trek.

Rooms are clean and spacious. Breakfast spread is good with a live juice station and a wide variety of food. Big compliments to Jyotshna and Chef Rabin at breakfast service who catered to our request for French toast, sunny side up, excellent brewed coffee and very prompt service. Pool is small but offered views of the city. Drinks by the pool deck was v enjoyable though.

Best hotel to stay in Kathmandu Thamel Area. We stayed here during the trekking trip to Nepal, Stayed two nights before the trek started and two nights when the trek finished. The hotel location is excellent, it is walking distance to Thamel and other shopping area. The service provided by all the staff were great. The food here was great as well including the breakfast and dinner. They have nice roof top bar as well. The staff will go out of their way to help you every possible way. Great staff, service, food and location. Cannot get any better hotel in Kathmandu than this.

The location of this hotel is very strategic in the center of the city, close to the tourist attraction area, Thamel.  Clean hotel and friendly staff.The restaurant is great, the waitress are very friendly. I give 5 stars to Ms Kashmita, Mr Bishal, Ms Urmila,Ms Bini...marvelous !!!

Everything about my stay was excellent. The staff is very attentive to my needs and don’t stop until you are satisfied and happy. The food is top notch. The chef Shambhy made sure the meal he prepared was to my liking. Tej Thanait made sure everything ran smoothly.

Barahi Kathmandu Hotel is a luxury 4 star hotel in Kathmandu and brand new , located in between Garden of Dreams and Palace Museum. The staff is very nice and the view from the rooftop is awesome. Delicious breakfast and yummy meals. Wah...nice swimming pool and more. We booked this hotel for many and more guests from Prime Himalayas and our guests enjoyed their stay at Barahi Kathmandu. Strongly recommended.

Best breakfast buffet with a variety of dishes. Warm and fresh food. Whenever we wnated something which was not on the spread, the staff immediately prepared fresh for us. Most friendly and amazing staff. One of the best hotels we have experienced. The staff turned our trip into heaven.

A group of six of us stayed here on our last night in Nepal. The hotel was lovely, clean, and new. The food was quite good, and the employees were polite. I would have given the place 5 stars if not for what happened as we were waiting for our ride to the airport. We were in the lobby with our luggage waiting just outside the door when we noticed an employee filming our luggage. Then, she came into the lobby and started filming all of us. When we noticed, she stopped. We had a Nepali friend visiting with us at the time. She and one of our party went up to the counter to ask staff why we were being recorded. They called the employee back and she said she was going to post us on their social media sites. We had her erase the footage from both her photos and her deleted files and told her that it was inappropriate to film us without our permission. She never did answer why she felt it necessary to film our luggage; that was just weird and creepy. The ironic thing is, if she had just asked one of us to make a statement about our stay for their social media, we probably would have gladly done so. This left a bitter taste in our mouths, and we would probably not stay there again for this reason.

We had an excellent stay at the Bayati hotel. The location is perfect, the rooms really comfortable and spacious and the food just excellent. All of the staff were all very helpful and really went out of their way to help. The restaurant staff in particular Dipesh  and Monish were brilliant, attentive and could not have been more professional. Many thanks for an excellent stay.

The hotel is still being built. There was drilling and hammering all day in the next room to us.On top of the they overcharged us on checkout adding an an extra $25 on our original quoted price.This hotel is not worth the money. Limited facilities and no atmosphere in the hotel.

We were having our Christmas dinner here and it was amazing. Everyone was very nice and helpful, they even played Czech Christmas songs for us. Food selection was really wide and it was delicious. I especially appreciated that they had both Nepali and international options. Thank you everyone and thank you, BIJAY, for taking special care.

My family and I had an exceptional experience at the Barahi Hotel Kathmandu. The service was top-notch, with attentive and friendly waitstaff who went above and beyond to ensure our comfort. From the moment we arrived, the hotel staff impressed us with their professionalism and hospitality.

This hotel is amazing. Staff is very friendly and sure keep this place clean and pleasant. The location is fantastic. You find great places walking distance to shop for good quality cashmere and pashmina. I have been eating at the terrace restaurant 3x a day, and must say that the food is topquality, besides there is a great selection of Western and Nepalese cuisine. The staff in the restaurant is well educated, they speak good English are kind and  very helpful. Overall they have great energy. I like to mention their names, Manish, Bishal, and Kashmir’s.

The staff are so friendly and helpful, remembering what you like, asking if everything is fine,  anticipating needs, and accomdating any special requests. The food is delicious with many choices from different continents. Highly recommend.

I recently stayed at this hotel and was thoroughly impressed. The comfort of the accommodations was outstanding, providing a cozy and relaxing atmosphere. The customer service was impeccable, with staff going above and beyond to ensure a pleasant stay. Cleanliness was top-notch, making me feel confident about the hygiene standards. The food was not only delicious but also offered a diverse and tempting menu. A special mention goes to Vijay Gupta and gentlemen on front desk who helped us with checkin after Airbnb refused entry, whose exceptional help added a personal touch to my experience, making it truly memorable. Highly recommend this hotel for a delightful stay!

The service is unbeatable, the whole team is very detailed and at all times are attentive to your needs. Specially Nic! In our case, they purposely made dishes with less spice in order to enjoy the specialties of Nepal. The rooms are large and spacious.

The food was awesome.Ambience, cleanliness, staff friendliness was worth praising.Chef Shambhu and Captain Sunil personally attended us, understood our requirements and accordingly served us excellent food.

Great experience, I had a wrong order initially for takeaway lunch but the F&B manager Gurav and the entire F&B team came to apologize at dinner and fixed the situation - it was a very good crisis management and made the initial honest mistake turn into a good customer experience ultimately. At dinner, the food was great, the customer service was good, and the ambiance was great. We enjoyed the rooms are very new and nice, would stay again next time. Great job team. Good hotel.

Dining at Hotel Barahi was a true delight, all thanks to Ms. Giri and Ms. Lamichani. Their impeccable service and attention to detail elevated the entire experience. The menu offered a wonderful array of delectable dishes, each prepared to perfection. Sanju Giri and Jharana Lamichani's recommendations were spot-on, showcasing their deep knowledge and passion for hospitality. The warm and inviting atmosphere only added to the overall charm. Without a doubt, I highly recommend Hotel Barahi for a culinary experience that exceeds expectations.

Hotel Barahi's brunch and swimming pool were a fantastic experience. Chef Bhuwan's culinary skills on individual care though it was a buffet service brighten through the delicious spread, and Sanjib's and Kashmita's service was top-notch. A perfect blend of great food, service, and ambience.

Food was amazing, the ambiance was lovely, music was melodic, service was exceptional. We had an amazing experience at Hotel Barahi, a dashain worth reminiscing and fonding over.

Our stay with the Barahi has been fabulous. From a swift check-in to prompt room service. Breakfast has been delightful, with a variety each day. Both Nepali, Indian and English breakfast. The French toast was my favourite thanks to chef Bhuvan, as well as some epic masala scrambled eggs. The restaurant service by Bijay Gupta has been fabulous, and he’s been such fun to talk to. Great conversation on religion and politics. We stayed for 5 days and could y have picked a better hotel. Thankyou to Barahis staff. We’ll be back!

Was served by Bishal Thapa who is extremely patient and friendly.  He took the effort to give me a few options based on my preference and he checked in on me after my meals.  I had the butter chicken masala and naan which is good. Will recommend to anyone keen to have a try here. Thank you Bishal and you are definitely an asset to the organization. Keep smiling cause you made my day!

This hotel is one of the best I’ve stayed in. I came here following a trekking holiday in the Himalayas, and I felt the luxury and hospitality instantly on arrival - it was a much needed place of rest and relaxation.Great service, food and facilities.Special mention to Bijay Gupta who was professional and provided great customer care!Would definitely come back if back in Kathmandu.

Overall experience was good especially the hospitality and staff, there way of speaking and feeling the guests so especial when he is out of his town for business trip or vacation.Chefs Sambhu, Sharada, sanju, Bini!!!!!Thank you Brij Mohan vyas

The dinner was excellent with great taste and specially staff are excellent in prioritising our needs . Very happy with the service at Barahi. Chef Shanthi , Sunil and shreedevi are the excellent staff who served us with great gesture . Thank you

The level of service at the barahi Hotel was outstanding. Every staff member I encountered was professional, courteous, and eager to assist. Whether it was arranging transportation, providing local recommendations, or fulfilling special requests, the staff went above and beyond to ensure a seamless and enjoyable stay

Great hotel, great staff, great location, and especially the food. The chef Shambu and Kashmita for the service really made our stay wonderful. Additionally Nabin who helped us booking trips was really attentive and responsive.  Truly recommend this fantastic hotel.

This hotel is good enough to compete with international hotels. Staff is really helpful and nice. They always say namaste to you. Room is spacious and clean. The location is great so that you could walk to some attractions, shops and restaurants. 10/10

Devyani was very efficient and attentive, food was excellent and service was quick but not too quick.I had fish which was superb served on potatoes and spinach.You only get one chance to make a first impression.We're staying for 4 nights so we will dine here again.

Great food. Wonderful service Deviyani Sharma is very polite and helpful.Great view of the royal palace. The swimming pool is great. Breakfast was very lavish and tasty.They serve wonderful masala tea in small original cups. Great for tea lovers.Overall. Great place to relax, right at the  enter of the city.

Hotel was very well organized, clean and elegant and comfortable. Had a great atmosphere and felt very well looked after. Excellent views from restaurant and pool,  felt peaceful despite being a few minutes walk from Thamel. Price might seem upmarket for KTM however you will find it good value once you stay. Very good place to relax in peace from the hustle and bustle of Kathamndu, especially if you've been trekking etc.Room, furnishings, and the entire hotel was brand new and classy. This was the best place we stayed in Nepal and are looking forward to coming back.

Great staff and drinks with an outdoor terrace that offers a full view of Thamel. There are fires to sit around outside, and multiple sitting areas on the inside that the staff will guide you to based on your preference. A wonderful place to spend the evening with friends.

Comfy bed, very good location (next to Thamel), delicious buffet breakfast, friendly staffs.This is not m first time to visit Kathmandu. I've been here for 4/5 times previously. I stayed in different hotels before. So if compared to all these hotels, Barahi is doing a very great job for all the guests. Staffs always take care for customers and of course they are providing very good 5-star services. I'll see them next time.

The breakfast menu spread  is scrumptious and one of the best I have ever had , especially the puff pastries are outlandish. Their restaurant on the top floor has a great ambience too and the stay in the rooms are very comfortable. I strongly recommend this place.

Bishal Thapa and Kashmita provide us with great hospitality which made us feel right at home. The hotel has superb view of Royal Palace, its a must visit place is Kathmandu. The service, amibience are superb. Simply great..

The food was amazing, the ambience and the view is just wow, you get a splendid view of the entire city specially the palace museum. The service was really good, the team treated us well and were really polite and gentle. ( we were served and handled by- bijay gupta ji) Overall I’d recommend people to go.

Fantastic hotel, brand new, rooms were comfortable, pool area has a wonderful view. The breakfast spread catered for all cuisines and tastes and the lunch menu was great. We sat out by the pool and enjoyed wonderful service from Dipesh. We would definitely come back! Thankyou

Hospitable environment with mesmerising landscape view from top and delicious food. A place to visit. We were assisted by Sunil, helpful in nature, provided us information about the hotel barahi. Had great  ambience we will visit again ...

Hotel barahi is one of the best place in town .Me and my friends were always love to be at barahi just because of food and friendly staff .      Whenever I visit to barahi I will always willing to take care by ranjan because the way he talks and his service he provide .    Thank you ranjan and your team.

Very comfortable rooms! The breakfast is great, and the service is excellent. Deviyani at breakfast was lovely. The hotel also has excellent views of the whole city. The location is very close to a lot of the city’s attractions and near to shopping. Can’t beat it.

The rooftop restaurant with pool is simply overwhelming. I have also eaten breakdöfas here two weeks sgo and the food quality and choice was superior to anything I have previously experienced in my so far four trips to Kathmandu. This time I had lunch with a close colleaugue: Deviani was superb in advising us about the food including a starter.— the food was overwhelming tasty and rich. My compliments to all, Deviani and the Chefs / owner.

Fabulous hotel, staff make it fabulous! Devi at breakfast has a happy, helpful attitude which brightens every morning and Kunga in the bar cannot do enough for us.This hotel is the first proper 5 star hotel we have stayed in. Well done to all staff, including management..

Very good accomodation. Great food. We had a toddler with us and the chef Mr. Shambhu made special soft rotis for the baby. In room dining is also very good.It's fairly in the city center and Thamel is very close by, for shopping etc. Travel arrangements were also very good

Very pleasant experience here. I truly enjoyed my stay here in the hotel. Excellent hotel staff like Mr Bishal Thapa (in the buffet area)I recommend staying in this hotel to all those visiting Kathmandu. It’s in thamel area & where all the action is

The best experience i had so far.  We organized a workshop program at Barahi Hotel Kathmandu. The arrangement was the at its best. We could experience the best tasted food with lots of variety. The ambience and the view from the hotel was just WOW. I strongly recomend this hotel if you are organizing any conference or meeting please do at hotel barahi kathmandu.

Hi Apurva here,We had stayed 2 nights at Barahi and we had a great experience here.The staff were very cordial and always ready to help especially the chef Mr Ram Singh, the. I really enjoyed my stay at the Barahi and will recommend anyone who travels to Kathmandu to stay here ..

The service at Barahi Hotel in Kathmandu truly sets it apart, thanks to the unparalleled kindness and dedication of the restaurant staff. We are very comfortable.Room service nice. Very nice view and serviceVery clean room and cool pool with beautiful view. Restaurent on 7th floor was outstanding, Ranjan and sanju was so friendly and lovely. Wok tossed chicken suggested by Ranjan was so delicious thank you guys 😘

Went with the friends and family for the buffet dinner. Amazed by the ambiance as the closet to thamel has awesome hotel. Good food, everyone enjoyed the buffet dinner, lots of variety in food and each food is top notch. For good food and quality time, i recommend this hotel.

Excellent hotel. Clean and friendly staff. Very modern and great views of Kathmandu. Breakfast was great with a diverse selection of local and western options. Would recommend highly for anyone wanting to stay somewhere modern and close to the centre

One of the best experience. The whole staff members are very friendly and helpful. Special thanks to Mr.Bijay Gupta for his nice food suggestions and warmth and kindness and genuine hospitality were apparent throughout our visit. The rooms are very clean and comfortable.

We had a very relaxing brunch by the poolside at the newly opened Barahi Hotel restaurant at Thamel.The view from the restaurant was breathtaking, and the food alleviated our overall mood. The service was very good. Mr. Lakhpa Tshering Sherpa was very helpful and friendly. We will visit again with family and friends.

I visited Nepal for my business purpose. And i stayed in hotel barahi kathmandu. It was really great staying there . I enjoyed during my stay .The food there was amazing . Staffs were really polite and helpful. Especially chef sambhu, chef krishna  jyotshna simrik  jharana manish were really excellent with their service. I will definitely visit again.

Yummy breakfast buffet and friendly staff. This was our first time here and I understand this is a newer hotel. The location is great King’s Palace and a few casinos is within walking distance. Roof top infinity pool leads to gorgeous views.

We ware on a business trip to Nepal @Barahi Kathmandu, we found a very professional Managment , the staffs are well trained with a smiling face at all times…. Ready to assist in any way…. The breakfast buffet with a good spread … special mention names in the Reception Ms.Aljina & Ms.Rusha has a very warm welcome & ready to assist for any of our requests…. Over all we had a good experience 😊

Really happy to stay in hotel barahi kathmandu.very good hospitality room was very comfortable and so many variety and options for breakfast. We all enjoyed a lot and we will be back again. Very understanding staff and warm hospitality given by all staff specially in breakfast time chef devraj, manager tej nd sr. Supervisor Sunil made out stay really memorable with their specific service.Thanks to all team members of barahi ktm specially service member.Jyotsna,simrik,sharada,jharana and divyani ,Jeet ,Dilli, all for great service.

The exotic spread of breakfast and dinner were awesome! The crew were very well trained and were helpful!

Amazing comfort of a luxurious bed after a tough trek up to ABC. The staff are so attentive and kind, cannot complain about a single thing. The food was lovely and the views of Kathmandu is perfect for a city stay, very close to a great night out in Thamel also.

Me and my friend went to hotel Barahi this evining. Best hotel in town food and service was excellent. Service by Ranjan bhai was amazing very friendly and well service .food recommended by Ranjan was delicious thank you Ranjan bhai for your services.

I am grateful to the team at Hotel Barahi for making our party a resounding success. Their dedication to providing top-notch service and creating a welcoming atmosphere truly stood out. I highly recommend Hotel Barahi for any event or occasion. Thank you for the unforgettable experience!

the service was impeccable very professional and friendly staff loved the food and the staff was very coordinating!!! will definitely visit again! Shanti Rasaili was essentially helpful in aiding to my problems! loved the place and the hotel everything from the location to the services.

Very neat and clean rooms. The food is awesome. The staff is very polite and co operative. We were attended by Mr. Manish, Bishal and Ms. Koshmita. We are pure vegetarian and they also helped us in providing jain food

Nice new hotel in ktm, courteous and very attentive staff who go the extra mile to cater to your needs! shoutout to manish neupane, Sanju giri, deepak thopa magao, who helped in making my wife’s Birthday a memorable one!!!

Amazing view from restaurant and food was so delicious tawa fish chicken curry with rice 🥰the service was great from sharada Urmila Keshia and Kashmita.   Senior captain Sunil and Prabhat specially thanks for chef Sambhu for delicious food  👌👌. The rooms are also so clean and hygienic🥰🥰🥰🇳🇵

The stay and the food was very good. In terms of serving dinner and the menu congratulations to Kashmita, Sanju, bini,sambhu chef and keshiya thank you for the service yoi have done for us. We have had a wonderful stay here at the Barahi Hotel. They gave us interconnected rooms as per our request which was great to have those available with teenage kids. Really clean and comfortable, lovely staff - with a special mention to Chef Sambu, and our food server Sharada, they looked after us beautifully.

Restaurant at 7th floor was amazing .  Food suggested by Ranjan Lamichhane (wok tossed chicken and tawa fish ) was really amazing .   Server sunil , bijay , jharna and Nikesh   was really nice drink made by rajnish was very good . Thank you entire barahi team .

We organized a celebration for my grandmother's 83rd birthday at Hotel Barahi. I would like to express my utmost appreciation for the incredible service provided by Ranjan and the entire team. Me and my friend we had a recient at bahari hotel left me throughly impressed. Beautiful Hotel , very clean, within walking distance of Durban Square but in a quieter area.Great and helpful staff..The hotel has a restaurant and the food is quite good.All the waiters in the restaurant were very helpful, Sumil was especially attentive ! Barahi Plaza  is a very nice hotel with great hospitality. Staff here is very welcoming and helpful. Ambience too is good. Rooms are well appointed and housekeeping is prompt. One of the best places to stay in Kathmandu. The hospitality and the service is commendable. The rooftop cafe is outstanding and has a mesmerizing view with one of the best services by Mr. Bijay. Overall , a great experience

Must visit when in Kathmandu. Food,ambience & view overall it’s too good. Bijay Gupta serves us so well & he creates unforgettable moments. Don’t forget to visit. Barahi ktm is good for staycation too.

We highly recommeded Hotel Bahari for people on business trips, couples getaway. Hotel is very good, clean, modern, neat and good facilities. Hotel staff are all very friendly and helpful.
