We had a lovely cocktail and food in the restaurant and poolside. Sanju really looked after us very well.We also had a lovely chat with Manesh at the end. Good luck with the restaurant and hotel. Thank you

We had the best swimming pool experience here. The food was very good and the ambience was amazing. We found the service here very nice, all the staffs were very hospitable, this is definitely one of the finest hotel in ktm.

Location - In the heart of Kathmandu. Easy access for foods and nightlife (Thamel and Durbar Marg)Accomodation - Squeaky clean and hygenic.Breakfast - Posh and multi-choice for national & international guest.Facilities - Roof top swimming pool was relaxing with mesmerising view of the historical palace. Overall experience - Nice and comfortable, outstanding hospitality.Points to consider - This could be a cultural shock to someone when the hotel service provider in communial area keep on staring at you readily available for service and may lose privacy or create awkwardness. Also, frequent greetings could be annoying for some visitors. But thats the cultural thing how you take it. I felt positive as I dont felt that they judged on you.Lovely stay & my wife and kids thoroughly enjoyed it - specially the bed, food and swimming pool.

We booked for 14 of us for dinner on a rainy day. They accommodated us perfectly. Everything was great from the view to the food. Special mention to Sunil for serving us perfectly. Will be back again.

High-quality 5* hotel. From the moment you arrive at the hotel entrance to the moment you are taken to the airport, you are provided with professional and friendly care by the entire hotel staff. Everyone is well trained in how to behave towards the customer so that they feel comfortable. Everyone speaks English very well. The rooms are clean and spacious. The bathrooms too. Cleaned very carefully every day. It is quiet at night. The area is very safe because it is a government district. Air conditioning and wifi work very well. Breakfasts served in the lower restaurant are varied and plentiful. In the form of a buffet. Additionally, you can order served dishes. Good quality. The staff from the entrance to the restaurant immediately takes care of guests in a very professional manner, typical of the best premium hotels in the world. It is similar during dinner. You can see that the entire hotel staff has been well trained and the managers are constantly in contact with hotel guests and constantly supervise their departments so that everything is perfect. This behavior is typical of the best hotels in the world. And I have been traveling a lot for many years on all continents and I have a good comparison.  On the top floor there is a second restaurant where we had dinner with local dishes and during it a folklore band performed with a very interesting artistic program. The waiter with excellent English told us the history of all the dishes served, which were very tasty, plentiful and of high quality. On the roof of the hotel there is also a clean swimming pool and a view of the Kathmandu panorama. The hotel offers free transport to and from the airport in a new, large, comfortable car. The driver was professional and took care of us until the very end. He took care of our luggage to make the last minutes of our stay more pleasant. I am a demanding guest who has lived in many hotels around the world for the last decades and I count this hotel among the top 5* hotels at the world level. In addition, you have a sense of privacy and peace in it.

Service- 5 starsLocation-5 StarsComfort - 5 StarsFood - 5 StarsViews- 5 StarsValue for Money-5 StarsWe stayed at this gem of a hotel on our recent business visit to Kathmandu. Basera is a boutique property located in the heart of Kathmandu. It is housed in an exceptionally beautiful building designed tastefully in traditional Nepali architecture and aesthetics.The service is exceptionally good with the same high standards maintained from check-in to room service to  F&B service and a smooth hassle free check out.The rooms large, clean and well appointed. The bathroom is spacious with all modern amenities.While we didn’t have time to enjoy the roof top swimming pool, we did enjoy a traditional Nepali meal on the roof top restaurant that provided a stunning views of Kathmandu city and the valley  beyond.I would like to make a special mention of Mr Udhav who made sure that we had a memorable stay. Will be staying at Basera on our next trip. 👍🏻

Beautiful clean rooms, great selection and flavors on the menu's, the best staff of any hotel I have stayed in over the past 20 years. Whether it was a day trip for a hike, or planning an evening out, the staff set up everything we needed ahead of time without any issues.

A truly great experience. I was worried as I brought my 14 year old daughter to Nepal from USA, but the staff, the rooms, and the dining made us feel at home while still having a Nepal experience. Clean, cost efficient, with a great gym and pool.

We had a really enjoyable stay here and would highly recommended Basera Boutique hotel. The staff were always very helpful. We had airport transfers included as well as 8pm late checkout included (as we stayed during low season). The breakfast was good as well as the dinner and traditional Nepalese dance performance in the Bhansa restaurant

Siisti, huoneet olivat erittäin kodikkaita ja petsoonallisia. Sosiaalitilat uudehkoja ja hyvin siistejä. Palvelu on ensisijaista. Huonepalvelu toi hyvin. Olisi ollut muka hyödyntää enemmänkin palveluita mutta meillä oli aikataulu oman retkemme suhteen

Awesome property, hospitable staffs, clean, swimming pool with Nepalese touch, good spa and great food. ,.....,.........................................................................................................

I recently visited here and with my family the location is wonderful and its also near to airport, food was really good, staff are very well behaved specially Mr. Suraj  He was very kind and polite and   he have really good communication skill as im from india he guided me with everything

Great value. Super staff. OK location. Clean. Definitely use if u can. Super friendly and accommodating staff from Managers to security top floor restaurant has amazing food and offers live dance show. They messed up our airport pickup tho. Didn’t show. We had to call

The overnight stay at Basera Hotel was beyond my own expectations. It rarely happens that I have been so well helped anywhere. It started after we landed in Kathmandu. Free airport pick up and quiet clean room. Price of the Hotel was in line with expectations. Especially for the location. It is near everything and there are many opportunities to eat. The supermarket bhatbhateni is around the corner and there are several options to eat. hotel is also only 10 min from the airport so you do not have to sit in the car for too long on arrival. Neighborhoods like Thamel are about a 20 min drive from the hotel , but rather stay in wen quiet neighborhood than in the bustle of the city . Super experience with friendly staff. Breakfast met everything.

Basera Boutique is an excellent hotel. Highly comfortable and a staff that goes above and beyond.  Uddav and Suraj were exceptionally heloful and kind.  If you are looking for a respite from the bustle of Kathmandu this is an excellent option.  In addition, the on site restaurants are great.  The breakfast buffet is highly recommeneded as well!

I visited Nepal with the sole purpose of trekking the Annapurna Circuit Trail, and while at Kathmandu, I looked for the highest rated hotel available as I needed to stay for several days prepping & buying gear for the trek. I chose Basera Boutique Hotel.Unsurprisingly, Basera Hotel resembles the genuine hospitality of Nepali people, I will list few things they had helped me with:1. Booking taxies, as well as guiding me into apps for booking taxies.2. Guiding me into hiking stores, cheapest exchange rates stores, Garmin agency store, as well as suggesting good barbershops before the trek.3. As I have bought clothing, books and other Nepali material as gifts for the family, I obviously could not take it all with me to the mountains. So, they stored two large bags, they also provided their personal luggage bags to store my stuff (as no stores were available when I was about to travel to the mountains), they additionally bought me luggage bags when I was away, for me to collect when I comeback.4. Washing my clothes -third party store- (noting the quality of cleanliness is amazing).Additionally, allow me to list some perks of booking at Basera hotel:1. It is a genuine & luxurious Nepali experience.2. The food at the ground floor restaurant is delicious, whether breakfast, lunch or dinner.3. Cleanliness at its best, you actually may request additional hygienic processes (such as cleaning the carpet, washing the floor, sanitizing the bathroom...etc.).4. Rooms are spacious, with a smart TV installed on every room. A/C is controllable and it is quite handy, especially in summer months.I could, of course, keep going in the praise of the hotel, because my experience was terrific as I have booked literally through a Whatsapp message the second time I stayed there (after the trek).Needless to mention, but important for the context, Uddav, the hotel manager, is a superb manager, personalizing the experience & making it as humane as possible, he will become a great friend of yours despite the fact he's always busy. So, shoutout to Uddav (or Oday in Arabic), as well to all of the hotel staff. You rock! Keep at it!

I liked the ambience of hotel especially artistic look of rooms. Quite different interior with nice cleaning. Regarding staff, Hats off to staff, cooperative I didn’t recall names only remember the Mr. Uddav, very helpful even any matter outside hotel. I had a feeling as in was in my homeland.

The hotel itself is very good: rooms, corridors, halls. Polite staff. Delicious food and great choice in the restaurant. The hotel itself gave the impression of being somewhat lifeless. There is a supermarket nearby. The area - there was nowhere to go, we took a taxi to Thamel. Plus, upon check-in, they picked us up from another hotel for free, and also provided us with a free transfer to the airport. Another disadvantage that affected us was that 3-4 days before check-in, the hotel’s account on Booking.com was hacked, and they began demanding payment on behalf of the hotel under the threat of cancellation of the reservation. Moreover, this was the first time we encountered such a hack on Booking.com; we were not prepared that this could be done both through messenger and email. The money was not written off, but the card had to be deactivated. It’s either a Booking.com problem or the hotel has such protection, but it needs to be taken into account.

This hotel has a lot going for. The staff is great, & the rooms are large. The front desk manager was terrific. The hotel is in a quiet area close to the airport. It was just a short ride into the busier parts of town, inc Thamel. The breakfast. Unfettered was good, but it could have had more fruits & local pastries.

Had a fantastic trip at the hotel! Service went above and beyond to make sure I was comfortable. Food was delicious and nice that room service was available 24/7. Did currency exchange from USD which was nice I didn’t have to go to the ATM. Didn’t get message or go to the pool but would’ve like to. 5 stars and no complaints!

Beautiful hotelI was so impressed with this hotel , its location is accessible.StaffVery polite and helpful, very welcoming and knowledgeable. Well presented and treated guests with such kindness. The reception staff right through to the waiters ……perfect service Waiting for my next holiday ☺️

I had the pleasure of staying here at Basera Boutique for over 5 weeks. It felt like a home away from home with the kindest, most caring hotel staff I've ever met.Their communication was exceptional from the start. They made sure we were picked up from the airport with our names on a plaque and the driver was amazing at navigating the chaotic roads of Kathmandu in a safe, comfortable manner. The staff at reception were always keen to make sure we had everything we needed with our stay, and as we were long-stay guests they offered to get us whatever we wanted for breakfast, although it was barely required as the breakfast was superb every morning. We were even able to have a breakfast to go one day when we went for an early morning hike. We always knew we could trust the safety of the hotel food which was a necessity especially when we took unwell due to eating outside food. When this occured the staff were so caring and helpful, ensuring we had extra provisions such as oral rehydration solutions and as much water as we needed. It meant a lot to me when Rebecca came to help me when I was quite sick and gave me a hug and ensured I had everything I needed, she even remembered me when I came to the Base Camp Café a few days later and asked how I was doing.Sushant has been an incredible overseer of our whole experience at the hotel. He has been so accommodating to our needs and there seemed to be nothing he couldn't help us with!We were greeted with a smile by every single member of staff. Doors were opened for us, staff made an effort to ask about how our experiences were going in Nepal and got to know our usual breakfast orders.The hotel itself is designed very luxuriously. Before you even enter the building you have a lovely security guard to open your door and take your bags if you have any. The lobby is both grande and cozy. I felt like a queen with my huge room (Heritage Suite) and jacuzzi bathtub! The A/C worked really well, and even when it wasn't working so well on 1 occasion (likely due to a power cut in the city) the team were very quick to sort it. The tea and coffee station was always well stocked, plus 2 bottles of water a day and toiletries for the bathroom.The rooftop swimming pool was lovely and cold after a hot day in Kathmandu. There was a nice little area to sunbathe and relax by the pool. They have a fantastic view of the city. The gym is well equipped with cardio machines, pin weight machines, bar bells and dumbbells.We tried food and drinks at both The Mantra Restaurant and Base Camp Café. Staff were always attentive and food was consistently good quality.Overall I would recommend this hotel to everyone. The staff will go above and beyond to ensure you have a wonderful stay during your time in Kathmandu.

I spent two months in the hotel. Excellent and very friendly staff. Restaurant menus were perfect. Clean and quiet room. Surrounding area of hotel had good options for shopping and walking around. I will certainly come to Basera Boutique Hotel again.

Service service service - what an amazing find. From the moment you arrive, the gentleman whom opens your car door with a salute and a smile and bringing your luggage in to the warm reception from the desk staff immediately making you feel welcome and what a sense of relief as  you know your reservation was the right move. Each time I left my roomAnd encountered any staff it was with a smile. Staff was over the top helpful with everyone making sure that whomever was asking a question of where to go or how to get there. Harendra on our first morning even drove us personally to the Garden of Dreams (I believe that’s what it was called) and showed us here to go shopping- sightseeing for the day. Upon our return to the hotel we were agin greeted with genuine enthusiasm and all asked how our day was. There was some people whom booked a flight to Everest and the company whom they booked with had cancelled on them. Harendra was immediately involved and on the phone trying to find another touring company for the upset couple. In fact they always were quick to jump on their phones to arrange anything you wanted from taxis to money exchange to genuine concern for how your holiday was going. The roomsWere  nice and clean and comfortable again when you book something from 11,000 km away you just don’t know what your in for but I assure you that you will be in good hands. We went to Langtang trek for 9 days and came back to this hotel again, we arrived late in the evening and wanted a massage and they made it happen even though the spa was closing in 5 minutes. I know I am missing many more points in this but what I do know is- I will be back here one day. I promise you that this wonderful staff made my trip to Nepal so much better. I have much love for them and their kindness.

On my bustiness trip to Nepal we had our event in Basera so we preferred to stay there. The hotel property is very nice & the whole event was managed flawlessly by the hotel staff . As for the stay the rooms are very nice with a very Nepali architectural & the restaurant offers lovely evening live performances. The hotel restaurant offers a very good breakfast menu & food is very delicious. They also have 24 hr in room service.    The reception was extremely helpful specially Mr. Uddhav who helped me with all the guidance to go around in Nepal. The staff services were very prompt always greeting us with a smile on thier face which made our stay very pleasant!! The hotel is so well situated so would definitely highly recommend it !

Very good hotel, well located, welcomes us and takes us to the airport, with excellent staff, I highlight Reeta, Uday and the restaurant staff who didn't know what to do to please. Large room, wonderful bathroom with bathtub.

Excellent accommodation in the city, in a safe and uncrowded neighborhood. The highly qualified, kind and efficient staff. Rooms generous in space and comfort. Very varied breakfast and excellent cuisine with international and local dishes.Excellent value for money

It was perfect fm the moment fm airport pickup till airport drop off. Very nice location. Extremely friendly and warm welcome (especially Mr Uddav). Clean rooms. Nice restaurants and bar. All hotel staff were very kind and friendly. I loved it.

It was the first accommodation on our trip to Nepal and we felt very comfortable. The staff was very friendly, the breakfast buffet was very extensive. The beds were very comfortable. It was nice not to be in the middle of the hustle and bustle of the old town or Thamel. The pool on the roof was also a plus.

Staffs are very friendly and clean environment of the hotel was impressing . We enjoyed authentic Nepali food from Manthra and Bhansa which cannot explain in words . Location of the hotel is another advantage for the guest which is reachable to any corner of city center .

This is my fourth stay.As always, we were greeted with a smile.They remembered all of our requests from the last time and supported us to have a good time.We arrived late at night, but they guided us to our room smoothly, so we were able to enjoy Kathmandu to the fullest the next morning.Friendly and polite service.Delicious food.Spacious room.The driver drove carefully.And the spa was also very nice.This is a hotel that will give you a great trip!!!Please experience it once.

The hotel is in a quiet area away from the Thamel area which is noisy and polluted. It is clean and modern in heritage style. The beds were comfortable. There is nice lighting to aid relaxation. The buffet breakfast is excellent with healthy choices, and perfect for us as vegetarian/vegan. The staff is so friendly and helpful. We liked the free transfer from and to the airport, and help with taxis. We had a very pleasant stay and highly recommend this hotel.

5 out of 5The staff at the hotel really can not do enough for you, they are extremely helpful.The hotel is very clean and everything works fine. Showers, plug sockets etc...Everyone is well spoken (english) and respectful.I would throughly recommend this hotel.the staff are also very well trained and professional.James

The hotel is beautiful and we really enjoyed our stay for 5 days. The rooms are very nicely done, the food is really good and the included breakfast was amazing. The front reception staff was more than helpful. They arranged tours, taxis, suggested places to go and helped us do it and get there. They arranged to and from airport transfers, they exchanged our money. We saw everything we wanted and then some and they were instrumental in making that happen. It has turned into one of my highlights of my travels the past couple years and couldn’t have done it all without their assistance and suggestions. Thank you!

The room was spacious, clean and the style was very nice. Aminities (spa, breakfast, etc.) were of very good quality too. The location is not exactly in the center, but free airport  service easily compensate. Great prive/value ratio. Overall, very satisfactory.

The hotel is very attractive, with antique wood and red brick furnishings in perfect Nepalese style. The staff is very friendly and polite. The room is spacious and fully equipped (apart from the lack of drawers - but maybe only relevant in the room where I stayed). Two restaurants with a wide choice of menus and excellent specialities.

Central, quiet and safe neighborhood; polite, professional and courteous staff; comfortable, luxurious and clean premises.We stayed for about three nights and our stay was made as easy as possible by Basera. The breakfast was very good and the evening culture performance was lovely!All in all, Basera is an easy recommendation and is from now on our go to hotel the next time we’re in Kathmandu.

Really I had a very good time at Basera Hotel, all the staff here are very nice and everyone is very polite in nature and they are helpful too, I was very impressed with the hospitality of Hotel Basera Boutique, so if you ever visit Nepal. A very pleasant hotel: welcoming and attentive staff, comfort and decoration of the rooms, copious and varied breakfast, rooftop and swimming pool. The restaurant offers quality cuisine. All for a very attractive price-quality ratio.

The Hotel is very nice, good size of rooms, very good restaurant (24 hours open), well located in Kathmandu and the best is how so kind and helpful is all the staff all the time.There is also a very good combination between rate and quality.Next time in Kathmandu I will be there again.

The hotel is about 15 minutes from the airport, impressive and very inviting.The reception at the airport and in the hotel by Reeta was extremely cordial, the atmosphere very warm and inviting.The rooms are extremely well cleaned, snow-white bed linen and towels!The entire hotel is very clean!The breakfast leaves nothing to be desired!There are 3 restaurants in the hotel!A Nepalese performance every evening.

Food of Mantra Restaurant was to die for, especially Thali set, still lingering in my taste buds. The ambience and overall visit was fun. I will visit again n again for sure. And staffs were helpful, specially Smriti, she was really friendly and made sure we had best dining experience. Thank you.

It’s a wonderful experience stay in Basera! I will  recommend this hotel to my friend. Very warm service! Good location! Nice food! The reception help us book the taxi, very kindly. Maybe I can take my family next time. Cheers cheers cheers!!

Excellent hotel recently renovated in a convenient location, my room was very comfortable, spacious and well decorated. The breakfast was very rich with a great offer.  We ate dinner in the restaurant a few times and the food was also very good, accompanied by traditional dancing. I also tried the SPA that is also great, and the  staff are very kind. Will go back there!

The room was amazing breakfast and room service brilliant but best of all was the staff the airline lost my luggage the staff helped me get it back in time before I left especially Harendra and Uddav. Beautiful boutique property. Loved the hospitality of all the staff write from reception to Restaurant. Rooms are amazing. Smart TV in the room. There is a roof top swimming pool.. very close to airport makes it convenient for travel. Overall very happy.

The hotel was beautiful The staff were very helpful and spoke English wellThe breakfast buffet was greatWe were warmly welcomedThe beds were comfortableThey were very accommodating by helping me get to the airport in time the catch my flight

It’s a beautiful hotel, excellent service, friendly staff, everyone speaks English. We greatly enjoyed folk dancing in the restaurant on the 7th floor. The decor of the hotel is very authentic. The staff is professional and eager to help. We  recommend to stay in Basera.

It has been a fantastic stay. The hotel is perfect, the facilities are very good. Very good food. The massage service at the spa is also very good. But the best of all has been the staff who have been very friendly and have helped us at all times.

Awesome Stay...Basera boutique is one of the best boutique hotel I found in Kathmandu..Nice, need and Clean rooms , Staffs are friendly and professional Specially Mr. Uddav who take cares for everything starts from my arrival he was so kind to explain the thinks and designs a tour itinerary for me and provides a good service. He was there to help out for each and every thing ...keep it up your excellent hospitality Mr. Uddav.

Great Place, amazing hospitality - the staff goes above and beyond to make sure you are comfortable and give you the best information for travel. I got great information regarding things to do in and around and also for other places. I would highly recommend this place to all.

Excellent property with nice hospitality. Must visit place . Special thanks to Mr Uday who take care of our family with best suggestion. And places where we should visit. Keep up the good work Feel like a king and staff was excellent. Food and service was outstanding.

Staff is very cooperative …. Specifically Mr. Sushant ji , Mrs Surbhi Kaur , Mr. Uddav Narayan .They helped us a lot during a stay over there .  Pleasant environment , Urgent service and food is good.

Longest check in and check out. Wooden panel infront of the window, wich made the room completely dark (on day) and claustrophobic. Also dont recommend the "spa", simple room, staff does not speak English wich resulted in uncomfortable situations.

Amazing stay and nice food. Only thing that could be better is room service gave us cold food. Amenities were nice and staff was friendly. Pillows and bed were very comfy. Clean hotel and provided all services we needed

Stayed at Basera Boutique Hotel for four nights. Had an amazing experience, they thoughly looked after us…from the cultural activities through to guidance on travel excursions. What a great stay! Lovely room, nice breakfast, wonderful location. But the best part is the incredibly generous and attentive team at the hotel. From smiling Deep at breakfast, to Manoj’s great room cleaning, every single person was kind, helpful and wonderful. Stayed 12 nights, and am super happy with my choice!! Thanks Basera team!!

Had a great time staying at Basera Boutique Hotel. Staff is very courteous and always ready to help. Make sure to try both of their restaurants, the food was the best we had in our stay in Nepal.The hotel gives a very aesthetic and traditional vibe. Rooms are clean and spacious with WiFi connectivity.I don’t think I will be able to pen down any negative thing about the hotel because honestly there is none.

A truly elegant and peaceful place in the middle of a hectic city. Mr and Mrs Uddar did their utmost to make my stay as pleasant as possible while maintaining a standard of service of the highest quality. This was reflected, to name a few,  in the delicious breakfast as well as in conveniently and reliably arranged airport pickup.

We arreived very late for the check in, but the reception provided us very warm welcome and guided us for the wonderful dinner and we had a very enjoyable moment. The breakfast was delicious and we tasted South Indian dish and was comparable to Thakali food, very tasty.

Nice Hotel, decorated in a very authentic way. Breakfast is good and staff really helpfull.The material used to build the hotel are qualitative.It is an hotel where you feel home thanks to human siez, only 6 floors totally.Good experience.

A lovely hotel, with authentic  Nepalese architecture and decor.  Very welcoming . Staff is so friendly and helpful in every way , especially the manager.   No issues  at all with communication.   Very responsive to emails when making reservations. Restaurants and included breakfasts were wonderful .   Quick walk to cute historical shopping area (called Babar mahal revisited)

Very  comfortable  and friendly  I will come back for sure. Food was delicious, best in the city. Staff was very helpful. They go out of their way to make your stay comfortable. I recommend everyone to visit once.

Wonderful  hotel, nice people and service. Food was great, very well centrally located. I will definitely come again! Thank you for your wonderful service.Very nice stay great place good location and good breakfast

Had a wonderful stay at the Basera Boutique Hotel. Greeted on arrival with warm lemon honey water and a sweet. Staff was  excellent meeting our every need. Food at the each of the three restaurants was excellent.

The Basera pays attention to detail from the men at the front door to the fruit plate in the room. The front desk employees were extremely helpful and paid attention to all our needs. The resturant's (both of them) was delicious. The breakfast buffet was quite extensive and you could ask for eggs prepared fresh. The location was very good. There was complimentary airport transfers which made it very nice. Would definitely stay here again.

Yes. Your staff were all very helpful and courteous at all times. I will definitely recommend your Hotel to family and friends. Best hotel in the town to stay . I felt like a home . I highly recommend this hotel. God bless you .

You feel at home from the very first moment. From the service, being picked up at the airport and then taken back there, to the architecture and the food, to the great staff who are there to help you with all your needs. Everything is perfect.

The hotel staff were very service oriented and did a great job with little details such as getting us taxis, recommendations on where to shop, accommodated a late check out and their airport transportation was great.  The rooms were large, clean and well appointed. Only slight drawback is location not quite as central but their service overcame that.

Best hotel in Kathmandu, the service is amazing … a home away from home.  The management people were able to arrange another extra night for us after missing our flight back to NY . definitely coming back to this place next year .
Excellent work and kindness of the service staff.The facilities are also very good and quiet.Everything as expected, good location close to the center but quiet and safe.Breakfast with variety.

A hotel heaven in turbulent Kathmandu This time we planned to combine very basic trekking (Langtang climate eco trek) organized by myself without a guide and porter and culture in the Kathmandu valley based on one base with more comfort than usual. Basera is more than great. A very very warm welcome, a relaxing atmosphere and great rooms. The gym, the restaurants gave us the opportunity to calm down besides a full culture itinerary. The personnel is highly professional and friendly. We love the culture a lot. To be highly recommended.

Very good hotels with staff who look after the guests and make them feel welcome and comfortable as if they were known to each other long ago! 24 hours kitchen! Cultural activities promoting young artists!

The hotel is located near the airport in a businness district, which means it is a bit faraway from the city center, however quiet and close to a street with some coffee shops/super market etc.We booked the heritage suite and as the rest of the hotel it has a very nice traditional vibe. The bed is very small. Me and my partner are 1.80 and felt cramped. The staff is very nice and the food options in the restaurant are really good, incuding a traditional ahow we watched at the rooftop restaurant.Breakfast selection must be enhanced and there was no fresh fill-up 40 minutes before breakfast closed, so the fruit/cheese etc. was dried up and uneadable. The room was not cleaned properly especially the hot tub after we used it. The pool on the rooftop has too much chlorine that burned my eyes.

The hotels are quite acceptable, although some rooms do not have a view of the street, you have to be careful when booking and confirming it. Overall, the staff is extremely attentive. The restaurant has a fairly varied and beautiful menu at moderately reasonable prices.

We stayed in this hotel for several days and were really completely satisfied without any compromises. There is an airport shuttle. The rooms are very attractively furnished with spacious bathrooms and good beds. The breakfast was great and the restaurant and bar were also very good. The super friendly and helpful staff deserves special mention. They all tried very hard to make our stay as pleasant as possible. The hotel is not far from the lively Thamel but is still quite good. A clear recommendation.

Basera Boutique hotel is simply one of the best hotels I've ever stayed in. The main reason for this is the staff, who are quite simply a delight, very friendly and extremely helpful. They could not have done more to help my friend and I when we stayed at the hotel. In fact, we decided to return to the hotel for a second stay after our trek as we enjoyed it so much. The rooms are spacious and comfortable, and the public areas are pleasant. We also really enjoyed the breakfast, with plenty of choices of high quality. We ate at the restaurant in the evening too; the menu is fairly extensive and the food is delicious. A special thanks to Haren who looked after us during both of our stays and really went out of his way to make sure we were comfortable and had everything we needed. I really can't recommend this hotel highly enough. We will definitely return.

Excellent staff from Sanish to Rozina to Susant all amazing and very kind and helpful. Hotel is clean and at prominent location. Bery helpful to make sure they give you the best trip possible. Food is average.

Great stay! Thank you very much Sharmila Manandhar, supervisor housekeeping.We made a good decision to choose BASERA BOUTIQUE HOTEL.Your performance is very excellent and the staff were very friendly, supportive & cooperative.Very clean, service was politely, fast laundry service, Restaurant presents traditional food, room was nice and clean and, traditional dance in the evening in one of the restaurant.

Very friendly staff, helpful and very attentive. Great service.Airport shuttle, pick up service,Great restaurant, great breakfast buffet. Quiet rooms, 5 minutes away from the busy Thamel. A perfect stay

Very clean, Not in the Center, but reasonable distance, Service was politly, laundry Service fast, Restaurant present traditionell Food, room was nice and clean, airport service, traditionell dance at the evening in one Restaurant

Great stay! Thank you Udhav, Harendra, Rojina, and everyone else for a wonderful stay at Basera Boutique.Staff is very attentive, the rooms are very comfortable, and the food is excellent!This was my second time here, and won’t be the last.Thank you again!-Geoffrey

The hotel has far exceeded our expectations. Everything is perfect. The welcome is exemplary. The rooms are very comfortably furnished and atmospheric. The friendliness and helpfulness of all the staff is particularly noteworthy. The breakfast buffet is varied and diverse. The restaurant on the upper floor - with evening folklore performances that are in no way intrusive - is also highly recommended. We wouldn't consider any other hotel in Kathmandu.

"The stay at this hotel was an absolutely amazing experience. First of all, the staff was extremely friendly and helpful. The staff was always smiling and ready to fulfill our requests. The rooms were clean, spacious and comfortable. The view from the window was beautiful, especially at sunset. The hotel restaurant offered delicious food and the breakfast was plentiful and tasty. The pool and spa were a great place to relax after a day of sightseeing.

A little delayed in this review… But had a great stay at Basera Boutique Hotel. As soon as we arrived, we were warmly greeted with friendly smiles, and complimentary welcome drinks. They were delicious! The Hotel staff repeatedly went out of their way on our behalf when it came to Taxis or any other tourist related activities…Often times even negotiating a better rate for us before we took a taxi. The restaurant on site has excellent food and evening entertainment.But the star of the hotel is the front desk staff. They were always welcoming and always accommodating. They also have a free shuttle service to and from the airport and a full spa. This was the first time I got eyebrow threading. Much more painful than I thought 😂My wife thought it was no big deal.We loved the decor of the room and the hotel. Beds were comfortable and showers were hot with high pressure. Also, free bottled water daily in the rooms. If we ever return to Nepal, there will be no question where we will stay. We thoroughly enjoyed the wonderful hospitality shown to us by the staff at Basera Boutique.

We are in Nepal for a month and will spend 7 nights at this property over 3 stops.The property is beautiful and the service team is exceptional. Highly recommend staying here if you are visiting the city! It was the ideal place to come back up after a long trek and a long safari!

Service and fun!!! Great Staff - always helpful with directions, recommendations hailing taxis.Restaurant Staff was always kind, fun and willing to please. Had 2 massages and loved them. Housekeeping even made an impression.

The hotel is beautifully decorated to give a Nepali feel in line with the old Newari architecture in Kathmandu. The rooms are well appointed and beautiful. The food in the restaurants is prepared to very high standards of hygiene and tastes delicious. The view from the rooftop pool and Bhansa restaurant is impressive. But the best thing is the staff, they really made us feel so welcome and made our stay exceptional.

One of the best experiences I have ever had for customer service at any Hotel in the world. Mr. Nepal aided in obtaining airfare tickets to Everest. Arranged to make certain we visited the many historical sites. The hotel and all of the facilities, spa, rooms, restaurants etc. are new. The entire staff was exceptional in anticipating any need and going beyond to meet it. Loved the extensive breakfast buffet, pastry and specialty coffees every morning. Multiple restaurants to choose from along with room service. The pricing was half of what I would have expected for this level of luxury. Mr. Nepal and his entire staff must be praised for their efficiency and care for their customers. When back in Kathmandu Nepal I will definitely return to the Basera Boutique Hotel.
Excellent place to stay with all the facilities available. STAFF is very professional and food is exquisite. We loved our stay and highly recommended place for everyone with comfort and luxury touch.

Really very friendly staff, they smile a lot, and are ready to help. The room was nice - spacious, the windows opened, do we could get fresh air, not just air conditioning. The restaurant was ok - nothing special, reasonable food.

The service and amenities were perfect. Close to the airport and a free transport. 24 hour room service and a gym with incredible spa. Maybe the best massage of my life and I have had a lot of them :) I will come back again this trip before I depart Nepal!

Exceptional hotel with amazing people, service and food. We enjoyed everything - the hotel's aesthetics, restaurants and quiet area just 5 mins taxi ride to everything. Additionally, the hotel  provides free airport pick up and drop off.

Basera Boutique is a great hotel with incredibly kind staff, clean rooms, and good food. The employees truly are incredible and I had such a welcoming and good experience at the hotel because of them.

The hotel interior and environment are very nice.The staff are also friendly. Highly recommend your stay.I plan to stay at this hotel again next time I come to Nepal.It's a good hotel. I recommend this hotel as a place to stay at least once.

Super good genuine customer service of the highest quality. The service delivers and made my stay at the hotel so good that I felt very well treated. Always cordially present to give me the best service. Would love to come back to Basera :)

always the preferred option of stay in Kathmandu, second time to stay here but can always be surprised by staff full of hospitality and delicious food in restaurant. This time can have chance to enjoy the cultural dance performance on 7th floor. Looking forward to next stay.
Third stay.  All the staff are kind and will help me with any requests you may have.  This is a hotel I'll want to stay at again and again.  I would like to stay here again when I come to Kathmandu.

It’s was a wonderful hotel very safe clean and the staff are nice and friendly The location is really close to the malls and restaurants Thanks everybody in the hotel …………………………I recommend to be there

Very nice and central hotel in Kathmandu. All the services where perfect. Clean rooms and spacious. We really appreciated the staff, highly professional, and the quality of the rooftop terrace restaurant with awesome Nepali taste food. Rooftop terrace provides a pool. Transfer from the hotel it is free, need only to provide information to the hotel desk. Highly recommended!

Had a few nights here on a trip to Nepal and was a fantastic experience all round. The staff were super friendly and helpful. The quality of the rooms was excellent and had a mini bar available at reasonable rates. Food was excellent, especially breakfast which had a great choice. There is an adjoined cafe and restaurant and you can also get room service. Nice rooftop pool area aswell which was welcomed after a trek round Kathmandu. 100% recommended!

I stayed for a week and thoroughly enjoyed my stay at Basera Boutique hotel. Mr.Haren ( Operation Manager) was very welcoming and very helpful.  Mr.Uddav ( The Front desk manager) coordinated well in organising trips and very friendly. Overall excellent  service provided by them. Highly recommended!

This hotel is a real oasis in Kathmandu. Great location and you will appreciate it on your first night. There is peace and quiet all around, which is very rare for Kathmandu. Very beautiful hotel in Nepalese style, excellent service, wonderful staff. Asim is very smart, a very pleasant young man. There is a rooftop pool with a wonderful view. The room has a minibar, bathrobes, shower amenities. The breakfasts were good, but personally I didn’t have enough fresh vegetables (tomatoes and cucumbers). The hotel complimented us in the form of a free transfer from the airport upon arrival and departure, a very nice bonus. The hotel fully corresponds to 5 stars and if we return to Kathmandu, we will definitely only go to them! Thank you, keep it up!

Wonderful stay in this hotel. I m fed up with international hotels that are real clones of eachother. Basera is really a boutique hotel.Fantastic experience: design, location, room, staff (operation manager Mr Harendra took such a good care of hotel guests!).  and pick up at the airport is very convenient. Highly recommended+++

Very nice centrally located hotel with nice specious rooms rooftop pool .Food is awesome in Mantra multicuisine  restaurant .Staff is very humble always there to support .Taxi is available 24 hours . My family loves this place.

Good ambience, good Breakfast menue, humble gracious staffs..Dinner timing with all menue in both the restaurants should be increased to 11pm!! Indian currency exchange should be flexible!! Thank you 😊🙏

Everything here was perfect. As we arrived, we had an upgrade of the room, which was amazing. The room was quiet, super clean, big and with an elegant style, with a/c and jacuzzi, including all the things you need. It is provided with an excellent wifi. The location is very good, near to Patan. The service here is amazing, all of the staff take care of you. We also tried the restaurant which was really good, with a lot of choices. Breakfast was rich and continental. On the top floor there is a pool with a view on the town. If you want to relax and fully enjoy your staying in Kathmandu Baseera Boutique Hotel is perfect.
酒店位置特别好，位于尼泊尔的权力中心，出行便利。酒店非常具有民族特色特色，酒店内的泳池，健身房都很齐全。顶楼餐厅菜肴不错、还有歌舞表演，很满意。

I recently stayed at a Basera Boutique Hotel in the heart of the city. The ambience was cozy and the staff was incredibly attentive and friendly. The hotel central location made it easy to explore nearby attractions. The room was elegant and spacious, complete with all the modern comforts one could ask for. It was memorable and indulgent gateway the exceeded all expectations. Especially want to thanks  to Mr Ashim for being so kind and helpful.

This is a cozy and comfortable place with all the required amenities, centrally located, near the Central Government Offices in Kathmandu. The staff takes personal care of the guests, food was excellent, breakfast spread was reasonably great. Not far away from the airport. Overall, a great place to stay with family or for business and offers comfort. Value for money.

I had a really good stay at the Basera Boutique Hotel in Kathmandu. The rooms are fully equipped and very nice, with views of the city and the mountains. The staff was very friendly from start to finish and met all my needs. The food was also very tasty, they offer a selection of Nepalese and South Indian, but also western dishes. I also booked a massage, which was very pleasant. All in all, my stay here was very nice and I was very satisfied.

Extremely kind staff, beautiful hotel with all amenities and comforts, and very nice location.The staff went the extra mile for us by trying to accommodate all our requests. For example, they found for us a trekking guide on our arrival and we managed to quickly organize a one-week trek to the Annapurna Base Camp within hours.When we came back from the trek, we of course chose to stay in the same hotel again.

We verbleven zes nachten in dit leuke boutique hotel. Bij aankomst op de luchthaven stond de chauffeur van het hotel al te wachten voor een kosteloze transfer naar het hotel. De incheck was vriendelijk en snel en we kregen een leuke traditioneel ingerichte hoekkamer met uitzicht over de stad. De badkamer was ruim en had een geweldige regendouche. Het ontbijt was verzorgd en bood niet alleen lokale maar ook westerse gerechten. We hebben daarnaast ook gegeten in de andere twee restaurants die in het hotel liggen (Bhansa en base camp) en beiden zijn prima verzorgd. Het personeel is vriendelijk, attent en zorgt ervoor dat je niks tekort komt.  Prima plek om Kathmandu te ontdekken!
部屋がクリーンでフロントのサービスが良い。とてもフレンドリーで、空港への送り迎えなどのカーもリーズナブル。

The hotel is a gem in Kathmandu Very reasonably priced Excellent value for money Staff are excellent The hotel manager was very engaging with our needs The food was great I would recommend this hotel anytimeThe room is very clean The decor is very traditional

beautiful hotel, friendly staff, amazing room! I would definitely recommend and go back in a heat beat :). there was a local traditional dance show at night on the roof top restaurants which was beautiful & a great touch !

They have theme called romantic dinner. I went with my husband. We were lucky that it didnt rain. The food was declious. I was able to give a great surprise to my husband, thank you basera team for making our day special

They have live kitchen which is amazing. The chinese food and Japanese food was best in town. Try hummus Pita, you will love it. The rooms were very clean and the staffs went out of their way to make our stay better.

Very unhelpful and inattentive staffs. I was carried away by the review and rating but it was completely different during my stay. Location was outskirt and transportation was very expensive. Poor wifi for remote worker. Poor facilities and services.  Spa and Gym was not available when required. There are plenty of good hotels near thamel with much better service at half of its cost.

Basera Boutique Hotel offered a relaxing retreat with its captivating Newari architecture. The attentive staff and top-notch service ensured a memorable stay. Clean and spacious rooms provided stunning views of Kathmandu and Singha Durbar, while the rooftop bar, swimming pool, spa, and sauna added the touch of luxury. The icing on the cake was the amazing cultural performance, making it an all-around exceptional experience.

I went for a date night and they had a perfect themed romantic dinner set up, the staffs made sure to make our day more special. They even gave us complimentary cake! Food was amazing, we tried pork chop and bolognaise spaghetti. The ambiance was warm and cozy. A must go place, you can go with your friends and family as well.

Basera Boutique Hotel is just fine, good food, in 2 or 3 venues and the staff is the best ever.  The only thing it lacks is a view of the Himalayas, but I'm spoiled.  I't located on a quiet street, convenient to everything.

Such a great place to chill and eat amazing food in Kathmandu! Would definitely recommend 10/10. They have a top tier hospitality and ambiance. Staffs were super friendly. I am definitely visiting the place again!

I had an positive experience with the hospitality at Basera Boutique Hotel. A combination of delicious food and exceptional hospitality can truly enhance any dining experience. It's great when a restaurant goes above and beyond to ensure their guests feel welcomed and well taken care of.

Stayed here with my husband, we would absolutely return and highly recommend if you are visiting Kathmandu. The staff were very polite, friendly and always available to offer help and advice. Front of house staff can offer advice on things to do in the city and will arrange guides if you need it, at great prices.The rooms were modern with a cultural twist, clean and well stocked. We were never short of bottled water, which was generously supplied daily; important in Kathmandu. The hotel has a great spa and a pool with views overlooking the city and Himalayan mountains.  It has three super restaurants with a wide range of food on offer with both local dishes and western dishes for those less adventurous. Great cocktails too!  During my stay I was ill after eating on an evening at the Marriott (Buffet), the staff at the Basera B were incredibly kind, offering medical advice if I needed it and then the restaurant staff offered to cook foods (not on the menu) that were helpful to aid stomach upsets.  They went above and beyond to make our stay the best!

Dirty Bathroom, Dirty Jacuzzi. Pool cleanliness. Definately Non 5 Star. Hair and stains on the bed and floor. Poor Electricity back up.. power was cut around many times during my stay, . Staffs are good but facilities were poor. Stay was below my expectation.

This hotel is one of the best I’ve stayed in, the staff from the 1st minute on arrival were super helpful, nothing was too much for them, I wish I could name everyone but that in itself is a credit to the hotel as every member of staff we met were superb !! room was fantastic along with all the facilities, rooftop pool gave a fantastic view of the city from all sides, great breakfast and so on, well worth a visit.

Nice place, great hospitality nice food...Staff was very friendly & supportive Hotel is in heart of city.Hotel is very neat and clean...Indian food is also available. Best Indian food I had in kathmandu thanks for the hospitality sunshant and the team

Located at the heart of Kathmandu. As you enter the hotel, with its interior it’s a treat to an eye. All the dishes are so good  with a lot of variety of menu. I would highly recommend to everyone. I had a great time at Basera.

BASERA BOUTIQUE is one of the finest hotels in ktm for dinner date. we had great time there. Food, decorations and the staff, everything thing was top notch. I would like to suggest every couple to go there and enjoy dinner date with your loved one.

Wonderful hotel. I mistakenly booked a room for just one adult even though my wife and young son were with me. The staff at the hotel were able to accommodate us with no problem even though it was my mistake.Breakfast was wonderful and the room was fantastic. Would definitely recommend.

An exquisite place to spend your precious time with loved ones, appreciate the kind hospitality. Ambiance, food, and the architeture is one of a kind. Everything about this place is serene and beautiful. Would love to visit here again🤗  !!

Stayed for an overnight stay as close to the airport. Lovely hotel interior and exterior. Able to check in very early due to flight which allowed us to enjoy Kathmandu clean & fresh which was much appreciated. A little further away from Thamel /main tourist district but an easy walk/taxi. Small rooftop pool and good for some plane spotting. Great room and breakfast.

Excellent hotel in kathmandu. Recommended for all types of travelers. Excellent staff. Clean rooms with all accessories. The restaurants are very good. I will come back if I come back to Kathmandu. If you travel to Kathmandu, don't risk it with simple hotels. You will always remember your stay at Basera Boutique Hotel.

Very beautifully done up interiors. Very clean. The staff are very kind and accommodating. The food is very good. I would def recommend this place. They offer free pick up and drop to the airport and the rooftop pool is cute.

Lovely room in heritage style - staff all charming, friendly and helpful. Great location to explore from. Added benefit was the airport shuttle. We will certainly be back with more time to explore the hotels many facilities.

I stayed in a suite for a night before starting a trek to EBC. The rooms are fantastic, with a big bathtub to relax 😃The personnel was so nice and welcoming, and breakfast is very good, with a lot of options. Everything is perfectly clean, and so carefully reviewed by hotel staff. It was a great stay!

I was on a business trip and held a workshop at the hotel. The meeting service team was excellent and accomodated our requests very well. The hotel room I stayed in was clean and the bed was very comfortable. The food at the restaurants (both the garden and the top floor) were excellent! All the dishes were amazing and the restaurant team was super nice. All the hotel staff were very helpful and friendly. The location is great, close to the airport and walkable to a nearby supermarket. I would recommend this hotel and hope to stay here again for my next trip. Thank you very much!

Very good,nice all thing very good .sevice food room accessories etc.Food for dinner breakfast too good Staff very good at reception,room. Service resturant.Very good heritage look with all modern facilities

Wonderful hotel, helpful and friendly staff.  Room great, great amenities, decorated classic Nepalese style but with all the modern amenities.  Staff did everything to make us comfortable.  Easy to hail taxi and for 500 NR. Go anywhere in town.

Basera is a lovely boutique hotel nicely decorated.The food is good and the drinks delicious.I enjoyed the spa very much as the weather was not very welcoming outside.I regret that it has been work on-going in the patio early on Saturday during my weekend stay and that I had to ask for my room to be done in the middle of the afternoon.Special thanks to Ashim and Rojina at the reception who have been very helpful.

Great service and luxurious surroundings- the Basera cannot be faulted. The room was very comfortable and the choice of restaurants excellent. From the first moment of arrival to a seamless departure, this was a fabulous experience.

A wonderful place to stay, delicious food, excellent service at the heart of the city. Aseem from the front desk was very helpful. There should have been more cabs attached to the hotel. Taxis don’t know the hotel location very well

Great hotel. Comfy bed and good showers. Easy and quick taxi to go and see the sights in Kathmandu!Reception were very friendly and helpful in organising taxis and they have a couple of restaurants in the hotel (although I didn’t have time to try)

Basera Boutique Hotel was spectacular! The staff and management were nothing short of amazing. Friendly, caring, courteous, helpful, and always greeted you with a genuine smile. The rooms spacious and clean and  has the best shower EVER! The food served in the hotel is word-class - second to none. Overall, worth ever penny, and then some.  We will definitely return to the Basera Hotel next time we come to Nepal. Thank you everyone at Basera for making our stay in Kathmandu and Nepal a 5-Star experience. 🙏

this hotel is very nice,clean and confortable.i spend 3 nights and i enjoied the honest and warm hospitality.the have a good SPA,the location is perfect.thank you for the front office manager and the  Gm.i suggest this hotel for your stay and you don t have any bud surprise.

An excellent stay in a lovely hotel with traditional style decor. Super staff who were extremely friendly, helpful and courteous. Excellent choice of breakfast with delicious coffee. Spacious bedroom. Great value for money.

I stayed at this beautiful property and oh my God, what an experience. Hospitality is amazing.Loved how they've done the room. Attention to small details is stunning. And the best part is the lip smacking food and the loveliest experience at spa Highly recommended.

Staff were welcoming and really helpful throughout our stay. Food was great. The hotel had three different restaurants. We enjoyed buffet breakfast, lunch, dinner and also food room service was great. The free shuttle service from airport was very efficient. Just what you need when you are tired from your flight and hassle free when you get to the airport they were already there. Do not need to stress about trying to organise and find a taxi. I used all the facilities except the pool as the water was cold. Would be nice if the pool was warm. Bed was comfortable and clean. Shower was very good with hot water. I would definitely recommend others to stay here. The location was good. There is bhatbhatini few minutes walk. Very convenient if you need to get anything. The hotel area is centre to travel around kathmandu. It was not too crowded and busy considering other hotel locations such as thamel. I would definitely go back and stay here. I would suggest maybe more options for entertainment would be good. Otherwise my stay here was great. Perfect place to relax and get back to when you are tired especially when all the staff are so helpful, friendly and accommodating.

Top class hotel,very authentic and gives European luxury feeling,the rooms are very clean and comfortable,the food is very good,the staffs are top class they help you and guide you if you need any inquiry about the city tour plus the spa therapist are very good,I had a good deep tissue massage,higher recommended

The location was perfect for getting to places and away from the hustle and bustle of Thamel. The architecture is traditional with contemporary touches. The room and all around the premises of the hotel is impeccable clean. The food in all three restaurants Bhansa, Mantra and Base Camp Cafe is delicious and the service amazing. I highly recommend a deep tissue massage with Sita. If you need help planning your tours, Asim, the front office manager is your man. Alina at the front desk was always helpful and ready to answer any questions. Overall the entire staff made me feel welcomed and at home.

This hotel is a beautiful gem. The best customer service with a very pleasant staff. The room was lovely and the bed was comfortable especially after a long flight. Dinner at the rooftop restaurant was delicious and so was the breakfast buffet. 10/10 would recommend.

We were a group of 10 people - and from the minute we arrived we were very well looked after. The highlight was when we left a bag in the taxi and Ashim was helpful in accessing the cctv and working with the local police to retrieve the bag- we got it back! Miracle ! Thanks again for an amazing stay! Great food as well!

Lovely stay for 3 nights, great hotel and super friendly staff.  Lots of choice at breakfast and our room was very clean and provision of dressing gown, slippers, tea and coffee making facilities.  Would definitely recommend staying here over and above more western style hotels as it’s more authentic.

We loved this hotel! A spotlessly clean oasis in Kathmandu!Wonderful friendly staff who cannot do enough to help you, delicious food that’s served with a smile, and just a short ride out of the busy area of Thamel. Would 100% recommend you stay here!
Excellent hotel with great architecture and service. Taxi’s and tours easily organised from the hotel. Two restaurants and the quality of the food is amazing. The rooms are clean and well maintained.

Fantastic attentive staff, great food, very clean, fantastic showerThe staff organised everything from transportation to tours. The food in all of the restaurants was very professionally served and was 5 stars in terms of quality… the shower was amazing

It was excellent hotel and the service was very good plus the food was good they make according to my needs and demand on the top of that the spa service was amazing,the staff very attentive and great,The manager sushant was very friendly in resolving the issue.

My stay in nepal was made 100% better because of my stay in this particular venue . Clean amenities, clean rooms definitely worth the money you pay !! Food was also not bad considering that usually these big hotels have a totally whitewashed menu forgetting about the local taste . All the housekeeping and front desk staff were very helpful and prompt to help me in anything I needed . I wish I could name them all but cant remember the names now . But SANISH  from management was a gem of a guy who made my stay very comfortable . DINESH from the restaurant was an excellent server who not had some good suggestions from the hotel menu but also gave me some really good local’s advice which definitely made it easier for me to travel around . Definitely coming back !!!

Очень отзывчивый и заботливый персонал! Помогли сориентироваться с туристической программой и организовать все по высшему разряду. Быстро, легко, удобно , продуктивно. Это бесценно на отдыхе в новой стране. Особенно когда только несколько дней на все. Благодарна до глубины души.Хорошие завтраки, разнообразные. Играют приятные мантры, улыбчивый персонал.Номера чистые, уютные, с аутентичным интерьером. Понравилось что люксовый отель, но атмосфера очень аутентичная.

We were a group of 7 ladies. Unfortunately we had only one night there. The service & the food was excellent. The surrendered area is clean & very safe . The shopping area is nearby. We will definitely choose this hotel again.

My friend and I visited Nepal and stayed at this lovely hotel and really enjoyed it! The food in the restaurant upstairs was great and the breakfast buffet had so many choices to pick from! The rooms were very spacious and clean! It had all the amenities you need. Its a short walk from local small shops and restaurants if you want to eat put. The price was really reasonable too! The staffs were very very friendly and helpful! Would really recommend it to everyone visiting Nepal! Will definitely stay at this Hotel when I come back!

Ha sido todo perfecto. Hotel heritage donde se cuida el mas mínimo detalle, las instalaciones són excelentes, las habitaciones fantasticas, pero si hay algo que lo hace definitivamente un hotel de 10, es su personal. Excepcional todo el staff del hotel, especialmente Sushant Nepal, que brinda un nivel de servicio y atención excepcional. Me sentí como en casa.

It is a great hotel with super nice staff working there, very helpful and kind. The building is very authentic, food and show are amazing. We really enjoyed our stay here. Highly recommend to everyone. It is close to the city center, so you can even walk there

Hotel was fantastic, but the staff were amazing after everything I needed and helping me around . I would highly recommend staying here. The room was  Very clean as well and the food in the restaurants was fantastic

Der Aufenthalt im Basera Boutique Hotel war super.  Das Personal war unglaublich freundlich und zuvorkommend. Man hat sich während der Zeit hier sehr wohl gefühlt. Die Zimmer sind sauber und groß, das Badezimmer sehr gut ausgestattet. Die Aussicht war auf Kathmandu war sehr toll (siehe Foto). Das Hotel befindet sich nicht direkt im Zentrum, aber in der Nähe von Thamel. Für ein paar Euro kann man ein Taxi ins Zentrum nehmen, um die Stadt zu erkunden. Dabei kümmern sich die Angestellten auch gerne darum, ein Taxi zu buchen. Bei Fragen über Sehenswürdigkeiten, Geldwechsel etc. kann man jederzeit an der Rezeption nachfragen.  Alles in allem wirklich ein tolles Hotel mit sehr netten Menschen, die dort arbeiten.  Wir können es uneingeschränkt weiterempfehlen. :)

Located at a 30 minute drive from Katmandu Airport,  I would highly recommend this small but well appointed  Five Star luxury hotel. It has a welcoming lobby. The rooms are spacious and clean. The hotel has Three restaurants including a roof top restaurant offering Nepali Cuisine. The staff is very efficient. A special mention for Sudip who made our stay comfortable .

What a jewel in the crown of Kathmandu. A beautiful hotel with excellent staff . A pleasure to stay here . But the guest relations member of staff Sudip Tiwari made every part of our stay a complete joy. From organising our day trips visiting all the amazing temples and palaces . To enabling me to get to Buisness meetings in the city . We were so impressed that we extended our stay by an additional 6 nights . Namaste Basera boutique hotel staff

I have travelled for over 40years and been in the travel industry for 30years and I have to say that I am always a bit weary when I hear the word 'boutique', but I think in this case the hotel absolutely deserves this description as every detail from the wooden panelling and inside and outside décor is traditionally and well done, to their fantastic ever so helpful staff, the very comfortable rooms with all amenities to the superb roof top little swimming pool and restaurant. It's also very close to the International airport and they offer a free pick up service. Their buffet breakfast is outstanding and the cappuccino I had was one of the best I ever had! I highly recommend this lovely family run hotel and will for sure be back! thank you all!!

Great stay here at Basera with all the amenities you need. . Came here to visit Kathmandu for business purpose.. Local shops nearby to buy stuff.... 24x7 support from staff.. Thank you Regards Lethesh

Wonderful hotel with great service! All the staff are so friendly and the stay was comfortable. I checked in very late at night and they still had staff to serve welcome drinks. The breakfast selection had many varieties fit for both local and tourist.When checking out the front desk offered me a drop to the airport as i was checking out early and they heard me of taking taxi so the staff was so kind to offer the service. Overall had a great experience!!

Magnificent! Basera is a beautiful hotel. Rooms are cozy and comfortable. Food is delicious. Apart from a very good breakfast, one cn taste western or Nepalese cuisine. On top of these, its staff of the Basera that truly takes the hotel to the next level. They are extremely polite and helpful. You’ll enjoy your stay at the Basera Boutique Hotel.

When it comes to Khatmandu travelers have plentiful hotel options to chose from. Boutique/Heritage hotels in Khatmandu are quite common but Basera Boutique Hotel is a great blend of both luxury and Nepal’s rich cultural heritage. Basera Boutique Hotel is located at a great location, all major tourist attractions of Kathmandu are within 10-25 minutes from the hotel. We stayed at the Basera for three nights.  The hotel is in a great location, in a safe but not-so-touristy area of Kathmandu, relatively close to the airport and a quick taxi ride (or a 30-minute walk) to Thamel.  It was a plus for us to stay away from most of the backpackers and tourist shops, which can be a bit overwhelming in the central tourist area, and the hotel's location was still close enough to see what we wanted to without much trouble.  The service at Basera is particularly good -- everyone on staff was so helpful and nice throughout our stay, from the front desk, to the bell hops, to the restaurant folks.  We arranged a taxi for the day through the hotel for 8500 Nepalese rupees (currently about $65 USD) which was so convenient for getting around town comfortably and at our leisure, and our driver was very professional and safe (and the car had working seatbelts, which is a relative rarity in Kathmandu).  The food at the onsite restaurants was quite good, and the included buffet breakfast was a bonus.  I also want to shout out how delicious the coffee is -- they have an espresso machine and their regular black coffee (really an americano) is excellent -- very strong and rich.The rooms themselves are very comfortable -- the beds are cushy and the room is very quiet at night.  The bathrooms are a bit tight (you have to close the door in order to use the sink), but they are well-appointed, and the shower is quite large.  If I ever find myself back in Kathmandu, I will book a stay with the Basera again without hesitation.

I accidentally left an important personal item in my room when I left and the hotel manager Sanish Singh has taken personal responsibility for ensuring the item was shipped to me in home country.  This turned out to be more complicated than expected and he continuously followed up and arranged the shipping and printed out shipping documents etc - all well beyond the call of duty.
