We had a long weekend and decided to visit Chandragiri Hills Resort. Our communicarion with them was quick and helpful. We were welcomed by the staff at both ends of the chair lift. And when we arrived help was cloase by. Our room was warm and light. We could see good views, when  it wasnt snowing! The bar area is a great place to sit and watch the mountain veiws, come and go. The staff were always helpful, and the place was warm. The nepali food was fresh and 'mittho chha!'

Traveling with a baby of one year ole, the hotel let us wait more than 45 minutes before sending us the shuttle that took us from the arrival of the cable car to the hotel. At every phone call, they kept telling us either that the van was on the way or already at the meeting point. Definitely not the best start even before check in. Restaurant food is overpriced and not even fresh. Despite taking thakali, a nepali speciality, the food was not even eatable. Rooms are quite nice but carpets were not even hoovered.. Manager was absolutely useless and only tried to find excuses rather than bringing solutions. He also refused to compensate us in any way. All in all a bad experience and i wouldn't recommend this hotel.

I have stayed one night(1) at Chandragiri Hills Resort on 11th March'21 but allocated room was with poor view. So, i paid extra and upgraded to Presidential suite(Room No. 403). Sadly, room amenities were not enough and i had to call staff twice for repairing bath shower and toilet shower, even though presidential suite was handed over without proper check up.Restaurant food was really sub standard and even  Restaurant Menu list is really Poor(very limited list).Personally saying, This resort with current management is a disaster and needs big change if it is looking to cater foreigners at this moment.disappointed.

I feel so disappointed that i had to write a review.I recently went there with my wife as an escape. Ill start with the pros: good rooms, good location, view and pretty good swimming pool and jacuzzi experience.My complaints however is with the food and lack of welcoming ambiance. Firstly i got a full on spider web on the rosemary garnish on my spaghetti. Spider web! quite clear that they didn't even wash the rosemary. And I'm not the type of person who complains but a place that charges so much for mediocre food should have at least given an apology. Nope! They just casually changed the food like nothing happened.Also the value for money for the food is horrible. Sure its covid era and you have to limit your menu, no problem. but dear god if you're charging so much for food one would hope it'd be worth it. Honestly i have tasted better food and better variety in many party palaces of kathmandu. This is why i am so disappointed. Not at the price but at the value for money. What a bad experience in terms of food: best thing i had during my stay was fruits.I was so disappointed that as soon as i came back to kathmandu i headed over to a good thakali joint for a wholesome meal, at less than 1/3 the price of "buffet dinner" at chandragiiri which serves less than party palace quality food. even the dessert was "kheer" which my mom would've prepared better.This sounds harsh but its true. Not going back again.

Pros: This was a family trip for us and we have been resort hopping all around Kathmandu’s vicinities. This is by far the best resort we have stayed in. The views, cleanliness, staffs, amenities and choice of drinks and craft beers here are a level above from any other resorts. There is nothing such as bad rooms here because they are designed in such a way that the views can be seen from anywhere. The pool and hot tub are amazing and the kids loved running around the property because it is very spacious.Cons: We got charged 2k extra for each room on top of what we had booked the rooms for, That would add up to the nightly price of an extra room, which left a bad taste when we checked in.

We stayed for two nights and the overall experience was worth it. Reaching the resort via cable car is one of the main highlight. On a pleasant weather the view is simply breathtaking and even during the foggy weather , there's a different charm to it. The rooms had all the amenity and it was spacious, met our requirement, no complaints.  Luckily we got the one with a nice balcony. While interacting the staffs we came to know they'd followed all the instructions set by the WHO. The room service was not available maybe due to the lack of staffs and maybe as per the rules but it was okay, understandable. We enjoyed all the meals that we ordered expect for the momos. It wasn't bad but on that price it could have been way better ( taste wise and colour wise) . I would suggest the chef to work on that. The thali was yummy and the Indian cuisines.  Nice breakfast and the manager was kind enough to give us a complimentary scoop of ice-cream after we ordered the THALI. And the pool and Jacuzzi was icing on the cake.TIP: if your staying for two nights and want less people by the pool or Jacuzzi which is so obvious. Make sure you dip in after 11:30 pm , that's normally when people check out and there are less participants. The checks in happens during the afternoon hence 11:30 to 12:30 or 1 pm is the perfect time to get some privacy.Lovely experience and cant wait to be back during Nov/Dec. Keep it going Team. !!

My family & I recently had an overnight stay at the resort . We were warmly welcomed & check in was seamless. We were escorted to our rooms & as soon as the door was opened we were hit with an overpowering smell of mould . I reached out to one of the housecleaning ladies who was outside our room and she said that the heat had been turned on to try & get rid of the mould smell.  With it being overbearingly hot I went to change the mode from heat to cool  but it didn’t work . After sometime I called reception who sent someone from maintenance who had to reset the system . After a short time the coolfunction started to working but not for long! When I called the reception a second time to inform them that the AC had stopped working they said they would send someone again. The tech came again & he got it working, it stopped working sometime in the late evening but by this time my sister and I (both in different rooms) were too tired. A few other things to note:The walkways were covered in slimy moss, the front desk staff who escorted us to our roomslipped en route. In both rooms our balconies were covered in the same slimy moss .The flower pot on my balcony had 2 cigarette butts. Restaurant staff need professional development: I enquired about the buffet cost & was asked for my room number, the staff checked & said you don’t have the buffet package quite abruptly. Thank you for informing me of something that I already know-please answer my question !At no point were we informed of any maintenance  work - hammering & drilling. As a 5 star luxury resort (as advertised on the website) I was shocked. Whilst I can understand that technical issues may arise forthe ACs to malfunction 3 times is not acceptable.  To not maintain the walkways & balconies of slimy moss to ensure the safety of staff and guests is not acceptable. Tobe welcomed by cigarette butts is not acceptable. A shame really as the resort has the potentialto be amazing & this is coming fromsomeone who has travelled extensively &stayed in world class hotels & resorts.

Service is good. I definitely liked the rooms. Great stay at this hotel! Excellent service, comfortable rooms, and convenient location. Highly recommend for a pleasant experience. The room was spacious, clean, and beautifully appointed, providing a comfortable retreat after a long day of exploring. The location couldn't be better, with easy access to attractions and dining options. I especially appreciated the attention to detail from the staff, who went above and beyond to ensure my comfort and satisfaction

The family was staying at Chandragiri Hotel. The resort is so peaceful that it takes you closer to nature. Fresh and clean air makes you feel rejuvenated. The service matches the local culture, the food was delicious, the team was very quick to deliver all the requests.The infinity pool and heated outdoor Jacuzzi attracted children and parents alike. The jacuzzi had a good time, temperature and water quality. Mr. Krishna Khatri helped make our stay enjoyable.Overall a top class resort. I will definitely stay at the hotel again when I come to Kathmandu.

Worst ever experience till date in a five star property . Seriously all lousy old staff with bad attitude and FO was one of a kind junky with serious hooligan hairstyle . Not only that he was more rude than hooligan . They made feel us as they were doing a favor .  Housekeeping was a total mess with stain bedsheet and dirty room . In front our our door (room no 221) it was dripping a/c water . Very poorly maintained property , room amenities were missing major even they had a rubber slipper for room use . Dinner and breakfast buffet was chaotic and trust me any party palace in kathmandu will give better spread than this .Seriously a nice place to be but not to stay .

All the hotel room view are of the Himalaya range, it is so beautiful during sunrise and sunset. The view from the pool is unbeatable and there's nothing like it. The service from the time you arrive at the bottom of the cable car until you're checked in is something worth mentioning. We were really impressed. Really nice resort if you're looking to relax.

Chandragiri hills resort- thank you very much for making this possible to have heavenly experience. You easily make it possible.  In the beginning, start warm welcoming and there is a big line to ride the gondola, if you are going to live in the resort, you don’t have to stay in the big line to ride the gondola. This is a big plus point of trip.Check in / Checkout procedures get done very well. All staff are well trained and well knowledgeable about hospitality and they perform very professional -well informatics.  All staff are fantastic, especially “Mr Kumar Lama” who makes our dining experience very remarkable. He knows well the picture of guest imaginations while having food.Let's talk about the room, very clean with 43” smart TV. Wow! Great to connect your device and enjoy your all day pic view on the big screen.  From the room there is a great view of Himalaya range, when you wake up. What else’s you need, just coffee. They have a great buffet breakfast with fresh bean brew coffee.Great resort for family gateway, dip in the warm Jacuzzi. Having a panoramic view of Himalaya range, view of Kathmandu valley and clouds make you feel peace of heaven on the earth. There are lots of activities, hiking on the mountain, lots of kids activity, Like: pony ride, playground for kids, even if you have more time, enjoy TT, Archery and other games.  We highly recommend this resort to all, once a time in your life, must visit and enjoy your life. The resort offers the best and it is very value for money. They make it possible to visit this place to every Nepali Citizen. Grab this opportunity and enjoy this place.

First, we were upgraded to presidential suite as all the other rooms were occupied. The room was simple the best.Of all the hotels we have been to in Nepal, these guys at Chandragiri go a step further to satisfy their customer. Qs far as I know, they don't mind at all, even if they have to start the cable car just for you, at the middle of the night.The room had a wonderful view from every wondows, inspite of the bad weather that day.There was a personal jacuzzi with enough amneties in two bathrooms of the suite room. The only issue is delay in pickup of vehicles, which is understandable due to a diffcult terrain. The hotel is perfect, if you just want to relax, stay lazy, enjoy the view and be pampered by the hospitality of the staffs. If you don't just want to just sit, then there are plenty of hiking trails around this picturisque place. This is the best hotel in Nepal, probably Mystic mountain and Gokarna village resort comes 2nd and 3rd to this. Mr Santosh Kunwar is the man. If you want to get the best experience there, just meet him. His hospitality is unbeatable.Enjoy!!!

It was wholesome experience if I have to remember the Cedar Re-Treat with the collaboration with Chandragiri Hills Resort. When we reached there, they had a comfortable pick up service which took us from the Temple to Hotel which I must say so helpful. The ambient of the resort was so overwhelming, refreshing and so pure that we could not ask more than that. The front desk staff named Relish and Brideesh was so professional and kind. All Front Office Staffs were so helpful, friendly and enthusiastic . As I get the keys from them, I headed towards room where I find cozy rooms but it needs to be more concise. The balcony was beautiful though the height of bars were so high. After the short tour of room and service, we headed to muti-purpose/seminar hall. We had lot of fun over there but most annoying thing was time limit. The snacks was also very good. After some food and fun , we took a tour to swimming pool, jacuzzi, helipad area which was so peaceful to chillout. It would be better if the swimming pools were heated before use because it was cold day. The best part of the thing I must say was breakfast. The quantity and quality, taste wise it was top notch.

My experience at this establishment was disappointing on several fronts. Firstly, the time it took to address concerns and the staff's confidence in handling them were lacking. The bedding provided resulted in discomfort, leading to back and shoulder aches. Additionally, the absence of hooks in the room made it inconvenient to hang clothes. The temperature control in the room was ineffective, making it difficult to find a comfortable environment. The quality of the food served was subpar, with unresponsive and slow service contributing to lengthy waits and interrupted meal experiences. Overall, I cannot recommend this place. While the view may be enjoyable and picturesque, the overall experience fell short, leaving much to be desired.

Nice place in Nepal . The experience of our stay in Nepal & in chandragirihills  was very nice . Food are decent breakfast was lavished. Every staff are very helpful and charming. I would recommend everyone to visit once in chandragiri hills in life.Specially front desk team for smooth check in and luggage handling. The coordinating of transferring us and luggage was very perfect from the receiving area at cable car station to Resort to Room . Well manage team of front

I had a fantastic experience at this resort!The environment was absolutely stunning, surrounded by natural beauty that truly took my breath away. The resort itself wad well-maintained and had a serene atmosphere that made it easy to relax and unwind. The staff were friendly and attentive, making sure that my stay was comfortable and enjoyable . I would highly recommend this resort to anyone looking for a peaceful getaway in a beautiful setting.  Lastly, i want to thank specifically Pravakar Khdaka sir for your kind co-operation.

Hi everyone, This is one of the most amazing resorts that we (family) had ever visited , it’s an hours drive from Kathmandu Airport, the adventure started right the base cable station , from there a 10 minute cable ride in the clouds takes you to this mesmerising resort perched right on the hill.   The checkin was quite breezy , the front office staff were  courteous and efficient.   The restaurant had an amazing breakfast spread and the quality was top notch.  Our stay in the suite room was exceptional the room was quite spacious the furniture excuiste, the bed soft and cozy in this cold weather, the rooms was temperature controlled. The view from our room was mind blowing and our resort covered with fog. The cherry on the pie was the heated jacuzzi given the cold weather.     Special mention of Mr Santosh kunwarji, the front office manager and face of hospitality in Chandragiri, a very hospitable person who assisted us all through our 2 nights stay and went beyond till our cable station, a thorough gentleman. Needless to say it was saddening at departure.

Disappointed by the overall service, if you are traveling with disabled or old person you will not get any help or support, transport from cable car to hotel is pathetic as you will not find any seat because staff will dump their stuff on seats. Manager is not interested in any feedback. Overall not Worth the money will not recommend for family or someone travelling with person who need mobility assistance

Chandragiri Resort is a beautiful, state-of-the-art property nestled amongst the mountains. It’s about an hour’s drive from Kathmandu and you’ve to ride a cable car to get up to Chandragiri. Once there, the resort’s vans will receive and drop you at the resort (a quick drive). The resort’s location is pristine and the property is nothing short of stunning! You are going to be surrounded by mountains and peaks and the view is gorgeous! The rooms (especially suites) are par excellence. We got to stay at an Executive Suite with a private jacuzzi. The bathrooms had big windows and we could witness outstanding views while relaxing in our temperature controlled jacuzzi!! The staff is extremely courteous. Special shoutout to Santosh Kumar Kunwarji for being such a great host! He made our stay at the Chandragiri resort extra special!!

The resort offers a range of services including swimming pool, spa, zip line, skywalk and cable car. The location is particularly exciting which offers the calmness of both body and soul.If you are in Kathmandu and want to spend a couple of days or day out in the nature, this is a right place to go.The only  downside is - the weather is hardly predictable.

View is awesome but room price is adequate but not par with the price. Fooding is worst kind. High price with very low quantity. I wouldn't recommend stay here. Ghumo aor wapas city me hi stay karlo bhaiyo..would save more and will have better experience than here.And dear owner of the resort, the price you are charging doesn't justify your service. If intention is too loot then you are on the right path.

The place is very beautiful with mountain view and swimming pool. Staff also very helpful and they know how to host the guest. Actually when we enter in lobby one of the staff help us very kindly and he provide bonfire as well as candle light dinner which actually we have to take shoot. All of us are happy and once everyone to be there.

A must go to resort for a nearby getaway from the valley. The rooms are comfortable and spacious. The infinity pool and Jacuzzi adorns the best view of the surrounding valleys and mountains. The panoramic view from the restaurant is amazing. Please check the weather before you go for the best experience!

Beautiful resort with very hospitable staff and great amenities! The buffet had a great selection for a variety of preferences and the front desk was very helpful in providing items we’d forgotten. Sanjay and Ganga at the front were particularly helpful. The view was gorgeous and swimming in the pool with the backdrop of mountains was an unforgettable experience. Would highly recommend!

I recently stayed at Chandagiri Hills Resort with family and friends, and it was an incredible experience overall. The resort itself is stunning, set against a picturesque backdrop that truly enhances the relaxation factor. The accommodations were top-notch, offering comfort and elegance that made our stay very enjoyable. After reaching to the resort it was simply stress free, out of this crowded world.The resort’s location and surroundings are certainly impressive, providing a fantastic environment. The staff was attentive and friendly, adding to the overall positive experience.However, I have to mention that the dinner buffet fell short of expectations. While the variety was decent, the quality and taste of the food didn't quite meet the high standards as 5* resort. Simple suggestion, Executive Chef should review the in-house guests mix, then accordingly food can be prepared.In summary, Chandagiri Hills Resort is a remarkable place with exceptional view of the entire city, amazing weather, green surroundings, simply awesome location. Just manage your expectations for the food, and you’ll likely have a memorable and enjoyable time.

Amazing view with great hospitality. Foods are so rich in taste. It’s great experience to relax here. Rooms are so comfortable and has maintained good hygienic condition. You can have best time here and see the citylights through here. It would be great if Greeneries(Room Plants)are placed in rooms and toilets.

Beautiful luxury hotel, accessible by Gandola high up on a mountain.   Great view of the Himalayan range including The Highest Mountain in The World Mount Everest.  Very friendly staff members who know how to pamper you and provide the best service.  Loved the food. Most of our time was spent around the infinity pool overlooking the valley and the mountains.   Truely felt like we were in heaven.

Hospitality was best.Mot humble people including guard to manager Mr Ram.They are taking feedbacks so seriously and that makes staying more safe and comfortable.The view from the room was outstanding. Morning view is so pleasant that instantly makes you fresh and fills your soul with joy.

My night stay at Chandragiri Hills Resort in Kathmandu was an enchanting experience. Nestled amidst the serene hills, the resort offered breathtaking views of the Kathmandu Valley below. The ambiance was tranquil, perfect for a getaway from the hustle and bustle of city life. The rooms were cozy and well-equipped, ensuring a comfortable stay. The staff were attentive and hospitable, catering to all needs promptly. Dining at the resort's restaurant was a culinary delight, with delicious local and international cuisine served. Overall, my stay at Chandragiri Hills Resort was rejuvenating and memorable, leaving me with fond memories of Nepal's natural beauty.

Staff were very helpful and humble always there to assist but f&b staff ms Pooja Neupane, front office manager Santosh Kunwar and his team was really amazing always going one mile extra for their dedication, being hotelier I felt really great. I would like to give a special shout out to Mr. Kunwar for being so helpful, outstanding while providing extra service, more information with respect and kindness. One of the security staff Mr Bir Bahadur also so helpful. He is very helpful he is very kind and assist to oust wheelchair to our parents. The staff in cable car is not cooperative like those others, when this kind of old age handicapped guest will come they have to help instead of play with mobile inside their cage. We really enjoyed in resort and we will come back again in Dashain with our big team.

A classic example of poor management…The location of the resort is exotic with great views & awesome climate.. but the hotel service is so poor. We felt stuck up with nothing to do for 2 days. On arrival we were offered interconnecting rooms as we were a family of 4. However the connecting door was opened after 24 hrs… that too after requesting multiple times. No one picks up the calls at reception & restaurant. Food is also average. We happened to have buffet lunch & dinner on same days.. & to our shock.. most of the menu at dinner was same as lunch.. supposedly the left overs! We did not pay this much for such pathetic service. They claim to be a five star hospitality service.. but I won’t give more that 2 stars.

A wonderful gateaway from the hustle and bustle and busy life. We were very grateful to share the special moment of our life together in the Luxurious Resort - Chandragiri Hills Resort. We were super amazed by the warm welcome of the staffs from the point we reached at the Cable car Station to the Resort. We felt like we were around our family. And we really enjoyed the breakfast with abundance of delicious foods. Thank you so much Chandragiri Hills Resort for having us. We promise we will be back again soon. 🙏💐☺️

I had a great time at the executive room. The view was incredible. We stayed for two days and the bellboy Sandesh was incredibly welcoming. Talking about jacuzzi its not that hot as we expected. Food price was way overprice and the quantity was not much as they charged. Overall the customer service was okay, room was way expensive didn’t gave any discount even we extended, food was descent overly priced, view was brilliant.

A perfect gate away for peace of mind.However, quality of some food & service need to improve at some point.Beverages delivery need to be quick as standard of time. Staff need to be more attentive while guest is dining to make sure full customer experience delightful.

Beautiful location, well kept hotel, great food options and staff were very helpful. We were hoping to get a glimpse of the mountains, but the fog and the rain just wouldn’t go away! Staff tried their best to ensure we had a good time.The outdoor pool is not heated and given the resort’s altitude, I see that as a must have, especially since there are no indoor pools. The internal entertainment program could be better. Hence it gets the 4 star.We were there for a birthday celebration and had a great time despite the weather.

Chandragiri Hills Resort offers a sublime retreat where luxury meets nature. The breathtaking views, from majestic mountains to Kathmandu city views, set the stage for an unforgettable experience. Indulge in a culinary journey with exceptional dining options featuring both local delicacies and international cuisine. Relax and rejuvenate in the infinity pool and heated Jacuzzi while enjoying unparalleled hospitality from the kind and helpful staff. Our stay in a deluxe room offered luxurious accommodations and wake up to panoramic vistas. Arriving via the cable car adds a touch of adventure, providing mesmerizing views before you even step foot in the resort. This is more than just a destination; it's an immersive experience that promises to exceed expectations and leave a lasting impression.

After a long time, I visited Nepal with my family and was eager to stay at Chandragiri Resort. The staff, especially Sanjaya Maharjan in sales, were undoubtedly very professional and knowledgeable. The breakfast at the restaurant was excellent. However, I found the room furniture not up to five-star standards. I requested one room for four people, but sales supervisor didn't accommodate this, so I had to book two rooms, which was a bit concerning.Sarada Shrestha

Perfect place for a weekend getaway. Peaceful environment, friendly staffs & great hospitality! They also provide pickup & drop service to the resort right after you get off from your cable car ride. Would definitely love to visit again 🙌🌸

The place where you can find your long lost soul along with the greenery of mountains and colorful clouds. The hospitality and the warmth of the Chandragiri Hill Resort is something you can cherish for lifetime. Felt every moment here and gathered best memories. Thank you and best wishes for you from Bangladesh.

Great resort and really friendly staff. Good dinner and breakfast options and the rooms are spacious and clean. Easy to get to the resort via cable car. You can take the cable car to the top and then there is a car that will take you to the resort.

Beautiful property, this time of the year the views were spectacular and we could see beautiful mountain ranges from gaurishankar to Annapurna .Now coming to the important part I.e food. Dal makhani and crispy tandoori roti were heaven. To top it off, Madan Nath ji served our food with his warmness. He was attentive to us, and was prompt. Thank you for your professionalism. Will come again.Prabhu

Excellent  experience  mesmerised  with service  and hospitality. Taken special care by Mr Sanjay Maharjan.We loved the views from the resort, the landscape  and the people right from ground to the hill were aweosme in hospitality. It is an amazing experience.

It was fabulous sanjay maharjan is the best staff. room ambience, restaurant , live music swimming pool etc are the best part of this resort. swimming pool dressing room must be separate for female and male . the view of kathmandu valley is an amazing. it's like a bird's eye view. shuttle bus and cable car are the lifeline ...

Nice property with excellent mountain range views .Rooms are also beautiful. Foods with great taste and mountains range views from the resturant too. Value for money price for the room rate. Friendly staffs. And mostly important the temple of Bhaleshwor Mahadev.

A peaceful oasis above Kathmandu. Our room was luxurious and to awake at dawn and see the sunrise over the Himalayas was an experience never to forget. Despite other reviews we found the food very good and the staff friendly and attentive. The cable car was included in the price which was a nice surprise !

The staff at the Chandragiri Hills resort are the epitome of hospitality.  The restaurant staff, front desk team and even the cable car station attendant were all friendly and supportive.  Sanjay Maharjan, in particular made our wait for the vehicle enjoyable by entertaining us with detailed explanation about the property and it's surrounding views.

One of the exquisite experiences with Chandragiri Resort stay with high elevation of 7750 feet. Outdoor swimming and outdoor jacuzzi included in the stay feel very relaxing. Complementary buffet breakfast is very palatable to our taste including healthy options such as porridge, breakfast cereal, beetroot lassi, plain and sweet yogurt, waffles and parathas and curries and others.

Our trip wasn’t as up to what we expected it to be. First, had to wait for the pickup for about 45 minutes after we got out of the cable car.  The phones weren’t picked by any of the staffs and we were so much unknown about when we were getting picked up. Secondly, we asked if we could check the other room as the room we were assigned wasn’t as we expected it to be and we were asked to wait for almost another hour as the room was dirty and had to be cleaned up and that too when the check-in time was 2 pm and we reached at 4. Limited menu with not much varieties of food. The phones in the room didn’t work for certain reason. Wanted to speak to the main person just for a feedback and we were told that he wasn’t there. The staffs looked like they didn’t care and had to ask things time and again. The breakfast was good though. Never going back again!

Nice and wounderful environment. First time visit in chandragirighills was very awesome. The hospitality given by staff wass very pleasant. All staff were very helpful. The dinner and breakfast was very delicious and flavorful. Thank you for great hospitality .

I was in this hotel to participate in an International Expert Dialogue on Mountain people and climate. Amazing beauty, excellent hospitality and good room rooms. More importantly i was received by Sanjay Maharjan, a staff, who explained about the hotel, logistics and asked my specific needs, if any. That was much appreciated.

Chandragiri Hills receives high marks for its natural beauty, cultural significance, and the quality of its facilities and services.Well-Maintained Facilities: The resort and its facilities are well-maintained, with clean amenities and helpful staff. The infrastructure, including restaurants and viewing platforms, enhances the overall experience.Activities: In addition to the views and the temple, there are various activities available, such as hiking trails and playgrounds for children, making it a great destination for families. Accessibility: Located close to Kathmandu, Chandragiri Hills is easily accessible, making it a convenient getaway for both locals and tourists.Thanks to Mr Santosh kumar kunwar

Excellent location and great customer service . Sanjay Mahajan was very courteous and explained the property in details while helping us get to our room.Per him best time to visit is October through December. I would recommend this place. This is my second trip and I am loving it

We enjoyed beautiful scenery, chilled weather and best hospitality of Chandragiri hills resort staffs. Food was delicious. Rooms were comfortable with all the facilities.Special thanks to Mr. Sanjay Maharjan who helped us throughout our trip. Hoping to visit again.

Great experience with the resort. Spacious, lovely ambience, hot jacuzzi beside the pool. We had a wonderful time. The view of kathmandu valley is majestic. The service experience can be greatly enhanced with ample lounging space. Kudos. Front office Mr. Sanjay Maharjan was quite greeting and helpful person.

Called exactly at 7:30 to ask about the charges of the room,transportation and any available offer. The receptionist picked up the called and without any greetings he said”call tomorrow during duty hour” and hung up. What an hospitality. Shouldn’t a hotel pick up calls 24 hrs?Kindly mention your duty hour as I didn’t find it in google.

We can highly recommend the hotel, it offers a perfect view of the Himalayas,the staff is very friendly. A quiet place to relax. We were offered an upgrade, from a room with bathroom to 2 rooms with bathroom and whirlpool.Minor problems (broken fuse on the TV) were solved immediately, perfect. Many thanks to the friendly staff.

I am giving 5 bullet to this property because of Front office lady ganga magar how she welcome to us and santosh kunwar manager who brief us about resort and story of Bhaleswor mahadeb temple. They are very friendly and behave professionally. I take this opportunity to thank all the staffs who have helped us which made our stay exceptionally pleasant and warm. One small issue is vehicle and training to driver how to behave with guest. Highly recommend to this resort .

Everything about the hotel was exceptional. It was clean, stylish, roomy with excellent service in where we had dinner. Food was good and great value for money and service was attentive and efficient. Friendly staff.Thank you Relish Shrestha for our extra effort and making our stay memorable.

I was extremely impressed by the orderly management and warm hospitality of all the staffs particularly Sanjay Maharjan and British Maharjan of the resort. The stay was very pleasant and comfortable due to exclusively lavish rooms of the hotel. Food was very delicious and the cost was also reasonable. Moreover, my overall impression of this resort is nothing less than excellent. I sincerely thank all the staffs of the resort for their kind assistance and cooperation.

GREAT to place to stay. Very comfortable and accommodating. Incredible view of the Himalayan mountains and the Kathmandu Valley. Time of stay is important for view and comfort. Dine in or room service. Cable car service required. Friendly staff to assist in every way.

Stay was wonderful, sanjay maharjan at the reception was absolutely amazing person, he helped us a lot. Pillow was fluffy, bed was good. Everything was amazing. Food waa great. View from the balcony was mesmerising, basically everything was perfect

We had wonderful time with family at the resort. It was a peaceful hideout. The views of the moutains , hills and Kathmandu valley were mersmerizing. We came with young kids who enjoyed the jacuzzi and the day ended with beautiful night view of Kathmandu valley. Overall this place was one of the best resort stay during our short trip to Nepal. Looking forward to come back again.

The stay was great, food was great. The staff were friendly, and overall the natural scenery just makes the overall experience best and the stay was joyful. Have you ever experienced the air so pure that you just want to take the deepest breath, hold it in for as long as you can, just so your lungs and soul can just capture that memory forever? I did, right here at Chandragiri Hills Resort. I had been looking for a place to take my family for a quick getaway and I had heard quite a bit about Chandragiri hills resort. They didn’t have an opening for the weekend but they suggested a weekday stay to accommodate our big family on the same floor. The day we got the reservation happened to be my dad’s birthday so it turned out even better. I had forgotten to order a cake for his birthday but when I called the concierge about it, he was quick to accommodate that too. We were all excited about this trip. It had been almost 15 years since we had spent time together like this as a whole family. The front desk called to confirm our stay the day before and followed up on the day of when we were running late for our check in. I am not sure if it’s the only way to get to the resort but we went by cable car. The ride up there had already won my heart! Gliding through the clouds with the cool, dense breeze entering in the cable car through a little window, listening to the sound of the forest was like a starter before a meal that set a perfect appetite for the whole trip! When we got up there, the cloud was so dense, you could actually feel the rain in the air! I have never experienced anything like it before. After a little wait, a van took us to the hotel where we walked into this meticulous lobby! We met the concierge and the front desk staff who were super friendly and welcoming. It was a true Nepali hospitality! I had booked a suite for my parents as a birthday present for my dad along with 2 other rooms for the rest of us. Finding our rooms was slightly difficult but it was also dark and we were all very distracted by the mesmerizing beauty of this place. All the rooms were beautifully done encompassing the comfort of modern luxury and yet staying true to Nepali art and heritage. We went for dinner, celebrated my dad’s birthday with his surprise cake at the restaurant, walked around and just took it all in. We created memories that we will treasure forever! The kids had an absolutely amazing time and it was all smiles with the adults. The team at the restaurant was very accommodating and we were all really impressed. Around 1 am before I went to bed, I opened the bathroom window in the Presidential suite. The clouds above the city that was illuminated by the city lights, the sound of the mountains and cold wind gushing in the room was so beautiful, I felt like I was reading a book. You know when you are reading something SO exciting; you don’t want to put the book down? Ya, it was like that but even better because I was right there! After about 15 minutes of taking this beauty in, I tried to go to bed, but went back to my bathroom window for one last look. I wanted to take a mental picture forever! My heart was so content! Next day started with tea, breakfast and a swim. I will say, I don’t think I have ever swam in a shallower pool but the view from the end of this infinity pool, was worth freezing temperature of the water. The pictures just don’t do justice. I am sure there are parts of Nepal that are much more magical. But here, you experience the magic of nature and Nepali hospitality in clean, calm, quiet space that is modern, luxurious and magical. If you have some extra money to spare, and want to create memories for a lifetime, definitely go to this place! I can’t wait to go back! Thank you Chandragiri Hills Resort for memories of a lifetime!

Chandragiri Hills is one of the best locations in Nepal to observe the panoramic Himalayan range. The stretch of snow-capped mountains starting with the Himalchuli in the West to the Mount Everest and beyond in the East is really amazing and inspiring. You can see all of that from a single spot from the top of this hill.Hiamalayan vista is most amazing in the morning just before and after sunrise. Before Chandragiri Hills resort opened, there was no way to get to the top before sunrise as the public areas were only accessible after the first cable car reached the top at around 9 am. To witness the first rays of sun touching the Himalayas, you have to stay at the resort. To me and other mountain enthusiasts, this alone is worth more than the price of stay and I will definitely be going back again and again to the resort for the morning view.Having said that, it is really sad that the designers of the resort did not think about mountain enthusiasts when they designed it. None of the balconies face the Himalayas. There are large balcony dividers completely blocking the view. The only thing you can see from the larger balconies is the view of the cable car going up and down the mountain. They could have designed every room facing the panoramic mountains. They could have learned from the design of Rupakot Resort, Club Himalaya or Mystic Mountain. (These are some of the other resorts in Nepal with great Mountain View) The service was really good and the night manager was really helpful. My neighbors were having a party in their room with loud Bollywood music and I called the night manager. I don’t know what he did but the music and the noise stopped within 5 minutes. Sadly, most of the other guests were there to party and didn’t care about the morning view.

They could have learned from the design of Rupakot Resort, Club Himalaya or Mystic Mountain. (These are some of the other resorts in Nepal with great Mountain View) The service was really good and the night manager was really helpful. My neighbors were having a party in their room with loud Bollywood music and I called the night manager. I don’t know what he did but the music and the noise stopped within 5 minutes. Sadly, most of the other guests were there to party and didn’t care about the morning view.

The room is big with modern amenities.Fantastic view from the room. The restaurant food was delicious. Staff of front desk really cooperative and he explain tactfully.Everyone should come once.The light is not enough when out going from the lobby.Hope more light will be there in our second visit.Overall a wonderful night that met all expectation....

The pool water was very crystal clear..the brunch selection was extensive and very much hygienic. The service I received was topnotch. The ambience and the picturesque scene from the hotel was exceptionally mindblowing.. overall the experience is superb. I recommend Dusit princess for best service and Hospitality.

The rooms are really nice and they upgraded me to a suite room as deluxe rooms were not available without any extra cost. Staffs are really amazing. Prakash is an amazing Chef in Soi lounge and took the time out to talk to me and check the foods I liked. Sandim is an amazing host and took care of all my preferences while having breakfast. Nisha helped me out with all my requests regarding the room. Priyanka asked me for my feedbacks and suggestions to make my stay more comfortable. All in all i had an amazing experience with the entire hotel staff. This is my usual go to hotel every time I am in Nepal and they treat you like royalty. Thank you for the an amazing experience always.

From the rooms to the food ,the staff makes sure you have the best of experience while you are on your vacation. I was happy to stay here I wish I knew earlier how beautiful and comfortable this hotel is then I would have extended my stay here. The front desk was helpful and catering to our neeeds ,the housekeeping team made sure we enjoy your space at our room. The restaurant staff got us everything we needed.Do stay here if in Kathmandu and spoil urself with luxury.

The hotel service is unmatched in my experience.  All staff treated me with respect and kindness. The rooms were very well lit, the bed was very big and comfortable, and the breakfast and bakery food was delicious. I would definitely return to the Dusit Princess.

Dusit Princess as the name suggests ,the management staff treats you like Royalty from the time you Check in till the time you Check out. The Room, the buffet breakfast, the spa , the roof top bar were all top notch. All the management staff right from the front desk to the house cleaning staff were all courteous and helpful.

It was the best decision to stay at the Dusit Princess in Kathmandu. The location is perfect as you can easily find cabs/taxis and restaurants, shopping center is at a walkable distance from the hotel. The staff is courteous, helpful and is willing to go out of their way to make your stay comfortable. My experience was amazing and this hotel is highly recommended.

I went with friend of mine for couple of drinks at the Kibu Bar. Lovely venue however the service was poor.First we were recommended with Carlsberg draft beer which was not even on menu. Also we ordered one starter recommended by the waiter Timur Chicken, it took over 45 minutes to arrive, we mentioned however no one senior approached to check on this. Then at the asked for bill, guess what for 330ml Carlsberg draft they charged us Rs1130 per glass, this is totally rip off. When I asked the waiter you are charging 473ml price of Sherpa for Carlsberg, his reply was this is the price and I asked him show me on the menu, he couldn't show me. I paid the bill and left. I was expecting bit better service could have stayed more as it was first time I visited Dusit. Very disappointed to receive this kind of service and lack of management attention on these little mess up.

The hospitality and greetings made us feel so acknowledged. At the same time, I enjoyed the interior, asthetic here is perfectly soothing. We have  such a good room and room service is upto point. Top floor has swimming pool and such an amazing view. You should not miss this.

Such a gem!  This is a brand new hotel in Kathmandu.  Family of four-we had 2 very comfortable rooms.   There are several restaurants serving a variety of different cuisines, great breakfast buffet, a beautiful rooftop lounge and pool, plus a spa. Manisha, Ambika, Suresh and many others were extremely helpful, providing terrific service.  Live music in the beautiful lobby in the evening was lovely (but never too loud or disruptive). Highly recommend!

The overall services were very good and we enjoyed a lot the services during our stay. We were here from different countries and it will remain with us as memorial. The services we received was on timely basis and found them flexible with the services rendered during our stay. Thanks

Great food, good ambience and pleasing hospitality. Our server, Pushpa ji was a great host who really showed us around and recommended the best foods to try. A pleasant experience indeed. It's a must visit place in KTM.

"The warm atmosphere greets you as soon as you enter and sets the tone for an amazing eating experience. The menu offers a mouthwatering selection of foods, each expertly prepared and brimming with flavor. There is something to satisfy every palette, whether it be a light salad or a fine food.your dining needs are fulfilled immediately and with a smile thanks to the dedicated personnel. All in all, this restaurant is a treasure, offering a delicious culinary adventure."

Our family stay at Dusit Princess was truly amazing! The front desk staff, food and beverage staff, housekeeping, gym facilities staff were exceptional. The breakfast every day had an exceptional spread and everyone in our family (ages 25 to 80)  got what they wanted! A special mention for Nisha on the front desk, Bima and Sandeep for taking care of us in the restaurant, Ambika and Binita in the coffee shop! Great service, food and great stay!

We were witnessed with one the best hospitality at the hotel. We were treated with warm and polite service even very late in the nightThe waiters were patient and served us with the yumiest food. The ambience called for an extra hour at the restaurant

The rooms were very nice , staffs were very friendly and helpful  special thanks to Prarthana PR Marketing Manager we enjoyed our stay and loved having drinks at rooftop restaurant. Also it was very near to Thamel with just 10 mins walk. Will vist again soon !

The rooftop has amazing ambience and amazing food. However the authentic thai cuisine needs a lot of improvement it doesn’t taste anything like thai. No  taste no flavor to the food please improve the quality the price you are taking is above what it should be seeing the quality and the taste of the food. PLEASE IMPROVE THE FOOD.

Celebrated my birthday with a group of friends at Kubi & thoroughly enjoyed the food, service and ambience. To top it off, our waiter Sumit Nepali was excellent! Thanks Sumit and to the entire team at Kubi- I’d highly recommend and will certainly be back!

I visited Nepal this week  and stayed at Dusit Princess in Katmandu for 3 nights. Hotel is will located with shops and exchanges just outside the hotel. The rooms were good and spacious and the staff as well as the management were very courteous and professional . The breakfast had a large spread and the chef was kind enough to cater to my special requirements which was not on the menu. The swimming pool is on the 12th floor and has an amazing view and a nice place to relax. I strongly refer this property to family and business clients visit Nepal for holidays and business purpose. It was my pleasure to meet the Hotel General Manager Mr Samir Banerjee and the front office manager Mr Humnath Acharya and thanked and complimented them for a well and professional managed property with a team of staff who are eager to take care of guest needs and make their stay comfortable.

The crest spa was really great with one of the best front desk manager and really professional therapist (Usha). One hour went by really fast, felt really relaxed after the session, Even when entering the spa reception the ambiance was really soothing and felt relaxed. Will visit again soon.

We stayed there twice during our trip and we had an excellent stay… hotel is brand new everything is working perfectly and has a lot of amenities… gym, bar, restaurant, coffee shop, pool, sauna, steam. Staff was very friendly and polite always trying to make us feel comfortable. Annika and Manisha from the coffee shop were incredible, Sandip at the restaurant was always very attentive to our needs. Nisha at the front desk was very polite as well. Fully recommend this hotel!!

Gopal Chaudary really went above and beyond to make our dining experience special. It's always nice when someone takes that extra step to make you feel valued. Good food and a nice ambiance can really make a dining experience memorable. It's great that both the food and the atmosphere were enjoyable. I would highly recommend SOI for nice cozy dine in .

I stayed in this hotel for business purposes. This hotel is centrally located and near from many corporate officess as well as tourist destinations. Rooms were comfortable and buffet breakfast was really good. Staff were very friendly and  hospitable. Special thanks to Ms. Jeni and Sirjana for smooth check out and Nabin for taking care of my luggage.

Courteous staff, especially Suresh and Nisha, were very attentive.The property is posh and well maintained. Same goes with the rooms, though a bit smaller in size.The roof top restaurants and the Pool offer a great view.Room service can be improved.

This hotel is very special, indeed. Well located in Kathmandu, the Dusit Princess exceeded all of our expectations. The rooms were outstanding; the food (including the fabulous included breakfast buffet) was diverse and delicious; the hospitality was welcoming and responsive; and the view from the rooftop pool area was wonderful. We highly recommend this property to anyone staying in Kathmandu.

This is the new place to be for Thai food. Tastes authentic. Tom yam tasted original. The Thai dessert sticky rice with mango ice cream was something i be never tasted in kathmandu.Shoutout for ishan (thanks my man).. catered us with utmost  care and grace! Will be coming back…

Gopal and the rest of the staff did a fantastic job in making  us feel  welcome. Friendly and attentive service can really make a difference in enjoying a nice dinner. Food were extremely delicious, good to found Thai delicacies in k town .

We stayed here after attending a wedding party on the rooftop and it was by far the nicest place we stayed in Nepal. The staff (particularly Manish and Rajat at the front desk who checked us out) were so friendly and the rooms were spotless. Not to mention the rooftop infinity pool and bar, and the sauna/steam rooms which we had to ourselves most of the time! Wonderful stay and we'd definitely return if we come back to Nepal.

The hotel's facilities were outstanding, starting with the infinity pool bar that offered panoramic views of Kathmandu Valley. The Kibu Bar had a cozy ambiance, ideal for enjoying evening cocktails. The gym on the 11th floor was well-equipped with modern machines, and the steam and sauna facilities were a great way to relax after a workout. Dining at the Thai restaurant was a highlight of my stay; the food was delicious and authentically prepared.

Manish, Nisha, Srijana, Nabin, and Kishor have been very welcoming and helpful throughout my stay here. They helped my friend and I find rides to navigate the city, made sure we were comfortable during our stay, and came to our aid whenever we needed it. Because of them, I would recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Kathmandu!

Very comfortable beds, absolutely clean rooms and the Thai at the hotel is authentic and delicious.  Staff is very hospitable and especially Nitya from reservations is always extremely helpful and very helpful.The pickup at the airport is very professional and efficient .

Sumit and Santoosh took really good care of us and really enjoyed our experience! Overall, one of the best moments of our trip in nepal. The ambiance overall was perfect and they really made sure that each and every one of our requests were considered.

The hospitality is great. I got my one the best massage done for 90 minutes deep tissue one from MUNA it was amazing and the best highly recommended massage here and the manager for the spa is so delightful and charming. Great great service totally worth it 😊

Great hotel near Thamel - modern accommodations, clean, and comfy beds. Rajat who was working the front desk was incredibly kind and helpful, I appreciated his help figuring out transportation. The hotel has a restaurant and is impeccably clean, it was a nice stayover on my way home.

The hotel location is abive expectafion in terms of location and room layout. The restaurants seeve good food and especially like the ones served on 12th floor at their sky lounge. Service provided is excellent and the staff went the extra miles to ensure all guests are comfortable and happy! Special mention about servuce staff, Sumit, who put attention to details and delight customer. Thank you for the good service!

Hotel looks great. Several options for food and drinks, a great lobby, gym rooftop pool etc.  we stayed in an Executive King room with balcony. Nice large room with  very comfortable bed. Problem is, however, that the rooms are far from sound proof. Especially the room doors close with a loud bang that can be heard from far. When the hotel is busy the banging door concerto lasts until at least midnight and starts again before 6 AM. Unless you are a very sound sleeper, it will definitely wake you up. Also other noises from adjacent rooms and above rooms can be clearly heard. For us a big minus for such a fine hotel and we would not come here again.

It was an an amazing treatment experienced in Crest Spa at Dusit Princess Hotel in Kathmandu Nepal. I had a Deep Tissue Massage for 90 mins and MyTherapist Ms. Usha Did a great job. She has a healing hands  very perfessional therapy service. Best for place to escape for your therapy's. Front office Manager Mr. Homnath recommend me to have a spa services, He did great job by recommending me to have massage. Thank you Mr. Homnath. I appreciate it. Definitely will come back again 😊Receptionist Pemba was very knowledgeable and friendly as well. Thank you.

The Dusit Princess provided a comfortable stay in a well-maintained room. The staff was friendly and helpful, especially front office department who went above and beyond to answer our questions. Breakfast offered a good variety and fresh options. While a bit on the noisy side at times, the location was convenient for exploring the city. Overall, a pleasant experience!

Message and spa was one of the best experience. We stayed in one of the best room and we absolutely enjoyed breakfast and dinner with the view. The massage therapist were very professional and we are definitely going to visit quite often

Lovely hotel. Newly built with amazing service. Breakfast in the morning is simply outstanding. Chef Prakash Avasthi cooks amazing dosas.  Will definitely come back here. The row of shops leading to the hotel also provide unique souvenirs which are competitively priced. Money changers also close by. All in all Dusit Princess as a hotel is a complete package.

The Soi Restaurant staff Mr. Sandip is very kind and helpful. He helped me to get comfort for my cold and coughing with your Indian Spices Tea💜🙏The food was delicious and authentic. The environment is friendly and welcoming Thank you so much !Sherry fr HK

Amazing Thai food and service! Sandip Thadpa was especially kind and professional in the Soi Restaurant. We have eaten twice here and the food is exceptional 🙏🏼 We also loved the Kibu rooftop bar with stunning views across the city, pool, bar and lounges.

Had a Great experience. Fantastic service and food. Would love to recommend everyone.Nisha ji & Nima were very helpful and patient. Also I must say Manish Bajracharya duty manager is really amazing he take care our request and make sure it’s done. He is very kind.

I had recently visited Dusit Princess’s Kibu lounge with my friends. The waiter Sumit who attended to us was wonderful ! He made sure we were very comfortable and enjoyed our time hereI would recommend this place for drinking and chilling rather than meals as the food could be improved. Overall Kibu Lounge is an amazing rooftop bar with great ambiance, wonderful staffs, good drinks and decent food ! Worth a try. Thank you to Sumit for making our experience here a good one :)

The Dusit Kathmandu hotel is lovely and everything a 5star hotel should be. The staff is amazing. My bags were lost by the airline for several days and the management was very helpful in recovering them.  The restaurant staff knew us (and our coffees) after the first morning.

Yesterday, I visited SOI restaurant. I had a amazing time with my friends and also enjoyed the delicious food.Also, the service was absolutely recognized by Sandip Thapa, and we will visit again in the upcoming days.

The service and the ambiance are amazing. But the server need to check the table frequently. The hostess was hospitable and friendly The food needs a little improvements but the prawn was so creamy . Just loved it. Thanx for the relaxing time

Last evening I visited Kibu Sky Lounge located at the 12th floor of this beautiful hotel.The Sushi platter and pizza that we ordered was very delicious. Staffs were humble ,attentive and courteous. Great music ,great ambience.

I had a wonderful experience at The Hotel Dusit Princess Kathmandu. Every staff member I encountered, from the valet to the check-in to the security staff was delightful and eager to help, specially Ms.Prativa for her assistance. They all go above and beyond to make my stay more comfortable. The rooms were clean, very comfortable, and spacious.Room service was very swift.Would definitely recommend this hotel to my colleagues and friends.

Very appreciated with their service, Suresh and Nisha. Thanks a lot. They have done thier great job. I feel like they are happy with what they are doing. I felt so tired after our long trekking trip but the service here made me fully recharged.

Fantastic service! Hospitality levels are taken to the next level. Amenities are very good. Friendliness of the staff is superlative! Nisha was very helpful! The shower pressure was like a spa massage! The restaurant staff is very efficient. Keep it up.

The hotel provides you with everything needed for business meetings and events.  The staff there are very helpful and responsive enough to all of our sudden requests.  The shops around provided us nice shopping experience while we did not have much time to go far. The rooms are tidy and new!

Excellent hotel and supportive staff. Plenty of personal attention to guests. The rooms are also very decent. Another notable attraction for me was the restaurant food again with high-level service and personal attention of the waiting staff...Overall, a truly pleasant stay for four nights!

The hotel is simply fantastic, and the staff is as helpful as possible, all of them are quite kind. In addition to the wonderful bed and bath, the breakfast is the best I've ever had. The products are of excellent quality, and they offer  countless types of meals, including for those with intolerances (for example, milk). This place has everything for a perfect stay in Kathmandu. The location is also excellent.

I have stayed in many 5* hotels across the world, this one is stand out. The quality of the rooms and amenities, breakfast, bar, all day dining, spa, gym and staff are all stand-out superb. All needs are catered for here, staff deal with issues with the minimum of fuss. This is not only a hotel with top class facilities and staff who have no idea how to implement them, Dusit has it all. One of the few hotels I will be keen to revisit.

The hospitality of the staff including front desk (Neha and team) and the dining hall teams is exceptional.  would definitely recommend staying and we would return back for our future visits as well.  The food was excellent and they would cater to specific dietary needs with a smile 😊

Sumit was excellent in every aspect especially service and knowledge of food suggestions Enjoyed good ambience food was great taste. View  from rooftop is great. Fun time with live DJ. . Highly recommended.

Hotel is fantastic! We highly reccomended, people very friendly and helpful specially MANISH, NISA AND MANISH at the front desk and Rana at the coffee shop. The only thing to improve is that water temperature at the pool was to cold to use it.

I enjoyed my stay at this hotel. The rooms are clean, and comfortable. The staff was very friendly. Breakfast service time need to change from 7 a.m. to 6 a.m. for live counter. all BF menu is delicious.  Quality of the rooms were very good specially Ms. Manisha from housekeeping was very friendly, and helpful thanks for the excellent service keep it up guys. They are always willing to help with a smile to make your stay more comfortable in every possible Way.Special thanks for Candle provided by night manager   due to short power cuts  accrued in my second day stay (Happens very very rarely).12th floor Bar is very excellent and staff are very professional and service was great.best wishes to the team.

Crest Spa is one of the best I have been to till date in terms of ambience , facilities and hygiene.Therapist Anisha has always been friendly and polite. Her flow and knowledge on muscle and joint points is amazing. Highly recommend to visit Cresta spa for Amazon experience

Sumit  was excellent and food was great. Amazing views of kathmandu and the surrounding hills. Music was a vibe as well. Our server really got our orders great and served us with a smile at every step of the way

We were impressed with our lunch in this restaurant situated in a new highly regarded hotel. The atmosphere was relaxing. We enjoyed Thai and Nepalese food, which was served quickly. The food was fresh and very tasty. Our waiter Gopal was very attentive. We highly recommend.

Very lovely thai food and hospital staff. The chef paid us special attention and made the food exactly to our needs. The pad thai and khao soi was cooked to perfection. The spring roll and papaya salad were a refreshing starter. Will definitely come back again with the family.

The hotel has a great restaurant called Soi. We had freshly made indian breads and curries for breakfast. The western selection was ok with your breads, bacon and eggs but the star really is the local selection, and the Thai food was very good for lunch and dinner. The rooms were very comfortable and the gym was very well equipped. The staff were all very friendly and helpful.  Was hoping to try the pool but it wasn’t open.

I am truly amazed by the exceptional hospitality you provided during our stay. Your hotel is absolutely stunning, and the staff is incredibly helpful and kind. The food was delightful, and everyone went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable and welcome. It felt like a home away from home, thanks to your team's guidance and generosity.Thank you from the bottom of my heart for making our stay so memorable and enjoyable. Your warmth and care did not go unnoticed, and I am truly grateful for the experience.

Very extensive facilities which were excellent maintained and very warm and friendly staff from reception, spa, gym,pool.No request was too small and the food was perfectly prepared.Tastey fresh buffet to suit every body's taste. Rooms were clean and spacious.Very good stay highly recommended

We had a wonderful stay here.The Spa had wonderful masseur Anitha and Usha.  We chose duo deep massage and it was one of the best massage we had in recent times.The staffs were extremely helpful.Saturday Brunch was great too.Wide range of South Indian food for breakfast was delicious.We chose the same hotel on return from Khailash.

A very well-appointed hotel overall. I checked in for some relaxation by the pool, and I was pleased to find the water exceptionally clean with no hint of chemicals. A special mention goes to Gambhir Jung Rai, who was incredibly supportive and attentive to all my needs. My stay was thoroughly enjoyable, thanks to his prompt and caring service.

The breakfast at Dusit Princess is really nice. The chief, Prakash Awasthi, is really friendly and cares sincerely about customer's feeling. He made me his signature dosa personally and it was the best dosa I've ever had. I really appreciate it.

Everything is good here and their service is absolutely amazing. All the staffs are able to speak English very fluently. The hotel is clean and tidy. So if you are travelling to Nepal, please don’t miss to check in such amazing hotel here. The staff Jeni Rai, Nabin Sinar, Amir Kharel assist us a lot. Truly recommend for this hotel.

It was a wonderful experience right from the start! I was greeted with a smile and a welcome drink at the reception, and also well looked after by the luggage porter. The check-in process went smoothly, and the room was nice and clean with a sun-drenched view of Kathmandu city.The food at the Thai restaurant was delicious! A special thanks to Chef Prakash for the Nepalese tea. I also want to express my gratitude for the top-notch service provided by the restaurant staff, especially Sandip, who was always very attentive and professional. Thank you, Dusit, for the amazing experience!

Absolutely fantastic hotel -- great food, outstanding service. The staff would practically read your mind, and were beyond kind. Great location is as well. Bibek in the restaurant was very kind, and the massage in the Spa was excellent. Would not hesitate to come here again, truly a 5 star experience!

The room was clean and the bed was very comfortable. Because the shower was not closed in with a door or curtain, water splashed and made the rest of the bathroom floor wet after showering.Everyone on the staff was top-notch! Everyone we encountered from the check-in desk to the breakfast restaurant, to the drivers was kind, friendly, and helpful. Our dinner at the rooftop, Kibu, was exceptional and our experience was made extra special by the amazing service we received from Sumit and Nabin. We were treated like royalty - Sumit and Nabin even surprised us with a VIP sendoff on our last day...priceless! I would HIGHLY recommend the Dusit Princess Kathmandu

This hotel is exquisite!  I travel globally a great deal and decor the quality of the hotel and rooms are unprecedented.  Even better than that is the high quality service and touch points by the staff.  The restaurant serves an impressive array of high quality food that nourishes not only the body but the soul.  I can not say enough about my experience here.  Thank you to the entire staff for your hospitality!

The dining experience was amazing, the service was amazing. Sumit Nepali took really good care of us and took care of all our needs.The food was good, the view from kibu was amazing. I recommend this place for anyone who is looking for fine dine experience in Nepal with good view

Dusit Princess Kathmandu is beautiful. The hotel's elegant decor and warm hospitality create an inviting atmosphere for guests. From luxurious accommodations to delightful dining options, every aspect of the experience is impeccable. With stunning views of the Kathmandu Valley and convenient access to local attractions, it's the perfect choice for both business and leisure travelers. A truly memorable stay awaits at Dusit Princess Kathmandu. All the staff are well trained and has well knowledge hospitality industry. Srijana and Nishan who was working the front desk was incredibly kind and helpful. Cant wait to visit their again

The staff at hotel were incredibly welcoming and helpful throughout our stay. The rooms were neat and clean and very comfortable. We also enjoyed the delicious food ( Veg and Non veg) Awesome view from swimming pool area. If you are in Kathmandu you must have to stay here.

It was an amazing experience staying at Dusit Kathmandu.The environment was awesome & the staffs were so friendly & hostile . The FOH staffs were so amazing ,the way they greets & treats the guest was an excellent service. The room was fantastic to sleep . The rooftop was like a real Dusit , Really enjoyed & entertained .Special Thanks tot Marketing & Sales Head Mr.Dinesh & front Desk Miss Nisha . Thanks to all Dusit team for your unforgettable service . Cheers !!Raj

I had a great time staying at this hotel, and Rajat deserves special recognition for his outstanding hospitality. My encounter was made much more unforgettable by his kind and attentive nature. I appreciate the staff's commitment to making sure visitors are happy, and I hope to visit again soon.

I used steam room and sauna room. The temperature in both rooms were quite up to the mark to have a feel on skin. I used this service two time while staying at this hotel. All The staff members were very welcoming and made my visit to steam room and sauna room very pleasant. They are very modest.

Very friendly and attentive staff made our stay at the hotel wonderful. SOI restaurant offers excellent Thai/Indian/Nepali cuisine - must try. Room was very clean and well appointed. Gym is very well equipped. Rooftop bar KIBU is great place to enjoy 360 degree views of KTM while having a drink. Location is very central - short taxi ride to Thamel and other attractions.   Definitely staying here again on next visit. Thank you

Light lunch by Kibu restaurant. The area was very clean, had great views and a wonderful chill vibe. I had a tom jued noodle soup with seaweed which was fresh and flavoursome. The service was exceptional. Bibek was a wonderful server! Very friendly and helpful.

We ordered spring rolls, pad thai and massaman curry.  Food was delicious, fresh and very tasty. We ate it all. We most definitely will return again.  Ambience was relaxing and service was exceptional. Thanks for a lovely dining experience.

Had a very good experience staying in the hotel. Staff was very friendly and welcoming. From the security to reception to restaurant, everyone has provided us a five star experience. Breakfast spread was really good and delicious. Hotel is a 10-15 min walk from thamel street. but note that walk is really dusty and noisy. There are not much eateries close to the hotel but the restaurants inside the hotel are really nice. The night ambience and view from kibu at the rooftop is amazing.  We also took a massage service from the crest spa which was really good. Therapists Sunita and Ankita was incredibly professional and attentive. Hotel lobby ambience is also worth mentioning for its design and aesthetics.Cons1. There is no glass separation from the bath area in the washroom and hence water is sure to fall into the common area.

Dusit Kathmandu provided a fantastic  experience during my first visit to Nepal. I loved my room, gourmet dining, and rooftop bar and infinity pool the most.  The entire staff was very helpful, polite and attentive. Themal market and many other landmarks are only 15 mins walking distance.

We had a great time at the Dusit with friends. It’s centrally located, rooms are large and spacious. Breakfast spread was amazing and also lot of flexibility in timing. The best part for me was the level of service and the trained staff (Nisha at reception was particularly helpful in arranging for an early morning airport departure).. amazing levels of personalisation. Thank you Dusit

The ambiance was great. The staffs were so polite and friendly and helpful. The room were pretty clean having all the necessities one could have. The food was very delicious too with varieties one could ask for. Thank you for the service!!!!

It's a brand-new hotel with lovely rooms and amenities. The staff were amicable and helpful. The in-house restaurant served excellent local, Indian and Thai food. This was all prepared by their chefs from Nepal and Thailand. The rooms were spacious and comfortable with amazing views. I enjoyed trying out their gym with plenty of new machines. On the top floor, they have an amazing infinity pool and a sky bar/restaurant with wonderful views. Made my stay in Kathmandu absolutely worth it.

Very Nice property with beautiful cafe, restaurants and sky bar. Pleasant Food and stay at this place. Very close and centre to other Vicinity and in Kathmandu.Polite and hospitable staff. Ready to go extra miles whenever required.All my friends and family stays here as o do not regret recommending this place to anyone.

Pleasant stay in Dusit. Very hospitable staff, quick service and clean. I can stay here again on next trip to Khatmandu. We had food at Soy, is small compare to other Thai restaurant at Dusit but food quality was good. The hotel is located in a posh cozy area with a please small walk

The breakfast was exquisite. I really enjoyed the endless varieties and also enjoyed myself as I ate the scrumptious meal. Along with the food, I was treated with such warmth and cordiality by the staff especially by Mr Suman Thapa which Im much grateful for.
Amazing staff , lovely food . Purustham chef gave great service and helped us out Sumit had the best waiter service . View is exceptional and location is in the centre of the city . WillBe back again

I had a perfect stay, the room was very clean.I noted alot of kind personnel among them Bibek and Sandip at the Blue club 12th floor. Amir the manager very helpful and kind. Narayan and the team ensured I enjoyed all my meals. The chef food was always delicious my favourite being the Okra well fried and seasoned. Oh the gym trainer ,never got his names, but he ensured I kept up with my training routine.  Definitely will come back to Dusit Princess Kathmandu. Thankyou Thankyou and stay happy as always!!

This is one of best hotels I have ever stayed. We were a group of 20 and each and everyone was fully satisfied and content with the stay. The staff management were always helpful and available 24 x 7. The Room was clean and had all the amneties and facilities. Our package included Breakfast, which had a variety of options to chose from. Would definitely visit this place again with my family

There are few hotels of this level in Nepal. The view from the terrace truly gives a sense of paradise that cannot be enjoyed anywhere else. The hospitality was excellent. This is a place that must be experienced once. It was my first time. I felt greedy seeing the respect behavior and management of the staff thereWhat a good arrangement even in a small place.keep it up

Very good service staff are very friendly. We enjoyed breakfast and dinner. Nice management.Manish Bajracharya duty manager is very helpful and recommend us to visit famous place in Kathmandu.  Every staff here was very courteous and eager to help. My wife and I had amazing stay. Here Indian food is delicious. Nisha is very generous and kind.

The hotel atmosphere is great, the facilities is good and warm support from Mr. Rajat. For sure will comeback again.Only the breakfast is always the same should change some everyday and AC cannot control for me is kinda little bit hot. The rest is good

Clean and organized hotel at best location in city. Good breakfast and very friendly staff. Specially Nisha Thapaliya from front desk was very friendly and helpful. We will definitely be back to this property. If you are traveling for business or for private I highly recommend it to everyone.

New hotel, beautiful interior, excellent service. Thank you for the great service and support. Excellent facilities and food court. We had very good time in Nepal. Having just returned from Kathmandu and a 3 day stay at Dusit Princess , I have a lot to say . I would like to share my pleasurable experience at this property. Wonderful experience. Brand new hotel, top quality amenities. Absolutely love the steam and sauna included in your stay. Location is ideal, close enough to Thamel without all the chaos and calamity.
