Good event & very apprcited  me. Hotel staffs activity is so good . Banquet team is very cooperative especially Mr.Dipak ,Suyash& Rupson are very helpfulAll the teams are very hardworking And provided us very best service I will like to come again in future events Thankyou.

The hotel is absolutely safe to visit and stay.Best part is that the hotel is not a quarantine hotel. The safety of each guests is not compromised at all. The food and the prompt service is just amazing at the restaurant, The Cafe and its value for money . The Everest Hotel has really come back. I am just lovin it.

Food was good and the service was also amazing. Himal ji was very helpful. He gave us suggestions about the local locations. The rooms are good but there was a typical smell so we had to change the room once. But the staff was very helpful. View is okay. It is very close to the airport so it  was very convenient. Overall a good experience.

I have thoroughly enjoyed my stay at The Everest. The whole team are super friendly and welcoming. Radhika and the catering crew offer an amazing breakfast buffet. Sushan and Yashoda make an excellent cappuccino and Sushan is also great for a chat. The hotel is also close to the airport and many shopping opportunities just around the corner

This hotel is a little outdated, but it really makes up for it by the staff hospitality. I have been to many to different hotels around the world. I have never felt so welcomed anywhere. The front desk manager Umesh attended to our every need from the minute we entered the hotel. Every problem we faced he was there to support us every if it wasn't related to the hotel. For example, arranged our transportation and venue for the evening and ensuring we have safe transportation getting back to the hotel.All staff we're very hospitable deserve their 5 star rating.

Great Hotel friendly staff! Hotel lobby is welcoming and clean.  Breakfast staff is over the top with service and the food taste quality and selection is excellent.  Rooms are adequate with A/C that's nice and cold ( Big Plus)! Rooms do need to be a bit updated not Modern but update. For example Mattress is a bit hard and maybe some paint! But don't let that discourage you from staying here! A definite return for me when I come back.

Talking about my overall experience about The Everest Hotel my stay with wife was for 5 days and we had a present experience. Each and every staff from all the department were very well experienced and perfect on their job. We were taken a good care by Radhika, yasodha, abhinash and the hostess samrina. Would like to show my gratitude towards them and hope for their best future ahead .Myself MD Go Flemming Go Resort Pench National park, seller gate.

I recently had the pleasure of staying at the Everest Hotel and was thoroughly impressed by the overall experience. The rooms were, clean, and well-appointed. One of the standout aspects of my visit was the exceptional service provided by the staff, particularly a staff member named Himal. Himal's professionalism, attention to detail, and warm hospitality truly made my stay memorable.

The best experience I have had in a hotel. The staff was amazing specially radhika from the cafe. I think I made a friend. The food was 4/5 but the ambience, location and service was 5/5. This hotel seems to be very lucky if your have your first date here

Good hotel choise to stay in KTM. Rooms are big and the internet is ok.Location is between thectown center and the airport. Breakfast has a good choise, and you can ask for more to be cooked.Good service and very polite team-especialy Radhika

Just in the perfect location,in the heart of kathmandu city with clean environment and great hospitality.  Room  was really very cozy with all the amenities. We loved it. Food was delicious. Whole staff of  the hotel  were very helpful  n charming.

Loved everything. The room, the room service, the food. …. Especially the food … the breakfasts were amazing and The Cafe’s Tandoor treats were the best we’ve ever had. The whole team including Mr Jagdish Subarna and edpecially  Susan at breakfast were all wonderful.

Great place to stay specially for family, prime location, easily accessible public transport. Hotel is full of all amenities. Great staff, was assisted by Mrs Radhika & she was really amazing. Entire hotel staff was to cooperative. Checking time was 2 Pm but they allow us early check in as we reached early.

What a great spot! The second we arrived we were greeted with smiles and delicious fruit juice. Comfortable room with exceptional turndown service. Location is perfect. All around very hospitable and comfortable. Sushan took the time to chat with me all thing growing up in Nepal which was wonderful to learn from, very nice guy who loves working for the hotel!

Impressed by the warm welcoming by the doorman and a beautiful lady in the lobby. The food at The Cafe is mouth watering. Me and my friends loved the club sandwich and lasagne. The poolside is also well maintained. My next visit will be with my family.

I stayed for a business purpose and felt like home. The service is excellent and front office team welcomed me so well.The food Was great and so was the ambience. Recently opened Chinese restaurant has a real taste of Chinese food..Will definitely visit again ,,,😊

one of the top best hotel in kathmandu for stay and food is so homemade. good in budget as well as in nice location.radhika ji attended the guest with warm welcome and so nicely that I was overwhelmed.must visit in this hotel.

Wonderful staff very clean and hygienic. Special mention to Himal for being very courteous at the cafe to assist with the best savouries. They do every bit to assist from booking to rearranging without any hassles. If u are in Katmandu do plan once to stay here

The staff and hospitality is excellent.Very delicious food. Well prepared and well served.The rooms are nicely maintained and proper service provided by the housekeeping staff.Breakfast is properly balanced and hygiene is properly maintained.

The service is amazing! We were treated so well by all the staff, especially Radhika, Sushan and Depak who went above and beyond to make sure we were looked after and the food is amazing. I cannot wait to come back to The Everest Hotel and Nepal.

Attentive staff. Very good amenities. Comfortable bed/room. Bar on 7th floor is worth a visit. Thanks to Radhika for making this an enjoyable stay.Also a worth a mention is the proximity to the bustling shops and also the plentiful supply of ATM’s.

Excellent service. Close to the airport. Staff were helpfulRadhika and Yashoda were very hospitable  breakfast buffet was excellent as well. I would give the whole staff 5 stars Gurkha bar was also very good. Bartender was knowledgeable and very nice

We have enjoyed a lot at The Everest Hotel. We are soo pleased with the service and food provided by Everest hotel. I strongly recommend everyone to stay at this hotel. Moreover I am delighted to stay at this hotel. The service provided by Himal and Radhika was exceptional. I love the service done by these two guys. May god bless them forever.

Wonderful time at the Everest. The hotel is set off from the main road so you manage to get out of the madness for a bit of respite.  View from the top floor bar is fabulous - right over the city.  The barman took me to the private part of top floor to see the view too ( on the hush hush).  Staff are all fantastic especially Radhika who looked after us each morning for breakfast. Very clean hotel, rooms big and spacious.

Hotel stay was excellent. Big and spaces room. Breakfast lunch and dinner was great very delicious and enjoyed all the food. Easy transportation and alot of attractions places for tourists . The hotel staff was excellent and served us fast and efficiently.  I would like to compliment Mr.Dipak Bist and Miss Yasodha for their excellent fast and efficient services. They went on extra miles to served us .Keep up the good work. Well done.

Very excellent service by Radhika , Sushan, Yashoda, very good and nice services by the team , they are amazing host , the hotel is very nice and beautiful, we would like to visit again . The food is good and nice , overall , my family had a nice experience .The front desk staff Akit and Kriti were amazing , they both have supported very nicely and suggested good site visits .All the best team and thank you .Regards ,Pramod Kumar

Sushan chaudhary  with Pramod thapa I have to say at the service given here tonight for our first night in the pool has been first right. These people definitely make things special and how welcoming it is to a new country for us from Australia.Thanks to them both and their team for doing what they did definitely professional and courteous with the soul, it meets their character

Everest hotel is centrally located.We had a good experience.  Staffs were friendly.There was no problem in parking .Ambience was good and the foods were served promptly.Food was delicious and we enjoyed a lot.Highly recommended!

THE EVEREST HOTEL, a very nice hotel in the city with a very good Restaurant at 7th Floor - FAR PAVILION with beautiful view around. The food is really delicious. The main Entrance and the Lobby is very beautiful now.

I had the most wonderful time at The Everest Hotel where i stayed 4 nights in a Deluxe Double Room with a King bed. The room was a perfect fit with a wonderful view. From the moment i got there i was attended to with great hospitality and a warm welcome everywhere i went. From the porters to housekeeping, the front desk to security, from the kitchen, the breakfast crew and dinner service, to the bar on the top floor; all my needs were met - and the staff all went above and beyond to make my stay in Kathmandu a most positively memorable one!. This review is for late march 2024 but the here i am months later recalling the wonderful time i spent here.Special Thanks to Goresh Gurung (Bugles and Tiger Bar), Anu (Front Desk),Sushan (F+B), Radhika (F+B supervisor), Satim (Housekeping), Santosh Kharki (Security) and the frinedly Head Porter gentleman (whose name i sadly missed), who served most attentaviely as doorman, - and a big thankyou to all the Staff, Management and Team at the Everest Hotel! I truly hope to be back in Nepal one day and the Everest Hotel will definietly be my first stop! :) Thankyou all once again.

Excellent Hotel. We are there for the fifth time. we choose this hotel because of it location for basically being in the heart of Kathmandu. But after being there for the first time we have been there for 5 times in a year. Parking is enough and the foods are also quite excellent. We even got some compliment from the humble owner.

The hotel has its charm, it's old but that's what the charm is. You will be amazed at the hospitality from the min you step in. There is no way I am staying anywhere else in my future visits. Must have a drink at the bar, very colonial. A big thumbs up to the team.

Awesome hopitality and great Nepali and Indian cusine. The room was cozy and warm. Staffs at the reception were charming and eager to help all the time. The doorman style of greeting is just incredible. Will definitely visit next time.

Basically, none of the resort facilities were included. It was not my first time to Gokarna and everytime before this all facilities were included in the package. I called the reception from my room to book the sauna when I realised it's not available to me. The reception staff hung up saying "I will call back later". Call didn't come for 10 mins. When we asked if we could at least use the pool, we were told that the pool can't be heated as they haven't heated it since covid. We all understand that times are hard for businesses and cost cutting is one way to survive, but talking and explaining nicely to customers doesn't cost money. Basic rule of customer service - you don't want to sound too defensive. Your voice can not be louder than the customer when the customer isn't being difficult at all. You are the staff of a reputed 5 star resort. You can't talk like a highway motel staff. I had fantastic experience 2 years ago. Looks like all those trained staffs are gone and business is running with untrained underpaid staffs. Carpets are dirty. Restaurant only serve set lunches in a ridiculously high price. It's not the same anymore. It's not a 5 star resort anymore. May be it's how they treat Nepali customers now and will change once foreigners start coming in but it's just ridiculous. And it's sad.

The food was fine and the place is quite old. They also wanted to make us pay RS 2,000 for a guide on a paved path in the forest which is ridiculous for the amount we already pay per night. They REALLY need to update their gym.... the equipment is from the 80's. Not acceptable at a resort.

Simply incredible place and people !! Me and my wife stayed at Gokarna Golf resort for over a week and we would rate the hospitality of the place at 10/10 if not more. I have been to many places around the world, but hospitality of the place is simply the best. The golf resort area is amazing !! Loved the forest walk and food is good. The place may be a bit expensive but worth it in terms of the quality of the stay and greenery. If you are in Nepal, I highly recommend that you at least book a weekend stay at Gokarna and if you are into Golf, you just found a home !!  Just to top it off, even during our checkout on a cold morning, they made it a point to get us hot masala tea. Come on who does that, The team is so wonderful and caring right from the front desk staff to the senior manager Rojin who takes care of the facility. Keep it up team !! God bless the good people of Nepal and Gokarna. God speed and wish you all the success Lots of love from India by Sandeep & Shweta <3

Dear Gokarna Forest Resort, once again, my family and I had an amazing time at your resort. We've come here 3 times in the past 10 years and we've always enjoyed our stay. The staff is always friendly, the SPA is far beyond standards and the pool facilities are very enjoyable! The atmosphere is extremely relaxing and the wildlife adds a great deal to the whole experience. Your hotel is like a museum full of Nepali memorabilia and overall beautiful!If you may, here are a few details that would have made me give 5 stars instead of 4 :- the rooms we stayed in could use a fresh coat of paint- the frames, lamp shades and other corners should be dusted- the bathroom could be a bit revamped : the shower rod was barely hanging and the tiles need a good cleanupBut other than that, keep up the great work!!! We look forward to coming back to your facility on our next trip to Nepal!

We decided to celebrate Valentine's Day with my family and collaborated with Mr. Santosh to ensure everything was perfect. He secured a great price for us. The front desk staff was professional and gave us clear instructions. However, we were disappointed that we didn't receive welcome drinks and the room's refrigerator was empty in our suite rooms. The housekeeping service was not up to par and the front desk couldn't fix the issue. The requested product was forgotten. The food was expensive for the small portions and the customer service was lacking. It seemed like inexperienced interns were working that day, making it a disappointing experience compared to previous visits.

Great time at the resort - thank you for every effort to make such a lively and vibrant cuisine. To be able to host such a large group and cater to international taste was epic. My best regards to the chef.

I would rate this hotel as a 5 except that both times when I stayed here I was placed in a room with a window view that was blocked by a green tarp.  On my second stay, I requested something different, but was told that was all they had.  In any case, it is a lovely hotel on a spectaucular property.  The rooms are very large and comfortable. A true oasis, especially after travelig through the other parts of Kathmandu which are so torn up and dusty that several of us ended up with a bad case of bronchitus.  The staff was very nice, the food in the restaurant was great and all in all, it was worth the drive to get here each night.

The Positives:Staff were amazing so friendly and supportive.The Cons Location is pretty central to Kathmandu no where near activities Facilities are in significant disrepair Mild in the poolStagnant waterLimited menu Old roomsRun down hotel, This is not a 5 star hotel, 2 at best being generous.On the positive side we only stayed one night and hotel were brilliant in allowing us to cancel the stay without additional charges.Overall huge work needed but staff are amazing

We had an excellent stay at the Gokarna Forest Resort for a recent trip to Nepal for a close friends wedding.  From the time we landed in Kathmandu, everything was perfectly executed.  A driver was waiting for us at the airport at 1 AM to take us to the hotel.  At the hotel, the breakfast buffet was exceptional with many options to choose from, the front desk staff were warm and welcoming, and it was always easy to coordinate a day trip with a shuttle from the resort.  The excellent hospitality from everyone, especially from Sumita, Sunil and Pradip, truly made this a 5-star vacation.  We took a forest walk twice, which was challenging and rewarding with views of various  shrines and temples along the way.  We were fortunate enough to be present for, and take part in, their Holi celebration.  We were welcomed into their culture with open arms, and this was an experience we will forever cherish.  We will be back to visit Kathmandu and when we return, we will definitely be staying at Gokarna Forest Resort.

Me and my wife have been to quite a few resorts in Nepal but so far this is the best one. Despite going in the worst season the experience has still been immaculate. The nature and the forest walk was very refreshing it felt like we weren’t even in the busy city of kathmandu. The service was just fantastic and exceeded our exceptions. This was the first time I noticed the Hotel manager was attentive not just to the VIP’s but the regular visitors as well which made me feel appreciated. Finally for once in a resort the overpriced food felt well priced it was simply delicious and worth every rupees or pennies in my terms.I would recommend this resort for anyone wanting a get away from a busy city area and anyone who wants to experience the heritage style resort of nepal and of course the beautiful nature.

The Good Aspects1. Wonderful ambience  2.Close to nature  3. Ecofriendlyeven toiletteries were refillable, even AC was auto off and on from time to time.  4 . The bar staff courteous and humble. 5. Dinner ,breakfast good.To Be Worked On1. Needs a lot of renovation, is still flocked for golf? and good old reputation??. 2   The pool is dangerous .one child cut his feet on the inner stairs.One pregnant woman slipped and pulled me down along. The pool bed was too too slipperry.The sides plastic covers all worn out.Showers in ladies changing room pathetic. No curtains.Really , the pool needs serious renovation.3.We ordered one dish at the club house but were charged for 3. Later we had go ourselves again to question and correct as similar order in room service was way to less in charges.4. Even in the morning breakfast we were asked by the incharge to sign a cash memo although almost every hotels have BB plan.  Later wonder what was the enlightment we were let go😆.  This showed no coordination in front office and restaurant. Ours was BB plus dinner plan though.5. No early morning pleasantries . Specially the front office seemed lost in some other world  6 .Room  service is to slow.

Great place for a family escape with good foods and services. We stayed for 2 days 2 nights with my wife, daughter and sister and we had an amazing time. Especially my daughter loved the place, as she had so much to do, including golf cart ride, horse riding, play area, swimming, etc. I was worried that food would be a problem for her as she is very choosy but to my surprise, she loved it and yes the staffs are amazing and were very prompt to address to our requests.

This is a amazing place to stay, Very large area of green, Golf course, Forest walking,  and staying at classic designed building & architecture. staff are very friendly. I was enjoying my coffee at club house is a romantic location to get top view of the golf area and forest trees.

So well known for golf and as a very popular wedding venue, the resort is a fabulous place for wildlife too. So much of the forest has been beautifully preserved and long may this last considering the pressure for housing in the surrounding area. Our 2 days here were all that we could hope for: kind efficient staff, good food and a very comfortable spacious room. After a long flight from the UK, the resort driver waiting to greet us at the airport and the further welcome at Gorkana were so appreciated. The setting is so beautiful: the well managed gardens, and the majestic trees towering over the path to the spacious golf course and lush forest. We greatly enjoyed the 1 hour forest walk, but we also loved the other small trails close to the gardens and even the wooded drive. Here in a day it would not be unusual to see over 50 species of birds and also enjoy the chital, hog deer, macaques and even martens roaming free in the grounds. The breakfast whether in the dining room or as room service was excellent. Other meals were very good value. Our very special thanks to Divas Shrestha for very prompt responses to all our e-mails, and to Bandana Silwal for her efficiency in arranging any extras for our memorable stay.

We stayed at this resort on the backend of a Trekking expedition and we were highly impressed.  Unfortunately, the resort facilities were limited due to COVID shutdowns (the pool was closed, and there were no tours of the surrounding jungle-forest) but to their credit, they kept a full staff ready to service us even though there were only five guests total in the entire resort.  Good food, great service, large, modern rooms, beautiful grounds, and interesting buildings.  Top drawer for Kathmandu.  A bit outside of Kathmandu proper, but worth the time to travel to this one-time hunting forest for the Kings of Nepal. Highly recommended.

This is a fantastic hotel resort. We were here for a couple of days following our trek and it was a perfect place to relax. It was to celebrate my fiancés birthday and the staff made it it a special place to celebrate and provided a complimentary birthday cake. The rooms are spacious and high quality. There were lots of friendly animals like deer outside our balcony. The breakfast is one of the BEST EVER! We also had an amazing couples massage and we enjoyed the facilities. The massage is lovely and we would recommend especially with the reasonable prices and spa facilities. If you are a keen golfer the golf course is great! It’s set in a forest jungle with monkeys and it’s challenging but also unusual. Me and my fiancé are golf lovers and the caddies were really helpful. We would certainly recommend a stay here.

I stayed here for 12 nights at two different times. First of all, I would like to mention the staff as that is what made the stay so special. I am endlessly astounded by  the Nepalese capacity to make you feel at home. And because I was on my own for most of it, staff went up and above to make me feel welcome. The hotel is in beautiful grounds set next to the jungle - so deer and cheeky monkeys are frequent visitors. There is a world class golf course down one end of the hotel which is quite separate from the main hotel but is a nice place to enjoy a sundowner - there is a Thai restaurant/cafe there. There is a pool and gym and spa. I had a few treatments by the wonderful Rhia. There is the main bar that does food and another restaurant too. The hotel is set away from the hubbub of the city  but it is easy to get a cab, which I did often via a local app called Pathao - though not many of the drivers speak English. You can walk in the jungle or the grounds and there is a temple down one end which you can visit. The rooms were large and though I did have a couple of problems with the AC they were quickly fixed. But what really made it for me was the warmth and kindness of the staff, right from breakfast through to dinner. I want to mention Nancy, Sujul, Razindra, Sunil, Sujam, Swastika and Sudarshan, for making me feel less of a guest and more like a guest in their home. That is the vibe of this place and it is very calm. Next time I go to Nepal this will be the place I will stay. Thank you once again to all the staff.

It was a perfect getaway from the city chaos to a calm and peaceful environment and i believe one of the main reason it was perfect would be their hospitality. They have the most welcoming and helpful staffs who will guide you through and will get you the best deals or rooms that you would want. I would like to specially thank Ms. Sabina Theeng for being helpful before and throughout our stay in Gokarna. Will definitely recommend them to my friends and family and would be more than happy to come back and again!!

Very calm- far away from the noise of the city. Kind staff- perfect rooms. The buffet was excellent- Good spa facilities. If you want to escape from the dusty and noisy city this is the best choice. In the garden you can watch Bambi and rabbits and monkeys

I have stayed in the property to celebrate our anniversary. We have stayed in one of their suite. The room size was pretty much ok but the worst experience is the temperature in the room, the air conditioning was not working properly though it’s peak Jan winter. Have called the reception at midnight and they have provided us an electric heater which was not effective at all and seems really old. Had to sleep with a lite kid in this freezing cold was the worst experience. Rest was all fine.....

Awesome property, we just cannot imagine we will get such a  huge nice property very near to Kathmandu.Their Indoor swimming pool with temperature controlled water, Jaccussi, most importantly their Golf ground is spectacular. Though access only to members, very nice to see Being a tourist from India during the wrong season (July 1st week) get stuck up in room, cannot see Mountain View due to bad weather, all these disappointments went away after we choose this property to stay back and cancelled our Pokhara trip. Actually the flight was cancelled.Children don't feel bored even though they missed the planned sight seeing outing. Enjoyed their quality time inside the property.Beware of Monkeys themselves trained enough to open the sliding glass doors. We lost our Packed fruit Juice. So kind of them as they don't touch anything else from the room.If you plan for trip to Kathmandu plan to stay here.Most importantly their Breakfast spread is too good. Kind  staff to take care of us during our stay.

I organised the wedding of my daughter in this hotel on 1st and 3rd March 2024. I am extremely happy and satisfied with the arrangement made by the hotel. it's booked residencial wedding at Gokarna Forest Resorts, our guest booked and stay in 57 rooms. All the staff, including the senior manager, ensured that our stay is comfortable. Specially Mr Rojin Sapkota especially has been excellent since the beginning of our wedding plan, he is exectionally cooperative, polite and helpful. we had arranged lunch, dinner, and B/fast in the ceremony. The quality of food and service was excellent. I have no words to express my gratitude and satisfaction for making the event successful & making our stay comfortable by the staff. I recommend this place for organising any event like marriage, birthday party, seminars etc. Once you have arranged it in this hotel, you can rest in peace as they will go out-of-way to make the event memorable and successful. All my guests appreciated the arrangement, and some of them were even enquiring about it to have their own events organised in a similar fashion in this hotel. The location of the hotel is very convenient and away from the buzz of the city. The service of the front l desk is also excellent.Thank you, Rojin ji and all staff of Gokarna Forest Resorts.Udaya Regmi

Excellent Resort. The staff are incredibly helpful and accommodating. The room was absolutely stunning. There are a variety of activities to do, such as the driving range, golf, nature walks and the swimming pool. The food was delicious. All aspects of this resort make it excellent.

We had an excellent stay at Gokarna Resort, which is situated approximately one hour drive from the city in a jungle-like beautiful forest with wildlife and surrounded by a well maintained golf course. The rooms are spacious, very clean, food is excellent and the staff extremely friendly and competent. Dont miss to take a guided walk inside the forest.

I really recommend everybody to stay at this great "Forest Resort".It has an amazing view and very kind staff.They were always welcoming us with smile , they were so cooperative , friendly and they were treating my family nicely, especially Mr. Hemant He was assisting us in breakfast time very friendly and our son loved him so much .Food is a good balance of different inspired Nepali and international tastes.  Starters and soups were excellent . Resort location is just amazing,& hotel rooms are modern, spacious and comfortable. Hotel bar and lounge is cool and super modern, good place to spend time with your family and friends

A bit old property with stains in many places. Our room smelled like urine and we had to shift to another one. Pool is indoor and heated which is good but is very slippery and not well maintained.  Food quality average.

I was there for attending a conference with some of my friends. They offer amazing and vibrant cuisine, The room was very clean and beautifully furnished with natural vibes all around. Chanting of monkeys, Indoor pool, Beautiful Garden, Golf and good amenities are the plus point at this property.

Had a wonderful stay at the resort in May 2022. Rooms are spacious and well maintained, they organise camp bed for kids. Breakfast and dinner buffet was great with a wide variety of choices. Resort has a temperature controlled swimming pool, which was a highlight for the kids. Additionally there are ample place for walk, play including a hanging bridge for kids. Tried the spa, which was excellent (rates are similar in India). One can see deers in the golf course, and we went for a guided walk in the forest.

The service was wonderful and the food buffet was deliciously prepared by professional management system.  The General Manager was helpful and very knowledgeable. Great place to take photographs for newly wed. It have an aesthetic atmosphere of nature and modern lifestyle. The golf course were very big  and well maintained.

We were delighted that the hospitality was extraordinary. The warm greetings we received when we checked in was maintained until the end of our stay. Throughout everything, service undoubtedly is top notch. We also had a great dinner at Restaurant. The scenery was amazing and all of our meals tasted so good.Temperature controlled indoor swimming pool was fantastic & we enjoyed like anything.Jungle track, golf course trails & lush green surrounding is very calm & peaceful gives you ultimate relax.Mr.Rojin Sapkota director Room division have us feel the outstanding hospitality gesture.

We stayed here for a number of weeks whilst in quarantine during abs after our Himalayan expedition. The rooms and facilities were fantastic as was the food. It’s out of town so very peaceful and a great place to relax between climbs. The staff were absolute fantastic and did everything to make us feel welcome. Sachina was brought in to care for our VIP team member and she deserves a special mention as she was amazing!! Will definitely come back and recommend to others

I am a pescetarian and I do not eat meat. It is a promise I have made. I got served meat saying it was fish for lunch. For the dinner a day earlier, I got served hardly cooked paneer. I am lactose intolerant. Hotel staff mismanaged the food order and I have to suffer. The ambience may be good but service is horrible.

Gokarna Forest Resort was a nice experience for me. Its tranquil forest location offers serenity and close to nature vibes. Staff were helpful, food good and rooms comfortable. It has some perks like a well maintained Golf course (probably one of the best in South Asia), indoor swimming pool and Jacuzzi. I can whole heartedly recommend this place for weekend retreat for couples and a family getaway.

We stayed at the Gokarna Forest Resort for 5 nights,  it is amidst nature, Gokarna Forest, away from hustle-bustle of Kathmandu city. Resort has a Golf Course amidst woods, the views of the golf course from Club house is amazing with deers roaming around.We did forest trek, played golf at practice session area( it reminded us  TOP GOLF, playing  in the woods).The Staff were polite, helpful, courteous and welcoming to us . From Front Desk to Housekeeping.The quality of the meals was good. Special mention to staff at Darbar Restaurant - Mr.Bivek Shrestha, Ms.Riya Romka, Mr.Anil Shah. Mr. Hemant Kumar Das, F & B Manager. Club House Manager.Thank you for making our stay memorable.

After driving thru Kathmandu, wishing we could unsee what we were seeing, arriving at this hotel was an unexpected and wonderful surprise!! The staff was welcoming, accommodating and very pleasant. The rooms are large, super clean and well furnished, beds/bedding ever so comfortable. There is not one negative thing I can say about this hotel, except that it was a real find!! Reading the other reviews I find shocking, as this was not our experience.  We were in the main building, third floor. (no elevators). We also stayed at the best American chain hotel in the city, but it had no local charm - cold, modern, clean. The fact that it is away from the center of town we felt a real bonus!! I would return to the hotel in a nanosecond, if I didn't have to see Kathmandu again to get there.

Situated in a very nice location- close to nature. Apart from the location, there was nothing special. The food was terrible. The service was awful. Asked for hukka- they served us what looked like a used and unhygienic hukka pot. However, the spa was really good. Thanks to the amazing staff at the spa the whole experience wasn’t so bad otherwise would  not recommend. .5/10.

This is a very special resort. Having stayed almost one month in this fabulous place I can sincerely state that every moment was an absolute joy. The staff are so kind and caring. The environment is a tranquil natural haven within a dynamic city. The food and hospitality are superb and, no request is too small.I travelled alone to a foreign place and not once did I feel alone. A seamless and incredible experience.Not for one second should anyone hesitate in staying at this resort. Experience the greatness of Nepal - captured at this very special oasis - at every single moment.

Excellent service , highly recommended. Peace and good environment for all kind of stay at this hotel. Appreciated. Staff are also good and food are also healthy and tasty very excellent environment. Every one must visit for any kind of stay at this property

I went as a part of a business trip. We set aside time for quiet reflection, and with the expansive property, this was indeed possible. Beautiful, peaceful surroundings. The room was very spacious, beautifully furnished, and clean. If you are overlooking the courtyard, it can be noisy if groups below are not monitoring their volume.

My experience was really good. Most importantly the staff I still remember her name Sabina she was really good and helpful over my stay and was taking a very good care of us. And the food and room were amazing. I really really had a good time.Very Good experience.

Clean room, friendly staff, tasty food. Breakfast was average and TV was quite small for such a spacious room. We had a great time got to see beautiful deers and rabbits early in the morning. Overall had an amazing time.

Enjoyed in such a wonderful environment. With full of positive vibes.Good hospitality with the best service available. Food was so delicious no complaints at all. Indoor swimming pool was awesome. Entire trip was so fun and memorable. Thank u gokarna resort.

The hotel has beautiful views which is away from the crowd of the city. The landscape is very beautiful. It has beautiful rooms with great service quality. The staffs here are very professional and friendly. My special thanks to Mr. Binod & Mr. Hemant who made memorable holidays and guides according to our needs.

Great hospitality, ambience.Food was amazing.Special thanks to chef Suresh Shrestha.He was assisting us in breakfast time very friendly way.Very friendly staff and peoples really made us feel comfortable.

The service was excellent and the staff made sure my son and I were comfortable. The room was comfortable, spacious and clean. This is a wonderful place for kids. I loved the Chinese and Thai restaurant. The cuisine was authentic and delicious.    We had an adventurous forest walk with the tour guide. My son loves adventures so this was a perfect experience for him. I would suggest to have more options for the breakfast buffet. Overall I had a quality time with my son.

Great stay overall. But the spa was a big disappointment. Hot tub wasnt hot..not even mildly lukewarm, they told us it was being renovated but i doubt that was the case. Pool was very cold. Came for the hot tub and spa and was disappointed. Great breakfast and great property and environmentally friendly.

Food and ambience was up to mark.Awesome property, clean and peaceful environment.All staff were humble with us.Everything was beyond our expectations.We really enjoyed our stay at Gokarna Forest Resort.We will definitely go back for another visit and we will definitely recommend our friends and family to visit this resort.

A relaxing refuge from the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu, but close enough to all the sights by taxi.  It was a restful interlude before and after our Himalayan trek.  The food was excellent and there was a great drink selection.  The staff was welcoming, knowledgeable, responsive, and helpful.  The facilities were well maintained, and the grounds provided nice views and walks.

Excellent service by front office ,House keeping, F&B staff. Clean, comfortable, cozy rooms. Beautiful surrounding blessed with nature & Golf Course. Well equipped Gym, swimming pool & spa facilities.

Beautiful location with a natural park and golf course.The bhodhi tree in Little Buddha movie was located there.service is four star with gentleness and helpfullness.the spa could use upgrading.Will return to stay for a week next time in Kathmandu

Food was great and Harmony Spa is great and room is great too. It would be great if you could sell the Buddha book that is in every room. I didn't get time to read for 1 night. At day time we had conference. Jungle walk was amazing.

Great experience here. Rooms very large. Huge variety of foods and great options for seating either outside or inside. Nice meeting rooms, pool, and outdoor areas. Staff was all extremely friendly and helpful. They had a nice crib for us to use for the baby. Room was a little musty smelling but other than that, loved our time here!

The customer service was very good . We had an excellent experience staying here . Totally refreshed and had good time with nature . The facilities provided here is worth taking . We are grateful for your wonderful adventure and wonderful company.

The resort is absolutely beautiful! A getaway from the hustle and bustle of the big city but not too far of a drive. The staff is always friendly and accommodating. The rooms are spacious and fully stocked. The only con is the property doesn’t have an elevator. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

Wonderful resort in the beautiful forest. The king size bedroom was very comfortable and spacious. Sabina was very kind and helpful. She helped us set up a forest walk and helped us get settled into our room. There is a big temperature controlled pool and a playground for kiddos too. Great place!

Really a A class hotel.Amazing staff and facilities. So many things to do in and around the hotel. There is something for everyone, wether be kids or adults.Will be back. I highly recommend this hotel for anyone coming to Kathmandu.

This is the perfect place with local culture and design with international amenities. We liked that the resort feels like you are away in a forest area but too far from the city if you want the city-life experience. The food was great. Spa was amazing! Staff was exceptional.  Don’t think twice - book this spot!  We will definitely go back for another visit

It is surrounded by forestHaven for golf players. The golf course is a challenge with undulating land. The Resort is comfortable to stay in, the staff is caring and efficient.You should go in a group. Stay for 2-3 days.Basically it has to be a golf holiday.The local food is delicious.

Spacious room. More on the basic side but with some character. Friendly and helpful staff. Good facilities in general and good dinner / breakfast buffet. Internet was very slow. Apart from this it was a nice resort to stay.

It was really a breathtaking view at the Resort, Delicious Food, amazing Hospitality, very friendly staff. Jungle style Stay was truly mind blowing and truly satisfying. Highly recommend to professionals and family for relaxing vacations.

Had a half decent experience. Went there thinking about bird photography but the staffs rudely prohibited taking photos from DSLR, however mobile photography was allowed. Also, the advertisement board proudly said bird watching as one of the activities. The first time I've been to such a place. Last time ever visiting this place.

Would definitely avoid.Recently stayed at the Gokarna Forest resort, had 2 separate nights booked but due to the poor service received I cancelled the second. I arrived to no hot water in my room, after 2 hours of excuses I was finally moved rooms, simple solution to the problem but yet it took over 2 hours of complaining to achieve this. I spoke to the duty manager who took no active involvement in the situation which was very disappointing.Also I ate at the golf club Thai restaurant. Very poor food and atmosphere.

Last weekend, we spent a night at Gokarna as a quick getaway from the city. Because of the good reputation that Gokarna has had in the past, we were really excited about our night's stay. We got there around 3:30pm which is pretty much past check-in time but we  still had to wait for about 30 mins. We were then informed that one of the two rooms we had booked was ready. The late check-in wasn't a problem, but after all that wait we asked if they could let us check-us out late too they said we'd have to check out by 12, which didn't really make sense. So after making us wait, giving us only one room, and telling us we'd have to check out by 12:00, we were politely told that we'd have to pay for the room first. That kind of killed our weekend mood but we thought it would get better. The fridge wasn't working and the door wouldn't shut either and they sent their housekeeping team to have it fixed but it wasn't fixable. We expected to be moved to another room since a sign in the room said "shut doors at all times to avoid monkeys" and our door couldn't be locked at all, but nothing. Dinner was okay, and so was breakfast since they were missing some of the basics. On the good side, the pool was very clean and the pool area staff were helpful. The highlight of the stay, was that there were deer right outside our door in the morning which was pretty awesome! On the whole though, their service has a lot of room for improvement. If they get their act together right away, they could still do great!

This hotel doesn't come close to a five star property or even a four star. Better to classify it as a two star hotel where the wedding parties go on till midnight will five speakers blasting music right below your ears. The gokarna of 15 years ago where it used to be the hangout place for the royals and the gokarna of today are completely different. The food sucks. The staff are always sulking. If u are a Nepali and stay in at the hotel, be sure to get mistreated ( they have the mentality of "how on earth do you expect us to cater to a Nepali "), however, if you are white, they will treat you like god. In other words, it sucks. Never again!!

1. No open spaces or green spaces for anything you might want to do ...Literally not even 50m space for a night walk...forget that its a jungle lodge...there is no open space where you can go 2. Staff's attitude is pathetic...they act as if they are all from the Royal family in Nepal and are doing you a great favor by talking to you...on top of that none of them are smart or resourceful so you might be better off banging your head to a wall rather than talking to them3. Have you ever been stranded on an Island and were forced to survive off scraps for a full day labor? I hope you dont go here because that is what i had to suffer through 'water' daal and stale food in their thoroughly overpriced restaurant.4. Tranquility - :) You cant imagine the betrayal i felt once we arrived here. Advertised as a serine and peaceful place...i found almost 200 vehicles parked in front of my room window, with the only accessible lawn covered with chairs and a whole party of people (not residential guests). On top of this, there was someone crying on the microphone till late. It is a blasphemy calling this a jungle lodgeI am still on my 1st day here and have already been regretting each minute of it. I will get back to completing this review with more once i get back home and away from this torture.

Disappointing. The building itself has potential, but it’s in disrepair.  Buckets underneath the sinks in the public restrooms (rather than the management repairing the plumbing).  Paint splattered on the walls.  Complete disregard for finish and detail - and upkeep.  Without a management change, this hotel is doomed.  The grounds are beautiful, the pool area is scary. Staff is friendly and helpful.  Rooms were not dirty, but they weren’t great.  Water temperature in the shower is inconsistent…..it will run cold to scalding hot on its own.  When in a country like Nepal, being comfortable in your room is important.  Note about the restaurant:  breakfast buffet wasn’t that great and the staff left all the plates on the tables, so there was leftover food everywhere.  Look elsewhere.

We were in Kathmandu for a wedding and due to the Turkish Airlines' mishap, arrived at various dates. The staff at Gokarna, from the bell-hop to the Guest Manager, Tashi, could not have been more helpful and empathetic in all aspects of our stay. We had 3 members of staff help us dress in sarees. When my husband and I asked to swop rooms so we could have more space (especially drawer space - we were carrying a lot of clothes), not only did they upgrade us, but they actively suggested  a room on the ground floor, after seeing the difficulty my husband had with stairs. The breakfasts were delicious, though it paid to arrive before the ravenous Chinese tour groups. Other meals were good and had a wide selection of food types, The rooms were spacious and comfortable, though we could have done with stronger reading lights. Others in our party who had massages in the spa claimed they were the best ever.  It was, overall, a warm and very satisfying stay.The one, small negative, was the wifi, which was only free in the lounge and verandah area.

Despite the above descriptors, it was not perfect.  I had a beautiful spacious room both times, I was there both before and after the EBC trek.  The food, pool, bar, massage, and the grounds were all exceptional.  Nepal is a land of have-nots, where poverty is the greatest problem facing their society. Unfortunately, at some point during my trek, or likely right as I was checking out....  my credit card's security was not maintained.  Just after my departure, there were fraudulent charges from Manchester, UK RentalCars.com on all the cards that were left in the hotel (un)"safe" during my trek.  I have since replaced all the cards.  Otherwise this hotel was a wonderful respite from the bad air and noise of inner-city Kathmandu.  Be careful with your valuables.Apart from the above-mentioned disappointment, my rating would have been EXCELLENT.

We got impressed from our first stay to decided to stay there second time to. This time we have worst expression.  We wait for 15 min after checkin to get our luggage in room. We order coffee in morning , it took 1 hour to get that in room. During breakfast they dont server coffee & water to our table. We pissed of & left the breakfast . We did checkout one day before date because of their services. After the checkout while leaving the room they stop to step out for 30 min because they have doughty that we didnt pay the bill. We had already paid the bill 2 hour before the checkout time. Even we have 500 rupees as trip beside the services charged. While we checkout the reception has been changed. Someone took the shift.  She even didn't speak softly. We totally piseoff this time with their services.

We stayed here for three nights after a trek and having already explored KTM centre, we were looking forward to the retreat. The room was great, spacious and well decorated with a lovely terrace. The staff were lovely - a warming welcome to the hotel. The kettle didn't work (which we needed to heat our baby's milk) which on its own was minor. The terrace had a ropey old table a chairs, which probably would cost little to replace. I did a yoga class, which oddly was held in and around the gym equipment on dirty and old mats, which again, would not have cost much to replace I'm sure. The pool area is tired and moldy, the walls need seeing to. The spa staff had left their uniform strewn across the changing rooms.My spa experience was terrible, I opted for a foot massage and a neck massage as I am pregnant. They did the foot massage on a waiting room wicker chair in the hair salon?! This was most uncomfortable and I had to ask for cushions and for the lights to be turned off. Before the neck massage I asked if I could have a treatment room, which she said OK (there was a perfectly nice chair in there that could have been used for the foot massage).The food was very poor, however this was fairly in line with most we'd had in Nepal - anything outside vegetable curry was questionable.On our trip we had stayed in accommodation from the most basic (in the mountains) to what was supposed to be high end. This fell well below international standards, which is fine given we are in Nepal. But what is not OK, is that international prices are charged - this was disproportionate to the hospitality offered.At check out, they had got the bill wrong in a monumental way - overcharging for some items and undercharging for others, each time making up a different excuse as to why. In the end we settled roughly what we thought it was since we had a flight to catch and wanted to get out of there.Sadly, as my first negative review of anywhere, we would not recommend and would not go back. Thanks.

My boyfriend and I spend our last days of our holiday at Gokarna. For us it was the perfect hotel/resort, because we just came back from a trekking and we wanted to stay in a luxury, quite place. Gokarna had super nice staf, the hotel was clean, the facilities were great (swimming pool, fitness, sauna, spa, beauty saloon etc). I will definitely recommend this place if you don't want to stay in the hectic centre of Kathmandu.

Luxury, Old World Charm, First Class Service, a great sleep, top food, peaceful surrounds, the ever graceful Sabeena to welcome guests plus a golf course! Could any traveller want any more. We will be back.

I had just ended my 2hrs horse riding trekking at Gokarna Forest Resort and I have to inform you that it was one of the worst riding experience I ever had. I love horses and I have rode in places like Malaysia, Scotland, Indonesia and another part of Nepal, Pokhara. All the places I went the guides were very nice and friendly and brought me to scenic routes. However for this place, I do understand there is a little language barrier, but the guides barely spoke to us. We asked for the forest trail but was instead brought out to walk a different route. A route that didnt have much to see and was extremely disappointing. To end it of, the guides were unsure of the way back and we kept going the wrong way. I couldnt be happier when the ride ended. I do not encourage anyone to do the 2hr ride, because the amount you pay is really not worth the experience.

We went for lunch in one of the Chinese/ Thai restaurant. The price was expensive and we knew it and we also expected good service and food. First the food is horrible, extra hot food was bland. Rice was dry and ugly. The meat was ugly. I have never tasted such a horrible thai green curry in my whole life.I have never eaten such a horrible food anywhere in Kathmandu and also never paid so much. Its totally unworthy of price. Its not allowed to walk anywhere.There was barbecue or something going on, it was so crowded and not peaceful at all. My advice, do not go!!! you will regret.

Another hotel recommended by Ker & Downey and well worth the visit.  We were there for 4 nights as a party of 6 and all enjoyed it. Two of us played golf on their splendid course reputed to be the best in Nepal.  The rooms are good and the food is good and well priced. Reception are helpful and Lasta their events manager looked after us very well organising trips, buses etc.Monkeys everywhere and on the golf course one has monkeys and deer wondering around which gives it a lovely setting.Only downside was the distance from the hotel to the centre of Kathmandu about 30 minutes.

Had an absolutely amazing experience at this beautiful resort. Not only is the property just great the hospitality was also very good. Highly recommend this place to everyone!!The golf course is an added incentive. Just sit back and relax.

Thank you so much for making our wedding day so beatiful and amazing. We absolutely enjoyed the cooperation given by the whole team of Gokarna Forest Resort.Thank you also for taking care of our guests from all over the world so brilliantly. We are absolutely delighted to have chosen this hotel as our wedding venue.

We stayed for 2 nights at the hotel. The property is beautifully tucked away in the forest. We checked in by a friendly lady named Lasta. She upgraded us to the club room which was a very spacious gorgeous room. She provided us with a complimentary wifi 24 hour wifi pass. There is only free wifi at the reception and bar. She also gave us a complimentary pass for the jacuzzi, steam and sauna area. They have an indoor pool and it is free to use and you dont need to pay for that.There is a large golf course area and if you are into golf you would love it. The nature walk was really nice and peaceful. The weather was lovely too for the walk.They have a couple of nice restaurants.  We pre booked the hunters lodge for dinner. It was a 6 course Nepali meal. We were hosted by a very friendly Nepali man who explained every course and also made sure we were comfortable through out. The restaurant however needs a couple of fans due to mosquitoes and it was a little hot too. And some soft music in the background would help too.Being the forest you would think they would have a couple of animals (which would have been nice) however they have just 2 deers tucked away in a corner. The wild monkeys keep jumping around the property especially when they smell food but they have dedicated staff hunting them away. There wasnt too many anyway.The last day we visited the spa and had a couples full body massage. It was nice.

This resort is beautiful and all the staff/service was exceptional EXCEPT for some of the FRONT desk staff. My husband and I booked our hotel/ flight via Expedia, as we normally do every time we travel which is 4-5 times a year. This hotel was going to be our home for 6 days and since we didn't receive a tour of the grounds (where the restaurants/ swimming pool/ business lounge/ golf course etc are located) I went downstairs and asked for one. Immediately a couple of the front desk staff started talking/ mocking the fact that we booked thru expedia not realizing I overheard them. Then they proceeded to tell me they don't provide one, but that if I wanted to purchase a tour I could (fyi. I am not referring to the forest walk nor the gold course ride). I also noticed that every time somebody checked in at the hotel, they were served a drink, which we were never. Another incident was when we were catching a shuttle into the city (leaves at 10:30 am). I was downstairs by 10:33, however by 10:30 I had already received 4 calls from the front desk. I apologized to the front desk that I was late but first of all why rush somebody and guilt them when they're on vacation over a 3 minute delay and not only that, why LIE about other guests complaining I was those 3 minutes late (When I got in the shuttle, I quickly apologized and asked if they were upset and they confirmed that none of them had breathed a word). Bottom line is, if you book through expedia or hot-wire don't expect to be treated like the rest of the guests. I did save a little under $20 a night but it wasn't worth the belittling and mockery we received by the front desk staff those 6 nights!! On a good note- on my last night and after I mentioned I'd be writing a review of the hotel, we were taken on a gold course ride.

Once a classy retreat from Kathmandu city, now a bit dated and not well maintained. The carpets and Windows are dirty. The food quality is average. The rooms are large, but again poorly maintained. The bedding is is old and the quality worse than a tea house. The hotel grounds have pretty gardens.Overall, needs improvement.

Loved this place. It was the last couple of nights after trip round the Kathmandu valley and Tibet, so it was great to relax for a couple of days. If you wanted to see the sights, although the hotel is only a few miles into the city, the traffic is so bad it takes a while (although there is a free shuttle that runs a couple of times a day). However, it was perfect for us. The room was huge and beautiful, breakfast was great. The grounds are lovely and we saw deer and monkeys. You can't walk by yourself in the forest unfortunately, but have to book a guide. Food and drink was excellent, even if more expensive than in the centre of town (which is probably to be expected). Service was excellent - there was always someone on hand to help but never felt fussy or over-powering. Throughly recommended for relaxation.

I along with my few golfer friends visited this beautiful amidst nature resort. It's very nicely maintained and playing golf here is real fun..Rooms are comfortable, reasonable in price and food served here is very tasteful.Spa services are good and after a hard day at golf, going here is very soothing.Overall strongly recommended if you mix golf with fun...

This hotel is so out of Kathmandu city. Went there on a Saturday which is a public holiday with little traffic and by the time I reached the here I was already worried about returning back to the city. The pool is dirty and I the food is so oily and everything fried. The staff need training. Never recommending it to anyone or coming again. Stay away.

This is a real resort holiday and an escape form the hustle and bustle of busy and congested Kathmandu.  A wonderful place to unwind and relax for a few days after a busy holiday in Nepal.  The staff are attentive, friendly and provide outstanding service.  The facilities are excellent with a 18 hole golf course accessible in the grounds and some walking tracks, although you have to pay for a guide to go with you for safety (animals) reasons.  An excellent day spa is on site.  Although this is a five star facility costs are reasonable compared to AUD facilities of a similar standard.Would recommend a stay if you are going to Nepal.

A clean, comfortable and safe resort in Kathmandu. Does not get five stars because of the distance to the town centre, which can be a hassle depending on which attractions you want to see and how many days you have. On the other hand, the quiet natural surroundings provide a relaxing break after a day in this bustling town.The hotel provides a free shuttle to/from the Thamel, at fixed times. Restaurant and bar are great, however we do  not recommend the forest tour.

Tough experience and largely disappointed. Food poisoning from dinner; very unhelpful and did not follow up. Lack of coordination and poor communications with staff became an issue. Would advise to stay away.

I have stayed and reviewed this place before. In the 4 years I stayed here consecutively, things haven't developed for the better. Given the fact that it's winter time, and even though heating is not considered standard in Nepal, in a hotel of this allure, one would expect to find at least a working heater and hot water.Only after several calls and reminders (I notified the staff before leaving the hotel for a round of meetings - when I came back in the afternoon, it still wasn't fixed). Ultimately some strong words and calls made by some influential local businessmen were needed to get things moving. All of us in the group had the same issues. Some had no water at all, others only had cold water and asked for a new room but ended up having the same problem, others had water but no heating.As we were visiting a conference with attendees coming from around the globe, the management should have done a proper test that everything is working, as some of us had exactly the same issues last year. Whilst I can understand that due to the infrastructure in Nepal there are sometimes power and water cuts, a hotel of this size and profile should have contingency plans for this - which they clearly don't. The staff seemed lost with the tasks given.When a hot shower then finally was possible, the water was spraying everywhere and it was impossible to keep the bathroom reasonably dry. The staff's tip to get hot water was to "let the water drain for 10 minutes". That goes really well with the hotel's eco message to save water!!Lastly, I had pre-booked a private car transfer to the airport (and not the van, even if that would be a bit cheaper). The hotel then tries to make you share a car with others, but obviously cashing in on the full fare from everyone!On next year's conference, I'd rather stay somewhere in town and take the burden of Kathmandu traffic, rather than to having to face the inefficiency and annoyance of staying here.

The rooms were huge and great. The bathroom was awesome, that shower was the best shower ever, and it can turn into a tub as well. The resort is kept in a very clean state however, the amenities are not what they seem in the pictures. The place is a little outdated and needs some sprucing up. I was a little disappointment with the amenities offered considering the place was a good way away from the city or anything else. Also no in house pharmacy that you could buy things from. The staff was lovely and very attentive. The food was quite good, but it would be nice with more variety. I'm surprised the bar had the same menu as the restaurant. It was a nice break away after doing the Everest base camp trek regardless.

We went to this place after hearing great recommendations. But was disappointed the from the minute we reached there. We had to wait for hours before we got our room (booked 2 days prior) and the restaurant refused to serve anything except drinks. While we waited, few other customers were served food and when we asked, they said the kitchen closed again. We literally had to shout before they accepted our order. After that too they served the raw food. The staff were not sorry about the delay but kept saying it was usual stuff on Saturday. I was particularly irritated by the manager, who was not willing to listen anything. After multiple requests we got the room more than 2 hours late and they said it was because of the large group from previous day.They offered us an additional discount on other facilities after we asked them how they could make our experience better. After we got the room, it was pretty usual. The hotel is located in a beautiful place and there are various activities to participate in, which made the rest of the stay memorable. The hotel has lots of group bookings as we saw and they give priority to these groups and foreigners (as we saw). So if you are going there in small number or you are a local, be sure to ask how busy they are !

Gokarna  Forest Resort is an excellent hotel in a peaceful location. Its the 3rd time I have been here with my girlfriend and will definitely visit in the future! The beautiful flowers and greenery offer a warm welcome at the first place.The staff are friendly and cooperative.Thanks to Tashi dolma. The rooms are clean and comfy.The food is yum(we enjoyed a nice Nepali dish at Hunter's  last time). Golf and pony ride are amongst the activities my girl and I never miss at Gokarna! Enjoy the golf cart and don't miss the opportunity to see the deer right in front of you!!!Above all the location is so peaceful and full of nature! I wanna hear the birds again :)Simply the best hotel in Kathmandu!

Gokarna Forest Resort is about 45 minutes drive from central Kathmandu.  So when you stay there, it is calm and quiet, not noisy like all the hotels in the city.  The staff is very attentive, breakfast buffet is extensive, and the gift shop there is very large and has reasonable prices and a very nice staff that is sincerely interested in helping you to find the right gifts.  We ate one night at the hunting lodge (reservations required) and the meal was SPECTACULAR, both in presentation and taste.  It was a traditional Nepalese meal.  Rooms were large and comfortable.  It was fun walking around in the early morning, seeing the Rhesus Monkeys coming out for the day.  Yoga sessions were well presented, at 0730 each day.  Spa offerings were very good, and relaxing.  I would gladly stay here again.

One of the best places we have stayed as time share. Location is a bit out of town but going there provides a good picture of what Nepal is as a country. The roads there can be bad but that is Nepal! Once you get into the gate, it is a whole new experience! A world away from the noise and dust, almost like a sanctuary! Very green in here and the facilities are excellent albeit a bit on the pricey side.Free Wifi is only available in public areas. Our room was very spacious and it overlooks the main courtyard. It had a balcony but beware of the monkeys who are your regular visitors. Nice to see them from inside the room. In the morning, one can hear the birds. And there are two inhouse spotted deers in the garden. We enjoyed our room, with a huge ensuite.The staff is most attentive, friendly and we could not fault the service.The hotel itself is very pleasant and beautifully decorated. One day we had to stay in and took the opportunity to walk all the corridors and enjoy the numerous photographs. Almost like an art gallery.The only setback is transport is expensive if you want to get into the various tourist spots. Luckily there is a free shuttle to and from the hotel although the time can be a constraint. It operates at 10.30am and return is at 4.30pm. Also make sure if you are returning by taxi, that the driver knows exactly where Gokarna Forest Resort is before you agree to hop in.

Gokarna is a serene getaway nestled in a beautifully wooded setting near the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu. Very nice accommodations. The rooms were spacious with nice amenities (a lockable safe, mini-fridge, microwave and good storage space). They were clean and comfortable and offered a nice, cool respite at the end of a long day of activity.We didn't take advantage of all of the extras (golf, spa, etc...) but the well maintained grounds and beautiful setting were very enjoyable. The pool, walking paths, and scenic setting make Gokarna a relaxing place for families!Free wifi available only in the downstairs courtyard area (router in the 8848 mt. Bar). Otherwise, inexpensive pay packages are available for in-room wi-fi. The customer service is excellent! Each and every staff member (regardless of position) from housekeeping to kitchen staff to security were incredibly friendly and service oriented! The staff make this place!

Really nice resort - friendly staff, clean room and facilities. Lovely food options in the restaurants, and the buffet breakfast was amazing. Expensive, but for the location and ambience it's to be expected.Really nice indoor heated swimming pool, jaccuzi, sauna and steam room - and lockers/showers - all available free for guests.Disappointing that you cannot walk much on the grounds without paying extra to go hiking on trails with a guide. If you want to walk on your own without paying for a guide, you can walk up and down the driveway to the main road and back, or around the parking lot, or to the golf clubhouse - woohoo! This was the biggest disappointment when we stayed.

I spent one night here at the end of a tour and wish I could have stayed for more. By the time we got there (with KTM traffic being what it is!) we only had a little time before sunset to explore the grounds. Dinner was included and the food was excellent! There is a mixture of cuisines on the menu- something for everyone. Drinks are a bit expensive, but this is a resort, after all! Breakfast was a buffet with a huge selection of choices - very delicious! Probably the best coffee I had on my trip!We also had a free 30-minute massage included in our package. It was very welcomed after 9 days of activity! The massage therapist was thorough and definitely worked out the kinks i my shoulders!We got to see deer, monkeys and lots of birds on the grounds, which are gorgeous!The room was huge! The bed could have fit 4 people! it was very comfortable! There is a kettle and tea/coffee. The tv had a wide selection of channels, and the wi-fi was the strongest I had in Nepal. The shower is hot and strong. I loved the shampoo they offer! The staff was terrific- very welcoming and attentive!

The premier room we stayed in was huge with high ceilings. But the tv was tiny. It was amazing to see rabbits, monkeys & deers roaming right outside our porch. The minibar was locked & had to call someone to open them. I find that wierd & inconvenient. Room service was on point especially the tenderloin burger. The spa felt bit dated and pool lackluster. The buffet breakfast was okay with very limited options. Apparently the SAARC athletes were also staying here & refills took some time. Transportation to boudha was was steep @Rs800. It’s a nice hotel if you’re more into golfing or nature. It wasn’t my style or cup of tea.

Beautiful setting. Luxurious room and bathroom with ultra luxurious toiletries. Unfortunately we didn't have a lot time to explore the hotel, we only had one evening meal here, our other evening meal was in a local restaurant where we met a Sherpa. Breakfast good. Staff very friendly. Thank you for the lovely cake delivered to our room for our 45th wedding anniversary.

A great way to end our holiday - after trekking to Base Camp we wanted a quiet retreat to rest and recover for a few days.  Gokarna was perfect.  Service was excellent and the spa treatments were amazing and much needed!  Rooms were spacious and the grounds were huge.  It's a peaceful retreat away from the hussle of Kathmandu.

A calm and relaxing oasis to retire to - very stark contrast to the hub bub and pot holes that are Kathmandu. Traditional style ex royal hunting lodge with an estate full of monkeys,deer and birds that have free reign, Service within the hotel is extremely attentive, and the food / rooms are likewise in keeping with the standard you might expect if you were looking for that contrast away from the bustle.We stayed as part of a wider tour but the venue works as a separate hotel to explore Kathmandu.

Very nice built hotel, rooms are cozy, hotel was all wooden, outdoor space was very nice, there is a golf course, and swimming pool and whatever, somehow, you ask for is available, very clean air, and the hotel is situated in the middle of the forest where some animals wander, like deer, monkeys, make sure you close your windows, actual travel date was march 2018

We stayed for 1 night only at Gorkana Forest resort at the end of a 3 week trip . The hotel , although only 7 kms from the airport , is accessible only over some very rough and potholed roads, so travel time needs to be factored into the equation when staying here. However, once you arrive , the setting among the greenery of the forest is very pretty. The hotel itself is stately- like an old colonial establishment . Our room was quite large and comfortable, the bed huge and the bathroom a little old and worn but serviceable. The bed in fact was probably too big for the bed covers on it- 2 quilts  European style may have been more effective .  There was a Holi day music festival being held on the driving range of the hotel when we arrived which was unfortunately rather loud, but we did sit and have a snack - delectable MoMo's and some french fries - and a beer at the bar mid afternoon which was pleasant if you ignored the music.Dinner and breakfast was included in our stay. Both were buffet style and although tasty enough , not fantastic. I had a massage in the early evening  as well. The massage was excellent, the young lady providing the massage very pleasant and competent, but the massage room was near the indoor swimming pool, which at that time was full and very noisy, so unfortunately it wasn't as relaxing as it could have been. I can understand the pool being inside, due to the monkeys that roam the property, but it does mean that the pool is not particularly relaxing if lots of people are there because of the noise level.My husband and I would have liked have been able to go for a walk in the forest, but you can only do this with a guide, and after spending the last 3 weeks doing guided tours, we would have just liked to have gone on our own. Gorkana Resort is a very pleasant stay in a pretty setting but not 5 star , probably 4 in my opinion.

Recently stayed here after a trekking adventure , this place was organised by luxury escapes and Himalayan social journey as a first class retreat at the end of the trip , this place is definitely 5 star , the greetings from was excellent , the accommodation was first class , the spa was very good ,the food in restaurants was excellent , I recommend for dinner their specialty pea and corn pie , delicious , I can still taste it ,the resort was very accommodating , in allowing a late checkout and allowing use of facilities as had a late night flight , I highly recommend this 5 star resort and if you are lucky you will see some tame monkeys

Gokarna gives a feel of being The Place to be maybe 10-15 years ago. Current rates are not really justified by the quality you get in return. Staff is very very friendly and helpful, however could probably be more attentive and better trained. Stay in general was good, except the unexplained downgrade upon arrival.Location: the hotel is located on the outskirts of Kathmandu, ~45 minute ride to the city center. Get prepared for a bumpy ride :) place itself (as in nature) is spectacular, as one would expect from a forest resort and from Nepal. The hotel building, however, could use some fresh up works.Rooms & cleanliness: bathroom was clean and extremely spacious - you can probably dance ballet in there. :) room itself is also generally clean, however, if you touch the floor around the room, it's covered with a thick layer of dust. Doesn't seem like anyone has vacuumed/wiped the floors for a while. Corridor floors also looked very dirty and tired, as much as the table covers at the buffet serving in the restaurant.We are both allergic to dust and were waking up with our faces twice as big as when went to sleep. Staff: thanks to all the staff who made our stay better. They are genuinely trying to be very helpful. However, one of the biggest issues was when were settled into a lower room type, when I have carefully chosen thw room type we wanted to stay in. Not only no explanation given and no apology extended at any point druing our stay, but on top of that one of the gentlemen from the front desk was trying to convince us it was the room type booked, qlthough the rooms was almost twice as small and had different furnishing and location. On the day were leaving, they also forgot to book our transportation, although we have informed them the night before. We almost missed out bus - not a very nice ending to the stay. However, after some talk, at least they were understanding enough to cancel our last night free of charge.Food: really nothing special. We tried 8848 bar first, ordered beef tenderloin and were informed 15 minutes after the order was made, that the dish was not available. We also ordered greek salad, and received something strange without a trace of cheese. Manager apologised and told us the kitchen didn't have feta cheese. Overall, it took them around 2 hours to serve the main course. Brealfast is okay - you can find something to eat in the buffet and live egg station can make fresh eggs the way you like them. Considering the quality of food in all the restaurants, though, I would say it is really overpriced at the low quality delivered.Activities: they offer a forest walk, horse riding, spa and yoga. We tried the latter two. Spa smelled a bit strange and didn't look 100% clean, but we gave it a benefit of doubt. Ladies did a good job, with a slight disregard to the extreme pressure they were putting to work, although we asked not to. Yoga session was one of the best we have ever tried and was on the rooftoo of the spa building. However, their mats were extremely old and dirty. We understand if you want to keep a touch of authenticity, but not at the cost of cleanliness and general hygiene.

The Gokarna resort was a wonderful place to stay in dusty Kathmandu.  This was our second visit and we were treated like old friends.  The staff are personable and helpful at evey turn, the rooms are speacious and the food is delicious.  The amentities are top notch.  We thought the breakfasts were the best of our tour in Nepal.  We welcome the chance to return in the future.

Staying in Gokarna Forest Resort was a great experience.  The location was great. Service quality, food, room.. everything were excellent.  Special thanks to  the staff of the resort for their warm welcome and service which made our stay more memorable.

Their hotel is in the forest jungle and the air is clean unlike the heavier pollution in most of Kathmandu. The staff bend over backwards to be friendly and serve your every need and request. You get to see monkeys and deer on the golf course. It promotes that it is only 5 miles from the city center. That would seem like no big deal and this is the only reason I rated this place 3 stars.
