The location is a bout 20-25mins without traffic from the airport and anywhere up to 1.5hrs in traffic but that’s Kathmandu for you.

Being a resort, this place is not offical 5* and it's a sold 4*. We couldn't get hot water in our room, so they moved us for our second night into a bigger room with a lovely 'Japanese' bath. Food was good and the second night we ate in the bar.Same food, but  much better surroundings. The early morning walk into the forest was nice, though few birds.

Our team had good time at Gokarna Forest Resort. The staffs are friendly and trust worthy. We like the bar and staffs are friendly and  helpful. I think when we go back we'll stay there again in the future.

Best location. Cool and peace. But survice provided by the hotel is not satisfactory. Muddy water, dirty bath tubs. No dental kit available at bathroom.too much chemical in swimming pool.Slow internet connection

I had a very relaxing stay in Gokarna Forest Resort.The rooms were very comfortable, clean and quiet. The environment is very nice. I had a nice walk in the forest that I really enjoyed. The spa is very high quality as well and I loved the massages.

The best location out of hectic city, very peaceful place with jungle all around. Unique facilities like golf course and horse riding seperates it from other resorts. Food was very good and temperature controlled pool was a great way to relax even during winter. Best of all is super friendly and polite staffs.

My wife and I found the resort very nice and staff eager to help. Some of the tilework in our bathroom was chipped and cracked however in the main the rooms were well kept,  large and expansive.  We had a large grassed area outside our room and it was great to see  spotted deer and monkeys roaming around.

This resort is just beautiful, spacious and a golfer's paradise.  Unfortunately we didn't have time to enjoy all the resort offers but hope to again one day.It is a little "out of town" so do all your souvenir shopping before or after, as no shops in the near vicinity.

I prefer this place as my first choice. Very safe, peaceful, pleasant, hygienic & enjoyable. I am a proud customer visiting for last 12 years with family & friends. Excellent Excellent & excellentJay Nepal

A Set in lovely surroundings away from the hustle and bustle this is a welcome retreat from the mayhem of Kathmandu.  Quiet environment with attentive staff make Gokarna Forest Resort the perfect place to chill out particularly before and after a trekking holiday. Our rooms on both occasions were very generous in size and well appointed.  They were also very quiet with good blackout. We would not hesitate to recommend it as a place to stay, the staff were all very helpful and were always very happy to help in any way they could.  Requests were dealt with promptly.

Gokarna is a real gem. One is costantly looking for quiet retreats in the heart of nature and its often difficult to find an option which ticks all the boxes!!The resort is quiet, tastefully done up, very comfortable with great hospitality, service and wine and food. All so important.I have already highly recommended this to my friends and family....its really worth it.And so easy to get to.40 mins drive from kathmandu airport.

Property is good with warm staff. We visited during dashain holiday so lots of activities were not available. Food is good. Rooms are clean and big. they have indoor swimming pool. Water is fine but the floors are very slippery. I think it needs better cleaning.

Prior to our 16 day trek to Gokyo Lakes and Everest Base Camp, we spent a couple of nights in Thamel to experience the 'real'Kathmandu. However, after our trek we were just looking for a place to chill out, relax and be away from the hustle and bustle of it all, and Gokarna was perfect for this type of experience. The premises is massive, set on acres of beautiful forest, with (what looked like) a very nice golf course, indoor pool, spa, sauna, Jacuzzi and a couple of very nice restaurants. Everything is always very clean but what really makes this place is the staff- they always ask if you are enjoying your stay and check to make sure you are happy with everything. If you are looking for a place to escape, Gokarna is a great option.

Excellent Stay. Friendly staff, Facility is great for children. Value for money too.Food and service is exceptional.Property is well built and maintained. Suggest airport pickup and drop be included as on day one you feel better with this.

We stayed here for 3 nights after our 12 day trek. Staff was exceptional! Very friendly and approachable. My boyfriend had a cold and they offered us medication for him. Room itself was much larger than expected and very clean. Hotel had lots of amenities! They offer a free shuttle into town, golf range on site, spa services at a very reasonable cost, and nature walk with a guide on site. Never a dull moment! Highly recommend!

We loved our final 2 night stay in Nepal at the Gokarna Forest Resort.  The peace and serenity was so relaxing after 14 days of trekking and sightseeing.  Our room was huge and very clean and comfortable and the service throughout the hotel was friendly and helpful.  A fantastic place to stay.

My boys and I had a lovely relaxing time at Gorkana  after doing an Everest Base Camp Trek. The rooms are lovely and clean (we stayed in a premier room). The food at both restaurants was grea, the staff are all lovely and very helpful. We found it to be quite good value for money.

Our stay at Gokarna Forest Resort certainly exceeded our expectations. It was a welcome source of peace and relaxation after a hectic day touring bustling Kathmandu. The golf course is stunning as is the grounds and forest - to see so much wildlife so close up and in a completely natural setting was an absolute  privilege. The rooms were large and very comfortable and all the staff could not have been more courteous and helpful.  All our meals were delicious - especially our farewell dinner in the Durbar restaurant where the manager and staff ensured a memorable last evening with the best food we had in Nepal. Thank you very much - we will return! Greg and Tracie

Cottages with interconnection .. Serene, isolated and lawn facing. Cart riding on the 18 hole Golf Course was out of this world. Sunrise and Sunset from the forests, walking through the dense forest, swimming in the temp controlled pool, quiet retreat, kids friendly, good momos, very friendly staff. Outstanding experience

Excellent facility . Very helpful staff. Value for money. Golf, swimming,  bird watching, Gym, Sauna many more activities for family.Away from city chaos yet not far. We enjoyed and highly recommend the place. Dr.Suresh Chandra

I stayed at this hotel for 2 nights after spending 9 days hiking to Annapurna with my brother.It was exactly what we needed.  Luxurious hotel set on vast grounds with great scenery. Rooms are a fantastic size with big en suite. The spa is as good if not better than most 4/5* hotels in uk& europe and we had a very good massage at the spa. The staff were already extremely pleasant and helpful also particulary a manager at reception named Bandana. She was very dedicated to ensuring our stay was an enjoyable experience. A few minor down sides though- 1- the road from the city centre to the resort is in very bad condition, 2- at dinner my brother found 3 separate black hairs on his plate( staff were extremely apologetic) but still it is not ideal and last the spa was fantastic however the water fountain next to hot tub provides 2 plastic glasses for everyone to share water from- i felt this should be improved for basic hygiene reasons to disposable cups as this was poor for a 5* resort. However overall this hotel is much needed relaxation in a crazy busy city at reasonable cost. Strongly recommend

Good property.  Improved service.  Good food.  Pathetic roads, not sure what the hotel can do about it, but it could lobby for improvement, surely they must be losing business because of it.  Car park in open sky, so perhaps a complementary car wash could be provided.

We had an amazing stay.We stayed there for a night with my hubby & baby.The room was spacious,well furnished & included with all the amenties.All the staff members were friendly & co-operative.The resort is so peaceful which is inbetween of forest with full of greenary.We didn't have much time to roam around and do a proper use of services that were given to us. But looking forward to visit next time!

Me and my wife checked in on 10th sep, property is very good, staff is also very humble and cooperative. Although my first night was not really good, as the room provided to me was not good. It lacked some basic things, since as per resort staff there were no rooms available. I had to stay in that room for first night. But very next day "DIVAS" and BANDANA" helped me and changed my room. Both were very cooperative and helpful, apart from first night everything was perfect. I would strongly recommend this property.

Dear Ms. Bandana & Gokarna Forest Resort Team,It gives me immense pleasure to drop a few words to you to thank the whole team who took great care of us especially the Assistant Guest Relation Manager Ms. Bandana.She offered us a guided tour of the resort and the facilities which was just amazing! She was very professional.Not forgetting the lunch.. It was just perfect.. And cherry on the cake was the dessert which was magnificent!Unfortunately the time spent there was too short as we just came to know about your fabulous resort in the morning.. Hopefully, we'll make it a longer stay next we visit your beautiful Nepal.Till then, stay wonderful as you are..Cheers.From Gulshan & Nitisha of Mauritius.

Excellent  view  every were green!!! Very good facility’s  number one place for gulf player and very big and variation  Bar and restaurant ‘excellent service and food,Every one can feel like own home!We will definitely  visit again !!

Go Karna is a right choice for those who wish to have a quite, calm place to spend time with Family / Friends The team were really caring and prompt in their responseOverall its a good place to have leisure time

Amazing location and environment, surrounded by the forest and golf club. The staff was soo kind, room was big with a nice view and confortable enough (good relation for price/value). Food could be better but not bad. Installations in general were good.

I discover the place a bit by chance trying to find a quiet and green place not too far from Kathmandu. The hotel is ideally located and it is difficult to believe one can be in wild forest land so close from the city center: a fantastic surprise !  On top of the location itself, the atmosphere, the rooms, the personnel, everything was perfect. How to make it more perfect ? Add a touch of  local food on the restaurant menu and keep the room price competitive.

I stayed here with My Husband and Brother in law for 1 Night only. We found the staff to be very helpful and friendly. I am Coeliac, once we advised our waiter of this the F & B Manager took care of all of My Meal Selections and Prep. We had a game of Golf within the resort and loved watching the many Deer and Monkeys as we played. We all had a massage in the Spa & would recommend

Highly recommended. Our family enjoyed our weekend getaway at Gokarna Forest Resort. The have a heated pool and jacuzzi, massage services (professional), and an amazing breakfast. We really enjoyed walking around the facilities and playing with their tame deer, riding horses, and swimming.

We stayed 2 nights at Gokarna Forest Resort after completing the trek to Everest Base Camp and was just what we needed!Staff were highly attentive and service in all areas was excellent. Food and drinks were quite expensive once taxes and service charge were added.The room was huge with lovely decor and the bathroom facilities did not disappoint following our time trekking. The hour massage in the day spa was excellent with professional service.  The pool was a pleasant temperature but not somewhere to spend the day relaxing as it was indoors. Enjoyed seeing the monkey families playing within the grounds and whilst we didn't play,  the golf course looked lovely. The resort provides a welcome respite to the chaotic Kathmandu streets but is quite isolated if you wanted to go out walking our sightseeing.

I play golf and I love Gokarna.Golf is one of the meditative game and Gokarna Forest Resort offers best environment for golfers and inner seekers to connect the nature and ultimately to inner soul.I highly recommend to other my golfer friends and nature lovers to this place.Thai food are very delicious there but Nepali Thali is overpriced.

Just driving in the gates of the resort whisks u away into another world. The hotel itself is gorgeous and the staff, well they are cut from a different cloth. They are so tentative and cater to every whim of the patrons.  On Saturdays they have a BBQ buffet lunch and the selection is so large one can not eat everything without being stuffed.   The flavors also are out of this world.  This place really is heaven on earth.   My congratulations to the management and I very highly recommend this place to all who want to escape even if it is for a little while.

Gokarna is excellent resort. It is a true resort in letter & sprite. One would wish to stay at such properties in the lap of nature. Staff is good and looks after you. Food is delicious. We are vegetarian and they took good care of our food requirements and even provided out of menu items. Overall a very good experience so far as resort is concerned.However the location is a major issue. With Kathmandu traffic and road conditions (Extremely bad), the joy turns into punishment.

We all had a great time during this weekend getaway at Gokarna. We were three families/friends with 3 kids. All of us loved it and enjoyed to the fullest. The resort has a couple of deers and rabbits which were an instant hit with the kids. Their indoor, temperature controlled swimming pool was a delight for all of us during the cool, rainy weather. The rooms were big and their service was very prompt. We had dinner at the clubhouse and the food was ready within 10 minutes of our placing the order. Everybody, including the kids, loved the food. Overall it was a pleasure to be at Gokarna and spend the weekend with friends and kids.

just an incredible experience.Hidden gem in the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu city.the staff is willing to accomodating the guests any request.will definitely recommend for all. Nice place to be get relaxed.

Very nice stay over this hotel,I love my stay with my foreign groups they are also happy with the service and food.i highly recommended for all customer for looking resort with golf court.We play golf with my friend we enjoy a lot.

Kathmandu in itself is a mesmerizing place. Gokarna Forest Resort is one such location where the beauty of nature can truly be felt and enjoyed to the maximum. Be it the warm hospitality of the resort staff or the excellent quality of the food, we were very happy with the overall service we received. The location in itself is very serene and calm. The place is lush with trees and greens of the golf course are a beauty to behold. The indoor swimming pool was a delight. The room had tasteful interiors and was very spacious. Overall an extremely memorable stay for us. Thank you Team Gokarna!

I like the overall ambience.  Nice location, Greenery .I like temperature controlled shaded swimming pool .It was crowed during day time.This place is worth visiting. Spending time over there is good value for money.

it was incredibly peacefu & tranquil with friendly wild life at out doorstep.the golf course & the caddies was amazing. the activities at the spa too was great with yoga every morning & beautiful forest walks.

Had an outstanding experience with friends during our vacation .The hotel service was so heart whelming and we loved the food . We loved their hospitality and looking forward to visit again.And thank you so much for everything who made our vacation memorable.

One of the best hotel in Kathmandu.Friendly staffs, green forest, gulf course, silence and peaceful stay.  Average good food.  Overall must stay property if you need peace in your holiday. Atleast stay 3 days in property to enjoy.

One of the best places I have ever stayed in the world and I have stayed at many places. Fantastic grounds include a full size golf course and forest filled with wild life. Food was excellent and so were the staff. I could not fault Gokarna in any way at all. Fantastic just relaxing watching the Monkeys, Deer and Eagles at the club house or just relaxing around the main hotel complex. Will return for sure after I have completed some other travels on my bucket list. Really did not want to leave. Thanks again to all staff there. Met and made some really good friends. Hope to see you again soon.

I was surprised, but we had a great holidays with my husband in Nepal !!! Nepal is such a beautiful country with a special atmosphere!!! And Gokarna resort made us just little more happier !!! Bcoz everything there was just amazing! Lovely staff, room, food, weather , animals everywhere, fantastic atmosphere, greens, spa, yoga, golf !!! Everything is just wooowwww!!! We r living in Dubai and traveling a lot, but like this service I didn’t saw anywhere !! Thanks everybody who works there!!! Special thanks to Bandana for organizing everything what we just want and wish , for our lovely anniversary cake , for care and love !It was our one of the best trip!!! I’m sure we ll comeback there again !!!
Excellent service amazing food and very warm gesture from the management. We were greeted with anniversary cake and later in the evening with another cake.We would definitely be back soon.Much love.

I would highly recommend Gokarna. The rooms were beyond my expectation, and the spa was extremely relaxing. I had just come down from Everest Base Camp when I got to Gokarna, and we had a well received welcoming to the resort. Staff is excellent and very friendly. I wish that there were more trails available to walk around the forests, but I guess they do call it a resort for a reason. I will be coming back someday!

Stayed for 5 days, had a glorious time! Ask for a room with a forest view. So peaceful and beautiful! The food was great, service was fantastic. All the staff are really pleasant and nice. The only thing is I wish guests were allowed to walk through the forest paths without a guide, at least some of them.

Gorkarna is a combination of beautiful greenery and modern hotel. We enjoyed the Spa , food and the rooms. But most delightful time was spending time in the beautiful gardens and forest .Thank you GFR.

The resort is breathtaking with its greenery, deer, amenities... The staff is simply amazing - Ms.Bandana made our stay extra comfortable and went out of the way to help us. We loved the food and highly recommend GoKarna

This resort was part of a tour that we did whilst in Kathmandu or Dustmandu as I have now named it.  It was lovely to stay at this resort after staying in some ordinary hotels during our month long visit to Nepal, Tibet and Bhutan.The staff were lovely at reception, restaurant and spa. I can recommend this Hotel it was a shame we only checked in late and left very early the next morning,  We really would have loved to stay an few extra nights to take in what this resort has too offer.

I found the hotel facilities sounds the best place of Kathmandu. I fully enjoyed with jungle walk, beautiful golf ground and other facilities available around the resort. The services have been provided very good. The staff are found very professional and well behaved.

Located in a quiet and tranquil yet very accessible from Kathmandu city, Gokarna Forest Resort is definitely one of the best resorts I have been to thus far.  It has everything. Beautiful rooms, well trained staff, delicious food and excellent facilities for outdoor and indoor activities. I look forward to going back there again soon when I am in Nepal. Thank you for your kind hospitality.

The Gokarna Forest Resort is a wonderful resort with a beautiful golf course and gardens. We watched deer's and monkeys during the early morning and  evenings walks. The rooms are extremely large and more than comfortable, we could not ask for anything better.The customer service and food was excellent and we were greeted with smiles where ever we went.This is definitely a 5 star resort and we will stay longer on our next visit to Nepal.

The Gokarna Forest Resort is a lovely property and golf course. We saw a lot of animals such as deer and monkeys in the early morning and early evening. The rooms are extremely large and comfortable.The food was excellent as well as the customer service.

An excellent Property to spend time with family + friends. Very many options to spend time in leisure for all age Catagory. They've complimentary shuttle service to City / Town thrice since morning + pick up once in afternoon. Airport pick up + drop is quite costly though, this should be rather subsidised or at cost basis, if not Complimentary. Overall good to stay.

Only 45-60 minutes from Thamel depending on traffic and you are in another world. Very nice older style building with comfortable rooms. Went as part of our trekking and wildlife tour organised by Himalayan Social Journey (a great company). A nice way to relax at the end before returning home.My wife loved the spa and massages. Nice pool with sauna and steam room. Reasonably priced Thai / Chinese restaurant overlooking the magnificent golf course. Hotel has a free shuttle into Kathmandu so you can do your last minute souvenir shopping.No lifts.

los baños necesitan más limpieza, el resto impecable. La gente hospitalaria, esube resfriada y me daban un te al efecto. El lugar tranquilo, verde un poco lejos de Kathmandu pero por las calles de tan mal estado, no por el hotel en si.

Large, spacious rooms with a/c and excellent wifi. High level of service. Stayed two different time during a three week tour. On second arrival, room had some issues so they immediately gave me another room. Extensive breakfast buffet with Nepalese type dishes on one side and Western on the other. Eggs to order in the middle.  They have a free shuttle twice a day into Kathmandu. Restaurant on site for lunch and dinners. Resort is on the outskirts of Kathmandu which is good if you don't like dust.

This resort is situated 10kms out of Kathmandu and was originally the palace for the King of Nepal. On arriving here it is hard to imagine you are in Kathmandu. Although the golf course appears to be a major draw card it is not necessary to even see the course.The hotel complex is on the upper level of the property and is surrounded by beautiful forest. It is spacious and well cared for. Staff are friendly and helpful. The yoga teacher was natural, perceptive and attentive. Harmony spa staff also skilled and attentive. Alfresco dining outside the bar very pleasant.

1泊だけしました。タメルから車で1時間弱のカトマンズ郊外の森の中にあるリゾート。いくつかのレストランと広大なゴルフコースや快適なスパがあり、短期間の滞在ではもったいないです。カトマンズ中心地の喧騒から解放されたい人におすすめします。宿泊したラナコテージのグランドフロアの部屋は広大でよく手入れされた中庭に面していました。外で常に何かしら作業をしているホテルのスタッフの気配を部屋の中きら感じ取れるので少し落ち着きませんでしたが、周辺には沢山の種類の鳥が生息していて、日中は鳥達の可愛らしいさえずりを聴いてリラックスできました。敷地には迷彩服を着た警備員が至る所に居て、少し怖いくらいです。まるで軍隊のようでした。フロントのスタッフはとても親切で好感が持てました。歯ブラシや歯磨き粉は用意が無いので持参してください。

This hotel is an oasis in Kathmandu. Located in a forest, the air is cleaner and the grounds are lovely. The rooms and baths are spacious and clean.  All of the staff I came in contact with were exceptionally professional and pleasant.

The room was nice. The carpet of the stairs to first floor needs replacement. We’re there for the golf and tend to visit again in October first week.the food is good but need more variety particularly in continental and Mediterranean food. May add labnese food,.the golf course is nice but the dress of caddies needs attention.the hotel can provide the dress like any other golf resort. The absence of uniform gives a poor impression.

Was there as a corporate meeting trip. Food was very India like and tasted good. Overall cordial behavior by all staff. The rooms are well maintained. Bathrooms are clean. The scenic beauty and golf circuit are the best.

It was my 7th time staying in the hotel. All the facilities are great and it's the best place for relaxation.I recommend this place to everyone willing to get away from their daily stress to find a little private time.

I just stayed at Gokarna Forest Resort with my mother and we has a delightful stay. The staff, welcome staff, reception, security, gardeners, drivers and wait staff alike, were all beyond helpful, kind and friendly. Everyone was accommodating, friendly and attentive. The food was great, we had the best massages of our lives! Would recommend to anyone looking for somewhere peaceful and relaxing to stay after completing a big hike (we had just done Everest Base Camp) and wanting to be able to quickly get back into Kathmandu to explore.

We stayed here after trekking to EBC. It was the perfect wind down! The only downfall was that we should’ve stayed longer. The rooms were spacious, huge twin beds. Absolutely delicious buffet breakfast. Stunning huge grounds to explore. The spa services were amazing, such a great inclusion to the resort. The staff were friendly and accommodating. I would return to Nepal just for a week at this resort.

Sehr gut! Hier kann ich mich wohlfühlen, ausruhen und ankommen.Schöne, saubere, geschmackvolle Zimmer.Abwechslungsreiches Frühstücksbüffet mit allem, was man sich wünscht: frisch zubereitete Eier, asiatische Gemüse- und Fleischgerichte, Obst, Brot und Belag...Sehr aufmerksamer Service, der unsere Kundenwünsche umgesetzt hat. Möglichkeit, sich im Spa verwöhnen zu lassen, Golf zu spielen oder die Gegend zu Fuß oder mit dem Pferd zu erkunden.Empfehlenswert!
四月的加德滿都已經進入雨季，但是在這，雨停半小時後路面就會放乾。戈卡納森林公園，這裏風景優美，設施齊全，是個好去處。消費水平在加德滿都來說比較貴。高爾夫練習場便宜，700NPR有50個球，3600NPR一次SPA。今天高爾夫球場還有外國友人進行比賽。明天是尼泊爾日曆新年，估計晚上會有很多遊客來酒店。BTW，酒店10000NPR一晚。希望對您有幫助。

The property was mesmerizing with the views of Deers, monkeys and other creatures making it a diffrerent experience all together.  The entire property is different from any other Hotels/ Resorts we normally stay in. I'll suggest it's a must try & stay property! Kudos!!

Huge property spread across 450 acres. Beautiful golf course with all the amenities one can think of. Great bungalow style rooms, excellent food and courteous staff. We used the huge courtyard for our corporate event and got all the support from the team!

Gokarna is such a relaxing resort and the perfect end to our action packed week in Nepal! I would highly recommend it for excellent customer service and beautiful facilities. The rooms are huge and extremely clean and comfortable!

On our last night we stayed at this magnificent hotel... Upon arrival check-in was quick and we were taken to our room where we were welcomed with a gorgeous honeymoon cake and best wishes... Our room was massive and beautiful,,, the bathroom was so cool... The grounds was just gorgeous and scenic,,, so much to do there... Food was great,,, had a buffet dinner to see us off... Wish we had more time at this forest resort... Will have to go back for more...

This little paradise on the borders of Kathmandu is the perfect place to keep your sanity if you are exploring the city and surrounding attractions. Amazing nature, fresh air, extremely friendly and professional staff, a great spa and lovely accommodations will give you the dreamed pampering for a relaxing trip. The pool and spa area add to the relaxing environment,beside the forest and the golf course. My room was very comfortable and detailed with small treats  like fruits, tea, coffee and cookies. The service was outstanding and very accommodating to my special requests. Breakfast was generous and creative.Extremely satisfied.

The people were warm and very hospitable... excellent place for a family vacation, peaceful and calming. Great Golf and amazing Spa facilities. The Service standard was exceptional ! Rooms are comfortable...

Quiet, pleasant rooms and dinning was excellent. Staff very helpful and always up for a good chat. I very much enjoyed my stay, helped me recuperate from trekking in Himalayas. Used the spa facilities (steam and sauna rooms) which were excellent.

Had a wonderful experience at this amazing ambience resort.Best time spent in paradise and had incredible amount of fantastic facilities.The staff were amiable especially Mr. Bibek,Duty Manager Chengu,Sumita and Bandana from front office.Would like to thank Chef Suresh and Chef Birkha for their attention and concern at the time of breakfast.Would love to visit again in near future. Thank you for great service.

I organized a reunion for a group of friends and could not have been happier!  The Gokarna staff was exceptional in every area.  The desk workers spoke great English and were more than accommodating regarding the different requests from our group.  The food was the best my friends had had in Nepal.  The rooms were very clean, comfortable and big.  The pool and spa were also a huge highlight for everyone.  The grounds are beautiful, peaceful and unlike any other hotel we have ever been in in Nepal.  My friends were so pleased that they are already asking me to plan another reunion there.  We will definitely visit again!

We stayed here for a few nights after an everest base camp trek to relax.  Staff are amazing, attentive, proper, and take great care of you.  The pool and spa are nice enough for Nepal but compared on a broader stage they are average at best when compared to North American standards.  We booked a massage and they did a good job and price was fair.  The Restaurant (they have three but all with the same menu and cost) has decent food but it is not consistent night to night.   We ordered chicken butter Masala one night and it was incredible.  The next night we got it again but it was awful (burnt, bad flavor, and different presentation entirely).  While the food is decent usually, the value for money with the 10% service charge plus another 13% VAT (paid everywhere) makes the food too expensive, especially when you add alcohol which is about $6 to $10 USD per drink (in USA & Canada it is cheaper by far)  Compared to Thamal nice restaurants it is roughly 2x as expensive and honestly the same quality.  Atmosphere is relaxing but really has nothing to do so make sure you bring a book or plan to golf / tour Kathmandu.  Rooms are Hugh and nice.  TV has tons of movies.  Staff gave us a cake because it was our honeymoon (suggest saying it is regardless) but bottle of wine would have been nicer since my wife is gluten and dairy intollarent but it's not understood here.

This super green oasis is wonderful! Though outside of town, there are no short drives in Kathmandu anyway so you might as well get out of the smog. And with all the amenities you have on the grounds, you may be tempted to stay here instead of venturing into the urban jungle!

We stayed four nights and had excellent service and accommodations.  Staff was extremely friendly and helpful.  Breakfast buffet in the restaurant and the meals at the in-house 8848 Mt Bar were excellent.

The property is pristine, surrounded by a lush green forest on a hill. Beautiful golf course where we took a golf cart tour. Absolute tranquility. The rooms are very well designed with a hint of Nepali architecture and all modern amenities - also, they are HUGE! A place where humans are actually coexisting with nature as monkeys and deer are everywhere in the property but seem to mind their own business. Also, the pool is just mesmerizingly beautiful and the food was great as well. The best part about this resort are the people who all seem very happy to help you at any given time, from the guards to the reception staff to the waiters. All of them are just happy and more than willing to help.

Stayed here for a few days of R & R after a Everest base camp walk. Nice way to unwind and relax. Located approx 20-30 min from the hustle and bustle of Thamel, a small forest oasis, with world class facilities and spacious rooms. Staff are attentive to your every need, plenty to do at the resort or organise hotel transfer into Thamel for the day.

One of the best Hotels and Experience I have ever had. Lovely Property, 7-Star Service, One of the finest Golf Course in the Continent.The house keeping staff are too nice and very prompt with every service.

My friend and I stayed here after a trek to EBC. Not only is this place a slice of peace and quiet even though it is in Kathmandu, it is a fantastic place to stay. The staff are all so helpful always checking if they can do any more for you. They are truly what makes staying here great. The massages are fantastic, the food is great and our rooms were superb. I cannot recommend this hotel high enough.

i was here for attending my friend's wedding. the room was clean and spacious. moreover housekeeping services were good. The interior was soothing and having large class windows with forest view. but the animals like monkey can enter your room if you open your gate or windows. for that hotel management provide instruction for keeping all them close.overall a good experience. they have other facilities likespa and golf course also.

Very inclusive and safe environment. Looking forward to visit again.   Very good place. Love the whole place. The place is 1 hour from the airport but its a worth 1 hour joinery to remember for life. I enjoyed every moment staying here.

We had 2 nights at Gokarna included as the ‘luxury’ component at the end of an organised tour. I’m sure that Gokarna is very luxurious in the nicer rooms, but our cottage room was nothing out of the ordinary. If you have the choice, opt for a room in the main building. The service was definitely nothing of note. We had a meal at the restaurant & had almost finished eating before anyone approached us to take a drinks order. The grounds looked lovely but unfortunately the weather was not on our side so we didn’t get to look around. We had massages at the spa & they were sublime! We did feel rather stuck there as it is a long way out of town & you’re somewhat at the mercy of the resort & their facilities- ie. their restaurants & Resort prices. Overall, unless you’re staying in a nicer part of the resort or you really wish to be out of the city, I would suggest finding a nice hotel in town.

We were given a treat by my uncle for our wedding anniversary to stay night at the Gokarna Forest Resort.  The experience was amazing.  Far from the maddening crowd of Kathmandu, it was peaceful and relaxing.  The customer services from the beginning (at the reception, house-keeping, restaurants) was very professional, courteous and friendly.  My husband and I felt that we were well cared of.  We enjoyed the peaceful, green environment including the food and spa services.  We look forward to returning in our next trip too and would not hesitate to recommend this resort to our families and friends.

I travel about 1/3 of the year and out of all the places I stay Gokarna is by far one of my favorites. The resort is comfortable and staff are nothing short of wonderfully generous of spirit. You can’t help but feel special. I would highly recommend a business or personal stay here. Looking forward to my return already.

This was our second visit to Gokarna Forest Resort and we were not disappointed. The rooms (both visits) were comfortable and clean, the restaurants and bar superb, but what made our visit(s) were the staff and the service they provided. The Resort is some distance from the centre of Kathmandu, which we have found an advantage as this allows us to escape from the noise, traffic and pollution to the tranquil forest setting.

I organized a workshop for 40 people at Gorkana resort and it was the best choice I could have made. The staff were so attentive and well organized. Thank you so much! The meeting rooms and workshop arrangements were made easy for me. Apart from that the grounds and accommodation are lovely.  I had my 10yo daughter with me and she had a lovely time, being spoilt by the kind staff and horse riding.  I recommend this venue for business and pleasure. Excellent all round!

We went to Gokarna Forest Resort for the office outing with more than 80 participants. Room and ambience were awesome, food was good but the service was pathetic. Staffs did not co-operate with us properly for our team building activities and musical session. Overall experience was fine but could have been much better. The indoor swimming pool is a plus point.

First, I will say that the hotel is a very nice place. The property and the staff are very good. (The Kathmandu airport and the road to the hotel are quite bad but the hotel is nice.) Now for the bad part: We made a reservation for the Gokarna Suite and prepaid the entire amount ($1,724.29) on June 12, 2018 for a stay in December. On July 30 Kalpana Shrestha (sales executive of the hotel) sent the following: “We regret to inform you that our Gokarna Suite will be under maintenance during December 2018, so we will not be able to provide you our Gokarna Suite. However, we have another suite known as Premier Suite which is as luxurious as Gokarna Suite and will be available that time. Please advise us if you can modify your booking from Gokarna Suite to Premier Suite. We will refund the difference amount as well.”We accepted the downgraded room reservation.We arrived at Gokarna on Dec 17 as scheduled and then the story changed a bit. They said it was necessary to charge us for the Premier Suite in full and that we would receive a credit for the Gokarna Suite. They managed to charge us for the Premier Suite immediately but I did not see the promised credit. I mentioned this to the manager several times during our stay and when we checked out to travel on to Bhutan I told them that I did not want this to turn into a fight when I returned home. Assurances and excuses were offered each time. Email trail:Dec 18 5:21 PMDivas,I do not yet see the credit for the original Gokarna Suite for $1,724.29. Should that transaction have been completed by now? Richard (We checked out on Dec 21 as scheduled)Dec 22 10:02 PMDear Mr. Kenney.Please accept our sincere apology. Kindly avail us some time as there has been some delay on the refund processing. We shall definitely revert the amount deposited for the booking at the earliest possible. We once again apologize for the inconvenience caused. With regards, Divas ShresthaDec 23 7:29 AMDivas,Please recheck. I still do not see the credit. I would prefer to not have a fight over this when I return home. Thanks, Richard Dec 28 6:46 PMDivas,It is now ten days out and the promised refund has not been processed. I am left with little choice at this point but to presume Gokarna Forest Resort does not intend to issue the refund. We are back in America now (New York City) and we will be home in two days. I will initiate proceedings on Monday to force restitution and I will include these events in my review of Gokarna Forest Resort on Trip Advisor. This is a most unfortunate and disappointing end to what you worked so hard to make an excellent experience for us. RichardTo this I received an email response that included (unintentionally I presume) an email thread that was internal to Gokarna. The thread included an email from Rojin Sapkota (director at the hotel) that stated “Please note that guest has cancelled room booking of Gokarna suite because this room is occupied with our long staying guest. Please help us to cancel the booking refund the same.” I interpret this to say that the room was not under maintenance but that another guest wanted the room and planned to stay for a long time so the hotel bumped us and instead of just saying the room would not be available to us they fibbed. I had to call my credit card company after we returned home and dispute the charge of six months ago for the prepaid hotel room. Fortunately, I am a long time customer of Chase and they proceeded on my behalf to resolve the dispute and credit the entire amount back to my account on Jan 13.

The standout of Gokarna is the staff! Sunil and Meena at the front desk are wonderful standouts, but everyone who works at Gokarna are an absolute delight, with prompt service and always happy to ask about your day. The rooms are very clean and spacious, which was appreciated after 2.5 weeks of trekking teahouses. The trip out to Gokarna is quite bumpy, and the resort is a long-ish drive into downtown Kathmandu. But if you're looking for a prime location that you won't want to leave, then Gokarna Forest Resort is the place to be.

A local friend suggested me to stay at Gokarna Forest during my stay at Kathmandu. On the outskirts of the town, the location provides excellent view of the landscape and I got to see monkeys and deers roaming around in the premises in my early morning walk. The staffs were incredible and food was great too. I also enjoyed a relaxing bath on the spacious bathroom in my room. Would definitely return for the spa and golf.

After a few days in interesting but turbulent and busy Kathmandu; it was great to get to Gokarna where it is beautiful and peaceful.It is an hour from Central Kathmandu but seems a million miles away.Formerly the hunting lodge for the now defunct Royal family; the Duty Manager very kindly gave us a tour of the grounds including the old hunting lodge.It is a beautiful resort hotel with golf course (Nepal's only 18 hole championship course); forest walks, monkeys, deer, excellent accommodation, pool (we didn't use), 2 nice restaurants, and no traffic and little pollution it seems.The only downside is the terrible road from the city or airport. We are not sure it would be the best place to base yourself for the whole visit; but would recommend 2 nights stay.

We stayed at the Gokarna Resort as part of a wedding party.  All of the rooms were spacious and clean with large bathrooms.  The wedding took place on the grounds, in the morning, and it was lovely and the perfect backdrop for the traditional Nepali wedding.The only downsides were the monkeys roaming the grounds (and even saw one inside the resort); we were told to just not make eye contact with them.  And we thought the beds were hard.  And both of these comments are totally arbitrary as many of the guests loved watching the monkeys and did not find the beds too firm

The accommodations were sparkling clean and super comfortable. I especially loved the large bathrooms. The food was delicious and the staff was incredible. Everyone was so accommodating and friendly. I can't wait to return.

My stay at the Gokarna hotel was short but I enjoyed it so much I wanted to stay longer. This resort is nestled deep in the forest just outside of Kathmandu, the sound of nature was relaxing. I woke up to Monkeys playing in the courtyard which was a treat.  I was on the move in the morning and the wonderful chefs helped me take some breakfast treats to go. I didn't expect this type of visit but grateful for a warm welcome to Nepal.

After a busy 18 day tour it was good to kickback in a big comfortable room. I spent our last day on the challenging, very dry but enjoyable golf course while my wife put herself through an hour and a half of massage that she said was one of the best she had. Finishing up with a drink at the popular main bar.

A wonderful visit, in a great location just outside Kathmandu. Worth visiting in December. Staff member Basanti made the visit wonderful with a friendly welcome and I would visit again when next in Kathmandu.

The property is truly a 5 star hotel with 5 star service and amenities . I had a club room which comes with perks however I was truly impressed with the service of most of the staff which is impeccable and try their best to give you the best and only because they take pride in their work. Of course it is not flawless but only because of some ‘lost in translation’ moments and perhaps some lack of communication between themselves but they do make sure to fix everything there and then! A big thank you to the girls at the reception being customer relations and reception ( sorry I did not take their names) and the night guys Bibek, Palden and Krish while a special thanks to Abhishesh and Kumari ( the living goddess? 😉🙃) who were very attentive and spoilt me at the restaurant. Also a big thank you to the breakfast room staff and their manager who were super super super fantastic! Loved the Spa and the Inside swimming room... but not impressed with the gym which needs much more serious care and maintenance as people can get hurt.  Thank you!

This hotel  is very beautiful, full of natural and peace. excellent staff, great customer service and foods. we had wonderful spa day. we stayed 2 nights and had nice time in this hotel. must be visited.

Atención del personal inmejorable. Habitaciones grandes y en general Hall, bar, terrazas muy amplias, lo escogimos como fin de nuestro viaje a Nepal, como lugar tranquilo, alejado del bullicio de Kathmandu y para practicar Golf. El campo es excelente y curioso jugar entre los monos y las gacelas, los cadis super agradables. Todo respondió a nuestras expectativas.

Stayed with my spouse on 5th of Jan, 2019. The arrangement was impeccable.The room and the bathroom was spacious and well maintained. There are three restaurants- one Chinese/Thai by the 18 hole golf course, one bar and a restaurant. We tried all three- snacks at the Chinese/Thai, dinner in the bar and breakfast at the other restaurant. The bar played live instrumental music- two muscians, one playing flute and another a guitar. The ambience was very relaxing and soothing. The bar had a decent choice of drinks. We even ordered cocktails off the menu. We chose the buffet breakfast and the food label was color coded green or red to show if the item is vegetarian or not, which was easy for us vegetarians.The air around the resort is very crisp. We went for the golf cart tour which is a tour of all the 18 holes of the golf course on a golf cart and the forest that we have to pass through to reach some holes. We passed golfers, maintenance workers and beautiful birds. It took around half an hour and was a beautiful experience. The golf cart driver was very helpful and helped us take pictures.They have sauna, steam, jacuzzi and a swimming pool. There is separate sauna, steam and jacuzzi area for men and women, which was nice. The pool is temperature controlled and large but we were too tired to swim so we skipped that.My only issue is... there's no bidet shower near the commode in the toilet. More people in the world use some form of bidet along with paper, from southern Europe, South Asia, South East Asia, some parts of Americas to the Middle East. So an addition of a bidet or a bidet shower would be nice.But all in all a very good place for a quick rejuvenating getaway. I will definitely revisit with my family some day.

We stayed at Gokarna for 2 nights and overall had a very pleasant stay. The resort is quite large and set in the middle of the forest reserve which is a nice change from chaotic Kathmandu proper. Highlights included a walking tour through the woods where you’d never know you were a stones throw away from a golf course. The food was some of the best we had in Nepal and the resort offers several different restaurants.Prospective guests should be aware that this hotel is quite far from downtown Kathmandu. Though the resort offers a free shuttle or private car whenever you wish.The rooms are huge but the showers are overdue for some remodeling.Overall, it’s a great value for travelers wishing to stay outside of the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu.

Staff service is excellent throughout the resort, in particular F & B Manager Nurbu Sherpa and front desk staff Meena.  The toilet overhead shower though can do with some cleanup and regular maintenance. Only shortfall is when there are functions or events, some restaurants may be closed for private functions and service can be relatively slow. Suggest that the resort highlight if there are events on their website and also display at the front desk /entrance.  Also the Windhorse stable owner Mr Prakaash is a remarkable host. The resort could better promote the Windhorse Stable by displaying more Ads at the front desk/entrance. Overall a beautiful resort away from the dusty and hectic city area. Food is good. Great resort.

This was the second time I was here with my family and it does not disappoint. Better than the first time as we took the 1 hr Forest walk which is highly recommended, go for 2 hours if you have time. Cart ride for senior citizen is best. Mr. Bibek  from the front desk was very hospitable showing us around and even accommodating us to better rooms. Awesome Breakfast!

Ambience- peaceful and sereneStaffs- warm and friendlyRoom- an escape However the A.C was not working and despite having the maintenance man they couldn’t fix it in two days. I couldn’t sleep for two straight nights :(Wifi- only works in phone and not in laptop- lacks intellect to fix it.Food- looks fancy and well presented but lacks taste and freshness and you get sick of it after one night.So my question is, how do they rate hotels and resorts? I don’t think it is a five star as it should have been top notch. Everything should have been perfect, shouldn’t it?

We stayed in the premier rooms and were delighted by the size and view from the rooms. The property is really serene and green. We enjoyed the jungle walk thoroughlyAt 30 mins from the main city, it's a great place to retreat from.the noise and pollution in Kathmandu.

Stayed here at the end of a trekking trip as the “luxury part”. Was expecting the hotel to be much nicer. Plus - big rooms, quiet surroundings for Kathmandu, staff very helpful. Minus - stuck in the middle of nowhere unless you get a shuttle or taxi for 30-45 mins to somewhere, have to eat in one of the 3 restaurants in the hotel - bar/restaurant/ clubhouse - clubhouse had functions everyday for 3 days we were there - restaurant and bar have the same menu - so one place to eat. Being a 4 star hotel I thought food would come out quicker but still 45 mins plus each time. Food was average and in most cases cold by the time we got it. There was no hot water in the room for 2 days, we were given a room with an interconnecting door - completely not sound proof - the family staying next door could have basically been in our room with the noise that comes through. You have to pay between 10-25 to walk around the Forrest. The pool looked dirty with suds all over it so we didn’t want to swim.

The Gokarna Forest Resort may be on the edge of town (in this case, Kathmandu), however, it has everything that a first class resort offers including an 18 hole golf course, nature trails with a guide as the property is immense, and pool and spa complex for those who wish to be pampered.  It is a destination for weddings and other large events.  While we were there, we were caught up in and invited to an over-the-top wedding that hosted over 1500 nearest and dearest.  This was a four-day affair with multiple venues and events both in-doors and outside.  We've been to upscale events in New York, but this really outshines them.But I am straying; the rooms are immense with HDTVs, WiFi, bar refrigerators, huge bathrooms with large soaking tub showers.  Most rooms have sliding glass doors leading to private enclosed courtyards.  We had meals in two of the restaurants on the property (one in the golf clubhouse and the other in the main building.  The breakfasts will blow your mind away with both Western and Indian/Nepalese dishes served buffet style, including everything from pancakes to custom-made omelets, sausages (chicken) to rice and noodle dishes, porridge, croissants and pastries, juices, and cut-up fresh fruit.  Their other meals are excellent as well and you can order off of the menu. I also must commend the service starting with the welcome by staff at the front door, those working behind the counter at the front desk and the room attendants who are on-call 24/7.  We were never at a loss of towels nor instruction on the use of the individual heating/cooling units.  All were very accommodating and willing to arrange taxi service or any other need that one might have.  The hotel also have an excellent bar with top-shelf liquors, beers & wines in addition to well-stocked boutiques with interesting art objects and unique clothing offerings.We were at this venue prior to our trekking in the Annapurnas as well as afterward allowing us to relax as well as take in the historical sites and temples in the area.  We have fond memories of our recent stay at the Gokarna Forest Resort and highly recommend this property to you.

I really enjoyed my stay so relaxing. Staff were excellent nothing too much for them . Also I couldn’t believe how informative the duty Manager was and gracious with his time . He made me so welcome I definitely will be back again.

I stayed just one night at Gokarna on my way home after trekking and enjoyed the spa and massage facilities. The rooms themselves are unusually and very spacious with high ceilings. There are monkeys and deers roaming the garden. Breakfast was fantastic.

We had two nights at the beginning of our trip and a dayroom at the end of our two week trip. It was a wonderful stay. The birds around the forest grounds are abundant and they have a resident guide who took us for a walk.

The roads to this resort is work in progress & you are advised to plan to & from travel with sufficient time.Once you arrive, it is a different experience. Resort is located amidst forest. Green Golf Course. Lotsa Deer's wandering all around the property.Rooms are spacious. Caution : Do not open the windows & strictly no feeding the monkeys.Front Desk & Restaurant staff are courteous & the service is super! Keep it up.Duty Manager personally provides information to guests during check inSleep quality is 100%.Since, the Resort is away from the Hustle & Bustle of Kathmandu city it's a great location for both Business & Tourists. Wi Fi & Cable TV maybe erratic. I usually do not have problem with that.Book early to get good rooms. This resort receives International Groups all thor' the year.

This is a great place to stay if you have already seen Kathmandu and/or if you want to play golf.  It is technically in the city, but the distance and poor road conditions make this hotel quite a trek.  The security is high (a walled compound) and the grounds are lovely (but watch out for the monkeys!).  The rooms are very comfortable and spacious, and the bathrooms are huge.  I stayed here after a trek to the Himalayas the day before a flight out of Nepal, and I greatly appreciated the comfort.  However, comfort has its limits; there is no central heating, so you will need a coat for lobby and hallways.   Highly recommend the restaurant, which is necessary, since the surrounding neighborhood has no tourist amenities.

my sincere thanks to everyone in the hospitality team of Gokarna Forest Resort. you guys made our holiday really really memorable - right from the moment we stepped out of the airport to our drop off back to the departure hall - you took care of everything. Many thanks and keep the wonderful work going! Thoroughly and highly recommended!

When I was a senior diplomat in Nepal I used regularly to come to this superb resort at weekends, to play golf at the spectacular course and to relax in the truly excellent hotel and spa.  Above Kathmandu's smog-line, amidst the forest trees (and the occasional monkeys!) you breathe clean air and relax as you can nowhere else in the capital.  Having returned to Kathmandu after nearly four years away I brought my partner to stay here again for a weekend and it was even better than I remembered it.  The food served in the comfortable main bar area was frankly sensational.  Now owned by one of the great self-made men of Nepal, Ang Shiring Sherpa, this hotel must now be in Nepal's top five. The massage and spa treatments, as well as the golf course with its spectacular views including glimpses of the Himalayas, offer the most amazingly restorative experience after business or tourism in the heart of the city below.  The bedrooms are not only clean but spacious and the decor is full of authentic Nepali character.  Just wonderful.  It costs of course, as you would expect from a 5 star outfit, but not a lot  by the global standards it meets, and  it is worth every dollar or rupee.

In a time when Kathmandu has become an apocalyptic nightmare of traffic, smog, crowds, and noise, the Gokarna Forest Reserve is a sublimely peaceful sanctuary on the hills northeast of the city.  The rooms are spacious and well-appointed, the cuisine excellent, the staff meticulously polite and helpful.  The forest is full of spotted deer and monkeys, and I was able to track a leopard--a leopard!--up a sandy wash for half an hour.  Whether you like to play golf or needed a quiet to place to work on a book (as I was) or simply want to get away from Kathmandu's craziness, the Gokarna is the place to be.  --Ted Kerasote

Located quite a way outside the CBD of Kathmandu the Gokarna Forest Resort offers an oasis to wary travelers. We stayed here multiple times on our travels between Kathmandu, the Seti River and Tibet. Note it is approximately a $30 taxi RT fare to get to “downtown” Kathmandu. The staff at Gokarna Forest Resort were always pleasant and professional. Bandana Khadka, Guest Relations Executive, each time we stayed at Gokarna Forest Resort made sure our stay was beyond perfect. We especially want to thank Bandana for all our wonderful stays. She went out of her way to order Gokarna golf shirts, in the correct size, so we could have them before our return home. We were able to store excess luggage at the hotel to be held upon our return. The resort has a golf course and spa which we didn’t. Others in our group did and were quite pleased with the services. The rooms are very comfortable with a large bathroom. The rooms are a little dark but acceptable. Food in the restaurant is very good.  The included breakfast always had an omelet chef, cereals, pastries, and local fare. Lunch and dinner menus were just as accomplished and reasonably priced. The resort is actually located within a forest complex so it is important to keep the windows locked or those pesky monkeys can get in your room and cause damage. The monkeys have learned how to open UNLOCKED windows. One day we looked out the window when a spotted deer walked into view along with two rabbits. I can’t comment on the room cost since it was included in our travel trip. Gokarna Forest Resort is well known and appreciated in the Kathmandu area. While at Gokarna Forest Resort there was a private reception for Turkish Airlines. The day we left there was a big elaborate wedding reception. From what we could tell they really did a marvelous job with both of these functions.

This resort hotel is on a large site in a lovely quiet location. It even had a golf course. The hotel room was large and comfortable. The dinners and breakfasts were good and the whole hotel and grounds are clean and well maintained.

We held a 7-days meeting in Gokarna, with great help and support from every firendly staff, especially Rojin and Divas, we became very good firends. Rooms are unique and comfortable, food is great, the kitchen even cooked some Chinese style dishes. Definitely will go back next time and highly recomand to everyone!

Had a Wonderfull time and great food & cosy as well as comfortable stay at best affordable price,SPA was true by its name. Very groomed and disciplined people, taking care of guest with sincerety and cool gesture spreading happy bonding environment.

Rooms,  service, food was all great.   And driving back from another restaurant,  we saw a leopard hanging out on the side of the road.  Beautiful!  Unfortunately we were only able to stay one night so we're not able to take full advantage of all their amenities.  I would've liked to have tried their yoga and seen more of the forest.

Everyone was warm and friendly and put a smile on my face.  Room was great.    Got pictures of many Monkeys, Eagles, and spotted Deer.       Food and bar were fun! Watched a great combo, which included the Tablas.

Nepal itself is a gift nature and Gokarna Forest Resort is the beautiful gem of this naturally enriched nation. Wonderful ambiance with delicious food including Indian, Thai,  Chinese, Continental and yes Nepalese cuisine. The rooms are quite very spacious and comfortable with general amenities like,  AC,  mini bar,  wifi,  blower etc,  and if you are lucky enough you will have a personal open balcony with scenatic view around.  The resort has got indoor swimming pool, with Jacuzzi, sauna,  steam, good gym as well as a spa with professional aromatherapy specialist. You can even go for  bike safari on mountain bike,  however this is a costlier affair.  If you love to play golf, this place is a little paradise with beautiful 18 hole course. The bar is spacious with all exotic drinks at your service and live light music.  Overall the stay was wonderful here and I quite recommend it for a lavish holiday. However, certainly not for budget minded visitors.

It has been a wonderful stay here,  scenatic ambiance, delicious food, warm hospitality and peaceful atmosphere. I really enjoyed the stay with friends. Strongly recommended for families and friends specially honeymoon couples.

Gokarna Forest Resort is beautiful, a delightful property, well finished rooms, and great service. They supported our team well for our business meetings, and it was the right place to do that some extended business meetings. The food is good, but is in my opinion one of their needed growth areas - to truly get my rating to five stars would need them to push their food into the excellent category. The dining atmosphere and environment are great - eating in the main restaurant or down on the golf course's edge.

We stayed here on two occasions during our 2 week tour of Nepal. The setting is beautiful, although a distance from the city. To me, this was an advantage. Not a big fan of Kathmandu noise and dirt. I especially loved the floating flower arrangements that were changed every day. Our two rooms were both large with comfortable beds and windows with screens. Both were on the second floor. The first overlooked the parking lot, and the second overlooked the yard, where a small family of deer live, and rabbits scamper. Also, there are frequently monkeys around, but be careful not to leave your windows open, as you will be charged for damage caused by monkeys. This is a real thing. More of an issue with the first floor rooms, which can also be dingy (one member of our party was really surprised when she saw the second floor rooms). She said it made her room look like a jail cell. Rooms have large bathrooms with sunken showers, no tubs. Closet with safe and hangers. Hair dryer and lots of mirrors. Couldn't adjust the temperature on the A/C, but the overhead fan worked well.Plugs are difficult. Some worked without adapters, and others wouldn't hold the adapter without being propped up. Reading lights are good, but the lighting in the hallways is very dim. Be sure to have a flashlight on you in the evenings, as we were told the lights were kept dim in deference to the local animals. We couldn't really explore the grounds because we were there at the end of monsoon season (September), and there were leeches in the foliage (always a real thing, from experience). Wish they would upgrade the carpeting on the stairs and in the halls because it is currently drab and worn. On the other hand, the staff is lovely. Good buffet breakfast with omelet station. Mostly Asian items, but hard-boiled eggs and bacon available. Coffee varied in quality. Food in the restaurant for lunch and dinner is OK, but we didn't get a chance to try the clubhouse restaurant on the property. We were able to arrange for a shuttle to and from the airport, but communicating by e-mail is almost impossible. We got through once (after many tries), then never again. Finally, had to have our guide in Kathmandu call them to confirm shuttle time.

My husband and I just spent one night, I was determined to find a special place to celebrate a milestone of our "First Marriage Anniversary" together :) and we did find one! Gokarna Forest Resort exceeded all expectations - location, food, room, staff - it made worth it.

I stayed at the Gokarna Forest Resort as part of a travel package.  The rooms were comfortable, the restaurant options fantastic, live music in the bar was terrific, breakfast buffet outstanding, service first rate, and the setting was lush and serene.  I was able to squeeze in a 9 hole round of golf, that made for one of my favorite memories while in Nepal.  This resort's 18 hole course is simply gorgeous.  I enjoyed walking the beautiful back nine with the assistance of a delightful caddie and great security for keeping the monkeys at bay.  From this walk, I saw not only a beautiful herd of spotted deer but the lovely high peaks which can be difficult to see from within the city.  So, if you are lucky enough to stay at this serene location then try to enjoy the beautiful grounds and the excellent food at the restaurant down by the golf course.  The staff was warm, helpful, and welcoming.  The only reason I did not rate this resort as excellent would have to do with how far it is away from many of the historical sites, the airport, and the center of activities of Kathmandu.  Traffic in the city is definitely an unavoidable and annoying issue.  All of Kathmandu suffers because of the poor transportation infrastructure.

We stayed here both before and after trekking. The first room we had was in the old part of the hotel - lots of space and ambiance. The shower had plenty of hot water, but the beds were a little hard. The breakfast buffet was varied and lots of good choices. The hotel restaurant itself was good, but we thought the best place to eat was the country club restaurant down near the golf course. This place had really good, spicy Indian and Thai food. The 2nd time we stayed here we had a more modern room with comfortable beds and a good view of the forest/jungle. The monkeys are everywhere, and, if you don't close your room door tightly, they will try to bust it open. There is a spa on site with a swimming pool, sauna, and hot tub. The spa also offers massages. I would highly recommend the Himalayan hot stone massage - 90 minutes for $50 - it's a little slice of heaven after a long trek.
Excellent experience with events, meetings and conference.Staffs are great with courtesy.Cozy environment all around and awesome golf coast.Room amenities are great, it's unique, clean, eco friendly.

Very relaxing, it is out of town. Food is fantastic as is the staff. The resort itself could do with some updating, carpet a bit tatty and dirty. We had the buffet lunch YUM! Tea we had at the golf club also YUM, asian menu. My husband played golf and was very dissapointed with the course, considering what it costs.!!

This is a lovely hotel, very good sized rooms, staff very, very pleasant and helpful. Hotel is on a golf course, this is the Forest. From the name we thought it was a large wooded area. Some lovely trees. Road to hotel very bumpy. Entrance is beside an industrial estate. Took the Nature Walk of 1 hour at 10$ plus tip. It was interesting and the guide was lovely, trying very hard to make the experience worthwhile.  But Gokarna you need to make sure your staff are trained to answer basic questions about nature.

We spent a total of 5 nights at the resort. We especially appreciated the relaxed quiet nature of the place. The rooms are clean and spacious. The food is excellent. We ate in the main restaurant for both buffet and plated meals. We also ate at the bar. Everything was very good and fairly priced. Coming from the USA  this is a bargain. The wait staff was the best - attentive and very friendly. Swimming pool, spa, morning yoga - what's not to like!We also stayed closer into town at a high quality international chain. It was a few minutes closer to the airport but much less personal. We would love to return to Gokarna if we didn't live half a world away.

It is difficult to put into words how wonderful the Gokarna team were during our stay.  One of our party was unfortunately taken ill during our trekking holiday and ended up staying here for a week until the others completed their adventure.  The hospitality and kindness extended by all members of staff was second to none and certainly assisted in recovery.  The resort itself is very calming with golf for those who want it and a relaxing spa and pool area.  Our room was spacious and very comfortable and the restaurants offer an excellent range and quality.

GOKARNA what a wonderful surprise amid the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu..How nice to come back to this wonderful oasis after a long day trekking..excellent facilities spa golf course horse riding and much more. The club house restaurant overlooking the golf course was amazing..the Durbar restaurant in the main building excellent a la carte menu and the service provided by the staff and Mr Rajendra Karki especially was customer service at its absolute best. Will definitely stay here again.

Our family enjoyed the most wonderful hospitality at Gorkona forest resort in Nepal.The staff were very attentive and nothing was a bother .A special mention to to the Food and Beveridge manager Rajendra Karki who’s attention to detail was phenomenal and made our dining experience a pleasure every evening. Thank you to all the staff  we will be back .

The Food and Beverage Manager who waited on us every night was amazing! I would have to say, his attention to the whole customer service experience was second to none. This made our stay at the resort something that we will always remember.

Gokarna Forest Resort is a great place to stay.  It is clean and quiet.  The food is delicious and the pool and spa area are wonderful.  The heated pool is actually heated: 90 degrees.  I very much enjoyed swimming laps in the pool and then sitting in the steam room and jacuzzi.  The staff was extremely friend and helpful.  The grounds are gorgeous.

I had a fabulous time at Gokarna Forest Resort.  The staff make this hotel special and really make you feel welcome.  They seem like one big happy family and the friendliness flows through to the guests.  My room was huge with everything you want to hand.  Food and wine choice in restaurants were plentiful and delicious.  I opted for the 2hr wildlife tour with guide through the forest and saw lots of wildlife.  There are also monkeys in the trees around the hotel and they can also be seen along with deer from the golf course/driving range.  I didn't see any leopard but they are there but very elusive.The spa was excellent with a huge pool, steam room, sauna and jacuzzi.  Would love to stay again.

This was a comfortable and elegant stay. The hotel is ideal for relaxing and taking it easy especially after heavy hiking. Really fabulous staff and the food was excellent. great value for money Only disappointment here is that French wine would be good instead of Australian

This is a relatively isolated golf resort with huge rooms plus a hotel spa. Suitable for a 'get away' to relax and re-charge, not explore. A key attraction is the Gokarna Forest reserve but guests are not allowed to enter the forest without a guide. Not sure why. Best 'no fuss' meal value is asian cuisine at the golf Club House. Staff built a traditional festival swing for Dashain which was fun for kids and adults.

We stayed 3 days here at this lovely resort in Nepal. A breath of fresh air and luxury after Treking to Everest Base Camp.Staff was lovely and attentive.Great cocktails food and service.Rooms facilities was lovely. Weekends it gets very busy with tourists on day visits.An area for sunbathing or lounges where westerners could relax would be nice as it gets hot.

Out of the way spot- we drove a long and bumpy/ winding road, then had to hike over an hour to get there. Hotel staff met us and carried our bags for us.  The staff were nice and attentive. Food was fabulous! I am vegetarian and they had very good options for me. The rooms were clean and very quiet. The views of the Annapurna mountains were amazing! We only stayed two nights; I wish I’d stayed longer. Had a wonderful massage while there too. During the day some of the local hotel staff invited us to visit their village and they opened their homes to us. Very memorable trip- I highly recommend it!

PROSVery large roomsExcellent serviceQuietResort style GolfIndoor poolCONS It is a bad ride from the airport to the hotel and back again. The hotel is on the edge of town which is nice but due to construction, dust, extreme bumps, truth is less than optimal and long.

Gokarna Forest Resort is a splendid respite from the rigors of travel and cacophony of Kathmandu.  The grounds are forested and we took an enjoyable hike in them.  The building is well-planned and functional and the rooms are spacious and well-appointed, although wi-fi is spotty at times.  The two on-site restaurant options offer a variety of sound choices although my wife and I especially delighted in the black lentil dal.  The included breakfast was fine.  The on-site spa services were reasonably priced and worthwhile.  In our three separate stops totaling almost a week at Gokarna, the greatest attribute was undoubtedly the exceptional and personable service of every employee we encountered.  Truly phenomenal.

My recent short stay was lovely.  I had been injured so was unable to participate in all the amenities offered at the resort but did have a wonderful massage at the spa.  My room was spacious and comfortable, the restaurant had a nice breakfast buffet and a comprehensive menu.  The best part of my stay was the kindness of the efficient and caring staff.

Kathmandu has been hit with an earthquake.  They are still recovering but the crowds, the sidewalks (if you can find them) and the chaos was difficult.  This resort was haven. The rooms were spacious.  Excellent breakfast.  A nice variety for light dinners or more.  Clean.My only complaint is the tiles in the bathroom.  Very slippery when stepping out of the enormous shower.

Part of our trekking holiday is to stay at the Gokarna forest resort, it's very beautiful, very comfortable, good value for money, the Indore swimming pool is very good,few things can be improved:- we meditated at the temple there, people who are working there were very noisy, it should have been quite- we wanted to walk around the golf course, we would not be allowed, it's so beautiful, I suggest should be walking tracks, if we have to walk then the guide is very expensive

Very comfortable and spacious rooms and nicely away from the hustle and bustle, very attentive staff, but drinks service can be a little slow and prices were quite high for drinks. Food was mostly really nice and amenities were excellent. We enjoyed our stay, but you could get a bit of cabin fever if you stay there for too long

Service & food was amazing it’s a great place to getaway from the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu city.Try the burger off the menu.See the monkeys and deer down by the golf course.And if lucky upgrade to the suite

Thoroughly enjoyed our 3 nights at this resort after 12 days of trekking to Everest Base Camp.  - Rooms were very comfortable and spacious - Food at all the restaurants was good and very reasonably priced - Staff were wonderful and very friendly - Pool and sauna/jacuzzi were nice to spend an afternoon in - Resort grounds are beautiful and very well keptAn older hotel but no complaints!

After trekking to base camp Mt Everest, this stay at the resort was just so relaxing. Our room was spacious and most comfortable and the meals we enjoyed were of a very high standard. We enjoyed our massage as well as the morning yoga lessons. These were provided by a very expert lady who was very confident and understanding during our lessons.

This was a lovely place to stay following a trek to Everest Base Camp, as long as you've already seen the real Kathmandu first! The rooms are lovely and the food and service first class. Perfect for a few days break.

After a 12 day trek to Everest Base camp, staying here was amazing. Everything was clean, the staff were friendly and the food was delicious!If I am ever in Kathmandu again, I will definitely stay here

I stayed here at the End of my holiday in Nepal.  The setting is relaxing - though in retrospect, it was a bit further from the airport than I would have desired.  The clean air is a nice change from the pollution of Kathmandu.  I would advise taking the guided forest walk.  I even saw a leopard!

After completing our 12 day trek to EBC we spent 2 nights at this absolutely beautiful oasis in the forest.From the moment we walked into reception and were greeted with the most refreshing cold juice I knew that this hotel was going to be special.The room was beautiful, the bed was AMAZING !!!The food..... wow wow wow. Just delicious.The staff went above and beyond with their service. They truly wanted to make sure that you had the best stay you could and nothing was too much trouble for them.The day spa ..... what can I say... THANK YOU, 😊And I loved our little guests everywhere.... the monkeys. We were told well in advance to keep your windows closed and not to feed them and there was plenty of signage. They were just beautiful to watch.My only negative is that we did not extend our stay and spend some extra nights here.Thank you for such a beautiful experience 🙏🙏🙏Namaste

This place is wonderful! The rooms are large and very comfortable and the staff is very friendly and accommodating. I am very impressed with this place we will certainly stay here again. While we were there my wife and our son’s baby blanket in the room when we left. I called the hotel and Sumita at the front desk went and looked for it, found it, and made sure it got returned to us. Customer satisfaction is a high priority at this place and that is what sets this place apart!

Do not go for horse riding. I booked 2 hour trip the night before. On the day was told it was going to be only 45 minutes. I had prepaid and said wouldn’t do it if it was only 45 minutes. Then I was informed it would be 2 hours. The guide took me to dusty road outside instead of the forest, and returned back to hotel in under an hour and half. Hotel returned me 1000 rupees out of the 6000 I paid. Overall a very disappointing experience and I felt short changed when something that is promised was not delivered.

the place is like an heaven for the people who is staying at Kathmandu city, you will be loving to there and finally you will have the best cost of the place where you will simply make things happen, the perfect place in peace where you find everything.

Abbiamo soggiornato un paio di notti in questo splendido resort letteralmente circondato dalla foresta ex riserva di caccia reale, a conclusione del nostro viaggio in Tibet. Ci voleva! Silenzioso, riposante e dotato di tutti i comfort, dalla spa alla piscina al campo da golf 18 buche. Due ristoranti con cucina internazionale. Pulito e dotato di stanze spaziose con una bella vista sul verde.
