State attenti e chiudere bene le finestre quando non siete in camera che le scimmiette, che vivono legittimamente nel bosco, sono curiose ed entrano quando quando siete via. Un saluto speciale a Rajendra Karki executive F&B che con gentilezza si e prodigato per accogliere ogni nostra richiesta. Consigliato.

We stayed here at the end of our 3 week Nepal/Bhutan trip, and it was a wonderful place to relax and unwind.The staff were all lovely, the food was excellent (I adored the Niome which I am very sad that I cannot find a recipe for on the internet), and you could eat outdoors under the awning which was lovely in the monsoon season and must be equally  nice in the hot months.The hotel is surrounded by forest, so great for walkers, and there's a golf course and spa.  You can organise a guided walk (not so great in the wet season as leeches are a problem - we thought we could cope having come across them in Chitwan, but here they were a menace even though we had liberally sprayed our legs and feet with deet) - and you might see deer and monkeys (almost certain to see monkeys!)Spa:  Great massage, but the pedicure was, to be honest, a bit of a disaster.  Also, for what I am sure are very good reasons the sauna and steam room are not kept on, so you need to be organised and prepared to wait.If you are planning to visit the city I'm not so sure this is ideal for you (we had previously stayed in a hotel in Thamel and the location was much better for visiting the sights).I would definitely recommend this hotel for a relaxing experience.

Zeroed down on this amazing resort, which I came across on a travel agency site,  however we booked a sight seeing package through the resorts website for 5 days.We arrived on Tuesday afternoon after a good 6 hours journey (four and half hours in flight) and almost (one hour on the road) from Tribhuvan Airport to the Resort. Seemed like all the roads in the capital were dug up for maintenance.We were impressed by the grand entrance and warm welcome we received at the lobby/reception. After quick formalities in the reception, we were taken to our room, which was very well lit with natural light, since a large glass panel served as window. The room had very good view of the courtyard. A grand bathroom with all necessary articles/things complimented the spacious room. A large bed, two comfortable big wooden chairs with a small wooden table, one big illuminated almirah (Wardrobe) in one of the corner added to the rustic look of the room.The Durbar Restaurant serves variety of dishes/cuisines, including authentic Nepali and Indian cuisine. Very well trained freindly and soft spoken staff is attentive to your every need. Both Durbar Restaurant and 8848 Mt. Bar being adjacent to a big courtyard has full view of the same and one can choose to sit out and enjoy the beautiful view, listening to sounds of various birds and watching monkeys on tree tops as they jump from branch to branch, while enjoying the food or sipping your favorite drink. As my wife had her veggie meals, I tried different grilled chicken flavors which they can do at your request. We dined in for at least 3 days. All the meals were a grand affair, with tastes to soothe every palate.  The property has one more large Restaurant known as Club House? which overlooks the huge 18 hole golf course and the forest beyond it. The restaurant serves Chinese and Thai dishes and we tried the Thai dishes, the preparation was good. Spent the first 2 days going to Thamel (Shopping & night life) and Pashupatinath Temple and Boudhinath Stupa, which are not very far from the resort.Besides the above, the resort has a excellent spa (Harmony Spa) and good swimming pool and gymnasium. The hotel arranges forest walks and morning yoga sessions under trained guides. Just avoid Forest or Nature walk in rainy season as the forest is full of leaches.If you are looking forward to a quiet, lazy & relaxed vacation experience with lot of greenery around, Gokarna Forest Resort is the place to stay.

One of my best hotel experiences ever. Amazing trancuality, great welcoming staff, tasty food , gorgeous scenes, and endless other services and activities that you won't find elsewhere. I'd like to escpecially thank the F&B manager mr.Nurbu Sherpa who is so friendly and professional and all the other staff and employees who made our stay worth every paid penny

My family ended our ECB Trek with a stay at Gokarna Forest Resort. It was a wonderful and restful day and night prior to our flight home to Australia. After 15 days trekking the Himalayas, we were pampered with 5-star food, service and facilities at Gokarna. Cooling off at the bar, heated pool and sauna and a well-deserved massage rubbed out all the aches and pain of our adventure. Understandably we did not partake in the exploration of the forest trails. Of our full experiences in Nepal, we do not hesitate to recommend a stay at the Gokarna

All of the staffs are so kind and it was very enjoyable stay even though rainy season. Golf course is not good condition because rain and it made us not to use power cart however caddies are professional to help us. Hoping to be here again at no rainy season sometimes.

We had a perfect ,short friends and family holiday! The food, the hospitality and the property is fabulous. We refused to leave the property seeing the roads that lead us there! In spite of us being at the resort for the entire trip, there was not a day we got bored! The spa, pool and a walk along the different areas in the resort were amazing.We lived on the momo's and Thupa! Had a traditional Nepalese Thali as well..Rajender, Kumari and all the managers and support staff ensured our stay was comfortable.Highly recommend the property to unwind from the busy city lives we lead!!

I stayed at Gokarna Forest resort from 27-29 July.I would like to state the stay from start till end was just perfect.Special thanks to Ms. Bandana for her whole hearted support & her customer care skills are commendable.Thanks to Kiran the restaurant staff & masseuse Ms. Rashmi & Ms. Ria for their profession approach.Please keep up the good work.

Lovely hotel with friendly and helpful staff for whom nothing was too much  trouble (e.g. lending me an adaptor for a UK plug).Amazing choice of food for breakfast. Huge room with everything you could possibly want or need, including WiFi. Experienced one of the best nights sleep I have ever had - partly due to jet lag, but also due to the amazingly comfortable bed!If I were to return to Kathmandu I would certainly want to stay here again, but would like time to explore the grounds and swim in the enticing looking pool.

I was staying there for 2 nights and had my parents with me. Really enjoyed this stay. Rooms are big and clean with modern amenities. Most of the rooms have nice view of forest area. Many activities to do and most of the spa facilities like steam sauna and jacuzzi are included in base price so no extra cost for them. Swimming pool was heated so no worries abt using it in cold weather. If you like trekking they have some forest treks. They have golf course also.Number of veg items in breakfast could be improved. In room dining was good. Best time to visit would be all year except heavy rainy season. One more thing this property dont have lifts so keep that in mind if you travel with elderly, but most of facilities are on ground floor and in walkable distance.

Well we ended here because our reservation was cancelled from some other resort. Excellent resort with great surrounding and lovely food. Staffs are very welcoming and helpful. Rooms are very clean and very good for the price they offer. Best part is indoor swimming pool which can be used all session even for late night.

Ideal hotel to get away from the stress and noise of Kathmandu. A bit pricey but certainly worth the effort if you fancy a bit of luxury. The hotel is beautifully decorated with authentic Nepali artwork. The rooms are also very nicely decorated. It has been thought about, you can see that. Nice to go to the Spa or hang out in the pool. Very friendly staff, nice garden. But the bar is a bit pricey.

We stayed at the resort for one night and then went golfing and used the spa. It is a wonderful resort. Very clean and beautiful. The staff were all very friendly and helpful. Would definitely recommend to others.

Great environment and staff care. It has a great restaurant with verity of choices and really good food. The facilities available can really make a memorable day out with loved ones. Really enjoyed and looking forward to stay again. However, it seemed like there was some miscommunication among staffs regarding our request for photoshoot. We were told it would not be a problem to take pictures with a professional cameraman. But, we were repeatedly asked by different staffs to either ask for permission or not to shoot anymore, which made us a bit uncomfortable. Nonetheless, apart from that, everything was top class. Thank you Gokarna Forest Resort for a great environment  for our first wedding anniversary.

Stayed there for one night upon return from EBC trek....and must say that the property is simply awesome. The reception, the check in, the massage all 5 star.......bar can have more draft beer options but still quite good.

We stayed in gokarna for two nights. Resort is very beautiful and so are the rooms. Rooms have a beautiful wooden look with all the modern amenities. I really  loved there shampoos and soaps. They were so good with beautiful fragrance. We also saw deer and monkeys there. Staff was good and polite. We had dinner there and it was really very tasty. Well these are the positive points. But as they se that nothing is perfect so that was same in this  case.First of all there is no lift. Our room was on second floor and since we were travelling with our parents it was difficult to climb up for them.Secondly beware of monkeys. They were roaming in galleries also.And the most important was the buffet breakfast. On first day we were served cold breakfast and the irony was that the juice served to us was not cold and the food served was cold. I think reason for this would be the marraige function there. So we complained at the reception and they told us that they will make sure to serve us better next day. Next morning although breakfast was hot but it was not at all tasty and the options are also very less and this should not happen in a 5 star resort.Otherwise our stay was nice and comfortable.

My wife and I stayed here on the full golf package. We had a great time. The resort was great and the staff were delightful. The golf course was wonderful and challenging and the scenery was amazing. We ate every night in each restaurant and the food was excellent. Would highly recommend.

We stayed not long after the floods in Chitwan and the hotel had been affected as it is right on the river,  but they had done an amazing job in making Th he hotel habitable staff were exceptional and the work in the garden while we were there was amazing. Would highly recommend if you intend to stay in Chitwan.

Staff was very cooperative. room size was bigger then the expectation and food was very delicious.location interior is mind blowing. mainly staff are ready to help the guest for 24 hour, which is beyond my expectation level.

this hotel was set far enough out of the city to truly unwind. it felt like a different country, clean air, green grounds, jungle surrounds and excellent service.free 30min massage, a drink on arrival and breakfast every day. the food was amazing! full buffet breakfast and dinner, with everything you could imagine. the a la carte menu was full of yummy choices!the rooms were so large and bathroom you could have a party in!

pros1)Really a gem of a place in terms of natural surrounding beauty and staff courteousness2)Forest walk is refreshing and the view of the golf course is remarkable3)Staff is warm and eager to help you4)Room is quite spacious and you feel relaxed overallCons1)A little far off from main city2)Roads leading to the place is in dilapidated state but that's almost everywhere in Nepal but still managebale3)The swimming pool was not adequately heated and the kids swimming pool motor was not working at the time of my visit.4)My kid was hence disappointed as he was not allowed in Jacuzzi ,hence some unhappy moments .The hotel should have a policy to allocate some family time(demarcate a separate time slot ) for Jacuzzi where kids can also be permitted along with parents

We stayed in Gokarna twice recently. Once was to attend a wedding and the other was to celebrate my huband's birthday. Both visits were excellent. It is truly a magical place. Far away from the dust and crowds of the city. Mr Norbu (Manager F&B) and Mr Rohit (at the bar) were wonderful. They and their team went out of the way to make our stay special. The food is good. The deer add a magical touch to the resort.

We planned our fifth anniversary at Gokarna Resort! Our stay was splendid as we were overwhelmed by warm hospitality. The only improvement needed was on the dinner buffet, it was bit of a let down for the money you pay. I highly recommend Gokarna Resort!

I’m so glad I found Gokarna Forest Resort... it’s close enough to Kathmandu, Thamel and the airport but an oasis that is a world away from the hustle and bustle of the busy city...Staff are very friendly, welcoming and ameniable... The rooms are very spacious and comfortable with fabulous views of the courtyard and the resident spotted deer and mischievous monkeys...Sensational forest walks and golf course cart tour are amazing and it’s so hard to believe you are in such a busy city.The “dancing road” to get to the resort from city is not what you would expect, though it is quite quirky..  it’s about 1200npr to get to the resort from the airport..The meals are fabulous and a great choice, the omelettes made to order at the breakfast buffet are sensational..I spent many lazy days just sitting on the patio of Bar 8848 drinking tea and people watching, especially when staff were setting up for weddings.. These were so colourful and spectacular, you almost felt part of the celebrations...Would highly recommend Gokarna Forest Resort to travellers that want a “luxury escape” from the kaos of Kathmandu city...

This place does feel like an oasis in KTM. We stayed for 5 nights, the room, bar areas, restaurant and spa were all nice. Do go to the Thai/Chinese restaurant/bar that overlooks the golf course, in my opinion its better than the main bar and restaurant up in the hotel. Be aware that you cannot access the forest at all unless you book a "guide" (don't expect any naturalist knowledge). We booked the 4 hour trail walk as advertised in the hotel reception (see photo), however it ended very sourly since we only walked in the forest/golf course for, at most, 40 mins, then we were in towns, on roads dodging traffic and breathing in fumes/dust. We gave up and went back to the hotel. The manager apologised and didn't charge us, but do check thoroughly what you will actually get/expect when you book anything because we felt very misled. I hope the hotel quickly revises its literature and others won't have the disappointment we did.

We were on an OAT group yrip and spent 3 nights at the beginning  and one night at the end. The staff is wonderful they do anything they can to help you especially  Sabrina,  she remembered  us when we returned and was so helpful.  The spa is one of the best I have been to, wish I could  have had another day just to have  amother message. If you are in Kathmandu  stay there. When we returned there was a wedding and we got to see it. What a treat.

A must visit for someone looking out for a peaceful yet comfortable luxurious stay. With amenities to make sure you get an excellent experience like an indoor swimming pool, gym, golf course to name a few. The Darbar restaurant was superb too with the quick and professional service. Definitely an amazing experience all in all.

Fantastic Property and has the one thing that no other property in Kathmandu has. Their own private forest.. Serene, calm, fantastic rooms and staff. They have a pool, golf-course, spa and a significant number of historical monuments on the 700 acre plus forest.

The Gokarna Forest Resort has a peaceful and relaxed ambience. We had a wonderfully relaxing massage on our arrival. Our room was most comfortable and clean. The local Nepalese food was lovely as well as the hospitality and entertainment. We would be happy to stay again on our return to Nepal.

Just overall a great place with great service all together. Warm welcome, good food for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Golf place looks nice and need. Super friendly staff, you felt absolutely spoiled by the people onboard. Can only recommend

This was a welcome sight after 5 weeks of traveling in Asia.  It has all the amenities including a beautiful golf course, spa, swimming pool, well outfitted fitness center and restaurant.  Food was great, service wonderful and attentive staff.  It stands in sharp contrast to the noise, and bustle of Kathmandu.  Rooms were large and comfortable.  Highly recommend.

Travelled for a golf weekend with 7 other couples ... we were to go to Srinagar but given the law and order situation there we decided on Gokarna. The rooms were nice  ... we were first given a room o the 3rd floor (no elevators) so we asked for a room switch ... they gave us a lovely very large room on the 2nd floor. The staff were very courteous and polite. But the highlight of the holiday was the golf ... the course is stunningly beautiful ... for a hill/mountain course  ...really well maintained. Amazingly pretty ... towards the afternoon there were literally deer & monkeys (not aggressive)  all over the fairways ...and everyday we saw a different type of snake on the course ... the greens were well kept and true and also the fairways . it took a couple of rounds ( interrupted by rain) to get a hang of the course ...but great fun. And the clubhouse has just superb food. So great golf, great food and great service

Spacious, well equipped room, very good food, beautiful location and excellent staff  ... what more could you wish for? Bird watching was particularly good in the hotel grounds and you could also take a walk in the forest with an experienced hotel guide.

The scenery was beautiful! You wouldn’t think you were 5 minutes from chaos. The customer service was 5 star and the food was by far the best I’ve had at my stay in Kathmandu.The only feedback I would suggest is that i felt quite restricted at times not being able to freely walk around. I would recommend providing the customers with walkie talkies or tracking devices so we could take a walk in the forest.

If the traffic in Kathmandu seems chaotic to you then this resort will be your relaxing place. The staff is very friendly and accommodating to all your needs. The rooms are clean and spacious, just make sure to keep the windows closed or the monkeys will go all Jumanji on your stuff. There are so many places to relax at this resort, you have the golf course, pool, spa, many seating areas, and your room. The ATM in the main lobby didn't seem to work for any of our ATM cards, which was a bit funky. The staff said it doesn't like VISA cards when there was a sticker on the ATM machine that says it only takes VISA cards. So, if you need cash bring it before getting to the resort or outside of the resort.

An out of crowd hotel, the right place if you want to be away from chaos of Kathmandu but still be close to the city. Beautifully laid golf course and surroundings, you can have a laid back day with nature around you. Very helpful and courteous staff especially at the front desk

It was excellent stay at  Gokarna Forest Resort. The thick forest together with lush green Golf course is awesome. we enjoyed morning walk in the dense forest and saw  lot deers roaming in the forst. Food taste has been awesome ....lot of variety and less spicy.  Rooms are also neat and clean. Overall enjoyable stay

We stayed in Gokarna Forst Resort for 2 days and found it amazing experience to refresh and rejoice while being in polluted & dusty environment of Kathmandu. The most significant is Fresh Air and very fresh environment. We had plenty of walk and exercised ourselves. The resort staff is amazingly cooperative and their management seems keen to put "Client service" as their top priority. Except a small unpleasant encounter at reception when they kept us waiting for tiny things, rest of the staff was very cooperative and pleasant. Especially Ms. Sumita who took us around to get oriented with resort amenities and was there all the time to help us. Ms. Bandana Khadka with huge smile and always in a helping and assisting mode, Mr. Rup Kumar with helpful tips for food and his tremendously supportive nature....all this made our stay more comfortable. Hospitality seems a trademark of Gokarna Resort. Worth mentioning is the kind services of their waitress Ms. Shrizana who was always there to make our outside food more pleasant and delicious. I give 10/10 hospitality marks to their staff. Apart from good food, good facilities, tremendous environment and extremely pure air, I would suggest some small suggestions to improve like:  Don't take much time at reception for formalities as this can be done once guests are in and settled in their rooms. Bed sizes must be increased as it was a bit short for a 6ft man :)Tiny surprises like small gift for kids, a Fruit basket in room, a free tea etc can increase the emotional value and affection a lot. Hope management will consider it For sure, we are looking forward to visit again very soon !!

After successfully negotiating the challenges of a 16 day Everest Base Camp trek Gorkana was a baven grom which to edxplore Kathmandu. I particularly appreciated the clean, clear air,warm service and great food.

Stayed here for one night on the last day of a very busy week long tour The resort is a bit of an oasis out of the hustle and bustle of Nepal and I loved the monkeys running around all over the place The rooms were very large and clean The staff were extremely friendlyBreakfast and dinner were both delicious A couple negatives- the cleanliness of the carpet walking to your room was not the best it needs to be replaced pretty much, there were also just random mattresses sitting up against the wall in the hallways My main negative- on the morning we were due to leave we were taken from the hotel to the airport, we pulled up, the driver said oh by the way the airport is shut, bye. This was at 8:30am and the airport had been shut since 10pm the night before- why would they take us to an airport that’s shut rather than let us relax in the resort until it re opened. So we were stuck there and had to call our tour guide to come get us and take us to a closer hotel until the airport re opened- which we had no idea how long would take. For a 5 star hotel I would have expected they let us know the airport isn’t even open so we didn’t waste a whole day sitting around Overall a nice stay but disappointing service when checking out

This property-both the facilities AND the grounds- are wonderfully maintained. It may be a little far from the excitement of Old Kathmandu, but in this case it is a good thing. If you have excursions planned to the sights of the city, Gokarna Forest Resort is the perfect place to come home to.  Green and cool and clean.The service staff is exceptional. If I had to single out one department, it would probably be the desk staff, who were always there to take care of every request. But housekeeping and food service were great, too.  This staff has not only been well trained, but they really care that guests are accommodated. I don’t usually rate the quality of the service, but the professionalism of the Gokarna staff at all levels was outstanding.And the foood selections were creative and well prepared.  Great hotel, all around!

Situated outside Kathmandu with its own golf course and land.All meals are buffet style, staff are friendly.  One night mainly Indian, the next Chinese.  Breakfast has a good selection of international food plus eggs cooked to order.  Room 162 overlooked main courtyard, large, well appointed with a seating area, large bathroom with a good shower & hot water.  Wifi free but slow & lighting levels low in room.

Gokarna Forest Resort is located in nice forest. Morning walk in forest is really a delight. We as a team walked for 2 Hrs each day for 2 days and enjoyed a lot. Second day program changed to Morning walk from Yoga based on 1st day's experience. Rooms are so big and Bath tub is a family bath tub. Entire family can take bath together. Indore swimming pool is also good

I visited this property during Baisakhi holidays for 4 nights and four rounds of golf. Property is very nicely managed and staff is very courteous. Menu both at Durbar restra and golf course restra were very nice. Food was really good. Golf course is not up to international standards but even then quite beautiful and located amidst nature. If you are a keen golfer then at least one visit is must...

The rooms are spacious and comfortable, the pool and spa is very nice. The fitness room is a little outdated but is still a nice feature. The restaurant serves nice food, but the waiting times can be a bit excessive. Breakfast is good and the setting is pleasant, but the wi-fi is quite slow.

We stayed at Gokarna on two occasions and were both times greetanded by a lovely guest relation executive, Bandana. She made us feel very welcome, showed us around the property and regularly ensured we had no queries.The hotel is an old style hotel in the forest with huge beautiful rooms. However, the corridors felt cold at night time. The hotel and restaurants are clean and elegant.   We had a great  relaxing massage, with a swim, sauna and spa.  The morning yoga and meditation session in the gym was a good experience. These facilities are however old and would benefit from an update.We had  fantastic meals in both the restaurant and bar area  with excellent service from all staff.   The morning breakfast buffet had a great variety including eggs made on order,  although one morning the sun was shining right on the food, melting the butter. Gokarna should ensure the cold food is  kept cold and away from the sun.The  porter and concierge staff are very lovely and helpful, assisting with bags, organizing badminton games on the front lawn and providing advise on facilities around the resortWe had a fantastic, relaxing stay in this forest resort

Dear all,We vistit this resort befor and after our hike in the mountains of Nepal. And it was very nice! Perfect resort to relax before or after a long flight or hike, on a quiet place not far from Kathmandu. The staff was very helpful and friendly. They arrange everything for you. taxi? No problem. They have their own taxi central. Mountain flight? They make the call and 30 min later you have your tickets and all info. Payment is in the resort as well. You want to relax for a day? Their spa has everything. swimming pool, sauna, steam room and go on. The Food for breakfast, lunch or diner, is good, included local Nepalese food, or European food. the choise is yours. Anyway, we had a great time in Nepal. Especially by the friendly Front office employees Sabina and Dikshya. Ladies, Thank you for all your help and everything else!!! Greetings Jeroen and Pascal from The Netherlands.

Beautiful and tranquil environment in a forested hill above the frenetic activity of Kathmandu.The rooms are spacious with comfortable beds and the restaurant food is delicious.The staff are friendly and accommodate all your requests.

12 jours au Gokarna pour profiter d'un cadre de repos et de nature rappelant un Népal hors de la pollution de la ville. Un personnel d'une grande gentillesse, d'une attention constante et un service impeccable. Juste faire attention aux singes. On entend les oiseaux de la forêt et le golf dans un cadre naturel est magnifique. Très bonne nourriture, bien préparée conforme à un très bon standard pour le Népal. Excellent rapport qualité-prix. Hôtel idéal si vous devez rester longtemps à Kathmandou. Buffet du matin pourrait être amélioré mais très correct.

We loved staying at Gokarna forest resort. It was nice after trekking for 12 days to unwind here . We loved the pool, spa and sauna. The food is reasonably priced and delicious. Rooms are spacious and comfortable. Suck a nice relief from from crazy Kathmandu. The staff are so helpful. Highly recommend it

After two weeks of hopping around India by planes, trains, bus, auto-rickshaw and bicycle rickshaw our tour group arrived in the middle of the night at the Gokarna- four nights in Nepal without having to pack up and move!We discovered when we woke up in the morning that we were in a beautiful setting- immaculate gardens, giant trees, a golf course and walking trails.  We had all of our breakfasts in the Durbar restaurant and the food was an excellent mix of Nepalese, Asian (there were many tourists from Asia) and American/European.  Omelets cooked to order were available.  My room was large and pleasant.  Giant shades kept out the morning sun.  There were signs warning about the monkeys (don’t feed them, keep your doors locked so they don’t enter the room and cause damage).  As promised, there were monkeys all over but they were pretty calm and it was easy to get pictures.  Internet could be very slow at times but Nepal is still a developing country so I assume it’s a function of the infrastructure.The staff was gracious and helpful and all were fluent in English.  On our last morning I tactfully pointed out a dead moth on a windowsill in the restaurant.  Within two minutes it was removed.  The gym had a nice view of the golf course and all the equipment that I used was in working order.  The indoor pool was a generous size (L-shaped) and very refreshing.  Members of our group who had massages, facials and pedicures raved about the results.I can’t comment on “value for money” since the hotel rate was booked in the cost of the tour, but I had dinner in the lounge one night and it was about US $22 for a vegetarian main dish and a Bloody Mary.  This was definitely a beautiful place to rest after hectic days sightseeing and enduring Kathmandu’s roads, many of which are under construction.  Highly recommended.

Our Everest Base Camp Trek concluded with a luxury stay here at Gorkana Forest Resort. It was just what we needed after our challenging adventure. A peaceful forest retreat away from the craziness of Thamel. Big rooms, lounge, king bed and massive bathroom. The Resort has a lovely Spa that provided many therapeutic services, including brilliant massages, facials, manicure and pedicures. Staff in all areas of the resort went above and beyond to make us feel super special. We loved it so much, we stayed an extra 4 days. We did some Yoga, used the gym and pool area, visited the Saibaba Temple and had a hit of Golf on the driving range.  The food was brilliant with the choice of 3 restaurants to dine in. We always came back to the 8848 Bar & Patio where the Executives Ramesh and Rajendra provided outstanding 5 star service. Sita gave us brilliant menu recommendations everyday. Prabim was the best, he explained everything on the food and drink menu and thank you for bringing me the best Dahl Baht I had in Nepal. Sirjana was gorgeous and made the best lemon mint tea 2-3x daily for my partner who had a touch of Khumbu Cough. There were also options of Shuttle Bus or your own driver if you wanted to go back into town or explore the local area. Totally recommend Gorkana Forest Resort, treat yourself to the amazing guest services that will make you feel like a king or queen.

My stay at Gokarna Forest Resort was full of surprises thankfully each one pleasant The resort is tucked away in a forest , cut off from the hustle bustle of the city nestled within expanse of lush greenery , the occasional sighting of wildlife makes one feel that the natural surrounding is undisturbed Having said this the resort in itself has extremely well appointed rooms and suites some with personal balconies , The rooms and bathrooms larger than an average hotel room lending  the feeling of spaciousness , each overlooking magnificent views of nature and it’s bounties The speciality restaurants and bar serving up delicious varied cuisines , the pool tables and sheesha stations set the mood for recreation and relaxation and add a special touch , the staff at all the outlets extremely courteous polite and warm A special thank you to Mr Divas Shreshta , Front Office Manager for making me feel welcome , cared for and safe , Safety being top priority for a single lady traveler such as myself , He took care of my needs from check in to check out and ensured that I was well looked after right through my stay  , thus exuding high levels of professionalism ,his kind  gentle and genuine mannerism represented the Nepalese hospitality in a true sense  Would strongly recommend Gokarna Forest Resort as a Romantic getaway , A peaceful retreat or to anyone who is need of heavy doses of fresh natural pure air Just Breathe !

Gokarna was our home for 5 days as we toured Nepal and Everest.It is truly an oasis away from the business of Kathmandu.The surrounding forest creates a lovely clean, green zone, along with a 18 hole golf course it is peaceful and charming. The staff give 120% especially, Nurbu ( Food and Beverage Manager ) and Bandana ( Guest Relations).We all loved our stay at the resort and can highly recommend it for your time in Nepal.

No negative things to say. Staff fantastic, unbelievable grounds, amazing facilities. We ate in the bar and had great vegetarian food. Also had a massage at the spa which although extra was thoroughly worth it.

We were there on a Valentine Day, Just newly married and it was a short and sweet stay. Everything was more than good than we planned. Amazing place with reasonable price. Near from city yet peaceful and felt like we were so close to environment.Firstly Thanks to Deepika mam for facilitating with all the things and being so comfortable to talk with about even the small issues.. Secondly thanks to marketing manager mam ( forgot her name ) for being so responsive and ready to help as we once cancelled and tried to reschedule the stay as my wife got sick. However, we end up staying on the same booked day. And lastly the massage guy for being so respectful and giving such relaxing massage.

I was there with a friend for a short visit from Kathmandu city centre. We heard about this place which has its own golf course and some nice treks nearby. When we first arrived, a friendly staff, Prateek Karmacharya from the marketing team welcomed us warmly at the reception. He even recommended us some lovely dishes at the Chinese restaurant. Since I am a vegetarian I am a little bit fuzzy about ordering the right kind of food, the fried eggplant with chilly and sour sauce was absolutely delicious! There are both outdoor and indoor seatings at the restaurant. If you choose to sit outdoor, you'd be able to enjoy the astonishing golf course view and a lot of greenery over a glass of beer or a cup of coffee.We then went for a little stroll on the golf cart. It's really a lovely way to check out this gigantic space if you do not want to walk all the way and exhaust yourself! My friend also went for a little golf practice. The tutor was really patient while teaching my friend. He ended up playing (kind of) like a pro in the end!I would recommend this place to anyone who's in the area of Kathmandu and looking for a place to chill which is not very far away from the city centre. This place would be a paradise for golf lovers of course!

We spend 5 nights at the Gokarna Resort and after having spoken with friends and colleagues about Kathmandu and read reviews, we chose Gokarna specifically because of its high standards, foresty location (Away from the dust, exhaust fumes and pollution ).The resort did not disappoint! The traditional Nepalese looking hotel sits on a hill in the middle of beautiful forest. One of its restaurants/bars overlooks a golf course and at around 4-5pm you can see deer wondering through the grassy areas. It was wonderful to be actually on 20-30mins from the airport and Kathmandu City, and wake up watching monkeys and listening to birds singing. This place is an oasis.We stayed in Club rooms which were huge, beds are very comfortable. Breakfast is plentiful and we tried all the restaurants for lunch and dinner. Food is very good. The spa is located in its own building with heated indoor pools and jacuzzis. Spa treatments are excellent. Possibly one of the best deep tissue massages I ve had. But by far the best part of this resort was its amazingly friendly and attentive staff. Daily we were asked how our holiday was going and if there was anything that they could do for us. Nothing was a problem; from arranging tours, booking restaurants, making spa reservations to changing pillows... absolutely everything was looked after beautifully. We fell in love with this hotel and would recommend it wholeheartedly. All of us love to adventure, hike, enjoy cultural and historical sights but we also like to take a break from the busy city. This hotel was definitely for us.Thank you Gokarna staff.

Spending a couple of days with my colleagues in Gokarna Forest Resort was a nice getaway from the hustle and bustle of a busy work schedule, and escape, for a time, the endless list of daily tasks at workplace. We were in a dire need of a peaceful place to rejuvenate our minds and souls in order to think constructively and strategically for developing our action plan for the year 2018. During our stay, I was amazed by the pristine beauty of the hotel’s surroundings and really touched by the hospitality of the staff. I am really grateful to Deepika Shrestha, Bandana Khadka, Binod Ghimire and other staff for their flawless customer service. We were served with variety of choices for breakfast, lunch and dinner. We also took our time to enjoy heavenly spa, Jacuzzi and swimming pool which were complimentary. Taking a walk in the morning and evening around the golf course was enlivening. An eye-catching view overlooking green forests makes the place heavenly. I could really feel the positive vibes and enjoyed every bit of my time there.  The place is truly an oasis in Kathmandu. Highly recommended to those who want to be closer to the nature. Best Regards,Lachhindra

I stayed there for 2 days 1 night and I must say it's one of the best hotel stays I've experienced in my life. The variety and quality of food is awesome. There are plenty of activities like golf, swimming, spa, all of which are really enjoyable. The rooms are as comfortable as it can get. The environment is green, healthy and peaceful. The staffs, including Diksha Khand, are really informative and helpful.

A wonderful relaxation place where you can set your mind in peace.Good and healthy food to have.Huge room space, tidy and with Bar facilities.Bed and bedsheet were tidy.A corridor on the back side but so pleasant to have fresh air. Unfortunately, unable to practice a golf due to some Food festival going on.But overall it was a wonderful and pleasant environment.

The facility is very nice and relaxing, especially the wide windows from which lying in the pool you can enjoy beautiful scene of outside nature. The air in the resort is fresh and is a huge relief from dusty Kathmandu. An excellent ending of the relaxing day can be the dinner the bar near fire place where delicious food is served by most caring staff.

Plus:  Staff are wonderful. Front desk staff, servers in restaurant, F&B manager, the friendliest and most helpful staff I've seen. They deserve accolades.   The location is quiet and peaceful.  I had an issue with the golf cart tour, and they went above and beyond rectifying it when I brought it to their attention. If I were rating the staff, it would be a 5/5. Cons:  Windows on 3rd floor were filthy,  this was in a luxury room, not the average rooms, but it didn't matter much because the view was of a broken down storage building/shed, fenced in area filled with scraps and junk. Food:  Lunch/Dinner a-la-carte was great, no complaints. Was delicious.   Breakfast Buffet was weak and almost unappetizing.  It was 3* breakfast at best. Disappointing. Overall, the resort was really just an old hotel that had lost it's former glory. It wasn't super clean or well kept up, lots of places you can see broken down shingles, moulding, dis-repair, lack of cleanliness.  Way way way overpriced. I felt cheated, won't be returning.

Bella la struttura e ben inserita in un bel parco . Direi un po’ lontana dalla città circa un’ora . Però arrivati l’ospitalità è garantita. Buona soluzione per chi vuol visitare la città e poi rifugiarsi in un’oasi .

Lovely stay at Gokarna, good facilities and lovely service and rooms. The staff are very friendly and helpful, always willing to book taxi rides to and from the resort for you. The 2 hour forest walk was very interesting and we enjoyed it a lot! Beautiful resort and a lovely bar too!!

Gokarna forest park provides a sylvan retreat from the city at less than an hour's drive from Kathmandu.  The hotel combines traditional style with space and comfort, and offers a full golf course (lessons available for beginners and the more experienced).  The staff could not be more helpful and do their utmost to ensure an enjoyable stay.  I particularly enjoyed the forest walks, the free yoga classes, the spa (I would recommend the ayurvedic massage) and the generous breakfast to start the day well.  In short, this was a perfect weekend retreat.

Thoroughly enjoyed this delightful resort. Room was huge, as was bath. Good excellent. All in all a great stay. Took a guided hike last morning and enjoyed seeing spotted deer and monkeys jumping tree to tree.

We spent 2 days in Gokarna Forest Resort, recovering from our trek to Mt Everest Base Camp. We felt very special as all staff were professional and helpful. In particular Diksha in Reception, Ujjwal in Housekeeping as well as Anita & Goama in the Spa Centre. Thank you very much to these staff members for making our stay so memorable.

We recently stayed at Gokarna Forest Resort for 4 nights. It is a well kept and friendly hotel with a spa and unique 18 hole golf course. You can eat in the restaurant, bar or golf club and there is a reasonable range of cuisine offered. We asked to move rooms but only because our first neighbours were very noisy. Staff are helpful and polite. Our main information for fellow travellers is that the hotel is isolated. If you want to go into Kathmandu to look around you have to take a tricky 30 minute taxi ride each way. This resulted in us spending more time in the hotel than if we'd stayed in the centre of the city. The treatments at the spa are excellent.

I really enjoyed staying there ,its a wonderful place ,I would like to thank pratik pradhan for all his valuable time to make us comfortable ,though we were there for very short stay but enjoyed every second ,,,we would love to visit again and again . really appreciated.

Gokarna Forest Resort sits just outside of Katmandu, far enough away for a great escape and close enough for day trips into the city for sightseeing and shopping. The spa therapist are quite talented, however do not expect a 5 star experience as the spa walls are shared by the indoor pool and jacuzzi areas and can be a bit distracting when people are using these facilities.Watching the ever present monkeys seeking the last rays of the day on the roof outside our window was the highlight of our day.Staff at Gokarna are awesome and do everything possible to accommodate and anticipate your needs. Will definitely return to Gokarna Forest Resort when visiting Katmandu.

The Gokarna was the site of a one week UN workshop that I co-facilitated; we had 22 participants from all over the world. We received excellent service, every need was addressed with a smile- the young women who run the place are exceptionally efficient and capable. All the service staff were pleasant. The good was delicious and we ate too much! I highly recommend this place for meetings and workshop.

We stayed twice during our time in Nepal and found the hotel to be a wonderful calming place to stay during a busy tour of the country. The rooms are spacious, impeccably clean, relaxing views and wonderful silence all around, which is amazing considering the chaos of Kathmandu. The staff are gracious and helpful and we were so thankful when they helped us locate a lost phone by calling around all our previous hotels and drivers to help find it - which they did! The food in the restaurant was excellent and we enjoyed dining in front of the roaring fire with delicious food and wine. The spa is also highly recommended and the traditional Himalayan massage is revitalising and very therapeutic. We would definitely return as our hotel if choice in Kathmandu.

A pristine environment in the middle of the city would be one way of describing the Gorkana Forest Resort. The forest surrounding the hotel effectively acts as a barrier to the dust and pollution on the main road approaching the turn-off to the Gokarna reserve. Once inside, it's hard to imagine that one is still very much inside the busy Kathmandu Valley. Spent a night there about two weeks back, over the year-end holidays. The welcoming and helpful front desk staff discussed the extra activities that I could enjoy in the resort, from which I chose a forest walk and a horse ride, while they arranged for my room. They also have a heated pool (one of the few in the city) and spa services. The room they gave me was at some distance from the lobby, therefore quite a walk down rustic corridors. But it was warm and comfortable, with a view of the garden, and the in-room tea/coffee were also a welcome addition. The bathroom was quite large, so the room had to make do with smaller space. With large beds and lounge furniture, it felt a bit cramped. Still, it was quiet and cosy.The food was quite good both at the restaurant and at the afternoon BBQ brunch laid out in the garden, offering a variety of dishes and drinks. A small band kept the rhythm going and there was also a raffle draw at the end of the session. The restaurant staff, particularly one serving staff member, was quite professional in service and knowledgeable about the local food options on offer at the breakfast buffet. Tried the "kiir" at his recommendation, which turned out to be excellent!The forest walk with the knowledgeable guide was quite refreshing. Through the golf links entered into the forested area, passing many macaque monkeys and a herd of spotted deer on the way. My horse Rudra was a friendly chap and that helped allay any apprehensions and make my first-time ride quite pleasant! Would certainly go back to Gokarna resort for more relaxing weekends as the weather warms up.

Beautiful resort like heaven on earth , beautiful weather and lots of deers in the forest, breathtaking views and lakes, you can play golf and have a tour in golf car around the resort and enjoy tasty dishes in club house restaurant, there are lots of monkeys be careful not to carry food while going around the resort, in general amazing place for get away from busy city.

Our stay at the Gokarna Forest Resort was amazing. The rooms are super clean, the showers get really hot, and there is a fireplace in the bar with comfy couches to relax. Further, the staff was attentive and worked to make sure that we had no issues throughout our three day stay. Last, we visited Nepal right after our marriage ceremony and they sent a sweet cake with best wishes to our room. It was an extremely thoughtful touch.

Außerhalb der grobstaubgesättigten Luft von Kathmandu und der entsprechenden Wohlgerüche des Orients bietet dieses großzügige Resort Entspannung pur mit 18 Loch Golf und schönem Hallenbad. Da wir mehrere Tage und zweimal da waren, konnten wir unterschiedliche Zimmer erleben. Sie sind geschmackvoll, den Stil des Landes aufnehmend, eingerichtet und groß wie Tanzsäle. Bei der Sauberkeit des Bads hatte ich einmal kleinere Probleme. Darf man bei 5* auch habe können. Das Personal war freundlich und bemüht, nicht immer aufmerksam. Das Hotel grenzt an einen urwaldmäßigen Nationalpark, was sich in der Fauna auf dem Hotelgelände auswirkt. Neben dem "resident deer" tobt die Affenbande. Fenster sind tunlichst geschlossen zu halten. Der Gast haftet für etwaige Beschädigungen im Zimmer.Die Küche ist gut. die abendlichen Buffets sind eine gute Wahl. Die Frühstücke sind bis auf den Geschirrnachschub super, der "Omelettmeister" ist nach zwei Jahren in dieser Position in der Lage, alle Wünsche zu erfüllen. Gokarna ist ein erlebnis, das man sich gönnen sollte.

Few kilometers away from all the traffic and dust, this place is so quiet and refreshing. The service is great. Lot of activities. perfect getaway if you are tired of busy streets. Rooms are spacious its home away from home kind of feeling. During or stay of one night during Christmas eve we enjoyed great gala dinner with live music and following morning had a great sauna and jacuzzi time during which kids enjoyed hot water swimming pool. after which we went on for a lunch at restaurant near golf course and had a nice golf cart ride exploring the golf course.

Had a great time at Gokarna Forest. People were very friendly.The staff is amazing. Will never forget Sabina for helping me execute my surprise for my friend. Had a meomorable time staying there. Breakfast was delicious. The room was very comfortable. Room service was very prompt. Thanks to all the staff who looked after us.Will defenately recommend and next time I will be staying there too. Never thought ever that I will be going to Nepal in my life but went there to see my best friend  and will never forget this trip and our stay at Gokarna.Amazing country and very friendly people.

A beautiful property with large, well maintained rooms. The hotel also hosts a great spa and heated pool. The rooms and food are definitely pricey considering the other nicer hotels in Kathmandu, but if you are looking for a breath of air in an otherwise hectic city, this is the place.

We stayed at The Gorkana with a tour.  It is very comfortable, large room, nice forest, clean air, reasonable food.  The golf looked nice (no one was playing), and lots of monkeys playing around.  However, it you like to tour Kathmandu it is an hour drive on dusty roads.  I would have preferred staying near the center of Kathmandu and spending more time exploring the city.

Great rooms, amazing staff & peaceful stay. It was great fun to watch deers outside our room. Decent spa & they also have Indoor heated swimming pool & Jacuzzi. Thanks to Bandana especially for premier room upgrade & great help during our stay :)

The Gokarna Resort is a lovely property with excellent restaurants, gift shop and golf course. However, the forest part was not emphasized. We would like to see more nature walks , possibly even a daily morning of afternoon walk.

From the delicious meals and the comfortable rooms, to the forest with its many species of birds and animals, it was a great place to stay. Our tour to this interesting country gave us three opportunities to stay here as we traveled from Bhutan to Nepal to Tibet and back. Thanks to the friendly, helpful staff, I would love to return.

Our stay at Gokarna started on a wonderful note when we got an upgrade to premium rooms. The rooms are beautiful and very comfortable. The resort is green and well spread out. A special mention to the staff here- they are so courteous and polite. Always ready to assist the guests with whatever they ask for. The only drawback is that the road to the resort is very bad. And the food is not that great.

Our experience at Gokarna forest resort was wonderful! Finally felt good to be away from the dusty and noisy Kathmandu city. Miss. DIkshya Thakuri received us and was very friendly,frank and welcoming. She recommended us doing the golf driving range during noon time,which we absolutely loved it.Hats of to her. Our room was very comfortable and exquisitely decorated. The next morning we enjoyed a delicious breakfast, with fruits and pastries. We hope to return again!

I stayed here at the very end of 2 weeks in Nepal. A wonderful, relaxing way to end a chaotic trip! Staff was fantastic, resort was clean, and the meals were all very good. Highlight was golfing with hundreds of monkeys spectating, very cool and unique experience. The course was very nice, much better than I was expecting. My caddy was also great, very knowledgeable and happy to take several pictures for me. Can't wait to return to Gokarna soon!

it was a good stay for me with my frens..hmm rooms were convenient, staffs were friendly,good food n service as well..id like to thankx my fren dikshya thakuri for helpn me out..by far it was the best resort ive ever experienced..

这是我个人第三次入住Gokarna Foreset酒店，不同于前两次的个人旅行，这次是在这里组织为期一周的禅修精品课程。选择这里主要的原因是：环境好、设施齐备、服务到位。这三个看似简单的要求对于地处加德满都的酒店来说其实是很难做到的。酒店藏身在戈卡那森林中，这是一片几乎与世隔绝的小山林，远离市中心的喧闹和弥漫的灰尘。距离机场也不超过一个小时的车程，非常适合度假和会议。进入酒店的大门，沿着林荫路盘旋而上，第一个冲动就是摇下车窗大口呼吸，第一个惊喜就是看到林间嬉戏的猴子和骑着高头大马散步的骑士，只要你多住几天，就一定足够幸运遇到鹿和叫不出名字的大鸟。酒店的装修是古朴的尼泊尔王朝时期的风格，红砖、木雕，房间超大，浴室超大，而且每个房间的装修风格都不一样，每个。这个我们布置会场，需要用两块一样的地毯拼起来布置，酒店说我们这里找不到两块完全一样的地毯，这也算是特色了吧。我们的课室全部是在会议厅内进行，会议厅的旁边就是一个超大的阳台，面向庭院，可以容纳20-30人的茶歇，茶点全免费还有专人提供服务。其实酒店的户外场地更开阔，有一个庭院式的小广场可以举行婚礼和party，还有大草坪可以练习瑜伽。另外酒店还有自己的golf球场、室内泳池、甚至自己的徒步步道和直升机停机坪。但这些都还只是硬件条件，服务就更周到了。每天两次房间打扫，随时随地Namastye问候，多晚都有客房服务可以把吃的送到房间。酒店有自己的温室和花房，蔬菜是自己种植的，所有插花都是每天早上现摘的。还有就是叫车服务，比城里最好的出租车要宽敞干净，而且价格一样，还能等时。如果是团队客人，酒店还有自己的中巴和大巴，算下来比自己分头打车划算太多了。总之只要在这里住过，不管搬到加都的哪家酒店，都会怀念的。

excellent large room with everything you need.  Huge bathroom with huge tub.  lovely setting with pool, bar, spa,  golf course attentive staff. Convenient to Kathmandu but in a more rural setting.  excellent breakfast buffet.

My husband and I stayed at the Gorkarna Forest Resort for 4 days during our hiking trip to Nepal.  We found it very relaxing and enjoyable and a nice reprieve from the chaos of Kathmandu. Our rooms were large and comfortable and the staff very accommodating and eager to help. The spa is dated but a number of us still had a very good massage there. Breakfast was included with our room and was very good although the dinner menu was kind of expensive. We really enjoyed the hotel but the road to get to it is very bumpy. Three of us played golf one day and three went for a walk on the property so we all had a good time.

This is a hidden treasure forest island just outskirts of capital city where you are treated as Royal! Beautiful and friendly staffs and out of pollution zone.  You will not believe that such beautiful resort exist in Kathmandu, Nepal.Highly recommended for a lifetime experiance.

This hotel is close to the main part of Kathmandu and the airport, but feels like a secluded world away. Great rooms, very large and nicely decorated.  Bathrooms are modern with a huge bath and shower area.  Hotel personnel are friendly and happy to help.  The breakfast buffet was amazing!  An omelet station to boot.  Just loved this place except for one thing.  I signed up for a facial and got it from the same woman who gave my friend a manicure.  I don't think she is trained.  Bad manicure, but THE worst facial EVER!!!!

Here for 4 nights, the rooms are huge and very comfortable indeed. The bathroom has a bath which is more swimming pool than bath. Out of the room window, you might see deer or the local monkey troop wandering past on the lawn outside. It has what must be one of the highest golf courses in the world at nearly 5000 feet. 3 or 4 excellent restaurants and the 8848 bar(The height of Everest in meters). The staff are among the friendliest and most professional and do everything to make your stay pleasant.  We were also able to take a flight from Katmandhu Tribhuvan Airport up to circle around Everest and along part of the Himalyas on, believe it or not, YETI Airlines..

Clean and spacious rooms, excellent and friendly service. Always felt safe. Hotel worked seamlessly with our Tour provider, which matters when you are always on the go. Staff went above and beyond to set up a surprise birthday celebration, complete with complementary cake. Forest and golf course grounds provided a welcome escape from the dust and noise of Kathmandu. Monkeys, deer, bird life all add to the sanctuary setting. (Leach repellent needed anywhere there is lush grass) Breakfast buffet was excellent, with lots of vegetarian options-if that is important to you as it was to us. Our package included a 30 minute massage, which we thoroughly enjoyed. A reality check for westerners: - the roads throughout Kathmandu/Nepal are potholed and busy, so distance is not a good estimate of time when calculating logistics to airport or anywhere. Leave 1-2 hours to airport from Gokarna.  We thoroughly enjoyed our 2 day stay at both ends of our mountain trek. Contrast: Don’t have alternative to compare, but hotels we did visit - not stay-  in Kathmandu did not seem to have the same quality-if that is important to you. Trade off is $$$ and travel time on a very bumpy, dusty road:-) Part of the Fun!We would absolutely recommend Gokarna and stay here again.

Gokarna Forest Resort is actually located in a small forest close to Kathmandu. So, while you are not very far away from Kathmandu city, the Resort is yet so calm and beautiful. We spotted a deer from our room! There is a beautiful green 18 hole golf course that adds to the charm of the Resort. The rooms are huge and nicely decorated. The Spa is has a temperature controlled, indoor swimming pool and a fantastic jacuzzi, simply refreshing after a tiring sightseeing trip.  On our first night we requested for dinner to be served on the grounds near the bar under a canopy for our group and the staff willingly obliged. The next night we decided to try the oriental restaurant near the golf course, and the chef whipped up a super delicious Tibetan dinner for us. It was like being in food paradise...Highly recommended...

My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed our stay at the Gokarna Forest resort. It was so peaceful after the hustle and bustle of the nearby city of Katmandu. The grounds of this resort hotel are beautiful. The staff were wonderful. Overall, a great experience and highly recommended,

Wij verbleven hier twee nachten op weg van Lukla (trekking) naar huis. Dit hotel ligt even buiten Kathmandu en biedt een rustige omgeving om te bekomen van de inspanningen. De kamers zijn ruim en mooi ingericht en de badkamers zijn prachtig. De bar en de restaurants zijn mooi ingericht en bieden een ruime keuze aan redelijke prijzen. De spa is eerste klasse - niet goedkoop maar wel een top massage. Overal is het personeel vriendelijk en behulpzaam. Prijs/kwaliteit is dit mogelijk het beste hotel van Kathmandu.

Very spacious room with good amenities. Dining on the patio was lovely; good food, wine and beer with excellent, friendly service.  We didn't play golf, but the course looked scenic.  Monkeys running around everywhere added a great touch of whimsy that we loved.

Absolutely beautiful facilities. The staff is great and very friendly. I had a wonderful massage and good forest walk. The food is very good and the buffet is great. I had a wonderful time there. Peaceful and spacious rooms. Love  it.

Lovely hotel, friendly staff, good food and a real oasis in the bustling city of Kathmandu. The room was clean, spacious and very well equipped with everything you need to make the stay comfortable. Whoever designed it had an eye for detail, everything matched. Will definitely come back

Superb hotel.  Staff are great, facilities are spot on and you are made to feel welcome and important as soon as you arrive. The food is great quality - make sure you try the buffet at night. The golf course is really nice and you have some great views. After hiking up to Everest Base Camp, this is just what was needed to recover.

A truly beautiful property that has clean well appointed rooms which are large and spacious. One can truly appreciate the way the royalty lived when moving through this resort. The central courtyard, adjoining golf course and the various jungle hikes and nature walks one can do are added attractions. The food is good and so is the service.Worth a repeat visit. The slightly  higher price is well worth the difference the resort affords to ones stay.

This place is a true five star sanctuary in Nepal. Raised above the busy streets of the city, it boasts privacy, clean air, local fauna and flora, highly attentive staff, delicious cuisines and all the luxuries you could hope for and more! The hotel is set on a huge block of land and provides many activities for its guests to indulge in, including swimming in the indoor heated pool, separate male and female jacuzzi, steam room and sauna, massage and beauty treatments, horse riding, badminton, morning yoga, Forrest Walks, horse riding... the list goes on. I would highly recommend Chef Mahesh Shah's Peri Peri Chicken dish for dinner or the many various cocktails the bar provides (pina colada is my favourite). The hotel also caters to my food intolerances (gluten) and have baked special gf goods just for me in the morning without my asking. All staff have been so friendly, welcoming and accommodating. If you are traveling to Nepal, you MUST stay at Gokarna!

We spent 3 nights at Gokarna after completing a challenging EBC journey with HSJ. The service and attention to detail by the staff was first class. They were polite and nothing was a problem. The rooms were clean and well presented.I especially liked the traditional Indian and Nepalis food. The F&B executive Rajendra was particularly service oriented and his team in the Main dining room attended to our requests with polite attention. The spa and relaxation therapy is worth doing as it is both inexpensive and helped us relax after our gruelling EBC experience.We did a forest walk for 2 hours. Whilst our guide was good in ensuring we did not get lost, he did not provide much information or showed much enthusiasm. I put this down (as advised by the guide) to the fact that he was paid  a mere US$2 out of the US$15+ we each paid to the hotel. We also paid a 10% service fee but the guide still expected a tip which we obliged.Unless you like golf there is not much to do other than chilling and fine dining. It is a place to wind down and recharge.

After along day of unbelievably bumpy,dusty travel in Kathmandu it was such a pleasure to arrive at beautiful hotel. It was as we had suddenly been transported to a calmer world. The staff was most attentive and helpful. The food was excellent with good variety. If I were returning to Kathmandu I would certainly stay here.

Just completed two excellent stays at the Gokarna Forest Resort.   Loved everything about it.   Great staff - with a special shout out to Himal Shrestha who was professional and super friendly.    An excellent property.

I stayed here for 2 days and it was an wonderful experience.Staff(at reception and restaurant) are very friendly, polite, helpful ,organised and responsible.Food at both restaurants and Bar is  good .Hotel is great too with various facilities .I will definitely comeback again and stay for more days :) . This is One of THE BEST HOTEL i stayed!!

As we pack to leave Kathmandu, we would like to thank all the staff at Gokarna for a beautiful experience both before we went trekking and upon our return from the mountains.The rooms, food/restaurants and bar have been excellent. The service as good as we have experienced anywhere in the world. We can highly recommend the Spa and the beautiful golf course. It was a real bonus to play two rounds of golf whilst we where here. All in all a beautiful restful stay.

The service level at this hotel is the best we have ever encountered and we travel all over the world. The employees without exception exception are amazing. Our particular favorites were Sambita at reception and Sita (so?) in the dining room. They were adorable. We wanted to adopt them! STAY AT THIS HOTEL!

After a 12 day trek through the mountains, Gokarna Forest Resort was a spacious, clean welcome relief. Beautifully appointed, massive rooms, fabulous choices for dining delights, well stock beverages, loads of stunning affordable treasures in the gift shop. All staff were amazingly friendly and very helpful.Golf was great, the nature walk was enjoyable, and the yoga was delicious.

Nice place to relax away from busy Kathmandu. Staff friendly and always ready to respond to personal requests. Grounds clean and well cared for. Wildlife such as monkeys and deer could be seen from large picture windows in guest rooms. Excellent buffet breakfasts. Celebrated 60th birthday with room service and complementary cake. Rooms were spacious, clean and comfortable. However, note it is an hour to airport on the “dancing” road.

Very nice weather. October was a good option!Nice hotel. Very quiet. In a forest. Beautiful golf course.Very helpful staff. Good breakfast in a nice terrace.It's a pity the very bad roads to the hotel...

I found that The Gokarna Resort, once a refuge and playground for the Royal Family, is now a comfortable, relaxing retreat from the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu.  The staff was top notch (Pukkha!); always courteous and solicitous, looking to address our every need. The room, the food, and most of all, the friendly staff, make Gokarna a fine place indeed.  If one does not need to stay at Kathmandu's center, Gokarna offers a pleasant, peaceful place to stay.

Location, Atmosphere and the whole premises of the resort is super. I guess everyone will love to stay here. Just a few minor recommendation, if someone is looking for quick access to lobby, restaurants, facilities at the hotel, do ask for rooms that are closer to these areas. We got the rooms very far which was a little inconvenient for our short stay for a day. As we tasted Indian food only, Indian food needs upgrade in taste as expectations are high from such superior place.

OAT group stayed here for 4 nights..breakfast buffet was wonderful, they even make you omelettes in the morning, rooms decor was cute and neat and clean, loved the huge shower, monkeys and spotted deer all over the premises...nice gift shop...would definitely recommend..

Stayed 2 nights at Gokarna after our 12 day Everest Base Camp trek.  The resort was so luxurious after the lodges that we had stayed in on the trek.  The room was beautiful, spacious and clean.  The food and drinks were good and the staff friendly and helpful.  The monkeys are funny to watch and so are the security guards who use slingshots to try and scare the monkeys away. The indoor pool was a bit disappointing, could do with an outdoor pool, but overall an oasis not far away from the noise and dust of Kathmandu. Would highly recommend staying at Gokarna, particularly if you've just completed a trek.

The staff and service was wonderful.  The Spa and staff were exceptional. Food was very good.  Our room was spacious and offered us a perfect view to watch the deer and monkeys.  Most noteworthy however, is that we checked out of this hotel and went to the airport.  When we arrived at the airport we were told our flight was booked for the following evening.  We panicked!  Oh NO!  We couldn't stay in the airport for another 24 hours because they close the airport at midnight. We raced outside and in the midst of shear chaos, we found 2 gentleman who spoke some English...they agreed to take us back to the Gokarna Hotel. On the way back, one of the gentlemen called the Hotel and spoke with reception.  They gave us back our same room and greeted us with warm hearts and the biggest smiles.  Needless to say, I don't know what we would have done had they not accommodated us.  The manager agreed to allow us an extended stay until 5PM the next evening. We checked out at 5PM the next day and two hours later, a very large tour group arrived. We heard the tour leader call out the room number of the room we checked out of just two hours earlier.  Thank you to the Manager, Reception staff as well as all the staff we encountered.  We cannot express enough our sincerest appreciation to everyone there!   And, one final note, the same people who took us back to the hotel that night, came back the next night to take us back to the airport again.  THANK YOU, THANK YOU, THANK YOU!

Lovely hotel for couples not families, security is to strict, too young for play ground to young for swimming pool and spa, we where kickt off the playing ground and denied access for spa with our child, and we have to pay 40 dollar for extra bed per night, our child is 3. First time I have to pay so much for my 3 years old child

My wife and I stayed here for two days preceding our mountain trek and two days after. We could not have asked for a more perfect time.  The food was excellent, spa services much appreciated and the staff gracious, efficient, and very helpful to all our requests. Strongly recommend Gokarna to family, friends and fellow travelers.  We will be back.

It's a lovely resort that has the potential to become a truly great if it fixes some of its service quality issues.The receptionist who checked us in on our first day was incredibly friendly and helpful. She insisted on walking us all the way to our room on the third floor and was quick to help us change rooms just a few minutes later when we requested for one with a balcony. The massage therapist I got on the first day at the hotel's spa was also excellent. In fact, it was one of the best massages I've ever gotten.The food at the Club House Restaurant down the slope deserves a shout out. Though the chef isn't Thai, the Thai cuisine served is pretty darn authentic and delicious. We had almost all our meals at this restaurant. The prices are quite reasonable as well.On the flip side, the massage therapist I got 2 days later was simply atrocious. She took long, awkward breaks during the session, there was zero technique involved and it just felt like she couldn't wait for her work day to be over.Then there was the waiter who messed up our dinner order and simply tried too hard to redeem himself. It's okay to make a mistake - just apologise and move on. What this guy did was after was loiter around our table and constantly kept asking if each dish was okay. It would be nice to have some privacy and not feel as if we are under constant surveillance. The day before we left, we requested for and was granted a late 2 pm check-out. The next day, someone from the front desk called the room at 1pm and said rather curtly: "Hello, when are you leaving the room? Check out was at 12 noon." I really don't think this is acceptable. All in all, it was a pleasant experience. But it would've been perfect if not for all these hiccups.

This place is perfect if you're not a huge city person such as myself. It is located in a quiet area with gorgeous surroundings for you to walk or bike ride around. They have horse riding or jungle tours which are just wonderful. The day spa is open until late so having a relaxing massage before bedtime makes for a perfect end to each day. The resort itself is absolutely gorgeous with fantastic staff. They also offer a range of food for breakfast, lunch and dinner which was absolutely decadent especially with all the yummy desserts. If you're looking to come to Kathmandu but don't want to be among the noise then I strongly suggest staying here, they also have a courtesy bus that takes you in daily if you would like to do some shopping or just to wander around the city.

We visited Gokarna Forest Resort on our honeymoon trip in Nepal back in February,2013! On that trip we stayed in different hotels in pokhara, dhulikhel and Kathmandu! But among them it was the best! The gigantic room, bathroom and the comfortable bed made our stay grand and helped to enjoy our honeymoon time at its fullest! The architecture of this hotel is so mesmerizing and the ambience of the full hotel area is so romantic! They have a beautiful golf area and a great setup of yoga practice which we loved most! The forest walk was so peaceful and the friends we made their(monkeys, deers) were an extra pleasure! The staff members were so professional and friendly! The restaurants and  quality of food was up to the mark! The complementary breakfast was so delicious as well! We loved each and every bit of staying in this hotel! It's really a world class hotel! Would love to visit it again! Thanks

We booked a mini-suite and it made for a great stay. Everything about it first rate — bedding, modern and sleek bathroom, very spacious. We felt coddled.Then, the food. This may seem hard to believe, but every bite was a treat. We stuck, largely, to the Indian/Nepalese side of the menu, and all were executed beautifully with top ingredients and a staff that is attentive and fun.The golf course is a world of its own, one of my favorites anywhere. It is near the jungle, not the ocean, but otherwise, maintained simply, purely for golf, like a course in Ireland. The caddies are smart and knowing; the staff, again, everywhere you go, were gracious and helpful.And, the Spa was beautiful, well run, staffed by masseuses who are skilled Ayervedic practitioners; delightful. Travelers to Kathmandu know that the city itself, particularly after the earthquake, can be fascinating and rich but overwhelming as well, so the word Oasis cannot be overused. And, did I mention, monkeys everywhere? Gorgeous animals; apparently they pretty much keep to themselves unless you leave your terrace door open, but there are plenty of signs to remind you.We observed successful and joyful weddings here as well as numerous business meetings during our stay, and all seemed to be having a great time. I cannot recommend a place to stay more highly.

Gokarna Resort was an oasis in the chaos of Kathmandu.  The staff at Gokarna were kind, attentive and accommodating.  The grounds were beautiful and peaceful and well kept.  There is a golf course, swimming pool and sauna and a spa for visitors to use.  On site, there is also a nice gift shop with many rational crafts and work from Nepal at good prices.  The food was good and well-priced.  The rooms big, well appointed, clean and quiet.  I loved it here!  It was a pleasure to come back after site seeing in the Kathmandu area and feel calm and welcome.  I highly recommend this property for all travelers.  It is a gem!

Excellent resort right on the outskirts of Kathmandu.Greeted very warmly upon arrival. Since it was raining, we stayed in the main building and not the cottage rooms.Rooms are huge and a mix of old world charm and practicality. Food is excellent and service is very prompt. Hospitality is top class.The resort has many activities to keep the guests occupied. Some of the activities which we tried included yoga, cycling and forest walk with a guide.The pool is temperature controlled and the steam/suana/jaccuzi are excellent additions.The resort boasts of a well maintained 18 hole Golf Course and driving range.Will highly recommend the resort to Nepal bound travelers.

We had wonderful time at Gokarna Forest Resort. There is no complain in service. Dikshya Khad from the costumer helper gave us a very nice service. Thank you for making our stay fun. We had thali for dinner which was not tasty. But the breakfast was very good. Indoor swimming was very good as well.Overall our trip our stay was very good.

We arrived on a Wednesday and left Friday. A 2 night stop over for a rest and to show our family member a new area of Kathmandu.We have been here 3 times now and always love the atmosphere and the fact that you can find different spaces to sit,read,write,exercise and walk.We basically come here for a rest. The staff are very friendly and look out for you. They also remember you!Thankyou Gokana.

Wonderful service and attention to detail throughout our stay It is obvious that all staff are highly trained  on customer service and attention to detail. Food was sensational, a good mix of authentic Nepalese and creative dishes with a modern mediterranean twist. I will definately be back with my family.

Upon arrival we were met with great service from the staff - offering drinks and a place to wind down after our long trip. Even though usual check in time is 2pm around the world, the reception had our rooms made up and ready by 10am which was fantastic. The rooms were spacious, modern and keeping in line with the culture of the Nepalese people. Buffet breakfast was included each day which was also of a high level and cooked on order when requested. We ordered room service for dinner twice and it was quick and delicious. The buffet in the restaurant was also freshly cooked and the deserts were to die for! The pool area was inside due to the monkeys in the area which was a bit disappointing but understandable. I had two massages and a pedicure which were both amazing. The only criticism would be that the prices quoted did not include taxes or VAT hence it was a bit of surprise when we received the final bill. This hotel is more suited for couples rather than small children due to the monkeys that will take every advantage to steal whatever they can, whenever they can, (despite security doing a great job to keep them at bay). Overall, a great place to stay and we would definitely return.

My partner and I were fortunate to have spent the last 3 days at this beautiful resort in Kathmandu.Our stay was included in an excellent trekking package through Himalayan Social Journey (please refer to our review for this awesome organisation).The resort was absolutely beautiful in an old school, colonial style. The facilities, food and services were outstanding. The personal service even better. Rooms were so much bigger and better than expected.Nothing was too much trouble - the staff organised seamless external activities for us and even arranged to have these added at no mark up to our hotel tab - very handy in a country in which it can sometimes be tricky to get sufficient cash and sometimes even harder to get a card accepted.Every member of the team greeted us with a very friendly "Namaste" everywhere we went throughout the resort and bent over backwards to ensure that we were happy with every aspect of our stay. All arranged transport was early, clean and efficient.Highly recommended - a very peaceful, family friendly environment run by an incredibly kind, thoughtful and friendly team.

Following a trek to Everest Base Camp spent 2 nights at the resort.  Service exemplary - great food, comfortable rooms.  On site spa services very beautifully presented, affordable and relaxing.  I enjoyed the swimming pool, sauna and spa !!

two nights at this FANTASTIC resort were included in our 16 Day EBC Trek. And what a sensational 2 days they were!From the moment you arrive it is hard to believe that you are in Kathmandu, with all the hustle, bustle and hassle of a large 3rd world city just metres away. Gokarna is like an oasis hidden away from all that noise. A peaceful almost serene resort with world class amenities from spa, pool, Jacuzzi, sauna, steam-bath and more. A great range of treatments to pamper yourself after a long trek. The rooms are simply amazing with modern facilities, local décor, large rooms, huge bathrooms and magnificent bedding.
