Seriously 5 Star without the pompous feeling.The choice of dining is great and meals are served fresh, hot and prepared beautifully but with prices that will be a pleasant surprise. However, all these things are good but one thing stands out more than anything else. The people. The hosts (I won't call them staff, they are so much better than that) are simply amazing. Every person you meet is friendly, courteous, helpful, obliging and professional. No matter what their duty or role they do it with real pride and perfection. They really make your stay just so much nicer again. I would go back tomorrow just to see these wonderful people once more. They are beautiful!For whatever reason you are going to Kathmandu, just make sure that Gokarna Rainforest Resort features in your trip. You'll be glad you did!

WOW is 1st word from my side everything was perfect just perfect breakfast and food served is outstanding .staffs are friendly indoor swimming pool is another golden touch if ur planning to stay in hotel and u must go to #GFR .My special thanks to Miss Dikshya thakuri u know how to treat clients very happy 😊😊😊 thank u Gokarna resort

I stayed at Gokarna forest after completing the EBC trek. The service could not be faultered, the staff were amazing. The food was great but the buffet was a little hit and miss on occasions. A great place to relax. If it's excitement and activity you are after then go somewhere closer to Thamel for easy access.

First of all let me acknowledge you that I am a student of grade 11 studying in Modern Indian School and I came here with my parents for a night stay for my Birthday and the moment I entered the people in the reception every one greeted with humbleness.. The people here are all angels.. Their hospitality was remarkable..They have the excellent quality of products and provided with all the facilities for a basis of relaxation..Even if you are  travelling alone when you come here you will feel as if you have a huge family here... It is really a tranquil heaven for quiet hideway.. This is the place you can attain full peace, humility and love.. Every human should visit this place as it is located in the lap of the nature with excellence of food, culture and love.. Hope to visit this again and again and hope you do be the family member of gokarna..

It's great if you want to get away from it all and rest as it is far away from town. At the moment the roads to the city of Kathmandu has a lot of pot holes and thus the driver described it as 'dancing roads'.

After our E.B.C trek and Kalapathar summit, what a way to wind down and enjoy the comforts of the resort before flying back home.I would highly recommend this to any person after you finish any great trek in Nepal.

The food was really good but I will  reffer to put low fat foods with out any fatning. The place and the location is very good . I will definitely recommend this to all my friends and relatives for four functions and all.

Le personnel est très prévenant et sympathique. Petit déjeuner avec un large choix. Les chambres sont très agréables.En revanche l'espace sauna/piscine n'est pas bien propre (hammam, douches). Les moquettes des couloirs sont sales, cela n'est pas très digne du standing.

The resort is beautiful and with some minor tweaks it could be a lovely experience. The staff is VERY invasive so you have no privacy or ability to relax. They will ask you every hour if things are good and at the spa, the male receptionist stands over you while you are answering female health questions which he then reads aloud to and discusses with the massage therapist (who could also read) which is a bit bizarre. Also, they have a list of activities but most of them you can't do with less than 24 hours notice, so it is unclear why they dont ask you about those activities when you book. The other ones were quite disappointing - yoga in the corner of a crowded gym? a nature walk which was nothing more than walking in a circle around a golf course? a swimming pool full of small screaming kids because the hotel has "members" and a Saturday bbq?

Every day is a new food experience ... Is really great, Congratulations Chefs!In the breakfast, lunch and dinner you find a lot of tastes, combinations and a service like if you were at home.It is a real Quality Service!

Room designing along with window panoramic view is commendable. Moreover, the bath room style and glass wall to bed room is quite fascinating.Cupboards are good. The quality of soap is not of good quality

Enjoyed our 2 night stay at this resort. Although a bumpy ride to get there, the location is beautiful & only about 30 minutes from the airport.The food & service were exceptional. Everyone we met was super friendly, welcoming and helpful. Would definitely visit again!

this hotel was very comfortable. al lof  the hotel workers were incredibly friendly and helpful. very good food at the restaurants. Had a tv which we rarely watched and plenty of hot water. The people in the souvenir shop were great. My brothers and I all bought a lot.

It was so dark in the large room that I couldn't see what was in my suitcase as I looked for things.  Everything else about the resort is absolutely EXCELLENT!  Location, service, food, gift shop were great - however, ladies, you'll need a sport's bra for the drive up - roller coaster ride since they can't fix the road until the monsoon season is over.

We thoroughly enjoyed our 3 night stay at Gokarna Forest Resort. The staff was very friendly and welcoming. The rooms were spacious and clean. The setting was beautiful. We also enjoyed the breakfast buffet every morning.

It was one of the most peaceful trips we've had away from Kathmandu. And a most needed one too. The roads to the resort are not the best given the monsoon season but once you are there it's like you are in another world.

This hotel is a very calm and peaceful place, good service and staff very attentive.Yoga should be in a quiet atmosphere and not in the gym hall.Should be able to order room service snacks before 11pm.

THis property is a very quite property with an 18 hole gold course and an ideal place for stay with family & friends . Resort offers some excellent food options and have some trekking options for those who wanted to venture into some adventures

Amazing, clean, nice and beautiful, but for the travelers who don't own a car during the trip, it's a little bit rural. On the last day, we even join a local wedding. If I can ever go back to Nepal again, I will definitely choose this hotel.

me and my friend when there for ghathering. It was a very nice place with very helpful, attentive staffs.there is very good environment.The place is infested with monkeys.yes this place is little far for city and way to hotel for city is very bad.

Vinimos aquí con mi esposo por trabajo hace casi dos meses y desde nuestra llegada toda la atención ha sido muy personalizada .Instalaciones sumamente cómodas desde el dormitorio,hasta los baños, spa con pileta cerrada,gym con variedad de aparatos y cómodas galerías que permiten recrear y relajarse en este ambiente de tranquilidad.Todo el personal es de una absoluta amabilidad ,desde el Director General,hasta los maleteros,el personal de limpieza y los que atienden el comedor atentos y cordiales.El menú es variado y muy bueno.

We came there for our Orientation Retreat. It was a very nice place with very helpful, attentive staffs.8848 mt. Restaurant had amazing food. We had our programs at Club House Restaurant. It was also very nice.Very calming, naturally fresh environment.

location is perfect with very comfortable rooms the staff are so friendly and helpful nothing is a problem.the food is top quality and very well presented.as for the golf course its a must return for me

Has a very romantic and extra special time with my BeLoved Wife. Food was good, selection was great. Rooms are cosy, well appointed and clean. The room service ok, but the overall service is first class

I stayed at the Gokarna Forest Resort for a week while attending a business meeting. The hotel is a one-hour drive away from central Kathmandu (more if the traffic is heavy), set in a pleasant forest above the pollution of the city centre. The rooms and grounds are spotless, the food was excellent and the staff go out of their way to be helpful. A very handy free daily shuttle to the main tourist sites is available and getting a taxi back to the hotel is easy enough. However, travellers should be aware that the hotel is quite far removed from the 'real Kathmandu' - both in terms of distance and amenities (golf course, gym, rather steep prices for drinks, laundry etc.) - if that's what you're looking for, the Gokarna is a lovely place!

After a 5 day trek, it was so relaxing to stay in such a splendid resort. The staff were very friendly and helpful, the spa excellent, and the restaurant at the golf course quite amazing. I had the best prawn dish of my life there!

Attentive staff, clean rooms and nice amenities. This hotel is tucked away from the main city and preserves the natural beauty of gokarna forest. There is a wide variety of cuisines served in the restaurants and a lovely bar. I highly recommend this resort.

I have visited so many hotels and resorts worldwide.But this is the resort I loved most as I have never seen the hospitality that was provided here anywhere else.So supportive staff and especially staff at restaurant.Amazing forest resort with superb pool.

After trekking for 6 days this was the perfect finish to our Nepal holiday. The staff were amazing (Krishma was outstanding) and nothing was a hassle. The rooms were clean, well proportioned and private. The food was affordable and very tasty at each restaurant. I wouldn't want to stay anywhere else in Nepal.

ツアーで泊まりました。緑に囲まれたリゾートホテルです。ホテルスタッフがとてもフレンドリーで印象が良いです。部屋は清潔に清掃されています。カトマンズからはちょっと距離がありますが、ゴルフ場があり、緑豊かな景色を楽しみながらゆったりとした時間を過ごすには良いと思います。散歩した時には、ゴルフ場を鹿の群れが歩いていました。部屋の配置が分かりづらいですが、非日常を味わっている感じがしてあまり気にはなりませんでした。

Soak yourself in pure green environs with simple caring staff . Diksha Khand was kind to take our team around for a quick tour of the property. Krishna from FnB took care of my team's comfort. overall a good experience.

It was my very first solo trip and Gokarna resort made it so easy . It's a beautiful and peaceful place rich in nature and good food. The breakfast specially was very lavish and quite good. Needless to say the place is run so well because of the people running it ..and specially would like to mention the staff named dikshya Thakuri who took so much care of my needs and was quite approchable in whatever I needed. She has been a great host. I am definitely coming back to this place... highly recommend it.

As the name suggests, the hotel is located near a forest. The area is very peaceful, and you can get rid of all the noises and pollution that the city has. Best place for doing yoga I would say. The service is also good, most of the staff there speak good English, and are very courteous. Thank you for the great service provided to us.

I was looking for a quite gateway in Kathmandu and found the right place. The place is very peaceful. The staff member were very friendly. Food was great. My favorite was the breakfast buffet. Must place if you are in Kathmandu.

The Gokarna Forest Resort which is not too far from the centre of town presentsa facinating view of the surounding area including the airport. Purched up on a hill you immeditely feel the difference of the fresh air from the rest of Kathmandu Valley! The Resort runs with military precision in terms of ammenities which I might add includes an indoor swimming pool facility with gym, spa, massage and a very wonderful golf course. The professional staff are always available for all your needs. This is the best place to come if you need the treament comparative of royalty!

During dinner and starting at 9am there was some form of loud construction. The entire reason you go here is to be away from the city and for a peaceful area, this lack of foresight was unfortunate. ...

Spent 5 days golfing at the resort.Staff were excellent, rooms were comfortable, clean and large.Good breakfast with lots to choose from, dinner was good too in the hotel.The golf clubhouse was the best place after a hard days golfing, great views of the 18th and cold Ghurka Beer.The course itself was set in acres of woodland with amazing wildlife all around.Caddys and ball spotters 10USD Each a day.Would definitely go back.

I was a guest of our Nepalese host for lunch at Gokarna Forest Resort outside Katmandu. We ate in the open area and it was a idyllic space to sit. We had the choice of the buffet but chose to go with the menu.I had a stater of bratwurst and potatoes and onions, our host had a club sandwich. All was of a decent standard and enjoyable.The service was ok as well. The food and beverage offer did not match the setting.

We stayed twice recently. The first time we had just a few hours overnight between 2 flights. The room we had was separate from the hotel - it was very noisy due to a flimsy interconnecting door and the bathroom needed a refurb.The second visit was for 2 nights and we stayed in the man building. The room and bathroom were lovely. The bed was comfortable and the room was quiet.The main hotel is beautiful with lovely decor and plenty of places to sit outside.The staff here were great - they were very helpful and friendly.The food in the restaurants was great and we worked our way through quite few delicious cocktails!The forest environment is a pleasant change from the very dusty city centre but the hotel is under the flight path so can be a bit noisy. Beware of the monkeys!I would definitely stay here again.

Stayed here for only 2 nights after trekking to Everest Base Camp. What an amazing 'reward' for myself. The resort facilities are top class as expected from a 5 star resort but the service was exceptional. Best I have received anywhere in the world (so far). Of special mention is Rishma Lama, Executive Guest Relations who went out of her way to provide all information we needed.  We arrived early so couldn't actually access our rooms but when they were ready she searched us out through the extensive resort grounds. Throughout our stay she happily greeted us by name, sought updates on our satisfaction, and ensured support was made whenever requested. All staff we encountered throughout our stay recognised us by name (and room number) whenever we crossed paths, giving a sense of really feeling a part of the family ...

DISTANCE:Gokarna Resort is around 45minutes from the airport and easily 1hr15mins from Thamel by road. The roads to the resort are bad (practically no roads.) It is highly advisable to have masks as Kathmandu is very dusty and this route especially. THE RESORT:The moment you enter the resort, you feel you have been transported to some other world. It's spick and span, green and serene. The staff is extremely courteous -  this includes the reception staff, bar staff, main restaurant staff and the staff from the Club House restaurant. I would like to give a special mention to Miss. Bandana at the front office, she was helpful and guided us well to make the most of the city in 2 days. We were offered welcome drinks on entering the property. The check-in was smooth. ROOM:We had booked a club room (room 221) - the room was huge, with super king size bed, TV, attached balcony overlooking the courtyard, study table, sofa seating,  and equipped with all modern facilities. ACTIVITIESThe resort offers many outdoor and indoor activities - golf, driving range, horse riding and mountain bikes for hire. They even have a billiards table, spa, jacuzzi, and swimming pool. They also arrange for 1 to 3hrs trek around the golf course, forest and a temple on top of the hill. MUST DOThe resort has 2 restaurants and 1 bar. We would recommend enjoying a sundown drink at the Club House restaurant overlooking the 18 hole golf course. It is lovely to watch the spotted deer come out and graze.WIFI:The resort has free wifi with good connectivity. FOOD & DRINKThe only and biggest disappointment for us was the food. Even though the selection is huge but the quality and preparations were below par level. We had a total of 4 meals at the different restaurants and would not recommend anything from breakfast to snacks to the main course. It was disheartening as food is a crucial part of a travel, and for me personally, the backbone of a great experience. TRAVEL TO CITYThe resort provides shuttle services toThamel, drop off at 1030hrs and pickup at 1630hrs. They even arrange for taxi/cab for inter-city or intra-city travel. We would recommend using the hotel cab, though a little expensive but they have A/C, which is a savior from the dust, heat, and humidity. City Taxi doesn't have A/C.

We were lucky enough to buy a cheap package (for 8) for a trek to Everest Base Camp and climbing Kala Pathar in Nepal through Luxury Escapes in Australia, which included a couple of nights at the Gokarna Forest Lodge at the end of the trek.Can I start by saying that Kathmandu is very third world to our western eyes - dirty, dusty, crowded, polluted, littered - which made Gokarna an even nicer destination.  It was much cooler, much calmer and much less dusty in the former Royal forest than in Kathmandu proper.Gokarna has many pluses - nice rooms, big, hot showers (a luxury after the trek), a spa (we upgraded the massages on our vouchers at minimal cost), an indoor pool, a small gym, reasonably priced alcoholic beverages (we gave the beer towers a good nudge), 2 restaurants, resident deer, monkeys, and pretty good food.  A clothes line in the roomy bathroom.  Bottled water daily.  Room safe and a flat screen TV.  Air con.  Comfy beds.  Strong, free wifi (note - European 2 pin plugs). Bliss!We all enjoyed the relaxed atmosphere, and the golf driving range was a hoot!  No complaints here.But what really made it special was the staff - there seemed to be more staff than guests! The staff couldn't do enough for us.  Always smiling, always happy, always polite - I was very impressed.  One even told me he would miss us when we went.  They asked the kitchen to open the lunch menu an hour earlier for us (as we were at Lukla airport flying to Kathmandu before 6:00am and were pretty hungry by the time we got there), and were more than happy to bring us coffee, etc.  All with a smile and a pleasant chat.It might be a fair way from Thamel in Kathmandu, but this is the nicest accommodation I've found in Kathmandu.My sincerest compliments to all at Gokarna Forest Lodge.

A good quality hotel, yes and comfortable rooms With pool and forest surrounds. Morning yoga with Ms Uma a great way to start the day but the highlight for us was the very professional staff. I swear that staff could read your mind. Attentive, professional and courteous. Cant forget to mention great food. Best mushroom lasagne ever.

The staff of the Hotel was trying to do everything in their power to make our stay as comfortable as possible. Big, pleasant room with a huge bed and even bigger bath, top class view of the surrounding hills. Swimming pool, sauna, jacuzzi and massage, live music in the restaurant and deer on the golf course complemented this fabulous place. Thank you.

The tranquility of this hotel must be commended.  It's a lovely property with amazing an amazing staff who are there to make you visit as comfortable and effortless free as possible.  The restaurant, lounge, lobby, all give you a sense of luxury and safety.  I really enjoyed my stay their. I was there a total of 4 nights (3 and then 1).  Beautiful property, but the staff is the component that makes it exceptional.

The hotel was beautiful, as well as the grounds.  What an Oasis in Kathmandu.  Bandana Khadka, Guest Relation Executive, was so personable and always checking to make sure everything was perfect.  The staff was professional and efficient.  What a joy to stay there twice during my three weeks in Bhutan and Nepal.

We checked in and were given a room, we were taken to the rooms, unpacked, used the bathrooms and lay in the beds. At the restaurant we were told we were in the wrong rooms and were going to have someone pack our things and move us to lower class room. Highly unusual, very embarrassing to have that play out in the restaurant and beyond belief when the resort is barely occupied. They've embarrassed their customer and will bear the cost of cleaning four rooms now instead of two. Makes no sense.

I stayed there three times in short succession and liked it even better every time. It is near Kathmandu, including in particular the airport, yet away from the pollution, chaos and hustle and bustle of the city. It is very well maintained and managed, with extremely efficient, helpful and warm and friendly staff throughout. It is well secured. The resort offers a wealth of activities, from gold course to daily yoga class to hikes and horse rides in the Forest which is full of wonderful wildlife. The spa provides exceptional value for money service with a range of wonderful treatments. The indoors pool and gym are of high standard. The gym in particular offers a wide range of well functioning strength and CV machines. The grounds are lovely, monkeys about (need to close windows) and there are dear and lots of beautiful flora. The breakfast offers a wide range of local and international choices, all of which are delicious. Room service and many restaurant options are available. The rooms are large, comfortable, clean, well appointed, including the bathroom. There is an ATM and a small local tourist shop on site which offers a nice range of quality items. The only thing is that the internet is slow and occasionally patchy. However, I have found it still works better than in hotels in central Kathmandu. The only thing with the resort is that it obviously does not have night clubs, etc. - but that's not what I want. If you want 24 hour lively music, hustle and bustle and easy walking access to the polluted and chaotic City of Kathmandu itself, then chose another hotel. If you want mindfulness and a mix of scenery, efficiency, comfort, activity and relaxation, friendliness - all at affordable prices - then select the Gokarna!

Little away from the hustle bustle of kathmandu,this place is what u need to relax urself. It isnt that far from nathmandu. Once u enter the vicinity, its calm, peaceful, amazing view with greenaries and u do get to see some deers as well. Food was ok but they have a thai resturaunt where they serve great thai food. Swimming pool was great,it wasnt crowded  and it was right next to the spa. Spa was however packed and they didnt have enough personnel for the service. Breakfast was great with a variety of nepali food and fresh omlette of your choice. I love the place because it is amazing, close to kathmandu yet away from the noise and crowd. Its just so calm and the architecture is a beauty in itself. Expensive but worth it.

This was our second trip to Kathmandu in the past few years. The staff are always warm and friendly. I must make mention of the reception staff especially Sumita and Bandana. Thank you so much for your care and understanding after our unfortunate experience while trekking. The dining room staff always served with a smile.Always great staying with you guys and we will no dought be back.

Had the opportunity to stay at this jewel of a property for a total of 5 nights on three separate occasions during the month of March/April 2017.  It was a home away from home, with welcoming and friendly staff; beautiful locations and grounds; rooms that were spacious and clean and wonderful dining.  The wait staff - especially Manish Mahet made you feel that you were at home with his attentiveness and friendly attitude.  The food was outstanding with the breakfast buffet offering lots of yummy options.  Happy hours at the Mt Everest bar was delightful overlooking a lovely courtyard.  The property was the former Royal Hunting lodge and it has not lost any of its luster.  The housekeeping staff was not intrusive, yet provided every service needed.  There was always hot water and the showers had strong pressure.  Overall a most wonderful home away from home and a peaceful refuge from the noise and dust of Kathmandu.

This is a beautiful hotel, but it's outside of Kathmandu. You'll need a taxi or transportation to go sightseeing. This is definitely a resort and offers a beautiful 18 hole golf course and yoga practice each morning. Plus there is an huge forests with leopards, monkeys, sloth bear and other animals you can hike through on the grounds. The rooms are large and clean. There is wifi in the rooms and good, reasonable priced laundry service. There is a lovely indoor pool and a spa that offers very reasonably priced massages. The restaurant serves a good buffet and the bar offers a large variety of international dishes. The ubiquitous hotel gift shop in this hotel is actually quiet good. This hotel is among the two top hotels we have stayed in on a 4 week swing through Bhutan, India and Nepal. So without hesitation, we'd stay here again.

We stayed here for a few days after our Everest base camp trek. The service was excellent and the staff were generally very good.  The golf course is tidy and a good layout and well kept. The rooms are large and comfy and the food selection is good. Overall, very happy with our two days here.

Enter the resort and then you'll find tranquility. Great place to stay and relax with lots of food options. Rooms were also spotlessly clean. The only problem I had was with wifi and internet speed. All other facilities are outstanding.

Wonderful property, great service, a very good spa, good f&b. I would recommend stay of at least 2 nights to truly appreciate the property. Ideally, a 3 night stay would be perfect. The 8848 bar is a must for all to chill & relax. One thing though is due to its location within a natural forest reserve, do make sure your room windows are kept closed to prevent the ever "friendly" macaques from coming into your room. Do take the forest trail walk - great for burning calories & enjoy the beauty of Gokarna.

Gokarna Forest Resort have Good Service and Food is delicious and have natural atmosphere.The Hotel Staff is very appreciative and they are supportive to the Guest and have good facility in the Hotel.Best season to Live at Gokarna Forest Resort is during December.

Kathmandu is often loud, dusty and muddy all at the same time.  When you enter the gates of Gokarna, you enter a new universe.  The grass is green, the setting is pleasant and refreshing.  The food is great and the rooms are amazing.

What a lovely place! Friendly staff, good food and drink, the best shisha I've ever had (and after 12 years living in the Middle East that's no idle comment) and excellent facilities. Fascinating forest location and handy for locations east of Kathmandu as well as the city itself. Staff could not be more helpful or friendly. Prices are not cheap but you do get what you pay for. Looking forward to going back for a longer visit. Thank you to all concerned.

Quite a bumpy trek through Jorpathi, to reach the resort was forgotten as we enjoyed a very tasty dinner with friends. Delicious Indonesian and Chinese food. Great ambience and views. Exceptional service. Spacious dining area. Stunning golf course.

A most excellent stay at Gokarna Forest. Located just outside of the hustle and bustle of Katmandu, a peaceful and tranquil stay with excellent service and amenities. After a busy day sightseeing in the city, it was a welcoming return home for a quiet dinner and comfortable accommodations. The staff was very professional  and personable.

Kathmandu valley is one my very often visited destination. But this was my first stay in Gokarna. As you drive into the resort  you feel you are in the lap of nature. Nice structures of buildings add value to the ambience. People are very helpful. I forgot my laptop charger home and was in a business trip but they all tried hard to find an alternative. It did not work out but I was given free access to business centre and everybody was sympathising me. Ultimately problem got solved through one of our team members upon arrival. food is fantastic, and ambience adds supervalue to it. in my morning walks I used to sit after a walk on a nice seating arrangement under the trees and calmness helped me ease all work stress , find solutions to my thoughts and monkeys wandering from one tree to another with natural forest fragrance in the morning was just heavenly!Room that I got was very nice with all kinds of facilities despite power cuts etc .services were great and made me forget infrastructure issues in Nepal. So stay at Gokarna actually gave me  many ideas which got into the thinking process and scientific report writing for which I was there. !! it was very productive stay. I wanted to write immediately after I travelled but my busy schedule kept it postponing. Now got time to write my sweet memories from Gokarna which I always desired to write. I still recall friendly faces in the front desk.

It was very peaceful stay at the hotel. Rooms were fine. Service was good. I stayed in the hotel for the program. I found the best place for indoor session as well as outdoor sessions. For recreation there was plenty of things that can be done inside. The instrumental music with typical Nepali tune was amazing to listen.

Situated outside Kathmandu away from the dusty noisy streets, this place is a breath of fresh air (literally). The hotel is up a winding tarmac road which leads straight to reception. It is a fairly modern building but fits in well with the surrounding forest. We were part of a 'Great Railway Journey' group, of about 30, 'doing India and Nepal’. Staff were very friendly and always smiling. Our room was 264 which overlooked the forest and gave us a great view of the sun setting over the mountains. Food was very good. Lots of amenities including spa, golf course etc. Quite a few monkeys climbing over the building. They could be a bit aggressive as one of her group found out. Luckily no skin broken, just bruising, and a tale to tell her grandchildren. Would have liked to have spent a few days there and walked in the forest.

Very satisfied, no surprises, restaurant food was very good, grounds clean, safe and beautiful, Staff went out of their way to start a conversation and help in anyway possible. Hope next time to try out the golf course.

This was my second stay here while working in Kathmandu and needing some rest and relaxation. The Service form all the staff here is outstanding and I felt that they did everything possible to make my stay enjoyable. The rooms are spacious and well equipped with comfortable beds. The food was good and the service in the restaurant superb. I had an excellent massage in the spa but the manicure and pedicure were disappointing because of the poor quality of the nail polish used. Otherwise the whole stay was faultless and I will definitely return when I visit Kathmandu again next year.

Its a bit far from the city centre but then it compensates with facilities not available in any resorts or 5 star hotels of Kathmandu.A spread of Golf course with learning lessons, an indoor swimming pool, excellent rooms, good food.Its also a favourite weekend gateaway for Kathmanduiets.If you are ok to stay from the city centre and in a peaceful setting, this is a place to be.

Kathmandu can be intimidating for first-time visitors. Staying at Gokarna Forest Resort was very comfortable. The resort is located on a golf course and in a forest very close to the city. The staff is very service oriented and they go out of their way to ensure your comfort. Sign up for a forest walk with one of the staff members (10 USD per person per hour). The forest is bigger than it first appears and I would not attempt the forest walk without a guide. The guest rooms are well appointed and had the strongest wifi that we found at any of our stays in Nepal or Bhutan. There are two onsite restaurants with a wide range of offerings. Excellent breakfast buffet and egg station.

My wife and I visited this resort as part of a small group tour of Nepal. It is absolutely beautiful. Our room was wonderful but the bed was hard. We told the staff and they brought in padding which made the bed comfortable for us. The grounds are beautiful. If you visit I would highly recommend two things. I have never had a massage but agreed to get one together with my wife.I don't know how such petite and pretty ladies could have such strong hands. But they were amazing and the experience was wonderful. And second be sure to eat in the Chinese restaurant at the golf clubhouse on the grounds. We had a Mongolian Hot Pot and other Chinese dishes our guide picked out & it was a truly outstanding meal and experience. I highly recommend this resort.

We stayed for 1 night at the end of a 5 day trek and it was fantastic. The rooms were very spacious and comfortable. The service was excellent. We used the spa which was great, lovely pool, Jacuzzi, steam & also had a Himalayan massage - which was excellent. The food was good, not amazing but good.

After trekking for a couple of weeks, Gokarna was the perfect end to our holiday.  The staff were all very hospitable. The hotel is well docorated.  The rooms are amazing, huge. There are photos everywhere with so much Nepal history, it's really interesting.My favourite facility was the steam room, sauna, jacuzzi & pool, with the massage well appreciated. The grounds are really lovely, a far cry from the mayhem and environment of Kathmandu.  Food buffets were well attended by our group.It really is a hidden gem and worth the money.  It does mean nothing else is in walking distance if you wanted to go shopping.  We had another couple of days in a cheaper hotel to do this.I could have easily stayed at Gokarna for another few days and recommending it is easy.

If you're looking for a nice escape from the hustle of Kathmandu then this is it!  About a 30 min cab ride from the airport, this quaint and tranquil property will give you much needed time to relax before your next big adventure. The staff was amazing, very welcoming, helpful, and more than accommodating.  They do offer airport transfer to and from the airport. The hotel property has a full spa, 18 hole golf course, nature hike, horse riding, parking, free wifi, a bar and restaurant, and plenty of other activities to do.  The food was excellent!  We got here on a Saturday just in time for their Saturday brunch complete with live music which was an awesome experience as well. Played a round of golf with the monkeys and deer...  My caddy was phenomenal. The rooms were beautiful complete with entertainment television and a beautiful bathroom. Absolutely recommend this place!  Would give it more stars if I could.

Peaceful luxury but not too far from Katmundu for access.Lovely room,Golf course was a gem, true and consistent greens, very knowledgable caddies, very helpful proshop.The golf staff and set up are very professional, everyone here, greenstaff, caddies, locker room staff and proshop do a fantastic job.

This time we came to Nepal for Everest Base camp trek for 2 weeks and our tour operator Himalayan Recreation recommend  this Resort after successful trip. Ideally that was perfect choose for us, Friendly  staffs, clean room with 24Hrs running hot and cold shower and best breakfast around Kathmandu is recommendable.

I stayed ad Gokarna Forest Resort for 2 days after a 12 day trek in the Annapurna region and this was one of the highlights of my trip. The resort is really beautiful, the spa is amazing (best massage in Kathmandu), the food is good and it is reasonably close to the airport. All the staff members are super professional, friendly and helpful. One special mention goes to Rishma Lama who made our stay so much more enjoyable, thank you for all your attentions and help!If you will travel to Kathmandu this is definitely a place that you want to spend some time at! They have a friendly bbq event on Saturday open to the public which I recommend doing if you want to know the place before booking. In any case, I'm sure you will not be dissapointed!

We held an event for some 50 people at Gokarna, most staying 2 nights, and it went off perfectly.  The meeting rooms and bedrooms were all first class.  The staff was superb.  The food and drink was well-liked by everyone.

We stayed at Gokarna after doing the EBC trek. It was a wonderful stay! The highlight was definitely the food! The breakfast and dinner buffets were phenomenal. The ala carte menu was also great but you just had to wait a little longer for it. The rooms and grounds are beautiful the only downside is the hot water. It takes a while for it to kick in (letting the water run for up to 15 mins). Especially after trekking I was really looking forward to a nice hot shower so that was a little disappointing. Besides this we really enjoyed our stay, the staff are friendly and attentive and I would highly recommend staying her for a nice treat, especially for trekkers.

Its amazing. The hospitality is good. The place is beautiful. Food is awesome.Its one of the best resorts for destination weddings. Beware of monkeys. Though its too far from city but the place is worth living.

Probably one of the better hotels I've stayed at in a third world country. Service was prompt, polite and polished from the reception, spa, bar, restaurant etc. Wifi was free and relatively fast throughout the entire property. Staff spoke good English.Rooms were a large size but the aircon in our room did not work and issue was not rectified even when I called reception about it. The Aircon blew hot air and fan alone was not enough to cool the room done resulting in a disrupted sleep. Other improvements i would suggest are bigger tvs with more English channels and better quality beds. They weren't up to five star quality. Spa treatments were all very reasonably priced and carried out well.Location is not central but ideal for a quiet getaway.

We stayed at Gokarna after 'roughing' it for two weeks on Everest base camp trek.It was so nice to have some luxury, especially enjoyed the spa, jacuzzi and steam room.The service was also amazing, very friendly and helpful staff. Great to get away from hussle of Thamel.

I loved how after wandering around Kathmandu city, I could relax at nearby resort. I didnot like monkeys going here & there though. Staffs service is good and I think, cost was also satisfactory. I am not a golfer so, I could not make utilization of golf facility. However, I enjoyed riding golf cart around golf court.

Kathmandu's 18 hole golf course is located not far from core downtown. Their restaurant food was great. Lobby decoration and ambiance of the hotel is also very good.  Drop by Hyatt Hotel on your way if you want to take a break for snack or a drink. Both properties have really beautiful and artistic decoration.

This is a beautiful golf resort, a taxi ride away from the hustle and bustle of central Kathmandu. Historic property, the forests were once royal hunting grounds. Stayed here ten years ago (December 2006), in a delux villa overlooking the golf course. You can play golf or take a guided hike in the forests (there is a small local temple deep in the forest). The villa had large, comfortable rooms with traditional Nepalese architecture (carved wooden beams etc.). Food was overpriced - we were expecting high prices but the quality did not match the price. Overall, a memorable stay!

Now 5 star accommodation, Gokarna was once where royalty stayed for their hunting expeditions. Beautiful, comfortable, large rooms complement this very peaceful resort. Meals cannot be faulted. Indoor pool, massage, guided jungle walks, golf course, gift shop and very comfortable and relaxing seating throughout. Macaques move in closer at dusk and can be seen from your room. They watch and wait hoping to snatch food from your plate while you are dining. Be warned, if you sit outside to eat, this may happen. Guards are on duty to deter them, carrying a slingshot as a warning to these sneaky, fast moving primates.Fresh air and peace after spending time in amazing Kathmandu central.

Purtroppo ci sono stata una sola notte.. da settembre ad ora l'ho trovato sempre pieno. La finestra della nostra camera dava su un piccolo giardino con cerbiatti e scimmiette.. all'esterno una pace lontana dal centro di Kathmandu.. siamo stati benissimo.

I visited GFR in December 2016. It is a twenty minute drive from the airport if the city traffic is light, and will take about an hour and a half during peak hours. The approach to the resort is bumpy and the approach roads are in a bad state. In fact driving into GFR in the dark is quite scary, especially in winter. The GFR is situated at the top of a green mountain/hill and is surrounded by forest vegetation. It is an attractive resort with neat and clean rooms, polite staff and lots of photo ops. A self-contained place, it hosts restaurants, a spa, swimming pool and other attractions within the campus. This is important because there is literally nowhere else you can go outside the resort. Needless to say, all the attractions come at a price, and this is an expensive place to stay in. The services are primarily geared towards the expat crowd and towards business conventions, but that is not to say that others are not taken care of- they are, and the staff aim to please. The resort can order taxis to take you to town, with a 30-45 minute wait time- but be prepared to haggle down the asking price to about half of what the cab driver quotes. Most of the taxi drivers as also the staff speak English and Hindi fluently. The resort is quite literally located in the lap of nature- it lies within the Shivapuri protected forest area and sightings of deer and monkeys are common. Some of the staff spoke of leopards and tigers walking around - but do take that with a pinch of salt. We saw nothing more than a few dozen monkeys, some exotic birds and a few deer.  The monkeys are gutsy ones, unafraid of humans and they will not hesitate to grab your bag or food, and will enter your room if you leave the door or windows unlocked. As a hillside location, there is quite a bit of climbing and trekking that needs to be done if you want to. You will need a good pair of walking shoes and be prepared to climb several flights of stairs. It did not however seem very inconvenient.  There is a quaint little Sai Baba temple on the premises that is worth a visit. The resort serves Indian, Continental and Nepali cuisine primarily. The food is of  decent quality. The breakfast buffet could do with a little more variety and there were not enough vegetarian options that did not have either egg or mushrooms in it. The desserts are excellent. The serving staff at the breakfast buffet could do with a little training but overall pass muster. In summary, this is a nice place to visit if you are part of a business/conference group, an expat or a rich tourist. Go there if you are looking for an undisturbed, quiet weekend in natural surroundings.

Very nice, Flushy green property in Nepal. Infact, the safest and the better place to stay in nepal. One can enjoy golf and can stay in the lushes of green in this property. Considering kathmandu, probably the best place to stay in nepal.

Lovely to have a peaceful place to stay close to Kathmandu. Staff were amazing! So helpful, professional and prompt. Rishma was especially attentive throughout short stay. Room and bathoom was very spacious. Furniture and decor were nice and room had all you needed. Would definitely stay again.

Beautiful resort located a few km from Thamel. Staff is very friendly and eagerly awaits serving you. The closest to an American-style resort you can get! We opted for spa treatment for two, which was ok. Massage was good, but scrub and facial were kind of weird. They have two restaurants with endless food options. Breakfast buffet was also great. Monkeys roam the premises so it's funny to watch the security guards chase them away.

Resort is located in city limits,having 19 hole golf court,heritage hotel buildings,maintained with old designful architecture,not modernised with lifts and lit,with nice breakfast and dinner with nepalese taste foods,courteous service from staff and ambient is excellent

Stayed here prior to trekking to Everest Base Camp. Hotel staff cannot do enough to ensure your looked after, very friendly. Food is great, breakfast each morning. Came back after the trek for a very relaxing afternoon / night. Fantastic place.

This is a very good hotel in a nice location. The appearance of the hotel was very good with plenty of photographs on the walls and good Nepalese style furniture throughoutStaff were wonderful; very friendly and very attentive. They went out of their way to be helpful. Particular thanks to Rishma.Rooms were among the largest hotel rooms we've come across and we have stayed in a lot of 4 and 5 star hotels. We loved our room. It was very comfortable and very nicely designed and furnished. Bathroom was also very large and had the best shower nozzle! Rooms were spaced so that we only had one immediate neighbour. Consequently there was little noise heard from other guests.Power interruptions were minimal. WIFI good.Food was very good with a wide choice at the buffet breakfast and the choices varied a little each day. Eggs cooked to order.Restaurant meals were very good. The 8848 bar and lounge was lovely with a large log fire burning each night (appreciated as the nights were getting cool) and again a very good ambience achieved through good design and well chosen furnishings. There was also a great outdoor area for drinks/ lunches etc. The golf course clubhouse was a nice place to lunch too with nice views over the golf course and surrounding forest and good food with excellent service.Massage was very relaxing and enjoyable but not remedial. The hotel runs a daily free shuttle service into town and also provided airport transfers.We would definitely  stay again.

I stayed at this resort with my friend and we love this place. The setting was amazingly done plus the room was good. We really love swimming pool and the spa. Great value for money and we hope to come back. The food they servce was tasty. 5 star resort of Kathmandu.

Front office staff and food and beverage staff were just delightful to deal with.  Rishma was just so helpful when we had problems with our tour organiser.  We had fabulous "5 star food service" in the 8848 bar by a lovely young lady that was trained at Movenpick (wish i could remember her name).  Food was great for a la carte and for the buffet breakfast (dinner buffet was a little sad but the a la carte dinner was great).  Shuttle took us into main shopping district of KTM which meant that we could shop but come back at the end of the day to a peaceful spot. the only down side really....Spa staff for massages can be "hit and miss".  Had one fantastic massage one day and a frightfully bad massage a few days later.

Right from check-in we experienced great customer service at Gokarna Forest Resort. The buffets had a good variety and great ambiance. The staff were very friendly and attentive. The massage was a bit disappointing and not to the expected standard. Also, if you require a taxi to the airport, make sure you order well in advance as it takes ages for the taxi to reach the hotel. Housekeeping was good.

We spend one night over there. It was nice clean and good location. There is lots of open place to relax and enjoy the sun. The room is clean and staffs are smiles all the time. Specially Tashi , she is very helpful,  friendly and taking care about us .  I would definitely stay again and highly recommend.

Sioence is a high value  in kathmandu busy urban center.At Gokarna, silence is within reach in just 30 minutes from the city.Golf, spa  and selected food menus will contribute tk your rest and making you enjoy silence, of the forest and the golf course.Really. The staff at the spa could be a little more smiling and friendly it would be a perfect match to all other staff teams from housekeeping, and restauranrs and reception.

A fantastic, secluded, tranquil hotel tucked away in the Gokarna Forest away from the hustle and bustle of the Kathmandu streets. Food was excellent both in the restaurant and club house. A favorite of mine was the Club Sandwich outside under the verandah of the 8848 Bar, well worth trying. Rooms were very spacious and clean and tidy. Great spa treatment service also on sight which was fantastic. Staff were extremely helpful and attentive to all and everyone's needs. Would recommend to anyone who is looking for some luxury.

My room was huge! It was fully functional in every respect and very comfortable. I have never seen a bath that big before and the shower was great. The TV was a decent resolution and the best in my experience in 5 hotels in the course of the trip. The staff were encouraging and super helpful in every aspect. This is not a budget establishment by any measurement, but it is worth it. If I return to Nepal I will factor in a stay here for sure. The Golf course is also exceptional, I had a 4 day 2 play package which was amazing. I saw deer and monkeys on the course in several places. The food was also extremely good, when I am in this region of the world I try to eat Indian food ( because I like it) and the food did not disappoint. But I could have easily eaten european or American cuisine of a high standard. Thank you Gokarna, I'd like to stay forever!

The rooms are huge, sparkling clean and comfortable. The restaurants are well priced and the food is good (it isn't overly fancy) and the waitstaff are all wonderful. I loved my stay and highly recommend the resort.

I have been several times at Gokarna forest resort. It is a beautiful and peaceful oasis to escape the busy life of Kathmandu city. The room is very clean and comfortable with the view of surrounding forest. The staffs are very friendly, polite, and attentive to the guests. They always try to accommodate all your needs. Ms Rishma Lama , a front desk executive guest relation,  has been very helpful during my stays. She made excellent suggestion and arranged my activities. The resort spa has excellent massage. Thank you to all the staffs, I have a wonderful and relax times.

After completing a trek to Everest Base camp my wife and I and the rest of the tour group stayed at the Gokarna Forest Resort.We were upgraded to the honeymoon suite for our first night which was a great surprise.  The room was comfortable and spacious.  The second night was a standard room which was also at a high standard.We didn't use the golf facilities but did use the gym which was adequate.  The pool is indoors and is heated.  There are different walks that you can do in the forest that surrounds the property.  You have to take a guide due to leopards!  What really stood out with this place was the level of service provided. There was always someone there to assist, take an order or give advice.

If you play golf, want to have a good massage or swim, this is the place to go. Very beautiful rooms, different settings and a very big court yard. They have everything your heart desire. Wonderful food, bus that takes you totown and monkeys around the property to wake you up in the morning. It is away from traffic so it is very quiet.You can walk around, enjoy the garden and follow the paths around the property.

After a long period trekking , this is the perfect place to unwind and enjoy being pampered.If there is a better appointed and staffed venue in Nepal, then I missed it.Excellent food, great rooms, fabulous forrest and golf course, and staff that just go way beyond the norm.It is a must for the exhausted trekker.

We stayed at the Gokarna Forest Resort for two nights after trekking in the foothills; we needed some rest and relaxation and a bit of luxury and the Gokarna Forest Resort certainly provided it! Lovely setting, removed from the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu, with deer and monkeys to be seen in the grounds. Our room was large and luxurious, beautifully decorated and with lovely examples of local art on the walls. The spa facilities, which we used a lot, were excellent. The Trekkers massage comes highly recommended!We ate dinner in the restaurant one night and outside the bar area on the second night. The menu was extensive but not overwhelming and the food was beautifully presented and really tasty. Breakfast provided a great start to the day, with fresh and tasty food.The staff in the resort, from the security guard at the entrance barrier to the reception staff, were unfailingly friendly and helpful, making our stay a relaxing and restful end to an activity-packed fortnight in Nepal. Highly recommended.

I loved the experience, it was the most relaxing experience for me.the hospitality is great the environment. i would suggest everyone to experience the Safari.Food was the best. Loved it and will visit again.

Stopped here for 2 nights as part of our deal after trekking to Everest Base camp, as stated not really for us. There was just nothing to do other than sit in room or sit in or sit down by the golf course. Also found the "Restaurants " extremely expensive compared to in the city proper, for food that wasn't very good probably only 2 star for restaurants. As others have said the place is in desperate need of an upgrade and that is probably why the Le Meridien jumped ship when they did. We were supplied with 2 / 30 minute massage vouchers which I decided to give mine to my wife as it was our anniversary, but 2 thirty minute vouchers don't make a one hour massage so had to pay an extra charge????. Planning on returning to Nepal in 18 months to do Anapurna but would not return here as Thamel area has better vibe, more to do and much better food

We stayed at Gokarna after a 5 days trek in the Annapurna Region as part of our Himalayan Social Journey 14 day tour/ The hotel itself was great, the staff friendly and the food quite good. As with mot things in Nepal, the resort is in need of an update, paint job and freshen up. There are not many activities to do by yourself, the bikes are for hire (they should be free) but there are not trails to ride them on. They also have lots of walking trails but you can't walk them by yourself, you need to use their guide ($10US for the first hour) these trails should be free. We couldn't book the guides as they were busy with a big golf conference. There is a very large golf course but as we don't play golf, this was of little benefit. The massage centre was lovely but the indoor pool had a very strong chlorine smell. Overall a nice place to stay.

I stayed 2 nights at the resort. It is a lovely location in the forest. You can still hear traffic and dogs barking but feel you are away from the crazy pace of Thamel. I stayed in a lovely large room in "the cottages", room 203, a few minutes walk on a muddy road from the resort. The room definitely needs attention. The door jam is broken, bathroom mouldy with cracked tiles.  The shower pressure was great. The room was well appointed with a king size bed and tea/coffee area.  The bar fridge was full but turned off - so drinks were hot. Monkeys can be seen roaming around in the morning. You can follow the path to the Golf club but otherwise you have to pay for a guide to walk in the forest. Restaurant was smorgasbord with mostly Indian dishes for breakfast and dinner. There is an Asian restaurant at the golf club but was not available both nights (private functions).  There is room service also.  I didn't use the pool as didn't have a swimming cap! The Spa was nice but expensive compared to Thamel prices. The gift shop was well stocked and fair prices. Try the morning yoga on the rooftop with Uma, it was very good. Reception was good but I asked for one of the bathroom soaps (they were lovely soap wrapped in nice paper) and this was the biggest hassle. There was free wifi and airport transfers.

Always a pleasure to spend some time in Gokarna. The atmosphere is peaceful, the staff is great, the rooms are luxurious and the food is delicious. Loved the golf course and the SPA too. My family and I have gone there several times and we've never been disappointed...

Make no mistake in picking the best resort for your stay while you are in Nepal. After spending three whole days at the Gokarna Forest Resort, I wouldn't dare to vouch for any other. Set amidst Kathmandu Valley in an undulating forest surrounding, this resort pretty much has everything you are looking for in a rejuvenating holiday. Located about 5 kms away from the airport, which is about 25 minutes drive, this place is very scenic. This place has a 18 hole golf course for the sport lovers, a well maintained forest for nature lovers and a great spa experience for those who just looking for a relaxing hideaway. Imagine waking up to the music of the chirpy birds and monkeys hanging outside your window...The RoomsQuite spacious and decorated with malla period architecture. Certain rooms are even a century old that has been restored to offer a luxurious experience. Set amidst the huge and old trees of the forests, every minute you spend around will make you feel closer to the nature. The FoodThey only have a restaurant located within the hotel and one of the negative would be that the food variety on the menu is not all that great. But whatever it is that they offer be the breakfast, lunch or the dinner buffet - it's quite good. I have to take the name of Mr. Rajkumar, who was quite patient with us during our stay.The Spa experience We loved the Himalayan full body massage that was done as well as the Reflexology and leg massage. They come with a fully equipped gym for health freaks, indoor swimming pool, jacuzzi and sauna which are free to use during your stay. What's more?Go for a forest walk which is worth USD 10 per person for an hour. During your walk around, they'll take you to a temple located in the middle of the forest, you can also spot Deers, monkeys, birds and many more. But beware of the leeches, honestly I was scared! Thanks to: Divas and Tashi, you've been of great help and assistance through our stay! Overall a great experience! Read more on my blog myweekendnotes.com

This place is in the midst of lush greenry and gives an experience of staying in a heritage property with modern facilities. Rooms are very spacious and service is excellent. Indian food in the restaurant is very good.

Hotel and facilities are good. Shower water I think was rain stored water as it was a bit yellow. Shower temp was tepid at best.Lovely resort and the best in Kathmandu as it is outside the polluted traffic filled city centre. Prepare for a bumpy car ride to/from anywhere outside the hotel. Golf course was kept in good condition, perfect for a Eid break escape to play golf and escape from the Middle East heat.

Situated in a wonderful forest with a well designed golf course, many facilities including spa, swimming pool, nice terraces and gardens. Reindeers and monkeys and much more to see, just walk around the forest with a guide or wait patiently for they to come on a park corner. Not far from the city center, 30 minutes to the main shopping district, and very quite at night for a good sleep!

I stayed here for two days at the close of my time in Nepal.The staff - particularly Rima- were open, friendly and very helpful. The environment was relaxed, the massage good, the pool and spa fabulous and the food on the first night outstanding.The forest walk was fun, despite the leeches! but i would have liked to have gone further into the forest over the two hours and had more info about the past history of the forest.This is not the 'real' Nepal, but if you are looking to relax for a few days its great!

Situé à l'extérieur de Katmandou, ce magnifique hôtel propose des services à la hauteur de son style architectural. Restauration excellente, soins de massages attentionnés, tout est réuni pour revitaliser un trekkeur endolori. Une balade dans le jardin s'impose. La végétation y est sublimée.

I want there to have food with all of my friend at golf course was sweet view .. If u are luck you can see animal around the place .. I check the place it look like good place to stay but it far from the city like 30 min drive

There is no better place in Kathmandu if you just want to enjoy the nature and laze around with a game of golf. our rooms were spacious and decorated pleasantly. Apart from golf there is nothing much to do there. I would recommend a nature walk if you just like to kill some time. It is more of a relaxed walk through the jungle and is not very difficult or exciting. senior people can enjoy too. The spa was decent and food was ok ok. room for improvement there.There is just one pool table for your indoor activities.May be developing a few more activities will really make this the ideal place. For people who like to go for sight seeing i strongly recommend not to go for this hotel it is more for people who jut like to stay in the resort. Over all we had a very nice time. Special thanks to the hotel staff for arranging a surprise cake for us on our special day.We would definitely stay there again.

We love Kathmandu, the lovingly crowded city with its hustle and bustle,car horns,cheers sound of prayers and mantra whispers.If you need to find your peace and quiet after having spent your day in the beautiful cityGokarna is the place for you.Just half an hour drive and will arrive in the beautiful hotel,surrounded by a forest.If you love massage,wonderful treatments are waiting for you.You can take nice walks in the forest or play golf too or just enjoy nepali hospitality at its best.

I loved the hospitality and friendly environment. Buffet Breakfast was lavish and the food which is of high quality , my friends also loved the vibes of the restaurant.It's great to be there. The garden location is very peaceful..

I have been here a couple of times before with family for Saturday lunch and the experience has been just amazing. Its a beautiful resort with the lush green scenery and the golf course. The architecture style of the buildings is great since it was a former Royal property. Its definitely a good place for personal retreats.This time, i stayed here overnight for the weekend. The room was spacious enough. However, my sleep was a bit disturbed because may be the monkeys were dancing on the roof. That was a bit of a bummer but hey you cant blame the monkeys. The cabinets may need a bit of oiling in the hinges as it screeched as i tried to open and close them. May be the management can look into better mainetnance. The food was alright. The staffs were friendly and amazing and attended to our needs properly. I also enjoyed the early morning Aarati at the Sai Temple. Because of monsoon could not get to experience the cart ride around. So will definitely come back again to experience it. All in all, satisfying experience.

My organization hosted a training event at Gokarna for a group of 18. We truly enjoyed the relaxed, natural environment surrounding the hotel. The staff are also very helpful, polite, and keen to see needs and assist you with anything you need. I would recommend this hotel for either business or personal travel. I look forward to the next time I can book a conference at this location.

All the staff - especially Rishma at the reception - were extremely kind to us and very attentive to our needs;  so important to have good service, whether in a hotel or a restaurant.  The historic hotel and extensive grounds are an oasis of green on the edge of the wonders of Kathmandu.Thank you all once again for your kindness and looking after us !

Amazing staff, location, food, room and atmosphere. Highly recommended, and good value for money. Tashi was amazingly helpful from the moment we checked in, and the bar / restaurant staff is the most considerate and friendly I came across in Nepal.

Gokarna resort has a peace surrounding with   greenery allover. It is awesome place to enjoy a night here. Food is delicious and room service is well managed. Overall worthy place to visit atleast once.

This lovely hotel is a former hunting lodge with the grounds turned into a golf course. I did not play the course, but did buy a shirt from the adjoining pro shop. There is also a spa at the hotel.The rooms are quite nice and some very large. All of the facilities were excellent and the grounds well kept. Staff was helpful as I requested a room change after having problems with my key.The food was OK, nothing really stood out. I liked the patio area to sit outside with breakfast.Free Wifi is available in the bar area and the adjoining sitting areas.

Sometimes i just want to escape from myself and this is the best place to escape. i love the place with all my memories the Gokorna Forest Resort, homely environment with excellent food from Darbar restaurant. last month it was my second visit there and enjoyed staying at this grand historical,heritage forest resortThe place and its spectacular location are unbeatable, looking at the forest and listing to the music of nature gives me a wonderful feelingsThe service was good including the security. All the staffs were kind and polite.special thanks to Ms Nrmaya Tamang, Ms.Tashi and  the Front desk people,, supervisor lady of Darbar restaurant and also the waiter and waitress for there kind cooperation. Namasta Nepal.chowdhury,

Dear all, First of all thanks for the great hospitality over my stay with gokarna forest resort . It couldn't have been better as the service was at its best ! A break from my routine life has turned out to be a memorable moment.. Service , food , restaurant , location and more importantly ppl working in gokarna forest resort is simply outclass with high standard s.So guys keep it up and would love to visit u guys again .Cheers Prasad

I always love and enjoy to be there for some good memories. Recently, we had a team meeting and it was a kind of re-treat programme.... I really enjoyed the foods and greenery surrounding around the resort. The place is clubhouse restaurant and foods served during the event... Sales executives have perfectly played a great roles for marketing i believe... they are very professional...   Some, recommendations are a bit lacking among the department such banquet sales and restaurant/kitchen or account... what i felt during my programme... but in overall it was perfectly managed i must say...Thank you Gokarna Forest Resort...

This Hotel lies on the lush green forest with a beautiful golf so many woody walkways lovely setting in a tranquil atmosphere Okey food good service & really quiet enough to forget all the craziness of Kathmandu wonderful property outskirts of Kathamndu valley approx 7 kilometers from bauddhanath Stupa.

We had a great visit during monsoon season. The indoor pool was great for the kids and we enjoyed the meals as well. We went for a forest walk which was lovely -- we saw monkeys, deer and black fox. Although be sure to wear high boots during monsoon season because there were a lot of leeches!

Actually, Hotel was great, very quite place, we are stayed 1 night it was fantastic. Room is very big!! AC is worked very well. Bathroom is very big , shower pressure was just perfect. Only I want suggested if hotel can fixes hand shower in the bathroom that will be great because of there was no bidet in the bathroom.Breakfast was just perfect especially chef made a live eggs it was testy.We had a dinner at club house it was very nice , specially, all are the club house  staffs are very respectful to the guest.Definitely, next visit we will be back to your hotel with family.

Enjoy the walks around the grounds, the indoor pool, gym, sauna plus heaps of other things to do when you have time. Gokharna was a great venue for our workshop. The staff took great care of us and made sure all out news were met. It's a beautiful place to relax or get some work done.

Spectacular view, relaxing spot, away from the Kathmandu traffic and pollution, friendly staff, spacious rooms..8848 cafe feature local favorites and some Chinese specialities, they also have a hookah.I would recommend this spot / destination for anyone who wanna escape from the daily pressure.

We visited Gokarna for relaxing after trekking! We were not disappointed - we had a lovely stay and all aspects of the hotel lived up to expectations! Food was excellent - specifically the Thai and Chinese at the Club house! The 8848 bar was also superb to kick back and relax - the bar staff here were lovely and helpful!!  The reception staff that greeted us were so helpful and hospitable! Would definitely return when we come back to Kathmandu!

Wife and self visited this resort in July 2016 and spent 3 nights. The stay was very comfortable with the resort providing all amenities including a very good spread of food and well a very tastefully decorated well stocked bar with beverages. The Asst Manager, Ms.Tashi Dolma, along with the rest of the staff were very courteous and helpful.The heated swimming pool and a health spa, pampers the mind and body.The ambience is completely natural and encased in a thick woody forest along with a 18 hole golf course where plenty of Deers and monkeys cheer the golfers in action. The hilly terrain of the golf course is quite interesting and the club house location is very welcome to rehydrate the body after a dehydrating round of golf. Mr Upendra at the proshop came in very handy to help on the golfing part. Would rate this resort as an excellent getaway from the hustle and bustle of Khatmandu. Kudos to the staff for their concern to keep the guests happy and a visit is certainly worth it.

The resort itself is beautiful with all the grounds and buildings. It can be expensive for a family with choice of three restaurants with top end pricing, the food though is well prepared and some of the best we have had in Nepal. The golf course is lovely, though you have to pay to walk around it with a guide or play a round of golf. I would have loved to be able to wander with the camera on pathways but was constantly told you can't go there or you have to pay for someone to guide you. It was a busy time of year for the resort when we visited with weddings, conferences, conventions etc, there was no where for the other guests of the resort to escape from all the people and noise, and no other activities or options were offered as some form of understanding that it was an inconvenience given we paid five star pricing for a tranquil and relaxing stay. The spa was lovely though again pricey compared to other resorts we stayed at. The beds are soft and the rooms are clean, though don't expect a hot shower or bath as the water is lukewarm and if you want one you have to go to the spa. The resort is a good 1/2 hour drive from Thamel or any sightseeing so expect to pay to do any of those activities. The best part was the team, both in the restaurants, grounds, housekeeping and reception, all very friendly, polite and welcoming. Although we generally enjoyed our stay I don't think I would pay that price again for such a limiting experience.

The hotel atmosphere is so wonderful, we have amazing stay and the stuff was so friendly and responsively (special thanks to tashi - gust reception). Also it's include an international golf club and Surrounded by a big forest which is good to have walk throw. Great time to spend with family and friends and enjoying the natural sights of mountains.

The resort is set in a serene surroundings attached to a beautiful golf course adjacent to a rich forest.The rooms are large and well appointed, but our disappointment the room allocated to us, had issues with the air conditioning. While going out for a trek we requested the staff to get it repaired, but found no progress on our return. Then started the hunt for another room and we found out that most of the available rooms had one issue or another. Eventually we got a twin room where beds were joined but one of the mattress was way over used and springs had given up!Staff are generally polite but seem to be ill trained to handle situations.Activities in the resort are expensive by Nepal standards... 1 hour trek in the jungle costed us 40 dollars... Guide was least interested in what he was doing! Yoga session was free and very nice.Breakfast is sub par, coffee even worse.I hope they make small tweaks to make it an awesome place to come back to.

I felt like I was in the lap of luxury.  The room was spacious and lovely.  The bathroom and shower were a unique experience being separated from the bedroom.  The grounds were beautiful, lovely flowers and greenery.  It had a tranquil setting to it.  The spa offerings were worth the price.  The food was great.  Definitely the place to stay.

Have been here just to attend a party... and what an amazing this was. Have to see to believe. Experience was great and place was exotic. People here were diligent enough to have take care of single one of us present the then. Restaurant was sort off good but overall experience made it amazing here. Will be back soon.

We stayed two nights at this lovely resort. Everything was perfect! the staff were amazing and so helpful.  We enjoyed all the amenities this hotel offered. I would highly recommend this hotel as it ticked all the boxes !!!

Upon arrival we had a warm welcome. We were shown to our room which was spacious, clean and had a good view of the greenery around which we often miss living in Kathmandu. The kids had a wonderful time in the swimming pool where the water was just the right temperature for them. We walked around the property which was well managed and had a few drinks in the bar which was great. Dinner was yummy and we all loved the food and the service we got. Tashi who was present there during our stay was always around with information and her smile made our stay even more wonderful.

Spent a long weekend there with a group of friends, most of whom came to play the resort golf course.   The resort accomodation has character and is clean and comfortable - though some areas are ready for an upgrade.   The staff are friendly and helpful and the F & B although not top of the range is perfectly adequate.  The resort itself is just minutes away from the bustling city and is a real haven after a day battling traffic, listening to non-stop horns etc  Easy to arrange shuttle bus service into the city to view the sights.  I didnt experience the Spa but friends who did thoroughly enjoyed their pampering sessions.

My recent stay at this resort was amazing ! My friend and I were in a huge and beautiful room, very cosy and appreciated after a long walk through the city ! The indoor swimming pool was also really cool to relax ^^Food was also great specially breakfast, all we needed to start the day in a good mood. And a special thanks to the staff, who was great, very helpful, specially Tashi from Guest service (thanks for all you did for us, you're such a nice person!) It was a great and memorable time spend in that place. Worth recommending !!!

Un endroit au calme, proche de Katmandou, avec tout ce qu'il faut pour passer un séjour de rêve au milieu de la nature. De quoi ouvrir à fond vos chakras et laisser la sérénité vous habiter pleinement !Un grand merci à Tashi Dolma, membre du personnel, pour son accueil et sa gentillesse !

Loved their big swimming pool with separate steam & jacuzzi with light music on it was a complete relaxation. rooms are very spacious and the food is simply awesome. location wise a bit far located but you can feel the calmness and enjoy golf

Fantastic place to stay, slightly out of the main city but then i believe that is the charm of this place. The staff was super friendly. The landscaping of the property is very nice, the restaurants and food quality is great.

We stayed on our return journey to Nepal. Wish we had stayed here earlier! Although, little far from the city center of Kathmandu, worth it. Peaceful place and nice decor. Many other local activities available. Definitely will stay again.

We enjoyed a tranquil and rb golf course with deer and monkeys joining us relaxing stay at this beautiful resort The food was delicious and we enjoyed the many activities n offer eg swimming pool massage (which was Wonderful ) and the superb golf course The caddies were so  friendly professional and helpful particularly ball spotting !?! We left for our return relaxed and revitalised

I very much liked my stay at Gokarna.  It is a beautiful, quiet and well care for property outside of Kathmandu.  It was a great respite from the hustle and bustle of my tourist travelling around town.  I well appreciated timeout from the crowds.

Gokarna Forest Resort is fairly close to the airport and convenient to many sites in Kathmandu. The breakfast has a huge assortment of offerings, dinner is well prepared and very reasonably priced.  Staff is very friendly and helpful.  Rooms are huge and well appointed. Wifi is fast and available throughout the rooms and lobby. There are monkeys on the property that are entertaining - screens on the windows keep them out of the rooms.

The place is 20 min from the airport in no traffic time. Well Spread in huge land mass. The Place has many things to offer for nature lovers. The rooms are nice and big but can improve on amenities. We had gone for jungle walk with a guide and spotted many animals :)  . The jungle walk is pretty cool, with a golf course .. The place has some great offering of Thai and conti food with a Bar . If you love nature then stay here and have great time ..

If you want to escape from the crowds, noise and dust of Kathmandu, this is the perfect place.  The grounds are gorgeous, there are three restaurants to choose from, the rooms are spacious, clean and comfortable and the service is outstanding.  Rishma Lama greets guests to make them feel welcome.  She also makes sure that they have whatever they need.There is an ATM in the lobby, gift shops, a golf course, monkeys, deer, a pool--everything you need for a wonderful stay!

This resort is a wonderful place to chill out after a trek or as a getaway from the city. It feels like being on different planet after the congested city of Kathmandu and yet it is so close. The rooms are beautifully furnished, the bathrooms are gorgeous and it is SO quiet. There are lots of different places where you can sit and chill out both inside and outside. The breakfasts are incredible with an amazing variety of food to suit everyone. Having a sundowner at the golf club looking over the green watching the sunset was so lovely and peaceful. I loved the spa treatment I had of a hot stone massage which felt very professional and fantastically relaxing. All the staff go out of their way to be friendly and helpful. We only stayed for 2 nights but it really was memorable and I will definitely go again.

This resort is a wonderful place to stay, sleep, relax, and have fun. The Nepali people are wonderful and so kind. It's just outside of Kathmandu and it's very quiet and serene. The air is clean and there's plenty of shade to rest. Our meals have been delicious. As far as recreation and relaxing, it's all very nice, especially the spa and horseback riding. It's a place full of life. Come!
