This is really good. Staff are very helpful. I love the overall stay in Gokarna. The garden is great. If you are looking for short trek then this place is very good for you. If it's raining then stay indoor as the surrounding jungle has lots of leeches.

This is a late post- after reading how tourism was down and that was the one of the things this gorgeous country needed (talking about last year) we ended up booking at the Hyatt which we had really enjoyed being at for a day 3 years ago . That was not the case this time. So after a very unhappy experience we moved to GoKarna who were super accommodating with our last minute switch. The resort doesn't feel like it's in the city. It's so gorgeous and serene. The best part were the deer that walk close to the room- our kids loved watching them from the window. The rooms are fairly big and modern. It rained while we were there and it was gorgeous just sitting out at the restaurant with the kids playing close by and just eating . Food was fairly good. We will definitely stay here on our next visit .

The hotel is very beautiful & the service is fantastic! We truly enjoyed our stay there! We loved to see the monkeys & deers around the hotel. I loved to hike around the trails around the hotel to the golf course & to see the far away mountains.

The staff was wonderful. They were very accommodating. The room was great. It was big and spacious. Loved the property.Overall I loved my stay at the resort. Will definitely be coming back. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone who wants a beautiful and comfortable place to stay.

Stayed here for two nights after completing EBC trek - was the ideal place for relaxation and recovery after all of the hard work on the trek.  It is also a complete breath of fresh air compared with the chaos and pollution of downtown Kathmandu / Thamel.  The hotel spa is very nice and good value for money and the massages are very good.  Skip the tour of the forest - there is nothing to see and the price ($10 per person) is absolutely outrageous and not worth it.  Save your money for the spa instead!The food in the restaurants was ok - nothing spectacular (although the buffet breakfast was very good with loads of choices).  There were a few service issues in the restaurants/bar - with servers forgetting and getting confused about various orders - and there is definitely some room for improvement on that side.Lastly, if you don't like monkeys, this is probably not the place for you - there are literally hundreds of them at this resort!

Stayed here two nights after ebc trek. Wonderful staff and rooms were lovely. Resort is about 30 minutes from Thamel but you seemed a million miles away from all the hustle and bustle. Had two massages while here and both times excellent. My only complaint is perhaps they could put in walking paths where you can do your own walk. After all it is on hundreds of acres. Lovely to see the monkeys playing around and also the herds of deers wandering around the golf course.

Di questo albergo ho particolarmente apprezzato la posizione, all'interno di una ex riserva di caccia reale. Una vera oasi rispetto al caos della valle. Il personale è molto gentile, anche se un po' lento, e la cucina è buona. Possibilità di organizzare in loco passeggiate guidate nella foresta, a piedi o a cavallo.  Molto belle e spaziose le camere, i bagni forse potrebbero essere più funzionali, ma in sostanza non manca nulla.

It just couldn't be any better.. Great view, clean room, delicious food, free transport and very helpful polite stuff... They even booked flight/hotel for rest of our trip to other cities. I 100% recommend it :) Thanks for lovely time !

resort apparentemente lontano da katmandu, all'interno di una riserva di caccia del re, gentilissimo il personale gradevole la struttura. Siamo stati ospiti con un gruppo numeroso, e abbiamo ricevuto un'ottima accoglienza.

We stayed in Gokarna twice during our trip to Nepal. The rooms are big and you can really feel the fresh air of the forest when you open the large windows. On our first stay we were not very happy with the bathroom as it had stains on the basin and the toilet and housekeeping was not doing a good job in cleaning it. When the reception staff and the room manager got to know about this they acted promptly and even offered to change our room. When we came back from Pokhara for our second stay in Gokarna we received a very warm welcome and they had a very clean, large and comfortable room ready for us. During our stay we took a guided forest walk which was quite a unique experience it involved two hours of hiking through the shade draped serene forest and we got to see lots and lots of monkeys, birds and deer. The golf course is huge, beautiful and perfect for golf lovers. The spa experience was relaxing. Food is great and next time when I am there I will have to try their Thai restaurant.I would strongly suggest if you have any problems during your stay in Gokarna do let the staff know about it as they are very helpful and polite and would do everything to make things right for you. Special thanks to Tashi and Rishma (in the front desk), Terring (junior executive food and beverage) and Chef Suresh for making our stay a very memorable one. We hope to come back soon. Amreena x

In the company of Nepali friends I enjoyed a delicious Thai meal next to the golf course. The service and cleanliness were good and the friendliness of staff quite notable. I have no hesitation in recommending this excellent venue. The rest of the hotel looked very smart and beautifully situated in the forest.

Posting again since my last post was only about a day trip. Me and my fiance got the honeymoon suite for our stay which was nicely decorated with rose petals and came with complimentary tidbits. That particular room is huge and has an incredible view. I fell in love with the bathroom. It came with a nice little step-down tub. The hotel really put in effort to make our stay there special with other little gestures, which I'm very thankful for. :)The pool stays open until 9 pm, which I would advise everyone to make use of!The stay at Gokarna was lovely except for the load shedding that put a damper in our plans for swimming in the heated pool. The entire hotel goes in sleep mode when there is no lights. There is no backup power either. Other than this little glitch, Gokarna really takes care of its patrons. Will definitely visit again.

Stayed here for 5 days for an international conference. The hotel is set within a forest with deer and monkeys which you can see on a regular basis. The hotel advises guests to keep their windows shut to keep the monkeys out. On my last day here I was running down by the golf course when over 100 monkeys were making the journey across the golf course to the hill on the other side - I just wished I'd hd a camera.On the positive side the hotel is well run, the rooms are large with comfortable beds, and all modern amenities although the shower heads could be replaced or tightened. The rooms have flat screen televisions, international sockets for electrical equipment, tea and coffee making facilities. The rooms also had candles and matched in cars the electrical generator failed when the electricity cut out across the rest of  valley.Best of all were the staff especially Rashwani? who was very helpful and always checking out I had everything I needed. The staff were always helpful and the hotel IT person helped sort a problem I had with my laptop. i ate at Durbar and the Everest international cuisine one, and both had good quality food at a reasonable price. The hotel offer a pick up and drop off service at the airport which was very helpful along with free transport to Thammel. The hotel also provides guided tours of the grounds 1,2,3,or 4hour treks! Lastly there is a very pleasant bar for the evenings. I did not try the Spa but a colleague really enjoyed it.On the negative side I found the wi-fi to be very frustrating, inconsistent and only usable on one device and would have a bit more variety with the buffets in Durbar. The breakfasts however had a wide variety of choice.Overall, I'd be very happy to stay here again and can full heartedly recommend it.

We were there for an international conference, and in that time there were trekkers, weddings and other conferences and all very well organised. The staff were great, very helpful and when I return to Nepal I will have to go back there.

Fantastic Location,Great ServiceSuperb Rooms and Delicious FoodAmazing SpaBeautiful Golf CourseIf you are looking for an amazing place that is just absolutely away from the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu, then this is IT!. Large size bedrooms with clean facilities, a great restaurant, beautiful golf course, great staff and polite service, an amazing spa team and your worries are over.Travel to Nepal and help them rebuild. The people need work not hand outs and the best way to restore their dignity is to visit this amazing country.I am glad we DID!

Back from a 15 day Base Camp Trek and all we really needed was long hot showers and sleep. We heard about Gokarna, so we thought after staying in lodges for 2 weeks, we definitely needed a resort. I'm glad to say that this was the best decision we made after an amazing experience in the Himalayan region because we got much more that what we wished for.From the second we entered we were looked after, our check in was done ever so smoothly and taken to our room. Our room for the next 2 days was just amazing, very clean, extremely spacious, great view into the garden from our window and beds that we just didn't want to get out off. The area around the resort is amazing for a early morning or a late afternoon stroll, which is refreshing to have, especially away from the city fumes. Being surrounded by the forest was just perfect and relaxing. We also tried out the spa located in the pool area, while the massage was just perfect, I did wish the spa was a little more secluded or sound proof as we were constantly disturbed by other guest splashing around in the pool or talking in the lounge. Never the less, the massage service we received was perfect and completely worth it.If I have to get a little picky, I do hope Gokarna expand their room-service menue, however apart from that the breakfast has great variety and food is great. Additionally open up an option to have un-guided forest treks for guest who are aware of the area and just want a light stroll instead of fixed hours of trekking that is paid for.To sum up - A perfect way to spend our last 2 days in Nepal. Keep up the great work  Gokarna! Looking to return someday.

We spent 2 nights here for a much needed break while working in Kathmandu. It was everything we hoped for. The cleanliness, space, airiness and total peace feels like being on a different planet from the city. Every member of staff without exception was focussed on making our stay as enjoyable as possible. We would recommend the Asian restaurant for open views across the golf course and a perfect place for a sundowner. Our spa treatments were excellent and all the facilities were what you would expect from a 5 star hotel. We will definitely return and recommend others to come too.

I had a lovely room, which was comfortable and quiet. Went to the excellent spa, enjoyed the indoor pool and free yoga classes in the morning (very nice), and did a few forest walks in just three days.

We stayed here the last two nights of our 9-day Nepal trip. It was supposed to be sort of a relaxing treat after the chaos of Kathmandu and days of trekking and activities in the mountains. Unfortunately, the experience was a bit disappointing and strange.First, let me start by saying that the grounds of the hotel are truly beautiful. It is a serene place with old majestic trees and lovely flowers. The main building is inviting and has photos of various temples and mountain climbing expeditions which we enjoyed looking at. We were shown to two rooms (one for us and one for our three children) next to each other and away from the main building. The rooms were very spacious and nicely appointed and the beds very comfortable (the only spring mattresses we slept on during our trip). Aside from these things, though, there was much to be desired, especially since this is supposedly a 5-star property.There were some issues with the rooms. After check-in we realized that the toilet in the kids' room was not flushing. We called and someone came to fix this problem while we went to dinner. While the rooms were very nice, the bathrooms needed a refresh. Moldy grout in the shower area of both rooms was off-putting and unexpected. At one point, I found a tick on the bath mat. The area is heavily wooded and there are animals around so it wasn't so much a surprise as it just made me nervous. I was constantly checking around the room and telling kids not to leave clothes, etc. on the floor or lying around. Additionally, one of the beds had a faint stain on the bedsheet. It was one of the kids beds and our youngest opted to stay in our room so we just did not use that bed, but yuck.The staff was pleasant but somewhat formal and reserved. We felt none of that genuine Nepalese warmth and hospitality that we had come to know. It just seemed like everyone was trying a bit to hard maybe to provide "5-star" service and it just came across as fake. Aside from one lady (can't remember her name!) who worked the reservations desk.. She took an interest in our family and asked about where we are from and what we've seen in Nepal, and we had a very nice conversation with her about Nepalese spices after she found out we had been to a cooking class that day. We really appreciated her thoughtfulness.Our first morning, we were woken up just before 6:00 a.m. by a noisy group apparently at the hotel for a conference. There was LOUD shouting... I thought someone was fighting, but then I heard laughter. When I looked out the peephole I saw people laughing and taking pictures in the grassy area outside our room. I tried to go back to bed, but as the noise continued for the next twenty minutes I gave up and called the front desk. I asked if someone could please tell the guests to quiet down as it was still very early and they had woken up my children as well. I don't know if anyone actually came or not, but the noise continued for another ten minutes or so before they left. So much for a restful retreat!Since I was wide awake now, I decided to get dressed and try out the free yoga class. My daughter and I had actually been looking forward to the yoga since we planned this trip and were pretty excited. I thought we'd be doing yoga outdoors since there is plenty of space, the grounds are beautiful, the weather perfect and the brochure actually shows a picture of a woman sitting in a yoga pose under one of the property's fantastic trees. Unfortunately, when we arrived to the spa we were led upstairs to the gym facility. There was one other participant there and the female instructor along with myself and my 11-year-old daughter. The four of us were crammed in to a corner of the gym on our mats. There really wasn't enough space, but worse than that was when a gentleman came in during our session and starting using the treadmill and lifting weights. He huffed and puffed and the machine whirred as we were trying miserably to get our "calm" on. He didn't stay long though. Maybe he felt as awkward as we did. The yoga itself was strange and consisted of running in place, various arm swinging, bending and loosening up moves. Then came the nose blowing exercises.. I kid you not... with tissues (gross!), followed by breathing techniques with our nostrils. I was so not enjoying any of this and wanted to leave but did not want to be rude. We finally got to the ending relaxation exercise where we were coached through relaxing the parts of our body (including our "genital areas"), followed by a minute or two of "Om" from the instructor. I was so relieved when this was over! I am not a regular yoga person but I have taken classes in the past and always enjoyed them. I guess was expecting more stretching poses and quiet relaxation/meditation. This whole experience was completely weird and awful! On a positive note, I did return later to the spa and had a nice massage.While the grounds of the property are lovely, you are not allowed to explore without a guide so you are restricted to the main area and facilities. Walking tours range from 1-4 hours and at an additional charge. We were tired from trekking and chose not to do this but I guess you can see temples along with the wildlife such as deer and leopards?! Yikes. There are plenty of monkeys on the property which is fine but two of my children were afraid, especially at night. You can hear them jumping on the rooftops and there are tips on how to keep them out of your rooms. Apparently you can also ride bikes or go horseback riding also for a fee, but we did not do this. We did take our kids to the pool one afternoon, but that was ruined by the noisy conference attendees as well. The pool area is small and pretty but since it's indoors all the noise is amplified tenfold. My husband and I could barely make it an hour before we told the kids to pack it up and leave the conference people to their NOISY game of water polo.We had some really amazing food while in Nepal. Unfortunately, none of it was at this resort. All the food was very, very average, generic or bland. We had one dinner at the main restaurant and one at the asian restaurant down by the golf course. The asian restaurant was better but nothing remarkable. At both dinners, we were the only people in the restaurant. The staff at the main restaurant, while providing good service, also tended to hover around our table making it a bit awkward. The breakfast buffet was pretty disappointing. The hot items were dominated by noodles and beans and things I would normally think of for lunch or dinner. You can get an omelette made to order, though, which was the only saving grace as the pastries and breads were lacking flavor and the porridge was runny. The "fresh" juice was not good, but you can get coffee, traditional tea or water brought to your table upon request.The hotel itself is isolated which is fine if you want a retreat but not so great if you want to go anywhere. We were at the end of our trip so it was not really a problem. Our driver picked us up to take us to a cooking class and aside from that we did not leave the hotel until we were heading to the airport. If you are planning on sightseeing or experiencing Kathmandu, however, you may want to look at other hotels. At this place we did not feel like we were in Kathmandu at all.Overall, I think if this were a lower rated hotel I would have been satisfied. But because it boasts a 5-star rating my expectations were considerably higher. To me, "5-star" means absolute excellence across the board: in service, accommodation, amenities, food & beverage... everything! Many years ago I worked at a 5-star Four Seasons Hotel and I remember what high standards the management held us to. The Gokarna Forest Resort is a pleasant place and has some good qualities, but it simply does not meet 5-star standards in my opinion.

The Gokarna Forest resort is a great option when visiting Kathmandu. It is situated in a forest away from the heavy traffic and noise of the city. The facilities were nicely decorated and well maintained. The staff members were friendly and provided excellent service.

Out of the dust and hustle of Kathmandu, this charming resort is located in a forested area and offers visitors large, well appointed guest rooms, areas to walk around, and very good food. There is a village nearby with a few temples, and lots of local color, as well as an onsite temple that conducts meditation services twice a day. Free Wi-Fi only works in certain places, (the bar is very comfortable however, and it works great there) there is an hourly charge for in-room wi-fi

Took the package including transfer, forest walk, internet, breakfast, deluxe room. Went on a Saturday afternoon and returned Sunday afternoon. Booked for a massage on Saturday evening, which was amazing and their massage table is heated. Breakfast is good too. Forest walk is best in the morning. I went at 9:30. Saw deers and monkeys! Felt great afterwards. Need to go more often get some fresh air...!

we went there for lunch, actual we wanted a family environment peaceful not so far from city but out of crowd where we can relax and enjoy the greenry. it was so perfect. we went there to a restaurant near golf course where they serve Thai and Chinese. food was really delicious. service was really good bit expensive but worth paying with the place and quality of food and service. perfect place for family, friends and for couple. it's a 15 mins drive frm Ktm city.

Loved the ambience .it's huge lavish property with always helping and smiling staff. They should increase their Indian food menu and improve taste too. Rooms are big and clean with all amenities. Indoor swimming pool is great activity for kids and is open till late...

Un resort che si trova a circa venti minuti dall aeroporto di katmandu ma che sembra essere molto lontano poiché costruito separata,ente dalla città che dal resort non si vede.Ottimo bar aperto tutto il giorno e buon ristorante che permette ai visitatori di non uscire dal resort.Dotato di una ottima SPA con brave terapiste che forniscono una vasta gamma di massaggi a prezzi buoni.La camera spaziosa con grande finestra con visione sul bosco.Il personale molto gentile e sempre disponibile.Unico neo la carenza di carburante nel paese che oltre a creare lunghe file ai distributori di benzina con conseguente aumento del traffico, ciò comporta la non capacità nella periodo dalle 11 alle 17 di erogare energia elettrica e dunque riscaldamento ed acqua calda.Nel giardino all aperto ci sono sia  i tavoli del bar che del ristorante per mangiare all aperto.Il luogo è sempre controllato da un sistema di guardie della sicurezza militare armate.Il prezzo risulta alto per il nepal ma certamente ottimo come rapporto prezzo qualità offerta è ben al di sotto della media europea.Da tornarci anche per ottimo campo da golf tecnico e ben curato.

We stayed at the Gokarna Forest Resort at both the start and end of our visit to Nepal. The reception staff are very helpful, as are the restaurant and bar staff. The rooms are of an excellent standard, both the standard and the executive suites; very comfortable beds and good standard bath rooms. The bar has international sports channels and live music on some nights if you are interested. The restaurant has breakfast and dinner buffet options but also a la carte for Nepalese cuisine or Indian Tali. The golf course offers reductions for guests and was designed by a St Andrews professional. The course is set in the Gokarna forest and offers tight fairways and plenty of streams and water hazards; unless you are a straight driver there are plenty of opportunities to lose a ball! Console yourself with admiring the bird life, monkeys and deer who share the course.Gokarna Forest is an excellent place to adjust time zone or enjoy the hospitality of Nepal.

Thank you for a great stay. This is a beautiful and very friendly resort. The golf course looks fantastic and has plenty of wildlife to add to the scenic beauty. The food is very enjoyable. Ask for Pork & Rai saag curry. Yum yum yum!The bedrooms are very comfortable and the whole resort is well decorated and maintained.

My mom and I were at the resort for a couple of days. My mom had work there and I tagged along. We got there early because her meetings were about to start and the staff informed us that they were trying to accommodate all the new guests and they would give us a room asap. They worked hard to do so and gave us a room hours before the check in time. In the meanwhile, they offered me options like taking a bicycle ride to a nearby village. They had excellent and well-maintained bicycles and gave me a bottle of water, clean helmet, and a map. I rode about 16 kms and it was beautiful to see a different side of the Kathmandu valley. The paperwork to get the bicycle was straightforward and easy. When I got back, I was able to freshen up in my room that they were able to have ready and then went to check out the salon. The indoor pool looked decently maintained and their salon staff was very kind and well-trained. Beautiful property and a nice getaway from the city. The room floor was a little slippery and the wifi device limit was frustrating. Other than those two - lovely stay! Thanks to Tasha for her hospitality!

Been wanting to stay ever since my first trip for work purposes 2 years back. Worth it! The rave reviews about their hospitality is true! From the way up to the resort till the moment me and my partner entered our room, we were greeted by almost every staff we passed on our way. The best was during breakfast when I had spilled a little of my tea and one of the resort staff interrupted her meeting from a neighbouring table to come over and discreetly pass me a new serviette. Now that's attention to customer service.Due to the ongoing border crisis, their Thai restaurant is closed during dinner. Their main restaurant offers the same in their bar but there really isn't much choice there. If you are lucky and they have a gorgeous buffet available, you're welcome to join in. I wasn't feeling up to the extremely inviting buffet on my first night there since I had had a particularly filling lunch at their Thai restaurant earlier. The buffet during my second night was rather paltry in comparison to the night before. What a bummer. My partner and I didn't try out any of the activities they offered like biking, trekking or horseroding but we did use their jacuzzi and sauna. It was decent. The rooms are also spacious but a few switches weren't working and our bedside lamp had fused. Loved their complimentary room amenities. Overall, it's a beautiful place to just take a breather. You might spot their a couple of spotted deer too. We saw 2!

Great weekend get away resort. Very open area and clean. Great spa and swimming facilities, though gym can be done better. The durbar resturant is not managed well enough, only trainees serve, and requested food is not available instead. Though a good experience overall.

Thank you all starting from the airport pick up driver up to the management, really you give us a pleasant stay, the place, the staff, the nature, just every thing except the food menu was more than excellent, specially Miss Nirmaya Tamang thank you soooo

This was going to be a 3 star review (based on food - mixed bag, chicken served was very, very dry - and the facilities / building itself, which could do with a little freshen up).However, the Gokarna Forest Resort staff were so, so welcoming and accommodating, and were always proactively checking in with me, talking to me about my stay etc. that their attitude and customer service ethos meant I added a star for their efforts. The staff and the location are the two main drawcards here - out of the smog of Kathmandu itself which is a plus, and surrounded by forest (including monkeys) which can be explored on bikes from the hotel.The only drawback to the location, is the fact that you have to organise transport to and from the cultural centres, temples etc. which does come at a cost.The room itself was a decent size and clean, with a very generously sized bath tub (so the room was a 'win').Please note - the fuel shortage and subsequent powercuts did not impact my review. In Nepal, power cuts are common, and no hotel can help them. If you travel here, it's part and parcel of the day.

Lovely peaceful sorroundings with amenities in full. Golf ground. Sufficient place for weeding ceremony and like that.  Peaceful but a little bit away from downtown. Boudhnath stupa the biggest in Asia very neat.

I spend a wonderful weekend at this resort just 30 minutes drive from Kathmandu.  The reservation was done at short notice, but smoothly handled by their front desk, who were waiting for me as I arrived.  It was my birthday, and they not only connected from the arrival form I completed, they hunted me out in the evening with a birthday cake, with my name on it!  What a wonderful surprise.The resort has a fantastic spa, complimentary to guests, although the massage was extra cost, but it was brilliant, done with experience and relaxed me.

I been there for college project, did swimming for an hour and was served good food with great service. quite environment to escape from the hustle bustle area of Kathmandu, I recommend the people who look for quite and full of nature environment.

If only this was not such a difficult time for Nepal. The resort is truly wonderful and the staff bend over backward to help. There is a wonderful spa horse riding forest treks 3 wonderful restaurants acres of forests full of animals and possibly the best golf course in south Asia....However, with the government cutting power at will and the hotel generator not able to fill in all the gaps visitors ate currently likely to have a cold stay. While I was there regular power cuts took place between 11 am and 5 pm....we made the best of it and it wasnt too bad....but the management probably should not be charging 5 star prices--around $120 a night--at such a time. With this uncertainty I would suggest cutting price to half--or advertising the problem clearly to potential customers I only found out about the problem AFTER I had already paid.I truly hope these difficulties are soon resolved because GOkarna is truly a beautiful place for a getaway and the staff were all great. Ramesh and Lasta come prominently to mind and they will do everything to help you.Would I return? Abdolutely! It would be a pleasure to go again--but only when the power issues are redolved.

Good place to stay for a few days in Katmandu.Spa and Golf facilities are really well adapted for leisure out of the city.Food could be more diversified (limited choices).Only 30 minutes from Thamel by car.

I have been visiting Gokarna quite often and we all love this place because of its location and charm. Spa is the best part of all where you can relax and rejuvenate yourself. But currently there is power cut so often so we have to check the loadshedding time and have to plan for that which was no problem for us. Service is absolutely great and staffs were kind enough to make you feel comfortable and cared. Tashi was helpful and informative. Salute to this hotel for having courage to run even during such a hard time. We had great time and Dhanaibad

Local resident with a family of three and always love going out for birthdays, weekend getaways with in the country. This hotel as always been our first choice. The location just right as its just Km or two away from the city. We are very choosy about our food, room location and other amenities and we have never had to be disappointed while our stay at this resort. Very very friendly and humble Staffs who go beyond to assist. The food keep getting better and better at each visit.

Me and my wife stayed in this resort for one week. We very much enjoyed every moment of our stay. Staff were so helpful, friendly and kind. The food in the Durbar restaurant was a well presented buffet and nice. The Spa was another thing not to miss. The trail walk in the forest, with an experienced guide, watching herds of deer and listening to various tunes of bird songs, was really an experience. Every staff in the resort knows his job well and our thanks go to all of them.

Spent two days during winter for business workshop in the hall by the side of the open space. The hall sometimes used to be noisy from the staffs talk from the bar area. The place is far away from the hustle bustle of the city. On the first day, group of monkeys on the ground surprised me, unfortunately many of them did not have a front leg.

Very nice rooms, there was much space there. Very friendly and helpful personnel. Nice location in the woods, quiet and green. The Spa area could be renovated, Himalaya massage was real relaxing. Did not like the breakfast very much, please buy a good coffee machine!!!!

our stay at Gokarna Forest Resort was a good experience. We spent 7 nights at the hotel. The pick up at the airport was good. The welcome at the reception was warm and professional throughout our stay. The hotel is clean, has nice gardens and faciliaties. The restaurant has a limited menu and we did not appreciate several items we had because of different taste. The breakfast was good. Due to the fuel strike some items were not available in the shop and in the bar but for some days only. The swimming pool could not be heated due to the same reason. But these are tiny things. In general: nice, clean, friendly and atractive . Well done.

After 3 weeks trekking in Khumbu Valley the Gorkana Forest Resort was the right place to relax and enjoy the last 3 days in Nepal. In the beginning of our tour we stayed in Yak & Yeti in Kathmandu. Gorkana is definately the better choice. The Hotel offers spacious, very comfortable & well designed rooms, a good breakfast Buffet, 2 different Restaurants, a nice and neet Spa area, etc. Even if the Hotel is a 40 min drive away from Kathmandu city  (Thamel) you will appreciate this green and fresh air place when you come back. So getting a driver to get into town and to come back is definatly a must but not a problem. Taxi are more than enough to find in Kathmandu! The whole staff was always very friendly and welcoming at any time.

Alles in allem genau die Abwechslung nach drei Wochen Trekking, die wir gesucht haben. Großzügige und moderne Zimmer, zuvorkommender Service, eine schöne Anlage und dazu nach langem mal wieder Abwechslung beim Essen. Abgerundet hat das ganze noch ein für nepalische Verhältnisse guter Spa Bereich. Was geht besser? Wenige Taxifahrer kennen das Gokarna, was das heimkommen aus der Stadt erschwert. Da hilft es eine Visitenkarte vom Hotel mitzunehmen oder gleich den Hotel Hol- und Bringservice zu nutzen.Wer als Frau die Sauna nutzen möchte gibt besser rechtzeitig Bescheid, da die Frauensauna meist erst angeschaltet werden muss. Internet for free gibt's nur an der Bar.Trotzdem positives Fazit: Preis/ Leistung stimmt. Hotel liegt etwas außerhalb, hat aber Vorteile in Bezug auf Ruhe und Großzügigkeit der Zimmer/ Anlage.Wer europäische 5 Sterne erwartet, der muss ins Dwarikas, zahlt dann aber auch 300+ USD.Regards to Lasta. Thanks. For your hospitality.

Gokarna Forest Resort was a beautiful slice of green heaven to come 'home' to after trekking, day-tripping and taking in all that Kathmandu and greater Nepal have to offer. My husband and I planned the trip in January of 2015 and never considered canceling as the staff and reviews of this resort stayed amazingly positive despite all of the natural and political happenings that Nepal has endured in 2015! Lasta and all of the personnel at the front desk, bar, club house, concierge are warm and genuinely concerned about making your stay in Nepal the best ever. The breakfast buffet is hearty, drinks are strong and the kitchen puts out delicious meals despite the austerity of power outages and having to utilize wood at times due to the fuel shortage. Getting a driver to take us to town and pick us up as well as airport transfer was definitely a must and the driver was always there on time.

More than satisfied.. Never expect will be so much happier and satisfied in Nepal specially with this hotel, the food, and their staff are all happy and accommodating one of them is Lasta who give awesome experience they pamper us so much that we cannot forget and surely will put in diaries to go back there again. I called this heaven in Nepal 👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼

Отель расположен на высоком холме на окраине Катманду и окружён густым зеленым лесом.  Раньше этот лес относился к королевским охотничьим угодьям. Да и сейчас в нём обитает множество представителей местной фауны от оленей до обезьян. Последние доставляют некоторое беспокойство как сотрудникам отеля, так и постояльцам, которых просят не оставлять окна в номерах открытыми. Отель не дёшев, но и уровень комфорта в нём достаточно высок. Рядом есть гольф-поле со всеми необходимыми аттрибутами. В лесу, занимающем 740 акров, можно совершать продолжительные прогулки и наблюдать за разнообразным животным миром.  Здесь всегда чистый воздух в отличие от центра Катманду.
知り合いは一泊して、自分は別のホテルでした。ネパールのホテルを期待していなかったのですが、ここは雰囲気が良く周囲も市内と比べ別世界です。ただ、良すぎてこのホテルに慣れると別の地区に移動した時のギャップでビックリするかもしれません。

we loved to stay at Gokharna while in Kathmandu. The resort is a bit out of the city, so you will need to book a car every time you go for sighseeings but once you come back to the hotel it is fantastic to be immersed in the nature. I saw hundreds of birds around the lush vegetation. There is also a golf course. Staff are amazing. I wish they inproved their a la carte food becasue when you stay in you want to have good food and we did not enjoy our dinners there. Breakfast though was excellent

After 3 days trekking this hotel was quite simply put amazing. The grounds are spectacular, the staff well trained and friendly. The food (dinner and breakfast) is lovely with a suitable set of choices. The spa and massage rates as one of the best i have experienced. In short, for anyone going to Nepal wanting some luxury it has to be at Gokarna Forest Resort.

We loved staying at Gokarna. It's nice to be a bit out of central Kathmandu, which can be polluted and overwhelming. Gokarna is quiet and peaceful. They also offer a free shuttle each day if you want to go into the city, which is nice. I will say our driver was late one day picking us up, by about 45 minutes. We also arranged a driver to take us to the bus station one morning, and he was late by about 15-20 minutes - so, if you need to be somewhere at a certain time, it may be best to tell them earlier than you think.The grounds are very pretty and they offer lots of activities. My husband and I both got a massage at the spa and really enjoyed it. The room was very comfortable, clean and spacious. The staff were always asking how we were, and offered to help with anything we needed. Only took off a star because of the drivers being late and the restaurant food could be improved. Otherwise lovely hotel in Nepal and we would definitely recommend.

From 6th Sept. until 5th October Gokarna became my base for travel to Tibet; Pokhara and Chitwan and trekking around Annapurnas.  Every time I returned the whole staff made me feel like a long lost friend (I was travelling on my own most of the time).  The rooms and bathrooms (and I tried several of them) were very clean, extremely comfortable...you could relax.  The food, breakfast, lunch and dinner was prepared and served in extremely professional, but relaxed manner.  Oh, the bar was good too.  Enjoyed a massage in the spa (and even had a hair cut there).  Beautiful golf course (but no time for that).  I hope that I can return to Gokarna in the next year or so......but certainly would recommend it highly to anyone looking for this calibre of accommodation in Kathmandu.

Pengalaman berkesan di tengah kehijauan. Oase setelah menjelajahi Kathmandu yang berdebu. Sajian makanan lezat di tengah suasana asri menambah kesan pada resor ini. Sejumlah monyet dan kicauan burung juga menambah asyik suasana.

Beautiful relaxing place in the midst of a big lush forest, Gokarna is really a beautiful place to stay in! The staff is all super friendly and helpful, especially Tashi from the front desk staff. Highly recommended!

Highly recommend Gokarna.  It's an amazing property filled with fabulous touches of service.  The rooms are spacious and tranquil.  Like living in a spa.  The bathrooms are well appointed and oversized.  You'll love the walk in shower.  The staff go above and beyond to welcome you and address any questions you have.  Be sure to eat in the restaurant off the golf course - the Thai food is fantastic.  The main restaurant is also very good for breakfast and continental cuisine. You'll love the monkeys on the property - add a special Nepalese touch.  Be sure to visit the gym - for an awesome view while you work out.  After touring around the Kathmandu valley filled with traffic and crowds, Gokarna was a tranquil respite.

I had a positive experience at the Gokarna Resort in Nepal last few week. Ms. Tashi , of the Front Desk Staff, she is very helpfull and showing me around the  resort to see the beautyfull place, as I was feeling very stressed. I wasn't very keen at first, but she seemed really concerned for me as a customer and that is what made me walk over to the spa. The massage therapist was very good, the price was very reasonable, and I decided to sign up for a package of 12 more. I'd say this was the best thing in my day today, a great experience, I recommend it to other travelers.less

Gokarna is the perfect getaway from the city.Everything spells tranquility at Gokarna. The staff is very courteous and will try their best to fulfill your requests. The staff at the Mt. 8848 Bar were nice enough to have my favorite dish (The Dragon Chicken) brought up all the way from The Clubhouse down below. The Clubhouse's staff even helped my my mom hold a surprise engagement party up on their attic/roof for me and my (now) fiance! I was there for their weekend BBQ buffet and it was really good. And the spa! Ohhh, its pure heaven! The hot tub is the best thing ever! I have such nice memories associated with this place. Hope to visit it more soon! :)

Si proche de Kathmandou, ce site est en pleine nature..sur le golf et dans la jungle! Cette demeure était l'ancienne propriété du Roi..ce qui explique pourquoi cet espace est si grand et sauvegardé. L'hotel est dans le style newar, les chambres sont spacieuses confortables et décorées avec goût ..plusieurs petits restaurants proposent différents types de plats Népalais...Nous nous sommes promenés avec un guide dans la jungle et avons même fait du cheval! Il y a des singes dans le parc pas du tout agressifs et de nombreux daims ! C'est un havre de paix dans un Kathmandou parfois si tumultueux..! C'était pourtant notre 5ème voyage au Népal et nous ne connaissions pas ce site!

Отель расположен в чудной местности, имеет хорошую территорию, приятный дизайн, но все же ощущения полной идеальности не возникло. Во-первых - дорого, во-вторых- холодно (мы были в марте), в-третьих - полностью разочаровало СПА при отеле. Завтрак тоже оставляет желать лучшего. Но зато принимают кредитные карты и задорные обезьянки бегают по территории (не забывайте закрывать окна в номере!)

I had a positive experience at the Gokarna Resort in Nepal today. Ms. Lasta, of the Front Desk Staff, suggested I try a massage at the spa, as I was feeling very stressed. I wasn't very keen at first, but she seemed really concerned for me as a customer and that is what made me walk over to the spa. The massage therapist was very good, the price was very reasonable, and I decided to sign up for a package of 12 more. I'd say this was the best thing in my day today, a great experience, I recommend it to other travelers.

Although I only had the pleasure of spending 2 nights at the superb Gokarna Forest Resort, I saw enough of the place to know that be it business (as it was for me) or for a vacation, the accomodation, the surroundings, the facilities and the staff are all really top notch.  From entering the foyer, to having a wander around the spa and golf course, to dinner at the 8848 mt Bar to the delicious breakfast, I was made to feel most welcome.  I cannot praise the resort and its staff enough, however, special mention goes to Tashi for taking time to make sure we were enjoying our stay and to Deepak for allowing me to beat him at pool.  Keep up the great work guys.

I reside in Dubai. Aa a part of my holiday trip i went to Nepal.I had to stay at Gokarna Forest Resort.It was just an escape from city life ,also it had Asia's one of the best golf station which was exciting.The atmosphere of the resort really touched my heart. The armospheee was natural , wild and exciting.

Our 5-day visit with a family and two kids was outstanding: incredible helpful and professional staff (e.g. Ms. Dashi at reception) going way beyond expectations on various small details. Friendly, great facilities, large/well equipped rooms and just outside the busy city of Kathmandu. Overall a memorable stay and we would really recommend to go now after the earthquake risks are back to normal - it is worth it

We stayed there 2 nights and we were transported to a world of beauty, serenity and gentleness. The view is spectacular, service is exceptional and staff took pride in their work making us most welcome and encouraging us to embrace the Nepali culture.

We stayed at Gokarna Forest Resort for 2 nights in August but really regret not being able to stay longer as the hotel was wonderfully tranquil with faultless service and lovely facilities.  Our deluxe room and bathroom were enormous with stylish, locally inspired furniture and decor.  Woke up to deers nibbling grass beneath our window and endless views across the surrounding hills.  Extensive range of food available in the restaurants and our guided forest walk was great fun (remember to bring thick socks to fend off the leeches!).  Staff were superb - ultra helpful and knowledgeable about all aspects of the hotel and area - they all went out of their way to ensure our stay was memorable.  Highly recommended!

This hotel and it's staff is excellent. The hospitality and service is amazing, as is the location (in a very green area with deer and monkeys around) and the rooms themselves. Really, really spacious and clean. We had a great stay here for two nights with our filmcrew.

We used an Interval International trade for this hotel in Kathmandu.  The property is stunning, from the architecture to the interior decorating to the expansive grounds.  It is a former palace used by royalty for hunting and recreation and we certainly were treated like that.  It begins when you roll up in your private car and are greeted with a  welcome drink.The room was exactly as pictured on the website, high ceilings, with beautiful tall wood doors and wood screens on the wardrobes.  There are several sculptures and pictures in the rooms that added to the Nepali palace feel.  We were given bath robes and even sanitized shower shoes in the room.  The television is a wall mounted flat screen with several english channels including HBO.  The room had a safe, refrigerator kept stocked with our favorite beverages, hot pot with coffee/tea supplies, a basket of TV snacks and always two bottles of mineral water.The bathroom is enormous and included products from the spa for your use, along with other amenity items.  Big fluffy white towels.  In fact all the linens were top quality. The bed was very comfortable and the views of the deer and monkeys was a wonderful greeting every morning.  We did not drink the water from the faucet, but did use it to brush our teeth, rinse, etc. with no problems whatsoever.  The shower is heaven.There are several restaurants at the property and we ate at all of them.  The Chinese/Thai restaurant at the 18-hole golf course was particularly good, and we really enjoyed the MT 8848 Bar.  We stopped in everyday and enjoyed excellent top shelf liquor and drinks of the day.  I particularly enjoyed trying new foods and many of the vegetarian offerings were particularly good.  The Chicken Picatta was one of my favorites and of course..mo-mo's.  The breakfast buffet is very large and even has a cook to order station.  The food was of the highest quality including Australian raised steaks, and huge prawns.  Cold foods and drinks are served icy cold, and hot items very hot.  From the table service to the china and glass ware used, this hotel is five star.The grounds are something very special...acres and acres of forest, spa, swimming pool, Jacuzzi, and children's play area.  We very much enjoyed walking the grounds where we saw deer and many, many monkeys.  We also saw wonderfully colored birds and butterflies.  We went on a guided walk in the forest and saw deer, monkeys and leopard prints, and enjoyed our guides knowledge of the history of the property, and his expertise in the flora and fauna.  He told us about the leopard family that lives in the forest.The hotel has uniformed security guards posted at the entrances and all over the resort armed with sling shots to keep the monkeys from being pesky.  We spoke with several who like all the staff that this hotel were very friendly and enjoyed telling us about where they were from, and learning about where we were from.If all of this wasn't enough, the shining star of this hotel would have to be Lastor and the rest of the staff.  We were so well cared for, they took note of the drinks we took out of the refrigerator and over our week stay, removed those we didn't like and made sure there were plenty of those we did.  They are very kind and are always looking for anything they can do to make your stay better.  The hotel arranged several trips for us.  We said we would like to take an Everest flight..10 minutes later we are booked on a flight and a private car arranged to take us to and from the airport.  When we came down the next morning, we found the car waiting..a clean, newer model, with bottled water for us.  A guided trip to the major temple and stupa sites was easily arranged, with an English speaking guide and even a stop at the Yak & Yeti for cocktails.  Everything was arranged with flawless efficiency and we felt like we had left behind new friends.As others have posted coming back to this hotel after being in Kathmandu feels like you are a world away even tho the drive only takes 25 minutes.  I would not only recommend this hotel to anyone, I would urge them to come to Nepal and stay here...you will never forget it.

A work retreat took me to this hotel. Stayed here for 5 nights. Gokarna forest resort is a beautiful property with well furnished and nicely designed rooms. Few drawbacks of the hotel are as follows:1. too many mosquitos and monkeys in the resort, because of which it was very difficult to open the room windows.2. theres is elevator in the hotel which makes it difficult for elderly people to climb stairs.3. The food was very very averageBesides these i enjoyed the property and my stay

It was pleasant moment for both of us, my wife and me staying at Gokarna Resort. Nice building structure and the location. Rooms were very beautiful and well managed. What  we like most is, "Friendly Staffs". All the staffs are gentle with caring heart. Food was very delicious, all the services that we got was very nice.As we both love quietness we really had a great fun with quiet environment, we enjoyed with greenery and the nature. Quietness of this resort made our stay unforgettable.

Rooms were large, complementry fruits were given on arrival, well maintained property, no sign of damage due to earthquake. no option of eating outside resort as it was far from city. good continental food inside but you north indian food was yuk!(Bad)

we stayed at gokarna forest twice by now. On the first visit we stayed at rana room which we prefer more. Swimming pool is indoor and sauna steam everything comes with the package for room. Breakfast got extensive varieties of foods items. Staffs were extremely courteous. Special thank you for the tall lady at lobby Tashi who helped us to get good rate for the room plus for her extraordinary service which makes us feel special. Thank you everyone for your service.

My husband and I really enjoyed our time at Gokarna. It was quiet, the rooms were beautiful, the food was great (first REAL caesar salad I have had in five years of living in Nepal) and the staff were kind, professional, and accommodating. We loved our time there.  We also appreciated that it was far removed from the chaos of Kathmandu. A great weekend getaway!
部屋がすごく広くて広すぎるぐらいの部屋もありました。　てんじょう天井が高くて、余計広く感じます。　すたっふは、みんなナマステと挨拶をしてくれて、きもちよくすごせました。　緑がいっぱいで、カトマンズとは思えないほど、ゆっくりすごすことができました。　ただタメルには少し遠いので、ホテルだけでゆっくり過ごすにはいいでしょうが、買い物には少し不便でした。　バスタブはちいさなプールのように広いです。

This was by far the nicest resort in the area. We stayed for a week and had a wonderful time. The people,scenery and golf were fantastic! I loved having all the wildlife around so close . The rooms were extremely nice as well. The resort is above and outside the smog area.

I went there on Saturday with my friends and enjoyed the BBQ and had great time swimming ....great service from staffs and amazing environment. Will  loved to be back again . Say Hi to Abha she was helpful .

A pleasant stay during our trip for National AGM of Round Table Nepal. The room in which we stayed was good, neat & clean, big rooms with all basic facilities. Food was good. The hotel is far from city. No free WIFI. Service is good. A pleasant place to spend some quality time. Golf course, spa, pool, billiards, etc., all is available.

The hotel is amazing,clean,surrounded with greenery.Really had great Saturday,enjoyed indoor swimming.Few golf practice shots were new experience to me.Foods were really really good and tasty.Support staffs were doing great job.

Went there with the family for all you can eat barbeque buffet. I just loved eat. Reasonably priced and variety of food including authentic Nepalese food. Big area and barbeque in the garden with nice view.Definitely go there again.

This hotel, not far from downtown Kathmandu, is set amid high trees. The grounds are attractive and well kept.  Monkeys add further character. The food (Chinese,Thai) is better at Clubhouse (adjacent to the golf course) than in the main restaurant -- at least based on the buffet served in the latter. I had major issues with the wifi: 1) one has to pay 2) the charge covers only one device 3) the signal strength, particularly in the bedrooms, is not that great. I had a discussion with a manager about this, and his attitude was unsympathetic and bureaucratic. Luxury is not a wifi in 2015, and this hotel should get with the program.

I stayed here with my colleagues for 2 nights. Clean, away from the city and greenery surroundings were the major highlights of it. Indoor swimming pool and Jacuzzi bath were the icing on the cake of the resort. Food was good and lots of option were available. I would love to be here again.

One of the Best Time Spent with family, quiet and pollution free environment. Best place for recreation taking a break from everyday hassle. Good hospitality, good food and being very close to the nature.

My wife and i stayed 12 days in early 2015 and felt cared for, at home, nurtured and inspired by our time at Gokarna. The combination of a delightful room, spacious facilities, the ayurvedic treatments and the spa, and friendly, extra-helpful staff was heart warming.We thoroughly recommend this resort to those seeking an oasis close to the heart of Kathmandu.

Quiet and contained within a natural setting close to Kathmandu, yet secluded. Exceptionally clean and spotlessly maintained grounds with hiking trails loaded with deer, monkeys, eagles, butterflies, etc. Awesome staff all around, who seem to personally care about you as an individual from arrival to departure. Food quality and service top-notch. Highly recommended for value and uniqueness. Say hi to Tashi!

A green Utopia amidst the fast spreading concrete jungle. What a relaxing and green spot of heaven for people wanting to escape the fast city life and the daily grind that goes with it. A place where one can relax and unwind and get some peaceful time with yourself after a full day of meetings. It was really a lovely experience for me. The staff was very helpful and always cheerful. Will certainly want to get back again and also recommend to good friends.

I visited Gokarna  forest resort with my family  last week-was amazed to see how wonderful place it was. Excellent services in every restaurant, friendly staffs, delicious foods and clean. Exceptionally large bedroom and bathroom, perfect place to relax. I liked the indoor swimming pool, perfect sized sauna and steam. It has a beautiful landscape and forest where you can enjoy the nature. If you are looking for the place where you can relax then this is the perfect place. For the month of June-July, they have an offer in spa and hotel rooms which is really worthy check it out.

My wife and I stayed for the second time at this property as the first one was memorable so we wanted to feel special again.The ladies at the reception are very sweet and friendly, always willing to assist.It was a special ocassion for us, and they surprised us with a gorgeous and romantic set up for both stays.We book a couple massage which was wonderful and very relaxing. We are looking forward to stay over and over again !Namaste,Maria & Santosh

Questo posto è stata per me un'oasi di tranquillità.Certo il Nepal ha subito un bel colpo dopo i terremoti che ancora oggi, seppur con meno intensità, scuotono il paese, ma questo posto, un po' fuori Kathmandu, immerso nel verde, esteso e non concentrato...beh, da anche quella tranquillità che in certe occasioni fa davvero piacere avere.Ero in Nepal per lavoro e non conoscevo questo posto, poi una volta arrivato ho trovato davvero un'ottima sistemazione. Stanze pulite e ben ordinate, forse non raffinatissime, ma stiamo parlando di un resort nel mezzo di una foresta! La mattina e la sera una tranquillità che, per chi come me vive in India, sa quasi di magico. Sentivo addirittura gli uccelli cantare al mattino!!! Non mi capitava da anni. Un'area aperta al centro del resort fa da "piazza ad un paio di ristoranti che si affacciano su di esso. Da un lato poi, alcune dependances con 2-4 camere ciascuna. Spa, piscina e centro massaggi. Buon cibo (anche occidentale) buona colazione e wifi gratuito nelle zone comuni con buona potenza, nonostante le difficoltà del paese degli ultimi mesi. Certamente quando tornerò in Nepal alloggerò nuovamente al Gokarna.

My friends and I stayed in Gokarna for 4 days/ 3 nights and it was such a refreshing treat for all of us. It's the perfect getaway for a staycation. Being here makes you forget about the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu life. The resort is nestled amidst the tranquil grounds of a forest. Monkeys can be seen roaming the grounds as well as a Spotted Reindeer. I particularly enjoyed hanging out at the Thai Restaurant by the Golf course, surrounded by the lush forrest and the well-maintained greens.I stayed at room 223 and the room was large, comfortable, and well maintained. I had a problem with the small refrigerator but their maintenance was quick enough to respond and they immediately changed it to a functioning one. Room service was fast and efficient. All the staff (front desk, restaurant, house keeping) that I've met during my stay were very warm and accommodating.I will recommend staying in Gokarna if you want to have a peaceful and relaxing time. :)

Excellent property, very serene and gorgeously green with a sprawling Golf course amidst a dense green forestVery well appointed rooms with lovely artefacts and plants and modern amenities and excellent LinenThe food is amazing and very personalised service The bar and patio,the clubhouse and the Durbar have excellent views and its sheer pleasure to dine thereThe gardens are organic and the ambience is breathtakingThe Spa and the front office and housekeeping staff are most cordial and their warm service is truly delightfulWould love to visit this haven again and again and recommend highly to all discerning travellers and holiday era looking for blissful relaxationNo damage is caused in the aftermath of the April earthquake and we had a most safe and serene stayThanks so much for excellent and warm hospitality

There are so many good things to say about this resort.  The rooms are large, comfortable, and well maintained.  The staff is friendly and works hard to make sure their guests are happy.  When I was at the resort, they were hosting a large wedding from Dubai.  They really did an outstanding job, and those of us not involved with the wedding  enjoyed watching all the activity.  After being detained in Kathmandu for three days following the 7.8 earthquake, Gokarna took us back and provided rooms for us until we were finally able to get a flight out.  They were great!

Went to relax to the Spa and had lunch at Gokarna Hotel.  The surroundings are beautiful, service is great too.  Lunch was very good, I liked it a lot.  it is nice to see green areas outside Kathmandu, which unfortunately is polluted and dusty. The hotel was almost empty as there are no tourist in Nepal after the earthquake but hope this will change soon.

My first business visit to Nepal and it was certainly a pleasant experience and the one that I will remember always. Warm greetings from staffs each time they pass by you. The peaceful area away from the hustle and bustle of the city. It made it look like Gokarna was a place far away from the city, up in the mountains but in actual fact, it is just 10-15mins away from Thamel Street. The entire facility is open, fully functional and I was very safe. Great breakfast buffet to start the day, the resort driver took me anywhere I wanted to go (free shuttle to town for shopping available too). Highly recommend it and I will return.

to my suprise it was a splendid resort, did not expect such kind of resort in Kathmandu, Luckily it is sound and undamaged after the devastating Nepal Earthquake. the staff is courteous, and warm. Nice driving golf course, njoy the indoor pool with a separate jacuzzi and steam.all in all a wonderful stay.

We stayed for 3 nights, a week before the earthquake struck.  The hotel is in a lovely location, away from the hustle and bustle of central Kathmandu but close enough to the tourist sites. There was a tourist bus provided f.o.c which was a good bonus.All staff provided excellent service and were helpful and courteous throughout.  Special thanks should go to Sumita who went out of her way to make our stay in Kathmandu special, especially after the guy on the "travel desk" (whom I dont think is directly employed by the hotel), seemed determined not to be very helpful with our enquiries about the Everest flight. Thankfully, Sumita saved the day and made my 50th birthday so very memorable.We stayed in a room on the edge of the forest and a short stroll from the main hotel. The room was nice and spacious and with nice forest canopy outlook. The only downside was the walls were a bit thin, so we could quite clearly hear the neighbours.Originally we were trying to decide on whether to book Gokarna or the Hyatt. After visiting Boudha Stupa we went and checked out the Hyatt and found it to be central for the sites but that also meant the air was more polluted. Overall, we were very glad that we made the choice to go to Gokarna, as it is much more tranquil.We would definitely choose to return to this hotel.

We were billeted in Gokarna on April 25th but the big M7.8 massive earthquake hit Nepal. Although there was no damage in Gokarna (except the old lodge building away from the main hotel/resort), they run out of rooms because the guests could not check out as most flights that day was cancelled. We decided to move our stay to a later date. It turned out better as we had time to help bring relief to Nepali communities in the following weeks. That day we were in Gokarna, all their staff were united in watching for the welfare of their clients, not minding their own families at the moment. They even provided free snacks for everyone- including us who were there yet not yet checked in. They truly care. They stayed calm and reassuring every guest, despite the rising crisis as we could only watch what was happening from the TV news.Finally this weekend we were able to take a break from weeks of doing relief work and we received quite a treat through a package for a cause they offered this week until end of May. For a minimum stay of 3 nights on double and single occupancy, inclusive of two meals-- they give a percentage of the tariff to earthquake fund to help Nepal stand again. So that feeling of being rested and refreshed and at the same time you get to help as well-- superb idea!Having stayed in Gokarna a few times before, we always look forward to returning. I've made reviews of our previous stays and this place never ceases to satisfy our reason to getaway from the city. It is indeed relaxing to be in the middle of the forest yet enjoy the amenities as well: swimming pool, spa, sauna, steam, jacuzzi. And of course the massage. They have the gym open for guests as well. There are two restaurants to choose from for your dining experience. Breakfasts are served in the patio area, with the open ground and trees as your view. In between meals you can go for the driving range or play golf, swimming, forest walk, meditating in comfy corners and roofed gandolas, or go around the forest on a pony or a horse. If you prefer indoors, bury yourself in the most comfy bed, pillows and duvets, or lounge watching your favorite series on the flat screen TV, or soak in a relaxing bath. They had a limited selection for the set meals at dinnertime but we assumed it was because of the limitations caused by the earthquake. But the service was very cordial and attentive. While we were there, there was an aftershock. We didn't budge an inch. The building is safe and secure. They even provide the structural engineers certification of their recent inspection of the buildings and properties. We did not see a single crack in any part of the main building. Our friends stayed in another building and it was safe. For now, it is the haven of some rescue and relief workers before going back to work again.  Most of all, their staff is the friendliest! We feel like we have known them forever! They are so conscious of your well-being. Every staff you meet everywhere asks how you are, how was the food, how was your sleep, etc. One even took note when I pointed out some design suggestions I had for the furniture. I appreciate that attention to detail and you are assured they will do something about it. Our family and friends felt safe and secure during our weekend stay there. Special appreciation goes to Ms Neeta, Ms Manita, Ms Abha, Ms Deepika, Mr Bibek, all the restaurant managers and staff, the maintenance/housekeeping staff for their prompt attention and of course to VP Dorjee Sherpa, the approachable, friendly Vice President who welcomes us warmly everytime he sees us around. This is the best place to be to be recharged. Looking forward to our next stay again.

Absolutely wonderful despite the earthquake,and we felt very safe there on the outskirts of Kathmandu on the edge of a beautiful forrest. Staff went out of their to make our stay very enjoyable, arranging cars etc as we needed. We able to help some local villagers on a personal level through one of the staff, Rajindrah the bar manager. Tashi from reception also very helpful and efficient as we're all the staff but cannot remember any more names.

I stayed in Gokarna Forest Resort right after the Earthquake and felt quite safe there with its wide open spaces, very helpful and friendly staff, spacious, comfortable and clean rooms and good vaiety of food in the restaurant. It is such a secluded heaven from all the chaos of the city, but very closeby in case you'd like to dive into the colourful energy of Kathmandu. I would like to thank all of the reception staff again, especially Tashi, who made me feel home and cared for whenever I requested something.  And a very special thank you to the hotel reservation, knowing that I only would stay there 1 day to bring medical/sanitary supplies for the Earthquake, accepted me to enter my room very early in the morning without any extra fees.

I was at the resort when the earthquake struck Nepal on 4-25-2015. My third visit before and after a trek in the Annapurna region, and a visit to the Bardia National Forest.The hotel is said to withstand M8 (Richter 8) earthquake and did not show have structural damage.The hotel staff was excellent. From the manager and the front desk persons, staff at the restaurant, bar, and housekeeping - they were allefficient, courteous and worked overtime and provided excellent service. I was impressed with Sunitha, Deepika, Lasta and many other staff at the resort.I will definitely revisit Gakarna and recommend the hotel highly.

This resort locates on the hill, above the area near Boudhanath stupa and the airport. If you want a peaceful and relaxing atmosphere away from the congesting and pothole filled roads of Kathmandu, this can't be a wrong choice! Settling within the forest of Gokarna and overlooking the golf course, your room would be as closed to nature as it can. Rooms are pretty big with balcony and plenty of window to give you fresh mountain air. The service is quite good with friendly staffs. However, with a five star standard and high room rate, I had expected free wifi but unfortunately it's not the case. On the other hand, the nearby Hyatt Regency offers free wifi to guest! Breakfast is ok with not many choices for Western or East Asian foods.

Nous étions à l'hôtel le jour de séisme.Un grand bravo à toute l'équipe de l'hôtel de Gokarna pour son professionnalisme et son sens de l'accueil. Notre séjour à l'hôtel de Gokarna mérite tous les compliments possibles.

Visited on a Conference. Stunning location and very pretty views of the mountains, forest and golf course. Hospitality of the Nepalese was first class, charming, helpful, genuine and efficient. Food: maybe ok by Nepalese standards, but not up to western standards, according to my sensitive, delicate, spoiled palate.Impressive hotel at first glance, but needs tidying up. Cracked tiles, poor lighting, tired interior, mesh fences (to keep out the monkeys) needed repairing, chipped drinking glass at breakfast. Little things which lowered the overall impression of the place. Doubt I would go back, but if I don't it's certainly NOT because of the location and the hospitality.

We stayed a couple of nights and had a very relaxing stay in a very spacious bedroom and en-suite bathroom. Food in the restaurants for breakfast and dinner was good although the level of service varied and at times was slow, but as we were not in any rush not a major issue. We also used the Spa service which was part of the swimming pool complex and the ambience not quite as good as I would have expected, but the massage was very good. Pleasant grounds to walk around in and organised walks around the forest can be arranged for a fee. Disappointed I did not bring the golf clubs as International 18 hole golf course attached which looked very good. Overall pleased with the hotel and facilities, the service at times let it down from being 5*.Hope everyone is safe following the recent earthquake.

We have just spent a week at Gorkana Forest Resort through an Interval International getaway. It was our first visit to Nepal. The resort is a real oasis away from the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu and was so nice to come back to at the end of the day. Had three games of golf and loved the golf course. It is very demanding.Can't say enough about the staff. They are the loveliest of people, so friendly and accommodating. Very special thanks to Lasta, Tashi and Abha in reception. Lasta even rang us from her holidays to make sure everything was going well.Really enjoyed the buffet breakfast. Something different every morning, the staff there was also outstanding. The bar staff at Bar 8848 were excellent and helpful. Overall, best and friendliest service have had anywhere.The rooms are very big. The bed may be a bit firm for some. The bathroom was enormous, great  bath/shower.Day trips with a driver organised by the resort may have been a little expensive, but were hassle free and we were well looked after.

From the first minute when we were greeted by Tashi at reception to our departure two days later we were made to feel special by the staff.Big bedroom with tall ceiling and best shower in either India or Nepal.Good buffet breakfast with mixed style of foods.'Enjoyed both the buffet evening meal and the more up market meal in smaller restaurant.Excellent spa with good treatment if a little expensive.Did not have enough time for a round on the golf course which looked stunning.All things considered this was a welcome break from the hectic transport and pollution of the city centre.Highly recommended expect to pay a premium for the high service standards.

Très bel endroit situé dans une zone calme un peu à l'extérieur de Katmandou.La cour intérieure est superbe et le petit-déjeuner y est servi le matin.Les chambres sont grandes et rustiques.Attentions aux singes qui se promènent dans les environs.

We booked this hotel prior to flying out to Nepal as a treat for our return from the Annapurna Circuit. After 3 weeks in tea houses this was pure luxury. Rooms are huge, linen is crisp and clean, the bath is amazing. The staff cannot do enough for you and the food is good. Monkeys and deer roam the forest and the golf course, it really is a great place to relax either in the bar, the gardens or the pool. 1500 rupees into Kathmandu or free in the hotel bus so you can still get to Thamel quickly and only half hour from the airport

Gokarna Forest Resort was an excellent choice for my visit to Kathmandu. The property is absolutely beautiful and peaceful. The staff are all amazing and extremely hospitable!We were three guests staying in one room. Rooms are big and spacious. The only disappointing thing is wifi is only accessible and free in the bar/restaurant downstairs. Quite a few monkeys, but they have security to keep the monkeys away, which is entertaining!  Hotel staff, Lasta, was so helpful and such a joy. She helped us plan our day sightseeing in Kathmandu as well as our trip to Pokhara. We were even lucky enough to catch a wedding being held at our hotel and joined in on the festivities.

Gokarna Forest Resort is a spectacular hotel situated in a secluded forest.  The facility, staff, food and ambience are superb.  The hotel provides a great respite after a day of sightseeing in the dust, noise, and bustle of Kathmandu.  We also enjoyed wonderful spa treatments in the luxurious spa and were generally catered to in every way.  Great hotel.  The special attention from Abha and other staff made our stay particularly memorable.  We had a wonderful time.

The staff are very friendly at this resort and even when there was a bit of a national crisis, they remained calm and approachable. Generally it is a very well maintained and pleasant resort. If I ever return to Nepal, I'd be sure to stay here again.

Wonderful oasis in the midst of this chaotic, busy city.  Rooms were very nice, and the little touches in the lobby and other common areas made it even more attractive.  Kudos to whoever arranges the flowers in the water pots.  We only had breakfast, which was OK, but nothing special.  Wifi only available in the bar or lounge area... it's available in the room at a cost.  We did not have time to use the spa, but others found it very good.

We were scheduled to stay for 4 nights, beginning the  1st of March.  We were having a wonderful time, in spite of the 2 days of rain, seeing the sights of the surrounding area and enjoying the facilities at the resort, then, thanks to the Turkish Airlines Problem, we spent another 2 nights. I am sure the flexibility and resourcefulness of the staff was taxed, but it never showed, when suddenly folks scheduled to leave couldn't, and others, scheduled to arrive couldn't, and other things like weddings and golf tournaments, happened regardless of the rest of us... but it was handled efficiently, both by our tour company ( OAT) and by Gokarna. It was wonderful to see sights that we would otherwise have missed, a walk through the local village on March 4th, the day of the Festival of Colors to observe and participate in local traditions, and a wedding on the Resort, with all the sights and sounds associated with that.   The staff were all accommodating and friendly, especially those in the dining room at breakfast time, Ranita was espcially helpful on several occasions.   Greetings to Abha, Tashi and Ranita, from Karyn from Alaska and special thanks to all for the wonderful time we spent at Gokarna Resort.

I've spent 2 nights in Gokarna Forest Resort. It's placed in the forest Gokarna. its a very nice forest view from the balcony of the resort. The really enjoyable moment was when I played football in a  field which was through into the forest. Staying this resort was a good adventure.

The Gokarna Forest Resort is is a great resort to unwind from the hubbub and hustle of Kathmandu.  When the rigors of traveling by car call for a massage, the spa at the lodge cannot be beat.  The entire staff at the resort are some of the finest and most experienced people we have ever had the pleasure of working with.  The rooms are beyond perfect, as well as the grounds. If there is ever a need to unwind in Nepal, this lodge is a perfect place.We thank all of you at the lodge.

My husband & I stayed before & after our Himalayan trek. It was excellent - Well rested before we started & after our return. The staff were gorgeous & looked after us. We highly reccommend the resort

I only stayed one night , but it was a fantastic experience. All the staff is very friendly and available for every need. I had a wonderful dinner at the Club House restaurant, and excellent lunch at the bar. For breakfast there is very wide choice of various dishes, all of excellent quality. Really worth it to spend some days here and, for fans of golf, play in the par 72 course, supported by excellent caddie , immersed in a beautiful landscape with monkeys , birds and animals of various kinds.I'll be back for sure!!!!

The resort is absolutely amazing and is located in a  serene area, away from crowd, noise and pollution. I am in love with the hotel. We booked a Rana lounge and it was just out of the world experience. The spa was equally good.5 star for the location, architect and the service. However, I see their food needs improvement. Breakfast and Chinese dinner was OK, I would rate the food 3.

My husband and our 7 month old son just returned from a very enjoyable weekend at Gokarna Forest Resort.  A lovely place, fresh air, great spa and so close to the city.  we found the staff friendly and customer oriented.  We look forward to going back there when our family visit us in Nepal next month!

EXCELLENT PLACE TO BE IN TO SPEND A QUITE TIME INSIDE THE VALLEY. we went for our honeymoon n were greeted with a cake upon our arrival. the service level from all the staffs was very friendly it felt like being at home. good selection of foods from the restaurant.we were particularly impressed by the breakfast they provided do not miss it :). Special thanks to Tashi Dolma and Norby for making sure we had a pleasant time during our stay

I would like to thank whole staff of the Gokarna Forest Resort for their amazing service and response. On entering the resort we were welcomed by Ms. Tashi Dolma and other lady with sparking smile on their face. Ms. Tashi Dolma guided us to our room with wonderful view from window. She briefed us about the resort, its facilities and activities.
