My recent stay in Waterfront and Fulbhari in Pokhara and Maruni Sanctuary in Chitwan was great but our one night stay at Gokarna Forest Resort was so amazing and wonderful and one of reason is because of Ms. Tashi Dolma, whose warm welcome and response made it different. In morning from our room we saw deers in greenery curtyard just below our room. Food, Spa, Sauna, staff and verything is perfect. Resort's environment is so nice that one can feel the nature by  breathing fresh air, hearing the sound of different birds, walking on the green park,  overlooking thick Gokarna Forest and so on.The rooms and toilets are spacious, beautifully done up and totally immaculate. Setting up of flowers petals in pot filled with water in reception, loby and room is something which one can understand how the entire setup and management of resort is done perfectly. Thank you,Sange Lama

A good resort in Nepal to choose, if going for holidays. You can meditate, play gulf or do morning walking. It is the best in Kathmandu. Distance is an issue but it is worthwhile, keeps you away from the filthy downtown.

Weil der Flughafen von Kathmandu vier Tage lang gesperrt war, sind ein paar Reisende von der Airline in diesem piekfeinen und sehr teuren Hotel untergebracht worden. Natürlich eine feine Adresse, für einen "normalen" Rucksacktouristen aber unbezahlbar. Die Zimmer sind groß und sauber, das Büffet im Restaurant ausgezeichnet. Auch das Personal ist sehr hilfsbereit und freundlich. Inklusive Security.

To my mind the best place to stay in Katmandu. It is so peaceful the deer just relax with the staff and guests. peaceful. The  staff is wonderful. The Spa does a good job at basic massages. The golf course is fun. And the entire hotel team is so professional and thoughtful you will feel pampered. The food is also good. The front desk staff includes a great team including in room registration by a very helpful and royal Tashi Dolma. The young man who runs the pro shop is super too.Because of the pollution in Katmandu this place is a little away from it all but still only 30 min from the airport.You will be well taken care of here and not regret the stay.

Nepal is amazing, many things to see and Gokarna Forest Resort is very peacefull resort, you can enjoy leisure and use all facility. The food is good, all hotel staff very nice, take care me like i stay at home. All is perfect, i really enhoy my time at this hotel and want to be back again if i have any chance.Thank you Lasta and all staff.Best regards,Yam

We spent a pampered week at the resort by the staff. They were warm, attentive and always helpful. Lasta, Tashi and Dolma at the reception counter were excellent in welcoming us and making us as comfortable as possible. All 3 restaurants had excellent food. The chefs were very accommodating to my husband's gluten free diet. Thanks to Chef Jibesh and F&B director Raju. We each had 3 massages during the week and it was simply divine. We went on a trail walk in the forest and saw many monkeys and deer. Kudos to all of you for making our stay so wonderful after 10 day of Vipassana. We definitely will be back with our kids to enjoy this great property. Thank you.

Simply awesome time. Hotel people are so humble and sweet. We had a great time staying there. And looking forward to stay with u guys. Soon as we back in Nepal.   chitwan is must visit place, and those special momo. Regards ASH

I was most deeply enchanted with the ambience , peace and tranquility of the Gokran Forest Resort.Unlike the other Five star hotels in Kathmandu- which are slap in the middle of the Crowded city- Gokran is located in such an eco- niche - a peaceful paradise in serenity and silence that I found so conducive to meditation.The forest around exudes peace  and happiness.I found the staff most helpful, friendly and always smiling.Frankly, I wanted to stay on but had a plane to catch. In fact I would love to return with my family and savour the peace and quiet and take strolls in the forest. I found the Momos very good and the flower pots at the entrance truly enchanting. The peace of the forest and the tranquility of the dense growth of trees around has a deep impact on ones spirit. Frankly i would like to come back for annual retreats with my family to get away from it all-Need less to say that one employee who made a very good impression on me was the young and very charming Tashi Dolma- the guest relations manager- who was so very helpful in organising my shopping trip to the town by taking deep personal interest and overseeing the arrangements herself. My compliments to the whole team at the Gokran resorts. keep up the good work. You guys have just pushed the friendship between our two nations many notches higher!

Landing at Khatmandu brings disappointment when you travel through its road and then u think... was that a beautiful mirage that u saw while planning a holiday in Nepal ?? Thanks to Gokarna who kept my wish come true.....Thoroughly enjoyed the stay...Excellent food, a perfectly located property, indoor temperature maintained swimming pool, a golf course with trainers, spa and to top it all... ever helping staffs !! tashi dolma has never let me felt out of my office as she took care of communication and needs of my official work too while i stayed there !! Nice to discover that place. Recommended. Will visit again .

Very friendly staff! Welcome by 'namaste' (= greeting from Soul to Soul) is the brand of this resort. I was impressed by the many choices of excellent vegetarian dishes served at all times. Truly healthy. Also great to see the resort paying attention to energy-saving and promoting low water footprint life-styles, while ensuring their guest is indulged in a heavenly environment of architectural beauty and friendly humans! I wish my family could be with me to enjoy the deers and the monkeys spontaneously coming to greet the guests.Great sport for retreats, golf, hiking, biking. For business and family stay. The Spa facilities are good and the facial treatment is certainly recommended.

Gokarna Forest Reserve is an elegant resort well separated from the noise, traffic, pollution and general pandemonium of Kathmandu.  We found it to be a delightful place to stay during a 3-day visit to Kathmandu.  The guest rooms are well appointed, the dining rooms offer outstanding meals, walking trails offer the opportunity to see many birds and other animals and the staff members are exceptionally friendly, helpful and well informed.  We were especially impressed by Communication and Hospitality Executive,  Abha Upadhayaya.  She was especially knowledgeable about the Resort and the region in general and eagerly shared this knowledge with us in excellent English!  A highlight of our stay was the hosting by the Resort of an Indian wedding which included incredibility elaborate decorations throughout the Resort.

I really liked this place....it was quiet and peaceful....away from the hubbub of downtown Kathmandu.  But that is also a double edged sword, because if you want to do something downtown (and there is a LOT to see!), you are far away.  Our room was comfortable, but there is no A/C during the winter - when you select the A/C, the heat comes on.  We opened our window, but kept the screen on to keep the monkeys out, and had a comfortable evening.   The large showers were great, and there was plenty of hot water.  There are two separate restaurants and we enjoyed a wide selection of food choices.  The breakfast buffet is excellent.   You have to pay for wifi in your room, but there is free wifi near, on in, the bar.  The wifi is, as in most places here, very slow.  I would stay here again.  The golf course is beautiful, and there is a jungle available for hikes, but you  have to pay for a guide.

The atmosphere, room everything was excellent! Not to mention friendly staffs specially Tashi dolma! I am looking forward to come back soon!! Just have a small suggestion to the hotel since everything is so perfect they should upgrade a bigger reception desk since reception desk are like the face of the hotel

The hotel looked really old and crumbling. The rooms and towels were showing their state of disrepair.The food was average, the bar decent.It's a shame that a hotel is such a beautiful location is not maintained better.

ホテルからちょっと下っていけばすぐにゴルフコースが広がっています。ゆったり広々とした敷地の中（周辺？）には3つのレストラン。２か所（インド料理とタイ料理）で食事をしましたがどちらもとても美味しかった！温水プールを目当てに泊まりに来ましたが、家族でゆったりと泳ぐ事ができて楽しめました。プールの外では泳ぐ私達を猿たちが木からのぞいていました。（子供はジャグジーがあるスペースは使用できません）鳥の声を聞きに早朝ウォーキングをしたり、夜も散歩をしているだけで楽しめました。温かい対応をしてくれるスタッフもいて、また泊まりに行きたいと思います。

I think that the Hotel is excellent in Kathmandu. The environment is very good. I like the forest.The staff members are kindly, friendly. They always smiling. Tashi is our trip adviser. She gave us a very good schedule. Thanks for her!The breakfast is good. The room is good to.My friend and I have a nice stay!XIn Lin

No es fácil encontrar un hotel situado en medio de un bosque primario, con instalaciones y servicio cinco estrellas y todo ello a tiro de piedra de Katmandú y sobre todo de Boudhanath, mi lugar preferido en la capital nepalí.He estado en 2010, 2011 y 2014 y cada vez mejor.Para los aficionados al Golf, no es mi caso, uno de los mejores campos de Asia, con vistas a los picos nevados del Himalaya.Monos, ciervos y ... Yo creí ver un par de pandas nepalíes aunque nadie me creyó, ni siquiera  los responsables del hotel, te rodean.Muy recomendable

We just returned from 5 nights at this hotel in fascinating Kathmandu. I would stay here again for usre If I wanted to feel safe and distant from the teeming city.  I would not stay here if I wanted to pop out of the hotel to do a little sight seeing or shop on my own.  Armed guards patrolled the place, I was told to portect us from many monkeys, though those we saw seemed docile. the hotel is low slung (2 stories) on sprawling grounds, connected by pleasnat well maintained paths.  Front desk is VERY helpful, bar with free internet warm and wlecoming with full food options, the usual big spread for breakfast. Beds were excellent, laundry service cheap and dependable.

This is a nice hotel in a park above Kathmandu.  The advantage is it is much more peaceful than being in the city, although if you want to tour the city or walk around it's not a great option (they do have nature walks though.)  The food was ok the service was excellent.  The rooms were basic but well maintained.  There is free wifi in the bar and paid wifi in the room, overall a nice experience if you're looking for a quiet place to stay in a very chaotic city.

Green forested well-kept grounds are quite a pleasant contrast to the rest of the Kathmandu area.  Hotel services were outstanding.   Breakfasts offered great variety.  Amenities abounded; pool, golf, yoga, spa services were among them.  The only drawback was that WiFi was only available in the bar/lobby area.  We stayed three nights and were quite pleased.

It was beautiful to visit during winter and the hotel is very nice and the hotel staffs are very friendly. Tashi Dolma was very helpful and kind to take care of us during the stay. The place was nicely maintained.  Food was nice.

After a cultural journey from Pokhara to Kathmandu, experiencing the essence of Nepal, Gokarna Forest Resort  was a perfect end to our adventure! Set in beautiful grounds with 5* facilities, this place is a must! We were welcomed by friendly, helpful staff (especially Tashi)who went out of their way to make the stay one to remember! Will be recommending this hotel to friends and family!

overall experience was very good, nice service, lots of thing to be done inside the hotels only, enjoyed a lot, but one negative thing is that being a five star hotel they are not providing the free WiFi services inside the room other than that it was an awesome stay.

The hotels is one of the best in terms of location and facilities if one is looking for a nice escape from the the city. We had two great days and invited our Kathmandu friends to come and share a day of indulgence in the gardens. Tried the spa and the massage was very good too. Well trained staff, breakfas varied and abundant. Reccomend

Had a good time staying at this resort... peaceful and complete retreat. They have a very good spa with professional masseur. Friendly and helpful staff. Rooms are clean and spacious with nice deco. The building is antique and nice deco. Can see some wild animals during day and night like rain deer, monkeys and raptors. Worth visit this resorts again.

We stayed at Gokarna Forest Resort at both ends of a trip to Nepal. The rooms were large and comfortable. It is relatively close to the chaotic center of Kathmandu but is protected by a surrounding forest and golf course. We don't play golf but the green space was very welcome, especially at the end of our month long trip. We saw several species of deer and raptors while strolling around the grounds. Monkeys were also present. The rooms were lovely with lemongrass soap and small flower petal arrangements in bowls around the hotel. The food was very good but the breakfast buffet was exceptionally good with many hot and cold food choices. One of the executives was particularly helpful to me. Abha H. helped me when I lost something in addition to the usual helpful answering of questions and giving suggestions and directions. She arranged for a nature walk for us and even helped me adjust my sari for a formal dinner. Her English skills were impeccable and her love for Nepal was clearly evident.

tidy, clean place. housekeeping/ room was picture-perfect. beautiful flower leafs swimming in water bowls. staff always friendly, smiling and helpful. continental-restaurant staff sometimes not optimally organized but always friendly. only thing to improve from my point of view is the buffet section of the continental. some flowers and white covers for the buffet table would provide an important virtual upgrade.thanks to all the staff for their great job!

I had a very good time staying at this resort.. very peaceful and loved the old fashion style of building .. Amazing.... the staffs were very nice, very welcoming (Tashi Dolma). kick back and just relax.... see you guys again!!!! Thank you.

One night at this hotel is too short a stay to soak in the warmth and surroundings. To start with, the hotel access is by a winding road and then the hotel looms large in its full glory. Lobby done up with local artifacts tell you that you are in the lap of luxury. The rooms are large and use of lights in the room highlights the idols placed as decorative items. The Bathroom is large and spacious and the amenities are amazing. The hotel had arranged for a bonfire for us and the food mainly consisted of Local cuisine that was wonderfully done. Not to forget the warmth of the service staff. Breakfast was basic but nice. The hotel has a golf course attached and I did take some time out to swing. The club house is the place where I hung out the rest of the day with some great food and drink. If you are a nature lover you should make it here.

Resort is located away from town, so you get the break from city life and can relax with business talk fully. the resort provided free spa and yoga lessons which was a boon and much need break from hustling and bustling life of Delhi. would definitely visit again.

After 2 weeks trekking in Annapurna region, down to Chitwan for a few days and back to Kathmandu this was a lovely finish to our trip to Nepal. Having stayed in very basic accommodation and mid range hotels it was nice to treat ourselves to a bit of luxury. Rooms were lovely, furnished to a good standard with a nice attention to detail. Hot water at any time of day, that was a first! The forest keeps the noise and dust of Kathmandu at bay even though it's sprawl is nor far away. Staff all very friendly and could not have been more welcoming. Good food, enjoyed the bar area at night and a tasty lunch outside in the sunshine down at the clubhouse.Used the resort's mountain bikes to get up to Nagarkot in a couple of hours on old Tibetian road from Sankhu. Stunning to be back amongst the peaceful terraces overlooking the mountains. Well worth the effort.Short transfer to airport to finish a bonus.Thank you to all concernedAlan & Sonya

our stay at Gokarna was the perfect way to gradually introduce us to Kathmandu.Coming back at the end of a busy day in Kathmandu to friendly staff, heated swimming pool, drinks at the club house and a comfortable room.All in all we enjoyed our stay for 7 days at Gorkarna very much.

Very good hotel, Nice restaurants and testy food, Beautiful people and good staff. I would like to appreciate the guest relation staff them good and nice work with hotel guests, and my big thanks to Mrs. Tashi Dolma for here hard work and nice relation to make our stay in hotel comfortable and beautiful. We will come again.   THANKS A LOT....

From entering and enjoying in hotel is fantastic with nice help and support from staff. I am stalk due to strike in Nepal. I could not check out in time (we planned to leave room at 9 pm on that day). I am with my wife and 11 month children. The staff repetedly inform me about the check out time instead she knows the strike and its violence and I am with my child. Even she said she needs that room besides they have plenty of room.Beside this I enjoy the trip.

This was our first visit to Kathmandu and Nepal and I didnt know what to expect. It turned out that Gokarna was a Jackpot. The hotel is very clean and neat. It has beutiful surroundings. After a day in the crazy city of Kathmandu it felt great to come back to the Hotel. My girlfriend used a lot of the SPA facilities and she was very happy with it. The staff is amazing, very friendly, helpful. Nothing is a problem. We became friends with Abha and she is excellent in how to treat customers. I must stay, its unusual to experience this level of hospitality in european hotels.We were there in end of December. The common areas are not heated, except the restaurant and the bar, so bring warm sweaters. The rooms are ofcourse heated. I missed Gokarna when I left, we met such nice people. The only thing I have to say is that Wifi should be free of charge. Those days were you had to get codes and pay for Wifi is long time gone.

I just recently returned from my second stay at this resort and I cannot say how great it is. All the staff are extremely friendly and always ready and waiting to help. The place has many great activities, great food, clean rooms and general cleanliness all around. There are beautiful sights all around and a great spa with something for everyone. Every detail of this place has been thought out and perfected. If you are going to be in Kathmandu this is the place to be.

We stayed in this beautiful resort for one week. It is a quiet and comfortable place only half an hour away from the center of Kathmandu. Indoor swimming-pool, steam-sauna and Finnish-sauna helped us to recover from our dusty day trips. Excellent restaurants, particularly the "Club House Restaurant" with authentic Thai cuisine supplied us with best foods. Special thanks to Mrs. Tashi Dolma and all members of the friendly and helpful staff. The rooms are big and the bath is equipped with wide bathtubs. Thanks also to the housekeeping. WiFi is available without charge only near the bar, but requires a fee for use in the rooms. :(

We stayed at the hotel on three short occasions during a 16 day holiday in Nepal.  It is peaceful and removed from the chaos of Kathmandu.  A little out of the centre of town, so if you want to use it as a base for short trips around the different sights of KTM then that might be a challenge.  Rooms are spacious and furnishings are relatively new, but the rooms can be a little dark depending on aspect; note there are no elevators but the hotel only has a few floors.  The spa is great with reasonable prices for massages etc.  Food was ok... breakfast buffet is average and the overall range of menu choices was comparatively limited given the status of the hotel.  Staff were friendly and helpful.  The resort grounds themselves are stunning

On our last leg of a Nepal trip, we stayed at Gokarna for a night. In the early part we had stayed at Hyatt Kathmandu so there was a reference point (though very different type of properties)What's good:1. Away from the Cramped City - Gokarna does score (if this works for you) on the location and its a serene, quiet, log-cabin type of place away from key locations(at least 20-30 mts from Airport and even further from city center)2. Well done rooms - Rooms are very well done (at least the new Qtrs where we stayed in the main block - there are rooms which are further away (Hunters Lodge) which can be a walk on a cold night)3. Spa, Pool & Sauna - Really good heated pool, Jacuzzi and Sauna facility (all complementary)4. Polite Staff - Lovely people, friendly.5. Sai Temple in the facility - for the Sai Baba devotees, a great to have.What's Not-so-Great:1. Wifi - Such a dampner. Chargeable in rooms and not cheap (besides being only for one device). Its free in the Bar and lounge area but they are not in close proximity to all rooms. Quality of wifi too is average. Very disappointed.2. Food was average - we ate at the Chinese/Thai restaurant which was at best 2/5. The Breakfast was also average - 3/5.3. Travel from the Airport - The road is terrible. Dont take a local cab from the Airport, better to get the Hotel Car (which is twice as costly but a better vehicle)4. Rates not published - Gokarna does not publish on its website rates of Green Fees, Service Fee for facilities (for example bike rentals etc). We felt these rates were very high and they should publish them for a someone to take an informed decision before booking. So we did not use the Golf facility there and hence cannot comment on the course. (the driving range looked quite good though)Overall, goto Gokarna is you want to stay for 2-3 days and largely want use in-house facilities (Golf, biking, spa, bird watching etc - some at a steep price though). Not Recommended if you are a touristy traveller to Kathmandu (or passing through) and want to be in proximity of main city locations/Airport. Also for kids, it may be a boring place.

Gokarna Forest Resort is a very nice quiet place to stay away from the noise of Kathmandu.  Rooms are large, the staff is friendly and helpful, and the breakfast buffet is extensive.  We were warned to keep windows locked because of the possibility of monkeys entering.  The free wi-fi was only available in the area around the bar.

Had a fantastic 2 day stay at the Gokarna Forest resort . The ambience of the resort is a stark contrast to the chaos of Kathmandu and is really beautiful and well maintained. Also very well located, considering you feel like you're far away from civilization and yet  are only  about 20 mins away from the airport and about  9-10kms from the heart of the city. The Hotel has a restaurant serving a traditional Nepali meal but that is avlbl only for dinner . Overall great place for nature lovers and golf enthusiasts .Also would like to make a mention of the Hotel employee - Ms Abha Upadhayaya who was extremely helpful and efficient and made the additional effort to make sure all of us had a comfortable stay.

Nous sommes restés 9 nuits dans cet hôtel pour visiter Katmandou et les environs. Magnifique séjour : proche de la forêt avec singes et daims, personnel attentif et compétent, buffet de petit déjeuner grandiose et délicieux ! voiture gratuite de l'hôtel pour Katmandou, piscine, spa, hammam à volonté et gratuit, beau choix de massages, 3 restaurants au choix et très bons.  Sans oublier une belle et grande chambre, en angle, service parfait, salle de bains. Séjour très apprécié après deux semaines de trek dans les Annapurnas !!

Man kände sig strax välkommen här. Mycket vänlig och hjälpsam personal. Vi åt bara frukost i restaurangen. En riktig utmärkt sådan. Vi lunchade i "Club House" restaurangen vid golfbanan efter några bollar på driving rangen. Nästa gång tar vi med klubborna och går några varv runt banan som ligger vackert, omgiven av djungel. Väktare skrämmer bort aporna "Gibbons " så dom håller sig i skogen och inte hoppar runt på banan. Man blir avrådd från att mata dom, så det är mera ett roligt skådespel att se dom svänga sig i träden. I baren ( gratis WI FI)  fick man också beställa mat. mycket smaklig sådan. Rummet var stort och bekvämt, fast kanske inte hemtrevligt som sådan. Och här kommer jag till minuspoängen : Ingen arbetsplats med tillräckligt ljus, i det hela taget var ljussättningen i rummet inte i toppklass. Svårinställd värme på AC , samt hög ljud. Samt NU är det på tiden att hotell i toppklass bjuder på gratis WI FI ! För oss som åker som privatpersoner blir det en onödig utgift och just nu åker jag på en rundresa i Indien och vi får se vad dom har att bjuda på. Gokarna Forest Resort : Nästan toppklass i allt. Ett tips: vi fick en guide vid namn Pranoy Rai genom ett resebyrå som pratade utmärkt engelska och visade oss Kathmandu ( en av dom mest stökiga städer jag har varit med om, iövrigt)  på ett utmärkt vis.

We stayed at the Gokarna a couple times during our stay in Kathmandu, and it was a wonderful experience!  The staff is wonderful, and the grounds are top-notch.  The dining facilities are all great, and we enjoyed an evening of massages at the spa on the grounds. You cannot go wrong staying here!

Stayed at the resort with few colleagues for a training. a lovely property, staff members are friendly, polite and very helpful. we ordered in room dining, because this place is in the middle of no where, food is great. if you fancy walking and hiking, you can do it with in the property. there is a tiny temple as well. not to forget the hundreds of monkeys you will meet where ever you go. we had a great time, some say this is the hunting lodge of the king. there is a lovely visitor you will meet if your room is in the ground level, a super friendly deer. I would love to go back for a proper holiday to enjoy the forest resort.

Came in from India and was delighted to find this retreat.  The room is huge and clean, the bathroom has a custom tiled tub/shower combination that is very inviting and the room's wooden floor seems so much cleaner than carpet.  My bed is two doubles put together and made up as one - heaven!   It is a bit out of town but not exactly a place you want to walk around looking for dinner.Wifi in a lounge for free or subscribe/pay for access in your room and anywhere on the property.  Laundry is same day and reasonable;  reserve time at the spa since they know what they are doing and at a great price;  breakfast buffet in the coffee shop is their best meal; few shops have quality goods but cannot be charged to your room.Clean and courteous - you will probably be happy here.

Bel hôtel aux prestations soignées à quelques minutes des sites touristiques de Kathmandou !SPA et Golf sur place, entourés d'une forêt et de singes !Personnel de qualité avec mention spéciale à Me Dolma Tashi pour sa disponibilité, son efficacité et sa gentillesse !

Very nice location.  The suites on the top floor (at the end of a spiral walk-up) are definitely recommended. Much much nicer than the standard rooms, in case you are deciding between the two.  Spacious, beautiful views, Floor to ceiling windows on both sides.

We stayed in Gokarna with our daughters for a week.  Nice resort furnished with good taste, pleasant atmosphere in a gorgeous environment. No smog, no noise. Staff is fabulous, very helpful and nice. Our kids loved the forest, the monkeys and deers. It was great experience.

Wonderful hillside location, utterly peaceful. Customer service fabulous, dealt very well with my complaint about the first bedroom allocated and moved to a much nicer one. Let down by scruffy spa facilities and very, very slooooooowwwwwww service at the bar, which is the only place you can get internet, so you spend a lot of time there! Nevertheless an oasis in the middle of hectic Kathmandu, fab to see the monkeys and deer and the staff were unfailingly polite and friendly.

I stayed here just for a day but couldn't have asked for more. The rooms (I stayed in a standard room) are great, breakfast buffet had a lot of healthy options, and the morning (free) yoga class was a good start to the day. There are plenty of other things to do as well, and the reception staff were very helpful. Will definitely go back for a longer stay soon.

We stayed at this lovely forest resort in May, entire stay was very good from being received with a smile, Garland and a tilak. The rooms are spacious and were in prestine clean condition. The food was amazing. Highly recommend it.

I spent 6 wonderful nights at Gokarna Forest Resort where the outstanding staff (Lasta and Tashi/guest services) provided outstanding service and really made me feel comfortable.   The atmosphere at this resort is relaxing, the grounds are beautifully maintained and the golf course is breathtaking!  Mornings started with a Yoga class to ground the day or a refreshing dip in the indoor pool,  followed by a forest walk through lush jungles where the wildlife and forest come alive and  you can get plenty of fresh air.  Along the way, big horn deers and monkeys can be seen huddling,  After a relaxing lunch at the outdoor restaurant and an afternoon nap, I was energized to play the championship golf course. The pro and novice can enjoy the reasonably priced challenging par 5 course with opportunity to view deer and wild birds.  Although a fantastic shop with quality merchandise is available on-site, a shopping trip to Kathmandu-Thamel Square cost less than 10 dollars via taxi and can be a nice diversion.  The staff was kind enough to provide hot-water bottle for my achy back  and delicious breakfast with variety of Nepalese and American selections.   WOW!  how miss it...... must go back next year!

We enjoyed Gokarna twice in a 3 week period and each time was excellent. Rooms, public spaces, food and service were all better than most other 3 and 4 star properties in Nepal. We appreciated that it was out of the center of twon and therefore quiet and peaceful. There is lots to do in Kathmandu and this is a very good headquarters.

The infrastructure around the property is excellent and the staff, especially at the reception is responsive and friendly. The green cover is impressive with some very old trees, which provides a perspective on how the Kathmandu valley would have looked before urbanization.Dining: The breakfast spread is good. The range of offerings for lunch/ dinner is limited and the quality is not really of an expected standard. I tried Indian and western food but was not impressed with the quality of the meat or the cooking technique.  Activities: There are several activities possible, and kids can be kept well occupied. A prospective traveler should check the cost of these activities. For example, a forest walk is USD 10/hour per person. Location: The resort is slightly away from the city so connectivity needs to be factored in. The resort provides a complementary shuttle once a day to the city centre. Otherwise, taxi expenses can be ~USD 50/day for outside taxi, which you need to arrange yourself and USD 150/day for hotel taxi.Overall, a nice place with very good clean rooms and worth visiting especially if you play golf or prefer quiet and natural surroundings.

This was our second visit everything was great.i like to be in gokarna because it is very peaceful and greenary everywhere and one of the best affordable hotels in kathmandu.food was great most important i saw staffs were very helpful and attentive whole time.

during our 2 week trip to Nepal, we stayed at 3 different 4 star hotels in kathmandu and we liked all of them.  This is a great property.  Great breakfast, nice staff.  No complaints at all.  The downside is that it is a little bit far from the city. The upside is that it is quiet and peaceful respite from the bustle of the city.

Great place to spend some time in Kathmandu.  The staff was very helpful, the room was really nice.  It felt safe and loved the wildlife, monkeys and deer.  On the negative side, some of the charges were excessive.  We wanted to do laundry, but figured it would cost almost as much as the room.  Also hotel transportation was more pricey than taxis.  Overall however, It was great.

The location and buildings are beautiful, service is impeccable. This is a great location for a weekend away from the city or recovering from trekking and travelling. A few points to improve: at this kind of hotel wi fi should be included in the rooms. They have a beautiful land but walks in the forest are not very accessible - you can only go with their guide, and with charges per person, which makes no sense. Overall unless you golf you can't really enjoy the land and location.

Not user friendly Wi Fi.  Wi Fi is very costly. Foods are outstanding. Staff are very cooperative. Rooms and Bathroom are very wel decorated. AIR CONDITIONED machine is not working properly. Need to be more good as per international standard. My suitcase is wet due to leakage in Ac machine. We choose those five star are approved by TripAdvisor.

I stayed here with my husband and 2 young children (8 & 5) for 6 nights over September / October. The resort was wonderful for a family who wanted to have a comfortable base to travel to and from. We had a wedding to attend at the resort and so it was very convenient for us with the kids to be there. Food was lovely, staff were wonderful and the service was excellent.

A truly lovely retreat above Kathmandu.  Bar and restaurant staff however have far more hospitality training than the front of house/reception people.  Overall, a delightful place to stay but too many smiles and too little help at reception.

We didn't stay here as we had to go to work the next day, I went with my family just to see how this place was for our next family gathering. It was amazing and I am looking forward to stay here. They have golf, pool, sauna.. it is a very relaxing place away from all the tension.. the food we ate was nice and the staffs we talked to were very helpful and friendly.

I have switched to Gokarna Forest Resort from another hotel (after one night). Actually I have found here everything I have missed in previous one: calm place, helpful staff (always smiling), amenities you need (good internet, golf, pool, sauna, 2-3 options for dinner). It was like my secret place after hard working day without a necessity to go somewhere outside. The road to reach resort was damage due to rain, so it is recommended to take better car than poor taxi if you do not want to feel yourself like tennis ball while riding. I will definitely come back next time here. Btw, they have funny but smart monkeys all around - nice to look after them (but do not leave your room open).

Stayed at Gokarna Forest Resort as a 3 day recuperation from trekking to EBC.And what a treat it was after the chaos that is Kathmandu city. Set in a tranquil forest just 10km out of the city the resort offers everything you need to chill out and relax. The rooms are enormous and well appointed. The facilities including top class golf course and spa are second to none and the service is impeccable. The staff are absolutely the most genuine friendly and attentive I have come across in 40 years of travelling. The food was of a high quality with a diverse range of cuisine. I was mightily impressed on my first night with a delicious Rainbow Trout!! The local Nepalese and Asian dishes were also great. The buffet breakfast with eggs as you like them made to order and wide selection of western and asian dishes was a great way to start the day.Special mention to Lasta and Nirmaya at the front desk for never failing to provide a smile and helpful information but all staff from bar, restaurants, spa and golf shop deserve special praise.

I booked this hotel for my wife and I to celebrate our 1st anniversary, and from the moment we arrived to the moment we left we were treated like royalty and were greeted and wished a happy anniversary from ALL staff that we encountered, from the manager, the check in desk, room service and in the restaurant. The food is very good to a western standard. There is also a golf course at the back of the resort, and a very good indoor swimming pool.We highly recommend anyone wishing to stay in luxury at an affordable price to consider this hotel.

We stayed a week in this wonderful resort from 30/8 till 5/9/2014, the room was old but well maintained , the view to the garden is wonderful especially on Saturday where BBQ lunch was held. Big trees surrounding and golf course's greenery  make the property ideal for honeymoon vocation or relaxation. The services and hospitality are absolutely wonderful special thanks to Miss Tashi at the counter that help to planed our sight-seeing trip which my wife and I considered it perfection! Her kindness to recommending and patiently explained every detail of the sites is an extra ordinary service that make our stay in Kathmando unforgettable .... Also thank you to MR. Raju and Krisnan for their kind hospitality and we would come back to this Hotel again if we ever revisit Kathmando.

Serene and quiet - a perfect place to relax. What took me by surprise was the room. It was really very nice and comfortable. The large spacious room was simply in tune with the serene relaxing atmosphere. Absolute thumbs up to the management and the team where I could not find anything lacking in the rooms and the "eco" touch was much appreciated. The toilet was perfect. Correct water pressure, large and spacious and nice amenities.The spa too is worth writing about. The courteous team at the spa was just the perfect touch. We are definitely going back for a longer stay.

Not a 4 star hotel, but a very good 3 star hotel+Big standard rooms and a very big bathroomBeautiful settings (near the forest, away from the noise of Kathmandu)Luxury golf Swimming pool (inside)-Breakfast, not very hygienic (cold things are standing in the sun)Room is not always very cleanNot possible with 2 persons in the same room on wifi (but I think in this beautiful nature of Nepal it's not a big issue)Conclusion: if you see how poor Nepal is, than I really admire the people of the hotel, they do everything to make you feel good at the hotel eventhough I think it is very difficult for them because of the limited possiblities they have because of the poverty of their country.

This property has good facility for conference & workshops. Staff are very hospitable and co-operative. Large golf ground is attached which is much more exciting. Bar and restaurant looks good. If you are staying for more than 3 days then try food at different locations in Nepal as the food part sometimes looks more repetitive, except for lovely and yummy deserts which is very tasty. Chinese food is good too.Water what they serve is clean and no need for bottled water. A/c worked fine.This hotel gives a good organic feel all around.

This is a very relaxing place to unwind from the manic streets of Kathmandu.The staff are very good and attentive and the rooms are kept clean and are spacious.The main part of the hotel has a good size bar which has discreet, Nepali music several times a week, which adds to the general atmosphere. The main restaurant serves breakfast, which is both Asian and Western, with a chef cooking a range of eggs etc.. In the evening it serves a wide selection of main meals and the occasional buffet evening. I feel there could be a bigger selection of Nepali/Indian dishes, but what they do offer is very good.The hotel advertises a golf course and trekking around the extensive grounds which I think would be good, but my schedule did not permit me to try them out.The situation is approx 10-15mins from the city centre, which gives it the tranquillity, but there are very few local bars etc nearby so a drive into the city is a must for sightseeing or change of dining facilities.9/10 for this hotel and its well worth the stay

We booked online and reached Gokarna Forest Resort for some time away from daily hustle. Most importantly it was the wife's birthday which needed to be a memorable experience. It was everything we expected including great services and hospitality by Ms Nirmaya and hotel VP Mr Sherpa. We had lovely meals and comfort at the Mt 8848 bar served by Mr Deepak. Great golf course and decent Spa with jacuzzi added to the leisure. While I am no pro but the driving range was great. And the jacuzzi was heavenly. With lush green forests and walking trails this makes my favourite nature resort thus far. I will recommend it to all.And just to add using international credit cards at the hotel is absolutely safe.

It is spread out and includes a full 18 hole scenic golf course extending through the gokarna forest. There are 3 restaurants to choose from and provides reasonable variety. The rooms are clean and the back up power is effective. They also have a functional temperature controlled indoor pool. The spa is slightly on the expensive side. The staff are welcoming and generally provide good info. The forest walk can be avoided in monsoon as there are leaches in the forest. I would have loved to have free WiFi across the property. ( they have it as paid into your rooms). There is only one shuttle in the day to thamel and its offered free. A hotel taxi to thamel will put you back by 15 dollars one way. So frequent shuttles could be good idea. And finally, there are some loud parties / conferences in the courtyard making it inconvenient for courtyard facing guests. This can be party avoided by taking forest facing rooms. But, definitely i would love to return to stay here.

The location of this hotel was a nice break from the Kathmandu chaos.  My room was a bit dark and just standard.  Housekeeping did a great job cleaning my room every day.  I'll have to say that the best quality of this hotel was the customer service.   Every employee was extremely helpful and very courteous.  I wish I could remember the names of the young ladies at the front desk that went above and beyond in helping me sort out a couple of things I needed help with.  Overall was a pleasant experience.

Excellent service and large space at this hotel resort, pegged to a forest with deers and funny monkeys. Very large rooms, reasonnable rates, plus a golf for those who like that. Only thing preventing a 5 note is the food. Breakfast buffet is nice but lunch and dinner options lacked variety and subtlety to get a 5.

Magnifique hôtel situé dans un immense parc avec golf 18 trous. Service top à la népalaise et bar très sympa. Grandes chambres très spacieuses et confortables.Dommage que le wifi soit payant dans les chambres. Attention aux singes qui, si vous quittez votre chambre fenêtre ouverte, vont faire le ménage dans vos affaires !!!

My wife and I enjoyed our holiday at GoKarna.  The staff was one of the best I have ever encountered making everyday a wonderful experience.  The rooms were well appointed and comfortable. The grounds lovely.  Our only disappointment was the restaurants were not the same standard. The Indian and Nepali food was quite good the European selection and preparation not so good. The breakfast needed help esp on the pastries although the breads were very nice. The health club needed alot of work on the equipment. The whirlpool did not work The pool was quite nice. Being this is the off season I suspect things will be improved before the season begins.

We visited the Gokarna forest resort as part of a golf tour taking in Nepal, India and Sri Lanka and it was probably my favourite golf course to play on.  So, golf course first, it's a very good test of golf.  The caddies were generally very good.  There's  a nice little spike bar at the golf course which doubles up as a restaurant in the evening.  We had good service and good food served here for both a lunch and an evening meal.The accommodation was very good indeed.  We had a room which was like a small bungalow in the hotel grounds - refreshing to walk back after dinner thru a garden and not down an endless corridor!  There is a lovely big bar to relax in and this is where you will get free wi-fi or in the spacious reception area.  There is a spa which was really relaxing with lovely staff who couldn't do enough to make the experience a pleasant one.  I had a lovely girl doing my pedicure.  I have to say that out of the very many hotels we stayed in on our 3 week tour that this was the  only one where the manager particularly asked how we were enjoying our stay.In conclusion, this is a very good hotel to stay in if you are in Kathmandu - golf or not.As a general few tips about travelling in Nepal - take plenty of immodium with you.  My lovely practice nurse sent me off with a course of antibiotics to be used if I really got a bad stomach.  They did come in useful although I kept them in reserve until India!  Don't forget your insect repellant and bite cream.  It's definitely worthwhile taking a reasonable first aid kit with you.  Take anti-bacterial hand spray and carry wet wipes and lots of tissues with you.  Most of us kept a loo roll in our day bags as quite often there just isn't any - also a lot of toilet facilities have no soap - best to be prepared.  However, even though we were all very careful about what we ate and drank, we all had very upset stomachs.A final word of warning: if you venture into Kathmandu take the hotel transport and arrange for them to pick you up again. Local taxi was the worst experience of my life - I think he was only lost but I thought he was taking us somewhere to be robbed and left for dead and in the midst of a chaotic drive we came across a big group of vigilantes.  It was horrendous.  Finally he hit a pot hole, the car virtually exploded and we had to get the hotel to send another taxi to rescue us.  Stay safe!

No, I am not exaggerating and I am not being paid to write this review:) This really was the best hotel I ever stayed in. The staff were very attentive and the rooms very spacious and beautifully decorated in colonial style. My bed was incredibly comfortable. The location is superb- in the woods, and close to surrounding picturesque villages. I went mountain biking one day, I would not recommend it for absolute beginners as it is quite hard to go up hill and the traffic is tricky. The food at the hotel was good, not excellent  but good to very good. The staff were the stars. All genuinely friendly and helpful. It is a very clean place, and the adjoining gym and swimming pool were also good to very good. You can make a lovely walk through the forest (guided tours only). The guide's English could be improved, and he could explain a bit more about the plants in the forest, but you can be sure to meet lots of deer en route. Thoroughly recommend this gem in the woods.

Having been to kathmandu many times over, this time i got to stay at Gokarna Forest resort for the first time for 3 days - 2 nights. I was visiting for a corporate event and was pleasantly surprised by this place's tranquility just a few kms away from the hustle bustle of the madhouse that kathmandu is. The resort is located on the top of  a 480 acre forest and the only noises are the ones that emanate from nature. Be prapared for cacophonous monkeys as they chatter non stop- i loved it. They move around the resort and jump up n down the balconies through the day. you will b okay if u don't come in the way. The rooms are dated but huge and i love space so full marks. Washrooms- Not spotless, but not unhygenic either- just like u'd have one back home unless u live in a mansion.Since i was travelling from a sweltering 40 degrees C Delhi, the thundershowers and cool weather just added more to the balm that soothed the senses. Food is OK and service is just Ok too. The wi-fi at the bar is free and I loved sitting outside in the gazebos overlooking the forest. Housekeeping is a sore point though as through the day  they did not replace my hand towels though they cleared the soiled ones. I had to ask twice for milk powder sachets, which were not replaced in the amenities box when the room was made. The steam room in the spa section of ladies was out of order at the time i went.I do feel that since the hotel blocks are spread over a fair bit of area, umbrellas should be readily available in case of rain etc as people need to walk up-down all the time and the buggy is not really available on demand unless u are checking in or leaving. Barring these small adjustments, I would go back again for sure, as there was nothing that put me off the place. Infact, i only have pleasant moments to look back to.

The property, rooms and food were all excellent.  The location is not within walking distance of Kathmandu, but this was good news for me.  The air was cleaner here with less dust and congestion.  I loved the bathroom with the huge open shower.

Far from the chaos of Kathmandu if that is what you want. Great if you want to play golf.Enjoyed the morning yoga sessions before breakfast - free - with very good instructors.Enjoyed having a facial and massage - friendly staff and not expensive. 3 days was too long - got a bit bored! Too far from the centre of Kathmandu for sight seeing on foot.The staff kept knocking on the door to ask if everything was alright. A bit annoying. Lots of different breads at breakfast but no gluten free bread!People smoking in the bar/eating areas.Enjoyed the live music on Friday night.

Excellent,quite beutiful property.Peaceful but still in Kathmandu city.Very good staff.Breakefast is a issue for vegetarian.Best property among all in KTH.U will really enjoy morning and sunset.Way to hotel itself is quite and pleasurable.rooms are big and very good.views from rooms-amazing-golf club.Value for money-best

We swapped our timeshare for a week at Gokarna. The hotel is not far from Kathmandu and is a peaceful option away from the madness of the city. The hotel room was large, but not perfectly clean with lots of dust, a wardrobe that didn't close and the water was slightly brown (maybe this is to be expected in a poor country?). There were some mishaps with the service and the food. We had booked spa treatments prior to arrival and had received confirmation from the front desk, however on arrival at the spa they had no record. This was also the same for our return hotel transfer. One of our meals tasted strange (we think it was cooked in old oil) but it was deleted from the bill after we complained. These couple of issues aside overall the service and the food were good. Things in the resort are not as cheap as you may expect (all menu prices are net of tax), and the wine was particularly expensive. We did a forest walk, which you must do with a guide. We were disappointed that the walk didn't include more information regarding the wildlife, plants and trees and more about the facts regarding the hotels previous life as a hunting lodge, but its worth doing to see the forest and the deer. The above issues aside, we had a great week that combined sightseeing, walks, spa treatments, relaxing, and a mountain flight to see the Himalayas. The massage and reflexology we had were excellent. We loved sitting at the Clubhouse late in the day when the monkeys and deer would appear, a fabulous spot to enjoy a glass of wine. I also played golf 3 times, which is great value and it is an excellent course. The fairways are slightly worn, but the greens were good and its a interesting course, I'd definitely recommend it for golfers. Kathmandu is a very poor place, very dusty, very hectic and the rubbish everywhere was awful. Do not expect too much! However there were places such as Bodnath Stupa that are kept clean and shows what can be achieved. This place is recommended for shopping and enjoying a beer on one of the roof top bars/restaurants.  So Gokarna/Kathmandu may not be perfect but its a great base away from the city but close enough to see the sites. We genuinely had a great week, but we were also ready to head home.

Was there twice in two weeks. The first time there, I was given a room that smelled like tobacco smoke. They were very willing to change my room. I got a very large room with two double beds, a sofa and a desk.  Large bathroom, hot shower with fragrant soaps.  The lighting is rather dim despite several lamps.  The rooms do not have wifi. Wifi is located in the bar area only. It works intermittently. The second time there, I got a very large room similar to the first.  This time the room did not appear to have been cleaned very well.  The bathroom counters had water and soap stains. That being said, the AC works great, especially since the temperature was about 100 degrees outside. Breakfast buffet is excellent.  The restaurants on the property were all good.  I had a wonderful massage at the spa. They have several "types" of massage, ie golfers massage, Himalayan Mama, Ayurvedic, etc but in reality, they are all exactly the same.The resort is in a great location on the outskirts of Kathmandu, far from the dust and noise of the city. I recommend the property and would go there again.

This is the right place if one needs a break from the crowd while still being in crowded Kathmandu. The rooms are large and well appointed, the gardens are gorgeous. I particularly liked the heated swimming pool and the spa, had a massage and sauna. Food could be better, only breakfast is really up the standard.

This is a very good place to relax and unwind -the pool, spa and the massages !!! appreciated ++especially after Kathmandu- The staff are very professional and friendly, loved the food!! The grounds were great to explore and remember to take time out to sit in the temple.

Nach anstrengendem Trecking in Nepal haben wir uns 4 entspannte Tage im Gorkana Forest Resort gegönnt. Das Hotel liegt etwas außerhalb Kathmandus,sehr schön gelegen,  inmitten eines großen Waldes. Kein Luxus-Resort aber wirklich sehr gut, mit viel Charme und Atmosphäre.zu sehr acceptablen Preisen. Die Zimmer sind groß und sehr schön eingerichtet, das Personal wirklich sehr freundlich und bemüht, das SPA aussergewöhnlich. Wunderschön frühstücken im Garten /Terasse- so richtig zum Seele baumeln lassen.Das Essen war gut, aber da wäre schon noch Luft nach oben, ansonsten wirklich ein Geheimtipp.Ch.K.

Gokarna Forest Resort is good. It is actually very good when you come here after spending hours in Kathmandu traffic jams. A lot of activities in the hotel itself and quite a large territory. Tasty food in 3 restaurants (we didn't like a lot the experience in the most expensive - Nepalese one, but the Thai-Chienese is great). Highly recommended

Gokarna Forest Resort is a peaceful sanctuary with gracious and exceptional staff, a fabulous pool / spa / fitness centre, and beautiful grounds to wander at leisure.  I don't play golf, but hear the golf course is very good too.  If you want a quiet, tranquil retreat to soothe your mind and spirit, this is the place to go.  The food is the only area where there is a little room for improvement.  I plan to go back as soon as possible.

Stayed at the Gokarna Forest Resort for a few days and enjoyed being there. Great service and nice people. The hotel is beautifully secluded, yet close to Kathmandu airport and several other sightseeing excursions. The forest surrounding the area is well worth taking a walk in. For the golf enthusiasts there is a beautiful 18-hole course. (There is no outdoor pool at the hotel but however an indoor pool). Good food and nice large rooms. I will happily return.

I spent 2 nights in this resort. I would say that it is a 4* and not a 5* resort. My room was big but the bathroom wasn't especially clean. The Chinese restaurant has a amazing view of the forest and golf course , worth a visit for lunch!

Not too far from the airport, yet in the forest and hills away from the noise of the city.  We received superb service from every member of the staff without exception, especially Lasta at the front desk.  I gave it a 4 instead of a 5 only because of some small problems with our bed, TV and view from our room window.  We would go back again without hesitation.

Wir haben uns wegen des guten Preis-Leistungsverhältnis und vor alem der guten Luftqualität für das Gornaka Forest Resort entschieden und es nicht bereuht. Immer wenn wir aus Katmando, wo man den Smog nicht nur sieht sondern wirklich spürt ca 2-3 km vor das Ressort kamen, änderte sich die Luftqualität dramatisch, da das Ressort ein wenig höher auf einem Hügel gelegen ist. Die Qualität der Zimmer, des Frühstücks sind wirklich sehr guter 4 Sterne Standard. Wir fanden auch die Qualität des Restaurants und der Spabereichs - wir machten nach dem ersten anstrengenden Tag eine wunderschöne 90 minütige hot stone Massage war super. es stimmt, das das Preisniveau für Nepal extrem hoch ist. Aber wir würden das Hotel auf jeden Fall weiterempfehlen, wenn einem die etwas längere Anfahrt in und aus die Stadt nicht stört. Einige Sehenswürdigkeiten und der Flughafen liegen eh zwischen dem Stadtzentrum und dem Hotel. Taxikosten ins Zentrum für Touristen mit ein wenig handeln ca. € 10, Das Hotel bietet auch einen kostenlosen Bus ins Zentrum an. Fragt nach, ich glaube um 10:00 oder 10:30 Hinfahrt und nachmittags zurück.

We spent a great week at the resort and found the staff superb, they couldn't do enough for us. Sundersan, the bell boy was really helpful, knowledge of the main sights and suggestions on what to do were invaluable. And lasta, she was really helpful also. In fact we have no complaints about any member of staff. We would recommend all the restaurants, in particular the Nepali. The spa was really good also. My back pain disappeared. On the whole it was one of the best resorts we have stayed in. Would recommend without hesitation.

Excellent experience at this resort.  Great spa and great food.  Very nice to excape the hustle and bustle of the city and not too far to go.  The employees were helpful and friendly and always willing to get you what your needed.

Now if you are a couple looking for a quick getaway then this is the place to go.. the place is a bit close to the main road but not that close for one to hear the traffic. The spa was the highlight of the trip.. we took the head to toe treatment and you will be pampered from head to toe. One can also go for organized forest walks, $10 per person per hour, can rent horses or bikes at the location as well. The rooms were clean and housekeeping service was provided twice a day. At the property they have two deers and a massive golf course, am not a golfer but can say that its a well kept course. The hunters lodge restaurant was the best eating option, and room service will deliver even off the menu (as much as possible). In INR I ended up paying approx. 1lac with round trip flights from Mumbai. In dollars that works up to $1500... this includes the massage and all meals. The internet is provided complimentary in the garden area, each device will set you back about INR 600 for a 24 hour package, not a one day pack but 24 hours of usage. They also have 4 hours and 6 hour packages as well.... That's about it from my side, kudos to the staff of the place....

Whilst in the middle of a hectic Great Rail journey we were booked into this resort. I was excited to be going to Kathmandu and at first disappointed to find out that we were staying outside the city, but it was such a relief to get away from the traffic and to stay in this lovely spot. It was so relaxing and our rooms were gorgeous. The food was good and the bar was warm and welcoming. It would have been even better if we could have stayed an extra night to make use of the facilities and to enjoy the surroundings.

Living in noisy Kathmandu I wanted a peaceful place for a pampering birthday weekend, and this hotel was perfect. The staff were exceptionally friendly and helpful from the moment I arrived. Nothing was too much trouble.The grounds were pleasant to walk in, and I saw spotted deer from my bedroom window. The noisiest thing was the dawn chorus! The golf course restaurant served good Chinese and Thai food, and was a pleasant place to sit with a drink, gazing at the forested hillsides.The spa service was excellent, and having enjoyed the 'Destressing' package, I went back for the manicure and pedicure next day.The indoor pool and steam room were lovely on a rainy day. I returned to work refreshed, and will certainly visit here again.

A great place to be, the staff are extremely friendly, accomodating and considerate....the food was great..the golf course was wooooowwww and to be able to spot soooooooooooooooo many deers right there was incredible!!!! My son loved the horse ride...The rooms are very spacious and cosy...over and above all this they are a eco friendly hotel, what more can one ask for!!! I wished i stayed they longer and whenever i visit Kathmandu next, i will definitely stay here again!!!

Stayed for four nights . Hotel is nice , neatly maintained with efficient house-keeping staff .Check in staff was helpful , especially Dipika and Nirmaya along with Mr Ramesh Bhandari .Food Menu needs to be augmented . Exploring the forest walk should be made complimentary and guest should be  encouraged to take the walk to enjoy  the entire property .All in all , a good experience .

We chose Gokarna through reviews on Tripadvisor, and from the first mailer to the the last day was satisfying warm interaction. The property is beautiful, food is excellent, a place where you can chill and relax after a day of sightseeing. The staff is very warm, affable and helpful, the rooms spacious. With a Golf course to boast of, Gokarna is the ideal holiday resting place..We are back to Delhi, and missing the lazing around area around the bar, which we used to access the free wi-fi..chirping of the birds and occasional sighting of deer and monkeys.We would rate it excellent

Sehr große Zimmer und Bad. Sehr freundliches und hilfsbereites Personal. Vom Bett aus sieht man in den Wald und Affen (Einmalig). Sehr gute und preiswerte Massagen. Sehr gutes Essen in 3 Restaurants. Super Golfplatz. Eine Ruhe- und Wellnessoase mit Sauna und Intoorpool in  Kathmandu. Richtig tolle Entspannung nach einem Trecking. Beim nächsten mal kommen wir sicher wieder hier her.

We stayed two nights in Feb 2014. Hotel is located in a quiet hill side area with awesome view. Rooms were clean and luxury & overall was very impressed with the service we received from hotel staff I would like to thank Lasta Kibanayo for making our stay a memorable, thank you so much for going out your way and book internal flight and hotel at Pokhara inc transit all that in short time. But you truly did make our visit special.

Stayed here two nights with a group tour. Lovely location with nice grounds, gardens, foliage and animals, monkeys most notably. Not near downtown for travelers concerned about logistics and at least 30 minutes from airport depending on time if day. But it is a beautiful oasis in a teeming city with a pace akin to Manhattan and a transportation system that doesn't support the pace. The rooms are spacious and comfortable, bathrooms modern and spacious with plenty if hot water and good water pressure. But this hotel, like so many others in Nepal offers wi fi only in a common area. I might expect that practice from a second rate, discount hotel, but this place is not in that category. I'm not sure what gives with Nepal hotels and wi fi service, but until the upscale places start offering in room wi fi they will remain in the category of second rate hotels. Yes a guest can buy in room service for a reasonable fee, as I did, but the resort doesn't even advertise it. Considering the bulk of the western world now provides included wi fi even in second rate hotels, Nepal tourism might want to consider a new approach.

A l'abri de la poussière et de la pollution de Kathmandou, le Gokarna Forest Resort est un havre de tranquillité.Très bel emplacement entre une forèt et un splendde golf habités par des singes et des dains.Service impeccable. Jardin et terrasse agréables. Bar et restaurant conviviaux  et excellents. Les chambres aux bonnes proportions seraient parfaites s'il y avait du chauffage.A noter les sempiternelles coupures de courant qui frappent tout le Népal.

I just finished a one to one 2 minute feedback interview with Lasta from reception.  I felt that my opinion was actually listened to because I am always convinced that those written notes I usually make in other places are lost in the filing system.  The staff are amazingly caring and very professional.  Lasta from reception and Sabine from the terrace restaurant really made my stay comfortable, relaxing and I felt that I had the time to just let my hair down.  A few kms out of the hussle of Kathmandu city Gokarna offers a peaceful setting with relaxing spa, golf club and beautiful gardens.  The monkeys add value to the natural setting and you are warned by all staff to enjoy their presence but to be careful.  We invaded their space and they are keen on joining us in our lifestyle.  I just finished a conference and added 2 days on to travel the bits of Kathmandu that I have time for.  Well try the hopper flight to get you close to Everest and then don't miss the Thamel market and many temples.  Its easy to get from Gokarna to the city to do these many things.  And remember, even though they say prices are fixed in the market BARGAIN.  Start by being ridiculous by offering 30% of the quoted price.  you will eventually pay 50% and that is still a good profit for the seller.  ENJOY

I spent four nights over two stays at the Gokarna Forest resort as part of a group tour. I stayed in two different rooms, and both were excellent. The resort is an oasis in this somewhat chaotic city. Breakfasts and dinners were very good. Free Wi-Fi is available in the bar area. The design and layout of the building and grounds are very nice. Resort staff were very friendly and helpful.

This was the nicest place we stayed during a recent trip to Nepal and Bhutan. the rooms are very large and well equipped and there is a nice spa and indoor pool.  The restaurants and bar are very good with a meal at the Hunters lode a special treat.  The breakfast buffet was also very good and varied each day. My wife enjoyed a massage at the spa while I got to try out the golf course which was very nice and it was fun to see all the monkeys on the course. The hotel is removes from the heat of the city but our tour company use a bus to get us to all the right sights.

One of the best hotels i have ever stayed at, everything is so good let's start with1) The staffThe staff was so kind and helped in every way possible, the staff at the check-in counter were fast and quick in their work, they accepted all types of currencies and didn't deny anything. The staff at the restaurant were so kind and also made a cake for us on our check out day.2) The foodAfter all hotel food is always the best, their authentic Nepali food was delicious, it was very reasonable and the food had authentic taste. Continental options were also available, they also have 24/7 room service. 'Shraddha' was a server who assisted us at the restaurant and also gave us her opinion on what tourist spots we should visit.3) The swimming poolThe swimming pool was brilliant, clean and had a beautiful view of the hills and skies, at the time we visited there were unlimited skies and it was beautiful. There was a bar which served mocktails, cocktails and snacks, it was indeed very good service.

The Hyatt Place has one of the best locations, and an even better staff that goes above and beyond to meet your every need. We traveled from India and spent 4 nights in this impeccable property. Located close to the Thamel district and some of the major government offices, the hotel is a peaceful retreat in the hustle and bustle of the city. The breakfast spread is lavish, and the dishes are well prepared. The staff does a great job of handling the very high volume of guests every morning. During our first night, we ordered from the hotel restaurant, and the a la carte options were so delish, that we ended up having most of our meals at the hotel. Team member Shraddha Saraswati was very warm and engaging and gave us a great deal of insight into the local sights and tourist hot spots. Other members of the restaurant staff that were exemplary were Sanjeev, Prithvi, Suvash, Supriya, Bipin, Aman, and Rishabh. At the pool bar, Govinda made it a fun visit each time with his personality and mixology skills. At the front desk, every question and request were handled with a smile by Anusha, Pramod, Yamika, and their colleagues. I would recommend this hotel to anyone in Kathmandu for a long stay or short.

I am torn writing this review, as I somehow wish that Hyatt Place remains the unknown gem in Kathmandu. It is not located in a touristy area but as we had tours every day, that was not a problem for us.As brand new hotel, the rooms were impeccable, where everything was working, from universal outlets to blackout curtains. We had a room on one of the top floors and the view of Kathmandu included some of the UNESCO sites. The staff was always friendly and welcoming, be it 2am when we arrived or 10am when we left. We communicated with the front desk several times before arriving and each time they were quick to respond and accommodating to our requests.Our stay included breakfast that offered options fit for both Asian and European tastes (including freshly squeezed juices, pastries, made to order waffles and omelets). We also ate at the restaurant several times and the service was quick and the food delicious.Overall, this was our perfect base for our Nepal adventure, a bargain for the price paid, and one of the most pleasant and memorable stays in years of travel across the world.

While its location is a bit out of the way, Hyatt Place Kathmandu excels at friendly luxury-hotel level customer service at half of the price of the other "luxury" hotels in the city (we also stayed at the Marriott on this trip and the Hyatt was by far the better experience). Everyone from reception and restaurant staff to housekeeping went out of their way to ensure we had a first rate stay. It didn’t go unnoticed. Kudos to the entire staff. We hated to leave after our week exploring the region. I know I’ll come back to Kathmandu and when I do, I’ll stay here. The staff earn all five stars and they should be incredibly proud of the service they offer at this hotel (even if it is out of the way).

There are no enough words to describe the overall service I had in this hotel. Starting from driver Narendra Dai who waited for me at airport and gave me guidance through Kathmandu for three days, then phenomenall reception staff: FO Manager Bimala, Anjali together with all colleagues working in morning/afternoon shift, then restaurant staff: Suraj Chef of Cuisine, Suraj waiter during brunch and breakfast, Anisha, Badal the barista/waiter at Lobby and so many of them which I didnt remember all names. This hotel is for me true 5 star hotel first of all because they are paying attention to details: every day my room was ready like it's for new guest, any possible request has been done within 10-15 minutes, every day I was greeted with smile and professional behavior. I would definitely recommend Hyatt Place and looking forward to come back in future. ❤️🙏

My wife and two daughters (ages 5 and 9) stayed for five nights.  The hotel was great; by day 2 the staff members familiarized themselves with us such that they knew I liked my americano very strong, whereas my wife wanted it lighter.  And they delivered to our tastes on that front!  The art center including paper, rocks, paints, and pencils were great for our daughters; after a long day out in Kathmandu, they settled in to draw and paint while my wife & I could sit at the bar within eyesight of them and have a drink to unwind.  And, the air conditioning in our room was nice and cool; my biggest fear of a summer trip to Asia is not being able to end the days back in a hot shower and to sleep in a cool room.  The shower was hot, the water pressure was strong, the air conditioning was effective and cool.  The house keeping was also quite attentive; when they cleaned our room and saw we had hung up some clothes to dry, they set up a clothes hanging wire and neatly organized our clothes (without our requesting) and neatly aligned my youngest daughter’s Barbies along the window sill (since she had left them strewn on the bed).  We all really appreciated seeing our room tidied so thoughtfully.  While we spent most of our days touristing around Kathmandu, at the hotel we felt welcomed back with familiarity that made cleaning and testing up for the next day very pleasant.  Overall— I highly recommend a stay at Hyatt Place Kathmandu and specifically believe the following members will make a great stay for you and your family:  at breakfast, Aaragya & Sajan, at the front desk/lobby/sales, Sonam, Bijayata, Kiran, Kripesh, Sunny, Enam & Rashib, and Govinda at the bar.

An excellent hotel to unwind, relax, or choose as a transit point. My husband and I spent over one week here on a business trip, and we enjoyed every moment of our stay.     The hotel rooms are spacious, the bed linen is clean and comfortable, yhe bed size is absolutely perfect,and the housekeeping staff is efficient and polite. Rina and Mamata attended to my every request, and freshened up my room with a 😃 smile!      The bathroom is well equipped, designed and well lit. Fresh towels and essential toiletries like lotion, a dental kit, shampoo, bathing soap and shower gel are provided for. This helped us immensely as we were not able to reach a shop immediately after our arrival to the city.     The restaurant provides great meals, with a wide ranging menu, from Indian, Thai, Chinese and Continental to choose from. The portion sizes are good too. We greatly enjoyed our daily breakfast as well, which comes with fresh cut fruits, juices, tea, coffee, etc on a cart.  We were pleasantly surprised to see a wide range of cuisine which included Continental, Indian, South Indian, Chinese items to choose from. (We loved the paper thin dosa, chutneys, and sambar!)     The staff in the restaurant are very hospitable and welcoming. The personal touch of asking guests what they needed, gave such a good feel! Needless to say, the kitchen staff is very well trained, and we enjoyed everything served to us!Don't miss going to the Zing Bar on level "P" to spend a beautiful, open to sky experience while enjoying a drink and great kababs, supervised by Mr. Devarya , who is in charge. We enjoyed watching a James Bond movie which was being specially screened that evening.    Last buy not the least, is the quiet ambiance of the hotel in general, which allows one peace of mind!Thanks to Team Hyatt Place, Kathmandu, for making our stay memorable! We will definitely recommend this hotel to our friends as well.

Very good services. All staffs at reception desk, housekeeping, restaurant are very helpful. Particularly, housekeeping staff very attentive and accommodating in helping us having a very comfortable stay. Mr Aashish,aviyan, nimesh is good in service.really appreciated and excellent attitude.

so amazing; the food the service the staff the rooms are absolutely perfect. a must experience hotel. so clean, bedding smells so fresh and pillows are so fluffy but also firm the best mix. the architecture and interior design is beautiful. beautiful lights and cultural paintings in dinning room. large tv, lots of channel options. lights in every which way you could need. the snack bar in the lobby offers many diff options including chips, cakes, pastries, tea, softest scarfs, mango juice and more. such a great experience both times. it sounds too good to be true and may sound like this is even a fake review but i’ve truly never been happier in a hotel. they are so quick to make you as comfortable and welcomed as possible! so happy i got to stay at hyatt place:) also give you welcoming drinks! lol

I recently hosted a small party to celebrate my 10th Wedding Anniversary at Hyatt Place with my family and close friends. I had visited the place a few times for dinner and I had loved the overall ambiance of the place and the foods were very very good. Everyone who came to my party enjoyed it a lot. Those who hadn't come before were very much surprised by how nice and beautiful the interiors were. The service staffs were very nice and helpful. The delicious food was cherry on top. Everything was very neat and clean. 👌Many thanks to Mohan Ji and chef Baburam Ji for helping me organize the party at such short notice and coming up with an excellent menu. 🙏 Each food complimented the other really well. "Bhatti ka Murg" was so yum and everyone went for a second serving of the warm, melting brownies! And thank you so much for the delicious anniversary cake! ❤️❤️❤️Quality meets Affordability - Hyatt Place is definitely going to be my regular go-to place.

We stayed in the Hyatt Place Kathmandu Hotel for 2 months, for business purposes and everything was excellent. The rooms are perfectly equipped with everything one can need for both business and pleasure travel. All the staff, from the person welcoming us at the entrance to the top managers, were so kind, helpful and accommodating. We've felt at home here and enjoyed the delicious food at the restaurant, the facilities and special events. The neighbourhood is a quiet one, (one can hear birds chirping and even spot some funny monkeys around), and at the same time it is situated very close to the center. We also received some gifts on departure, which touched us deeply and will always remind us of these wonderful people. Thank you to everyone in Hyatt Place Kathmandu for making our stay in Nepal unforgettable.If we were to return to Kathmandu, we would definitely choose this hotel again.

Wonderful hotel, very modern and in tasteful design. A very calm environment. The people working at the hotel were very efficient and polite. The rooms are very spacious and clean with all the amenities needed, a fridge, a boiler and stuff to make (instant) coffee and tea. The bathrooms are also great, water pressure on the shower was strong and there were plenty of towels. On the top floors (we stayed on the 11th and 14th floor) the view of the city is amazing. We had breakfast and dinner and the hotel and the buffet was full of great food in wide variety (including desserts) and it was also plenty. There was also option to ask for something specific from the chef.

Don’t usually leave reviews but the the hotel staff are incredible and will do the upmost to make your stay in Kathmandu as pleasurable as possible. The hotel itself is clean, modern and comfortable. The restaurant has great options and is really good but can be quite pricey for some items. Overall I highly recommend a stay here while in Kathmandu.

The food was beyond horrible with patchy service. They serve cola only in glasses no cans or bottles. We did manage to squeeze two bottles but later were told it’s now out of stock. I hurt myself and had to wait for more than hour for a first aid kit. Same was with room service. Check in took close to 20 mins although we were offered an upgrade. Thankfully we were there were less than 24 hours and have the option of never going back!
