Hotel Review: Hyatt Place KathmanduHyatt Place Kathmandu is an elegant and modern hotel located in the heart of Nepal’s capital city. Known for its exceptional service, contemporary design, and breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains, this hotel offers a perfect blend of comfort and luxury for both leisure and business travelers.The hotel is situated in the vibrant Tahachal area of Kathmandu, offering easy access to many of the city’s top attractions, including Swayambhunath Stupa (Monkey Temple), Kathmandu Durbar Square, and the lively Thamel district.How to Reach the Hotel-  The nearest airport to Hyatt Place Kathmandu is Tribhuvan International Airport (KTM), which is about 6 kilometers (approximately 20 minutes by car) away from the hotel. Upon arrival, you can take a taxi or arrange for a hotel transfer service. The ride offers a glimpse of Kathmandu’s bustling streets and cultural vibrancy.-By Train Nepal currently does not have an extensive railway network for passenger travel. Therefore, reaching Kathmandu by train is not feasible. However, if you're traveling from nearby regions like India, you can take a train to the nearest border town, such as Raxaul, and then continue your journey by bus or car to Kathmandu.-By Bus-If you’re traveling from other cities in Nepal or nearby countries like India, several long-distance bus services operate to Kathmandu. Once you arrive at the bus station, you can take a taxi to the hotel. The bus journey provides scenic views of the Himalayan foothills and the Nepali countryside.Hyatt Place Kathmandu offers spacious and well-appointed rooms with contemporary decor and modern amenities. Each room is designed to ensure comfort, featuring plush bedding, a work desk, and a cozy seating area. The large windows allow natural light to flood the room while offering stunning views of the surrounding landscape.The hotel’s rooftop pool is a major highlight, offering panoramic views of the Kathmandu Valley and the Himalayan range. Guests can relax here after a day of exploring the city or indulge in the hotel’s fitness center, which is equipped with state-of-the-art equipment.Dining at Hyatt Place Kathmandu is a delightful experience. The hotel features multiple dining options, including a 24/7 Gallery Menu & Market, offering a variety of local and international dishes. The breakfast spread is particularly impressive, with an array of options to cater to different tastes.

Our experience at the Hyatt Place was fantastic. The rooms offered stunning views of the Swayambhunath Temple, and the food was delicious. The hospitality team, particularly Mr. Amit, went above and beyond to help us plan our days and provide recommendations for activities. We enjoyed our meals at the hotel which was the reason that almost all of our meals were at the hotel. The price is also very reasonable as per the facilities and the property.

The receptionists were extremely attentive in sorting out some of the troubles that I was having with my tour operator, they swapped my assigned room to a slightly bigger room to accommodate my family needs. The housekeeping staff, especially Aashish, helped me to setup the extra bed swiftly to allow my family and I to rest as soon as possible after a long journey from Lumbhini. The hotel staffs exceeded my expectations. I will definitely be recommending this hotel to my family and friends, and coming back here whenever I am in Kathmandu.

Stayed in Feb 2022.   Staff was unbelievable friendly.   Had a beautiful picture-window view of the  city with the mountains just beyond.  Manager came out to greet us as we exited out of our taxi.  Room was on the smaller side but it was perfectly functional.  Breakfast was fantastic.  Fruits, breads, multiple hot dishes of meats and cooked vegetables.  You would struggle to find such a breakfast at even an upper-scale U.S. hotel.  Weather was too cold to use the pool or the outdoor spaces but we looked at them and they were inviting.   As we left the front desk worker came out to our taxi and offered a small gift as appreciation for staying at the hotel.  Who does that?  Simply amazing hospitality.

My name is Asset, I'm from Kazakhstan. This was our first trip to Nepal with my wife. We have stayed at several hotels, but our experience at Hayatt Place was by far the best. The staff warmly greeted us, brought us delicious herbal tea and completely helped us check into our room. The room was excellent, bright, and most importantly very clean. But the best thing about this room was the view from the panoramic window. Falling asleep and waking up with such a view was simply wonderful. Breakfast was very good, a large number of freshly squeezed drinks (I tried watermelon juice for the first time, it was amazing!!!). Massala tea was also served in special carts. The food was very tasty, there was a very large selection of main courses, salads and fruits. My wife and I really liked Nepal, it’s amazing beauty, our eyes couldn’t get enough of it, but the Hayatt place hotel in Kathmandu brought a huge amount of positive emotions. When my son grows up and we go to see Everest, I will choose this hotel again!

One of the best hotels I have ever stayed in, Hyatt place is located on red cross road and has an easy view from the main road.Rooms are spacious and well maintained Bed sheets were fresh and clean.The breakfast buffet has a variety of options to choose from. Both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options are there. The food was absolutely delicious.There is a fitness center available.In room amenities you'll get tea / coffee bags, water bottles, locker inside the wardrobe, iron table with iron, digital clock with charger, bathrobes.The bathrooms were hygienic and clean. In bathroom amenities you'll get shower gel, shampoo, conditioner, shaving kit, dental kit, hairdryer, hand towels and bath towels.There's a pool area plus a bar so you can enjoy your drinks along with a pool view.The pool area feels amazing.Overall it's an amazing place to stay in Kathmandu.

I stayed at Hyatt Place Kathmandu from 8-16 April 2022 in Room 1111.  Since the hotel is fairly new, the rooms are clean.  I love the big windows and the red elephant art.On top of that, the hotel staff are very nice.  They never failed to smile and greet you "Namaste."  They deserve to work at the front desk.  On the day of my departure, I asked to weigh my luggage and they personally got the weighing scale.  I was also assisted in printing some documents for my trip.The restaurant staff are all very charming.  Because of their previous experiences, they work with professionalism.  It is very obvious in their body language that they love what they do.  They are pleased when hotel guests are pleased.In the morning, we were always taken cared of by Soniya and Puja while in the afternoon, we were attended to by Anjali and Anu.  We are drawn to the restaurant because of their positive disposition.  And at night, Priya and Smitri is at the Zing to serve us. They all made sure that we are taken care of with smiles on their faces.  I won new friends in Hyatt Place.  They are all gems and Hyatt should not let go of them.Hyatt Place Kathmandu is a good breeding ground for Trainees and Interns, precisely because of this warm hospitality and professional client engagement culture.  As the saying goes, "You are only as good as your last performance."  Don't keep your guards down.  Keep up the good work!

I stay here quite often, and have been pleasantly impressed each time I’m here. Apart from comfortable rooms and a good gym and pool, the staff here go that extra mile to ensure everything is in order. It starts with the senior management and the entire front office who go out of their way to welcome you and ensure all your requests are attended to. The housekeeping, especially Rina and Dolma, ensure that the room is well made up and exactly how I’d like to find it at the end of the day. The restaurant staff (Suvash, Sandhya, Bipin, Shraddha, Alex, Avaash) are incredible, and take great care of you, especially accommodating your dietary preferences and the like. The invitation by Varun was a nice touch, and it was good hearing from him on their journey so far and their vision for it going forward. There are so many others I’ve interacted with, but can’t fit everything into this review, and will leave it for another time! I might have stumbled upon this place a few months back by accident, but it’s sure to be a place I’ll keep coming back to whenever I’m in the city.

I checked in for a 7 night stay, the lobby area is spacious, they have a great bar and restaurant. I did have a couple of issues, mainly with the A/C as I do like my room to feel cool. Everything was resolved. Ms Bimala, the Front Office manager is very accommodating and helpful. She was on hand constantly, she always came over to speak and made conversation. She is a real asset to the hotel and really works hard to ensure guest satisfaction. Other than Ms Bimala, there was Mr Jay who stood out and really took care. The hotel seems to be very well managed and it was a pleasure to briefly say hello to the GM. I was a little underwhelmed at first after some issues but by the end of my week the staff had won me over. Everyone had always something nice to say, from the guy delivering room service to all the restaurant and reception staff they were one of the most friendly and hospitable group of staff I’ve come across in many hotels. They really to offer a personalised service and a warm welcome in Kathmandu. It was all very genuine and sincere. The room was spacious and very clean. Great WiFi and always hot water. I found the decoration really tasteful and modern. Breakfast is a buffet which has a fine selection, I enjoyed the food I ate at dinner also. This was always very good quality. I think there might have been some kind of local buffet option but I tended to order A La Carte. This is I’m certain the very best hotel in Kathmandu with the most lovely staff.

From the day of check-in, hotel had HVAC issues which never got resolved even after raising it multiple times with the teamThe hotel has safety issues as there is water leaking from bathroom that also at times reaches the carpet of the room so when choosing to stay at this property, please be mindful about this as the hotel takes it very casually.Breakfast is ok but the dinner buffet is only for guests who have the dinner buffet in their package. The staff told me that they cannot offer me the buffet or if they do offer, they won’t refill the buffet or heat the foodThere are many other better properties in Kathmandu which can be considered over this property.

A great place to stay where we were treated with warmth and care by a cheerful and enthusiastic staff. Food was good with a wide variety at breakfast. A perfectly clean ambience at the hotel. Location is close to city centre, and Kathmandu is set in a valley where it is easy to get to all the main attractions within half an hour by car from the hotel. Would surely stay again!!!

This hotel is new and in perfect condition.   I think someone said it has been open for about 6 months.   Everything is clean and brand new.  People were nice and everyone was charming.  Too be honest, I booked the hotel room for the last 3 days of my stay in Nepal because I was told by some people to go to a hotel like this just to make sure I didn’t have problems with the covid test.   It ended up being unnecessary for getting a test, as I think it is about the same everywhere.  The hotel itself ended up being an oasis in Kathmandu.

Excellent service and wonderful ambiance! Our bartender (Dipendra) was very helpful and provided amazing service! I highly recommend coming here for drinks and snacks. Dipendra provided us with recommendations on food and drinks in the area. The dinner menu also looks very delicious with fairly reasonable prices.

We stayed here every year when we visited Nepal. It's just like back to home whenever we are in Kathmandu. We are here to celebrate 2 years old birthday of my son. The room with a spacious terrace is amazing. The breakfast buffet has a lot of variety. We would like to express our gratitude to Mr Debarya, Bipin, Rupesn, Sunil, Shraddha, Chef Baburam, Chef Tek, and Chef Sanjoy, who works in Zing restaurant are attentive, highly skilled and heartwarming. They have made our stay remarkably comfortable and memorable.Moreover, Jay, Bandana, Vivek, Abhishek, and Tanika from the Front Office are magnificent. They are knowledgeable, helpful, and always with a wonderful smile. There are more staff from Room Services and Housekeeping that has taken care of us very well during our stay. Sorry that I can't name each and everyone. All of them are so professional and courteous that I truly appreciate their hard work. Overall: The best hotel in Kathmandu. Highly recommended!

The hotel has a great team of employees who are ready to assist with any issue.  The chef and restaurant crew was very accommodating and flexible with the menu for our group during our stay in September.   The rooms are well maintained and appointed.  The housekeeping team does a great job and is very respectful to the guests.  Simply the best place to stay in KTM

Awesome experience with Hyatt Place Kathmandu, we stayed for 04 nights and it was one of the wonderful stay at this hotel. all staff members are very polite and very courteous, very prompt response and room dining service was amazingly good. Food was very delicious. The only need of improvement is Hotel entrance,  rest all are very nice and maintained.

One of the best stays I have had in last 2-3 yrs. let’s start with staff n service very friendly and helping staff. Always smiling and ready to help u in any way possible. Them rooms were very clean n comfortable. Modern design and all amenities. View was of city in backdrop of the mountains. Location: best possible in the heart of the city everything was in very close I’m a range of 3-8 km. best way to communicate is call a cab I used and app indrive suggested by one of the hotel staff. Overall all excellent stay. One more thing poolside bar Zing is one nice place to Spend ur evening very posh pls. Try Mashroom Kurkure. 😀

I stayed in May-June for a week.The hotel exceeded my expectations in terms of food (excellent local specialties, not too spicy), staff (highly professional and friendly), and views (expected only view of Swayambhunath stupa and had great view of Osel Ling Monastery as well). The hotel met my expectations in terms of sleep quality (excellent bedding, no city/road noise, limited noise from adjacent rooms) and overall cleanliness, amenities, etc.Design, decorations are also beautiful and give a good sense of being in Nepal (wallpaper in room, paintings in corridor, brick walls and photographs at restaurant, etc.) In terms of negatives, I  had some issues with the bathroom shower which were addressed promptly. The were also some power shortages which lasted only a few seconds. While all staff were great, special thanks to Pema for her warm welcome everyday at breakfast and for her food recommendations, to Nilam for teaching me some Nepalese, to Shyam for cooking breakfast with a special touch for me, and to Rashib for helping me get taxis every day !I hope to come back!

The Hyatt Place Kathmandu has an amazing staff. We will always remember this New Years vacation, and with that the wonderful staff that helped create the memory. They helped arrange everything from local tours to spa treatments (off-site, as a portion of the hotel is under renovation). Also, this location is great for touring the city, the hotel even arranged transportation to all the sites!

Came to Hyatt Place after making a plan the same day for an intimate birthday celebration. When I mentioned that it's a party of three and it's a birthday, they immediately arranged for some balloons and fairy lights. Not to forget, a wonderful handwritten note. Soooo sweet! The restaurant staff guys Suvash, Ajay and Navraj took good care of us and served us well-presented, good food that was to everybody's satisfaction. Luckily, we landed up on an evening with a live band performance, so the ambiance was perfect! We ended the meal with a small cake we had brought, and the team walked over with it singing (and the band playing) happy birthday - really cute and full of heart. Thank you for a memorable evening :) Team HP KTM!

If you are looking for a great hotel with excellent restaurant and swimming pool, we recommend you stay at Hyatt Place in Katmandu. We had NOTHING to complain about. They have very friendly and the most correct staff and there was not anything we could complain about regarding our room, airconditioning or shower. We had a SUPER time with special thanks to Susmita, Pawan and Nabraj. They made us feel very welcome  and made sure we will remember our time here with a big smile. So thank you again Nabraj Susmita Pawan and colleagues!Many greetings from Hans and Marian who sadly went back to the Netherlands. Till we meet again.

More than the food I was amaZed with the hospitality in the restaurant. The chef personally assisted us with the order and gave his own touch in the food. The zing naan is a must try!! Also the dal makhani and paneer kofta. If you’re looking to try some amazing Indian food, do give it a try

@Aashishmaharjan from house keeping department is the best support and helper i have ever recieved at hyatt place katmandu in my overall stay,i really appreciate his service and love from him. he is so warm and helped me get food and  water even very late without any hesititation. i just love how good he is with each and every people who stay here.

The overall experience was wonderful including room and breakfast buffet, but a sour note was struck during check-out. As Discoverist members, we had requested a 1:30pm late check-out when we checked in, and the front desk staff confirmed it. However, the next day at 12pm, we received a call from the front desk asking us to leave immediately, despite the seemingly unoccupied hotel. We requested an extra 30 minutes, which was granted. It's unclear whether this was due to a lack of communication among the staff or a disregard for the promised service, but it left us dissatisfied with the way our stay concluded.

Our stay here of 1 week was indeed an enjoyable one. From food to hospitality services, everything made our stay more pleasant. All 3 meals, along with tea, were provided, which made sure we were never left hungry in the day.

We booked for one night at Hyatt but their service and warmth was welcoming and we extended our stay to 3 nights at the same hotel. Milan and Bandana at the front desk were really helpful and resourceful. At the Resturant Robin catered to us promptly. Chef Rajender makes awesome dosas. Definitely recommend. A bit far from the Center about 20-30 mins to Thamel /Durbar marg and cab takes around 400NPR , but rest everything really makes anyone feel home.

We were here in hyatt place for buffet brunch .. the overall experience , the ambience was excellent! Our host shraddha was very helpful and was attentive .. gave us the best experience of this place.. the food was warm, fresh and amazing taste.. the aroma was mesmerizing! Would definitely visit this place again!

Great experience at Hyatt place with very friendly and accommodating staff, clean and modern venue and great breakfast offering Indian/Nepali to western meals. Really good after a tiring day out around Kathmandu. They even hosted a special Christmas celebration during our stay there with snacks, mulled wine and a choir performance. Received great service and assistance from Aashish throughout our stay. Highly recommend to all!

Excellent place to visit . Me sister  with my parents and family were there to celebrate our parents anniversary and we were happy with the ambience food and specially the service they provided to us . Special thanks to Govind the one who take care of us during our visit. He feel us more special by providing anniversary beautifully decorated pastery to us. Thank you Govind and team for special gesture 💕❤️

Pillows are a little bit too soft. When sleeping I don't feel my pillow elevate my head enough. Pillows could be a little bit less soft. Food is great. Heaters are warm enough to keep me and the room warm. Service is good. When my heater wasn't working, room service came in and gave us a different heater

My family went for celebrating the fathers day in hyatt place ktm we had the best buffet dinner there, our stomach was fully loaded. Special thanks to ajaya for guiding us through every section of buffet and taking care of us and that panipuri trolley was very nice concept we ate so much. Hats off to chefs for yummy food.will surely visit again

Not a great property, situated at congested area and poor response of reception for services. Rooms are not sound proof and outside noises on floor and commotions keeps disturbing. Very limited options for vegetarian guests in breakfast. Response for toilories is very slow. Ofcouse certain staff members are prompt at reception while dealing in person but not all can be counted for such prompt response.

The hotel is very centrally located. The hotel has a wide spread of buffet breakfast with multiple cuisine and they prepare the dish specially as per your taste in case u demand. All staff is very courteous specially omin ,ajay and Yamika. Rooms are very spacious. We enjoyed our stay.

We stayed at the Hyatt for our family vacation. The hotel was perfect in every aspect. It was new and plush. The breakfast was particularly a highlight with a very elaborate spread. I was travelling with my Indian parents who prefer a south Indian breakfast and the options daily was amazing. One of our host, Enam was quite attentive and made sure all our requests were attended to promptly. Would highly recommend staying at this Hyatt

The hotel's ambience is elegant and inviting. Soft, warm lighting creates a cozy atmosphere in the lobby, while the gentle hum of conversation adds a touch of liveliness. The décor is modern and tasteful, with a blend of rich colors and comfortable furnishings. The ambience is designed to make guests feel comfortable and at ease during their stay.Indulge in a visual feast at Hyatt place, Kathmandu's exquisite restaurant, experience the perfect blend of opulence and culinary delights as you embark on a gastronomic journey within this magnificent dining space. Savor the delectable flavors crafted by talented chefs while being immersed in a luxurious ambiance. Allow your senses to be captivated as you witness the finest dining experience .

Very friendly staff. Excellent rooms. Fantastic service. Pawan (wait staff) and Preshant and Pema (housekeeping) should be commended. The only reason I didn’t give 5 stars is that they often hold conventions and these people end up in the breakfast area making it very full. In addition, these people were often very loud, rude (taking items off your table or sitting on your table without asking), or pushing and leaning over you whilst you wait in line for food.

Hospitality at its best. Chef Rakesh Pandey Ji made sure that our group of 14 had the best time and best food to celebrate our friend’s daughter graduation. We had a great time would recommend to try their Pizza.

I had been 3 times to Nepal before pandemic and this stay post pandemic has been the best experience with regard to hotel quality and service. So this is the brand new hotel which may not be more than a year old.What I liked is the quality of room, food and the most staff's dedication to provide best experience.Few names I remember are Milan, prasiddha, Anu, Deepak,ayush and sorry I missed some names who ensured that we get the best experience.Must try your experience..The view is awesome from the room.The only drawback is the location which is little away from places like Thamel and prime business areas. Having said that indriver app can help you to roam around easily.RegardsPonnappa Nalenda708

The Hyatt is an excellent place. Great ambiance, great service... The kind of facilities and service you expect at a Hyatt and that too for a princely sum of only $60 per night!Special shout out to my new friend and bartender Amir  who fixed me a glass(s) of Khukri rum, hot water, lime and honey as the perfect antidote to the cold I picked up at THE EBC,  I would say, this was almost as good as the Pan Galactic Gargle Blaster...

Enjoyed buffet breakfast at Hyatt Place. Waffle must try dish. Buffet dishes were limited. Chef Ido, always ready to prepare any special dish on your request. Freshly brewed coffee wake you up. Nice ambience.

Extremely helpful staff from check in until check out. Awesome breakfast, especially the crispy dosas. We had a picturesque view of the mountains through the large room window — the check in staff upgraded us on a complimentary basis.

I was there for one of our work event. The service that Hyatt Place provided was very professional. The ambience was nice. The hall, food and amenities were very good. I would like to thank Mr. Vikram for being with us during our whole event.His continuos engagement and efforts to meet our requirements is very much appreciable. I would recommend Hyatt Place to everyone for any sort of events.

Definitely the best 5 hotel that is worth for the price ! They served great and different cuisines of breakfast also. Everything was so comfortable and excellent ! They even greeted their customers with welcoming hot drinks and helped us to take our luggage up to the room. 👍👍💯

We stayed a week at Hyatt Place. Check-in started with a warm welcome and room upgrade.Unfortunately, my son got ill and had to be admitted in hospital for a couple of nights. We were helped and supported by several staff (providing transportation back and forth, complimentary fruit for my son, we were allowed to borrow a pillow, etc.). One staff member even came to the hospital after his hours to help us out. We very much appreciated it and it made our lives easier.This situation aside, hospitality was really remarkable from check-in to check-out. Very friendly and helpful staff, nice food and nice clean rooms. I can say without hesitation, as a frequent traveler, this has been my best experience so far. If you book with Hyatt Place, you'll be in good hands for sure.

This was my first trip to Kathmandu and was not sure which hotel to stay. I was fortunate to stay at Hyatt Place Kathmandu, a wonderful experience, must visit again! Room size is Big, Beautiful and offers very nice view from big windows. Roof Top Open Bar ZING and other restaurants offering yummy food and warm hospitality goes everlasting memory.

Awesome ambience, great delicious food, pleasant stay and on top of all the staffs at Hyatt are very friendly and go above and beyond to help you. We were 5 people with an infant and staffs helped us on every walk of stay at Hyatt Kathmandu. Highly appreciate help of Suvash at the restaurant to provide customized food for the baby.

We really  enjoyed the music of dj quinn and sangria made by smriti thapa & arbin gurung along with the food was really good.likewise the hospitality of sushil and priya was really appreciated.Me and my friends had a great time yeye!!Will vist zing sky bar and lounge again :)

It was an amazing stay, the rooms are fresh and new. The food is top of the class and the team is very hospitable, loved the lunch, specially bhatti ka murg, definitely worth trying.Thank you for making us feel at home

This is one of the nicest properties in Kathmandu. The view from the room is spectacular. The service is nice and the food is amazing. Chef Baburam is gifted. We found out that he is a celebrity chef with a show on TV. He was very friendly and surprised us with unique dishes. For the week of our stay, we tried everything on the menu. His signature Hummus and Qinua Salad is out of this world. I did not feel well one of the days and the chefs catered for special food for me. Bug gratitude to all the F&B team: Nabaraj, Ajaya, Sciuash, Susdhimto, Shraaahoi, Pritun, Nilam and Rohan. The hotel is new and everything works. I just hope that they will get rid of plastic bottles.

All services are finely arranged in Hyatt.Definitely there are very convenient lift systems without any hindrances and with full secure system in almost all places. Food and hospitality are excellent. Rooms I resided was uniquely fine as my experience with other *****Hotels.Thank you for your services.

We just recently got engaged at hyatt place. It was a small intimate event consisting only close family and friends. However the hospitality the Hyatt place gave us made the event lot bigger. Each and every staff were very very polite and genuinely helpful. The event hall was very cozy. The food was excellent and rooms are very thoughtfully designed with lot of contemporary aspect taken into account. Ours was on a higher floor with breathtaking views of the swayambhunath and kathmandu city. And finally would like to thank our sales manager SABIN MAN SHRESTHA for treating us like his own family and guide  us through different aspect of the event.

Recently stayed at Hyatt Place Kathmandu and what a wonderful hotel it is!!! The hotel has a nice, vibrant vibe to it and the food they offer is so delectable. They have a lot of variety in the buffet for breakfast and I must agree that I have never tasted such delicious waffles. Would surely visit again.

Al the staff are very cordial and helpful. The hotel is very clean, and food is good. They have very smart elevator. The city center is nearby and can visit within 15-20 minutes. I had little problem with the pillow.

Hyatt is one of the best restaurant to stay & enjoy, the service is great & ambience is very beautiful. Food is very delicious,has varieties of food. People out there  are very polite, service is really appreciable  i remember a guy named deepak was very helpful & polite.I can surely recommend this place to evryone willing to go.

This is one of the best hotel to stay in kathmandu.  They have a splendid view of the city from their rooms. The food is very delicious, the entire staff is very well polite and Samriddhi (Their intern) especially was  very quick and prompt to serve us during our breakfast. Highly recommended for an exemplary stay.

We travelled as a group of 6 lady friends. From the moment we stepped into the hotel, we were treated like royalty. Every single staff member was ready with a warm smile and was exceptionally courteous, polite and helpful. Service was superb. Assistance at the reception was quick and efficient. The hotel is new, so the rooms are modern, well appointed and clean. We had a lovely hill range facing view and could see the Bouddha stupa on another hill in the distance. Housekeeping and room service was very prompt. The food at the restaurant was really good and the chefs went out of their way to cook what we wanted. Unfortunately, the pool and bar were under renovation and we missed that. We received a wonderful send off from the hotel staff as well. Thanks to Hyatt Place Kathmandu for this memorable stay.

We had a lovely stay at hyatt place! The receptionist/F&B team were very friendly, professional and accommodating with every need, willing to help with a smile. The morning breakfast service at Zing was delicious and had a selection of sweet and savoury foods to indulge in, as well as fresh fruits and juices. They went over and beyond to help make our stay memorable. The room that we had stayed in was comfy, clean and most of the staff whom i meet were amazing... special thank to Ms. Prazena, Ms. Corrina, Ms. Jyoti, Ms. Pema, Ms. Sushma, Mr. Bipin, Mr. Sachin, Mr. Ajay, chef shankar, and chef shyam.Big shout out to HK team for 100% cleanliness.I highly recommend hyatt place kathmandu for your stay

Thanks to Mr Dipak Gurung staff in Hyatt who suggested me to chose Hyatt.I really had my wonderful time with my husband in Hyatt Hotel environment was superb.little young staffs was very polite and friendly.Room was neat and clean.Swayambhu View from hotel room was very  beautiful.Breakfast was delicious.I just cannot stopped sharing what make me  feel happy there.I felt cold at the room.we spoke to the staff and in a minute they provided us room heart extra. What a great service.

I went to Hyatt Place for a staycation with my husband. It was very raining so we were not feeling good about the day but when we got to the hotel, the way we were beautifully welcomed by the reception staffs, we felt very nice. Food was also very good and all staffs were very humble. We ended up having an amazing staycation.

We went for lunch in the restaurant and it was so good! Best one i tried so far, and the staff are very welcoming especially Suraj, he had the initiative to recommend the best dish and explain the menu, and he has been very accommodating with our needs! Will surely come back for more!

The hotel is new, very cute and the service was excellent throughout all my stay. All the employees was so caring and always smiling. Everyday the chef came to greet us and offered breakfast recommending local food! It was a very pleasant stay.

I was at Hyatt Place Kathmandu for a conference/meeting and a buffet dinner. I found the food to be extremely delicious and the facilities to be very nice, but, more than that, I would like to express my gratitude to the dinning-related staff, especially Ajish. They, specifically Ajish, were all extremely friendly, trying to help out with our food preferences, and also made conversation with me and told me about the local food, which I found extremely enjoyable and memorable as a foreigner from Thailand.

Amazing hospitality and warmth. The restaurant team were courteous to accommodate our food requests. Definite go to place. Our Indian food requests were elaborate and the team of chefs and waiters served with complete sense of customer service

Empathy and hospitality are not uncommon in  branded hotels, however warmth of care and passion to serve made our stay in Hyatt place Nepal a different experience Mr Pammy the head operation, was ever smiling and courteously making us feel at home. Right from helping us with stay, safe keeping of luggages. Importantly guiding us through souvenir selection. Surprisingly he never missed a call of reuqest and support as we are new to the geography. Mr Pammy  surely warmed our hearts with ever ready support and kind demeanor Pilgrim trip though hectic, the most missing link, early evident was good and traditional food. Chef Baburam Sharma with his experience in South India cuisines spun magic with tasty South Indian food on request. Multi cuisine with overload of South Indian food was both delight to eyes and mounth. From authentically tasting kulzhi paniyaram, appropriately spiced gun powder to arachavecha sambar, the taste lingered for long.... His team of Mr Nabaraj , Ms joythi made the ambience warm with smiles and service. When wife took to poor health, the team over saw providing pro biotic simple food of idly curd and juice to help her recover Beyond this all the team were well coordinated by Mr Pammy and Mr Baburam to attend to dietary needs. While they caring and joyfully served the requirements The front office team was clear and courteous with SOP understanding what is possible and what is not. Prazeena was a testimony of clarity in handling issuesEven the fresher Ms Samigla had broad smile at all times and sent a note of thanks to us for the stay and urging us to extend our stay, as a member of larger family My stay with The Hyatt Pune and Hyderabad has always been exemplary but this was clearly a notch above the bestGood luck team Hyatt Place , keep adding smiles to the world 🌎

Thank you hyatt place especially the pool bar for lovely evening with my wife and small son . All the staff were very polite and helpful . The ambience is quiete and lovely with saying this we can't forget the food they serve and we meet Chef Dilip and Rajendra Sapkota over there . Their signature drinks were amazing too also thank to Sushil Govinda and Manish for the best hospitality ever 😍😍

The restaurant staff and breakfast buffet made the start of each morning special.  I always look forward to staying at Hyatt Place while in Kathmandu.  The hotel staff is friendly, helpful and welcoming!  Felt comfortable.  Seeing the familiar smiling faces with their positive vibes.

Stayed in Room 1110 with wonderful view of swayambhunath temple. The service was professional and the employees were benevolent. Mr. Sabin Man Shrestha from sales, Mr. Sushil Shrestha from F&B sevice and the front office team made friendly and enjoyable environment. Would love to visit again and will definitely visit again. Need to improve the quality of food served in ZING bar. Better to build a dedicated kitchen for the bar rather than bring it from the main kitchen. Breakfast was exceptional with varieties of Indian dishes to choose from.Swimming pool is nice would love to dip in soon.

ExcellentOf the various hotels I have stayed at in my travels, this is by far among the best. Everything was great: very soft bed, excellent cleanliness, impeccable service, kindness and accuracy of the staff. One really feels pampered. The Chef in the restaurant is a food artist! I really hope to come back soon!An heartfelt thanks from Patrizia & Davide - Italy

It was a wonderful experience! The hotel staff was the best part. Nabataj, Pushpa, Arusha, Prazeena, Rupesh, and Sunny to name a few were amazing! The food was delicious at the restaurant. The hotel was clean and the rooms were very nice. Our lights went out in our room and the maintenance staff was there quickly to fix them. We would love to go back!

We have been to the few 5 star hotels in Kathmandu however, Hyatt place was outstanding and perfect for a stay in luxury accommodation. The apartment was extremely spacious and immaculate. Perfect choice, everything was clean, with good public access to the city center. Well accomodating, Child friendly, Good foods, spacious rooms and very attentive staff.  Out of all Mr Aashish Rajaure was extremely professional, supportive and very knowledgeable in terms of customer service and relations. I would like to say heartiest thank you to all staffs and especially Mr Aashish to make our accommodation more comfortable and memorable. Thank you Mr Aashish for toys and complimentary dessert for our daughters. We cannot wait to see you all again. Highly recommended.

Obsessed, love this hotel, welcomed like being greeted by family. Seamless check in, seamless understanding of my needs and great responsive to food requests if you have particular needs. Clean. Upgraded room with ease. Really love the entire team, hotel and vibe.

Excellent facilities and courteous staff, immensely enjoyed the stay .  Beautiful rooms One improvement is the food: please serve hot food. The buffet was cold. And so was dinner by the time it was served it was lukewarmCeaser salad: must not order thisHave the buffet.. ask for it warmHave the muffins and pastries

Spacious room with a view of mountains. Room had all the amenities.Check in check out process was smooth. Staff at the reception and in the restaurant are very helpful. We used gym and pool everyday and it was raining. Bipin took care of food intolerances personally. Breakfast had variety of options from Egg to waffles to live dosa counter

Good hotel but we went when swiming pool was under renovation, which was a bit disappointing.Very good, humble, cooperative and professional staff, Anjali, a very humble and sincere staff is a Special mention , always willing to help and cooperate.Thanks for the good time.

Last night I visited Hyatt Place, Kathmandu and there was jazz night in Zing Bar it was very good the ambience, music and food was very good and i was very satisfied with it especially the staffs SUSHIL, SMRITI and SUDAN Chef were very kind and generous. They gave a very good hospitality to us which made us feel special.Thank you so much guys for such a great service and memorable night. I would love to visit again.

The food tasted delicious and the ambience was amazing (suitable for all type of events and guests). Overall, our server Mr Subash gave us great service. I would recommend everyone to visit Hyatt Place.

I spent three nights here with my parents, and it was a fantastic experience. From seamless check-in to enjoying specially prepared meals by the chef, and the exceptional hospitality from the staff, every moment made our trip unforgettable. I'm deeply grateful to the entire team for their outstanding efforts, with special recognition to Bimila at the front office, Reena the restaurant manager, Chef Shyam, and the exceptional service from Pema and Jyoti.

We have had the pleasure of staying at the Hyatt Place Kathmandu 3 times now and feel it is like a home away from home. All the staff are friendly, helpful and efficient. The chef Suraj was most helpful in answering our questions and advice on local cuisine. The hotel is well located with spacious rooms, we would definitely recommend staying here.

The place was good, ambience was nice, the food and the people from the hotel were very accommodating. However, the view from the hotel rooms are not great. The hotel was well decorated for Christmas and new year. The front desk team was very receptive and accommodative.  ever smiling and nice to talk with for any issues/clarifications.

Excellent and friendly Staff, Nice Hotel, Stayed for 3 nights and didn't experience any issues with the hotel. Check-in was so quick.  Room was nice and clean. experienced the 'WOW' factor from the staff. breakfast was good. Mr.Dipesh was very helpful for us and he went for the extra-mile for fulfilling our travel needs and guided us to make our trip meaningful. Thank you Dear Hyatt. keep up the good work

Our stay in Hyatt Hotel in Kathmandu was more than excellent. It is a modern, brand new hotel that offers  all the facilities you need. The rooms are large and very clean. The restaurant offers fresh and tasty food and the stuff is friendly, knowledgeable and with high level of professionalism. Many thanks to Omin! He is an excellent gastro guide to the spicy world of Nepalese food.

The experience was amazing. The workers were very nice and welcoming especially Marina and  Mr .Omin Maharjan .he was really nice he made our trip much better. The food was amazing. The head Chef Baburam personally welcomed and talked with us

The service was excellent. the food delightful a  blend of Nepali and western tastes Special thanks to Sushant for his kindness and professionalism. Also his complementary Hot apple tea with spices , is amazing.Thank you Sushant

Starting with the breathtaking property and the warm hospitality, our experience at this hotel was simply outstanding. From the delectable food to the convenient location in Kathmandu, every aspect exceeded our expectations. Our room, complete with a private terrace boasting stunning views of the city, added an extra layer of delight to our stay. In fact, we were so impressed that we ended up booking it twice within a single week! 🌟

I would like to thank all the staff in hyatt place for giving us a warm welcome especially Mr.Aashesh and Ms.Bimala from reception, Mr. Ajish and Mr. Subash from buffet breakfast who always take care of us all the time. We really find the hotel comfortable and beautiful with the staff who is always eager to help and provide a extremely great service. I also admire how proffessional they are. Will definitely comeback here

The hotel staff here are the best. There is nothing they are not willing to help you with. Thank you to all of you for making our stay very special - a honeymoon to remember and that is not because of Everest but also because of your wonderful service. Bandana, Anu, Ajay, Shushil (very special thanks to the Zing bar team, your service was excellent). The cake you provided on arrival was delicious. The room was beautiful and the breakfast, dinner etc was fantastic. I rarely have nothing bad to say but the HYatt Kathmandu is one of the best hotels I have stayed in.Special thanks also to the night staff on the night of 26th September who thanks to him, we made our flight on time after he called the driver from our trekking company. You are all amazing and we can’t wait to visit again. I will recommend you to all my friends who plan to trek! They should all use HYatt Place as a base! 🙂

Staff at the hotel are friendly and helpful. Aashish, at the front desk, is always helpful with additional requests. The rooms are clean and comfortable. The morning breakfast buffet is excellent. I always enjoy my stay at Hyatt Place KTM.

Food were good but little bit cold at bronze. Environment and servicing were good. Staffs were great at service especially by Sushmita and Ajay. Really loved how they were so good at explaining the stuffs regarding food and available services.

We had a wonderful stay at Hyatt Place. This is a cool hotel beyond my imagination. There are warm and welcoming service at the front desk during checking in; cultural dance performance prepared by the staff for the guests; and outstanding service and food. Sajan provided awesome service to us during breakfast. Professional, warm, conscientious, and his smile is contagious. The cooking team are making food that are both tasty and beautiful. Definitely a 5 out of 5 experience.

Ashish and Nimesh are the best in housekeeping. Over all loved it. Best place i have visited on nepal this is our first stay at nepal and first we visit nepal Housekeeping boy aashish brief us about all the place of nepal we can see from hotel he is great his collegue nimesh help us for making sofa bed aashish schedule all the places to travel in the city he is too polite and smart we like to visit hyatt place for next time tooo

Amazing staff and service. Chef Baburam and F&B Manager Bipin were just extraordinary. Baburam ensured our group of 15 were fed with our local food and always went out of the way to make us feel home. Bipin extended wonderful hospitality every time we dined at the restaurant!

Amazing experience at an Hyatt Place Kathmandu, I personally would like thanks to all the staffs from FO, Housekeeping, F&B along with security team, who went beyond their way to make sure my stay is memorable. Especially would like to thanks Priya at the Zing pool bar very professional, courtesies and really appreciated her sincerity towards the customer. Please cascade my sincere gratitude her. Look forward to staying back again

It’s an amazing place to stay. Newly built and very elegant property. The rooms are very spacious with a great view of the city and Swayambunath Stupa. Also the Breakfast had a lot of varieties and was excellent. Overall had a wonderful experience and would definitely visit again.

The service was very good. The event was good and food was also very good. The event host was excellent. Attended the event form tattoo consult pvt. Ltd. Would also like to recommend the venue to others for their event. Thanks to Bikram for great service and hospitality.

The service couldn't have been warmer. I came for lunch only to find that it was a buffet. Most dishes had red pepper in them which I am allergic to. Ajay went out of his way to show me which dishes were safe for me. And he requested that the chefs make me my favorite dishes with no chilli's.  The live band played soft jazz and pop in many languages. This is a classy place and well worth the money.

I would like to give a huge thank you to the Hyatt Place staff in Kathmandu.  We were greeted by friendly staff and were served hot apple toddy by Rohan.  He greeted us with his warm friendly smile and in a well dressed manner.  Karma another staff member assisted me with my luggages and provided me assistance how to access the a/c control.  The room were freshly cleaned with a king size bed.  The mountains can be seen from my bedroom window.  I took a flight to see Mt. Everest which has a spectacular view.  The entire staff at the Hyatt Place were very friendly, courteous and asked me for my feedback about the services provided at the Hyatt Place.  Special thanks to Rohan for making my stay a memorable experience.

Comfortable and very friendly staff. Exceptional service and quality! Pema was very warm and friendly, polite. I really enjoyed my stay! Food at Zing restaurant is of high quality, their ala carte menu is extensive and the buffet breakfast has a wonderful spread! Well done.

Excellent stay. The location is perfect and the hotel looks and feels brand new. They have an excellent gym, the breakfast spread is good, and I’d be really hard pressed to find an area in which it’s lacking. Merina contacted me before my arrival to check for any preferences and endured those were taken care of, Milan at check in was extremely warm and welcoming, and provided done great recommendations of things to do in the city. All in all a great stay and I’m already looking forward to being back.

We decided to stay at Hyatt Place since it’s a new hotel in town, turned out to be a great weekend for us. Great interior! Friendliest staffs! I had booked the room over a phone call where Merina gave us an upgrade to a city view room which was lovely. The rooms were very cozy and had a homely feels with minimal interior. Over dinner, the staffs gave us a great service. Mohan was very kind and made sure we were served on time. The food was equally great! We absolutely loved it! Would love to make a visit again. And I would definitely recommend it to others!

I visited as single female but ina tour group. My room was clean and nothing was missing from offered items. There was complementary water bottle. Excellent mattress and pillows. My best impression was formed when I mentioned to the waiter that the food was too spicy ( even the rice ). He immediately talked to the chef and they prepared pizza and fries. Their politeness is exceptional and really made me more relaxed. I regret not experiencing the pool but .. maybe next time. Around the hotel there are some shops but you need to walk Abt 7-10 min. Totally safe though.

"I had a wonderful dining experience at this hotel, all thanks to the exceptional service provided by the F&B staff. From the moment I entered the restaurant, I was greeted with a warm smile and attentive service throughout my meal. This particular staff member named Sushma Magar was knowledgeable about the menu and made great recommendations. Not only was the food delicious, but the service truly made my visit memorable. I will definitely be returning and highly recommend this hotel for its outstanding F&B team."

Excellent time I have passed in Hayaat Place in Kathmandu. Very clean, enthusiastic, and also the service was excellent. Especially Ms Badal,👍 Rupesh 👍and Krishna.👍.They took really take care with their excellent behaviour and always with smiling face. From 7-26 February I have only twice chance to take food from outside, rest of the day during staying in Hayaat Place I took my food every day. Keep up the good work.On Saturday 24 February enjoyed the Solo song by Samikshya & Karat arranged by Hotel management at lunch. Simply awesome 🙌 Hope to see you again.

Excellent , manager & waiter kindly service. They always want to know what you need, and always can feet your need. Food is good, also can cooked by  personal ask, chef’s chatting and explaining , feel like home.優秀，經理和服務員服務友善。他們總是想知道您需要什麼，並且總是能夠滿足您的需求。食物很好，也可以根據個人要求做飯，廚師的聊天和解釋，有賓至如歸的感覺。

Arrived at hotel and was promptly checked in at front desk by Rohan and I believed assisted by Dipesh! They were definitely friendly and clear in their instructions. A smooth and hassle free process. Thereafter Sajan accompanied us and brought our luggages to the room. He was friendly throughout and assured that we are settled in before leaving. We got a room with awesome view of the mountain. Dinner was at Zing, World of Flavours. Our service staff was Dipendra Maharjan, Bartender. Not surprising he was friendly and gave good recommendations. Our order of Himalaya Dumpling Soup, Sisno Ko Soup, Smoke Timur Chilly Chicken and Stir Fry Tofu were flavorful and simply amazing.
