And to end our evening; we had amazing cocktail from the bar.

New hotel, in good location,  safe,  clean  and spacious.   Breakfast buffet in Zing Restaurant has  a variety of choices,  Chai tea is hot and delicious.   Surat in the Zing restaurant provides friendly and excellent services. Will choose to stay here in my next trip to Nepal.

Me and my friend stayed at this hotel.We enjoyed a lot at hotel the Lobby and restaurants are outstanding. Restaurant staff Mr Omin is very friendly and very attentive to guests.Rooms are very comfortableAlso we found miss srijana phuyal is very comfortable and cooperative to deal with.Definitely we stay again in future at Hyatt

Mr. RupeshThe restaurant staff delivered outstanding service with a smile. Our dining experience was memorable due to their attentiveness and friendly nature." We appreciated the waitstaff’s knowledge of the menu and their excellent recommendations. The service was top-notch."

This was a perfect place to be. The staff was so courteous and helpful, most importantly they always had a smile while answering our questions. The room had a beautiful scenic view from the 11th floor. We had booked for 2 days but extended our stay. Overall an excellent family place to stay at. Thank you for making our holiday in Kathmandu perfect

Good place to stay and good service.Great rooms, all facilities are available in just one call. Foods are awesome. Never felt like I away from home Sanjeev is great guy who provide great services at the time of breakfast.

We stayed two nights at Hyatt Place, Kathmandu. It was a wonderful stay made possible with spacious very clean rooms with a great view. It was made memorable with the smile and very helpful attitude particularly of Ms Parzeena, who took care of our little little personal needs. We highly appreciate the front desk and reception staff too who were quick and polite to check us in and even helped us for our cabs etc. Thankyou!!! Keep it up guys 😊👍

It was a very good room and an excellent location. The reception staff were amazing and I would like to thank chef Baburam who was so kind to welcome my family and me. I will return back  soon thank you so much all Hyatt family………….Once again thank you so much

Special thanks to General Manager Varun, FO Manager Bimala, Sunil Thapp, and the rest of our team who made our trip to Kathmandu such a memorable one. We enjoyed the morning chats, insider tips, and the frequently check ins to ensure we were feeling right at home. We loved the authentic breakfast options and the variety. Would highly recommend the Indian food under In-room dining! The free shuttle to Thamel/Durbar marg is also great as we didn’t have to worry about transport. Should we come back, we would definitely stay here again!

We spent a week in Hyatt Place in Dec 2022. The highlight of our stay was the outstanding breakfast, especially the awesome waffles, another recommendation on food is "Jhol Momos". The staff is courteous and provided oustanding hospitality, standout mention for Ashish, Kiran and Amit who took care of taxi and transportation for us.This is a new property which is an added bonus as everything is in sparkling condition.Overall, we highly recommend Hyatt Place for stay, and we will gladly repeat staying here when we are in KTM next.

Absolutely great service. The team went out of their way to make me feel comfortable. I'd come back after a difficult hike and had an aversion to food. Chef Bhol Bahadur offered to name whatever I felt like eating and made tasty rasam. I will never forget his care and service. Great experience overall!

I chose this hotel to stay in Kathmandu because I love this chain and I often choose their hotels while traveling. The hotel is located in the city about 8 km far from the airport. They don't have transfer service so I had to take a prepaid taxi at the airport. This is a standard hotel with standard rooms, service and everything else.The only disappointment was the cuisine of the hotel. Food seemed not fresh in breakfast and it was not tasty.

Absolutely amazing place to eat, we will be making a reservation for our next visit probably for Saturday Brunch .10 of 10 for every single aspect of this F&B, and this is coming from people who know and love great food. The menu options are an excellent value specially for happy hours lovers in ZINC SKY BAR. Excellent service from professional servers .Anjali with her pleasing smile and warm greeting and her escort to SkY BAR, Purna as a leader sat next to us explaining every outlets, properties,and food. Sushil,Priya were great too. The dining experience overall was next level. Highly recommended.

Rashib prove good service to us. He help us with baggage when we arrive. Guide us during our stay. RECOMMEND good food during our stay. Introduced us to house keeping staff  when I found that the room TV always not working after I switch off any power switch, He help me to get electrical technician to check. Although it still not resolve but his attitude is good and friendly

We were very well served by Subash, thank you for looking after us. Setting clean and spacious with open kitchen. The food we tried was varied similarly the taste ranged from OK (thai veg green curry) to BEST (lamb chop - most expensive dish on menu). Regards NKG

Hyatt Place is a very new property located in a good location. The rooms are very spacious with a good view of the city and Swayambunath Stupa. Breakfast has lot of varieties and excellent. Staffs are very couteous and very helpful.

It was an awesome experience! They made my birthday very special by singing a birthday song for me, and I was totally overwhelmed. The staff were incredibly friendly, caring, and provided excellent hospitality. The food was delicious, of good quality, and the environment was pleasant. One thing I particularly liked was the thoughtful uniform of the staff, which allows them to feel comfortable without feeling bound by strict rules and regulations.

I revisited Hyatt Place Kathmandu recently and was pleasantly surprised by the positive changes in the food, and I must commend the exceptional service provided by Jyoti, Suraj, and Krishna. The service provided by them was exceptional, characterized by attentiveness, friendliness, and a genuine commitment to ensuring a positive dining experience.The food was exquisite and the ambience inviting. The upgraded flavors and variety compared to my previous visit were impressive. Kudos to the team for taking feedback positively and enhancing the dining experience. Highly recommend for a delightful culinary experience!

Attentetive staff in all areas, who make your stay extremely relaxed. Restaurant as well as ambience do very well differ from many standard places. Clean and well maintained in all areas. Excellent service from Sushma Magar. No communication problems at all.

The food and service was really flawless.Susmita, Pawan and Ajay were there to help me out with the provision of food and beverage. It was really great experience. Thank you Hyatt place for your kind courtesy.Namaste 🙏🙏

The hotel is incredible! Exquisitely decorated, not a single detail missing! Every member of the extended team at the hotel has the nicest attitude I’ve experienced.A special thank you to Chef Shankar and his team. He leads an incredible kitchen and restaurant with the most varied and delicious plates for breakfast, lunch and dinner.Thank you for the overall experience that highlights the natural beauty and magic of Nepal!

Absolutely wonderful hotel with a charming and helpful staff.  The restaurant is also the best place to eat in Kathmandu - the Nepalese food was delicious! The breakfast that comes with the room makes it wort the extra for the room.  You should stay at this hotel if you come to town.

This place is too nice and the ambience is good as the PLACE . Every time I came here with my friends and family every time they give us full satisfaction.  I usually like the vibe they give me and I suggest my friends to be here the pool is good and quite and thank you Raju the pool boy  . Especially thanks to Govinda for suggesting me new food and beverage items and providing us five star service . Thank you man. And thank you each member of Hyatt Place

Very nice bar and the staff is excellent and really polite and helpful. Beena in specific has been really eager to provide any information we wanted without any hesitation.  Great drinks and great staff. Excellent  ambience  and experience Thanks a lot Beena!

Just had an incredible stay. From the moment I stepped foot into the lobby, I was greeted with warm smiles and impeccable service. The attention to detail in every aspect of this hotel is truly remarkable.Friendly and welcoming team. The ZIng Restaurant was awesome Room was clean and comfortable

A pretty nice and quiet room with a great view and friendly staff in a recently built hotel. Unpractical bathroom, and a hotel  location which was out of town with poor shuttle service. Not up to European standards for the cost. While the food was pretty good the restaurant itself was uncomfortable (room service every night).

Awesome rooms, awesome service, awesome ambience, awesome food…. Everything about this hotel is just awesome. Pillows, mattresses, were soft fluffy, the Linen was spotlessly clean. Buffet breakfast spread was amazing. To top that, Omin and Juna were very courteous host. I would definitely suggest booking this hotel for your next visit to Kathmandu

It is a nice property with most of luxury which we can expect from Hyatt. Staff is very supportive and humble. Rooms are managed very well with good carpet area. Kitchen or buffet they need to improve. In veg they have limited items in breakfast, anyway taste of food is good. Ambiance is really nice and located in a very peaceful area.

Comfort stay. Very good team. Good food. Very clean. Must stay in Kathmandu. Its a bit away from main city but still closer to places of attraction. Special mebtion of Abhishek and Omin for making the stay much much cooler

We recently enjoyed a wonderful stay at Hyatt Place, where the staff, particularly Samriddhi and Karam, stood out for their exceptional service. From a seamless check-in to helpful recommendations, their dedication enhanced our experience. The well-maintained facilities and central location further contributed to a memorable visit. Highly recommend Hyatt Place for a comfortable and welcoming stay.

We had a great experience at Hyatt Place. The best part about the hotel was food. The kids loved it and so did we. I would seperately like to mention, Suvash, our server at the breakfast. He was quick and attentive and he made sure we had a great experience every single morning. All in all a good hotel with an extraordinary staff. Thank you.

This hotel is very good. It’s appears to be a new property, the staff mostly has trainees but they were awesome, very friendly, hospitable and cooperating. Few services like spa were unavailable but altogether a great place to stay. I can name a few trainees , Priya , Monisha , Ayush and all others were just excellent

It was an amazing time at ZING. Bartender Smriti excels in anticipating what customer exactly need. And Sushil on the other side, was very courteous. Thanks for the experience!!!!However, buffet dinner at coffee shop was not up to my expectation. It lacked choices.

Excellent place to stay. It's a new property, very elegant. We have never experienced such a prompt room service and for that matter all other responses. Food quality was really super and fantastic breakfast. Overall we thoroughly enjoyed our stay here. Highly recommended for others planning a trip to Kathmandu

We did office anniversary party in Hyatt Place, From sales team to Banquet team everyone did their best to serve us. Sales stayed late to show us venue and banquet team extend all possible support to us. Food was good, Staff were supportive with smily face.

Hyatt Palace is in centre of city, close to other 5 star properties. 10 minutes away from Durbar Square which is hub of Shopping plaza. Also, close to Themil, street food and shopping area. I primarily enjoyed the stay and also its close to Durbar Square, you are minutes away for any cravings for branded shopping

The hotel is exceptionally well in all the cases. Food and service is applaudable. All the staff members (Dipendra Mohorjon (Bartender)) are well mannered and deciplined and have a good professional courtesy. Hotel rooms provide a good view of Kathmandu

I am a world of Hyatt member. I travel a lot. Hyatt Place Kathmandu is by far the BEST one I've stayed. Exceptional service was given by EVERY member of the team. The staff went beyond their designated roles to serve. The housekeeping manager, Mr. Jeban, for example, offered to help get medicine for me when I wasn't feeling well. That's exceptional! Special thanks to the breakfast staff, all of them,  and their manager, Supriya Upreti. This is a GREAT team. I'll get in trouble if I name some and leave out others 😃The staff at dinner was excellent as well and served us exceptionally too. We got to know so many of them. They now feel like family to us. Keep up the good work everyone.  We hope to be back and bring others. Thanks a million!

My overall experience at the hotel was excellent. The food was finger licking good and the rooms had a superb view. The staffs were very polite, the housekeeping staffs, the receptionists. Samriddhi was so kind and always had a smile on her face. Anusha and corrina helped me alot too with all the places i want to visit in kathmandu and also helped me arrange transport for everywhere.

I’m immensely grateful for the outstanding team at this amazing hotel. Every encounter with the staff, especially Dipesh at the front desk, Suraj from the wait staff, and Bipin, the restaurant manager, has gone above and beyond, making my stay truly exceptional. The hotel itself is impressive, offering outstanding rooms and a delightful culinary experience. What sets this place apart, however, is not just its facilities but the genuine care and warm hospitality of the staff. Their dedication and attentiveness have made my stay one of the most memorable experiences in my journey. The overall atmosphere created by Dipesh, Suraj, Bipin, and the entire team truly exemplifies exceptional service.

We had a lovely Saturday brunch at zing restaurent. Excellent property hotel staff is extremely efficient, pleasant and helpful. swimming pool and  lobby very attractive and clean. I love this place i am soo pleased with the staff Raju coach and deepak They are very professional, knowledgeable and courteous. Highly recommended

Beautiful 5 star hotel  in the heart of Kathmandu city. Food is so good, staffs are amazing. Whole breakfast and dinner teams are very attentive and professional. My special thanks to Suresh,Rabin, Susmita, Aman and Gopal. If you traveling to Kathmandu, I highly recommend Hyatt Place and whole team.

We were a family of 4 holidaying in Kathmandu. We enjoyed the excellent service provided at the Hyatt Place, Kathmandu because of which we thoroughly the stay. Dipesh and Ayush for going beyond what was required and Sushant (Bartender), for fixing up some mean cocktails and Anu for her service at the restaurant.Besides this the food is worth mentioning. A stand out was the Awadhi Chicken Dum Biriyani - so much so that we ordered it thrice. Go for this hotel if you would want excellent service, food and location (very near to the key places in the city).

Lovely modern hotel with very friendly and informative staff. Especially Suvash at the Zing restaurant. Cannot comment on the rooms as we only went there for the pool brunch. Great selection of dishes at the buffet with live music. Wish the pool was heated as water was freezing cold despite the warm 27c daytime temperature.

My wife and I stayed at the Hyatt Place hotel few three nights. The staff were very friendly and welcoming. The food at the restaurant was excellkent, offering a wide range of dining options.The hotel is clean and modern and in a great location for sightseeing.

Everything is great about the place! The food, the rooms, the overall ambience of the hotel and also the staffs out there are really welcoming. Also they have live music on Saturday brunches I was lucky to be there on a Saturday. When you are in Kathmandu it’s a must visit place, they have a great vibe there which I’m sure will totally mesmerise you.

The whole staff was wonderful and accommodating. The bartender from my trip here in November remembered me and even remembered what I was drinking.Special thanks to the beautiful Sulochana and Dolma the Himalayan Princess for their wonderful service.

My stay here was fantastic throughout.  Rooms very spacious with good amenities.  Staff including front desk house keeping and Restaurant was very efficient and cooperative. Specially in the restaurant Mr. Rupesh, Mr. Krishna and Miss Badal were outstanding in providing services.  Food was delicious and variety of the food was awesome.

My stay was amazing at the Hyatt Place. Everything was great. Food was delicious with wide choices to pick from. The rooms were good too with an amazing view. The staffs were so helpful and kind. Staffs like Samriddhi, Anusha were really kind and always ready to help. I will surely recommend more of my friends to stay at your place.

We had went HYATT Place for small formal gathering. The hospitality of the newly built place is awesome. Five star rating. Staffs were well-informed regarding our arrival and everywhere went as per expectation. Delicious food. Especially RAJU greeted us  with big smile! Thank you RAJU and Hyatt place for best experience in the town!

The staff at Hyatt place were very attentive especially Bimala and Karan. The hotel was beautifully designed,  our overnight stay was comfortable and smooth. We were very impressed by the breakfast bar, overall a wonderful stay. Would highly recommend to anyone planning their Kathmandu trip!

Great Ambience, Good food, very kind n caring staff. Loved the time every staff gave us. Surprised us with a nice anniversary cake. We didn’t tell them but they were very attentive n realised the occasion when we exchanged the flowers.

The hotel and the staff have kept up the standards of the hotel as it was on our first visit. The staff make you feel at home without being intrusive. The hotel boasts of the best Indian food in town and we could not agree more.

The  rooms are so clean and the staffs are very polite. The overall ambience of the hotel is great. I had a great time staying here. Staffs like Anusha Samriddhi and yamika were very polite and always had a smile on their face

An amazing property with awesome views from the rooms. The best Indian food I've had ever. The sky bar has amazing nights featuring International DJs. This was my 3rd trip and I can't wait to be back again. The staff goes the extra mile to make you comfortable and create experiences.

I have stayed with my parents at the property to visit some temple and I find the place perfect for family and the Indian dishes were amazing. Staff were very accommodating, they even provided us fond farewell during out departure. Recommended for family, specially if you are travelling with your parents. They make sure to make your stay comfortable and safe l.

Was there during banquet event, meeting with dinner. Buffet was impressive, tasty foods with good choice. Snacks were enough; accompanying drinks. Service people were very friendly and smiley. Barman was smiling and making cocktail with changes. Also, one guy who seems incharge of place was actively interacting.

I recently went to Hyatt Place and had an exceptional experience, largely due to the outstanding service provided by one of the front desk staff member Abhishek Acharya. Abhishek went above and beyond to ensure that my visit was comfortable and enjoyable. His professionalism, attentiveness, and friendly demeanor truly stood out, making me feel valued as a guest. I highly recommend this hotel, especially for the exceptional service provided by a very professional staff.

We stayed for 3 nights when visiting Nepal. We had a wonderful experience and look forward to staying here in future. It's relatively new hotel in a nice location. Overall food was good and we really loved the wide range of breakfast options. Staff were attentive and super helpful. Definitely recommend it!

It was excellent 👌 the hotel employees are great. The front desk personnel couldn't be more helpful and kindDipesk Yanika and in general all the employees were very helpful at all times. The hotel is.very neat and I will recommend to all my friends

We were greeted with warm abience and friendly staff. The food and drinks were delicious, and the flavor and taste were just right for our palate. Thank You Zing team - Suvash, Ajaya, Nabaraj, and Chefs Prem & Surendra. Keep up the great work, we really loved the overall experience.

I personally recommend the place beautiful room view amazing food. Never feel like missing home .. so friendly staff specially chefs and servers. Chef Pandey is taking care very personally to all of us ... thanks you chef. amazing hospitality

Amazing hotel, great rooms and absolutely stunning view. Only issue we had was the Landry service took our bag we brought from home but we just took the one given instead. Pool was nice but not very fitting for how cool it was in the city. Wonderful tourism spots and great guides. Food was pretty good and I didn’t have much issues. Like most hotels have figured out, you prioritize dinner buffet which was very good. The breakfast was also very good!

Very impressive choice of hotel in Kathmandu. Really is a 5 star valued hotel. Good security and the lobby was so welcoming on entry. Staff was amazing and attention to details and very energetic and takes initiative without being asked. We got a free upgrade to the top level and and amazing view of the city and Swayambhubnath Temple. Spacious and clean room with amenities. Food at restaurant for breakfast and ala carte dinner is superb.Will highly recommend and will be the choice hotel everytime from now on.Special thanks to Bimala, Varun and Team.

Best hotel out of 6 we have been to in this trip. Food was amazing they have a good variety of food ranging from spicy and not spicy that we could actually eat. The service was superb everyone was so caring and always smiling.Everyday the breakfast got better!

Food is fresh and chefs are good. I frequently visit zing restaurants and find serving staff namely Jyoti, Omin, Rupesh, Dipendra, Pema, Som Krishna are always eager to serve which is the hallmark of this business. They know my and my family preferences.

My stay at hyatt was very pleasant. The rooms have an amazing view and the food is delicious. All staffs are so helpful and kind. Samriddhi and Yamika at the reception always have a smile on their and tries to help the guest in everywhere. I was delighted by your service.

The overall experience was nice and I enjoyed my stay. I would recommend this to my dear ones and will consider this for my future trips. The breakfast buffet was good and there was a variety of food options. Chef Prem and Chef Chetnath are so kind and help us to try the best food in Kathmandu.

We, Ascent Consultancy Services, recently organized a 2-day CMMI service training on March 15 and 16, 2024. Throughout the event, the hotel's service was exceptional. Ms. Rosha Maharjan from the sales department extended significant cooperation in facilitating our program, and Mr. Ajish Maharjan, responsible for managing the hall, played a crucial role in ensuring the success of our event. The hospitality exhibited by the entire team at Hyatt Place greatly contributed to our positive experience, prompting us to consider hosting future corporate events at their venue. I highly recommend Hyatt Place to other guests as well. Thank you for your outstanding service.

Warm friendly Hyatt Place Hotel staff makes you feel at home.  For a picky eater like me, I enjoyed the Biryani, Grilled fish, and the meal in the bowl.Service in the training venue was really good.  The staff were supportive and readily helped and attended to us when in need.I also liked their playlist.

The rooms are very spacious. The service was excellent. The rooms were kept very clean and the dinner was amazing, a lot of variety and very tasty. Sushma made and wonderful masala tea and her service was of a very high standard. An overall wonderful experience.

We had a three-day training session at the hotel , and we had a good experience . The staffs were really friendly and helpful , specially Mr. Ajish who helped us a lot during all the sessions through out the day. Overall it was a nice experience.

Subansh was serving us . He is helpful . Thanks. Loved the food , the ambience. Management and staffs were helpful . You have to Keep coming  with offers , so that you can attract all kinda customers . You even have to add few more items to your menu .

The event was very good every staff was very helpful ,food was amazing specially the bartender SURAJ . wedding went smoothly and very good.I enjoyed very much with the barman. He was very generous and his performance was very very very much enjoyable.

Very friendly staff! The restaurant is very nice with an amazing selection of food items on the brunch buffet. The chefs are amazing with their smiles. Very new hotel with a young star. Recommended for friends and family get together. Thank you Hyatt... Thank you Team...

Amazing place to stay. Very friendly staff. Food is the lip smacking. Rooms with beautiful views of mountain. I remember few names like chef Pandey Anu omin and all are too polite. Must recommend this hotel. Complete family stay

The cheerful staff makes Hyatt Place Kathmandu my favorite.  Welcoming, vibrant and helpful.  Always start my day with breakfast at hotel.  Why?  Warm greetings with wonderful selections.  What a way to start the day!  And, sometimes after a long busy day, a quiet dinner back at HPK restores and relaxes.  Thank you to the front of house, wait staff, chef, and his kitchen team.  Dipendra Maharjun keeps my coffee filled.

I went with  family/friends 6  ladies on a pilgrimage trip to Kailash mansarovar, Muktinath, Janakpur Pokhra  etc.Our hub was Hyatt Place. Which we used in between our visit to the holy places.Excellent hotel, with excellent, polite staff.Nothing was to much trouble. 5 star plus hotel, unfortunately renovation was going on with the spa and pool out of action.Food was amazing. Bhol Bahadur sous chef and the chef was very pleasant and kind,  if we preferred anything else. The staff on front desk was amazing, can't remember the name of the   young lady think it was taraza and what a smile young rashib always had who took care of our luggage.Also the young lady supervisor in the dining area from Mumbai was very helpful.

Out stay at Hyatt Place was beyond expectations. The rooms were so spacious and equipped with good quality amenities. The service by Deepak Yadav, our server during our business meetings was exceptional, and the overall hospitality of all of your staff was what highlighted our stay

The guests sevice is excellent, all employees are so friendly, front desk manage is so kind, prabha morning restaurant server is the ornament of the property. The morning and evening restaurant service is welcoming. I recommend this property as a perfect destination for the guests.

My stay at Hyatt was very pleasant. I have come to Kathmandu before also but this was my first time at Hyatt place. The hospitality and service was impeccable. The food was very tasty and the rooms were very good. The restaurant staff were very polite. Everyone was really good at the reception too and one girl her name was samruddhi she was very helpful and had a sweet nature. When I come to Kathmandu again I will surely come back to Hyatt place.

Pros:Friendly staffs, most of them always smiling with an eye contact, clean room with nice view. Personalised service, the varieties of breakfast alot to choose for, the best was Masala Omlete was superb. The ambiance of Zing.Cons:No Astray in Smoking room.Upon C/O I wasn't asked if my stay was great. I think its the C/O standard to ask every guest.No Valet Parker. However, ample space for self parking.P.S. Overall experience was great, Kudos to Govinda, Priya from Zing and the friendly guy Milan who checked me in.I was enrolled Hyaat Membership programme however I am yet to receive their email that I am enrolled, which we usually do. I am looking forward to receiving it.

The accommodation fantastic and the food at the ZING restaurant was phenomenal. The menu is varied but the Chef nailed every dish, each better than the last. No need to leave the hotel as everything is at your disposal. The staff are warm and friendly and helped us with anything we needed.

Corina shrestha prastina, sagun and Bimala manandhar found delivered a wonderful servive. I found them very supportive and hospitable, they will be successful in their career ahead. Facilities them more so they can provide lot to customers and enhance the image of this hotel

The hospitality of this hotel is outstanding. The rooms are spacious and extremely clean. Special regards to Inam, who has been a road map for us throughout our stay in Katmandu, his knowledge of the place is in depth. Thank you for that. We will soon visit again, to explore the other side of Nepal

I complained 3 times to Reception  due to continuous disturbance by banging doors and peoele chatting in the corridors at any time of day or night. No any Action was taken. Room door insulation is nothing. Nice hotel with terrible experience due to zero customer care.

The hotel is new and seems to have sorted out its teething problems so it is running very smoothly. The staff really make a difference and handle everything so well. The rooms are beautiful and the view of Swayambhunath from the hotel room is spectacular. After a day out in the exuberant chaos of Kathmandu it is really so nice to return to the calm modern interiors of Hyatt Place.

Overall good ambience. Hence, want to suggest to add event wise theme, maybe photobooth. Food and beverages were up to the point. Ajish helped me personally with my issue by keeping my phone in charge as my phone was running out of battery. It maybe a small help from him but I found it a very nice gesture.

They have one of the best restaurants in the city. I would highly recommend Black Bean Chicken Bowl, Risotto, Daal Makhani & Chicken Tikka. They have got a brilliant team in the food & service department as well! Thank you Luzah, Sajjjan & the chefs for your great hospitality.

Being a Hyatt colleague I would like to thank Hyatt place really appreciate it and  the lady who help me  during the breakfast I dint remember the name sorry for that  but specially I would like to thank mr Sunil . Highly recommend because he will make U feel like you  are the one .Once again thank you Mr Sunil .

We would like to thank Hyatt place for. Providing. Such a great hospitality and delicious food. Bikram with a wonderful smile and great personality helped us throughout the event and provided assistance for everything we required. Suraj ghorsane was rocking at the bar. Loved the personalized service and delicious food. Would recommend Hyatt place for everyone for further events. Lovely place with great service.

Hyatt Place Kathmandu, absolute great hospitality and service, thanks to entire team.Would like to thank following team members with whom we communicated during stay-front desk guys Ashish and Laxmi for smooth check inn and travel arrangements for 2 days.Chef Baburam for all 3 days unique lunch and dinner arrangements. Entire restaurant team &In-housekeeping team Deepak.

Hyatt Place Kathmandu is one of the best properties in town with very friendly staffs and amazing food variety. The hotel has very beautiful ambience to hang out with friends and family for quality time. Saturday brunch was yummy 😋 😄

The stay at Hyatt place is exceptional with an unlimited options in breakfast. The hotel staff are very nice and friendly. The limited timings of pool are little bit troublesome but it’s clean and tidy. Had a splendid time and definitely stay again.

The food was great, lots of varieties. The service was good as well, with child friendly environment. Live music was an added entertainment. Overall we had a very great experience and service. Thank you Hyatt place team.

I had a fantastic stay at Hyatt Place. My check in was smooth, even though I arrived very late at night. The facilities are excellent, with a spacious room with modern appliances. The staff were incredibly welcoming and went above and beyond throughout my stay. Special mention must be made to Aashish and Abishek on the front desk, whose local insight was invaluable and helped book taxis for me to navigate Kathmandu. It was also a pleasure to speak with Bena at the poolside.I would wholeheartedly recommend the hotel for those staying in Kathmandu.

Zing sky lounge and bar has a nice ambience. My husband and I  ordered some food. We loved  the chef's signature dish which was very good.  The service  provided by Beena was prompt and excellent. We enjoyed having dinner there.

Food was amazing ..pizza  and meal in a bowl was so delicious and the service done by Sushant,suzen was very nice. ..the way they recommend the food and the way they talk was very nice and humble...and thank you Hyatt place  for giving us the opportunity to get this type of food and service..

Excellent service, I was being cheered up with reviving soul and mind welcome drinks with genuine welcome. Check in was so smooth. Though buffet breakfast I was being served as a special guest. Thanks to the person and his entire team who served me. Thanks to the manager and her front office team including the telephone operator. Special thanks to Neelam Dhungana ( Assistant Manager, Human Resources) for offering the opportunity to meet colleagues in the colleagues restaurant " The Hive" though I wasn't able to manage the timing. It made my stay memorable.

My stay at Hyatt place was excellent. The rooms and the ambience if the hotel is so good and calm. The staff's are so polite and helpful. Food is very nice. Staffs like Yamika Jay and Samriddhi were very helpful to me during my stay.

We had a lovely stay at Hyatt Place during our visit to Kathmandu this past week. The property is extremely well maintained and the team’s hospitality is outstanding. Ajaya, Sushmita and Anu have been extremely helpful as was Srijana at the front desk. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here and highly recommend!

We really liked the ambience and the food was delicious.The service given by priya and smriti was nice.The small complement cake they provides us made our day even more special.We"ll definitely visit this place soon.Thank you zing sky bar and lounge for making our day really special

Thank you for your heartwarming service! We really enjoyed our stay, the modern welcoming and clean rooms, the food and most important the wonderful personnel!! Special thanks to Nilam, Dipem, Laxmi, Golu and the rest of their team 🙂 will recommend the stay at Hyatt Place at home

Nice new property. The rooms are decent sized and quite modern. The hotel does not have any open spaces but is called modernly replaced. The restaurant has a decent service. The Chef Babu Ram took very good care. Also, the young chef Umesh Taman took very care as well.

We choose to stay for 2 nights at Hyatt Place Kathmandu on our way back from the mountains of Nagarkot. Hotel allocated us a higher floor room with a magnificent mountain view. The front office team were amazing and so were food and beverage team. Also this hotel serve halal food for the muslim travellers. Highly recommended.

The food and the service here is really good. I was here for my parents anniversary and the staffs treated us really well. They were really humble and polite. They even presented us with a small pastry and that was really cute. I would recommend everyone to come-here as couples friends or family.

We wanted some quick authentic Indian food taste wise and the place didn’t disappoint. We were received and assisted warmly by Ms. Nilam at the restaurant. Chef Chetanath was spot on with the Indian flavours. Will definitely recommend it again.

I came for a staycation at hyatt place with my friends and it was one of the best one. All the facilities at the hotel were up to the mark. It was just that we wanted heated swimming pool and it was not there neither jacuzzi. Rest everything was great. Food was very tasty and staff were very helpful and kind. Restaurant staff, reception staff especially Samridhi, shagun and anusha were very kind. I will surely suggest it to more of my friends and colleagues to come and visit this place.

Had visited Kathmandu for a business trip and stayed at Hyatt Place for around 10 nights. Loved the charm of this hotel. The room was spacious, vibrant and clean. The bed was extremely comfortable. The staff was very kind, caring and professional. They went above and beyond to ensure our stay was comfortable. The food was delicious. Covid protocols were duly followed. This place really felt like home!! I will definitely stay here even in my future visits to Kathmandu. The location of the hotel is really good and the rooms have great views. I highly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Kathmandu.

I , my wife and my sisters went to have dinner at Hyatt Place on my anniversary. The hotel and it was very peaceful. Sky lounge and bar were so good. We were very happy there. The food was awesome and the staffs were too good. They were smiley, cheerful, and very kind. Anjali, Govinda, and Priya was the most loveable one. We were overwhelmed by their services and their heart-touching behavior.

My experience at hyatt was great. Everything was superb, the rooms, the food and also the staff was so good. Jay and Samriddhi helped me alot during my stay, samriddhi always lent an extra hand to help me. Your service and hospitality is very nice. The overall ambience of the hotel is very calm and soothing.

All the Hotel staffs are very attentive, polite and cooperative. They have made our stay here very comfortable. Rooms are very clean. Breakfast is good. Our dinner was delicious. Highly recommend the Iranian cello kebabs platter. Nilam, Jyoti and Pema were superb.

Excellent service and good food. Breakfast has a good choice of food. Rooms clean and great view. The staff is very friendly and the coffee is really good. Govinda provided brilliant service at the pool bar  and really went out of his way to accomondate our needs.

The stay was excellent. It was a great experience for me. Sonam and Anusha from front desk offered great help and service. The Breakfast was superb, Room service was very polite, Rashib was very helpful with luggage assistance. All an all great experience. looking to visit again.

Amazing hospitality. Really love their wide variety of food that they serve with instant services. It was a beautiful experience. Thankyou Hyatt for taking a good care of me and my team. Would definetly visit again and highly recommend their masala tea 😅

Newly opened hotel at heart of city, neat and clean environment. Professional and well trained staff. I recommend everyone to stay if you would like to experience 5star service. Since arrival till departure meet several staff Laxmi at front desk, Srijana, Mohan, Prakash and  I believe hotel manager Mr Amar is awesome always ready to help with our request.Good luck guys and hope to see you all soon …Glad  that new chain  Hyatt added in Kathamndu.

Property is new and excellent. New Rooms well maintained hotel.The staff was very Cooperative. The staff at the restra was even more cooperative. The Location is though too far from Airport, however the Hotel is value for Money.

Aashish and Milan made sure our trip was hassel-free and comfortable. We felt welcomed and the breakfast was the highlight. When in Kathmandu it is advised from my side to book accommodation in Hyatt Place. Breakfast is sumptuous and have different options each day.

Service was very excellent i loved it. They were very polite and sincerely doing their work . Especially Anjali was her name . She was very polite and humble towards uss.. Place was very peaceful with good environment. Foods were also very yummy 😋 and cocktail 🍸 were very good.

It was an excellent experience with Hyatt place Katmandu. Comfortable room, delicious food, friendly staffs. I would like to come back again in this place. I should mention about a staff name Sujen, every morning he welcome us with wide smile and his friendly gesture. He even remember our coffee/ tea and fruit order during complementary buffet breakfast. I is indeed a nice and safe place to stay in Katmandu.

A special thanks to sky bar team and lounge who provided us a wonderful time and most of all the bartender Arbin Gurung and the service provided by Sushil shrestha was really pleasant. Will be here soon. It was also good to talk with Anil Adhikari and Milan who were doing a great job as they were responsible for maintenance and everything.

One of our best stay at a Hyatt in the entire world. Me and my wife travelled with a small baby and the hotel staff went above and beyond in ensuring we had a good stay at the hotel. Hotel staff are prompt, responsive and courteous as well. This hotel is easily one of the nicest hotel property in Kathmandu.

Great food. There were a lot of options for food, from fresh fruits to idli and sambar. The staff was so nice and attentive. The service was amazing and really went out of their way for our table. It was a wonderful time!

Good property with amazing and delicious food. The staff is always there ro help amd very polite. People at the reception arr very sweet. Abhishekh, corrina, samriddhi and karma helped me alot. My stay was very pleasant. Whenever i come to kathmandu i will stay at hyatt place. My daughter was very happy with samriddhi she treated her like her sister.

It is a very nice place I usually stay at the bar and the bartender Sushant over there is very nice .He always prepares me awesome drinks. A good hearted, soft speaker  and very helpful. I love the food of Hyatt too.

Our experience at Hyatt Place Kathmandu was super heartwarming. Everything was prompt,  from the reservations until check out, it was all perfect. The staff, especially Laxmi,Bandana, Milan, Mohan, Dipesh, Karuna, Abhishek, Priya and the most caring one, Puja. She will greet you every morning with the most beautiful smile ever, that would make your day.( you can't see her smile because of the face mask). We stayed here 4 nights and were so emotional while leaving. This place is just like HOME.  They even surprised my friend with a cake at midnight for her birthday. All the craziest requests we made,these guys fulfilled it. You guys are the best. Love,Claudia and Moe.

The food and The service was top notch. Shraddha Prajapati jee who attended to us was amaZING… tended with great finesse and care. The specials on the menu were to die for.  Cannot recommend this place nuff

I loved Hyatt place. The service is amazing and the food variety is awesome. Sushil and Govinda took care of us and they are really good. They also made me meet with chef Rukesh and food prepared from him was lovely. The chef in Zing were also very helpful with me and my family for Brunch.

The hotel staff is very friendly and very welcoming. We were stayed there for 3 nites and the stay was really nice. Samigla will be there at the front desk and she will always be smiling and helping. Abhishek Enam every one at the lobby is just great.

Its always been a pleasurable dining experience here. Tried Rjasthani menu today. Like always the restaurant staff are very humble .Very impressed with the service showcased by Suraj Maharjan and the head chef.

The breakfast is so good. I love this hotel. Restaurants staff help me with food. Front office team enam and pusha help me.Rashib help us with luggage , taxi, and always give us umbrella when we are going out. He always take care of us. He is helpful to guest.See you soon Hyatt place

I recommend this hotel for multiple reasons like a good and hygienic breakfast with local masala tea. Good view from room and supporting staff at front desk ,dinning areas and cafeteria. Overall excellent service.

Its a newly built property soo everything was neat & clean. Good food.. But the location is not very good and its interior doesn’t look very luxurious as we see in other Hyatt hotels. But according to nepal’s point of view its one of the best properties.

The ambience of zing was amazing! I loved the food as well, and honestly the service we got from suraj was just amazing! Whenever you go, try the himalayan dumpling soup, it is just so good. Id definitely recommend people to go and try it! Worth spending

It was my 3rd visit. The greatest asset of the property was the ever smiling team, so caring. I received special attention in the breakfast area as they took care of my high protein healthy breakfast. In the Front desk Parzena, Pushpa, Korina and of course Bimla obliged my all requirements with a cute smile. Definitely come again in October to have a clear views of Himalayan peaks.

The service, hospitality, and management are excellent. The staff is very friendly and attentive. Special thanks to Sonam from the front desk, who helped me by arranging spas and taxis on multiple occasions, and Nilam from the restaurant for service and helpful advice.  The room was spacious, very clean, with a beautiful view. Thank you to the entire team of Hyatt Place Kathmandu for making my stay so nice. See you next year!

I’m truly impressed by the service. Special service by Sonam,Anusha,Praveena,Kripesh.Really loved the warmth,care and hospitality.Bless u all. My family enjoyed food, ambience, I truly believe Hyatt has employed the best team I have ever met.

My wife & I stayed here on our visit to Kathmandu and cannot recommend it highly enough, the only negative is that we didn't want to leave... 😂The staff were all amazing, the hotel is stunning and the food... the food is some of the best food we have had on our trip and we have been travelling for the past 7 months!We would definitely recommend staying here and using this as a base to check out Kathmandu!

The event was good ..The food was delicious specially the DANCING bartender .he was kind and generous. the event at thr hotel was superb.?I very delightful and hope to experience the service. Thank you Hyatt and the bar boy suraj ghorsaine .

Good ambience with great infrastructure n class interior. Breakfast was good and the service provided was satisfactory. Love to visit  again for dinner. Signature hotel with good room n restaurant.  Hotel is providing room n food with discounted price.

#we had a very nice stay at Hyatt place. It was very nicely furnished and room was very need and clean. When I visit the swimming pool I meet the Raju he guide me how to swime. The whole experience was awesome the Housekeeping guy Deepak is very helpful.

visited Hyatt Place after long time for breakfast. we were warmed welcomed by Mr. Mohan and his team. Breakfast was delicious as always, specially liked the bakery items today. omin served us today very humble and friendly. Thank you Hyatt Place KTM team for the great service

We went to hyatt place for a social event. We would love to recommend everyone to hyatt place for family events and work events. The staffs are very professional. The food was really delicious. Would like to thank suraj ghorsane at the bar and bikram at the buffet for providing suc a wonderful service and experience. Over all ambience was wonderful. Love hyatt place. Would recommend everyone for future events and meetings. Thanks for your great hospitality.

My experience at Hyatt place was overwhelming. The food is very tasty I ordered alot and I love their jhol momos. The staff is so polite and very friendly. People at the reception are very helpful. Samridhi Anusha and karma were very helpful and very kind. Hyatt gives an awesome hospitality. The gym is very clean and the zing bar upstairs is very great. Shisha is very good. I will surely come back to hyatt

An overall poor experience. The hotel didn't recipt my room payment and tried to charge me again. I booked a transfer  to the airport and it didn't even cone on time making us late. It was horrible as we were quiet anxious about catching the flight. It was just bad

The hotel is an amazing new property nested in the city centre. Nice and good service with very warm hospitality across the board with smiling staff. Rooms are decently sized . Would recommend stay to leisure and business traveller both at the same time

Been in almost all major hotels in Kathmandu, but this scores hands down in all categories. Amazing location and brand new set up, but more importantly what hospitality & service. Food which will certainly make you overindulge 😊 Thank you Varun and team, for the seven star experience. You guys rock 👍

The staff was very caring and the food was excellent. The pasta was very good as well as the burger. The lemon ice tea was very refreshing. The environment was very nice and the people were amazing. The paintings around the setting made the restaurant even better.

This hotel is one of the best I've ever stayed at. The rooms are beautiful, the facilities are well-designed, the breakfast is out of this world, but what really makes this hotel spectacular is the staff. I've never experienced such a personalized experience at a hotel. 100% recommended!

The hotel is very clean and the staff is very, very, very friendly. The rooms where neat and clean. The breakfast had a huge variety of food. Me as a huge sweet food fan, can say that lacked some options of sweet. They were very few and not that tasty. Highlight for Jyoti and Sushma Magar, they were very nice with me and friendly. Loved the buttermilk and since we do not have in Brazil I asked for the recipe. Next Morning they shared with me! Thanks a lot you both and also the whole staff

Great place to stay in Kathmandu, Nepal. Nice hospitality, great food and warm welcome by the staff. Great service and guidance for travelling around the city. Ashish from Frontoffice really helped a lot and acted as a guide for us, really helpful guy and very generous. I recommend this place for tourist coming from abroad and local. Thumbs up 👍

Best stay in Kathmandu! The most amazing, warm and helpful staff I have ever come across in all my travels. Can’t praise them enough. Special mention of the delicious spread by the Head Chef Rakesh Pandey. The food absolutely marvellous, with great variety and fresh flavours. The property is absolutely beautiful and one of the best places to stay in Kathmandu. Highly recommended.

I have stayed 3 nights here one of the best place I could say to stay and booked this hotel. From the arrival moment and through out of my stay it was so great morning breakfast was great. We had a dinner at restaurant which was so great. Staff are so friendly and welcoming. Overall everything was just perfect stay.

Very nice property, all the staffs are too generous. Reception team is exceptional- Dipesh , kiran and one more lady ( forgot her name) Zinc lounge is superbly located. Pool is ok. Breakfast menu ( veg ) was good with plenty of Indian varieties- idli, dosa, poha, puri bhaji and many more

Had a nice stay . Food is nice and polite staffs Thank you for service Aashish and Kiran .Highly recommended will come for next stay Nice hotel beautiful city and Kathmandu visited first time every thing made us felt like wonderful 👍👍👍

We would like to thank hyatt place for providing such a nice hospitality . The food was really good. We would like to thank suraj ghorsane for best drinks at the bar he was really rocking. And Bikram was taking a very good care of the buffet. Food was really delicious .event was well organized . Love to visit Hyatt place once again and would recommend everyone to organize social events at Hyatt place. Probably the best place at katgmandu

The people are so nice and the kind of service they provide is really excellent. The staff is well mannered . I am happy with the gesture provided to our family during the stay. I recommend the stay here in good budget and good atmosphere

I had a excellent experience at hyatt. It is one of the best hotels in kathmandu. The staffs are so polite and kind. Always ready to help. The rooms had an amazing view of the kathmandu city. The hotel's infrastructure is rich and posh. The food is finger licking good. Im sure if i stayed a bit more longer i would have gained 10 pounds. The restaurant staff is very kind especially Samridhi. She was so kind and polite to talk to and her service was excellent. She always had a cheerful smile on her face. I will definitely come back to hyatt and suggest more of my friends to come here. I will specially come back for the hospitality and food.

Nice place to stay.Staff very welcoming.Very nice ambience.I had been alone,i guess even staying with family is worth.I was staying on the 12th floor was a little noisy because some renovation was going on, other wise nice place to stay.

The staffs were very welcoming. And the buffet breakfast served is probably the best I have ever had in a hotel. The hotel is very clean and is located in a quiet location. I would definitely come and stay in Hyatt Place Kathmandu again.

It’s was very nice experience over here , staff is very sweet obedient and kind heart. I want to convey my special thanks to Sajan and Dipanker who take care of our family during whole day. They served very good breakfast 🤗. Highly recommended

Nice place, but a bit outside the center so you need a taxi wherever you go. Comfy beds, excellent reception stuff which is really helpful with all requests. Haven’t tried the restaurants. Pool is not heated, so only usable in summer. A good for conferences with lots of people

It is my second time here and I liked the overall experience here, the ambiance, rooms, overall service and the price is affordable too. I love  the food here. Thanks Sunil Thapa , thanks Hyatt Place.

Great hotel, excellent restaurant and friendly People at the reception.The beds where very good, the rooms are clean and the airco helped to get a friendly climate.Special thanks to the most friendly and capable staff, Susmita, Pawan and Nabraj,They helped to make our stay extra special.If you are looking for a relaxed address in hectical Kathmandu the Hyatt place certainly can be recommended.

Sushma was amazing and show great character and serve with a cheerful smile always willing to serve us. I highly recommend her best service ever ! She always approachable and will to assist at any given time when called apon. She the best ! I highly recommend her!!!

The hotel is not too far from the international airport.  I had a suite which was very large, comfortable, and clean.  There was a nice view of the mountains from my room.  The breakfast is complimentary and was quite a spread and delicious. I would definitely recommend for a short stay!

Fab stay - exploring Nepal with my son. The hotel is fantastic to stay in. Decor, styling , food , service , room size, etc to drawer. We stayed there on arrival and also before departure. Happy place and definite destination to return to. Wishing the hotel team the very best.

I stay 8 nights doing my 1st trip @katumandu. It was good experience.Staff are all very kind. Breakfast never get bored.. everyday enjoyed different local foods.Housekeeping service are very fast and good! I will definitely comeback again! Thank you so much!!

The hotel and the team go beyond anyone's expectations to make you comfortable. Excellent view from the rooms and amazing dining experience both in terms of food and service. If you are looking for Indian and Asian food, this is the place to be in Kathmandu.

A very warm place, the staff was welcoming and the facilities were kept neat and clean. Enjoyed every moment being at the hotel. Though somethings could be better, but I guess it would only become better since the hotel is a new one. Would have given a 5, but there is a slight improvement needed. Rest asured to have a pleasant experience

Me along with my 2 friends really had a great time and experience at the hotel ‘s Zing sky bar.The open bar along with swimming pool with lights  carried awesome ambiance.Furthermore the food they served was delicious and fast.I highly recommend this fantastic place.Also I would like to thank Ms Anzeli And Mr Purna for their hospitality.They were always around for the best service we can expect.

Very clean hotel all the staff very friendly and helpful polite. The atmosphere in the restaurant, lobby reception etc very calm relaxed. As I had a diet requirement the kitchen staff were very good, in making my request.  I will definitely recommend to friends and family’s

The Ireland Wolves cricket team had a fantastic 3 weeks staying at the Hyatt Place. Huge thanks Sabin Man Shrestha, his team andChef Baburam. Outstanding service from all staff. The best hotel I have stayed in and I’ve been to many across the world

All services is good      Good breakfast .cleaning full service good staff good food. Everything is amazing nice view see from windowIt’s everything is perfect food taste is so good nice Staff nicely talking

Had a grateful time with friends. The food was really good and the service by Sushil was excellent Mr raju helped me with swimming . The cocktails was really smooth and tasty. Loved the big wow and will be back soon

Must visit Hyatt place. Great ambiance food and service. Highly recommend.I visited this zing restaurant with famil, was very impressed with the food and ambiance. Very welcoming team of Hyatt place. Aman Ranjit he was very humble.

Wonderful food and wonderful service. Kudos to chef who prepared the food and service team special mention to Mr. BIKRAM. Venue was wonderful as well. Highly recommended for others who wanna organize any sort of program here.

Good ambience great staff service warm welcome and great service provided. Chain hotel @ Hyatt group posh interior and good price offer for local citizens. Hope to visit this hotel again for dinner and during summer for swimming n brunch.

Aashish from house keeping is a well knowledgeable and humble person. His way of guiding guests is invaluable. He's very polite well groomed and helpful in nature. Apart from that the hotel is amazing and very much recommended.

I regularly stay at your place. I always feel comfortable n relaxing.This time I sometimes have to work at the hotel.Rina gave me a good housekeeping service. I appreciate.I hope to come back again. T Kikukawa

A truly awesome experience! Our vacation was improved staying here. Great views of the Mountains from your rooms. Tasty food at breakfast and in the restaurant throughout the day. Very pleasant and helpful staff.......a definite recommendation if you were to visit.

The rooms are clean and beds are comfortable. The quality of breakfast is great. The wi-fi connection is good too. The servers in the restaurant is kind, especially Sajan, he is a kind server too,and his service is excellent. The restaurant experience and the resting quality made me pleasant during my journey.

We had a wordenrful time here, safe and clean hotel. Very kind and profesional staff, like te waiter of the Zing Bar, Govinda...he is great!!!. It has been a good place to stay in Kathmandú. Good food, also for westernes.

Facilities, staff, and food are all excellent.  The room was well furnished with good AC and hot shower.  The fitness gym was clean and had all the necessary equipment.  The food and drinks at the poolside bar were well done.  Overall, the environment of the hotel was better than expected!

Extremely good behaviour at all touch points. Responsive, sincere and caring.Food at Zing@Ground Floor was very good. Ajay was very helpful in suggesting the right dishes. Overall an excellent experience…as always, at Hyatt.Room offered was excellent. Offered nice city view.

Been there once with my friends. Their ambience is good , food is good too . They provide with good service. Personally, safe for women (imo). Thank you to Mr. Sabin , Mr. Arbin , Ms. Priya and Ms. Smriti for their service. Trying to go again

I suggest to try bhatti ka murg, Iranian chelo kabab was great. Sanjeev, Sujen  and Navaraj was friendly and helpful during service. You should visit here once if you stay in Kathmandu. Ambience was good and service was great

Hyatt Place is great venue for the events, programs and other activities. Thanks to Hyatt Place team for great service specially Bikram. We Nafij and NADA had great event here. Food was good and every staff were great.

Aaahish ana Animesh from House keeping have really helped me keeping my room clean. They have made my stay a good experience.They are doing remarkable job in their domain. Wish you both a great success in their future endeavor:)

I am here for a dinner with my friends and the food is amazing as well as service.I always feel this place like my home  this place complete your event & party they give there best in case of service,time everything. Food of hyatt place is top notch in ktm valley. Specially mention Rupesh Nawaraj & pema were one of my favourites.

Nice ambitious with great music. The staff here are very welcoming .Good place to visit. The food here is also nice. We were served by Mr suraj and he was very polite and welcoming. Its a bit expensive but still you can visit it once

Amazing place to hangout/party with friends. The menu options are excellent value especially for girls aloud in Zing Sky Bar. Service was excellent by Zing Sky Bar team ( Sushil, Arbin,Smriti,Priya). Food were awsome and cocktail too. Thank you for your great hospitality.

Warm hospitality. The team s extremely helpful and Courteous. Minute details were taken care and stay was made special by the everyone. Great food. Breakfast layout was extensive and good selection. The property is well located and being new is well maintained .

New property by Hyatt, conveniently located with staff who are always on their toes to make your stay wonderful.I had absolutely amazing experience right from the checkin to checkout.Spacious room, super efficient staff.

We checked in for a weekday getaway to this beauty of a place, didn't feel like we were in Kathmandu during our stay.Yummy indian food at Zing, the sky bar is super chill and really hospitable staff. Must book a stay.

We stayed in Hyatt place for five nights.The hotel room was clean and spacious.view from room was fantastic especially in the night time.Hotel staff was very helpful special thax to Amit,Aashish,Abhishek and sahil from front office and house keeping member Abhishek. I would love to stay again in this hotel if I will get a chance to visit Nepal in future

It's a beautiful hotel with extremely well polished team, and a stunning city view from each room.  The aesthetic of the hotel is detailed and the food is splendid. A pleasant experience overall, highly recommended!

The Hyatt Place is very good hotel to stay and all the staffs are polite and service was good. The young guys like Rashib, Puspa, Raju, Enam, Satan and Rupesh are really helped me a lot. Good luck to these young guys for their future and good career in life.

Visiting from US to Nepal and stayed at this hotel. Excellent hotel, nice breakfast. Dependra Maharjan was very hospitable, professional and helpful, excellent service. I will for sure stay again at this hotel, very nice hotel to stay before doing any activities near base camp.

Everything was exceptional. The rooms were cozy and comfortable. Food was good. The staff was warm and welcoming specially Krishna was very nice and friendly. If you check out early they even pack your breakfast.We enjoyed our stay. Really nice.

We had an amazing experience at Zing World of flavours for brunch. Good music, ambiance was nice, food was delicious and the best part was the service from Shraddha. Highly recommend and will be back for sure

Excellent Experience, Very good room, good quality breakfast and the most important was staff, excellent service specially from all young boys and girls. Also gods quality Buffet and value for money.  They could have make batter coffee shop but rest all was perfect

Rooms were clean, very comfortable, and the staff was amazing. The food served was very delicious. Thank you, Sabin and Suchan doe making our stay pleasant and the conference successful. Also, appreciate Sajeev and Prithvi from Room Service Team. Regards, Meenu Tyagi

Food was ok. Loved the soup and pizza, but biryani and  sichuan chicken were very bland. Overall Ambience and the staff were great. helpful and nice attitude. Sushma and dipak was the best. Very hospitable and caring. Will come again. Thank you

Beautiful new hotel outside the downtown area of Kathmandu.  Staff was very friendly.  I want to give a shout out to Samriddhi, one of the guest services manager.  She was so very helpful and kind and always had a smile!  The breakfast buffet was amazing and I loved the pastries.  The pool was clean and beautiful as was the lobby and the rooms.  Bed was comfortable and bathrooms had a great shower!

Overall, I had a great experience with the property; staff was incredibly helpful, and the amenities were great. The property and pool is well maintained, staff were wonderful. Shout out to Raju ji .. keep it up.

The food was delicious and appetizing. The chefs did a great job with the food. Kudos to the whole team. Our server Nilam was genuinely polite and served us really well. The interior is astounding with cozy and comfortable seats. Overall 10/10 experience.

Short stay so did not use all the facilities offer but a beautiful hotel. Staff extremely friendly and helpful, room was a very pleasant delight, exceptionally clean, food was tasty. Would highly recommend this hotel.

I love the helpfulness of the staff. The hotel is really clean and modern one of the best hotels in Nepal. Lives up to the Hyatt brand. Will definitely be visiting again soon. I also signed up to the Hyatt membership which gave me a good deal too which is a good tip use next time.

Spacious room and having nice convertible bed. Very lovely staffs and reflecting genuine guest hospitality culture.CheckIn Mr. Deepesh is way beyond so as  sunny, rohan and others.Nice Breakfast and Ms. Prabha gadtaula served well professionally during my stay. Mr. Suchan is great asset here.Big thanks to housekeeping team. Great stay at this new property.

Fantastic service and food. Buffet was a good mix. Special thanks to the lovely staff, Dipendra (bartender) and Ajay, who served us every morning with smiles. The room was also clean and modern, with nice view. Will definitely stay again if ever I am in Kathmandu. Thank you!

Today we had an event for Nafij and Nada program. Here at hyatt place. The breakfast was really delicious.the event was well managed and pleasent the ambience was excellent. Great hospitality and personalized service. I would like to thank bikram for all his efforts for making out event sucessful. Surely would reccomend hyatt place for further events.

I loved this hotel . What a lovely breakfast spread .staff is also very helpful . Rooms are great . Food served was so delicious . They especially made few vegetarian meal for us on request .if ever I visit Kathmandu again Hyatt would pace would be my first choice

Nice n new modern , Very clean and tidy hotel (one of the only 3-4 modern hotels in kathmandu), with fairly priced. Ask for Soaltee hotel facing rooms, that’s where the view is, all the snow capped Himalayas. Rooms and bathrooms were spacious

I was amazed at the level of service we experienced! Very clean hotel with excellent food. Awesome pool area and lounge area that is outside. We also used the fitness center which was very nice and well outfitted.

It was a great experience. The ambiance was so good. Stafss were amiable. They made us feel home. Staffs such as Samriddhi, Jay and Anusha. Even food was scrumptious . Will surely visit again. This place has various amenities. Swimming pool area, restraunts, laundary, fitness center, etc.

Amazing view as got an upgrade. New property and well managed. Half an hour from city centre. Staff is very welcoming First ever pet friendly hotel in Katmandu. Food was sumptuous Nothing but 5 star to the property…

First one is friendly staff. Good hospitality.Good and very neatly served food.I can give full marks to room service.Frontdesk helped us in giving information and arranging taxis. I would love to visit again in the future. Rizwan from the front office was very polite and helped us in different situations.

I along with parents stayed in room # 612 from 26th to 28th November 2023. Thank you so much, Hyatt Palace team for your amazing Hospitality. All the staffs are friendly and helpful. Service was up to the standard as expected. My parents enjoyed their stay. Thanks once again and best of luck for upcoming days. Hope to see you all soon.Regards,Amit.

I am a Marriott Lifetime rewards member but decided to try Hyatt Place because my small dog could stay with us.  I was surprised by how pleasant my experience was at Hyatt.  The atmosphere at Hyatt Place is fun with lots of activities.  The staff was helpful and engaging.  The rooms are larger than those at Aloft.  We will be back!

Had a very comfortable stay in hyatt place . Receptionist staff was very helpful . thankyou dipesh for smooth check in.  liked the room. and food in restaurants  was amazing . thankyou  hyatt place team.

My second visit here, stayed a week, was perfect. Food was good with a mix of local and international dishes. Suvash in the bar/restaurant was helpful but all staff were excellent.  Recommended as a good place to stay in Kathmandu.

Good service, excellent food, appreciating the helpful nature of all the staff especially Deepak Kumar  Yadav. The beds were really good and the ambience was excellent. Overall, enjoyed the stay and hoping to come back to nepal and enjoy the experience of this hotel once again. :)

Asthetic space which is spacious and cozy, from the lobby to the rooms. Great view with room lighting that bring a good vibe...... The view form the room is amazing!! staffs are really friendly. Love the place, love the vibe.

Great stay at Hyatt Place, Kathmandu. Special thanks to Aashish and Surya for their great behaviour and hospitality. The housekeeping department is really superb along with the other staffs. Thanks you all....

Special thanks to sushil for hosting us, i was here with my friends for the dinner. I really enjoyed food lovely drinks service and environment. We were very comfortable. Stunning view with moon. We had blast. I was so happy seeing my friends after 5 years. Thankyou so muchh i really enjoyed. Lots of love

Good service good hotel good people and good food. Enjoyed the food at zing world of flavours. Jyoti at the restaurant is very attentive and friendly. Would recommend this place to anyone visiting Kathmandu. Can't wait to come back to this beautiful hotel.

Nice place. Good staff especially Ashish, Nischal and Yamika at reception. Good food and good staff at restaurant. Hyatt Kathmandu's nice place. The pool side is great place. Good cooperation from all the staff

We had a really good experience at the pool. Suraj attended to all our needs and made sure we were comfortable. Lovely place to relax with friends and family. Highly recommended. Food was also good. Planning to come again.

Overall experience at Hyatt Place was good. The room is fabulous and the service too. The breakfast is fantabulous and we enjoyed a lot. The staffs are also friendly and comfortable to talk with. The hall where I attended the conference is really nice. Overall experience in Hyatt is unforgettable.

We had an amazing stay in the property.. The hotel is clean and fresh with great ambience. The staff is very friendly and helpful. Special mention for a Aashish, Akshay, Milan, Dipesh and Shradha for always helping us out with a smile.

Hospitality / staff behaviour/ food and room quality - you name and you have it .  Thank u to front office staff/ samriddhi ( our marwari friend ) . The rooms are spacious / clean and upto mark . Food - breakfast platter is fulfilling

Great place to stay in Kathmandu, staff were nice and polite. Room was nice and clean, and room service was great. Food was great with lots of choices in breakfast. Certainly a go again place when staying in Ktm.

The best of the new wave hotels in Kathmandu. Great rooms, amazing staffs, spotlessly clean space and nice food. Great place for a brief staycation or long stay too. The city views from the hotel was good too.

The hotel was awesome. Rishabh was very cooperative, helpful and polite. I liked the food (breakfast, dinner), it was delicious. You get a lot of items for breakfast. Also quality of food and ambience of the hotel is good.

Me and my friend had a nice stay at Hyatt Place Kathmandu. We spent three nights in the hotel. Everyone was friendly, the rooms were clean and the service was good. The hotel is new, in good condition and the food is good. Sushma Magar was really friendly and helpful.

Really loved the room service by Aashish from house keeping. Good level of knowledge about local places very well mannered and good personality. Enjoyed talking to him about local places. Helpful and supportive.

I stayed first three nights prior to trekking (in a standard King room) and then one night in the Regency King Suite afterwards. The rooms are quite large, with beautiful and tasteful decoration, as well as high ceilings. The bathrooms offer a waterfall like shower experience -- with endless hot water what a relief to use after the gas heated trickle offered in the trekking teahouses. I experienced fantastic service, friendly staff, and great food both in the club lounge and the buffet. I had only one confusion. The website advertises the Regency King Suite as follows: "enjoy amenities such as daily local newspaper, high speed internet access and Regency Club lounge offering private concierge, Continental breakfast and hors d'oeuvres."I had a misunderstanding about this and though the hotel graciously extended me free breakfast buffet, I don't think it was supposed to be included in the room and I also don't think that Continental breakfast is offered in the club lounge (it wasn't offered the day of my stay). I feel that this was misleading and should be corrected on the website, especially for a higher-tier room like the standard suite I stayed in.

...if you can because it’s definitely worth it. For $55 per room, breakfast, happy hour drinks and snacks and our ride to the airport were included. And the ‘snacks’ were so good that on the two of the nights we stayed there, we just made that our evening meal! Plus the club lounge area is just a nice place to hang out anyway. But even without the club upgrade, this hotel is lovely. The forecourt and lobby are beautiful, our room was large and comfortable and breakfast was delicious. Lovely spa (with 20% off between 10am and 2pm) and gym facilities too.

My husband and I stayed at this hotel for three nights at the end of our vacation in Nepal and had a very mixed experience. We booked a Regency Suite (room 510) with the intention of taking advantage of the many benefits included as part of that booking.First, the positive: The hotel grounds are absolutely lovely, and the room was spacious and comfortable. We appreciated complimentary water each day, and the included breakfast at Sesame was ample and delicious. We went to the complimentary happy hour in The Living Room each night and enjoyed it; staff member Samira made us feel so welcome, and she was a delight to interact with every evening.The not-so-positive: Our suite was definitely showing some wear. What was a real problem, though, was an issue with the outlets; we were only able to use one outlet on each side of the bed because everything else in the room was a nonstandard outlet type. We couldn't even plug in the ironing board the hotel provided because it wasn't compatible with any outlet in the suite.The frustrating: As we booked a suite, we were to have access to a complimentary shared airport shuttle during our stay. In advance of our arrival, I corresponded with the hotel by email and arranged to use the complimentary shared shuttle (1) to and from the airport for our early morning Everest Mountain Flight and (2) for our departure flight. When we arrived and I asked to confirm these arrangements, the person who checked us in seemed confused but reconfirmed verbally. The morning of our Everest flight, we went to reception, and there was no record of our complimentary shuttle reservation for that day; apparently, it had been scheduled for two days later. The person at reception said "there was a miscommunication" and did not acknowledge that there was a mistake on the part of the hotel. We panicked about missing our flight and asked them to help us; we weren't able to get a local taxi for some reason, so a hotel car was called. Imagine my surprise two days later at check out when I found out that we were charged US$28 for that hotel car transfer to the airport for our Everest flight because of the hotel's error. Most hotels would have comped that sort of expense as a courtesy because the mistake was clearly on the side of the hotel. I inquired about it as we were checking out, and the person at reception called her manager; they said that it was not complimentary. She asked if I wanted her to call back and "argue" with the manager. We did not have time to press the issue, so we paid the bill and left. At least the shuttle to the airport for our departure was complimentary as promised. While everyone we interacted with throughout the shuttle confusion was kind, the whole thing soured our experience.

We were told by a conference organizer to book here for our final night in Nepal before heading to the airport. (The conference was held outside Kathmandu.)This is a large property. We stayed on the 7th floor where there are only three rooms, one of which is an enormous suite. We weren't in the enormous suite, but our room was still really nice.We had four large bottles of water in our room (necessary in Nepal where tap water isn't safe), robes and slippers were provided, and we were asked if we wanted the minibar stocked (but we said no.) The bathroom was amply stocked with toiletries: shampoo, conditioner, lotion, body wash, mouthwash, cotton balls and swabs. I appreciated having a kettle to make myself a cup of tea at midnight before our departure.Our flights changed, so we had only half a day here, leaving shortly after midnight. Staff did everything they could to make us comfortable as we tried to squeeze in dinner and a long nap before such an inconvenient departure.Very important to note the blackout drapes were sufficient to allow sleep during daylight hours.Again, our plans were confusing, and we'd arranged transportation to the airport from the hotel (using their service) before learning our conference host already had a ride booked for us. The front desk accepted this change at the last second without any issues.We met colleagues in the lounge off the lobby and had a nice time there.
