Both snacks and drinks were good, but service was a bit slow here. It looked like perhaps they were changing shifts and the waiters were engaged in a brief meeting, so this could be about timing.We ate dinner in the restaurant downstairs, and the food was tasty with a varied menu offering many types of cuisine. Even my picky spouse who requires a bland diet for medical reasons found something he could enjoy eating.When we left, they were constructing an enormous gingerbread house in the lobby. I wish I could have seen how that turned out. I'm guessing this is the beginning of some Christmas decorations?The grounds appeared gorgeous from our 7th floor room, but we had too little time to explore them. Our friends told us the walk to the nearby Stupa was not too long, but slightly meandering. The price we paid seemed very fair for a really nicely laid out, large guest room with a terrace in a city. I don't know how it compares to the rest of Kathmandu, but, as a traveler from the USA, I felt it was a great value.

My husband and I stayed here in March and April. We felt like VIP’s! Customer service was exceptional. The staff were professional, friendly and courteous and tried to accommodate to all our requests. Everybody smiled and said hi (well Namaste) everywhere we went in the hotel. Reason who is in charge of the well-equipped fitness room was very attentive. The steam room, jacuzzi and sauna were well-maintained and the temperature in there was just right. Chef Ramgodal at breakfast came around every morning to say hi and asked if he could offer us anything else. Laxman, Gopal and Samir at breakfast were also very attentive and remembered our orders after a few days. Siddhant, Amrit, Subash and Naveen in the Living Room made delicious dishes and drinks that I sometimes requested during happy hours. It’s really a very special place for us in Nepal and we already look forward to coming back here.

We checked in to this hotel for 5 days just after Dussehra. First of all it is a great location, close to the airport and a bustling market nearby. Then the property is huge which we spent days exploring, be it the running track or the courts or the large banquet halls the pool. All were exquisitely maintained. Then coming to the more important things in a hotel i.e. food and staff behaviour. It was excellent throughout. The menu at Roxs Café was varied and of very high quality particularly if you like Indian food. The serving staff was always ready to help with a smile. The HK and the security staff were always prompt to respond to our request be it cleaning our room, giving us supplies or getting a taxi. The lounge called the living room is also great place for relaxing. Finally the architecture...it is a beautiful building built keeping in mind all the 9 famous stupas in Nepal and it is stunning. A must place to stay if you are in Kathmandu.

Room number 451I had only one day stay at Hyatt but it was very nice and up to the mark Room was clean and well maintainedFood was outstanding and tasty. Staff was so genuine, polite humble and well trained I like to mention the name of some staff who really help us santa and sunita from housekeeping. And sabina from reception  Such a nice ladies. Housekeeping ladies was so friendly and talking softly and politely. such a nice hospitality . Next time l like to stay in Hyatt regency definitely. And thanks santa and sunita made our stay memorable. See you soon 😘

This is my second stay at the Hyatt in Kathmandu; the first time was in 2017. The property is a welcomed oasis of simple luxury in the middle of an ancient and historic city. The hotel overlooks the famous Boudanath Stupa. The trees are taller than when I last stayed here and partially blocked the viThe staff from the time you arrive are constantly looking out for the welfare of their guest: greeter at the front of hotel when you arrive, the bellhop who takes you luggage, the check-in staff, the delivery of room service, the guard at the entrance gate to Boudhanath village, the bar waitress, the breakfast room server, the egg chef...everyone is top notch, on top of their game, and treat the guest with respect and honor.  I can't say enough about the staff.  As the for the hotel, it's gorgeous inside, somewhat dated, but aligned with the antiquity of Kathmandu. The rooms are spacious, the bathroom clean and luxurious by Kathmandu standards, and the bed comfortable.  It's not a bed designed by Western standards but more of a modernistic approach to a traditional Nepali bed. Due to jetlag, the blackout curtains kept the room dark when needed. Lighting was adequate and the water pressure sufficient.  In fairness, it takes several minutes for the hot water to reach your room but once the hot water comes out, it's very warm if that's what you like. The hotel staff sent up fresh fruit for my room, an unexpected tough.  The snacks served to Hyatt Club guests in the bar area were freshly prepared and I was offered seconds of a sample plate along with a nice cup of tea. The breakfast buffet was extensive and filling. The only observation was it appeared that they ran out of smoked salmon but there were plenty of other items to choose so I didn't feel deprived at all.  The servers came around often to pick up soiled plates and offered me several food for me to sample like Dosa.and a bowl of spicy lentil soup.  The egg omelet was cooked perfectly to retain its tenderness.  The artwork, which adorns the walls of the hotel, is something worth spending some time enjoying; don't miss the traditional artwork located in the Regency Club on the 5th Floor. The grounds and landscaping are beautiful and well maintained. The pool looked inviting and was very clean.  The hot tub was closed.  I have nothing but praise for this property and look forward to my next stay at this property.

Our first impression was that the hotel is really huge - we could even get lost in the garden! That said, the hotel is generally well maintained with cosy rooms equipped with all the facilities we needed.The restaurants are definitely a delight to us. Rox (Italian): we took an indoor table which was spacious with great ambiance. Pasta and stuffed chicken were done in an excellent manner thanks to the careful choices of ingredients and nice presentation. We were mainly served by a young gentleman, Anjan, whose caring services were very much appreciated.Sesame (international): the dim sum and Thai dishes were a surprise - they are comparable to those served in really good restaurants in Hong Kong. Again, we were impressed with the hospitality.It’s a good choice offering peaceful space in a busy city, yet conveniently located not far from the airport. Recommended!

My partner and I both live in Kathmandu, but when we want a romantic getaway for a few nights, Hyatt Regency Kathmandu is our top choice by far. We have been routinely visiting Hyatt Regency Kathmandu for years now and we are always surprised by the professionalism of the staff and the personalized service. The rooms are cozy with a local Newar flavor, the bathrooms are luxurious (with separate bathtubs and showers), the food is delicious, and the massages are exquisite. However, above all else, our favorite thing about Hyatt Regency Kathmandu is the fact that the staff remember us and remembers our quirky preferences and tend to those preferences BEFORE we even ask. Having grown up in the USA and travelled through over a dozen countries, I can say first hand that I’ve never encountered such high quality service at such a (relatively) affordable rate!

I stayed at the Hyatt for a total of nine nights before and after my Everest Base Camp trek in November-December 2021, and once again was very pleased with the accommodations and service I received.  The two stays were my fourth and fifth at this property.  The hotel is a wonderful sanctuary from the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu, and I enjoyed being able to exit the back gate of the garden area, wander through the narrow lanes filled with small shops and be at the Boudhanath Stupa in ten minutes.  My room with a good view of the stupa was very comfortable, and the bathroom with a great hot shower and bathtub was an almost indescribable luxury after spending one month on the high-altitude trail!  Service was also excellent from every individual I interacted with.  During my two stays the hotel was quite busy with wedding parties, and my only criticism here would be that many outdoor events were held outdoors in the gardens with extremely loud music which often made it difficult to rest in my room which was overlooking this.  I definitely understand the need for the hotel to make money on these events, especially after the pandemic, but perhaps a better balance can be struck taking into account the needs of tired and/or jet-lagged guests as well.  Many of us travel 24+ hours to reach Kathmandu from the other side of the globe, and would appreciate peace and quiet to be able to rest.  Aside from this issue, I loved my stay and am already looking forward to my next visit!

We had a wonderful stay in the Hyatt Kathmandu over the last weekend. The staff were absolutely unbelievable, really kind and very generous with their time. Some of the staff such as Juna, Salina and Shreeti on the club lounge were exceptionally good and gave us a great deal of their time. they really went the extra mile and made our trip far more enjoyable. The club lounge is 100 percent worth the extra money as it is so worthwhile. This is a fabulous hotel that is exceptionally good value.

We have come in a family group with kids for 3 nights. When we arrived the hotel cars did not even arrived to the airport to fetch us and we like waited for an hour outside with the kids and got drenched as it had started to rain. Hence we hired the local taxis and got to the hotel. Mr. Sangam the Duty Manager was very casual and laid back about the whole thing. When I checked in to my twin sharing room with my daughter there was only one bathing towel, one set of toiletries, one water bottle and one glass. The safety deposit locker was missing from the cupboard. The in room wifi wasn’t working and the room phone as well. The housekeeping needs to be in order and proper checklist should be followed before handing over the room to any guest. The hotel is even running out of spare room keys so just be careful if you lose your room key here. I went to the health club and wanted to take just steam but was denied entry by Mr. Pushpendra. I have never encountered this kind of behaviour in any of the Hyatt Hotels or be it any other luxury hotels. It’s highly alarming and such a pity to see a Hyatt brand like this.

The pool and the grounds at the Hyatt Regency are remarkable and beautiful (once they were cleaned up). This alone made the stay much nicer than it would have otherwise been. However, the condition of the hotel was very poor for a five star hotel. My wife, two-year old son, and I had to move rooms three times because of problems with the water and AC. In a 9 night stay, we only had hot water for showers 4-5 times and never for our son's bath. The first three rooms did not have working AC (only the fan was blowing) and finally the fourth room had a split AC unit so that we could have working AC. In a five star hotel, we expected hot water and AC (as any two star hotel would have) but were greatly disappointed. The staff was generally kind about this and one of the best things that happened was the manager finding a fan for us to use so that our son could fall asleep at night. This hotel is very nice and from talking with others is normally a fantastic place to stay but until the hot water and AC can be fixed, I would not recommend it to anyone.

I have to say.  I’m very disappointed in my stay.  People are human and your staff is professional.  However, I’m disappointed in the hotel for a few reasons.  First I would like to commend the chef staff, top notch and the food was excellent.  Restaurant service was superior.  My concerns were as follows:1) allowing a wedding DJ to play music until I called at 3am is inexcusable.  The hotel should not even allow this, especially a 5 star.2) I was very disgusted when the India guest came into the restaurant like a bee swarm.   They didn’t wear masks, they cut in front of me multiple times, and ignored the requests of your servers to not serve themselves.  We are in Covid lockdown and they need to respect others.  I know the hotel can not control the behavior of all guest, but I found this disturbing and felt my health was potential at risk.3) lastly upon check out, I find out my one bag of laundry was $11,000 rupees.  That’s approximately $94 US.  I find this not only totally unacceptable but also felt as if I was being ripped off.  I understand fees for hotel services may be higher but, $94 for one laundry is incredibly excessive.  I accept the apology from your front desk staff and apologize myself for getting angry.   With that said I believe in voicing my concern when I feel something is not right.I hope the Hyatt Kathmandu learns from my experience.  At this point in time there’s no way I can honestly say my stay was 100% pleasant, except for the chef staff and excellent food.I’m sorry but other than the food I can not recommend another stay at Hyatt Kathmandu.

Myself and my daughter and her husband and baby went to this Hyatt for a one night getaway.  It is a very grand hotel with an enormous lobby, beautiful and extensive grounds and a huge pool.  Unfortunately the keys that we were given did not work and  the porter had to go back to the desk to get it fixed.  This was a little frustrating as the baby was fussy and we just wanted to get in the room.  Our rooms were large with high ceilings, comfortable beds and beautiful bathrooms with big tubs and separate shower.   The water was never hot enough for a true hot bath but it was ok. The tending of the grounds has taken a hit due to the pandemic but I believe they will be brought back to original splendor.  The trails are perfect for walking the baby in the stroller.  On the first day there were waterfalls at the pool, but on the second day they were not working.  The pool was mostly clean, but bird feathers were floating on top.  Lounge chairs and umbrellas were very nice and we enjoyed our time at the pool.  I would definitely return to this hotel! Oh, and the breakfast buffet was extensive and had lots of variety of delicious choices.  All staff were very friendly!

I am staying in room no 154 from 7th June 2024. The receptionist was very helpful to me as I am a patient of young onset Parkinson's disease, he helped me manage things well. But I have a twin baby, they refused to provide us with a king size bed and asked me to manage with a twin bed. As I check in the room I find a dead mosquito in the bath tub. Then my daughter found ice cream cone in the drawer which I needed to throw immediately and I was not able to take pictures. Behind the side lamp there was a spider web. The refrigerator was not there in the room. Service is very poor. Today in the morning breakfast, we were not provided with a low height chair as i said I was with two kids and my brother two kids. Some VIPs were provided 10-12 capacity tables with 5 occupancy and we were 4 adults and 4 kids were asked to adjust with a high chair as there was a morning rush. Terrible service and response. Also in room service, I was asked to pay the bill immediately and did refuse to add on to the final bill at checkout. In the swimming pool, I asked for help to bring a towel for my kids They reacted as if what I had asked for. Not a kids friendly hotel . Even milk for infants and kids is on a chargeable basis. The plates in which we ate and kept outside the room in the evening were not cleaned and taken away till night.

When it opened, the Hyatt Regency Kathmandu set the standard for oher leading hotels to follow. Sadly this is no longer the case. Maintenance has been ignored for too long and due to the downturn in tourism to Nepal the hotel have been selling heavily discounted packages to Indian tour groups. I am informed that these groups largely comprise employees of Indian corporate houses who send their people to Nepal on incentive holidays. They spend one night only and are not concerned about observing discreet notices placed for the benefit of other guests, such as keeping noise levels down in residential areas and observing no smoking floors. This greatly inconveniences other guests

I love staying at the Kathmandu Hyatt Regency! This was my 14th visit to Nepal, and by far this is the best hotel in Kathmandu. They always exceed my expectations. At the moment, they are undergoing renovation, but each renovation they do makes this hotel better and better. The Hyatt Regency Kathmandu feels like an oasis in a bustling city that can initially be a little overwhelming for some. What really makes this hotel a cut above and beyond any other hotel in Kathmandu are the lovely staff. In particular, Merina was incredible at keeping in contact with me during this past visit to make certain that all of my hotel needs were met. And Anil went above and beyond in transporting me during the Covid citywide lockdown to ensure I got my PCR test and safely transported me to the airport. Wonderful staff such as these make staying at the Hyatt a relaxing and pleasurable experience. Cheers, Craig

My husband & I recently stayed at the Hyatt and were very disappointed for a number of reasons.We arrived hungry and wanted to order room service-no QR code for the menu to be found so I had to call to ask for it . The lift was not walking so we had to call the front desk who said they would send a technician who never arrived so we had to walk down the steps. Usually this would not be a problem but having recently received injections in my knee for an injury you can imagine my discomfort. When we met with a manager in the lobby having walked down and explained why I was in discomfort there wasno response from him.Our air conditioning was turned down to 10 degree celsius and on high yet it was warm so a technician was sent up. His reply was it’s central air conditioning and that there appeared to be no problem and that by the door it was cool to which I replied well I amnot sleeping in-front or the door ! He did suggest that I contact the front desk and ask for a fan which I did and it was sent up without apology for why we were requesting for a fan.Whilst the technician was there he also looked at our tv which had stopped working and saidno signal .  After unplugging and plugging some wires at the back the tv signal came back . To top it all off my husband had a bath and when he drained it the water came back out of the shower drain - by this time I was beyond calling the front desk and just waited patiently for the water to drain itself before I had my shower ! For a 5 star hotel the problems we encountered were simply not acceptable . The staff whilst very polite offered no apology and upon check out I was not asked how our stay was. My husband and I are well seasoned travellers and have stayed in many hotels all over the world and I have to say that our stay at the Hyatt was by far one of our worst experiences. Nepal’s major source of income is tourism but if our 5 star hotels provide such services how are we to encourage people to come and visit .  I had to advise my friend not to stay at Hyatt based on my experience. I will be very interested to see if anyone fromthe hotel responds to my review and reaches out .

I had a wonderful 2-night stay in Feb 2022.  Everyone at the hotel is kind, warm, and friendly.   I arrived very early, 10:30a, and asked if I could store my luggage until my room was ready.  I was given a room immediately, and was told I could stay there until my upgraded room was ready.  Very generous and appreciated.  Similar experience at checkout.  As a Globalist I was allowed a 4:00p checkout.  When the front desk worker asked what time my flight was, I answered 11:00p.  She insisted I keep the room until 8:00p, at no extra charge, which was the time I needed to leave for the airport.  Again, incredibly generous and appreciated.  In their main lobby lounge they offer a happy hour from 5:30p to 7:30pDuring that time, food is complimentary.   They consider this appetizers but its more than that.  It is easily dinner, with tasty fish and chicken entrees, local specialties etc..  The wait  staff could not have been attentive.  During those happy hours, the chef came out to explain each dish, ask me if I was satisfied, and asked me if I wanted him to modify the spiciness and taste.  The chef, a young man named Siddhaut, could not have been more engaging and personable.  He took time to answer my many questions, not only about food but about Nepalese culture and customs. Conversing with him was genuine pleasure.  He is a credit to the Hyatt.  In Nepal the people are overwhelmingly friendly but at this particular Hyatt the friendliness was over the top.  Thank you to all the staff for making me feel special and appreciated.

After a somewhat shaky start, this hotel delivered on it's promises. The staff there were lovely, especially the rooms manager Pooja, who took care of a complaint I had almost immediately. The suite I was in had a lovely view of the stupa and was quite spacious. The breakfast buffet had a very large selection of food to choose from. The grounds are beautiful and the pool area was located next to a large garden that provided a beautiful and tranquil view. There is a casino there for those who are interested. It was not packed with people and was quite pleasant. The service from everyone in the hotel was fantastic. They have a free shuttle to pick you up and drop you off at the airport, which is only a twenty minute drive from the hotel. It is a perfect location to take day trips from, as there are seven Unesco sites within easy driving of the hotel. I would recommend booking a helicopter ride to Mt Everest while staying there. It is a trip you will never forget. I would highly recommend this property to anyone going to Kathmandu. If you are a Hyatt member, the redemption rates on points are fantastic.

Issues plagued my stay from start to finish. The room had maintenance issues, however some of the bar staff were rude and appeared displeased to be serving me. To top it off, my 'private' car to the airport, which came at a premium, was a minibus, and I ended up in a taxi due to other guests being late. Maintenance issues aren't ideal but happen, however poor service is inexcusable.

My work as well as our family vacations have taken me to some of the best hotels in the world. Without hesitation, I can say that Hyatt Regency Kathmandu would rate right at the top. Location is amazing and allows you a nice relaxing walk down to stupa every evening or early morning. Ashish Kumar, Ajay Kumar and the entire team are very genuine, and one feels extremely invited throughout the stay. We loved the food and the chef and his team were very accommodating of our special needs. Thank you Team Hyatt Regency Kathmandu. Can't wait to visit again.

The property is very big and offers a combined feel of a resort and hotel. But a good property is worthless without welcoming and accommodating staff.We were treated with a very refreshing drink and had a very smooth check in experience. The restaurant offers amazing delicacies. The most wonderful experience was breakfast and lunch at Sesamé. We were hosted by Jalpa and Rajju. They greeted us with a smiling face and were always on their toes to fulfil our requests. The testy food was served hot & fresh by them. The hospitality provided bh Jalpa will be one of the biggest reason for me to turn back to this property. If anyone of you visits, do ask for her.

Many issues, but worst was the bed.  It was damaged beyond its useful life, thin, worn and springs noticeable with uneven hard/soft sections  - the worst of any hotel I've ever stayed in  (and I'ma globalist with this brand) - unacceptable for any hotel, let alone one that is supposed to be 5 star. On top of that, there was no mattress pad or mattress cover either.  Really?  This is the very worst, not to mention a health issue.  The hotel had to know of the condition of this bed but gave it to me anyway- unforgivable! Hotel was unaccommodating, and my coworker also had no mattress cover or pad in her room among other issues, so we left in the morning and canceled the rest of the week.  Glad we did as rest of the week was great!

Stayed there for two nights with memorable experience after long boredom at home due to Covid-19. I stay with clean and cosy atmosphere rejuvenated all my energies . Big open space for morning jogging with well maintained track was unique .

We had an outstanding dining experience at terrace bar thanks to our server nirman and his colleague bibek , From the moment we arrived, they greeted us warmly and made us feel welcome. It was incredibly attentive, ensuring our glasses were never empty and that we had everything we needed. Bibek provided excellent recommendations from the menu, which turned out to be delicious. He was knowledgeable about the dishes and answered all our questions with a smile. The service was prompt, and nirman always checked in with us at the right times.Overall, they contributed significantly to our enjoyable experience at terrace bar swimming pool ( area side ) . We highly recommend other when they visit Hyatt Regency Kathmandu and We will definitely be returning soon!

When i checked in the room it was dirty. Then the electricity to the AC and the TV kept shutting off. We had to have technitions come turn the power back on three times before deciding to leave after the power would switch back off after being turned on. Whenn we decided to leave they offered us a different room which we accepted and it was really nice but we had already spent four or five hours of our one night anniversary stay dealing with no electricity no AC and no TV and continual visits from hotel staff to try and fix these issues

Excellent property was built maybe 25 years ago but beautiful hotel spacious rooms. The decor and furnishing of the rooms is Nepalese style. Hotel grounds are huge with beautiful Gardens. Since the property is old there are some visible maintenance issues in the rooms and the property itself such as broken tiles and flooring around the hotel.

This property is charming in many ways be it the beautiful architecture, luscious green trees and plants, beautiful swimming pool and spa. We had a splendid time, however, there much to improve in terms of room service and maintenance. It took about an hr to deliver cutleries to the room and the room lock was out of battery. We were excited about the famous morning breakfast buffet which was quite average. But the staffs were always friendly and smiling.Overall promising.

After reading good reviews we landed in tis property for 3 nights in a Regency Suite, which offers club benefits, The club is not at all offering quality services and food and drinks were substandard. the room furniture is worn out and sleeping mattress was worst giving backache, did not expect this from Hyatt, they need urgent upgrade , The hotel has a beautiful campus but stay is not worth the money they charge per night. The club addition is a fiasco , please do not expect any quality drinks here, even a fresh juice or cocktail is not provided in the cocktail hours, the wines are the worst possible

You get zero value for the money that you spend to stay on this property. Service during breakfast is poor and most important the food is COLD. Even if you order from the live station, the food that you get on your table is cold. It was not even cold in Kathmandu. On all 3 days, I had same experience.In-room dining experience was sad too, as the food takes a long long time to reach you. An ordinary pastry which usually is there in refrigerator took 40 minutes to come to my room. Not to mention, the staff is unthoughtful.Housekeeping, slightly better than others but again slow and reminders required.The rooms are very old and depleted. I read this in other reviews too but still decided to go ahead. I repent now.Only saving grace was the property, huge with lush green gardens. Casino is within the premises. Won't recommend this at all. One can get cheaper room rates and better stay options elsewhere. Better to stay in Thamel area which is closer to most tourist attractions.

My son and us really enjoyed our stay here. I love their pool area and we arrived on a Saturday so we got to taste their Saturday buffet by the pool which was very scrumptious and all the hotel staff were very welcoming and helpful. I would definitely go back.

We just finished 5 days wonderful stay at Hyatt Hotel in Kathmandu. Kalpana had organized our stay, more favourable than via internet booking companies. We enjoyed every bit of it: the room overlooking the stupa, the coffee in the room, the copious breakfast buffet, the coffee lounge in the lobby, the backdoor walks to the famous Boudhanath stupa, avoiding the busy streets, the tempting swimming pool. The rooms were perfectly cleaned by people like Santa, the service at the breakfast was breathtaking. Like a swarm of bees trying to serve: people like Jalpa, Shree,  Raju, Binu and Srijana at the lobby bar and particularly the swift Chandani.We will return late November for a ten day stay: heavenly.Tina & Bobbie, Germany

Staying in Kathmandu in the winter poses a bit of a challenge as housings generally lack central heating, or any heating for that matter. So even when one is not living at the Hyatt, it can be a warming (thawing :-)) experience to sit down in the lobby bar of the Hyatt to enjoy a pot of tea (they have a great selection of teas), and some snacks or food. Their vegetarian burger,  the Bombay sandwich and the samosas are all of good quality and quite tasty. Service is attentive but not intrusive.

I have been visiting Nepal and Kathmandu for many years but this is my first stay at the Hyatt Regency in Boudha. This large hotel is surrounded by manicured gardens and walking paths. I always book a hotel in Boudha since I prefer to be near the Stupa but stayed at the Hyatt since my travel group was meeting here.  It was such a great stay and I will definitely be booking the Hyatt in future visits.  Walking to the Stupa is a short walk down a small side street providing easy   access for morning and evening Kora.  The Hyatt has several excellent restaurants and I found the food at the Breakfast and dinner buffets to be excellent.  The staff at every point of contact are professional, helpful and friendly.  During my stay I had several transfers for trekking and side trips and the Bell Staff and in particular Mr. Yadou ensured that my luggage was handled and stored during departures and returns to the hotel. The pool is well maintained and great for lap swimming.  There is gym and spa and so much more—-what else could you ask for?

My first impression of this property was "wow"!!! The infrastructure is nothing short of spectacular. So, in one sense, the hotel is fantastic.However, my overall impression was of deep disappointment. Why?It is obvious that the owner has chosen not to keep investing financially into the hotel. Almost everything is worn out and dated. For example, when is the last time you saw a boxed television at a brand name 5 star property?From the rooms, to the fitness center, to the spa, to the public spaces everything shouts out, "I need a massive renovation."On a positive note, Kathmandu is bringing in a much higher standard of 5 star properties. The Aloft is good and the Kathmandu Marriott is very good. Soon, there will be a new Sheraton.Hopefully, the owner of the Hyatt Regency Kathmandu will take this time and invest significantly in the property. If this is done, the hotel can become a phenomenal hotel. Let's hope ...

The staff were fantastic and room was spacious enough. loved the grounds and the terrace cafe. Sadly, the spa looked a little worn out and didn’t really match Hyatt’s standards. The lockers were in a sorry state, towels had rusty color stain spots and the shampoo and shower gel both had funky smell like phenol. Also, The jacuzzi didn’t work and the toilet looked yellowish, had a strong deet smell. I really hope the management steps up and makes some changes. It is sad that this part of the hotel has been overlooked.

Amazing service. The staff went above and beyond especially during Covid times to make sure everybody was safe and provide me with extra towels and etc. at my request. Amazing breakfast buffet. Wi_Fi fast enough. Wow 200 characters is a lot to leave as a minimum for a review.

I just completed 2 stays at this hotel. As Hyatt Globalist, I was upgraded to a suite both times and had access to the Regency Club. The location is great, close to the airport, close enough to the city center that is a quick 20 min taxi ride away, but far enough that I didn't feel the city noise/traffic.  They provided airport pickup and drop off, which was very helpful.  The hotel itself is quite something,  we took several pictures of the beautiful entrance and lobby, it should all be featured in magazine!   Buffet breakfast had a good variety of Nepalese and Western food,  the Regency club also had a good spread of food where I got to try some great momos among other things.  Probably where the hotel really excels is with how nice and helpful everyone is - starting with Sujita at the front desk, everyone at the restaurant and Club, Santa at housekeeping... definitely all made this a nice vacation with my family. I highly recommend this hotel!

Me and my husband  planed for buffet lunch at Hyatt hotel on nepali new year2079. The staff are very nice when they take booking for that new year day ,they call us 3 Time and we are very excited ,of new experience of lunch at Hyatt hotel.we went there on middle of the day .The buffet lunch was already start . The dish item of topu was smell like left over of yesterday. I said one waitress amount the smell but she don't care and didnot remove from buffet.The arrangement is for nepali new year celebration but it seems left over food from last night indian groups.They charge us around $50 for 2 pax but the food and hospitality  is better in small restaurant than this big 5 star hotel. We go every where for the new taste but they is worse experience .They don't care nepali people but we had paid more than foreign.so I don't recommend this star hotel .It is better to go small restaurant and hotel than paying more money and no thing nice . I can say staff are okay the management team is worse. Shortly saying the buffet is looks like charity purpose not high class lunch party.

Upon arriving, everyone is so friendly, its like inviting a long time friend into their home. The hotel felt like a Grand Old Dame of Kathmandu, the architecture and huge estate, it command utmost respect, and with it, the right people to go along with.Everything feel and has the DNA of a Hyatt, I just can’t explain in words but you can feel it. The carpet, the lounges and style, everything scream Hyatt.Now, the room, it too has the DNA of a Hyatt, but it is an old era, everything scream luxurious 1990s, it need to be updated. Everything works fine, and I had opt for the Stupa View room, but sadly it partially covered by the trees.Breakfast is fantastic, not just the food which had a wide variety, but the people too. The service is top notch, all the staff are attentive and very friendly. Coffee, Chai, etc, no problem. Oh, and the best Dosa I have ever eaten, I think 2 weeks down the road I will miss the Dosa.Oh, I chanced upon the Spa, Sauna and Steam Room after jogging. They have separate men and women facilities, you can use the Sauna and Steam Room without engaging any Spa session. It was really good to soak in the hot jacuzzi and feel the fatigue to melt away after a day tour. I have to give credit to the staff at Front Desk, Sesamo (Breakfast team) and Gym/Spa team utmost applause for their good work, keep it up Team Hyatt !!!

This is a lovely property with stunning architecture in the spacious entrance and lobby, wood and stone carvings, water feature and art pieces.  The staff were friendly and responsive, with some protective practices, like ultraviolet treatment of credit cards. (Although, on checkout we were not provided a clean pen.) The room was spacious with comfortable bedding, big bathroom, mirrors and windows.  The hotel has gym, spa, pool, restaurant and jogging track that we did not use.

Everything is immaculate!!Conduct of staff is professional and restaurant is superb. Every employee is so nicely behaved- the luggage attendant at entry, check in staff, housekeeping staff, restaurant staff, swimming pool staff and everyone else is so attentive and prompt. We Loved the entire stay!!

Big room that can contain a family of 2 adults and 2 kids. The hotel’s compound is huge although it is getting dated. A good selection of breakfast and the hotel is only about 7 mins walk from the Stupa. Overall, we enjoyed our stay and agreed that it is value for money as it is near to the Stupa & airport. A hearty breakfast with a wide selection was also very much welcome after a few days of hiking!

Marvellous and Iconic Hotel having a great view of Buddhnath Stupa. Staying in hotel itself has a great feeling.. too much positivity all around. Staffs are friendly, it’s very safe and very close to two most visited tourist destination in Kathmandu, Buddhnath Stupa and Pashupatinath Temple, i and my family, we walked to these two places. Foods were sumptuous. Happy hours was super excited and verity was amazing.

Luxury and service exceeded our expectations ! We had upgraded to Regency Club and enjoyed complimentary breakfast and evening reception. Staff with welcoming smiles made our anniversary experience extra special. Breakfast menu was very elaborate, while staff was willing to go to great lengths to accommodate vegetarian options for evening reception. Overall a true 5 star experience !

This property is set in 40 acres and has beautiful lawns and jogging tracks. The team is excellent and food is amazing. They will make you feel welcome and attend to all your questions and requests with prompt response.

We landed in the very early hours of the morning, the cab arranged by the hotel arrived on-time and we were warmly welcomed by the staff. The check-in was well taken care by Prakash. Prakash was very warm and helpful. our specific instructions on kids bed etc... was well organised well in advance !!The reception team was very cooperative, highly appreciate the gesture of Kirti when we had few minor challenges ! Kirti was at her best in her profession approach with a caring personal touch !At the breakfast and Dinner we were well served and appreciate the service standards exhibited by Jhapad and Samir !!Jhapad was highly caring and took care of us, he knows his job very well and comes very naturally to him. He is very pleasant in his approach.Only one feedback to the management: internet speed is poor, pls work on it.Wishing the best !Ramakanth & Swapna

Awesome ambience, including outdoor umbrellas and all very comfortable seating got check menu it was very healthy food but we had some tea and coffee only as we already had lunch somewhere. Actually we are from Kapan monastery and wanted to see the view from outside of the bar but one of the server Nirman offered us to seat there. It was such great hospitality, very professional service, we just spent short time but it was unforgettable experience there Thank you. Definitely visit again soon.

The Hyatt Regency is always clean, very beautiful, and a great place to unwind from the bustling city of Kathmandu. We love how family friendly it is, and yet, it feels sophisticated and relaxing. The food is probably my biggest let down. It tastes fine and is safe to eat, but the price is very high. We would take walks to near-by restaurants or have food delivered to the hotel to reduce the food expenses and still get yummy food my American family enjoys.

Best hotel in Kathmandu considering location ambience services quality of food etc.. Will suggest to family and friends to stay for short or medium period of stay. Excellent walkways and green areas around are well maintained.

My partner and I stayed at Hyatt regency for 3 nights in December 2023 and had breakfast at sesame cafe every morning as part of the club package (which is soo worth it- if you are visiting I recommend paying for this extra!).The staff at breakfast (Rohit, Sunita, Nista,Sajans and Shree) were all fantastic and I don’t think I have ever come across better service in any other place I have stayed.  The food buffet is incredible, so many options. The quality of the food given the options available was still incredibly high.My partner and I felt that the reviews on trip advisor that we looked at prior to coming didn’t do the place justice, if you are thinking of coming here I recommend you do, you won’t regret it 🙂

This morning we had breakfast at Hyatt Boudha. The food was fabulous and the service so fantastic. They made our day so joyful and energetic. Today we had the Apple and cucumber lemonade mocktail which was superb prepared by Rohit. The restaurant manager Suman, Amrit and team are so attentive to the customer. The service the food uuummmhh so good, thank you guys.

We loved our recent stay in the Hyatt. The staff was so attentive and knew how to serve so well. The food was wonderful especially the salmon! They made our 40th anniversary stay very special with a cake and special decorations in the room. We received a room upgrade as well that was much appreciated.

The property is very big and nicely maintained in main reception areas and lobby. The lobby seating gives a very calm and soothing atmosphere with instrumental music.The team playing instrumental music was amazing.The melodious sound was mesmerising.The pool and spa ,jacuzzi ,steam& sauna areas are  quite impressive but the changing rooms of pool are in a bad state.No lockers or attendent in that area.Best part of our stay was hospitality at dining.Right from day one we got delicious food. The staff was amazing, helpful, courteous with a smile and ready to help always.To name some were Sajana JhapadSunitaNistaReshmiRohit……and the CHEF Dhiraj khadkaOn our request he prepared veg food which was too good specially the tomato soup and monchow  soup.

Writing a review because of a great staff Ms. Binu I almost never write restaurant reviews, but we met a lady staff at The living room restaurent , Hyatt Regency boudha there who had to be recognized publicly. Binu  was her name and she was phenomenal. She catered to the delicious food in the group. She was prompt, smart, caring, and knowledgable about the food. And she just had this friendly demeanor about her that made us all happy. By the end of our meeting , two of us said, " she is  the best restaurant staff we've ever had in Nepal ".By the way, the food is pretty good and the menu is diverse.Thank you  Binu for the wonderful service!Namaste!

Everything was really nice and staff are trained to the highest degree. Food at Sesame is next level. During our visit chef visited the table and organised something to our personalised taste. Thank you for accomodating to our needs kids really enjoyed the mangoes in morning breakfast.

I recently had the opportunity to visit hyatt l regency hotel, and I was thoroughly impressed by the cleanliness and hygiene standards. The hotel went above and beyond to ensure a pristine environment throughout the premises. The Spa, restaurant, and entire Hyatt premises were impeccably clean, and the h fitness staff paid great attention to detail. Public areas such as the lobby, restaurants, pool and fitness facilities were also well-maintained. It was evident that the hotel took cleanliness and hygiene seriously, providing a safe and comfortable stay for all guests.

Excellent stay at the hotel. The location and the setting is superbThe front desk staff were very helpful as usual and in particular Bikrant was very very helpfulThe food in the Restaurant was excellent. However special mention for chef DInesh who went out of his way to ensure that we were comfortable and looked after our Jain food with ease. Chef Prem was very knowledgeable and was keen to help with any special request.   Good quality and service par excellent

Brilliant stay for our 2 week fieldwork trip! The staff were excellent and attentive. The food and staff at breakfast were particularly exceptional. The lovely Anu Priya would greet me everyday and ensure that my dietary requirements were adhered to. They were able to make porridge and dosa without dairy due to my allergy which I am particularly grateful for. Thank you Hyatt for the wonderful stay!

My friend and I had an incredibly enjoyable day at the hotel's pool, relishing a refreshing swim. The atmosphere was perfect for unwinding, complemented by the crystal-clear water that added to the serene vibe. What truly set this experience apart were the two outstanding staff members at the poolside bar, Nirman and Sandesh. Their attentive and warm demeanor ensured we lacked nothing, from chilled beverages to delectable snacks. Their hospitality significantly contributed to making our visit truly memorable. As we lounged by the water's edge, we couldn't help but admire their commitment to our comfort. Both my friend and I are eagerly anticipating our next visit. Hats off to them and the entire hotel team for crafting such an enjoyable environment

NOT to be elegible for being a Hayat member. Allmost all staff are freshers with zero knowledge Person at recpetion does not know what cousine is served in the restaurants. Person in restaurant does not know what portion is served in one serving. The girl escorting us to our room looks like a college girl, not even knowing on which floor we really are, And where is the room. Person at swimming pool does not know where to get tube. Everyone knows anything. Just few freshers hired by Hayat. Very bad experience of big brand like Hayat

My wife and I enjoyed our time at this property but it was because of the service we received. The people working at this hotel are outstanding. They go the extra mile (and then some) to make you feel welcomed and attended to. The recently renovated restaurant, Rox, located just off the lobby offers delicious homemade pastas and impeccable service.The resort itself is in a beautiful setting but it's getting very outdated. Our room was spacious and comfortable but it could use a serious update. During our stay there were two large weddings (back to back) that meant large crowds of people in the lobby and at the breakfast area. It was chaos when the wedding groups were around. If it weren't "wedding season," I'm sure the experience would have been more serene.In Kathmandu, the Hyatt is among the best places to stay. This resort doesn't align with other Hyatt resorts we've visited but all that's missing is some modernization of the rooms and facilities. Otherwise, this is a good place to spend a few days.

Our more than two weeks of stay in Hyatt Regency Kathmandu was really a sweet memory for us. We remembered those smiling faces even after we came back from the trip, just like we feel that most Nepalese are very nice. However we were not able to express our gratitude to all of them. Ms. Jalpa of Sesame Restaurant always greets every guest with lovely smiles. We can feel that she loves her job from heart. Mr. Rohit is gentlemanly as always while keeping the guests' special request in mind. Ms. Reshmi is so nice and friendly although she did not talk much. We also went to Regency Club almost every day and the special offerings were very delicious. Ms. Pramia is very professional, passionate and quick in responding to customers' requests. We also had a very good impression on Ms. Sujita of front desk. She is very patient and considerate in the room selection and other arrangement. Mr. Prakash also offered us lots of assistance in our daily chores. Many other staff gave us so much help, including concierge and housekeeping. We are sorry we don't have all of their names. But we do hope to see the lovely faces soon. All the best to all of you, and thank you so much!

I had the opportunity to visit Kathmandu Nepal a couple of times in the past few years and I always choose this Hyaat Regency because they are very close to the airport and local sight scenes. This hotel has amazing staff and the property is huge compared to other 5 star hotels in Kathmandu. I love the food here and service is the best so I’ve experienced in this city. The only thing I hate about this hotel is it’s Spa. I’ve been coming here many years and frequently use the steam sauna due to Kathmandu pollution but they never updated the Spa. It’s Very old and outdated. Broken faucets, dirty shower heads, old towels etc. they don’t even have a proper shower gel and shampoo, they use the same product with different labels. The swimming pool is one of the best, it’s big and wide. I just wished they would take better care of the spa since that’s what i use most of the time during my stay here. Over all, amazing hotel with great amenities. Can’t go wrong.

I spent 2 days at Hyatt for business purposes and it became truly a home away from home . The location is great far from pollution but the rooms are little outdated but the staff made the entire experience so wonderful. They took exceptional care of me and were always asking how my stay was along with top notch customer service. I would like to express my gratitude to club lounge team Selina, Juna and the others. I hope to visit Nepal and stay in Hyatt again in the future!! :)

Very nice and accommodating staffs. During breakfast, the morning staff on duty gives extra attention; Rohit, Shree, Amisha, Jalpa, Nima and Jhupad. The breakfast buffet is cheap and delicious too, only usd 15 or less. The selection varies, but you have to try their dosa

Hospitality here is unparalleled and the food is exquisite. Everything about this place is exceptional and I couldn't recommend it more for those who're looking for a one-of-kind life experience. The best property to stay in Kathmandu...Walter Pereira (Director Operations), Pooja Ghosh (Director of Rooms), and Kriti Maharajan ensure to make your stay amazing…A very big shout out to Ex Chef Gopal and Chef Prem who made our stay extra special and joyous by providing us with awesome delicacies.We miss them so much and are sure to return with family and friends just for the experience again.Loads of love and regards to you all

Beautiful staff with awesome food.Our group stayed here before heading to Kailash pilgrimage. Our stay was for about 5 days, and those those five days the staff of Hyatt Regency accommodated us so beautifully. We had vegan/plant based requirement for food, and the dishes to desserts that were served were amazing. All of us ate every time without being hungry and that is saying something. The chef who prepared our food, the staff who waited on us with every need, and to the hotel staff every need was delivered perfectly. Perfect place to stay before embarking on a pilgrimage like Kailash or with family. It is a beautiful haven in midst of busting city of Kathmandu.

My first time visit to Nepal was greeted by the hotel’s complementary chauffeur service at the airport.  Upgraded the room to the suite.  There are bottled water for brushing teeth.  The waiters are very attentive to what I want through the breakfast.  Great first experience of visiting Nepal.

really a great hotel, well placed, in a calm environment. Food and service from Hyatt team is really at the top. But one should avoid the dumbest travel agency which is in charge to organize any tour and is situated inside the Hyatt premises : please organize your trip before, otherwise not only you will pay between 20 to 150% more than the market prices, but they won't answer you or went they decide, no matter your personnal agenda !!!! we are still waiting for the organization of the heliccopter tour (2000$!) despite meeting them at least 3 time and sending as many emails !!!!

Here you live like a royal, you continuosly feel pampered! This is a HD quality stay! all the facilities, amenities, the food, the services, the set up and most of all - the staff are super fine! You would feel like coming back here, again & again!

With old world elegance and nice amenities, the Hyatt is a terrific choice to escape the urban bustle of chaotic Kathmandu.  The park like setting buffers the property from the city’s noice and congestion.   Our group stayed here on both ends of a trekking trip to Lukla.  While not as modern and “hip” as other properties, the Hyatt provided everything we needed.   Service was first rate.  The spa/gym area was very good and my massage treatment was excellent.   I will stay here again.

The service was really excellent provided by Mr. Rohit Pandey and his team Mr. Sujan,Miss Jalpa and Miss Sujata.I had my breakfast there with my family. Breakfast was so delicious and also the politeness and courtesy provided by his team was unexplainable.My family really enjoyed being at Hyatt Regency under supervision of Mr. Rohit Pandey. We are planning our next holiday soon. I wish to be served by Mr. Rohit Pandey and his team Mr. Sujan, Miss Sujata and Miss Jalpa.This review is not only for the Hyatt regency Kathmandu but also service provided by Mr. Rohit Pandey and team. Thank you guys for being so nice to me and my family. Kudos to you and your team Mr. Rohit Pandey. Hope to see you soon there

Stay Here. Sujitra has been very accommodating to my never ending requests. In fact, all the staff are incredibly accommodating, always going above and beyond to ensure each guest is well taken care of.

Super friendly and caring staff. Especially F&B and Dinesh’s kitchen TeamVery caringGreat foodLooking after special requirements (allergies). Very friendly Bar staff. On the first day a bit slow but (can happen) after feedback just great

Hotel and grounds are beautiful. Some areas need a bit more maintenance. Rooms can also do with an upgrade (the bed headrests are made of white fabric, which turned brown due to too many people resting the heads on them and never being washed). Staff is super friendly. Location is close to the airport and to the Budha Stupa, but around 20-25' from Thamel and Durban Square (the touristic areas). I will def recommend it as it is probably one of the best hotels in Kathmandu.

The staff at the front desk, in the breakfast area and gym have all been very attentive: particularly when dining. The hotel is old but it has a wonderful charm to it that grows on you as you stay. My stay coincided with my birthday and to my surprise the staff had prepared a cake and gift: something that shows the level of attention they provide to guests. This is further reflected in some of the room visits and calls regarding anything f the staff can do to make the stay more pleasant. An overall pleasant stay.

Big room and generally good  while we were there many weddings. Many restaurants and only Ala Carte if you ask.  Very busy but spacious.  Large grounds and big outside pool staff only come to life if you are not happy.   The restaurant on the ground floor is very good.  Close to all the sites

Wonderful stay! Food was outstanding, The service in the Regency Club was better than outstanding! The two young ladies, Samik Shya & Juna Salina, in the Regency Club were the best! They were very attentive and made me feel like I was at home. My stay in Kathmandu was very enjoyable, and Samik & Juna played a big part to ensure my first visit to Nepal was memorable. Thank you Samik & Juna.

Although it is in the middle of a crowded market, it is a very nice place with a large area and lots of plants....Making the most of vacation time and that unforgettable breakfast ☕️at Hotel Hyatt in Sesame restaurant Sesame restaurant's service is top notch 👌 One of the staff, his name was Mr.Rohit Pandey, respected us .He clearly mentions about the breakfast buffet and gives the highest service. we have a lot of respect their team. We will meet Hyatt family and Mr.Rohit Pandey. again soon "NAMESTE"🙏.It was wonderful days at there.

Staff at Sesame Restaurant within the hotel were extremely warm, welcoming, and very courteous. They all genuinely went over and beyond to make us feel comfortable.The breakfast food stations catered to all tastes. Sajana and her colleagues are the best, and are the sweetest people in the world.

The staff worked hard to make sure I felt welcome and tended to my demanding needs with grace and patience. Ajay, one of the Hotel managers, went so far as to accompany me to a motorcycle dealership to help me with a purchase and then spent lots of time giving me tips on traveling through Nepal by motorbike.  The rest of my accommodations won't be this luxurious but this was the perfect place to get sorted and prepare for my adventure.

I stayed at the Hyatt regency and had an great experience from the get go. At the club lounge Prajwal and all the team on the 6th floor lounge were exceptional and went above and beyond to cater to our needs. The reception service is always welcoming, assisted in navigation to the room while providing detail information regarding the amenities.

The rooms are spacious. The bed frame is sturdy & elegant. The dressing closet is neat. Hospitality is excellent.. Binu@ barJhapad @ sesame & Bishwa@reception are just a few!!The head chef Suvindo Roy is quite humble and open to feedback The South Indian breakfast is outstanding!!The local nepalese fare too is great. The masala chai is the best! The lobby is very tasteful, meaningful & welcoming.The horticulture staff have done a stupendous job as is visible..The room service (gosht biryani) can improve as given feedback for.👍👍All in all… a befitting stay in the beautiful country of Nepal. Value for money…Bhagirathy Jhingran United World College Maastricht Netherlands bhagirathyjhingran@gmail.com

Nice property with good ambience; good choice of on-site restaurants and bars. ATM on-site makes it easy for foreign touristsThe property has a nice pool but all our evenings were spoiled by couple of ladies yelling at other guests about swimming attire. The staff seemed to side with those ladies and seemed rude to guests. The property should put up signs about swim attire to educate guests and avoid yelling at guests.

We stayed 4 nights at the Hyatt Regency Kathmandu.  The Hyatt Regency Club team were spectacular.  Very kind and attentive, without being overbearing.  The food was delicious, they always greeted guests with a kind smile, and provided a comfortable and warm atmosphere to have a drink and unwind.  Many thanks to Pramila and the whole team for your kindness and care.  We hope to visit again sometime in the future.

Hyatt Regency Kathmandu is the perfect, ideal hotel for any guests visiting Kathmandu.  It is the biggest hotel offering amazing amenities, including a big surrounding garden for various activities and a beautiful poolside with wonderful view.  The beautiful lobby display of Buddhist statues offer such a relaxing, spiritual feeling - perfect for hotel location right at the Boudha stupa.  Our #1 choice to stay for many years visiting Kathmandu.

Exceptional service from the sesame restaurant Mr.Rohit Pandey know the value of guests. He knows well greetings high standard. The ambience service and hospitality was top notch. And the hotel area are very nice and facilitated. We enjoyed the delicious breakfast at the sesame restaurant. I always enjoy my time in Hyatt. Everyday when I come to Kathmandu I make sure to visit Hyatt. Its more like a home now. Again thankyou very much to Mr. Rohit Pandey for providing excellent service. Lots of love to Hyatt Regency team. We really loved the whole experience there.

Jhapad,Rohit, Bikash, Nisto they are very kind and professional.They always checked if the food was okay and asked if he needed anything. Thank you for your care.Thanks to them, I was able to have a comfortable meal.I totally recommend the hotel breakfast restaurant.

I went with my family with the group of 8. We had a wonderful lunch time in the sun light with umbrella shade. I am surprised with the kind of hospitality we received from Balaram Dhakal. He made sure every item of food we ordered was to the perfection and we are happy with it. Good job to the whole team of the Rox Restaurant :)

I stay 200+ nights a year in hotels. Even in 2020, I stayed about 190 night. The Hyatt Kathmandu is like a home, more than a hotel. The staff from Chef Dev on down to the housekeepers are some of the friendliest, happiest, most polite hotel employees I have met, anywhere.We're Hyatt Globalists and we truly felt like VIPs. From a suite upgrade to amazing breakfasts and happy hour food and drinks, the red carpet was rolled out for us. We made some food and drink requests that were not on the menu, and viola, they appeared.Team members checked on us daily to see if there was more they could do? How we were enjoying our stay? It was more a feeling of friendship than just doing a job.There are far too many team members to thank, but the few who stand out are Sanjeev and Chef Sid at the Living Room, Laxman and Gopol at Rox for breakfast, Reason in the gym/spa and housekeeper Santa. Everyone was good, but they all made a special effort for us.It's a shame more people aren't visiting the property or Nepal at the moment.Just to show not everything is perfect, the pool, at 18 degrees, is bitter cold for swimming, but a minor complaint.

Staff are all very nice and polite! Show cares to the guests and always have a lovely smile! Food are delicious too! Tried the Indian food in the hotel which provides the authentic taste of this cuisine! Try breakfast too, eggs will be cooked on demand with the preference of the guest! Also they have north and South Indian breakfast, Chinese as well as western one! Would appreciate if there would be more selection of fruit juice though!Special thanks to the staff in the restaurant, especially to Jhapad, Reshimi, Jaipu and Rohit panday! They always come to the table asking if we would need anything and the satisfaction of the food

My recent visit to Hyatt Regency, Kathmandu with my family was an absolute delight, thanks to the incredibly polite and helpful staff. Rajju, Ram, and Shree who provided exceptional service, making our experience truly memorable.Chief Umesh deserves special recognition for his efforts in accommodating my mothers specific dietary needs. He personally ensured that her meal was tailored to her requirements, showing a level of care that is truly commendable.

We had our dinner at sesame restaurant. The buffet was well spread for both vegetarian/non-veg and live cooking was on. We need to mention about three staff Rajju, Rajendra and Ishan who took a very special care of us and appreciate their efforts to make us fully satisfied with their gestures and hospitality. The food was very tasty and would highly recommend to dine here during your next stay.

One of my favourite restaurant and bar in kathmandu “The Living Room”I went with my friends...best greeting from  Samirra,best one was the bar and drinks served by nirman he was very professional open space great ambience. Beside of chaittya (very classic historical temples) and evening lighting and people who praying around the lobby area was such joyful.Highly recommend this place,Thank you.

Went there with friends and it was great experience starting from security to reception, housekeeping. Food and service was great chef also helped us choosing the food from menu. Area was very hygienical and clean. Would love to visit again soon.

Front desk manager Mr. Ajay ensured that we have a memorable stay and attended to all our needs. He was very responsive, quick, friendly and warm. Restaurant staff needs to be more attentive while attending to guests and following food orders. Overall i had a lovely experience and look forward to visit again.

It was really awesome experience on TLR. Shawarma, Fish kebab was so delicious and cherry on top was a americano with a beautiful view of Boudhanath stupa. Also the greenery and lighted swimming pool view was breathtaking with the sweetest hostess Asmita and Subash who made my whole evening.

Everything about this hotel was perfect - staff, housekeeping, rooms, food, decor, ambience. Other hotels should learn from this hotel.All the staff we met during our visit were exceptional. They were welcoming, helpful, friendly and efficient. From the young man who checked us in when we arrived to Tashi and his team in the club lounge, we were always met with a smile. The young lady we met in the reception area and other areas, Neha (sorry if I spelt your name wrong) was wonderful too - she felt more like a friend. I would also like to commend the chefs and waiting staff as well as the housekeeping staff for making our stay memorable in every way.Although I have stayed in many hotels with beautiful rooms, food or decor, this is the first hotel where ALL the staff have been great without exception. The rooms were excellent, the food was delicious, the entrance was very peaceful and serene. Great management.

Rox Restaurant is what made my stay in Hyatt Regency quite exceptional. My dining experience there the first evening lured me back for more a second evening, though it is a little on the expensive side. Cosy atmosphere, delicious Italian classics,  and hospital hosts whose priority was to make guests feel welcome and special. I enjoyed every bite of the food that melted in my mouth.

Booked the hotel mainly based on the price and was amazed by the overall experience at the hotel. It was my first time staying at a Hyatt property and I signed up immediately for the program. The staff was attentive, everyone knew my name no matter where I went in the hotel and the hospitality was unmatched. Look forward to visiting this hotel again in the future. Great place to stay in Nepal, centrally located for shopping and close to the airport.

I have been hyatt regency with my family members. We have enjoy a lot and have fun. There is friendly environment with staff members. Excellent services is provided by @Rohit. There services and hospitality is good so good. Food was also nice. We have enjoy on swimming pool a lot.Today sunny environment environment that help to enjoy a lot on swimming pool.There is green environment that feel so good. We have ordered non veg club sandwiches, mint lemonade, icelemon tea,glass of fresh juice watermelon was too good,paneer wraps, chicken warps, Freanch fry,peach ice tea is so tasty.Once again thank you soo much @Rohit. Next time obviously i will visit again there.

The Hyatt was everything you expect from a quality hotel.  We had two nights on arrival in Nepal and two  nights before departure, and were delighted to return.  The rooms are spacious and comfortable and there is a good choice of food and drink outlets - we particularly recommend the Italian option Rox where the food and service were superb.  The staff are friendly and efficient and the grounds provide space to relax amid the bustle of Kathmandu.

The food is very high  quality and served in buffet style in a lovely environment. The buffet allows you to taste a large selection of wonderful things. We ate exquisitely flavored and delicately cooked dishes that we would have never known to order otherwise. Truly special food and presentation, The staff is generous, engaging and very much a part of the lovely experience. Rajendra and Rohit were attentive, made sure we could engage fully and we enjoyed talking with them ! We will definitely return.

Top class Excellent hospitality by Ms. Sajana and her team, gala Christmas Brunch with a wide selection of cuisines to pamper your taste buds, live music and kids play space. We had a wonderful afternoon. Thank you Hyatt and team.🙏🕉️🇳🇵🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟just WoW👏👏👏

A marvellous and grand hotel and brings the spirit of Kathmandu alive! The ambiance is amazing and the views of the stupa make it even more sensational. It’s a peaceful respite in the city with its beautiful gardens and grounds. And of course, amazing service! The team in Sesame restaurant were attentive and friendly and a special callout to Rohit for his professionalism and attention to detail.

The service provided by them is so nice , food is also good ! Attentive staff and always ask us what we want and keep refilling the drinks for us :)  large variety of food like Thai style, Indian style. Lots of different desserts as well. Personally love the butter chicken the most!

Newly done up Sesame is fantastic. We had two breakfasts and two buffet dinners there. The food is absolutely good quality. The staff was also good and service at Sesame is great. The spa we used was also good.Coming to the rooms, the property is old and tired. Rooms need modernisation. Batrooms not having lock just doesnt sound good. This is a business / family hotel and such things do need urgent attention.

The breakfast buffet is very nice. They provide Asian, western and Indian dishes. The service is superb. The staff work with passion especially Rohit, Jhapad, Sunita and Reshmi. As its my first time been to Nepal , the staff recommend me to try there local pancake which is very nice and he even introduces every condiment to me. And from time to time the staff will bring some food to the customers, such as MoMo(Nepal dumplings). Also they have eggs to order, you could order omelette or any kinds of egg you like. It’s an excellent dining experience here.

This was my 4 month old daughter’s first trip so nevertheless to say I was stressed but everyone made sure that they did everything to make our stay very very comfortable. Each day at the breakfast, the staff made sure we got a good table for our kid. Sajana always greeted our lil one with her name, other staff including Rohit, Rishma, Jhapad, Bikash ans Amisha went above their way to mlake sure everything was great. During the cocktails hours, Tara was amazing. In the lobby bar, subash was terrific. He even heated my food twice to make sure everything was to my taste. Cant wait to come back again

The team at Hyatt Kathmandu makes all the difference. It is a beautiful property but the people make it wonderful. Chef Naveen, Rohit, Reshmi, Jhapad and the whole crew made each breakfast memorable redefining hospitality! In addition to the food services, the property is beautiful and has all the usual refinements. The 6th floor lounge is a great place to unwind after a long day of sightseeing. Finally, the other oddball requests that we had like help packing a weird shaped item we purchased to room service to laundry all were executed really well. My 7 year old, when asked what her favorite part of the trip to Nepal was said it was the Hyatt ☺️.

Our trip to Kathmandu became extremely successful primarily because of the hospitality provided to us at Hyatt Regency. The staff was courteous, efficient and always smiling. We were in a group of 65 people and normally service to such large gropups is always a bit lax. But here we saw a major difference. The staff was always at our beck and cal and the food was way better than any we have experienced in about a dozen of our previous group tours in the last decade. Would look forward to visiting Hayat Kathmandu again!

What a delightful stay at the Hyatt Regency Kathmandu! We stayed there for 3 nights after a trekking trip through the Himalayas and we were surprised by the beautiful hotel and exquisite treatment we received. The rooms very nice, with views and had a pretty good size.The real highlight was the amazing food in every restaurant, specially the Sesame, as well as the food in the Executive lounge. It was also very closed to the Boudha Stupa so we walked there several times as it's a wonderful place to walk around and admire the beauty of the UNESCO monument. You could also see the stupa from several locations of the hotel. We are looking forward to staying again!

Rooms are now comparable 18 Th century . Restaurants has least possible menu . Bathroom fittings could not have been worse . No where near Hyatt . They even charge for steam and sauna to in-house guest which is very funny too .

While the hotel and staff were lovely, this hotel hosted multiple large wedding gatherings during the height of the COVID pandemic. Irresponsible and negligent of their duty of care for guests and staff. I will never be a customer of this hotel again.

We have stayed at the Hyatt about 5 times.  Spacious gardens provide a buffer from the busy world outside and the closeness to Boudhanath stupa is added benefit.  The breakfast buffet is exceptional and the staff are well trained to make you feel welcomed,  There is a sense that the buildings are getting older but that is partly a good contrast to the very modern hotels.

Stayed here for 3 nights in a well maintained luxury property. Though a few corners of the might need updation but they are comfortable, spaced out and ensure a good experience for all residents. The staff is helpful and overall experiential areas at the lobby bar, restaurant, poolside etc ensure a good stay.There are newly built star rated properties around the city as option but the others might be a little too cluttered in the city center.

The space was fantastic. The room was exceptionally clean and organized. They delivered a fantastic service. The staff were courteous, displayed nice body language, and reassured with statements like "don't worry, we're here to help." The experience was sincerely appreciated, and warm regards were to Ms. Sabita, Mr. Sandesh, and Ms. Kalpana for their efforts and service on July 7, 2024.

The food of hyatt is very good and also the staff of hotel and as well as staff of kitchen are very helpful and providing the best food with best quality with lots of love. Providing valuable service.And a very special moment one of the staff member Anu Priya Khadka provided us a very good service with carring nature provide good food and provide us proper information about that food and taste and she personally very polite with good nature. Very special Thanks to Anu priya Khadka for your kindness and cute gesture and the best service of you .

The hotel service is one of the best I have, especially in the Sesame restaurant when I had breakfast. I’m impressed when a staff proactively introduced me some local cuisine and encouraged me to give a try. I usually stick to my western breakfast but the dosa he recommended and the apple carrot mix juice he offered are really nice! This adds to my memories in Nepal. His name is Jhapad. Thank you!

The experience of staying at Hyatt was very good , staff is very courteous . the drink and food was well presented by nirman and bibek .The staff nirman and bibek was taking personal care of us . The experience at terrace bar was very relaxing and luxurious . Their attentiveness and friendly demeanor enhanced our meal and made us feel valued guests . A big thank you to nirman and bibek for providing outstanding service throughout our special drink and food , bibek was a  friendly and patient personality . Overall, real value for money and would recommend to those visiting Hyatt regency Kathmandu for short breaks .

Just now i viewed my pictures, i never forget the guy & his name chandn & i remember i forget something to share. After i celebrate new year eve during my vacation in Hyatt nepal, i retured back to US-home country. Arrogant guy and mannerless with cheap attitude, doesnt know the way of talking . i noticed he see the customers with dress codes and which is really shameless for such huge hotels where other people treat " guest as a god". people should change their apperance with cheap attitude after that guest will recommend their bests and visit theirselves again and again.Apart of this food was really amazing and the buffet decoration  with warm ambience. My friends and me really enjoyed the moment.Thanks to entire Hyatt team to make our new year eve WOW.

This was my 2nd stay in the same hotel in last 2 years. Got a feeling that that the hotel is maintaining the same standards always. Room was clean and spotless.Concerns about the wifi signal in the rooms and quiet weak, which I experienced the same always.

Beautiful place!!!  Staff there is amazingly friendly!!  Especially the dining staff of Rajnish, Sunita, Rohit, and Shree - they were always available and catered to our needs swiftly.  Also kudos to Chef Prem and his staff. The food was exceptional and they went out of their way to cater to our dietary interests.

Everything is almost perfect in the hotel. Especially, when we’re having breakfast the team made you feel like they’re really there for you. They’re so professional. Dear Rohit, Sunita, Jhapad, Shree, Mallika, Jalpa, Kunsang I want to thank you once again for your kindness to everyone.

It is probably one of the best hotels you can find in Kathmandu. The location is good, close to the famous Stupa and airport as well. the architecture maintains a good shape as well as traces of traditional elements. The hotel serves good with different restaurants, spa and gym. the room is spacious and well functionally planned. They also provide local musical performance in the looby to welcome the guests.

I had an exceptional dining experience at Hyatt Sesame Restaurant, thanks to Ms. Sunita Basnet, the assistant manager. Her warm demeanor, impeccable service, infectious smile, and extensive knowledge of the menu truly enhanced our visit. Ms. Basnet’s passion for food shone through, making our time at the restaurant memorable. What stood out most was Ms. Basnet’s ability to create a warm and inviting atmosphere. Her dedication to ensuring guest satisfaction was evident in every interaction. Her enthusiasm for the restaurant’s offerings was infectious, enhancing the overall enjoyment of our meal.Highly recommend her attentive service to anyone visiting!

Superb experience with great hospitality!!! Stayed from 20th Nov till 25th Nov. The flexibility the team goes to ensure you have a good time there was truly commendable. The rooms is spacious with a rustic feel. The bar lounge is a good place to hangout.   I have to thank Mr Walter Pereira the Operations Director who had a hand in making my stay even better than it already was. Things to improve on:-1) The lift needs an upgrade as it feels too old 2) The breakfast menu needs to have more variety for someone staying over 5 days

The service at terrace bar is top-notch ! If you’re a foodie like me, you’ll love this place ! The menu has a fantastic selection of dishes, and we loved everything we tried . The staff is friendly, attentive, and goes above and beyond to ensure a memorable dining experience. Kudos to the staff nirman and his colleagues bibek . I was blown away by the service of bibek he was incredibly knowledgeable about the menu and offered excellent recommendations. Truly great service . Their server was attentive without being intrusive. The entire staff worked seamlessly together to create a seamless dining experience. We never had to ask anything twice ! The service was impeccable from start to finish. Terrace team was gracious and accommodating, ensuring every aspect of our dining experience was perfect. I can’t wait to come back again .
