This is an update to my previous review. I came back to Kathmandu and had the opportunity to visit the hotel. To my surprise, they’ve changed most of the spa facilities. I’ve had the opportunity to meet with SAROJ who’s the manager of the gym and spa department. He was very accommodating and made sure that all of my needs were met.The spa has beautiful relaxation rooms where I could sit and unwind after every treatment. I would highly recommend the spa at Hyatt. It is the perfect place to go for relaxing and rejuvenating experience.

Great experience Very good service from Rohit our attendant as well as Sunita and the team. The breakfast was very good. Wide selection of food . Fresh juices and fresh coffee on offer We were offered the Nepali platter with Bara by Rohit which was amazing.Staying here for two more nights. Looking forward to two more delicious mornings.

Service of staff is great as always. But rooms are seriously in need if renovation. There was also a damp smell when entering the rooms below the loony level. Spa was great and so was the staff. Food is decent though pizza was great. Renovate your rooms and you are good.

Dipesh the waiter at Rox restaurant at Hyatt was always there when we need and brought out the food which tasted amazing just looking at it made my mouth water. The manager Sunita greeted us with warm welcomes and seated us to our table. The service was amazing and have been here almost everyday I’ve been here

Really delicious Italian food!!  Our server, Laxman,  was awesome.  We really enjoyed this restaurant.  Every meal we received was well prepared and very tasty.  The starters, pasta, pizza, and secondi were all excellent.

its a luxurious property.. the entrance of the hotel is extremely grand !!the service provided by them was great.. the staff in the restaurant was very welcoming and food was delicious..Swimming pool is also maintained  in good standard.. the complete ambience of this property is excellent.. most importantly, staffs were very sincere and polite..they also have a CASINO in the same premises..highly recommended !!

It was a pleasant stay nothing to write home about but no complaints as well. It’s a 23 year old property with serious need of a revamp. But on an average the stay was pleasant. Food though is really good and seldom found banquets appetising. I enjoyed the stay the rooms were clean. Pool was clean but preventing guests from entering in non swimming wear could be done, and I did not use the pool because of that.spa was average,

Fantastic Pool with a nice garden surroundings. A very friendly and helpful Mr. Shikhar at the front desk. Rooms are comfortable in a classic 80´s style, althoug it was built in 2000. The shower was Nepal´s best.

We are  extremely happy with hospitality of hyatt regency Kathmandu . We enjoyed our stay.we highly recommend this property. We would like to mention Ms,Binu Mr.Subash and Mr.Rabin from TLR who ware always smiling and made us enjoy our dink and food . Mr.Jhapad from sesame made us enjoy our Brakefast he was always atantative and knwe what we want for our breakfast.

I found the hotel staff and accomodation first Class and could not fault the service in any way , the front office staff and restaurant staff and terrace cafe staff were always most pleasent and only too willing to help and advise me , which made my stay all more comfartable and enjoyable .I would like to thank again especially to Ms Sujata and Mr Kumar and Ms Sonam from restaurant  team and Ms Samira from terrace cafe for the great service .Captain Asim Dogan

I stayed at Hyatt, KTM for a week in Jan'20. Chef Halim Khan turned out some gastronomical wonders and the food was a delight.Suman Shrestra was an absolute delight. He spent a lot of time with me and his company was very enjoyable.

My 3 night trip at the Hyatt Regency Kathmandu stands 11 out of 10.This has been one of my preferred and highly recommended option,  and the staff makes this possible. Spread widely over with beautiful greenery,  lavish pool, good F&B outlets, rooms with heritage aura and yes the Staff at every corner are gem.F&B Service :IRD : even mid night order was so well made and presented, which is barely seen ever anywhere. Lounge : nice ambiance with good food, liked their unique coffee cups.Rox (Italian Restaurant) : Gosh! That was THE BEST. Great magic by chefs to freshly made pizzas and pastas.Cafe : again leaves the impression to come back again with the magical food and service with recognisation.Chef Gopal & Chef Naresh : you have a great team.Rohit Rawal & Kumar : hatttts of to you and your team for Great service and giving the recognisation at every meals.Front Office :Yogendra,  Sano : always there with a positive ready to help attitude. Laxmi : lady with a smile always there to welcome and assist.My & my wife's favourite was : Kriti  - the lady is a GEM. ALWAYS made sure we are well assisted, timely attended, given the acknowledgment and honor of a WOH member & a guest. She not only took best care of our all our requests personally but also made us plan our itinerary for all days. Definitely a recommended option to visit when in Kathmandu,  Hope to visit you guys soon.Regards & Cheers !Rajat & Ashima

Ms. Binu, a staff member at the Hyatt Regency TLR restaurant, is truly remarkable. Her exceptional communication skills are apparent in her interactions with guests, and she displays a remarkable ability to engage and convince. Notably attentive, her impressive behavior and extensive food knowledge enhance the dining experience. The cuisine at the restaurant is of a world-class standard, and the menu prices are reasonable. The dishes are not only delicious but also meet international standard . Regards Madhu

The location is what made me choose this hotel, but the food, wait staff, spa, and rooms made it special. Jhapad and Jalpa in the dining area were always very quick, courteous, and attentive. I don’t remember the name of my masseuse, but she was fantastic as were all of the spa staff. Like I mentioned, the proximity to Boudhanath Stupa and the airport are huge pluses. It’s much more quiet and relaxed than staying in Thamel. Anytime I come back to Kathmandu I’ll be staying here.

I had a great breakfast buffet here with freshly cooked eggs, dosa, and spicy noodle soup. There was also a wide selection of breads and Indian cuisine. The staff were very friendly, and I especially appreciated the excellent service from Rajanish.

This may be the best Hyatt deal of all time!  My husband and I enjoyed our stay so much that we're returning in 2 weeks for double the time.  In our experience, Hyatt always has knock-out customer service, but the staff at this hotel went above and beyond.  From recommending fair cab rates to upgrading us to a lovely suite to storing our bags during a trek... even breaking our large bills: the concierge and staff were nothing short of incredible.  We also highly recommend getting club level.  The food during happy hour was excellent and ethnic!

The stay in Hyatt is always delightful and this time, I had the breakfast in the hotel & was taken cared of by Ms.Jalpa & Mr.Jhapad.  Both of them were attentive and very observant to my needs and not only me, they treated all guests with high standards of service.  Thanks for your excellent service, Ms.Jalpa and Mr.Jalpa.

Great property with fantastic views. Room maintenance and cleanliness needs attention.The room was smelling of Cigarette smoke even though these are non smoking rooms. The room maintenance needs to be done more properly, with some cracks in the tiles, and non optimal functioning of the shower

I had an absolutely fantastic experience at the terrace bar, largely due to the exceptional service provided. The server not only demonstrated exceptional professional competence but also imbued a warmth and friendliness that genuinely elevated the entire experience.The epitome of hospitality, nirman and his team made  us feel genuinely welcomed and taken care of. His service boosted the whole bar's lively ambiance ,Their attentiveness wasn't intrusive; instead, it made me feel well attended to. This, coupled with the memorable ambiance of the terrace bar, made it a night to remember. Strongly recommend! Hats off to Hyatt Regency Kathmandu and their phenomenal team!

It was a great experience to have my mother’s 50th birthday arranged by HAYATT,  Kathmandu.It was a great choice to make.Helpful, friendly staff who go above and beyond to make sure you have the best time.The suggestion made by Chef ( Mr. Dipankar Chakraborty) To select the food menu was excellent.Thanks to Mr. Harish (Sales) for all arrangements and overall service.Keep up the great work and have a very prosperous and successful season.A big thank you to Mr. Rajesh ( General Manager) for hosting us.Once again thank you to the entire team.Aishwarya Anand & Aviral Anand

The whole family decided to have breakfast outside the house.We all decided to go to the hayat hotel bouddha and we went to the destination the hotel is about 100 meters away from the main gate. We reached the ground floor for breakfast the restaurant was very busy. We finally got a table no.31 But since there were five of us, the table was a bit small but Rohit Panday ji and Robin KC ji helped us. they arranged a comfortable table for five of us. Unfortunately, we did not think that they would give us such a nice service hotelier. Both Rohit panday ji clearly mentions the buffet also excellent service, Robin kc ji also had excellent service Many thanks to Rohit Panday ji and Robin kc ji Of course we will come again now bye.

The staffs in the resturant were very nice. Thanks Jhapad and Jalpa. You can enjoy different cuisines from diffent countries, like Thai and Chinese. The Thai Food here was very decious. The view of the resturant was very good, especially the side facing the pool.

I was absolutely taken care of by the staffs of hyatt hotel. It was a really happy experience being there I usually go for meetings over there and I recommend choosing it for any sort of gathering . I loved the outlet on the lobby area it was very warming . Binu was very polite and took good care of me whenever I have been there

The food was great! There were a lot of curry selection as well as western options. They also give endless naan of different flavors which were freshly out of the oven.Jalpa, Japad, Shvee, Amisha were serving us and was so attentive and kind. Thank you!

We have stayed many times at this beautiful hotel. Always feels like coming back home when we are there. This time in customer services Sharmila made our stay very comfortable and arranged all the things we needed the help with. Reception, restaurant and all other departments are also very helpful.

Good experience in here! Hotel staff very nice and helpful. Good attitude all time! They always carry happy smile and eye contact to customers. Their first impression is very good, I feel warm and friendly! I try breakfast in my first day, food ok, taste ok, but for me, choice of food is not too attractive, but I like the hotel staff on the service!And hotel room conditions are not very good, especially the toilet, shower area can make it better, Bec water will come out when u shower, make the floor wet.And I also have try the Italian restaurants, hotel staff service very good, but the food very salty. Environment is nice!Last day I try lunch in cafe, I order butter chicken, I love it, very yummy.And the staff very polite even he make a mistake, they are Shapad, Reshimi, Jalpu and Rohit panday, they always check back with me, I feel very good service! I’m happy and satisfied stay in here!Joanne

we stayed in Hyatt regency room no 154, 156 rooms are very old, found spiders nets in rooms , insects in bathtub, ice cream of someone in rooms drawers . Rooms are very outdated & unhygienic. We were with small kids & requested to change from twin beds to king bed they denied that also

Hyatt Regency Kathmandu is always my favorite, every time I visit Nepal for the last ten years. So happy and excited to be back since COVID started, and to see the hotel resumes normal operations. The staff at various departments, including front desk, F&B and housekeeping consistently provide excellent, caring and friendly service. They are professionally well trained by the management team to deliver a truly five-star service, and they all deserved to be recognized, including (not all are mentioned in this review) Rox Cafe restaurant for the wonderful, great variety, delicious breakfast buffet (Binu, Rohit, Gopal, Reshmi), Front Desk for the smooth, professional check in and helpful staff (Yoshoda, Sujita, Sabina, Samikshya, Sanu, Rajesh), and the amazing chefs (Naresh and Shidhant) creating many great dishes for a memorable dining experience.  Overall, a truly awesome, unforgettable hotel to stay, relax and enjoy its great facilities.

Exceptional experience at the Sesame restaurant thanks to the Sarmila who was a young lady with remarkable professionalism and warmth. Her attentive service and friendly demeanor elevated our dining experience, making us feel truly welcomed. She effortlessly navigated guest requests and ensured a memorable visit. Kudos to her for going above and beyond in creating a positive atmosphere. Thank u Sarmila.

The hotel is quite lovely. I especially enjoyed the dinner buffet. Such a great variety of food with many vegetarian options. My server was Rohit Rawal and he was very professional, warm, kind and attentive to my needs. I highly recommend him and the hotel.

This place is truly phenomenal ! The environment in the terrace bar takes relaxation and enjoyment to another level. The staff, especially the waiter nirman and his colleague bibek exhibit commendable hospitality. Their behavior is polite and attentive, creating an inviting ambiance. But the true gem of the place is their drinks, they're simply awesome. High quality, perfectly mixed and always served at the right temperature, these beverages enhance the overall experience. Undeniably one of the best spots to unwind!

We stayed here after completing the exhausting Everest Base Camp trek. The hotel is expansive, luxurious, clean, and replete with comfortable amenities.There are 3 main bars/restaurants at the premises. We found ourselves spending most of our time at the “Living Room” on the 3rd floor. The food and drinks were delicious. But the truly memorable quality of our experience derived from the staff and the quality of their service. Two of the staff in particular, Srijana and Binu, worked tirelessly to see to our  comfort. They provided some of the best service I have ever experienced in a hotel. It did not matter the time of day, the nature of any request, the obscurity of the cocktail, or, for that matter, how busy they were: both ladies enthusiastically went out of their way to see that we were diligently attended.I highly recommend this hotel on the basis of the customer service alone. It’s comfort and scale was simply a bonus.

The property was Amazing. We were there for 1 week with my family and we loved each and every moment from front desk to restaurant everybody were professional. U have an amazing team. The regency lounge was great Mr Saurav was very good in his works and always smiling and helping us in our needs so everyday happy hours we could not wait to go to lounge because of warm hospitality. The breakfast was great and lavish.

Hyatt after so long. I went to the restaurant for lunch with my family. The food was really good and the service. The guy named sagun i remembered his name because of his extra care we don't have to ask him for anything he use to know what we want and fulfill our needs.The food we ordered are uptomark. Pork chop, lamb chop, and homemade pasta all taste so delicious. The food recommended by him was excellent.The smile on his face.The green area, the architect of hotel, the birds chirping all around all our stay gone so well and beautiful. Food and service 10 out of 10 for me.The things every guest desires from a reputed hotel all fulfilled. Much obliged with restaurant service.👍👍👍

Hyatt is one of the best hotel experiences I ever had. The hotel and garden is very pretty and clean with good standard. But the thing that makes Hyatt such a great hotel is the wonderful high service minded staff. They remember your name, asks how it's going, especially after you've been sick. They make the best pink thunder cocktails in the bar. I really hope I'll stay at this Hotel again! ☺️

We went for breakfast to celebrate our 5-year anniversary, and it was a truly wonderful experience. Food is very delicious and variant, there are many mouthwatering options from which to choose. And we specially want to highlight the kindness and friendliness of all the staff members: Shree, Sandhya, Jalpa, Pratima, Sujan, Gshun and Guurav Giri. Thank you for an unforgettable celebration! Looking forward to seeing you soon again.

My friend and I are members at the Hyatt spa and frequently visit sesame for breakfast. Rohit, Reshmi,  Jhapad and Sunita are always welcoming and offer great service. Rohit even brought us a special dosa with egg that was absolutely delicious. Having a cold cuts section would be a great addition to the offering.

I had a wonderful dining experience at Sesame in Hyatt regency Kathmandu.  Thanks to server Jappad n Mallika. They were attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable about the menu.  They made great recommendations for appetizers, main courses, and desserts. They also checked on me frequently and refilled my drinks without having to ask. They were very professional and courteous throughout the meal. I appreciate their excellent service and I would definitely come back, thanks

Breakfast at Hyatt Hotel was unforgettably delicious.All the staff of sesame restaurant were helpfull and friendly.Especially the service of Mr.Rohit Pandey and Ms.Kunsang lama was excellent.Rohit offered us ABC (Apple Beetroot Carrot) mix juice(Let us think Annapurna based camp)😆 It is very good for health he said and we took ABC.He also served us fresh puri bhaji and Kunsang served fresh coffee Americano Cappuccino Latte and Hot Chocolate ........ Many thanks to all the staff of sesame restaurant Special thanks to Rohit and Kunsang for their outstanding service👍🏾👍🏻👍🏽👍🏼We will come back again soon, thank you all again.

To say with immense harmony at Sesame Restaurant inside the HYATT hotel i saw such a service that there is hardly a word in any dictionary.How shall I describe it? The first thing the staff should do to the guest the staff respects the guests very high quality.A staff greeted me (Nameste) when I entered Sesame Restaurant for breakfast his name was Mr.Rohit  he made a remarkable mention about the breakfast.From the bottom of my heart to Mr.Rohit special thanks with high regards.        After this affection and love of yours will definitely come back again                                          Bye see you soon

In the busy streets of Kathmandu, the hotel is designed to keep calm, because of its surrounding landscape. The location feels calm and relaxing after a busy day. Staffs do treat very professional in all departments of the Hotel.

Everything about the hotel was amazing. The facility was exceptionally clean and unique. Gorgeous entry, great room, great location, wonderful garden and kids playing area.We were quite delighted to see all the staff were very accommodating and helpful. Huge breakfast option at Sesame was delicious. Thanks to Samir, Amisha, Jalpa, malika for caring us with your exceptional service, also for Sreesha for the welcome amenities my kids love it.I want to thank Chef Roy, Chef Bhattarai for your time and short chit-chat, you guys provide us the beautiful, healthy, gourmet meal.Overall it was a very unique and memorable stay.  Thank you Hyatt Regency team  ❤

The breakfast here contains wide variety of choices. Jhapad, Pramila, Rohit and Sunita are very attentive to us to make us feel warm, thank you. We enjoyed staying here for whole morning, quite relaxing indeed. Definitely will come again.

As usual, the Hyatt Regency Kathmandu staff went over and above expectations to make our stay comfortable and pleasurable.  Our teenage children and their friends were also made to feel special, especially by the Regency Club lounge staff.  We have stayed at this hotel many times and it continues to be our home away from home when traveling to Kathmandu.

Vivian from hkWe really enjoyed the buffet in this restaurant, They provided variety of food and beverages. With the amazing staff here ( Jhapad, Bikaah, Sunita, Shree, Jalpa) They feed Vivian so well. So Vivian came every meal from morning to night !  Vivian feels so full now !

I recently visited this hotel and had a wonderful experience in breakfast at sesame restaurant. The ambience was far better than I expected and also the foods were very delicious. From the moment I arrived, the staff members were very welcoming especially Mr Rohit, chef Dhiraj, Raju karki and masala tea guy samir. I can't praise them enough for their dedication.

Jhapad provided me with a wonderful service and the food was well balanced,. Enjoyed it a lot. Had the grilled chicken with mushroom sauce, mashed potato and veggies and the thai red curry with fried rice.

Beautiful property, had a lavish stay. The hotel made sure to keep our needs at top notch priority. In terms of cleanliness also it was A1. I just felt that the swimmers pool should be temperature controlled as mostly it’s cold in Katbmandu, so the guests could be at ease when it comes to using the pool. Overall experience was amazing.

As soon as the car turns into the driveway of this hotel, you feel like you're in a different world. It's an oasis in the middle of a crowded, noisy and polluted city. The grounds are big and well maintained. The service is great. The food is excellent, well most of the times. It's starting to show its age though so hopefully it gets a face-lift soon. That's the reason for only 4 stars.

During this pandemic this hotel is still striving to thrive and doing its best to serve guests.  Once used to be bustling place now a days quite quiet but they will not disappoint to serve u at their best disposable even they have limited service to offer u. Lets hope once pandemic becomes normal and arrival of guests becomes smoother this gem will spark again and flourish. Thank U guys for making my stay wonderful again. Cheers to front desk guys Bal Ram at Rox and all other staffs for making my stay memorable.  Will see ya soon.

I am currently stating in this hotel 🏨 and it’s as amazing as always 💃💃💃. Hotel’s 20th year Birthday Celebration is mind blowing. I’ve never seen anything like it in my life, food, music, dance ... it’s just so fantastic to be part of 🥂🎉🎶🎊🍷

Spacious, well furnished and relaxing, Sesame is a good place for lunch with a menu offering choices between Thai, Chinese, Indian and European cuisine. Special thanks to Bikash and Jalpa taking excellent care of me today. It is my second time visiting after also a great service from Nista. I look forward to my next visit.

Breakfast buffet is nice . All food/ fruits / pastries are fresh and taste very good. Very good service from Jhapad,priyanka and Niraesh, they are professional and made me feel warmth .The cleanness has a big room of improvement . Rather filthy carpet in the corridor outside room, as well as those inside the room.

Had a chance to visit SESAME Restaurant for Buffet Dinner. Indeed an outstanding Experience. Food quality and variety was amazing. "🍒  on the Cake" was the Professional Hospitality and service by the ever smiling and Courteous Staff that included ....Ms Sajana,  Mr Rajendra, Ms Anu, Ms Sangita, Mr Sabin and Mr Ishan,

Overall a good stay, rooms are big enough. Breakfast is amazing ..most of the things served in buffet breakfast were fresh unlike typical buffets …. Thanks to Chef, Japhad and shreya for making are mornings happy.Dinner at italian restaurant Rox was another lovely experience with family, thanks to Chef Abhishek.I loved the meditation area at the lobby with om chants most of the dayOverall great place to be while in Kathmandu

The hotel was very good & everything was top notch including the breakfast. The staffs were also well trained and we stayed foe 2 nights and we enjoyed alot in the hotel. Anyone coming to kathmandu should try hyatt regency . The also gave great swimming pool where you can spend ur time.

The food and service very nice and Malika treated us with utmost respect. Her customer service was excellent and made us feel warm and welcoming. I would highly recommend any of my friends to come to Hyatt if they experience a similar service provided my Malika

Terrible service in sesame restaurant in hyatt regency, they only catered the buffet customers but did not cater other customers very well. The food was only 5 on 10. Very bad service. I would not recommend visiting the restaurant. Initially they said food was available later after an hour they said not available. Terrible restaurant for fine dining

Horrible service, bad value and underwhelming. Rooms are old. No covid safety measures in place. Guest relations are just incapable of getting something done in time or efficiently. Only good thing was the PCR test they manage to arrange for me in the hotel.

Had a lovely light lunch in the living room restaurant on the terrace.  I finished Everest base camp trek a few days ago and was looking for some calm luxury.  It really was a lovely experience. I could hear the music from a traditional wedding in the grounds and the service from the staff was delightful. I was solo but not alone.  With thanks to Anu, Binu, Sinatra and Shikar 🙂

Yesterday I had my dinner with my friends at sesame. The food quality was amazing and satisfying. The server name Rajanish was very polite and helpful… the service he gave us was very helpful to us .. he recommended us various food .. the Thai food path thai was amazing whereas the kun pao chicken was best . Thank you Hyatt regency for such a good quality food and the service .

During my recent dining experience at Sesame restaurant in Hyatt Regency Kathmandu, I had the pleasure of being greeted by Mallika, whose charming smile instantly brightened my day. Not only was she welcoming and attentive throughout the meal, but her genuine enthusiasm for ensuring guests had a delightful experience truly stood out. Mallika’s warmth and professionalism added to the already wonderful ambiance of the restaurant, making it a memorable visit. I highly commend her excellent service and look forward to returning soon.

I cannot emphasize enough how amazing the staff is at Sesame department. Sesame and his team, especially Mr. Rohit were very inviting and attentive as soon as I entered the premises, making sure that all the details of my visit were taken care of. any time I asked for something Rohit did it with attention and professionalism.

All good. Good Hygiene levels. Good Food. Stay was pleasant and comfortable in the Hotel. Air conditioner were not working in room no 151, I adjusted the temp and fan speed, It did not responded, As the climate was chill we could not not feel, If it is hot climate then the working of Ac adjustement may required

Our family and a couple of friends stayed there.  I picked the hotel because of the 14 years old daughter would not have enjoyed staying in Thamel.  Worked out wonderfully. Also, the staff jumped in with two feet helping to recover my friends' luggage that was lost by the airline.

We spent 3 nights at the hotel Hyatt regency and it was such amazing , very clean room and all the areas. The  food and drinks at the room service where awesome  even all the restaurants are there where amazing , we would recognize the name off staff Nirman,rashan was such kind staff  well taken care to us , even through everything was perfect People and all. Nice pool greenery , landscape. We would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Kathmandu and hope will see again the same experience.

I was not sure about staying here due to the mixed reviews, BUT glad we did. I used points which was very reasonable for the club/suite for 4 nights. Note the club has not opened up but they have happy hour in the bar area, so that was fine. Yes the rooms are dated but they were still nice, nice big suite and very clean.  The breakfast had a good variety. So glad it was not close to the road and all the noise. It is close to the airport and they picked us up at 11:45 PM very late. Someone had mentioned the outlets and they are were the C with the thicker pins BUT I was able to plug in the USA plug with no problems charging up our phone. I would have no problems staying at this hotel again!

Beautiful setting, friendly staff and a varied and delicious regional buffet at Sesame’s restaurant. We were traveling with family   Everyone enjoyed the selections ( especially the desserts). The variety of spiced dips and spreads was so much fun to sample Warning! Avoid those little green peppers but if you do try them be sure to have some yogurt, rice or bread nearby   —a new definition of ‘hot’. Dinner there makes for a very enjoyable evening.

A four-night stay gave me a good opportunity to experience this wonderful hotel in Kathmandu.Firstly, the staff are uniformly exceptional, professional, charming and helpful. All staff members speak good English.The hotel lobby and public areas are designed in a way that perfectly captures the Kathmandu aesthetic - it may be part of a global chain but 10/10 to the designers of the public spaces for localisation.Rooms are large and spotless, a little dated in look as at early 2024, but well laid out and everything works!This hotel may have the best looking hotel alI day restaurant I have ever been to and the diverse breakfast buffet may well have been the best I have found anywhere.Cannot take credit for choosing the hotel as it was selected by the tour company I travelled with, but if it is in your budget, it is a brilliant bet.Excellent sustainability progress re consumables was impressive.

I cannot emphasize enough how amazing the staff is at sesame department. Sesame team, especially Mr Rohit Pandey were very inviting and attentive as soon as I entered the premises, making sure that all the details of visit were taken of. The breakfast of sesame department was very delicious.

This was our first time in Hyatt for Breakfast Buffet. We were treated with a very good hospitality given by Miss Jalpa Adhikari and we are very satisfied with the good food. The surrounding around here is also very soothing and full of greenary. However, it would be great if there were more items of meats in the beeakfast.

It's not far from the airport and a shuttle is available but you have to book it with the hotel in advance.The lobby is beautiful and the front desk is helpful. Room size was okay, fine for two. Attention to detail in decor, clean, well-appointed. The bathroom was wonderful, great water pressure.The bed, however, was uncomfortable. The mattress was flat and hard. It was a terrible night's sleep.Breakfast the next morning was incredible. Spoiled for choice with wonderful food options. There's a travel agent on site, just off the lobby to book excursions. I would recommend staying here overnight but not more simply because the beds were so bad.

Fantastic service and beautiful place.  Is one of the most beautiful hotels in Kathmandu, the food and the rooms are great and they always go above and beyond to ensure the guests are comfortable and don’t need anything.  I will definitely stay again here

The Hyatt Regency is the perfect place to get away from the chaos of Kathmandu. Rooms and services are top quality, food is delicious, and the setting is so relaxing. I literally felt stress melting away as I sat beside the pool surrounded by flowering trees. Really great stay!

An excellent, top notch hotel to stay in Kathmandu. The ambience and size of this hotel, to me it's certainly qualified as a resort as it's perfect for many activities, including swimming and trekking around it's big beautiful gardens. Lots of great choices for it's breakfast and dinner buffets. Club lounge offers tasty appetizers and an awesome view of the famous Buddhist site of Boudha stupa.

I wasn’t rushed and Rajendra told me to choose the buffet instead of the a la carte.  It was a much better value and I got to sample all of the cuisine.. Indian, Asian, European.  The whole team made me feel like home. Thanks again Rajendra, dipak, Prakash, Sabin, rohit and Preeti!

I am a regular guest of Hotel Hyatt and I often go with my family for breakfast I like Hyatt's service very well and Sesame restaurant with swimming pool.Breakfast is also very comfortable.Most of the time Mr.Rohit Pandey helps us. I saw that he respect not only me but all the guests. I went there with my family. I want to thank Mr. Rohit Pandey many times for making me happy experience beyond imagination and Nepal Number One Management.

Excellent hotel in great location.  Interesting surroundings, very pleasant garden to wander around & gallery in garden providing very interesting historical view of the area. Being so close to the Stupa (15 mins walk) was perfect...

Hyatt being a brand name, never thought of having such a bad experience.We were a group of 10ppl.We checked in on 13th june during 3:00.We straight away went fr lunch.2 of thr restaurants are under rennovations.So, they were serving breakast,lunch,dinner in thr ROX Bar. It was hot as hell.After telling them to switch on their Ac's for minimum 10times.It wasnt ON.Aftr like 30mins they switched on thr Ac's.Our order took approx 1hour to come.We were already dissapointed by the service.After checking in our rooms.Few rooms had fruit basket, few did not.Our washroom essentials were not present in our rooms.No bath or hand towels were present in 2rooms. Thr phone was not operating ..Aftr asking them to send towel, calling them 3 - 4 times frm the other room.We received our towels aftr half n hour.10:30 is the closing breakfast time..We reached at 10:15 - 10:20 in thr ROX Bar for breakfast.The staff comes and says tht the breakfast time is over.Things like this spoiled our whole trip.2nights in hyatt regency kathmandu, highly dissapointed by the behaviour and service given by them.Never expected such a service from a brand like hyatt.Subham mittal

Customer service and hotel exceeds the expectations. My wife got sick in the middle of our stay and hotel staffs tried everything to make her feel better. With fruits and hot water, staffs were excellent and attentive. Will stay here every time I visit Kathmandu.

Service level is excellent in roxx restaurant. The service crew ,  meghna was excellent in her customer service.  The ambience was excellent. Entire crew in the hotel was very attentive to customers. I used to visit thei place whenever I visit Nepal.

We enjoy stopping at the Hyatt Living Room for a cup of tea and coffee when we are out and about in Kathmandu. The Living Room is a comfortable place to spend an hour or two, great ambiance inside and wonderful views out toward Boudha Stupa. We have been coming to the Hyatt for many years and the staff are always wonderful. We especially appreciate Binu, who is always so kind and welcoming!

Arranged a dinner at the coffee shop to taste the menu for a forthcoming dinner. Staff was very friendly and attentive. The food sampled was very good and innovative. The Chef was engaging and accommodating. Banquet and F&B staff were very helpful. One observation was the the upholstery was dirty and needs to be updated. Cutlery could do with an update too.Looking forward to the main events next month.

We enjoyed our stay at Hyatt! The best facility is the enormous lap pool which our kids enjoyed! The view and property were incredible, they have jogging paths as well as a small playground area near the dining hall in case the kids get bored or done eating. We love their breakfast buffet with a great selection of food. We appreciate that they accommodated our requests for baby cot and late check-out. The staff were friendly and helpful, will definitely come back and recommend to family and friends!

The staff, the facility and the food were the best.  The specialty infused drinks and shrimp in parmesan cups at the bar were great.  Breakfast assortment was vast and everything was delicious.  The rooms were clean, comfortable and service was twice daily.  But the best part was the amazing staff-friendly, easy to ask for help and wanting your visit to be perfect.

Old property with issues in room and bathroom. Bathroom fixtures not working. Had issue of power cut in room in the evening, had to wait for 20 minutes before staff came for help.New restaurant team unable to cope up with guests leading to delayed and not-so-good service.

We had a great stay at Hyatt Regency Kathmandu! From the arrival until departure! Spacious lobby area where you will be greeted by traditional musical player.During our 2 nights stay, we always dined at the Hotel. Breakfast with wide selections and pass around, buffet dinner was nice and offer lots of variety. Rox, Italian restaurant offered nice foods from starter - desserts!Spacious and elegant lobby bar!Housekeeping team who always keep our room clean.Heads up for Food and Beverage team including Chef who always ready to assist you during dining.

Good spacious rooms, though service can further be refined and optimised.Overall location and transit time between hotel and airport is way better than most of the cities.Food quality and taste is great.Services can be improved looking at location and space.

My family and I enjoyed the stay at this hotel and my daughter was truly elated to receive the surprise birthday celebration and a gift from the hotel team. They made her day so special and wonderful. Thank you so much once again for personally taking care of the celebration and our staycation.

This is my second time at the Hyatt Kathmandu. Compared to other Hyatt around the world I would say it is one of the worst I stayed the beds are uncomfortable, the rooms are rundown. Without talking about the bathroom. But the location is nice, a huge garden, the swimming pool is big, and it is so close to the stupa.The food is good. Even if I love Boudha, I rather stay elsewhere than staying in these rooms

I am regularly visiting the hotel. It is very peaceful and I love the food and mesmerizing environment. I want to give special thanks to TLR team Meghan, Subash, Rabin and shikhar for giving me the best service every time I visit even with my friends and family. I will always  back again to take a great service from the team

The overall experience staying in Hyatt is very pleasant and I'm very impressed with their services. All of the staff is very friendly and helpful.One of the staff, Rupesh is very nice and helpful and always serves us very well during lunchtime. All of the staff really deserve for vest staff award!  I will definitely come back to Hyatt Place Hotel next time I visit Nepal!

Very expensive in an environment which lacks all class, style and sophistication. Nothing complimentary and a wine list which reflects London Solo prices. It’s absolutely ridiculous and obscene franklyIt’s a corporate, it’s totally lacking and incredibly expensive. Shocking rip off

There are variety of options for breakfast buffets, including western, Indian and Asian style. I really enjoyed the local style bread comes with soup. The service staff were so helpful. Especially Jhapael, Rajuigh and Ghree! Thank you so much for the service. I can’t wait to come back.

We ate at the Rox Italian restaurant at the Hyatt Regency Kathmandu! Excellent cuisine  -  the pasta “al dente”, the salad beautifully prepared and the minestrone soup exceptional. Compliments to Chefs Dristi, Pasang, and Rajesh! And kudos to our servers Laxman, Mahesh, and Sunita!  As a lifetime NYC’er and one who has frequented some of the best Italian restaurants in Manhattan, I recommend Rox without hesitation if you are ever the world-class of Kathmandu, Nepal. 🇺🇸❤️🇳🇵

The hotel and facilities are very nice but the staff need additional training. The check in experience was not good due to our room still being occupied at the check in time. The fridge was not working well and even though we asked for it to be fixed or replaced nothing was done and we ended up needing to discard our babies breast milk. Overall a mixed stay.

I want to thank nirman and bibek for going above and beyond to ensure that our dining experience was perfect. Their genuine hospitality and impeccable service made us more memorable in hyatt,Bibek is an absolute gem, his professionalism and warmth added a personal touch to our evening and we left feeling thoroughly satisfied . He went out of their way to accommodate our requests and made us feel like VIPs. We’ll be back, thanks to them .

Great place to stay with excellent hospitality......G R E A T food along with good people...... Nirman served me on my stay and thank you for everything.....Want to recommend this for all other future visitors of Kathmandu . This one is from fully satisfied customer.

We have been to the breakfast restaurant with family and kids few times.. we loved our food, it was amazing. All the Staff were very caring and friendly specially Ram KC, Rohit Pandey, Rajju Koju, Sharmila Gurung, Amin Neupane Pratima Parajuli, Jalpa Adhikari, Ishan Khatri and Prabal Khadka. If you find any of these staff, you don't have to worry about anything. They will take care of everything, and they make sure you enjoy your food. Thank you once again for everything you do and keep up the good work. We recommend everyone to visit Hyatt Regency Kathmandu for the food and amazing hospitality.

It was amazing stay for me. Smooth check in by Pasang very sweet and C/o was also smooth and fast I forgot her name. Thank you to sabita from HK very friendly as well as the bell boys too. The hotel is really amazing. Thank you team for making my staying lovely.Hope to see you all again.

Hyatt Regency Kathmandu a five-star luxury hotel and resort is the ultimate property for both business and leisure travelers as it caters to families, groups and singles, it is absolutely fabulous. Very friendly and helpful staff. Centrally located close to the major shopping, Bhatbhateni Supermarket, Bauddha and Cinemas.

Jhpad, Shree, and the entire staff (literally every single one of them) here are extremely professional, genuinely caring and took the very best care of me, my family and friends. We will definitely come back again and recommend others to enjoy their hospitality. Namaste!

The best massages my wife and I ever experienced. Thanks to the wonderful hands of masseuses Surya and Prem.The 90 minutes Deep tissue  massage took the stress out of our bodies and left us in a thoroughly relaxed state. We couldn’t recommend there two women enough. Many thanks.

The hotel is well located, the room are spacious and quite clean.During my stay only one restaurant was open and the bar, which was quite limited in term of food.Peoples from the bar are very nice and do a nice cocktail!! Thanks to Norman, Roshan and Rabina.

If you in Nepal, Hyatt Regency is a place to stay.  It’s just not a 5 star hotel but the warm by hotel staff makes it special. Tesering , Tashi, Sujan, Jhapad, Sunita, Shree, Rohit, hotel chef, Abhishek - chef, Abhishek - service. A big shout out to all of you for making our stay special. And thanks to the musicians who gave me an opportunity to play with them. The trip was special as it was my wife’s birthday and these folks made it larger than life.

We celebrated our daughter's birthday today at Hyatt Regency. It was wonderful and memorable birthday for my daughter.Ms. Kalpana and Ms. Sanjana helped us a lot to make it so memorable and their service is really appreciated. Staff also very freindly and polite. Food also good and we enjoyed that evening a lot. Thank you Hyatt Regency Team.

We had a wonderful stay at Hyatt Regency Kathmandu. Our room 543 Regency suite was amazing. I wanna thank all the Regency Lounge staff: Saurav gurung, Rabin KC, Tara lhala, Asha Magar & specially to Tashi Lhubdup Lama. Tashi a very fine young man was professional & friendly. He went above & beyond to make my family & little kids feel welcomed and provided excellent service. Breakfast spread was nice. Playground for kids. Overall nice property close to Boudhanath stupa. We’ll be back for sure.

It was really a wonderful experience during my stay  Everything was perfect.i felt that I am in my home .Thanks to team members who had taken care very well .Bibek RamMahimaRashmiKumar PurshottamAminPratik chef - morning breakfast Kriti - front desk

Everything in the hotel is great. The stuff works so hard to make your staying much more comfortable and satisfying. Specially thanks for sunita, scijana, jhapad, rajanish, shree and pramila Without your work and kindness this experience would not have been the same.

We stayed at this hotel the first time we came to Kathmandu 20 years ago.  We loved it and this is the reason why we came back.  Overall, it’s a very good hotel. However, we were a bit disappointed for three main reasons: 1. It’s decaying and it  shows. 2.  Food service is rather slow. 3. Unresponsiveness. We asked for tissue and adapters to the front desk and hours passed with no response.  A pity.

The service all-around was exceptional. Starting with Sanuram at the front desk who went above & beyond to accommodate our family and facilitate a last minute room change. The morning breakfast staff was a dream! Quickly into our two week stay they greeted us and knew our coffee orders. We’d all like to thank Sunita, Shreya, Shree, Jhapad, Meghan and Chef Prem. I tried to learn their names as they had learned ours.

Didn't enjoy this trip. absolute waste of money. Every time I ordered tea it was super cold. One time ordered 1 cup but I was charged for twoI called at reception regarding the overcharged. they were not bothered to call back

Rohit, Shreya and Jhapad are amazing! High quality service. Food is fantastic. Service is amazing. Really impressed with the service they provide here. They go above and beyond to make sure food is hot.

I really appreciate the effort of our beautiful lady in the restaurant for taking care of us. She was really courteous, helpful attentive at the same time. I must say she is the sweetest person I have ever met. Thank you so much Sajana. The food was also delicious and the other people were also very nice.

The room was specious and spotless, with nice decorations and soft pillows. The breakfast buffet was delicous with a huge variety of options. All the staff were kindfull, frank and went out of their way to ensure that we are comfortable. Specail thanx to Aruna, Bikrant, Passang And Sujita.No torouble at all and we fell like as home.

Have visited over 25 countries worldover but this one has one of the best Portico I have ever seen. Wooden Carvings are amazing. Area is huge. the water body leading up to Hotel Lobby is very good. Flute Music in the evening specially Aarti by the artists is amazing. Stupas in the central porch is just too beautiful. And to cover it all Rooms are big, Lawns are great and Breakfast Spread is a Vegetarian delight. And last but no tht eleast it is close to Shri Pashupatinath Temple. I will surely visit again.

Hyatt is a great choice while in Kathmandu.  Highly recommend upgrading to executive level- includes airport transportation, happy hour and breakfast.  It’s close to the airport and has a “jogging track”, which is a stone sidewalk. But can get a decent run in if you choose. Service is exceptional, they cater to your every need. Would definitely stay there again in the future.

Words are not enough to express how wonderful my experience was here, it was simply beyond my expectations. The food was amazing, and the environment was clean. Additionally, we couldn’t help but be warmed by the very impressive hospitality we felt by the staff. With her gentle bow greeting us, Ms Sajana and an attendant with million dollar smile, Mr Sabin made our experience here delightful.

nice, clean and classy hotel. Authentic Nepali design hotel. loved the hotel thus we added extra day stay on our itinerary. safety is not an issue and the hotel staff are always there for any needs and issue. front desk, Yancheng was superb and airy accommodated to us.

Very modern and nice place with traditional Nepali hospitality. I was very happy with my stay, will definitely come back. Area of Bodanath also is full of interesting atteactions with tones of things to do / look / shop. I fell in love with Nepal through Bodanath.

We had dinner at Sesame to celebrate my parent’s 50th anniversary. The food was good but the service was better, thanks to Sajana. She took care of everything, including organising a great table and a surprise cake. Her attention to guests during a busy time was greatly appreciated.

We had lunch at Sesame Restaurant, Hyatt Regency Kathmandu. Papaya Salad (Som Tam), Pad Thai, Thai Green Curry, and Schezuan Chicken were delicious. Jalpa and Sagun staff were wonderful. They were warmly welcoming and attentive to their service. My family and I will go there again.

Amazing food with superb service! Special shoutout to Sajana, Rohit, Chandan and rest of the staff! The chef has a magic touch, especially the Indian cuisine, is top-notch! Overall, extremely delighted by our experience.

The best ever food with good quality and taste tipical india taste.The servce staff of hotel and restaurat service staff are soo good and provide valuable service with politness and kindness. We found one of the service staff Anu Priya Khadka privide us very good and vqluable service with kindness and a very soft hearted service.Thank you hyatt regency and staff And very special Anu priya khadka for very well servce provider in food

I had a really bad headache and vomiting, staff helped by calling medicine and provided me all the care they could.Throughout the stay staff from all the departments were kind and polite.Cannot wait to come back and bring my family with me for this lovely experience.

We stayed for one night and were celebrating birthday. They made arrangement in our room including decoration and birthday cake (has mentioned in special request while booking).Room and bathroom were spacious and clean. we had lunch in rox restaurant and it really exceeded our expectations although options were less probably due to covid situation.Breakfast buffet was awesome with freshly and on demand  prepared items. staff were good and courteous Had nice experience.

It was a great experience having  dining in The living room section of this hotel. Staffs were so friendly and helpful. Service was so good.Especially thanks to the section head; (Mr Nirman)This guy is awesome.Even chefs were very professional (chef jit ) on their work serving awesome food. Will definitely visit back thank you.

Japla and Raju were very thoughtful and attentive. It definitely created us a very calming, comforting environment. We came with a big group, they made sure we are all well rested. Naveen, the chef, he cooked good food especially the Naan, very authentic and nicely seasoned. Thank you for the great service, we will definitely come back!

I heard great reviews of this hotel from my friend who had enjoyed her stay here the month prior and have to agree with her positive sentiments. This place is awesome! Such a lovely, serene respite from the noisy, bustling traffic and city life. I especially enjoyed the friendly staff as well as the peaceful walking path around the property.

It's been wonderful staying at the Hyatt.There is a difference between other 5 star hotels. The staffs and the Ambience make the difference.The staffs: lead by the manager Raju Jhapad , and his staff Rohit Pandey, Jalpa,  and Rajju have been warm, hospitable and made our stay relaxing and homely.We recommend Hyatt Regency, Kathmandu for their impeccable hospitality, peaceful atmosphere and great food and care.

The hotel facilities were good... breakfast must include more non veg options. Overall all staff are quite helpful particularly worth mentioning the front line staff sabina and sangam. Would suggest this hotel to my friends and family

The food was delightful. The cheesecake for example was light and not too sweet, it was in the goldielocks zone. The same can be said for most of the other desserts. The naan was also wonderful. It was thin, crisp and perfect. Special thanks to Sabin, Sajana, Rajanish, Deepak, prakash, Mahima,Raju for their wonderful service.

I visited Hyatt regency Kathmandu last Saturday for breakfast and I must say it was really delicious. It was an incredible experience. The hotel's ambience is truly captivating. Throughout my stay, I witnessed the staff's genuine dedication especially Mr. Rohit Pandey, his care for the guests and commitment was really very amazing.

hotel is still impressive but food is somewhat disappointing especially outside of main restaurant (wasn't able to try Rox the other main restaurant as it's closed on Tuesdays).  Stayed in part of the Presidential Suite (701) which was very impressive with huge balcony.  Stayed at hotel 7 yrs ago and it seems about the same.  Prices are more than double of 4 or 5 star properties especially in Pokhara.  However, the spa was less than half the price of the Marriott's spa.   It's a good choice for  a couple or few nights max.  Location not as central as others but transportation is cheap although traffic terrible.

The staff of sesame restaurant is superb and friendly. They always serve with smiling faces and special thanks to sajana ishan Preeti and rajender to give the vibe of home away from home. Thank you for your service and making our stay memorable.

I was greeted by a rude security guard on our way back to the room at 10 pm. The way he DEMANDED us to show our room key was very embarrassing.Being polite doesn’t cost much.People should really learn to respect and be polite regardless of what we wear outside. Such a shame.

The setups were very good from the lobby to the sesame. Smiling staffs all around there for support wonderful buffet and delicious food. We were there to celebrate a birthday!! The way they have arranged us and greeted us through the entire those few hours have made our event unfogetable. @RohitRawal is graceful manger and his entire team whoever has served us were fab!!Wow!!Thanking you so much!

Nice resort with good breakfast spread.. Sanajana and Rajanish were very helpful in making our stay comfortableResort's location is good in terms of nearby attractions. Staff was very polite and courteous. Multiple restaurants options within the resort as well.

I reached a terrace bar. It was an outstanding location to relax, and my friend and I ordered some wine and cooler . The cooler  was prepared by Nirman and Sanjiv which was fabulous  and the orange cheese cake tasted great. The service was also excellent.

Checked in early went shopping, returned and was told there were no available rooms. I insisted. They gave me two twins rather than king I reserved, the shower wasn’t clean, and there was water all over the floor.  Guessing toilet plumbing fixture was leaking but had to deal with it by throwing all available towels onto the floor the two days I was there. For the money paid, this was not a good experience. I won’t stay there again.

Excellent service  provided  by ms binu and rohit .            Staffs are so friendly and cooperative specially ms binu and rohit  keeps  of the good work on the comeing day's  .i stayed  on room 326 and the service  were  upto the expectations  level overall enjoyed in staying at  hyatt recency  .

It’s been such an amazing experience to stay in Hyatt Regency. The room was pretty huge! Enjoyed the garden and swimming pool areas. The staff was amazing! They are very friendly, helpful and attentive to us. The breakfast food was really good that we ate too much. Special thanks to Rohit who took care of us while we are here. It’s been a pleasure to stay here. Hope I can come back again next time.

Hyatt, the terrasse restaurant is amazing. Food is superb; the staff are so sweet, attentive and personalise the experience at the restaurant. I will keep coming back. A warm thanks to Sabin, Sajana, Rajendra, Anu, Rohit, Prakash, Dipak and especially Kopila.

An amazing getaway. The staff were very courteous and handled every request with utmost professional manner. The place is one of the finest example of Nepalese hospitality. Highly  recommended, kudos to entire team & keep up the good work.

When we entered the terrace bar, the display of drinks attracted us, and we ordered some drinks. The drinks had an extremely striking appearance and flavour. The atmosphere was calm and serene, the bar was well-maintained and clean, and the service was excellent. Thank you very much to Nirman and his group.

It was good experience visiting this hotel. The hotel is very neat. The food were very delicious. Love the natural surroundings.  The staffs were very friendly and so welcoming especially Mr.Rohit Pandey, he knows how to take care of the customers.

I enjoyed my stay here very much. Hotel staffs like Mr. Rohit, Mr. Jinpad, Ms. Sunita were very kind and I am thankful for them. Those who visit nepal for whatever purpose, come and stay, enjoy Hyatt Hotel service. You won't be disappointed and will be very happy like me. Dunebat!

Stayed with my family for a single day.Its a very huge Property, whole staff is very polite and friendly especially the Chef (I forgot his name but a guy with Moustache, met us in Lunch time) Food Quality is awesome but rooms looks bit old. Any one can make out from Doors and some interior. Missed out going to casino which is in the propert itself. In Short it was a nice and memorable stay

I had a wonderful lunch experience at the Hyatt Regency Kathmandu, thanks to the great hospitality provided by Binu, Srijana and Robin. They were all attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable. The fried fish with potato wedges was yummy! I would highly recommend 'The Living Room' to anyone looking for a memorable dining experience in Kathmandu.

The hotel is a bit dated, but the exceptional staff attitudes made up for this. Everyone was friendly and caring. The teams in the f and b establishments were friendly and knowledgeable. Their attentiveness was on point every time we visited

The hotel has a beautiful garden and is in a quiet place It is best for a couple to visit and destination wedding ceremony. Having a large space with a jogging track tennis court and many more. Miss Sabita from the housekeeping department took really good care of our room. Thanks to all the members from the hotel.

The pasta and the lamb chop which was made by Mr hira Lal shrestha . Mutton seek kabab was amazing taste made by chef surendra .The service which was provided by the evening team was awesome..I don't remember  the name but Mr rajanish was so helpful.. service was excellent.. want to thank Ms jarana too for pastery item she provided to us..Thank you all the Hyatt regency team for marvelous services and food .

Being a member of Hyatt it's really pleasue to stay in Hyatt Regency and  appreciate it and thanks to all the team members . specially the lady in reception who help me  to check in I don't know the name and housing supervisor she gave me a beautiful flowers ,chef  and miss Neha, all of you team make me feel like I am the one 😊.Once again thank you all .# Hyatt Regency team .

My second time at Hyatt Regency Kathmandu. Nice hotel grounds, friendly and courteous staff, good breakfast, spacious and comfortable room. Large pool and gardens. Internet service very patchy and needs improvement. Otherwise would recommend for business or leisure.

Hi guys I am staying in the Hayat regency Kathmandu, I would really appreciate the staff over there. I would really thanks Mr. Rohit the Cafe manager, Chef Nokhi, Sandhya and Anup,who made our evening so special, by preparing Jain food.The taste was awesome and fabulous.Thanks to entire staff over there.

Every staff is so friendly and hard working! It’s my second time to stay in this wonderful hotel, Jhapad and Rohit always wear big smile and really care about customers!Also Jaspa, Sunita, Shree works ethic and provide good service!

Hyatt regency have a very beautiful restaurant named TLR(the living room ) which has the delicious food with great team members. Asmita , Subash and tenzing .The ambience is great . Thank you so much i would recommend this place .

Great place to stay away from the hustle in Thamel. Boudha has it’s own food scene and the hotel has a great bar to wind down the night. Balaram served me on my stay and was fantastic at showing me the local offerings.

The Cafe Sesame is great! The waiter Rouit, Jalpa, Bikash and Kunsang made me and my colleagues feel like home. Their excellent service definitely raise the valuable experience on this trip. I hope to return here and see them soon. Thank you so much for the great service.

Hyatt regency is Good property, excellent hospitality and good food I would particularly like to thank Nirman for taking care of everything, me and my room service order.  As I say the location is one of the very comfortable to come from airport, service is good l,club rooms are best . I would definitely stay here again. Thank you

The rooms are great. Food good too. I was at a conference, so I spent a lot of time in the conference hall (the chairs could be a bit more comfortable there!) I loved the walk-way (jogging track) which goes around the property, surrounded by lush greenery. It was a pleasure to walk there every morning.

The stay this time was not as it used to be previously. Understand that COVID restrictions are applicable, but things could be better still. The gym can be made operational with limited persons allowed.The property has vast open area, sadly all beautification is lost. the grass is no longer green, the flowering plants are not maintained, the pool is very dirty although cannot be used, but still can be kept clean, or leave it empty rather.

Ive been staying here just for a night but it was a great experience. Nice staff and clean bed. Laundry service is excellent and welcome drinks was also nice. I definitely stay here again when I visit Katmandu. At the breakfast buffet there was a staff named Jhapad, he has a very kind and nice service attitude. Thanks to him I enjoyed good coffee and dosa.

The living Room at the Hyatt hotel is one of the best restaurants in town. Services are excellent and foods are delicious. Staff are very welcoming and specially Binu’s smiling nature and good services attract customers . We wish entire team of TLR great success.

We came to Hyatt Regency for the events from India and the stay we had was amazing. The food and service was out of the world. They have a good attitude and welcoming nature. Special thanks to the whole team. I would like to appreciate the special effort of Sunita, Rohit, Sajana, Nista, Mallika, Anu, Ram Chef, Shree, Rajanish, Swastika, Jalpa and Jhapad. Thank you so much.

Hotel exterior is beautifully designed with Nepali arcitecture. Room and bathroom is out dated and AC doesn’t function well but it is spacious and clean. I want to appreciate every staff member and special appreciaton to Sesame Restaurant staff especially Sajana/Rohit/Bikash/Jalpa and every one else for their outstanding service. Overall staff hospitality sums up your stay. Thank you Hyatt Team!!!

We traveled all the way from India for travel purpose with our friends, and we stayed  in the best hotel of the city, Hyatt Regency Kathmandu. We loved the food, people and the place is extremely beautiful. Special shout out to the manager of the restaurant Ms. Sunita and her team, sajana, jhapad, Rohit, rajanish, shree reshmi. Thank you everyone.

Perfect stay in Kathmandu Perfeito! Quartos maravilhosos, atendimento excelente, comida, piscina, localização  perto do Buddha Stuppa, rooms with wonderful full!! I recommend 🙌🏻The restaurants Sesame is terrific — stuff, food and service! Thank you 🌹

Staffs in the Sesame Restaurant  were wonderful, friendly especially Jhapad, Shee, Malik’s and Rajnish. Breakfast is great  with the staff hospitality.  Highly recommended to friends in future and will look forward to see them again.  As I’m in the same service industry just want to thanks them for their hard work and professionalism.

it was a nice place with all luxuries, swimming pool, spa and the landscape it was awesome. I like it so much. rooms are quite comfortable. Staff was very welcoming. weather was very good. reception staff, housekeeping everyone was very supportive

We stayed in Hyatt Resency Hotel ktm 12 - 15 Nov2021. Arrived mid-night, Room 511 we found cozy, tidy, spacious. Impressed by hospitality , humblenesses of Binu, Rohit and all staffs at restourant, Ms Rajbhandari at  reception, staffs at Bar  and room service. All  food we choose delicious  and excellent. Golden gate, chaityas are worthy to be captured for memorable moment of our tenure at kathmandu. Magnificent Views of Baudhanath stupa we liked very much.  One can stay in this hotel for life time experience being at kathmandu . Had gone through some previous reviews however at our tenure no complain at all. - Prachanda/ Radhika Shrestha.

Breakfast is amazing with wide variety of choices or authentic food. I had 3 cups of masala tea.the staff are efficient and friendly,Bikash, Jhapad, Sunita, Rohit, Jalpo, Karun.  They treat us really well and kept replenishing our drinks. great job

I simply wanted to express my sincere gratitude for your wonderful hospitality.I want to deliver a message to Mr. Ram and rest of his team in Sesame Restaurant (Mr. Jhapad, Mrs. Rajju) and the rest I didn’t get the chance to remembered their name but all of them was smiling and greeting me I feel like I am in home between them, thank you very much for your kindness. You are deserving of far more than a simple thank you. Please accept my heartfelt gratitude!Thank you very much for your warm welcome. Fron desk team (Mr. Bhushan, Mr. Tsering, Mr. Bikrant, Mrs. Anita, Mrs. Kriti) generosity and thoughtfulness will be remembered forever.

The hotel was great in general but the restaurant hostess Sajana was especially fantastic; friendly and informative about the local Nepal culture!! Looking forward to the rest of the trip but this first impression on our first day has been a great start!!

I have been coming to the Kathmandu Hyatt since 2001. It is simply my home away from home. Each year gets better than the last. I am treated like family. I cannot thank them enough. A special shoutout to Sabita in housekeeping for taking such good care my needs. They are all so wonderful. I cannot recommend this hotel enough.

It was an amazing experience we can’t thank enough to the staff some names we remember is Sajna, Jhapad, Sunita, Rashmi and Sabin also  above all the Head Chef. We loved I so much must visit for the hospitality. It was the love and care what we felt there. Kathmandu is so spiritual and dive place the energies here are so different and beautiful. Hyatt Added cherry on top. Thank you so much everyone 🙏🏼♥️

Great location overlooking the pool in an outdoor (COVID safe) setting. The Living Room is newly renovated and elegant. The food and service (fromBinu and Sanjeev) was outstanding. It’s also close to the  Boudha Stupa. We’ll be back.

My husband and I enjoy going to the Hyatt for the buffet breakfast at the new restaurant - Sesame. The food is wonderful, the renovations were very well done, and the staff is outstanding! We are always very well cared for. Rohit and Jalpa, in particular, have always made us feel right at home. Jalpa is so joyful in her interactions and Rohit is so kind and courteous! We always feel at home. Thanks!

I recently stayed 3 night in the amazing Hyatt Regency Kathmandu hotel. Every aspect was amazing; the architecture, the quality, the location, and most importantly the wonderful staff. I had the great pleasure and honour to meet Ms Sabina,Anisha basnet and Housekeeping staff Mr Krishna,pankaj,santosh,sabita, narayan, nirmal. Their friendliness, their professionalism and their kindness was a great credit to themselves their families, and to hyatt Regency Kathmandu. These gentlemen made my stay so very memorable and enjoyable.only one thing to improve is wifi connectivity(its very slow) and tv in my room was not working properly.thx guys for wonderful hospitality.

The food from sesame was amazing prepare by chef HIRA LAL SHRESTHA: and sandhya, surendra was also so helpful. The service which was provided by rajendra and rajanish was excellent. Thank you hyatt regency Kathmandu.

The hotel is probably the most beautiful in all of Kathmandu. The hotel building has beautiful architecture and a stunning garden. It’s ideal for a morning or afternoon stroll. The Buddha stupa is walking distance from the hotel. The food was impeccable. They seem to serve a mix of Indian and Chinese food at buffets.The rooms are a little dated. However, large and clean. We really enjoyed our stay here.

This was my first time at hyatt regency kathmandu .i went for dinner with my friends. I remember her name chanda she was best she served with smily face and grace and Sandhya  at front of resturant was very smily and helped us . All evening team like prakash rohit rajendra was very good . Would love to come again with family .

Last week, I was there for a brunch and we were served by Jalpa. She provided excellent service. We really enjoyed the food and the service provided by the sweet and kind Jalpa. We will definitely visit again next time and have more time there in the hotel.

Ambience beautiful, however beware if you request a taxi.  Really bad experience.  Made request and when taxi arrived, very bad condition of car, driver did not speak English, and no GPS or idea of where I wanted to go.  So refused to get in and complained to those ordering the taxis.  So another ordered, on arrival, exactly same scenario, so once again refused to get in the car.  On the third try, finally got acceptable car, although driver tried to over charge me, 3 times the value of the actual trip.  All of this not only disappointing, but could have put me in a lot of trouble.  After this happened, returned in a week and spoke with management about the situation. The Hyatt Regency Kathmandu was booked as the end of our tour with ECO Holidays Tour. It is an impressive, luxurious hotel complex with an impressive, temple-like Newari-style entrance area. The lobby, where religious rituals are sometimes practiced, is extremely attractively designed. There is also a small museum on site that invites you to explore. Despite these notable features, we unfortunately have to mention some minor flaws in the service. Five stars means perfection, and although the hotel offers a good standard of luxury overall, this perfection was only achieved to a limited extent here. As you can see from my many reviews, I visit a wide range of hotels and a five star hotel must be able to live up to this standard.Location and surroundings:The location of the hotel near the Boudhanath Stupa in an extensive garden area is particularly attractive. The proximity to the airport is also convenient, which also explains why various airline crews like to stay here.Room:The rooms are spacious and our room had a bathtub.Unfortunately, I discovered a duvet with stains in this five-star hotel of all places. The staff only applied a thin layer of varnish, but the stains (blood or juice) showed through. Something like that shouldn't happen in a five star luxury hotel. After calling reception, nothing happened at first, and it wasn't until I complained to reception that staff came to the room to re-upholster it.Service:The service was generally friendly, but it lacked perfection. The cleanliness of the corridors to the rooms left something to be desired (should be vacuumed more often), and the used dishes from the rooms should not be left outside the room doors for hours.Gastronomy:The breakfast and dinner (both buffet and à la carte) were excellent and varied. Many Indian and Nepalese dishes were offered. The lady in the Sesame restaurant, whose origins we had initially misjudged, was particularly friendly and attentive. She was actually Nepalese.Pool:The hotel's pool is large and very attractively designed, but unfortunately the water was very cool. It would be desirable to set up some parasols at the pool bar to provide guests with a pleasant ambience even in the blazing sun. The fitness room, on the other hand, was equipped with the most modern equipment and therefore offered a pleasant training experience.

Having evacuated from my home just over the road from the Hyatt Regency Kathmandu after the first earthquakes, I stayed in the grounds of the hotel for five days, living under a tarpaulin.  Whatever you read elsewhere, Ang Lama's rant, which has unfortunately been repeated by news channels, is a complete fabrication.  He seems to have photographed guests who had been evacuated before local people in the area had time to arrive, or has taken pictures from carefully calculated angles, and then contrasted those images with ones taken outside several days later.I left yesterday and there are still many many local people staying in the grounds of the Hyatt. Staff have provided tarpaulins, food, water and help of other kinds to everyone who was there. They also gave people hotel bed linen to keep warm with and even washed and returned it to help keep people dry in the rain! They were incredibly kind to everyone, locals and foreigners alike, and the team did everything they could to help people out.  When I left yesterday, there were many local families still camping out there in the grounds as their homes have been destroyed.No camp can be seen in Ang Lama's pictures because the locations in the grounds he photographed are all very close to the hotel, and people don't want to camp close to buildings right now for obvious reasons. Several of his photographs I know for a fact were taken with his back to a whole area of local people's tents. How do I know that? I was in one of the pictures!They say an image is worth a thousand words, but the direction the picture is taken in, and the context it is framed with, can make it into a complete lie. Think he must have had an agenda to stir up trouble. Not at all helpful at a time like this!Thank you again to everyone in the Hyatt team who did so much to keep us safe, warm, dry, fed and watered in a very difficult time.  You are all amazing!

We had organised a corporate offsite in June 2014 at this property and had booked almost 50 rooms. the entire payment for rooms was settled by my credit card. 12 days after my check out i was surprised to see a debit charge on my card for Rs 22,000. The Hotel Finance guys are cheats and they have misused my credit card details and charged my card without any authorization or approval from us. they have done this without even informing us.I am taking up this case with the competent authorities and the bank.Everyone using this hotel should be beware and do not give your credit card details to these cheats.The hotel is very average & looks like the oldest Hyatt property.The finance team is full of crooks.

Having paid for more than 200 EUR per night handling of the situation after the earth quake was appalling. Below any level. First, it is understandable that in a crisis situation people are moved away from their rooms. BUT after the government issued a plea to go back to normal operations what did Hyatt do. Norhing. A structural engineer was supposed to inspect the premises but Hyatt failed to get the person to visit the site. Yet another night without sleep in the lobby.Second, immediately after resuming normal operations, meaning people having sleep in the lobby the hotel started charging normal fees for limited food and drinks available.Third, the personnel response was unhumane. Having fainted after having had no food for three days what did these guys do? I have ask my manager if we can provide any food. And nobody ever came back with response.Nice lobby but that's about it!

I did not feel i got worth what i paid for. I paid for a 5 star hotel but got an old 3 star room. The headboard and the bed werent clean.. a big NO for me. My friends stayed at the Tibet hotel nearby and thier room while smaller gave me the impression that they were cleaner. The mattress was dissapointing so were the pillows. the furniture was dirty with stains on the upholstery. the curtains looked old and not well kept. the breakfast was good and also we had a lunch buffet one day which was quite good as well. the lobby area while quite dark and empty had a charming section in the middle with traditional nepali decor. one evening there was a 5 piece traditional nepali band playing when i entered the lobby, definitely a good touch. Bottomline is they need to improve the quality of the rooms. Location is that great either as its far away from the happening center

We were stranded in Kathmandu during the earthquake without luggage (at airport) and without a hotel booking. We were enormously impressed by the professionalism of the management and the heart warming efforts of all the personnel. Plenty of food for everyone, both for dinner and breakfast, handing out blankets and mattresses, good focus on safety (practicing a quake evacuation) and very dedicated personnel (staying on, even though their homes/families were perhaps at risk).Don't believe anything else they say: these people did an absolutely outstanding job in these extraordinary challenging circumstances!

This is the first negative review I have ever written. The experience has been so bad I have to write about it!  Checked in for one night as I needed a relaxing day, quiet night of sleep (have the KTM crud) and had a lot of work to plow through today.  Explained the situation at check in and asked for a quiet room. The entire experience went downhill from there. The manager put me in a room on the 2nd floor where they were breaking down an event structure outside with a fair bit of metal banging. Switching to a new room took 20 minutes with the manager standing by without helping or eye contact. Never said a word. New room had no heat for the first few hours and no adaptor for my laptop. It took 7 staff, 1 hour, my going to staff to resolve the issue myself and a bit of drama to finally get a solution aka electricity to my dead laptop. Now I am trying to watch BBC and the TV keeps going on the blink. Next time I want to splurge on a supposed 5-star hotel to get over the flu and accomplish some work I will go to Dwarikas.  PS- the staff in the Cafe restaurant downstairs were WONDERFUL. Unfortunately they were the only positive about the place. #neverreturn,  #norwillmyclients

I stayed at the Hyatt during the earthquake. I'd like to extend my thanks to Sinead O'Reilly and her entire Hyatt staff for providing food, water and shelter even to those who are not guests of Hyatt. They even risked their lives and went to my room to get bedding etc so I can be comfortable sleeping on the ground. Kudos to staff and to all involved. Anyone who complained is obviously oblivious to the fact that it was an emergency situation.
