Doubt if there has been any major refurbishing done since the time it was inaugurated in circa 2001. The hotel seems to depend a lot on groups (Religious Tourists and Wedding Parties). Being next to the Boudhnath Stupa it is obviously an attraction for Buddhist tourists. But, the distance and traffic from the main city makes it an inconvenient location.

LOCATION: Its close to the airport, which is great. There are a few places you can walk to, but mostly you would have to drive to the tourist sights. ROOMS: cleanPROPERTY: huge. Nice walking path around hotel. Pool looked nice.

Visit the city for two days, and choose hyatt regency. The hotel is extremely fantastic, the room is nice and spacious. What's more, the lounge staff is amazing. Here I am deeply impressed by Kushal & Samikshya who helped me all the way through. Kushal assisted me to confirm the pick up service for the next hotel, he is professional, conscientious, considerate and caring, since he has taken into account every single detail a person who is not familiar with Nepal needs. Also, he showed me how to make some Masala tea, which is the thing I truly want to know. Samikshya is also super nice during my stay and always wear a friendly smile, and remember each of my preference. I will definitely come here for my next visit!

Visited Kathmandu after 16 years and chose to stay at this hotel, coz back then, when we had visited the hotel for lunch: the memory of the immaculate property never left our minds. Now the hotel is in dire need of renovations and refurbishments. The hotel rooms are tired and the bathrooms are dated. The carpets need a change and the hotel lawns need to be really looked into! Didn’t expect to see dusty trees on the drive up to the hotel. The location is a good 10-15 mins away from the City centre. We used the back entrance of the hotel to visit the Boudhanath stupa every morning.. (its a comfortable 6-7 mins walk from the hotel). It's a MUST DO!The wifi is spotty in the rooms but good in public areas.Also the food is good. Loved the lavish breakfast spreads (special mention to the live dosa counters and yummy cappuccino) and club room happy hour treats. We had dinner at the hotel once and the indian food was delectable! Loved the Indian breads esp the naans!The club rooms are on the 6th floor and one can avail of the evening snacks from 5:30 to 8pm.  The Club house chef used to go above and beyond, serving us everything that we required!Hopefully next time around, this once beautiful property will regain its splendour!

The best hotel to stay in Kathmandu. Mejestic building and very close to airport, shopping and temples. This hotel also provides exceptionally delicious food. Please try their chicken momo during your next stay. I was treated like a royalty by Samikshya and Mr. Summen. Other staff at this hotel also provides exceptional hospitality especially, at restaurant at first floor. I was extremely impressed by the quality of service at this restaurant.

My husband and I stayed at the Hyatt Regency Kathmandu for five nights at the end of November and we couldn't be happier with our stay.  From the first sip of rose flavored tea they have for guests in the lobby, we knew we were somewhere special.  We were celebrating our wedding, albeit a few years late, and the staff couldn't have been more welcoming.  They even sent us a cake and decorated our room! Sujita, who helped us at the front desk and with various requests throughout our stay, was friendly, professional, and ensured that we had the best possible experience.  We loved her.  If you want a great deep tissue massage, Bhagya gave one of the best massages we've had in a long time! The entire staff was super-friendly.  Never once to did we pass a staff member, from waiters, to housekeeing, to the front desk, who didn't greet us with a smile and a good morning.  Do get the club room, which is totally worth it.  Not only does it include the fabulous breakfast buffet, which includes Nepalese, Indian, Chinese, American/British, and Arabian delights, it also includes a complimentary happy hour with several salads, appetizers, canapies, and desserts.  You won't even have to go out for dinner, though they do have an outstanding Italian restaurant.  Overall, it would almost be worth a day of travel just to go relax here for a few days!  Congratulations to the Hyatt and staff for offering a truly excellent experience.

I am staying in the hotel - In a club room no less - right now as I write this. The facilities are just beyond ridiculous. In one of the over $200+ rooms the shower is so poor that the entire bathroom floor gets flooded therefore we cannot use it. We have notified staff three times and they seem blissfully ignorant to our problems. Moreover, in the 2°C weather the central heating in both of our rooms des not work properly after repeatedly bringing up the issue with the staff. The only positive that comes to mind is their accommodation of our dietary requirements- at all meals the chefs have been very helpful with our veganism. All in all, we are not impressed with the failure to deal with some basic issues and we feel that the price is absurd considering the service.

I am a frequent business traveller to Kathmandu and has been always staying at Hyatt Regency Kathmandu. Its the most beautiful property like a resort, with meticulosly maintained clean rooms, facilities & amenities provided meets the needs of all age groups very courteous, helping & friendly staff at all levels, delicious food with Chefs taking special care of all my dietary needs.Overall experience is like " A home away from home"

The hotel is very nice but a bit off the city center. Overall experience was very good, the staff is very friendly and attentive, the rooms are well maintained and clean. For my stays in Kathmandu I will always pick the Hyatt Regency!

The Hyatt Kathmandu isn’t as luxurious as some in the chain but makes up for that with its peaceful setting and wonderfully hospitable staff.  The hotel is set in spacious and lush grounds and is very convenient for the airport.Check-in was efficient and all staff were cheerful and helpful throughout my stay.Rooms are large, secure and well-appointed, although beginning to show some signs of wear and tear.Breakfast is buffet-style and is sufficiently varied to cater to all tastes and nationalities.  The pancakes and omelette were especially fine!An excellent choice if you want to get away from the relentless bustle of the rest of the city.

The Hyatt in Kathmandu is a calm oasis in the midst of a chaotic city. Security here is omnipresent. Check-in is relatively easy and the rooms are in acceptable condition. 5 star rating would definitely be by Nepalese standard - not US - it’s not on par with the Ritz Carlton, but it is on par with Hyatts across the US. My room was clean, albeit a bit worn, and the shower was nothing short of remarkable in terms of pressure and hot water availability. Food in the dining hall is plentiful for breakfast and well prepared. Meals in Rox are lovely, and reasonably priced for a hotel.  All in all, if you want a more western-feel/western-standard while in KTM, this is the right place.

Always treats us well.  Would be nice if you could print out room numbers of each crew member and provide under the door of each after we check in.  Very nice discounts for our meals.  Looking forward to our next stay.

Cet hôtel a besoin d’un sérieux rafraîchissement, et aussi de surveiller la tenue des employés de cuisine qui dès le petit déjeuner ont des tenues pleines de taches et certains et certaines sentent la sueur même dans le lounge au 5ème, par contre la piscine toujours aussi belle mais manque d’hygiene, toujours pas d’accès réservé aux personnes qui ne vont pas à la piscine et pas de pediluve c’est très regrettable.Enfin je vais sérieusement réfléchir pour y revenir l’annee prochaine car de nouveaux hôtels de luxe s’ouvrent petit à petit,alors attention le Hyatt, il va y avoir de la concurrence si vous ne faites rien, pour ressembler à un hôtel de luxe car vos tarifs sont élevés

We Checked in into the hotel on 17th September and stayed till 20th September. Its really beautiful property with amazing lobby  and Entrance with traditional architecture. Service was excellent and the rooms where large and very comfortable. Good breakfast  and worth the money.

The location of the hotel is good. The maket and sightseeing places and close by. Easy to get a cab from the hotel.Staff and ambiance is great. It’s a huge property and nicely kept.Food is really bad and the breakfast was average.

1. very comfortable stay in the rooms.2. In the room there is an interesting walk-in closet3. Very spacious bathroom4. Beds are very comfortable and they have options on pillows5. The team is always will to help and move the guest comfortable6. They have good restaurants too.7. They have a very large breakfast spread.8. The front desk can be a more efficient

Stayed here for a week on business. The hotel is beautiful, rooms are great and the staff are super friendly and helpful. Not sure about the location, but we took cabs most places we wanted to see and they were very reasonable.

Great hotel with beautiful gardens and swimming pool, rooms a little tired but clean and comfortable I would go for an upgrade to Club Regency for more space.  Good spa and very good food, breakfast was a delight, dossa and western choices, can't really complain about anything probably the best hotel in Kathmandu and 5 km from the airport is also convenient.

This is a truly beautiful hotel on a very large property in Kathmandu!  Having visited the other luxury hotels in Kathmandu, we concluded that the Hyatt is by far the best hotel to stay at in Kathmandu.  The entrance hall is large and gracious.  The rooms are large and comfortable.  The main restaurant is a very nice place to go for breakfast and for dinner.  The breakfast buffet has a lot of variety and an omelet bar.  The pool is large and is a lovely place to hangout.  The grounds are very nicely maintained.  There is a back way out of the hotel that allows you to easily walk in to town and the main temple in a square which is a good place for shopping.

We stayed here from 26th August through to 29th and again from 9th Sept through 12th Sept 2018.The hotel is conveniently located close to the international airport and offers great ambience both indoors and and outdoors as it has a very large foyer indoors and a large outdoor grounds with a jogging track.The indoor foyer has architectural stone figures and places where you can sit and relax. They have local musicians playing melodiously soft music every evening which is very relaxing.We found the staff very friendly and accommodated our requests. Special mention to the head chef who always came and asked us about our comments on the cafeteria food which was very nice to enjoy.The hotel also offers a gym which we took advantage of for our preparation to the Mount Kailash Mansarovar journey.We will definitely stay here again.

しばらくの間、ネパールに来て、第１日目はこのホテルです。残念ながら、立地場所の関係で、タメルなどに行くにはいささか不便ではありますが、毎日、シティドロップサービス（１０時　１１時３０分　１６時　１７時３０分）があるので、ダルバールマルグ、カンティパス、タメルなどに行くのに利用できます。空港へのシャトルサービスも早朝から夜まで１時間から１時間半ごとに運航されているそうです。　レストランその他が十分完備しています。ロビー階でいただいた紅茶はグッドでした。

This is a gorgeous hotel with outstanding staff. The restaurants are excellent and the service is top notch, just as one would expect from a Hyatt Regency. We enjoyed our location. We had two rooms for our family, with one overlooking Boudhnath Stuppa, which I enjoyed; otherwise, the rooms were the same. We tried multiple dining locations on site and found them all to be of high quality. Truly outstanding, except for one caveat of poor communication and management. Upon checkin, we were offered to pull a prize from the fishbowl, which was a free laundry service. We were not planning to have laundry done on sight, but since we had won it, we thought why not. There was no mention verbally of what the service covered. We put several items together for two people and when the representative came to collect it, we told him we had a coupon for free laundry. He indicated that he did not need the coupon and made no mention of the limit on laundry, nor did he have us complete any form.. He simply took the laundry to be done. When we went to check out and presented our coupon for free laundry, we were told that we had exceeded the amount allowed and we were asked to pay $150 USD. My husband was very angry and I was trying to get this taken from our bill, for it felt a little like "switch and bait". You have won, so we had laundry done, and now you have to pay an exorbitant price. The manage on duty, ended up giving us a 50% discount but still we did not want to pay $75 for laundry, nor would we have, if we had been fully informed. I suggested that the staff make the "winning" of free laundry much more clear verbally to future patrons. We paid the $75 which we should not have incurred, and left in a sour, angry mood, at the end of what was otherwise a wonderful experience at this hotel. Moreover, I sent a letter of complaint regarding this experience to Hyatt Regency Corporation, hoping they would make amends in some way; however, they did not even respond to my e-mailed complaint. I would have otherwise given this hotel 5 stars, and I am resisting giving a much lower score in fact due to this caveat. I am chalking it up to poor communication, but really Hyatt?  I must include that we did choose to have laundry done, a lot of laundry done, in the exquisite Rachamankha Hotel in Chiang Mai  and it was a tiny, tiny fraction of our "discounted" price at Hyatt Kathmandu. The hotels are of comparable luxury. I suppose I would give the hotel and general staff 5 stars, and the management sadly one star.

the hotel is really good. service is awesome and food is also awesome. the place is providing a beautiful ambiance and and the rooms are really upto to the mark. place provides you a beautiful life for the day.

Nos hospedamos un par de noches después de volver de un treking, y como en otras ocasiones, fue una recuperación total.Además de lo excelente que es el hotel, el trato del personal súper amable y servicial , el desayuno bufete increíble

The staff were super friendly. When we arrived we realized that there was no non-smoking room with stupa view as we booked, but the manager did us upgrade on the room and offered us a complementary breakfast. We loved the architect, lobby, terrace, garden and food was good.Too dark at night, we would've loved a walk around the garden at night. No in house entertainment apart from casino and a local band that plays 2 hours at the evening.

Wat a beautiful place hyatt regency Kathmandu amazing style of welcome superb location,one can go there to live in peace very nice and friendly staff who serves u with full hospitality and can go beyond just to make sure that ur stay goes very well. Nice selection of food at the restaurant called THE CAFE and food is amazing full of flavors if u r visiting Kathmandu do visit to this hotel highly recommended.🙂🙂🙂🙂🙂

I had a great stay at the Kathmandu Hyatt Regency. I recommend it to anyone for any type of visit. It's a wonderful place, wonderful grounds, wonderful location, with wonderful staff. If you're planning a trip to Kathmandu do not hesitate to make the Hyatt your place to stay.

Très bon accueil des l arrivée, prise en charge rapide et sourire à tout les coins de l’hôtel. A proximité de lieus touristiques et historiques.Chambre spacieuse, salle de bain tres tres correct. Petit déjeuner avec jus de fruits et légumes frais mixer en face de nous. Connexion internet excellente, service au bar et petit dejeuner tres professionnel. Nous n avons pas tester le restaurant de l hotel.Bar et restaurant de la piscine de tres bonne qualité, n hésitez pas a demander Nirman, tres arrangeant et de bons conseils.Salle de sport tres bien équipée et moderne, courts de tennis tres bien entretenus.Nous reviendrons !

The Grand Hyatt in Kathmandu is most probably the best stay in the city. If you want a first class stay you will need to consider the Hyatt. We had traveled for about 36 hours - so we needed a proper hotel. The Hyatt was able to provide.The hotel has several eating options, as well as a very nice lobby bar to relax after a long day. The staff is very attentive and aim to please. The hotel is very well situated - next to the most important Stupa in Kathmandu. You walk out the back gate and within 10 min you are at an important religious site. When you want to go further afield, you can arrange a car with driver with the transportation desk, or a full tour with the tour desk. It is up to you, both options work.Choose the Hyatt and make sure your trip goes smoothly.

This is by far the nicest hotel in Kathmandu and I believe is there only five star property.  This hotel is highly recommended for a number of reasons, those being the location, staff, food and overall hotel grounds.  The staff is just fantastic from the bellmen to the bartenders.  Everyone treats you like you are the most special person on the planet.  This did not apply to one or two members of the staff, but all members of the staff.We had the club room package and took advantage of the complementary food and drinks in the evening, which were just fantastic.  All of the staff in the club room, including the chef ensured we had everything we needed and were enjoying ourselves. The pool is just beautiful with an adjacent bar for poolside drinks.  The room is very nice with air conditioning that keeps it ice cold.  You have a king size bed, flat screen television with cable (American movies) and good size bathroom.  It has an excellent bar and restaurant with an excellent breakfast. This is the place to stay!
バリ島などのアジアリゾートのような雰囲気です。この時期のカトマンズはかなり暑いのでプールでみんなのんびりしてました。わたしたちはプールサイドでビールを飲みながらのんびり。敷地の広さの割には人が少なく、ゆったりしてます。スタッフもみな親切ですし、目的によるかもしれませんがとてもおススメのホテルです。朝食はなんでも美味しいですよー

Horrible Internet service, impossible to watch a movie or a sport game!, specially now during World Cup!Not one English movie channel, only one or two news only. The rest, all either local or Indian languages.Room was not very well clean.Never a pool view or upgrade available.Pigeons on window don’t let you sleep at night!

Had a great time during our stay, every single time spent there was worth it,especially was overwhelmed by the courteous staff and their hospitality.upgrading my room to club room was a worth every penny and the facilities it provided.would like to mention about miss jyoti serving us at club lounge was an exceptional service provider .

nicely build hotel resort , great ambiance and spacious rooms . Very good open pool for kids as well. Good food option and mega breakfast buffet. Casino in built but was closed due to govt regulation. A nice and huge property with complimentary airport transfers.

I stayed in this property with my family recently in May 2018. I enjoyed staying there. On my request they offered me connected rooms. Rooms were good with decent size. Finding chilled rose tea and still water always in reception was very interesting. I found their staff was really courteous and polite. My welcome to hotel was appreciable and they took me to rooms directly and then completed the check-in formality there. Also they have casino in the hotel only. Food was  also nice. I was disappointed to find no hand spray in toilets even when they have too many guests from India. I booked this hotel directly and found it overpriced in comparison to other hotels and I am also told, after I came back in India, that if I would have booked through some agents then it would have been cheaper. Overall this hotel is good and can be recommended to stay.

We were promptly collected from the airport and transported to the hotel by their hotel car.  Though a very short stay of one night only, we can see that the staff and management are trying very hard to come up to the level of expectations of their hotel groups performance.

As other reviews have alluded, this Hotel is tired and in need of a good makeover, yes, I was told too that they would be starting renovations soon. They need to start on the rooms first!! A grand old lady who needs an urgent facelift.We booked 3 rooms mine was on the ground floor and I was appalled at the stains on the furniture and bed heads. The other rooms weren't much better and general lack of maintenance in the accommodation wings were evident. They were apologetic when I raised a few issues with my room but were full with weddings and promised to move me to a better room the next day. However the next day I meet Dwgar who was cleaning my room, I showed her what I was not happy with including the seal on the shower and when I  got back that afternoon, furniture cushions had been replaced and the shower seal fixed. Dwgar was a gem. I didn't change rooms because of the extra mile she went to. Thanks Dwgar.Saying that I found the majority of staff excellent. When I went to breakfast the restaurant was packed and the staff found me a seat and offered to help get food from the buffet rather than fight my way through the wedding parties making the most of an extensive breakfast buffet!!. Also the gentleman who looks after the lounge / bar area was great and ensured we were looked after.We also experienced the VIP lounge where we were well looked after and the canapes were delicious. Even when the lounge was closed due to the President of India staying they ensured we were looked after downstairs. The Assistant Front Office Manager was charming and ensured we enjoyed our stay.We had a late check out on the day the president of India was due but were whisked away early in fear we would be trapped with road closures. What transpired was a dramatic comedy as we were trapped near the airport surrounded by hundreds of people as the road was closed with people wanting to glimpse the President. The hotel driver was exceedingly patient and we really appreciated this until our travel guide came to rescue us. I would have scored 1 star but the staff make this hotel. I look forward to visiting when the hotel is refurbished, there are no weddings or visiting dignitaries .

I stayed recently at this hotel for a couple of nights.  Overall the staff was helpful and friendly, which I appreciated, and the grounds were very nice.   The executive or frequent guest lounge was good, as was the staff there as well.  Particularly considering there are not so many international-class hotels in Kathmandu, this one is worth considering. A downside, and it was not extreme, is the hotel is a bit old with a fair amount of wear and tear showing.  For example, immediately across from my room was a door that was severely scratched all over, and therefore aesthetically unpleasing, certainly not making me feel as though I was in a five-star property.  Also, one of the elevators stopped on one floor, and then wouldn't start up again to get to the next.  I therefore had to walk to the other side of the hotel to catch an elevator that worked, and got to my destination floor that way.There were other signs of wear and tear in the hotel, thereby disqualifying it from a five-star rating.  On the other hand, I used Hyatt points for the stay and given it is a Category 1 hotel (in Hyatt points parlance) it was a bargain so I'm not complaining.   I likely would stay again if I were to visit Kathmandu.

We were in Kathmandu in the month of May... First off we had great weather, so that anyway put us in a great mood... After a painless check in, we got a very comfortable room with decent view... We loved the pool and jacuzzi, but the 2 things that stood out for us were the food and the excellent staff that went out of the way to make our stay comfortableThe one drawback... Location!! It is a bit distant from Thamel and Durbar Road...and even though the hotel provides a complimentary drop-off to both the places, it's still a bit inconvenientOverall, though, it was a very pleasant stay...

Excelente localização, ótimos Quartos, lindo jardins. Dois ótimos restaurantes. Staff amável, competente e simpático. Lobby e areas sociais muito bem decoradas. Os banheiros precisam de renovação embora estejam bons.

This is one of the better hotels in Kathmandu. It is very close to the airport and conveniently located. Very friendly and helpful staff. The building and architecture are very traditional with all modern facilities.

We were on a family holiday with children and senior citizens for the first time to Nepal. Hyatt Kathmandu was definitely the right decision and we couldn't have asked for more. The rooms were great, the food was impeccable and the total area was large and had a lot of facilities like a pool, tennis court, multiple lawns, indoor and outdoor Jacuzzi, spa, sauna, steam room and much more.We enjoyed many aspects of Hyatt but what we enjoyed the most was the personal attention and support from the Hyatt staff. They were extremely helpful and made us feel like royalty. Once we happened to meet Sujita(a staff member) outside the hotel, on the streets, out of her working hours and she went out of her way to support us, thus saving us time and effort. Our stay was full of surprises and wonderful experiences that will stay with us forever.

The HYATT Regency was our little oasis of calm, relaxation and comfort during our last Nepal cruise. Spending only 3 nights in total, we were really looking forward to coming here every time after our city tours and sight seeing rides. Checking was super easy and fast, and someone showed us to the room. The rooms are not super spacious or modern but they have the right flair and atmosphere for Kathmandu - it would be weird to have a mega modern glass building in the middle of Kathmandu. If I had to name one outstanding service among all the good ones: breakfast. A huge variety of local and international breakfast options, live cooking stations and buffets. Fresh fruit juices, and Himalaya cheese, combined with all sorts of bread (incl full grain German bread) - the perfect start into the day to be energised for many hours with all the exhausting walking around the city. On our way back from the Himalaya, we stayed another night, enjoyed to pool area and the greens, light snacks and delicious coffee by the pool.Unless you’re doing a back-to-basics-hotels-Nepal-trekking your, definitely check into the Hyatt!

We have stayed here several times now and we love the hotel for several reasons:First, it's close to Boudhanath Stupa, an amazing, historical space with great shopping and restaurants. Be sure to check out the back way to the stupa from the hotel grounds. Second, it's staff. Always ready to help you out. Great for families too, they are really patient and love our 3 year old. And third, the spa, and specifically ask for Hom Thapa. By far the best massage I have ever had. He's so intuitive and has great advice. I will definitely be making appointments next time we're in Kathmandu. Oh yeah, and four, the pool...wow.

My husband and I planned a trip to Nepal with the help of Joshi at hoteleverestview.com. Prior to our stay at the Everest View, we stayed in Kathmandu for 2 nights to tour this area so rich in culture and tradition. Nabin Moktan was our city guide whose knowledge was immeasurable. The hotel was incredible with excellent service, food and amenities. In fact, following a trek from Everest View Hotel, we again stayed at the Hyatt for 2 more nights prior to our departure from Nepal.

There was definitely a WOW  when I entered the main hotel entrance; lovely tranquil, gracious.  Everything in the room was comfortable and modern, very comfortable beds, everything worked.  I especially liked the buffet dining room. Wonderful selection and all the food was very tasty.The only thing that caused hesitation were the hallways from the elevators to the rooms, the wood on the walls and frames were excessively dinged, most probably from luggage carts.  Looked a little ratty, but everything else was great.I would return and recommend this hotel.

The property is beautiful. However both the quality of service needs drastic improvement. I got a broken iron board and had to wait 2 hours and make innumerable calls before it was changed. The hot chocolate had spoilt cream topping and the buffet was very average in taste and display. The room was clean but toiletries were awful. There was no toothpaste and brushand the shampoo , moisturiser etc were not good either. Lucky for me i carried my own stuff. Check in and check out was quick .

We spent in the hotel 4nights me and my husband and son. The service and the stuff were excellent and kind, the food was very goof and well designed. However, the hotel itself and especially the rooms were old, not adequate at all and don't deserve being considered as 5 stars hotel. We have been traveling a lot all over the world and this was one of the poor Hyatt we've ever seen. If you're looking for luxurious hotel in Kathmandu, go to another hotel like Duarika or else.

Hyatt, has alot of great hotels around the world! Regency in Kathmandu is one of them!Rooms are good, spacious and clean! Some rooms have bit of bird poo outside window but views are otherwise good and green! Noticed tho on last visit that the overall appearance and service quality has gone down, rather sad. Sure each 5 star property has their ways but guests should always be a priority. The overall impression is great, just need staff to pay more attention to details and provide real 5 star service. Just because your in a 5 star hotel does not necessarily mean you receive 5 star service...Training training training...

The hotel is in a qiute, cosy surrounding and a very big complex. A very big lobby, nice pool area, large rooms, very friendly service, good and reasonable kitchen. All in all the Hotel has to be renovated, specially the spa is in a very poor condition

This is a huge property of 30 odd acres so it buffers you from the dust and bustle of  Kathmandu.  Very near the airport so we needn't fear the traffic jams either.    The food is excellent.  The break fast is wholesome.  The rooms are lovely and spacious over looking the lawns.  After you have seen it all there is a casino in the hotel for those interested.

Buen hotel en Nepal, si te gusta la comodidad y algo de lujo este hotel es el indicado.  la comida variada.   Los precios elevados que es normal.   Es relante llegar al hotel después de un tour por esa cuidad tan difícil de describir.

Good and relax hotel. Attentive and polite personel. Balanced atmosphere to start and to end the Day with positive energy.  Located at the outskirts of City center,  easy to reach anywhere in the urban area with Taxi and other local transport.
네팔에 살고있는데...  일상에서 벗어나고자 할때 우리가족은 하얏트에 간다. 네팔이 아닌것 같으면서도 전통적인 모습을 갖추고있어서 낮설지 않고 편안하다. 직원들모두 친절하고 장소도 적당히 격리되어 있어서 소란스럽지 않다. 넓은 화장실이 가장 마음에든다.

Stayed in Hyatt sadly this New Year's eve. To start with staff is clueless about the process or bookings, me and my family were made to change 3 rooms in 2 days since staff goofed up in my booking and gave me lower rate room at first since they didn't 'Believe' that I had booked a Deluxe room even though I had confirmation. Then I registered a complaint and was give second room that too was somehow only available for the day and again I had to shift the room. Had I not paid amount in advance I would have definitely not stayed there!!On top of that all complaints were falling on deaf ears. Their new year's party was pathetic and poorly managed. All in all money gone in drain and my family's new year's eve was nothing more than a whimper.They have multiple desks for customers and all desks are equally clueless. Be it their Travel desk or front desk or the so called Club Lounge. Heights of rude behavior, I have never seen any hotel staff shooing away kids using hammocks!!! In simple words Pathetic experience never ever to be repeated. I am never ever going to HYATT anywhere in world.

A grand hotel. In comparison with other hotels in Kathmandu it’s the best one. But it’s not as other Hyatt Regency. Rooms are big size but a bit dated. Food in the restaurant, simply awesome. But it’s quite expensive. Wifi in the hotel is not up to the mark. At night time it’s almost unusable. Hotel’s main gate to lobby is a bit far. At winter night it’s not so pleasant to walk, they should provide buggy service. Taxi is always available. Staffs are friendly. Nagina was really helpful. Pool is still under renovation

５つ星でなければ､気にしませんが客室は古く､シャワールームの水が流れません｡床もはげていて､古い｡ペットボトルのボトルは埃をかぶっていて５つ星なのに､残念｡枕カバーもシミがついていて電気もすぐおちるので､カードキーを差し込み再起動させないとでした｡エントランスから､外に出るのも徒歩だととおいです｡Wifiも､つながらなかったし､歯ブラシもなく､アメニティも不十分｡ステューパも､あまり見えません｡一応､羨望のよいデラックスルームでえらびました｡｡｡残念すぎる｡カトマンズの､安いホテルのほうが､気が利いています｡

The hotel has a lot of character and decorated well. The rooms quite spacious but dated and it shows. The flush in the toilet is not very convenient and requires an effort to properly flush through. The heating was not very effective.

I stayed there for several very uncomfortable nights. My room was freezing cold; visits from electricians did nothing. On day three I was "moved" to a room where, despite two electricians and a supervisor, supervised by an assistant manager, the HVAC couldn't be made to work. Finally I went off to an acceptable room having spent four hours dealing with this which I would have preferred to use sightseeing.The breakfast service is chaotic. Most of the staff, while trying hard, speak very limited English so, if you're inquiring about sights, you get little, if any help. The rooms themselves badly need an overhaul--dirty, stained fabrics, chipped furniture, showers that spray the entire bathroom...Should you be so silly as to order a drink in the lobby bar, best keep it simple. My request for a vodka martini on the rocks ultimately brought something a companion described as a "vodka slurpee" meaning a huge mound of crushed ice with little straws sticking out and very little vodka.Truly the only really positive thing about this hotel is proximity to the airport. If that's high on your list (and, given the traffic in Kathmandu you can't discount it), stay here. Otherwise, avoid.

Beautiful building and surrounding property.  Hotel is in need of good management, lots of confused staff, elevators did not work for part of the stay.  Either they need to renovate or they need to drop prices for what they are offering.  Very close to the famous Stupa, but in general the hotel leaves you frustrated no matter how much you meditate.

The Hotel in general is beautiful like 5 star hotel should be. However the room was really dated with leaking sink, old marks everywhere, wifi worked purely, with bad sound isolation, could hear my neighbours all the time. The most disappointing was the smell from the towels in the gym - like fried food - really gross. From the other hand the property is big, in summer time there is a swimming pool, and the Stupa is walking distance.

Nice, it was ok to be a 5star hotel. The food in NYE was ok. But not amazing. The people working there were nice and friendly sometimes. It was ok on the whole, but I would expect much more in a 5 star hotel.

Kathmandu is a busy city - chaotic, but also fascinating and friendly. And in the midst of the frenetic energy, the Hyatt is a solid choice. It's in a relatively good location - a bit of a drive (in inevitable traffic) to Thamel but close to the airport and right near the Bodhnath Stupa. The grounds are well maintained and peaceful, and the architecture and common areas are quite nice. The rooms are not quite as nice - certainly nothing wrong, they're all clean and functional, but just a bit worn and dated. However, given what this country and this city have been through recently with the earthquake, I didn't really mind it, especially since the service from all of the staff, including Neha at the traveal desk, was exceptional. All were very friendly and helpful. If you're in Kathmandu, this is definitely a good option - especially since I considered the price extremely good value, maybe not compared to other hotels in town, but certainly by global Hyatt standards.

Katmandu şartlarına göre , yani şehrin genel durumuna göre muhteşem,çok temiz,sakin,yemekleri ve personeli çok kaliteli gönül rahatlığı ile tercih edilmeli,kesinlikle tavsiye ediyorum pişman olmazsınız

I had the pleasure of staying at the Hyatt Regency from the 22 Nov to 24. The service, facilities and ambiance was what one would expect from a Hyatt Regency. The buffet breakfast was impressive with a good selection of Nepali and international dishes. I especially liked the self pouring masala tea and the masala omelette (which is effectively unheard of in Singapore). Besides breakfast I would also recommend having dinner at the hotel. There’s a really nice balcony area where you can have a drink and chill out. When I was there at the end of Nov 17 the evenings were pretty chilly but having a coffee and chatting the night away with my friends was a very pleasant experience.The grounds are impressive, there’s a swimming pool (which I didn’t really want to try out as it was winter) as well as a smallish heated pool.By the way there’s also a casino and sports bar in this hotel. Didn’t visit the casino but the sports bar was pretty well utilized as the English Premier League matches drew a good crowd

This Hyatt is nowhere the standards of some of those in other cities but then maybe the expectations and star rating should be lower too. KTM is not Paris, Tokyo or another developed city and as such you run into problems such as power cuts. However, the rooms are old and dated and the internet is possible only when sitting by the window. These could be fixed. The breakfast was below par too whilst the dinner buffet had limited choice at best. The staff were excellent though; well drilled, polite and helpful at all times.

The hotel is an oasis in the dusty Kathmandu, with nice gardens, pools and spaces for walks. The rooms are good and clean, the only problem was that the air conditioning was not working properly - the room was very hot. The restaurant is really good, the breakfast has a lot of options and the dinner buffet too. The staff was very helpful and kind. We had the opportunity to be part of the Christmas tree lighting and it was amazing.

Unsure how many problems are due to earthquake so I was forgiving. Anyway, the good parts:  workers are pleasant and helpful, lobby is comfortable and good to sit in and relaxing, breakfast is great and you won't go hungry, bar is empty for unknown reason but is a good bar with good menu, comfortable and a good bartender, main restaurant was good especially the minestrone soup, casino is getting old but has the typical games including Texas hold 'em.The bad:  room is falling apart, every time I pulled my room key out of the holder the room key holder would fall off the wall, the button to flush the toilet would sometimes leak brown and black colored water, the shower water would leak out of the shower and create a large puddle in the bathroom, the travel desk inside the hotel is not the concierge and is actually not associated with the hotel and can't bill to your room, the real concierge is the bell hop located outside the hotel, it is unpleasant to walk from the hotel to anywhere in town because the sidewalk just outside the hotel is rubble and dust.

The hotel is situated on beautiful grounds that is far enough away from the main streets, which makes it quieter at night.  Our room was really nice and spacious.  The bathrooms were really clean, and the water was clear.  We found the bed very comfortable and clean. The room came with bottles of water.The food at both the restaurant and during room service was delicious, and the service was excellent.  We had no problems.  The only problem I had was with drycleaning.  I sent some clothes for drycleaning.  One of my shirts came back smelling like I had been sitting in a restaurant for hours.  The location is within walking distance (10min) of the Boudananth stupa, but you would need to take a taxi or shuttle to Thamel.
11/20~11/21エクスペディアにて予約。チェックイン時、2部屋を同時に予約しているとのこと。控えの予約表見せても取消はエクスペディアを通さないと駄目だと全く取り合ってくれない。エクスペディアに連絡し、確認してもらいホテル側のミスと判明。エクスペディアへの連絡に右往左往し、国際電話料金(3000円以上)も発生するなど旅の楽しみが半減した。一流ホテルとは思えない対応の悪さだった。

We had an exceptional stay at the Hyatt Kathmandu. The staff were genuine in their warmth and hospitality. We had a room facing the Stupa so the blue eyes were welcoming us to Kathmandu. Food was excellent. Ate dinner, breakfast and utilized the Regency Club. Again all excellent. Hotel is an island of tranquility in chaotic Kathmandu. Special hint you can leave through the back gate and easily walk to the Stupa

We stayed in this hotel every time we were in Kathmandu,  the stays were always very relaxing, the service excellent and the rooms are very comfortable. Try to request for rooms with Stupa view, amazing sunrise view. We were in the club floors and I personally think that it its good idea to pay a little more for the room rates and have the comfort to be able to have a drink and snacks available when you return from your outings. The club floor also served afternoon tea and happy hours before dinner. An advantage if your flight is in the evening and you are able to check out and still be able to use the lounge before your evening flight. (the business class lounge in the airport is not that exciting ! ) The coffee house on the lower ground floor serves an International breakfast with all the cheeses, sausages, bacon etc. There was also a big selection of curries, bread and vegetarian dishes. You can have a hearty breakfast before your outings.The Italian restaurant is also worth a visit, served very good Italian cuisine and wine.A good point to remember is that if you are visiting the Boudhanath Stupa, the hotel has a back gate near the swimming pool where you can walk to the Stupa in less than 5 to ten minutes (out of the back gate and turn left , Do Not turn right as it will lead you to a vey long walk in the wrong direction ! ) An interesting walk through the back lanes with interesting small shops selling all types of souvenirs, incense, prayer items and then you will arrive in front of the amazing Stupa.This hotel has the serene feeling when you enter, as the centre of the hotel has some stone stupas with seats where you can relax and enjoy a cold drink of mint and cucumber.We will be staying in this hotel for our next visit to Kathmandu.

Nice hotel and nice staff. We felt very welcome.Only negative thing is that the hotel lies very isolated from the town (Katmandu) itself.The club facility which we experienced was top, top.Very satisfied

Everything about this property was exceptional and exceeded all of our expectations.  The grounds are beautiful, the building is in immaculate condition, the food was all tasty and the service was always impressive.We were especially impressed with Nima at check-in, Lopsang in the club lounge, and the food and friendliness of Chef Anjan.We highly recommend the Hyatt Regency Kathmandu and definitely plan to stay there on our next visit to this fascinating city.

We stayed here twice, once for three days before we went to Bhutan and for another night when we came back.Staff are excellent in all departments, very friendly and very helpful.The hotel is set in beautiful grounds where they grow herbs etc for the kitchens, within the grounds is a large outdoor swimming pool, a bar and three tennis courts, there is also a wonderful garden , that has a path around it and is well worth walking.The reception area is large with a coffee shop and a balcony, on our return from Bhutan we were able to get into our room at 10am.The rooms are large, we had twin beds on the first stay and a large double on the second, both excellent, good size shower with plenty of hot water, also in the room is a safe which is free to use.The main restaurant is on the lower floor, this is also where they serve breakfast.Breakfast was really good, good mixture of food, from local to European, two chefs were cooking eggs as you wished, someone else was making health drinks to order, plenty of choice for everyone.We also dined in the restaurant at lunch time and night, always 2 choices, buffet or al la carte, food was excellent as was the service, there is also an Italian restaurant and we dined there, again food was excellent, I had a crab and shrimp pizza and I have got to say it was one of the best I have ever eaten.Would certainly recommend that if you are coming to Kathmandu you would think about staying here

I can consider this to be one of the top three 5-starred hotels in Kathmandu. The service and hotel premises are one of the best I have seen in a top quality hotel. The hotel staff including front office, room service, concierge and housekeeping are one of the best I have experienced in a high end hotel.

I thoroughly enjoyed my stay. Every employee acted graciously towards me and appeared happy to help whenever possible. I used a club level upgrade which included free transportation to and from the airport in addition to the free shuttle into town that is provided to all guests. The lobby was attractively designed and the hotel grounds were immaculate. The lounge provided a variety of appetizers during the evening and fruit and non-alcoholic drinks during the day. The lounge staff was always pleasant and happy to engage guests in friendly conversations. Although the lounge was nice, I chose to eat breakfast in the restaurant which had a good selection of local and western foods. The hotel is only a short walk away from the Boudhanath stupa which I would highly recommend visiting.

İş için sık sık gelir ve bu otelde kalırım. Şehrin karmaşadından sonra otel sınırları içine girer girmez huzurlu bir ortama giriyordunuz.  Şehrin iyi bir konumunda büyük bir alana kurulmuş Nepal ve modern çizgileri içeren bir otel. Lobby ye giriş şatafatlı. Personel iyi niyetli ve yardımsever. Yaklaşım iyi. Kahvaltı ağırlıklı olarak Asya ağırlıklı tabiki Hint yiyecekleri ve az da olsa condinantal bulunuyor. Kusacası herkese hitap eder nitelikte. Yiyecekler çok lezzetli. Restorant personeli ilgili ve hızlılar. Odalar yöresel motiflerle ve ağaç kullanılarak dizayn edilmiş. Eşyalar eski ama kullanımda sorun yok. Çarşaf temizliğinden pek emin olamadım. Bu nedenle de şikayetim olmadı. Odalarda yeteri kadar içecek su ve meyve konulmuş. Lobby deki cafe bölümü çok geniş bir alan içinde ama küçük bir alana kurulmuş. Koltuklar yırtık pırtık ve kirli. Servis güzel. Personel yaklaşımı çok güzel.Akşam yemeği de çok çeşitli ve lezzetli. Kathmandu için çok iyi dünya standartlarında vasat bir otel.

All year I look forward to my stay at the Kathmandu Hyatt Regency, and I am never disappointed. The spacious, bright rooms and comfortable, firm beds make coming back in the evening a real delight. Should rain or flagging energy make you want to stay in during an evening, there are good English options on TV and good wifi in the rooms. Friendly staff, great service.

L'hotel non è molto centrale ma meglio così... nessun rumore né caos. Camere molto comode, bel bagno, pulitissimo... La cena è a buffet, molto varia e buona come la colazione. Bellissimo giardino intorno con piscina. A piedi potete raggiungere una  stupa molto bella con negozietti e tanta gente che prega. Ci ritornerei

Clean and comfortable, a nice place to hang out after trekking in the Himalayas. Menu offerings are in moderate price range while drinks served pool side are pricey.  Hotel included a casino if that's your thing.

Es un excelente hotel , bien ubicado , restaurantes muy buenos, si no te gusta la comida picante puedes disfrutar de su restaurante italiano , después de todo un día de visitas puedes relajarte en su piscina , el personal muy amable , lo recomiendo totalmente

Es la segunda vez que me hospedo después de un tour por India y Nepal la primera fue excelente y esta segunda también sí que creo que necesita un poco de remodelación las habitaciones pero siguen estando muy limpias cómodas y amplias desayuno   bufet muy bueno y una situación estupenda a 10 minutos andando desde una puerta trasera del hotel a bohudanah con su estupa y un montón de locales para cenar y tomar algo,es bastante más caro que otros que están más céntricos pero merece la pena por la tranquilidad lo recomiendo se nota que es cadena hyatt

What a nice hotel!!The moment I walked through the courtyard and into the lobby, I was enhanced by the sheer beauty of this hotel.  The architecture is classic Nepal, with an amazing collection of art and sculpture.  The staff took very good care of me from the moment I stepped out of my airport shuttle and through out my stay until my final departure.  My room was great -- well appointed, comfy bed, nice bathroom, and most wonder of all, and incredible view of the Stupa (this is to the east of the hotel, so I could watch the sun rise over the Stupa!)..  The grounds are quite extensive and nice -- well worth an early morning walk!  The pool is excellent -- very clean and refreshing, with a nice hot tub area and comfortable lounges.  All the food I had was excellent and of the highest standard.  It's an easy 5 minute walk to the Boudhanath Stupa -- well worth a visit.  I highly recommend this hotel, and will stay here anytime I return to Kathmandu.

We stayed in Hyatt Regency on our way to Muktinath for a pilgrimage. Hotel is close to the airport and the Stupa. Rooms, though dated are well maintained. Has lots of open space around to go for a stroll / morning walk. The Cafe serves great food and we have to mention the name of our Captain Abiskar for his impeccable service.

My wife and I live in Kathmandu, and this place is a good break from the dust, dirt, and traffic of Nepal. The food is good, room are excellent, and the grounds are beautiful! It's close to some major tourist sites and is worth the extra!

Excellent service, food, water pressure and wifi.I stayed at this hotel for 3 nights before starting my mt Kailash journey and for 1 night on the return leg back to New ZealandThe trip from Kathmandu airport takes about 20 min one way and the roads are beyond terribleThe aircon at the hotel rooms were a welcome relief from the heat. Standby generator works well and was often in use during my stay. It was able to keep the aircon going which is a big plusThe food at the main restaurant is fabulous and along the lines of the straits kitchen at the Hyatt in Singapore which is also brilliant. Sumptuous breakfast. Multi cuisine. Multiple fresh cook stations (masala dosa, eggs prepared any way you like, Nepali hot food)Fresh fruit and juice station. Huge dessert section.Very far above 5 star standardsThe bar and short eats Restraunt near the lobby is similarly excellent and my friend and loved the large sized "Gorkha" beer which is absolutely excellent. (Before and after pilgrimage)Toilets were clean and excellent water pressurebeds were also very comfortable and the room cleanAircon works well in rooms and wifi is excellent particularly if you opt for the $10/day premium package.The paid upgrade to the club rooms on level 5 is an excellent option as breakfast is provided as part of this packageStaff were friendly to a fault and did their bestIf possible try and get a room on the 5th floor where the wifi is excellent. This is particularly useful as my global data roaming with Vodafone does not work in NepalI used the laundry service which was priced appropriately for this hotel ( I note that other posts have commented adversely on the cost. I disagree)At this level I expect to spend between US$ 250 to 400 per night including accomodation,meals and services.I travel extensively and this hotel is an excellent example of the Hyatt Regency brand and standardsMy congratulations to the excellent staff and management at this hotel.Suggestion: please consider getting a sugarcane juice machine for the juice station at breakfast. Your Singapore branch has one and nothing tastes better than fresh sugarcane juice.Note: this is not a paid/ endorsed review

De mi viaje por India y Nepal , este es el único hotel de cinco estrellas merecidas en todos los aspectos: habitación , comida e instalación es. El hotel es precioso aunque alejado de todo el bullicio . Para mí fue una ventaja. Es un oasis dentro del caos del tráfico y la gente . Además , tiene un acceso por una puerta junto a la piscina a un templo de visita obligada y que tras un paseo por una callejuela llegas a una gran avenida y en 15 minutos te presentas allí. El desayuno y la cena estupendas. La piscina y el spa merecen un tiempo para disfrutar de ellos. El hall precioso. Volvería .

Stayed in room 612 (Club level) a week ago during travels in Kathmandu.  This room is located at the very end of the hall on the right side.  It does NOT face the side with the Boudhanath Stupa but rather parts of the courtyard as well as drive leading up to the main entry area of the hotel.The team here from the receiving area to the front desk to the Club level to the staff at the restaurant "The Cafe" were all amazing.  Smiles were never in short supply as everyone was quick to greet, smile, nod and check to see if there was anything needed or that could be assisted with.  Facilities are kept looking tip top from the grounds to the various parts of the hotel's interior.  The complementary breakfast and happy hour offerings for those staying on the Club level are quite generous and varied.  I found myself dropping in for a bite or two during the stay."The Cafe" has an amazing brunch that you should consider if a Saturday is in your schedule.  Aside from the brunch, the food was so good that I ended up having dinner there twice on separate evenings.  Both times were well executed as service was top notch and food perfectly prepared.The hotel offers complimentary shuttle for drop off to various points in Kathmandu which was a nice option to utilize.  A short walk outside the hotel gates towards the back of the property will lead you to the stupa which makes for unbelievably easy access to the World Heritage Site.Thank you Hyatt Regency Kathmandu team for another great Hyatt experience.

Safe, clean, good food, pool gym spa the hotel has y ennis courts, nice pool, jacuzzi, gym, spa. staff friendly, beautiful installations, great views. We loved the hotel. We used their driver and he was good, we felt safe with him, he took us to nagarkot. We definitely recommend it

You notice the 5 stars difference. Excellent hotel, probably more suited to business travelers than leisure tourists. Staff are competent and friendly. The "Rocks" bar and restaurant deserves a special mention for its setting, good food and the best mojito I've had since long. The main breakfast room lacks a bit in charm, but this is made up by the quality of the buffet.  Rooms and bathroom furniture are a bit dated, but fully functional.  All in all to be recommended if you have the budget,

you really feel like you are unique , we have been upgraded to 6th floor and our stay was just incredible , staff amazingly nice and pro . really the place to go , and for us to come back . If you have time try the SPA , that was our last few hours before leaving KTM , we would do it every day ;-)

I stayed here with my family for 5 nights and we had booked two rooms. The rooms were not ready even when we arrived after check-in time. You can see the Boudhastupa from the hotel. All other tourist locations were nearby but took us sometime to reach because of the traffic. Hotel staff was courteous.Now the disappointing part. The food service at the Cafe restaurant was very slow. They took ~1 hr to serve food which was just some salads. The hotel has wooden floor, is slippery and makes a lot of noise when you walk. Housekeeping staff were not proficient. They entered our room even when we were in the room without our permission. Wifi was very poor in the room. Pages like google took a long time to load and the internet was very very slow.Hyatt is a good brand, however, the Hyatt regency in Kathmandu has to make a lot of changes to match the standard of the brand.

Off the main road and into a beautiful landscape garden. What a difference from the mayhem of the streets of Kathmandu! Great place to come back to after a full on day of travelling within the city or other areas.

Good hotelstaff was no friendlyRoom was not good no view dirty windowesThe garden and the pool are very good the bar was niceI was waiting for more The hotel is beautiful clean and very impressive But it needs good staff and good care of the guests

I was here with my friends for the brunch n it was very disappointing. The service was very poor. Table was full of empty plates n noone was there to clear that for more than 1 hour.Even we asked to clear it and it was very embarrassing to ask for several times to clear our table. I went to the bar counter personally to ask for tissue n 2 of the server were just busy on their own conversation and finally i got it after 15 minutes. However the food were good and the chef who was on barbeque was 👍👍. What I saw on staff was lack of training which need to have in 5 star hotel staffs.
As a loyal customer and frequent guest this has been a very disappointing experience in terms of room preferences, room condition, cleanliness, and in terms of makingMe feel like a frequent customer.

Beautiful hotel, not very far from the airport. The staff here was very polite and helpful. The lobby has a live local performance in the evenings and is very captivating. We also went to the Spa for a massage. A must try!! The gym and the pool are well maintained and should not be missed. The travel desk is quite helpful and have knowledge of all the sights to visit. Please check for weather conditions. If rainy, plan your Nepal trip for later.

The rooms are ancient and lack maintenance in every sense, the furniture items are old and dirty with stains;the linen feels cheap and overused. Bathroom flush squirts back at you when you flush. Amenities are very low quality. I would not recommend the rooms to anyone. Especially at their prices. PS. Don't trust the price quoted to you because when you checkout, they will add all the taxes. Hotel lobby is wow and so is the property and its location is close to the airport. Garden is lush, and pool is pleasant. Its worth visiting the property for a snack/drink and enjoying a massage. Breakfast buffet has a good selection. But the rest of the meals are so-so.

This hotel is famous for Casino and to  play gambling .This hotel has also buffet and good quality food service was self service all of the staff was also cooperative and it was a wonderful experience staying there.

Cannot speak highly enough of this hotel.  The Assistant Manager-Outlet, Suman Acharya, assisted us tremendously.  The breakfast buffet was excellent.  They have a large swimming pool (approx. 25 metres) which was great for swimming laps.  The Himalayan Hot Stone Massage was specially good.

not advisd for family vacation. i have has terrible experience where my family and i did not bath due to no hot water! not meeting minimum standards of 5 star property. the rooms are also not in good shape and rquire renovation.

Me and my wife we had a day of "Hyatt" services and hospitality to treat ourselves.Nice bar and food on the swimming pool.Room was nice, but super modern as expected.We enjoyed the happy hour at the top floor and had opportunity to socialize with other guests.Recommended if you don't want to experience Nepal's nature.

We stayed as part of our tour of Nepal, did upgraded to the Club rooms, and to honest couldn't fault it. The service and check in was excellent, rooms large, spacious and really quite. We stayed for 2 nights and had a view over the back we then returned at the end of the tour for 1 night and had a view over the front, if you get chance ask for a room at the front.Lots of grounds to walk round and a really large swimming pool, staff all trained to Hyatt standard and couldn't do enough for you.Would we come back if in the area yes we would.

A luxury hotel with beautiful premises and huge rooms. Loved the infrastructure and the hospitality but ran into a couple of issues not expected from a 5-star hotel. Here is the summary: Pros - close to the airport and boudanath stupa. Huge property and rich interiors. Excellent rooms and bathrooms. Super courteous staff. They have a live music program every night near the reception, definitely recommended to see that. One of the 5 Casinos is within the hotel premise and offers free pick ups and drops to Thamel. Cons - Multiple power cuts when everything blacks out and it takes them about 60-120 seconds  to get the back-up/generator working. Scary if I were to be in an elevator at that time. Food is average and a la carte is priced highly. Buffets would be a better choice. Airport transfer is at $9 per person. I suggest automatically adding this amount in the room tariff as I don't appreciate being billed for every small thing. A Hotel like Hyatt should have an all-inclusive luxury experience, least of all charging clients $9 for airport transfers or premium internet. I would happily pay additional $20 than their standard room tariff but the small incremental costs take away from the overall experience. If in Kathmandu, I might come back to Hyatt one more time but would definitely hope to see the recommended improvements.

The location is near the Airport, the hotel premises is great, staff are extraordinary.The most relaxing place is near the Lobby.The Jogging Track, garden, Tennis  court, swimming pool are great.I feel this is the great hotel in Kathmandu.

広々とした敷地の中に建つ大きなホテルです。よってロビーから正門まで歩くだけでも５分以上かかります。３階にロビーがあり、その３階も含め上下階に客室があります。ロビーでは、生演奏があったり、お茶のフリーサービスが有ったりします。お国柄なのか、客室のアメニティに歯ブラシやカミソリなどがありません。頼めば持ってきてくれました。また、これもお国柄ですが、ナイトテーブルの上には懐中電灯が鎮座しています。５星でもしっかり停電していました。すぐに復旧はしますが…。あと、ここの口コミでも度々書かれてありますが、タメル地区へのシャトルバスは、午前と夕方に３本ずつあるだけで、あまり使えません。よってそれ以外の時間帯はタクシーを呼んでもらいます。ホテルのスタッフにだいたいいくらか聞きましたが、人によって答える金額がまちまちです。また、タクシーを呼んではくれますが、値段交渉等は、ホテル側はノータッチで、全部自分でやらないといけなく面倒でした。運転手も、ハイアットに泊まっている客という目で見るので、かなりふっかけてきます。ちなみに私は交渉してなんとか700ルピーで行ってもらいました。正門斜め前には、ショッピングセンターがあって、衣料品や食料品などが買えます。

We did try to get this hotel for our last night in Katmandu but it was completely booked. It is a very nice property set very far in from the main road away from him which is away from the congestion, dust and noise. We were out for a walk and as it was near noon, we decided to stop in for lunch.The menu offers a varied list of items and I know that nasi goreng  is only fried rice with an egg on top but they made it spicy and it was very very good.  it was also served with chicken satay skewers with good spice and wonderful peanut sauce. We had Jasmin ice tea and with dessert we had Jasmin hot tea with honey and crème brûlée with chocolate garnish spears.  All this with a wonderful view of the outdoor pool and garden.  Very good service (March 23) very good food and luxurious property.

This might be a good place to stay in Kathmandu, but that would only be  because there aren't really any good places to stay in Kathmandu. (But, watch out, Hyatt - there's a new Fairfield by Marriott going up in Thamel - new tall building, scheduled to open April '17....)Why not 5*? Poor maintenance. Poor bed. As others noted - no mattress pad! The mattress is a thin-who-knows-what, no-spring piece of something. Tired towels in the bathroom. Nice bathtub, but the water you would put in it is yellow. Want to bathe in this water? I don't think so. Very noisy room - paper-thin walls and doors. Lack of electrical outlets near bed - or anywhere else for charging/powering modern-day things. The hotel's Internet connection is HORRIBLE!!! So slow. Unbearably slow. Almost unusable most of the time (and drop-outs too). Loading a webpage takes a minute or more. This is a hotel problem, not a Nepal/Kathmandu problem as we walk to the street to a restaurant with free wifi and the connection is quite good and fast. (The Hyatt's internet is so bad I resorted to using my airport-purchased local SIM card/internet package from NCell which gave me good fast LTE connection.)The hotel is situated about 30-mins from the touristy Thamel area - which was OK for us. Have to bargain for taxi (they'll want 700 NPR or more, but the "correct" price is 400 or less- may have to walk to the street, and avoid the taxi's waiting for hotel-prey. Much easier to get a taxi back to hotel from Thamel for 400.) The best grocery/department store in Kathmandu is just across the street from the Hyatt's entrance. And there are some decent restaurants and street food close by. 4-star is generous - this property needs some serious mainteance. But, until the new Marriott opens, hard to do better.

I stayed there for couple of night while travelling for business. They arranged for the airport pick up and commute while I was there and were very professional in conduct. The room was big, comfortable and bright. They have two restaurants but the spread is  wide enough for a delightful meal.

The boudha stupa is within easy walking distance. A very good hotel with 2 restaurants we only ate in the main restaurant and only ordered from the a la carte menu, plenty of choice but I would add to be careful my wife ordered the Thai green curry which we have had on many occasions in the uk and we do like it spicy but there's was extra hot and she had trouble eating it we asked for yoghurt to ease the heat but the maitre d insisted on changing it they were very helpful, but be warned. I had peri peri shrimp which I expected to be hot, it was but I was ok with it. Breakfast is buffet and very good with dosas and omelette made to order

As we drove from the airport in Kathmandu to the Hyatt Regency I told myself not to expect much.  If you've been to Kathmandu, you know what I mean.  All around there was evidence of the terrible earthquake that hit Kathmandu in April 2015.  There were people still living in tent cities.  So, when I got to the Hyatt Regency, which is a little oasis from the crazy streets of Kathmandu, I was pleasantly surprised.  I was thankful to have electricity, a comfortable bed and running water.  The grounds of this property are beautiful.  There's even a swimming pool.  Our room, which came with 2 twin beds, was a little tired and in need of some updating.  It could have used:  new linens and the black finger prints washed off of the telephone.  Other than that it was a comfortable stay for the two nights we were there.

The hotel is well located and reasonably maintained. As a business group we upgraded to club level but had to change rooms several times. The magnetic locks never work and I had to change access cards 8 times during my stay. There are constant weddings and noise during weekdays - even rowdy guests on the club floor. The rooms were cold and the air conditioning did not work consistently. They charge an extra fee for breakfast in a double occupancy room on the club floor - even to gold card members.The hotel is located next to a refugee camp and the dogs howl loudly at night.Breakfast offers significant choice and the snacks and drinks on the club floor are really good. The hotel has potential if more attention is paid to detail. Ask for a room away from the entertainment areas.

This was our first time in Kathmandu and were totally pleased with our stay at the Hyatt Regency.  From our check-in until we left the service was superb.  At the end of our stay we had a change of plans and they were able to extend our check out by a half day until we left in the evening.  Our room was large and the water pressure on the showers was to die for. The buffets at The Cafe were large and well done and we also ordered off the menu as they had a delicious array of international foods.  The grounds were nicely landscaped and we had a lovely view of Boudhanath Temple.  The Rox restaurant was the perfect place for a relaxing romantic dinner and they even opened the restaurant early for us on our last night.  We both really enjoyed our stay here and would recommend it to others.

As soon as you enter the property of Hyatt regency in kathmandu you feel the positive vibe. Hyatt regency is by far the best in Kathmandu city..amazing property..very green..spa is recommended..good food..great ambience..highly recommend it to everyone who visits Kathmandu. You won't regret your stay here.

Food is average, we tried in room dining .ordered pasta, tandoori chicken and a salad, the taste was average but you cant say the same for the prices.location of the hotel is fine.We looks rooms with some stupa view and pool view could only see the pool not the stupa as the hotel is only 4 floors, so please dont waste your money on views.For westerners the rates for drinks and in room dinning will not pinch but if your coming from india be prepared to pay a bit of a premium here.

Apres un long trek de 3 semaines, il fait bon de s'arrêter et de se reposer...L'hotel se trouve à peine à 5 km de l'aéroport international de Tribhuvan et à 7 km de la destination touristique de Thamel..Vous étes sur les hauteurs de Katmandou mais seulement à moins de 2 km de Stûpa de bodnath ( site classé au patrimoine de l'UNESCO).L'hotel dispose d'un Hammam, d'un centre de remise en forme et d'un spa..Les chambres sont propres, un peu vieillotte, mais jolie vue pour certaines sur le jardin et sur la magnifique piscine..Il fait bon de rester 2 jours pour se refaire une santé....

The hotel Hyatt Regency Kathmandu is 4 star hotel with a lot of problems.The room has a very, very old furniture. The A/C only function is heat, the sensation is you are in a oven. Bed is comfortable. Bathroom is like a 2 star hotel. Terrible. The hotel has a blackouts some times during the day.Internet is very slow.The common area is very big and beautiful.

The hotel is excellent the staffs and the service are great, it was a great and wonderful experience in Nepal and hyatt. Beautiful country and wonderful people. Love to visit  the place again. Thank you again.

The outside of this hotel is beautiful, and it is on a nice, big piece of land, but it is isolated.  There is no place to walk and see sights or shop other than one Stupa that is close but takes navigation past dogs, cars, and motorbikes to get to. The good:Staff is very friendlyRestaurants were good but eerily empty at dinnerGrounds are largeNice fitness centerGated and secureThe bad:Pool is under renovation and the blue paint from the pool is being drained via the creek on the propertyThere is no air conditioning this time of year and rooms get very stuffy. If you open the window, you will get smog and smoke and hear dogs barking 24 hours a day plus horns constantly honkingLinens are worn and scratchy and pillows are horribleLampshades are all stained and flooring was buckledBath products were very cheapAirport transportation was very expensiveTravel desk was not helpful at allView from half the hotel is a tent city where earthquake victims are livingThis hotel is a solid 3 stars....not the 5 it advertises.  No Four Seasons would have stains, buckled floors, lack of air conditioning, or uncomfortable bedding.  I am giving this hotel 2 stars as I feel we were mislead by the descriptions and ratings it advertises.

Abbiamo soggiornato in questo hotel per cinque notti in totale. Si tratta di una struttura molto bella, in stile nepalese e questo fa sì che non stoni troppo. Dico non "troppo" perché uscendo dall'albergo ci si trova immersi nella Katmandu post terremoto e le tracce si vedono chiaramente.L'hotel è circondato da uno splendido giardino all'interno del quale è tracciato un percorso di jogging.La struttura, come ho detto, è molto bella; le camere spaziose ed il personale veramente gentile.Per quanto riguarda il buffet della colazione, pur essendo più orientato alle abitudini orientali, era piuttosto fornito sia nel salato che nel dolce.Insomma, un 5 stelle tutte meritate.

Although a 5 star hotel and probably one of 3 best hotels in the capital, the Hyatt in KTM is old and tired and is in desperate need of renovation.  The property and furtniture are well worn and not maintained well. The food is about a 3 star quality. The service staff are pleasant and friendly but do not maintain their appearance according to 5 star standards (clothes are stained, not well groomed).  The rooms are big and spacious but the beds are extremely hard and uncomfortable.  The wifi signal is poor in the rooms. Overall, the Hyatt Regency KTM is an oasis in the middle of a chaotic city but they can do much better to raise the standards to make this hotel merit a 5 star rating.

Heb je genoeg van het rumoerige Kathmandhu dan kan je hier tot rust komen. Mooie, ruime kamers, lekker eten en altijd vriendelijk personeel. Zalig ruim zwembad en de spa moet je zeker ook eens uittesten.

Hyatt Regency Kathmandu is so beautiful that we were supposed to get married here in June 2015. But unfortunately 1 month before our wedding a massive earthquake left Nepal devastated and we had to shift our wedding to Jaipur, India.The hotel itself is amazing beyond words. You can see the Himalayan Range from some of the rooms. And it has a beutiful walkway leading to the Stupa Mandir within the hotel itself. The highlight is the acres of greenery in the hotel and they even have a helipad. Overall, It doesn;t feel like you are in Kathmandu upon entering the premises.--A drop of ink may make a million think.Pawan Manghnani

I like the Hyatt in Kathmandu mainly because of the staff. They are very helpful, welcoming and pleasant to deal with.  The location is a bit cut adrift from the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu so you will need to be prepared to pay for a taxi to the touristy areas. I am very used to luxury hotels so would give this 3.5 stars of it could. It has a nice pool and jacuzzi area on the lower floors and a gym in the basement floor. All in all I'd say it's the top hotel in Nepal from the locals perspective. Just missing a few touches of class.

An amazing hotel, love the infrastructure as well as the customer service. Visited only for banquets. Banquet food is good at times but sometimes its not up to the mark. Depends on your luck. Love the views from this place.
他のホテルよりかなり高めだったのですが最終日くらいはと思い宿泊しました。とにかく豪華なつくりでカトマンズ市内とのギャップが激しく驚かされます。中にはカジノも併設していました。プールの裏手に門があってBoudhanath (Stupa)があり、滞在中は何度も行ってしまいました。

When you are in Kathmandu it is worth treating yourself and your friends to breakfast at the Hyatt Hotel. Located just near Boudha and the great Boudha Stupa, the Hyatt Hotel and its beautiful garden offer peace and quiet and a delightful setting to spend a few hours.  Many people go for the lunch and swim package on the weekends, but the breakfast is well worth considering for a special treat.  Breakfast is served from 6am to 10.30 am and includes a really wide range of foods with freshly cooked omelettes and Indian and Chinese and western dishes. The cost is Rs1,250 plus taxes which is very reasonable for the wide array of tasty food.  The setting in the Café downstairs is lovely and you can also sit outside in the garden. They don't mind if you stay on and relax in the lobby or out in the garden. Highly recommended for a special treat or a lovely place to take your friends. Your Nepali and Tibetan friends would really appreciate being taken there.

If you're trekking or moving around Nepal to catch all of the sites and would like a couple of days to relax in the middle this the place for you. The hotel itself looks fantastic and the pool area is hard found in the middle of Kathmandu, rooms are to a high standard but the bathroom is what makes it a 5 star experience. Ate in the hotel twice and both times the food was very tasty, would recommend a short stay here and to move around Nepal as there is so much to see you could forget to leave the hotel at all. Staff are all very accommodating, would recommend.

Een van de luxere hotels in Kathmandu. Mooie ruime kamers die prima onderhouden zijn en van alle gemakken voorzien. Zeer ruime badkamer met zeer goede douche. Bedden slapen prima. Kamers kunnen enigszins gehorig zijn, maar dat stoort niet. Ontbijt is dik voor elkaar. Dineren kan ook uitstekend. Prima schotels en een prettige wijnkaart. Het hotel is ruim opgezet, met een groot en fris zwembad.

we stayed in the hotel for 3 nights, the location is perfect, walking distance from Stupa temple and 15 min away from airport.They have a great Italian restaurant, and a big variety in breakfast compared to all hotels we visited in Nepal,Swimming pool is big and, rooms are spacious and clean. i recommend this hotel for all type all travelers. They also have a free shuttle service to Thamel market, and a casino in the hotel.

Location is so good. Hotel is so beautiful and peaceful. Their pool is one of the best pools. Head chef has amazingly cooking quality.h is white sause pasta was tooo good.overall nice stay. Lobby is also very beautiful

Our group had a delightful stay in the hotel. The most outstanding feature was the level of service provided by an exceedingly attentive staff. The Indian buffet in the cafe was superb in the evening and the international cuisine buffet lunch was excellent. The rooms are spacious and clean and are very relaxing. There's a wide range of treatments and therapies available at the spa which were very favourably commented on for value and quality. Overall a very pleasant and relaxing end to our intense Kathmandu experience.

Wifi wasn't working most of the day, sound insulation is very poor, I was hearing every thing from next room and corridor, the room don't have any brochure describing hotel facilities.The hotel structure is nice and beautiful, there is a good land Scape area which you can take a walk, stuff is friendly

This hotel was very nice, upscale, clean and centrally located.  Without traffic, it's about 15 minutes to the airport.  There are plenty of shops and restaurants nearby.Service is outstanding!  The rooms are clean and quiet.  I did have to ask daily for face towels, and the air conditioner didn't work on the first day (We stayed here for 3 nights, went on to Pokhara and then back here the last night.  Both "first nights" I had to request to have the air conditioner working.)The ONLY negative is the disgusting yellow water.  I don't drink tap water, but I really wasn't thrilled with having a shower with yellow water.  You can see it in the toilet and if you run a bath.  Breakfast is VERY plentiful and delicious.  I really enjoyed the lobby.  You can have tea in the afternoon and relax.  Oh and this hotel has a casino on the property.

I visited this hotel in May 2016 for business. I had to wait almost half an hour at the reception although the booking was confirmed earlier. The reception team was not welcoming, and not answering my questions.Breakfast was not a great experience. Coffee shop staff were friendly, and the massage service is great

The hotel had a great reception area and really plush finishings and touches to its public areas (live traditional music etc). However it didn't really have the high end finishes i would expect for a hotel chain of it's reputation. Toiletries were lacking, no mini bar menu, no room service menu.The other thing is I paid extra for a room with a view (of the stupa) which was clad in scaffolding at the time. I would say this is extremely misleading and should be taken down from their website while the monument is being repaired to it's former glory :(
