Please ensure that you use purification tabs in ALL the water you drink. Including that supplied in the hotel.

While visiting Kathmandu a friend was taking us around town and we stopped in to have some lunch.  I had the Himalayan Trout which was one of the mid-range priced items.  It was good, but for the price not worth the food.  Lunch for 3 of us, none of which ordered anything extravagant was over $75USD.  Beautiful Hotel though...

Always enjoyed staying at Hyatt Kathmandu whenever I'm in Nepal. Came to Nepal again to climb EBC. Have to stay at Hyatt Kathmandu. The crew in club floor are always so polite and willing to help. Unfortunately, I only got to know the name of 1 staff - Dinesh before I left. He has been there last 5 years, always cheerful and looking sharp. I love my room 643 which has good wifi connection. They finally change the toiletries to Spa and it smell and look a lot nicer. I wish they change the gym bikes which look tired and old. Swimming pool is of excellent size for lap swimming or laze around. Breakfast on the 1st floor can be improved with a soup station? Eg. noodle soup would be great! I hope to come back here again next year!

Yes! the rooms are grand and huge and classy and minimal...but a bit too much of all these so that they end up being...empty and soulless...(and cold in March!)The breakfast was a huge dissapointment; from such a hotel you expect a feast and you have a...well, a buffet that is just OK...some 3&4 star hotels in Europe have much better breakfast...The gym is ok but the pool is glorious! So pity that was freezing cold! But still a beauty!The surrounding gardens are glorious too!And the best part; within walking distance from one of the best parts of Kathmandu; Buddha! Love this place...like a visit to Tibet ...

bell'Hotel decisamente. grandi spazi comuni , bellissimo e curato il giardino  e la piscina veramente notevole.  Ottimo il ristorante self service con ampia scelta  - E' un hotel che garantisce tranquillità /silenzio nel sonno.La stanza grande , ma meriterebbe una bella rinfrescata, le finestre non si possono aprire causa stazionamento giorno e notte dei piccioni - Alla Reception : cortesi ma lenti

Great SurpriseMy stay started with some e-mails to the hotel regarding the food allergy. Quick replies assuring the special attention and no issues at all. Room – Spacious, comfortable bed, nice desk and wonderful view to Boudha Stupa. Fantastic Bathroom with nice amenities and shower separated from the tub.Internet – Very fast comparing to others in Nepal. Free for Diamond Members.Breakfast – Had the chance to have it at Club Lounge and at the main restaurant. Club Lounge, limited but with better quality items and very quiet. Free for Diamond Members.Lobby – You really feel you are in Nepal. Spacious and with lots of nice sculptures. At night there are always some locals performing nice local instruments. Location – US$ 7 official taxi ride from airport. No need to reserve, just pay at the exit from the airport inside the terminal. The hotel it’s near by Boudha Stupa and a bit far from Thamel and other landmarks. But don’t worry, taxis in Nepal are really cheap. The hotel offers a Executive Car for US$ 10 an hour with driver.Business Centre – Very prestative and caring team. Not expensive.Pool – Great but not heated. Plenty of towels and sunbeds available.Food – Lot’s of choice to eat. On my case, special thanks for the attention to my Gluten allergy. The team even prepared special hours d’oeuvres items Gluten Free. Fantastic!Hotel Staff – All the people in Nepal are warm. The whole team at the Hotel was very prestative and care. Special thanks to Mrs. Mamata at the Club Lounge which did everything to make the stay even better.Special thanks also to Mr. Suman Shrestha for the attention in advance.Hope to be back soon!

At first on the map, it looks like it is quite out of the city centre, but it actually is in a very convenient location - near to many spots including airport. Decor is a little tired and dated, but otherwise, charming services and fantastic view (towards the Boudnath Stupa on one side).

アンナプルナでトレッキングを楽しんだ後、こちらに二泊して疲れを癒しました。チェックイン時にラウンジとジム、スパ利用を申し込み、ホテルステイを満喫しました。広く綺麗な部屋、オシャレな調度品、安宿とは比較にならないバスルーム。山小屋生活から文明生活に戻った喜びを楽しみました。ホテルのシャトルサービスで主要な観光エリアまで送ってくれました。初カトマンズだったので外出して観光しましたが、次はずっとホテルの中に居るかも。

Hyatt Regency Kathmandu is in a very central location of the city but when you step into the door of the hotel you get into a different world. This place does not belong to Kathmandu. It is probably the most green, clean and calm part of the city. The hotel has almost everything you can ask for a 5 star hotel. The rooms are clean, big and comfortable. The only drawback was the electricity which continue sly come and go but the hotel has its own generator which gets into action immediately so it is not a big deal. The hotel started to become outdated so it will require so renovation in few years but it is still yet the best hotel in the city. Although the choices in the breakfast are not too much, it is still tasty and enough. We ate one night at the italian restaurant of the hotel, it had good wine and pizza.

Nice reception. Superior rooms lovely with good view of stupa. . Pool nice with lots of monks about. Yes monks not monkeys! Although we did see a mongoose. . Good gym with nice interesting outside running area. Good range of equipment, well maintained and very clean. Always an attendant present. Good variety in breakfast buffet, try the yaks cheese its lovely. Bar very nice with great snacks on menu. In fact we never made it to the restaurant because of them. If you go to the bar learn to play the game, bagh chal. The bar staff are great and will show you how. Location a little out of the way but has a shuttle bus. Rooms were ready very quickly after our early arrival which was very welcome after a night flight. So thanks for that. Takes 3 pin plugs. If you're looking for a tour company when you get there try Royal Mountain - very safe and professional. Ask for Buddi and tell him Julie and Dave sent you.

Stayed at Hyatt Regency in January 1014 while on a business trip to Nepal. This has to be the best property to stay while in Kathmandu. The rooms are spacious and comfortable. Giant bathroom too. Loved their Masala Chai. That's not to be missed. The staff is friendly and nice. Will definitely stay here on my next visit.

We spent 10 days here while exploring the sights in the Kathmandu valley.  We loved the location with easy walking access to the area surrounding the Boudhanath Stupa, the great food, and the peaceful atmosphere.   The food at the buffets for breakfast and dinner are excellent with a wide range of choices - there is an exceptionally good variety of vegetarian options.  The staff dote on you and are very receptive to your requests - they knew us by name after a few days.  The hotel architecture is beautiful and it was always refreshing to return to the calm and peaceful quiet of the hotel after a day of sightseeing and riding through the crowded and bustling streets of Kathmandu.  Wifi access was excellent and the power is always on - a real plus in Kathmandu where load sharing cuts electricity for a good portion of the day.  We would definitely recommend this hotel to our friends and would stay here on future trips to Kathmandu.

The Hyatt Regency is, simply, the most pampered, relaxing place you can stay in Nepal. You might think that you wouldn't feel "in Nepal"; but you do. You might think that a big chain hotel would not make you feel welcome: but it does, in many very personal ways. I would not want to spend all of a trip to Nepal in the Hyatt; and it's not very convenient for southern and western Kathmandu; but I would definitely stay there on arrival after a late flight, and for a few days of self-pampering at the end of a trip the Hyatt provides the ideal base for exploring Bouddhanath and the hills and ridges to the north.

Stayed here for 2 nights with a group of business friends.  The property is beautiful with nice landscaped gardens.  A casino in the property and a decent gym there is a lot to do.  It is also next to the Bodh Stupa and Pashupati temple (close by).  The food is ok though South Asian hotels usually have a better spread. The business conference rooms were very limited.  If you are headed there for any kind of offsite, be sure that the conference room will meet your needs.

The drive in to the property - 1 mile and the grandeur of the huge 37 acres property is amazing !!! If the traffic is low ...you can reach the city centre in 20 minutes. Further they have a one way shuttle service free to Darbar Square every day.Loved this place ...the way they light it up during the night ...with diyas is so spectacular !!The lobby areas has the stupas and temples structures around ...the lounge bar is a delight to sit and have a drink .. and you will be so tempted to take photographs.The check-in is smooth and the hotel has 5 wings. All rooms are spacious and every wing has its own view. There is a great jogging track going over the hills with steps going around the swimming pool ... worth a walk if not a jog.The property is fabulous and very clean. Kathmandu city is undergoing road expansions so there is dust every where. At the Hyatt ..its clean air !!!

I stayed there for two weeks for business. One of the best hotels I have stayed at. Great location and a quiet place to be after driving through the crazy traffic in Kathmandu. Exceptional service overall and welcoming staff.

The hotel is situated close to the hotel but faraway  from city center, the room is spacious and clean, the bed is good, the bathrooms are clean and tidy, service is good. The buffet dinner in the cafe was pathetic and tasteless. The environment and interior of the hotel is very good, the staffs were courteous and properly dressed, there is a casino also in the hotel.

We had a lovely big room, nicely furnished, comfortable bed and bathroom with a choice of bath or walk-in shower.  Breakfast offered excellent choices and the menu in the Rox restaurant was exceptional.  The staff were efficient, helpful and very friendly.  We have another night there to look forward at the end of our trip to Nepal.

From the moment you turn into the Kathmandu Marriott Hotel, you are transported from the bustling streets of Kathmandu into a beautiful city oasis. My brother and I were in town for a wedding and intended to stay here just the first 2 nights as we overcame jet lag and got the lay of the land. We booked rooms with access to the M Lounge on the 10th floor which meant breakfast included each morning (try the dosa!) and snacks and cocktails in the evening (all free!). The staff in the M Lounge were beyond helpful and so friendly. We were sad to leave when it came time to go to our next hotel and missed it so much that we ended up returning after 4 days at another hotel in the valley and then again for our final night in Nepal before flying home. I treated myself to an Asian Stone Massage at the spa on my final day and it was the best massage I have ever received, also extremely competitive in pricing compared to massages in the USA. Although a pricier option for Kathmandu, I would 100% recommend a stay at the Marriott for the service, food, location, tranquility, spa, and overall ease.

I stayed in Marriott Kathmandu twice, 1st time for 10 days on 1st floor, 2nd time for 1 day in 7th floor.Overall, I think the hotel is great and generally meets Marriott standards even in Kathmandu. The rooms are clean and comfortable. If you get the rooms facing the mountains, the view is fantastic.The breakfast crew is fantastic, very helpful, positive and encouraging to try their variety of food.The hotel is very new and will be celebrating their 1st anniversary in April, so everything works well. Special mention to the housekeeper on the 1st floor, Sangla, I found her very meticulous and kept the room spick & span. She also took time to remember my personal preferences which is a great personal touch.The hotel travel services is something they need to work on. I think there are only 3 hotel vehicles and I found it somewhat upsetting that when I checked out and needed to go to the airport, all 3 vehicles were at the airport and I had to wait for at least one to return. As my company had complementary airport transfer arrangements with the hotel, I did not want to take a taxi to the airport at my own expense. But it turns out maybe I should have as I waited an hour for the vehicle to return. So, please inform the concierge well in advance if you need to get to the airport to avoid last minute anxieties!

I stayed in this hotel for 3 days through the company i work for. The room s quite clean, tidy and good but icannot say the view is breathless or beautiful. There is a nice corner for drinking coffee and reading books and the bathroom is also very tidy and clean. (This is very important in these pandemic days...) There were really tiny tiny tiny little ants in the room and i gave information to the reception and they sent someone for disinfectant. I would like to especially thanks to the lady (and her crew) who came to my room for disinfectant. She was absolutely nice and friendly <3 They also offered to change my room but i have a lot of belongings, it would be very difficult to carry and put them again so i refuse it.I like the dinner service, but I cant say the same for breakfast service. I chose the condinental option for breakfast and they only brought me bread, tea and boiled eggs. I told the waiter that i think they forgot my cheese plate, musli and juice, but they still did not serv the breakfast. The lady on duty said she would compensate for this and said she would send breakfast to the room for me. I think they couldt reach the service because the hotel was crowded i didnt want to burden them but i accepted breakfast in the room so as not to offend them. I would like to thanks to the f&b also. Especially waiters. They re very nice and hardworking.Shortlyy, they solved minor problems with their friendly service approach im leavin the hotel satisfied in general.Thanks Marriot family.

I am writing this email to you regarding our recent stay at the property of Marriot in Kathmandu that was recently opened. However, we would like to inform you that our stay was very unpleasant. In the starting everything was good, the staff was hospitable. The housekeeping and the waiters and the chefs took due care of us as and when needed. But during the course of time it became our displeasure to stay there as when we had asked for the bottles of water from the room service, they informed us that they cannot give extra bottles the management is saying not to give. We were offered complimentary drinks at the lounge which we didn’t avail for the longest time. Since there was a lockdown therefore, we choose to go and have a drink for 3 days but during that time, they informed us that they can only serve us non premium alcohol when earlier we were being served premium alcohol as they were finished with all premium alcohol as informed, when I am sure that Marriot will have sufficient alcohol. We may also inform that during breakfast time for the first 3 days we were being offered juices and proper breakfast, but during the course of time and till the time we left even juices and the breakfast and even bread baskets became more of problem to be served. We were very surprised by this when I am sure that Marriot will have sufficient food and juices to be served to their clients. We are utterly concerned with the behaviour and the hospitality given to us by the management of Marriot and that made us leave your premier property and come to your other property ALOFT as being loyalist to Marriot from a long time.I request you to please look into this matter at the earliest.

I stayed here for two nights in the off season in February. Overall was very impressed and feel that the staff here were top notch. The only awkward thing is that the hotel is a bit in the middle of nowhere, which means a taxi is mandatory.Checkin was smooth, helped that we were connected at the airport for USD30++. You're the highest building around which helps with panoramic views, including from the well situated club lounge on the 10th floor. Later on we'd realised we were some of the few guests with club access , which meant it was typically very quiet in the lounge, eg the only people for breakfast and maybe 10 in the evening.The lounge, like the whole hotel, is full of excellent friendly staff who are keen to chat and welcome you. In the evening there was a happy hour of alcohol from 5 to 8pm, and evening food from 6 to 8pm. These were of a good quality and the chef came round to check things were OK. We ate in the hotel restaurant, which was offered as an alternative to the lounge. In the main restaurant there was a good variety of choices: international, Nepalese, Japanese and Korean were on offer , including an egg chef, fresh noodles and an excellent dessert selection which incuded bread and butter pudding. Again the chef came to check we were happy with the food.So, what can I see that may cause objections to stay, mainly the location. You need to pay 'rip off' (amusing, these are local prices) taxi prices to get to and from the hotel, 500 rupees (USD4) to get to Durbar Square. There were always taxis waiting, but you've no choice without grab or uber in Nepal. Tip, take the hotel taxi card as not every taxi knew where the hotel was. Overall , next time we're in kathmandu, we will stay here again due to the staff quality.

This is my second time to Kathmandu, first visit was in 2016 when Marriott was not even built, and now returning September 2021 a returning second visit, and wow! Marriott Hotels made the right decision to  forge a deal here for the first five star in country. From the time you walk in, you are greeted with a fresh press welcome drink to the lovely reception staff you already feel at home! I had the pleasure of staying on the 9th Floor MClub  privelages for business for 1 month. Every day, I was greeted with smiles and hello’s at breakfast, personalized notes from the housekeeping staff, different towel art as a surprise to make the room more homey and top knotch amenities & really comfortable bed ( love the linens & feather pillows). I’m a long standing Bonvoy member so am always loving the Marriott family whenever I travel overseas. Big shout out to my KTM Marriott fam staff who have been generous & really made my stay fabulous: Reception: Samir Thamel kitchen: Chef P ( Chef de Partie), Rejina, Laxmi, Rojan, Nitun, and Rashmi — I will miss seeing you all EVERY morning and having my latte ( by the way shout to the KBC coffee bar & their superior latte artists) and fresh press ABC juice. chef P really made it fun and had me try something new weekly for my western self :) Housekeeping: the dynamic duo Sharmila and Kalyani made sure I had plenty of water cold & in the mini fridge, a clean space and beautiful towel art to welcome me home. Anyways, I know Marriott is expanding its footprint here in Kathmandu, but right now this is the best quality & serviced hotel with the most updated amenities and 5 star quality! it was a smart partnership, MG Group! Thanks everyone & Namaste. Until I see you again, Valerie ( Room 907).

Our party of 4 stayed here for 3 nights and we are sure it's, at the moment, one of the best in Kathmandu. The hotel is located about 15kms from the airport and has only been opened for 8 months so is brand new.  I've no idea if the location was equivalent to CBD area, but it was close enough to the center and all the major attractions.  The rooms are modern, attractively designed and include full amenities and a bathtub.  The view was nice overlooking the city and mountains in the background.  We had breakfast all 3 days and also an evening meal in the Thamel restaurant.  The food was excellent and certainly up to Marriott standards.  Staff service was great.  Near and around the hotel, don't expect there to be any modern convenience stores but there are certainly several mom and pop stores and a fruits/vegetable market nearby.  The only thing I need to mention is that the electricity in Kathmandu is unstable which results in blackouts quite often, no fault of the hotel and I think generators kicked in to ensure continuity.  Price was at the top end for Kathmandu but cost of living is still generally quite low so good value if you compare it globally. I recommend this hotel as a really good oasis of luxury away from the hectic, bustling and dusty city of Kathmandu.

I enjoyed my stay at Kathmandu Marriot. The staff were vey welcoming and helpful. I would like to convery my thanks to everyone from concierge to housekeeping to kitchen staff to the unknown employee who kept sanitising the Gym equipments after every use. I would like to thank the Spa staff in giving me a relaxing experience.I would like to specially thank the staff at Thamel Kitchen. From Chef Prakash and other chefs (pardon my bad memory) to Dikshya, Laxmi, Anu, Ram, and others (again pardon my bad memory).

This hotel and the staff are fantastic! I cannot say enough good about them. We were in Nepal for two months and used the Marriott as our home base while traveling through the country. They have a very efficient luggage storage system which we used about 5 times and never experienced any problems. I strongly recommend booking a car service through the hotel for arrival at the airport. The Kathmandu airport is chaotic (at best) so it was a pleasant surprise to step out and see a car waiting for us. The moment we arrived at the hotel, everything seemed to be just perfect. While checking in, we were given fresh watermelon juice which helped settle us after a 24+ hour journey to get there.All rooms have a view of the city - the higher the floor, the better the view. The hotel is about a 15 minute walk to Thamel and is located in a residential area. Walking the local streets and exploring the neighborhood was delightful.The M Club lounge was perhaps the best I have ever experienced - as an Ambassador level member of Marriott, I've seen quite a few. Breakfast was quiet and they offered a wide selection of standard options as well as specialized items. We especially loved their Masala Chai made from scratch (not the standard tea bag). Dinner had both vegetarian and meat choices with salad and dessert. Evenings can get a bit noisy as people enjoy the complementary drinks. Tea and snacks were available throughout the day. Ms Bijaya arranged for several transportation and tour options for us on our travels. The staff quickly learned our names and food/drink preferences. We felt that the Marriott was our home away from home. I can't wait to return.I used the spa services while I was there - mostly the hot tub, sauna and steam room. Other services are available at competitive pricing compared to European and North American countries but there are much cheaper options available locally. However, they are probably not on the same level as what's available at the Marriott.The only drawback (and it is minor) is that the swimming pool is almost too cold to swim. In general, this hotel is outstanding. It is the staff that makes it one of the best Marriott properties I have ever stayed at. Can't wait until my nest visit.

Stayed with Marriott from 5th to 10th Jan. Rooms , cleanliness and location is good but service is not at par . Will definitely like to mention two incidents : 1) As per the in room dining menu one can order dinner until 11pm . I called restaurant to order my dinner at 10.30pm and I was told that they do not take orders after 10pm , not seven bakery item( this was not informed beforehand ) 2. I had a early check out on 10th at 6.30am so I called the restaurant on 9th night as requested them to give a take a way breakfast . I was told that it will be ready by 6.15 and will be kept at reception or restaurant . To my surprise , it was not done and while checking out I was told that it will take some time . I had to leave as I had to catch my flight . This kind of service is not accepted from Marriott.

The hotel is a new property and is conveniently located within short driving distance of lot of businesses and the happening districts of Kathmandu. Late night, it takes less than 10  minutes to get to the hotel from the airport and about 30 minutes during day time. It's a refreshing change from the madnes that is  Kathmandu airport. The transport facility provided by the hotel to/from the airport is polite and efficient.  The breakfast spread was massive with dishes from most cuisines (including South Indian, continental) spread over a large restaurant space. You need to get used to the lack of spice in the standard dishes, though. While I stayed here for business, there were quite a few families as well. Probably my number 1 option for future stays in Kathmandu

We stayed 4 nights in a short trip to Kathmandu and this could be one of the best options to stay currently in the city. Hotel is rather new and even though rooms lack some basic items (not a proper working desk for example) they are quite comfortable. The breakfast is simply great, with so many different options, local, western, Indian and many more. It's impossible to get bored like sometimes happens in many hotels. Then, the M lounge is one of the best we ever been with great offerings, especially in the evenings, but at the same time with a very good team that make you feel very comfortable. The hotel is in a quiet area but not far from Thamel or Durbar Mag. You can even walk from Durbar Square and visit Ason market area on the way back. This was a great experience and highly recommended.

The service here is impeccable. They truly strive to make sure their guest's needs are met in every way. The rooms are spacious by Asian standards and the beds, while not "American soft", aren't anywhere near the marble slabs found in most Asian hotels. They are very comfortable. The breakfast and dinner buffets are TO DIE FOR! They have an AMAZING amount of food! Everything from American dishes to Nepalese cooking. It was very nice to try ethnic dishes in the comfort of the restaurant. Their spa is also top notch. I've gotten massages in Ritz's, InterCon's, and more, and this one is better than all of them. When we return to Nepal, this is where we'll stay!

This hotel offers very high standard in services as well as in all its facilities. The services from check in, restaurants and the SPA are very friendly, effective and very helpful. The Edamame restaurant has a varied and very well balanced menu and the food is of very high quality. The rooms are spacious and have all amenities needed for a comfortable stay with a extra plus for beds which are of the best quality for a great nights sleep. The SPA treatments are of very high quality and all therapists are very good. I have had hot stone massage several times and it’s one of the best treatments I’ve ever had anywhere. One therapist I’ve had is named Eva and she is very skilled with a deep sense of what pressure to use as well as going out of her way to relieve stiff and aching muscles. Overall I can warmly recommend the Marriott SPA to anyone who wants a really good treatment, it’s well worth the price.

I apologize for the long winded review, this hotel is great and much to say.I stayed at this hotel which I considered home for 3 months, the staff made this hotel feel like home, from the guards and concierge team welcoming you to the hotel, to the front desk agents (Alina,Riju,Samida, and the rest of the staff) who were always so helpful and welcoming. To thamel kitchen where excellence was always expected (a few people who stood out there were (the chefs, Rejina, Sonima,  Bujan, and of course Rashmi probably the nicest person in the world who will remember you from your first meal to your last and will recognize what you like and will go out of her way to get you what you want so everyday starts out right. Going to other restaurants Raksi everyone was great welcoming making your stay enjoyable. Edamame great restaurant and Krishna the supervisor was always there to ensure everything was perfect, Along with the rest of the staff. The M lounge was a great way to end your day or start your evening Bijaya, Prajwal and Sonic Always went above and beyond to make your stay fantastic. The housekeeping and laundry  staff ensured everything was clean and in your room always went the extra mile to keep you satisfied with your room. The General Manager of the hotel was spoken highly of, he was always around the hotel and shown that he had a sense of humor along with extreme professionalism and should be proud of the staff that works with him that makes the stay perfect. Thank you Everyone for showing me what a perfect hotel is.

This is my second review about the hotel and dedicated to the fantastic team at Kathmandu Mariott hotel. A regular visitor to this hotel every month for business trips and sometimes the stays in Kathmandu get really long but the hotel staff ensures to make me feel at home. Prakash KC at the Thamel Kitchen is truly an asset to the hotel who provides the best and most scrumptious breakfast and would even go out of way to cook anything that would be even out of the buffet menu. Laxmi is very courteous and greets you with your name and warm smile and would just know exactly know how do you want your dishes to be done. Rashmi is very kind who would get the coffee and juices just the ways you want without even asking simply based on your previous preferences.Barsha and Sonic at Raksi bar are absolutely fantastic and so is the entire team at M club lounge. Really wanted to put in more names here from Thamel Kitchen and Raksi bar but seem to have forgotten their names.All in all, the best service, best staff and the best hotel in Kathmandu.

Not only the best hotel in Kathmandu but the best Marriott I’ve ever stayed at. Forget the yucky green carpets and heavy furniture of most Marriotts, this hotel is airy, light, bright, clean and fresh. Neutral, modern rooms with great bathrooms with shower separate from tub. The lounge on the top floor has dreamy views and sublime service. The trophy facility is the spa and locker room. Male and female areas with jacuzzi, steam room and sauna. Spacious gym with latest equipment. I thought I was staying at a Four Seasons or Ritz Carlton. I would not stay anywhere in this city.

We stayed here for two nights.  Our flight got into Kathmandu late so we didn't arrive until about 11 pm.  However, our check in was fast and efficient and we were given welcoming drinks with a brief explanation of meal times and location of dining room etc.  The receptionist clearly recognised we were feeling quite tired after our journey.The room was exceptionally comfortable and well laid out.Food was varied with local and western options.  I particularly liked the attitude of the staff.  All of them, without exception, were friendly and helpful which must be difficult sometimes when they see so many visitors.

The hotel of course is a very grand one and the breakfast was quite wholesome with a great range. The staff members were generally helpful but quite an interpersonal variability was observed in how helpful they were. Although I booked a triple room, I was only offered a twin room where the three of us had to share the two beds. None of the rooms could accommodate three guest beds comfortably. I particularly booked this hotel having paid extravagant amounts to see the green mountains right outside the windows as demonstrated on Booking.com images. Sadly this is not the case with this hotel. Therefore it was just an average experience.

Kathmandu Marriott Hotel is what five-star luxury is made of.Our room, including the view, was gorgeous, very comfortable and clean.Thamel Kitchen breakfast and dinner were extraordinary experiences, with so many tasty local dishes on offer. The hotel has got extremely talented chefs who prepare absolutely fantastic food. We enjoyed the great team spirit in the kitchen and loved to talk to young enthusiastic chefs like Pratikshya.What is best about this hotel is the staff. We cannot express strongly enough how delightful, welcoming and helpful they were!The service has always been impeccable, and we would like to give an honourable mention to Mamata and Sonic who have been so genuinely kind and friendly.Special thanks to Rabindra for his advice and support in organising our day trips.Our housekeeper Bibek and his team provided an excellent service with a personal touch, both in the mornings and in the evenings. Thank you so much.Bijaya, the Executive Lounge Manager, represents the epitome of professionalism in hospitality. She socialises with guests, is warmhearted and always walks the extra mile. She is the perfect role model. Many, many thanks for her overwhelming courtesy and her outstanding service.In summary, the Kathmandu Marriott Hotel outperforms many world-famous five-star luxury hotels, and it is by far the best Marriott Hotel we have ever been to.Our highest praise for the Kathmandu Marriott Hotel! Nepal 2020 – lifetime experiences!

I stayed here for a week on business and had a wonderful experience.  The hotel is new, modern, with everything you need to enjoy your stay.  The hotel is well-maintained, has plenty of amenities including a spacious gym, wellness spa, pool and multiple options for food and drink.I had access to the M Club Lounge, which was always a pleasant experience and worth any extra cost.  I usually started there for evening reception and would end up at the Raksi Bar for a final night cap and snack before bed.  The turn down service was always a nice touch to come back to at the room. The Thamel Kitchen has the widest variety of food choices and was always a culinary experience.  I didn’t get a chance to visit Edamame but will certainly do so next time. Finally I cannot say enough about the staff...they are INCREDIBLE!  Every single one of them, and I interacted with probably close to 30 total, were all friendly and would go out of their way to ensure that I was taken care of and happy.  I wish I could name them all but since I spent most time at the M Club Lounge I have to thank Neha, Dhiraj, Bimala and both managers Bijaya and Vicky for their consistently exceptional service.  I am looking forward to returning again soon!

We stayed at the Marriott Kathmandu before our  Everest Base Camp trek and after. What a great hotel. The entire staff was very hospitable, friendly and nice. Always available to answer a question or help to resolve an issue. The hotel is very new and it’s well appointed and very comfortable. Many great restaurant choices on the property with excellent food and amazing staff. Babita was our amazing server at Tahina Terrace. Food was delicious and her service excellent. Anill and David were our servers on two different visits to Edamame—an Asian fusion restaurant with food that rivaled what we had in Hong Kong. Service by both servers was exceptional, but not over the top formal. Ajay who works at the front desk/reception is a particular call out—he was super helpful in providing guidance on dining, pointing us to places of interest, etc. Another call out is Narendra in laundry. We missed the daily cutoff for dropping our laundry off. He came to our room and took two large bags of laundry said he would do his best to get them to us before end of day—which was beyond what we expected. When we got back to our room, our laundry was all nicely folded and packed. He even called to make sure we received it—definitely a very service-oriented individual. Finally, the hotels “M Club” lounge was excellent—food was great as was the service.

We stayed here for 2 months. What makes this hotel outstanding is the staff. At every venue, there is a very high level of service. Our housekeeper Caron always noticed if we needed extra towels or more water, coffee or tea. She was very accommodating to our schedule, our room was throughly cleaned every day. She surprised us with a lovely bouquet of flowers when we left.I would also like to commend the staff of the M Club ( the business lounge). They made a point of learning our preferences and always offering us things they knew we liked. And suggesting new cars bings for us to try. They were a great source of information about Kathmandu an Nepal. They made our long stay feel like more like staying at someone’s home.

We stay in a lot of Marriotts, but this was by far the nicest; likely the nicest hotel my wife and I have stayed in.  The facilities and amenities were classy and luxurious, nicer than we've seen before, and still somehow significantly cheaper than we typically see at a Marriott.  The staff were the best part for sure.  They were friendly and thoughtful.  We stayed for two weeks and got to know a number of them, and they went far above and beyond staff expectations.  When we went out, they offered to take us and show us things.  When we felt under the weather, they made organic tea from scratch and sent it up free of charge.I wish I could remember all of the names, but some of those I can remember that were so kind to us include: Manish, Elina, Sagar, Alina, Rojen, Ishan, Prakash, Sonima, Unisha, Sharad, Aakisah, Anmoi, Chiron, and many others.  We didn't catch the name of the housekeeper, but she was so far above what I would expect from housekeeping.  And the laundry was efficient and also washed more than the two free items per night for free.  And every time we ordered room service, additional gifts were sent up for free.  It's really actually quite hard to describe how lovely this experience was.Thanks again to everyone who made our trip so exceptional.  We are so grateful we came. :)P.S.  I'm having trouble getting the photos to load, but will add later if I can.

It is clearly one of the more expensive hotels in Kathmandu. The rooms are modern, clean and tastefully decorated. We were disappointed though that we couldn't change to a King Bed room from the start. And everything we tried requesting for always came with an extra charge so that was a real put off as in many other international hotels, changing of rooms due to beds is complimentary. Their swimming was under maintainence during our entire stay so no comments there but overall the staff were very friendly and always ready to help albeit at times without a smile!! Another thing is that during heavy rains, the hotel starts to trip and electricity comes on and off till it stabilizes. Their breakfast buffet however was fantastic with a wide range of literally everything!! The location is quite central and walking distance to Thamel or the main eating areas (1.5km or around 15mins). The laundry service was quick. Overall, a huge business crowd, great breakfast with amazing servers and amazing rooms.

I stayed at this hotel both before and after my trek to Everest, and after staying at other accommodations in Thamel.My experience at this hotel was one of my favorite in all of my travel experiences. The rooms were immaculately clean, the beds were so comfortable. The shower and bathtub combination was perfect for a quick day of traveling or a long soak after trekking.The spa was amazing and fitness center was also very clean with just the right equipment (could use some sanitizer so you can clean your equipment after use).The food I tried at every restaurant was so good that I didn’t have to leave.Most importantly, however, this hotel had OUTSTANDING customer service! From the welcoming and accommodating front desk, to the amazing waitstaff at all of the restaurants, and the spa staff.I would like to particularly give a shout out to the service at Thamel kitchen from Rashmi and Manjeet. Their service was exceptional and truly reflected the outstanding management of Bikram who truly epitomizes passion in food and service.Thank you all for the wonderful experience.

Stayed one night at Marriott before our next destination. This is a brand new property located in the heart of the vibrant Kathmandu.  It’s one block away from the trendy Himalayan Cafe and 10 min walk from a shopping mall. Loved the new and trendy design, very clean, huge breakfast selection, a good bar, love the courtyard, watertight security around the property, great service. Very friendly checkin and check out service, helpful concierge who help us arranging cars to the rural area.  I found English being a challenged in general across the places we went, but Marriott have maintained its standard by offering full English service, no language barrier at all.  Fast WiFi.  Large floor to ceiling window offers amazing view of the city and mountain range far away.Highly recommend.

Well appointed rooms , friendly staff , great service , undoubtedly one of the best places to stay in the city . F&B staff as well as chefs at Thamel kitchen ( Pratikshya , Kumari , Rabin Khadka to name a few  ) get u engaged into the dining experience and provide exceptional service . Overall staff around the property are professionally trained , looking for opportunities to create memorable experience for guests . Couple of F&B outlets are yet to open plus the casino . Once open it would enhance the experience at the property . We wish the kids area could have been more elaborate with an attendant plus better ventillation in bathrooms  . Rest all was truely fantastic . Thank you KTM marriott team .

Kathmandu marriot hotel has a really nice ambiance. I really like the food in here . Specially rina , pemoa and manish helped me out ti choose the dishes that i really loved they were taking a really good care of me and my child as well .

Hotel has all the qualities of a recently built 5 star hotel with all of the modern amenities.  The rooms are comfortable and clean and everything is beautiful.  However, the food quantity and quality for the price of the room service menu needs to be improved.  The food itself was room temperature at best (sage roasted chicken) and to say something is served with potatoes would entail something more than 2 fingerlings.  Likewise, the bread basket was completely stale/hard as hockey pucks.  Given the cost, one would expect more. I also had laundry done and this was done on time perfectly.  Overall great staff and beautiful property, just need some work on the room service menu/standards.

The Kathmandu Marriott is indeed an oasis in the city. It is centrally located, the rooms are well done up, housekeeping is good, and the 3 functioning restaurants are top class, We were offered complimentary airport transfers (as part of the Marriott Platinum Elite package). Yet there was no Marriott representative at the airport, and no transport. After a considerable wait (and after flying the whole day from Manila) we called the hotel and got a car to pick us up.We were entitled to a room upgrade but were not provided one. We were told that the hotel was full. Yet, when I protested 2 days into our stay that the hotel did not seem as full as was claimed, we were offered an upgrade. There was no consideration given to voluntarily offer us an upgrade.The bright spot during our stay was the Club Lounge. The views of the city and the mountains are stupendous, The variety of food and wines was excellent. And the service was superlative. I must particularly compliment Bijaya - she is the kind of Club Floor manager that any good hotel would be proud to have. Thank you Bijaya!!

The hotel stands out in Kathmandu as probably the nicest hotel and all the staff is very friendly and helpful! The rooms are nice and modern, with really nice views! I have particularly enjoyed the Raksi Music Bar! There you can meet Samir and Sunita who are excellent hosts and will take care of you really well! You can ask them to recommend you local Nepalese drinks and they will tell you all about them. They also have live music with local bands. During my stay they had Janita and Kshitiz, a local duo doing some jazz and pop music covers with a guitar and a saxophone! I enjoyed their renditions of Fly Me to the Moon and Summertime! Sunita is also a wealth of information about Nepalese culture and traditions.The hotel is within walking distance to Thamel (lots of tourist shops, cafes and restaurants) and the museum (used to be a palace).Overall, I had an excellent experience and cannot wait to come back!

Happy New Year to team leader Bijaya and her team members Sujan, Sonic and everyone else from the M Lounge! You guys made our stay at Marriott Kathmandu truly enjoyable and memorable. Our 4 year old daughter loves each one of you and we have lots of respect for the good work you are doing up there.  We always felt welcome and received the most outstanding personalized service anyone could wish for. From travel advice to booking, help and suggestions for helicopter trips we were extended a great deal of attention and thought. We noticed that the same high level of service is being enjoyed by all the guests visiting the M Lounge. This sort of consistency is rarely found.  Thanks to all of you.Shouts out also to the chef who created delicious surprises day after day. We stayed for appr. 10 days and never got bored by the food. Try the asparagus risotto!The M Lounge itself offers a positive ambience and an amazing view of the city. Seating arrangements are well thought-through and cater for chillers, laptop workers and even project team meetings. A large project table invites for working and socializing. There is also a top-notch adjacent conference room. I spent a few early mornings in the lounge working on my laptops and watching the sun rise above Kathmandu with a coffee - truly memorable.I would also like to mention Mr. Shamsher form housekeeping (hope the spelling is correct), who was very friendly and kept our room in a state of immaculate cleanliness.   Moving on to the Thamel kitchen downstairs, we see a different picture. The service was inadequate. Being Bonvoy Ambassador Elite members we have been staying in various Marriott hotels around the world for extended periods. Hence, we know how to distinguish outstanding service with a personal touch from mediocre service according to Standard Operating Procedure. Despite SOP the service is still inconsistent. The hotel overall is most probably the best in Kathmandu if international standards, cleanliness, location and comfort are what you are looking for. There are some issues, which I would attribute to general challenges Kathmandu is struggling with. Given this testing environment the GM is doing quite an outstanding job in my opinion.

Where I arrived at the property, there isn’t any staff in sight to help with my bags. And this happened on my return for a 2nd stay too. However, things changed once I’m inside the hotel and checking in, the staff Mega is kind, friendly and apologetic to get my room ready on time. She did thank me for being a Gold member etc.I had booked the Club Room and very pleased with it, the room size is just nice and had a good view.The staff from M Club namely Asmita, Sonic, Anup, Prajwal, Ishant and Bijaya the manager deserves praises, they attended to all my F&B needs with a smile and eagerness to please. We also had some conversation on tourism and tips on what to do, good job ! The staff at the Thamel Kitchen where i had Lunch and Breakfast are good too. The team lead by Bikram, Pujan and Yam Sahani are great, the food are tasty and plentiful. We had lunches on many occassions, dishes such as Nepalese Thali, Mutton Biryani and Butter Chicken, all the taste exceeded our expectation.  The waiter staff Sandip; Romi, Susmita and Sharad lead by Alina deserves praises too ! Of cos, the cooks behind the counters are great too, namely Alisha and Anil. Went to M Wellness and was warmly welcomed by Rama, I had an Indian massage, the therapist Sara is really good in her skill. The intern attendee Anish is helpful with the customers needs to get towel, etc.I felt I had an extended family here, well done Team Marriott Kathmandu !!!Namastes !!!

I had a 6 night stay at the Marriott Kathmandu and used the spa everyday. The gym has a fitness instructor that was on the spot at all times making sure the equipment was wiped and if there were anyquestions he was there to answer. The shower and wet room had an attendant aslo , everything was spotless and clean ,pleanta of fresh towels and ice cold water was always on hand. I had 3 messages and i used the same therapist every time, after being in the mountain 3 weeks belive me she was the best I have ever had...Susila was the message thereapist, Kapil and Riya were there to make everything perfect Thank you

Let me begin by saying that I haven't actually stayed at this hotel, though I have been a somewhat regular for almost a year coming both for conferences in work as well as privately for food or drinks every now and then. The breakfast buffet is my all time favourite and I normally go once or twice every month as it has become something of a breakfast addiction. The drinks are really good in the bar on the first floor. The Japanese restaurant has really really good food; it's pricy but worth it. Staff is incredibly welcoming and nice and I have always felt well treated with a high level service.

Nice hotel located close to Durban marg. Hotel was clean and had a nice ambience. Thanee kitchen was good with their breakfast menu and taste. Friendly staff. For longer stays, hotel does offers limited free laundry on daily basis and also complimentary airport pick up and drop. Fitness center is excellent as well.

First time in Nepal and stayed here for 3 nights for my birthday experience trip. Overall a pleasant experience with clean and nice room with the view of the hills, good hospitality of the staff from front desk, f&b establishment to the concierge. Breakfast was a reasonable spread but only on the last day that I saw the cheese station that was quite 'hidden'. Had a pleasant experience with ala carte food and room service too. The bathroom amenities were pleasant. There was good supply of mineral water provided in the bathroom and the room. There was also alcohol wipe provided in the room which I really appreciated. There was a slight hiccup during check-in as I booked for Members Rate including breakfast but the front desk informed that the system showed that it didn't include breakfast. I had to show my Bonvoy app where several photos were taken. Good thing is that the front desk confirmed that it includes breakfast not too long after. However, on the second day when I was having breakfast, a staff came up to me and informed me that my rate doesn't include breakfast. I went through the same explanation and the staff (different from the front desk personnel the day before) took several photos of my booking showed on my Bonvoy app. After breakfast, I went to the staff and asked if I needed to go to the front desk to sort this out. She then informed me that it was all sorted. So all good.

We had the most wonderful stay here to end our trip in Nepal. The rooms are immaculate. We were lucky enough to have a mountain view room. It is surreal the way the windows let you look out at everything from the luxurious comfort of the spacious room. The staff went above and beyond to ensure we were catered and cared for, especially at breakfast where we were made to feel like we were family. Laxmi took great care of us and we left with a big smile. Looking forward to visiting again soon.

I have stayed here for a week and the experience I have got here is outstanding!! Top of all, the hospitality by the staff is the most appealing experience of Marriott. Especially Rajesh & team at Rakshi bar offered us a great service during watch of FIFA Football world cup final match. Barsha has taken care of us very well amidst of crowd. The new chef Shahani at Thamel Kitchen is a surgical care-taker, paying attention to every single need of us. Alina's warm welcome with the happy face at entrance of Thamel kitchen will energise you to start your day with positive note. The service of Romi, Rojen, Manish will make you not to leave Thamel kitchen. The other services like Gym, Pool, Steam batch and Jacuzzi are great and will definitely make you to relax and end your day.There are few areas to improve as well, The food offered is less spicy. It could have some spicy items like Spicy french fries (for Indians) which Barsha used to specially provide me by standing besides chef to make it more spicy. The Indian masala or ginger tea or filter coffee is missing in the in-room dining menu. The polythene seal around Aquafina bottle kept in room is difficult to open. The temperature of AC in the room is not able to be controlled. Taste of Sambar, white chutney and red chutney in Thamel kitchen need to be improved a lot. Another branch of Marriott can be opened in somewhere in the hills around Kathmandu which experience will be completely different. Apart from this, overall, I had a great stay experience.

My wife and I stayed at this hotel in April 2024 and were pleasantly surprised by the quality of the hotel for the base Marriott brand.  The room was spacious and comfy with a great view (we were on the business lounge floor).  In particular the service at the business lounge was outstanding.  We were greeted each day and treated with very personal service in the lounge.  On our last day we were sent off with a nice small serving of cake.  We tend to stay at Marriott premium brands, but were quite impressed by the quality and service at this newer Marriott property.

I’m a Marriott Member and the Kathmandu Marriott in Nepal is my favorite hotel.  I really appreciate Vishal Mahat with the front desk.  He is very kind, attentive, and extremely helpful!  Munu with the wellness spa is a great massage therapist.  I’m also impressed with the entire staff.  The spa, restaurant, front door employees, housekeeping, and restroom attendants are consistently professional and very detail focused.  As a former Corporate Customer Service Training Manager, I have great appreciation for highly trained employees who share a vision for superior customer service.  The Kathmandu Marriott Hotel is the best and far exceeded all my expectations.

Having stayed in almost all of the so called "5*" hotels in Kathmandu in the past years, must say that this one truly lives up to being 5 star rated in terms of rooms, amenities and most importantly, service.Being a regular visitor and occupant in this hotel, the service has always been top notch and so is the courtesy of the staff. The entire team at Raksi bar is just fantastic and so is the team at Thamel Kitchen. Everyone is polite, friendly and more than willing to help for any of your requirement. Wish could remember and write the names of each one personally but the list is just too long !!!The rooms are spacious, well maintained and have all the amenities that one would expect out of a 5 star property. Food is amazing and gym and spa is very well equipped.Always a favorite place to stay and definitely my choice while in Kathmandu !!!

EXCELLENT :Manish from the M Club lounge is an asset to this hotel. Always professional and good customer service. Sharad, Romi and the supervisor from the restaurant took good care of us. Good location and view though too much pollution. Comfortable beds and room.POINTS TO IMPROVE:Front desk and concierge require training to be as per standards. We booked the transfer from airport to hotel with Marriott (for a safe and comfortable trip). Mineral water in the car offered to us were already opened and consumed by someone else. Upon check-in though we have done mobile check-in, we were asked what kind of booking we had as they did not know if breakfast was included. We were not being offered a welcome drink .Our room was a M Club with breakfast included. They did not know if the pool was heated. We wanted to keep our room 2 hours after the checkout time, we were asked to pay 168 USD. In the room, our bathroom was flooded each time we took a shower and in front of the toilet, there were stains on the floor. Amenities were for 2 people and we were 3 persons. We one to book the SPA, the reception staff was polite and was assisting us. But there were 2 ladies at the back office who seemed to be annoyed because we wanted to book late afternoon on that day. On our departure day, while settling the bill, the cashier was constantly communicating numbers in hindi though I told her that I do not understand, please speak in English or give me the amount in USD. Our transfer to the airport was late by 20 minutes (we booked with Marriott again for a safe and comfortable trip). We were stressed as we knew the traffic would be densed. The car was freezing. We asked the driver to put in on 24. He told us that he was having hot tea and snacks instead of apologising for being late.I sincerely hope the mentioned points will help the team to improve.

We stayed at this hotel for almost 2 weeks, and it was an absolute pleasure. The staff accommodated every single one of our requests - even special / off the menu food for breakfast. They remembered our names everyday, kept our table for us and even had our standard morning cravings ready and ordered for us. Special thanks to Laxmi and Srinajana (I don’t know if I’ve spelt the name correctly) The chefs made specific food that we requested and even tried new things and offered them to us. Special thanks to chef Alicia.The spa too, is superb. Some of the beat treatments that I’ve had. Special thanks to Eva and Sonam. The jet lag massage and the hot stone massage are must try’s. Not to mention, the rooms and property itself, are wonderfully done.To top all of this, the staff even did a cute little farewell for us when we checked out !!! Just amazing.

I stayed at the Kathmandu Marriott for six days in early October, 2021, prior to my trek in the mountains. I have stayed at Marriotts in a few national capitals, and while the service has always been good, the hectic activity often made the stays a bit impersonal. The Kathmandu Marriott was very different. The staff in most departments seemed to focus on personalized care, and the care seemed very genuine. I suspect it was partly Nepal itself, and partly the staff, but I really enjoyed my stay here, the first in the country. A special mention for Ms. Bijaya, who made sure the staff were aware when I was incapacitated with a bad back for a couple of days, and also kept the folks back home informed. There was always a friendly word from everyone at Breakfast and during the day. The Hotel is well located in the Nag Pokhari area of KTM, about 15 min from Airport. If you like you walk, it is 20 min to Thamel, and 30 min to Pashupatinath. All key locations in the valley are 10-30 min by taxi. Highly recommended.

As an American I have travelled all over the world and this Marriott property is in the top 5. If you are on the fence book now and you won’t be disappointed.I can tell that this hotel is managed very well. The biggest thing that stands out is the staff/ team members - everyone was really friendly and helpful, most staff would come up to you and have good conversations about your day.I like how new the hotel was and all of the modern touches. The food here was a huge plus because you can get variety and the quality is very high. Drinking water was plentiful and always stocked in your room. I loved the view from your room. The room was large and comfortable and everything smelled good and new. I really enjoyed the awesome GYM each morning as it had everything you needed for a great workout whether you are doing cardio or free weights.Thank you for all the hard work that go’s into maintaining a high quality standard that makes the difference!

Driving from the airport through the urban wreckage that seemed to be Kathmandu, we could not have been more relieved to arrive at the clean, pleasantly modern and quiet Marriott hotel. We stayed two nights on the way to Bhutan, specifically to take a helicopter flight to the base of Mt Everest. Other than that extraordinary excursion, we did not leave the property, spending a comfortable afternoon at the pool and having all our meals there. Most travelers to Kathmandu will want to foray out to see what is to be seen. Those accustomed to the comforts of developed world lodgings will find the Marriott a fine refuge from those forays.

The Marriott hotel is a great place to stay. The staff throughout the hotel is always looking after you and provides excellent service. I would recommend people to book a club room as the club is a great place to chill after a long day outside. A particular thank you to the floor Manager Bijaya who is caring and offering the best service who may experience. Aldo the Chef is always bringing his personal touch and makes sure you are satisfied with the food he is cooking. I will miss u both for sure.....

I have had two massage treatments at Kathmandu Marriot SPA the last ten days and as a continuous and experienced massage customer I must say that these two treatment rates among the vest I’ve ever had! I took a 90 minutes whole body oil massage combined with hot stones massage and the therapist name was Eva. If you are looking for the outmost relaxing as well as a thorough whole body massage which will make a huge difference I definitely recommend this warmly,  as well as the therapist who is super meticulous applying a very balanced pressure and works each and every muscle of your body. It’s a bit pricy but worth every rupee! Thanks, Tommy Gustafsson

I stayed in Marriott Kathmandu during March 2021. The property is centrally located hence it is easy to commute to any place in Kathmandu from the Hotel. The hotel staff is very supportive and helpful. The property is well maintained and very clean, rooms are spacious and well lit.They have musical concerts in the evening on various days. The hotel also has a casino. I really enjoyed all my meals, though their should me more Nepali vegetarian cuisine on the menu. I would love to visit again.

The Club lounge is 24 hrs so even in the wee hours when it is unattended, you can make a good cup of coffee or have a small bite of the biscuit. The setup of the lounge is highly conducive for work with work benches setuo around the corner with readily accessible power loints.Thermal Kitchen at ground floor serves superb food. Buffet food which I had on four different days changes daily and is extensive.Service was top notch.and exceeded what you normally get from a Marriott. It is probably Ritz services and staff/guest ratio at Marriottt price. This hotel is faultess. It would have been perfect+1 if it upgraded me -mid tier Gold Bonvoy member - even when there's no obligation to do so. This is esoecially when occupancy rate is low in low season January. Reserved a club room and got what was paid for.RT 24/1/24

You are lucky indeed if you are fortunate enough to stay at the Marriott Kathmandu.  Having stayed 10s of thousands of nights at hotels around the world, the Marriott Kathmandu not only rates as a top Marriott hotel but also a top hotel against all.  Excellent service across all staff: front desk, cleaning, restaurant, and executive lounge.  Beautiful and highly efficient rooms coupled with steam, sauna, and spa make for an excellent hotel and an outstanding Marriott.  Even within the fantastic staff, there were a few who stood out.  They provided not only exceptional and efficient service but were beyond helpful and sincerely wanted their guests to feel appreciated and respected.  Dhan’yavada to the Executive Manager Bijaya and her staff Prajwal, Ashmita, Sonic, and Rohan, for making my stay memorable and among the top hotel experiences I have ever had.Namaste

My stay Kathmandu Marriott was almost for two months One of the best experience I have ever had in the hotel stay I’ve travel all around the world and I have stayed at Marriott, Hilton, Ritz and other hotels and have never experienced such wonderful service. All staff members greeted with a smile and your name and were attentive at any time of day. I would specifically like to thank  Chief Mr. Prakash Kc  who took especially too care of me while iI was sick by preparing specially meal. Specifically to the restaurant staff like Rashmi and Romi Who paid special attention to my needs in my likes. It was very nice of Bhola chief and Bishwo chief to make special cake  for Bon Voyage  the last day of my breakfast. The front desk staff made sure to take care of everyone needs I had .The room was wonderfully sized and decorated and great amenities  thank you to the whole team, I am indeed impressed!

This hotel was exceptional. Staff, rooms, and breakfast were wonderful. Good location and really felt like an oasis in the city. There were only two slight negatives. First, the power in our rooms occasionally turned off even though the key was on which was a little annoying. Second, after eating Indian and Nepalese food for two weeks, I decided to get a club sandwich from room service. Definitely a bad choice. Other than that, everything was perfect

The service and staff was just impeccable comparable to any of the best Marriott properties. Bijaya at the M Lounge went beyond her regular duties to serve the guests but also was so thoughtful and considerate about the journey we had undertaken of climbing Everest base camp and our health conditions. She made sure my wife who was sick with cough and cold was well attended with warm soothing drinks, and also providing tips to take care of on our onward journey back home.The food was also surprisingly beyond the average M food choices and quality with local delicacies.I would highly recommend this property if you happ n to be in Nepal.

I've stayed at the Marriot a few times in the last 4 months and have really enjoyed my stay everytime. The staff at the reception from Aditya & Bijaya give you a warm welcome and try to make the stay comfortable. The rooms are of decent size and the bed is quite cozy. I usually take the lounge access but this time I opted for trying all the food the hotel had to offer from Tahina to Edamame. The staff at Tahina especially Rajesh whose now gone to the bar made every trip of mine at Tahina very warm and welcoming.At Edamame the staff Sandeepa, David, Krishna were all wonderful and the chef Saroj was just brilliant with his food. My wife and I had everything he recommended including the lobster which was simply delicious to say the least!The breakfast at the lounge is limited compared to the ground floor restaurant but is still with enough choice to fill you for a long day ahead and the view from there is also great.The location of the hotel is quite central and the tourist spots like Pashupatinath temple are just a short drive away.I will surely be staying here again!

I have stayed in many Marriott hotels but Kathmandu Marriott provided exceptional service. The hotel is very neat and high on hygiene standard. Centrally located as well. Staff was extremely polite and courteous. Starting from front desk to Edamame restaurant or at Thamel Kitchen or housekeeping, entire staff greet you with big smile. I do not remember all names but wanted to thank Aline, Kriti (Front Desk), Laxmi, Nitin, Mamta and Bhol Bahadur at Thamel Kitchen for providing exceptional service. I find hotel value for money.

We stayed at the Marriott for 3 nights and were very impressed. Located in the heart of the city, the hotel was very modern, clean and had many impressive amenities, entertainment and dining options. The service from housekeeping to the front desk was exceptional and we were particularly impressed with Moj who was working in the Marriott Club when we arrived early and our room wasn't ready. He made us feel very welcome and made sure we were comfortable and had everything we needed while we waited. He is a true professional, a real asset to the company and was a highlight of our stay at the hotel.

I made the Kathmandu Marriott home for three weeks when I was in town for business. I appreciated that they have a fleet of electric vehicles, one of which picked me up from the airport. At the hotel, the facilities were exceptional but it was really the staff that made my stay so wonderful. Everyone on the breakfast staff (including Pempa, Sharad, Rina, Romi, and Rojen among many others) we’re so kind and accommodating, as we’re the bellmen, front desk staff, gym/spa staff, and cleaning team. I enjoyed the spa and as a marathon runner, I really appreciated the nice gym and rooftop pool for laps. Unfortunately during my stay I got quite sick (from food I ate outside the hotel), but the staff was so responsive and helpful to me during those days. I highly recommend the Marriott and will certainly stay again if I return to Kathmandu.

It was my first time at the Kathmandu Marriott Hotel. It was a great experience. I brought my whole team. The hotel was clean and gave outstanding service. I was extremely impressed   Ajay Gautam -Guest Services Agent.  I travel around the world for business a lot and I found that Ajay was OUTSTANDING. His personalized attention to detail and the extra effort that he put forth to make our stay superior was recognized and greatly appreciated. I know what great service is and he truly exemplifies the true meaning of a superior employee. He will be a major reason to return to the hotel.

We had a wonderful 4 night stay at Kathmandu Marriott for our first trip to Nepal. We booked a club room and the M lounge staff were very friendly and helpful throughout our stay. A big thank you to Moj and his staff for looking after us. We also enjoyed traditional Nepali cuisine at Thamel Kitchen, visited M wellness for spa treatment, and concierge assisted us with organising private tour of UNESCO world heritage landmarks. Our hotel room was clean, comfortable with beautiful views of Kathmandu city and we highly recommend staying at the Marriott.

I had a wonderful stay. Took advantage of the pool and also the options for dining... I think this hotel is a good option for thos who come to visit Kathmandu and want to enjoy western standard of service. Staff was very kind. Hotel is not far from Thamel - which is a tourist district with local vendors and little restaurants.Very clean.

We had to stay at Marriott Kathmandu as part of our visit to Nepal. Our stay was comfortable.  Chef Prakash has given us extra care by preparing our favorite dishes for our breakfast. It was very heart touching moment for us in the foreign land.Such acts go on to make one feel at home while away from home.

My husband and I stayed here for two weeks, and I can’t say enough about how wonderful it was. The run and facilities are lovely, there are 5 different restaurants onsite (all with phenomenal food), the spa is incredible, the pool is beautiful, and the view from our room!!!  And the breakfast buffet was my favorite part of every day!!And even with all that, the people were by far the best part. Every single staff member went out of their way to be kind and friendly. They helped in every way possible, provided tips and suggestions, and remembered our names and room consistently with our faces despite hundreds of guests. They invited us into cultural celebrations. They provided twice as much of anything we asked for and added niceties to every order.  They even asked after every adventure we had and celebrated with us.  I wish we could take take each person home with us; they were as kind as our closest friends and family. We would stay here a hundred times. Thank you again for the heavenly experience. ❤️

Unbelievable attentive staff throughout the hotel, including in the Club Lounge (lounge); they even remembered my name... impressive. Outstanding service at all levels. My first room had mechanical noises in the wall, but when I moved to a new room, I heard no noise. The new room was very comfortable, clean, and nicely designed. Extensive breakfast offerings in the main restaurant, understandably less so in the lounge; however, lounge staff provided anything I needed upon request. Happy hour in the lounge was good, and food throughout the hotel was also good. Excellent full-service gym (see photos) and perfect location. Stay here!

Hotel is good but its the people that are amazing. They take care of you like how family would. In the breakfast Sharad, Romi, Laxmi, Chiran, Pempe (and lot more of people) take care of us beyond any golden standards of hospitality. They recognize our needs and don’t hesitate to provide us service and comfort beyond our expectations. Chef Raju has made our long term stay experience a unique blend of hotel-but like- home warmth. Alina is very warm and perfect for the job as hostess. When we come to breakfast, we feel a lot of love and get genuine care. We feel sad if any day either Sharad or Romi or Laxmi are on their day off.(On photo- Sharad and Laxmi)

A three nights layover on the way to the mountains. The hotel is a nice modern property with very spacious rooms. The concierge desk was very helpful in sorting out my tours even with last minute changes. My back had stiffened during the long flight, but the massage at the spa sorted it out easily. The spa facilities are great and service level at par with the best in the world. I did not use the gym, but it seemed spacious and very well equipped. The only slightly negative observation is the location, while it is sort of central and close to the airport, around the hotel there really is nothing and you need to take a taxi to go anywhere. With this hindsight I'd probably take a closer look at the Thamel hotels.

The hotel seemed pretty good, but we had several issues with the front desk staff that have soured us on this hotel. We won't be back again. We checked in and informed the front desk at check-in that we'd be checking out for a night to go visit the countryside and then returning. We were told that the reservations were updated to reflect this. When we reached our first checkout date, they told us that we weren't supposed to checkout for a few more days. We pointed out again that we were leaving for one night and would be back. They said they'd take care of it. We just got back to the hotel, and they don't have a reservation for our two rooms. I had to rebook and pay 20% more per night, since it's a day of booking. On top of this, the Marriott app now shows 3 reservations: one for this return stay, 1 for the original stay (including the night we left), and one for the days we were actually here originally. To add insult to injury, we're being told that we only get lounge access for 2 people, despite the fact that both rooms are in my name, I have lifetime titanium elite status, and the same 3 people were just here a day ago at a lower rate with lounge access for all of us. At the front desk, they said they would look into this issue, and they just called me in the room to tell me that they checked with the manager and would need to charge us to add a 3rd person to the lounge. That was the final straw that led me to leave this review. If even the management doesn't understand why this is bad customer service, then a bad review is warranted.

Came here on a business trip. Front desk staff were rather new but tried their best to meet the standards of the hotel. Although an international hotel, the front desk and operations  and overall impression is that there are many local folks working here - adding to the personal touch to the Bonvoy chain of hotels where the cultural and traditional approach is apparent. Great views from the room. Clean, view of the mountains, quiet and very clean.Even though the hotel is not right on thamel where all the actions are, it is within a 20 mins walks. Concierge m/ bellboy is station at the front of the hotel which makes it accesbike getting where we need too.If you’re ever back n the Raksi bar, look out for this very attentive and friendly waiter who enjoys helping the customers what they need .

I am a Titanium Elite member with Marriott - so I have stayed in many Marriott hotels over the years.  Recently I had two visits to the Marriott in Kathmandu, Nepal.  Among all the Marriott hotels where I have been a guest, I would rank this the best one overall.  The staff was not only attentive; they were winsome.  I hosted a dinner for ten at the hotel's Themal Kitchen restaurant.  Everyone raved about the food and the ambience.  The hotel was spotless and my wife (who is an architect) and I thought highly of the design of the hotel and our room.

Just completed a 1 week stay while on business travel. The guest room was spacious and comfortable. The breakfasts were delicious and Just completed a 1 week stay while on business travel. The guest room was spacious and comfortable. The breakfasts were delicious and served by an attentive and friendly team including Laxmi, Sandip, Rashmi and Sumita. The warm greetings and remembering every morning how I liked my coffee and eggs were a great way to start the day. The Raksi bar was a great place to finish the day with a refreshing glass of Barahsinge served by the warm and gracious Sunita and Barsha. Will definitely stay here again.served by an attentive and friendly team including Laxmi, Sandip, Rashmi and Sumita. The warm greetings and remembering every morning how I liked my coffee and eggs were a great way to start the day. The Raksi bar was a great place to finish the day with a refreshing glass of Barahsinge served by the warm and gracious Sunita and Barsha. Will definitely stay here again.

Best service. From doorman, receptionist to maids, cooks, chefs waiters are all courteous Clean rooms. Large size room and bath, soft pillowsExcellent food. Big breakfast spread, Tasty Indian food Center in the town closer to shopping area and close to attractions

We stayed here for several nights in May 2022, before and after trekking near Everest.  Excellent location - a short walk from Thamel and the Garden of Dreams.  Clean and modern, with a very nice restaurant, terrace bar, and pool area.  But the staff made it special.  Everyone we met there was unfailingly solicitous, prompt, cheerful, and extraordinarily helpful.  Directions, currency exchange, room service, printing documents that we needed - even help making international calls.  Whatever we needed, they provided - quickly, effectively, and with a smile.  (Thanks, everyone!)  If you're staying in Kathmandu, we highly recommend this hotel.

This is my second stay at the Marriott at Kathmandu on a business trip, it was a long one. When you stay for a long duration, all you want is care and service and I got that in spades. The team I really want to commend is the team at the M-Club on the 10th floor: Prajwal, Sadikshya and Chef Keshav (and on the final day, Chef Samir) really, really  know the meaning of service and personal care. Every morning I would look forward to meeting them and their conversations, caring, attention to my needs, etc. was exceptional. I also spent working days in the quiet of the M-Club and they would swing by with water/ coffee or tea, just the way I liked it. It was a joy to see them every day and they made my trip feel like a home away from home. The other personal who was absolutely exceptional was Funji as she managed the conference at Koshi. My gosh, the lady really knows how to keep on top of every need of demanding clients with a smile on her face. She was attached to our conference for 4 days, and she was there: front and centre, making sure the laptop was attached, ensuring tea and coffee service and even serving lunch to the participants.
