She is efficient and friendly and can deal with multiple requirements effortlessly, along with her smiling compatriot Supriya. Ram, who was at the restaurant at the lobby for breakfast and lunch also always greeted customers with a smile and was personal in his care, and his recommendations whenever he saw me. Thank you Ram. And Bijaya, who is the executive floor manager, thank you for commiserating when I had an issue in my room and ensuring I had a good drink and a quiet meal on the final day I was there. I will be travelling to Kathmandu often, and I do hope Marriott continues to be my home away from home.

In short they very professional to provide very good services, in all sectors, like Thamel kitchen staff Alina, Elian and many other and their manager like Rojen and also his managers. All staff are so professional in treating gusts. Front Desk give the feeling you’re still in your home, always with great and wormy smile. When book in the hotel don’t want to leave.

I had a wonderful stay at the Kathmandu Marriot. The staff were super friendly and very helpful. The hotel is very clean, the breakfast is amazing, and the concierge staff are all professional. The hotel is well located, close to shopping and dining options as well as tourist attractions.The facilities are at a five star western standard, but it's the humans who bring this place alive. From the manager Samir, to the humble Rashmi who without her hard work daily we wouldn’t enjoy our breakfast, to and Bedjia the Lounge mixology-turned  manager who invented news drinks to make us have peaceful nights, ensure every dinner earns every star of this rating. I highly recommend the hotel for business travelers.

The Katmandu Marriott is truly a 5 star, beautifully appointed hotel and its central location provides visitors with access to a number of significant cultural sites. The real gems of the Katmandu Marriott were the caring & helpful staff. Each employee exemplified professionalism and the MClub staff, in particular, were truly amazing..a heartfelt thank you to Moj and the entire team!!The MClub amenities were high quality and the food offerings were exquisite (with great views of the city from the 10th floor). I highly recommend the Katmandu Marriott for business or pleasure. Best wishes to everyone on the hotel team and we will see you soon.

This was one of the best Marriotts that we have stayed.  The hotel itself is modern and beautiful.  Breakfast in Thamel Kitchen was amazing.  We sat in the same area and were greeted each morning by Rashmi and Laxmi.  They were prompt in remembering coffee or tea preference and introduced us to local food favorites.  All of service throughout the hotel was very kind.  We would stay here again.

We have been to many Marriott Brand Hotels all over the world and the Marriott Hotel in Kathmandu is definitely one of my favourite!  The hotel is very modern, quite new, very clean and we enjoyed our stay very much! Our room was very spacious and clean and very modern refurbished. As it was located on the 9th floor we had an excellent view over Kathmandu. The gym also provides top class and very modern equipment making your workout away from home very pleasent. The spa facilities are beautiful as well and the massages were great! Breakfast was very delicious and the kitchen crew responded to our individual wishes. Due to our elite Status we also got access to the beautiful lounge, located on the 10th floor. We especially want to thank all the great staff at the reception and the lounge for their exzellent service at all time! We enjoyed our stay from the first minute and can highly recommend this hotel.

Hotel service met the international service standards which is very rare to find in Nepal. We had a sweet stay at the hotel with delicious complimentary dinner, however the breakfast was satisfactory, and the wedding which was happening close to the lobby and bar made it a little noisy and crowded. Overall, friendly staff at the Thamel Kitchen and we had wonderful stay :)

We thoroughly enjoyed every minute of our recent stay at the Kathmandu Marriot. Our room was spacious with a beautiful city view. Bed and pillows very comfortable.The lounge on the 10th floor has a wrap around view, evening snacks were delicious and the staff at the 10th floor lounge were instantly like long time friends. We were welcomed back every night and the staff didn’t have to ask, they knew what drinks we liked and put them in front of us. Manis kept us in an interesting conversation every night.The restaurant on the main floor hosts the buffet breakfast. The buffet has so much to choose from and the food is delicious with so much flavor. The staff in the kitchen will offer you whatever you’d like. There is everything from traditional Nepalese food to bacon and eggs and more. In addition to the amazing flavors of the food the staff go out of their way to make you feel comfortable and are so welcoming. Our server Sonia went out of her way to help us choose different local dishes for breakfast. She is a great young person that will definitely go far in the hospitality industry with her beautiful personality! In addition to Sonia, we need to mention the wonderful Elina and Rashmi who also looked after us so well in the restaurant.We enjoyed every minute and our experience at the Kathmandu Marriott and highly recommend taking advantage of their great hospitality and comfort. It is so worth it in every way!

I have lived in Nepal for many years now and the Kathmandu Marriott is by far the best property in the entire country. It's clean, modern, and very well maintained. The staff is incredibly helpful. Gym is nice. Infinity pool is beautiful. Spa is very well done. Amar Thapa, one of the managers, goes over and beyond to make sure the guests are treated wonderfully. We spent our anniversary at this hotel and all the staff cared greatly for us during our time there.

Well, situated in the heart of Kathmandu, this western style hotel does provide a glimpse into Nepal with antiques and art displayed throughout the property. As well, the restaurants feature, lots of local cuisine, and the staff provide the level of service that the Nepalese are famous for. rooms are spacious and well appointed. The pool offers views of the city and surrounding mountains when it’s clear and the spa is a lovely experience

My stay at your place was exceptional.  A real 5* hotel.  The employees are very careful to the customers' needs... especially Mr. Rojen and Sagar. The room every day cleaned... you will find coffee and tea in the room thanks Mr. Ashok who along with his team do a very good job.  Hope to see you again soon 👍

City of living God with a beautiful hotel 'Kathmandu Marriott'....we stayed in this hotel for 4 days and I must stay Marriott with the best service staf also have the best  director S& M in the city.....he was very humble and personally help us in understanding the places of interest for tourists. A big thank you to Team Marriott and specially ' Varun kamra'.I highly recommend this hotel for stay in Kathmandu.

We stayed at the Kathmandu Marriott Hotel three nights, two nights at the beginning of our tour, and then our last night.  Fantastic 5 star hotel all around, from the room, pool and restaurant where we had our daily breakfast.  Staff very helpful and friendly.  The view from our room of Kathmandu and mountains was breathtaking, and we had the pleasure of experiencing a week of Nepal Holiday festivals.  The Marriott is walking distance to the Thamel district (restaurants and plenty of culture) or via  taxis.    All in all a great around experience.

Nepal is a unique and beautiful place. The fact that you are even here is significant and you should take a moment, wherever you’re staying, to appreciate the atmosphere, the culture and the people. This hotel epitomizes the greatness of Nepal. Incredibly friendly staff that is genuinely seem to be looking out for you. I especially enjoyed the rooms, clean with a nice view, and the breakfast they offered. It is also close to everything in the city, very central, and not far from airports. It is a great place to start your journey and again the chefs, the front desk staff and workers at around were super friendly and nice.

This is my second visit in last 20 days, Firet time it was a business stay and this time leisure stay. The hotel is very well located in the heart of the city and most of the places are withing 5 miles from the hotel. The ambience and the I terirors are modern architecture with perfect blend of green and antiques. It has variety of dining options, gym, lounge, swim, spa and 24/7 casino. Amongst all, I enjoyed Thamel restaurant the most. Delicious food, highly efficient; well groomed staff and the perfect hospitality. I would specially like to recognize Rogen and Sushmita at Thamel, they really made our eating experience special. Yependra at the front desk managerial is also very curious and helpful, over all I highly recommend this hotel👏

We stayed at the Marriott for few days to adapt to the jetlag before traveling to Bhutan. We received an exceptional service from the staff who took the word "hospitality" to the highest level. A very special shout-out to Prem and Bibek who both recommended local exclusive experiences, food and activities, and facilitated logistics to make our stay unforgetable. We will definitely come back next time we are in Kathmandu.

We had an amazing customer service experience led by Vishal Mahat. Each person we encountered was so kind and thoughtful. We even left something in our room and the housekeeping staff quickly alerted us so that we weren’t missing our items upon checkout. Highly recommend this hotel in Kathmandu.

A one month business visit in Kathmandu made memorable by the excellent stay in Marriott. Excellent premises, the unparalleled Marriott comfort and, above all, the Marriott super staff. Sirjana and Laxmi at the breakfast hall together with Chef Prakash were superbe, as was Indrika at the Raksi Bar. The other Laxmi at the reception and the director there, Kumar, were always ready when you need them. Another superb stay at Marriott! Thumbs up!!!

I stayed for 6 days at Marriott Kathmandu, and I have to say that it was a great experience. The more the number of days you stay, the more the feeling of warmth and hospitality grows on you. Location is excellent too, with places like Durbar Marg and Thamel at walking distance.Special mention for the warm hospitality meted out by all staff, especially Riju, who is naturally welcoming, strikes up warm conversations and also showed me around the facilities like gym and sushi bar (found her to be more of a friend than an executive, but she never asked me to mention her in the feedback). Also worth mentioning are Rojen and Dikshya, who used to be ever welcoming at the Thamel Kitchen.Overall an enriching experience!

I have been visiting Marriott Hotel Kathmandu quite often. the experience of staying in Marriott Katmandu is exceptional, be it value for money, the food quality, taste and spread is outstanding last but not the least, the staff is outstanding, they always serve you with smile. They are so helpful and so engaged that you feel like you are amongst your family members. They take care of your needs and concerned about every small need. e.g. at breakfast table the Chef will ask you for your specific need and they always endeavor to fulfill the same to the best of their ability. I am lucky enough to get upgraded on many occasions and enjoyed the access to executive lounge which is very well maintained with good variety of snacks and drinks in the evening.  If you are looking for a stay in Kathmandu, I would strongly recommend going for Marriott Hotel Kathmandu to fall in love with Nepal.

This is our first trip to Kathmandu and the Marriott here is probably one of the best hotel we ever stayed in all around the world. We will made to feel so welcome and everyone from the door person to the manager at the Club Lounge Moj was so friendly and helpful. The executive suite was spacious, modern and housekeeping doing an excellent job cleaning your room daily. One of the team member at Club Lounge Suraj deserves special thanks as he looks after us so well.Highly recommended Marriott Kathmandu and will be the only hotel I will stay in Kathmandu.

Brilliant! A great experience at the Marriott. They have the most humble people working here and will provide you with service at any given time of the day or night. It was such a warm welcome here that I never felt like leaving. If you're ever in Kathmandu, please ensure to stay here because the hospitality here is not similar to anywhere in the world. Kudos  guys! Hope to see you soon.

The M Wellness Spa at the Marriott Kathmandu is a new, clean facility with friendly and attentive staff. As a temporary Nepal resident I was looking for a place to get regular massages and after trying out multiple spas in Kathmandu I can hands down say this is the place to go. The spa menu is extensive so you’ll definitely find something you like. The steam room, sauna and jacuzzi are also highly recommended. Special thanks to Namuna and Rama for always providing top-notch service.

Marriott Kathmandu was great, Especially the food and service at Thamel kitchen,The staff was extremely kind and generous. Thanks Sandip and krishna for your great hospitality We had a amazing time at Raksi also . The staff in raksi bar sandeepa was fantastic with the services. Food was of our taste buds were happy and satisfied.

I did not have a positive trip to Kathmandu for my two days and it started off at the Marriott. I am a Bonvoy member and stay at the Marriot frequently, with 20 nights in the past six months. I checked-in after 10 pm for two nights with a reservation directly through the hotel. I was taken to one of the worst rooms, on a low floor, next to the elevator. When  I said I did not want this room, they said the only other option was a room with twin beds on the first floor. I proceeded to the room next to the elevator and called the front desk and requested a room change again. Then they offered another room down the hall, which was fine. The room was clean and nice but small. Breakfast the following morning was every good. I tried to make local calls from the phone in my room but they would not go through. They offered to place the call for me but I declined because I had multiple calls to make. They said to dial 9 for land lines and two other numbers to call cell phones. I tried this but it did not work. I decided to leave the hotel early because I felt I was not one of their preferred guests. When I was checking out, a man was saying he could not place local calls. The front desk said that there is a special code and would he like them to get it for him.

the BEST hotel I've ever been to. in terms of service excellence and cleanliness, no one does it better in Nepal.huge shoutout to these folks who made our stay phenomenal: Sharad—at breakfast, he knew our needs before we did! he has a genuine passion for hospitality, and he made each breakfast memorable with his positive energy and attentiveness. Shanti Cama—outstanding housekeeping, extremely detailed and thorough.Arpita—excellent recommendations and a great conversationalist, she made our lounge visits extremely comfortable and always took great care of us!excellent facilities: best way to start the day was working out or doing yoga in their separate yoga/martial arts studio. best way to end the day was relaxing at the spa (with jacuzzi, steam room, sauna). the entire staff was so warm and welcoming. I'll visit Nepal again just so I can stay here. 100/10 would recommend to anyone.

It's challenging to pen down a review without a single negative observation after spending five days at the same hotel! JW Marriott Kathmandu stands out as one of the finest establishments I've experienced. Their impeccable selection, recruitment, and training of staff truly reflect a job well done.The team at JW Marriott Kathmandu is simply outstanding, leaving me feeling remorseful for not recalling all their names. Nevertheless, individuals like Unisha, Sandep, Pamshita, and Miqnz, whose names I might have misspelled (apologies!), epitomize the exceptional service you can expect throughout your stay.RoomsThe rooms at the hotel offer a delightful blend of comfort and sophistication. With expansive spaces, high-tech amenities, and breathtaking views of the mountains, they provide an unparalleled experience for guests.Nearby activitiesYou are 15 to 18 mins walking distance to thamil and few mins by car.Food & drinksYou guys should try the famous mariott burger, just delicious! 😋Hotel highlightsLuxury, Great view, Romantic, Quiet, Kid-friendly, Great value, High-techKudos to the entire team at Marriott Kathmandu!

Our Marriott stay was just perfect. It is the staff who make a good hotel, great. Every staff member was exceptional. They were so friendly and helpful.Breakfast is not to be missed with many traditional Nepali dishes offered each day. ( As well as Western&Asian options.) The hotel is in a great location- only a 10 min walk from Thamel. We enjoyed our stay very much. Thank you Marriott Hotel.

I had an excellent stay at the Hotel for 12 days. The service was outstanding, rooms were of this highest quality, food was amazing consistently at all the restaurants and the staff were the most friendly. Concierge Prem in particular was simply the best, helping with all kinds of arrangements including tours. I have stayed at many Marriotts but consider this one as the best of them all!

I absolutely enjoyed the stay in this hotel. I had been treated as a most valued Elite guest throughout my stay that includes in particular check in, Restaurant, check-out and hotel car service. On my last day during breakfast I got a surprise,  the Team came over to my table and thanked me for being with them and as a small present they gave me a piece of cake nicely presented.

Wonderful hotel with professional staff, enjoy delicious breakfast at Thamel kitchen, don't forget to try salmon fish, Magarita Manakish (forget the chef's name) at Tahina Terrace. Most of our stay we ordered food from the above mentionedrestaurants and all the dishes were mouth-watering and delicious. For sightseeing would recommend contacting Mr. Bibek at concierge services. Wonderful and relaxing trip to Chandragiri hills and last moment Mountain flight arrangements thanks to Mr. Bibek. If you're staying in Kathmandu, we highly recommend this hotel. Thank you, Marriott Kathmandu.

The pastry shop in the Marriott is a treat for Europeans looking for quality pastries that are not just imitating the look of European pastries. The service by Taeyan, a young hospitality expert from the remote Himalayan region of Mugu, made the experience especially delightful for both me and my companion. His intelligence, polyglot ability and savvy interactions made the visit to the pastry shop extra memorable for both of us. The young man has a bright future ahead of him

Hotel looks great from outside but when we checked into Junior Suite room looks old and tired. Shower is jammed as usual. Meaning within 1 min, the shower area is flooded. You can see the quality build is poor, just a matter of few more years, it'll need a revamp again. Why 5 star? After staying 2 nights here in Oct, we checked out and went for our hikes. Came back Nov 5th at 1pm already booked Junior Suite but front desk lady Ashmita? told me have to wait till about 245 and if I'm willing to pay extra USD 160+ to get an upgrade then is available in 45min. I said no. First not because I'm tight to pay but I'm a returning customer so I find it quite offensive. Anyway, we went out for a nice lunch back at 3pm and Ashmita managed to get us the upgrade to Executive Suite free of charge! I was impressed and grateful. Executive Suite is way better than the Junior Suite as it has a door that separates the room. Room is also newer without seeing cracks and problem. Even have a big fridge. Only issue with the room is the stupid switches of light. Who design it? So silly is like a game show which direction you can see some lights. Gym is 24hrs - love it. Good gym and Spa area (jacuzzi, steam and sauna) are good enough for me. We'd 90 min massage. It was ok, not fantastic but price is reasonable. Location wise I think is still ok. 15-20min. walk to Thamel but you've to cross the road like the locals. Club lounge is good 5pm-8pm and all the service staff are amazingly courteous and out of their way to help you. I never like Marriott chain as is full of Americans talking too loudly but their staff make it up and I might consider staying here again if I can get a good deal of Executive Suite!

The restaurants i.e. Tahina Terrace (serves Mediterranean cuisine) and Edamame (chic asian fusion cuisine) has left the best impressions!  Amazing food to die for - everything we tasted melted in our mouths and beautifully presented. All the staffs are very professional, polite and hospitable specially Vicky and Rasi Chitrakar.  Ambience is lovely and charming. Definitely meets an elite standard -  Highly recommend!!

I’ve stayed in several hotels in many countries, but this stay has out shined them all. The staff went out of their way to assist me, some even outside their work hours to make sure all my needs were met, and this is staff across departments. Even though everyone was amazing, the below staff really exceeded and deserved to be recognized: Kriti & Riju (reception), Sandip (concierge), Thaman (room service), Bijaya (Management).If you want to stay in a hotel where all your needs will be met, then this Marriott is the ultimate. Also, great food, good location, nice views, good facilities, great shower, comfortable beds.

I am a Hotelier with over 30 years of Service 21 at Ritz- Carlton Hotels. I travel world wide often and it’s easy for me to zero in on inefficiencies.When I arrived in Kathmandu, I had no idea that I would find an incredible oasis in the middle of a dense city.We arrived at this sparkling property after 23 hours of travel. At check in the most accommodating agent arranged for our immediateaccess, it was 0730 hrs. As I chatted with her, I mentioned my hotel background and that the next day we would be celebrating my wife’s birthday. After a nap we returned to the lobby to arrange for server Al tours and were smartly assisted by the am concierge. The Assistant LP Manager, Dhan LAL KC introduced himself to us and became our most accommodating Kathmandu go to reference. Dhan really unlocked the city for us. After our 2nd day of touring, we returned to our room with a lovely birthday cake surprise for my wife.  The hotel service overall was world class, from prompt housekeeping service daily to the hotels bar and restaurant where the food was delicious and the service impeccable. Kudos to the am F&B Supervisor, “Cliclis” I know it’s incorrect spelling but she Always greeted us by name as did most of her staff.Mr. Dhan introduced the hotel GM to us, I regret I don’t have his name  but we spoke at length about hotels and he was most generous to us with accommodating us with breakfasts during our entire stay,F& B Director Bikram Poudel also took time to chat us as I complemented his teams service.The hotel itself, had brand new decor the rooms were modern, big screen tv, safes everything god’ expect at a Marriott, anywhere.On our final tour day, Mr Dhan was kind enough to personally take us to several wonderful attractions on his personal off time

This was my second stay at the Kathmandu Marriott Hotel, and it was remis of me not to have left a review back in April 21, when sadly, I had to leave swiftly due to the Covid lock down.I have to say the hospitality and attention to detail by the Marriott team from first arriving, to reacting to your every need is excellent.  No task is too much, they respond quickly, and everything is clean, well presented and carried out with care.What is impressive is the customer service is not forced but genuine, and you feel the warmth from everyone.  The facilities are brilliant; for dining and meetings the Thamel Kitchen and Coffee Shop were first rate, and I was fortunate to eat dinner in the Edamame Fine Dining Restaurant which was superb.The Marriott is unsurpassed in my experience of visiting the city, and you wouldn’t be disappointed staying there.  It’s also a great hub for meetings.  My complements to the GM and his team for being so consistent.

I had a wonderful experience.  Staff was very pro active in helping me . Mr Ram KC went out of his way to ensure I was helped . Had a wonderful experience overall. For dads birthday I had wanted Cake delivered . I was surprised you could use WhatsApp to personally interact with staff . They ensured everything would be done timely . Living in Canada I was a bit nervous about not getting the items I wanted . It was exceptional service . Thank you

My wife and I stayed at the Kathmandu Marriott Hotel.The hotel is everything and more you would expect of a 5 star hotel. It is world class.Our experience here was superior to any other hotel I can recall having stayed at.The facilities are modern and the hotel is ultra clean.The three restaurants in house provide a wide range of food options of high quality.There is a pool, a well-equipped gym and day spa.The feature that sets this hotel apart from other hotels is the service. I have read many other reviews about the high standard of service here. Our experience was consistent with those described by others.Rohan the supervisor should be proud of his team.Numerous members of the team were outstanding including Sharad, Sandip, Elina, Sonima, Alina and Susmita in the Thamel Restaurant.Megha, Ajay, Kushan and Unisha at reception were always very helpful.I would highly recommend this hotel for anyone planning a stay in Kathmandu.

I enjoyed my 23+ day stay at Kathmandu Marriott hotel especially thanks to the great team!  Laxmi, in particular, greeted me every day with a cheerful smile and great care to ensure that I (and all other guests I observed) started our day on a positive notes.  Chef Alisha and Chef Nokhi prepared a splendid assortment of Western and Indian dishes (as well as accommodating any special requests) and introduced me to several dishes that I hadn't tried before (I loved the savory tapioca and potatoes, thank you!)  Bijaya welcomed me to the hotel and extended extra care to help smooth out my departure on a long day.   Massage from Trishna was one of the best I've had in years.  Facilities are clean and pretty too, and location is great. Thank you everyone!

This is a lovely hotel within walking distance of lots of sights and the city center.  I enjoyed my stay - the room was comfy with all the amenities I needed, and the food served at the hotel restaurant was tasty (tons of food options).  Special shout out to Santoshi at Thamel kitchen who was so kind and welcoming!  Well done.

We love coming to the Kathmandu Marriott! The rooms have comfortable beds. The M club has excellent service. In fact, the service is excellent in the Thamel Kitchen as well. Check-in was easy and efficient. Ghan in housekeeping did an excellent job with our room and was eager to help us in any way we needed. The chefs would very often customize my food order to meet my needs. We were very happy and will return!

I stayed here for 5 nights in total, this involved 2 stays bookending a trip to Bhutan. The room is excellent, good size, great amenities, and lovely Mountain View. The breakfast and dinner buffets offer a great selection of tasty food. The spa is wonderful and I’d recommend the fitness and hot stone massages. The staff are amazing - welcoming, warm, helpful and friendly. I’d definitely stay here when visiting kathmandu again.

We had a wonderful 4 days at the Marriot. Great service always with a very warm smile. Rashila at the breakfast buffet was exceptionally warm and hospitable and made us feel very special with her radiant smile and exceptional service. Amrit, the mixologist made us some magical concoctions and amazing cocktails. Made us feel very special.

Stayed in the Marrriot for a week after arriving in Kathmandu in early October. Lovely hotel and a very quiet and comfortable room. The staff were always helpful and friendly, especially Laksamae always smiling and cheerful at breakfast!

"I had a wonderful stay at Marriott Kathmandu! The hotel's impeccable service and attention to detail truly stood out. From the warm welcome at check-in to the comfortable and beautifully appointed room, every aspect exceeded my expectations. The staff were incredibly helpful and accommodating, making sure all my needs were met throughout my stay. The location was perfect for exploring the city, and the amenities offered were top-notch. I especially enjoyed dining at the hotel's restaurants; the food was delicious and the ambiance was delightful. Thank you to the entire team at Marriott Kathmandu for making my visit so memorable. I look forward to returning soon!"

Thank you vai Rojen for warm hospitality.I loved the food and the place.I got chance to visit with the reference of Rojen. It’s situated in the heart of kathmandu and I really liked the hospitality shown by the staffs.I really recommend you to visit this place .

Thank you in particular to Umesh and others in the ground floor restaurant and the reception staff for being so helpful and friendly. We needed to sort a late check out as our flight wasn’t until the evening and they were really accommodating, even bringing some soup to our room when my girlfriend was ill. WONDERFUL dinner buffet too, I can recommend the curry especially. Sublimely comfortable room as expected. We loved staying here!

What a great hotel. The staff was amazing. Everyone knew my name and greeted me with every encounter. The staff also knew that I like Coffee/Latte and ensured I always had one during my stay. The room was clean, neat and very spacious. There was an element of peace one you left the streets of Kathmandu and entered into the rooms. That was a really nice touch.The M Lounge was the perfect space for a snack, a meal and a meeting amongst colleagues. The staff, again, knew exactly how to accommodate.Lastly, the people. Everyone is extremely friendly. The doormen/women, the bellhops, the hostesses, the managers on duty and the other guest from around the world who stayed at the Marriott were all very friendly. The ambiance created from the Marriott seems to attract great peopl.I would HIGHLY recommend this hotel for anyone staying in Kathmandu.

I have joined events at bagamati hall . hall. Our events in charge Mr. Prakash Raj has done a great job of organising everything smoothly I look forward to attending more events at Bagmati Hall in the future. The venue was spacious and well-decorated, creating a pleasant atmosphere for all attendees. I am impressed with the level of professionalism and attention to detail demonstrated by Mr. Prakash Raj

So extremely impressed by the staff at the Marriott. I left my phone in the hotel transfer to the airport. As soon as they were alerted the driver returned to the airport and the airport lounge staff picked it up from the driver and brought it to me just in time before I boarded my flight. Who would have thought it could work so well! Thank you!

What an exceptional team! I will name many names, and I regret I will miss many too. M Club is home: Bijaya leads a caring crew, with smiles an personal care from all members: Prajwal, Ashmita, Anup, Sonic, and Manish (and now several new trainees). Thank you for your empathy and kindness! At breakfast, Sanjeev leads another extraordinary crew. Thanks to Laxmi, Rashmi, Alina, Nitin,Sagar, and Rojen (and sorry for everyone I am missing). Chef Alysha is always positive and makes exquisite special requests (thank you for all the mushrooms!).  Front desk team also made every check in and help request a breeze! Thanks Kushan and Niti. Robin was kind and courteous with each call downstairs. Everyone is top notch! Thanks to the concierge Deuraj and greeting team, especially Gyan! You all made my three months fly by!

The Kathmandu Marriott is centrally located, making it easy to explore all the major attractions and main government offices. The hotel staff is incredibly friendly and attentive. They went above and beyond to make sure that I had a wonderful stay. I especially appreciated their warm smiles and friendly greetings every time I enter the hotel.The breakfast buffet is extensive with a wide variety of Western and Nepali dishes to choose from. I look forward to the wide selection of coffee every morning. I also enjoyed the fact that the hotel is located right next to the Kathmandu Royal Palace Complex, which is a great place to go for a morning run. The gym is also well equipped with cardio machines and weights.Overall, I had a great stay at the Kathmandu Marriott. The hotel is beautiful, the staff is amazing, and the location is perfect. I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone traveling to Kathmandu.Special thanks to Elina, Rasila, and Aakriti for making my breakfast experience so special every morning!

Amazing hotel, an epitome of luxury, courteous staffs and very well maintained. Have to applaud Mr Sandip Gautam, his friendliness and behaviour was so exceptional that it made us feel like home and made all our travel arrangements very well. Room service team was also very good, on time and attention to detail. Exceptional. As far as food is concerned, a wide array of food options to select from, all very tasty and as per the needs of the guest, also have to compliment the food service team as well.A must stay hotel in Nepal, the best. Infact a must visit place in Nepal.

Major issues - Air Conditioning in the hotel is compromised. Late night one feels claustrophobic as AC is switched off. It happened both nights i stayed there. One night for longer period and the other short one. GM and the operating staff doesnt bother about it nor wants to address the issues.We were four people who ordered four different dishes, I being Veg ordered for Veg sandwich but was served a chicken one as trainees were operating the Bistro outlet. F&B head Mr. Subarna was apologetic and nice guy but how can hotel do such mistake and get away with that. Not Marriott

Incredible experience, easily some  of the finest service I have received in a hotels anywhere in the world.All staff incredibly attentive and willing to go the extra mile, this ranged from Front of House staff to restaurant staff to any of the waiters and attendants.Would recommend this to anyone looking to stay here.A big thank you especially to Alina / Manish / Karki

Where do I begin…The property is great, we went there in a large group for a birthday celebration and left with no complaints.The hotel is situated in a great location with beautiful scenery all around.Rooms are comfortable and spacious as well.The staff members were very helpful and were able to accommodate all of our requests with a smile on their face.Our friends hosted 2-3 large dinner parties there and the hotel was very organized, so would definitely suggest for family functions or eventsThe service and facilities were perfect!Would highly recommend!!

I visited this hotel with my friend. We had coffee in extended outdoor of lobby. The place was quiet and the coffee was nice and server freshly baked cookies. Bar looks good and the Asian restaurant was amazing however We didn’t had time to experience due to the timing. I tasted Yarchagumba Whiskey in lobby as the bar was not opened at that time. I would like to thank Sandeep and Naz for taking care of us. The hotel is still new and staffs may new too. I personally felt that still there need more trainings for staffs to provide 5 stars service and some service standards to improve and hotel to look into some basics to make feel 5 stars hotel to the guests as well as be different than others.

Marriott has taken the game in Kathmandu city to the next level at Marriott Kathmandu. Impeccable, proactive and gastronomical extravaganza is how we would describe the property. The five day holiday was absolutely wonderful. Credit goes to the entire hotel staff - most of whom are invisible but absolutely brilliant and specifically to Joginder Singh, Prazwal, Birat, from F&B and Samana from the bqr to look after our taste buds and Sandip and Devraj from the concierge team to plan our internal travel to local attractions and transfers. We look forward to visiting the property again.

Amazing service. Rama in the Wellness Spa was kind, skilled, and made my spa experience special. I would also recommend the hotel meals, both my room service meal and my dining in the area restaurant were very well prepared and tasty, both the Western style food as well as the regional fare.

This is a beautiful hotel with some of the best service I have ever experienced. Everyone who works there is so polite and kind. The ladies at the front desk were efficient and lovely. Bibek the concierge was particularly helpful, and even made himself available on his day off to help arrange transport. The food is fresh and delicious, and the pool is very pleasant. Good views of the mountains in good weather.

Excellent hotel and spa. I had an elegant and comfortable well appointed room, gracious hotel staff and an amazing massage by Trishna in the beautiful hotel spa. The spa was serene and relaxing. I also enjoyed the dining options. One caution is rooms facing the pool and terrace do have a little noise when the DJ is cranking on the patio.

Room facilities are very good. Swimming pool is also very good. But room rate is too high  in comparison with other 5 star hotels in Kathmandu.Staff are not welcoming. The man who checked me in did not smile at all, looking more like a prison warden in a scary movie.The manageress and general manager were inflexible and unreceptive hence short sighted of them when there is fierce competition among the many 5 star hotels in KTM. The lobby is  uncomfortable and limiting if one has to conduct business among more than 2 persons. The Overwhelming Food smell from the restaurant  across the passage is really annoying. The sort of center piece wall in the courtyard made of cheap looking concrete tiles is the last straw. The big letter M  in the middle  (apparently standing for Marriott) looks more like a sign for a fast food chain.

The people of Kathmandu are a warm, welcoming, and ancient people who pride themselves on hospitality and diversity.  The staff at this Marriott are a shining example of those very same precious sentiments.  I have stayed here three times for business and will almost certainly stay here many more and at this point it feels like home.  The facilities are at a five star western standard, but it's the humans who bring this place alive.  From the mixologist-turned-manager Samir who is always inventing new drinks for the Raksi to the humble Rashmi and Laxmi who ensure every breakfast earns every star of this rating, I want for nothing during my stay.  I promise, they will do the same for you as well.

Kathmandu Marriott is an outstanding and prestigious hotel with great facilities and lovely staff.  It is a 30min from the airport and a 15min walk from the bustling Thamel, and a stone's throw from many other places.  The rooms were large and clean, and the bathroom is also spacious with a bathtub. I had the opportunity to experience the Club lounge and it had a lovely view of the surrounding and the Himalayan mountains surrounding Kathmandu.The staff at the hotel was exceptional!  I would like to especially call out Chhejan and Prazena from reception who attended to my requests promptly and patiently; Prajwal, Manish, and Bijaya at the lounge who were attentive to my favourites and were ever ready to ensure I had a good time there, and Prakash from dining who provided me lots of tips on places to visit in Nepal.  There were of course others which I may have missed out, and each of you made a difference in this stay. Kudos!We had our conference there and the ballroom, and breakout rooms at the Mezzanine were well-equipped.  The morning breakfast spread was just fulfilling.  With added attention from the staff, every morning was just a joy.  I missed the chance to visit the next door casino although I heard the entrance fee deal was good/worthwhile.All in all, a great place living up to the reputation of a Marriott hotel and even more.  Enjoyed my stay and would be back if I have the chance!

What a fantastic stay at the Kathmandu Marriott. The food was delicious, the staff was amicable, and the rooms were comfortable. They have great packages for elite guests with complimentary airport pick up and drop off, two pieces of laundry, and M Club Lounge Access. The M class staff was terrific. The banquet staff was outstanding too. They had very excellent facilities, including several restaurants on the property. My only two recommendations are to save suites for elite guests. There were no suites available during my entire five-night stay. Being a Lifetime Titanium Elite member, I am almost always guaranteed a suite upgrade, even before check-in. The other is to have a club team or elite services guest email before arrival. That way, arrangements, and requests can be made.

Amazing sanctuary in the busy centre of Kathmandu town. This hotel is a lovely place to be for business or personal travel if your in Kathmandu, the staff are wonderful, attentive and knowledgable.The restaurants are plentiful and the sauna / steam room pool and gym is amazing. Some shops and coffee places also serve great cakes and coffee. Concierge have all the knowledge you need and can arrange anything.

We loved Tahina! This rooftop restaurant had a great ambiance, romantic lighting, amazing food, and views. Bikash was very attentive, Manjeet provided us with exclusive drinks, and Barsha is very friendly and energetic. Thanks to all the chefs.

Perhaps the best hotel experience of my life. All the amenities, spa, hot tub, sauna, steam, infinity pool, great workout facility. But what made is special was the incredible service. The most caring, attentive staff I have ever experienced. Amazing lunch buffet featuring multiple cuisines and excellent food overall. I especially want to shout out to Rina, my frequent server. She was delightful. After finishing my lunch on my final day I was too full to order dessert and had stood up to leave. Rina came hurriedly over to say “ Mr Mark ! Please wait one minute”. She and her coworkers then gathered around my table and presented me with a personalized “Bonvoy” dessert and photo op. I didn’t want to leave..

Loved the stay at this property situated in the city centre. It made our stay perfect and loved all the aspects. Rashila, Rashmi, Raliesh, Chhejan & Bhuwan made sure that every comfort was ensured with their helping nature, pleasing smiles and delicious food with outstanding hospitality even at the restaurant.

The Marriott at Kathmandu is our first choice every time we visit Kathmandu to see family and conduct business. The attentive service all staff members provide is wonderful and makes me and my family feel very well taken care of, even in long stays. One of the hotel workers, Laxmi, is especially helpful and attentive to our needs— she always makes sure to go the extra mile for us. Me and my family recommend Marriott Kathmandu to any and everyone coming to the city.

We had a great three-night stay here.  The hotel is brand new, having opened in fall of 2019, but everything went smoothly.  The staff was incredibly nice, many were Nepalis that have worked at Marriott properties in the Middle East and took advantage of the hotel opening to come home.

It’s my first time to visit nepal and staying in marriott kathmandu is awesome, the stop was accomodating, friendly, and I got what  I expected. One staff name sandip his amazing And helpful. When i was in the bar to order my drink I request taste that I wanted then he got it. The whole 3 days im staying was worth it the money I spend. ❤️😊

If I ever returned to Kathmandu, I would stay at the Marriott for the simple reason that the superb breakfast which consists of a rotating variety of freshly prepared local specialty dishes, made-to-order stations that are different each day, fresh fruit and baked goods, beverages to suit any palate and enough to fill you for an entire day of sightseeing.  The best part are the staff who are personable, accommodating and fun to interact with daily.  The rest of the hotel is safe, secure, clean, modern and comfortable.  Would I stay here again?  Absolutely yes.  Would I recommend it to others?  Absolutely, yes.

The hotel is centrally located close to the airport and the city. The rooms are spacious clean with beautiful, modern amenities. The spa is luxurious the gym as every type of equipment you could imagine.  We ate breakfast, lunch and dinner at the hotel multiple times, and the food was absolutely delicious. The one thing that stands out,  above all, was the staff. We’ve been to multiple Marriott all over the world and I’ve never encountered staff as pleasant, polite, or as helpful as the staff of Kathmandu Marriott. This is a gorgeous hotel all around snd the staff take this Marriott above and beyond anywhere else that we have stayed.

Marriott Kathmandu is a beautiful and aesthetically pleasant hotel. Our stay at the hotel was exceptionally comforting. Mr. Vishal Mehra and his team were incredibly welcoming and took care of all our requests with smiles and willingness to assist us throughout our stay. We dined at Edamame and the food was simply delectable. A MUST TRY Restaurant and  I would definitely recommend staying at the Marriott Kathmandu

The location is ideal as it's at the heart of the city. Starting with the enough parking space for vehicles and friendly staff standing Infront of a big traditional nepali vessel filled with beautiful seasonal flowers , the experience keeps getting better with friendly staff making our every needs met. Specially Supriya Katwal, was very sincere with her duty and was available 24/7 for us- from serving beverages to us and ensuring our every meeting went smooth. The food was delicious too! I'd definitely recommend this hotel for business meetings.

Enjoyed my 3 days stay at the Marriott Kathmandu . Right from the check-in staff to the lounge staff and Resturant staff everyone was very hospitable and provided great service with a smile . Rooms are great with gorgeous views of the nearby hills and city . Very well maintained rooms and service was impeccable . Breakfast was great and lounge has lot to offer . Highly recommend this hotel to all fellow travellers .

I have been going to Mariott for their breakfast buffet for many times since their opening. Great selection of dishes and staffs are always very helpful and friendly. I would say the best service I received in Nepal comparing to other 5 stars hotel. Hotel room is nice and modern too. Front desk check in personnel and house keeping staffs are all very friendly.Special thanks to Prakash (chef), Roni and Laxmi. They always go extra mile to make you feel welcome.

Great hotel; friendly staff.The breakfast buffet has a huge selection including local/indian food. Rooms are clean and comfortable,For gold status they give free drinksLot of small tea shops within walking distance.  Very quiet, not in Thamel

Me and my husband visited Kathmandu for the first time and we booked for three nights.Everything from airport pick up, courtesy of the staff and the food was excellent.The location is very close to main centre Thamel with small cafes and clubs and yet not in the middle of hustle bustle.Definitely staying again with them in the future ❤️

I was able to get a massage (back and shoulders) from the therapist Eva, and it was definitely one of the best sessions I’ve been to. Excellent ! If you are staying here and have the chance, do try the spa. And of course, the ambiance too was just right.

I have been to this Marriott for work several times and the catering staff. In particular Supriya are just terrific.  She is thoughtful, attentive and anticipates our needs way before I even know it.  The service staff for events is the best.

I enjoyed my stay at the hotel, the staff was friendly, especially the F&B team.Breakfast was great although I was not a big fan of the a la carte menu, but the friendliness of the staff made up for it. There was a lady in the mornings (forgot her name) that was especially friendly.

I spent a leisurely vacation at the Marriott Hotel from July 20th to July 28th. This is my first time to Nepal and my first time staying in a Marriott hotel. Feeling very satisfied. What surprised me most about the Nepal Marriott Hotel in Kathmandu was the enthusiasm and kindness of their service staff. Especially Mr. Moj of M CLUB and the team he leads. They remember our preferences and habits and prepare our favorite drinks. There is no mango among the fruits provided by M CLUB, but I wanted to taste the mango from Nepal, so they asked the kitchen to prepare a cut mango for me. I think this service that tries its best to meet the needs of customers can only be found in first-class hotels. Thank you to these kind and gracious people. If I come to Kathmandu next time, I will definitely choose the Marriott Hotel.

Top notch service by Srijan. Made us feel very comfortable and gave some great suggestions. We tried the local pork dish and had some local beer, both tasted great. The bar overlooks the ground floor and has a great ambiance. A must visit!

Great hospotality with great ambiance perfect for a comfortable stay at the luxurious hotel. Had a long business trip of 11 days the hotel team made sure we get the best of food with fresh fruits and great drinks. They even have a small little custom of saying bonjour on the last day of stay.Will love to visit the property again.

The service and the staffs were very cooperative. The management was pretty comfortable and flexible when we asked for various things for the event. Prakash Raj ji was the one who assisted me with a lots of services, he went over the board to help us

We were here for 5 days over Christmas and we had a delightful stay. Kudos to the very fine hardworking staff of the hotel. Special mention to the two Manish , Rojen, the girl who loves K-drama and the rest of the breakfast staff. The room was spotless and the bed, pillows, and linen were of high quality. We'll definitely stay here on our next visit.

So glad we chose this hotel for our trip to Kathmandu. From the airport pick up in an EV till our departure, we couldn’t have asked for more. Having travelled and stayed in various hotels around the world, the warmth of service and care shown by this team, left us floored. Dining was amazing - sumptuous buffet breakfast, exclusive Asian dining at Edamame (best in town), and belly dancing evening with Mediterranean food at Tahina Terrace… showed how much emphasis Marriott puts to be the stand-out hotel in town.  Gym was perfect and my wife truly endorses the Spa. We’re definitely going to tell our family and friends about this jewel. Our compliments to the management and team of Kathmandu Marriott. Thank you

I stayed at the Marriott Kathmandu 3 times over a period of 2 weeks in April 2024. Each time, the service provided by the staff was beyond my expectations. From the front desk to the M club lounge, the staff strived for complete customer satisfaction, whether it was setting up my 4:30 am breakfast order or ensuring my luggage was looked after or topping up my wine in the M lounge as needed... I want to especially recognize the the M Club staff, Prajwal, Asmita, Moj and the rest for providing exceptional service

The staff at Kathmandu Marriott are nothing short of exceptional. From the warm welcome at check-in to the personalized service throughout my stay, every team member exudes professionalism and genuine warmth. They seamlessly anticipate and fulfill guests' needs, making each interaction a pleasure. It's evident that the staff takes great pride in ensuring every guest feels not just accommodated, but truly cared for. Particular words of gratitude are directed towards Moj and his team at the hotel lounge. They made our stay not just enjoyable; it was an unforgettable experience that has left me eager to return.

it has been my 4th time here and I have to admit that mariott in kathmandu is my absolute favourite hotel in nepal. my fiance introduced it to me as a surprise gift for my first visit of capital and since that every stay here is a bit of celebration for me. moreover when I have my family over (my mom and later on my sister) first days of the trip in nepal we usually spend here: to recover comfortably from jetlag and enjoy the peaceful ambience in the noisy& overcrowded capital. every time I'm here, I enjoy fully all the conveniences kindly offered: I love their well and very professionally arranged gym, small but very pretty swimming pool, wonderful indoor restaurants and my absolute highlight - mwellness spa.mwellness became my big addiction and maybe over the couple of months I was visiting kathmandu, I tried many treatments offered by the team. absolutely in love with signature massage done by Eva therapist. she is wonderful masseuse and scrubs, wraps and facials with her are incredibly enjoyable. the entire stuff of mwellness is always very friendly, considerate  and accommodating with timings. the rooms are always clean, the amenities perfectly arranged. couldn't wish more comfort!thank you very much for making each of my stay with you so memorable and relaxing. I will definitely come again and can only strongly recommend to experience the stay here as soon as possible.

I stayed here for a total of 5 nights over the last 2 weeks, one night before a trek and 4 nights after.  Both times were terrific.  The hotel is pretty new and very clean, and the rooms are well designed and comfortable.  The food was also excellent—the breakfast buffet, the dinner buffet, and Edamame.  The crowning achievement is the staff:  they were all very helpful and efficient. The front desk team got me in and out quickly and kindly, and answered my questions.  The restaurant employees were always available, and in particular, Dhiraj at Edamame.  He helped me pick the right dishes and all the food there was delicious.  Marriott should be very proud of its hotel in Kathmandu.

My spouse and I were here for 28 days from May - June 2023. This proved to be one of the most comfortable experiences we have had in a hotel for an extended stay. We especially appreciated the thoughtfulness of Laxmi Thapa at Thamel Kitchen, who never failed to stop at our table (no matter how busy it was) to have a friendly chat and ask us about our stay. She always made us feel very much at home.We also appreciated the care of Manish in the M Club. He always remembered small details about our preferences and interests and treated us with wonderful care and courtesy (as did the rest of the M Club staff). One more shout-out we'd like to give is to Ashmita at the front desk, who always was responsive to all our questions. We're about to do another 8 week stay at the Marriott Kathmandu starting today, and we cannot wait to see the wonderful smiling faces of its staff!

This Marriott stands out in Kathmandu.  From the beautiful building and interior to the relaxing pool (used in November) to the M Club. We received excellent service by name from the moment we entered. In the M Club Moj and Asmita were both accommodating and we had personal attention when we entered each day. Hotel is very centrally located as well. We used 3 tours from the hotel, a Mt Everest flight booked with the concierge, and the cable car transportation and a full day tour booked through Marriott hotel  website. We would definitely stay here again should our travels bring us back to Kathmandu, Nepal.

Staff in every capacity was unparalleled. As a Platinum Elite member my status was recognized and staff consistently asked me how I was doing and what they could do to make my stay more comfortable. The rooms were perfectly made and the amenities were incredible. Perfect gym, pool, sauna, and spa with incredibly kind and genuine staff members. Everyone was fluent in English which is an incredible feat.

Kathmandu Marriott provides a true 5-star experience. My wife and I visited for 10 days, and we had a superb stay. The staff treated us so well, headlined by Anúska Piya, the hostess at Tahina Terrace Restaraunt. Anúska ensured we were well cared for and went out of her way to build rapport and to learn about us and our travel itinerary. Those 5-10 minutes of conversation were always a highlight of our day—as we came back to that restaurant often. The other staff at the restaurant and beyond were great as well. The pizza and grilled meats were the best food we had at the hotel restaurants.The breakfast was likewise superb—one of the best and most variety I’ve had anywhere in the world. The M Club lounge provided a great spot for a light dinner or nightcap.Rooms were luxurious and amply sized. Location was secure and they worked well to organize taxi and shuttle services.

The staff at this property are the most gracious, kind, welcoming individuals. They really make your stay wonderful. Thank you Moj and his team. The views from the lounge are spectacular for sunrise and sunset viewing and the breakfast buffet is fantastic. The rooms are luxurious and the gym is wonderful. Thank you for making our honeymoon a wonderful experience.

I personally feel the hospitality and service of the hotel quite appealing and satisfactory. Specifically, when I was served water by Saphal Baniya and Supriya Katwal exactly when I was getting thirsty made me feel so thankful to the hotel staffs and the entire Marriot Hotel. Thank you 😊🙏🏻

Within 12 days of our travel of Nepal we stayed at the Marriot 4 times. Each and every visit we were treated with utmost courtesy, warmth, respect and absolute attention. Our accommodations were outstanding and we felt comfortable and cozy. We found our place at Mclub Lounge. The ambiance and view was so welcoming. We enjoyed the refreshments and happy hour and mostly the warmth of the servers. We particularly want to mention Bijaya the manager and Asmita a server who showed us such a special attention. Thank you Marriot hotel for being of one of highlights of our trip to Nepal.

I stayed at the Kathmandu Marriott Hotel on Valentine's day. The very first welcome was very traditional and heart touching. Surprising upgrade to junior suite with overwhelming valentine's decoration along with red roses, balloons, rose bucket and welcome amenities made our stay over the moon. In addition, 6 courses valentine's special menu and wonderful dining experience made our stay one of the best travel experience for me and my partner. Everyone at the Kathmandu Marriott were welcoming and very friendly. Staffs were professional and curious to provide authentic hospitality service. David, at the Edamame along with Bikram and the team were fantastic.  Thank you Kathmandu Marriott Team for the amazing travel experience and I look forward to come back again.

Its was a great experience with friends. Food was excellent Mr. Saroj chef and Ronish chef was very perfect with food knowledge. Cold mezze and manakiesh was super. Naz was very polite with us and suggest very good cocktail and he made our day by serving good drinks.

Outstanding hotel.  Service is attentive and exceptional across every aspect of the property—front desk, restaurants, housekeeping, and the spa. Of course, the breakfast buffet is extraordinary, with almost countless choices and all of them prepared and maintained well.

As a native of this city, I am very stingy at writing reviews of restaurants. But I could not help this time. Very impressed with how Laxmi at Thamel Kitchen served us for lunch today. You are polite and v friendly, and prompt at your service.

The training program was arranged well. The food menu  was planned well and delicious. Food was served on time and the staff was very helpful and cortious. The staff in charge of this program Mr. Subash was very accommodative, helpful and flexible.They were all very polite. Made the Programme successful.

We had a great stay at Marriott as tourists. We stayed in a club room and it was very clean and new. We had dinner at Edamame and breakfast in Thamel and they were both excellent with a good variety. We would like to specifically thank Bijaya and her team for the great hospitality and for sharing so much information and knowledge about the beautiful country's history.

It was the most heartwarming hotel. The service is above and beyond, starting from the front desk, cleaning, cooking and restaurant and the spa staff. At every turn they surprised us with grandeur gestures. Saru, Susira and Trishna at the spa were a relaxing experience. Well worth it. Sagar, Pemba, Bigat, Amit and the restaurant and bar staff…top notch. To all the staff, thank you very much for your hospitality. We hope we can return to this hotel in our future travels.

A pleasant surprise in the city!Two close friends planned a long overdue trip to Kathmandu and couldn't have done it better!We were welcomed to the hotel with bright smiles, the traditional namaste and thoroughly commendable hospitality.The courtyard next to the breakfast area was a pleasure to take a stroll in and enjoy the weather without having to break into the city. The rooftop bar was fun to enjoy the sunset and staff made us feel right at home.The organization of all of our events were brilliantly coordinated and exceeded our expectations!Thank you once again Marriott Bonvoy!

This hotel is one of the best hotels I have been to. It is all the wonderful people that make this hotel so special, and in return make you as a guest feel special too!!! From the moment I arrived, they welcomed me with smiles and gifts. Big thank you to the wonderful staff at the Executive Lounge, always caring and welcoming, making us feel at home. Whether you are there for a day or a longer stay, they will take good care of you. And if you have no idea where to go, what to visit and need assistance, the concierge and all the staff will go beyond their duty to make sure you get the best experience.I’m still amazed how nice everyone is and how everything flows effortlessly in this hotel. Pure joy, no stress. And it is all due to their awesome staff trust me… and when talking about no stress, well, you have to try one of their signature treatments in the spa, you will feel reborn. Also, big thanks to housekeeping too, for putting up with me. You’re awesome.You might think I’m exaggerating, but once you visit this place and meet all the wonderful people here, I can bet you will feel the same way I do now.

We love going to the breakfast buffet at Thamel Kitchen!! The staff is always so considerate and takes care of us like we are family. Rasmi, Laxmi, and Mitin are so wonderful. The food is always fantastic and the chef and kitchen staff are always willing to make any accommodations we need. This is a great place to enjoy a meal in Kathmandu.

Just stayed here recently and the stay was exceptionally good. The hotel is in the best location in Kathmandu and has the best restaurants in Nepal.The gym is among the best I have been to in the world. I heard from my local friends that the owner’s son is a model and hence has invested a lot of money in the gym. The bar at the hotel is very lively. The staff are very eager to please and assist. Great work, will be back again.

I had another wonderful experience at Kathmandu Marriott! Delectable food, friendly staff, and cozy rooms. Elite guest packages with complimentary airport services and laundry are a highlight but weren't available during this stay. Kudos to Mr. Moj for his exceptional assistance in meeting space and transportation assistance. The rest of the M Club Lounge staff were also fantastic. The spread was delicious and the cocktails were superb. The banquet team was also impressive with their patience in setting up for our event. Facilities, including various on-site restaurants, were excellent. Two suggestions: reserve suites for elite guests, and implement pre-arrival communication for elite guests to arrange requests in advance.

I had a wonderful 5 nights at the Marriott Kathmandu. I’ve been a Bonvoy Titanium member for several years and spend a lot of time in hotels all over the world. Rarely do I find a hotel that consistently demonstrates such high standards in all aspects of hospitality. Every employee consistently went out of their way to make certain my stay was excellent. The M Club was a wonderful oasis. Bijaya, the manager, and the entire crew were uniformly gracious and professional. After my late check out of 4 PM, I was told I remain the lounge prior to my 8 PM departure. They obviously didn’t have to do that, but they did, and it was appreciated. Next time I’m in Kathmandu you will find me at the Marriott.

Every staff at Marriott were polite and courteous. It was delightful because they make you feel very welcomed. On the last day of our departure, we were presented with a special farewell dish and it was nice because they had in mind your departure date. It was a very nice and heartwarming touch to the end of the vacation. Special shout-out to Sandip, Riken m, Romi and Mavish (I hope I got the spelling correct!) for the surprise dish. And lastly thumbs up to the superb service from everyone at Marriott

Magnificent stay at Kathmandu Marriott Hotel. The hotel could not be more elegant, comfortable, clean and well located with great and spacious rooms, but the best of all was our experience in one of the best M-Clubswhere we have been, with a splendid breakfast and happy hour with dinner varied and complete, as well as good wines and cocktails. All M-Club staff were extremely attentive and friendly at all times. Our thanks to Moj, Prajwal, Rupesh, Suraj, Rohit, Shinsti, Muskan, Anup and Asmita. We will definitely return!

Kathmandu Marriott is the best hospitality hotel I have ever been in this region. Hotel staffs were always nice and recognized me as a valued customer during the stay. Hotel was very clean and well maintained. Nice M club view look down the city of Kathmandu. Don’t forget to say Hi to Mrs. Bijaya and her lounge team at M Club! She and her team members are awesome!

The team at the hotel was very hospitable. They went over and beyond to cater to my needs - they made me feel at home during my 15 days with them. A special shout-out to Moj and Manish at the M lounge! Thanks and see you soon.

Marriott Kathmandu a wonderful oasis after a busy time in Kathmandu visiting all it has to offer.The staff are welcoming and happy to see you.Nothing is ever too much troubleFood is excellent quality and if your lucky enough to be able to go into MClub you will be greeted by the loveliest staff and great views while you enjoy happy hour

We had our event from 13 th of may.It was great doing the events at marriott we got the best service and the best team from banquet for our event.They were to helpful and coordinating.Suabsh ji did the fantastic job helping us with everything what is needed. Keep it up subash ji and do the best sservice you did. We are very grateful and happy with the marriott and the service the team has provided

Unrivaled service levels and comfort!  We are currently four nights into a five night stay and thought I would write this review since I did not want to forget as our holiday continues.  The hotel service levels should be replicated everywhere at Marriott.  They rival or exceed those we have recieved at Ritz Carlton and Autograph properties around the world.  I am remiss to be specific with names but it would be unfair to list a few since every service touchpoint has been above and beyond in terms of kindness, helpfulness and professionalism.  The restaurant’s service and food were fantastic!  The housekeeping and bell staff were great.  The M Lounge team were truly over the top!  Their recognition of our Marriott status was greatly appreciated. Concierge was knowledgeable and helpful.  Kathmandu is a crazy city!!  The Marriott is an oasis amidst the controlled chaos of the streets and traffic.

Wow! I'm just impressed with the hospitality of Marriott. You'll be welcomed in a marvelous way when you reach there. They won't let you feel that you're in a hotel, it feels like home. I stayed there for 2 days. The room was very standard and clean. Kudos to housekeeping team, I also loved the buffet in thamel kitchen, Miss Rina gave me a good service. Thanks to Miss Alisha Chef for hosting me well. I would like to thanks Miss Prateema katwal for the recommendation. The kathmandu Marriott hotel is a an  place if you're planning for a short vacation to be refreshed.

I stayed at the Marriott Kathmandu between 15th and 17th May 2022. On the 16th, I enjoyed a sports massage at their spa on the mezzanine floor. It was one of the best spa experiences I had in years. Aside from the cleanliness and professionalism of the staff, the treatment I received at the expert hands of Eva was phenomenal. By the time our one hour session was over, I must have thanked her 100 times. Eva is truly an asset to Marriott Kathmandu and by extension to the entire Marriott hotel chain. If you ever come to Nepal, I strongly recommend that you consider staying at the Marriott. It is by far the best hotel I have stayed at here, but do so because of their spa. I guarantee that the experience will be memorable. Thank you Marriott. And thank you EVA!! 😀Ardavan FF

Great service and warm, welcoming staff. Dipesh at the front desk was incredibly helpful in providing recommendations on where to go for sightseeing and checked in on how my stay was going throughout.Facilities and food were also quite good.

The best Marriott ever !! The staff make it that good, whether it's Sandip at concierge, Regina and all the staff at bfast or the lounge staff Bijaya, sonic, prajwal-  they were all brilliant!!! They are all always smiling and pleasant. Food is fantastic here especially bfast where chef Prakash made sure the Idlis and vadas were so authentic. The lounge staff even made my daughter feel special with a cake for her. Overall- truly sad to leave this hotel.  We knew everyone by the time we left after 2 weeks.  Until next time.....

We went to Kathmandu Marriott for a business meeting and stayed for 3 nights in the hotel. The meetings were really good with nice big windows for natural light. Staff were attentive and friendly, especially Supriya who was looking after us on our meeting. Thamel Kitchen is a good all-day dining restaurant, and Edamame Restaurant is a very good restaurant that we had for dinner.

Their speciality restaurant “tahina” is the place to be if you want to indulge in Lebanese food. Their service is amazing and the staff is super polite. Bikash has always been extremely warm to us and it makes us come back again and again.

My husband and I live in Nepal and will often have breakfast at Thamel Kitchen whenever we are in KTM. We are always thrilled with Chef Prakash’s food and the service we receive! It is like being welcomed home. We are cared for so well and the food is outstanding!

I’m a frequent guest at Marriott hotels and I’m sure this is the best straight up Marriott brand  I have experienced. The property is beautiful and modern but with Nepali touches. Only 4 years old, you would think the staff has been here for much longer…extremely polite and professional, it’s a real testament to the local management. The food in both restaurants was great, the room (1019) was spacious with a great view, large bathroom and all the right touches. Special thanks to my massage therapist, Trishna, who was a master at her art, to my friendly driver Arjun and especially to Prajwal, the M Club Manager, a great host who was extremely helpful in guiding my first Kathmandu experience.

Staff members at the Kathmandu Marriott are absolutely fantastic! From reception to housekeeping to the restaurant and bar staff, everyone was helpful, accommodating, and professional. My room was spotlessly clean. Moj and his staff in the M Club Lounge are incredibly helpful and thoughtful. This has to be one of the best hotel properties in Nepal. A lovely stay.

The hotel had a very nice atmosphere which met all my requirements. The receptionist Dipesh was exceptionally efficient, kind and helpful. This was fantastic considering that we arrived tired and late and were still made to feel very welcome

This is an incredible hotel in Kathmandu! It had all the amenities you need while traveling: multiple restaurant options with delicious food including a buffet, a really nice pool, exercise room, bars, shops and even a casino. Most importantly, the service was impeccable! Everyone is so friendly and helpful from the front desk staff to the housekeepers to the restaurant staff. The hotel was very clean and modern, and located about a 10 minute walk from Thamel. Marriott is a reliable brand and this Marriott certainly lives up to its reputation. Thank you for making my first time in Kathmandu a great experience! Would definitely stay here again on my next trip to Nepal.

The Kathmandu Marriott Hotel room and the food was great. The service was impeccable. Our stay at Hotel Marriott , Kathmandu was from 22nd July to 25th July 2022.  The Hospitality of the staff is amazingly good specially Mr.Varun Kamra Director Sales and Marketing  who has a exceptional positivity in his attitude. He  came forward to take extra care to avoid any inconvenience. We enjoyed our  stay at the hotel, the staff was friendly, We would like to give & star ratings to front office staff, F&B team, Housekeeping, Drivers as well as to supporting staff.

Thanks to Elina Sagar Dipu Nipurna Mani Raj Rashila Shekhar Anjan Ashutosh Laxmi Pempa....... Excellent motivated team.Food and ambience is top notch.Good vegetarian options.Chef team is very welcoming.They make the guest feel very special with their little gestures!!!

We enjoyed our stay at the Marriott where we were located before and after our EBC trek.We were made to feel most welcome by all of the Marriott team but I would like to make special mention to the bar staff in the Raksi Bar - Samana, Prabin and Anjon who made us feel very much at home. They ensured we were always looked after and their level of service and attention to our needs was very much appreciated.I found this an amazing stay which I can only say felt like an oasis in the middle of busy Kathmandu.

I have traveled to Kathmandu many times.  I usually stay at the same hotel because it is reliably clean and comfortable.  But, in the last couple of years, a few new ones have opened.  Since I try and stay in the Bonvoy family and it was now possible, I opted to try this hotel.  I am so glad that I did.  The hotel is in a great part of the city within an easy walk of many of the places that I needed to go including Thamel.  The staff was kind and happy to accommodate any request.  The hotel is spotless and the single most comfortable bed I have ever had in Nepal.  Reliable internet and power (which isn’t always the case in Kathmandu) and good food options, this hotel will now be my first choice when I return.  The other Western hotels in Kathmandu are fine, but this one seems to be the best I’ve encountered.  I really have to give a special thanks to the staff at the front front desk and the small cafe outside who were exceptionally gracious and warm.Really well done!

Guys please don’t stay in this hotel. The staff is good but the management overcharges for everything. They were counting the breakfast and denying to give extra bottles of water. They behaviour was extremely discriminatory. During our stay of 10 days when asked for bottles of water they refused to give us any extra ones. They refused to give us bread baskets with soup. There was smell in the linen and towels that were given to us. I will not recommend anyone to go there. Please be sure before going.

Had a great stay with Mariott Kathmandu. The room was perfect and agreeable clean. All the hotel services I have experienced were amazingly endering and supportive. The food was additionally up to check. I strongly suggest this place for anybody searching for posh assistance and extravagance accomodation.

The beds were the most comfortable I have ever had at a hotel. The staff was very personable and professional. I will suggest this hotel to anyone traveling into Kathmandu, very nice and clean restaurants and bar plus awesome food .   Mr Kumar (Front office Manager) He was Excellent with lots of customers service Knowledge. If you are visiting this property please Ask KUMAR ,He would do anything to make your stay Comfortable. Thank you house keeping team for maintain ing hotel very clean .

I attended a workshop at the Marriott and everything was great! I really liked the food that they served, both Nepali and western. The attention to detail was obvious. Subash from food and beverage was very attentive. I definitely recommend having events here.

We went to Tahina terrace for our Anniversary. Amazing vibe and great service. Food was delicious and drinks were great... I would like to Thank Bikram and his team for making us feel welcomed and comfortable... Very happy with the customer service..

I highly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Kathmandu. The hotel is beautiful, with excellent dining and fitness facilities. The pool is gorgeous. But the best thing about this hotel is the people who work there. Every person I encountered is incredibly friendly and helpful. The concierge Deu Raj helped book me a last minute half day tour of the city.  The Executive Lounge staff are wonderful - Bijaya took the best care of me every time I walked through the door.   I can't wait until to return to this hotel again.

I stayed here for 15 days during my daughters wedding. I cannot say enough about the staff. When my daughter needed some emergency hairspray and they did not have it in the salon Salma wrote me a note to hand to someone in the store if they did not understand what I was looking for. For breakfast Sagar, Romi, Nikhil, Manish, Rojan, Sharad all knew our names and our preferences. They would not even have to ask what I wanted. When passing in the hotel they would stop to ask about the wedding or my hike in Pokhara. The place was clean and made for an extremely relaxing time.

We have organized many corporate events at Kathmandu Marriott Hotel and every experience has been excellent. The venue for the events is clean, spacious, and bright, which is essential for any corporate event. Anish Shakya and Maya were very professional and always available to handle any of our questions and concerns. They helped us in the planning phase and definitely in the execution of the event. The support staff at the venue, Mr. Prakash Raj Adhikari, is extremely efficient, pleasant, and helpful. He is easy to work with and understands every detail required for the execution, which is why he is highly dependable and highly recommendable!

I have stayed at the Marriott Kathmandu four times in the last seven months and have nothing but praise for the hotel and the staff.
