The hotel is centrally located, a short ride from the airport and walkable to all that Thamel has to offer.  The rooms are modern, spacious, clean and well maintained. The staff are the real stars and they strive and succeed at the highest level of customer service which I usually only experience at the top tier Marriott properties. I have spent over 835 nights at Marriott properties over the last 20 years and this is the first time I have felt compelled to write a review.  Marriott corporate should use this property as a training model for other Marriott hotels worldwide. This type of service from every employee interaction comes from the example set and demanded by management. From Riju at the front desk who greets you with a smile and makes any request a reality and has personally assisted me on each of my four stays.  To the M Club Lounge which is one of the best I have ever visited.  I specifically want to acknowledge Moj, Asmita, Muskan, Prajwal and the rest for their exceptional level of service.  I can’t wait for my next visit!

meeting held I  Koshi hall. First of all thanks for mariot hotel service department.  All service and items are good.  we are very cool with the service of this hotel.  Drinks with smoke area restrictions different matters with customers point.

This is an outstanding hotel with a very professional staff. This was our first time in Nepal and we wanted to attempt a two week trek in the Himalayas. We are experienced backpackers, but wanted to find a trekking agency. One of the concierges named Prem contacted several trekking agencies for us and found us w great guide who organized a wonderful two week trek for us. Prem followed our trek and made sure everything went well. We were in Nepal for two months and used this Marriott as a base camp for our travels. The entire staff became like family for us as we took several excursions through the country. They made sure we got the right buses and hotels. The M Club lounge is one of the best I have experienced in the world. The breakfast and the evening buffet always had a great meal. I would recommend this hotel to anyone.

I loved this experience as it was relaxing and it was a place where we could unwind. The hotel is highly under rated but is a gem. The design, the art, the location, the food, the service, the gym and the pool are all top notch and at par with the finest globally. I will keep coming back and recommending.

Great property in a great location.  Very friendly and helpful employees. A premium Marriott hospitality experience from the moment you enter the premises till you leave. The hotel lives up to the name of strong international brand such as Marriott International. Hands down "The Best Hotel in Nepal"

We have stayed at a few hotels in Kathmandu. This was on the top of the list of best experiences ever. The room was spotless with great amenities as well as a beautiful mountain view. What made our stay an unforgettable one was the amazing staff at the Thamel Kitchen who all went above and beyond to make our visit welcoming which completely exceeded our expectations! We’d like to thank particularly Laxmi, Taeyan, Naresh, Nikhil and Manish for their exceptional hospitality and thoughtfulness! The birthday surprise was incredibly impressive, touching and very much appreciated! We did have a wonderful and memorable stay this time and will definitely come back again! Thank you very much!!

Had Pleasant stay. Caring for customers at its most. Food varieties at its best related to the customers came from. South indian dishes at its best. Caring customers according to their taste is highly appreciate able. Thanks for their kind hospitality and stays in our memory.

If you are wondering if you should book this hotel, wonder no more. Without a doubt, this stay has been my best experience in over 2 decades of travel.  This hotel, building and services, was beyond my wildest expectations.  Each staff provided excellent service and treated us like family.  The staff engage in authentic and genuine conversations.  While the hotel itself is immaculately clean, modern, and kept in overall great shape, it’s the staff that made the hotel truly  magnificent. After 8 days, we now have new Facebook friends and memories of meeting these kind souls and hearing about their lives and family.  They do this all while providing 5 star service.  So, what are you waiting for?  Stop looking at the reviews and book your stay at the Marriott. You will not be disappointed!

I was amazed at what a top notch hotel this is! The most endearing feature is the absolutely fabulous team in every department that churn out pristine world class hospitality exuding care and warmth. My compliments to every team member and kudos to GM - Vishal Mehra for the leadership and motivation that reflects whatever one may be indulging at Marriott Kathmandu!The product itself is wonderful, contemporary luxury with well laid out rooms and other facilities. F&B is a delight with multiple choices from fine to casual dining.

This is my second time staying at this hotel and the service is consistently excellent. The rooms are large and very clean. The gym, pool, lounge and restaurants are all top notch.  The reception, lounge, restaurant and housekeeping staff are all friendly, warm and very efficient. Over a three day stay I visited the spa twice. Indira gave me the me wonderfully relaxing facial and massage. The location is great. It's a 15 minute walk to Thamel.  Overall, this hotel and its restaurants and spa are a great value for money. I loved every minute of my stay and look forward to staying here again, hopefully soon.

Today we have  program at bagmati hall in 1st july 2023 .Events  was smooth by the helpful staff of marriott . service & food was really amazing . These all sucess happens by the help of the our Food & beverage incharge mr.prakash raj . Thank you marriott team for excellent service . See you again

We had a event on 24th feb, 2024 at bagmati ball room hall which was organized by PCOS society of Nepal. We had a great experience there. The event management team along with the service and hospitality was magnificent.Bishal and Prakash raj was very helplful and kind.

Unisha serviced as with excellence along with her manager Subash, Vishal and Alwin . Food excellent and served hot. Loved the live flute being played while we eat created fabulous environment. Thanks team Kathmandu Marriott was your services.

If you are traveling to Kathmandu, this Marriott is the place for you. The concierge’s are five-star the food is five-star. The hotel is five star all of the staff are so welcoming and most importantly. Ms. Riju Maharjan gives the best hospitality and assures all your needs are taken care of. For this being my first time in Kathmandu, I am so glad I chose this hotel. Thank you all for doing such a great job! Stay blessed.

Eva delivered an incredible fitness massage. I've received hundreds of massages during the last 10 years, and I can say for sure that her technique and expertise were tremendous.Highly recommend Eva for everyone that is looking to balance and relax their bodies.

We are family want there for Friday dinner.It was second time .Last time we have great experience about food variety and  nice hospitality. Excellent service. Very kind and always helpful staff. The rooms are very clean and nice. The lounge on the 10th floor is a wonderful experience with great views and tasteful  snacks and deserts. The hotel is a great place to stay.  The Thamé restaurant on the main floor is also great.

We had a wonderful holiday here. The staff in the M+ club provided us with meticulous service especially Mr.Moj. He is a gentleman , and he always know what we needs. The food here is very fresh and delicious, not only local characteristics but also Chinese flavors. The gym here is very cool.  I will recommend it to my friends and family.

On our departure flight day, Dasain celebration, staff told us only buffett was available but kindly helped us  and allowed a la carte menu. Nikhil our waiter shared super kind courtesy as paneer tikka and Happy Dasain desserts.  We felt taken care of as Nikhil and all staff extended Dasain to us visitors.  Nepal has great people. Danyavada- Thanks! PS and yes food was delicious, clean, quick.

Best hotel with best staff in the city Kathmandu. I stayed with my family for 3 days and I loved my stay. From pre arrival to post departure the experience was wonderful. I must thank the head of Saes & Marketing Mr. Varun kamra for his hospitality and advice about the places to visit in Kathmandu. Also the food served is best in this city. The food items you will get in marriott Kathmandu you will kind in very selective outlets.I highly recommend this hotel to traveler's looking for a great hotel in Kathmandu.

The service are splendid, all the staffs attitude are very warmth.Our event in the hotel was attended by associate called Subash to meet all of our needs, and he spoiled us all the way. The food was great and the facility are consider complete. Keep up the good work!

For a fair price, our group reserved a meeting room together with breakfast and lunch for our office work. The room was clean, spacious, and the surroundings were quiet, making it ideal for working.  Also, the cuisine was quite excellent here. We appreciate Mr. Ashish's hospitality, and we thank him for managing our necessities.

The services of the hotel is really good. The event incharge Ms. Supriya Katuwal is very helpful and facilitates very well for overall coordination of the program. The food served is also excellent specially the white sauce pasta is really good.

Nepal is known for its world class hospitality but the staff at the Marriott hotel in Kathmandu exceeds any discerning traveler’s highest expectations.  Moj and his top notch team in the M club are truly the best of the best.  So warm and friendly, with tips for tourist activities as well as serving up top flight drinks and food.  Also want to give a shout out to the 1st floor restaurant servers and chefs.  They are first rate!  And the staff at the front desk are also amazing.  I have a 4 month stay here and everyone here makes me feel like I’m part of the family.  Highly recommend this hotel for both and long term stays.  Truly an exceptional experience.  Best of the best!!!

Excellent service and facilities. Lots of varieties in Breakfast and lunch with great taste. Very good property for small celebration and family functions with clean and maintained facilities. Room size are very large and beautifully designed

The food and the service of marriott is just overwhelming.Thanks to Mr. Bijay chef for hosting us so well. Our stay there was amazing during Christmas. We had a quality time. The most important thing was the behaviour of the staffs was very professional and welcoming. The club room was very standard and clean. I would crave for the food of Marriott again and again. The team was very excelling prateema, romi, ishan. Thank you Marriott!!

I continue to be impressed by the exceptional service provided by the team at the spa and fitness centre. Each team member consistently delivers outstanding services, ensuring a wonderful experience every visit. The instructor Prem Gurung particularly noteworthy, as he actively supports me in achieving my fitness goals. They understand my needs and consistently provide tailored guidance and encouragement. Overall, I am delighted with the wonderful service offered here.

Kathmandu Marriott is right up on my list of favourites and I can never think of staying anywhere else when in Kathmandu.  A lovely hotel with spacious, cozy, well cleaned rooms and breakfast is plentiful. Staff are some of the best I have ever come across and offer the best of Nepalese hospitality. Its my home away from home.

My recent event attend at the Marriott Hotel in Nepal for the NCLEX Hub event deserves a solid 5/5 rating. The event management was top-notch, but what truly stood out was Mr. Santosh's exceptional hospitality. His warm and personalized approach added a special touch to the experience. Mr. Santosh went above and beyond, ensuring our comfort and satisfaction. His dedication and professionalism exemplified the high standards of Marriott. I highly recommend this hotel for its outstanding service and the genuine care shown by individuals like Mr. Santosh, making the stay truly memorable.

I have engaged in the organization of the event at this hotel recently. Being at the core of capital city, commuting is very easy. Provided hospitality was very good with delicious food and attentive staff. I was impressed with the efforts of Mr. Santosh in Banquet management, Ms. Punam and Ms. Alina in event management and all other associated staffs of the hotel. Last but not the least, dinner at Tahina restaurant with beautiful night views of the city was amazing.

My friend prateema suggested me this place, and I'm glad she did. I must say it was such a great and pleasant stay. Thank you. People looking for a hotel in Kathmandu can visit this place for a number of reason like view, food and ambiance.

This Marriott sets the standard for service.   While the hotel is modern, extremely clean, and very comfortable, the people make the difference.   I had the opportunity to spend almost a week at this property and visited the executive lounge daily.  The service was phenomenal and offerings were better than most comparable lounges.  I want to recognize Bijaya, the manager who provides friendly and attentive service, but has also put together a phenomenal team.  I also want to specifically mention Prajwal who took the time to give me a visual tour of Kathmandu from the windows of the lounge the first morning of my trip.  I felt like I knew the city after talking to him for 20 minutes.  The pride in his job and his country were evident and his optimism shown through clearly.  He did an outstanding job throughout!  Thank you!

I stayed 4 nights for a work trip. As a platinum elite member, I was upgraded to a club room. The room was comfortable, clean and quiet despite it being the start of the tourist peak season. The service was also thoughtful and attentive, especially at the M Club lounge.

Our stay at Hotel Marriott , Kathmandu is since 12th of July. The Hospitality of the staff is amazingly good specially Ms Kusha and Ms Megha who has a exceptional positivity in their attitude. She came forward to take extra care to avoid any inconvenience. A 5star rating to these girls.

Marriott Kathmandu is attentive, expedient, and high-quality. Food is phenomenal, service is unrivaled, amenities are great. Would like to mention Laxmi specifically, who continuously ensured our satisfaction throughout the duration of our stay.

Salute to hotel management. You demonstrated the real meaning of hospitality. All your staff are great, hospitable and courteous. They have been a great host all along. Starting with the reception staff, restaurant staff and specially the conference room staff. Subash had served us all four days of the training and we felt as if we were at home.Thank you for everything. I will definitely recommend your hotel as one of the best hotels I have stayed in.. if not the Best ever!!

We are ending a week-long stay, sadly. In over 80 countries, staying in many Marriotts, this is our favorite. From a SNAFU in our reservation (self-inflicted) being erased by Magagement, to every other detail, our stay has been superb. The service here has been spectacular in the Business (M) Lounge, morning and night The genuine attentiveness and care have amazed this older, well-seasoned couple. Special thanks to Bijaya, Prajwal, Sonic, Amup, Asmita and Manish. Apology to anyone we missed. We hope to return.

This hotel offers an excellent gym, which is well maintained, modern and clean. You will find a lot of different machines and all other equipment you would need for a decent workout. But what makes this hotel gym special is Mr. Prem, the instructor at the gym, who is a very professional and motivated trainer. He is always keen to improve your workout and happy to help. Thank you for your support! Also the spa facilities are very nice, especially after a long day at work or a busy day in the city.

Did the spa package with my friend. Overall service was excellent, however, the temperature of the jacuzzi could have been higher. The service and the welcoming atmosphere from the staff members were no doubt the best in town. However,  I've noticed this in both of the  Marriotts in Kathmandu, both Aloft and the Naxal one,  there was a strong sewage smell around  the jacuzzi and sauna area for Naxal one and lobby toilet area for Aloft one. This has nothing to do with the service provided by the staff members but Marriott's infrastructure itself. Overall brilliant service! Hope they look into this issue.

Overall, I highly recommend Marriott hotels to anyone looking for a top-quality hotel experience. Their commitment to service and guest satisfaction is truly exceptional, and I have no doubt that you will thoroughly enjoy your stay at any Marriott hotel. specially hospitality of ms.Supriya Katuwal was very good.

The staff showed what it means to care for every detail of our stay. The restaurant food and service were exceptional. The room was spotless. Great views from the expansive mountain-view windows, even if there were clouds in the distance that sometimes prevented mountain views. will be back.

Good location. There are shops next to Marriott, convenient to get supplies or snacks. There are also some good eating places within walking distance.It's walking distance to Durba Marg and Thamel is a bit further, but walking along the road is quite dusty.Staff at Marriott are great, especially the breakfast staff. After a couple of days they remember your preference which makes the experience more personal.

My wife and I have stayed at many properties worldwide, Kathmandu Marriott Hotel ranks one of the best - definitely a 5-star experience for us! The hotel has several fantastic restaurants, excellent workout and spa facilities, modern and comfortable rooms. Also for us, what makes the Marriott Hotel the best place to stay in Kathmandu is their INCREDIBLE STAFF.  The Marriott staff’s customer service is top notch, nothing is over looked -  they make you feel at home.  We are definitely a huge fan of the Kathmandu Marriott Hotel and will definitely our choice hotel when we return to Nepal. I spent six nights here for a business trip, and helped to run a four-day workshop in the hotel. I cannot recommend it highly enough. The facilities were excellent, which, made the whole trip incredibly manageable. The wonderful staff were the highlight. Everyone we met was friendly, attentive and incredibly down to earth - particularly during breakfast. I am so grateful for their care and attention.  Thank you very much.

It was a wonderful stay experience and the services provided were very good. The staff were all very helpful, and all of the arrangements were perfect.The assistance of Romi, Nikhil, and Manish Karki was really appreciable throughout the event.RegardsProf.G Bajwa( ATMC)

The service are pretty good. The employee in serving area are very friendly and attentive and foods are very nice. The environment and the area where conference happened is pretty well organized. Timely delivery of required items were there.

My wife and I stayed at the Kathmandu Marriot from 19 to 24 March 2023. We were very happy with how we were treated throughout our stay. However the best part of our stay were the staff. The location, the stuff, the service, the food, the spa everyone of them was absolutely amazing. We finish two weeks of trekking up in the mountains and we had a soft landing at the Marriott hotel. We couldn’t ask for more and we had a very great time.

We absolutely loved our stay at Kathmandu Marriott. The 10th floor lounge is very special and so is the Asian restaurant Edamame. The hospitality of the staff and their warmth is very special. If you are coming to Kathmandu then the only hotel to stay is Marriott.

This hotel is amazing. We stayed here roughly 9 days over our 4 week stay in Nepal. This place made us feel like its home away from home. The team here goes above and beyond. After completing our Everest Base Camp Trek, I had to go to the hospital. They helped us arrange transportation to the hospital and then got us everything we needed when I got home from the hospital. The staff was superb. They helped teach us Nepali and took care of us so much. We were initially at another hotel and hated it. We ventured out of our original hotel to the Marriott in search of a better place to stay and they lived up to our expectations. Our bartender Shah Rym was incredible and so patient with us while teaching us Nepali. He helped us learn over 200 words. He is now a chef and is incredible. I would also like to give a shoutout to Rashmi. She made us feel so welcome and deserves a raise with how helpful she was. I also want to give a shoutout to Raj at the front desk, she went above and beyond and is the reason we decided to switch hotels. She deserves to be running the front desk. She won our business as soon as we stepped in the lobby. This made our vacation and is the best decision we made.

We stayed here for 2 nights at the property. The room had a really nice view overlooking the city. The front office team were diligent and gave all the needed information about the hotel during the check in which was helpful. The club lounge staff were all lovely. Subash Duty Manager from Front Office was very kind together with his team. The second night we were given a free upgrade to suite which was cherry on top.   I enjoyed the recreation facilities available there.

Our experience here was OUTSTANDING! The facilities were fantastic- spotless, new,etc. The gym was best I have seen recently at a hotel abroad or in the US, the spa was amazing (jacuzzi, steam, dry sauna) and the M club Lounge was fantastic! The personalized attention you receive here from the staff is beyond belief…A special shout out to Moj, Prajwal, Asmita, Manish, Anup and Suraj for your wonderful hospitality. Truly a FIVE STAR experience!

Staying at Marriott Kathmandu was truly a luxurious experience. The hotel's elegant design, impeccable service, and attention to detail exceeded my expectations. The rooms were spacious, well-appointed, and offered stunning views of the city. The staff specially Santosh Dhungana was very friendly and comfortable with us.

Well satisfied with the service and arrangements. Flexibility is something to be cherished in the last hour. Santosh, Subash, Rohit and  Umesh were excellent being a part of the event's success. The food presentation was good, the selection was nice along with suggestions from Punam. Felt a bit high concentration on sweets of higher sugar. Helpful staff, understanding behavior is very flexible .... Food tastes 9. 55/10, please look into the tea break combination. Masala tea to be improved though I am a coffee person.Over all satisfied with 3.85 GPA.

Recently I had attended one of the best  hotel Marriott naxal. Hotel experience was mind blowing, food was excellent and services was too good . I had met staff whose name was prakash raj adhikari , I love his Interaction and communication skills , the way he deal with client.

Excellent service, outstanding experience I can observe your future is bright Mr prakash raj in this field, Nice experience i have ever had, I have gone to many places but i can see Marriott hotel is one of the finest place to conduct events and seminars i have ever experienced in my entire life.Good Job all staff members, I loved your service and all. Thank You !

It was a very pleasant and fun experience at the hotel. The staff was extremely friendly and went out of the way to take care of our group, especially the children. Will highly recommend the hotel for a great property, friendly staff & overall great hospitality.

Symbol  of hospitality is this hotel .The staff makes a great difference The smile , and attitude to made us feel like home .Great breakfast with v v good server .Cannot expect better staff specially Like “Ashmita “ in reception and server “birat “ and  “shaurabh “  .Hotel should give free shuttle to thamel toMake guest life easier “Front baggage handling should improve  as they don’t notify and handle properly . Suggest welcome fruits in the room .If we ever come back , this is the hotel to stay .

Is Kathmandu the most prosperous city you have visited ? Is it a city with the best skyline in the world?The answer to all these questions are a NO.Then what is it about Nepal  that charms someone atleast me .Its the people, their humility, the sense of truthness that still prevails among the people in this competitive world , the bright smiles and the selfless attitude of people af large.Kathmandu Mariott is a perfect example of all these qualities put into one. We were given a very personal farewell and our needs were taken care off. Special Mention to Mr. Bibekji at the concierge. He took special care of us and helped create a lasting impression on Nepal in our hearts and our minds.

"I wanted to express my deepest gratitude to Prateema for recommending the Marriott hotel to me. My stay was truly delightful and exceeded all of my expectations. The rooms were comfortable and inviting, and the view from my room was breathtaking. But most of all, I was blown away by the exceptional hospitality and service provided by the hotel staff. They made me feel right at home and went above and beyond to make my stay as enjoyable as possible. Thank you, Marriott, for a truly memorable experience."

Amazing trip to Kathmandu..With pure support and kindness from team Marriott (Varun Kamra, bibek, Mrinal and many more) made our trip very joyfull and comfortable.We stayed at Fairfield and Marriott bonvoy both and both hotels were fantastic. hotel staffs were so polite and food was so delicious.Over all Marriott made our trip memorable

Kathmandu Marriott is an outsmarting hotel, 30min from airport and 15 walk from Thamel.  Customer service was excellent, albeit a bit slow. The rooms were large and clean, and the bathrooms also large and clean. Absolutely to Marriott standard. No concerns, will return. The Nims climbing gear store onsite was a pleasant surprise.

Supriya was a very good lady with us.All of our colleagues feels good cause his hospatility. We need to support these imazing women.Thanks supriya from our heartWe suppose we will come back to Kathmandu again cause of her flexibility with us and reflecting a good culture to Nepal

We had event of The world Bank at koshi hall on 17 th february 2023 . He was always ready to tackle with the problem , knows sense of urgency , customer satisfaction and many more qualities . Thank you so much prakash jee , appreciate your service .

People are the best especially subash.They're extremely helpful, kind and hospitable. They go above and beyond to please you and provide what need before even asking. They provided the best service ever over the course of the four days training that we was held there. Also the M lounge people are the best and amazing

We stayed 4 nights. The hotel was well designed, beautifully decorated and had really good service. There were a good range of restaurants in house for hosting business meetings and meals. The location was also very convenient, about 15min to the airport. As a Bonvoy platinum member, I was upgraded to a junior suite which was well laid out and spacious. My only complaint is the lack of a proper work desk. But maybe most visitors don't come for work...

My first time to Kathmandu and it was highly recommended by a booking agent bro stay at this hotel.  They provide arrival and departure pick up for free which was amazing. The hotel are so warm during a cold weather . It was warm by the staffs that works there . From the front desk to all the service crews at the breakfast area, the lounge and the Tim sum restaurant. It was a pleasure to dine in all the restaurant in this hotel . We love the gym room too. Of course the view from the room was extremely beautiful to view the mountains from the hotel room. Thanks for taking care of us during our stay on 23rd-28rd Oct ! From room 717 & 715 ! We will definitely be back next year !

Amazing hospitality! They even noticed it was my birthday (without us mentioning it) and made sure to help me celebrate it at breakfast. Very comfortable beds with lots of pillows. The upstairs bar was a peaceful escape from the bustling streets. It was a great way to start (and end) our trek in Nepal!

Special thanks to Ms. Chhejan at front dest for quick and early checkin. She was clear with her communication and very forthcoming for any help which  was requested.Ask for Mr. Ghan Lal for any quick help you might require from housekeeping. Very helpful.Overall a brilliant experience.

Marriott is not only a place of hospitality, it's a place of creativity too. I was there during my Christmas morning. The team was very welcoming and supportive. I was greeted by Mr. Pemba when I arrived. He hosted me well. I had a lovely Christmas breakfast. The idea of recycling the bottles into Christmas tree was amazing. Miss prateema, who is a marketing intern there recommended me about the place I loved it. Would love to come there again!

The Mariott is a really excellent hotel, with the most wonderful staff. The concierge Prem is helpful, polite and highly professional, just perfect. Also the waiters and managers at Thamil Restaurant are very professional and very nice. Best place to stay in Kathmandu. Best place I stayed ever. Rooms well designed. Everything sooo perfect.

This is one of the nicest Marriott’s I have stayed in anywhere. It is very modern, impeccably clean and loaded with amenities. We made good use of the beautiful pool, well equipped gym and excellent spa. The massage therapists were very good, as well. What impressed us most was the friendliness and professionalism of the staff. There are plenty of staff on hand to be attentive and helpful. Everyone meets you with a smile and willingness to serve and make sure you’re comfortable. If you’re traveling to Kathmandu this is the place to stay.

We stayed here for 4 nights.  It’s a beautiful oasis in the middle of this crazy city! You can walk to Thamil, where all tourists hang with tons of restaurants and shops, massage spas. Go to Tranquility Spa for one of the best massages ever. Breakfast is magnificent! Like 5 stations of Asian, Nepali, and continental food. They have the best pastry chef also. Chocolate croissant is amazing. Staff is so well trained and so kinds. We are elite members and the 10th floor club lounge is one of the best I have experienced. Staff is amazing. Everyone of them. Ask about anything, shopping, where to visit, and where things are since you have a view of the whole city to get the lay of the land. Night time Happy Hour and dinner buffets are excellent. We also used fitness center. Fully equipped.  Can’t say enough great things to say about our stay here except to say stay here.

Stayed for 2 days along with Family, Starting from Entrance, Front office, rooms and view from room Window, Food, Sauna, everything was excellent. On Final day in Buffet Breakfast, staff created a special moment for us by providing special sweets. Thanks a lot for creating beautiful memories of Nepal through you.

WOW what a amazing event that was. I cant stop my self to post a genuine review , this was the 3rd time we visited at Marriott with our business partner for the Visa event at Bagmati hall. Everytime this Hotel stunned us by their amazing staff , the way they put so much efforts to make the event unique . Everytime the event is so wonderful this time i also met with one of the finest staff Mr Prakash Raj Adhakari for this amazing event. He never disappointed by his amazing talent. He proved that he has good skills to organize and make the event as smooth as possible. I am really thinking forward to hand over  a event in future to Mr Prakash Raj sir.

At the event of ecan, I found Events hall & food was excellent, staff was best . Thank you entire Kathmandu Marriott team for amazing service, appreciated 🙏🙏

It was amazing staying at the property. The Japanese food was just amazing. At the reception Mr.  Vishal Mahat and miss . Ayusha was great personified person and very helpful during checkin process. I thank all the staff members at Marriot Kathmandu and wish them all luck for future.

We had event of USEF at bagmati ballroom on 3rd February.Everything went smoothly by the help of our young, energetic and professional host mr.prakash Raj ji. I would like to say thank you for everything you manage for these event . Thank you marriott team !!

The hotel is beautifully designed. Marriott had given me one of the best dining experience.  The staffs service is very nice. They all make sure everything is going well for their guest. The restaurents have multiple choices of food. I love to eat sweets and i enjoyed varieties of sweets which made my day. Rojen in the lobby restaurent made sure we were well take care and offered us ice cream. I would like to thank everyone and i will soon come back.

We had a grand seminar on 17th feb 2024 organized by Nclex Nepal pvt ltd.It was hard to manage without proper support from hotel teams But we find Mr Prakash Raj and his team very supportive and friendly which eventually lead to the grand success of our Event. We really appreciate from the entire team.

My overall experience with the Mwellness team was excellent. Their commitment to quality service and customer satisfaction is evident, and I would highly recommend them to anyone seeking wellness solutions. Thank you team for always providing dynamic services in all aspects.

hospitality was really awesome. i love how they treat their guest and special thanks to dikshya from thamel kitchen who showed us the whole thing around there. she was really good. Thanks kathmandu marriott for making our memorable

We had a great time at Marriott Kathmandu, the hospitality was top class. My interaction with Prakash Raj from Banquets and Events was amazing and he has a great sense to guest service and satisfaction !! All the best for upcoming days to him !!

Marriott Hotel belongs to Top Label. The environment here is calm and clean. The seminar hall space is a bit amazing. I found everything perfect until the service.It is in the near distance. I want to give this hotel and their staff the highest possible rating. The location is excellent, with beautiful views of the city. Food was fantastic. The room was excellent and extremely clean. Honestly, don't look at the price, just treat yourself. The people are great, and the property is top class.

good and positive vibes...friendly,respectful,good manner staff. The food was superb.and the ambience was perfect. Especially Bishal was very helpful & polite.He was so humble as i talk with him & i got to know he is really respectful person and the way he treated us is so nice.Thanks Mr.Bishal.😀😀

One of the best hotel in capital . Hotel  offers Pleasant and clean environment  to guests and secure about their safety also . Staffs  of this Hotel are so much professional  specially Sharad, Romi, Susmita, Rina, Pujan, laxmi , Rashmj, manish ,Alina, kirani , Elina  are the best in their job they are always ready for providing hotel  service on demand with lovely smile 😃

I had a wonderful stay at the Kathmandu Marriot. The staff were super friendly and very helpful.  The hotel is very clean, the breakfast is amazing, and the concierge staff are all professional and go out of their way to help you with your plans. The hotel is well located, close to shopping and dining options as well as tourist attractions.  I highly recommend the hotel for business travelers, and for those coming for a short stay in Kathmandu.

I felt very good with marriott to conduct seminars, symposium and workshops. Well arrangement, specifically good hospitality with Mr. Prakashraj. Power point projector, cleanliness are the best part here.

The club floor team led by Bijaya made our stay wonderful. The junior suite is perfect for a couple - spacious, great view and loaded with amenities. The club lounge on the 10th floor is the main attraction with a nice bar, great canapés (that changes everyday) and wonderful staff. Raksi bar is wonderful but unfortunately I didn’t get to spend too much time there. Defiantly coming back again. One of the best hotels, perhaps even the best,  in Kathmandu.

First class hotel. Service above and beyond across the board. Friendly and attentive. Special call out to the housekeeping staff, and to my new friends in the restaurants and lounge areas, especially Sandip in the main restaurant, and Prajwal in the lounge. Everyone was exceptional service professionals!

I stayed here for my short business trip in Nepal. Everything was perfect; room layout, amenities, and especially staff here are very helpful and service mind.I am waiting for my flight to go back at 23.30PM and Moj took care of me at Mclub to ensure I had everything I need. Thank you so much… This hotel will always be my first choice for business trip at Kathmandu.

We recently stayed at the Marriott hotel in Kathmandu. It is a beautiful hotel with an excellent location  at the city center, extremely clean & comfortable. We recently stayed twice at the Marriott Kathmandu and found it to be beautifully designed and furnished and highly comfortable.  The rooms are large and well designed and done with high taste.  The restaurants are very good as is the breakfast  (not always included in room price).  But the hotel lacks the local charm and historical perspective of hotels like Dwarikas.HIGHS-Beautiful room with comfortable bed and pillows-Great rainfall shower-Amazing WIFI - best we found out of the 9 hotels in Nepals we stayed at on this trip-Huge windows and good to great views-Big TV with good choices-Lots of outlets conveniently placed-Room very soundproof from outside and inside-Excellent food at both restaurants but had service hiccup in EdamameLOWS-Staff is very efficient and friendly BUT interactions are very robotic.  We were greeted over and over and over within a short period of time by the same questions - "Is this your first time in Nepal?", ""where are you from?" , and "how is your _____".  At breakfast once we were asked how our meal was 9 times in ten minutes - so often we could hardly eat.  And when my wife answered that she had been in Nepal 30 times and we had a non profit supporting an orphanage the employees just stared and turned away with this repeated four other times.  The staff is good and efficient and friendly but all engagements are very shallow and not very authentic - if you provide an unexpected response.

We spent a week at the Marriott Kathmandu during Christmas/NYE.Everything has been truly amazing while staying there.Pros:-a real 5 stars property by European Standards, the hotel is brand new and everything is working perfectly well.-very good centralized heating system, which most of other hotels do NOT have in Nepal. Believe me, in winter when it's zero degrees celsius outside, this is a VERY important point.-fantastic location, just far enough from chaotic Thamel, but only a 15 minutes walk to downtown. You can easily reach all major attractions with a short taxi ride.-very good soundproofing in the whole hotel, we especially LOVED to return in our room after a day of sightseeing in crazy Kathmandu, we thought that the silence in our room was extremely refreshing! We slept like babies.-very comfortable beds, which is extremely well thought out by the Marriott property.-huge shower in each room, there is even a small bench inside the shower where you can sit and relax while showering.-TOP cleanliness, this hotel has been the cleanest place we've found in our 2 weeks stay in Nepal, cleanliness is top notch.-AMAZING staff, we have travelled to more than 50 countries, and these guys are really amazing, always smiling and ready to help you, thank you everybody for your hard work!-a fantastic GM, Monsieur Jean-Louis Ripoche, who takes great care of everything and has done a truly incredible work in order to elevate this property to EU/US Standards. The staff has asked many times the Management for our special requests, and the answers were always extremely satisfactory and pleasant.-really good buffets, very high Hygiene Standards, with whatever choice you can ask, we especially liked the fact that you can order almost anything yo want, you just have to ask to the waiter who will forward your order to the Chefs, et voila! The made-to-order Butter Naan and MoMos are not to be missed!To conclude, I have to say that we have visited the other "5 stars" properties in Kathmandu, but none of them was of the Marriott's standard. We were really glad to have chosen the Marriott, and we would not stay anywhere else if we go back to KTM.Thank you so much for your service and for having made our stay truly memorable!

Get a drink and snacks on the deck at sunset for a incredible experience. Service:The staff is courteous and very responsive! They try to accommodate any and all requests. I went to Marriott Kathmandu in December 2023 during the Christmas holiday and stayed a total of four nights. My interaction started with Robin Maharjan when I was arranging my airport transportation five days before arriving. I called and he emailed me a confirmation. He was very professional. I noticed at the bottom of the email it had a link that said “Christmas and New Year’s extravaganza” so I reached out to the festivity desk for more information. Marriott Kathmandu had a variety of holiday packages that they were offering for their festive season including both New Year and Christmas.  They had dinners and brunch that included a mocktail, live music, caroling, and Santa Claus. I had the pleasure of getting the information for festive packages from Anjina. I reached out to her from whatsapp and sent over the brochure that listed everything in detail for 24-25 and 31 Dec. Anjina was very patient with me and answered all my questions and concerns. I requested a copy of the menu for a restaurant I was interested in reserving. She sent it and I even requested a special request for the restaurant that she accommodated me with. Thank you for sharing details and be professional with me Anjina. We decided to eat at Edamame on Christmas Eve, which was listed as one of their festive packages. Edamame offered an eight course meal at the Asian restaurant located directly in the Marriott Kathmandu hotel. They even had an additional drink package that you opt in on. I made reservations for two and one drink package for myself.  From the time we walked in Edamame restaurant we were treated with the best customer service. Our waiter was a nice gentleman named Niroj. He explained every meal that was brought to our table and was so helpful with us deciding on what to eat. All of the food was made fresh and was hot. It was our anniversary and we had some flowers and a happy anniversary cake too. Thank you to the entire Edamame staff including the host at the front door of restaurant, chefs, and Niroj for making our night special and memorable. I highly recommend this restaurant as it exceeded our expectations. They even had live music and a holiday mocktail with our meal. We also ate at two other restaurants in Marriott Kathmandu including Thamel Kitchen for breakfast each morning and once for lunch. The breakfast had a variety of food, which catered to everyone’s taste including vegan, vegetarian, pescatarian, and etc. For lunch, I had a salad, buffalo burger, fries, and water. They gave us veggies, some type of green sauce, with some bread before my meal came out. It was made fresh and came out quickly. The other restaurant we ate at was called Tahina Terrace and it offers outdoor seating with views of the city. The service was fast. The servers were helpful and professional. I ordered hummus, salad, and cocktail. This hotel was beautifully decorated with Christmas decorations including the lobby, main entrance, and throughout the restaurants in the hotel.  When I checked in, the staff was very helpful and her name is Unisha. She answered all of my questions and concerns. I was also helped by Prazena as she arranged my airport transportation to be taken back to the airport the next morning. We left Nepal at 12am from the hotel and I requested a packed breakfast to take with us and Prazena arranged it. She also helped with things to do at night in the city. Overall, my stay at Marriott Kathmandu was fantastic and I would definitely come back to this hotel again. Next door is a casino that is attached to the hotel but I never had a chance to go inside of it. I highly recommend this hotel if you are looking for a safe place to stay. They offer many restaurants, pool, gym, lounge, and more! You will not be disappointed. We miss Nepal and thank you for making our stay memorable!

Our room was beautifully furnished and very comfortable with wonderful views over the sprawling city.We also appreciated using the hotel's car service to the airport--more expensive than a taxi, but the comfort and convenience made it worth it. 首先非常感謝M club經理Bijaya以及Sujan的超乎水準的服務，她們會記住客人的名字，更重要的是她們會仔細關心我們的需要，並盡力的去達成要求，即使超過她們的工作職責。就在我們過中國新年的除夕夜，她們知道年夜飯對中國人來說是很重要的，所以雖然酒廊的歡樂時光招待到晚上8點就收餐了，但是她還是等到最後一刻我們的出現，並且請廚師做出我們想吃的餐點。因為經理知道她很難在客人重要的日子裏，對客人說不。她們是發自內心的真誠服務。我會推薦Marriott酒店，如果你想住在尼泊爾的話。同時那一天，我們也遇到比利時的王子與公主入住這家酒店，當然她們有當地的警察隨車保護進來的。一樓餐廳也有非常大的佛陀唐卡可以欣賞。

Brand new, and top end hotels - the VERY highest standards. WHAT a joy to stay in.  We travel an awful lot - over 150 countries, in higher standard hotels. I am not kidding, there would not be a cleaner, better Marriott or Hilton anywhere globally.  Not in the USA or Europe.  Only completed 8 months earlier, so all shiny and new and sparking.  And converted to $US, VERY affordable room rates. Very friendly check-in agent Kumar, who sorted out a few things the lazy Bonvoy desk had not bothered to address, despite emails to them many days earlier.  They are hopeless - they responded as we checked out of our 3 night stay!   Starwood Guest were 100 times more responsive. Got a lovely spacious Deluxe room 717 - absolute city and mountain views. Hotel has a nice Nepal décor slant - not over the top, but evident and such a smarter move than the usual box Marriotts that you’d find in Germany or USA etc.   A huge 5 ton bronze temple bell hanging from ceiling in check-in area, and ancient and authentic and intricate wooden house windows as wall decorations etc.  Even the exterior shape is a little irregular at top – a nod to Nepalese traditional style. Arrived for New Years Eve.  Hotel had a very pricey “Mandatory” dinner that cost us $A200 for two, after the terrible taxes, with a 75% full glass of Bubbly each - cost in Sydney would literally be less than that.  It was Hotel’s first NYE. Lots of food and staff, and seemed to work well, but the lack of any fireworks or real fuss at midnight, was a failing they might look at?  Do book a room with ‘’M’’ Club lounge access - worth the extra.  STUNNING 180 degrees solid glass mountain views from the top floor.  See photo attached.  Have never visited a hotel lounge with a more stunning view, and have been in 100s.  Drinks and substantial nibbles and desserts 5pm-8pm.  There were for instance 3 or 4 white wine choices - near all lounges have a house red and white, and that is the choice. Lounge Manger there is Bijaya, a Nepalese lady who it appears had worked at Marriots in Qatar and Dubai etc.  Very smooth and friendly and professional,  and other staff were also great - indeed ALL Hotel staff were always friendly and smiling. General Manager, Jean Louis Ripoche was discreetly working the room one evening, having brief chats with guests - a nice touch.  Universally good staff in Hotels reflect strong training and wise selection, and in my experience this all sheets back to the GM. We were there for a special occasion, and staff picked up on that and arranged some thoughtful things to recognise that - very classy. We stayed at 3 Hiltons in the past week in India.  Lounges in all 3 were like McDonalds playgrounds. FULL of screeching kids, with parents and staff who did not care.  Did not see a child of any age here in our visits - I am sure they get them but sure nice NOT be in a child care zoo. Internal room fittings all top end … BEST in-room safe I’ve ever seen - code pad on TOP, large than usual and LED lights inside - all common sense but have not seen these before.  TV a dream to work in 5 seconds - JOY!   We often spend 10 minutes wresting with them. Breakfast is enormous choice and top quality.  Just as strong in Western as in Nepal/Indian. Great staff too. Nepal is a crazy place out on the streets - mad traffic and chaos and confusion - to escape all that insanity after a day or touring, into the superb tranquil room and the wonderful lounge for a quality wine was a true joy to look forward to, trust me!A top stay - FAR more enjoyable than I’d have ever imagined.  Almost brand new, with workmanship and fine details all done perfectly - not usual in countries like this.  Book it while it stays shiny and new!  Ten out of Ten.

The Thamel restaurant, both menu items and buffet for breakfast and dinner were quite good. And need to call out Srijana - our server, as excellent. We took time to enjoy the spa as well. We stayed 6 nights in executive suite with M club access.Reception 5/5Efficient and friendly , service is excellent.Housekeeping 5/5Everyday the housekeeping was perfect and immaculate. The hotel only opened 4 years ago, so everything is very new, luxurious, and clean.As a Marriott Platinum, and as I requested, we were kindly upgraded to a Club Level room on the 9th floor (10 floors total). We had a Mountain View, but because of the haze/dust/smog, we were unable to see the mountains from our room (see photo). But, on our last evening at dusk, it cleared, and we got a glimpse of the snow-capped Himalayas from a Thamel street.Our room was spacious, very clean, and comfortable.The Executive Lounge had snacks and drinks between 6 and 8 pm, and deserts after. During this time, it was often crowded and noisy with fellow Americans.The service throughout was exceptional, including at the front desk and lobby, Executive Lounge, breakfast, housekeeping. The front desk graciously called rides for us every morning with a Nepal ride app (Nepal phone number needed).The breakfast had great variety, with noodle, omelette, and dosa/paratha stations. It was very good, but got a bit repetitive after 5 days (and 11 days in India). It was quiet and never crowded.About a month before our stay, the room rate dropped about 30%, and was a good value, only slightly more than the 4-star Aloft.Our room rate also included round trip airport transportation. I easily arranged our airport pickup by chatting with the hotel on the Marriott app. The hotel always responded immediately, and when we arrived at the airport, the driver was waiting at arrivals with a Marriott sign.The hotel is less than a mile from Thamel, a 200 - 300 rupee taxi ride, or a 15-minute walk. A taxi to Durbar Square is 400 - 500 rupees.

We spent 4 nights at this hotel in Kathmandu. It is close to the airport (15 minutes by car) and close to the city center (10 minutes by car). It is a new hotel, with modern, attractive decor and all the infrastructure expected for a hotel of this level and even above expectations, including an outdoor lounge, next to the pool, relaxed and with music.Check in was done at the front desk, in a friendly manner, we were given the necessary and complete explanations, we were offered juice and we received a typically Nepalese welcome. We were diligently escorted to our room by the baggage handler. Our room (#1022) was located on the M Club floor, overlooking the mountains. Here, a welcome letter awaited us, accompanied by fruit and sweets. The room was spacious, with two very comfortable queen beds, as well as pillows, which allowed for an excellent quality of sleep. The AC worked perfectly. The modern furniture included a large sofa next to the large window that allowed us to relax after an intense day. The bathroom had a toilet, with a large counter. There was also a separate shower and bathtub, with a complete range of products, from the brand used by Marriott. There was also coffee capsules and water available free of charge and replenished daily. The housekeeping service was good and was done once a day. We didn't have a turndown service on any night...We had dinner once at Thamel Kitchen, a meal of Nepali food (Nepali Thali) that we enjoyed. The service was friendly and attentive, but it took a long time. So we were offered dessert.However, the highlight of this hotel is its M Club, which has extraordinary management and exceptional staff. It is on the tenth floor, has a wide view over the city and mountains and has a calm and relaxed atmosphere. It was here that we had our daily buffet breakfast, with the possibility of ordering some items à la carte. Everything of very good quality. Although, without the variety offered at Thamel Kitchen, we consider this the place to have breakfast in a much calmer environment. During happy hour, which in this lounge is longer than usual, some cocktails, wine and soft drinks and some cold snacks are offered from 5 pm until 8 pm. Furthermore, between 6pm and 8pm, some hot items of regular quality are also served. Furthermore, the cocktails are made in a very professional way. All staff are attentive, extremely polite and go out of their way to satisfy customers' needs. It can be seen that the management does an excellent job here. We will not name names because the list would cover the entire M Club staff, of which we do not all know, and naming some and not others would be unfair. The farewell was personalized and, at the last breakfast, we were even offered a cupcake (a gesture that was appreciated).We were very impressed with this property that Marriott should be proud of. Your M Club is a paradise!…

Few hotels and tourist establishments in Kathmandu can boast the constelation of quality offerings as the Marriott. The building design articulates architecural excellence with true 5 star features from top to bottom. No expense has been spared here in maintaining the consistency of the Marriott brand's reputation of excellence. You know what you are getting. Furthermore, several culinarily diverse restaurant options, cafes, and bars contribute to a satisfying stay when coupled with a top of the line gym, spa, sauna, and pool facility. Finally, and most importantly,  what sets the Marrriott Kathmandu above the rest of the places I've sampled is its quality of service. The staff are superbly trained to economize on time and frustrating language barriers.  Most notably, I would like to recognize Mr. Ujjwal Adhikari, who rapidly recovered a missing gold jewel that had fallen off of my ARIA NOIR sunglasses which would have cost me a fortune. That said, he saved the day, and so did the Marriott Kathmandu, by extension. In sum, they may not be the cheapest--but I believe they are the best. I will consider this hotel my home for future visits and recommend everyone else in my line of work to do the same.

Recently, my wife, my colleagues and I had a outstanding, totally unexpected, and most pleasant stay at the least expected location….Kathmandu Marriott in Nepal.     After the difficult turn of events, I must say that this particular hotel has put together  an excellent and very impressive staff for which it should be highly commended.  Of the few hotels that I have visited after the pandemic, I must say that the turnaround plans for this hotel are the best with perfect chance of success and that is all due to the wonderful staff that it has been able to recruit and because of the staff’s relentless commitment to extraordinary service to its guests.  This hotel has warm, efficient, and remarkable staff throughout.  One cannot help but feel the soothing and inviting vibrations throughout the hotel. The entire staff is simply wonderful.  However, as always some of the staff went beyond their call of duty during our stay and to them we would like to express special appreciation and admiration. These staff really made our stay extra special. This visit immediately exposed us to several of the hotel’s front desk staff including Megha,  Kushang, Kriti and the night duty manager Samikshya all of whom gave us a royal welcome which was truly memorable. The common trait and zeal for  service in dealing with and treating the guests in the Marriott’s original spirit was clearly present and evident in this very first encounter.  This is an extremely important point to note for the future guests because to my disappointment I have observed that this trait has been fading away at many of the Marriott’s properties.  The hotel should be very proud for keeping this trait and tradition alive in today’s environment of staff shortages and limited training.   We had several difficult requests but to them no request was too small or too large and all were entertained with smiles and most importantly with action.  By having all of hotel’s front desk staff acting in sync, the hotel has really orchestrated a masterful display of superb and reliable service, a very pleasant and delightful atmosphere, flawless customer service and a memorable guest experience. We all were truly dazzled by the hotel’s front line ambassador, the most personable, most charming, and most efficient Executive Lounge Manager, Ms. Bijaya Ray who relentlessly continued to give us royal treatment in the lounge and continued to make us feel like we were the most important guests.  She made sure that we were well taken care of by her staff and by herself in the lounge.  She remained our Ambassador throughout our stay.  She was full of smiles and cheers and that truly brightened our day.  She tirelessly made sure that either her or in her absence her staff met all of our requests and made us feel like we were her personal guests.  We are very appreciative of her special attention and special service.  Bijaya represents a perfect art of brilliant service.  We thank Bijaya for her exemplary service and wish her well. Bijaya’s leadership qualities were further manifested in the staff that she led so very eloquently and so very efficiently.  Reflections of her leadership and training were marvelously on display in the lounge by every staff member that reported to her.  It is difficult to recall all the names but the ones that touched us and provided us with superlative service includes Anup, Prajwal, Chef Keshav, and Sonic.  All of these staff were equally efficient, receptive to our needs, and most importantly left no stones unturned to make us feel at home.   We must also acknowledge the wonderful service and big cheery smiles of the housekeeper Sharmila.  Meeting her each day brought us great joy and happiness.  She has all the maternal instincts to make any one most comfortable and inviting.  Every time she made up our room, it was done perfectly and there was never ever a day that we could spot or pinpoint even the tiniest fault.  Always perfectly and skillfully accomplished.  Additionally, she also has the greatest aptitude to serve guests from all countries and all backgrounds.  Our sincere gratitude to her as well.  Our special gratitude to housekeeping supervisor Mr. Suljan who made a special effort to make time and to meet with me to make sure that we were happy with the housekeeping service.  That was very kind of him.  Small gesture but with immense impact on customer satisfaction.   Our special mention and gratitude to the hotel’s restaurant staff members including Superwoman Chef Alisa, Laxmi, Trainee Ashish, Sanjeev, Romi, Sharad, and Reshmi all of whom happened to be the most attentive, pleasing and hardworking staff; and also to the rest of the restaurant staff whose names escape us, for special treats and special service each morning during the breakfast in the restaurant.  Each morning, these delightful and hospitable staff would greet us and surprise us with suggestions for new culinary creations that would be guaranteed to please our palates.  Their kindness was overwhelming and very humbling.  I must say that the hotel’s restaurant has reached a new dimension….delightful, artful, and delectable with most pleasing service. During this visit we have experienced the best from all levels of the hotel’s staff starting with Ranjana in the cleaning crew who made sure that the hotel remained most inviting to Ms. Bijaya Rey, an outstanding and brilliant performer in the hotel’s executive staff.  All of them had only one goal….to please the guests and to make them happy.  With such a dedicated staff under helm, the hotel management should feel very lucky and proud.  All of the hotel’s staff makes this particular property an epitome of unparalleled service and an envy to many.  We are truly grateful that this opportunity to meet these wonderful people was availed to us.     Our heartfelt gratitude to all of these wonderful staff.  We wish them well in advancing their careers here and elsewhere. This hotel should really take pride in what it has achieved in terms of best staffing, best service, best food, and outstanding upkeep of the property.

The highlight was the daily happy hour from 5-8pm. A big selection of warm and cold food, and a large variety of drinks. The service by the team in the lounge was amazing as they helped me also sort PCR tests, tours and were engaging to answer all my questions about Kathmandu and Nepal.I ate at the Edamame restaurant a few times within the hotel and it was excellent. In summary - one of the best hotels in Kathmandu, great and warm service, excellent food. I would highly recommend to stay here!

I had my massage done here at the marriot by Eva- Therapist. It was the best massage ever. I loved it and highy recommend to have a massage with her. It is in Marriot Kathmandu!!! Go for it guys and enjoy the massage.

I feel secure  and safety , more responsibility staffs , they are gave me the respective and catering services very wonderfully and very very exalent  I humbly request the management take care of your staff God bless you 👍

This hotel has an incredibly helpful and caring staff. I was looking for a way to provide the young workers at my small local restaurant business a special treat, and Marriott proved to be the answer - one night in a world class hotel. From the front desk hosts to the sales representatives, to the on site staff in all departments, everyone was extremely helpful and considerate in making our adventure a reality.. A very reasonably priced package for six guests (two fantastic rooms) including an excellent buffet dinner and breakfast came in at under $400. Swimming pool, gym and portions of the spa were included. Extra furniture, (some chairs for a group activity) was graciously provided. All my young workers were treated with the same respect and consideration given to the much more sophisticated clientele that frequent this establishment.. I would highly recommend this accommodation  to anyone seeking more than just an ordinary "business" relationship with a hotel.

That's amazing hotel all thing is fully good I advise any one visit nepal to book with him restaurant is very good comfortable room amazing food serving is amazing.The room was very comfortable,I had very warm welcome staff was very friendly  and hositability reception people was very helpful fully and among them I found Mr kumar the manager  was very helpful.And Ms Kriti was also very helpful she was jolly as well for And in restaurant  dikshya was very good.

Extraordinary staff, they will go the extra mile to accomodate all your needs, great rooms, very good food, super clean and neat... Just perfect! Would also recommend it for tourism, maybe not so much for families, but for couples and singles definitely great!
