visited Tahina terrice !!! fantastic environment ,happy to visit here,,wow service served by #BikramThapa..We enjoyed a lot here...cool environment !!! Really happy moments !!! Cool environment !!Cool time!!! Happy to visit Here,loved to live here

Excellent Hotel, plush rooms and tempting food menus. Also, different cuisine Restaurants and a fantastic cafe. Lot of open space to relax.Last but not the least, Excellent service staff who are very courteous and Makes you feel at Home. A few names to mention specially CHEF PRAKASH, F&B STAFF LAXMI & ANU !Thank you so much for making my stay wonderful with world class service. Cheers ! Look forward to visit again.

I've stayed at this hotel 3 times during a trip to Nepal, and every single time I've been blown away by the team at this hotel. As a Marriott Platinum member, I am generally treated well everywhere I go, but nothing has ever come close to the service at this hotel.Across the board, the team has delivered an incredible, relaxing, safe, and clean experience during the 15 nights I've stayed at the hotel. Starting with the breakfast team - Dikshya (sp?), Anu, and Laxmi greeting you every morning with a smile and impeccable service starts the day off right. Special mention has to go to Alisha and the rest of the chef team at breakfast who often were willing to make me off-menu items to keep the breakfast buffet exciting. The front desk team - dealt with my many requests with such grace and class, I never had an issue. Even helped go above and beyond like organizing cars, a covid test etc.The team at Raksi Music Bar - The lounge is currently closed to platinum members due to covid, but this team, especially Indrika helped me make the most of the benefit - not to mention the best old-fashioned's I've had outside the US!The team at the spa, especially Eva who provide clean, relaxing, and incredibly professional treatments.Such an incredible stay, and really the entire team deserves credit for their service.  This hotel and the staff will forever be part of an incredibly memorable trip to Nepal.

I stayed here for 6 days my stay was fabulous as always nepal is my second time whenever I come here I choose Kathmandu Marriott I love this hotel a lot wonderful staff wonderful hospitality no complaints m really happy with few staff Dikshya , Anu,laxmi, incharge ram and  barista Sandup they take good care of me even on my last visit thank u team thank u Marriott

You will not find another hotel like this in Kathmandu! The professionalism and kindness from the entire staff will go unmatched for years to come. I stayed here for 6 nights before heading into the mountains for 12 days, then stayed 1 night at the end of my trip. I left two bags with the hotel for almost 2 weeks and had no issues retrieving them upon return. The front desk even assisted in scheduling an in-room COVID test so I was able to depart Nepal. Everyone, and I mean everyone, from those in the front-of-house including the  front desk staff, bag attendants, the Maître D', restaurant servers and cooks, security, gym/spa staff, to those in the back-of-house like hotel attendants, laundry services, and room service, etc. did a fantastic job and did everything they could to see that I was enjoying my stay. A special thanks to Kumar, Laxmi, Dikshya, and the rest of the team for making my first (and definitely not last) trip to Nepal a great one.

Thanks Marriott Kathmandu for amazing hospitality....enjoyed our stay n love the room and amenities....all staff are so polite and friendly....hope to stay soon again our stay was amazing.love to be back again

Must say- fresh environment, friendly staffs & the best part is its delicious cakes & Mango Tart😋 no one can eat just one👍It's @ perfect location to travel at any part of the city. Visit once & Thank me later🙏🏻

With mystique designing and decor The Kathmandu Marriott Hotel is blessed with an amazing chef in Thamel Kitchen restaurant ! Mr. Bhol Bahadur is a star chef! Best Biryani I have ever had in Nepal. Kudos!

The Kathmandu Marriott was nothing short of perfection for us on our post-Everest Base Camp trek. The staff was outstanding from the second we stepped out of the car. The hospitality and warmth was heartfelt from every employee in the building. Our check in process was smooth and the attendant did everything in her power to get us into the room as soon as possible, even though we arrived a bit before check in. She arranged for housekeeping to deliver extra toiletries and towels for us which we greatly appreciated! She told us a bit about the M Wellness spa while we were checking in and explained how to make an appointment. We were able to schedule a facial and massages with ease (which were divine!). The room was #825 with an awesome view of the city and the mountains in the distance. We never heard any other guests around us so we were able to sleep peacefully. The bed was so comfortable! The concierge staff outside the hotel helped us arrange for taxis to take us just down the road to Thamel if we did not feel like walking. They confirmed our drop off location and the price with the drivers each time. One occasion, one of the staff was taking the Marriott car in the direction we were going and offered to drop us off, free of charge! The proximity to Thamel was perfect! We could walk if we wanted or it was a quick taxi jaunt down the road. Straight shot! Our favorite part of the stay was waking up each morning for breakfast! The breakfast buffet was out of this world! We stuffed ourselves daily! The hostess, Mamata, was so kind and welcoming, and she remembered us each time we arrived and asked us about our stay and our plans. It felt very familial. Rabin and the chefs and staff at the breakfast buffet made this the highlight of the day with their service! The chefs prepared speciality items at their live cooking stations and their attention to detail did not go unnoticed! On our final morning they brought a “Bonvoy” treat to wish us well on our journey and to invite us back in the future. I would highly, highly recommend this hotel to anyone staying in Kathmandu!!

J'ai passé un excellent séjour dans cet hôtel. Très bon accueil. Service accessible et professionnel à l'image de Madame Dikshya douée pour le service clientèle. J'y reviendrai pour un autre séjour. Mes vives recommandations.

We were attracted by the Christmas tree in the courtyard but another courtyard stole the show as Rojen showed us how cosy it ll be with the heating system outdoor and chilled Nepalese white wine, we re in heaven 😍😍😍😎

Marriott ReviewWhere to start...I spent two and a half months at the Kathmandu Marriott, and it was, from start to finish, an amazing experience. Living in a hotel is far from ideal and can become quite a tiring affair, but the staff at this property created such an unparalleled experience that the Marriott genuinely became “home” during my time there. The front end and check in staff were, even though I arrived rather late in the night, warm and inviting. The care and consideration they displayed on night one were continued throughout my stay. Any issue I brought to them, even the smallest, was handled with the utmost care and speed. Sandip was a particular shining light at the front end, always welcoming me back after work as one would an old friend. The servers, hostesses, and chefs in Thamel Kitchen (which hosts a wonderful breakfast buffet) made each morning special and important. People like Shrijana, Yubak, Sujan, and countless others delivered great experiences every single morning and are a credit to this property and the Marriott brand. Chef Samaresh is absolutely fantastic, always ensuring that each guest was having a wonderful, tailored experience. His smile and professionalism were a highlight of my days at this property. My room, a suite, was well appointed and fully cleaned and prepared each day. The housekeeping staff was, without fail, polite, attentive, and gracious in every encounter. Ashok, who often returned my laundry to my room, was one of the most friendly, happy individuals I have ever met. While all of the above are important and made the stay comfortable, the highlight of my stay was, without a doubt, the team in the M Club. Led by their wonderful manager Bijaya, who proudly leads a team of absolute all stars, the M Club team was the main source of my feeling at home during my somewhat lengthy stay. No matter the request, the professionals like Vicky, Prajwal, Anup, Purnima, and so many others, did whatever they could to make it happen. Being with this team, visiting and getting to know them was a highlight of my days in Kathmandu. Upon learning of the fact I was missing my wedding anniversary, the club team blew me away with an awesome opportunity to recognize the day with my wife back home. While each of the individuals that work in the club is wonderful on their own, I have little doubt that many of their cues are taken from their talented leader Bijaya. If you’re coming to Kathmandu, do yourself a favor and book a room at the Marriott (and ensure you get a room with club access). Never have I been away from home for so long yet still felt so at home.Bottom line: best hotel experience I’ve ever had.

Good property, excellent hosting and good food ... I would particularly like to thank Binay for taking care of everything ... Location is nice, service is good, club rooms are better, i booked package rate which comes with lounge access, which was really worth

We cannot rave enough how fantastic our 10 day stay has been.  First it's the staff, how incredibly friendly, professional yet always with a sweetness and the warmth, a hallmark of Nepali people. This new Marriott  more than lives up to its 5 star rating and quite the bargain.  I don't think you can find this value the world over. From the 1000 Marigold petals at the entrance, salute at the door, you are warmly greeted and well cared for.  The breakfast is a feast, blend of Asian and Western.  Thank you to the incredible staff of Chefs Bishou and Samaresh, Santosh Kunwar, Pratikshya, Mamta, Rashmi, Rojen who gave us so much care.  Thank you to incredible help at the front desk of Bijaya, Laxmi, Kriti, Sunita, Hari, Deuraj and Concierge Rabindra. And if course incredible housekeeping/maintenance engineers, can't thank you enough Bharat supervisor gave us flowers, Rita and Gyan Kumari - Beyond sweet, helpful. Thank You Marriott, Kathmandu, Naxal.

I stayed here for several weeks on business and I found the service to be amazing. The staff are extremely friendly and helpful, and they took the time to get to know me and remember my name/company during my stay. The Club Lounge is very nice and has a great 360 view of Kathmandu! I ate breakfast there frequently and enjoyed the happy hour in the evenings - if you have the opportunity to book a Club room/lounge access, I highly recommend it. The bedroom was very nice (great view also) and clean. Breakfast on the first floor was amazing - there were so many options. The gym and spa are solid as well. All around 10/10 and I would definitely stay here again!

Surprised to see that the Access to the hotel is a little clumsy. Crowded roads hides the entrance. We were unfortunate that our stay coincided with the stay of Bangladesh President and that meant, the whole security arrangements were taken over by Nepal Police. This made our stay very uncomfortable. One did feel that the hotel management could have definitely done a few things to make other guests are not put in discomfort though. The hotel is new and this means, the staff are also not very experienced. We did find the checking in process to be tedious but we were given rooms in 6th floor, which makes the views from the room better. Food and the options are good.

Good location if you’re the type that likes to walk around and explore. The buffets and food in general is decent, not the best breakfast. The rooms are relatively clean. The staff is very nice and helpful. If you stay there take a room that overlooks the pool, that side has a nice view of the mountains.

Hotel centrico,con buenaas instalaciones,comidas buenas.Personal,complaciente,agradable,cafè occidental.Habitaciones gigantescas con todo tipo de comodidades.Excelente servicios .Estuve una solanoche y no me importaria el poder quedarme mas tiempo

Stayed here two separate nights. Once before a trek and then after with friends and our 2 young children. Service is fantastic. Smiling helpful staff always. They really pampered us. Massage was perfect after a long trek. Food top notch with great variety at a reasonable price. Would not hesitate to recommend after staying in other Kathmandu accommodations before which were personally disappointing even with high marks on tripadvisor.

This hotel is a gem - I hope Marriott fully appreciates what is happening at this location. First off, there is literally no better place to stay in Kathmandu. The facilities are ultra new and modern and everything from the restaurant to the spa to the front of house is phenomenal service. Whether you're starting a trek or finishing one, this is exactly the place you need to rest before and after an adventure. The service was so extraordinary, I'm going to call out some names of individuals to acknowledge their unique contributions - but really the whole hotel is special. Laxmi and Riju at the front desk. Laxmi was wonderful and ultra responsive when we were taking a helicopter from Gorak Shep to KTM and needed to move our reservation a day earlier. She made magic happen during an ultra-busy time. Riju picked up where Laxmi left off when we checked in, acknowledging the toll we put our bodies through on the Everest Base Camp trek and making sure we had everything we needed including courtesy discounts at the spa. All gestures that went above and beyond what was expected. Prashant in the spa was a fantastic masseuse. Hope he gets the recognition he deserves. The restaurant has some wonderful people working at it. Specifically, Chef Hari was constantly attentive to our dietary needs in a way that was extraordinary, Mamata at breakfast and the three person super team of Umesh, Bibek and Kamal at dinner all made visiting the hotel restaurant a delight. There are too many people to mention everyone by name - but just a hat tip to the whole team at Marriott Kathmandu for raising the bar every day. Can't wait to come back!!

Staff are well trained, professional and go all out to assist the in house guests. Special thanks to Laxmi, Chef Prakash K and Kabi who made our stay extremely comfortable and enjoyable. Will definitely come back. Thankfully, Ms Tang

I cannot state how wonderful this hotel is. Not only is it absolutely gorgeous, comfortable, clean and luxurious the staff are all so incredibly welcome and accommodating, kind and friendly. We only stayed a night on the way towards kohulpor but they welcomed us back for the day when we missed our early morning domestic flight and took our bags and offered us a days use of the facilities and even offered a room for us to stay in for the day whilst we wait. Everything about this hotel is perfect, special thanks to Bishnu and Samida who made our trip so effortless and relaxing. We were made to feel incredibly special. Thank you so much, we would come back in a heartbeat. You are wonderful ambassadors for the Marriott brand.

I have been a loyal Marriott guest and chose Marriott in Kathmandu expecting the same STD service that we get. But I was blown away by the fantastic service that our group got at the Kathmandu Marriott. The Thamel kitchen and wait staff were amazing. Chef Bisu and Chef Hari went above and beyond each of our 5 days to make something for my wife who was fasting. Token and Sonic took care if us every day to ensure we had everything we needed. The club lounge staff was also phenomenal, especially Bijaya. I would definitely go back and highly recommend this property to everyone.

I have been very pleased with my stay at the Marriott. The hotel is very modern, has a great atmosphere, with delicious local cuisine and outstanding gym and spa. Special thanks to Umesh and the other staff in the dining area for being extremely hospitable and for giving great food recommendations and explaining local dishes. Thank you!

I spent nearly 6 weeks in Kathmandu for a work trip and the Kathmandu Marriott truly became my home away from home. The location is great, the rooms are extremely clean, the amenities are top notch (gym and spa are fantastic) but the staff are what makes the hotel so great. The staff took exceptional care of me and were always asking how my stay was and if there was anything that I needed. I would like to give a special thank you to the M Club lounge team, Bijaya, Vicky, Sujan and Prajwal and also to Krishna and Sirjana at breakfast in the Thamel kitchen. While all the staff in the hotel were great, these staff particularly went out of there way to make my stay comfortable. The service is fantastic and not something I’ve experienced elsewhere. I hope to visit Nepal again for many reasons but one of the top reasons would be to see this team. I visited other hotels in the area for work events, none of them compared to the Kathmandu Marriott. I can’t thank the team enough for all of their help including tourist attraction suggestions, insight to Nepal culture including introducing me to my new favorite sport Kabaddi, hot tea with lemon/honey/ginger when I got sick, lots of laughs and overall helpfulness and kindness. For short or long trips, I wouldn’t want to stay anywhere else besides this hotel. Thank you thank you!

I stayed at this hotel for almost 10days, they have great breakfast and nice coffee. I accompanied my husband while he's doing a business trip. My husband rarely has his time for breakfasting at hotel, but one of the hotel staff ms. Laxmi has been very nice to us and give him a breakfast to go, while one of the cheff - mr. Hary always came to us with the abc juice that we loved so much finally!! The staff has been very nice to us .. we would love to come and stay there again in another time.

I stayed at the Marriott in Kathmandu for three weeks.  The facilities are all new and designed well.  The services is better care than your family provides, at least my family.  They helped me and my colleagues when we were not feeling well, making us tea and fresh lime sodas.  They helped navigate some language and cultural questions.  They also made our time there fun!

Beyond all expectations,even for a Marriott!  Excellent customer service from the front desk, to the doorman, to the bellman...everyone was extremely friendly and very appreciative.  They greet you with a cold towel and a cup of tea.  I had breakfast and lunch in the lobby restaurant and dinner at the restaurant on the 2nd floor, Edamame. Everyone was warm and welcoming.  I can't say enough about their customer service.  A special shot out to S Shrestha and R. Yamargard (sorry if I spelled them incorrectly).  They were excellent at the lobby restaurant. Luggage was delivered to my room efficiently with complete explanation of the cooling and TV, gift shop attendee was very helpful with my purchases.  I can't say enough nice things about them other than "thank you" for a wonderful stay in Kathmandu.

There is a saying in Sanskrit - "Atithi Dewo Bhawa" which means Guest is God. The Marriott staff went above and beyond to live up to that saying during my two-week stay at this amazing hotel. My work colleague had recommended the Marriott for my work trip in Kathmandu in mid-September. I was happy to oblige and stay here since I am a Bonvoy member. However, I have no doubt that my experience would have been just as great even if I was not a frequent guest at Marriott. My go-to place to catch up on emails or take a break was the lounge on the 10th floor. Bijaya-ji and her staff were exceptionally helpful and attentive. The ambiance and amenities there is a match to none. I also hosted a large group for dinner at the Thamel Kitchen downstair. Everyone spoke highly of the quality of service and food. The kitchen staff was amazing. Special thanks to Rajani for helping me with all the reservations. The front desk was also incredibly accommodating. I had to make an impromptu work trip outside of KTM and had to change my reservations but the staff at the front desk made the overall process very easy. I have already recommended Marriott to all of my friends and colleagues for their stay in KTM. I will continue to do so. AlohaRufus G.

A college of mine recommended the Marriott Kathmandu for an upcoming business trip in the late summer of 2019.Although I have to admit that I get some preferential deal because of my Marriott status, that has not been the highlight of my stay. The best thing of this Marriott is the customer service, regardless of who you are; since you come in the driveway, the lobby, the restaurant, every employee knows your name and your preferences, and they take care of you in any possible way.My favorite spot was the lounge, where my dear new friend Bijaya checked on me, and how my day was, always helpful and with a smile (and delicious food and drinks), made me feel at home.Facilities are brand new, and very nice. Food was exquisite and good variety of it.My colleagues and I got a complimentary shuttle (a brand new sedan) to our workplace every morning.Totally recommended for business.Cheers,Diego A.

We stayed at the Marriott to celebrate our wedding anniversary.  We were blown away at the service, hotel room, and the food.  We had a great time and the Marriott made our celebration very special. We especially enjoyed the M Club Lounge.  Bijaya did a wonderful job taking care of us while we were in the Lounge. Her and the staff there went out of their way to care for us.  Food was amazing and the views were amazing!  Thankful for the wonderful memories and wonderful time. We will come back.

Everything at this hotel is perfect. Service, standard, design all are best in Nepal. What was the best for me was the experience with the owner. I met this guy at the gym a couple of times and asked him if he was local. He said he was a local and advised me on places to go out and things to do as I didn’t know how to spend the weekend. I was visiting for work and my wife accompanied me. Then one day I saw him with other people working there and I asked him if he also worked at the hotel, he said yes. Only later and on my last night, I saw him at the cafe downstairs and asked the staff what was the that guy’s position at the hotel and was told that he is the owner. Very humble person, he could have boasted and been bossy for being the owner of such a big hotel but was so down to earth and friendly. True inspiration.

What a contrast with the scenes outside, this hotel is a modern city oasis from the moment we step into the lobby. Generous sized room and bathroom. Restaurant is excellent by local standards both breakfast and dinner. Great gym, good WiFi. Staff are very warm and friendly. Some minor issue with check in and check out which is time consuming but not a big deal. Staff here genuinely tries their best and is very accommodating. Great place for stay either  business or leisure. True to their international standards and Marriott brand.

The hotel itself is superb. Excellent facilities. Quite new. Excellent food in both the restaurant and Club Lounge. And the staff are amazing - very well trained and so warm, friendly and helpful. The problem though is that apparently there is still work being done inside the hotel. The construction noise was awful - day and night. If you're sensitive to noise and will spend much time in the hotel, then I'd recommend waiting until it's finished. At that time this will be the top choice.

My colleague and I thought the staff working at the Marriott are exceptionally professional - we congratulate the team on their wonderful service. Well done - both to the cafe/restaurant and reception staff.

Everyone from the top starting with the manager Mr. Jean Louis to the Chef Mr. Das to the Concierge provided excellent service and always checked in with me and my colleagues on quality and satisfaction. I have stayed at Marriott brand hotel across the world and this experience was by far the best in every way. I highly recommend this hotel for the service and the amazing food quality and choice.  We were given custom breakfast each morning in the lounge with great service.

I always except good things from a Marriott but when I heard the one in Kathmandu had just opened, I was a little on guard. It turns out the the staff were overwhelmingly professional, friendly, and service-oriented. I highly recommend this place.

We felt that this hotel had the most beautiful staff of any place we’ve ever stayed in. From all the reception staff who helped me so much after I left my wallet in my taxi. They had CCTV and were able to trace the car and my wallet was returned. Wonderful Laxmi and Sirjana in the restaurant not forgetting the Sous Chefs. I can’t speak highly enough of my two room servers both by the name of Bibek. Would highly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Kathmandu

My family and I stayed with them in July, and we were all very content with the level of service and friendliness of the staff. They catered to our every need, and were very eager to help in any way they could. The food was first-rate, and our visit was a very enjoyable experience. The hotel concierge team was always very helpful in answering our numerous questions. Thank you to Chef Bahadur, Chef Prasad, Chef Das, Hari, Rojen, Srijana, Saluja, Shoni, Riju, and Sandip for making our stay memorable. We hope to return soon!
チトワン、ポカラと周った後、こちらにチェックインしました。オープンしたばかりでとても綺麗でスタッフの対応も大変良かったです。

Excellent hotel stay and accommodation. Staff is very friendly and hospitality is great. Breakfast options are good. Staff remembers your preferences and caters accordingly. Special mention to Chef Pratikshya who makes excellent parathas and also the serving staff Laxmi and others ( I miss to recollect their names). Amenities are excellent. The mountain View rooms are great and you wake up to an amazing view.

Wonderful place to dine. The staffs are attentive and are willing to help with special requirement. Special thanks to chef Bhol and Chef Govind for their warm wellcome and wonderful professionalism. We really enjoyed the food.

Excellent service staff performing their roles with diligence, lively and smiles as they interacted with their guests. starting with Front Desk, Thamel Kitchen and Resky Bar.  Thanks to Managers Bimila, Prakash and Samir and their staff teams My 4 days stay was pleasant and enjoyable.  There was one disappointment with a F&B manager who goes by the name Pammie or Dammie ..He is always seen walking in and out of the Thamel Kitchen and elsewhere with arrogance in his face and never saw him do any productive work either. He must be the black mole of this new hotel. Hope the GM of this hotel has a better plan for him before he chases the guest away. Thanks to great staff and teamsSiva , 19 to 23 July 2019

This trip was all of sudden and my friend recommended me to stay at the Marriott KTM - the newest property in Town. I had a nice experience at the Property as the rooms are spacious, mountain view windows, nice amenities like Gym, Spa, Swimming Pool and variety of Food options across different floors and restaurants like Pan Asian, Retro Bar, Multi-cuisine Food. The Hotel was buzzing with activity with conferences during the day, networking dinners, lots of tourist guests made it very much happening at any point of time - courteous Hotel Staff across makes it a very Warm environment. Overall a very nice experience as you would expect out of Nepal full of warmth, courteousness. I expect to visit again once the Hotel is fully operational after its grand launch in August. The casino should be up by September make another attraction at the Property.Special Mention for Staff - Saluja Shrestha at the Morning Breakfast at Thamel Kitchen

The overall servuce was pleasant. Having a hotel and staff providing you a service beyond that extra mile help in recovering the day stress. Had a lovely stay. Especially I would like to mention the names who is the star and hitel assest. Saluja Shrestha the hostess,  with her affable, warm personality and vivacity, she is the one to watch out for and her good personality. Hope to get an opportunity visit again. Thank you

Das Marriott Kathmandu ist ein nagelneues, echtes 5-Sterne-Hotel in Kathmandu, es hat erst seit 3 Monaten geöffnet, gut aussehende Mitarbeiter, die sehr aufmerksam und gut (international?) geschult scheinen, das Frühstücksbuffet war das beste in 14 Tagen Nepal und wir waren auch in anderen Spitzenhotels. Es war auch das einzige Hotel mit voll-isolierten Fenstern. Auf den Zimmerfluren war ein etwas übler Geruch, aber sonst alles perfekt, wie in Marriott was auch in einer anderen Metropole stehen könnte. Guter Pool, der leider nicht lange geöffnet ist. Schade war nur, dass sie für einen Late-Check-Out den vollen Übernachtungspreis haben wollten, obwohl das Hotel garantiert nicht voll belegt war.

It’s been a few days already since I left the hotel and came back home. It’s hard to forget the amazing experience that I had staying there. The facilities are fantastic and full of good taste, but nothing makes the difference from the rest like the incredible staff that runs the place. From Prazena (front desk receptionist), Laximi (guest relations), to Rajni (Thames kitchen) and Indira (masseuse ),everyone seems so friendly, professional, heart giving and smile providers ..But a very special mention definitely deserves Saluja, the breakfast hostess.. that amazing buffet is granted and increases brightness by her charming kindness, her will to help, her savior faire, her beauty and her amazing smile.. difficult to forget and a definitely worthy reason to go back. What can I say, I still miss those breakfasts with Saluja’s  outstanding presence. Congratulations in all senses to the hotel and especially for having her.. if details are what makes the difference, there’s one to remember. In overall, a five star location highly recommended!!

Stayed here for 2 days on a business visit and I was totally mesmerized. Every time I walked to the hotel I almost forgot that I am in Kathmandu. The hotels feels like walking into a hotel in Manhattan or Hong Kong. Very impressive design and very futuristic for Nepal. The ceilings are the highest I have ever noticed in a hotel in Asia. I would like to bring my family and children here for a holiday the next time. The design is international but there is a lot of nice and expensive local creativity. The hotel is almost like an art hotel with upscale Nepali antiques and good paintings.If the management is reading this, you should take out all the 3D and design pictures from trip adviser or the hotel website. The renderings of the bar and the lobby do no justice. Those 3D pictures give a bad impression. Make you not look complete and ready while you are 100./. complete.All in it is an exceptional product and walking distance to Thamel. The gym is outstanding and faces the bar deck. Very nice concept. Good work and a lot of investment for whoever has made it. A room and a hotel like this in Central London would be at least GBP 500 per night , I don´t understand how will the investment recover.

I spend 3 nighs from july 08 to 11 and I can say one of the best hotels I ever visited , the staff was so nice and to be fair one of your staff name Sajula she made my day during the breakfast in Thursday july 11 , she was so professional and nice with her so beautiful smile I feel so comfortable and welcomed , you are lucky to have staff like her if I visit again I will choose the same hotel just because of her .

High quality standards of brand Marriott and best in class Nepalese hospitality makes this new property a real gem. Being a business traveler visiting KTM every 3 months and having patronized most of the luxury hotels, I believe I have finally found my nest in the bustling valley of Kathmandu which meets the demands and requirements of every business as well as leisure traveler. Seamless check in and and check out at the front desk by Kriti, Parzana, Rijju and Alina, amazing hospitality all around by the staff namely Srijana, Saluja, Rashmi, Prakash, Santi and Laxmi (2 of them) to name just a few (I apologize if I forgot to name the others). What I liked about the ever so smiling staff was their attitude, which had "We are at your service" all over their body language. I look forward to being back at the property every time I visit the valley because I believe “A place is only as good as the people you know in it and It's the people that make the place good” and at Kathmandu Marriott Hotel It is the good people who make place not only good but exceptional. Thank you for the wonderful hospitality and look forward to seeing you all again.

😊The hotel is very nice, very good facilities, very professional and friendly staff(except reception staffs)🤗Thamel kitchen: the food was delicious, I found breakfast buffet to be absolutely delicious. Restaurant staff Ms.Laxmi is the best helping and kind employee overall the hotel.

My first time in Nepal. A friend recommended this new hotel. I am a very picky person, but there is really nothing to complain about. I recently spent 7 days at the new Marriott in Kathmandu.  Service:  I cant say enough about the staff at this hotel.  They went the extra mile to make my stay as enjoyable as possible.  They new my drink orders and food every morning and when we left they gave us a farewell cake.  I truly felt like I was at home.  Specifically, Sandip and Rajani at the Bar in the hotel. Sandip shared many stories and was the perfect bartender.  Anu and Saluja were amazing and attentive every morning at breakfast and took time to be extra friendly.  Samida and Prazena work at the front desk and from the time of arrival to the time we left and needed a late check out, they were always smiling and happy to help out.  Management should be happy to have them.Food:  The breakfast, lunch and dinner buffet were all excellent.  The quality of international food (usually indian, nepalese, and asian) was outstanding.  The staff were extremely helpful in encouraging you to try new dishes and I ate more than I normally would at a buffet.  A couple of times I asked for a custom order and the staff bent over backwards to make it happen.  They didn't have pizza on the menu but the chef made me one anyways from scratch.  Rooms:  I stayed in a king room with great views on the 5th floor.  The room was very large and the bathroom had a separate bathtub and shower.  Everything was modern and looked nicer than many hotels I have stayed in around the world.  Bed was super comfy and the window was HUGE. Automatic controls for the black out shades made the room completely dark. Amenities:  The spa, pool, and gym were all amazing and first rate.  I did a spa treatment and the massage was wonderful and cheap compared to western prices.  The gym was also complete with every piece of equipment you would want and high quality.

It was amazing to stay here... Very good staff.  Personally I very impress with behaviour of 1. Anjil Bimail2. Saluja 3. Rashmi Maharjan4. Sandip Niroula 5. Rojen Maharjan6. Samida 7. Sunita Karki8.shaka(I don't know all staff name)So all sfaff of your hotel...

An excellent hotel consists of not only great amenities and accommodations. The upmost important aspect of a good hotel to me would always be the service of the staff. And the staff of Marriott Kathmandu did just that, and even beyond. Their enthusiasm to approach me to offer any help before I ask is beyond amazing, especially Rashmi and Luxmi at the breakfast buffet. But without a doubt the most impressive part of the hotel service team is the never-say-no attitude as well as their pursuit of perfection in their service. I cannot help but noticed how the staffs respond to your requests, without saying the word, “No”.The air conditioning in my room was not functioning as well and I had approached the lobby staffs to request to change my room. Within minutes, I got the keycards to my new rooms with the staffs helping me to move my belongings over. This is commonly expected from any hotel but from my experiences traveling in Nepal, it sets a new golden standard for service in this beautiful country. Being very original, the staffs here will you till you are satisfied. Going beyond helpful, they ensure that you are happy with what you requested for and they will not stop until it’s done, even if you tell them that what you get is already sufficient. And the fact that they did all that with a smile on their face adds even more praise to what is already an excellent service.All in all, an excellent hotel with an exceptional service. Highly recommend to all traveling to Kathmandu. Will definitely visit again!

All their staff has excellent service mind especially Rashmi and Lakmi who take care me really well. They never say no any of your request. Not only the service is excellent but also room is very comfortable and they have variety of food with good taste in their restaurant.

Good and comfortable hotel. Breakfast was good and the service from Chef Deepak was the best! He really went the extra mile to make his customers happy. Convenient location to shopping street. Highly recommended!

Great place to be, went there on last friday for sundowner party on raksi music bar. Really had a great time. Food,music,service,management everything on top. Staffs are always smiling and ready to help. Top class in Kathmandu. There are other 5 star hotels in ktm, but Marriott has its class!

The overall service was pleasant. I was on a tight business schedule. Having a hotel and staff providing you a service beyond that extra mile always help in recovering the days stress. Had a lovely stay, though the hotel is yet to fully open with all amenities.The staff are some of the finest. Especially, I would like to mention couple of names who are  the stars and hotel assets. It was a great stay in Marriot Kathmandu. It’s a brand new hotel with all facilities. I was very happy to get a warm welcome from the Restuarant staffs especially the chef I met who is from Kolkata. Also Saluja one of the staff was very warm and made a very pleasant experience. Thanks to Marriot.

The hotel isn't yet fully open but it is already a star. The service, food, and management have all been outstanding! The executive chef, Hari, and his staff provided world class service as did the entire Marriott team here including the GM. See you next time.

We hosted a high tea for 50 people at the hotel today; and I must admit this is by far the best hotel (not to mention new) I’ve seen in Kathmandu in the last 10 years. The attention to detail was explicit - and every small thing has been taken care of. We ordered high tea and I must admit the spread is the best I’ve had amongst all of the hotels in the city. Highly recommended. Areas of improvement: The view is a bit sad. There are houses right next to the hotel, some with their walls touching the hotel where underwears etc are being put out to dry. Unfortunately, this is the view you get if you’re next to the meeting room. Needs immediate improvement: The valet showed up promptly with the car as we waited at the entrance. However, the music was blaring at a full sound (he didn’t have the common sense to close the radio or lower the sound as he delivered the car) and the air conditioning was at a full blast. This isn’t a high end experience. Perhaps the hotel management can pay better attention there. I rated the hotel 4/5 stars and minus the last bit - came away incredibly happy with the overall experience.

We didn't know until the morning of our departure, but we were actually the first guests in this new Marriott Hotel in Kathmandu. We can entirely endorse the comments made by reviewer Anshuman: this is an excellent new hotel staffed by attentive and thoughtful personnel - from Bibek and his incredible towel art through to all the restaurant and front of house staff. The Thamel kitchen has an impressive breakfast buffet and our evening buffet meal was similarly excellent. We hope to be back!

I've visited Kathmandu before, but never have I experienced such comfort and quality in a Hotel. I was on a work trip and spent 10 nights at Marriott Kathmandu. Its favourably located, and there's even a lovely circular park nearby where one can go for a morning jog. The lobby sets the tone for the rest of the hotel with warm and helpful front office executives and a huge wall mural depicting the glories of Nepal and Kathmandu.My room (no.211) faced the circular park and I woke up in time for the sunrise every morning. Housekeeping was impeccable. Every day my bed looked better than the day before. A note of thanks to Bibek Bhandari, Sujan Sakya, Kiran and Bibek Khatri for the amazing in room experience. The AC worked fine, bed was very comfortable and the day bed was my favourite place to sit with a cup of tea and look at the hills in the distance. The food at this hotel is absolutely gorgeous. Thamel Kitchen has wonderfully attentive staff, and they all looked after me very well. Reshma remembered my Earl Grey every morning and Anu promptly brought me my glass of Orange Juice in the afternoon after lunch. The cappuccino here is to die for. The Barista here was Nepal's Best in 2016 or something like that.My favourite dish at Thamel kitchen was Tandoori Trout. The Pan seared salmon here is out of this world. I even tried the Lamb rack and it was outstanding. I stayed for 10 days and there was always something new to explore.I went to Patan in the Hotel Car and Milan, who drove us there was extremely helpful, giving us tips and making sure we are doing fine in this wonderful cheerful city.Marriott Kathmandu I miss you! Can't wait to find some work to do in Kathmandu, explore the rest of the menu, brush up my Nepali and interact with the lovely happy-go-lucky people of this wonderful country! Cheers!

We recently stayed at the property for 5 nights with our two kids ... we had interconnecting rooms absolutely amazing ... newly done up interiors and a fresh vibe was super comfortable and enjoyable ... large & well equipped with everything for a comfortable stay ours kids loves the bath tub ... Food is just amazing ... from breakfast lunch and dinner we never saw a repeat on the buffet everyday they had something new to offer ... and it was yumm ... they were kind enough to make special egg less pancakes for us ... extremely hospitable staff ... great conceirage told us the best places to visit ...great pool and bar ... all in all it’s a must visit the hotel as well as Kathmandu ... can’t wait to go back

I recently stayed at the Marriott Hotel in Kathmandu. It's a beautiful hotel. In the middle of the city.  All places to visit are hardly a 10-15 min drive. I had a comfortable big room with a beautiful view of the Himalayas. Fantastic Food.The hotel staff was lovely, always smiling and very helpful. Will definitely visit again.

Having travelled all over, one of the most hospitable hotels. From the most efficient check in process to the timely housekeeping, I can literally say this is THE gem of Kathmandu in terms of hospitality. Being a foodie, I have to say the croissants 🥐 at breakfast are one of the best I’ve had along with the fresh local strawberry jam. The view from the pool on the mezzanine floor is outstanding and in fact quite romantic actually, perfect to sit and down a bottle of Champagne or two seeing the sun set. I cannot wait to savour the Oriental restaurant on my next trip as I can guarantee that it is going to be Legen....... Wait for it ......... DARY !!!!!!!

Thanks to Gaurav Agrawal, management and staff for a super stay last Saturday (20.04).Not far from the tourist area of Thamel. We had a wonderful stay and were very well looked after by all staff. Our room was spacious with a view of the lovely gardens. The hotel facilities were excellent, gardens to relax in, swimming pool, spa and beauty parlour - we can highly recommend the foot massage! The restaurant provided a very good breakfast selection and the evening menu was also varied. Would highly recommend.

I stayed in Hotel malla many times for my work. It's in great location, just few minutes walk away from Thamel. Front desk staff are very helpful and attentive to the guests needs, especially Ranjita Shrestha, she is very cooperative. All other staff takes good care of guest.They give 15 minutes complimentary messages to all check-in guest by the pool side spa. Though it is very old 5 star hotel, it seems like they are constantly improving. Rooms are comfortable and has all modern amenities. Morning breakfast is highlights, serve in their big and beautiful garden. I always enjoy my stay at Hotel Malla.

We stayed at the Malla Hotel for 4 nights. It's is a lovely hotel with great staff. It is so well located, on the edge of Thamel and easy walking distance to shops, restaurants and attractions.We enjoyed the pool daily-nice to refresh after a day of walking in the warm weather and appreciated the free foot massage voucher!The room is comfortable and well serviced each day. Plenty of bottled water is provided.Breakfast and evening drinks in the garden are lovely. Staff are really helpful.This really is a little oasis in busy Kathmandu!

Really !!!! we had a wonderful stay at this hotel.all staffs were so good and helpful during our stay.we had stayed in the third floors,we ordered multiples foods in the rooms.Waitress was full of smiley face,nice uniforms,cleaned,gardens is so beautiful,swimming pool is so good too.we too swine and had a wonderful time.we had received the welcome drinks,which was good,receptionist were nice ,during breakfast we had an opportunity to speak to Mr.Upendra Nepali,briefed that  organize meetings,in different halls,like malla plaza,tara hall,business center and Belveder hall ,weddings, ,and international meetings in different times. avairy bar,cocktail bar,for cocktails,mug-tails,i am very happy that the staffs at the Malla Hotel are energetic,enthusiastic and ready to serve the guest any time .thanks a lot!!!!!

Absolutely stellar, stellar service! Everyone was incredible friendly, welcoming, and accommodating. Five stars and highly recommended!

The hospitality of the Hotel was wonderful, particularly in reception- Mokina, and staff in food were found very cooperative. It was a pleasant experience to stay in the cover. There was a nice experience to stay and get connected with these lovely staff.
