Die Organisation hat wunderbar geklappt.Um in die authentische Altstadt einzutauchen, muß man das schreckliche Touristengebiet Thamel durchqueren. Das fand ich ziemlich lästig.

Buen hotel para descansar después de unas semanas de trekking. Con todo tipo de comodidades, las habitaciones son amplias y con vistas a los jardines. El desayuno correcto y el trato exquisito. Situado a 3 min andando de las calles comerciales

Nicht weg von Thamel. Schön angelegter Garten. Die Zimmer sind in die Jahre gekommen. WLAN, mal geht es mal nicht. Die Boys, die das Gepäck auf das Zimmer bringen, sind was Trinkgeld etwas aufdringlich, der wollte von uns Trinkgeld, nur weil wir von einem ins andere Zimmer wechseln mussten.  Die Angestellten sind sehr freundlich, aber natürlich im Grunde alles sehr oberflächlich. Insbesondere im Frühstücksraum wirkt es oft nicht wirklich organisiert, obwohl da oft viele Leute mit schicken Uniformen herumstehen.

Ci siamo trovati benissimo, sia per la gentilezza di tutti i dipendenti, sia per la posizione ideale dell'Hotel a soli 2 minuti dal centro di Thamel.Camera spaziosa e luminosa, possibilità di scelta con parquet o moquette. Bagno lussuoso in marmo. In camera portano sempre 2 bottiglie d'acqua minerale al giorno, cesto di frutta e fiori freschi.Le camere hanno la vista sul bel giardino dell'hotel o sulla piscina. Hotel ideale per tutti.

A bit off the dusty road and with a garden on two sides, this hotel is an oasis in crammed Kathamndu. And they have a pool.Not a luxury place but nice staff in the dining room, and a decent breakfast. Rooms are a bit tired, and would benefit from a restauration. But still a place worth the stay and the price.

Stayed here at start / end of tour of Nepal.  Breakfast buffet was acceptable but other meals were very poor, and the staff attitude was not very helpful.  Curtain fell off curtain rail; others in the group complained of showers not functioning, TVs not working etc.  Early morning noise from construcition work opposite the back of the hotel (pool side).

Stayed at this hotel twice whilst arriving and departing Kathmandu found it very tired in need of a makeover.The shower didn't work on both occasions , the paintwork needed a good clean the bath was chipped. The food was very mediocre and on occasions cold. I can only wish the room cleaners were as keen on cleaning as they were on collecting a tip. Would not recommend this hotel.

I visited Kathmandu with a group of about 10 people in an organised friends' trip. When we contacted the agency to book us a good hotel in the city centre, they told us that Malla Hotel was one of the best, if not the best, hotel in Kathmandu. This turned out to be absolutely the opposite.We payed around 150 euro each to stay at Malla for each night, and every single night was an incremental disappointment. The rooms are spacious and relatively clean but the furniture and equipment (air conditioning, TV, etc.) was very old and in bad shape. I stayed at Malla for 6 days, and there wasn't a single day in which I had a shower and the water didn't intensively smell like iron and soil with a very brown colour. I repeat, all the water I saw running in the rooms is brown. Do not drink it or brush your teeth with it. You are paying very good money to ingest brown water.Our regime included breakfast at the hotel. This turned out to be very precarious as well. The food trays were always ridiculously empty, considering the big size of trays and the small amount of food in it.Regarding technological matters, not only free internet was not included for the price you have to pay to stay at Malla, but you had to pay 2 euros for every hour that you spent on the internet.Overall experience, I plan to go back to Kathmandu because it's a beautiful place, but I will never return to Malla Hotel. During the days I spent there I browsed for a few other hotel options and asked around for prices and saw the rooms they offered and you have way better hotel options with much more cheap prices in the city. Do not get caught in between of this touristica scam.

I stayed here as part of a package, 3 days at the beginning and 2 at the end of a tour in Nepal. I was in rooms 514 and 510.Room 514 had the curtain falling off, every time I drew the curtain a hook fell off, by the end of the stay it was on 5 hooks. The hotel is quiet, I didn't hear any noise from adjoining rooms. Most of the staff are friendly and hard working. The air con is good, we had one sweaty night before we realised it is contolled by a remote and NOT the gadget on the wall - a notice to this effect would be helpful.In Room 514 the shower head is a trickle. Washing hair under these types of shower is a challenge.  The bathroom is very dark indeed. Service can be very slow and innacurate. One of our party waited an hour at dinner and then served the wrong item. One breakfast waiter was almost hilariously surly. These are exceptions. Wifi is poor, it is free in the lobby but very hit and miss.I went to the spa, although the foot massage was excellent the hygiene is not, the covers on the bed were grubby and in holes and the walls could have done with a clean and lick of paint.   I was amazed that feet were not washed before the massage - Kathmandu is a very dusty place.There was one very bad note which I don't feel reflects the overall standard of the hotel. On our return I agreed (after being approached) to another foot massage - £12 for 30 minutes. Afterwards the lady suddenly and abruptly said we owed 500 rupees (£4)_for tea we had had on our previous stay and not paid for ! We were both absolutely speechless and shocked at this. It sounded unlikely but we had no way of proving it as we were not handed any chits we had signed. It left a very bad feeling - very unprofessional especially as out of a group of 18 I was the only one who had any treatments in the spa. From the hotel it is easy walking distance to many good restaurants, souks etc.There are two gardens, one by the pool, both with tables and chairs, however both overlooked by the hotel windows.

I was staying here as a stepping stone for a trip to Bhutan. For that purpose the hotel was fine. Although its location within Kathmandu is unclear to me, it was, for me about half an hour from the airport (my other companions took an hour the following night). The hotel is within a secure compound and there is a guard on the gate at all times.The staff were excellent; warm and friendly. My room was perfectly adequate and clean. There is an excellent café within the grounds with lovely gardens to look over (tea and coffee is not provided in the room, nor is there anything in the minibar). A safe is not provided but valuables can be left at Reception.  Wifi is available at the hotel and is free for the first 2 hours of use after which you have to pay. Money changing is available and the exchange rate is agreeable. The room had TV and A/C (neither of which worked well). There is almost no UK news and the main language papers are either local or USA.Noise around and between the rooms can be a problem especially if you are not sleepy (I had flown in from London and therefore slept quite well). There will be a bell-hop to carry your case (you don't really get an option).Walking nearby is interesting. The pavements are very high and walking needs concentration. The traffic can be manic and the road very dusty. That said, it is sometimes better to follow the locals who just walk and to hell with the traffic.

Everything more or less ok. Big room, nice view to the garden. A kind of an oasis in the middle of a noisy and dirty city. Unfortunately some standards are missing: WLAN not free, no minibar, water only first Night, no water cooler. In Relation to the Price, a Bit disappointing.

if you want to see modern aminities with traditional then this hotel is perfect for to stay. happy to stay here. this is located thamel. parking space. my 4 days here very nice. come and stay here for your holiday.

Mon séjour est un peu ancien (5 ans). Bonne situation. Très jolis hall, desk et bar. A l'étage ça se gâte. Chambres très ordinaires. Urgent de rénover. Le personnel à la réception est très mal gracieux. Jardin, volière et piscine agréables mais prestations fitness, soins et salon de coiffure lamentables, dans les gravats. Nous étions accueillis par des amis à  l'aéroport porteurs d'une immense gerbe de fleurs. Impossible d'avoir 1 vase. Les fleurs ont séjourné dans un seau plastique pendant une semaine. Eau jamais renouvelée. J'espérais beaucoup mieux d'un hôtel prétendûment de cette classe. Déjeuner très copieux. Restaurant sympathique avec un spectacle folklorique.

If you want to stay in a modern faceless Euro box, this characterful hotel is not for you.  If, on the other hand you are a connoisseur of the  country house style with a hint of Art Deco, all mixed in with a marvellous Nepalese twist, this could be the place for you.  We spent 10 days  at the Malla and it’s subtle faded elegance and charm along with the overwhelming hospitality of its friendly and most accommodating staff made this a well positioned resting place from the general rudderless chaos that is, in fact, Kathmandu.  The garden where we breakfasted every morning along with its coffee shop, serving fresh ground coffee, is a delight and really our overall feeling is that this is a hotel that needs time to have its subtle nuances appreciated.  The whole of Kathmandu could do with a bit of a wipe over due to the traffic and massive on-going reconstruction work after the earthquakes; considering this I think The Malla does pretty well.      We had two evening meals at the hotel, not usually fans of buffets suppers but the taste and quality of the food was a most pleasant surprise (to a degree that second helpings were also enjoyed).  A good tip would be to go to the extra expense of a suite, these I believe, overlook the well landscaped and planted garden instead of the swimming pool (though mountains behind are visible).

The malla advertises 5 stars, but it's in need of a full refurbishment, the rooms where quite shabby, but the worst let down was the breakfast, the hot food was on the most part stone cold and inedible, the toast was precooked cold and has hard as a brick...it's such a shame because it's a great location, the staff were very friendly but very over priced and will not be staying again.

Katmandu es parada obligatoria para las expediciones al Himalaya. en este caso paramos en este hotel.  tiene una gran ventaja y es que esta muy cerca del Thamel. a 5 min andando. el servicio de habitaciones bien.  el desayuno completo. jardines muy espacioso. con piscina y jardines.  va bien para evitar el ruido del trafico. ojo hay habitaciones sin aire acondicionado.  he puntuado 3 estrellas si comparo con los europeos, pero si solo cuento con el Nepal pondria 4

This Hotel is nice hotell near Thamel a part of Katmandu center. The rooms is okey to stay in but not fancy at al. You hav TV on the room but you have to pay for internet.It is a friendly hotel. With an odernary breakfast. Have stayed there for 3 nights inclusive breakfast.

El hotel está bastante bien, si bien es antiguo y se nota en las habitaciones y salas comunes. El desayuno y la cena son muy buenos y la ubicación esta bien. Esta muy lejos de ser un 4 estrellas pero para las opciones que hay en Nepal debe ser de los mejores

It is hard to write this review because there were many really good aspects to this hotel but it really needs a make over to justify it's 5 star rating. The good things included the people all of whom were very friendly and helpful. We had breakfast and dinner at the hotel and the food was very good, The trouble is that this hotel which I understand was once part of the Royal palace , is a mere shadow of its former self. The room I booked had to be changed because it didn't meet the requirements we asked for. The new room was larger but like the entire hotel it needed updating and painting. The hotel has a nice pool but the surrounding area also needs a good clean up. It has nice gardens but the Gardner must be on holiday.One thing that did annoy was that they charge for internet. On being told I challenged them and the price halved immediately. The toiletries were not replaced every day. The room had old fashioned furniture and uncomfortable pillows. There was no safe. The shower is in the bath. The lift starts on the floor above the reception. The price was quite reasonable. I would say this is a nice 4 star but it is positioned as five star which it isn't.

We stayed at the Malla before and after trekking in Nepal.  Perfectly positioned adjacent to Thamel, the Malla was a haven for us after the chaos of Kathmandu.  The staff are friendly, quietly engaging, and cheerful, and go out of their way to ensure that you have everything you need.  They kept our passports and extra luggage without charge while we were away, and have a excellent double key system for keeping valuables safe.  The hotel room for my son and I was spacious, comfortable and the water was hot!  There was no disturbance at all from our neighbours.  I would recommend this hotel to anyone for whom it would be convenient to stay near Thamel.  When we return to Nepal we will certainly return to The Malla.

... in bester Lage, 5 Minuten Fussweg zum Zentrum von Thamel. Wunderbarer Garten. Alles wunderbar, wenn..., ja wenn da nicht diese aufdringlichen Bemühungen des Hotelpersonals wären, um Trinkgeld zu erheischen. Da muss in der Uhr die Batterie ausgewechselt werden, da kommen gleich 2 Laute und fragen, ob wir frische Handtücher haben oder ob das Bett gemacht wurde.Ich habe das Management gebeten, ihre Angestellten so weit zu entlohnen, dass sie dieses unwürdige Spiel nicht mehr nötig haben.

Hotel bien centré a coté du palais Présidentiel Confortable mais aurait besoin d'entretien régulier Les chambres sont spacieuses  mais les poussières sont présentesPersonnel au petit soin ,carte du restaurant népalaise qualité prix ok

We were the first visiting group this year and there were no other guests but luckily there were 16 of us.The hotel made us very welcome but it did lack atmosphere.There were power cuts, which were not the hotels fault, as there is a shortage of fuel coming into the country.  The hotel did have a generator which kicked in when the power went off.The hotel is large and in pleasant grounds and is well maintained.It is only a short walk into the shopping area and we felt very safe walking around.  However beware of the pot holes in the roads and lanes.  But don't be put off by this.We would stay there again.

Although the hotel staff is very nice, the condition of our guest room (a "Delux Room") was dingy, dirty, and had tattered lamps. The company who booked us there probably had a good rate, but we expected more. Luckily we booked two additional nights that we required at another hotel. I would never recommend this hotel to anyone, there are much better choices in the city for the same price.

I stayed for a total of 3 nights at the Hotel Malla as part of the hf holidays Bhutan Adventure, with Kathmandu being our 'jumping off' point in the region.  Very conveniently located for souvenir shopping, outdoor kit (although 99% are Chinese knock-offs not designed for the European female frame) and some nice restaurants.The rooms on the 4th floor were quiet, spacious and spotlessly clean.  Sometimes the water was tepid, not hot, but perfectly adequate overall.  Bottled water was provided as standard.  Beware the obsequious cleaning supervisor who made a nuisance of herself by hanging round outside bedroom doors.  If you want to leave a tip for the maids, I suggest you hand it to them personally to ensure it reaches them.  One oddity is the free availability of a solitary PC for guest use in the 'business centre' at the hotel, but you have to pay to use the wifi.  Buffet breakfast was fine, although the muesli was a bit gritty.  Supper on arrival also OK, as was our final lunch taken in the garden in glorious sunshine (now a distant memory).  In conclusion, a haven in a city of noise, dust and frenetic activity (although I'm told it's worse when there aren't fuel shortages).

El hotel es un poco antiguo, sobretodo la parte exterior, pero las habitaciones y el servicio son muy buenos.Fuimos con el gv de ccee 2014 y nos permitieron hacer una fiesta en el patio del mismo.La ubicación excelente,  si bien la zona no es muy linda, es segura y está muy cerca de la zona comercial y otros atractivos de la ciudad.El hotel tofrece piscina, y area recreativa con gimnasio.

The trekking company I contracted with insisted I stay here. I wish they hadn't. A hotel changing US$100+/night should sand off some of the rough edges of Kathmandu, not add to them. In the 8 nights I ended up staying here, not once was there warm-ish water for a shower, it was always cold; the room and bedding was not clean, and housekeeping did little more than leave a plate of stale cookies; the Wi-Fi, in addition to costing 200NPR for 30 minutes, was unusable: slow, intermittent and only if you were in the lobby. In a backpacker hotel charging $25 these would be quirks that make a good story, but not at a self-proclaimed "luxury" hotel. I do not recommend the Malla, I would never stay there again.

Stayed here at the start and end of a Trekking holiday. Hotel provides a good base for visiting Kathmandu.Rooms are spacious and clean. Staff in reception were very helpful and always keen to ensure everything was ok. Ate in Restaurant one evening and 3 breakfasts, here the service was not so great and the food quality was poor (this is even comparing to service and food quality experienced in Tea Houses on a trek)Would definitely recommend for stays in Kathmandu as major sights are all within a short walk.

In view of the "unofficial" fuel blockade imposed by Nepal's "friends" in India they are doing as well as can be expected. The only hot water is a bucket on request. The building badly needs a face lift and a good clean down but all staff members are pleasant and try hard. As usual the gift shop in the hotel is expensive compared to small shops nearby which provide much better value for money. The lobby bar is a nice place for a pre dinner drink. The money changer at the reception desk offers a good rate. Keep the receipt so you can change it back into something useful  at the airport.

Stayed here as part of a group before and after a trekking holiday around Annapurna.Room was hot and stuffy as the windows don't open and the air conditioning wasn't working.No hot water for the shower so be prepared for a cold one.I've stayed in better guest houses that are a tenth of the price of this soulless place.There are far better hotels in Kathmandu for much less money.

I have staid in this hotel 2011 and written the review that time itself now I found my review lost at tripadvisor profile so I have to recommend this lovely hotel and food we found the Chicken Curry is identically likes  to Sri Lankan palate.Lovely location and closer to tourist attraction so easy for shopping and people are nice in Nepal, we were at a Trade Fair where Nepal head of the state was Chief Guest.Thanks to Malla Staff

Es un buen hotel, buenas y espaciosas habitaciones, un poco pasado de moda, nuestro frigobar no funcionaba :( . El personal era muy amable y cordial, tiene un jardín muy grande y lindo, nuestra habitación tenía vista al mismo. Recomendable

Um hotel bom e suficiente com quartos confortáveis, relativamente perto da zona de thamel, staff atencioso, piscina, mas sem wifi gratis. O pequeno almoço é farto e bom. A estrada que se tem de percorrer entre o hotel e a zona de thamel é simplesmente horrivel quer no que respeita ao transito quer no que respeita ao estado da estrada!

E' un hotel che ha, senz'altro, visto tempi migliori, quando tutte le sue strutture erano aperte e funzionanti: l'ala del casinò e quella antistate l'ingresso. Nonostante questo conserva ancora un suo fascino, grazie anche al grande giardino, curato, con un piccolo stupa e con una voliera, ed alla struttura del corpo centrale, di una certa imponenza.  La hall, i corridoi e le camere, grandi e con servizi ( un po bui invero ) in marmo, anche se datati, sono comunque ancora belli e funzionali, per lo standard nepalese, anche se un po' di manutenzione gioverebbe ( serratura della camera "capricciosa", lampade non tutte funzionanti , ect.), considerando comunque il numero di stelle di cui si fregia. Wifi anacronisticamente non disponibile, se non a tempo e a pagamento, e anche caro e un po' ballerino. Colazione continentale tutto sommato decente. Il personale in generale è disponibile, in particolare quello ai piani. Non abbiamo provato il ristorante in quanto Thamel offre molta più scelta. Strategica invece la sua posizione: nella ring-road settentrionale, ai margini superiori di Thamel, è comodissimo per raggiungere, in 5 minuti a piedi, la bolgia del centro, ma è nel contempo tranquillo per il riposo notturno.

Fuimos en 2014 con el grupo de viaje de ciencias económicas. Al llegar al hotel nos recibieron muy calidamente y nos hicieron un bindi. Luego nos invitaron con una bebida típica del lugar. La atención es muy buena, la gente es muy cálida allí. La habitación excelente. Tiene un patio inmenso y hermoso, donde hicimos una fiesta muy divertida una noche. El restaurante y la comida excelente!! Muy recomendable!

Es un hotel modesto, pero confortable con lindos lugares comunes. El servicio es muy bueno, sobretodo el gastronómico dado que el buffet de desayuno y cena tiene gran variedad  de comida. Tiene lindos jardines con piscina

Bardzo przyjemny i zadbany hotel . Hotel blisko dzielnicy Tamel, Wokół hotelu duży  ogród. Obsługa hotelowa uprzejma i miła. Pokoje zadbane czyste. Na teranie ogrodu duży basen i centrum spa, W Hotelu sklep z pamiątkami. łazienki z prysznicem czyste. Ręczniki w pokojach wymieniane systematycznie

Es un Hotel grande  con lugares comunes amplios, y un jardin grande y muy prolijo. Durante el dìa se puede disfrutar de una linda piscina. Las habitaciones son grandes, pero están un poco descuidadas. Tiene una gran variedad de comida en el buffet, tanto en el desayuno como en la cena.

this hotel is near my house about 5 to 6 km in distance. i was there as a guide for foreigners. the food and rooms are nice.but a bit expensive. and late service.overall it is a better place to stay ..

Il est clair qu'on est plus dans le confort des hôtels indiens: chambre (316) exiguë, 2 lits single pour 1 nuit admettons mais pour 3... eau colorée au robinet, électricité approximative. Ma réclamation au desk pour obtenir une chambre avec un lit double a été poliment écoutée mais jamais exhaussée, trop de monde... ou pas envie de se bouger. Par contre, un service blanchisserie impeccable, courtois et ponctuel. Restauration plutôt bonne, petit déjeuner varié. Pas sûr que ce soit le meilleur choix d'hôtel à Katmandou, rue en travaux, environnement plutôt poussiéreux et bruyant. Quant à la piscine, verte à notre arrivée, elle avait repris une couleur décente à la fin mais pas au point d'avoir envie d'y faire trempette!

Abbiamo pernottato due notti in questo hotel perchè purtroppo all'Hotel Shangri-La non c'era posto. Il vantaggio di questo hotel è che si raggiunge il centro, Thamel, a piedi in poco tempo. Il posto è pulito, il giardino è carino. Noi avevamo la camera n. 417 con vista sul giardino che ha un simpatico piccolo stupa al centro. La camera è grande e comoda, così pure il bagno in marmo. Il tutto risente del peso degli anni anche se ancora funzionale. Il personale, ad esclusione dell'addetta al piano sorridente e gentile, possiamo definirlo indifferente, ma mai scortese. La colazione è sufficiente. Al ristorante non abbiamo mangiato.L'hotel ha una piccola saletta con un unico datato computer da dove è possibile collegarsi ad Internet gratuitamente. La struttura non è dotata di WiFi libero ma in ogni stanza è presente un computer, datato come quello della saletta, ad un costo decisamente eccessivo.
カトマンズには魅力的でリーズナブルな小さいホテルが多い中、大きいホテルにも宿泊してみたく、一泊してみました。びっくりするような安い価格で泊まれましたが、予想以上に大きなホテルで、部屋も世界的なホテルに近いような作りと清潔感でした。スタッフのサービスもレベルも高くカトマンズにいる事を忘れる様な少しリッチな気持ちになれました。

El hotel tiene unos amplios jardines, muy bien cuidados.La comida es muy rica, buffet amplio pero no varia de un día a otro. La habitación dejaba que desear, sabanas sucias, con roce, pedimos que las cambiaran pero las otras que pusieron también estaban con roce.Baño pequeño que se inundaba al bañarte.

Es un hotel bueno pero medio venido a menos. El principal problema que tuvimos fue el de la limpieza de las sábanas. Al ingresar pedimos que las cambiaran porque estaban sucias. Y las nuevas también estaban sucias con roce. Además la ducha tenía alguna filtración y hacía que se mojara gran parte del piso del baño, que no era nada grande.La comida sí era muy sabrosa, hasta puré encontramos.El entorno es muy pintoresco, cerca tiene una zona para hacer compras que es muy interesante y típica.

Il Malla è un buon hotel , le camere ai piani superiori sono le più belle, quelle nel piano sottoterra le sconsiglio.Buona la colazione, la cena a buffet e la cucina.Bar e sigarette troppo care. Non esiste la Wifi gratuita, viene consegnata una password oraria a pagamento.Vicino al Thamel e alla vita notturna di Kathmandu.

Hotel confortable, calme, à 10 minutes à pied d'un quartier commerçant où le shopping est roi. Les chambres sont spacieuses, douillettes avec un seul (gros) défaut: les fenêtres ferment mal ce qui fait que dès 5 heures du matin on se retrouve réveillés par les pigeons puis par les jets d'eau au dessus du spa. Dommage ça gache un peu le reste qui est plus que correct; les jardins sont magifiques, la restauration très bonne avec une mention spéciale au petit déjeuner, le personnel est souriant et serviable.

Buen hotel para descansar y huir del caos, ruido y estrés que produce la ciudad de Katmandú.El hotel dispone de un amplio Hall, con algunas tiendas, bar, terraza y un jardín muy tranquilo, donde poderse tomar un te tranquilamente e incluso ver algunos pájaros exóticos que tienen en unas jaulas, también dispone de piscina, tratamientos estéticos y masajes y cambio de divisas.Con respecto al personal, no tengo ninguna queja, atendieron a cualquier pregunta que tuvimos y el trato fue profesional y correcto.Las habitaciones son amplias y con todo lo que se le puede pedir a un hotel de estas características, la limpieza es adecuada y la insonorización perfecta, se nota que el hotel ya tienes unos años pero en general todo está más que correcto.Buen desayuno, con variedad de comida y te hacen tortillas o huevos revueltos en el momento.Al llegar a la habitación te dan dos botellas de agua y una cesta de fruta que todo ello incluido, además dispones de mini bar para cualquier otro consumo que necesites. Los baños disponen de jabón, champú, etc.La localización es buena, justo al lado de la zona de Thamel y de todo el bullicio de la ciudad, así que desde él puedes salir a pasear y volver andando, aunque si quieres ir más lejos no tendrás ningún para poder coger un taxi.En resumen, un buen hotel que te ayuda a descansar de la agotadora visita a esta cautivadora, estresante y vibrante  ciudad de Katmandú.

Another good example of a great lobby but dreadful rooms. We had room 706, looking out over the Award winning Garden. A pity the rooms are not Award winning. Our room was worn, dirty, curtains torn, Doors very dirty. Apparently no money is spend on keeping these rooms up to a certain standard. Breakfast was not very good. Perhaps the location, near to the Thamel district is the biggest attraction.

The patio and garden are nice and the swimming pool is cool - I managed to have great strokes in its 20 meters.However, the rooms (and actually the whole building) could well use some renovation.They charge for the internet but it is very slow.

Malla Hotel is set in it's own courtyard and in a great location just a few minutes walk from the commercial and touristy Thamel!  Initial impressions of the saluting commissionaire and the pleasant reception and public rooms are good, but we had room 104 which was on the ground floor and  any relationship to a 4 star hotel stopped as soon as we entered our bedroom...its' décor and facilities are in a sixties time warp that need updating and refurbishing and it's electric are positively a safety hazard...I spoke to a number of others who had rooms on this corridor and all without exception said the same....Perhaps rooms are better elsewhere in the hotel but sounds like the ground floor is one to avoid! Breakfast buffet was very good and staff were friendly and helpful! Pool and garden areas were nice at first glance but again both are not as well kept as first impression...struck me as a hotel that really needs a refurbishment.!   No kettle no hairdryer and no room safe all things you expect in a four star hotel. Bathroom was very much in the old sixties motel style and old fashioned...but what a strong water pressure from the shower...it pinned you against the wall! Ha ha!  Television was so large it barely had room on the side table to fit... To be fair the room was what you might term functionally obsolete! Décor tatty and fading!  First floor close to reception tended to be a little noisy due to the proximity to reception and early departing guests.

I LOVED❤ this place it was awesome, I loved the workers they were the best because they were so friendly and helpful, the food was perfection, and the decoration was old but classy I loved it. By the way all the people that thought the Malla Hotel didn't deserve 5 stars I don't know what happend when you were there but you must just be crazy because this place was bæ. I really loved the staff and I will never forget them especially the manager, I think, that wore suits, the talk skinny guy, the guy that was a little chunkier, and the room service lady! If they do see this I want them to know that was they were the coolest people I have ever met and I will always remember you. 😏 😑 🚖

A nice haven from the hustle and bustle of Thamel, which is only 5 minutes walk away.  Pool was brilliant - the ladies from the Salon were keen to get business though.  Seems inefficient in some areas and over efficient in others.  Rooms were nice - air con worked.  Mini bar was empty which wasnt a bad thing.   Room service was excellent.  Nice garden and some staff were excellent.  Needs a bit of a shake up and an overhaul - but the price was pretty good.

Estuvimos una semana en este hotel. La verdad deja mucho que desear, el lobby normal, las habitaciones con olor fuerte a humedad, el frigobar no funcionaba, el aire tampoco funcionaba, las sabanas manchadas un desastre.La comida y el desayuno bastante bien variado y abundante. La atencion del personal fue buena.La ubicacion del hotel es un lugar medio feo, aunque en katmandu todo parece que hubo un terremoto.No recomiendo este hotel.

Un hotel con un bel giardino a prato inglese, le stanze molto grandi e con ampie finestre, la nostra affacciava sul giardino e si vedeva l'alba. La colazione aveva un pò di tutto: dal salato al dolce. Un pò internazionale, un pò asiatico. La vicinanza col quartiere turistico Tamel è stata importante perchè era possibile uscire a piedi la sera per andare a cenare o comprare souvenirs, frutta, acqua o altro.

Me aloje en una habitación de tamaño normal con dos camas single, vista a la piscina. Durante toda la estadía (3 noches) se sintió un olor fuerte dentro de la habitación, posiblemente a nafta. El aire acondicionado funcionaba solo en el modo ventilador y muy ruidoso. El mini bar no funcionaba, para compensarnos un día nos dieron dos botellas con agua fría. Durante el día la luz se cortaba en reiteradas oportunidades pero volvía luego de unos minutos. El descanso fue bueno, no se escuchaban ruidos a pesar de estar ubicado en el medio de la locura de Katmandu. La cama cómoda pero no tenia sabana superior, el acolchado estaba manchado y para disimularlo lo tendieron con la mancha para abajo y hacia los pies.El agua tanto de la ducha como del lavatorio salía con suciedad.El desayuno normal, la cena variada.Wi fi paga y cara, y la señal era buena solo en el lobby.La atención del personal es cordial. El acceso al hotel esta totalmente descuidado entre la tierra. No volvería a este hotel entiendo que hay hoteles de mayor calidad en Kathmandu.

Das Malla ist als Stadthotel in Kathmandu absolut okay,praktisch gelegen, sauber und es verfügt über einen Park, der eine ideale Ruhe Oase und Kontrast zum hektischen Getümmel der Stadt bietet. Das Personal ist freundlich und das Frühstück ebenfalls in Ordnung. Alles in Allem eine absolut empfehlenswerte Unterkunft.

Es un muy buen hotel en medio de una ciudad muy alocada. Habitaciones bien, servicio bien. Comida buena. La ubicación está bien. Es una ciudad alocada, es conveniente ir a un buen hotel. Quizá haya algún otro más barato.

viel Licht und etwas Schatten zeichnen das Hotel aus.positiv - und ausschlaggebend für die Gesmtbewertung:Service und Stil des Hauses (letzterer zuweilen etwas zu bemüht)hervorragendes, sauberes  Zimmer in der zweiten Etage (Poolseite); alle Funktionen jederzeit  intakt; Frühstücksbuffet mit guter Auswahl und nie erlahmendem Kaffeservice;Wellnessangebot (erstklassige 90 min after-TrekkingMassage genutzt; vergleichbar zu thai-oil-massage) positv auch die Grünflächen/ kleinen Parks beidseitignegativ: Polster- , Einrichtung und Interieur teilweise in die Jahre gekommen; Zimmer Parkseite teils durch Froschkonzerte, Hahnenschreie und Generatorgeräusch beeinträchtigt; Eingangs-, Lobby und Loungebereich halten dem aüsserlichen TOP-Anspruch nicht  (mehr) stand.

Being in KTM, so far away from home (Florida, USA), we could not have been made to feel more at home than at The Malla. Lovely hotel, lovely and professional staff, (and a lovely garden court yard!). The rooms are very clean, good wifi, cable tv, nice pool, and massage & spa services to boot. The restaurant in the hotel made it so comfortable, with delicious fare and such nice service. It wasn't a surprise that from front desk, to house keeping, to restaurant, the attention to detail and warmth of the staff was so great, as the manager (Mr. Murari) is a tremendous hospitality leader, and treated us and all of the guests at the Malla as if they were, as I wrote at the start, home!We will be back in June! Thanks again, Lisa Srivastava

nice place to stay specially if you are looking to stay in mid of the city.nice cosy room with friendly staff. swimming area also average.only problems is the regular water logging in their bathroom which have very poor drainage facilities.overall the hotel is good

We stayed here for three nights. The hotel looks great o n the outside but has a tired feel inside. The room decor is worn . The food is OK and the staff are helpful and polite. The hotel offers two style of menu-french and nepali /indian. when we stayed there the hotel was not able to offer any tandoor cooked food. The swimming poold id not look as if it had had much attention -but it was the start of the trekking season

From the outer sight, the Malla Hotel wants to play in the higher division. As soon as you enter the room, you realise that it actually cannot keep up the appearance.The hotel lobby is the host for quite some redundant personnel, from saluting door sentinels to an irrelevant Guest Relation Officer.The room is fair equipped, but the cleanliness is poor and the room is sloppy (half painted walls). The bathroom has everything except a good air evacuation.The prices for optional services are exaggerated: WIFI costs are high while internet connection sucks. The bar and restaurant prices are too high.Depending on your the room location, you may be annoyed during the night from barking dogs in the neighbourhood.

wir reisten mit einer Gruppe und übernachteten mehrere Male im Hotel Malla. Leider bekommt man nur gerade am ersten Tag Wasser in Flaschen!!  Obwohl das Leitungswasser absolut ungeniessbar ist, auch für das Zähneputzen muss UNBDINGT Flaschenwasser verwendet werden. Auch Haarewaschen überlegt man sich gut bei diesem braunen Wasser. Von 6 Lampen im Zimmer brannte gerade mal eine! Zimmer hat extrem nach Zigarrenrauch gemieft. Gibt sicher bessere Hotels in der Stadt.

Stayed here for one day at the start of my trip and three days at the end . It was very quiet when I was there as it was out of season , everyone was very friendly from the door man to the cleaners . The food wasn't great & watch the prices of beer by the pool ! At least it's only 5mins from the main town

I stayed at the Radisson at the beginning and end of a trekking tour earlier this month. Firstly, the great strength of this hotel is its staff who are all unfailingly pleasant, polite and professional no matter what their respective roles are. They are a credit to the hotel and I hope all are valued and respected by management.My room was in the older wing of the hotel and was kept spotlessly clean on each of my stays. As other reviewers have noted, these rooms are well due for renovation, particularly the bathrooms (please install walk in showers when it’s time for updating). However, I was perfectly comfortable and secure throughout my time here and have no complaints whatsoever. One suggestion I do have is that the provision of bathrobes would be a welcome addition for guests. Overall, the Radisson is very pleasant and well located in Lamzipat. I have no hesitation in recommending it to future guests.

The hotel is great. The downfall that i experienced this time is the set up of breakfast buffet. The management i think must keep the area hygienic with or without covid. I saw plenty of guest standing next to the food corner having their food in the same area using their hands and take more food holding the serving spoon with the same hands. I think hotel staff must notify the guest to have their food in the table as a courtesy to the other guest. The hotel must also be proactive in cleaning up the excess food and sauce that is all around the serving area.

Full marks for all round excellent service -10/10. The staff were extremely courteous, good tasteful food variety at reasonable prices. The room was extremely comfortable with adequate facilities like iron/ironing board, hot water, multi international channels wide screen TV & coffee making. Room was always tidied on time.

As it was raining we went in at Radisson for a coffee. We asked for the coffee menu but was told there is none. We ordered three cafe lattes without seeing any menu or price and they were brought to the table cold. We sent them back in (to the not very big happiness of the staff claiming that it got cold on the way between the coffee bar and the table...) and long after we had finished the cake three new and hot lattes came out. They were not very esthetically appealing (latte art seems not to be in Radissons vocabulary) and too thin, but they were ok. We asked for the bill and came to know that just one of these luxurious coffees was worth $5. In Nepal an expensive latte will be around $3-4, this was pure cheating...

This is regarding my stay in kathmandu from 10th to 14th feb. At the time of check-In there were some items in my room like 2 kitkat chocolates, 1 choc wafers, 1 potato chips, 2 peanuts and 1 small cashewnut along with a soft drink..I assumed this would be complementary but at the time of check-out hotel charged me for these complementary items approx 4000 and they never told me this would be chargeable at the time of check-In. I visited so many 5 star hotels and have never experienced something like this, infact these type of small items were offered as a customer gesture. I never thought that Radisson hotel will do like this.

The hotel is good and staff is courteous. I have visited the hotel a couple of times which were quite please. The last visit was not so comfortable and hence writing this review. During my last visit there was a group of guests accomodate on my floor, having some party with room doors open, awake all night drinking and making noise which made the sleep really uncomfortable. Would appreciate if the staff can take a note of it and prevent such inconvenience in future. Although I did report this however not much was resolved except for some intervention which helped for a few hours. P.S. Do visit the casino if you are staying.

Radisson Kathmandu was extremely warm, welcoming and we had a perfect stay of about 2 weeks here with no complaints at all. The staff went out of their way to help us and we had one of our most memorable holidays. Very comfortable, great property, great food and great people. Rooms are perfect and have everything you would hope for. Amenities like swimming pool, gym, spa all very well maintained, adding on to the experience. Easily accessible to the airport and the market, and very prompt in helping you explore the place. Highly recommend!

My recent visit to Kathmandu Radisson was made unforgettable , From the moment I stepped in, the warm hospitality of the staff made me feel right at home. The well-appointed room provided all the comforts I needed, and the delectable meals at their on-site restaurant call "The Fun Cafe"  was  a treat for the taste buds. The breathtaking views from the   swimming pool area , perfect for unwinding after a day of exploring the area.I highly recommend Radisson Blue Kathmandu  to anyone seeking a tranquil and rejuvenating escape. Can't wait to return!

An excellent hotel.  The staff at the Radisson are very well trained, and so helpful in every way.  They all wanted to make our stay here a really great experience.  The Guest Relationship Manager sorted out any issues we had immediately and was so helpful.  Any questions you have about the city can be answered!  The breakfast was a delight with a wide range of foods from different cultures and all of an extremely high standard and quality.  We also ate in the restaurant in the evenings  because the food was so lovely. We stayed here three times during our trip in Nepal, using it as a base to leave luggage in-between trips and it was a pleasure to return to after our various travels.  The quality of the bedding is lovely with very soft sheets and pillows, and the cleanliness and hospitality is excellent.  During my next stay in Katmandu, I am not staying anywhere else!

If you're looking for a centrally-located hotel with an elite experience for business guests, look no further!  The Radisson Kathmandu goes out of its way to ensure that business guests receive VIP service.  In my 3 days here, I have met nearly all hotel staff, the food and beverage manager, and my favorite host, Sujan, who all have worked diligently to ensure an amazing stay. Coffee as I prefer, food I prefer, room kept well - excellent!

I stayed at the Kathmandu Radisson Hotel for the first time. The stay was generally good, although their internet is too weak to do a stable Whatsapp call. Buffet breakfast was good. Buffet dinner was cold one night due to a problem with food warmers, but the kitchen kindly reheated the food for us. Noisy guests arrived on my last night and talked loudly all night, turned up TV so loudly I could hear every word, but I told reception and they called them and turned it down. Very nice staff, although door staff are clearly more respectful/nicer to white European/American tourists, than black Africans so they need some training to treat all guests equally.

Hotel management should take care of loyal customers those come to hotel. Old rooms need makeover. Members should get some privilege and priority. Breakfast menu should have different types of foods varieties.

Radisson speaks for itself, in Kathmandu it is located in Lazimpat which is walking distance to Thamel ( popular) market and very close to their heritage sites and temples. Hotel has 2 different buildings, 1 is new and even the older one is quite well maintained. I am a fitness person and their gymnasium was great and typically  you wouldn't find such gym's in a business hotel. Wide variety of cuisines, has a casino, banquets and open area for parties. More than anything their staff is super pleassing and very supportive,  I give full points to their helpful staff and nice big clean rooms. A brilliant hotel in a brilliant location.

The hotel is located close to tourist spots and the hotel itself is very clean and easily accessible in terms of location. Customer safety and customer service is also top notch. The rooms are clean enough, the kitchen/food is acceptable. The only thing missing from my room was a minibar and an iron, but this was easily made up for by the hotel's many other perks. In a word - I recommend to stop there during your trip to Kathmandu.

Nice hotel with great staffs behaviour. Highly respectful and courteous. Food options are also good and room service was great. It is in the center of the city so you can go anywhere within 20-30 min. CBD like Newroad and Thamel are nearby

Radisson Blu Kathmandu continues to offer a exceptionally high level of service and comfort. Especially in the COVID times, I saw that all the staff were following the protocols and this was very reassuring. The internet service was very good and stable and this turned out to be a big plus for a business traveler like me.

Hotel’s location is good. Food is very average. There was no taste in breakfast buffet. Even the food that I orders in my room for dinner was average. I would like to appreciate Ramhari Thakur, who served me breakfast was very humble and friendly. The moment I entered in the restaurant, he found me a decent seating. He served me all hot and fresh meals. I asked him for the places to visit nearby. He helped me in that too. I would give him 7 star rating for being such a nice and genuine person.So my five stars are for ramhari and not for hotel

Overall experience is good, some visualization is required in rooms example visualization on switches of lights, lamps and sockets etc. Elevator required maintenance, little noisy.  Rest all parts are perfectly maintained.

Stayed six months in the penthouse suite, business trip, and was totally impressed with the staff as well as the facilities.  Everyone from the front desk to the concierge to the housekeepers to the drivers were very helpful and friendly.  The location is also a plus.  Nice neighborhood with plenty of excellent restaurants in the area.  It is an easy walk to Thamel and other points of interest.  Highly recommended!

I stayed at Radisson KTM for 2 nights after successfully completing my Annapurna Circuit Trek.Check In/Check Out was a breeze. Currency Exchange facility is a big plus. I went for the Trekker’s Massage at Tranquility Spa. Something that was needed and totally worth it. Rooms are super comfortable and the staff is extremely helpful.Covid related protocols are followed all the time on the premises and one feels safe.The location is excellent with a short walk to Thamel. All in all, a fantastic experience. Highly recommended. Look forward to staying here again.Also, if you’re taking the flight out of KTM, do visit the Radisson Airport Lounge. Again, highly recommended.Thank you Team Radisson for making my stay memorable and comfortable.

The Hotel has always been very receptive. The staff is well mannered and courteous. Food is good.Rooms are well appointed, neat. Spa is good.Only thing to improve is A.C during winters, this works only on heating mode. The only option to cool the room is to switch off the A.C.

The team at Radisson Kathmandu went out of their way the make my stay absolutely memorable. Surprise cake for my birthday and delivered to my room. Every single member of staff helped in making me feel at home and been extremely helpful throughout the entire stay, and made all aspects of my life easier and more comfortable. It is much appreciated! Rajiv Upadhyaya and SUNAM SHRESTHA have even managed to support me in getting PCR test at the hotel premises and last-minute helping me fill online Airsuvidha to travel back to India. Special thanks  Sunam & the team. I will be back and recommend it to friends and family, Namaste!

We stayed in raddisson for 3 days and what a roller coaster experience First day the hotel staff in front office refused to give us the desired room for which we had booked almost a month and a half before .. after a lot of intervention by our travelCoordinator they gave us the room . Then the food the first day was bad , half cooked mutton curry , hard roties and salted veggies .. our package had buffet but we were offered alacart n with limited choices .. it was a bad day n experience we almost thought of checking out Then after we complained the next day it was the best experience, we got upgraded rooms , excellent services by the staff and what a food .. the chef wa. Personally taking care of our food requirements Best dessert n non veg n veg dishes as per our taste were prepared and what awesome services A trip to remember And dessert n mutton rogan josh Taste  still lingers

Pathetic Furnishing Material Quality, Most Uncomfortable mattress a Hotel can Provide.... Zero Customer Service even if a Customer is Unwell.... Poor Maintenance of Equipments. 04 Sleepless Nights wasted Money... Radisson should leave this property instead of Ruining their Brand Name.

Myself and my colleague were totally mesmerized by the experience of staying at Radisson hotel in Kathmandu. Each and everything they do is the best anyone do for you to give that wonderful experience. Food is exceptional and very rarely you get such authentic Indian and western food at one place. Those who love to Gym will be pleasantly surprised with a Hi-Tech gym that's better than most of the Gold Gym's in the big cities. Location of the hotel is just in the center of he city and at walking distance from British and Indian Embassy. Airport pickup and drop service is very good.

Stayed in the newly constructed part of the hotel. View was good with very good breakfast. Staff very caring and hospitable. Terrace garden caffe is goid for evening coffee or dinner. Adjoining area is full of shops and restaurants. Main hotel lobby is good for meetings or gatherings where one can order drinks and snacks etc. Ask for a higher level room for a better view.

Well equipped but you pay for it. Great food is in the street out front at more affordable prices. Now the bad news… despite numerous requests the fridge in the room isn’t working and everything I bought cold is now room temperature. It wouldn’t matter but I am confined to the room so have nothing cold despite having bought it cold. I can’t store things and eat them later. Definitely not 5* facilities. There many other places and cheaper

Amazing hospitality, needs more option in Indian mughlai cuisine,Was expecting a good location. But anyways it's in Lazimpath main area, so no issues. Some items in restaurant was in expensive side. As it's my opinion, it's similar to Hayaat, which has a great property. So needs to reduce prices in comparison to Hayaat.

Stayed at the annexe which has been recently renovated and well maintained.Staff was very helpful and courteous right from the hotel entrance , checkin , housekeeping and restaurant service.Airport pick up was arranged in short time and waited even though the flight was delayed

Radisson Kathmandu is a perfect hotel to stay in the city of Kathmandu. The staffs are welcoming and exceptional most especially the staff Prajeena. She can communicate well, so generous, and compassionate. She took care everything and exceeded my expectations in Radisson. Because of Prajeena, I had an unforgettable stay in Radisson. Breakfast and dinner are sumptuous, most of the facilities such as body massage, fitness gym, pool, sauna, jacuzzi, steam bath are available also. Definitely this hotel is highly recommendable to my family and friends.

Had the good fortune to stay at the Radisson after my flight was delayed overnight. Chef Subash Naral's wood ear mushroom curry was absolutely delicious and a real treat. Would stay here again just for the buffet.

I have been to Kathmandu many times on business and have stayed at the Radisson Hotel from the beginning and this is my fourth stay. All the staff are very friendly and the rooms and other facilities are a bit dated but always kept clean. What I particularly like about this hotel is the breakfast. Not only do they have Nepalese food, but they also have a wide variety of delicious breads, fruits, yoghurts and juices, and I never got bored of them, even though I stayed here for 10 nights again. Food is not the only thing to look forward to at breakfast. The female staff member, Manita bisural, who makes the omelettes and waffles, always has a beautiful smile on her face and makes me very happy in the morning. The waffles she makes are very tasty. She speaks to me kindly and I looked forward to seeing her every morning, even when I was staying alone last year. This year I saw her kindly explaining and serving the food to other guests. The guests, who seemed to be from Europe and America, seemed very happy to see her. When I come to Kathmandu, I choose this hotel partly because I want to see her smile. The other staff are also very friendly. I would recommend this hotel.

The hotel was clean and comfortable. And the staff was very courteous and attentive to the needs of guests, especially the staff at The Fun Cafe. When I was down with a sore throat, they made me a drink of hot water with lemon, honey and ginger and served it complimentary. As a solo woman traveller, I felt comfortable and safe staying there. Keep up the good service!

Loved staying at the at the Radisson before and after our Manaslu trek. Facilities and rooms are very good. The staff are friendly and helpful and always have a smile on their faces. The highlight was Manita’s custom omelettes at breakfast - highly recommended.

We are writing to you to express our dissatisfaction with the service we received at your hotel. Our stay was not up to our expectations, and we feel that the quality of service delivered was poor. We would not recommend your hotel to anyone. I have never seen in my life a local Coca-Cola bottle used in the bar of a 5-star hotel, but I have seen it in your hotel.

Poorly managed and maintained property.I stayed for 3 days. Wardrobe were about to fall, phone not working, no one answering, dirty windows and what not. On top of that servive team has no reply to why property is not maintained properly. It seems like a 3 star hotel and not at all a 5 star Radisson level property.

We stayed at Radisson Kathmandu during our trip to Nepal and was astounding by the service of the hotel. Right from Airport Pick Up, to Check in during stay and Check Out l have never experienced a more professional and brilliantly run hotel. Moreover the thoughtful effects in the room, like a weighing scale for your baggage, toiletries which are replenished without you having to ask, no questions asked currency exchange at the reception are just a few examples of the brilliant service.

Everything of my stay at Radisson was wonderful, I have used Radisson in few other countries as well but service that we received at Kathmandu Radisson was outstanding. Food was delicious and several options to select. The best part of our stay was food and service in which Ramhari played very important role. He is the best staff in Radisson. Overall it’s a clean & safe hotel. Definitely recommended

Hotel was far below the average stay I’ve experienced in other radisson properties. In the name of premium rooms, we were moved to adjacent building. This building has a very poor reception and helpdesk, rooms are average and poor interior, breakfast Servuce is below average. I would prefer other properties next time and shall suggest the same to my other colleagues.

The staff at Radisson Kathmandu always take excellent care of me whenever I am in Kathmandu with consistent high-quality service,. This was especially true in my most recent visit when I had a medical emergency in the middle of the night. The hotel manager rushed me to the ER at the closest int'l hospital and ensured my well-being until my colleagues arrived. Thanks for your great care and excellent service!

I’m very happy with the accommodations, service and support 😊😊 All the members and staff are very helpful. I will again visit and recommend all to visit this Hotel 👍. The location was very good and very easy to find . Regarding from my opinion everything thing was best here. The  food was very good and especially thank to the Chef for making such a delicious food 😊😊😊.

I went to the hotel to enjoy the spa, it was excellent. Would recommend going here for a massage, value for money is good as well, and the team is very professional and friendly.Will be returning the next time im in Kathmandu.

Stayed at the hotel on several occasions. This time we stayed there for 5 days.The rooms are always clean and comfortable. The staff are welcoming and friendly.There is always a wide range  food for breakfast. The breakfast team are amazing.A staff that is outstanding is a young lady called Manita who always  makes an effort to come and talk to us and suggest  breakfast that she can make for us.  We always look forward to seeing Manita when coming down for breakfast she is obviously an asset for the hotel.

Decent hotel for the area. Difficult to cross the main road however as a stop before trekking is fine. There 8s a sister hotel across the dead end road where located that has steak on the menu!  The wait staff is overly attentive. Not much into this but this must be their work ethic. Not a problem though.

The hotel was very neat and clean, and the room setting was very nice done. Like all the staff around during my stay.I loved the breakfast buffet. the staff was good, but the lady the Omlet maker named Manita was extremely caring and friendly staff.She introduced to me crispy dossa, which I would never know that it's in breakfast buffet. She went inside the kitchen to order it for me.That's what it makes her standing out among her colleagues.  I noticed whenever she is not make Omlets she is moving around and talking to the guests who were having their breakfast. I wish her all the best with her future endeavours!!!Saeeda Sydney ( Australia )

As  always Radisson  gives its best to its customer. My stay at Radisson  Kathmandu was very comfortable  and enjoyable. Rooms looks quite new  with great view on higher floor but not able to see the mountains  from the rooms  may be the reason being rainy time. I will love to stay  again  this type of clean and new room. Break fast is superb  with european style  but seen  Indian dishes more.

Disappointed by continually having lunch bill thrust under my nose while still eating. Really insulting. The doormen were amazing and friendly. Front counter staff are brusque but competent. Most of the dining staff were friendly and helpful with the exception of the incident previously mentioned

It was a memorable stay at Radisson Kathmandu.  I like the property, rooms, bedding, dining, special care by dining staff, room service, concierge and house keeping.  Front desk team did a phenomenal job, they are courteous and well caring.  Location of the Hotel is awesome.

I got there around 9:00am.  Asked them if they have room available,  lady at counter pointing to sign saying check in time is 15:00.  Asked me for id and made photo copy of our passport.  We had lunch buffet at around 2:00pm. Got there half of food was empty.  So,  we booked king size bed told we only have twin and combined to make king.  Asked manager, are you manager?  He asked someone else to handle complaint instead of listening to me.

you will notice their hospitality and kindness of Nepali from the entrance, receptionist, deli and  housekeeping,Hotel offers local and continental breakfast at spacious restaurant area. Many kinds of bread to choose from and I enjoyed it the most. Room was clean and with very comfortable bedding. One thing is that right next to my room was a construction site of the next building. Construction noise was noticed, but it was okay. I would definitely recommend this hotel if you are in the area.

Me and my husband went there in occasion of our anniversary .we have booked buffet dinner. We had great time there .There is variety of nepali dish . I am happy about what I pay and I have good memory about that dinner .I have been to many places after that but the food for nepali that time was really nice .They are very much careful about the taste and they totally deserve the 5 star rating . I guess I was there on 2019  and I don't write the review like the foreign but it totally deserve to give the 5 star after I compare with other star hotel .Very smart waitre  and best hospitality,I am eager to go again for the same hygenic food and they have  maintain best standard in buffet dinner.❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️

Great service when we arrived, friendly and warm welcome, even  we arrived very early due to our flight schedule. All personnel were very friendly and helpful in getting us settled in the hotel and in Kathmandu. We ordered breakfast to go the day after, as we needed to depart early, and this was the only point where we experienced opportunities for improvement. The food was not too fresh and no coffee or tea was offered, where it was most needed at 5:30. That said, still a great overall experience and somewhere we would book again!

My stay at Radisson Hotel Nepal was truly exceptional. The daily breakfast, especially the delicious omelets, was a standout feature. Kudos to Manita and Anu for their outstanding hospitality, making my holiday even more enjoyable :)

As what can be expected of a Radisson Hotel, the staff is very friendly, food is great (both breakfast with a lot of variety and dinner with helpful staff). They have an excellent gym for those who want to work out and a great spa as well. Rooms are clean and the beds are good. So I can recommend this place to everyone who is planning to stay in Kathmandu!

It was a wonderful experience at Radisson hotel Kathmandu. This was my second experience with Radisson hotel chain and must say, Radisson hotels do not fail to please customers. It provides top class service with a humble and courteous staff. All your staff including reception and house keeping staff do not let customer feel down. For them customer is supreme and it makes the experience memorable. Mr. Rajesh Paudel at The Fun Cafe made my Buffet Dinner experience memorable with his courteous service. I have no words to explain the service i enjoyed at hotel. Even Darbans ( Door keeper) were doing their job best.Overall more than 100% happy with your serviceThank you

I lost my laptop inside Radisson Hotel in Kathmandu during my stay there on Nov 1 to Nov 6, 2016, but the hotel dealt with it very badly. What happened is the following. On November 2, at about 6:30am, I checked out my room in Radisson hotel, because I and my team had to take an early morning flight to Bhairahawa for a site visit. I stored my luggage at the hotel and only carried a small backpack with me. Then we had our breakfast in the hotel. At about 7:15am, we left the hotel. The Government of Nepal who invited us to visit the country kindly provided a government vehicle to send us to the airport.  By the time we arrived at the airport I realized that I left my laptop in my room in the hotel. I immediately called hotel and informed the reception about it and ask him to send someone to collect it and keep it for me. I left my local phone number to the person and asked him to call me back once they get my laptop. About 20 minutes later, I called the hotel again. This time another person picked up the call and again promised to check my room and call me back. About 10 minutes later I called again and this time the person at the reception told me that they did not find my laptop in my room. Since the boarding has already started, I told the person to report to hotel management and search it for me. On Nov 4, at noon time, we came back from the site visit and checked in Radisson hotel again. I asked about my laptop and the reception told me they did not find it. Then I went to see the duty manager, and the duty manager apparently was not even aware of the conversation I had with The reception on Nov 2. After I explained what happened, she first suspected that I may have kept my laptop in my luggage which I stored in the hotel. So we opened and searched the luggage together and did not find the laptop. At that point, she said she would ask the security officer to carry out investigation including checking CCTV footages. Then I went out for my meetings in different ministries in the afternoon. In the evening when I went back to the hotel and asked for results of the investigation. One security officer came and explained to me that they checked all CCTV videos and did not find anyone carry anything out from my room in the morning of Nov 2. I asked if I can watch those videos and the official said yes. So my colleague and I went together with that security officer to the monitoring room. He showed to us the video clips from the cameras that were installed on the 4th floor where my room was located. We saw that after I left my room at about 6:15am, one housekeeping person (the same person) went in and out of my room three times, at about 6:30am, 6:40am and 7:06am respectively. On the third visit, the house keeping person spent about 2 minutes in my room. When he came out of my room his hands look empty. But when he walked towards the elevator and got closer to the camera, we ( three of us) saw clearly a square shape hard object on his belly underneath his uniform. We replayed back that video several times and we (including my colleague and the security officer) can conclude there was an object hiding inside this person's uniform. I asked the security person to protect this video from being damaged and deleted and he promised he would do that and he would also report it to his security manager. On the next day, I reported the loss of my laptop to the metropolitan police, and the police immediately sent two inspectors to the hotel to check those video clips. However when police arrived in the hotel, the hotel's security officers refused to show those videos. They said they could not play the videos because they were encountering some technical problems, and they need at least three hours to resolve the problem. So police and us left. About 4 hours later, When my colleagues and I came back to the monitoring room in the afternoon, the security officers of the hotel told us that now they can play the videos, but the video clips for the period from 6:35 am to 8:00 am, the most critical time of the incident, were lost. Moreover, only the video clips of those three cameras on the 4th floor where my room was located, and only that 1.5 hours video clips got lost. All other video clips of all cameras are still there. Apparently someone deliberately deleted those critical video clips. At that moment, I think something totally wrong was happening in the hotel. It is no longer about one individual of the hotel who may have done something bad. I think something much bigger and much more systemic is going wrong in the hotel. It is also not about my laptop any more. It is about security and safety of many more guests and every guest who would visit Nepal in the future with very good expectation. Before I left the hotel, I requested for a thorough investigation on this case and get to the bottom on what exactly happened. Unfortunately, up to date, the hotel management has given no single word to me - no apologies and no explanation - as if nothing had happened. I am a frequent traveler, and I used to stay in Radisson a lot when I travelled to India and other countries. With this bad experience in Radisson in Kathmandu, I don't think I will stay in any Radisson any more in the future.

ネパールではよいと思います。価格も高いですし、当然といえば当然のことですが。ただ同じグループの他国よりは、設備が劣ります。お風呂の水は、目で見てわかる薄い茶色でした。今回だけだったと思いますが、朝6時くらいからどこかの部屋の工事をするような音が、15分くらいしていました。フロントの接客は、問題ありません。ホテル評価ではありませんが、ホテル前の土産物店(いろいろなショップがあります)ですが、両替商もあります。各店舗では、JCBカードが使えます。日本語がしゃべるスタッフのいるお店もあります。他地域へ行っても同じようなものを売っているお店がありますので、慌てて買う必要はありません。値段も他と比べて、高くも安くもありません。値引きをしてくれる店もありますから、交渉してみてください。カシミア、ヒーリングボール(仏教で使う鐘のようなもの)、刀剣(飾り物)、革製バックなどがあります。

It is wise to remember that Nepal is undergoing some growing pains. When you finally get past passport control and collect your luggage you will be met (if you set it up with the hotel) by a driver and are escorted to your waiting Hotel shuttle, tipping is considered polite.First of all, understand that the hotel consists of three buildings. The Original building, the "new annex" and the Corner Bar above the Corner Bakery. The rooms were neat and clean..a bit worn around the edges in spots. I was very satisfied with the bathroom configuration and the bed/pillows. I was checked in on the 6th floor room with executive level privileges. The lounge was across the parking lot in the other building. The Hotel staff were very nice and I overheard the desk staff speaking multiple languages. English being the most common, along with Nepalese. I was very comfortable in the room and the hotel provided a newspaper and turn down service in the evening. Bring a small LED type flash light and always carry it with you. Kathmandu suffers from frequent power outages and while I suspect that the Hotel has a generator, it gets dark in the hotel until the generator kicks on. If you happen to be outside walking, it pays to have it with you at night to see where you are going. Keep in mind that power surges are not gentle on electronic equipment, so unplug whatever you are charging when you are done. The Wi-fi was slower than I expected (512k) but the signal was sufficient in most locations in the hotel and in the room. Since I travel with a mini router, I was able to plug into the Cat-5 port in the room. The hotel provides a code for Wireless and Wired access. One device per code. If you are traveling with more than one person, you will need a code for each person...every 24 hours.Breakfast seems to have improved since some of the prior reviews. You may still want to wait until about 6:45 before you head down. Not everything is in place promptly at 6:30am. Standard fare, and above average for this part of the world. Eggs cooked to order and if you want coffee, ask for brewed coffee...I did get some Nescafe a few times before I learned to ask for brewed.I was fortunate to meet the new General Manager who was on site during my stay. She was very helpful and was very receptive to my impressions and suggestions.The area is off the main street by a few hundred yards. I see this is beneficial as the main street noise can get quite loud.Overall, I see some changes being made (based on the comments of prior reviewers) and when I go back to Kathmandu, I will stay here again. The new General Manager has a challenge with power and internet infrastructure, but improvements are already evident.

GM to complain about the shortcomings and was promised 100 times that he would see me during my stay, neither did I see him, nor have I heard from him to date.Car for pick from airport was clean but drop back was similar to being in a just erupted volcano area, i.e. full of dust and filthy, my brand new suit needed special dry cleaning.Good points: breakfast and food is very good and the buffet is value for money. Staff are very courteous and polite. But what's the use when you can't get proper sleep. Unless they sort out the AC problem, I would never recommend this hotel to anyone.
ホテルの周辺にはスーパーもあり、 カトマンドゥの中心地タメル地区からも徒歩圏なので、とても便利でした。カトマンドゥでは定期的な停電があります。停電してもすぐに自家発電に切り替わるのでストレスなく滞在できました。ただし、お風呂の水は薄い茶色でした。 インフラは期待しない方がいいと思いますが、ネパールではよい方だと思います。

I stayed here for 3 nights with my husband after our amazing trek. The rooms are stuffy and the service is very poor. And don't ever eat at this hotel. The food is really bad, even the breakfast. Don't recommend anyone staying here, specially not for the price.

We started and ended our tour of Nepal here. The rooms are huge and very well equipped. Staff are helpful and courteous. The food has a fantastic selection, even for me being a vegan. It is also very close to some good shops for buying last minute souvenirs.

Everything was up to the level as expected. The room was big and nice with everything necessary, nice swimming pool, nice cafe on the 4th floor of the new building, very welcoming personnel. Internet was ok as well
市内の喧噪と埃を避けつつ、周りはお土産屋、スーパー、レストランがそこそこあって便利。部屋は十分なスペースがあり、設備、アメニティなども申し分ありません。バンケットやロビーなど含め、安心してくつろげるホテルと思います。ちょうど年末最後の日にガラディナーを予約しましたが、非常に楽しい雰囲気でした。

My wife and myself tried to eat at the Buffet last night, it was about 7.30pm, but very little food was available. No Soup, all the meat and vegetable containers were empty, and all desserts and ice cream was empty. We spent nearly 1 hour asking every staff member we could find for some food, it's coming was all they could say. Also spoke to reception and a duty manager, but still nothing. A waste of time and money, shame on you Radisson.

New building is what you'd expect from the Radisson.  Old building is run down and extremely poor value.  Save half the money and stay at a local option if you can't be guaranteed a room in the new building.  Don't forget to request a non-smoking room as they won't offer the option.  Front desk is manned by arrogant, rude jerks, while everyone else at the hotel seems delightful.  Too many inconsistencies to recommend this hotel.  It is also a bit of a hike away from anything interesting.

Was there from June 17th to 21st. Was there with Family and had taken 2 rooms in the hotel. I had a complimentary airport transfers but they said complimentary return is only for international and not domestic terminal which is very strange because domestic and international terminals are adjacent. you have to pay if the pick up or drop to is from domestic. Staff is not at all friendly. Very limited options for vegetarians even at the breakfast buffet. They agree to get you stuff but then you have to remind them 5-6 times and it takes about 1 hr before it arrives. When you try and escalate it to the staff they just don't care about it.  Not worth the price for such a service. Worst radisson property i have stayed at. Rooms are okay.

The Radisson is in a great location, close to many good restaurants and within walking distance of Thamel. Excellent service, friendly staff, great rooms and facilities, huge buffet breakfast and service with a smile!

From the moment we arrived to the hotel we were misinformed.First we were told the room would be ready in 90mins, but when we came back they still needed another 30min to clean the room which was very disappointing.Second, the girls at the reception in the new wing need some serious service-training because they are definitely not 5 star worthy material! There wasn't a single smile or welcoming attitude from her at any of the times we spoke to her. This is definitely not what you expect at a internationally known 5 star hotel.We had a room in the new wing but already 10mins after we entered the room the toiletflush fell down and the water started to run without any reason.Interior is really worn down for a so-called "new-wing".The outdoor pool is so-so but the indoor public poolfacilities is laughable.Restaurant in the mainbuilding was very noisy, extremely slow waiters and served some of the worst food I have had this year.To sum up this is definitely not worth any money and I would actually prefer to stay at the nearby hostel.

We had 2 nights at the Radisson in November. We were upgraded to a business class room by either the hotel or tour company (SITA). It was brilliant to come home to of luxury after a long international flight on the first night and a long day of sight-seeing on the second. We had lamb chops in the restaurant - very tasty and not expensive for a 5* hotel. We did the Everest flight on the next morning and the flight was delayed due to bad weather and got back after 10:00 - the breakfast closing time. Our guide told the hotel and they kept the buffet open just for us - brilliant to get such personal service from such a large hotel. The room was great (everything including air conditioning worked perfectly) and the staff were excellent.  We were there during the fuel embargo and it did not impact at all.The supermarket at the end of the road in front was good for extra bottles of water etc and had some other interesting shops. Be wary of the jewellers though - we bought some aquamarine earrings (£125) which turned out to be blue topaz worth a fraction of what we paid (£50). They are no less nice than when we bought them but nobody likes being cheated.

Stayed for almost 2 weeks while on business. Stayed at the annex which has nicer rooms with the downside being that you had to walk to the main building for breakfast and also to use the gym. Staff friendly, courteous and helpful. Decent gym but confusing layout in two levels. Centrally located with eating options in Lazimpet and Thamel. .

カトマンズ屈指の5星ホテルだと思います。スタッフの質も比較的高く、部屋も幾つかのタイプがあり、自分に合ったグレードを選ぶことができるようです。4Fと5Fにはトレーニングジム、スパ、プールがありますが、カトマンズの喧騒を忘れることができ、もし天気が良ければ朝夕にヒマラヤの遠望を望むことができます。最近、中国からの団体客が増えてきて、その対応によってはマイナス点が発生しますが、これはどこのエリアも同じだと思います。泊まった時、2機あるエレベータの1つが故障しており、待たされた事が残念でした。

The hotel is located in a good business area next to antic shops and few meters away from the main road, next to other residence facilities.  The main road is full of shops, restaurants and small markets. The connection between the main road and the hotel is a small street with shops at the two sides and couple of restaurants and night club. The hotel is well furnished; rooms are comfortable in area and facility. Staffs are friendly and supportive. the new building of the hotel id fancy, but i did enjoy the stay i the old building. The loopy of the hotel is wide open and relaxing environment, furnished with sofas arranged in small areas of sitting for the privacy.

Stayed here from 30 May - 1 June 15 on an official visit. In the main building, on fifth floor, I could not have any reception for Wifi at all. Despite several  repeated requests, it was not working and if worked, only for a short while at a time needing you to call reception again. Eventually, I was offered a room on first floor. In addition, the AC in the room was temperamental, the bath taps were old and on the verge of breaking. Except one, all other restaurants in the hotel were closed, which was not made clear on the hotel's website. The staff was friendly and the ambience was nice. I am not sure if it is indeed good value for money, should have gone for other top-ranked hotels in Kathmandu for a fraction of its price. Lesson learnt.

Thank You so much for being so helpful. I feel short of words to describe how protected we all felt because of your constant efforts to provide us with whatever you could,be it bedsheets or juice or fruits to eat. I am one of the Nepal earthquake survivors and the credit goes to your efficient staff,their credibility. We were under constant scrutiny by you people,that came to us as a morale booster. I am only able to post this today because of your help. I am home, I am safe. I am sound. A big thank you from me and my team.
