A well located hotel for business. Would return to this hotel any day. Very comfortable.  Just a bit far to walk to Thammel Market but the little shops in the same street are very good.  The rood top restaurant is beautiful and very relaxing to sit out there at night.

Radisson in Kathmandu is well located for a conference, especially when you have lots of local participants who want to minimize their driving time. The hotel proved very helpful when it started raining and the conference dinner had to be shifted from their open air rooftop restaurant

Nice place... nice service... They upgraded to premium room...nice open garden restaurants...Have enjoyed stay.. Highly recommend. You get very well greeted on entering to hotel. Very efficient front desk staff.

We stayed three nights during a tour of Northern India and Nepal. Like the proverbial curate's egg it was good and bad.The hotel looks somewhat aged (and aging) and probably needs refurbishment. Our room was of a good size but it did look a little "tired". The air-conditioning was pretty abysmal and did not significantly reduce the temperature - and this was also the view of other fellow travellers about their rooms. There was a bath (good!) but the single tap was misaligned. If it was turned on much more than a trickle the water came out in a round spray and hit the top front edge of the bath. From there it flowed down the side of the bath to form a large pool on the floor which eventually found its way to a drainage hole which might have been for all I know designed to cope with this exigency. It took ages to run a bath without creating this effect and the water was not hot enough anyway.The breakfast bordered on poor. Coffee was often not hot enough, they could not supply my wife with an egg which was not hopelessly runny and there was a toaster at which you could end up dead of old age before it delivered toast at the second pass through. The evening meal in the café was also modest although my breaded fish was acceptable. There was another restaurant - I think it was called "The Olive Tree" - which was very good and where four of us thoroughly enjoyed an evening meal of Italian style.But there were things in the hotel which went well. There is a bar called "the Corner House" in the hotel complex and run by the hotel about 100 yards from the main building which was excellent. It was pleasant to sit in and the service was first rate. In addition there was a Happy Hour running from 16.00 to 19.00 where two drinks could be purchased for the price of one. We made use of this facility. There was free wifi which in the main worked although my wife, first time, had to obtain from the reception three different long numerical codes as passwords before she obtained contact. The main shops adjacent to the hotel sold tourist souvenirs but there are a couple of money changing shops offering slightly better rates than the hotel and at the end of the street, partly obscured, a reasonable sized supermarket although the prices looked a bit high for Nepal.I read in a local newspaper that a new general manager had been appointed to the hotel and we actually exchanged morning greetings when we passed her. I think that she has a bit of a job to do but I wish her luck - the rogue bath tap can be found in room 316. As per my heading, this is a reasonable hotel which I am not knocking but it can be improved - it is not difficult to adjust a toaster!

i stayed in new building. Great room, but view of car park (ugly though occasionally interesting) and noisy from night club opposite with poor taste in music and dogs barking (possibly in protest at music?) Buffet food very good, room service food not so. Staff were great, but nothing can make up for the dreadful internet - a clumsy and irritating password system to a facility that kept going down and sometimes was completely unavailable. Hotel location is okay-ish; not really near anything, but not too far away. A nice row of tourist shops just outside (somewhat over-priced of course, but i guess they have to cover the rent) anyway convenient and good selection, plus a good supermarket, ATMs and an excellent pizza restaurant on the corner.

Rotten food buffet and highly unprofessional staff is what you will encounter at Radisson nepal...We stayed here for 4 days unfortunately and the overall experience was awful. Here goes the breakfast menu..day 1- idli,sambar with rotten coconut chutney,grilled tomatoes,and french toast..day 2- idli sambar with rotten coconut chutney grilled tomatoes and french toast...day 3- chole bhature..day 4 chole bhature.....Chefs at radisson are well trained in recycling the left over food....for more adventurous pallet you can try their Chinese food from room service...i can assure you that you will never ever dare to eat chinese anywhere in the world.In case you plan to stay here after reading these comments(obviously if ur left with no choice)...i would like to give you a tip...just be quiet and do not complaint,this way you will spare yourself of the embarrassment that can cause due to grumbling and murmuring staff...also do not expect the staff to resolve your queries since they have no knowledge on the services that they provide.I had taken the servoice for their tranquility spa and wanted to do some changes in my timing, but no staff was able to help me...also on the breakfast table i had asked for some hot bhatures....and i am still waiting...

ネパールナムチェトレッキングの際、カトマンズでの滞在で3日間お世話になりました。アルパインツアーサービス株式会社のアレンジでした。ほかに四つ星ホテルに泊まった経験がなく比較はできないのですが、感じたことを書きます。中心地区タメルから徒歩10分ほど。おなじくらいの距離にクライミングジムもあり、個人的にとても便利でした。また帰宅する時には、タクシーの運転手に「Radisson hotel」と告げるだけで分かってもらえます。さすが有名四つ星ホテル。メインドアではホテルのスタッフが笑顔で出迎えてくれます。カトマンズの喧騒で疲弊した身にはとても癒しになりました。部屋は文句なし。ベッド二つを置いてもまだ広々としており、窓から眺めるカトマンズの街は広大に見えました。風呂にはバスタブがあり、お湯がたっぷり出ます。トイレは（日本人にとっては当たり前ですが）紙を流せる水洗トイレ。朝食付きの宿泊だったので朝食をホテルでいただきました。ビュッフェ形式で、洋食が多いです。せっかくなのでネパール料理を食べたかったのですが、そこは残念なところ。果物がたくさんあり、私は好物のライチをたらふくいただきました。Wi-Fiは、ワンデイのアカウントを発行してもらう形式です。24時間で失効してしまうので、その度発行してもらうのが面倒でしたが、それ以外は使用に不便しませんでした。総合的に、とても過ごしやすいホテルだと感じました。高級そうな家具やエステなどの施設、スタッフの待遇など、贅沢な気分を味わえるホテルに違いありません。

Awful place Had an very frustrating and irritating experience at the restaurent. I went to the restarent named something cafe in the evening at 6 beside the lobby and the waiter was too rude there. Even the supervisor was racist . I was assaulted with the term dhoti when i tried to approach him for quality service. I heard this and was very disappointed with this 5 start property. There were many waiters but none of them noticed me and gave their quality time to serve me better .Worst experience. One of the staff even told me he was not the staff. Why are you keeping those type of staffs in the front dining area terrible!  i hope you will make sure  to elevate your service and recruit your staffs properly. Disrespectful staffsHygiene awfulcleaniness was also terrible at the restaurentjust a very unpleasant stay.also My good experiences were1 friendly room service staff2 nice rooms3 food was goodplease not about my reviews thank you

Causa problemi del volo di ritorno, siamo stati alloggiati per una notte all'interno di questo hotel di lusso, certamente l'unica nota positiva di quella giornata.Avendoci dormito una notte, non ho usufruito di tutti i potenziali servizi messi a disposizione dall'hotel, per quelli di cui ho potuto usufruire:1) camera: ampia, pulita, materasso molto comodo, rilassante2) ristorante: interno alla struttura, affianco alla reception, buffet multinazionale con pietanze di alta qualità, possibilità di richiedere alcuni piatti preparati sul momento, cuochi ai fornelli abili, promosso persino un primo piatto di pasta che mi sono fatto apposta preparare per l'occasione.Lodevole l'organizzazione e lo sforzo notevole profuso dal personale alla reception nell'organizzare checkin e checkout di massa al nutrito gruppo di persone vittima di cancellazione del proprio volo.Chapeau.

This was now our 3rd and 4th time in the Hotel. The service and location is just great. The rooms in the old building are quite old by now and could be renovated, but the bed is very comfy and the rooms are clean.

The staff at the Radisson was put into a tight spot when our flight out of KTM was canceled at 03.30.With a slew of travellers arriving nearly simultaneously at such an odd hour, the hotel managed to coordinate everything from basic room assignment to meals, later check-outs & overlay, re-booking info with ease.Complicating matters several (as in at least 4 or 5) people became ill on the plane as we waited on the tarmac for 4 hours before flight cancellation.That didn't faze, as Radisson has an on-call local doctor.Yes, it's a chain hotel & Western style but it's located just 15 minute walk from Thamel and staff was extremely helpful.Thank you to all Radisson staff who handled our layover with professionalism & care.

This is a very modern hotel in Kathmandu. The lobby is grand with doormen and concierge. The room is well appointed and clean. The restaurant at the lobby provides excellent buffet and dinner in buffet style. The varieties of food served there are more than enough to satisfy the most demanding guests. The roof top of the hotel commands a great view of the city. Hotel staff are very friendly and eager to serve.

I had a conference to a attend in Kathmandu at hotel Radisson and was booked to stay at the same hotel.I landed at the Tribhuvan international airport at 20.45 hours and reached the hotel in 20 minutes .The checkin was smooth.The room was spacious and the bed comfortable.the bathroom is a little tiny especially;;y the shower area . There is a  rainwater shower and a handheld shower but the water flow is not good - seemed to alternate between hot and cold water all three days.The staff are helpful.The dinner at the Terrace on the 4th floor under the open sky with heaters was good.The breakfast spread at the coffee shop was adequate with live counters for eggs, paratha and dosa.The check out was smooth as well.The good part was the airport transfers were taken care of by the hotel.

I stayed here twice recently for 4 nights and for 3 nights respectively. Both times I was in the old section of the hotel which is very dated without becoming historic. The first room was very shabby and the airconditioning unit made a terrible noise. The corridor outside was hard (no carpet) and the back-of-house access was across the corridor so there was a lot of noise from trolleys and other staff movement. The second room was in much better condition and the noise problem was not as bad. The rooms are big and the beds & pillows are very comfortable. Buffet breakfast is good with reasonable variety and choice. The hotel location is in a quiet location and reasonably located for the main attractions in Kathmandu. While walking to many of the attractions is possible, the horrendous traffic makes it quite unpleasant to do so.Overall the hotel is quite ok but for the price A$160/night (superior single) it is expensive for what you get.

I didn’t get the room I reserved. The room smelled. There was someone’s hair in the tub that wasn’t mine. The hotel was run down and it is clearly not a 5 star hotel. The bed was uncomfortable. The power kept going out. I can go on.

Beds, pillows, toiletries and room amenities very good. Hairdryer a disaster, one of the ones attached to the bathroom wall with  a pipe blowing practically no hot air. Attached with one screw so was wobbling, you could not blow dry your hair with this type of hairdryer, please Radisson Kathmandu provide hairdryers suitable for 21st century. Pool area has 8 white plastic sunloungers with no mattress pads, impossible to lie on for any length of time, again Radisson Kathmandu buy 8 mattress pads for the beds. Over and able this the evening buffet and breakfast buffet were superb, best we had in Nepal.

The hotel service people always greets you with a friendly ‘Namaste’. The front desk seemed a little less friendly, maybe because they were always busy. The Olive Garden Restaurant was delicious but empty. We could only imagine everyone wanted to eat Nepalese food. We had a wonderful conversations with the head Maitre d’ and our wait staff. The main issue was, they didn’t warn us the water got shut off frequently in afternoons and when you turned it back on the water was an unpleasant color.....

very enjoyable stay at the Radisson Kathmandu..my first experience..hotel was recommended to me by a work colleague.  Staff were very friendly.  Hotel was ideal situated to my business meetings.  Breakfast was very good. Airport transfers went very well.

They have sold their privilege membership at 20,000 bucks to me with assurance that my guests can stay there on free stay vouchers. They have told that membership is not transferable but usage are allowed by my guest. I have requested to give stay to my son against free stay vouchers but they denied the same  accomodate and told only I can stay there. This is completely against what they told me during the sales. Their terms and conditions on the voucher card also doesn’t state this clearly. The most horrible part is that when I called them regarding this and requested them to consider this stay, they were rude and outrightly denied the responsibility for this. The membership is going to expire in this month and we are left with so many vouchers that cannot be used and all money going to trash. THIS IS OUTRIGHT CHEATING BY SUCH BIG BRANDS. VERY SHAMEFUL AND DECEITFUL!! Their T&C is completely one sided and very ambiguous. IT WAS A BIG MISTAKE TO PURCHASE THEIR MEMBERSHIP!! We have used Radisson property on so many occasions before, but after this incident we may not use it anymore!!

Stayed for 2 nights. Property is nicely located with all amenities inside the property.  Nice and courteous staff at reception , was upgraded to premium rooms on request. Room size was good. Had a little issue with room, but was very well taken care by Deepak Man and Anita and was offered another room.  Even got a courtesy call from GM Mr. Banerjee.All the praise for excellent team management by GM of property.Breakfast spread was good and had enough choices for every one. Gym and pool with steam and sauna is also in property.Overall a nice Property and excellent stay.

The best part about the Radisson is its location. Bang in the heart of Kathmandu, within walking distance of Durbar Marg and Thamel. The staff is very courteous and the hotel is fairly well kept, though a few areas need an overhaul. All in all a pleasant place where much fitting into the Radisson template.

I'm not satisfied at all, this is not the Radisson, spoiling the name, unprofessional team,  one of my worst most stay, All this begin from airport pickup until I stay. I highly how do you command not to stay.

Very good stay in an excellent hotel with well equipped and furnished room. Excellent breakfast buffet. Very effective and welcoming staff. The only weak point is the garbage seen from the room window.

We enjoyed several nights at the Radisson while we were touring India and Nepal.  The rooms are nice, staff is very good and the breakfast buffet quite nice.  On my last day, I scheduled a tranquility signature massage and it was the best massage ever!  I have had massages all over the world and this was my favorite ever!  Ask for Kamala.

Rooms are VERY comfortable—we have stayed in the newer front part of the hotel many times and absolutely never have been disappointed!  Spotless rooms, prompt and pleasant service, EXCELLENT breakfast with good variety, made to order omelettes, Indian, Nepali, western selections.  We have eaten in two restaurants in the main building, Olive Garden for Italian and The Fun Cafe, very happily for dinners.It’s very convenient to work out in the main building with weights, spa/sauna, and a nice treadmill room overlooking the city to the north.  Hotel is convenient to Thamel, Asan, Pashupatinah, city center.Price-wise I wouldn’t consider this hotel a deal, but actually a pretty good value for high-end experience!  Highly recommend you stay here in Kathmandu!

I've stayed at this Radisson 8 times over the last 4 years, each time as part of a trekking package (3 with World Expeditions, 1 with Trek Climb Ski Nepal).  They consistently deliver a very good, although not perfect, level of service.  On the most recent stay, I had two nights in the new wing and 1 night in the old.  The new rooms are perhaps a little better furnished, although I note only the old room has baths (important distinction if that's part of your post-trek plan!), also the old wing is more convenient for accessing the gym/pool.Facilities are quite good- the gym has a good assortment of machines, the pool is small but suitable for some sunbathing, fruit infused water is at hand at the health centre desk, and food/drinks can be ordered at the pool desk.  On this visit the jacuzzi, steamroom and sauna were all working.  While on trek I safely left my passport in a safe deposit box at reception and bags with the concierge service.  The buffets tend to be of a high standard, although the room can feel understaffed- the service is sometimes a little slow at clearing tables and restocking, or there will be no one immediately available to take your breakfast vouchers.  The omelette station at breakfast is great, there's a big assortment of fresh pastries on offer, the fruit selection is a little underwelming, the juices/smoothies are good and the eventual offer of tea/coffee for the table is greatly appreciated.  I paid approx AUD$100 for a delayed checkout of 6pm.  Power in the room requires the door key inserted in the wall switch.  Solo travellers should ask for an extra key if they wish their devices to continue charging when they leave the room.

I wouldn't say I had a 'stunning' stay at the Radisson but I didn't leave feeling disappointed.The Radisson has two buildings - effectively either the 'new' building or the 'original'.  I stayed in the new building, the rooms as such had a modern contemporary style.  It was good to see plenty of accessible plug sockets.  The bed was big, comfortable and easy to sleep in - it was the waking up that was the issue.  The room was clean, the bathroom was spacious with a nice walkin shower.  It certainly wasn't a room you would feel claustrophobic in!Breakfast was nothing to write home about, it was ok nothing more. The gym and small pool are over in the original building and offer some nice views of the city and surrounding mountains.In terms of location, the hotel is tucked out of the way down a side street, which means you're not drowning in the noise of the traffic from the main road.  It's also close to a number of restaurants and there's a supermarket at the end of the road.  For the more adventurous Thamel is no more than a 15/20 min walk away for those wanting to explore old Kathmandu and expand their choice of dining options. Overall I'd say this wasn't the best hotel I've stayed at, and certainly not the worst.  Would I stay here again?  Yes.

A clean and quiet room, breakfast spread was very good. Location wises its excellent, just a few mins walk from Thamel. All toilet fittings r very old and outdated and some of them were not working properly, its time change now.

Estuve en dos veces hospedada en el hotel, en la parte vieja y en la nueva y ambas veces muy buena experiencia. Los desayunos son completos y la gente que trabaja muy amable. Es un gran hotel, sin dudas para elegir

Overall a good hotel but faced issues with air conditioning in the room. Apparently it doesn't work in winter months making the room very stuffy and hot in the nights. Location is good and has a casino attached so you dont have to go too far for some entertainment.

We stayed at Radission Kathmandu for 02 Nights for official conference. But disappointed for swimming Pool-very small, cold water, dress code in not convenient, staff behavior was not good, Old rooms, Dental kits are not available readily, beds are not fixed in floor. But good dinning, conference room casino (underground), near to Thamel. I think it is good for large crowd

Stayed 7 nights at the Radisson during November. We usually stay here because the location is good - outside of Thamel but close to Thamel & other attractions. The hotel isn’t bad (stayed in the new wing) but not good either. We paid extra for a premium room which hadn’t been well maintained. The bathroom continually flooded and soaked everything on the bathroom floor, the blinds in the bathroom were dirty & mouldy & the carpet also very dirty.  We received no fruit basket or other food which we had expected & it appears other people received. My main complaint however is in relation to some (not all) of the front of house staff who were very unfriendly & terse to my Nepali husband. I’ve had this experience with the Radisson before when they wouldn’t even let my husband into the hotel even though he was a paying guest & have complained previously but little seems to have improved. For some absurd reason the reception staff seem to resent and be rude to Nepali guests which is totally unacceptable. This is an issue which must be addressed by the management of the hotel. I must add however that the housekeeping staff & concierge were extremely friendly & helpful & I cannot fault them.

Our stay was pleasant with unexpected hospitality from staff.   Guest Relation Officers ware extremely helpful. In particular Ms. Ganga Maya is a GEM of a lady with Hospitality personified.    Become a Member and contact the Hotel in advance for your best room/deals.  Premium Rooms are in a separate building without much noise of a Hotel with serene surroundings, where you can have a good night of sleep, if you so desire without any disturbances.  We would definitely stay in this property as and when we re-visit Kathmandu.

Indeed Radisson, Kathmandu lives up to its rating. Was there for two weeks on a business trip and I enjoyed their service. The hotel has Warm and friendly staff who were flexible in accommodating requests. Was in their new wing and the room was very clean, spacious and tastefully furnished. I enjoyed their buffet breakfast and the meals at The Terrace Garden. Got to sample the pastries at The Pastry shop and my sweet tooth was well appeased. Having experienced Radisson hospitality in other countries, I like that Radisson as a brand is also able to replicate standards and even room design to some extent across countries.

Bad hospitality staff, bad food and bad state of property! It is one of the worst Radisson property I have visited. Staff is not good and is not cooperating and understanding. Breakfast very limited spread and bad quality. Very old rooms.

Just completed a three nights stay here. Stayed at a suite in the new wing.The hotel is quite basic. The new wing has a small lobby...probably three stars standards. My suite was ok, though "new wing", the furniture in the living room needed renovation. Rug didn't seem very clean. No hot water ever in the sink; lukewarm water in the morning in the shower. Proper hot water in the shower at night. This is after complaining once. The bed was good though, as was the quality of sheets and pillows.Not at all impressed with the food. Breakfast items really not upto international standards. Poor quality bakery items.Generally helpful staff. It's located about 30 minutes from airport.

location of hotel is perfect, it is located at a T section end of a tourist shops of hand made scarfs and jewelries and small statues. the hotel well recovered from the earth-quack of 2015. People are same spirit of smiling and welcoming staff. improvements was made to the internet connections without limit to the number of devises used per person.services hotel staff are customer services oriented, and promptly responds to service calls.minor maintenance required to some installations but it was not affecting the usability of the items.

I am traveling on business and have been highly recommended by my local colleague to stay here. I am totally disappointed with them. I indicated preference on my room - non smoking, quiet, high floor and late check out. They gave me a smoking room and on the 4th floor where the bar is which playing loud music in the evening.When I asked to be shifted to a non smoking room, they gave me 2nd floor facing the dump...Last evening, when I asked for room service, they say they will check if they still have the item and then never called back. I decided not to eat than to go through the mess with them and be upset.I asked for a bathrobe and it came without the string. I asked for late check out and they said pay for it. I am never treated so poorly in any hotels even 3 stars hotel. I think we are talking about basics here. So very disappointed. Looking forward to Marriott when it is ready..  I will definitely be staying there for future business travels.

Stayed here for 3 nights... centrally located... not too far from Thamel.... rooms are not very big... breakfast spread was ok.. staff was helpful and courteous... taxis are easily available right outside the hotel... free wifi in rooms... Mini bar was decently priced

I had stayed in this property a few years ago and had carried away pretty happy memories. Sadly not this time. The property needs urgent upgrade. For the money we paid, we came away with a sorry opinion. The fittings and fixtures seem to date from a couple of decades ago. The bar across the reception was horrendous. The service at the restaurant non-existent. Never again! Exercise caution please before choosing to stay here.

No hot water complained on numerous times from 19:30  never got resolved was always given a story.Down graded to another room just to bath across the road with hot water.But I was told initially that the hotel’s boiler is same which clearly was not.When asked if water was not hot I was asked if I wanted to move to a smaller room.No one helped us with our things across we felt so embarrassed walking the way we did.Only had supper after 22:00.Very dissatisfied with the radisson staff and water.Beatiful hotel set up and restaurants.Very nice casino which is child friendly.Not to bad but can better the standards.

Very pleasant staff, every facility you could expect, a resort to visit and enjoy, now existing as two separate blocks linked with a stroll across the car parking this venue has it all. Multiple Restaurants to choose from, all service, and even space to throw and impromptu banquet!

Hotel as such is good but the services are too bad and no one to take care of your issues in the hotel. I had a terrible time towards hotel services and there was no GM on duty.The hotel is good but need to improve services to make sure guest come back again.

I am regular at their fitness center which needs a lot of work.1) If you are in the gym in the morning rush hour you may have to wait more than 20 minutes just to take a shower. For all the crowd they have - they have just 2 showers2) Also their Cardio rooms is like a sauna during Summer months because there is no AC or even fan3) Their cardio room and their shower rooms needs additional air conditioning as it get really hot However, I am highly appreciative of  the staff who are friendly and helpful .

Its really good place to enjoy, near to thamel, craziest street in kathmandu full of shops and restaurants. The pool on the roof is cool with nice view of city and also the casino downstairs is nice place to enjoy in the evening. The service and the staff is the only thing that is letting down this place.

I stayed here as part of an emergency response team, just a few short days after the earthquake. I cannot say enough good things about the staff here. The hotel was operating on extremely reduced capacity, but the staff still gave full effort. The whole city was in chaos, but the staff still showed up to work and tried their hardest.However, I probably wouldn't consider staying here in the future as the facilities are not up to the standard of the Radisson brand. The buildings are very old and in disrepair. The hallways are musty and carpets not clean. Linens are worn and need to be replaced.With a little TLC to the facilities, this hotel could shine since the staff are stellar. However, next time I'm in KTM, you'll find me at another hotel.

Its a great hotel for all travelers to stay at Kathmandu. The Place is well located and has a good crowd also. I would recommend for stay in this hotel for all travelers travelling in Nepal and all those planning a trek to the Himalayas.

It is a really wonderful to be here. It is a nicely made hotel  to cater all your needs .weather it is comfort or food or fun activities or basic needs. it is in the heart of the city and all the things  like embassies or the local market or local malls are at walking distance.

Made a last minute booking for the Radisson in Kathmandu for a one-night stay between flights. Checked in late at night into the new wing, which is not attached but a short walk from the other lobby.Room was of a decent size but felt a bit tired. Bathroom was okay but the shower had a blind over the glass facing into the room which was a bit dirty/moldy - probably because it would get wet during every shower. Bottled water provided in the rooms. Wifi was available but terribly spotty. Friends in another room seemed to have less trouble so it might just be luck of the draw.Breakfast featured a good selection of choices, with a fresh eggs-to-order station. Staff were friendly and attentive.

Stayed at this hotel for two nights before and after a Mt Everest trek / climb. It is a comfortable hotel with solid facilities and a good base to organise things before a trip. A 10 minute walk to the Thamel shopping district, but be prepared to get dusty. Although the room rates are expensive by local standards, when booked as part of a trip it becomes more reasonable. Be prepared for some of the local inefficiencies that are not confined to this particular hotel. For example, there was a three day city-wide strike called when we arrived back from our trip - no taxis, no internet, not much else. would return to this hotel for the same purpose.

ビジネスでのカトマンズ滞在では最高のホテルです。中心地にあり官庁・大使館・国際機関へのアクセスがとても良い。ブッフェスタイルの朝食も美味しく、イタリアンレストランオリーブはゆったりくつろげる高級感があり、お客さんとの接待でも利用出来ます。近くには徒歩圏内に日本食レストランや居酒屋もあり、日本人にとっては良いロケーションです。部屋は標準的な広さですが、バスタブも大きくカトマンズにしては綺麗な水が出ます。飲料水も無料のペットボトルが2本毎日いただけます。ミニバーにも充分の飲み物（アルコール）が備わっています。デスクもパソコン作業を含め十分なおおきさがあり、wifiも無料です（毎日フロントでアクセスナンバーをもらいます）。

This was a trip designed to attend an international architecture competition as jury member and obviously the accommodation facility was provided by the organizers. Facing a hassle at the airport, to me one of the worst in the world, when I reached Radisson Hotel at Kathmandu, I was in a complete disappointment as I just finished one of its kind Radisson BLU in Chittagong, Bangladesh as the principal architect of the project. Radisson at Kathmandu really tarnishes the Brand name as any where in the world I visited never found a Radisson of this sub standard. Situated in close proximity to airport and almost close to city center, the hotel is the best example of how a star rated hotel must suite with the time by regular massive renovations. Each and every items are ruined, completely out fashioned and far from giving a service which a traveller destined for. I don't understand how Radisson being a global brand accepts such property in their name. The rooms are of 60s style and in reality completely turned down to its last level of dilapidation. Each an every part of the hotel is full of disappointments. The minimum standard for such a brand is not complied when one looks into its FF&E. Toilet is cramped and allows noise from neighboring toilets. In a nutshell, if any one books Radisson Hotel at Kathmandu considering its brand name then he would be made fool when hero she enters the hotel. It's nothing more than a mere sleeping quarter.

I would not consider this a "luxury" hotel. It is a bit worn and rough around the edges. It is also not as clean as would be expected. The location is nice. It is outside the Thamel district, so not quite as noisy yet a close walk to get to where you need to go. While there is a fitness center, most of the treadmills did not work properly.

The Radisson Hotel in Kathmandu has all the services necessary for a comfortable stay in Kathmandu.  The location is perfect for walking around the city, the hotel itself has several dining and drinking venues, plus spa services, a business center, a fitness center with swimming pool, plus other services like money exchange, car hire, laundry, etc.

A good hotel at a very nice location in the city. The food was good. Rooms were clean and well kept. It had all the required facilities we were looking for. Had a wonder full stay. The staff, too were courteous and helpful.

Stayed for 4 day whistle trip for work.  Nice hotel spotlessly clean. Staff really friendly and helpful. Chandra on hotel front is a pleasant guy and very helpful. Room cleaned and fresh towels daily. Food was good apart from breakfast. There was a vast choice to chose from but the cooked side of things such as bacon sausage and beans we stone cold everyday. They have a hot plate but they were either turned down or off. 10min taxi drive from main centre and temples but also a pleasant walk. Internet not great to get best reception you had to sit in reception as not strong enough signal in room and bit inconvenient when having to bring paperwork down stairs to sendDaily reports back to uk. All in all nice hotel but need to get the little things  right and would be a great hotel

This is the third hotel of a similar category that I visit in Kathmandu, and I find it the best. The new wing has spacious, light-filled rooms, and bed mattress quality is excellent. Only pillows leave some space for improvement. Very clean, big bathroom. TV with many programs. Wifi is not excellent, but more reliable than elsewhere. Breakfast is nice. Italian restaurant was much better than expected, and prices are reasonable. Overall, I found it the best hotel so far in Kathmandu. Service is good, but less good than in other establishments.

the place need better security for staying guest room definitely need upgrading staff need to be courteous and helpful especially those at the reception area  if there  is an option, i would prefer to stay at Grand Hyatt which gave us better customer experience.

L'albergo è situato fuori dal centro caotico della città un po' antico ma piacevole. La camera grande e pulita. La colazione abbondante è ottima. La cena, per noi italiani, è sufficiente. Davanti all'albergo c'è una stradina con diversi negozietti, cambia valute e market in cui abbiamo trovato tanti prodotti alimentari italiani.

albergo molto grande situato in una zona nuova, fuori dal centro più caotico della città,  ci abbiamo soggiornato complessivamente 6 notti all’inizio ed alla fine del ns. viaggio in Nepal. Appena fuori dall’albergo c’è una stradina dove si possono trovare cambio valuta, negozietti e almeno un paio di ristoranti, occorrono circa 15 minuti di taxi per raggiungere Tamel,abbiamo cenato una sera al buffet dell’albergo che non ha un buon rapporto qualità prezzo, da non consigliare quindi il ristorante interno.Buona invece la colazione con una ottima scelta di salati/dolci/frutta. per il wi-fi forniscono un accesso giornaliero per camera da richiedere alla reception,

My husband and I stayed at this hotel with a Gate One travel group.  Although it is not the most luxurious in terms of rooms, the service and location make up for it.  Every request we made , whether for Internet or to change our rooms to non-smoking was met graciously.

There was no jet in toilet. I was given room in old wing whereas earlier I was given in new wing when I stayed during May 2014. Also food quality for the price was worst. Rice was coarse and the Dal was really very badly cooked. It was looking like uncooked. I will not at all stay again. There is least value for money for corporate customers. Your staff did not listened and simply said they can't do it.

hotel OK ROOMS COULD BE CLEANER. BETTER THAN MOST HOTELS IN Tibet but not much better than best in western Tibet  Hotel position is OK but take time to get to other parts of city. Hotel needs a spruce up and paint job

My passport and all money were stolen after trekking in Everest.  While working as an ESL teacher for RTC English I came across this hotel.  Sitting in their lobby after sleeping in a no heat, 6th floor room at the Thamel Skylark Hotel was divine.  It was freezing cold in Dec and Jan 2012 when I was there.  My classroom did not have heat either.  My school was between this hotel and my room.  On 2 occasions I had breakfast in their open air dining room adjacent to the large lobby (construction for the new wing was underway during my Nepal stay).  The service was poor and the food was below average.  Lots of shops line the walkway up to the hotel.  I did not stay at the hotel.  I would use their hot water in the lobby bathroom to wash up.  I was so thankful for that water! A short walk takes you to a main thoroughfare where buses and taxis can be found.  My stay was December/January 2012.

The furniture in the room is too old, not suitable to use anymore.  The bed and the chair is totally cannot use.  The carpet is smelly also.  The food in cafe still ok, but do not eat the fruits, you will regret.  Rot fruits is still serving there.  Will not recommend to stay there

The hotel management needs to get into any other business. This is not their cup of tea. Thank you for your email.  In fact this has been the worst experience in all of my international travels. The hotel needs to overcome many major issues including the communication gap among staff, customer care and staff motivation. Details can be taken from the Managers to whom I had talked.

hotel seems to be ageing, rooms making one feel sick, wifi poor signals in the rooms, leaking bath tubs, water not available through out, carpets used are too old, the bed is not comfortable either, Ventillation in the rooms were too bad . I was feeling sick for all the 3 days. May be the Radisson ( new one ) next to this one is better

だいぶ古くなってきましたが、清潔さは保たれています。品揃えの十分なスーパーマーケットが近くにあり便利ですね。手前の通りの土産物屋は高いですが。タメルからも徒歩圏なので、まともなホテルに泊まりたいけど、カトマンズの他の高級ホテルは郊外にあるし、周りに何も無いのもなあ、という人には良い選択だと思います。ただし、最近は強気の価格設定になっていることが多いので、コストパフォーマンスはイマイチな気がします。

Excellent no complaints hotel in the centre of Kathmandu, very close to Thamel. Unlike most hotels in Kathmandu, no power cuts, the AC runs smoothly.  The hotel is located very close to Thamel the shopping destination.  Food is quite good. Really no complaints

今回は本館に宿泊をしました(毎回本館泊だった)が、本館敷地の入口手前に新しくできた新館がすばらしいです。難点はバスタブが無いことで、日本人にはうけが悪いとの話でしたが、施設を見学させてもらった結果、何もかも新しくて、まるでカトマンズに居ることを忘れてしまいます。もうもう一点、バスルームがガラス張りでベットルームから丸見えで、お友達同士での同室はちょっと厳しいかもしれません。(ロール式のカーテンはあります)そのバスルーム関係だけを除けば、新しい部屋、新しいベット、新しい水回りですばらしいです。シングル利用や、カップル、家族連れでしたら是非おすすめします。３階に食堂があり、オープンテラスもあります。次回は是非こちらに宿泊したいと思います。尚、ラディソン本館はそろそろ古びた感じがありますし、お部屋によっては水回りを確認した方が良いですね。それでもカトマンズのホテルの中ではトップクラスです。部屋の広さは本館の方が大きめです。バイキングでの朝食内容は、カトマンズのホテルの中ではトップクラスの品揃えです。

年明けに3泊しました。カトマンドゥの中心地タメル地区からは、徒歩10分程度。多少距離はありますが、ほぼ一本道でたどり着くので分かりやすいです。ホテルの周辺にはお土産屋さんやスーパーもあり、とても便利でした。ホテルの部屋は広く、バスタブもあり、窓からの眺めも良かったです。（乗り出せばヒマラヤ山脈も見えました）朝食も種類が多く、パンなどコンチネンタルな朝食からネパール料理まで飽きる事なく食せました。ホテルのスタッフも皆フレンドリーで、快適に過ごせました。が、日本宛てに送りたかった絵葉書をスタッフに預けたのですが、未だ届いていません・・・。全体的に清潔感があり、概ね満足しています。

I just spent a month at the Kathmandu Radisson.  The rooms were spotless, tidy, and well maintained daily.  The cleaning staff could not have been better.  The gym is excellent too.   I tried all the restaurants.  The buffet has a great variety. The complimentary breakfast is wonderful.  The cuisine at the Mediterranean Restaurant was good too.  In some of the other restaurants the selection is not wide, but the food is good and the service -- just terrific.  The staff is well trained, polite, friendly and helpful.  I can't say enough about the people throughout this hotel, from the greeters at the door to those who service the rooms. By the end of a month-long stay, I felt that I had made a whole hotel full of close friends.  Great people.  The only downside of the hotel is the location next to a noisy nightclub.  Bring earplugs for comfortable sleeping if you plan on retiring on the weekends before midnight.  It's a small downside for the many major comforts of this hotel.  I'll definitely be back.

Very bad experience  bathroom is very bad rooms breakfast lobby interior are good I have three night stay but my opinion is I m not coming next time in this hotel Raddission group is very good group but khatmandu experience is badThanku

Excellent service Good behaviour  Clean and tidy rooms Helpful reception Fantastic hospitality Active and very punctual housekeeping Excellent  ambiance  Food quality can be improved slightly if proper vigilance is maintained before serving in future.

This is very good hotel staff is very fine and very sophisticated and very humble staff and food quality is very good so international quality food staff name Anu manika Govinda and Sumit and chef manita all is very good god bless you happy merry Christmas

nice hotel and staff but tranquility spa sucks, they have no sense of hygiene at all, i left an expression on the bill no one bothered to ctc what a waste of money the best part of the stay was from the house keeping, the girl was too good, she took care of all my needs
ホテルを出てすぐスーパーもあったし便利。部屋にはアイロン、無料のボトルウォーター、ティーセット、バスアメニティーもあり。朝食のスムージーが美味しかった。バスタブだが、サビのせいか茶色いお湯が出てくるのが難点。

In a good location. Great breakfast. Nice clean rooms although air con in the rooms don’t work very well. Great spa. The massages and hair salon are particularly good. Had the best and cheapest hair cut I’ve ever had. The hairdresser was extremely good.

A lovely hotel ideally located near bustling shops and restaurants Helpful and cheerful staff always ready to help.Good standard of rooms that you would expect from a Raddison and great selection and quality of food at breakfast.Standard WiFi a bit hit & miss and upgrade options are too expensive so need to be improved.We were a family of 8 on a spiritual journey and thoroughly enjoyed our stay here, happy to recommend to other travellers to this part of the world.

We stayed in the older part which is a bit dated.Rooms have old furniture but comfy bed.Tv remote had no off button.  Air con worked well.Like most hotel rooms, not enough lights.Our room had a connecting door, which I think was made out of cardboard - could hear everything.Restaurant was first class.  Plenty of choice.

Stayed here for just one night before our return to the UK at the end of our trip. Our room was comfortable and clean with all amenities and the buffet food was good. Staff all very helpful indeed.The hotel has a very good shop which was useful for gifts to take home and is also down a side street where there are other shops which are good too.The Garden of Dreams is just a short walk away.

stayed for 2 nights, AC not working,on second  night finally, finally midnight shifted to their so called premium wing, the room was much smaller the the old building with a big pilkar inside the room, used the Iron board, it was broken and just a steel net, on ironing the net will imprint fully on your clothes. Forgot my belt in old building, went to get it, after the house keeping confirmed it was there in the Room, for 20 minutes kept on waiting at the reception, finally as an illiterate person started shouting because it was time to leave for the Airport, after this the reception person only had to rush to the 3rd floor room and get it, Full 30 minutes to get a small belt from 3rd floor. Horrible Hotel.

ツアーでランクアップをさせ、2泊しました。シャワーの出も良く、排水もよく、観光から疲れて帰ったとき、砂埃はすっかり流され、気持ちよくリラックス出来ました。室内は、落ち着いた家具、雰囲気でさらにリラックス出来ました。安心して、宿泊できるホテルです。ホテルマン達は、程よい親切さです。GW後のツアーで宿泊料はいくらかわかりませんが、カトマンズの砂埃、バイクや車のクラクション、ゴミだらけの通り、などなど、初めてのネパールの旅ではちょっとキツイ思いを感じた分、ここに一歩入れば、ゆっくりリラックス出来ます。カトマンズを初めて訪れる方に特におススメです。

Not the greatest reason for staying at a hotel. However, the staff at the hotel were courteous, polite and extremely friendly. The room was excellent and the total experience at the hotel and with every member of the staff was excellent. Highly recommended without a doubt!

I've had the best part of 3 weeks here at the Radisson so plenty of time to get a feel for it. I comfortable hotel which is split between gusts from NGO's, business and the constant trekking community.  The hotel is  split between 2 sites just across the road from each other and is a good standard, I stayed in the smaller of the 2, the 3rd floor dinning hall is pretty standard and the 4th floor 'roof top' bar is a good quiet place for breakfast.  I did have an issue with safety, early morning fire alarm, false, thank goodness, but escape route was blocked and not clearly signed. So top tip do your escape plan early on first day and report any issues.  Management were very responsive and I had a meeting with senior management and security to discuss the issues.  Rooms?  standard are well equipped, fee wifi, quiet and comfortable, suites are very nice, p[purpose made and have nice lounge and 2 bath rooms.  You are a 15 min walk from the famous, Thamel road shopping area where walking gear +++ is available.  Accommodation in Nepal tends to be basic but this hotel is of an international standard. You wont experience Nepal in this hotel but you will be very comfortable.

We love Radisson Hotel as it is working distance to most of the tourist attraction eg Thamel (you can find local handicraft khukuri, cashmere shawl, and even trekking equipment), Kathmandu Durbar Square, Garden of Dreams,

Great stay, excellent staff and perfect location. Food was good and the rooms were maintained to a high standard. Overall very satisfied with the Radisson Kathmandu and will stay again on next visit. Thank you

Kathmandu hotels have made big strides in terms of service and amenities; sadly, Radisson hasn't kept up with the trend. Arrived at the hotel just before 1pm and was told to wait until 2pm to check in; this was not noted anywhere on the reservation I made through hotels.com. Housekeeping failed to update my room with basic amenities over the course of my 3-night stay, and there was a leak in the bathroom. My room was an echo chamber: Doors slammed continually throughout the night, guests shouted and played music in the hallway, construction drilled outside, and furniture slid across the ground overhead. When I reported my concerns, little was done to make amends. To add insult to injury, my Nepali colleague commented that when he entered the building alongside me, he was greeted by the doormen. When he returned to the hotel alone, however, he was gazed upon skeptically and didn't receive the same courtesy. On a positive note, the sauna on the 4th floor is a nice place to relax and the gym is equipped with cardio and weight machines, yet I can't say this perk is enough to warrant another stay.

I stayed in hotel for 5 days. I am pure vegetarian and got many options in it. Connecting road leading to the hotel is narrow and gets congested sometimes. Due to my busy schedule I could not enjoy other facilities like club, etc. but all are well known and famous.

We visited Nepal and went to Radisson katmandu. And we have taken buffet dinner over their. While taken food we have found insects in the same and complained to F&b manager he ran away from restaurant. After this problem we went to meet duty manager Mr.Prabul and told the same thing with him and he also don't want to listen anything. Then we asked GM number Mr.Subrata banerjee and Dir.Sales Nikhil and they said we don't have their number. This is not the way to treating their guests and hospitality service.

Stayed at this hotel for three night whilst visiting Kathmandu.Good, comfortable hotel with nice breakfast, just as you would expect from the Radisson chain.It was our 40th wedding anniversary whilst we were there and the hotel kindly decorated our room and brought us a cake and fruit. Kathmandu is an amazing city, all be it that they are still recovering from the earthquake of 2015 but there are still some wonderful places to visit.Sadly the cities roads and pavements are not to western standards and there is a lot of litter and rubbish in the streets which needs to be addressed before the year of Nepal in 2020.My top tip would be get in a taxi and venture out to the old capital of Bhaktapur. Its fabulous temples have not been damaged by the earthquake as much as Kathmandu's, it's much cleaner and full of mystic charm.

Wij hebben hier niet gelogeerd, alleen gegeten. Heel mooi hotel.Eten was echter slecht en heel duur in vergelijking met andere restaurants. Bediening knullig, per persoon werd er een rekening uitgedraaid.Wel heel eerlijk, vergeten telefoon werd nagebracht👍

The rooms are clean and good size. The restaurant serves good breakfast. The Front Office Manager Saroj Poudel is Customer Friendly. I am concerned about the  pale water in bathroom taps on the day of arrival.

I stayed at the Radisson Kathmandu in August-September of 2018 for business. Overall this was a really comfortable hotel in a great location! I stayed in the newer building which was very nice and quiet. Rooms are clean and comfortable. Wi-Fi is fast and free.  There is a breakfast buffet in the building (you don't need to go over to the main building) and a lovely bar/restaurant on the terrace. All staff were very friendly and attentive. Saroj was especially helpful in arranging a car for me to the airport when I checked out! The gym is also nice and has an awesome view of the city. Hotel is very close to the Thamel shopping area (about a 20 minute walk). Overall I would recommend this hotel and stay here again!

One of the finest hotels in Kathmandu. We loved the fitness centre especially the steam room. I entered the sauna area was but jumped out immediately after seeing floating particles including hairs in the water. Our worst experience was the room, which has strong cigarette odour, but we had to live with this problem due to unavailability of another similar room.

Hotel is really good for short stay. Good food, spacious rooms and the staff is really traveller friendly. Location is perfect and all the amenities are in close proximity. Bed was comfortable with clean sheets.

The hotel is located on Lazimpat and close to all amenities. It is situated inside a lane from the main street which makes it very quiet place for work and leisure. Value for money. good restaurants and coffee shop. The hotel approach lane has all types of shops on handicrafts and antique. The lane also has an ATM hub. Very comfortable.

o hotel é bom, sem luxo, mas suficiente para as condições do Nepal, um pais sofrido com  terremotos, mas de gente acolhedora e simples.Sua localização central  é um ponto forte, pois o faz perto de tudo que um viajante precisa

Hotel is located in one of the shopping areas of Kathmandu with lots of small stores selling local handicrafts, and stuff form neighbouring countries. Property is good and well maintained with 2 wings (buildings). I liked the new wing more, though the lobby is much better in the older one. Staff is friendly and courteous. Breakfast is good with variety of Nepalis and Indian dishes are served. Rooms are nice and bed is comfortable. Gift shops around the hotel are opened till almost mid-night.

Stayed here before and after our trek with World Expeditions. Great location about a 15 minute walk from Thamel and a really nice place to stay. No noisy dogs at night. The rooms are large and very comfortable with free WiFi and a nice bathroom. The food in the restaurant on lobby level was superb,with a  delicious breakfast and plenty to choose from and the Indian food at lunch or dinner was as good as I have eaten and I have been to India many times. The service was top class and very friendly. An extra bonus was after the trek and you need a serious shave, well about 400 metres up the road is a fabulous barber by the name of Namaste Barber Shop. Great for a shave,head massage and face massage. Totally recommend them,you will look and feel 10 years younger. The Raddison is a great place to stay

A welcoming hotel with superb and friendly staff. Nothing was too much trouble. Room size excellent, food excellent, people excellent. All very professional and caring. Located within walking distance of shops and restaurants but just tucked enough out of the way to provide a peaceful stay.

Worest hotel it is black mark on the name of radisson They r very bad in behav Dont pay by card over there as they deduct money from your account without informing you this kind of behav was not expected at least from radisson very bad very very bad even the bf was very bad no tatse of 4-5 star hotel they use rough words with touristand even now we not feel safe to come over there again i request to everyone be aware dont give your card details to them

This colourful, relaxed hotel is 5 km from the Pashupatinath Temple and 5 km from the Boudhanath stupa. Refined rooms feature free Wi-Fi, flat-screens and minibars, as well as desks, and tea and coffeemaking equipment. Upgraded quarters include sitting areas; some have access to a private lounge offering breakfast and refreshments. Suites add black marble bathrooms; some have living rooms. Room service is available 24/7.Breakfast is available (fee). There's an informal rooftop restaurant with a terrace, as well as a rooftop pool. Other amenities include a gym, a spa and a garden. There's also regular live folk music, and complimentary parking.

Overall, the hotel is quite comfortable, with a full range of amenities,  and in a good location. However, their security was extremely slow to respond to a security incident at the hotel, leaving my colleagues and me feeling unsafe.

This hotel is very nice. I got an upgraded room that was very nice. A large room with a very soft and comfortable bed. The service was excellent. Breakfast was very good with everything you need. One advice however is that you should not take their shuttle to the airport. The car they are using does not have functioning set belts in the rear seat. Kind of hazardous with the traffic in Kathmandu.

The room was spacious, clean and the bed very comfortable.  Toilet was very clean even though the fittings were outdated.  There was a wide selection to choose from at the breakfast buffet. Location was good too.  There are a wide variety of shops surrounding the hotel and it is within walking distance of Thamel.  Will definitely stay here for my next trip.

Es mejorable el cuarto de aseo que en el caso de mi habitación se le veía muy antiguo y también es mejorable el servicio de WiFi . En el cuarto de baño, no funcionaba bien el telefonillo de la ducha y la WiFi se iba cada dos por tres

Bad condition of the rooms. Aged dirty bathrooms and the ac wasn’t working. The service is quite nice but it doesn’t compensate for the lack of upkeep in the hotel There are two wings - the old wing and the new wing. The review is about the old wing and is not worth staying. They charge the guests extra for the new wing - which is quite unfair

I am still shocked how a Radisson can be so pathetic in guest experience. I stayed there for 2 nights while I was on a trip with my family (a large group of 25 ppl).The hotel felt like a torture chamber where we had to call up at least 5-6 times to even get simple things like room cleaning done. The kids in our group starved while the food order took more than 2 hours to get delivered with rubbery and cold naan that they simply refused to replace.One day we were to visit the nearby Temple and requested to  pack our breakfast or extend the breakfast timing by 15 mins in case we got late. They simply refused. Repeated requests were made and repeated insults were received.The list goes on and on...Radisson is a reputed name and getting a service so poor is just not done. I hope they do some massive restructuring and trainings to improve the non existent hospitality. Till then, plz avoid the place. It is a hoge disappointment.

très bon hôtel réparti sur plusieurs batiments dans un très bon quartier de Kathmandou, calme tout en étant près du centre villeexcellent petit-déjeuner service impeccablepartie wellness très soignée et très professionnelle

The hotel is very well located and close to all major tourist spots in the city, however, the rooms need a major upgrade and refurbishment. Hotel has two wings, old and new, make sure you get yourself booked in the new wing. Food is decent, nothing extra ordinary though.

I was lucky enough to get a full bathroom ( including a bath) everything was clean and tidy, housekeeping staff friendly. Room service quick, but the burger was a bit dry and the chips warm not hot, but I was starving so ate them all. Breakfast buffet was great, chef makes beautiful scrambled eggs. The evening buffet overpriced and not really great. Overall the atmosphere here is one of welcome and I would stay here again. With indoor poor exercise room and spa.

It is not at downtown but there are small stores to shop on the road to the hotel. 5 min. drive to main shopping area and city center. Dinner and breakfast are good. Staff is very helpful. Especially nice for large groups.

I stayed at this hotel for almost 3 weeks. The best part was how the staff took care of me.At breakfast, I was served by the very warm and friendly Ra Man and Milan. Both took time to chat with me and I was offered a few special dishes from the kitchen which were delicious.The travel agent Sarina helped me arrange two excellent trips to Lumbini and Patan/Bhaktapur, and all her recommendations, including the tour guide she selected, were perfect for me.The front desk staff was helpful, providing change for my big bills, making suggestions for how much I should offer taxis for various trip and even catching that I was scheduled to check out one day later than I intended. The hotel bill was also correct which, after 3 weeks, is pretty amazing. Finally the concierge always opened the door for me and greeted me with a Nasaste! My only other comment is that the gym, restaurants (including Olive Garden), laundry service and internet all met my expectations and made the stay overall very comfortable!

Stayed in Radisson Kathmandu on a business trip and was very satisfied with this well functioning hotel. Rooms were clean, breakfast great, they have a beauty parlour/spa downstairs and staff was very polite and attentive. Everything functioned smoothly and quick from paying the bills to room service. There is a small "shopping street" conveniently just outside of the hotel for a quick shopping as well.

You read the title. We were at the annex.There is an immediate danger to life and health and the management would not fix it.The elevator on the right is broken. It dropped a few feet we we were in it and the management would not listen.Go to the Tibet Hotel...very nice.

Great location, 700m from Thamel down a little alley off the main road. The staff are really friendly and helpful. In the alley you can find money exchanges, local laundry at reasonable prices, and a great fondue restaurant with wine. The internal fancy restaurant in the Radisson has great western food and check out the French red wine. Both times we dined we were the only guests so got fabulous attention and was even visited by the chef. Rooms are comfortable. Here is a tip if you go to bed early - get a room at the front of the hotel as sometimes there are functions at the back, we had to move on our first night, but the staff were super friendly about it an accommodated our request. Great WiFi and great spa which you will need if you return from a trek.
ツアーで利用しました。深夜到着して、すぐに熱いお湯が使えました。部屋には金庫、アイロン、ボトルウォーター、ドライヤー、お茶セット、バスアメニティが揃っていました。部屋は清潔で良かったです。朝食は種類が多く、美味しかったです。

The experience was unfortunately horrible. It looks as if the management has no role in making their guests comfortable. The food they serve is stale. The food is never served hot. The staff is also not up to the mark. Not recommended at all.

I have read other reviews and people need to temper their expectations when they come to Kathmandu.  You will not find a Ritz Carlton, or Four Seasons here.  This is a wonderful city full of wonderful people, who live in very difficult conditions.  I did not expect four star accommodations, but I was very lucky, because the Radisson met, and exceeded many of my preconceived notions.  The staff were exceptional, friendly at every turn. The room was spacious, and the bed comfortable( I stayed in the newer building I believe, not where the casino is).  The breakfast buffet met my needs, the food was plentiful, and tasty.   I did not use the pool,I wish that I would have had the time to do so.  The gym was limited, but it was functional.  If I go back to Kathmandu, I would stay here again.

Stayed at the Radisson for five nights.  Service was excellent from the front desk, to housekeeping, to the staff at the breakfast buffet.  Location was convenient to Thamel, Garden of Dreams, and other shops and restaurants.  Would definitely stay here again if back in Kathmandu.  Hotel also made arrangements for activities such as hike and visit to Nagrakot, flight to see Mt Everest, etc.

The Radisson Hotel is located about a kilometre from the main shopping/restaurant hub of Thamel. The rooms were spacious and very clean. We stayed for 4 nights in the main hotel wing and one night in a newer wing. The main wing was slightly older but had a bath which welcomed after our trek of 14 days. The breakfast which was included had a good variety of fruit, cereal, juices, an egg station and other Asian breakfast fare. Their cappuccino was very good - not the usual machine produced but hand made with coffee art on the top. World Expeditions had a desk in the lobby. We were impressed with the organisation and knowledge of the man at the desk. We had the feeling that World X play a big part in the hotel. Great location, friendly staff and good food. One of the restaurant staff even invited us to look at a 5 yo birthday party set up in the courtyard just off the restaurant. Staff are so friendly and willing to please. I had a signature massage at the Hotel Spa which was very good - she catered to all my sore muscles after our trek.

In of itself the hotel is what you would expect. my only gripe would be in the bar, with pictures of hendrix, Floyd, the doors, bob marley, it was slightly sad to know that both there was no accompanying music or that the people at the bar had no idea who these people were. however, I put that down to culture & time.The quality of the rooms is enough to warrant 4 stars (yes, I have read the other reviews but we had no such issues regarding food).The reason I give 5 stars is because I asked a guy on the desk why he was wearing a poppy, something very dear to my heart. I expected the usual response of not really knowing or 'this is what happens in November' and I was greeted by a much more respectful response that it relates not so much to the British soldiers that fought during the great wars but for the ghurka soldiers that died alongside our soldiers.I should point out, to be completely clear that I have utmost respect to the people that gave their lives for us to live freely & that includes the ghurka's equally as much as our home grown talent.In actual fact I was expecting a load of wishy washy lies about how it was "that time of year" and in actual fact, the guy exaplained it was for the lives of lost soldiers during the great War, British & ghurka's who fought with us with equal fearlessness.That is the reason they get 5 stars from me, not only for knowing but for respecting that fact. I would happily die for the ghurka's just as they died for us & my respect for these people will never, ever be properly quantified by words. Actions speak louder than words & frankly I'm disgraced by the English government who tried to deny visas to the ghurka's & had to be coaxed into allowing them to stay.I say this and I mean it to the depths of my soul, if any ghurka wants a place to stay in London I will happily put them & their family up.I had a huge amount of respect for the Nepalese ghurka's who fought alongside us bravely & I always will have. As far as I'm concerned, these people are my friends, my brothers & are welcome in my home. Never did I meet a more respectful group of people and I doubt I ever will.That is why a 4 star hotel gets 5 stars from me. The Nepalese people are legendary for their friendship, their bravery & they will  have my complete respect until they put me in my box & send me to Hades.

Arriving at 3 in the morning, I was met with an amazing warm welcome by several members of the staff. The room was delightful with a lot of wood that gave it a good feel for Nepal. The breakfast buffet is excellent, with fare to suit any range of ethnicities. There is also a find restaurant there, unfortunately named The Olive Garden which may not appeal to Americans. It is not related and I recommend this one highly. There is also a second building for the hotel across the parking lot, with a spa and a fantastic roof garden.

A Value for money. At a convenient location from Airport & Pashupatinath temple. Have airport pickup & drop facility. Enjoy good food. Can also try some Nepallies dishes also. You can also try your luck at The Casino. Hotel staff is also very helpful......

Hotel decadente en algun momento de 5 estrellas pero ahora ni de 3. Sin aire acondicionado en espacios comunes. Wifi de pago. Comida limitadisima, picante en exceso sin alternativaEn resumen un desastre

I was originally provided a room in the old building. It was in need of some updating. There were insufficient power outlets; the internet was weak; the fuse for the rooming was triggered three times in 15 hours. i asked to move and was placed in the new building. The room was of international standard.  Breakfast in the Fun Cafe was disrupted by tour groups of 50+persons arriving at the same time for breakfast. Kitchens and wait-staff could not cope.  You can find better hotels in Kathmandu for an equivalent price.

Moved me to three different rooms in the first week due to maintenance issues with no offer to move my belongings for me. I had to insist. I got stuck in the elevator. Hotel shuttle left me waiting for 30 minutes past scheduled pick up. Bathroom in room offered no privacy as curtains covering glass walls were bent. At no time did staff offer compensation or accommodation for the inconveniences. It would have been much better for example, had staff simply said,"we are sorry we are moving you for the second time, why don't you have dinner while we shift your belongings."

I stayed in this hotel for 3 nights during a conference. Rooms are spacious, clean, good wifi connectivity, nice ambiance and clean beds. The breakfast and dinner buffet had plenty of options. I enjoyed to food everytime. The hotel provided airport pickup and drop which made commute hassle free. The hotel also has a casino -- not much recommended. Overall I had a comfortable and pleasant stay. Recommended for short stays!

Unprofessional Behaviour of Staff, no one was willing to provide any service and not willing to listen to customer complaints. Facilities at the Hotel were also not upto the mark. Overall my family had a Bad Experience and we will not consider any Radisson property worldwide for stay in future.

The hotel has good ambience and the staff is very co operative. There is less of veg food items but bathroom are good. For my senior parents they liked the place very much and my parents bag was missed by the airways. The staff took care and provided everything to them

The hotel staff at the reception, housekeeping and the room service was good and serve with a smile.  Te breakfast spread at the coffe shop is adequate. This wa second consecutive month that one of the two lifts was under maintenance/repair for the entire two day stay.  Room are old and need to be redone. However the cleanliness is maintained

We booked 4 rooms for our stay during our visit to Kathmandu, since I have my love for Club Carlson I booked this hotel. The check-in was super quick and we were given the rooms in the new wing which is just adjustment to the old building. The rooms were good everything was in place as expected. We were complimentary 15 mins back massage vouchers 2 per room which was a welcome gift since we had almost travelled 1000 odd kilometers on the bad roads of Nepal. The breakfast was good and had a lavish range of veg and non veg items. Location wise its centrally located with embassy's of major countries in walking distance, Thamel is like 15-20 mins walk but the shops outside the approach road to the hotel offers things at almost the same price as in Thamel. The improvement points I would say should be done to the casino. There was dance show performed makeshift stage also the card did not accepted any Credit card and their reasoning was our machine was too slow. But overall a nice stay and recommended for travelers who want to stay in the middle of the city. Do negotiate with the taxi drivers if you opt for taxi outside the hotel they try to overcharge you, if you are not convinced walk towards the main road and you will find cheaper taxis.

hotel the room was absolutely poor, the size of the room was small and the furniture were old. I was not allowed to take my friend up to the room even for 5 min because she was a girl. they happily disgraced me and humiliated my friend. My friend is a social worker who helps women in need and they treated her so disrespectfully. Please do me a favour, do not waste your time here.

Once we arrived to the hotel we were told by a not so friendly employee that our room wasnt ready yet - fair enough since it was only 11:15 am. It would take around a 1-1,5 hours until it would be ready. After an hour we came back and asked again and were told it would take another 30 minutes so we decided to take a taxi into Thamel and spend some time there. After an hour and 15 minutes we returned to the hotel again and were told to wait 10 minutes because they had to confirm with housekeeping wheter or not the room was clean. A bit frustrating since it was after the deadline they gave us. During the time we spend at the front desk and in the Fun Café only one employee smiled and seemed friendly - the gentleman whom hold the door for us. Especially Radha from the front desk in the new wing wasnt friendly at all!After some time we got our room but i am sorry to say it wasnt impressive at all. The room seemed used and dirty even tough it is called the new wing. The toilet was dripping so we called the front desk and after 30 minutes no one had shown up so we called again and were met with a hostile attitude. Maybe the staff should have some hospitality training. We ended up leaving the room after 2 hours due the lack of hospitality and quality. All in all very disapponting since it should be a 5 stared hotel. We ended up going back to a 3 starred hotel which was a lot nicer and more welcoming.

2017年4月末に仕事で新しい建屋の方に3泊しました。地元の人曰く新しい建物の方がよいとの事。大通りからホテルへと逸れる小道にはお土産物屋や両替屋などがあり、近くに日本料理屋の「こてつ」もあり気さくな初老な夫婦？が切り盛りしており連日大盛況。肝心なホテルですが、出張ではWIFIと朝食が個人的には重要なのですが、WIFIは接続&速度は大変良かったのですが、朝食ははっきり言ってショボくワクワク感ゼロでした。ネパールでは蕎麦粉が取れるそうなので、蕎麦がきを揚げたものなどオリジナルティ/ローカルなものがあればと感じました。部屋は大変清潔です。湯船はありません、初日のシャワーは熱い湯にならず生ぬるいままでした、2日目以降は大丈夫。テレビのチャンネルは沢山ありますが、映るのはニュース番組の4チャンネルは繰り返し表示されるのみです。 残念なのは、フロントの人数が少なかったことです、チェックイン・アウトともに30分くらい待たされました。1泊約13,000円くらいでした。

This is a great business hotel within 15 minutes walk from the hectic yet spectacular Thamel tourist area.Stayed there twice, both times in the new building, which has modern rooms with surprising twists like see-through glass walls between the bathroom and bedroom areas.The bed was really comfortable, the breakfast offered a generous selection of international and Indian food, the free Wi-Fi was more than decent and most of the staff were really nice and ready to help (Sujan in the business lounge showed up out of nowhere with a band-aid when I had a papercut). According to my wife, the spa was also good.The outdoor terrace on the 4th floor is a good spot to relax over a beer.

We stay at the Radisson for three days and if the first two days were very good, the third one was even better. We were given a suite at the business floor, and wow! What a suite!Breakfast and dinner were great with a good variety and vegetarian choices. The fitness center offers sauna and Turkish bath. To improve: adding a luggage room would avoid having the luggage in the lobby for anyone to pick up.

Clean, tidy, quiet. Perfect for a busy week and a short stay. Staff were exceptional, internet service pretty good. The hotel is also in a convenient location. Would come again for either business or holiday.

where in the world can you find a hotel where the OLD WING is in better condition than the NEW WING? I have to say that when we/ I stay at the Radisson I insist on the old building. its old but it is solid and has character unlike the new wing which was built on the cheap and the rooms now reflect that lack of extra care and cashDon't get me wrong I really like the Radisson and its characterBUT! my wife sent her lovely expensive slacks to be dry cleaned and laundered. it was supposed to be 24hr service. . Anyway after 3 days of chasing making a bit of a ruckus at reception we finally got a knock at the door. It was the laundry manager and the Rooms Division Manager. Yeap you guessed it, they made a mistake and my Wife's white slacks now had turned into light blue. whoops!The annoying thing was that if they had fessed up straight away we could have accepted it better. 3 days of dodge and weave made us a little angry!YOU WANT SERVICE? YOU WANT CUSTOMER SATISFACTION? YOU WANT TO BE AMAZED?After discussions about what we can do to resolve this issue, they finally asked us to come to reception. They had scoured Kathmandu to try and find a similar pair off slacks. Then with 2 managers a driver and a car they took my wife shopping for a pair of slacks in the western shops of Kathmandu. unfortunately they had nothing to which compared.(read this again 3 staff a car and 2 customers for 2 hours)A compensation figure was negotiated (one of those chq's in the mail scenarios, you know the one)LESS than a week of arriving home I had received a chq in the mail from World Expeditions for the nominated amount.all this was organised via the Radisson hotel.There, I rest my case! why stay anywhere else thanks to Deepak Man Pradhan, Subash Khadka at the Radisson and Emma from World Ex in SydneyReally impressed, I'm still in awe of this service

Stayed here for 1 week. Clean and spacious. Friendly staff. However, internet was slow and unreliable in the room. Only 1 of the 2 lifts were working throughout my stay and the pool wasn't available all the time. Not up to Radisson standards.

The Radisson brand suffered serious damage here with me. The rooms air con doesn't work, the breakfast buffet ran out within 10 minutes, coffee was ordinary, staff were overworked (but doorman and one of the receptionists was very friendly). One of The elevator has been out of order for at least 3 weeks. Management were not showing the sort of leadership I would expect by coming out and lending a hand during the busy times. Need to try harder to live up to the brand. You'd be better off saving your cash and finding something in Thamel

Vwry diappaointed with the hotel. They had no staff in the morning , just one person at the reception who was overwelmed with lots of things to do. They need to empoloy more staff of they charging a lot for the room in Kathmandu.I have to think a lot before booking my clinets here.
ツアーで利用しましたが、夜遅くチェエクインをして、翌朝は早朝にチェックアウトしましたので、本当に寝るだけのホテルでした。とはいえ、早朝にも拘わらずに朝食のバイキングは、しっかりとしていました。建物は、幹線道路から少し入った処にありますので、市内の喧騒からは逃れられました。

Service was friendly and competent. Rooms were clean and well furnished.  Some confusion on transport for hotel.  Once again I am adding text to meet TripAdvisors requirements. I've already said all I want and hopefully they will get rid of this requirement. I am considering no longer completing TripAdvisor's surveys.

Our family of 5 (2 adults, 3 teenagers 15, 15 &16) stayed here for 5 non consecutive nights (16 & 17/12/16 & 26 & 27 & 28/12/16). The 16 y.o. was in a room on his own & felt very safe. It is not luxurious by some people's standards or expectations but it certainly surprised me as I wasn't expecting it to be as clean and attractive in the old fashioned way that it is. Remember we are talking about a Radisson in Kathmandu not Fiji or Sydney. It is in walking distance of Thamel. There is a reasonably priced supermarket on the corner and a few restaurants nearby. There is an upstairs area in the newer building where one can enjoy drinks while watching the sunset and order light meals. Our kids enjoyed the buffet breakfast (so did I). The rooms are neat and clean and functional. The upper floors have quite a good view of Kathmandu. As it was the only place we stayed in Kathmandu, I can't compare it to other hotels there but I would recommend it to my friends. The service was efficient and pleasant.

From the moment I walked into the Raddison everything was taken care of. The staff were very friendly and attentive, and my room was clean, a good size, quiet, with a lovely view. Food service was exceptional whether at the Fun Cafe or in room. Prices reasonable. Very happy during my two night stay.

Its good to stay but staff attitude in fun café is not appreciable. They are very lethargic and many time service is not rendered and you leave place without even completed food .  I guess the staff is not well trained about how they should behave in hospitality industry

Second poor experience with Radisson Hotels in a row. The air conditioning is extremely faulty, the hotel staff is unable to maintain liveable temperature in the rooms. It is too suffocating. Definitely not Radisson by any standard. The first night they asked us to sleep in different room, today we are being asked to stay in the same suffocating and stuffy room. There are two Radisson buildings here- one old and one new. There is no operational restaurant in the new building - as they call it. Exorbitantly expensive food - 1 fulka costs INR 160 + Taxes. The casino facility in the hotel is one more disappointment. Most of the machine are non-operational most of the times. Difficult to justify overall 4-stars for the property. Wish I had stayed at some better hotel instead of Radisson for the New Year.This comes from a Club Carlson Loyalist (Gold Elite Member for the chain)

Hotel is very big but font desk is very poor...no care at all...... for check inn they took 45 min......Rooms are good some rooms are newly refurnished..breakfast has a good option and it was good ample space for parking...

Um bom hotel para se hospedar em Kathmandu, infraestrutura adequada, bom atendimento, recursos fáceis de acessar, bem localizado para ir a pé ao centro comercial. Melhor relação de custo x benefício (para a categoria dele) na cidade. Não esqueça de visitar o bar no terraço do hotel.
カトマンズに着いた日とポカラ観光の後に宿泊しました。中２日間スーツケースを預かってもらいました。ポカラへ身軽に行けて良かったです。お風呂のシャワーが取付タイプで古くチョット清潔さにかけますが部屋は広くゆったりできました。朝食もネパール料理をはじめ充実していました。
やや古い感じはしますが、清潔でサービスの良いホテルです。おそらく、ネパールの中では最も高級な部類だと思われます。タメル地区まで歩いていける距離にあり、観光の拠点として便利であると同時に、大通りから裏に入った場所にあるため、非常に静かで過ごしやすいと思いました。
