Proches de plusieurs sites touristiques (certains sont accessibles à pieds) idéalement placé au centre de Kathmandu cet hôtel propre et chaleureux propose aussi un service de conducteurs et d’excursions d’un bon professionnalisme. Après 14 nuits en plusieurs semaines chaque retour sur Kathmandu boutique hôtel était un plaisir cela est devenu mon QG pendant mon séjour au Népal

Mal servicio desde que llegamos. Ni se acerca a un 3 estrellas. Nos cambiaron 3 veces de habitación y al final nos  fuimos del hotel sin dormir ni una noche. La primera habitación al lado de un almacén, la segunda en edificio “nuevo” sucia y cama incómoda y ruidosa. La tercera vieja y baño sucio (el wc sucio con pipí). No se lo recomiendo a nadie. Además personal prepotente y poco resolutivo.

I was staying here for a couple months for business. I dreaded being in a hotel that long, but the staff at Radisson made me feel welcome every single day. I enjoyed each day of my stay and was actually very sad to leave. If I’m back in Kathmandu, this is where I’ll stay without question.

All that you would expect from a 5-star hotel.  Lovely staff.  Responsive. I did not make use of all the facilities, so cannot comment. Breakfast is fine, but make sure you check what chef will make.  I missed out on ordering dosa :-)

I found it's the best place with verything one may need in the middle of the hustel and bustle in the center of Kathmandu: wonderful and helpful staff, very comfortable rooms, great facilities, fantastic food and varried for all tastes, and fantastic services. The facilities are great,

excellent location, excellent staff and excellent Radisson quality as with all other resorts by them.. Casino was also nice. Overall it was one of the best experiences i've had right from check-in to stay to check-out.. Thanks to the whole team Radisson..

When i have my seminar with cartis nepal group for my construction meeting i choose this place for accomodation and fooding they provide us a reliable price within best service i have never get in my whole trip to world.I highly recommended this five star hotel for all who  want a quiet place near lazimpat.As  a review writer some people just drop there review without analysis so this is my truth for this hotel.

Have stayed in this hotel several times but I don’t see much of improvement in terms of quality of service, breakfast (staff & food quality), checkout experience, internet service etc . Not sure I stay there again

Average stay. Was expecting more especially from the food and breakfast. Good location though and staff are very nice and friendly. Gym is small but manageable and you’ll probably find similar at other hotels.

I took dinner package and was served worst quality food - see pics attached. On complaining to Guest service manager - no credible action taken. Mr Kiran promised to call back but did not care to call back. It’s worst Radisson i have ever visited. Mistake i did was that i did prepaid booking and that made hotel guest service team believe that customer is trapped and cant go anywhere. But they need to realise  1 unhappy customer can lead to loss of many potential customers. So friends be ware of this poor hospitality hotel.Also would raise appropriate feedback Radisson apac when i reach back.

This property is very conveniently placed in the heart of the city. The quality and variety of food and beverages offered are nice. Overall stay was very comfortable and good value for money. I am a frequent traveler to Nepal from last 3 yrs and every time I visit this hotel, makes me feel home outside home.

We stay there for 3 nights. It was fantastic.very good housekeeper Mr. Yuvraj gurung kind and humbble person. Fantastic service.ambience qas good. Good food. Restaurant team was also nice. I will be definetly back for this place. Thank you radission team.

Posizione eccellente per un hotel con tante camere, ottima reception ed ottima colazione. Le camere sono buone (vi consiglio di prendere quelle rinnovate) e l'hotel si trova in posizione centrale, a pochi passi dall'ex Palazzo Reale e dal mercato di Thamel.

Being a member from the privilege club of your hotel I feel I was over charged by your ++. I had to pay at corporate rate which I found NOT good and welcoming. And the snacks basket you kept in our rooms had NO rates sticked anywhere and no mentioning of anything about pay-basis. So my kids happened to take it thinking it was free (complimentary). But when I ended up paying I was overcharged 5 times the market price. It was like it was there to loot us; a honey bee trap. I am surprised to see a 5* hotel like yours not even caring to giving such small things as complimentary to its own member. Worse you guys don't even hesitate to heavily over charge us.

Hotel di catena nella zona delle ambasciate comodo alla zona di Thamel con i 3500 negozi.. (10' a piedi). Le camere non rinnovate sono proprio inguardabili, puzzo di fumo in camera bagni maleodoranti e poco funzionanti. Indubbiamente le camere rinnovate che ho visto sono decisamente meglio e molto curate con doccia a vista in camera...Consigliato per la posizioneColazione molto valida intercontinentale a buffet
繁華街のタメル地区にもタクシーで5分くらいと近く、買い物も便利です。　通りから少し奥に入るのでホテルの周りも静かで、部屋も広いです。　ハウスキーパーも親切で、何回もアメニティーを補充してくれます。

I had a decent stay at annapurna radisson on my way back from gonghrel. location is goos, quite close to the city and airport. airport shuttle is available free of charge. rooftop swimming pool on the old block alongwith sauna, steam and jacuzzi enable a good relaxation

I have stayed at multiple hotels in Kathmandu over the years. My favorite remains the Radisson, for location, professionalization and friendliness of the staff, quality of the food and service, and a lovely and well-maintained swimming pool.

Hotel buono per gli standard internazionali, camera grande e spaziosa, bagno nella norma... nel bagno però non veniva acqua calda dal lavandino mentre dalla doccia si... colazione buona e anche la cena a buffet ricca e varia. Ottimo il fatto di trovare due bottiglie grandi di acqua gratuite.Nel complesso ok.

Had a brilliant time staying in style at the Radisson in Kathmandu. All the staff were so friendly and helpful and always gave the best customer service and always with a smile!! Highly recommend the Radisson in Kathmandu, Nepal. Food was scrumptious as well with various cuisines available.

Friendly helpful service. Manager’s welcome evening very pleasant. Spa massages wonderful. Granitas in the ground floor bar were terrific. Food and drink great. Room nice. Location good. Markets nearby. We had a pleasant and enjoyable stay.

v nice hotel w good amenities; overall v good value. Nice breakfast. Divided between two buildings but pretty seamless. V friendly staff v v nice spa. Gym, pool, and travel desk  not entirely up to standard.

Had a very good stay and enjoyed the hospitality. However one meeting hall had a lot of noise from the kitchen behind the hall disturbing the conference and the other hall was full of flies as they had frequent dinner parties. Else a very good hotel , good amenities and good rooms and very friendly staff members

We stayed here for one night before our trek and 2 nights after.  The rooms are clean and comfortable, have good bathrooms, bottled water and free wifi.  The restaurant is excellent, buffet breakfast is served from 0630 offering plenty of hot and cold options. The pastry shop in the newer part of the hotel is great for a snack after a busy day out and about. The hotel is walking distance from Thamel shopping precinct. Staff are friendly and helpful.

I visited Radisson for their spa service, the spa service was at it's best. The staffs there treated us in a very well manner, me and my friend had steam bath it was very good experience there. They also served us with green tea that was even more awesome loved their hospitality. Recommend for everybody.

Best location and service, good room. I can recommend this place to any tourist who would like European comfort and customer service. The breakfast was not so perfect for the price. There was nothing that I did not like, everything was perfect.

Radisson Hotel is located in Lazimpat, Kathmandu which is very close to Thamel, one of the most happening places in Kathmandu and other tourist attractions. I was given a room in the new annex. The staff were friendly and room was spacious and clean. Because the gym and breakfast areas are located in the old annex, it created some confusion. The fitness center was equipped with weights and machines but they were all crammed in one small room.

Abbiamo soggiornato presso questo hotel e abbiamo cenato per 2 sere presso il ristorante interno Olive Garden.Siamo rimasti favorevolmente colpiti dalla cucina mediterranea e dalla scelta di vini soprattutto italiani che ci è stata proposta. Personale molto cortese.

The hotel is comfortable, clean, and the beds are comfortable, which is one of my priorities. Be sure to lower the shades in the shower stall before you use the toilet, lest you be embarassed! There are 2 hotels, actually, an old and a separate new building.  We stayed in the new building.  There are also 2 separate dining facilities.  The new building's dining room is smaller than the older building, and has a smaller breakfast selection. There is a small shopping area right next to the hotel within their courtyard and adjoining streets for souvenirs and sundries.

The Radisson Hotel Kathmandu was my least favorite of three properties I used on this years vacation.I had requested a twin bedded room, and on arrival fairly late in the evening was  told we were "upgraded" to the new Tower, located across the parking lot. If this was an upgrade from the main building I would worry about the quality of those rooms. Room size and cleanliness was ok, but we were given a king rather than twin.In fairness when I raised this question the following day I was offered a change, but on a two night stay chose to remain.Restaurant was clean and breakfast was good. I didn't try other meals as the menu was high compared to the local restaurants.My other concern was a slightly racist response when I entered the lobby with my Nepali companion- he was challenged by the doorman and told to report to reception. We did straighten it out with a sort of apology, but it left a bad taste.Probably would not return there as there are better options.
世界のチェーンホテルだけあって、今まで泊まったローカルホテルとはサービスやアメニティーが全然違う。バスタブから冷蔵庫、湯沸かし器、ドライヤー等全て揃っている。清潔感もピカ一。NHKワールドも見られる。朝食のバイキングも種類も豊富で味も良かった。ホテルの前の通りには色々な店が並んでいるので散策に良し。夕食はホテルの近くで地元料理を食べたが美味しかった。

Este Hotel es muy moderno y agradable. Tiene un cuerpo principal y otro edificio a unos metros que funciona como anexo. Ambos edificios tienen habitaciones muy modernos y cálidas. Es para recomendar.Los desayunos buffet son muy completos. Las censa pueden ser a la carta o con un precio fijo para el opción buffet.

bon hotel, accueil un peu "raide" à l'arrivé mais après rien à dire, chambre spacieuse, belle salle de bain, agréable et bien équipée. La vue n'était surement pas à la hauteur de l'hotel mais il suffit ;.. de ne pas ouvrir les rideaux.

Nice place. Good food. and great Gym and swimming pool is nice too thou not warm. The location is really good. But approach road is not very good. Food options for vegetarians are somewhat limited.  Buffet b'fast is very good too.

This place is about 20 minutes from the airport down a small side road. Service excellent but food prices a little high. Remember prices quoted will need to add vat and service charges. Breakfast 6.30 to 10.30

welcoming environment to all kind of guest.Nice place to visit with family and friends. Party and lots more to do. Good food.Clean and peace place. Easy to find the hotel. Its in the heart of capital city

Terrible place to stay if you are a Muslim. Despite telling the room service to serve Halal food, the restaurant served me food that contained pork meat in a club sandwich. Not only that room which hotel claims as premium is with broken old wooden flooring, furniture old & scratched, worst quality of dental kit & so on. My stay at this property is the most recent during Feb/Mar'19.

We dinned at the buffet lunch. As vegetarians we found the selection excellent, with lots of choices for non-veg diners too. The food was fresh, well presented and tasty. Not overly spicy. Service was attentive. Overall good experience.

I can’t think about any other property in KTM. Stay at home kind experience. Very clean and ideal for business or leisure visit. New Building is bit modern but old one gives a touch of local culture and better food taste.

Well positioned hotel with friendly staff. I would not hesitate to stay here again. I ate in the roof terrace cafe which was a nice quiet place to contemplate my explorations of an incredibly interesting city.

Radisson Hotel Kathmandu is a very nice hotel with everything you need to enjoy the wonders of Kathmandu in style.  A great place to rest and prepare for what ever awaits!  A short 30 minute ride to and from the International Airport.

Not a worthy stay..we paid extra for breakfast though we had included breakfast in our booking.. casino was worst.. rooms were not upto the mark with no privacy in bathroom walls..ove overall a worst experience

Stay was good and nice experience. Food is very good. Overall I enjoyed my business trip.Casino experience is good. Parking facility is nice. However they are not keeping up their commitment on arranging the vehicle.

The Radisson Kathmandu was a highlight of my travel this past year.  If you have the status for lounge access, that is a major benefit here, as the food and drinks there are wonderful and the lounge manager is a delight.  I prefer the old building to the new one--the new one is very nice and has excellent amenities.  The old building just feels more like a Kathmandu experience to me, and I moved there part of the way through my stay.  I had a minor issue after departing getting credited for points for my stay.  I finally got it resolved but this tarnished an otherwise amazing 2 week stay.

The hotel is now very large thanks to the addition of a new wing. Alas the full choice of restaurants is only available in the older part. The rooms are spacious and the bed comfortable. The large wetroom with rain shower is a huge plus point. Food is great too. You can avoid expensive meat dishes and have some vegetables cooked in an Indian/Nepalese way.

The Radisson at Kathmandu is a great place to put up, it's proximity to tourist hubs, excellent warm service by its staff and a great cuisine made our vacation not only comfortable but also a great experience...

Very rewarding experience with very hospitable and caring staff. Food is very good, you should try their lunch buffet. The chefs are ready to assist you with your taste buds.  Very good place for hosting parties.

Good facility however staff ar reception and check in shall be more flexible / friendly . We are a large group staying for a month . They could have given us a proper discount . Location is good and food is good value fo money

On the the worst stay in this hotel... furniture are so outdated, not working, not value for money, breakfast standard are worst than other 5 start hotel in country.... staff are not so comfortable since they feels they are favours us whixh is not correct we are favourite them to stay in hotel....

I had visited Kathmandu and happened to book Radisson for my mother & myself. Had requested a handicap abled room as my mother is 79 Years old and is on a wheelchair. They gave me room 112 on the 1st floor next to the elevators which had provisions for handicap people such as support bars etc. in the toilet at the WC helping them to sit and get with ease. Further, the entire staff of Radissson Kathmandu was very helpful and courteous in order from the security , to the bell boys , the reception desk attendants, the restaurant managers and the house keeping staff etc. Would love to mention an appreciate Ms. Ganga Maya Tamang : Manager Guest Relation at the hotel was so helpful and very courteous as my mother was on a wheelchair , I had no difficulties at the Hotel. She went all out to help me to ensure total comfort and convenience for my mother. Kudos & Cheers to Ganga Maya Tamang Madam. Thank YOU Madam. Further , the ambience at the Hotel was great, the rooms were very nice and comfortable and the breakfast buffet every morning was well spread and delecious. Will comment saying that if YOU are visiting Kathmandu then do check in at Radisson. 3 Cheers to Hotel Radisson Kathmandu and Specially to Ganga Madam. Thank YOU 👍🙂👌

Had a great time staying at this hotel. I was there for two weeks and luckily was given a room in the new wing. VERY nice. The staff was very nice and accommodating, especially Sujan in the Business Executive Lounge. He was a great staff member. I'd give him a raise in pay if I could!When I return to Kathmandu I'm definitely staying at this hotel

My room in the new wing was very nice. The gym facilities are some of the best I've seen in a hotel. Well equipped gym, huge pool, and jacuzzi/steam/sauna. Food was very good. The massage was excellent, but one odd thing is you have to pay to use the steam bath at the spa. Seems very silly when you're paying for a massage, and the main hotel health club has a steam as well.

Hotel staff should inspect all the rooms thoroughly .AC switch was wrong settings.its too hot inside.AC switch was not working.Water tap was broken.mattress looks good but with a horrible sleeping experience

Room was overheated and option for reducing the temperature was not working. Rather than giving other room they advised to open the window and switch off the heating. Nothing worked and whole night we were suffocating, thought to spend night in the lobby. Additionally door to the room didn’t lock itself and it can easily opened by a push on door. Really felt so vulnerable. Has not expected this poor quality from Raddission.

I arrived early at 10am and was allowed to check in without any problems. All staff was helpful and professional. The location is not too far from the airport and near the center. The hotel rooms were comfortable. I had a smaller room but traveling solo that's all I needed. I was only staying one night in Kathmandu and everything everything was nice and easy for that purpose. I would stay longer if I am back in Kathmandu.

Its good Property but Overall Service Should be Much Better in such type of Hotel. During Check in , we were not offered any Welcome Drink Hence asked for Water and Hotel Staff took more than 10 Minutes to just serve Water. Also Breakfast option was OK not very good as we expect in this type of Hotel

Have stayed in this hotel since last three years (twice a year). However this time I found the Manager of front desk rude and unfriendly. Amenities and location of this hotel is excellent. Bathrooms are very good but the water spreads all over the floor when you take a shower.

Stayed three nights at this hotel and enjoyed every moment of it. Staff were extremely helpful anx friendly. The rooms were of good size, clean and had ample toiletries. Buffet Breakfast and dinner had an extensive range of food and delicious.  This place is well recommended.

Very comfortable, the staff is excellent and very polite and helpful . The hotel could do with a little refurbishment of the rooms , it was very clean but old . And the room needs to have more light . Other than that it was great.

Fortunately we were in the newer building which is opposite the original building. By all reports this is a superior to the old one. The room was extremely quiet and comfortable and the food choices at breakfast were good.

Our first three nights were in the newer wing across the road and our last night after trek in the original part. The room was better in the new wing with full shower. Both rooms suffered from no aircon at night. Food was luke warm in new wing and better in the old part. Staff particularly at door were friendly.This is home for our trek company: World Expeditions.

The newer part of the hotel has nice rooms so would recommend going for a newer room. While you have to walk to the main building for the gym the comfort of the rooms makes up for the short walk. The pool is not great, you can have a splash but it's too short for laps but people are usually not coming to Kathmandu for swimming. The breakfast buffet is okay with a decent selection and I'd recommend ordering the dosa.

I am generally a fan of the Radisson chain but this has been the worst Radisson experience. One of the highlights of the Radisson chain is the 100% Satisfaction Guarantee offered, which I have triggered many times in various Radisson hotels around the world. However, out of politeness, I did not do so here in spite of dissatisfaction.To start with, there are essentially 2 hotels, the 'Old' and the so called "New". They are physically separated. At the time of booking there is no indication about any of this. We were given a room in the New hotel and told that it is Premium! It looked anything but. It was dark and dinghy, with darkened corners, unlit Bar and a generally depressing and uninviting appearance in all the common and public areas. The room itself was generic though functional, but not too spacious. This was made worse due to a large pillar in the room near the window. The worst part of this New hotel was the coffee shop where breakfast is served. It appeared more like a school canteen, totally unkempt and uninviting.We asked to see the Old hotel and Rajeev the Guest Relations Manager showed us around. It was much smarter and better maintained. The rooms appeared slightly smaller than the New hotel and the decor a little better. The public areas and restaurants were smart and much better kept. We were staying for a week and Rajeev informed me that as a Club Carlson member, I would be entitled to 10% discount on the room and all F&B and the Spa. We were not too excited with the F&B options in the Hotel but did have a couple of meals and also used the Spa. However, at the time of checkout, not only was the discount not included but when I asked about it, I was told there is no such discount. Rajeev was not available at the time we checked out. Further I was told that I should have asked for discount at the time of each transaction!!! Talk about service!The location is close to Thamel but far from Durbar Square. The Crowne Plaza Soaltee is a much better option in the same price range.Mr. General Manager, please do not bother to respond if you cannot provide a specific response to the issues raised here. The readers are not interested in a generic response.

My family and I recently spent one night at the Radisson Hotel in Kathmandu. The staff were friendly and very helpful. We had planned to transit back though Kathmandu 5 days later and had 8 hours between connecting flights and there was nowhere suitable at the airport to stay or leave our luggage. I asked the gentleman at the front desk, Jeevan,  who checked us in if he had any suggestions. He told us that it would be no problem to leave our luggage there on the way back. And this was despite the fact that we weren’t planning to stay there. He also offered to arrange a tour for us to pass the time. In any event on the way back we were too tired to do a tour. We took a taxi to the hotel and it was our good fortune to find Jeevan working at the front desk. Despite the fact that it was 9:30am, he arranged for us to check in for 6 hours and gave us a special day rate. He was truly an excellent ambassador for his hotel and I would like to thank him and the rest of the staff at the Radisson Kathmandu for helping to make our holiday so memorable.

Best food, peaceful spacious room. Had a pleasant stay. Enjoyed complementary pic an drop to airport.Great breakfast. Overall a very satisfying stay. One of the biggest hotel in Kathmandu to dtay.Thanks for all hospitality

If you are travelling to Nepal there may be other choices if you are tight with your budget. The hotel price is not worth it. The breakfast buffet was a bit ridiculous for $140 meal. If you are not fan of Indian food better go out and find somewhere.

Radisson Kathmandu is very conveniently located within the city and a good hotel.  Besides, there staff members are extremely courteous and helpful - Ms Ganga, Keshab, Rishal to name a few - makes this a good choice in Kathmandu.

I stayed here twice during my trip to Nepal - once before and once after my trek.The first time I stayed in the older part of the hotel - and the second I had a room in the newer part of the hotel.  They were quite different in quality, comfort and amenity.The older room was less spacious.  The bed was okay, but not great, and the shower was over the bath...The newer room was far more spacious, far more comfortable and the bathroom far more functional.In terms of location, it is probably okay for business travelers, but not particularly good if you are in Kathmandu as a tourist / traveler - unless you are with a tour group on a bus...when I imagine location doesn't really matter as much.

As usual Radiason staff is courteous and neat and clean hotel with strategic location..just room service is bit delayed for service..rest all is ok..good buffet..value for moneyRooms in the old block are little old design but neat and clean..New block is newly made with fresh global interiors.

The property is fairly old but many rooms have been recently renovated. The location is great and close to centre. Buffet spread could be better. One major concern is leaky faucets and bathtubs in the washrooms.

It is better than i expected. Good hotel. Nice room. Friendly services. I Stayed in New Wings. There is casino in Old one.   location is good for shopping and walking around. There are plenty of restaurants around too. Do Shopping around it.

I'm a regular in Kathmandu for business. I chose to stay here because it is a little bit away from thamel and durba marg but an easy walk to both. The staff is great, incredibly helpful and friendly. Breakfast can be a bit repetitive but that is the same for any hotel. Both the old wing and new wings are nice in different ways. The gym is a good feature

It was a good experience. Staff was hospitable and very attentive to the requests and issues of guests. Food quality was also upto the mark. Rooms were tidy ane well maintained. Only i would like to mention that there should have been enough lights in room

Stayed at Radisson, Kathmandu to attend a workshop. The service and food was awesome. One improvement they can make is to refill the food items in buffet a bit faster during peak hours. They struggled to keep pace with guest's requirements.

I stayed at the New Wing, I understand it's newer than the original building just across. It's clean and very comfortable by Nepali standards. I did not experience any brownouts while I was there. The wifi is decent and there's a supermarket nearby at the main road. Although it's not in the main tourist areas there are always taxis outside the hotel, just remember not to accept the first fare they give you!

the hotel offers a great stay, stay is very polite and helpful, lunch and dinner buffet can be a big disappointment however, a la carte is good. the hotel has a very good pashmina store offering good quality stuff at a very decent price... hotel has 2 wings i stayed in the new wing and it was a great stay however view outside the window will be a big disappointment. evenings at terrace garden will be a superb idea. you will always find a taxi at the gate of the hotel so no need to worry much about local travel.....

Kathmandu is a good city but at least I felt that quality food was an issue outside the hotel. Also if one wants to have a hassle free stay at a reasonably priced hotel, then I would recommend for Radissdon, Kathmandu. The guys at Radisdon helped me arrange for local transport also for a very readonable price and if hood quality. So full marks!

my husband and i stayed 2 nights via point redeem.  luckily, the reception simply upgraded our room without asking.  the first night was so great because the hotel isn't located in Thamel district so it was so quiet and the room itself was so nice and cozy.  however, the 2nd night was a bit terrible: the night clubs surrounding hotel played music crazily and our room was right in the opposite to one of the most crazy night club.  we could dance with their music in our room!  we complained 3 times to the hotel will 10pm but they could not really manage external parties.  meanwhile, something wrong with hotel hot shower so we couldn't take hot shower before 10:30pm. we shared our needs of having a quiet sleep to the reception and they were kindly offering us another room for one night sleep without repackaging our stuff!  furthermore, they offered us a free late check out which was super generous since our flight was 11pm!我用點數換了兩晚住宿。入住時reception直接升等。第一晚超棒的，因為飯店不在熱鬧繁華的Thamel，所以安靜而舒適。然而第二晚變得很可怕，因為飯店外的夜店以全區共同開趴的心態大放音樂。因為我們房間正是夜店正對面，音樂大聲到我們在房裡可以隨著音樂跳舞了！跟飯店抱怨了三次，然而我們也清楚這不是他們的問題。屋漏偏逢連夜雨，當天熱水器出了問題而要等到10:30pm左右才能洗澡，但我們真的累壞了，只想早早睡覺。所以飯店提供了另一房給我們睡一晚，而且完全不用搬動行李！甚至還給我們免費的late check out！

Location is perfect.Breakfast and food need lot of improvement.Bathroom need lot of repair as shower is not working properly.Staff is friendly and make you feel good.I wish there is a option to get hard mattress to have a better sleep. Thanks

Hotel excelente, ótimo atendimento e localização. Comida excelente.Hospedei-me neste hotel em outubro 2016 mas não consegui colocar esta opção na seleção do período pois só tem até dezembro2017,O hotel é muito limpo e os apartamentos muito confortáveis.

I stayed in a 3 floor, double room for 5 nights. The staff were always helpful and pleasant, the breakfast was good (although a bit variable depending on what time you got there), and the facilities were clean and pleasant.Not quite 5* rating as there were a few annoyances which did not help - small things like the shower head being completely bunged up,  the air conditioning being underpowered, and one of the lights in a wardrobe never switching off (giving an odd eerie glow at night!). Overall however I was well looked after and comfortable, so can't grumble!

If you need comfort and a higher level of luxury in Kathmandu, the Radisson is a reasonable bet. The premises are spotless, the rooms spacious, the service attentive and the breakfast buffet impressive. It is about at 30 min cab ride (without traffic) to the airport and 10-15 min to Durbar square.

It has good facilities for customers: gym, sauna, swimming pool... However, jacuzzi was broke! The location is quite central. If Kathmandu has better pedestrian zone and pavement, this hotel is easier to access.

An excellent stopover in our favourite hotel in Kathmandu. Over many visits, this is where we choose to stay. Clean, safe, comfy beds, good hot water and excellent breakfasts. This trip we noticed the well above average service given us by Aslan Khadka, a lad who has excellent service manners and will hopefully progress up the corporate ladder.

It is a regular Business Visit for me. Radisson Kathmandu is a perfect one to stay. The amenities are adequate. Food is excellent. Service is the best. The people here are very good in hospitality. The location is very important. Not far from the center of the town  You get small shops around the hotel too

Good hotel, pleasant staff, restaurant has an interesting spread in breakfast and dinner, centrally located, close to major attractions and business, easy transport availability. Overall a good choice both for business and pleasure

i supposed to stay in this hotel for 10 night ,but after two nights i cancelled the reservation and moved to hayat regency hotel (amazing hotel ) and for many reasons:-the hotel furniture is so old, dirty and you can smell the bad smell from the bed and covers and blankets . the breakfast is very very poor . staff seems never taken any training how to work and talk to each other during work . rooms view to back yard full of garbage and cars . hotel rate is so expensive compared to the service and facilities . not recommended at all .

During my recent business travel, I stayed in the new wing which is modern and well-maintained. The only bummer is, for dinner one needs to go to the old wing, which is another building across the road. During the evenings, they only have a functional bar in the new wing. Breakfast is available in the new wing and the spread quite limited. I used the spa services at the hotel (I gather they’re a chain and Radisson is only renting its space) which i felt was overpriced in comparison to the services rendered. Also a little slow service. Have used better spas in KTM and also stayed at better Radisson properties. Closer to the airport than most other hotels. So that’s a plus given KTM traffic.

Radisson was the destination for a conference that took me to Kathmandu. The Hotel at Lazimpat is a surprise. You get off the main road, enter a narrow lane and viola - barely 100 meters drive and a vast open area throws up multiple hotels. Radisson itself is split into two parts - New wing and old wing. I was at Old Wing. The lobby was a throwback to 1980s. But staff was amazingly polite and efficient. A quick check in and I was in my room.The rooms certainly need the upgrades. The wooden flooring is old and chipped. The electronics, washrooms are all a throwback to 1980s and need upgrade.To give credit to management, the renovation is underway.The staff is polite and very helpful.And wifi connectivity really great.The Chinese influence in Kathmandu is now visible and more so through presence of large groups from China in Hotel. So expect loud noisy crowds at breakfast times.A hotel close to all key destinations, Darbar Square, Lalitpur, Patan, Pashupatinath Temple. All these places are within a radius of about 5 kilometers. And a good place to rest after your business day is over. Will speak of restaurants in other post.

I like this hotel in Kathmandu. I have stayed here three times. I think it is more like 3-4 star hotel. Location is very nice close to Thamel area which is mostly tourist attraction and close to many small resturants. The mini bar in room and food in hotel is very expensive. Also laundry charges are very expensive. You can get food from outside near by resturants for very cheap price and good quality and also you can get laundary done from outside for 50% cheaper price. Overall this hotel is nice.

We stayed  in this hotel as part of a group tour. The check in was ok not too fast not too slow. The hotel needs some refreshing and cleanliness. The staff is friendly, we stayed in both wings. The rooms in the main wing are ok and clean, but not exceptionally clean. Breakfast was ok with a good variety, my only problem is that it is located in the main lobby where you can hear the locals and tourists clearing their throats and spitting which was very disgusting (get used to it while in Nepal). On our second visit we were upgraded to the second wing, where the rooms are newer, we had an issue with the shower overflowing and wetting the entire bathroom . Breakfast was better in this wing and more private. The staff at the front desk at this hotel in this wing was less friendly. most hotels in Kathmandu are located in narrow, congested streets, the radisson has ample access. Both wings had free internet

this hotel s really good, the food is awesome, room are really amazing and service is in the top level. i do prefer to refer people to check in so they can experience the level based hospitality and you will enjoy it for sure

Awesome staff n friendly, good experience, good food, great driverEasy to get around, easy money exchanges and supermarket storeLotsa shops n restaurants nearbyLotsa souvenirs, great experienceGreat people

Last month, I had a chance to conduct a trg workshop in Radisson Kathamndu and it turned out to be a fascinating one. Their banquette team, front office and others were extremely customer oriented and helpful. However, its their restaurant team takes the spot light. Not only their quality, taste and presentation of food steals the show but their staff's impeccable and very personalized service is what touches your heart. Great place for all types of tourist to stay and eat in Kathmandu as the hotel is close to most tourist places in the city. It also has a casino if one wants to have a feel of it.

Comfortable rooms, good location. Good facilities. Down side street off main road. Good restaurants nearby. Range of rooms to choose from standard to suites. Quite location with good parking facilities
酒店有两栋楼，游泳和健身在主楼从四楼上去到五楼室外泳池室内桑拿走到六楼跑步设施。房间标准间是blu统一标准。接机15美金还有缴税。klook订比较方便便宜。早餐简单。门口有小商店，ATM和超市。

I am aware that you cannot expect first class service in a poor country like Nepal. A country recovering from a catastrophic earthquake in 2015. But you should not be expected to pay a very high over-price when the service you are getting is corresponding to the standard of the place where it is located.Typically when you pay for a Superior Room you expect to be paying for the room, irrespective if it is single occupancy or double. Here you pay a high rate only to find out that you are just paying for yourself (your wife has to pay extra 30USD/day) and that you are not even getting breakfast. Which is served at 15USD per day. Which may not sound too much to the standard European traveller, but if you think that dinner for two in one of the top restaurants in Kathmandu will not cost you more than 25USD (including drinks), then you feel that you are being ripped-off.Going back to the Superior Room. Well, be aware that it is located in a different building than the rest of the hotel services. This means that, if you want to swim, you will need to get out of your room and building, cross the street half-naked, and then make it to the fourth floor of the main building (after showing yourself off around the lobbies of two different buildings) before you can enjoy a refreshing splash! Maybe you are overheated and would like to have a relaxing bath. Well, you can't. The Superior Room does not have a bath tube. Moreover, the shower has a nice see through glass to the room and if you want some privacy there is a thick curtain that insulates the shower area. Very nice (ans sexy) indeed. But it becomes less nice when you roll down the curtain only to find the is mouldy and (very) dirty. Getting to a new country some times can be a very stressful experience and you may like to be fetched by your hotel's shuttle from the airport. Well, while this is typically a free service in most hotels around the world, in Radisson Hotel Kathmandu this comes at a price. And at a price which is twice the standard taxi rate!If you are coming to Nepal, it is very likely that you are planning to do some trekking. In such case, you may be willing to live your more bulky pieces of luggage in the hotel and travel a bit lighter. Well, be ready to pay Radisson Hotel Kathmandu 15USD. Why? No reason. Just because the feel that they can take advantage of the needs of their clients. Any other hotel in the city will provide this service for free.The staff is lovely and diligent.

I have stayed here a few times over the past number of years and the hotel is like a Grand Old Dame that is past her prime. This once was the go to place for upmarket accom in KTM. Alas now, it has lots of competition that beats it on price and service.My reservation was nowhere to be found upon check in, but it did get resolved fairly quickly. However, I was then put into a room that is surely the worst room in the place (105). On the lowest floor, a smoking room with a view of the carpark.  Not impressed.  My tour leader subsequently followed up with the front desk, and my room was changed.  Given that it was low season, and they had a lot of availability, I would have expected to have been given a better room from the start.   I had asked for bags to be collected from my room, which they weren't.  Had to follow up, and on my second request, they did come.  I stay here because it is the hotel for the tour company I book with.  But when I am not on tour, I stay elsewhere.  Much better value elsewhere in KTM.

Good Clean 5 Star hotel. Close to amenities. Highly recommended. Friendly service breakfast provided. Has spa, pool and gym. Reception staff are friendly and flexible. I would love to come again. Excellent.

I had the experience of visiting Kathmandu because my son had to have emergency surgery there.  As you can imagine, the stress of the situation left me tired and drained.  This hotel, close to the hospital, was my lifesaver.  The staff were professional and friendly, and they even returned cash to me that I had left in the pocket of some jeans that I sent to the laundry!!!  The food was wonderful, and the room an oasis.

The hotel is generally ok. Beds are very comfortable. The hotel could overall be much better maintained. Cheap decoration. The swimming pool area is sad. The sauna is old/doesn’t work properly. The steam bath is genuinely disgusting with humidity stains everywhere and stinky- could not use it.Staff is friendly period. No commercial zeal. Overall, a price too high for what is is.

poor service, didn't offered what booked. Pool was not climate controlled, booked king-size bed and offered  two separate single beds for me. staff were not friendly and not properly trained. limited menu for round the clock service.

I have stayed at the Radisson multiple times and I am always impressed by the quality of service. This hotel is well-situated and has a excellent fitness center and swimming pool -- which are high priorities for me when I travel. I would highly recommend staying here. It is clean, family-friendly, and the food is excellent.

Was there with all my mates onJune 19.The best part was obviously the food.I really loved the waterfall in that banquet section.Ambience is great. I personally loved the ambience of the hotel.Well,did not stay there overnight so dont know much about rooms and stuffs

Good location and good value of money. You can be rest assured that requested services will be delivered to you as requested and hotel provide safe, comfortable & enjoyable stay. Staff is friendly and take very good care of guests

Very cheater staff in buffey area I hv check in 26th June 5.30pm dinner buffey I hv purchsed  I hv sit in buffey area Staff say buffet will start 6.30 But tea n little snack will serve u comlementry But after eat his say u will pay 3200/- inr  I will paid 7000/- buffet also purchase Big cheater staff  I hv complain on desk his no actionThanksAtul9310313999

Was in Kathmandu for a 7-day family vacation and stayed at the Radisson Hotel. The hotel made the entire vacation that much better by providing a comfortable room and quality amenities. The staff was very kind and caring and did their absolute best to take care of my families every need. I would 100% recommend staying at this property over any other and I look forward to my next stay.

Friendly staff, comfortable rooms, and great location.  Nice place to meet people.  Guest relations staff were great.  Airport drop and pick up are nice perks.  Also like that hotel sponsored taxi/car service is available.  Food was good.  Easy access to a number of embassies as well as the Travel Clinic - the latter gave me a piece of mind as I was traveling with a group.

Excellent ambiance with all comforts taken care in the most decent manner. The staff goes beyond their capacity to give the best service. Quality of breakfast and food is remarkably good. The rooms are spacious and nicely decorated. Highly recommended.

We are regular visitors to Kathmandu and always stay at the Radisson. Good rooms, friendly staff, great guest relations staff. Nice service.  Food tends to cater to Indian cuisine but always delicious. Close to Thamel - shopping center and to embassies and to the clinic!

Was in Kathmandu on business visit for 2 days. Stayed at the Radisson Hotel. It was a comfortable stay. The rooms were nice. Breakfast was also good. It has swimming pool on the top floor with view of the surroundings. Situated next to old Radisson Hotel which is also open.

I travelled to Nepal in June 2018 and stayed in Radisson for a day and I would rate them average compared to Carlson group of hotels.Location wise it is very good, 15 minutes walk to Thamel shopping however service is average, way below you would expect from Radisson group.

The Radisson was excellent location, about 15 minutes walk to Thamel, the popular tourist area, but also close to restaurants, a supermarket at the end of the street as well as ATM’s. For the price though, there are many more places to stay in Kathmandu that are cheaper for the kind of room you get. The staff were always very kind, the food was great, and rooms were comfortable. Highlight of the stay were the door men. They were always so kind every time you walked in or out of the hotel, it was a lovely greeting arriving back each day! Another highlight is also the comfortable beds. It was great to finished a two week trek and come back to a great bed! Highly recommend using their day spa. Great prices (well, compared to Australia) and treatments were fantastic, as was the Henna! Would I stay again? No, unfortunately for the price to stay there- it really isn’t anything super special and Kathmandu is filled with hotels that offer the exact same for a much cheaper price. We have several friends that left after one night, finding equally great places for half the price in the same area.

I stayed here because of my trip on May 20-June 02. I stayed in the new wing on fifth floor. Breakfast was good enough compare to the others hotel in Kathmandu. Staff are very good and work as a great team. I think this is the most impression for me. They are trying to make the hotel the best. They always welcome when asking for any help, Trust me! Great location for my work and Thamel in walk distance. Shuttle is quite small but always reliable compare to the high brands in Kathmandu. The room is very clean and very good complimentary. Laundry services are very clean and on time. Swimming pool and Fitness facilities are good and clean. Staff there, they are very helpful, provide very impression of service, especially Mr. Anjan Rai, he was very informative and helpful when I need help about hotel information, including Kathmandu information. The Executive lounge was quiet,  however the service there impressed me.  Thank you

stayed here as a part of a trip to Everest Base Camp in April 2018.  Very friendly staff, clean rooms at a reasonable rate.  Fantastic breakfast buffet.    Great location within walking distance to Thamel and only a short ride to the Airport.   Also close to other main tourist sites.

The hotel is very good with very good location in nearby local market. Rooms are good and spacious. The hotel is located inside from main road so you have to keep it in mind while searching for the hotel. Breakfast is very good with Good buffet option of veg and Non veg food. Zym is also very good with Cardio, Swimming pool and weight training. Trainer is also available. Very well laid out rooms and amenities. You can also buy local Nepali goods from nearby shops also..

Had international level conference at hotel. Clear communication was given to hotel event team that room charge will be covered by event organizer for exsmple. But some guests still being requested to pay for rooms during check out and it took so long for the hotel to sort that out Internally.Hotel promised to give black and white communication through duty manager. So far nothing received (3 days later). Disappointed.

The beautiful Radisson is located in the heart of the city. Though an old hotel but maintained very well. The staff is so so nice and respectful that they make you feel special from entry to exit. The doorman to reception to room delivery to house keeping, I am short of words to praise they courteous behaviour. Food is tasty but not that great. I tried chicken club sandwich and can say I had many better ones that this before. The blue berry cheese cake was nothing more than okay. Rooms are spacious and comfortable. Bathrooms look tired and shower is not that great.

The hotel, rooms and staff was acceptable but a dose of food poisoning from the roof top restaurant ruined my and other people in my groups trip and made for a very unpleasant flight back to the UK.  I expect better from a 4 star hotel although the staff did allow me to stay in my room and provided me with water while ill.

Stayed for three nights in two rooms with my family. There was a vast difference from what I expereinced in Raddisson Lucknow India. A very neutral Staff,  airport shuttle not available at Kathmandu Domestic Airport.  Vegetarian Breakfast menu was limited. Dosa items not avble due to Dosa hot plate equipment was not working.

We stayed at both the wings of the hotel and enjoyed it. The new wing of the hotel is modern in every way. Loved the hotel and the location. Breakfast offering was wide and enjoyed the food. Rooms are comfortable with all the conveniences you can expect in a good hotel. Just a few minutes away from the city centre, the location was quiet and peaceful. The hotel has a casino. Staff extremely friendly but very slow in providing service. The slowness in service was the only disappointment at this hotel. Housekeeping staff were most helpful. Great hotel You will love your stay here.

We had a two day workshop here and was disappointed in the support, it was pretty disorganized, and we didn't have a point of contract during the workshop. They got the tea time wrong at one point and tried to argue with us about it. They didn't have our room reservations, etc. Also the beds are incredibly hard, making it hard to sleep.

Been here thrice for business and Hotel is really nice. Buffet is the best specially the BACONS 😍😍😍Though it has some power interruptions quite some times, it is still okay since it is a country wide thing.Pool area is perfect as well as the bar on the terrace. Hopefully I can return.

Lived in Radisson for 2 months and had a great experience. The waiters and bellmen are very friendly and go the extra mile to antecipate your needs. The restaurants are very good, especially The Olive Garden and the Fun Cafe. Internet is a bit slow but I think this is standard in Nepal. Usually the hotel is very quiet, far from the main road, but when they have weddings, prepare your earplugs because they will not make an effort to stop the noise.

We found this hotel ideal. Stayed in both wings, old and new. Pleasant and cozy. Friendly staff. Good restaurants and a wide choice nearby. City center and is walking distance to Thamel Market (if 20 mins is fine by you).

Pleasantly surprised by the warmth and hospitality of Radisson Kathmandu. The hotel has a main building and a new annexe. The rooms are excellent in both blocks. I was fortunate enough to receive an upgrade to the junior suite in the main building. The restaurants churns out the choicest delicacies with a well mix of veg and non-veg cuisines.The casino floor is large and has a variety of options.

I stayed a total of 5 nights over 2 weeks around a trekking break. This hotel has much to offer, with great shared facilities, attentive and friendly staff, and reasonable food standards. Location is convenient, and would be highly advantageous if staff were to risk recommending local facilities( bit careful about this). one glaring deficiency ws the standard of the bathroom, which was very low indeed. Hot water was abundant, but the look and perceived hygiene was surprisingly low.Overall the hotel was of a high standard with one very poor aspect.

Stayed here twice in two weeks - different rooms each time.  The hotel is ok... most staff are very friendly - found the least friendliest in the restaurant.  Rooms need to be updated badly - bathrooms are tiny and the shower was the worst ever!  not sure why there were guests allowed to smoke in the hallways but it stunk.  The spa was great - staff there very friendly.  Probably a good value hotel for Kathmandu but not sure i would stay there again.

This is a difficult review to write.When we arrived the first desk person told us that we had not cancelled our room reservations (we had gone with a tour guide company). he was quite insistent that I would have to pay for the stay! I eventually found my cancellation from Orbitz with the number and everything. He was still not a happy dude! However, this was resolved. Move on we think. We were given room 341. What we didn't know, was that this was directly below the gym and the weight machines were constantly thumping and banging very very loudly. Methinks this was pay back from the front desk guy!I complained and was moved to another room 511, which was excellent. The next morning , the manager talked with me and was very apologetic (never saw the front desk guy again) and simply could not have been better. Indeed, quality of service was excellent.Details:Bed is excellent. Room size is good. Room is getting tired and will need renovating soon. Wifi is good, but slow, too slow. Room service was excellent. Pool was excellent, lovely view over Kathmandu area. Breakfast was good, varied and the service was second to none. The corner bar is really nice.In conclusion, we felt welcomed, except for the person who served us at the front desk on the first day. That left a sour taste in our mouths. The manager, however, was excellent and he and his staff are to be recommended for the first class service after the first unfortunate day.Recommend

Me and my husband really enjoyed staying at this hotel in Katmandu. The location is great, breakfast and restaurant very good.  All atmosphere very relaxed and a friendly staff. The room quite big and the bed very comfortable.

Overall hotel stay was pleasant. The ambiance, the rooms, the staff & every other thing was perfect except concierge service. That guy didn't bothered to ask the guest before letting go the cab for the airport for international departure whilst we were sitting there in lobby itself waiting for the bills to settled. Instead upon asking he said the cab left because we are 3 mins late to reach him.

I really appreciate the level of service and comfort at this hotel. Everything from arrival to departure were arranged the way i want. Thank you for the whole team involved in providing the service. Recommended for people willing to stay at luxury hotel in Kathmandu.

We had an excellent stay at the Radisson Hotel. The hotel is located not far from the airport. Popular Thamel area is at walk-able distance from the hotel. Staff at the hotel are very helpful and courteous. Nice hotel to stay.

Stayed 5 days in the new wing. Very comfortable room with better than average mattress. Wonderful shower with plenty of hot water. Amazing , responsive, helpful friendly staff!! Will stay again next time i am in town.

Les chambres de l'ancien bâtiment sont peut-être plus authentiques mais nous avons voulu privilégier le confort et donc demande chambre dans annexe C'est effectivement plus aux normes mais cela aurait besoin de travaux de rafraîchissement En outre. 2 problèmes avec coffre-fort. et impossibilité ouvrir porte entrée qui a été bloquée par le bloque porte intérieur !!??. Beaucoup de temps perdu Sinon personnel très accueillant sauf conciergerie Nourriture bonne mais excessivement chereSPA pas mal mais décor un peu glauque

This hotel has a surprisingly low rank among hotels in Kathmandu. It was everything that I expected from a Radisson – clean, modern and spacious rooms and public areas, cheerful staff right from the doormen to housekeepers, quick internet, prompt service, and good food in ample portions. My room was in the new wing. From what I saw, the old wing was also just as good. The location of the hotel is within walking distance to Thamel, Garden of Dreams and the Narayanhiti Palace Museum. There were always a couple of taxis in the lane outside, even before dawn when we were looking for an airport transfer for our mountain flight. I would certainly consider coming back.

The hotel was nice & comfortable. Rooms & bathrooms too very nice n comfortable. Location of the hotel too is nice. The staff n service was courteous. Though the hotel seems to be a little run down. Overall the experience & stay at the Hotel was nice.

Rooms are what you expect but my room needed a bit of maintainance in the bathroom. The staff are always very friendly and welcoming. Be mindful of the airport return charges as the are simply a rip off

This hotel  provided a great place to recoup after a week of camping and exploring the areas surrounding Kathmandu. It was clean, comfortable, and affordable. The food was good and the service above average.

I had the pleasure to stay several days at the Radisson Kathmandu. The rooms are extremely comfortable and they were serviced daily. The housekeeping staff were very good and nothing was a problem. The front desk staff were always polite and very professional in their approach. I ate in the restaurant on several times and was not disappointed. Good choice of dishes and always tasty.

Great feeling. It was home away from home. My appreciation for all the members of the this hotel for the excellent work, great ambience, warm and hospitality. Definitely would recommend other to stay in Radisson.

The hotel is modern with friendly staff and an excellent service. Spacious and clean room with comfortable bad. Breakfast is very good. Includes free wi-fi, gym and pool. It's not too far from Thamel (15-20 min. walk) although due to air pollution, taxi is recommended (about 2-3 US$ per ride). Shuttle to airport was kindly supplied, as well as keeping luggage while away for several days.

We spent 6 nights at this hotel. Friendly and helpful staff -Sunam and Anuj at front office/Reception were particularly superb. Clean and comfortable large room, Lovely rooftop garden area, Great variety selection for breakfast and dinner, Great location! Great that airport transfers can be arranged by the hotel.Downside is that Repeat requests are unacceptable for 5 star hotel (e.g. our request for extra hangers arrived on the third request). The designs of the bathroom wasn’t the best either (Slow drainage of shower water). Overall this was a great stay at hotel that has quality and style true to the Radisson brand. Highly recommend.

It was wonderful stay with Radission hotel in Lazimpath, Kathmandhu. Location is good near by Thamle and Durbar Murg. Hotel facilities up to the mark. Services and response of the room service very nice. Specially General Manager Mr Subrata Banerjee has very spontaneous person and he will make your stay memorable. Hotel guest can use Executive lounge at Kathamandhu international airport and get some discount coupon also. So all together I must have to recommend this property for  Business, solo, young and Family traveler.

I made a group booking (for about 20 pax) at Radisson for a conference and the reservations team was extremely patient and accommodating to our last minute and ever changing demands. They made the logistical part of my work so much easier and always acceded to our requests with a smile.Our guests were well taken care of, and the hotel staff always made sure the arranged transport to and from conference venues came on time, and helped coordinate with the drivers when there was any change in schedule.We all stayed in the new wing and the rooms were comfortable - I was able to get a good rest every night, and there was sufficient bottled water provided daily. We also celebrated a colleague's birthday and the hotel provided a lovely cake to surprise her with and it meant a lot to us.Special shoutout to Keshab and Sonam for all your help, and thank you for making my stay here a truly wonderful one.

Traveled  Jan 2018 spent a week,  our package  included pickup and drop off, laundry ( one change of clothing per day, breakfast and snack lounge stayed within government rate. Very responsive staff. Centrally locate. Little trouble with heating in winter but staff changed it not clear if this affected others. Would not stay at any other hotel here.

The hotel is centrally located at around 30 minutes from the airport. I was given an inter connected room.On the first night, while I was asleep, the occupant from the other room knocked at this door and then I had to change the room. It was not comfortable for me to change the room for none of my fault. The rest of the things were good. The room was good. The breakfast was good. Some Indian dishes like idli were far away from Indian taste.

Wir waren am Anfang und am Ende unserer Reise hier, insgesamt 6 Nächte. Klasse Hotel, super Service. Nettes hilfsbereites Personal und schöne Zimmer. Das Frühstück und das Dinner Buffett sind sehr gross und lecker.

The staff, rooms and services are excellent. Because I stay in both category of rooms and both rooms are excellent. The food was very good and value for money. Location is also very good. Peoples are cooperative

We recently stayed twice at the Radisson after previously staying at true 5 star Dwarikis.  While it's hard to compare the two the Radisson is perfectly functional for much less.  Location is great and lots to do within walking distance.  Bed, WIFI, Shower, Cleanliness all very good.  AC did not work due to time of year and room was warm on first stay.  Breakfast buffet is excellent.  It's important to find the right room to have a great stay.  One side faces a loud disco, one room was under the breakfast buffet dining room with chairs scrapping the floor all morning and evening so chose wisely or move rooms.  Staff is very cordial and helpful and front desk was wonderful when we requested late checkout.  Olive Garden (not that one) is in older Radisson building was very good.  Not much local style but you can have a very good experience here and get all the culture you ant a short distance away.

Room Was Worst...Including Bathroom...Rice Served Was of Coarse Quality @ Premium Price... Chapatis Were Worst @ Premium Price...Could Not Sleep Due to Poor Quality Beds..Very Old Type Linens...Room Service Quality Bad @ Food Served with Additional Service Charge...Full Looters...

Though the hotel is inside the street but has very good ambiance & hospitality, Check-in & Check-out is very smooth & fast, Staff is Excellent & very co-operative, Lavish Breakfast. Make you feel very comfortable.

The hotel is modern, clean and spacious. I was upgraded to a Junior Suite which I enjoyed immensely. Check-in and House keeping was efficient. Internet works alright. I did have difficulty connecting additional devices. As you walk out of hotel, many taxis and a few restaurants are available. I walked to the busy Thamel area as well. The pricing is a bit steep and there are other options available in Kathmandu.   I had a good stay at Radisson and if i find online deals, I will continue to stay here in future visits.

The hotel is having good clean rooms with a decent decor. Staff are friendly and helpful. The breakfast buffet is a good way to start the day and it has decent options including made to order parathas and dosas apart from omlettes. The Vegetable thali at the restaurant was a decent Lunch/dinner meal.

tipico albergo con standard internazionale, noi abbiamo soggiornato in due momenti diversi in due stanze standard confortevoli, ma piccole,  silenziose... (attenzione, se non ci sono come vicini gruppi di indiani), pulite l'essenziale, bagno ok, buona e abbondante la colazione, ottimo il buffet del ristorante, personale disponibile

I stayed for 52 days at this hotel (Nov. 1 -Dec 22). Overall, experience was good.  Hotel staff are friendly, house keeping is efficient- i.e. when I request something, it would be promptly attended to. Fitness center is good. But I had issues when I checked in. First, even if I told the check in staff that I am a Club Carlson Gold member, I was told that the morning shift would attend to it - so no welcome gift and no room upgrade and I was put in a room under the gym that vibrates and is very noisy every time someone drops the weight, especially early morning. It took the hotel more than 3 days to transfer me and to get me an upgrade. I was told that the welcome gift would be given before I check out. When I checked out, manager apologized but merely told me that on my next stay, I would get my welcome gift.

The hotel is very neat and clean and the staff is good. However, the breakfast, lunch, and dinner were not up to the mark.  Considering it is a five star. We had dinner taken care of but still, we decided to eat out. GAIA was the place we went for dinner as also the Rosemary Kitchen.

I always had the misconception that this hotel was in the middle of nowhere and previously stayed elsewhere. It is surprisingly close to thamel and Durba Marg. Just be cautious with the taxis that are organised by security as they end up charging triple what they should be

Great experience at the Radisson. Very friendly and helpful staff. Good location with a view of the Himalayas. The hotel had several restaurants.  The rooms were comfortable and clean. They have an airport shuttle that was very good.

Een zeer goede optie voor een comfortabel verblijf in Kathmandu. Goed gelegen hotel met nette kamers. Wij verbleven in de nieuwe vleugel. Uitzicht niet zo mooi (desolate parking) maar je bent overdag toch weg om dingen te gaan bezoeken.Gezellige bar op een dakterras. Ontbijt kon iets beter voor dit soort hotel, nogal rommelig en weinig aanbod, maar voldoende

What more do you need after trekking than a extremely comfortable bed, fluffy pillows, crisp linen & a hot strong shower!  But there is more to this hotel than those immediate needs : -)  Excellent variety for breakfast, room service was delicious - Nasi Goreng was so good!  Highly recommend this hotel with free wifi and a gym and outdoor pool.  The day spa was really good as well.

J'étais dans le bâtiment annexe en face du bâtiment principal.Très bon hôtel avec personnel très accueillant. Les chambres sont propres et spacieuses. Le restaurant est correct bien que un petit peu cher. Un petit bémol pour le bruit la nuit ou au petit matin. Je n'ai jamais compris pourquoi dans les hôtels ils installent des portes qui réveillent un mort quand elle claquent...

MY opinion hotel check IN & Out  service very good  Need to improve House keeping service  hotel atmosphere very good and good look  transport facilities very good   Restaurant break fast good taste & service

It was my first time in Kathmandu and the hotel staff made my stay a great one. They were accommodating to meet my needs. The restaurant also served good food at reasonable prices. The location is also ideal.

Hospitality and Courtesy need to be drastically improved . Washrooms need to clean. Reception person should be attentive to the need and should respond in either way. Though ambience is good but still lots of improvement is required in terms of services

Hotel Radisson in Kathmandu as per our stay i would assuredly say that its the best hotel to stay long or short, its nice view hotel. Location of the hotel is located in the very beautiful area of Kathmandu. Hotel has wide space in the part of entertaining area, gymnastic, swimming pool and relaxing area. widely spread ed separate villa and building too. we had booked one room luxury type. Our room had good view from window we enjoyed out view while living. about hotel staff easy booking and check in process done by staff, every staff were helpful as well as honest we found. rooms were specious and clean total relaxing area of room made us so comfortable while living. they had provided us dine in facility too. Enjoyed nice living time.

Lovely hotel.  The rooms were spacious and well appointed.  Buffet breakfast was great - lots of food to choose from plus eggs cooked the way you like.  Staff were excellent.  Nearby shops are good to look at to, and the Thamel market is not that far to walk to (about 15 mins).

Room is clean and comfortable. not much varieties for breakfast if you are staying there for few days as food are repeated.  There are some souvenir shops and money changers very nearby the hotel or at the door steps away.

The room view was very good,break fast spread was excellentThe staff members are very humble and coopretiveits value for moneyin room you get fruit basket ,cookieshouse keeping service was also very goodThe casino is well renovated and the ample people are there to serve you

Fantastic hotel at Kathmandu I had stayed recently, it was awesome experience to stay and enjoy cool atmosphere as well as good services from the hotel. I had booked this hotel as part of my tour to Kathmandu. Very easy booking process and check in process made me relaxed. Hotel has more than expected amenities and beautiful swimming pool and garden. Nice relaxing chair and great services from the staff made my stay very comfortable. Nice and big rooms rooms had all facilities like, comfortable bed with refreshed bed sheets, sofa, dining table, Ac, Tv Fridge and clean bath rooms and toilets, everything was proper and excellent about this hotel we found this hotel was total valued of money with their great services, enjoyed too much.

I would avoid this hotel for anything.The rooms in the annexe have walls of such poor quality, that I could hear the TV if your adjacent room loud and clear!! I could also hear all sorts of noise coming from the corridor. With the price you pay for this hotel, I could not even get a good nights sleep due to all this noise.Then there are loads of other small problems like the flush buttons in bathroom broken, the head shower spraying holes clogged.For a hotel claimimg to be 5 star, i dont expect such issues, especially with their room rates being over the roof. I wouldnt like to stay here for my next trip.

Very good hotel. located in the posh area. Bit away from the busy city. Very clean, Rooms are big, well decorated and all amenities are there. I liked the breakfast - so well spread with continental, Indian and even South Indian delicacies - all well cooked and served by the staff with a smile. The open air area beside the breakfast - in the new wing feels so good in the morning.

First night we had a room where the shower floated the bathroom, the second room (we switched) had a window who was not closing, after we told them they didn't fix it until we left (5 nights). And in november it can be pretty cold in Nepal at night.The room was okay, it was clean and the service was good. The roomprice is not that cheap, i sleeped already cheaper in pretty the same environment or even better. The breakfast was to expensive for what they offer (1500 Rupie is way to much). Nothing more to say.

Stayed here before and after a base camp trek and was satisfied with everything. Comfy clean rooms, the breakfast is good and varied and the staff are all friendly.It’s nit cheap but you get what you pay for and it’s nice to escape the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu and rerun to a comfy air conditioned room.Try to get a room at the back above the 2nd floor, it’s a cool view over the city and you may see kids and their parents flying kites off rooftops at sunset.

The Radisson Kathmandu is amazing. Our itinerary in Nepal involved staying here on more than one occasion. It was very heartening to be “welcomed back” on our second and third visits by staff - starting with the doorman followed by reception and a smiling concierge. To top it all, we were allocated the same great rooms on each visit. That has to be something special in an International Hotel chain - and very much appreciated! The standards are well in keeping with the rating of the hotel. Breakfast could be chaotic a peak times - but that was because of the clients rather than the staff. I have used Radisson in various parts of the world and always found them reliable. This one took it stage further and really made me feel a “special “ client. Three great stays.Many thanks to all the staff. ￼	◦

My family and I stayed here earlier this month. This is an absolutely luxurious hotel in Kathmandu and I am glad that I stayed here. The rooms are very nice with good bathrooms and toiletries. AC worked very well and TV channels also had a lot of options. There was also a fantastic Gym center with complimentary services like spa, sauna, pool and jacuzzi to use. Also we were provided with complimentary welcome drink and 15 min. massage upon check in - which was very nice.The hotel is close to Thamel which is the main shopping area and takes 100-150 NPR to get to in taxi (if you do not want to walk - like 15-20 mins). There is also a fully Veg. restaurant nearby named Angan.Before my arrival at the hotel I got in touch with the hotel Manager Mr. Deepak Pradhan who was very pleasant to talk to. I informed him regarding the purpose of my trip to KTM for tourism and for family celebrations. To this he made many great arrangements for our stay which I thank him. This included an upgrade to a premium room in the new wing and also offering us a complimentary delicious buffet breakfast. In addition to this he also sent a cake to our room to celebrate the birthday. Also at the front desk Elisha was very nice and helped us with answers to many questions we had.We definitely enjoyed our stay here and I'd recommend this place highly. Would also thank Mr. Deepak Pradhan for his wonderful management.

Have been twice to the hotel for work purpose... Gym,rooms,service everything is great except food which is average! They make Indian food but taste doesn't match to flavours of India. Definitely in one of the best area in Kathmandu which is lively and in a centre part of city!

We stayed here for 3 nights as part of a tour and found the hotel meet all of our expectations. We stayed in the new wing and our rooms were modern and clean although a few things didn’t quite work and I don’t understand why modern hotels insist on glass windows in to the bedroom, but that aside the room had everything we needed. The breakfast buffet was excellent and the service of all hotel staff to be friendly and attentive. The location is good and is quiet at night but still walking distance to Thamel for good shopping. Also used the Spa and it was worth it! In all a very pleasant stay.

If subject to heat request a room in the new building. Staff there was very courteous and helpful. Lovely room service. However these rooms have only showers. Next time I hope to check other things they offer.

The location of the hotel was convenient as it was in the downtown. There are two blocks in the hotel cross the road from each other. The staff in the reception of main hotel sent us to the other block and vice versa. We booked a twin room and we were given king room. We waited in the reception area more than 1/2 hour to resolve this issue. The staffs behind the reception desk were busy chatting themselves rather than helping the guests (typical customer service in Nepal).

Fair deal compared to the properties in the area.Gym is paid attention too.Courteous staff and very home like place. Centrally located and quite prompt on service delivery. The Bathroom is relatively small but fair enough when you are the one staying.

My stay experience with Hotel Radisson was wonderful. I could use all the facilities and there was no problem at all. The hotel was very accommodating to the last minute changes which I appreciated a lot. Also the service and the hotel personnel were all very helpful and approachable.

Da kann einem ein frischer Gartensalat, ein Zimmer und ein Bad nach europäischem Standard schon einmal abgehen...Der perfekte Ort, um zumindest für eine Nacht dem Gewimmel von Kathmandu zu entgehen. Günstige Preise? Für Nepali Verhältnisse nicht. Für vergleichbare Hotels in Europa, ist es dennoch günstig. Sorgenfrei Salat essen, ein gut ausgestatteter fitnessraum mit Zitronen- und Limettenwasser, welches bedenkenlos getrunken werden kann.. Nicht alltäglich!2 wunderschöne Restaurants, eines mit Außenbereich und "fließenden" Wänden, lassen nicht nur das Auge, sondern auch den Gaumen vor Freude tanzen.Im Keller ein Casino, in welchem man als "Spieler" kostenloses Buffet & Getränke nach Lust und Laune genießen kann.Für alle Raucher: die Kippe am Roulettetisch in der Hand, gehört quasi zum guten Ton!

Let me begin with the biggest advantage of this hotel: the swimming pool is just amazing.  And for some reason or another, almost always deserted.  But a swimming pool is a big plus in a city as KTM.Apart from that, dinner facilities are ok, but acoustic insulation could be a bit better.We arrived at 9 in the morning and immediately got a room, which was also very convenient.

We stayed for 2 nights at the Hotel.It was good.Food - [we are vegetarians] - tasty and not expensive at all.Very good ambiance .  Not an expensive hotel. - surprised.The Breakfast - indian stuff is also served. Overall - 7/10 krishna

We spent a few days in this hotel following an amazing trip to Kailash and Mansarovar and Himalayas. On a number of occasions when approaching the hotel staff on reception it appeared that we were troubling them and their manner was cool at best and unfriendly and rude at times. When asking for charger facilities they were dismissive. The choice of food in the restaurant  was not great without much choice and definately not up to the standard I would expect in a hotel of this standard. However, one of the staff members made amazing ginger tea which made our breakfast much better.. The nicest part of the hotel is the spa and especially the ladies in the hair and beauty section who were professional in reception, very friendly and accommodating of timings for treatments, clear ideas about what we might like and although I can't remember her name the hairdresser was great.

I have travelled to Kathmandu several times in last two years and every time have stayed at Radisson Hotel new wing. Staff, hotel and services are very good. Their physical fitness facility, swimming pool and whirlpool are not very clean. I found Sunam, Elisha & Bijal in reception/front desk area very good and helpful. Also, Om, Dipak & Krishna doormen were very good. Top Man from maintenance was also exceptional. Based on staff and facilities in the new wing I will always go back to this hotel when I am in Kathmandu. Thier staff in Tranquility staff and services are also very good.

We started our yatra to Kailsh from Katmandu.  We stayed at this luxury hotel.  The hotel is located in a busy area of Kathmandu and easily accessible from the airport.  We were picked up too and the drive is around 20 minutes without any traffic.  The place is really huge with two buildings housing the complex.  Large spacious car parking facility.  The rooms are really big and is almost equal to a suit type in other hotels.  All facilities in the room are of 5 start grade.  There is a nice roof top restaurant too.  Several halls and business center are the hall marks.  The quality of sleep and the beds are all really good. These are the positives.  However, I felt that the service levels were not really upto the mark as compared to the same chains hotel around the world.  As for example, it takes ages to get an Wifi to get activated.
