The service in the restaurant was also not to that mark. Felt they were understaffed at the restaurant.  The food was the lowest point and personally I felt it was not in line with most star hotels.  There was very little local variety and the food was not tasting all that great too.

This hotel in city center, foods/Room/staff qualities are good.  Hotel has casino in the ground/basement floor.  i was watching first time, nice time to spend here and learn the casino game.  Few KM away from pasupathy temple.

Staff members were good.  The property lacked some cleanliness issue's. Room service was good and quick.  Terrace garden staff was outstanding. How ever the pastry shop i found a bit unclean and had too little seating options. Checkout was also nice and simple. The front desk staff helped me with everything.

Location wise the Radisson is nicely located at Lazimpat which is considered to be a posh area. The rooms are neat and tidy. However, the AC was not cooling properly which was brought to the notice of the concerned at around 2.00 pm. However, the complaint had to be repeated at around 9.00 pm and the room was changed at around 10.00 pm thus causing inconvenience to the guests.The socket for plug to charge the mobile phone is placed rather inconveniently.The quality and taste of food served at the buffet was not up to the mark. They did have great variety and the decor etc. were pretty good. However, the food was not as tasty.I asked the housekeeping for extra milk powder pouches. somehow I found the staff a little reluctant to give them.I feel that the whole exercise of any hotel should be to make their guests comfortable during their vacations. Somehow the Radisson was found lagging in it.

Visto che si sceglie un Radisson per andare sul sicuro, senza aspettarsi nulla che non sia uno standard internazionale, il giudizio dipende appunto da quanto si scosta rispetto ad un analogo Radisson in qualche altro angolo del mondo. Non conta quindi né la personalità dell'albergo né la tipicità del suo stile, che appunto non sono richiesti da una struttura che appartiene ad una grande catena internazionale. Visto in questa prospettiva, il Radisson soddisfa tutti i requisiti di base (pulizia, gentilezza del personale, completezza dei servizi, comodità delle camere, colazione ampia e varia, ecc) con una eccezione. Che però non è trascurabile. Ovvero il funzionamento dell'aria condizionata nell'edificio più datato (quello centrale, per intendersi). Si tratta infatti di un impianto esausto che avrebbe bisogno di aggiornamento o sostituzione. Il sistema centralizzato non riesce a raffrescare abbastanza le camere (quantomeno la 717, al settimo piano, dove sono stato), che per la loro esposizione tendono quindi a scaldarsi. Così, nel clima ancora estivo di Kathmandu, la stanza è immersa in un'aria caldo-umida, con annesso odore di muffa che aleggia, tuttaltro che piacevole.

Reception staff knowing fully well that we would be checking out at 530am, still insisted on 12 hr notice for providing packed breakfast. Reason, kitchen is unable to cook eggs at short notice of 1 hr. they charge so much  and in return they have these pathetic rules or incompetent staff.

Very good and quite place. Easy access around the city. Great restaurants around the place. Host of Taxi services available from the Hotel. The food is good and goes well with anyones taste buds. would recommend for family stay.

really nice hotel, good staff, good room, good food, and beautiful décor. I was truly impressed with the décor. the décor is in the form of exquisite carvings of wood, based on the history of Nepal. very artistic. truly a nice hotel to stay.

The staff was very supportive on our journey. We had a conference there, and people at the hotel sincerely helped us to be successful as they seemed to consider it as their work. I strongly recommend you to visit this hotel when you come to Kathmandu.

Between the old and new buildings, it has a good spreadWhile I got an upgrade, and thus shifted to big deluxe room in the Old Building, I missed room with a view.The location is good and close to ThamelEntry though a bit congested Food - not exciting; Tad 5-starish routine foodA but far from the airport and on a bad traffic day -- which is quite common for Kathmandu -- can take even 45 minutes to reach airport

Very nice staff knowledgeable and extremely helpful would definitely recommend. The roons are nice the internet was good quality the whirlpool is perfect. The drivers that they have available are very helpful

I would consider this hotel is a place to stay ad enjoy. I had been to this hotel >5 times and found that the old building is better than the extension building, in terms of room and lobby. I would recommend travelers (particularly on business) to stay at this hotel, if he/she considers to stay in a nice hotel. I am looking forward to stay at Radisson Hotel of Kathmandu again

Small rooms with antiquated feel.doors. Doors not fit.  Decoration Nepalese.  Staff very friendly and polite. Systems not all that great.  Manager insisted I had beer from minibar.  I said look inside the fridge.  Nothing had been taken. I had bought it at local shop.  Maid had not bothered to look.

The hotel was very welcoming. The room was comfortable. However, several messages left at the front desk were never relayed nor were the names of callers. Used plates removed from the room were left in the corridor for over 6 hours.

The location is good, but the room is too noisy. I could hear people talking and laughing from the hall, door slamming and the sound of trolley being dragged along the hall so that I kept waking up in my sleep.

Highly recommended. The room service food was not worth the money & bathroom felt cramped and looked very old, else completely satisfied. Would highly recommend for short business trips. However, need to try the new building block next time.

Overall this hotel offers good accommodation and amenities. I stayed in the new wing. The rooms show signs of wear and tear though are adeqate. The hotel offers escape from a hectic city. The surroiunding area is chaotic and there's little to see within walking distance. The staff were friendly and competent. The highlight was early breakfast on the 3rd floor which offered great city views and a peaceful and tasty start to the day.
호텔 룸컨디션은 만족할만한 수준이었으며, 조식 또한 괜찮았습니다. 수영장 사진은 있지만, 카트만두 공기가 안좋아 이용은 하지않았습니다. 본관과 별관으로 동이 나누어져있고, 본관 지하에는 카지노도 있습니다. 호텔 출입구쪽 마트도 있고 기념품샵, 미용실, 마사지샵 등도 있어요.

The hotel was good in all manners. breakfast was good variety of options. rooms and bathroom clean. only 1.5 km to Thammel. In Khatmandu i was told this eas a prime area and good restaurants nearby and every thing at walkable distance.

The Radisson in Kathmandu met every expectation.  There are half a dozen dining options, pool and fitness center and other amenities.  It is conveniently located in town, not on the outskirts, near restaurants, shopping and cultural sites.

Its a good hotel with a good appearance outside as well as when you enter and beyond the fun cafe.  I feel the hotel needs a good food outlet, the bar needs to be within the hotel and the rooms to be improved/refurbished.  The staff overall are very good.

The hotel building is not very impressive and neither is the entrance. A simple lobby leading to a breakfast area. There is a second building which is an extension and has the restaurant and the banquet hall. The rooms are clean and well equipped with kettle, hair dryer and other regular toileteries. There is not much view from the rooms. The breakfast is very good and they serve fresh fruit juices and delicious south indian cuisine. The buffet lunch is rich with a variety of desserts on offer. The cost of the rooms is approximately 5000-10000 Nepali rupees depending on the discounts offered.

I had eaten at Olive Garden once before for a large group, fixed-menu meal and it was fair.  We tried it for dinner last night just for a regular weekend dinner and we left very disappointed and still hungry.  The "Crispy calamari" had more crispy than calamari and was overcooked.  The beef was the toughest beef I've had in Nepal (after living here for 1 year).  Nepal is a generally Hindu country, so beef can be a challenge, but La Sherpa, Chez Caroline, and even the Shangri-La hotel consistently have very tender beef with great flavor.  The Olive Garden's was really tough, had little flavor, and (unless you count the three leaves of garnish) no vegetables.  Both of our main courses were small portions, presented very nicely on overly huge plates.  Sadly, despite the appetizer and mains, we left the restaurant $50+ poorer and still hungry.  Main point: don't waste your time or money at Olive Garden.  If you have transport try one of the other places around.  If you don't have wheels, just walk up the street to Vino Bistro.

Anche a Kathmandu, magari con qualche pecca non tollerabile in Occidente, Radissson riesce ad offrire un servizio di alto livello. Le camere sono confortevoli, pulite con tutto ciò che serve. La colazione è molto varia e di qualità. Anche i pasti sono di buon livello con un buon assortimento di portate, naturalmente se non piace la cucina asiatica la scelta è più scarsa. Molto buono e cortese il servizio.

A huge hotel, vibrant, excellent spread of buffet meal, good staffs ! everything is simply amazing, a great 5 star hotel. I personally feel rooms in old wing is preferable, though rooms are new & contemporary type in new wing, this is more for business traveller. Our of the hotel has good souvenir shops to take a stroll. Overall highly recommended !

Cozy rooms, I was impressed with the pleasant smell, everything is spotless including the toilet,prices adjusted to the luxury offered by this hotel, you can not ask for more,It was nice staff who tried in all ways to make us feel at ease recommended

Rooms are horrible to stay in and food is like icing on cake most horrible food in Kathmandu. I hope Radisson will take their name away as this hotel makes radisson name look bad. They have no customer service and they only concentrate on getting new guest the forget the existing guest aren't staying for free.

Dear All,I would like share my experience with Radisson Hotel Kathmandu Nepal,This is too much worst hotel in Nepal, they don't care their own customers and staff people don't have the manner talk with customer,room service is too much worst, they worry just only for, how they can make money from customers.Thanks & RegardsArvind Kumar Jain

very relaxed and comfortable stay. The way to the hotel is lined with small cafes , money exchangers and a supermarket. Indian currency is accepted everywhere except 500 INR . An excellent Buddhist SPA is right next to the Hotel. must try

Although parts a little "tired" we loved it. The people were very friendly, food very good, rooms very comfortable. It was an easy walk to the centre of the city so it is a a good place to stay to see the sites.

Radisson Hotel at Kathmandu is a large luxury 5 star hotel about 7 km from airport.The staff at the reception are very polite and efficient and the entire staff are well trained and oriented towards Nepali hospitality.Rooms is quite large and the 2 king size cots in every room are clean and indulgent.The bathroom is small and toiletries limited.Hotel serves an excellent and lavish breakfast.Overall great stay experience.

If you looking for a peaceful place where you want to relax and enjoy your time than this is the place to be, Excellent service and professional staff, a real value of money, highly recommended to everyone but internet needs improvement, overall it's all good

Nothing like the photos seen on the booking portals. The fitness centre and the spa are too crowded and shameful. The food is below average. I will not stay here when I visit again. The location is not too bad. They need to seriously do something.

This hotel is in good location in the city. The room is clean and well maintained. However, the room I stayed was too cold. It was 18 degree celcius and could not be adjusted. I called the front office and someone came to take a look at it but nothing had been fixed after that. I should have changed the room but I did not. So I needed to turn the A/C on and off a few times that night. Other than that, I enjoy my stay there.

Hotel Radisson Kathmandu is at a convenient location. Stay here is always pleasant. Staff here are very friendly and helpful. Their warm smile makes you feel at home. The food here is very tasty. Room service also good.

A great hotel. With great ambience, food was owsum. Staff was really co operative. Love the place...would recommend everyone to stay at this place. Location was perfect. Radisson name itself is enough.

Radison Hotel was selected for me by Karnali Excursions (Hiraji). My purpose was to support Nepal tourism for Kailas-Mansarovar Yatra. It was very nice experience as I was able to finish my work as planned.

True to Nepali Culture and Hospitality, had a very comfortable stay at the Radisson Kathmandu. Courteous Staff, Good food, Well maintained rooms...very good housekeeping... Highly recommend the hotel for business as well as leisure stay...

This hotel need to revamp their management. I have been hoping that it gets better - but not.  Got to change the a few things such as bedsheets and towels. They seem to be at least 5-7 years old.  They also have tho think about healthy version of the breakfast.

Positives: Free pick up/drop off transportation from/to airport was efficient although the staff waiting for myself was not very friendly at all. The room was clean, will most expected facilities such as cable tv, air con, mini bar, ironing, etc, although these facilities have seen better days-dated. It has a swimming pool, a 'casino' and some restaurants at the ground floor. Negatives: Staff attentiveness, friendliness and attitude seems to be mixed. While I have encountered some staff who are friendly and helpful (frontdesk), others seems to brushed me away when asked for assistance (one waiter at the restaurant was extremely rude and couldn't be bothered to look at me when I have politely asked for tea). Also, the person (not sure if he is staff of hotel or airport) who escorted me with my luggage from the airport to the Radisson bus, demanded that ai gave him tip for his 'service' of escorting me. He even waited and kept staring me from outside the bus of which I eventually gave him money. Irrespective if he is Radisson staff or not, the real Radisson staff with the sign did direct me to this weird guy.  The menu for room service was extremely limited. The restaurant food was ok but go early, as after 8am, you will be fighting for a seat and clean plate.

Went to have dinner here during our visit. We were told by them that they serve indian veg food. But when we went, their menu only had 2 veg dishes....one paneer and one dry potato. Had to order both these. The food was not good. Did not enjoy at all. Were greatly disappointed.

Well located hotel in a street a little away from the chaotic traffic of this city. Good service, good food. Tha faucet of the bathrooms is somewhat deteriorated. It has a single operating elevator which is a pain. In summary, good place to expend a days before and after the Everest BC trekking.

I expected more of one Radisson hotel.My biggest complaint is related to the stuff who is pretty untrained and not friendly enough. The rooms are pretty clean but all hotel need some seriuos update.The food is fine.However the hotel can be ok for couple of days stay.

Good location for a single women traveller. friendly staff. Fitness Centre is awesome and the view from the TOP makes the workout so relaxing . It would be good to have more in room dining options , especially for people who want to eat healthy

Few minus but many plus.Check in should have been 2pm. But it was at 3pm.Reception staff requires much understanding. Specially the hotel gets in prime tourists.Room given in main building. It is very old, poor maint.and cries for much renovation. Poor bath room with leaking faucets. No electrical points for charging. Had to go down to request for extn.box . These are minus.of course they offered room in new wing but later. New wing in a different building. But it  is isolated and no life thete.Plus points and positives.Extremely good staff in restaurant , in the bar , house keeping. Very friendly and helpful. They make you feel welcome and makes up for all the other minus.Wish they keep the rooms renovated and the standards of Radisson kept up.

I booked three time hotel taxi and none of them offer good car and even one of cars didn't have A/C. It seems that hotel taxi actually is 3rd party private car and hotel can't manage them well. Other service are generally well, such as room, service and etc.

I booked a room at Radisson Amritsar specifically requesting a KingSized bed and even paid in Advance. At the time of checking in, the Reception Staff mentioned that since a large Group had checked in and they wanted the room with a Kingsized bed, he could not help but give it to them. I was offered a single bed. when I wanted to see the Manager on duty I was told he had gone home for a while. After waiting he came to the Hotel and had the gall to offer me a 'bribe' of a free meal voucher if I would not make a complaint. Shocking !!!

Stayed for four nights in the hotel and enjoyed the stay very much. Only negative thing was the quality of breakfast, particularly Indian food. The quality of Indian food is pathetic. Rest everything is perfect.

I had stayed in Radisson for 2 nights. I found the rooms to be comfortable, service efficient and overall ambience was good. The location is very central. I have no major issue with this, but when I checked-in, there was no help offered with the luggage etc.

Att besöka Kathmandu var att möte många trevliga människor. Hotellet var stort med en bra service och en fin restaurang med god mat. Rummet var välstädat med några år på nacken men sängen var skön och man sov gott.

good service and good rooms staff is good, hotel staff is good, swimming pool is more clean, Casino also is nicely maintained, enough parking space, near to main road, Unique location and spacious rooms

I recently stayed in this hotel for 3nights and 4 days and loved every bit of my stay. The rooms are comfortable, breakfast is sumptuous and all comfortable facilities are in the hotel. The staff is also helpful and friendly

The Radisson is not a bad hotel, but for the price you pay you would expect more or conversely given the facilities you'd expect to pay less. Among the things that don't sit well with the price tag: elevators out of order half of the time, noisy plumbing (yes, I mean you hear the noise from the wc a bit too much), broken and/or noisy A/C, breakfast: all you can eat but not very tasty, lousy minibar, lousy TV channels, etc.All small details that I wouldn't mind too much at a sub 100$ price tag, but given what they charge for the basic rooms, I find irritating.Staff are nice enough, it's really the facilities.Also don't go to their restaurant at the airport, have lunch or dinner before.

Lovely place , centrally located with swimming pool on higher floor. Try to book the higher floor. courteous staff. Breakfast spread is pretty good to suit every age group. There are shops close by to do last minute shopping.

Decent hotel to stay . however being a big brand does not make any major difference on the quality of stay.  Pick up & drop services from airport has to be done in meticulously replacing the current vehicles with quality high end sedan/fleet.

The Radisson is a standard chain hotel.  The rooms are a little tired; we stayed in the annex.  The breakfast was average but nothing stood out.  I held a workshop there but could not get the staff to post a sign about the location with the result that many participants wasted time searching.  This despite repeated attempts to get them to simply put a sign.  Now having said that, it is located close to the Jazz Club and the French Bistro and I enjoyed these venues rather than the hotel.  There are better top end hotels than this.

I was blown away by the humble, gentle nature of all the people I met in Kathmandu.I immediately felt safe and welcome in this city. The Radisson Hotel was just an extension of this city's hospitality with all the perks of a modern 4 star hotel. All the staff were friendly and professional, the room was clean and very comfortable, I thoroughly enjoyed my stay and would gladly recommend this establishment. Thank you Radisson staff for a truly wonderfull experience.

Generally we received the satisfied services. And nice stay, there too. What I most like is the typical food they offer for breakfast and lunch because we usually dined out at night. I tried everything and love it. the location is also convenient to take just half an hour walk to the downtown tourist spots. They also take care of our luggages when we go away for a day trip to Chitwan. As there is a business trip, I have no time to try other facilities given swimming pool, spa, etc. But my friends love it. In my opinion, the meeting rooms are quite small and the air conditioned system there is quite inconvenient,   however, ok for bedroom. The souvenirs stalls are near the entrance of hotel, we therefore, easily wander around for presents. Also the downtown is just a few minutes walk from hotel, so we can dine out easily and tried new things on our own. What else I experienced is there are many brass statues everywhere at the reception place, at the lobby, etc. they are interesting decoration. I love the painting at the bedroom, too.  Its quiet, lovely and comfortable for stay. The room size is convenient and things are in neat and tidy.

Located at the end of a steamy side street of pashmina shops in Lazimpat, the main hotel is anchored by a grand and airy lobby, an elevated outdoor pool, and, above that, one of the world’s most splendid cardio-room panoramas ever, looking out over the humming, chaotic city toward its magnificent wall of mountains across the valley. An adjacent, newer wing offers a funky rooftop patio. Service is attentive and organized, and the rooms are well-appointed and pretty quiet.  The in-room movie channels are limited, though if you love Bollywood, you’re good.   Plus, whoever bought the art for the walls of this hotel knew what they were doing.   Subtle, colourful, and sometimes surprisingly powerful, its diverse collection of prints is an unusual benefit to hotel-chain customers.  Finally, if all that weren’t enough, a block away is Jazz Upstairs, a friendly club whose house band specializes in Nepali reggae.  Enjoy!

Excellent facilities and very warm staff, highly receommended. the room was very clean and bathrooms were excellent. Breakfast spread was very good and the room service food that we got late in the night was excellent.

We were a group of 26 from US, India, Taiwan, Australia, Canada, UK and we stayed in the hotel and the services were good and we were satisfied with the services I would recommend people to stay in this hotel. First we stayed in the Radisson hotel which was developed later and later after a 5 days tour we stayed in the main hotel

I have been on this hotel twice and i would highly recomment this because the service is good. Rooms are super!The breakfast buffet are totally delish especially the bacon which is to die for (I'm coming from the UAE) so why not take this chance hahaha

Staying here currently, never been on a more rock hard bed in my life- I think I'll sleep on the floorEverything else is okay bit considering this hotel is expensive you would expect a decent bed. The room I had in Thamel had a perfect bed and was half the price of this place

Nice hotel but need extra shine . food is good , staff is well trained , rooms are bit compact but  cozy . they were kind enough to give us good packed breakfast early morning on the day of our departure.

A great service, attentive staff, good location and superb food.  The spa provides good massage services.  I was on a short business trip and did not have time to visit the gym and pool.  Will definitely go back.

The hotel has two buildings. The old wing has smaller rooms - so always go for the new building. The breakfast is excellent. Also do remember to carry connectors (the old building rooms all have European style plug points). The new building rooms are bigger, but the washrooms have glass windows to the room. The furnishing in all the rooms is plush (albeit the new building has better furnishing). The staff is responsive and does help out to make your stay hassle free.

O hotel é muito bom para sua região.  Boa localização, cafe da manhã em ordem. Jantar buffet é variado com tendencia indiana. Os quartos sao grandes e o banho é otimo. Me hospedei aqui por 3 dias antes de embarcar para um trekking até o acampamento base.

Excellent friendly and helpful staff, clean and comfortable rooms (opened window for air flow as air-con centrally controlled at higher temp than preferred, but understandable given electricity issues), very good dining at the fun cafe, nice outdoor pool area and appreciated the cardio room (ok given location, could not exercise elsewhere!)

This is the 4th time I am staying in radisson however I had opportunity to write the review this time only . The review is as follows Rooms - rooms are big , clean , good wifi connectivity , nice ambience and clean beds . Toilets - toilets are very clean and neat and well maintained Room service - room service is pretty good and fast . The choice of veg is less and you have plenty of non veg options . Truly international and prefer to order non veg in room service . Inspite I have ordered veg thali ( Indian meal ) in the night and it Islas good for a place like Kathmandu . No complains .Restaurant - coffee shop - the coffee shop is in the 3rd floor and they serve breakfast in the morning . Good one to visit Traveldesk - poor one and lot of service improvement is needed . Inspite of prior information the communication does not go properly from the reception and they fumble lot to give a decent pickup from airport . The quality of vehicles are pretty ordinary one and you don't feel like travelling in the same when you land . Radisson has to seriously to change the vehicle fleet which gives a bad impression . Swimming pool and gym - thete is a pool and gym in the 5th floor in old building and it is open always . Okay not highly impressive and it is crowded Spa - it is in the -1 level in new building and I had 15 min head massage for 1 day . Okay one not too impressive . Overall the Experience is like a normal hotel nothing too good and impressive to pull international traveller.

I was promised to get an airport pickup but was ditched at the last moment, and i had to reach out at hotel all on my own at 2:30 am.  The services and stay facility was also lousy and not up to the mark.

the new block is well designed to be quiet and effective. Does hardly have the large tour groups that are in the lobby of the main hotel. The food is good but not authentic Nepali. The bar is good and the conference facilities excellent

Good front office & other staffs, location is fantastic. Rooms are spacious at new wings, i prefer not to stay at old wing. Food is "pathetic"(sorry to use this word, but you get amazing food at other restaurant) Breakfast is okie, if you take only fruits & juice, rest everything is under-cooked or  uneatable.

The hotel is in a good location away from major hustle and bustle, but close enough that you can walk to where "the action" is. There is an excellent wine bar with an impressive selection of wine, cheese, and meat about a 2 min. walk away from the hotel (20% discount for a take away bottle of wine). In the same radius is a grocery store, deli, and a good coffee shop. Check out the rooftop bar for a sunset or a good rain.

I stayed at the new wing, the room was clean & comfortable. Internet was relatively slow. Breakfast variety was alright for me although it didn't change much during my stay.The location was great with a few shops nearby including a grocery shop.

Radission is very good hotel in Kathmandu. The facilities are a little bit old. Internet is not fast enough. Sometimes blackout. The lift is running with some problems. The buffet is just so so. Wish to improve the speed of Internet speed.

Swimming pool major attraction closed.Unfriendly reception staff.even the bell boy.Ticked  while booking double bed joined one.Blatantly refused when we reached to stay and we husband and wife slept on two seperate beds far apart.Power not in room for first 15 to 20 minutes.Overall not a good experience.We have stayed at meridains and hyatts internationally but never experienced so bad

Rooms allotted were smelly, dark & cramped. Hotel staff were not keen to take action. In fact found them rude. upon great insistence they obliged. very unlike Radisson. least expected for this kind of customer service

Stayed here for a night, because of the canceled flight. It was free. The hotel build in European style, so no more Nepalese crazy features. Rooms are big, breakfast is fantastic, stuff is helpful. This is probably not the place for backpackers or trackers, considering the price, but for free it was wonderful. If you got tired of mad-scientist-build nepalese hotels, this would be the perfect solution for you.

We just stayed for a day and were quite happy with the services though we stayed in the new one .My only request is to keep the incharge of the coffee shop  restaurant updated on the items available.We went for a buffet breakfast and since I had kids with me I requested for chocolate syrup with pancakes that was layed on asking the lady first  she flatly denied having one, I was surprised because a hotel of this caliber with guest from many countries esp foreigners  can just not  afford not having one then god knows what occurred she went around asking if it was available finally after 10 min or so she came around telling we do have it and kept it on the table .The staff seemed quite short at that time.

This is a standard western style hotel but for the price I'd recommend looking elsewhere. The rooms are reasonable sized but are starting to show wear and tear. It is a quiet location at night time. The staff are very friendly but this is not a five star hotel and is not worth the price.

We were staying at another hotel and saw an sad for the Olive Garden.  A Mediterranean restaurant in the Radisson.    Easy to get to off the main road.  Ultra clean   food served hot and was perfect.   There is also a large restaurant in the middle of the hotel that looked just a good.

I'm a regular here. The place is nice. Service is nice. Food is average. Have all sorts of facilities. Wifi is decent but the max they provide for an individual is 2mbps speed and that one is also chargeable... complementary speed is like 1 mbps. Other than that no complains... recently they started their casino as well which is good.. spa fitness center and swimming pool is good too...

This is actually my first experience .with Radisson hotels, but really am not satisfied with my stay there specially for comfort room & varieties of food. Food lounge is small.CR is to be equipped with toilet washers aswell as an option for others who are not using paper rolles. Try to change room but no obtion available.

I stayed in the "new" building which is showing wear and tear. It was fine - it met my needs during my business travels. Not much to walk to around the area. Staff are very friendly. Good selection of breakfast options.
素敵なホテルです、空港からも近く、設備もよかったです。部屋も申し分ないですし、朝食もラム肉の炒めものや、果物、スムージーありました。

bathrooms and rooms needs renovations swimming pool was closed Jacuzzi water was very dirty rooms are too small and furniture are old breakfast was ok  0 1 - 3 8 s h f beopls i k j h s d be l iwnsuse rsd

Reached down a narrow sidestreet barely wide enough for our bus. Collected our room keys and queued for the one working lift. Other one having 'temporary repairs’. Eventually took the back stairs to our room on 3rd floor.Room pleasant but all fittings/finish were to a very poor standard. Bathroom tap wouldn’t turn off. One tap very stiff. Shower taps were loose. Shower itself sprayed everywhere and water was very brown ! Chair in bedroom falling apart.Had to phone reception to get wifi password etc. Line very poor. Could barely hear. Not sure why this info could not have been given with key.Went to the bar across the car park. Just missed Happy Hour which was a shame as £6 for a bottle of local beer is a rip off. Seems to be the norm as most hotels in India/Nepal charge ridiculous prices for alcohol.Dinner was very average with a choice of Chinese (lots of them around), Western and the normal token Nepalese dishes. Some of our party had earlier complained that the hot food was cold. The staff offered to microwave their meals. Reheat the food ! Totally unacceptable in a hotel of this supposed standard.I find it strange that a worldwide chain such as Radisson does not regularly check the quality of its hotels.

Upon arrival at Kathmandu, Nepal International Airport, we were driven to our Hotel through the City where the main  Road arteries were broken up due the installation of underground water pipes. The City was a Dust Bowl !!Once we reached the Hotel Complex,,we were in the Oasis. Hotel is very nice, huge expansive lobby and very thoughtful service. Nepalese are a "Genteel" people, always ready to please you.

This is my tenth visit past four years now , feel the warmth , right when they receive you at the Airport till you are immediately checked in . I like the rooms at New Wing more spacious . Though view from front room at Old sigh is better . The food is good and reasonably priced . The Inroom service is very efficient and staff greets you evertime you see them with a very fresh smile . Very good for businesss and Family too !

As a seasoned traveller, this hotel is a fantastic blend of comfort, safety, and relaxation. Great rooms, very accommodating and welcoming staff, and top notch amenities. Only improvement they could make is a more up-to-date fitness facility.

Well appointed hotel close to the airport. International standard rooms with spacious comfortable beds. Bathroom has a bath / overhead shower which is welcome. Buffet breakfast is really nice and varies from day to day.Only negative is that the tap water, which although clean has a strong odour and is very yellow. So avoid washing out white clothing.I had the Trekkers Massage at the Tranquility Spa in the hotel - totally worth it and recommended to anybody looking to destress.Overall, I rate this hotel very highly. Price, by international standards also very reasonable.

Hotel situated in a nice place in the city. Have good room facility. Staff of the hotel is cooperative and reliable  . have a very good fitness club and spa facility. Security of this hotel so far i found is satisfactory and transports facility is good

Es un buen hotel. Habitación comoda. A pocos pasos hay una pequeña calle que tiene tiendas y uno o dos restaurantes y a 15 minutos caminando se llega al centro de Kathmandu.El baño es un poco antiguo, pero es limpio y no hay problemas con la presion del agua. Los empleados son muy amables

If the weather were good then it will be more satisfied the trip. Overall hospitality of the Radisson was too good and satisfactory. We visit temple and Darber and took Juma prayer in the Nepal Jame Mosque which were really enjoyable. Hope so, if I'll get change I make a family visit to Nepal.

Bathroom not cleaned properly, doesn't have 24hrs hot water supply.  Staff was not friendly. Checkout process was horrible. Sleep in room was not good because you can hear next room sound. I was in a other building so apart from breakfast all other meals I have to go to main building.

The Radisson hotel is in a quiet location not far away from Thamel.  There is a casino in the basement, but I didn't go there.  The room I had was spacious.  One elevator was out of order, so you sometimes had to wait a little, but not too much.

I never had such an terrible food any in Hotel and internet services was extremely poor. Also, room size are very small and congested. So much noise was coming from the besides room as there was a common door between two rooms though it was closed but noise was coming.

O hotel é bem localizado, ficando a cerca de 20 minutos a pé de Thamel. Só precisa se acostumar com o trânsito caótico de Catmandu! Não tem farol quanto mais faixa de pedestre. Atravessar a rua lembra o game "Crossy-roads"... É uma aventura e vc tem a nítida sensação que será atropelado!!! Mas creio ser melhor que ficar nos hotéis dentro de Thamel, onde as ruas empoeiradas faz a gente cuspir tijolo...O staff de funcionários deste a portaria até a recepção é bem atencioso. A parte comum: restaurantes, business center, sala de espera e banheiros do Lounge são adequados. A área fitness é pequena e a piscina descoberta no 5o. andar estava em manutenção no período que hospedei (fev/2017). Tem um Cassino anexo, que não visitei.Os quartos são um pouco antigos, mas confortáveis. O banheiro não é grande, mas limpo. A água é um pouco amarelada e ocorrem frequentes quedas de energia, fato que atribuo à cidade, não ao hotel.Mas o custo extremamente barato com instalações de uma cadeia conhecida vale a pena!!

Nice hotel, friendly staff, great food we stayed in the new part and room was everything we needed, views aren't great but think we're you are ha, it's a modern hotel, we didn't use the gym or pool so can't comment on them.

For people visiting Kathmandu and want to remain near city centres, this is an ideal location.  Market outside for shopping and Thamel the tourist hub nearby. Pashupatinath temple and other religious centres are closeby. During our time swimming pool was not functional.However, we enjoyed our stay and it is a good hotel.

Its not what you normally expect from a Radisson Blu property elsewhere. House keeping need to be improved if they want to maintain 5* rating . Restaurant is good. Spa therapists are also good. The view out of new wing is not at all interesting.

The hotel is having old and new building, the old one is quite old but not that bad. Room is ok.- Bed is ok but the fabric use for the mattress is so poor- Bathroom is old design with bathtub - Hot water not working 3 days out of 4 days of my stay- HK team is good and friendly, they should try so hard to get this old room in tidy all the time- FO not really helpful, not impressed with thier service at all except one guy Mr. Jeevan, he is super good and helpful with always smile and sincere- Breakfast is also below standard and poor service

Very high standard for Nepal. We stayed via World Expeditions for a trek tour up in the Himilayas. The Hotel is of a very high standard for Kathmandu, perhaps a slightly false representation of what the rest of the City is like tbh. The staff are impeccably polite, even by Western standards, and are always busy doing something rather than loitering. In fact, we found fellow guests to be the rude ones but we put this down to let's say "cultural differences" :) The food choice is good and to a very good standard, this from a Chef. We'd say avoid the taxis loitering outside as they overcharge, instead use the hotel transport. Also, if you want a quiet night on aFriday/Saturday, insist on staying in the secondary accommodation block NOT the main hotel as they hold weddings/parties in the main hotel and you certainly know about it. All in all, we'd definitely go back without a shadow of doubt.

I carefully reviewed several hotel because I intended to stay in Nepal for more than 60 days.  I choose, Radisson, and am glad I did.  At the end of my 60 day stay, I can honestly state the Radisson is very responsive to any reasonable request, and never has to do anything over.  Excellent hotel and great value for money.

Pleasant experience during my stay. All in all I would possibly stay at the Radisson again. Front desk and housekeeping staff were very professional. Rooms very clean and staff are very helpful. Food was good, breakfast was excellent

the hotel and service is good and nice people, for more very good i think the hotel provide many card or little books information for guest, the information could be map and destination and how to go the destination

Stayed for 4 nights on a business trip, the staff is quite friendly but not experienced, the corridors are noisy and the sound isolation isn't the best. The view of my room was to a parking lot with some bars and restaurants around it. The location couldn't be better, is central and there are plenty of transportation options, you can even walk somewhere as it is perfectly safe to do so. F&B staff needs to be a little bit sharper and fast on attending the guests.

Good ambience, room arrangements & service Support. Good networking. Dilacious breakfast. Spacious area. Good spa and staffs. Nice gym. Nice support service. Good pricing. Good location. Easy to find out the location.

Located at nice area, surrounding by some great local shops and pubs. Staff is friendly. Gift shop guy is really nice and helpful to select item. Rooms are nice and comfortable. Food is really good over here. Try napali nonveg thali.

Le camere sono nella media, mentre il bagno è un po' piccolo  e datato.Il personale è gentile e disponibile. Hanno messo a nostra disposizione due camere comunicanti con la felicità del mio nipotino. Durante il soggiorno in questo albergo ha compiuto gli anni e la direzione ha offerto una torta Sacher.

Hotel ótimo! Nos hospedamos antes e depois de fazer o trekking até o Campo Base do Everest e adoramos! Quartos limpos. Oferecem água mineral (2 por dia), já que ali não é indicado nem escovar o dente com a água da torneira! Nos hospedamos por 5 noites! O Café da manhã é excelente e enorme! Com mil opções e foi uma das melhores coisas do hotel! A localização achei boa, já que era apenas 10 minutos caminhando até o Thamel, mas bem menos agitado! A rua que dá no hotel tem caixas eletrônicos para sacar dinheiro, casas de câmbio e lojinhas muito interessantes. Também tem um mercadinho para compra de algum lanchinho ou algo que fique faltando! Depois de 15 dias de trekking, tomar um bom banho de chuveiro e deitar numa cama gigante, com um super café da manhã faz toda a diferença! Eu recomendo muito! O hotel tem piscina, mas não usamos.

We visited Hotel Radisson today for lunch during a British Council conference and were thoroughly impressed with the level of food - great service and freshly cooked food from the chefs. Great experience

Will never return to this hotel considering the poor wifi, TV problem, lack of variety on buffett menu and for over-charging my non-Indian colleaugue. The treadmill in the fitness center suddenly stopped while running at 8.5km/hr and the message flashed "out of order" suddenly. This is how they maintain their machines and it can lead to serious accident also.

The gym and pool need refurbishment. The music in public areas need to be changed (Nepalese traditional, classical). The gym music is bad and the ones who like to hear it should be provided earphones at the treadmills.  The old building air-conditioning needs to be replaced.  The new building is OK.

This hotel is centrally located and staff are great. Food is good. Just be sure to ask for a non-smoking room if you don't smoke. There is also an additional restaurant in the hotel but unfortunately it's Olive Garden of all choices in the world!!
阪急交通のツアーで利用しました。時々電気が消えますが、すぐに復旧します。バスタブ付きの部屋でした。水を溜めたら茶色でした。

This is the best possible place to stay at Nepal for a business trip. The overall service is outstanding and food is also great. It has all required services and very good location and large car parking.

Highly recomend Radisson for thos who travel to Kathmandu. Staff is very professional, facilities are convenient and clean. I liked the attitude of the people to guests. Very welcoming atmosphere and comfortable suits.

The hotel itself is in 2 parts physically separated from each other and you get sent across from the main lobby to a building across the street as premium rooms are separate in a new building. (but you come back to the old building for breakfast). The inexperience of the staff is very visible in almost every thing they do. I once stepped in and told the front office lady how to print my boarding pass which I had sent to the front office by email !!(after waiting for it for 10 minutes)You also get service when you personally "ask" for it. More responsive service will help this hotel.

Food needs to be taken care of with utmost imporatnce not at all at par with the International quality especially the breakfast buffet was also having very low average spread along with the taste of food.I do not want to visit this place specially for food

Clean, comfortable, good facilities. Jacuzzi was not open at the time. Good gym. Decent room service. Efficient and friendly staff. Varied breakfast. Close to bars, shops and restaurants. Would stay again.

Excellent hotel. Offers great food, service and facilities. The location is central for moving around in Kathmandu. Highly recommended for any traveller visiting Nepal. The breakfast is best with wide variety ranging from Nepali to India to English & Continental.

This Is full wastage of Money if you think it is 5Star property. Very Basic and average hotel since it is not owned by Raddison-It is running by Franchisee. There is little to fault - other than the view which is nothing to write home about.Overall, I was pleasantly surprised with the hotel and it scores on many points, but most importantly value. I was in Kathmandu for work last week and my company booked this hotel for me. Though the hotel vehicle picked three other guests from the airport along with me the process was very swift. It's only a 15 min ride away from the airport in traffic.I was told that I had been moved to the new building at the time of check-in as the main building was at full capacity. Like many reviewers have noted already, the new building is better in terms of many facilities and the rooms. My room was very comfortable and clean. The only problem was noise - the walls are not sound-proof and I could easily hear noises from other rooms in mine. My first evening loud music was heard blaring through the walls and the entire corridor. Seemed like a club nearby but not sure. My colleagues on the third floor (I was on the first) also complained about noise. The Wi-fi in my room worked great though - no problems like those mentioned in other reviews.The staff are particularly great especially at the reception and the housekeeping. I forgot to switch off the DND light on one of the days and my room could not be cleaned so the team came in the evening and made my room within minutes. The reception staff help you with currency exchange and general advice about sightseeing etc.The main irritant however was the breakfast service. The buffet has many non-vegetarian choices but only a couple of vegetarian ones. The service was ok but they seemed under-staffed in the peak hour of 8am when nearly all tables were occupied. As such, they took a lot of time to respond and I had to remind the chef about my order four times before it was served - half-burnt!! The vadas (served on two days during my stay) were under-cooked on both occasions and were extremely tough to eat. Staff need to be more proactive in keeping the food options warm - the sambhar for the South Indian options was found cold on nearly all the days. The dinner that I ordered through room service was only lukewarm, not hot.I also tried out the Spa which is completely worth a visit. They have a lot to choose from and the therapists are good so do take out time to use this service. Their pastry shop is average though - while the pastries were fresh, other eatables such as the patties seemed at least 2 days old.The hotel is centrally located. It was within walking distance of my office and many sightseeing spots that I wanted to visit. There's a supermarket in the same lane to buy any essentials you may have forgotten to bring along. There are some Nepali bank ATMs in the same lane and a Standard Chartered one a further down the main road. Taxis are easily available from the main road and are pretty comfortable and safe to use. I wish I had realised this earlier as I booked a cab from the hotel's travel desk on the first day to see some sights near Kathmandu. Booking through the travel desk was quite expensive and the driver tried to convince me to pay him extra during the trip!! It's better if you hire one of those Maruti 800 taxis from the main road - would be cheaper and you will get better service!! Don't forget to bargain though.Despite the few inconveniences, I had a fairly comfortable stay overall. I would suggest eating out though - food service is not a strength of this hotel and you will get better options with better service at cheaper rates literally anywhere else.
