After traveling we come back to the hotel and it looked like a home away from home. Of course we went through a tour operator, Monterosa Travel and because of this we got a good rate also.

This hotel is had stayed on August 1st 2016, I found that the welcome is warmth ,the staff is trained well and it's the best examples of hospitality, Particularly mr subhash at front office was so helpful in guidance about each querry regarding Kathmandu travel .The rooms are best one with a class of royal interiar and the lobby area is crispy ambience, There is spa, gym, swimming pool with amazing ambience and we'll maintenence. There is a casino for travelling ppl who want to try their luck. great memories collected at this stay .A best hotel in Kathmandu suggested

Great location, friendly and helpful service staff. Most front desk staff are helpful and client oriented. However, the hotel could do better in the area of food and drink choices with more coverage of local produce. Cleanliness (smelly carpets, lifts and AC) need attention, and senior staff be more visible and client oriented.

Okay experience.  Hotel needs to upgrade its service package. Property needs maintenance e.g. one lift is regularly out of order; woodwork looks shabby, the food is just basic and unimaginative. Gym is fantastic

It has everything you would expect from decent hotel at this price range. I was just little bit disappointed about the reservation system. I've made booking online and it was not possible to change by phone and it made lot of redirecting calls to find this out. I was stuck without internet connection unable to change my booking.

I really enjoyed the hotel.  The free internet was excellent, which is often not the case at hotels.  I really enjoyed the Terrace Bar and Grill.  The food and the staff were excellent.  I am an early riser and appreciate a gym that is open 24/7.  Sadly, because of my busy schedule, this prevented me from using the gym services.

Hotel abbastanza datato, di tipo coloniale (arredi in legno tipo old navy), servizio ottimo, buona pulizia, cibo ottimo. Considerando che a Kathmandu vi è scarsità di acqua e la corrente elettrica è erogata solo per poche ore al giorno, in questo hotel hanno un ottima scorta d'acqua ed un ottimo generatore di corrente.Bravi direi 7+

The Radisson name truly comes with a 5 star recognition! Being in a really crowded part of Kathmandu, the exteriors of the hotel seem very modern. The hotel is well connected and the food offered is also very tasty. Although the hotel is a real crunch to your pocket, being a 5 star, it is worth every penny paid for! The hotel has an immense amount of facilities guests can use to feel at home. There are few places one can visit while in Kathmandu and some are quite close to the hotel. Really enjoyed my stay here!

Very friendly staff, very clean, excellent location.  All services and facilities are excellent, except internet which could benefit from some improvement.  Excellent place to stay in Kathmandu.  Highly recommended

The hotel is fine although the internet connectivity is really very poor and the speed provided by the Hotel is really slow. This hotel is not recommended for business guest. In you are going with your family then the hotel offers good services including excellent location.

The staff needs to improve the service quality and response time to the requests by the residents. And internet Wi-Fi service needs to be improved which is very bad at the moment. The menu in food may also be increased, the present menu has very limited number of items.

Whenever I go to Kathmandu, I generally prefer to stay at Radisson as the hotel is nearer to my place of work. My experiences are generally mixed in nature ranging between Good to Poor. After my last detailed feedback to the management pointing out few issues, I was glad to see that they have improved their wifi management system this time to some extent. Now you dont have to maintain a dozen of wifi passwords, each valid for one day and one device, and keep on changing. This time they gave me a single piece of paper with password written on it, valid for the entire stay for three equipments. Much improvement indeed! However, most of the hotels nowadays simply allow guests to login using room number and surname, so no burden of tracking the password. Hopefully it will be done some time in future! Didnt see any improvement in lift operation though. Lifts are still old and often 'closed for maintenance'!Some of the rooms are terrible. Inspite of my advance booking, I got a room at lower floor , with twin beds, and with a terrible view of the 'not-so-nice' side of Kathmandu. The beds were not fixed properly and was travelling all over the room. No carpet, and the even if there is a 'heat' and 'cool' marking on airconditioner switch, it always works only one way. It seems choice is made by the operator and they decide at which point of time in a year the vents will be delivering hot air or cool air. My choice is  limited to switch it of or on.I was given a nice room on the very last day of my 4-5 days stay, and that room was cosy, with king-size bed, high floor, front view. I was surprised, at the same price, how the rooms could be so different in comfort level! You cant expect to rent a luxury car from the hotel desk. Anything like BMW or Merc is out of question. Even they cant arrange a decent Honda or Toyota sedan. There seems to be a disconnect between the front desk and the transport desk. A quick car call will not produce good result, they will just call a local taxi from the road. Restaurant staffs are nice and good, but they will never produce the bill before you leave the table. It seems to me that they love to chase me with bill book in hand as if I am running away without paying. At least two times they came outside of the main front door following me when I came out to see of my guests after meeting over drink/dinner. Finally I had to tell the waiter sternly not to follow me this way and wait till I come back to restaurant after seeing off my guests. And most of the restaurant staffs now know me, even then they lack the confidence somehow:-)

The hotel in bang in the heart of city but at the same time serene and peaceful. The rooms are well spaced and comfortable. Cuisine is great. The room service is prompt. The other guests I ran into seems to be enjoying their stay as well. Shopping out side the hotel is good but needs bargaining skills. The Pool Side restaurant in the main building is very impressive and the ambience is great.

A decent property, overpriced, and not so good on cleanliness. The hotel is located in a prime location in the heart of Katmandu. We checked in the hotel on the night of 11/6/2016 . The rooms are pretty small and that was the first disappointment. Much to our shock the rooms has cockroaches. I woke up in the middle of the night only to find a cockroach crawling near my pillow. Couldn't sleep after that. Discovered more pests when I bend down to pick my slippers below the bed. Overall this is an OK property but needs to pay more attention on the cleanliness and should offer more value for money.

I keep travelling Nepal often. It is very good to feel comfortable and secure in Radisson. Centrally located and near to departmental stores and needy things. comfortable check in even in add hours. spacious hotel and good fitness centre. very good coffee shop and staff who serve there. I always prefer to have meetings with clients in Coffee shop. very suitable for having breakfast meetings, lunch meetings etc.,

I stayed there on May 28-31st for a meeting organized in Kathmandu. Excellent service received from Prabin Shresta and his colleagues for our group of 20. I will recommend this hotel for business/family stay.

The hotel is at a good nightlife area with some amazing food and music places. The hotel is pretty old but well maintained. The service and food quality is very good compare to many places in Kathmandu. Rooms doesn't have great view to offer but surrounded with good area and great spa...

Stayed here after returning from a trek because I didn't want to stay at the Hotel Tibet where I stayed before I left.  Rooms were much nicer.  There were more food and beverage options.  Service was good.  But I filled the tub with water and it was brown.  Gross.  Went up to the pool area and the Jacuzzi was the same color.  Don't take a bath or get in the Jacuzzi.

After a couple of weeks travelling and staying in varying standards of hotel the Radisson in Kathmandu was pleasingly predictable. The rooms are a good size, spotless and have everything you could need; the shower is brilliant and the food superb. Of course you pay slightly more for these benefits but we were on holiday after all.

The wifi connectivity is terrible :( When me an my other colleague request for the wifi password, the front desk lady offered us one password to share. This was shocking for me. Though she gave two password later on. And I didn't expect this from a five star hotel.

Hotel provides all the required facility required for a Business and pleasure trip for Couples and family. The location of the Hotel is ideal, in a place where you can get whatever you require, within walking distance.

I would not recommend this hotel, there were several issues. while the staff was polite and helpful, i faced issues on hygine and ambience  - water would fill up in the bathroom and this also happened to a colleague of mine - room was overlooking a dump yard - the gallery outside the salon was stinky

This is a place you get good service, meet your business purpose. Great hospitality, Good food. Nice rooms. Location is near to city center. Lounge is good and spacious. Room service is excellent. Laundry service too good

Comfortable rooms, good sized dressing room and good basic facilities in the room.  Free wifi is very slow. Bathrooms quite small.Convenient to parts of town, short walk to shopping areas.Buffet at tfc quite good, but variety could be better. Overall a old hotel in an amazing city.

Decent hotel with good ambience and adequately stuffed rooms. The size of the room is relatively small but for short comfortable stay it is a good property with fitness centre and excellent spa. The buffet spread for breakfast , lunch and dinner is good .all in all a good comfortable hotel

Oasis of calm in the mayhem of Kathmandu. Clean and modern with excellent helpful, friendly staff. Good location, restaurants nearby. Try Fire and Ice, great pizzas. Best to use hotel transportation to - from airport.

Very Good hotel in terms of location and overall handling. Staff is very courteous and helpful.  Best place to stay with family as you can visit good markets of Kathmandu from here very easily.  Rooms are also very comfortable.

I was travelling alone on a guided tour around Nepal. I didn´t expect to find such a lovely hotel in Kathmandu, so it was a wonderful surprise. Everything was perfect: delicious meals, comfortable room... The location and service, excellent.

The hotel provided an island of calm from the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu. The room was comfortable, the staff was always courteous and welcoming and they kept the electricity on. That last point is key to a stay in KTM.

My experiences on the Radisson hotel kathmandu high quality service in hospitality,can ,choose different level of budget rooms ,excellent customer service ,overall had wonderful moment with the Radisson

Had a very pleasant stay at Radisson Lazimpat. It is easily accessible from the airport and is close to the shops. The breakfast was superb with choices to spoil even the best! The only issue was patchy WiFi access.

Centrally located close to Thamel but away from the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu. Rooms are great. Hotel a litlle dated but overall very good. Italian restaurant very good as well as the breakfast buffet. Will certainly recommend this hotel

I stayed at the Radisson for a total of 6 months.  At first, it was because it was close to my place of work.  It didn't take long for me to begin recommending it to other colleagues. The staff are top-notch, learned my preferences quickly, and were generally very helpful and professional.  The location is great, and the rooms are very clean and comfortable.

Silent, peaceful, and pleasurable stay at the hotel. Good quality food and helping nature of staff. Clean everywhere. not even regretted my stay for a second. would like to visit again and also wold recommend.

Dieses Radisson ist eines der besseren Hotels Kathmandus und bietet alles, was Radisson-Hotels üblicherweise bieten: Große Zimmer, wlan, Gym, Pool ... Es besteht aus zwei Gebäuden, einem neueren und einem älteren, mitbzwei getrennten Rezeptionen und Restaurantbereichen.Allerdings ist es wie offenbar immer in Nepal: Man muss Abstriche bei Sauberkeit und Instandhaltung machen, gemessen an europäischen Maßstäben. Nicht alle Ecken Ecken im Zimmer sind wirklich sauber. Aber im großen und ganzen okay.Frühstück ist eher nicht so toll.

I stayed in Kathmandu for business for 6 weeks, and was very pleased with every aspect of my stay at the Radisson.  The rooms were well serviced, and i enjoyed my stay very much.  Special thanks for helping this non-tekkie get access to internet that worked 24/7.

The Radisson is tucked away from the main street, which keeps it fairly nice and quiet.  Rooms are small but well appointed with all amenities. Staff were friendly and helpful, World Expeditions has a travel desk here and can book trekking trips for you.The breakfast buffet offers all the usual western foods, and also a full array of Indian and Nepali food.  All delicious.

Well-located, great staff, very comfortable rooms with baths (very welcome after a trek), pool, spa and gym, good food options - it's all there in this oasis in Kathmandu. Front desk staff can't do enough to help.

The staff at this hotel are generally very friendly with the exception of one minor issue I had on the roof terrace. The hotel it's self is quite nice but not really a luxury option. The rooms are pretty basic and the wifi connect isn't very good which makes it difficult when travelling for business. The location is great though. Walking distance to Thamel and close to the rest of town. They offer a free shuttle to and from the airport which is helpful.

le Radisson possède un bâtiment principal et une annexe. j'ai été logé dans l'annexe pendant mon séjour. les chambres et les parties communes sont OK. le bar/grill de la terrasse est a recommander bien que cher!

Stayed at the Radisson Kathmandu for 4 nights on a short vacation trip. I was upgraded at no extra charge to their newly built extension. Staff are very attentive, helpful and friendly. The morning breakfast buffet is outstanding as is the dinner buffet in the main building. Much of this city is still feeling the effects of the 2015 earthquake and the 2016 fuel boycott from neighboring India, but the Radisson eases the inconveniences for their guests. Great location in the center of the city with easy access to local attractions.

Je recommande cet hotel de part sa localisation pas trop près du centre ville et le bruit mais suffissament proche pour le faire à pied comme Thamel et Durbar. Les chambres sont propres et de bonnes dimmensions. Le petit déjeuner est toutefois dispendieux et à éviter 15$us. Il y a toutefois de la musique au alentour jusqu'à tard le soir mais sans nous empêcher de dormir. J'ai payé en avril 110$us la semaine du nouvelle an. Mais négocier le prix avec le petit déjeuner.

Very much suitable for Executives who travels on business  . Pleasant experience and centrally located & within Business District of Kathmandu. I prefer to stay in this Hotel. Near by restaurants such as Angan, Trisara Bar & Restaurant and many more hotels and Departmental stores are around the Hotel. Money exchange in Hotel and around small money exchanges centers and Standard Chartered Bank etc will add a value for our stay at the Hotel.

Agreeing with many of the views, it is desirable that this hotel will do it a comprehensive reform to bring it up to current standards for hotels in its category.That said, my opinion on it is based on repeatedly I have spent in the same over recent years, the last two last year.The first thing I would like to evaluate is the great professionalism and, at the same time, great kindness of its staff.The rooms are spacious and comfortable, although the lack of updating of furniture and decoration is denoted, at least in the old part and I still do not know the new wing.The restaurant is well located, the food is, mostly, high quality although it would be great if it could be more varied.The restaurant servers are extremely friendly and professional and made just missing a place in the hotel where a beer or a glass, ie a bar.The value of the hotel I think it is good, location is excellent and certainly seems a highly recommended hotel. This is the reason why I've stayed in it and I went there with groups for some years.

Had a lovely stay at the Radisson Hotel Katmandu. It was  for a short business trip, the staff was great, good food. and great service experience overall. The hotel is has all the facilities that you make need including a spa, gym and swimming pool.

I stayed at Radisson for five nights and would come back again.While the hotel, in the old wing where I stayed, could use a paint job and a change of panels some places; it is still among the best of hotels in Kathmandu. The staff is attentive and very friendly; accommodating and service-minded. The breakfast buffet (a little steep, at 1500/day) caters to both western and SEA customers and has a fairly broad selection of options. The 24 our Room service I tried only once, but food was delivered fast and was of good quality. TV channels are heavily skewed towards SEA customers, but do include CNN, BBC and HBO. Location-wise Radisson is walking distance from the vivid Thamel district and lovely Garden of Dreams, and only a short drive to the airport and key embassies in the area. Taxis are readily waiting outside the hotel and will take you to Thamel for around 200-300 Rupees and Airport for 4-600. The small street, leading directly to the hotel is lined with shops and cafes, making it easy to snatch a souvenir in a somewhat quiet environment, if and when, one has had enough of the bustle in Thamel. Hotel wi-fi is stable and free of charge; pool is clean and has a lovely view (though they have no poolside bar) there is a fantastic terrace-bar in the new wing of the hotel. Here you'll also find the tranquility spa which I can recommend for a massage after a day of wandering the city.

Staffs are good but the room are pretty bad especially in old wing. Heard the new wings are good but when asked to be shifted to new wing , no availability. Internet facility was good , the foods are very good.

The staff were great and friendly. The lobby can be a bit chaotic at times due to trekking trips arriving/departing. Food we found to be okay, the drinks are over-priced. We went to the Hotel Tibet across the road most nights for drinks which were much more reasonable - plus their roof terrace is a gem of a find. The rooftop pool area is very disappointing, the hot tubs are gender separated and indoors, plus they looked very grubby. The pool area could do with some updating ie they should consider a food menu up there. We have stayed in both the new and old wing, the old wing we found to have less problems than the new - the room sound insulation in the new wing is very poor and the hot water can be hit and miss - although the rooms there are more modern than the old wing which could do with some updating. There are some great little shops in the road leading to/from the Radisson, plus a gem of a traditional Nepalese restaurant a few meters walk away down a side road. We have stayed in a traditional boutique type Nepalese hotel and when comparing the two you can see why the rating between them is so vast - we felt the Radisson was not worth the money they charge per night when there are lots of smaller more traditional hotels out there who charge less than half of what the Radisson does. Definitely not the worst hotel, but for the money we would not return.

I stayed here for 3 days and luckily I was upgraded to a suite in their new wing which has been recently renovated.My first impression of the hotel was that it's no way close to some of the other radisson properties I have stayed so far. It's pretty much an average property.Having said that, the room was nice but the view outside wasnt great. The best part bout the hotel is their staff and they were genuinely warm and welcoming. I really enjoyed that part.One thing that needs a lot of improvement is the menu and the quality of food... the options are too less and the food isn't something to write about. The breakfast menu needs to be in line with radisson standard which it wasn't. Overall I enjoyed the stay primarily coz of the staffs and it's location. May stay here on my next visit too.

We stayed at the Radisson whilst visiting Nepal, with 2 children under age of 10. Service and hospitality was excellent, comfortable beds and spacious rooms. Location was good for the city. Excellent staff

Good place to stay - is safe, secure. The rooms are a bit noisy The fitness centre is unique with cardio on the terrace, swimming pool a floor below and the fitness gadgets a floor below. The service is a bit poor but ok

Altogether Radisson is very good and i used Radission in many citys in India like Jaipur, Simla, Kadmandu,  Chandigrah, etc. Most of my visit is with my family, and  my all family members are very satisfied in Radission Stay. in future also we are giving first preference  Radission. Myself and my family members are Wishing ALL THE BEST TO RADISSION AND THEIR ALL STAFFS

The hotel is located conveniently in the central part of Kathmandu. Unfortunately, that and the 'Radisson' brand name are just about the only things that work favorably for this hotel. Entering the hotel feels like traveling back in time to the mid 80s due to the rundown furnitures and fixtures. The two elevators, of which one was out of order more often than not, are extremely slow and seem to have a mind of its own, deciding to skip floors as and when they please. They do have a 'new' building across the street from the main hotel, where the rooms are tiny and are prone to the constant sound of cheesy bollywood music from the night club and dance bars in the neighborhood.I stayed at a 'Business Class' room which was located on the first floor of the main building next to the hotel parking yard. The room was quite spacious but the sound proofing was absolutely terrible. Even with all the doors and windows closed, every night was a cacophony of the noise of vehicles driving in and out, drunk people singing in the parking lot in the middle of the night, the television from the room next door, and a migraine causing hallway vent.The free wi-fi internet at the hotel is substandard (below 512kbps) and even the premium internet that I purchased was nowhere near the advertised speed. I tried to use the business center to get some documents printed, but that was an impossible mission. The attendant tried to help, but after a quick phone call, her suggestion was that I return after 30 minutes.Lastly, even after 4 days of checking out, my Club Carlson points still hasn't been credited even though I was assured by the front desk staff it would be done within 48 hours of checking out. In summary, this hotel is plagued with a myriad of problems that the management needs to address in order to keep up their reputation of being a premium business hotel in Kathmandu. Having stayed at Radissons all around the world, this is definitely not what I have come to expect of the brand.

Good hotel with nice, comfortable rooms and not so bad dining options. The staff and service was good. The front desk activity was relatively slow during check-in; however, the check-out was quick. It was a good stay.

Poor and not well maintained rooms ,looks like staying in a normal economical hotelDoesn't give a feel like staying at Radisson and paying handsome tariff. Further AC was too noisy and problem is not fixed properly even after complaint. House keeping need to be reminde at least for 2 times for getting a service

الغرف جيدة، ودورة المياه يوجد فيها شطاف ماء ، والافطار خيارات متنوعة ، يعيبه فقط وجود فاصل زجاجي لدورة المياه ويفضل لو كان غير ذلك.القنوات التلفازية لاتوجد قنوات عربيةووجود الفندق داخل المدينة وسط الاحياء أمر جيد.

فندق رائع وخدماته مميزة وموقعه قريب من المركز التجاري ويبعد حوالي خمسة وثلاثين دقيقة مشيا عن المركز الاسلامي ومسجد جامع وتوجد هناك مطاعم اسلامية صغيرة ومتواصعة ولاكنها افضل من لا شئ وافضل وسيلة للتنقل هي استخدام التاكسي او وسائل النقل العام

My stay at Radisson Kathmandu was excellent.  My room was comfortable & clean, all members of the staff I encountered were polite and helpful.  Excellent breakfast buffet, internet service consistent and fast, front desk helpful at all hours.

This is my second stay at the Radisson in Kathamndu. Like the first time I was given a very pleasant room on the second floor. It was clean, quiet and comfortable. The breakfast was again a wonderful daily experience.

Internet was not compatible with my android phone. They took 3 hours to rectify problem on their end. Then they just made me pay for entire day in spite of their service fault just for 3 hours ... A big shame on brand like Radisson. Should be blacklisted. Rude staff.

It seems not to have been much updated and we were there in February, non-air-conditioning season. I'm sure it is adequate to the needs of hotel-stayers: we were there on a package tour so  really I have zero complaints.  Breakfasts were fine with English language newspapers available.. one really good thing is that there are multiple tourist shops in the foyer and the sellers do not pressure the buyers.  If you abhor the hawkers etc, here is where to buy your shawls, jewelry, your dresses etc.Also, the location in a cul-de-sac is unbeatable...quiet and private

This is a wonderful hotel with wonderful friendly staff.  The rooms are spacious and well appointed.  We were fortunate and we were upgraded to a suite.  The food here was good and safe to eat.  The hotel didn't seem to be affected by brownouts.  It is in a central location and there is a grocery nearby.

Visited for one night. The staff is very courteous. However, the Internet was pathetic. Also the shower did not have hot water. Food is just ok. No buffet for dinners. On a business trip, one looks for good internet and a refreshing morning shower. And both did not work for me.

My stay was with a group tour for February 22 - 24.  Overall, a very good hotel.  As we have found throughout Nepal, the people are great and the staff at the Radisson were no exception.  However, only one of the two elevators was working during our three day stay so waiting for the elevator was longer than it should have been.  Never could get the temperature of the room below 76 degrees.  Other members of our tour group also expressed the same complaint about the room temperature.  The breakfast buffet was very nice.  The lunch was nothing special and never ate dinner in the restaurant.  Nice selection of shops within the hotel.  The WiFi was free which I found to be unusual.

Everything was good except for the food served during lunch and dinner was not up to the mark,but stay would have been more better if there would have not been power cuts .the location was really good,close to all the tourist spots.

Stayed few days either side of a 2 week trek .... Beautiful beds and rooms . Great helpful staff and lots of yummy things for buffett breakfast . Would stay again ;) corner bar was also a great place to unwind with a few drinks after a long day in the city

Stayed here for 3 days on a business trip. The hotel has a good property. Rooms are comfortable. Service is good and prompt. The location is great for tourists as it is very close to Thamel.Only negative is the room service menu which has very limited options and quality of food that I ordered in the room (grilled chicken sandwich) was not so great.Breakfast buffet is good with ample variety and great service.There are interesting little local restaurants all around the hotel which you can just walk to and that makes up for the limited food options in the hotel.

The Radisson has definitely become my hotel of choice when travelling to Kathmandu. The staff are very helpful, and are keenly aware of perspective of western travellers. Whether you are on business, or are looking for a comfortable stay while exploring the beauty of Nepal and its people, the Radisson is a good choice

I had been to hotel on 29 Jan 2016 for attending a marriage. The approach of the hotel is very bad. you will have to cross through a narrow road from main road. But inside is very well maintained. sufficient parking. no words to say about the banquet hall. nice and big. the food were really tasty. all the preparation were fantastic. the The dinning area next to banquet was amazing. the sound of the waterfall on the side wall would always give you a feeling that you are some were near a fall. Loved it really. the staff service was jast as you expect in a 5 star hotel. full numbers.

Hotel Radisson is *** base hotel in the city it has party seminar space and deluxe room service with casino, swimmingpool and all the facilities are available. I personally reccumend this hotel to stay.

Good experience with worth of money. Staffs behavior was warm and hospitality received found satisfactorily. Mini bar at the room should have improved with the supply of liquids. Elevators should be fragrant and cleaned and checked for better experience.

Stayed in the hotel for 3 days. Hotel location is OK. Many restaurants nearby and a small market and money change within 5 minutes walk. However, hotel lobby is Ok , but the room is dated and not very clean. I am sure there are better hotel in Kathmandu for a similar price range. I also had a hard time to find a electrical outlet to charge my cell phone and computer. Staffs are very pleasant and helpful.

De voorzieningen van dit hotel zijn top en de staff is über vriendelijk en service gericht. Het eten in restaurant maar ook de room service is van top klasse en geen zuinige porties.  De locatie van het hotel is prima. Loopafstand naar de meeste bezienswaardigheden.

The Radisson is perhaps one of two decent business hotels in Kathmandu. The staff are nice and accommodating. The restaurant has a selection of buffet and a la carte so it's convenient and doesn't get old. The rooms are traditional Radisson style, tourist class and don't expect high luxury. It's definitely not 5 stars (that would be the Hyatt) but it certainly is very good. The spa is also nice for after work relaxation. Overall a good experience.

The current fuel shortage in Nepal is affecting all businesses in Kathmandu, including the big hotels, even though they get preferential treatment. Traffic in the hotel was rather low at the end of January; tourists seemed to be rather few and those you could see were mainly Chinese. The new wing of the Radisson was closed. The old wing has more character but is at the same time also a not up to the standard of a 4 or 5 star hotel. To compete with the Hyatts and the likes it would need to upgrade its overall service and particularly its amenities.  While the hallway emanates the smell of a run-down hotel, the room was super clean and felt cozy. The room was generously large with a separate walk-in closet.  The bathroom was a bit small with a bathtub instead of a shower stall.  I can’t comment too much on the food as I only consumed breakfast, which is not first class but acceptable. Getting internet access – a must when working – is a bit tedious as one must get daily vouchers from the front desk. As a business traveler I always appreciate access to a gym to alleviate the pain of sitting too many hours on airplanes or in meetings. Unfortunately, the hotel’s fitness center is a huge disappointment. The weight room is tiny – and that is not an understatement. Since the fitness center is open to the public, it is super crowded in the mornings and after 5 pm. Every piece of equipment is occupied. Treadmills and bikes are located on a separate floor and can only be accessed from the outside. The equipment is old. The treadmills are unbalanced so that running fast is simply out of question for fear of stumbling. An unexpected power outage caused the treadmill to stop abruptly, adding an element of anxiety to the workout experience that is more harmful than healthy.   I chose the Radisson due to its proximity to he places I needed to visit. If distance is not an issue I would suggest using a different hotel.

too expensive for what it is, i don't consider it a 5 star hotel at all. The rooms and bathrooms are old and I was put into a room with a door separating from the other room so I had too much noise at night. location is not the best as I've red in the reviews. clearly disappointed

i had a smooth checkin, rooms equipped well, food was good, the buffet is great. Need to check hot water inflow in taps, and room heating. Internet is good, but connects to only one device at a time. Staff is warm, helping and courteous.Bar is well equipped, very efficient and the bar tender great.

Had a number of longer stays in Kathmandu with work and stayed at the Radisson.  Hotel is in a good location with plenty of restaurants close by, and easy walk to Thamel.  Rooms are comfortable, although they could do with some renovation.  Gym is very well equipped, and I used this most mornings.  Buffet breakfast is great, and was a nice start to the day.  No complaints from me on this hotel.

The hotel is a little tired but this is Nepal. They are struggling with fuel shortages and electricity cuts. With all this in mind ether is little to complain about. Everyone was helpful and the restaurant was working. The breakfast buffet was good.

The rooms are great - as in all Raddison.  But . . . forget ordering any type of cuisine other than the local goodies.  They haven’t a clue how to make a good omelet and their ravioli was hard and chewy like it had been made from chapati flour or something.  Also, they skimped on the cheese - barely any.  And if you think you’re gonna get two drinks for the price of one at their Happy Hour, bring your own alchohol!!!!!  They measure every ounce to make sure they don’t go one drop over.  The bar was empty.  Wonder why? HERE’S A CLUE !!!!! A great happy hour gives a good pour because people going for the 2 for 1 thing are looking to get a little buzzed in the afternoons.  So, Raddison, if you want to fill up your bar, give people a reason to come!

Please degrade it to 2 star hotel. It was nothing as expected with the name of radission. Please improve internet wifi speed. Please atleast provide clean water in the bathroom. I had to shower and brush with muddy water. Please provide little bigger bottle water to drink. You called it business room but it was nithing sort of business room. Please donot call what ut is not. Too conjusted rooms. And finally respect the brand name radission.

Mi pareja y yo estuvimos dos noches. Pasamos unos dias realmente increibles. La atencion del personal, las instalaciones y la comida son increibles. Disfrutamos del bar y la pileta. Inmejorable experiencia!!!

beautiful atmosphere and well maintained garden. the entrance was very attractive. The entrance guard was very presentable. The new building is also good as i had used the spa facility also.  good place for arranging get together and small private parties

This is a very central and popular hotel in Kathmandu. It's also a very well appointed place with all the facilities you'd expect of a 5 star operation.  The people that stay here seem to be more social - or maybe that's just Kathmandu generally! staff are great, super friendly and helpful.  Service is spot on too.

Staff was friendly and professional.  Room was very nice in the new building and modern.  Room service, despite the fuel crisis, was quick and very good (chicken burger with wedges were quite tasty).  We were fine with the short 15 minute walk to Thamel but if you are not used to walking in an environment without traffic lights/cross walks, just walk slowly in a straight line across any street and motorized vehicles will work around you.  Despite the earthquake/fuel situation, the people of Nepal were a joy to be around and had a great attitude.  Great visit.

This hotel has an old and a new wing. Stayed 3 times in that hotel the last year. The old wing / main building is dated and not very much taken care of (for a RADISSON). Room interior is old, bathroom too and the carpet must be from the early 90s. Breakfast buffet is medium to low stsndard. Most of the hotel guess are groups of retited Americans for hiking. Casino in basement is dodgy and the hotel has no proper bar.

Check in and check out were very smooth and professionally done. Hotel is very close to the city. It's an old property but maintained well. At the breakfast section staff are not friendly and not taking any initiative to interact with the guest. Staff can be more friendly and helpful. A pleasant smile is missing from many staff.

This is the hotel which I'll recommend where you have a chance to travel or for any occasion where you are away from home. The hotel is clean, comfortable with facilities of all you can think of.  The employees are friendly and professional.  You will have you warm welcome at all time.  I couldn't think of any other place to say in Nepal else than Radisson Kathmandu.

The staff is extremely friendly .. clean rooms. Due to fuel crisis they were unable to accommodate my request to reach airport early but they assured me that I will reach on time without worry and what they said was true.. reached on time no hassles

this stay was paid for as a treat for us as a group of tired ladies. It could not have been better. Everything was clean and fresh and the food was amazing; a good range of choices at every meal. The desserts were particularly good. staff were always attentive and friendly but not over powering. the location is good for shopping

Centrally located.  Neat and clean.  Affordable.  Lots of shops around the area.  Food quality was good but the menu had limited items to serve.  Breakfast was awesome.  Indian style tea was missing! Lease it was a pleasant stay

Hotel Radisson Blu, Kathmandu is one of the best hotels in Kathmandu. They have two buildings, one the main hotel and a new building just adjacent to it. The hotel provides perfect accommodation with neatly decorated rooms and offers quality amenities to make the stay comfortable. While the old building rooms are elegant, the new building rooms are better with modern touches and good space. It offers good food but services can be improved. It is not far from Airport and give easy access to THAMIL area which is good for shopping for foreigners.

We had 9 nights in a deluxe room which were comfortable. Lazimpat is a great location where the hotel is situated. Many eating places are around as well. Hotel could (i) improve its Internet services, (ii) educate its management and staff about Club Carlson; and (iii) management staff could be more visible and talking to guests time to time with smile.

First time in 3 weeks travelling we had BBC News!  Rooms comfy, staff very polite and friendly, breakfast choice excellent.  15 minutes walk to main Thamal market area but a few shops in the immediate vicinity.  Nice little supermarket at top of street if you want a few cheap beers!  Higher floors have rooftop views.  Nice swimming pool area but water very cold.

I stayed here for two days on a business trip. Food was standard. Locality and ambiance is too good. Staff are cordial. Tariff is reasonable. Be careful about mini-bar billing. In my case they have marked almost the entire fridge as consumed. However, upon pointing out they struck those items out.

I feel very comfortable to stay at Radisson KTM. Other than having all five star facilities, Radisson staffs are exceptionally warm hearted towards the guests. And, in case of earthquakes, this hotel building is safer than many other hotels. On the day of April 2015 Gorkha earthquake, I remobilized all my remaining staffs from other hotels to this hotel.

Good hotel on all grounds. Excellent Wi Fi & business facilities with spa & fitness end of the day.  Reasonable tariff to complement your stay....  Food could have been better needs fine tuning. Service & staff good enough to cover the lacking.

Location was good , I've stayed in the new building , it was a one bedroom hall , room was good , clean , no noise , the only very bad thing about was the food options are very little to none , only one page on the menu, and very very very bad internet connection , I could not really do anything regarding that , also tv receipt ion was bad . They have to work it out .

Spending holiday in this hotel is a great pleasure. Good food with great guest services pleased me to stay here more. I love the environment of this place......lastly i have been there for an interview for a multinational company and it was great

Gran hotel, com habitacione amplias, yun millón de amenities en el wc.El wifi tiene límite, y en caso de sobrepasarlo hay qyue ir a la recepción, desayuno impecable.El único pero que le pondría es que la zona histórica de la capital queda un pelín alejada, en cambio para negocios, la zona es la ideal.El personal de recepción fue de lo más atento con nosotros, debido a u problema con los vuelos que tuvimos, todo fueron atenciones y facilidades.Buena elección.

Excellent stay on ClubCarlson points. Great staff who are extremely friendly and helpful are what made this hotel so fantastic. Facilities and rooms are really nice. Easy walking distance to restaurants, shopping, nightlife, etc.

I stayed at the new wing which is smaller and less active than the main wing. Staff is Okay. View is bad. Rooms are good. Little over a kilometer away from Thamel a shopping and restaurant area for tourists.

Large modern hotel in a central location-about 10 minutes walk from Thamel.Lobby area spacious and comfortable with plenty of seating.Staff most courteous and helpful.Free strong wi fi.Food in restaurants good. Pleasant bar also with happy hour and good deals.Rooms comfortable and spacious.Beds good.Bathroom/toilet clean and satisfactory.Excellent gym and fitness area. Lovely outdoor pool (6th floor). Good view of city.Recommended.

We had 5 rooms booking & the check in was slow and such a hassle. As gold members we didn't get higher or better rooms like we usually get at club Carlson properties. Nor welcome fruits/drinks/breakfast. We were given 1st floor rooms which had no views of any sort. They also have token system wifi which I didn't like. We had to ask 5 different tokens every time for each rooms to use wifi. Also skip the elevator & take stairs cos it works in unusuall manner. One of the worst radissons I've stayed.

Spent one night/2 days there last week. Rooms are clean and comfortable. Staff is friendly and professional. The bars is in another building, which is very noice in terms of noise. Buffet is ok. Wifi is free and good quality.

The Raddison is a relatively short walk to Thamel and a little further to the old part of Kathmandu and to Durbar Marg. The hotel is down a quiet street and away from the noise and bustle of the main road. There is an old wing and a new wing, with the rooms in the new wing being fancier and very well appointed and the rooms in the old wing a little dated but still very comfortable and clean. The staff are very friendly and helpful and the breakfast buffet is high quality (ask for Masala Dosa if you like south Asian breakfast). The hotel has a pool and gym and a health spa. The street leading to the hotel has a small supermarket, some restaurants and a bakery as well as trekking gear and souvenir shops.

Radisson Hotel Kathmandu is very good hotel to stay in Nepal. Rooms are goods, spacious and clean. Staff is very supportive. Located in heart of city. Restaurant is very goods and serves tasty foods but variety is limited.

Overall the experience was good. The staff was welcoming & informative. It was a pleasant deal & people of Nepal were really amazing. The location where the hotel is good - calm & quiet.  I would recommend to others

A very good hotel offering value for the price you pay.  Good, quiet location near shops and restaurants ... walking distance to Thamel.  Amenities include a swimming pool, fitness center, steam room, and massages, the latter for a modest price.

Though the nation is going to a severe fuel crisis the hotel and its employees made sure the guests are well taken care off. Non stop smiles and the hotelaccommodated my delegates and me for 12 hours after check-out until flight time.

The hotel is located in the heart of the city and had a good ambience. The hotel is comparatively a new construction with decent rooms. The food is good with good varieties serves various varieties. It has a SPA, a fitness centre, nice swimming pool, jacussi & sauna to relax oneself. The outside view is also soothing to our eyes. One again enjoy in tranquility in this place.

I had gone to the Soaltee Hotel for family wedding the venue is perfectly set with a sun facing room and exquisite banquet. The hotel knows its hospitality standards we well. The hotel is rated amongst the best 5 star rating and the array of restaurants which can be found is incredible. If you feel like rejuvenating there is a spa and fitness center and a pool. Such an amazing time you all will have and the staff are really friendly.

We had our dinner at Garden restaurant , the food was so good that has amazed us. The service team during the evening shift on 12th August so good especially the food recommended by Mr. Dharmendra was  amazing , we loved the food  and service provided by Mr. Dheeraj was great. We had nice dining experience there and we will plan to visit again very soon and we will try the same foods again.

Great food and Sambhab was a great amabassador for the restaurant. I had the butter curry which was lovely. The restaurant is set in a lovely part of the hotel grounds and a nice escape from the busy streets of Kathmandu. Enjoy it as much as I did.

I have been staying in this hotel a few times after the Covid. Great hotel with nice room with a view. Very comfortable bed which is a plus.Staff extended their hospitality with a beautiful smile on their faces The breakfast was excellent and I tried the local dishes which is so nice. The staff on duties also were very friendly and smile all the time. They are there when you needed something and has shown sense of urgency and hospitality.Thank you to the management team for their excellent briefing to the staff Good customer service experience :)

Family dinner at Kakori. Lovely meal & wonderful hospitality. Amazing service with friendly team. The restaurant manager went the extra mile to find our umbrella despite the rain. Will definitely go back with family for a memorable meal.

I loved my Stay here!! The property is amazing and hospitality is on point. We had a great experience with Mr. Sudip. He was really kind and sweet to us.I will highly recommend you all to stay at Soaltee if you are here in Kathmandu. You can never go wrong with your stay at Soaltee Kathmandu.

Went for a quiet evening at the Soaltee. Was met at the entrance by Shashika who worked at the Patio Bar and was well extremely informed of everything available, the options I could have and was attentive throughout my evening there. Made the whole evening very pleasant.

I went there to chill and have my coffee at the restaurant patio area, while i was enjoying my coffee with good view to my surprise one lady from the restaurant came to me and trying to be friendly which came across as if she was forcing me to write a review for just having a cup of coffee, I find that really annoying and it was pissing me off like what should I give review for just having a coffee? Irritating ugh ! So disappointed

Dhiraj and Saroj at the restaurent never stopped giving that warm Nepalese Service, it’s amazing. Customer service goes a long way. I will recommend Hotel Soaltee, it’s a nice place. Nice atmosphere and nice food. Not forgetting the wonderful spirits to accompany the food.

The hotel is classy and the staff is very friendly and warm. Kudos to Dharmendra, Sakar and their team...... The food at the restaurant is full of variety and delicious. The rooms are very comfortable. The location of the hotel is good and safe. Security is everywhere.

The service was as excellent. Sambhav was really good at his duties. He had good education regarding the menu. Gave us suggestions and helped us in every way possible. The food was amazing. Loved how the chef came to us for the feedback.  Enjoyed the dinner with soothing music.

Great drinks and amazing staff. The location is in a quiet area of the hotel with chill out live music. We had amazing mojito cocktail and there is also a big variety of drinks, wines and cocktails. Thank you very much for your service Manish. We will be back soon!

The moment you arrive at the main entrance of this hotel, a genuine hospitality is felt, right from the security staff to any manager you interact with.At the main entrance you get a prompt baggage assistance,A seamless and quick checkin process The rooms are high plush with quality room amenities,They also have various dining options in the hotel, you may dine at their multi cuisine or specialty restaurant, the food and the service is very impressive,The housekeeping staff takes no time to meet any additional requests.At every touch point the hotel staff will amaze you.It was also my birthday when I was checking out, I was absolutely amazed by the surprise cake organised by the front office team.I’d like to thank the entire team who made it for me. It will remain as a beautiful memory with me for a long time.Few names to highlight :Ms.Sijan, Mr.Dinesh, Mr.Pratik from the front office teamMr.Dhiraj, Ms.Sabita, Ms.Sobha from the Garden terrace I am also sorry as I don’t remember all the names but my heartily thanks to all those who made my birthday really a memorable one.The hotel is five star and the staff is truly seven star .Thanks for everything.

Compliment to Ragisha n Britney at the Restaurant, they are good staff, attentive with warm smile in there face make me so comfort enjoying my meal n drinks, they should be reward for their hardworking job. The room are so comfort n clean, the location also very nice near the city centre so easy for me to explore. All staff are good from the entrance to the lobby, cleaner also do their job well.

Staff were very delightful and helpful.Ambiance is awesome too.Food is very tasty, also the staff served us very well.Everyone in staff is very good but I can remember the name of Sarkar, Ranjan and Shobha.Rooms were very clean and other facilities were also very good.Hotel staff follow customers’ suggestions with immediate effect

One of the best dining experience i ever had and  hospitality of staffs was excellent . Amazing food, impeccable service! Cozy atmosphere, perfect for a romantic dinner or casual night out. Highly recommend!Food was delicious, service attentive, ambiance delightful.

From the airport till the hotel I had an amazing experience all the staff are very humble and welcoming. The customer service is on another level and the facilities in the hotel are very satisfying, not only me but all the crew were happy and satisfied. Looking forward to another visit.

Great Experience , great vibes and make sure you have Ajay thing as your server/bartender if you are staying at patio. He is friendly, energetice and has great custumer experience. Hopefully Soltee hires more like Ajay.  He is great and everyone was very friendly. Aryaman was also great guy with smile on his face all the time. Thank you Ajay and Aryaman. You guys made our stay wonderful

Nice breakfast selection. Love the poori and masala dosa. The staff also very friendly especially mr Sakar. Always come and ask for order. Very helpful. Keep up a good work. Love to seat outside the restaurant. Can enjoy the morning chill weather.

Very nice Ambience and best hotel special thanks to RAGISHA and RASHMI for giving a best hospitality in Garden terrace resturant ! And wonderful dinner by Chef BASANT NAYAK  and hospitality by JANAK ji and BHUVAN KAILASH   In  KAKORI resturant thank you everyone for making our stay wonderful memorable pleasant stay !

Well i do visit lots of hotel. Among them The Soaltee gave me the pleasent vibe. i went there with my family for dinner at kakori restaurant and it was awesome. There i met a person name janak who was a excellent server and a fantastic guy. The food was delicious, services were great. I will do visit next time for sure. Thank you.

The staff is extremely patient and helpful. I was greatly impressed by the behaviour of staff Deepika and Sugam. Also, it has a beautiful view and good complimentary services like a sauna, jacuzzi etc. The rooms are also pretty spacious and gorgeous.

It was really good hotel. When I first entered Nepal, the roads and all were soo damn choked, traffic at its best, you gotta be a god to drive there XD. And then when the taxi entered the hotel, it was like a heaven on earth. Its totally different from the outside world. All my parents and all wanted to roam kathmandu, but the hotel attracted me soo much, that I just wanted to stay and then go downstairs and checkout the restaurants and have fun there itself. Its a super cool hotel. I absolutely loved every part of this. Just a little sad that the pool was under some work when we went, so I couldn't really enjoy that (P.S. i visited soaltee last year, so it should be all good now). , but apart from that, everything was TOP-NOTCH.Just a little story. I have a friend here in Adelaide, Australia, he is from Nepal, he is a front office manager in a hotel, and he has actually also worked in Soaltee, so he advised me to book it, and it was really worth it. LOVED THE EXPERIENCE. When I went there, the on site manager was a guy named Krishna, he was super helpful. I however, dont really know if he still works there. But he was a gem of a man. :)

Manish was very helpful and patient with us great service and very friendly with us i would definitely recommend to go back to the restaurant due to the good service Always good to have nice people taking care of you we were group of friends and he took our order without any mistake keep up the good work 🙏

I stayed in Soaltee Kathmandu hotel for 2 days. Dined in Patio both evenings. Staff is amazing provided excellent service. Especially I want to mention Manish’s effort. Such an approachable wonderful waiter. I was completely impressed. He comforts and takes care of each customer with so much respect. In one words he is above and beyond. Dining in Patio in such cool atmosphere was the hilight of my stay in Soaltee Kathmandu Hotel. I wish him all the best in his career.

The hotel hospitality was top notch. It was a business trip, so many meals were at the hotel. The garden restaurant had  a wonderful buffet with plenty of regional and worldly selections, and the live stations were excellent. I would highly recommend this hotel when visiting Kathmandu.

It is a very nice hotel especially the breakfast. A lot of choices of food. The service staff Sabita Thapa and Sakar Sugam Basnet are very very worm and enthusiasticly introduce local customs and provide various support. You will feel at home in this hotel.

I would like to say how accommodating the staff in this hotel is, especially to these people: Yuna, Ragisha, Britey, Sakar, Sabita Thapa, Rangita, Bitashma, Nemon, and Sudan. Since entering the venue, throughout the service time, they have always been asking if you need something and will give it to you until you finish your meal, saying goodbye until you exit the area. What I really like about them is that when you see them, they have this aura that they are friendly, not just because they’re working there, but because of their personalities. And also thanking the management because you are hiring the right people and training them well. Thank you, and see you again!

It was a very comfortable stay at Soaltee. The property is beautiful. All the staff specially Ragisha and Sabita Thapa at Garden Terrace restaurant who were very kind and attentive to all our needs. Our kudos to them! Thank you for your service.

Special thanks to Aryaman, Rohan & Saroj  for there superb service. We recently visited patio restaurant which has welcoming atmosphere with great food ( pizza n spaghetti was best)  and charming outdoor dining experience with lovely songs.

Great food and service. …………Especially Sabita Thapa was awesome. Garden terrace restaurant breakfast buffet was a great experience. ……….I would highly recommend to visit.. but except Casino. It was ok. ……….The place was bit outside the city but that’s I like about it.

The front  staff was very professional. It did not even take a  Minute to check in.  The room was so clean, awesome jobs from housekeeping.  Breakfast was lavish and all the food was flavourful. Lots of choices. I like the masala chai the way s of serving. Dinner was fantastic as well. I would like to recognize Mr. Sagar was manager in the afternoon shift. He was so friendly and he knows what we need.  He is always caring for all guests. He is a fantastic manager in that property. Also the crew member for breakfast was awesome. They are just doing out of the box. I really forgot the server name but I really enjoyed breakfast and dinner. Overall hats off to the property and the staff. Hope to see you soon in next visit.

Beautiful property, all amenities above average. A lot of facilities , ATM, taxis, sightseeing, casino, etc. i found their pool is great.Food is something to remember!Worth every penny.Excellent for both business and pleasure.Staff and service is also very good

Beautiful hotel, amazing breakfast, well-maintained gardens, well-equipped gym, stunning pool, and most importantly very friendly, hardworking,  and hospitable staff - thanks to special standouts Bigyan and Yuna from breakfast restaurant for impeccable service!

Excellent service by staff member, especially sabita thapa...she was just too good...very humble, swift and taken good care of kids n elders. I recommend her for further roles. Hotel outside ambience is nice and soothing. Lobby is great. Good one

Been to kakori restaurant its was a beautiful experience and the server sambhav was very helpfull and excellent in his service love  the food and had a good experience 5 stars for the restaurant must visit for indian food and experience 👏👏👏

Really happy to be spending a holiday at Soaltee Kathmandu. The staff was courteous and professional.We would like thank and appreciate the efforts of the F&B team lead by Sagar and team Hari, Sagun, Bhupendra, Sheraya and Sufin.Thanks for a memorable holiday.

I am very pleased to see that the garden restaurant in the hotel has excellent personnel, always very polite, smiling and helpful. Especially Miss Sashika has always a fantastic smile and this makes the big difference of the adorable Nepali people

It was my first time at the Baoxan restaurant in this hotel, but it will definetly not be the last. Food was great, but the service provided was just perfect. The whole staff looked spotless and their kindness  and knowledge about their products had no match.

Very good property. Good rooms. Good food. Very clean. Casino however is dirty. Entry fee is a barrier.Salon service should be cheaper. Spa is also very expensive.Staff is good and cooperative. Breakfast is lavish and good taste. Overall good property.

Soaltee Kathmandu was excellent in every way. The breakfast spread was the best 👌. Made for a very good experience. BUTThe casino at Soaltee was a big let down. Didn't expect a hotel of such high repute to have a casino with cheap ambience with poor & discourteous service plus(it was like a dance bar). People need to really think twice before visiting the Soaltee casino!!!!

Our stay in the hotel can be described with 3 words...… excellent ,  excellent, excellent.Staff was incredible. Super friendly and the send off they gave us.......was a total surprise!!!!! Highly recommend it.  Hope to visit Katmandu again. Thank you ALL for the great time we had!!!!

We went to the Indian restaurant and the food and service was outstanding , a special shout out to Ashmit and Janak was very friendly and helpful for us. The food we got was an excellent, butter chicken and Naan, we loved the experience and would highly recommend taking some time out and going to eat there.

The room was in the central wing which is probably the old one and needs to be renovated immediately. The bathroom with many problems and dirty. The reception areas are beautiful. Food quite good. There is a bar that has live music at certain hours.

Came back to try a different food choice at Kakori restaurant. Special mentions Ashmit, Manoj and Janat as usual went beyond expectations. Both of them care so much for their guests and I believe someday soon become managers in their respective Hotel/Restaurants. I wish them all the very best for their future. They are very hard working and genuine. I REQUEST THE MANAGER READING THIS TO APPRECIATE THEM WITH PROMOTION OR A SALARY HIKE. My stay was from 13th Mar to 14th Mar, 2024

Excellent hotel in Kathmandu, efficient reception, super comfortable room, bathroom with all amenities.Fantastic restaurant and breakfast, great gym structure.Bars inside and outside with excellent service. We were welcomed by the employee Sashika, friendly and very attentive.

Amazing property and service quality. I would love to stay there again during my travel to Kathmandu. Music in the evening adds to the pleasure..The staff is very pleasing and ready to help. I would like to specially thank Manager Krishna Sapkota for making my stay such a wonderful experience.

Very pleasant stay, lovely service and helpful staff. Excellent restaurants with a very good selection of food. Highly recommend the spa. Also the bar with the exceptional service, high praises to Sashika and the rest of the staff. Thanks for a great experience.

Very good and nice place the staff are so friendly and humble specifically   ASHMIT/HARI//JANAK and chef MAHESH the food was amazing and the way of service was really satisfied مكان رائع ممتاز يجب زياره المطعم العاملين بالمطعم في غايه الاحترام واسلوب الخدمه حقيقي مبهر

Kakori restaurant: had a wonderful dining experience, exquisite Indian dishes and wonderful costumer service from Ashmit, Hari, Janak and chef Mahesh who allowed us to witness how lassi is made. What stands out is the genuine hospitality offered by the staff.

We loved the hospitality. Ashmit, Hari and Janak were very helpful. The food was amazing, u need to try the daal Bukhara. Mahesh Gupta the chef has magic in his hands. Welcomed by a tika and going out with good relations. A wonderful night spent.

The food here is excellent. The staff here is extremely cooperative. Ashmit shrestha is a gem of a person. He catered us wonderfully.Sambhav dhamala was also cooperative too. We were happy to be served complimentary dishes as well.Special mention to Chef mahesh.Overall quality of food, ambience and qualtiy of service is 100/100.Please do pay a visit.

Had a wonderful experience. The humble staff (Ashmit, Janak, Hari) made our dinner memorable. Thanks to the head chef Basant Nayak for the amazing meal. The Kakori dal is the best thing about the dinner. Would hugly recommend for a family dinner.

The Chef at kakoori restaurant- Basant Nayak was amazing and fantastic. And the staff - Ashmit and Janak were the best hosts. The manager Raj was warm and welcoming. Great service with the best Indian food. The Sufi songs lifted the atmosphere to a heavenly abode. Good food, nice ambiance and soulful music - grateful for it all.

Our overall experience was excellent.Stay-Very comfortable. Open spacious property. Clean rooms.Food- food was simply superb. I am vegan and family nonveg. Variety, quality and taste, all were to our expectations.Staff-top notch. Raj sekar the South Indian chef presented excellent authentic South Indian delicacies.  Rojen, their manager and his team (I'm forgetting the chefs name ) took extra effort to accommodate my (vegan) food requirements.All the staff were very warm and hospitable. Kajal at reception, bimala and other names I don't remember, were absolutely professional and efficient.Activities- music performance at the patio, spa experience and tennis (remember to bring your tennis shoes) made our stay memorable.Overall an excellent stay.

It's an amazing experience to stay at The Soaltee Kathmandu. Had a comfortable stay, all thanks to the wonderful team at The Soaltee. Right from the Reservations, I was helped by Ms Amrita for a hassle free and smooth booking experience. The team at Front desk is very warm and helpful. They will make your sure stay is as incredible as it can  be.Rooms and all the facilities at the Hotel are impeccable. I couldn't enjoy a swim at that beautiful pool because of the winters perhaps I would be able to do that next time I am here.Food at the Restaurants is delicious, you can even try the traditional Nepali Thali and some local cuisine.Thanks to the whole team at the restaurant, Rashmi, Srijana, Sagun, and Upendra, they are such warm and courteous people, it brings a smile on your face every time you meet them.Thanks for the amazing hospitality.

The ultimate staying experience!Helpful staff, immaculate facilities, clean and comfortable rooms. Wide range of buffet choices both for breakfast and dinner.I have stayed there 3 times so far and the one time I had to stay somewhere else for business purposes I regretted it!Definitely worth 5+ stars.

What can I say about The Soaltee Kathmandu!!!Helpful, extra polite stuff accommodating every need, spotless and clean facilities, extravagant buffet for breakfast and dinner! Comfortable beds do as to make me forget the tiredness of the day! An overall amazingly positive experience making me want to go again and again!

Yubak and Ayush are so kind and helpful. They made a delicious cocktail for me. At first I had no idea what to drink but they gave me a really good recommendation. I’m really impressed with their service.

It’s HOME AWAY FROM HOME …. Especially Mahadev and Ashmit from the Kakori restaurant were incredibly amazing, both hav great skill of interaction and are really hard working  nd actually running that extra mile for customers comfort and statistician….Kudos to u guysss!!!!

All of the staff at Soaltee were extremely accommodating, kind, warm-hearted and went above and beyond to help us. Our flight got canceled leaving Kathmandu, our airline took care of getting rooms for the whole flight. The staff handled the influx of many many (tired & upset) customers, all with a smile on their face. The buffet breakfast was delicious & we also enjoyed the buffet supper...equally delicious!I needed some help shipping a parcel home, Bijay was very quick to look after getting it shipped, after business hours. Sabina was helpful during the length of our stay. If you're visiting Kathmandu, please visit this jem of a hotel in a busy city...you won't regret it!!!

Thank you mr. Asmit, mr. Hari and mr. Rajesh for your good hospitality and good service. Had a good evening. The food was awesome and the singers were pretty good. They were able to impress the guests.

As a frequent guest in this hotel, i want to highlight the excellent of their hospitality. They never disappoint me. From the lobby until the moment im leaving they never miss to amaze me. Special thanks to Ms Sushmita, her stunning service. She was always there to assist me and being so helpful for anything that i asked for. Such an asset to the hotel. I will always put Soaltee hotel as my no. 1 choice.

It is bright, modern, and really ideal for those who need to catch up on some work. You can see these differences from the pictures of the corridors I uploaded. Guest have options to select from four different types if pillows. I chose to have all four types. The buffet spread during breakfast was decent with some Western choices. I was not able to try any of the amenities but their pool looks really amazing.The only downside of staying in the hotel is that there wasn’t much dining options outside of the hotel. What a blissful stay at the Soaltee, Kathmandu! You are welcomed by ever attentive and ever helpful reception desk. Always smiling with very pleasant manners. I stayed for only a night and I must say the room is really spacious and the bed is comfortable. The staff overall is truly hospitable, nice and smiling. Special mention to Rabindra from the buffet restaurant where I had the dinner, he was really kind and always keeping a check on my table and catered the needs professionally.

Came here in business and all the staff made me feel like I was home. They cooked for me when the restaurant was already closed and the food was amazing. Thanks specially to Ashmit, Bibita and the cookers from patio restaurant.I hope I comeback soon to this lovely hotel.

Hotel environment is really good with garden and pool. Hotel staff is courteous and humble. Food also is really authentic.Hotel staff* In Front office - Ms. Kesang is very welcoming and approachable and she helped us find good tourist locations.* Restaurant staff- Mr. Aashish, Ms. Sanjita, Mr. Ramesh provided a good service and dining experience* Health club - Mr. Mukesh is a good and knowledgeable massage therapist.

Excellent customer service, no hold time when you call for room service. Food arrived quickly and was delivered by Ms. Isha. She's polite, friendly and greets you with a big smile. They will call you back again to get your feedback and check how was your dining experience.

Meet Ashmit Sunil at the lobby bar to experience the best of Nepal & enjoying music. His smile makes a difference & don't miss out on the live music. A melo voice that reaches your heart. Three days of stay and full feeling experience 👍Me & my friends enjoyed a lot

Very cozy hotel.Room is clean.Staff i super friendly.Lots of amenities in the hotel.Around the hotel is very hectic, but it is Kathmandu.Dint try anyfood due to my dietary needs.Overall experience is awesome 👍

The restaurants in the hotel has an amazing atmosphere and well as top service especially the hostess, Ms. Anisha, at the GL restaurant. I personally recommened anyone visiting Kathmandu to stop by the restaurants inside the hotel.

The hotel was an excellent choice and it was as per our expectations. Loved the ambience loved the cuisines. Especially Bhupendra was kind enough in making us comfortable there. Food was amazing. Loved the stay. Will definitely visit again. :)

This review is specifically for the Garden Terrace breakfast buffet; however, the food and service for the rest of the hotel is excellent! The breakfast buffet is one of the best, if not the best, I’ve ever had! The food was great, with options changing daily, and the service was top notch. I want to also give a special acknowledgment to our server on several days, Aashen.

A true sample of excellent hospitality…The staff is so friendly. Starting from check in, one can ask any staff  to get any request in a blink of an eye time.The food with dinner buffet is amazing…special thanks to Anisha who was explaining all details about local Nepali food.

After a 35 hour trip from US to Kathmandu, we finally arrived to Soaltee Kathmandu--beautiful grounds, a traditional welcome with "namaste" and flowers everywhere. You feel like you are special and treated like royalty and respect--only here for a couple hours so far but we are particularly impressed with Sunil and Ashmit at the outdoor entrance pavilion bar/restaurant-  first, the steamed chicken dumplings were the MOST delicious we've ever had (and I'm asian so I know my dimsum!)--spicy sauces included and lots of dumplings. Then Sunil and Ashmit made amazing Long Island iced teas, and a surprise drink for me--we have dubbed it the "Soaltee Sunil Sunset"! They went WAY out of their ways to make me a fun new drink, and it was delicious!! COME relax at Soaltee and visit Sunil and Ashmit! (we have traveled all over the world and stayed in the best resorts, and Soaltee does have a unique charm!)

I really had good services with staffs but mostly standout are unika, dharmendra and sanjita that they are really friendly that they were really there when we needed. Cannot thank thank enough that I wish them all the best fir their future and keep u the good work👍👍👍

My stay in this beautiful hotel was amazing. The room was clean and cozy, however the light kept switching off constantly. Staff is welcoming and helpful. Many thanks to Sabina for making my stay memorable!

The hotel staff did a great job helping me to find my lost phone.... I would really appreciate specially mr. Ashmit and miss.sushmita and the whole security staff for doing such a great job.. Amazing thank you so much.

Extremely happy with their service, specially staff behavior is very good. Special mention for Hari & Ramesh who have taken care us so well. Good meal options along with my personal favorite RABRI. Thanks for the great hospitality. Highly recommend while you are traveling to Nepal.

It was a pleasant experience, We had a great time here. Special thanks to Anjali and all the staff members for the warmth that they showed us. We will definitely visit again !! The service is excellent with good behaviors of staffs towards others. Also front desk almost every one also are helpful. And many many things that I can tell about how they’re very professional.

My stay at Soaltee was great and the general vicinity was welcoming. The fitness centre was also very beneficial. The Patio has good quality drinks. Ashmit made wonderful and tasteful drinks. He was very friendly during my stay at Soaltee, Kathmandu.

Had an Amazing stay at Soaltee.. this was my second visit in last 4 months.... All the staff are very professional and polite... Everyone has a Smile on their Face and are very welcoming.... They never fail to make you feel special... Other than staff, the hotel property is humongous and is very well maintained... Amenities provided in the room and in the bathroom are on point.... Room service was Quick and the food was delicious... Overall it was a wonderful stay.

It was a really very good experience staying in this hotel .It’s really a star property we stayed for 3 nights Oct 5,6 &7 .The front desk people took care from the time of booking to the time we left . The rooms r very clean & interior is very good The restaurants r good the breakfast buffet was very tasty with lot of choice the main cook by name Mr Ramesh dosas very good .I recommend it for all who look out for luxury good ambiance & good food od

Great evening at the Patio terrace with a great performance by a guitar player and singer and very professional service by Ashmit thank you guys for an amazing night at the hotel , beautiful ambience good food and great music

Had a wonderful stay at Soaltee. Staffs are very polite and courteous. Very good customer experience, Lovely hospitality. My best wishes for Ms.Sabina in the front desk.She made sure all my queries are answered with the best solution.Kudos to team Soaltee for having such a staff. 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟

The stay was nice.. Had nice garden view.. Dining at The garden terrace restaurant is awesome.. Nd outdoor restaurant 'patio' is superbly designed and eye catching. Mr.Ashmith served us well.. All ataffs are very kind.. Had complimentary steam/sauna/jacuzzi..

Very good hospitality and super friendly staff and so helpful. Thank u all specially Sabina. The room is big and clean , they helped us to exchange money and order taxi for us. And guided us to where to go.

The place that will give you an unforgettable experience, live music, food, friendly people.. helpful and smiling staff and perfect hospitality.. i am so thankful to Ms. Sabina.. she made my stay better.. Definitely a must stay hotel and for sure i will visit again soon.

Great location, really pleasant and clean rooms, but the thing that makes this such a good place to stay are the staff. All of the people are incredibly helpful and generous. I would highly recommend everyone to stay here if they looking to visit Khatmandu.

Nice hotel with complete amenities and comfortable and cozy room with classic traditional design.Staff is great and helpful as you walk in welcomes you with warmth and smile esspecially to SABINA the guest relation officer....

I spent the evening here at the patio restaurant. All the Staff are very professional and friendly. Staff Ashmit made my day. I really enjoyed my time here. The hotel and the restaurants are spotless.

We had appetizer at Patio with some drinks. Asmit took care of us keeping everything nice for us.  There is live music good weather with light fresh rain. Nice place to go. Fully recommended if you are in this part of Kathmandu. The hotel is nice and clean.
