I was surprised with the hospitality with all the staff and the hotel especially the waiter Ashmit in the garden restaurant. Keep on asking for my needs.Also they greeted all the guest with very polite way. Also, room was really clean and nice.

My stay at Soultee has been one of the best getaway experiences in recent times. At the airport, i was greeted by a gentleman and the driver, who picked us up in an Electric Kia Luxurious Car. The car had wifi, which allowed me to check my emails before we reached the hotel. As soon as we reached the hotel, we were greeted by the complete staff of Soultee, garlands, flowers and a welcome drink (Complete VIP experience) . We were taken into our room, which was a special suite with 2 jointed rooms with oriental style furniture. The room overlooked many peaks in Nepal. Things that nobody should miss at Soultee 1. Bao Xuan - One of the best chinese restuarant in recent times, fantatsic ingredients, flavours and what combination of sauce in each dish. Hot and sour soup is my favourite. 2. Breakfast - The spread is very nice, everyone should try the detox drink at the entrance, Also the chole bhature is out of the world. 3. Property - The property is a good walk in the evening with your partner, do enjoy it. 4. Swimming pool - pretty large for any property and very beautiful. The gym is pretty big as well. 5. Staff - They are the ones that make this place special, I will specialy like to thank Rajiv for taking care of us.  Rajiv would take care of every small - large request that we had. We never felt away from home because of him.  Soultee is an example of those kinds of hotels that know how to make their guest feel comfortable and special.

The stay in the hotel wouldn’t be pleasant without a great and professional team, that works there. Very accommodative, polite and friendly. Food was great! Additional thanks to “Hari”manager and Bhupendra for looking after us. 🙏🏻 The gym is nice.

Ashmit and Sunil who is working at the Patio of Soultee Kathmandu are excellent. The ambiance is very calm and overall the place is very clean. Coffee also tastes good. They provide the best service. Will definitely come again.

It was such a pleasant stay, with top-notch service from the kindest staff. And the breakfasts were an experience of its own. Special shout-out to Mr Bhupendra for providing such a professional service in the Garden Terrace restaurant!

On my recent visit to Kathmandu i chose Soaltee for 1-day accomodation. The property is huge and is spread in thousands of acres of land and very well developed. Soaltee is a beautiful serene property in the heart of bustling Kathmandu. We stayed for a week. Ujjeal, Bibita, Simona, Sachita, and all other staff were perfect. The place is a must visit place. Everybody must stay in this clean and historical design hotel which really deserves 5 star and every great comment.

This is my first stay in this hotel and comparing to other star hotel it is one of the best hotel in nepal with very very humble and excellent staff. Absolutely loved the stay and fantastic staff specially i would like to thank Ashmit for lovely suprise on behalf of my birthday! Not to mention the coordination of staff and other hotel members available 24 hours for any type of service. Just WOW

Very nice hotel with a lot of facilities and excellent restaurants. All the staff was very helpful and kind during our stay.The premises are quite old but they are under renovation. Our favorite spot was Patio bar with live music. Take advantage of the happy hour!😜

Excellent property, Excellent Services , Excellent spa experienece .Excellent foods .Excellent restaurants .Really enjoyed a lot even though we came for Bussiness purpose.I will  really recommend this Hotel without a second thought.

Pleasant place to stay... Delicious Breakfast to start your day ... Best quality service provided by Ramesh 😍😍🤗 Nice place to stay along with the family in between Himalayas ... Hope to see you soon again

The check in process and check out process was very smooth. The breakfast was at ground floor level and food was fresh and tasty. We were provided everything whatever we asked. Best ambience, best food , best services , very friendly staff members jyoti, Anisha , and all Best place to visit with  family and business trips.Very happy to be here I recommend and will definitely visit again.

Ashmit is very hospitable and kind and highly motivated to work. I recommend his services to the visitors!And the food is amazing!The ambience is also amazing and the staff welcoming.Will be back!!

Excellent service by Mr Ashmit. He was very friendly and polite. I went to Patio with my friends and he was very nice and humble to all of us . Very professional. And the food and drinks were nice too .

Really nice hotel with beautiful gardens! Ayurvedic Massage is highly recommended! The breakfast buffet has a wide variety of options and the service is excellent, Mr Bhupendra is really helpful and kind!

Warm welcome and helpfull staff from reception to dining. Amazing Spa facility with massage you never knew you needed. The best hospitality. The service is more than excellent. Hair and all his team and the most kind and amazing people.I want to come back just for the people who work there! I recommend 100% this hotel.

This hotel is great as its offers wifi services, room service, they have excellent spa and therapists, food is great and overall you just feel comfy in this place. I stayed in the hotel during my business, hotel is beautiful n clean all the staffs are so kind and helpful I had my breakfast and dinner at garden terrace restaurant all the staffs hari, niroj, diwash, drarmindra are helpful and extremely professional , food in the restaurant is so good. Hotel selezionato dal nostro consulente di viaggio sul Nepal perché volevamo una struttura elegante ma con "anima". La struttura è un 5 stelle su diversi piani. Best place to stay with family. Super & food, friendly environment with staffs.. Room was spacious and dust free and specially cake and flower excelent, faith towards this property, many many thanks to Deepak & his team for helpful and lovely arrangement during the stay.

This was my third visit and I grow fond of the place and people. The food quality has improved quite a bit after arrival of Shri Agnimitra. Do enjoy the dinner at terrace garden restaurant. The walk around the property in morning hours are serene and one feels cosy and mentally refreshed.

After having seen all of Kathmandu along with the other top ranked hotels in the area and it’s surroundings like Chadragiri , Nagarkot and Gokarna we can safely and confidently say that our choice of staying at Soaltee was a great one. It is easily, if not the best, one of the best hotels in the valley considering the price, amenities etc. It has wonderful open areas with nice greenery unlike other city hotels who have more horizontal space. The pool is also wonderful and breakfast is excellent with a wide variety to choose from with several dishes being rotated through the week. The service also at all dining areas is very nice and they have a nice open space where you can enjoy your breakfast with fresh air and sunshine. Rooms are nice and spacious with wonderful views of the hotel courtyard. It also has a wonderful spa and a fancy Casino. A very active concierge desk also who can arrange either a private or public taxi for you at a moments notice. Also this hotel has lots of marriages and other local functions taking place in their empty lawns which is fun to watch as we get an idea of how the locals dress and celebrate giving us a taste of the local culture as well. A special mention to the amazing staff at the hotel specially those at the front desk who work very well together and ensure that our stay was fantastic. Ms. Sabina, Sampada, Prativa and Mr Krishna, Deepak are the few names that comes to mind but all in all the ENTIRE staff at the hotel is very helpful, friendly and welcoming, a big thank you to them. They did their level best to accommodate our every request and were the main reason for us enjoying our stay and we will most certainty be staying here again for our future visits. Would highly recommend selecting this hotel for a memorable and comfortable stay at Kathmandu.

They recognized by IHG status and gave me an upgrade to a newly renovated room which was beautifully done with a mix of local heritage aesthetics and contemporary functions.After sharing that I have a late flight on the next day, they tried their best to give me a complimentary late check out till 3 pm instead of the usual 2 pm and also made recommendations and what I could consider for my itinerary to best make use of the time in Kathmandu and the hotel.I decided to add breakfast to the stay and it was an additional 10 USD instead of 12 USD at the restaurant itself. The buffet spread was decent. The cheese variety was good and includes Yak cheese, although the blue cheese could be better and it would be nice if there are condiments placed alongside with the cheese. The live egg station and hot food options are okay too.I also had a Tenderloin Beef Burger and Mushroom Soup from the room service menu for dinner and it was quite okay. Fries were fine and they even served bread with butter along with the dishes.The hotel uses a gym that is part of a fitness club, which can get very crowded in the morning. There is also no covered walkway between the fitness club & spa and the hotel which could be an issue during rainy weather. The hotel is relatively quiet due to its location in Soaltee. It is quite a distance away from the popular Thamel or Durbar Square in Kathmandu. It is about 500 NPR for a taxi ride but it is also walkable : roughly 30 minutes on a leisurely stroll which cuts through some quiet neighbourhoods or a market near the river. In early March, the weather's not too hot to walk back and forth the hotel.After check out, the staff were helpful to keep my luggage and even a cheese that I bought in the chiller. Tsering, the duty manager from the day before was also very helpful and getting coffee and food orders when I decided to spend the time at the bar area to do some work instead.This is also the Covid-19 period, I think for improvements, the hotel could implement further precautionary measures during this period with more hand sanitizers around the hotel and temperature checks at the entrances. Other that that, overall, it was a good stay and the service was the best part of it.

Lovely hotel. Very comfortable. The front desk staff all were professional and pleasant The other staffs were very approachable and helpful. The food was excellent It was a wonderful experience. Good hospitality

I stayed in the hotel for 9 days at a stretch. They impressed me the moment i reached with their warmth. I liked the individual attention,  attitude of the staff,  involvement of the management and most importantly the facilities. Special mention for the breakfast spread, amazing oriental restaurant and a great gym. Highly recommended

When I go to Kathmandu for business I like to stay in this hotel. The staff is very kind, rooms are big and clean. There are three restaurants 1 International/local, 1 Chinese, 1 Indian. I normally eat at the first one which is very good.

Good hotel and friendly staff. The food was nice and overall ambience was different in a good way. Location was very good and it seemed a traditional well maintained hotel. Will be happy to go back spend some relaxing time.
私が思うには、良かった点は広い庭と静かな雰囲気と美味しいオムレツです。あと、ホテルのスタッフがとても親切だったことです。ホテルの手配してくれたタクシーの運転手は完璧だった。おすすめは少し良い部屋を予約することだと感じた。2泊目の部屋はNewari architectureな内装だった。

Was in Nepal for a short trip, was confused about the hotel Luckily booked the right hotel in KTMWarmly Welcomed Perfect locationGreat HospitalitySpecial mention for Mr.Dharmendra Sapkota (Patio Bar) and Ms.Tara (front office)For a great experience

Very nice location in the heart of Kathmandu, the hotel has all the facilities of a 5 star hotel.The best asset is their staff which are always helpful and prompt.The staff organises every Wednesday from 6 pm a cocktail bar in the terrace of Patio bar, where guests can socialise and enjoy a great time. For this I'd like to thank As manager Ms Karuna Khadka, the bar tender Mr Dharwendra and the entire staff.

Felt like we were staying at a private estate in the city. The hotel is excellent and the decor really gives you a sense of being in the best of Kathmandu.  Slept with the windows open (screens shut) and were never bothered by any noise.  The breakfast was of high quality with an interesting collection of dishes.

This is a great hotel. We arrived late afternoon for a business trip in Crowne Plaza Kathmandu - Soaltee. Special Thanks to Rosheen in Sales who has exceeded our Management's expectation in every way. Though we were there for 3 nights and had a tight schedule but she managed to guide us on site seeing places, eat outs which shouldn't be missed after coming to Nepal. The resort has a lavish buffet breakfast and a la carte menu too, beautiful lawns where we did our team activities. The restaurant staff had great customer service. I would highly recommend staying here if you visit Nepal.

Front desk was very friendly, restaurants were very good , breakfast was fantastic and all the staff were extremely friendly! The gym was very modern and spa was very good,especially the steam sauna and jacuzzi room! Cheers! See you next time! Security wise very safe, since I travelled with a team we were looked after by the hotel authorities. Need to improve the bar.A half an hour ride from the airport so local yes very well near the Tribhuvan university premises.

Just to mention that the nice lounge keeper on 5th floor Bihal was so nice and helpfull talking about his fantastic country and advising me the fresh watermelon juice which sure was genuine. Small breakfast but very tasty.All the staffs in this hotel are very welcoming.

Friendly people and outstanding facilities contribute to make your stay in Kathmandu an unforgettable experience. Very good value for money. It is worth taking a walk in the gardens where you can relax over a cup of tea

Το ξενοδοχείο βρίσκεται μέσα σε ένα καταπράσινο χώρο με ησυχία, το προσωπικό του πολύ ευγενικό και εξυπηρετικό στις ανάγκες μας κατά την διάρκεια της παραμονής μας, το πρωινό του όπως και το δείπνο του πολύ καλό, το δωμάτιο ευρύχωρο και καθαρό τα μουσικά δρώμενα κατά την διάρκεια των Χριστουγέννων δημιούργησαν μια πολύ ζεστή και ευχάριστη γιορτινή ατμόσφαιρα!

We stayed at this hotel for 3 nights as our tour package to India and Nepal.  The check-in and other service was good.  The room is clean but a bit dated.  The amenities inside the room was sufficient. The washroom really need some update.  There are a few restaurants in the hotel.  We tried the buffet breakfast which was quite good.  We also had dinner at the restaurant where they serve the buffet breakfast.  We ordered a mutton biriyani and a curry dish.  Both were tasty and the service was good too.One late afternoon, we went outside the hotel through gate 3.  There is really nothing interesting to see.  Those are the local residential area with some shops.Another time we went out through gate 1.  We turned left at the gate and walked a fiew blocks.  Those are also the local residential area with some shops.  At the big intersection, we turned left to a big busy street.  There are all sorts of shops, restaurants, a small shopping malls, grocery stores etc.  Those shops are apparantly for the locals.  We walked about 10-12 cities blocks and returned.  We felt completely safe, although cross the street was a challenge as cars wouldn't stop for you.  We followed the locals.On our way back to the hotel, we stopped by a local restaurant and had a simple dinner there.  The food was very good and it was very cheap.

It was a quick less than 24 hours layover, the hotel is amazing. The moment you reached the hotel, you’ll be greeted by the best hospitality of their staff. They’re very friendly and giving you a very warm welcome. I was assisted immediately once I got down from the airport transportation, my luggage was carried straight to the main lobby and I was greeted along the way to the reception counter. Kudos to the team. During my stay, I ordered room service, and the called was answered by this lovely lady who very happy to help me to choose my meal. She even recommended a meal that wasn’t in the menu to ensure it matches my meal preferences. She even told me on the portion of each meal so it made it easier for me to decide if I need more or less when I’m ordering my late lunch upon arrival. The room service was sent to me in shorter time by a nice friendly guy who ensure I got what I need. The food was wonderfully made and presented well with a big portion!  I love it!she even called me back to check on my ordered. Very thoughtful of her. The check out process was done well. I really enjoy my stay here. Bravo to the whole team! Hope to visit again soon!

25 years ago, we had stayed at Soaltee for our honeymoon! For our silver anniversary this year, we contacted them again...and what a fantastic decision that was! The management and all staff members have given us the most special and most amazing week to re-live our every joy at the hotel! Right from the warmest welcome, to decorating our room, to sending us goodies and gifts, special care for our meals, arranging local travel and lots more. Thank you Soaltee! We are definitely going to keep coming back to you!

We travelled as a large family with 8 rooms booked.  Check-in was a complete mess. Smoking rooms for us with kids etc. Took a half hour to get a room. We, with our 4 year old had requested an extra bed. No surprise that they were surprised that this was on their system already. We were told the best was for us to proceed with our dinner plans and the bed would be ready. How easy they made it sound.Come back at 10 pm to our room and needless to say the extra bed wasn't there. Called the reception and the most inept answers are given. Finally have to go down myself and they end up saying I have to pay extra.I say, please send the bed, my wife and kid are waiting and we need to discuss the charge as all was pre organised.Nope. Agree to the charge now!After losing tempers they claim I haven't given ID for 3 people in the room. I'm like you took 3 passports! And they dig and dive and finally say we sent the extra bed to the wrong room. Tbh they are extremely calm and composed. You could say unconcerned, but that would be a tad of an understatement.Absolutely zero service minded. Money minded only.The staff think they are doing us a favour by having us thereAnd the whole place is falling to bits with major renovation needed.Avoid at all costs!

4 суток жили съёмочной группой из 3 человек. Персонал отеля был отзывчив и приветлив. Подарил нам доступ в лаунж и улучшил номер. Расположение отличное, на островке тишины среди городского безумия. Если где и останавливаться в Катманду, так Crowne Plaza.

Stayed in this hotel whilst in Kathmandu - would not hesitate to go back! The rooms are very nice, spotlessly clean. Can't comment on breakfast as I don't eat this, but the Indian restaurant for dinner and room service both excellent. Had a very nice massage in the spa too. But the thing that really made this hotel stand out for me was the service - the staff are amazing. I stay in a lot of hotels, mainly Crowne Plazas, for work, and they are all excellent, but Crowne Plaza Kathmandu really stood out as exceptional. Thank you so much!

The hotel is a quiet and relaxing spot and a reprieve from the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu. We were attending wedding events at another hotel which was a 5 minute walk away.  The breakfast buffet had a lot of variety and was very good. The hotel staff all exceeded our expectations, but the breakfast staff was really excellent! Our room was very comfortable.

Crowne Plaza - Soaltee is an enclave away from the noise and dust of the majority of Kathmandu.  The property's greatest asset are their employees.  We were warmly greeted and treated very kindly.  Any request was always met with a smile and an urgency as if we were royalty.  The restaurants on site were reasonably priced and the food was excellent.

Very good rooms and overall facilities. Peaceful location, located right in the city of KTM. Excellent service and staff is very caring to make sure that guests are very satisfied. Hotel also have very good restaurants with good food and service.

It was a delight to stay in this hotel and be looked after by attentive staff. I enjoyed some wonderful meals in the main restaurant and the breakfast buffet had a diverse range of local and international dishes. My Platinum Ambassador status was recognized ans I was upgraded to a larger and nicer room. The staff helped me to retrieve my bag which was delayed by the airline. They had their agent follow up an bring it from the airport. The location is around 30-45 min from the airport depending on traffic. I was able to walk to the Thamel area in 35 minutes.

It was great and the service level was excellent and staff were very friendly and supportive. The restaurant food quality was excellent and I throughly enjoyed my stay in Soaltee.I enjoyed the food which was excellent and of high quality and reaspnable.

In the night of 30.11.2019, I visited the restaurant in this hotel and Mr. Tilak suggested me to order Mutton Biryani.  I and my wife really enjoyed the delicious Biryani.  The Chef personally came to meet me and took my suggestion regarding the preparation. I and my wife was surprised with happiness when Mr Tilak served complementary Jalebi, Burfi, Rasmalai,  Chukundar Halua and unamed nepali sweets  for both of us ...!!!!!God Bless himI must say that Mr Tilak is a thorough professional and humble person in this hotel, who know how to give respect to the visitors.  I don't like the behavior of the waiter ( served water), who replied in a very rude manner when I enquired about the govt policy regarding the service tax levied upon the food in Nepal....The waitor,  who served the food was attentive and upto the mark I will come again to the restaurant to eat food  only because of Mr. TILAK

Hotel molto spazioso, camere pulite, cene e colazioni di ottimo livello, con molta scelta e veramente di qualità. Wi fi gratuito, staff cordiale, situato a pochi passi da una zona ricca di negozietti. Consigliatissomo!!

Could not imagine that a hotel that looks so fresh, new and has state of art facilities - is actually amongst the oldest hotels in the country akin to the tourism heritage of Nepal. The Himalayan wing rooms look brand new, services  are impeccable and team at the hotel are extremely friendly and hospitable.

The room was in the new wing and the rooms on 3rd floor of the new wing are heritage theme with wood carvings. The room was spacious, clean and comfortable. Around the hotel compound, one could go for a spa treatment with reservations and a functional gym just 2-3 min walk from the main lobby. One could also enjoy the morning outside the hotel at the porch.The hotel serves Indian style vegetarians and International non-veg. dishes for breakfast, with a small salad bar in the middle and bakes and juices at the bar near the entrance. Though I would prefer they serve more local Nepalese cuisine. The cafeteria staff were polite and helpful. There is also a Chinese restaurant.The hotel has a currency exchange counter for the guests at a fairly reasonable rate. There are also 2 travel agency counters for those who would like to have a guided tour trip or even a mountain flight. The hotel is just 30-40 min away from the Tribhuvan airport. One could get on a airport transfer shuttle bus or just hire a car for a more private ride.They have a 1-day christmas bazaar outside the hotel on 30th Nov (from the staff said every year). There one could get good deals from scarfs, clothes, local jam and food, home decors etc. The hotel has a grand ballroom to host functions and banquets.Overall it was a pleasant experience.

This is my 4th week-long stay at this property.  I stay here now for the consistency of this property.  The food is great, the rooms relatively nice and the property has a garden around it on one side, which is a plus in Kathmandu. And there is a gym!

staff was really friendly and helpful. Location and room was great as well.Not too far away from the city. Alot of local resturants closeby. I would highly recommend this hotel for the services they are offering.

un poco frio , buena atención , habitaciones comodas , desayuno y cena excelente servicio, comida local  con disposición de atender a los que no gustan de las especias y picante , jardines amplios  y muy bien cuidados .

I stayed here after a lengthy business trip in India, and found the perfect respite in a quiet corner of Kathmandu.  The hotel is one of the oldest in the city, but they keep it impeccably clean and beautiful.  It’s tucked away in a resort-like area, complete with a few small shops, several restaurants, a casino, and a spa that is a real gem.  You can arrange tours though the onsite tour company Yeti Tours, or with the concierge who arranged a wonderful visit to Chandragiri Hills for me at the last minute after my Everest Flight was cancelled.  I really enjoyed the food, especially the breakfast buffet which featured Nepalese, Indian, Chinese, and western dishes every morning.  My host was especially proud of the Nepalese poppums they had at the dinner buffet one evening, and I agree they were delicious.

Stayed here two nights on a tour group, so can't comment on the location as we had a bus take us everywhere.But the breakfast buffet was very extensive with a very good staff.  They will explain the different dishes to you.  The service is fantastic.  We were commenting on the delicious slices of sweet lime.  The staff overheard one of us wondering how it would taste as a juice.  He offered to get the kitchen to make some juice for us.The Chinese restaurant in the hotel is also very good.

The hotel is on a beautiful private property and service was excellent.Felt highly secure and enjoyed the feel, comfort and amenities of the hotel.Will definitely go back again.  Food was delicious as well.

A beautiful hotel to stay , nice surroundings . good staff , Nice place to stay with family for a holiday.Enjoyed the trip and overall a very good experience.Friendly hotel staff and nice views from hotel room

Stayed at this hotel after trek to Everest Base Camp which was fantastic but tough going x was lucky enough to have a 90 minute Swedish massage which was fab and the following day a facial and pedicure x would definitely recommend the treatments in the tranquility spa x pool was very cold but jacuzzi was lovely x food in hotel was so good and reasonable that we ate in every night x only complaint was only one choice for glass of white wine

This big hotel close to Tribhuvan International Airport and the biggest temple in Kathmandu called Pasuphatinath temple. I can say this hotel is very nice with big landscape and the staff is very well trained. They handled my booking so well and really attentive.

It was a great experiencing staying at the hotel. It is just 15-20mts from airport. the hotel is best to stay. the hospitality, room, other facilities were good and restaurant surveying food from across the continent.

I stayed here twice in October 2019, once for 6 nights and once for 1 night. My stay was great in almost every way.  The hotel has security to enter the property via the front gate and outside the lobby.  My room was very clean and comfortable. The property has a nice pool area, spa, and gym.  I used several services at the spa and it was very relaxing.  I also used the gym which can be a little busy in the morning.  I also used the pool which is not heated and could be a little warmer, but it was very satisfying. I had breakfast everyday, and tried various food at the 3 of the 4 restaurants. All the food was great and while I ate everything I did not end up sick like you can if it is not cleaned properly.  I did use the laundry service while I was there and they did a great job except they did not return the clothes by the time committed which was a little irritating because I needed them.  I also bought some suntan lotion at the gift shop for 8USD.  I would note that they only had 1 bottle so the selection is slim.  It is more of a tee shirt shop. If you like casinos, there are two on or near the property. I think the best part of my stay was the people and service.  Each and every individual I encountered were all very helpful and friendly.  Within 1-2 days they knew my name and welcomed me.  They went out of their way to help me when needed. They all spoke English great except maybe for housekeeping, but we communicated.All in all I would definitely visit the hotel again!!!

We stayed at this hotel for two nights and couldn't be happier. It is a short drive (less than 10") from the monkey temple and easy access to Durbar Square and other attractions. The hotel is charming with attentive staff, very clean, great meals and the spa was a wonderful, relaxing experience at the end of a long day.It is very secure and safe with shops right on the grounds. The swimming pool looked very nice, although we did not have time to experience it firsthand. There is also a nice pastry shop right at the entrance where you can sit and have coffee and desserts. I would highly recommend this hotel.

It’s not high rise but spread horizontally so feels great, staff very good, food excellent Being old hotel wear and tear eminent otherwise it’s good hotel, very safe feeling, neat and clean Would recommend It and love to stay again

Very welcoming and helpful staff all round the hotel. Nice gardens around pool area and great fitness centre and spa. The hotel is in its own secure grounds so feels very safe and relaxed. Rooms are a little dated and need a refurbishment but are well maintained and clean. Hotel can arrange airport transfers $20 each way...great personal meet and greet service...recommended. Breakfast buffet good. Two good restaurants on site, one Chinese one Indian. Overall nice location.

Wir haben im Oktober im Rahmen unserer Nepalrundreise insgesamt 5 Nächte in diesem wirklich schönen Hotel verbracht und können es nur loben.Ganz besonders begeistert hat uns die aussergewöhnliche Freundlichkeit und Hilfsbereitschaft des Personals, das haben wir auf unseren Reisen bisher selten erlebt. Das Hotel ist sehr gut ausgestattet, alles sehr sauber, wirklich gutes und abwechselungsreiches Frühstück. Auch die Restaurants im Hotel können wir nur empfehlen. Das Hotel liegt gut und ruhig, zum Flughafen sind es ca. 30 Minuten. Insgesamt eine sehr gute Empfehlung!!!
別途グレードアップしたクラウンプラザ ホテル カトマンズ ソルティです。大多数が宿泊するスタンダードのグランドホテルの近くです。クラウンプラザ ホテル カトマンズ ソルティには道路の入口にゲートがあり、それを上げてもらって入るようになっていました。膨大な敷地なんでしょう。2日目にはイベントがあったようですごい警備でした。

Me aloje ahi varias veces cuando trabajaba de tripulante, es un hotel muy calido, con gente muy amable, lindos jardines y pileta, buena opcion de restaurantes para comer (son 3 de distintas comidas) y las habitaciones son amplias, comodas y agradables

With it's grand location and setting,  Soaltee naturally rises head and shoulders above all other hotels of all categories. This is a premier hotel, and the management has made sure to keep up the reputation of the hotel. The first impression itself brings a sense of grandeur, when you see the beautifully kept lawns and landscaped grounds. The wide lobby and seating arrangement includes a quiet bar. At the far end, on the same level, you have the 24 hour coffee shop which serves delicious meals and drinks.The service is very good overall. We enjoyed a live musical evening in the Indian restaurant, called Kakori. Along with beautiful, quaint interiors, which brings Nepali architecture to the forefront, the kababs and biriyani were out of the world.      Room sizes are spacious and has a view of the mountains up ahead. The quiet and elegant hotel has all facilities for the traveler, including a spa, fitness centre, and swimming pool. You will never regret your choice by staying here.

We had booked a triple occupancy for family at the hotel, however husband could not join last minute due to an emergency. When my daughter & I reached the hotel & requested for a compensation of any sort, they reluctantly gave us a club room in the club floor & particularly said " We will give you a club room but you cannot use any of the facilities including happy hours". Was not sure why they made this offer , as we had made it clear that we would hardly be in the room & what would be a real compensation would be a complimentary meal or cocktails. Even after repeated requests, the "manager" in charge very curtly said "not possible" Just wondering how indifferent a 5 star hotel like this can be so indifferent & insensitive to tourists & guests especially women travelling alone & for the first timeThe entire experience was very average & will definitely look at more guest & women friendly hotels next time

Stayed here for 2 nights with a family and just loved the entire stay. Rooms were of good size and best was the breakfast spread. Everything they had and it was a splendid one. Highly recommend this place to stay. Casino was an added advantage

We stayed for three nights at the Soaltee in Kathmandu and were impressed with the entire stay. The property is located within a large area somewhat blocked off from the bustle of the city, but just a few steps from the fun of the city streets and shops. The hotel is modern, clean, and attractive with spacious lobby and meeting areas. Rooms are adequately spacious; staff are probably some of the friendliest, most accommodating I've ever experienced. The impressive breakfast buffet is extensive, and the food delicious; I can't imagine anything you'd want that isn't either on the buffet or readily made to your specifications. Obviously, I loved this hotel and recommend it highly.

I've been staying at the Soaltee for the last 2 years on frequent business trips and the service, hospitality and staff have been consistently great all this time. The rooms are clean and tidy. Breakfast is always a joy every morning with friendly staff & plenty of choice. Note: there is currently some construction at the basement of the Himalayan wing so be aware there is lots of construction noise during daylight hours, 7 days a week at the moment. Not sure how long this will go on for.

We have stayed 5 nights in Crowne Plaza Kathmandu-Soaltee Hotel. The premises are located in a clean and vast area where greenery and trees are the most common features. Although the place is a bit far from downtown, it takes actually 20-25 minutes walking to get Durbar Square.In spite of the low rates in some reviews based on apparently outdated facilities, a big positive surprise was to confirm that the Hotel is very well maintained, not missing any kind of modernity and comfort.We could indulge both the spa and hair-dresser, whose treatments and cares were really superb. We also enjoyed the good quality of the food at anytime.Since the early moments of check in up to the farewell, all the personnel were incredibly servicial with us. We felt at the Hotel like in our own home. We would like to highlight the good work carried out by employees as Mrs Sharuib at the front desk or Mr Himal and Mr. Dipak at the club lounge. Sorry for those we have for sure missed. Anyway the entire Hotel staff was very friendly and professional.Congratulations for your good job!.We will come back.

Very warm team, it is like home away from home.It is very good experience to stay (always) in Solatee, just one mail and work done.good food, neat and clean room.Best place to stay in Kathmandu and good ambiance.

I have been staying in Soaltee Crowne Plaza Hotel in Kathmandu for a week. This hotel is nice and clean. Staff are very friendly and polite. I enjoy staying here very much. Their restaurants serve excellent food. I like their Italian restaurant, lamb chop is very delicious. Their spa and swimming pool is very nice and I recommend you to try Hamalaya massage that combines Thai massage and oil massage. A special credit to their duty manager Ms. Sampada Singh who offers much assistance and advice. I would recommend this hotel to you if you travel to Kathmandu, Nepal.  You won’t be disappointed.

I can mention and estimate  only services and opportunittees used like room service, currency exchange at the hotel, restourants usage and all listed  went well; the rest questions like hair and beaty, locker rooms at fitness or steam room couldn't be estimated as were not used. In general I'd like to mention big hospitality, polite and attentive attitude of the whole hotel staff/guards.

Il crowne plaza  di kathmandu e’ una perla di hotel , Camere perfette , piscina , tranquillita’ , prima colazione tra le migliori mai provate .Un particolare ringraziamento alla duty manager  Sampada Singh , che ci ha risolto un grosso problema di prenotazione .Mai trovato tanta gentilezza e premura

I visited Crown Plaza for official work and i had a truly wonderful stay. Rooms are spacious and well maintenance staff is courteous and ready to help on each and everything. Special mention of Sampada Singh for making my trip really wonderfulFood was absolutely sumptuous.I think icing on the cake was  newly built gym which is not only spacious but is also equipped with new  machine.In nutshell really wonderful stay

We stayed for just four nights, celebrating our 20th wedding anniversary. Our room was excellent and the swimming pool also very pleasant (sometimes eagles circled overhead!). We tried two out of the three restaurants in the hotel, as well as breakfasting there each morning, and the food and service were excellent in all cases. Live music in restaurants usually makes us flee, but the very talented musicians in the Indian restaurant definitely added to our evening. The most memorable aspect of our stay was how kind and helpful the hotel staff were on all occasions. We asked the best way to request a blessing for our anniversary at Swayambhunath, the Monkey Temple; the desk staff enthusiastically helped and advised. They must have spread the word within the hotel, as on our anniversary itself all the restaurant staff surprised us with a cake and the room staff arranged roses and rose petals on our bed. We were stunned! Really nice people, and an outstanding hotel. I don't usually write hotel reviews but this place is first rate.By the way, you really need a taxi to get to and from the city centre but try to avoid rush hour as traffic get very snarled up. The taxis available through the hotel are much better than the ones you flag down in the centre of Kathmandu.

We visited to Crowne Plaza to celebrate my husband's birthday and we were delighted with exceptional service of few staff members like Dharmendra in patio the pastry shop, duty manager sampada, reception staff Rajeev and Sharmila.The rooms are bit small and have strange smell being newly renovated but the hotel staff did there best to make the experience wonderful for us.Dharmendra only suggested us for visit to Chandagiri and my God it turned out to be trip to heaven.Thank you Dharmendra for your wonderful suggestion.

Não estou achando aqui no trip advisor pra deixar a dica então estou escrevendo na página do hotel.Tem um restaurante italiano dentro do hotel que a comida é maravilhosa!!!! Se chama alfresco.Comida fresca, feita na hora, deliciosa e o atendimento é 🔝.O hotel também é bom, tem várias atividades, piscina, spa, amplo espaço e várias opções para almoço e janta!

Excellent hotel, friendly staff for when you get out of the transport until you leave the hotel. The food is plentiful in choice and there is 24 hour service. Beautiful hotel grounds which you can enjoy from the patio bar.

Crown plaza is a great hotel for guests who look forward to staying closer to the central area. The hotel provides great levels of hospitality and staff does not fail to accept mistakes and apologize for the same. Very sweet staff. Nepal felt like home, away from home, and cannot be thankful enough to the warm hotel experience. Big thanks to Ms. Sampada Singh (asst. manager) for her constant support. Best Regards, Namrata

Hotel situado en un recinto muy amplio y acogedor, el personal muy amable, el desayuno completo y todo muy limpioLo único menos destacable es que no está céntrico y tienes que tirar de taxi, que también es una aventura en siMuy recomendable

The hotel is probably the oldest 5 star in Kathmandu. It was my safest bet for a 5 night stay. Rosheen Shrestha was exceptionally convincing in getting me to stay here.The room was neat & clean & the breakfast had a decent spread. What I really loved was the amenities & facilities the hotel had to offer.I used the Tranquility Spa for one of their signature massages & was pleasantly surprised with the facilities.Made a visit to Privee, a really lavish nightclub with a private karaoke room which was amazing. Even the casino called "Mahajong" didn't dissapoint.Special "Thank You" to Mr. Surya Bahadur Kunwar & Ms. Sampada Singh for making the stay comfortable & memorable.Look forward to coming back again.

This is a nice property. Ms Sampada Singh, Assistant Duty Manager is very helpful. Staff is polite. But whenever you visit the reception, they seem to be too busy in some kind of paperwork. Rooms could have been bigger. It is due to room size that I have to give 4/5.

The staff are very well trained, courteous and genuinely caring. The accommodations are excellent - very clean and everything you could possibly need. No request is too big for this place. Kudos to the team !!

This may not be the most modern hotel in its “star” bracket but the service provided outweighs the “tiredness” aspects We were treated to a suite upgrade which provided two bathrooms and a very pleasant sitting room. There is nothing negative I could say about the the staff approach 10 out of 10

Soaltee is the oldest five star hotel in Kathmandu. With lovely restaurants, a happening casino ( by Kathmandu standard) and great service, this is a good property to stay in. The hotel also has a big banquet. Location is average as it is away from the city centre but then how big is the valley?!!A special mention of their restaurant, China Garden which serves the best Chinese fare in Kathmandu. The food is delicious and hygienic. My favourites are chicken chive dim sums, red chillies stir fried prawns and burnt garlic chicken fried rice. The prawns here are specially good and definitely the best I have had in the valley. I recommend Soaltee for the best casino in Kathmandu and good restaurants.

Excellent  property ...Very Hospitable staff....Great buffet  Breakfast ...we ordered butter chicken from room service at late night but the preparation was sub standard it didn't tastes like butter chicken even the tandoori roti was like a chapati ...Rest...We had a comfortable stay and casino is a part of the property which is great !!!

Stayed there a couple of nights. Highly recommended.It is actually a small resort with several (good) restaurants, nice outdoor pool, gym, casino - all within the hotels compound.Very friendly and service oriented staff.Rooms are nice, rich breakfast.

we just recently stayed for 4 days and it was absolutely amazing. From their GM all the way to the hotel staff. We had a fabulous accommodation. Our request (if there's any) is immediately addressed and sorted out. Transportation request (since it's more comfortable than ordinary taxis) are also immediately provided. They have modernized spa and gym facilities which made it perfect after long travel. You can also find 3 different kind of restaurants that serve authentic Chinese, Indian or Italian dish. The staff are also very attentive and polite and very well trained. I wouldn't mind coming back here and can highly recommend to my family and friends.

Very large property with many amenities like spa, casino etc. Very friendly and helpful staff. Breakfast buffet quality and variety was average. A bit far from the airport but we had free pick and drop service. Overall a very comfortable stay.

Very cosy atmosphere and friendly staff. Especially Mr Dharwendra from Patio bar. Excellent service and great conversation.Three options for  restaurants and an outside bar. Nice and afordable spa.Will return for sure.

Had visited this 5-star hotel in Kathmandu a long back ago, even though had not stayed in it. This upscale hotel is located in a business area in Kathmandu. It offers 3 restaurants and a bar, a casino, spa, sports court and a swimming pool. The rooms are a bit spacious. The lobby and reception desk is bigger and spacious. It has a conference room for holding meetings. Outside the hotel is a lawn where wedding receptions can be held. Within the hotel complex, there are Buddhist prayer wheels in the niches of the walls. The hospitality service of this hotel is good.This upscale hotel is ideal for an overnight stay or a two day stay for business tycoons, upper class families etc. while in Kathmandu.

5 star rating to the hotel, the staff, cleanliness, heritage rooms, food, support staff, restaurants & food options. end to end the stay was an absolute delight. thank you once again for making the stay so nice.

Un sitio extraordinario,tranquilo dentro de una ciudad caótica. Instalaciones confortables y limpias con un personal excepcional, atento y amable. Empieza a ser una instalación que podría modernizarse pero está aún bien y el lugar es precioso

Stayed here for two nights on work. The property is quite large and targets the conference market but it's a good option for families and holiday peeps as well. It has a pool, nice large gym, a spa and plenty of dining options. I just had breakfast there as the city has many dining options. You will need a taxi to go anywhere as the property is set away from the city centre which is good in a way. This wasn't my first visit to the city so we went out for most meals. The gym was nice though didn't try the pool. The rooms were very nice with a good blend of modern and traditional. If you are sitting outside in the evening, remember to have mosquito repellent!

5 days in any hotel is a push but the staff made this a pleasant business stay. A good breakfast, an excellent spa and Chinese restaurant made this a a good experience for this happy guest. The rooms and general appearance of the hotel could do with refreshing but there was nothing to spoil the stay.

The Soltee is an hotel very complete and confortable. Only we were 1 night but very nice hotel.The breaksfast was amaizing and rhe service perfect. All staff asked us if we need something.The reception is very good.

This was our second time at the Crowne Plaza hotel and it does not disappoint. The facilities and were rooms were very clean and all the staff was super friendly. They have a new gym/workout area with 8-10 cardio machines, free weights, and machines. The swimming pool is spacious and well maintained. Breakfast buffet is a must. Great food, service and selection. It is one of my favorite thing about the hotel. On the premises of the hotel, they have four different restaurant venues (Indian, Italian, Chinese, American (International). Restaurants are pricey, but high quality. Overall, our stay was excellent and I'd highly recommend this hotel for any type of visit.

I can politely tern this visit as one of the not so memorable one. Being a member of Taj Hotels group , my first preference is always Taj Property mostly in India.This time I went with the family recommendations to Soaltee Brunch along with my entire family n friend. My views :PROS :1. Well managed pool.2. Efficient bar tenders and swift in their service.3. Beautiful propertyCons:1. Limited food spread.2. Live station chef appeared to b under trainee serving under cooked food.3. All the food in the live station was being served cold.Overall lot needs to be done in terms of standing to the reputation.

I have been to hotels all around the world and honestly this hotel is the best I have been to so far. Reason is the people who run the show, each and every staff gave me exceeding expectation service. Everyone was very kind and genuinely caring. Unlike i western world mostly where you get the treatment for the money you pay, here regardless of what you sped, everyone fro the manager to the cleaner greets you with a smile from the heart and that is GOLD. No doubt whenever I come to Kathmandu without a second thought this is the hotel I will choose to stay in always.

Very old property but still well maintained and in centre of Kathmandu . Rooms and toilets are ok but some smell in rooms . Staff is good and help in quick checkin . breakfast spread is good for indians . Casino hall is very good and crowded but smoky .

It was a positive and wonderful feeling that I had my time in saoltee hotel. I was there from June 5th to June 7th and I had several meals in different restaurant in the hotel and it was so nice food. Specially you must go to the kakori restaurant to tried the great Indian dish.

One of the 1st Five Star hotels of Nepal,Soaltee is still going strong.It has 3 restaurants and a lobby bar,Casino and a fitness center with a pool.The Chinese restaurant is awesome and the Garden terrace serves all cuisines.Kakori, the Indian restaurant has a good reputation.The staff is very disciplined and dedicated and will go the extra mile to make your stay comfortable.The room is comfy,bathroom is clean with good shower.However some furniture needs to be replaced as they look dated.

ツアーのホテルアップグレードで宿泊。広い敷地の中には、門の側にお土産屋に、24時間カジノに宴会場に屋外プールとスパにジム。中心地から離れていても、愉しみはたくさん。①カジノは短パン・サンダルはNG、入口でパスポートを見せ、中に入った受付で又パスポートを見せ2階へ。すぐの窓口でドルかルピーでコインに両替。スロットで遊ぶなら更に奥の窓口で専用コインに両替。舞台ではダンサーがショーを行い、親子連れが観覧しながら食事を。バカラやルーレットなどで遊ぶと飲み物は無料に。簡単なルーレットの席に着き、コインを【2】単位のコイン数枚に両替してスタート。私はすぐ負けましたが、友人は連勝して3時間遊べました。最後に最初に両替した窓口でルピーに。②プールは側に更衣室がありますがロッカーの鍵が掛からないので荷物は少なめに。シャワーやトイレも中にあります。係に部屋番号と名前を伝え黄×白のタオルをもらい、いざプール。途中から急に深くなる本格派。子供用もあります。部屋はバスタブに動かせるシャワー、当然お湯が十分な量出てきます。バスローブやスリッパもあり、プールに持っていくことも。アイロンやアイロン台、セーフティーボックスも完備。冷蔵庫にも飲み物やスナック、他に無料のペットボトル3本にポットでコーヒーやお茶を持っていくと部屋でのんびり出来ます。残念なのは、ドライヤーは洗面台の引き出しにありましたが、風力選べないタイプ。それとテレビが2日目から何も映らなくなり、修理をお願いしても直してくれませんでした。ロビーの前の玄関にもパブがあり、朝から風通しの良いテラスでケーキやお酒も楽しめます。朝食ブッフェは、種類も豊富で、卵料理とパンケーキ・ワッフルはオーダー。クロワッサンはパサパサして美味しくなかった。

If you want to experience best fine dinning in nepal please visit soaltee crown plaza kathmandu Garden Terrace restaurant. All the staffs are friendly, very kind and home environment And different cousines are served . You will not regreat it try it once.

Namaste,My wife and I enjoyed 3 nights at this wonderful hotel in Kathmandu. Staff was excellent and very helpful. We ate at 3 of the 4 restaurants on property. The food was made fresh and was wonderful at all 3 locations. Our room was spacious and bed was very comfortable. The hotel exchanged our USD to Nepalese Rupee at the front desk. The hotel assisted in getting us car service (taxi) to some of the famous tourist locations at a fair rate. The property is very big and features a pool, spa, small stores and outside dinning.Check-in and checking out was fast and easy. My wife and I enjoyed our stay and if ever back in Kathmandu we definitely would stay here again.

Great property with nice garden .The staff was very polite, courteous, and helpful. Need to review the charges of Taxi taken from the Hotel which is definitely expensive. They should charge on per Km basis rather than a lum sum amount.

Hospedei-me nesse hotel durante 5 dias e fiquei muito satisfeita!As acomodações eram aconchegantes, apesar de móveis um pouco velhos, mas foi exatamente o que eu precisava. Cama confortável e banheiro limpo. Fiquei muito feliz com o atendimento de todos os funcionários, principalmente dos restaurantes. Jantei todos os dias no hotel e não me arrependi! O café da manhã era excelente também. A academia do hotel é muito boa, com uma variedade grande de aparelhos. Inclusive realizei uma aula de Ioga muito agradável durante minha estadia!Voltaria com certeza!

Hotel was well-decorated, staff was very helpful and friendly. They have a specific counter for currencies exchange which was so efficient for your stay. Recommend to exit the hotel and get a cab from the road, it’s safe to do so, as the hotel will help you to book some limousines only and it’s two times more expensive than a normal cab. The restaurant Garden Terrance and room service were not tasty, as well as the breakfast. I would recommend the Chinese restaurant (closer to the concierge counter), absolutely tasty and authentic Chinese food.

Albergo molto comodo silenzioso e tranquiĺlo ,dispone di un bellissimo giardino, ed una attrezzata palestra con piscina. Ristorante ottimo.Personale disponibileWi-Fi con buona copertura Dispone di un bel parco per passeggiare con negozi.Vicino al centro

My recent stay at the Crowne Plaza in Katmandu was hit and miss.  First the grounds of the hotel are quite nice, and expansive.  The location is not far from the airport and I was able to reach most of the temples and tourist sites easily.   There were plenty of eating and shopping options on the streets as well.  The dining at the hotel was pricey but delicious, good mix of east and west choices, and delicious Indian foods.  The staff was very polite, courteous, and helpful. Now, the bad.   The room had issues on day 1.   The door would not close properly, it would not lock properly.  The aircon wasn’t very cold.   The amenities weren’t up to par in the room as well.  It was a big room but dated in interior and also wear and tear was obvious.  The same applies to the hallways, carpets, etc. The pool was nice as was the gym, one of the best hotel gyms I’ve used in recent years.  Overall a positive experience.

We ara regular customers of IHG hotel and we relay on its properties to find comfort and certain standards. Room wasn’t ready as we had agreed on the phone several days ago. It was fixed upon arrival. Air con didn’t work, it was not very hot but we could have used it during the day for sure. All prices come without VAT and taxes so if you are coming from Europe, watch this point to avoid a 23% surprise. Maybe is something normal in Nepal that I wasn’t aware of but alcohol is ridiculously expensive. Transportation: I received a lot of comments to avoid to take taxi from outside which is cheaper. There are cars outside at the entrance waiting for guess which they have arrangements with the hotel or bell boy. So if you want to pay extra and get it quickly, go for them, for me it’s tiring to bargain with these drivers which work often with the hotel. If you pay cash, you pay to the driver without taxes and might get discount . If you want to charge to the room, you can do it but then they will charge 23% taxes and service fee, funny when the service is not provided by them but outsourced.

Was here for a conference with about 600 delegates and still felt that the service was amazing and the staff experience was really great. Room was clean, amenities were good food was delicious! Did not feel their service was compromised by the sheer numbers crowding the space. My go to hotel while in Kathmandu.....felt safe and respected as a solo female traveller in Nepal but also particularly in this hotel.

The Soaltee Crown Plaza, is to be polite, a little dated.   Wifi is back in the cleft stick era.The hotel is in the middle of nowhere, so you are pretty much captive there unless you have a car available.   We decided to try the Indian Restaurant in the grounds, the surroundings were very nice but we were not overly impressed by the food.  In contrast the included breakfast was really excellent, with a large number of choices and a Chef in attendance who produced some excellent Eggs Benedict.

A decent hotel, with a very very friendly staff, they always give a very patient hearing, to all our needs. Rooms are spacious and good, comfortable bed. There are three restaurants in the hotel.  An Indian , Chinese and a cafe . I tried the cafe , authentic Nepalese thali, took 45 minutes but in the end it was worth, got a complimentary Gurkha cap too. Highly recommended.

I had just checked in this afternoon.I asked the staff where can I find a flower shop around the hotel as I just need to buy some small amount. Mr.Deepak was very helpful not only suggested me some shops around but he also went beyond my expectation to check with the housekeeping if they had extra flowers which they had and get it delivered to my room!!I'm impressed with the generosity and the hospitality him and the hotel staffs provided. I heard about it from my colleagues before that this hotel has a great service but today I experienced it myself. I will recommend this hotel to everyone!! Many thanks to Mr. Deepak and all hotel staffs. Very small thing does matter as it shows how much you care for the guests.

The Crowne Plaza is a beautiful property with lovely rooms, sparkling clean bathrooms, and very gracious staff.  We spent 3 nights in this hotel, where we had breakfast all 3 mornings and dinner on 2 evenings.  The breakfast buffet was delicious and contained numerous offerings of various types of food.  Most importantly to us, the restaurant offered a delicious hamburger with nearly 1/2 lb of beef imported from Singapore, and it was fabulous!Each staff member went out of their way to show kindness and Nepali hospitality to us.  We very much enjoyed this beautiful hotel, and if we were to return to Kathmandu, we would certainly stay here again.  Thank you for a wonderful stay!

Nous avons passé deux nuits dans cet hôtel et s'était très bien. Il y avait beaucoup de monde pour une convention mais cela nous a pas vraiment dérangé. Les lieux étaient très propre. Le buffet était bon, il n'y avait pas beaucoup de variété mais les saveurs étaient là et le restaurant est vraiment très bien décoré. L'air climatisé ne fonctionnait pas au début mais après un appel de service, ils sont venu régler le problème très rapidement. Seul petit point négatif, les portes de chambre ne ferme pas très bien et font un très gros bruit quand nous forçons pour les fermer.

We were booked in a deluxe room that was about a 2 star room.  when we went to the desk they helped us sort it out with the company that had booked the room for us.  We were upgraded to the next level and very happy with that room.  Grounds and service were very good in this hotel and we enjoyed sitting outside having a beer after a long day of travel.  Wait staff could not have been better.

Amazing Stay. I enjoyed every Moment staying in the hotel.All employees were cooperative and helpful all the time.The hospitality and the services your staff gave to us was excellent especially the duty manager Deepak Pandey. The receptionist Ms. Puja was great too. She always welcomed us with a friendly smile. He was really helpful. Thank you very much for making our stay enjoy full..

Warm hospitality, courteous and polite staff. overall very enjoyable experience . good restaurants to select from. good food. room AC was not that effective. not sure they fixed the thermostat due to winter.

Really nice hotel, fantastic and helpful staff - great Chinese restaurant, lovely food, great beer (Everest) and in a good location - i would really recommend staying here - great place and reasonable priced.

Stayed here a few times over the years. My most recent visit in March, 2019 was a disappointment . The wifi didn’t work all that well. We complained and were given the better wifi. The hallways needed vacuuming. The very bottom basement floor... don’t go down there, it will scare you. The hotel seemed worn and tired... it’s seen better days. The morning buffet was good but not great. This hotel is Crowne Royal in name but not quality. I will say the staff are very good and did try to address some of our concerns. Can’t give this hotel a 4 star. We brought our complaints to the managers attention. He did what he could to satisfy us.

I am always delighted to go back to Soaltee Crowne Plaza for many reasons. To start with, the location of the hotel is ideal, as it's quite close to Durbar Square and Tharlam for strolls and shopping. Moreover, the rooms are spacious, clean and very quiet, and the food at the restaurant is simply delicious. Here I have to thank Mr. Khadka, Mr. Luitel and the rest of the team (both breakfast and dinner) for their wonderful service and very friendly welcome to me and my party. Looking forward to going back again before too long!
初めてのネパール旅行で勝手も分からなかったこともありローカルのホテルを敬遠してクラウンプラザを利用しました。ホテル自体はキレイでセキュリティもしっかりしていると感じました。ただ滞在した日は気温が低かったのですが部屋も館内も肌寒く感じました。室内空調はあまり期待できません。スタッフは親切で、概ね満足は出来ました。
メリットはチェーンホテルの安心感。サービスも行きとどおっている。デメリットは立地。空港からは一度街を通ってホテルに着く。街に出るのにもタクシー必須。他の方の口コミには空港からの無料送迎やスカーフのお出迎えがあったが、今回はなかったのが残念。

visited there with my friends and the casino was huge and mind blowing....... the crowd was not that great but the games were nice.... we all enjoyed the free food and drinks............ the cover charges were 2000 rs..........

We arrived during election day in Kathmandu (May 14) and we learned at the airport arrival that all taxi services are cancelled and even the tourist info desk was closed. Hence, we didn't know how to get to the hotel. A tourist guide of another group was kind enough to help us so he called the hotel and somebody arranged for our transport. We should have been informed ahead by the hotel that there will be no public transport at the airport when we arrive because of election day. If not for the helpful tourist guide we wouldn't know how to get to the hotel. Upon arrival at the hotel we were standing in the lobby for several minutes because the check-in clerk was attending to somebody else who appeared to be arguing. Since we noticed that it will take some time we interrupted and the hotel desk called the lady sitting in another desk who already saw us earlier standing and waiting at the lobby. She should have attended to us when she saw that we have been waiting for some time. Upon check-in we were given an additional key for another room in case we don't like the room assigned to us. The room they gave us was smelly, had a defective toilet bowl and some broken furniture so we checked the other room and it was newer and cleaner so we chose this one. The first room was obviously old and needed renovation and we should not have been given this one when there are better ones available in the hotel.

I have been in the hotel in wedding ceremony. I found the interior, services, location in outstanding. But most of staffs are found juniors and also very local food served. I don't know it was wedding plan or the hotel menu. Thank you.

Stayed here overnight after our departing flight was delayed/cancelleddue to intense rain and windstorms.  Late evening arrival for a LOT of unexpected guests, but the staffwas ultra-polite and very helpful - and the rooms were definitely UPto, or above, the normal excellent standards of Crown-Plaza.

It was a just wonderful.  I left most of my luggage at the hotel while I travelled to other cities in Nepal and also to Tibet.  Every time I came back they had a very nice room for me and my daughter and the people were as nice as anybody could wish them to be.  When an issue arose they helped solve it immediately.  I definitively broadly recfomend it.

I have been a regular at soaltee for last couple of years travelling mostly for business . I have to say that by and large Nepalese are very courteous and helpful people and this shows all the more when u stay in this property. Leave aside the approach to the hotel and everything else is just too good weather landscaping and open area or restaurants and top of it all helpful staff .Highly recommended and priceing is also reasonable

We had done a conference at Soaltee and also taken approx 10 rooms for guests ...from the very day we arrived at the hotel on 9th we had suffered..first the rooms alloted were not of the category we had discussed after that it was issue with the conference also the menu selected was not served ..post that we had planned our arrival in Kathmandu a day before the conference to enjoy the weather and celebrate my birthday, but the hotel couldn't arrange vehicles for us so that we could reach the party venue due to the venue closed and we had to sleep literally without food.We had  8 buffet dinner in our package for one day, which we asked the hotel to give is ala carte or make it lunch but the hotel management was toorudeOnly last day the hotel guest relations manager sampada tried to reach out to us and apologize for the goof ups This time it was sorry affairs at Soaltee
きちんとしたホテルにも泊まってみたくて選択しました。わかっていたものの観光地から少し離れていること、周辺には何も無いこともあり、すっかりホテルに居ついてしまいました。レストランなどは充実していますし、のんびり過ごすにはよいのではないかと思います。値段は少々高いかなという印象です。

The property is well decorated. Lets you have a lot of pictures with different and exciting background. The staff is polite and helpful. The amenities are good. Good is also good specially the Chinese one.

We booked the hotel on the day of arrival after our first hotel did not live up to what we were expecting.On arrival at 10:30 hrs the staff were superb and arranged for a room to be made ready and gave us orange juice whilst we waited. By 11:00 hrs we were in our room.Whilst the rooms are a bit dated, they are clean, warm and comfortable. There was a safe, tea and coffee making facilities and the bed was very comfortable. The bathroom had lots of towels and toiletries. It was a quiet and we slept well. WiFi was available throughout the hotel and was a good speed.We opted to have breakfast one morning and the selection was outstanding – one of the best breakfast we have ever had.We were able to change currency at the reception desk and got a reasonable rate. Overall we had a lovely stay made all the better by outstanding staff.

A sprawling property and pretty well maintained . However it is very inconvenient in the rains and cold winters to walk so much outdoors to reach their gym . The gym itself is huge and well equipped but if it were connected to the main hotel indoors it wd be amazing . The spa looked nice but the massage costs are prohibitive in comparison to spas in Indian five stars . The travel desk was pretty helpful in organising a trip to chandragiri hills by car .The breakfast is ok and the staff are super energetic and full of enthusiasm which feels great . Their club room gives privacy more so in the evenings with great wine and snacks and if you are with friends it’s like being at a home away from home !The casino next door is well located and you cd spend the whole night out there ! All in all a lovely experience!

I did not stay long at the hotel ,just for 2 nights but what I could not stop noticing is the hotel staff ! If I could give more than 5 stars I would . Specially a particular lady trainee  working at  the buffet restaurant in the morning shift ,I am  so amazed with her hospitality, she remembered how and what type of  eggs I like   as she was just standing near the live cooking area the first day I placed my order now this is attention to detail , I just said eggs and she explained the chef how I wanted them And moreover such a pleasent and pleasing personality . I almost travel every week  to countries and cities but for the first time have experienced such attention to detail . All other restaurant staff were good too and not to mention the morning buffet is amazing . I hope this review reaches to the management and the employee is appreciated for her excellent work .  Checked in on 2- 1_19 checkout on 4  Anshul Thakur

Soaltee is a wonderful hotel in Kathmandu spread over a wide area with nice buildings which you love for in the first look itself. The recognition as a IHG member was heartening. Three nice restaurants with good gym and spa facilities fulfil all your needs. The rooms are nice with wide range of TV channels. Was very happy to stay here for 3 days.

Me, my wife and 2 children 14 & 16 years reached this hotel (Soaltee Crowne Plaza Kathmandu) on 24th Dec. 2018.  It was unplanned trip that I thought of 3 days before only.  I was searching on the net for Oberoi Hotel in Kathmandu; when I came across this hotel, which is of IHG Group (earlier managed by Oberoi for 20+ years).My first contact in reservations was one Ms. Ramila - but for her prompt / efficient service to book my accommodation, I would have opted for Hyatt.  NO REGRETS & I realise that it was a better choice to stay in this Hotel @ moderate tariff - a 5 star hotel for the price of 3 or 4 star hotel only!I coordinated with Ms. Ramila on her mobile and could book my suite room, which ACCOMMODATED 2+2 of my family for additional bed charge.  Airport pick-up and drop complimentary, club lounge access complimentary, breakfast included etc. Me/my family were feted a warm welcome with shawl and greetings from friendly staff and welcome drink too.  Ms. Tsering Shrestha, Front Office Executive gave us lots of useful advise on the hotel, the places to see around, help on how to get sim card etc. Ms. Ramila coordinated with her Senior Mr. Vijay Nanmaran & GM of the Hotel Mr. Upaul Majumdar & upgraded my room to a bigger suite room; so as to accommodate 4 guests - it is a heritage hotel & very well maintained; with detailing.  GUESS WHAT???  I CAME TO KNOW FROM SOME OTHER PEOPLE IN THE HOTEL THAT THE SUITE ROOM GIVEN TO ME WAS OCCUPIED BY HON. PM OF OUR COUNTRY & HIS TEAM!!!!  I paid just INR 27,500 per night + luxury tax!Very polite staff @ hotel, prompt service from Housekeeping / Room Service - in house dining was customised for me/my family with South Indian Rasam/ Sambar too!On Boxing Day 26th Dec., a cocktail party was organized by the Hotel. where I was introduced to top management of Hotel; including GM.Excellent Spa facility in the Hotel - Spa & Sauna were complimentary & massage therapy was extra-ordinary by well trained masseurs - having climbed many steps in 3 temples previous day, @ 56+ years age, my knees, ankle etc. was paining and had good therapy by trained masseur Deepa & her team.CASINO IS THERE WITHIN THE HOTEL PREMISES, WHICH ALLOWS CHILDREN TOO i.e. SOME GAMES ARE AVAILABLE FOR CHILDREN & NICE WAY TO SPEND TIME FOR ADULTS TOO.I WOULD HAVE LOVED TO GIVE PERFECT 10 RATING; BUT GIVE 9/10 RATING DUE TO 2 ISSUES BELOW -1. Tennis was the only outdoor facility that I used - Rs. 2,500 + tax for renting 2 tennis rackets & ball is expensive.  It could have been complimentary; as anyone would agree that the amount of RENT is too much; especially considering this Hotel that gives more expensive things as complimentary!  Indoor Cricket (seen in web site) does not exist - more space in the hotel; hence same with TT, Pool / Billiards table, carrom, chess etc. among others for small children/ toddlers can be included - as more amenities for Adults & literally NOTHING for children in this Hotel.2. HOPELESS SERVICE is the TRAVEL AGENCY within the Hotel - it is outsourced & the Travel Agents are literally fleecing guests at Hotel.  Particularly the 1st Travel Agent next to Coincerage is manipulative too.  We ordered car for sightseeing for 2 guests (me/my wife) @ 10.30 AM - car was provided @ 12.30 PM - we were forced to have it for 8 hours (not 4 hours as requested) & charged Nepal rupees 5,500 - IN FACT, having a car from private operators is good i.e. it is about Nepal 400 rupees per hour - everywhere it is hourly; ONLY IN THE HOTEL IT IS 4 HOURS OR 8 HOURS @ DOUBLE MARKET PRICES.  This Travel Agent charges in CASH & DOES NOT ISSUE RECEIPTS - I went on Company provided trip; hence I missed out on tax bills for 8,000+ rupees!  For Paragliding, this Agent charges 7,500 per person + his charges too!  TOO MUCH CHEATING BY OUTSOURCED TRAVEL AGENT WHO IS GIVEN SPACE WITHIN THE HOTEL & MANY GUESTS ARE TAKEN FOR ROYAL RIDE - I SUGGESTED TO GM OF THIS HOTEL THAT AS BEFITTING THE 5-STAR TAG OF THIS HOTEL, THEY MUST DISPENSE WITH OUTSOURCING THE TRAVEL AGENT & HAVE IN-HOUSE TRAVEL DESK THAT HELPS GUESTS; ELSE MANY VISITORS TO THIS HOTEL FEEL CHEATED.OVERALL EXPERIENCE; but for aforesaid 2 things i.e. bad service by Travel Agent in Hotel & lack of outdoor / sporting facilities for children/ adults, I would still RATE THIS HOTEL & THE SERVICE BY THE STAFF @ HOTEL AT 9 OUT OF 10!  I WOULD MAKE A POINT TO RE-VISIT THIS HOTEL ONCE AGAIN; AS IT WAS LUXURY RE-DEFINED AT THIS HOTEL IN LITERAL TERMS.  I STRONGLY RECOMMEND THIS HOTEL AS PROBABLY THE BEST HOTEL IN KATHMANDU - WITH MORE GUEST VISITING AND PROVIDING SUGGESTIONS TO COVER DARK SPOTS, I HAVE NO DOUBT THAT THIS HOTEL COULD SOON BECOME ONE OF TOP 20 HOTELS ATLEAST IN ASIA; IF NOT WORLD!I profusely thank Ms. Ramila and all staff of the Hotel; including GM Mr. Majumdar for making out stay very comfortable in the Hotel.  As one of my business is a Travel Agency in Bangalore-India, I would recommend this Hotel for group travels conducted frequently.PLEASE BOOK THIS HOTEL (Soaltee Crowne Plaza; an IHG Group Hotel) WITH NO 2ND THOUGHT IS MY FINAL MESSAGE FOR FUTURE TRAVELLERS TO KATHMANDU, NEPAL.Kind Regards,K.S. MadhusudanGuest from Bangalore-India (for 3 nights @ this wonderful Hotel)

Very beautiful hotel in the middle of the city... My first time to Nepal, but amazing place. Very courteous staff and great food...Good place for a conference, which we had hosted for Indian guests, and will definitely come back for more!

Check-in was swiftAdditional bed was quickly providedThe clear and transparent corner window between the bathroom and bedroom albeit loosely covered with wooden blinds was immediately made opaque by hammering a towel over at our request by the housekeeping staff whose name I did not take at the timeBreakfast had a good variety of food and we never suffered any ailmentsCustomer service was particularly impressive with all staff going the extra mile at breakfast time however special mention to Ms. Sudana (apologies if incorrect) who catered for all our needs during check out and between check out and when we actually left the hotel several hours laterCheck-out was swiftOnly down side was I felt the NPR3300 cost for one way hotel to airport drop off for 5PAX in a Renault Duster was excessive particularly when airport to hotel in a spacious Suzuki cost NPR900.

Don't expect this hotel to be fancy crown plaza in the US standard. It more like regular hotel for US standard.Service is great, stuff are nice and friendly.Breakfast is great.Dinner at Chinese restaurant was good too.

Enter the main gate & you are inside the road that leads to Kathmandu Soaltee. This Hotel is a large property with Garden in the front & 24 Hrs Casino.All the staff are extremely courteous, well trained in Guest Relations, genuinely warm & friendly. The service is very good & the restaurant will know you by name, if you are loyalty program member. Offers wide range of F&B, if you need anything the Staff / Chef will be happy to serve you.Front office paper work is fast & accurate despite the rush hour sometimes. Leading airline crew stay at the Crown Plaza Soaltee. Good for Business, Tourist, Large International Groups, Conference.This Hotel has recently been renovated. The New Rooms are good post renovation.

I frequent visit the property and it's always a good stay. They always greet in ' Namaste ' from the pickup driver to the bell boys and housekeeper on the way to your room. My last visit was in Christmas night,when i checked in my room I found a Christmas souvenir which was delicious! The linen are clean and well stretched. Food in the hotel is good. They have proper bathroom amenities provided as well. Always a pleasant stay,thank you

A usual VIP destination to stay, and a nice comfortable hotel.Plus:- Proximity to city is easy- Large space to accommodate large parties and business functions- Nice lovely staffMinus- Rooms needs repair badly- If VIP movement, the hotel management becomes helpless and your plans get a hit.Overall nice and comfortable stay.

I have stayed at this hotel on a number of occasions over the past 6 years. All staff on every level are polite, friendly and professional. They put the guest first in everything. We stayed this time as family and staff know you by name and always asking what they can do for you. One on my daughters has a nut and gluten allergy. They knew this from previous stays and everyone who serve ensures that she was only served food without nut or gluten. Even special made bread and pancakes made from millet were provided by the chef. One extra plus this time is that the new gym and sauna suite is open. The gym equipment is of the highest quality along with the trainer who is there to guide and help. All included in the price for guests. All staff want to know immediately if there is anything wrong and if there is, it is resolved immediately. A must choice if visiting Kathmandu

The hotel eased my first visit to the city.  For example, after the airline had lost my bag, they managed to turn around Express Laundry in 80 minutes, well within the 3 hour commitment.  Car services were modestly priced. And ultimately, Sharmilla (Front Desk) managed to retrieve my bag in the face of silence from the airline's official channels.  The hotel itself is relaxing, with dark wood furnishings and deep maroon colours.  F&B was excellent.

Our room was 341, overlooking a Beautiful Yard with yellow flowers, and a very nice pool with an aesthetic fountain. The best was the staff, and oh food. I think it is a 4 or 5 star, but we had never experienced such a marvelous treat from the all staff. Will recommend it highly.

Kathmandu is a fascinating but difficult city. Soaltee hotel is the best spot after an exhausting day.Luxurious,clean and spacy rooms.Extremely polite personnel and very good restaurant although European style food is in small variety.Great gardens and quite in a very noisy city.A casino is also included in his neighbor building. I certainly recommend it for a high grade accomodation standards.

This hotel is lovely. The location is excellent, the hotel is pleasing to the eye, the restaurant is good and the staff is wonderful. Highly recommend! We were presented with Ilam tea when we checked  out and, since it is delicious, that was a lovely perk. The hotel gives you a nice Nepalese feeling. In other words, it is not generic.

The reception and the Hospitality stood out, special mention for Ms. Sampada who humbly took care of the services throughout. Different food options available, the cafeteria, Happy Singh Da dhaba was the tempory attraction, but Kakori was best amongst all.Keep up the good work.

Standard hotel with very good breakfast.Buffet dinner with few protein options without spices. Sometimes empty trays remained without renewal.Very friendly staff (I emphasize the maitre Binod and the receptionist of the dining room: Monika)Internet: We had difficulties connecting with some equipment.Positive: You have a rope in the bathroom to hang freshly washed clothes.

I visited the soaltee hotel Kathmandu. I was tgere fir 5 days. The staff was very hospitable. The room was comfortable. The restaurant had a daily different and a wide variety. The restaurant staff was very helpful and was very quick in service. Special thanks to Ms Sampada Singh of the front office who was constantly inquireing about my stay and ,Ms Monica and Ms Shova Rai in the restaurant for the excellent service.
