I spend 5 nights in total at this hotel, a combination of business and pleasure and was looked after in the most amazing style. The hotel has the a nice gym, pool, spa, good selection of restaurants and a lovely grounds to walk around. But what really made the stay special with the staff they were extremely professional, attentive, helpful with advice and friendly.

Hotel in ottima posizione a Katmandu Curato minimi particolari Bellissime le stanzeNotevole la cucina ed il servizio Il personale è attentissimo a soddisfare Tutte le esigenze degli ospiti Da ritornare

i expected an easy experience with getting a room and checkin in......check in took a long while.....i had lunch first - mind you...no shower for many days in clohtes that smelled....-1st room allocated. faced tghe sun - it was hot and stuffy - the bathroom drawersone was broken and the ohter would not stay shut and the door hinge was broken afer 10 min i tld them i wanted to leavethe last time theyhad given me a better deal and this time round htey werent being acoomodatingi asked for check out and was going to find anohter hotelthe floor manager stepped in ( i had been dealing with the duty manager ) and she got me the SAME ROOM class as i wanted in hte beginning anf all okaythe staff at the Coffe shop and chinese restaruant remembered me and gave me very warm welcome - breakfast was like a reunion of old friends and ehy went out of their way to accomdate my vegan needs.......they are the best diamond of hte hotel....the stafff

the property is very good but the best part of this property is its staff. They are one of the best I have ever seen. They are always smiling and eager to help for everything. The food was awesome. Overall a very very nice experience and Crowne PLaza. Strongly recommended !!

They had a very helpful restaurant manager who had previously worked in London who spoke very good English and was able to aid us with our dietary requirements which was useful. That said the food was pretty bland and basic. In my personal opinion you can't be an upmarket hotel with a buffet, especially one that tries to combine both Nepalese (although in a much blander format) and western food to cater for everyone. Buffets just means trying lots of things, not really having a strong preference for anything and generally mean you end up wasting along of food. A reduced choice preferably a set menu with a couple of options for each course is much nicer, more sophisticated and reduces so much food waste and stops you over eating (which is never a bad thing)The rooms were okay, pretty outdated and basic, and wifi was poor. Facilities were okay but swimming pool is currently placed in a strange location for use. It has an ATM which is helpfully when arriving in a country and getting out cash there probably gives you a better exchange rate than the guy at the counter in the hotel who takes commission. Not really much to see or do if you venture outside the hotel for a walk and some of the nearby roads are quite busy so quite difficult to cross. I was also very disappointed as we stayed there on the first night of our holiday and returned at the end before flying home that I had found some souvenirs in one of the little gift shops downstairs that I really wanted to buy and the guy who opened the shop said no problem have a think and get them on your way back so your don't have to carry them for the rest of your trip, however when we returned the shop was closed and the hotel staff at the front desk had no idea where he was or when it would be open so I never got the souvenirs I wanted Overall very average, lots to be improved to reach 5 star territory

From the airport pick up to drop off The Soaltee did everything in their power to ensure my trip was amazing.The hotel is on an estate away from the chaos of the Katmandu traffic and offers a pleasant place to unwind. Shopping tips, tourist advice and recommendations on new foods were all helpfully made.It’s clean, there’s a vast range of food on offer but most of all the staff are friendly and genuinely helpful. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend  and hope one day to return.

I stayed here for 3 nights solo and returned a week later with my husband. Both experiences were excellent. The hotel is lovely: all aspects I rate excellent but the staff are amazing. They pay great attention to details and remember personal likes.....for instance I like a cushion for the dining chairs. Every morning and evening without any reminder my cushion appeared. The  staff are outstanding. They are very helpful and friendly whilst being extremely polite and respectful. I felt very comfortable as a solo traveller. I felt very much a valued guest. I look forward to returning. My thanks especially to Sampada and Anil. Hilary Garrard

I couldn’t believe the buffet breakfast. It was by far the most elaborate one we had on our entire trip. Plus the service was phenomenal. Nothing was too much trouble, and someone was always ready and willing to bring you anything you wanted.The hotel itself was nice, and the rooms adequate. The beds were not real comfortable and the pillows were way too big for my taste. I tried all of them to find a flatter one, but they were all really large/thick. WiFi worked well, and the room was quiet. The grounds around the hotel were very nice to walk around in. Staff throughout the hotel were the best.All in all, a nice stay and would return.

Very enjoyable stay - staff were friendly and very professional, efficient  and helpful. Any issues were dealt with immediately and it all made for an extremely enjoyable stay. Room was spacious and had lovely views of the immaculate hotel gardens and swimming pool. Vast choice of food for breakfast which was delicious, and a good choice for a la carte or buffet in the evening. Wi-fi was very good, and staff are all well trained and very courteous.

It was a great stay, European level of hospitality. The room given was very clean and comfortable (one of the upgraded rooms of the hotel). Good breakfast with mix of European/Asian cuisine. In general, stuff was very helpful, especially Sampada driving guest relationships. No issues during the stay. I can recommend the hotel for everyone staying in Kathmandu.

Bathroom was very bad, it is not star stander bathroom! They don’t have bathtub, whenever shower all water flow in to the bathroom toilet pen, some crocoge were there. Overall good, customer service is good.

Hotel located around 30 min drive from airport.Staff is nice and friendly and always ready to help.Wi-fi for as was complimentary and works very well.Rooms are quite good but needs to be refurnished - looks used.But in general not bad hotel.

Me and my family went to the chinese restaurant of this hotel couple of days ago.We were very happy with the staff, service and food quantity. Was overwhelmed by this particular girl Anisha who helped us with the menu and the food she recommended was highly pleasant to the taste. Also her service was admirable. I wish to stay in this hotel on our next visit.

Excelente hotel em Katmandu Nepal, apartamento excelente, limpeza, café da manhã, restaurantes do hotel, tudo bom. Gostei das lojas do hotel onde comprei varias lembranças do Nepal. E as orientações em cado de terremoto sao em preparadas.

Normally I don’t write a review on hotels where I stay for work but this hotel is worth the review. I’ve been staying in this hotel for over four years and now it became my second home. The customer service and care of each employee is outstanding it is the truly Nepalese culture. From the driver to the receptionists, the bell boy, the managers, the chef every single one embraces the values that will make you feel like home. The food is very good, the Chinese restaurant is outstanding and the Indian restaurant is incredible and I am not fan of Indian food, but here is a must. The place is always happy as it is one of the most wanted for weddings so the happiness is all around. The decorations for festivals, weddings are surprising no a single one is like the one before. My airline soon will stop the layover and I only found this way to say to everyone thanks for all the care and great service during all these years. And I highly recommend this hotel for those that are looking beyond luxury, for real customer service, then this is the best hotel. Thanks to all the wonderful  people of Crowne plaza soaltee.

My husband and I stayed at Soaltee for three days after our trek to Everest Base Camp. It is a welcoming, very comfortable hotel set in beautiful gardens. The staff could not have been more friendly and helpful. Breakfast is a feast! The on site restaurants provided us with some great meals.Thank you so much for making our stay so enjoyable.

We were warmly welcomed - beautiful setting - breakfast especially was excellent service - people went out of their way to give a perfect breakfast service - swimming pool was albeit very cold (November) perfectly maintained, we will definitely go back when going to Kathmandu.

Landed quite late in night after 12 but still got a very warm welcome from this hotel , which speaks volumes about the hospitality standards of this property. . Room was ready and dinner was organised in the room bcos their regular Resturant was closed by that time. . Breakfast experience was just fantastic with a wide variety of food options , Indian food , continental food and many health food was served in abundance. . To top it was the ever smiling and ever ready to serve , Resturant team . . You will almost feel that every one us serving just you . . Amazing training in personalised service to each and every guest . . Good quality and taste was quite fine . .We were accommodated in their old wing in executive room. Room was decent with clean bathroom. However  found it not as overwhelming as their service but not much to complain though. I was also made aware that they have just renovated a new wing of their property , which I will surely look forward to experience as soon as possible. . Overall a great stay . .

I stayed in CP ktm for 1 night. The security, concierge and front desk extended very warm and cheerful welcome to us and greetings in local culture, NAMASTE upon arrival.They  did this always when we were going out and coming in. Front desk PUJA was very helpful, professional and friendly. I was recognized as rewards club member.She upgraded my room to the heritage one. The room was clean and comfortable. The room interior was wooden made classic heritage style and the floors as well made of wood.The wooden floor keeps the room always warm especially during winter and Kathmandu is mostly cold. The telephone operator were very attentive on guest request.They made fast communication to hsk to deliver the extra water, dental kit and shower gel.The Hsk staff were very polite and professional.In the evening,  surprisingly I met my old student Rohit who was there in Patio lounge. He provided  really great and professional service to me.I was very happy to meet him as it recalled my some flashback.Rohit was very attentive to the guest request as I also noticed  when he was assisting other guest. The good thing was Patio  serves local food. PUJA helped me to extend 1more hour next day. Such a great front desk staff. Bellman Bimal was very helpful, I had lot of bags due to the shopping.They happily took care of it.They also stored my stuff in their storage. Bimal helped me to arrange hotel transportation and it was very affordable.They managed to fit all of my stuff inside that car.They have good skills of their work. In overall,the stay was very pleasant.All hotel staff came out of their way to make  my stay memorable.   I will stay here again as my fiance liked the service. Thanks to all CP ktm team.

This is probably one of the biggest 5* property in Kathmandu. Little old world charm but well maintained. Breakfast can be a little better, maybe we are vegetarian so had limited options. Kakoree their Indian restaurant is very good, service excellent. Overall can give 8.5/10Special mention to following staff front office Puja and Anjali, Sampada front office and Janak in   kakoree restaurant, all if them went out of the way to make our stay comfortable

My first choice, Yak and Yeti, was full and I came here instead. I am so glad to have found this place. The staff displayed the most outstanding hospitality. Without exception. At times, however, the attention was intense. Especially when there weren’t many other patrons around and I got everyone’s undivided attention. The grounds are beautiful, the rooms spacious and attractive, and the breakfast buffet was excellent. I also loved Kakori - their Indian restaurant.

Set in the middle of the hussle and bussle of Kathmandu this hotel property offered a calm and relaxing atmosphere. The rooms are very clean and the professional and polite. Very satisfied with my stay.

I am Qatar Airways pilot staying more than 6 years in Soaltee Crown Kathmandu. I have to tell that I consider the staff like a family. They are much more than professional, kind, nice.. my friend DHARMENDRA is a bar Supervisor always giving me a warm welcome, and He speak spanish!!! Same apreciation for  rest of staff working there, restaurant, reception, duty manager...The hotel is clean, renovated and very well connected by taxi to the downtown. People in Kathmandu are really nice and humble. They apreciate tourism and never try to chit you. Downtown is funny, with a lot local shops and restaurants. I encourage to visit many life music, like Reggae Cafe, where you can enjoy nice local people, music and beer. Leaving now Qatar Airways back to my country, I will really miss my Soaltee Family. All the best my friends!! All the best dear Dharmendra!! Captain Alfredo Aragon.

Stayed in Hotel on 20 Oct2018. Excellent property. Front safe was very helpful. Had Excellent food in Kakori restaurant. Amazing food , highly recommended. Room was well appointed and nice. Breakfast was very nice with good variety. The staff is very helpful, soft spoken and cheerful to serve you. Highly recommended to stay here.

Beautiful property is an oasis in otherwise teeming Kathmandu. Large, green area to stroll or just relax. Safe with tons of military and police support. Absolutely perfect staff--polite and friendly. Rooms large and well furnished. Quiet. Good shopping for souvenirs in gift shop and basement. Three very nice restaurants. Great pool area (sit and read now, or swim when it's warmer). I would gladly stay there again.

We, NRNA had a conference from 12 - 14 October 2018. We across the globe 350 Pasa were participating. I stay there for 3 nights which is amazing. Service was excellent but time to upgrade the facilities. Anyway it’s wonderful stay with conference.

Albergo molto bello e lussuoso, con un curatissimo giardino ed una splendida piscina esterna.La camera, appena rinnovata, ha uno splendido stile nepalese, con set di cortesia, acqua in bottiglia té e caffè. Bellissimo e pulito il bagno, molto moderno e funzionale. Nessuna vista degna di nota dalla camera. La spa è estremamente antiquata, interamente da ristrutturare. Accettabile la palestra. Ottimo il ristorante buffet per la colazione e la cena. Personale gentilissimo, siamo stati trattati con ogni cortesia e riguardo, tanto che non c’è stata richiesta che non sia stata soddisfatta (dalla frutta allo yogurt, persino i melograni venivano serviti e puliti davanti a noi). Buona la pasta fatta sul momento, e da provare i piatti tipici nepalesi. Sicuramente ci tornerei. Unica attenzione ai rumori della ristrutturazione che vanno avanti giorno e notte. È bastata però una telefonata alla reception che immediatamente ogni rumore nella vicinanza della mia camera è stato fatto cessare. Ottimo Wi-Fi gratuito.

El hotel es excelente, muy bien decorado con estilo del lugar, desayuno excelente. Los empleados son muy amables y el sector de pileta es Dovino!! Muy recomendable ya que es un hotel 5 estrellas para disfrutar Katmandú como mínimo 3 noches.

Very nice place to stay. My room was located in the quiet area. Room was clean and really quiet. Everything worked out perfectly. The breakfast was delicious and there were small changes each day which was nice while I was staying over a week. The personnel is very polite, kind and helpful. I can recommend this hotel.

I stayed in September for 2 nights in this hotel. Service was very good. The Concierge and Front Desk were so courteous and helpful. The room was decent. This hotel is old but it was very well-maintained. Bed and pillow was great, hot water and water pressure was satisfying. Hotel location is near to tourist places, it is convenient to stay here I will come back to stay when I visit Kathmandu in the future.

Es un hotel 5 estrellas, con espacios acogedores, terrazas, piscina y restaurantes que te hacen sentir muy cómodo durante toda tu estadía.Estuvimos 3 noches, en una habitación muy cómodas, limpia, baño grande .El desayuno completo, variado con comidas Nepalesas, Chinas, Indias e internacional.La atención siempre muy amable de todo el personal , en paz , en armonía.La cena en el restaurante del hotel es excelente, buena carta de vinos, platos muy bien preparados.Felicitaciones y agradecimientos especiales para todo el personal del hotel.Volveríamos sin dudarlo a  este hotel en un futuro cercano

the place is perfect, Nepal's one of the best hotels. it has been serving from a long time and has been one of the best place in Kathmandu, room perfect, service awesome and food that makes your appetite more n more.

Soaltee Crowne Plaza is an older five-star hotel in Kathmandu. First up, it's not without it's cons. There are two wings to the hotel and the older wing looks a tad old. Second, the hotel is not exactly in the city center. However, the prons are aplenty and IMO, more than make up for the cons. The Soaltee has a really lovely garden and pool and looks stunning in pictures. The entire property is beautifully landscaped if you have a get a room that is on the higher floors and has a view, you will not be disappointed. The breakfast is decent - it's not as lavish as lavish can be - but it's adequate and the staff are super friendly and helpful. The fact that it is an old hotel is not exactly a con if you like the element of old-world charm Soaltee offers. Bollywood actors have been known to stay here and I attended a really nice conference by Frost & Sullivan. I rate it five stars, everything considered.

Hotel que cubre las expectativas . Habitación amplia aunque algo anticuada en cuanto a decoración. Muy buen servicio del personal. Comida buena , tanto el buffet como la carta . Zona exterior y piscina destacable.Estuvimos 3 noches camino de India .Recomendable.

I was so disappointed to stay in hotel soaltee. I visited Kathmandu after 19 years and found the hotel to be in the same shabby state as it was then. Have been visiting Soaltee since 1975, and remember it as a royal grand hotel. Hence I came again trying to revive old memories but was severely disappointed. The food was also without any authentic flavours, just too spicy n oily. Nepal hasn’t progressed one bit in the last 15 years. Hence has become holiday destination for back packers & lower middle class.

Stayed here for about 30 nights across 1 - 1.5 years for business travel.Location: Not exactly in the city center and that's the only negative of this hotel. However, allows more space for things like pool, gym etcRoom: They have two wings one of which is recently renovated (even the older wing is decent enough). Rooms are neat and clean and well maintained Food: Breakfast spread is good, love the Chinese restaurant (though one of the more expensive places in Kathmandu)Facilities: Has a nice pool, decent gym (they are coming up with a new one soon which apparently is going to be pretty good), nice garden to walk aroundService: Decent enough

Hemos estado 3 días en el hotel y el servicio es excelente. Las habitaciones muy bien. El restaurante, no podíamos imaginar que en Nepal íbamos a comer tan bien. Está en una zona vallada , con vigilancia y además de la preciosa piscina, tiene un casino y tiendas dentro del mismo recinto.

Abbastanza riparato dal caos di Kathmandu perché immerso in un area verde con bella piscina , l albergo e ' una struttura a 5 stelle che avrebbe bisogno di una bella rimodernata. Camera decisamente vecchiotte e bagno non certo alla altezza di un cinque stelle ..Inoltre il panorama dalla mia finestra era inguardabile ( allego foto di camera , bagno e panorama dalla camera ...)con il generatore Dell aria condizionata parecchio rumoroso ( dormito con i tappi ) Per il resto Buona la cucina con ottima scelta e qualità del cibo sia cena che colazione con personale decisamente gentile ( una sera ci hanno portato anche la pizza ..) ottimo il wi fi  gratis e ben funzionante Soggiornato quattro notti ..giudizio tutto sommato positivo...ma le camere sono da risistemare .

Bonito hotel, grande y espacioso, buen aire acondicionado (sin helarse), buena zona de piscina y buena atención del personal de recepción y de las habitaciones. La habitación es grande y la limpieza de la habitación y el baño es buena, la cama es cómoda. El desayuno buffet es variado y completo. Tiene tres buenos restaurantes y un bar 24 horas. Esta un poco alejado del centro pero tiene un buen servicio de taxis y precios económicos. Una muy buena opción para Katmandú.

Stayed here for 2 nights, pleasant environment. Service was good, efficient and charming.. Not sure if I'd put the rooms in the 5 star category, nothing wrong with them but relatively small and not too much in the way of mod-cons. Was staying in the main block,   lift could take quite a while.The restaurant was good, breakfast was certainly 5 star and spacious room. Outside is a pool and decent area of green to sit and stroll. There is a casino there too, bit surprised to see toddlers running around inside at 10pm.Location-wise, about 30 mins from airport, about 10mins from Thamel.

Buona soluzione per uscire dal caos di Kathmandu... una specie di oasi... propone anche diverse soluzioni interne di ristoranti anche se a mio parere troppo care.La colazione è di medio livello.Non mi hanno fatto il solito upgrade IHG ma la camera era di buon livello.La piscina molto carina ma i lavori dell’edificio accanto disturbavano la quiete

Love this hotel, a real home away from home. Got upgraded to regal suites where princess diana stayed so felt rather special. Amazing staff especially Bibek who showed me my room and Nikita in the cafe who brought me the best coffee ever! Your coffee is amazing quality and I also had Momos and aloo gobi, both fab. Love the gentleman in the basement souvenir shop, hes so kind and accepts all currencies. Hopefully Il be back in september!

My wife and I stayed here twice in March 2018, on the way to our EBC trek and on the way out when heading to Dubai.I was able to book 2 free nights with IHG Reward points here, which was the reason why we chose this hotel.  Having never been to Nepal, we had no idea what to expect but we’re happy we stayed here because it reminded us a little more of home.  This place is very secure, it has a guard shack and a TSA-style baggage X-ray unit you have to pass through before you enter the building.  The hotel itself is very nice, beautifully decorated and the rooms are nicely appointed.  The staff were extremely friendly and wanted to talk about our experience on our trek and share stories of their past treks to the Everest region.  This trip was technically our honeymoon so they included a small cake in our room as well, which was a very nice touch.  The only drawback to its location is that it’s farther away from Thamel and the airport than I would have liked...  Cab trips to Thamel we’re about 600 rupees each way and the airport was about 800 rupees each way.  But we stayed for free so I’m not complaining.  If we were to visit Kathmandu again we would definitely stay here again.

The ambience, service, food n hotel rooms are the best in Katmandu. Banquet halls are good enough for large gatherings. Don't miss the leather chairs at hotel lobby.... Unique n comfortable ones. Lifts can be changed as they are older ones.

Everyone knows that most of the five star hotels in Kathmandu are run down old ones, whereas this hotel is under renovation and comparable to any new luxury hotel. I would rate this as the best luxury hotel in Kathmandu today. despite small inconveniences due to renovation, it offers very well appointed rooms and high quality restaurants. Food is great and service is with a smile always.

I am posting this review sitting in the lobby, still awaiting a room allotment after 45 mins of checking in. The original room (323) given to us had drilling and hammering going on continuously. And the receptionist has the hall to tell me that this is slack season so renovation is going on. I have a video and have requested tripadvisor to post it. Travellers and people looking for even a sliver of calm should steer clear of this mismanaged and socially irresponsible Hotel. Travelers Beware! Do not spend ur hard-earned money on trash like this. N.B. I wish there was a zero rating.

The hotel is one of the best in Kathmandu.Rooms are quiet airy and the beds provide a great sleep.The restaurants are very good esp the Kakori which is only open for Dinner.The Chinese restaurant is worth a try.There is no 24 hour coffee shop but there is 24 hours room service.Casino Mahjong is in the property and require a visit.

It was so sad that this hotel of such a history and repute could be so irresponsible towards its neighbourhood and society. Yesterday evening July 10, 2018 the hotel played total disregard to the general conscience and social responsibility by hosting a party that it could never handle nor had the capacity to do so. The results was thousands of vehicles and possibly many more thousands of general public were held sort of 'hostage' for hours due to the jam created by so called 'dignitaries' coming to the wedding party. If this is what crowne plaza stands for then all your claims are all fake.

On arrival we were greeted. However once we were given the keys we were not shown where to go and from this started a dismal stay. Once we entered the room we were thrown off by a terrible smell and noticed the smoke alarm had been covered. Upon finding this we went down to resolve this issue. But after returning from dinner had found nothing had been done, except them closing the curtains. Went to use a bottle of complimentary water for brushing our teeth to find the bottle not sealed and the glass beside it filthy. If I could get negative stars I would.

Very nice rooms. Service and food is fabulous. Rooms are medium sized but luxurious like normal five stars. However, outside view from our room in Himalayan wing that  of  a congested road and not so appealing. Beware of some renovation work going on in Himalayan wing which can disturb by noise. Service is the best part where every body is helpful. Food quality and variety, particularly indian Food, was excellent and rarely seen outside india. Breakfast Buffet is huge and tasty. Overall, worth the money as a luxury hotel. Surprisingly, they dont take Diners card although IHG website lists Diners card as being acceptable.

Been to this hotel  & Stayed for 2 nights. Been here around 25 years back , when this property was part of Oberoi group. Overall food n service is good. Rooms worn out .Needs immediate renovation. Overall  very helpful n cooperative. Always smiling.

I have been to Crowne Plaza for multiple business meetings, the ambiance here is simply wonderful, the entire facility is extremely spacious and the meeting hall is just perfect. ConsThe only problem I faced was the distance from Airport.ProsThe Staff is really professional and the food is also really good.

The Crowne Plaza was my home for three weeks. The two things that stood out the most were the hospitality of the staff and the cleanliness of the hotel. From the outset, Rojina and Deepak, made me feel like a very welcomed guest. I don't know if it was because I'm a platinum member, I was staying three weeks, or they greet every guest that way. I do know that it felt good. Every morning I had breakfast at the Garden Terrace and was warmly greeted with "Good morning, Ms. Hartley" or "Welcome back, Ms. Hartley". I stayed in one of the Heritage Rooms on the Club Floor. It was perfect. The shower was spacious and the water pressure was perfect. There was a wonderful array of snacks waiting for me upon my arrival. It had a nice view of the main entrance. One downside was that the sound from the patio cafe travels and I could hear the staff cleaning up at the end of the night. However, that was a minor detail.The hotel has a lot of staff, many are interns "trainees" from a hospitality school. The interns rotate through various positions in the hotel to get a well rounded experience. The permanent staff were always busy. Every day I saw the lawn care staff clearing the leaves that have fallen after the night's rain. One morning I saw staff cleaning the windows across from the Chinese restaurant. When I returned to the hotel later in the day, a staff member was once again cleaning the windows. The hotel is spotless.The Chinese restaurant has pretty good food, as does the Garden Terrace. Everything at the restaurant was very tasty except for the duck. I love duck, and order it whenever I get a chance. However, I was so disappointed. It is the only duck item on the menu. They should just remove it from the menu altogether. The hotel is constructing a new fitness center. It wasn't ready during my stay, but I'm sure it will be ready for my next stay.One bit of advice for travelers is to regarding transportation. The hotel charges 2500 NRP plus 10% service charge plus 13% tax. This is excessive. I have paid as little as 1000 NRP to go the hotel from the airport. Getting a taxi from the airport, frankly from anywhere, will require negotiating on your part, but even if you pay 1500 NRP, you are still better off than using the hotel car service. The hotel has a set price list to go to various destinations from the hotel. I almost always just walked to the main road to hail a taxi and negotiate a price to my destination. After a few days of taking taxis, it was easy for me to determine how much a fare should be. Another thing to note with the hotel car service is that the drivers want to charge for air conditioning. On the rare occasion when I had to use the car service, they wanted to charge anywhere from 300 to 1000 NRP more for A/C! This is absurd. On my next trip to Kathmandu, I will certainly stay at the Soaltee again. The staff and service are fantastic.

my trip was a conference trip here. its located a little far from the airport , but thats fiine because its so tranquil where it is.Its a huge property, nd there is so much to do. there is a casino in the premises too. there is a beautiful outdoor pool and the temperature is just perfect, the bathrooms there were also good.the breakfast served was so good the items on the buffet were just amazing .i loved the room with everything in it, well kept and comfortable. i did not have a good view but!the service and hospitality was excellent.

As IHG Ambassadors we have stayed in many hotels & it is very disappointing when expected benefits from the scheme are removed. Fortunately, Sampada the Duty Manager upon our arrival was incredibly helpful & really looked after us. The hotel is being refurbished so there is construction noise in the day & we also found other guests very noisy into the night. The pool area is very nice. Gym disappointing & needs new equipment. We had massages & again this was very old fashioned & needs an update. Bedrooms are OK but showers are great. Breakfast was very good & the staff generally were very helpful & friendly. The 3 for 2 promotion on beer was also very welcome. The hotel is expensive for Kathmandu but not bad by international standards

A great place to stay with family. Great food.. great taste. Enjoyed the complete facilities they provided. Very courteous people and their attitude towards their customers are so nice and its a wonderful experience we had during our trip. Beautiful property too ..

I always stay here when I’m here in Kathmandu, this is maybe my 6th stay in this hotel . They were always anticipating my needs before I even ask . During all my stays , I noticed that people here are always smiley , genuinely kind and ready to assist the moment you show up  .Never had an issue with anything at all .Food is always delicious , either you eat in the restaurant or room service .Today, I just arrived to this hotel again, Check In was smooth and super fast.Few minutes after I reached my room, they called to check on me if all good and if I need anything else before I go for rest . Unfortunately, for the first time ever, I saw some hair on the bed sheet and the pillow covers ... i called them immediately , they offered me a room on the spot and in no time, the duty manager Abd cleaning supervisor showed up in my room and sincerely apologized, I asked them to just change the covers for me , because I understand that things happen sometimes , because honestly the sheets looked like they are still new and fresh and they were folded before they were used on my bed and it doesn’t look like someone was sleeping on them or used at all , it was maybe the cleaner hair (who changed the bed sheets) so I understand that it was a genuine mistake and I was amazed with the way they reacted and how fast they did that and that they were so ready to do anything possible for this mistake . I really trust them and believe them . I hope that they will pay more attention on these details in the future ... other than that, I’m so happy with this hotel and I don’t think that I will ever change it in my future visits . Ps: I’m writing this review straight after all the employees who came to my room for the service recovery left the room and made sure that I’m ok and happy again , which I appreciate .

The hotel was very good , the Hotel s staff were amazing and very attentive , welcoming and caring. The travel agency within the Hotel ( Suman ) was really good . 2 little remarks :The Indian restaurant service was very slow . We were not hungry anymore with ager especially that some people arrived later and were served first bcz a lady was working for the hotel and has a invited a couple. The whole staff were trying to satisfy her . That is very bad for the hotel reputation . Also the breakfast at the hotel should be more attractive . It s very basic . It s not fair for the Staff who are really good and professional

Very well managed hotel. Extreemly comfortable in all aspects. Rooms, restaurant, facilities all up to standard. Hospitality by all level of staff superb.The hotel is well maintained and clean. Room rates are decent.

Room was good. But food was perhetic, aircondetioning  was good. But food was perhetic, checking was smooth But food was perhetic, checkout was smooth But food was perhetic, service was slow But food was perhetic, pool was good But food was perhetic.

Big grounds, a but outdated rooms, huge breakfast spread. We enjoyed the pool after busy and hot kathmandu sights. It is a bit out of the way of most sites and pretty much self contained. Nothing to see or do around the hotel

This is a fairly large & well appointed hotel on the outskirts of Kathmandu. Rooms are large and well furnished and the place has good restaurant options. The staff is quite courteous and friendly. Only complaint is that there was renovation going on during our stay and the work started early morning, which was very inconvenient. Other than that a good place to stay and relax.

Spent three nights at the Soaltee Crown Plaza. Starting the mornings with a great breakfast. Plenty of choice, fresh fruits n juices, live counter for eggs, pancakes, waffles, dosa. Option to sit in the open air was fantastic. The swimming pool was great.

The rooms are a bit outdated. The resort is being renovated. Too much noise from renovation during the day in the room.Visited the hotel after 20 years. Before it was run by Oberoi and was one of the best hotels in Kathmandu. Very disappointed with the casino.Breakfast was good and staff is attentive.Overall the staff is good.The travel desk sucks.I feel the rooms are a bit overpriced.The facilities on the club floor are decent. The lounge on the club floor is open for only 2 hours daily in the evening which is weird. Other hotel the club lounge is accessible from breakfast and normally meetings can be held at the club lounge.

Spent an unforgettable 4 days in Kathmandu soaking up the unique local culture and cuisine. Hotel facilities and restaurants are excellent and staff were immensely attentive and helpful at all times. The ancient local buildings in the local shopping districts were breathtaking as is the scenery and temples.

We were on an Insight Gold Luxury Tour of India & Kathmandu & this hotel certainly fitted that class.Set in expansive gardens with a swimming pool that after a day tour in the heat was most enjoyable.Bagmati River in this city turned out to be one of the highlights of the holiday as well as this nice hotel.The buffet breakfasts & evening buffets were great.

it was a toss up between this hotel and another 5 star i had stayed in beforei went with the Crownei was a bit nervous coming in cold- no reservationa and not sure if i would get a roomwhen i got into the lobby it was busy with lots of peoplei was messy and untidy and i held my passport in my hand hoping for attention and someone came up to me one of hte juniour Managers and he assited mei explained i had just finished a trek and had been in the car for more than 8 hourshe seated me in the coffee shop and offered me some thing to drink and proceeded to get my deatail to check in....it was such a reliefthe duty Manager Ms Singh was there as well and her name had been mentioned in several reviews and i told her as much and she gave me a big smilei knew i was in good handsthey gave me an upgrade .....sorted me out     sent me up for a shower and made reservations for dinner at the chinese restauranti left like i was at home with not a care in the worldfood was goodmy room had wamrth and it was very comfortablebreakfast the next day- all were very very attentive and looked after me very wellhome away from homelots of cable tv to watchfood delicousstaff all mostly very friendly with smiles all aroundthe checkout could do with some workslow with lots of back chatter......took quite a while to get me all sorted adn on my way to the airport !will stay there again for surethe coffee shop manager looked after and even got be a special mealthe FB manager sat with me and we chatted like old friends

This is a hotel, which will feel u, that u r in a palace, i stayed here twice for a corporate event, they have excellent facility, and  awesome food of all quality. Good hospitality, and overall a Grand hotel

I’ve been twice this month. Much better comparing to other hotels in Kathmandu. Great food selection especially the Indian restaurant... it was delicious. Great service and smiley faces all around the place. Has nice pool and surroundings so you can get some peaceful moments after coming from busy Thamel area, which not very far from hotel. Special thank you to the Lobby Lady (sorry forgot her name) and the team at the entrance’s new terrace outlet. They all did great job. Cheers,

I stayed in this hotel a number of times, the rooms I have stayed into the right of the check-in desk are fantastic. The rooms and hotel itself is a little aged, this isn't a problem at all. Hotel staff are extremely friendly and food options are brilliant. This is a great option for those visiting Katmandu.

We stayed at the hotel for 3 nights and it was a fantastic experience. The food was great and it has some hidden gems like the chef for Italian cuisine is great. Breakfast was a big spread. The staff always eager to help with a smile. The three days were really less and will surely come back again. Kathmandu is a great destination with perfect weather and good list of things to do.

Had a comfortable stay at Crowne Plaza ! every thing was so perfect from check in to check out. Rooms was spacious and restaurant food & Service staff was very good. I would like to thanks Sharmila room service for fulfilling my requirement quickly. The best thing about hotel is smile on every one face. All the best !

カトマンズ「ソルティ―クラウンプラザ」ホテルは中心部から東へ3キロほど離れた敷地の広い立派な建物で入り口には警備員が配置され荷物検査をするなどセキュリティーもしっかりしているようでした。客室は広く清潔感があり、スリッパ、電気ポット、ボトルウォーターの用意があり、WIFI無料でした。朝食会場は広くて食材の種類も豊富でエッグステーションと店員の応対も親切丁寧で気分よく食事ができました。敷地内にはカジノもありますので時間を持て余す人には喜ばれますね。

We stayed at Soaltee for three nights.  The first two nights were before our trip to Chitwan, and we stayed in one of the newly renovated rooms, with fantastic views over the garden and pool area.  Our room was huge, and beautifully decorated.  Our third night was in a different area, with a view over a construction site, but the room was still very comfortable and well set out.The staff are super friendly.  Because we did a joy flight over the Himalayas, flew to Chitwan and back, etc., we passed through the Kathmandu airport several times, and each time we had our lighters confiscated (I know, we are disgusting smokers!!) - but the staff at the hotel were more than happy to provide new boxes of matches whenever we returned, which was much appreciated.The food was lovely.  We can definitely recommend the cakes at The Garden Terrace!!  Room service was efficient, and the food was excellent.  Plenty of selection for breakfast too.It is worth a walk down the very long driveway to see the selection of shops close by.  We got some lovely souvenirs of Nepal there, and spoke with some nice locals.All in all, a great stay in Kathmandu.  A beautiful city, still rebuilding after the devastation of the earthquake of 2015.  Gentle, lovely people and an impressive place to visit.

Stayed in this hotel for 2 nights and had a very good experience. It was formally Soaltee Oberoi and considered the best. Even today although the building is old but very well maintained. The open area in the heart of city is a bonus for residents as ne could go for long walks inside the premises. Food in their coffee shop was awesome and we had all our meals there only during the entire stay. We were well looked after Mr  Binod Taladhar who is there Coffee Shop Manager and were provided delicious food by Mr Yubaraj who is their Executive Chef. Casino is definitely a great attraction of this property.

We stayed at this hotel for a few nights in March on our visit to Kathmandu. The standard rooms are very dated and the sinks and bathtub are not very clean( stained). However when we upgraded for 1 night to the suite , they we very clean and well appointed.Beware of the Elevators , as we had a VERY bad experience getting stuck in between floors. When we called for help they sent some of the employees to try to open the doors and have us climb out. I requested them to call emergency services but they told me they can't. We were horrified as they partially opened the doors and then shut it back and my wife is clusterfobic.Eventually they opened the doors and held it as well had to climb out. They paid for our dinner at the restaurant.I then observed to my amazement, they continued to use the elevator without any service being performed!! We were horrified after this experience!!Beware!!

The Crown Plaza has some charming qualities but is greatly in need of a complete renovation.  From the popcorn ceiling to the patched walls and broken tile floors, the upkeep is lacking.  The sauna area needs to be rebuilt and replaced.  I suspect the hotel survives and does not upgrade its facilities based on conferences.....there are many large and small conference rooms.   If staying here, demand a conference room rate, as there are many hotel in Kathmandu superior to this for $50-$70 per night.  The location is not idea as there are no restaurants within walking distance and the hotel dining prices are absurd.  On the positive side, the staff is excellent.  The hotel grounds are impressive; they do have bathrooms with bathtubs; and the place is clean.

這是家很能溝通的飯店即使是不同的文化圈有不同的服務習慣。如果有需要服務可以找坐在前台對面辦公桌穿紗麗的女士，她的職等很高，很能提供服務與接受旅客的反應。Differt culture different service style. Most of the staff are very friendly. You can reach to custermer servive lady sitting in front of front desk for your request. She is in charge of concierge services in this hotel. The garden restaurant staff are very welcom , they real care guest response and do their best. Thanks for them. Room services are very convent.Laundry servive is efficient.although there is electric power problem sometimes, the hotel fixed it in one minute. There are salon service.

Best place to be if you are planning to visit nepal for holiday price is reasonable but facilities they provide is awesome highly recommended to those who want perfect holiday in Kathmandu. The morning sun rise view from hotel is awesome . We can see great view in morning time

Μετά από το πολύωρο ταξίδι η εμφάνηση του ξενοδοχείου με αροποίη κήπους και πισίνα καθώς και τα χαμόγελα του προσωπικού μας χαροποίησαν.Το προαύλιο της υποδοχής πολύ όμορφο ο δε χώρος της υποδοχής ευχάριστος.Το προσωπικό χαμογελαστό και εξυπηρετικό ,τα δωμάτια μεγάλα και πεντακάθαρα.Το πρωινό παρα πολύ καλό και με μεγάλη ποικιλία.Το κυρίως γεύμα κυρίως "καυτερό " από λίγο όσο και πολύ.

The entry into the property is really nice - all the way to the reception! The staff is friendly and helpful. The property itself is very nicely spread out and the exterior has a very nice feel. The lift was lit up quite weak!The reception area and the room needed some upgrade. But on the whole is a very comfortable and nice set up. Took an early morning flight out and the staff arranged a quick bite with some tea/ coffee at the bar - on their own initiative. Thank you for the same!Has a casino - didn't go there but - the option is there.
部屋の鍵が開かなかったり、空調の調子が悪くフロントに電話して対応するというはずの回答なのに何もしないなど対応がずさんでクラウンプラザに相応しくなくがっかり。朝食は美味しくいただけました。

El hotel es muy grande pero muy cómodo para acceder a todos los espacios. El desayuno, almuerzo y cena son de primera calidad y el personal es mas que atento y servicial. Se esfuerzan por entender el idioma español y siempre con alegría. El paruqe y piscina están en excelentes condiciones de limpieza y cuidado. Está cercano a locales comerciales públicos y también posee negocios propios. El salón de fiestas es grandioso. Las bodas allí son fantásticas! Especialmente agradezco la atención de los empleados Dharmendra Sapkota y Shova Kumarirai

Nice room with plenty of space.  They actually had space for our four pieces of luggage that we work out of.  The only drawback was that there was only one plug in the room to recharge phone, camera, and tablet.  Fortunately we purchased and adapter that had two USB ports and a regular (US) plug in one unit.The Breakfast Buffet was one of the best we had.  Everything we had was top shelf.I would highly recommend staying here.
This was my first stay at Crowne Plaza Kathmandu.This hotel is quite nice. Rooms are good. Clean bathrooms.The Executive Lounge is rather small.After a while we got good service from the front desk.
房間乾淨舒適。 價格合理。 工作人員很好，樂於助人。 但無線網絡在房間裡不好。 在前台和接待無線上網是好的。 晚上舉行婚禮宴會的時候很吵，我睡不好。

The hotel is one of the better hotels in Kathmandu. The rooms are adequate but somewhat cramped. The staff are friendly and the loby unfortunately is overcrowded with day visitors at sunset coming for drinks. The disappointing experience was that we had arranged an early breakfast but the dining room was not open.

I spend 240 days out of my country. So i can be classified as a frequent traveller. 60% in Africs and rest Asia and transiting in Europe. Have stayed in all sort of hotels in the past 20 years but nothing beats the friendly staff at Crown Plaza in Kathmandu. Friendly staff and so helpful,clean etc.

We had a wonderful stay at the Crowne plaza Kathmandu.  The rooms were spacious and clean and very comfortable. Room service was totally up to the mark. Food at the restaurants was delicious. The Chinese restaurant was especially good. Hats off to the F&B staff. We got everything exactly how we wanted it. The front desk staff was also super efficient and helpful. They helped us tremendously with the “what to do” “where to go” as we had limited time. All in all a super stay.

I stayed for a few days at this hotel and it was a wonderful experience. The staff of very kind, the room excellent and very clean and the restaurants were very good. The chinese restaurant is excellent ! I stayed for three nights in one part of the hotel and then, after returning from Bhutan I stayed one more night and they upgraded us for a more luxury part of the hotel. Both rooms were very, very good.

This is my 4th stay at the Soaltee. The staff really go out of their way to make you feel at home. The front staff (especially Sunita Gurung) are exceptional in assisting you whilst the food & beverage team at the Garden Terrace are truly warm, welcoming & professional. If you're looking for somewhere to stay that is secure, warm & friendly. There is also a gym & swimming pool (currently being refurbished) for those who are physically inclined.

Otel maalesef eskimiş olup bir bloğunda kısmi yenileme yapılmış.Diğer blok oldukça eskimiş acilen yenilenmesi gerekiyor.Kapılar ve koridorlar çok gürültülü oluyor.Sabah Everest uçuşu var ise gitmeyenlerde uyanmak zorunda kalıyor

I stayed there for 2 days. Found people to be so friendly. Bar among all was my favourite place as i more often use to be there i made a friend named Anisha. She was so little but with so much information. I will be back to Nepal after two months and i have already decided i will be staying here again.

Very nice, modern hotel with access to nearby sites. Free WiFi is available too.  Food is plentiful and the breakfast buffet was excellent.  Staff responded quickly to all requests. We were booked in this hotel twice by Gate 1 Travel as we arrived to and from Kathmandu.  I would definitely recommend this hotel!

Having stayed in 4 hotels now in Kathmandu, crown plaza is definitely the best. However, the best Kathmandu has to offer.  I could not fault the staff, the breakfast nor the excellent Chinese and Indian restaurants. The biggest problem I have is with the rooms. They are clean and functional but all hotels in Kathmandu are very dated and it feels like no investment has taken place for decades. However, when I return to Kathmandu which I do about every 2 months, I will definitely go back and stay here. You will definitely receive a warm welcome from the second you arrive and staff are well trained to take care of guests from start to finish.

This hotel has all you need in Kathmandu. First of all friendly staff and nice rooms. It lies in a beautiful garden right outside the Tamel area. You can easily walk downtown to temple square and Tamel. I suggest you try the Indian restaurant located in the hotel garden. It has fantastic food inspired from northern India. In the basement you can either have a nice massage or a haircut. If you have surplus/used clothes you can give it to the staff at the reception and they’ll give it to people still suffering from the earthquake a few years ago.

Very luxurious and comfortable hotel.ideal to host an international conference like ARCASIA.Staff very friendly. Breakfast buffet is fabulous WiFi is very effectiveLocation is away from commercial areas this very calm place

This is an older hotel that is well run and well-maintained.  Everything in the room worked and the internet was free and had a strong signal.  The bed was comfortable.  The buffet dinner had adequate choices and good food quality.

Crowne Plaza chain of hotels is considered to be good business hotels. I was however very much dissatisfied during my stay in the hotel. The furniture in the room has been very old and table drawers are not working. It requires replacement/repairs. Very limited power sockets provided in the room for charging of electronic devices. Restaurant food is not upto the desired international standard. Insect shown to the restaurant staff in the dry fruits container during buffet breakfast. Hotel does not have any gym/health club facilities. When asked about such a facility, the hotel staff recommended that I can go to the nearby hotel and use their gym facility which is not practical.

Visited Kathmandu with family n friends for celebrating New Year & also my Wife’s birthday which falls on the 1st. We were there for 4nts.  I stayed in the Club Room, it’s spacious n good for the three of us, including my 10yr old son. The complimentary Cocktails n Snacks at the Club Lounge were good after a tiring day of sightseeing. Memorising visit to Pashupatinath Temple & The flight to Mt.Everest, it’s breathtaking. The property has a lovely lawn for the family to have some fun playing games. Buffet spread for Breakfast & Dinner was good. The Front office Desk were friendly n caring for making our stay comfortable. Thank you Ms.Pranisha (Duty.Manger) you made our stay  beautiful n enjoyable. Ms.Sunita for the hospitality & Mr Vijay - Executive Asst Manager for the lovely evening on the 1st we had celebrating my Wife’s birthday. Thank You n Keep Smiling.

It was my 2nd time in this hotel. I like to stay in this hotel with my family at new year eve , because they have really fantastic some new year programs specially for families. Normally in the new year time hotel always over book. But the stuffs are handled the situation very smartly. They are perfect and most professional to handle these type of situation. My kids are happy to spend their new year with lots of fun and enjoy the party. About the room , my opinion is they have to change some old furniture and room interior which are really needed. One another thing I like to advise them....smoking and non smoking room should in deferent floor or deferent wing.

Après les embouteillages cauchemardesques de Katmandou il est bon de se retrouver dans cet hôtel, un peu à l'écart et au fond d'une allée au calme (sauf quand il y a un mariage ). La chambre confortable, la literie aussi, salle de bain propre et bien équipée? Pour 2 nuits, tout à fait satisfaisant .Par contre la clim est soit en panne soit impossible à régler. La restauration comme partout, très épicée mais bien assortie. Petits déjeuners très complets et personnel aux petits soins

The property is located a little away from the main attractions of the city, however transport is easily available. The staff is courteous and makes you feel at home. The pool and health club facilities lack when compared to other properties. Best dining options among the star properties in Kathmandu. Highly recommended.

This huge hotel is one of the oldest in town, but I did not have close a 5 star hotel experience there. The staff are slow and not always helpful, the rooms are old and not so clean, the food is average at best. Plus, the hotel is a drive from the center and with the Kathmandu traffic, moving around can be very stressful. You can get much better quality for the same rate or lower.

Soaltee is situated on a beautiful property set back from noisy road sounds.  There are marvelous cultural pieces around the expansive lobby.  The staff is welcoming and helpful.  The rooms are clean and comfortable and the food is excellent.  We were very excited to be in this nice hotel and in Kathmandu.

Though the property is away from main city destinations, but is worth staying. The best part is their staff, making you feel like home making sure that you every need is met. I would like to especially mention Mr. Dharmindar (who took care of my breakfast every morning). Rooms are nice (a bit small as per my preference), you can hire taxi or hotel car anytime to go around the city and places. Fitness club is ok, there is a shopping arcade in the lower level (expensive as compare to shops outside). Highly recommended and perhaps the best place to stay in Kathmandu !

If you really want to pamper yourself for a night or two in Kathmandu, I highly recommend the Crowne Plaza Soaltee. Large rooms - closer to suites. Great bathrooms with plenty of hot water and A/C. Delicious food. The pampering comes at the price of budget hotels in the U.S.

Mid Dec, I stayed here with my wife for three nights. This was our first trip to Nepal. Booked a pre-paid taxi from the airport. The moment you enter the Crown Plaza campus, you see the difference- from the dusty roads to well laid out green space. My first impression was that " this should be the best place to hang out in Kathmandu". Every thing about this place is good. Ambience, grandeur, cosy rooms, break out areas and finally the HOSPITALITY. When we were walking to the reception to check in, I realized that I left my wallet in the cab that we came in (had cash, debit cards and some documents). I panicked and told this to the lady officer from the hotel who came to receive us. What happned from then onwards is pure magic. The charming lady by name Sampada, made us calm and assured that she would see what can be done. The only thing what we knew is that its a prepaid cab from airport (in Nepal, taxis do not use English numerals/alphabets for number plates). Sampada talked to Crownplaza travel coordinator at airport (Seshan; please correct the spelling if wrong) and they inturn could get details of the cab. After two hours Sampada and team could talk to the driver of the cab, confirmed that the wallet is in the back seat. To cut the long story short, by 8.00 PM I got the wallet back.  When I look back, I know the extra efforst taken by Sampada and team to help us through the tense situation. They were all very busy, but still tried hard to help one of their customers- Hats off to your commitment Sampada and Seshan If ever we travel to Kathmandu, our stay would  naturally be in Crown Plaza-Soaltee because of the great staff. You all made us feel more than at home.  THANK YOU TEAM. We would always remember you

El hotel no esta mal, aunque tiene sus pro y sus contras. De las habitaciones en las dos que ocupamos,las vistas fueron algo malas mas bien al interior, la habitacion era comoda y limpia pero con un mobiliario algo anticuado y lo peor era el aire acondicionado que no funcionaba y la habitación estaba helada lo dijimos en recepción y nos trajeron una estufa que una vez calento algo hubo que apagarla ya que iluminaba toda la estancia y no se podía dormir con ella encendida.El hotel se encuentra algo retirado de las zonas de visita turística.Lo mejor fue los desayunos y el restaurante así como la atención del personal muy correcta, servicial y amigable.

fui  com um grupo de fotógrafos conhecer a cidade. o hotel é bem bacana, tem restaurantes legais, a comida é muito boa e o atendimento é cordial. O único problema foi que nosso quarto estava com cheiro de resina.  nós pedimos para trocar e fomos prontamente atendidos

O hotel é bem estruturado, o atendimento é bom, câmbio bom de se fazer também. Os restaurantes do hotel são muito bacanas e a comida é muito boa (e apimentada, comum na região). Só pedimos para trocar de quarto porque estava com um cheiro de resina. Café da manhã muito bom e diversificado .Recomendo.

The location is 20 mins from the airport and during traffic hours it can extend to 50 mins. The property is huge and has a special charm. The staffs are very courteous and nice. Kakori restaurant is my all time favourite.
#NAME?

I have always stayed here when in Kathmandu. May be this was the 6th time. It has changed hands - from Oberoi to Crowne Plaza but the service quality remains intact. I am an Ambassador Platinum member of the Inter Continental group. So one may suspect a bias in my review.But it is not so.Having travelled world wide I think this hotel is at par with most hotels in this category. The client service management and the front office deserves special mention. But the Manager of the Chinese restaurant there takes the cake. He took special care of our dinner order. We were 7 people and all of us have the same opinion.

Una oasi tranquilla per riposare dopo una pesante giornata di visita.Camere ampie ,silenziose ,pulite.Buffet cena e colazione strepitosi.Non buona la posizione ..a piedi non vai da nessuna parte ma con qualche minuto di taxi si arriva a Durban .Ottimo il servizio cambio valuta in reception.

Food and the compound is good as it is 5 stars hotel. Elevator, rooms and amenities are as 2 stars hotel. AC is hard to control. Internet is good. Very friendly helpful staff. Not bad for business travelers.

Yes when you travel around Kathmandu the hotel looks impressive compared with the surroundings, however when the room is cooking in December and the solution by the engineer is turn off the AC and wait 30 mins you know that you are imposing first world complaints on a third world situation. Relax and sweat. Other than that. Bed is not great and I think I should have tried elsewhere.

choose a garden view at the new wing Himalaya wing, is recommendedhotel manger service excellentrestaurant service also very good,really very pleasant staybeautiful wedding next door everyday (the wedding season)but one day wedding party at the garden a bit noisy there is a Chinese restaurant,a bit expensive but still good for Nepal standard

28 kasım 1 aralık 2017 tarihleri arasında 3 gece konakladık Otel çok iyi konumu da iyi odalar çok geniş ve rahat iki adet su bırakıyorlar çay seti var temizlik güzel kahvaltı oldukça güzel bizim ağız tadımıza göre her şey var meyvası bol garsonlar güler yüzlü Ve kibar akşam yemekleri oldukça güzel yiyecek her şeyi bulabiliyorsunuz yemek konusunda hiç sıkıntı çekmedik birkaç tane küçük alışveriş dükkanı var otelin bir özelliği de düğün salonu var çok güzel Nepal düğünleri izledik otelden çok memnunuz ayrıca internet her yerden çekiyor

The hotel staff is outstanding in offering any service to improve the quality of stay at the hotel and even if going out in the city or near by areas. I found them very thoughtful and caring. In fact the duty manager PRANISHA gave me her scarf while going out on a cold day.

Despite being far from Airport it is quite close to all other nice spots to visit in Kathmandu. High quality service with staff always available to help and give advise. Tried all restaurants and was impressed with quality of food and service. Will definitely visit again.

the stay was really comfortable and rooms were nicely done. Beds were comfortable, food was really good and most important is the eagerness to serve which i found in each and every staff members. In shorts it was lovely staying at Soaltee.

Ресторан при казино mahjong.по местным меркам очень прилично.Можно выбрать блюдо со шведского стола или заказать по меню.Алкоголь тоже есть,вроде даже безопасный.Выпили джони черного и остались живы:))идет культурная программа в виде индийских танцев иэпеснопений.Официанты бегают и-все делают.По местным меркам дорого.Рядом казино.Еда местная и специыичная-все очень остро.

Very nice hotel and the Staff is very freindly and serviceable If you go to the international restaurant, they will treat you like in heaven, the best guy is Dharmendra He will take care of you during your visit at the restaurant.

This hotel is a welcome respite from the commotion of Kathmandu life.The facilities are good quality,and the staff are very friendly helpful and accommodating. The breakfast is good,and there are several good eating options within the hotel.

A beautiful property set within the city, yet seemingly untouched by the hustle and bustle of the busy and noisy streets. An old hotel that somehow manages to preserve the traditional and yet be up todate with the needs of the modern traveller. The well kept grounds and traditional pergolas and 'mandaps" add a classic touch to the scene.The staff are well mannered and courteous. The buffet spread was up to expectation with a wide selection of local, Asian and Continental offerings.Definitely worth a repeat visit.

I stayed at Soaltee Crowne Plaza during my first trip to Nepal at the end of May to attend the Himalayan Travel Mart. I was very satisfied with my stay. Courteous and competent front and in house staff, great restaurant with delicious options, fantastic buffet breakfast spread and stunning gardens all in a quiet location protected from the buzz of Kathmandu. Room was decent in size but could certainly use a refresh and renovation as it did feel a bit dated. Overall a very good experience and will continue to endorse this hotel to my clients.

The hotel staff went beyond the call of duty to Make mine and my husbands stay comfortable. The staff was friendly and always greeted with a smile and offered assistance timeously. The restaurant staff was of great help in aiding us to choose meals. They were efficient and very friendly. A big thank you goes out to everyone at the Crown Plaza. It is difficult to add all the names as every staff member had a special quality to recognize with.The hotel building is old yet well maintained and clean. Great work from the management and staff who aid in caring for the hotel.

We had a marvellous stay in Crowne Plaza , Kathmandu.Wonderful interiors, very good service and some excellent dining and very reasonably priced too. I would just like to say a huge thank you to the staff specially Anisha from the lobby bar who made our evening outstanding and did everything, plus more to ensure we were comfortable and happy.It really did exceed my expectations. Thanks again!

My husband and I traveled through India and Nepal on a Gate 1 group tour. We stayed in this lovely hotel twice during the tour. The grounds are beautifully maintained, and the rooms are very comfortable with very nice bathrooms. I requested a universal outlet plug and it was sent to our room immediately. The hotel has a very nice restaurant where we enjoyed the buffet breakfast which included many less spicy Western choices. Also, it has a Chinese restaurant on premises as well as a bar. We found the staff to be very friendly and accommodating. I highly recommend this hotel!

Great campus hotel in Nepal. Big area,cozy place,a very good family hotel that are rated 5.I stayed 3 times in this hotel. The room is as usual.Service is so so.Their breakfast is awesome...lots of items.There are 2/3 more restaurant in this hotel.Bukhara is one of the best for Indian kebab,Alfesco is best for Italian food.

Fantastic clean rooms. Staff are very polite courteous and helpful.Umesh, Asst Front Office Manager helped me in getting the room of my choice, i.e. location, bed facing west, etc. etc. Keeps meeting each and every guest in the lobby asking if all is well, if not, makes sure the client needs are met and personally accompanies the guest wherever and for whatever reason required. The food breakfast and dinner at the Garden Terrace is excellent and must not be missed for the quality and variety. It's surely value for money. All staff will pamper you so much with their service and food that you are bound to overeat. Not to worry, the idea is to have a heavy b'fast, avoid lunch and have a sumptuous dinner.The restaurant Manager Rohit is an amazing character who visits each and every guest in the restaurant to ensure that everyone is enjoying their food, to the extent that he will get the dish prepared as per your choice.

On my recent trip to Nepal I stayed at this hotel two nights in October and one night in November.  The grounds are a sanctuary from the congestion and confusion that is Kathmandu.  The staff is extremely friendly and helpful.  My bag was stored for 9 days while I was up-country and promptly brought to my room upon re-arrival in November.The breakfast buffet is excellent.  For the first two mornings, there was steak - grilled minute steak one morning and beef goulash the next morning.  On the third morning there was lamb stew. There is always made to order pancakes and waffles.  I enjoyed both the variety as well as quality of the food.  I had lunch one day in the dining room and it too was excellent - Pasta Alfredo - huge portion and very tasty.My room was clean and quite comfortable.  It was a little dated and worn but did not bother me.On a security note - luggage is screened prior to entering into the hotel.  The bottoms of vehicles are checked  prior to entering on to the property.The hotel is a very popular venue for organized events which may cause some noise and congestion but not too much disruption.

It has been four years I last stayed in this hotel when I found it quite e good property to stay in but this time it was full of frustrations that put me in high disappointments. The property apparently with its public areas seemed the same good as I saw but entering into the guest room I found it not even up to the mark of a one Star Hotel. Starting from the door locks, switches, bed, shabby blanket, pile of dusts all were of so poor quality that compelled me to think how ICG being an high end international chain offers such under quality services. During my 4 night stay the AC did not work despite bringing this to the notice to the authority. The toilet was horrible to its extent. There is no level change between the shower and the rest area causing inundation all over and the sliding toilet door made out of junk is a threat for accident. Other fixtures are torn out. The size of the lavatory is funny. There is no hair dryer. In a nut shell the toilet as a whole is a nightmare. The rooms in the old wing, those are not facing the garden, is flanked by the water treatment plant exerting a continuous water splashing sound. The view outward is awkward. The elevators are at its junk state and scary to ride in. In recent years I have never experienced such degraded rooms offered to guests who pays handsome tariffs. Travellers should look into the rooms before checking in as its public areas, landscapes are alluring and deceptive to the comfort expectations in the room itself.

This hotel need a lot of refurbishment. The old part is not ok, the club rooms are ok. I changed room after one night, needed upgrade to have it ok. The lady in reception should make it, but started with other customers. That irritates me. Garden with breakfast is good. But in total, the hotel can not defend the price they ask. The Summit was full else I prefer that.

Security excellent and very welcoming Food very good ... wide choice breakfast and dinnerStruggled to cope with DF and GF diet but overall goodInteresting shop on siteExcellent base to access Kathmandu and nearby places in the UNESCO World Heritage sites

We stayed here for 2 nights, while on a short jaunt to Nepal.  The staff was beyond expectations, they were the friendliest happiest bunch we have ever come across.  From checkup phone calls from the room service team ensuring everything was to standard, to the special in room details, including fresh cookies, down to the preference of the tea in our room, nothing more could be asked for.  We enjoyed the huge veranda out front, and spent quite a bit of time as the bar service was offered outside.  The grounds of the property are flawless, including the charming antique elevator and again the staff was phenomenal.  I have stayed at many elite north american hotels and the Soaltee has put them all to shame.  No hesitations to stay here again. Thank you Vijay and your team for making sure all the little details were as perfect as they could be!

Lovely hotel with a superb Chinese restaurant and friendly, professional staff. Central location. Good breakfast. Great pool too. We stayed in one of the regal suites which was brilliant for families (it's basically an apartment with full kitchen and washing machine). The only letdown was rude internet.

Las habitaciones del hotel son un poco antiguas; pero todo limpio impecable. Al hacer funcionar el aire acondicionado sale un olor a humedad.Tiene un buen comedor, la comida rica y con un amplio buffet, piscina amplia, con lindos jardines.Atención del personal excelente.  Si el Wiffi en reiteradas ocasiones se cayo, había que conectarse del  primer piso.

Este ha sido el peor viaje de mi vida, creo que debo comentar mi experiencia a otros viajeros sobre mi estancia en el hotel Crowne Plaza Kathmandu.Llegue el 9/8/2017 junto con 5 amigos más.Mi habitación era doble. Después de cenar subimos a la habitación pero la puerta no abría. Tres horas después la dirección del hotel no había conseguido tener los recursos necesarios para poder abrirla,teniendo que romper la cerradura. Nos cambiaron de habitación y dejamos claro que estaríamos en el hotel en total dos noches ( la del incidente de la puerta y la noche siguiente) , estamos agotadas lo que iba ser una noche tranquila se convirtió en una noche de espera de pie en un pasillo y la posterior mudanza de habitación en la madrugada.Al día siguiente nos fuimos de excursión con la esperanza de que el incidente de la puerta hubiese sido mala suerte.... pero no.... en mitad de la excursión nos llaman para preguntarnos si nos podían cambiar de habitación a lo que nos negamos pues teníamos nuestras pertenecías en la caja fuerte de la habitación , maletas y objetos personales. Nuestra intención era disfrutar de un Buen Día de excursión y al regreso del hotel poder descansar.A media tarde vuelen a llamarnos por si queremos cambiarnos a lo que volvemos a decir que no.Nuestra sorpresa fue mayúscula al llegar al hotel:Nos habían sacado de la habitación, abierto la caja fuerte y sacado nuestro dinero , joyas y objetos personales y las maletas.Al bajar a recepción nos dieron en una bolsa de basura gris nuestras cosas.Al pedir hablar con la dirección del hotel nadie salió, no nos dieron hoja de reclamación y todo esto después de llegar agotados de la excursión.Dos horas después nos metieron en una habitación inferior de la que teniamos.Ni una disculpa, ni un perdón.Las conversaciones fueron todas en inglés idioma que parecían no entender.A la mañana siguiente una Sra que dijo ser la directora ( ni se presentó) se negó a darnos la hoja de reclamación que por cuarta vez volvíamos a pedir. No pidió disculpas. Ante esto cogimos una hoja y pusimos una queja.Tengo todo documentado.Luego entendí que había pasado. Esa mañana en el hotel había una reunión del G7.Para esta cadena hotelera las personas normales no son considerados clientes pese ha pagar religiosamente nuestra estancia. Vergonzoso, nada recomendable.Mal servicio, falta de profesionalidad y respeto a los clientes.

The grounds are awesome and out of the rat race of nearby city. Rooms are comfortable and quiet and very clean. TV choices are limited but good quality. The staff makes the place a five.  Always willing to assist in any manner. I am not sure if it Nepal in general or I have just been lucky as the people are so friendly and accommodating. At the hotel I do not remember ever hearing the word no.

my big humanitarian team and I had arrived almost sunset after a week from huge earthquake of April 2015, a lot of people crowded front of reception, but Nepali real smile was attended at the faces of all of the receptionists under all pressers, i think 4 weeks of stay under a pressers can gives you a good justice estimating for all around in hotel, but i don't like to explained all ! old building, nice helpful staff, delicious food, green view (eastern one), but the lobby was far from the entrance,Despite everything, they did not give us a competitive price with we booked almost 12 rooms for a month ( the only most advantage was that it was next to the Humanitarian Operation Center of the earthquake "Nepal Red Cross")..  rooms level and hotel in general status comparing with the price and other 5 stars hotels was over for an old hotel inside of an old public area !..

El hotel esta bastante bien, amplio con varios restaurantes una piscina buena y en general con todo tipo de servicios, Sin duda las habitaciones y algunos servicios precisas de una modernización urgente.Lo mejor es el personal muy amable, la comida es variada y de calidad y el servicio del restaurante bufe es particularmente amable y servicial,

Nepal'e bir tur programıyla gittik. Otelimiz onların seçimiydi. Odaların büyüklüğü yeterliydi. Banyo yenilenmiş konforluydu. Yatak rahat çarşaflar temizdi. Personel çok güleryüzlüydü. En iyisi de mutfak harikaydı. Yemekler için çok seçenek vardı. Hem Nepal hem de Avrupa mutfağını aynı anda sunuyorlardı. Nepal' de olduğumuz sürece en iyi Masala çayını orda içtik. Kesinlikle tavsiye ederim.

Burası Katmandu nun ilk beş yıldızlı hoteliymiş. Ancak biraz eskimiş gene de mutlu olduk.Alternatif otel pek yoktu.otelin bahçesi çok güzeldi. Odalar ve yemek bizi pek memnun etmese de sıkıntı yaşamadık.Fiyat ve performansı iyiydi.

Hotel lujo muy aceptable. Uno de los mejores de Kathmandu. El personal muy atento , especialmente de habitaciones, de entrada y de seguridad.El hotel ocupa un amplia área , con mucha seguridad y pendientes del viajero. Muy tranquilo , la zona es limpia , sin contaminación, y buena para descansar.Hay tiendas y un casino de juego.Se organizan reuniones y congresos . Las habitaciones son amplias y bonitas, aunque parte del hotel está en renovación. El restaurante , la mayoría de su personal son muy atentos , debe mejorar su calidad. De cuatro noches , para cenar , solo un día fue self-service. El resto era un menú con pocas opciones.Recomendable, volveríamos a repetir la estancia.

We went for a family trip to nepal in June 2017. This hotel was the last part of our trip. The hotel is very good. Everything went smoothly till the day of our Checkout, when we checked out at morning 6 am since due to the incompetency of the Nepal Airlines we were informed at the last minute that our Flight due in the Evening was preponed to the Morning Flight.  However when we reached the airport, we found that our flight will be delayed by 5 hours so we asked them to check in our baggage and then got them to drop us back to the Soaltee Hotel. The Manager on duty was really helpful in providing us with 2 rooms out of 3 we booked back to us till Noon. We really did not expect in getting even a single room since we had checked out due to the fact that we had 3 kids and 2 senior citizens in our group.  5 Stars to the staff for being so understanding

I recently got an opportunity to stay at Soaltee for 3 days. This was my second stay at the hotel which i enjoyed to full. The staff gave such a warm welcome that i  felt like coming back to my home. Soaltee really values its guests. Small things like personalised attention during breakfast and getting a complimentary pastry in the room made my stay memorable. Special thanks to Ms Sampada Singh and Mr Umesh for their interactions during the stay. You guys are doing a great job.
空港からは市街地を超えて西の郊外にあります。タクシーでゴミゴミした街をぬって30分くらいでした。やや古ぼけた建物ですが、落ち着いた静かなホテルです。部屋に入るとスタッフがまだ清掃中でしたが、ボーイはおかまいなしに荷物を置いて帰りました。笑市街地へ出るには少し不便です。

Crowne Plaza Solatee is offering an amazing level of Nepalese hospitality in all areas. It seems that nothing is too much to request. Well done staff of Crowne Plaza. This hotel is on a secluded area,away from the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu.
