We came here as part of a trekking and spiritual holiday to Himalayas mansarovar and Kailash.The hotel is great the food is amazing with both international as well as Nepalese and Indian food.The staff are helpful and there is a business centre in the hotel that you can work from.They charged my phone but make sure you explain clearly the guy at cash desk was a bit abrupt.. I put it down to communication.This evening Rajiv manager on duty was great young bright helpful guy who discussed our travel options looked up flights on google because the travel desk was closed at 9.30 pm rightly so!!I would recommend this hotel as a great base to experience Kathmandu.

Questo hotel ha poco da discutere è di buon livello sia nella cura delle persone,che nel cibo,che nell'accoglienza. Non è molto centrale,ma può essere un vantaggio perché più tranquillo. Bella l'area piscina.

Its first time staying in a Crown Plaza Chain. The experience is fantabolous. The hotel has a rich history in itself which root back to the King of Nepal. The most courteous & hospitable staff we have ever come across. The General manager even hosted a cocktail party for the IHG members. It was fun meeting other travellers and the staff at the party. The party is held every Wednesday. The breakfast has a rich variety of foods. For dinner, the Chinese and Indian restaurants have amazing dishes. Never felt like going out for any food. Best part is 'halal' food available across all restaurants. You ll be surprised to see a dessert waiting in your room when you return from a long day of site seeing.The rooms are neat, tidy and spacious. My son loved the swimming pool. its beautifully crafted and designed to give a cultural and modern touch. The yoga place at the pool site was really nice. An amazing hotel for families and bussiness stays.Would recommend for families, couples, friends or solo.

Ambiente pulito, personale molto disponibile, ubicato dentro la città ma immerso nel verde lontano dal traffico e dalla polvere delle strade.  La colazione, abbondante di tutto, è prevista per tutte le etnie. Vicino l'albergo c'e un casinò molto bello dove poter trascorrere la serata.

suitable for all folks of 5 star stayer right from business, family, leisure, honeymoon travellers. Beautiful spreaded resort ambiance, rooms are spacious, nice decor, lawn, huge restaurants. Staffs are courteous. room rates are not very expensive too. Overall highly recommended.

Delegación de India con una planta completa reservada . Nuestra habitación  en  esa planta(nos la dieron por error). Sin pedirnos permiso   ( aprovechando q estábamos de excursión )  nos  meten la ropa  en las maletas,   nos ABREN LA CAJA FUERTE (donde teníamos el dinero y los pasaportes) y nos las llevan a otra habitación un piso más arriba

Large Hotel with Garden, swimming pool, and lots. Nicely manage hotel with clean rooms, helpful staff, tasty food and on time service. Nepal largest casino is also located in the same complex. The only problem with distance, most of the attractions are far from this hotel.

Um bom hotel situado num ponto estratégico, dentro da cidade e quase fora da confusão. Um bom serviço com um pequeno almoço excelente. Para quem tem pensão completa o jantar já é muito fraco, com pouca escolha, principalmente para os ocidentais. Parte de jardins bonita e bem cuidada e é pena uma parte estar em obras e por isso não estar a funcionar às lojas e a piscina. Ficamos numa zona antiga do hotel mas muito bem cuidada. Aconselho

Its an upscale hotel with all facilities. Staff is nice. Taxis are available from the porter's desk itself who explains to the driver in Nepali language, and taxi fares are reasonable. However, stay in the New Wing not in the Old Wing, because the AC system conked of in my room in the Old Wing to which neither the Customer Service on phone was responding properly and the repair guy offered me a table fan to make through the night, which was nonsense given its a hotel of few stars. On insistence, finally I was moved to a room in the New Wing which was excellent and well-run

The hotel complex is large & comfortable. The staff are friendly & helpful. The rooms are spacious & tidy. Try to get a room on a higher floor if you wish to cut out the noise. The breakfast buffet downstairs is always a highlight as they rotate what's available from local Nepali, Indian & Asian cuisine to typical western food such as cereals & hot style food. There's even a small section of shops under the ground floor so if you need to buy those last minute gifts. Highly recommended if you want to stay away from the tourist crowds.

Hotel amplio que cuenta con muchos eventos a diario. Las habitaciones amplias, limpias y ofrecen todo tipo de detalles. El restaurante es muy bueno y toda la comida de calidad, ofreciendo en el buffet incluso algún plato de pescado, algo difícil de encontrar en otros hoteles de la zona. La piscina muy limpia y amplia, a la que acude poca gente, por lo que puedes disfrutar tranquilamente.Justo al lado hay un casino, ofreciendo así un plan de ocio también.

A local friend recommended that I go to their Chinese restaurant when we were looking for dinning options.They have a Chinese chef and the food was very authentic.The service was also very good and the staff were smiling.

We in a group of 13 family members stayed in the hotel for 3 days from 29 Jun to 1st July. Very comfortable rooms and excellent service staff are available along with all facilities we expect.Mahajog casino is located in the same premises which was a good place to relax in the evening. We enjoyed card games along with free drinks, dinner and dance everyday.Coupled with the hospitality of the hotel staff there is nothing more to expect. Overall an enjoyable stay.

Good stay, food and service but watch out when settling your bill. The reception staff took my debit card and then returned it saying the system did not accept it. So i settled the bill separately. But later my bank statement shows the hotel has made 3 swipes and withdrawn 3 times the bill amt without my authorization. This happened on 31st May 2017 and till date they have neither replied my emails nor returned my money

Very old and bad service almost nothing work old furniture but nice stuff they try to help the place is nice near the city cleaning is good and swimming pool is ok tv need more option and service need to be more fast

good food, great ambience and a good pool. The hotel has beautiful gardens to walk in the evening. The air is clean and fresh unlike in the city. The major problem is the traffic which makes the location very impractical.

Numa cidade poluída e barulhenta tem que se ficar num bom hotel. E este com certeza é ótimo, fica em meio a um grande jardim, é limpíssimo, tem restaurantes de várias especialidades, incluindo um buffet. Tive a oportunidade de experimentar todos e a comida foi maravilhosa. O meu preferido foi camarão ao molho de ervas. Atendimento perfeito, concierge muito atencioso que nos indicou um taxi com um ótimo motorista e um café da manhã completíssimo.

Very comfortable n enjoyable stay, staff n services are very helpful n courtious.. Food quality perfect.... Added advantage of having a Casino in the same hotel compound... Real value for money... Must visit....

Amongst the hustle and bustle and dust of Kathmandu is this piece of paradise. Incredible levels of service and focus on the hotel guest. Every facility that you can think of. The staff are energised and focused and want to help. A bit out of the main tourist area of Thamel, about 20min and a Rs500 taxi ride, but if you want a place to breathe and relax and escape for a bit, this is where you need to stay.

Our group stayed here for two nights. The last time I was here was 46 years ago when it was much smaller and I was anxious to see it.  Now it is a quite modern hotel with 100+ rooms. The grounds are as beautiful as ever.     The rooms are becoming a bit worn, but still spacious, quiet and comfortable. The bathroom was large and clean, with the full set of amenities.      The service from the front desk to the waiters was excellent. The breakfast buffet was the best we had experienced while traveling through India and Nepal for a month.The selections were quite extensive and well-prepared.     There is a nice set of gift shops with reasonable prices. There is also a casino which has grown from a single story affair many years ago to a multi-level garishVegas style one today. The old one held more charm. Foreigners need their passports to play; and any winnings are paid in Indian rupees.      This is a superb 5-star hotel set in a quiet area. The one drawback is that one needs transportation to access it; it is not convenient to walking to any sights.

The hotel is large and looks nice. The staff is friendly too, I had some great conversations with them. No issues about the service quality at all. However it just feels a little dated. I do remember staying at this hotel 15 years ago and it still feels the same. I did find a cockroach in my room and saw a worm coming out of a lychee, which put me off a little.This hotel is about 20-30mins from Thamel area, so that would be worth thinking about too.

We recently returned from 2 weeks in Nepal. About half of that time was spent in the Crowne Plaza Hotel. If you are a Priority Club member this is the place to go to feel special. We cashed in Points for our rooms at only 20,000 points a night. Yet they still "upgraded" our room. There was fresh fruit, nuts, and cookies waiting in our room. Every evening they brought a slice of cake to our room.This Crowne Plaza still offers a Club Lounge for members. This is a feature that I love, but unfortunately many Crowne Plazas are doing away with it. Happy hour at the lounge had free cocktails and other drinks. We ate breakfasts and had lite dinners there. On Wednesday evening the manager hosts a reception for Priority Club members. On weekends they have a BBQ lunch for members. The swimming pool is, without a doubt, the nicest pool that I have ever swam in at any IHG property. Speaking of water, all water throughout the hotel was filtered and purified. You can drink water out of the tap. You don't have to worry about getting sick from water in your mouth while showering nor in the pool. The restaurants on the property, while expensive, did offer good quality food for a variety of tastes. If you are vegetarian, try the Kashmiri restaurant.  The staff heard that we were celebrating our 27th wedding anniversary. They delivered a beautiful and delicious cake to our room. There are shops and a spa in the basement. We got a massage and used the steam room there.I don't normally pick out individual staff for special recognition, but I will break with my tradition. There is a young man who is a Front Desk Manger named Umesh. He helped to make a special trip extra memorable. He was kind, attentive, and helpful on a number of issues. He helped with drivers, reservations, other details of travel. Thank you Umesh, and thank you to the entire staff at the Crowne Plaza in Kathmandu

nada sorprendente. Las toallas muy chicas y viejas. La atención es muy buena. El "The Chinese Restaurant " tiene un muy mal servicio pero el "Al Fresco" por el contrario muy atentos. El desayuno muy bueno , variado y abundante. Buen SPA

I stayed in this hotel from 4 to 6 June 17 with my friends and we all like the hotel and the service provided.We took interconnected rooms which are big in size and had good view of lawn and pool .This hotel is located little far from the main city but taxi are easily available. Casino is there in separate building and to my surprise they allow children inside the casino which i did not like.

There are lots of Hotels in Nepal. AN they are quiet good as well. But Crown Plaza is one of the hotel that treats you as a family. You will have beautiful memories over here. Being a 5 star hotel not so expensive though.

This is one on the most divine properties I have ever visited. Everything here is so natural. Must visit place.China Garden is a very authentic chinese restaurant....very change of taste for an Indian traveller.

We are staying at this hotel with a pilgrimage group. One bag was delayed at the airport and the hotel staff helped track it down and retrieve it for us. The food is amazing and the beds are comfortable. Will def come back.

This hotel is a good option in Nepal. The rooms are spacious. Although it may look very old. The bathrooms are relatively quite  old. The restaurant is ok with limited veg food options. Their breakfast is very good with South Indian food option. They do have some bhajiyas and samosa in food option which is superb but very expensive. The garden and poolside option is very nice and picturesque. They have a small shopping arcade which is quite reasonable compared to 5star standards. Their casino is the best attraction. It is 24 hrs and has lot of entertainment factors in it. A must checkout for every1.

This is set away from the bustle of Thamel so is too far to walk but if want a bit if luxury with a swimming pool then this is for you! Meals were good and varied and staff attentive and professional.

In mid March, we were 3 couples who stayed in Soaltee hotel. This is an old property but is well maintained. Rooms were cozy and decently sized with almost all modern day amenities. We got a garden view room but the other 2 couples got a construction-site facing room which was actually a bad luck.Swimming pool was closed due to winters. Breakfast spread was decent enough for a  5-star property. Steam, Sauna and Gym facilities were available at free of cost.  Mahajong (hotel's casino) is arguably the best in Kathmandu with amazing live dance performances.This property is any day better than Raddison and Yak&Yeti hotels in Kathmandu.

I can't believe I took shower in mold all over shower, I did not expect this dirty and filthy hotel for 4 star hotel . Also they promised for female Sanitary products and when we called they said they don't provide that!!!

A nice hotel in the heart of Katmandu. The hotel is clean, comfortable and the staff are polite and very welcoming. I have had the opportunity to eat only breakfast at the property, and that was at best average. The rooms are comfortable, toilets are clean, but a bit dated in comparison to the other Crown Plaza's I have stayed in. Nothing to write home about, but a definitely a decent place to stay. I would not mind staying at this hotel again.

Hotel is very good and comfortable... Has good and clean rooms with all the basic amenities that one will need to stay for 3 nights. Hotel is slightly far away from the city center, however can are available round the clock. Breakfast was good with a great spread offering something or the other for everyone. Hotel has a conference room for holding meetings for up to 30 people. There is great casino at a 2 minutes walking distance which operates entire night. I would like to stay here again.

Хороший отель, по местным меркам даже отличный. Неплохие завтраки, опять же со скидкой на местную кухню, отличный персонал - очень приветливый  и решающий множество вопросов. Зелёная территория с бассейном, что опять же для Катманду редкость. В Катманду однозначно рекомендую

Our extended family of 14 including the tiny tots stayed @ the Soaltee for a week from 18th - 24th April. The hotel all the amenities of a 5 Star with 3 restaurants, a huge swimming pool,Conference hall & even a Casino. The rooms were well kept & comfortable & the breakfast had a huge spread. The only drawback was that the pool was too cold to swim in. They definitely need a heated pool. Otherwise our stay was very comfortable.

Llegamos tarde en la noche así que el check inn fue rápido y sin mucha ceremonia. Nos dijeron que nos daban una habitación superior, realmente estaba linda pero hacía mucho frío y el acondicionador no calentaba y el mayor problema es que había un ruido permanente de un motor y además los ascensores al lado. Como era muy tarde no pedimos cambio y al otro día nos dijeron que nos cambiaban a una habitación standart. Estaba muy calentita y daba al jardín pero la sorpresa fue cuando fuimos a dormir, la cama era dura, las almohadas viejas y de inferior calidad. Los amenities del baño eran de muy inferior calidad que en la otra. Lo peor fue que se rompió el ascensor y tuvimos que bajar por escalera y la suciedad era terrible y no exagero. Meses sin limpiar, lo que me hizo pensar cómo estaría la cocina

Checked in on 4th may 2017, service of the hotel was very ordinary, specially the in-charge of the restaurant was over smart & ill behaved, the keys of our rooms (6) became in-operative several times during the stay of 2 days, the food was pathetic & non edible, thank God we carried snacks from India.

Unfortunately we have experienced many failure during our last stay.We have booked for 2 adults , but all amenities including tea-coffee maker and toiletries for 1 person. Mini bar was not provided.Bathroom shower not working properly also have installation problem. Hot-cold mixer do not work properly.And most IMPORTANT while entering the hotel main gate the security guard stopped our taxi and asked something in Nepali language and when we said that we do not understand it ,, he said .. If you come to Nepal then you should speak Nepali in a very rude manner and uttered some abusive language .( 14th evening)No bread refills during breakfast !!!
深夜のチェックインでしたが歓迎のプレゼントにスカーフを貰いました。ロビーは広くて綺麗であり部屋もシンプルで広かったです。チェックアウトも早朝であったためホテルでは食事もできませんでした。また、部屋が寒くなりましたがエアコンのヒーターが効かないとの口コミを読んでいたので十分な対応がとれました。

One of the great hotel kathmandu, good service and comfortable room and bed. Serve international breakfast. Hotel also cater with few different type of restaurant. Nice view, you will need transport from airport to reach this hotel.

El servicio es estupendo pero el hotel da aspecto de ser un poco viejo. La comida es buena y todo parece estar muy limpio y cuidado. Estuvimos en una habitación sin enchufes europeos pero nos facilitaron un transformador.

Crowne Plaza Hotel Kathmandu-Soaltee it is about 2 miles (3 km) of Kathmandu Durbar Square and Taleju Temple. The hotel is surrounded by gardens which alleviate the massive pollution of Kathmandu.They serves  buffet breakfast, available for a fee from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM.  The food was very good and the waiters service always caring.The room was clean and comfortable.  All the hotel staff were friendly, professional and performed their jobs efficiently and effectively. I have to say that from the bellhops to front desk to housekeeping and of course, at the restaurant they are warm and accommodating.This hotel  have an outdoor pool, free self parking, and a health club. Fee for in-room wireless Internet: US $12 per 24-hour period. Airport shuttle fee: US $ 25 per vehicle (one way) .Overall this hotel fulfilled our expectations.

The hotel is existing for several decades although the management changed in between. It's basic attractions like huge compound with well maintained garden, the well appointed rooms, the casino have remained in tact. The human side of this iconic hotel is just amazing. Customer centric approach at every contact point like entrance gate, reception, rooms and restaurants made us feel happy and delighted. The weather favoured us for a clear mountain view from the specific flight. The Pashupatinath darshan was smooth and peaceful due to introduction of new systems and processes in the temple. All in all a very delightful experience except for the dusty and bumpy roads with traffic congestion in Kathmandu city.

Every time I come to Kathmandu I stay in different hotel to explore the quality and service they offer with the cost This time I preferred Soaltee. The feedback is as follows Ambience - one of the best hotel with higher quality ambience . It is a mix of different architectural style and massive lavish green lawns . Yes you really have quality ambience to wander inside the hotel premises . It tops the ChartReception - very fast and simple . If you book prior it is a cake walk checkin . Rooms - there are 2 buildings I stayed in the main one in 5th floor . Good ambience and pretty clean and neat in all aspects . Quality of wifi speed , bathrooms are appreciable Dining Kakori- near swimming pool and offers exquisite cuisines from punjabi, Kashmiri, Rajasthani all Indian cuisines Garden terrace - in the ground floor main building offer buffet during breakfast and dinner and a-la-carte also Alfresco- Italian cuisine like Sardinia , Emilia etc Chinese restaurant- Chinese regional delights including Korean , Vietnamese,Cantonese, szechwan Rodi bar - variety of wines , high end scotches operates till midnight Gym - there is a small gym in the basement in the basement shopping arcade . Good one and decently maintained Shopping arcade - in the basement of annexe building and it hoses small outlets for local shopping Swimming pool- outdoor one , big and clean . Kids pool is also there with lifeguard on duty. Should enjoy if you are coming with family It holds service like ATM , travel desk support , beauty parlour etc . To tell it is not a hotel it is a mini complex for all inhouse guests.Strongly recommended for stay for people with family from other countries .

This is a nice hotel you can stay in Kathmandu. It is clean. The food is various and nice. The staff is very nice. They even brought a birthday cake to my room which was a nice surprise for me in the evening on my birthday.

We stayed at Soaltee for 3 nights. Though the hotel is over 50 years old, the upkeep is pretty good. The rooms were comfortable, nothing to complain. Wish the room had more electrical sockets for charging. The breakfast spread was elaborate. As I'm from south India, the delicious dosa, Idli, uthappam and vada made me feel at home. Wish the hotel had something fancy or out of the box. Otherwise, we enjoyed the stay.

Ficamos uma semana em Kathmandu e ficamos no Soaltee, a cidade é caótica, o transito um horror, o hotel é silencioso, com comida ocidental, ficamos na parte velha do hotel, relativamente limpo, sentimos falta de uma piscina termica, apareceram umas baratas no quarto e camareira logo resolveu. Atendimento muito bom. Adoramos ter ficado nele pois ficar emThamel ia ser ruim pelo barulho (quem foi pra Kathmandu ira concordar)

Il "Soaltee Crowne Plaza" di Kathmandu è un ottimo albergo collocato in località amena, silenziosa e non vicina al centro storico ( per raggiungere il quale occorre armarsi, causa il traffico, di  grande pazienza). Le camere sono pulite, spaziose, confortevoli e sono anche dotate di ampi spazi per i bagagli. La stanza da bagno è ordinata e pulita anche se il kit per toeletta è piuttosto limitato ( portarsi spazzolino e dentifricio). Il WI-FI, assolutamente gratuito, è presente anche in camera ( password: numero della stanza + cognome dell'utente). Vi ho  soggiornato tre notti con un intervallo di 10 giorni. Nulla posso dire sulla cucina perché ho cenato fuori. In conclusione: giudizio, a mio avviso,  ampiamente positivo.

Everything was good. The reception staff, room cleaning staff, house keeping staff, Room service staff are very nice. Very clean rooms. But surrounding view from hotel room was not good at all. Was in room number 415. Food was not that spicy except for mutton curry.

I like this property that is still in my mind whenever i think about Kathmandu, Very Good staff and i like the first impression of Reception staff, who help us with very quick check in and surprisingly they update my room as well. i would definitely recommend this property to every traveler.

Great conference facility, well-mannered and good English-speaking staff, good food and excellent rooms.Special assistance provided by junior staff Ms. Sampada and other staff for locating a special kind of Tea from Jiri. And late check-out hospitality by use of sauna and VIP/Airline club after my return from Dolakha and on the way to the airport.

First things first, the hotel is not in the traditional 'center' of Kathmandu. It's in the Soaltee neighborhood which is a good 20-30 minute drive (depending on traffic) to the tourist center of Kathmandu.The hotel is built in the old-style sprawling resort feel. It has multiple restaurants, shops and even a casino. The rooms are new-ish and really quite modern. The hotel has beautiful manicured lawns and grounds. My guide called an an Oasis of calm in Kathmandu. Its a pretty solid hotel, just remember the location isn't convenient if you like exploring the city by foot .

El lugar muy bonito.Bodas que alegraban el ambiente.La habitacion muy anticuada,con ducha adosada a la pared,y sobre todo la limpieza dejaba bastante que desear,sin cortinas ni persianas que hicieran la noche oscura para dormir.

We have gone for dinner, hotel was running Punjab food festival. We had nice starters and drinks followed by tasty punjabi food. We had near authentic lacha paratha with baingan bharta. In dessert we had apple jilebi, rabdi and phinri.

This is a very old property but right in the center of the city. The campus is big with multiple buildings,lawns,outdoor swimming pool and you will not feel like staying in a hotel but inside a gated community. They have a casino in the campusThe rooms are old but reasonably maintained. The overall decor of the room do not justify the 5 star tag.They are however comfortable and offers good sleep quality. The bath rooms are neat but again a far cry from the typical star rated toilets.The toiletries are also limited as you will have to carry your own dental and shaving kit.The overall service is slow including check in/check out and room service. May be this is the pace at which life in Nepal moves. The staff are very polite and courteous.They have many banquet halls and you find that the lobby is always full with conference participants.The restaurant is the best part,especially if you are a non vegetarian. The breakfast spread is fabulous. The food seem to be a major attraction and the quality of food, Indian(North Indian and south Indian),continental and Nepali cuisines are all well made.There is small gift shop right behind the lift area where you will find many of the souvenirs and gifts at a very reasonable price. The rates are fixed but the stuff is of high quality and almost at the best bargain prices in city shopping centers. Pick it up from here which will save you the time,trouble and moneyOverall this is is a good place both for family visit as well as for business

The hotel is actually has 3-4 buildings - one of them is newly constructed. The others are old. The rooms are pretty small and the furnishing is old. Even the washrooms are not the same level which you would expect from a 5 star property. The moment you enter the room you would actually feel a little underwhelmed. The only saving grace is the food - the breakfast buffet is good and so is the dinner buffet. The restaurants also have outdoor seating.

I stayed at this hotel in December 2016 as a part of my nepal visit. Location wise it's close to city Center and is in middle of crowded city area. But inside its a big property which houses a casino, lush green garden, swimming pool and couple of restaurants. Hotel itself is one of the first luxury hotels in Nepal hence you will find room interiors to be old fashioned but they don't compromise on space or Hygene. Breakfast spread is in line with what you get at 5 star hotels and service in restaurants is good. Distance from Kathmandu airport is approx 30-45 mins subject to traffic. Only area where I felt service could be better is for room service. Overall good option if you are a family traveller and looking for semi luxury stay.

Excellent hotel with very good service. Food and service good. Good Seminars rooms. Except for one room other rooms were good. Excellent service by staff. Very friendly staff. Stay also very comfortable.

Stayed here after injuring my feet on a trekking trip and the staff took very good care of me!Especially Shiam and Umesh, the FO Managers, provided exceptional service and went over the top with helping me sorting out issues with my flights and other requests I had! The staff really make the difference between hotels and I can only recommend the Soaltee in Kathmandu! :)

Hay una gran GRAN diferencia entre las habitaciones REFORMADAS y las antiguas, EXIGE que te den las Reformadas desde tu reservación, no hay punto de comparación, aun cuando las reformadas ya podrian estar mejor (hay que tomar en cuenta que luego del terremoto el turismo bajo un poco), creeme que las habitaciones antiguas no están bien. El resto de las instalaciones estan muy bien, buen restaurante, buen Desayuno.El Wifi tambien puedes ver desde la reservación si lo incluyen pues si esperas a llegar al hotel tendrás que pagar por el aunque no es tanto.

La gente es sumamente amable y atenta. Hemos comido buena comida local y una muy rica cerveza de Nepal. Toda la calidad de la cadena, con muy buena atención. Está ubicado en una especie de "barrio cerrado", pero se llega con facilidad a la calle. Hay lindas tiendas en las afueras del hotel y los precios se pueden bajar bastante.

Dopo il caos della città e l'allucinante traffico delle ore di punta e ...non solo, era bello rientrare nell'atmosfera ovattata dell'hotel e ritrovare la pace ed il silenzio. abbiamo cenato tutte le sere in albergo e ne siamo stati contenti perchè era possibile scegliere  tra la cucina nepalese e quella internazionale. ottima la colazione in cui non mancava assolutamente niente.

El hotel no es céntrico, pero no fue necesario para nosotros ya que teníamos contratados tours todo el día. El hotel está bien, pero a mi criterio le hace falta una renovación de mobiliario y decoración. Habitaciones amplias. Desayuno buffet bueno. La cena buffet tenía mucha variedad de platos de cocina local muy condimentados, y poca variedad de otros platos internacionales no tan picantes. La atención del personal fue muy buena.

I stayed at this hotel last December. The first 3 nights were through a tour and the last night was a direct booking so during check in I informed the front desk asking for an upgraded room (as I had spire elite status) so that I didn't have to change rooms. They assured me that this was going to be the case. I checked into my room which was old, filthy and had a terrible smell. 2 nights later I looked up on my direct reservation and it said it was supposed to be a mountain view room which I wasn't given. I was extremely annoyed so I talked to the manager. He offered me to transfer me to a room but I didn't care to pack up and move again as I had to clean the room using anti-bacterial wipes. I simply didn't care to go through the process again. As I told the manager, knowing this could happen, I specifically asked to be given the right (upgraded) room during my initial check-in to avoid the unnecessary inconvenience of moving again yet this hotel failed. I am therefore hugely disappointed by this hotel and the management. I did provide feedback as soon as I returned and received a useless apology email.  IHG needs to seriously reconsider their licensing agreement with this sub-standard hotel.

It was an amazing experience staying in this hotel..extremely spacious and beautiful property with good comfortable rooms and amenities.The staff is extremely humble efficient and cordial. Everything was neat and tidy in my room when I returned back as I had come for a conference..The souvenir shop at the lobby is one where you can get good stuff at fair prices. Food was excellent and the servers especially Mr Dharmendra takes extra efforts to make sure you are comfortable and takes it upon him to make sure we don't miss out on any delicacy. Housekeeping staff is really good and helpful...they got me a heater as they had centralized cooling and it was freezing cold outside..in totality had a really good and comfortable stay. Would highly recommend this hotel if you visit Kathmandu!!

The Crown Plaza Soaltee offers a nice break in the middle of busy and dusty Kathmandu. This hotel is strongly positioned amongst local standards. Nice pool environment, great park around the hotel, good facilities for venues, and above all nice, efficient and friendly staff. Certainly worth considering putting on your list when travelling in the region.

First of all... I found the location quite nice. Lots of space inside the compound, with good restaurants. Easy 15-20 minute walk to Swanayasbhum pagoda, and about the same to Durbar Square. Through an OK neighborhood that allows you to see normal people going about their business. Not worth to take taxis from there, unless you go to Thamel or farther afield. It is Kathmandu, so it isn't a leafy, relaxed walk but it is interesting.Where the hotel really let me down was in services... I tried 3 times to book a mountain flight, leaving my interest with the front desk only to come down a few hours later to a new crew at the reception and my request lost in limbo.The third time I decided to go with the reception to the travel agent in house which was 2 young men who asked me to pay in advance, without giving me a confirmation. I found this quite unprofessional so I walked away.I was very disappointed that an international hotel wasn't able to book this for me... I am sure I am not the first one with this request... Disappointed.The breakfast staff tries hard and despite a few inconsistencies, they treated me very well.Spire Elite and received no upgrade, last room had a window covered with a tapestry that let in a lot of light.Next time I will try another property.

Cockroaches in bathroom, terrible service, poor upkeep, steep prices. Not worth a stay! This hotel has fallen drastically since the last time I stayed here. Quiet a disappointment. Probably the worst Crowne Plaza I have stayed in. This is certainly not a deserving of its IHG affiliation. The staff attitudes are equally undeserving of a guest stay.

I joined my husband who was on business nine days in Kathmandu.  The opinions expressed are those of my husband and I.First, the negative aspects so people can determine if they want to disregard these issues:1. We have stayed in numerous hotels in 22 countries in Asia in these last six years and the front desk male staff at Crowne Plaza Soaltee are the most arrogant and dismissive as if they are the highest on the caste system. 2. They did not have "exchange rates from the government" and could not exchange our money.  I found out four days later that the casino on site exchanges money so I had to walk over to it, not very convenient and I should have been told the casino would change our money.  3. Room temperature is centrally set at 22 C which was freezing for us from Singapore. The POSITIVES:1. Staff both male and female in Garden Terrace and Chinese restaurants and all housekeeping and exterior guards are wonderful, helpful, friendly, and kind.2. Housekeeping  (female) recognized we were buying extra bottled water so they gave us two additional bottles a day!3. Housekeeping (female)  recognized we needed extra wash clothes and gave us extra.4. Pranesha, a Duty Manager, I think, is a competent young woman with good sense. She had a portable heater brought to the room and she came up to check on it.  She also engaged a service tech to get our safe operational. She was helpful for our 8 days by calling our driver and helping arrange our times and venues speaking to the driver in his language.5. The Cottage Arts store in the basement next to the salon is a real find. The prices are lower than stores outside the hotel. The owner is a fine man who appreciates customers interested in the artisans crafting his wares.  He is trustworthy.6. The breakfast buffet is delicious. We travel a lot and have come to expect smoked salmon and Crowne Plaza even replaced the platter when it emptied.  The egg station men are good-humored and have to tolerate a lot of impatient guests. These guys made us perfect over-easy eggs every day!   7. The Chinese Restaurant is fairly priced for the excellent fare they offer. They make perfect dry martinis too.8. The Himalayas are not in view as the title of one reviewer states.  You can see them from Dhulikel and Pokhara or take a Buddha Air or Yeti Air flight.  9. Bedding - our bed and bedding were high-grade, comfy duvet, good pillows, and the curtains close tightly so you do not awaken at sunrise unless you want to do so.10. The bathroom has the Asian hose next to the toilet, which is great when you have become accustomed to it. The shower is large, clean, and they supply good quality amenities.  You will use a lot of the lotion due to the dry air.  Our hair dryer was good.  Be eco-conscious and hang the towels and use them again.  The shower has HOT hot water, be careful.11. The wifi in our room was reliable; the wifi in the lobby was not always reliable.   Ironically, it worked great outside!12. The souvenir store in the lobby has a friendly man who will change small amounts of your money, The stores that sell local wares in the basement and this shop are offering good products and good prices as I shopped around a lot to compare prices, so, if you want a fair priced object or carpet or clothing, consider these shops.  It is safer than taking out your money to buy a souvenir in a square. 13.  Western food on the menu:  obviously, the local food is best but if you want western food, do not expect it to be identical to that in your country.  I ordered a rueben advertized in the menu as ham, swiss cheese, Russian dressing, sauerkraut, etc. but what I got was a roast beef sub sandwich without sauerkraut. It was delicious and so big my husband helped me eat it. Do not complain about your food unless it is totally incorrect or bad in taste. You cannot expect exactly what you get in your country.  This is Nepal and though this is a Crowne Plaza, you cannot expect western duplication of food at 100%.14. I think the hotel is beautifully maintained, constantly polished and dusted and swept. The decor is lovely and there are art objects of museum quality.  The gardens and pool area are lovely, Walk around and enjoy them. Sit outside in their leather chairs and relax ...you can meditate by the exquisite stone-carved Buddha outside in a garden of its own.15. You can walk around the local streets and gather the flavor of its people.  Everyone was friendly to me,So, though my husband, me, and many guests shared their disappointment with us about  the nasty men at the reception and checkout desk, we would stay at this Crowne Plaza again because many more people WERE nice, helpful, and kind. In fact, when my husband checked out he was handed a card to complete. He gave it to me because he was upset at how he was treated, I filled out the form giving  a good rating. When I approached the desk to slide the card into its designated box, the tall, bespectacled man (who was severely rude to my husband ) asked me to give him the card (presumably to toss out as he may have thought I wrote a poor review) and I replied to him "No, it goes HERE!" and I walked away.You cannot let two nasty men ruin your stay.  Though all employees should be civil, helpful, most were kind and friendly.

I just visit the hotel for a dinner but they did not get any penny as their service is totally poorNo WifiStaff is also no hospitality at all I visit the room and it is super old and lack of maintenance Not recommended to stay in this hotel and I would not go to this hotel any moreSo bad having such a experience by IHG hotel

The buildings of this hotel from outside with beautiful building and plush gardens look awesome from outside, but once you are inside- the story is entirely different, especially for a business traveller. The internet services, house-keeping, wide choice of meals for a single traveller are very much below satisfactory levels. Internet can frustrate you to death..Gym has limited equipments notwithstanding the building outlay and the brand. Yes, the breakfast is quite good, and has a good spread..but a single traveller may feel frustrated during the dinner time..Avoid for business travel, esp if you are a single business traveller

it's one of the famous and beautiful hotel. hotel is very nice antique and nice ambience. staffs are very helpful. big space. located in kathmandu. restaurent also very very nice. you can get various food. you can swim here. hangout in garden.

Starting from lackadaisical staff at check in to no wi-fi service in the room, staff was not bothered about keeping the room clean or providing basic amenities like towels in the room. Even the staff at the restaurant for breakfast was non-responsive at all the occasions when approached.And was damn expensive for this kind of service and environment.

We stayed with my wife for one week and we enjoyed every moment. The staff are very friendly. The grounds are beautiful and relaxing. There are many well priced souvenir shops and the food is very good indeed.

Abbiamo soggiornato alcuni giorni a Kathmandu in occasione di un viaggio in Nepal. Nel traffico caotico e nell'inquinamento di questa città, l'hotel sembra proprio un'oasi di pace. E' dotato di un bel parco, le stanze sono spaziose e il bagno pure, wifi gratuito. Da apprezzare particolarmente la disponibilità del personale nel rispondere alle diverse richieste. Apprezzato anche il buffet. Hotel da consigliare

We stayed here for 3 nights while touring Kathmandu. The property is huge and there is a Casino and ATM on site. Our stay was enjoyable but the property is a little worn and could use some updating. My first shower caused some minor flooding in our bathroom due to the shower curtain style and a plugged floor drain. The drain did get fixed when I made the request.  I found the staff helpful with some going out of their way to assist or provide the extra help that makes a huge difference when traveling.  I would recommend the Crown Plaza when in Kathmandu...

Good condition American brand hotel in this town. The day of our visit,  they have international investment conference or attendees of that conference staying at this hotel. Tents are also added in the garden for a wedding or banquet. There are three restaurants on site: Indian, Chinese and a American buffet type casual dining. I think it is perhaps one of the better venues in town for parties.

We were a group of six (3 couples) and went to Nepal for a tour... We are basically from India.. The Hotel is quite different and huge... However, Swimming Pool was not available.. Obviously its freezing cold and no one would even dare to step into it..I loved the Casino of the property looks like a Bollywood one.. Lavish and beautiful!!Overall a very good stay at the property :)

The oldest 5 star hotel in Kathmandu is beautiful. The rooms are clean, food is great and staff understands the word hospitality! Nice gym, lovely spa and good tennis court and swimming pool. Quietly situated in busy Kathmandu.

We were here with a group of 16.  The property is very beautiful and this time of year it is very busy with weddings and functions.  Main areas are beautiful and well maintained .  Rooms are rather tired and in need of refurbishing.  Linens on bed are adequate but certainly not luxurious, very thin blanket between two sheets, not a nice fluffy duvet as you might hope.  Rooms are clean and nice toiletries are available in the bath, very old hairdryer on the wall should be updated.  Very nice breakfast buffet with lots of choices our first and second day, third day was so busy that staff could not seem to keep up with clearing of tables and refreshing of food.

La habitación no se condice con un 5 estrellas. Ropa de cama, toallas, cortinas y elementos del baño y muebles descuidados. El desayuno muy bueno y la atención también.  Está alejado de Thamel y zona más céntrica.

First realize the hotel is old and is need of some refurbishment.  Some of staff is very personal, while most of staff is cold and distant.  Pool is not operational,which I can understand this time of year.  Room is in bad state, furniture needs to be replaced along with some of the bathroom facilities, cabinets don't open and door locks don't lock. Restaurant for breakfast was horrible and while sitting in my chair it broke and I fell on the ground, the staff saw it happen but nothing was said.  Chinese restaurant for dinner completely different staff and was optimal in service.   They brought us snacks in room each night but since they had ants crawling all over we decided to pass on it . Maybe a local hotel delicacy. I would not recommend this hotel to anyone.

Courteous staff, clean rooms, excellent breakfast, location was good for business.liked the pool side and gardens very much.I was offered free wifi during my second stay. The WiFi frequency was very poor in room as well as in the lobby.

We stayed here for 2 nights . It was everything we needed . Spacious rooms , clean rooms and good wifi . The staff were incredible helpful and friendly . We ate in the Chinese restaurant which was delicious. The only draw back , if you are wanting to see the sights of Kathmandu the hotel is nowhere where you need to be .

My wife and I were there for 9 days and had comfortable stay.  I liked it because of it's proximity to the city centre.  Food is fine and staffs are very humble and piano playing in the lobby gives it nice touch and creates nice ambiance. The only very disappointing was nepalese restaurant, it was way below our expectations and food and service was lousy.  I couldn't believe that hotel of that standard can operate such poor quality of food and service. But compared to the hotel around I think this is good one. Buffet  Breakfast in coffee shop was nice and food at chimney was good as well but nothing remarkable.

We usually have a mega conference here in Soaltee Hotel.  It's a wonderful venue for big conference, helpful staff, delicious food; lovely venue; heart of Kathmandu; nice room.  Every aspect  value of money!!

ツアーで1泊しました。夜中に到着したにもかかわらず、全員にシルク調のロングスカーフを首にかけてくれてお出迎えされました。ロビーも部屋もラグジュアリーこちらではランクが高いホテルだと想像できます。部屋でのWi-Fiは無料です。電気ポットとボトルウォーターが置かれていました。口コミにスリッパは一組しか置かれていないと書かれていましたがこれは本当でした。ただ、残念なことはこれだけのホテルなのにエアコンの温度調節が出来ず夜中寒かったことです。起きている間には停電は無かったです。朝食は種類が多くて満足でした。エッグステーションではオムレツを焼いてくれます。敷地が広いので、時間があれば散策するのも良いかと思います。
カトマンズの中心部から３～４ｋｍ離れた場所にある、東京ドーム位の敷地に建つ歴史を感じさせるホテルです。広目のツインの室内は白基調でダークブラウンの家具、モスグリーンの絨毯など落ち着いた内装で、過ごしやすかったです。若干年季の入っているホテルなので、設備面では満足のいかない面も若干ありましたが（暖房の効きが若干弱い）、全体的には満足のいくホテルでした。

E' vero ci sono dei particolari un po' datati (tipo la spa e qualche camera della vecchia ala con bagni non proprio allettanti) ma ha moltissimi aspetti positivi: il primo fra tutti è che ci si riesce a sentire in Nepal!Ci siamo fatti cambiare la camera e quella dell'ala nuova è decisamente meglio anche se non esattamente di lusso.Gli ambienti per la colazione e la cena sono decisamente carini e comodi.Buona varietà e qualità del cibo e molto bella la terrazza antistante le sale ristorazione.Bellissimo arrivare e fermarsi a sorseggiare un bel tè nel salottino all'aperto ma coperto davanti alla hall che si affaccia su un prato curato e sulla piscina veramente molto bella.Si trova a circa 2 km da Durbar Square ma, si sa, in Nepal 2 km in macchina o autobus possono voler dire anche 40 minuti di traffico! Meglio a piedi: 20 minuti di una passeggiata che vi faranno ambientare in città e sarete arrivati alla Piazza dove si trova, fra l'altro, la dimora della Dea Bambina ma se siete un po' suscettibili alle polveri sottili attrezzatevi di mascherina: lo smog è a livelli davvero altissimi!

Everything at this hotel normally falls in place except for the room service. It is shoddy, imagine placing the order and someone ask you everytime if they food u ordered needs to prepared immediately or after a while. Tell them immediately and prompt comes the reply, we are very busy . The food at room service is slow and gets cold by the time it's delivered. The rooms are nice, clean and modern. Staff is generally helpful and accommodating, though the room service (F&B) needs to buckle up. Lovely property. Great big lawn, nice pool and tennis ground. The casino is nice as well!

O hotel têm acomodações de luxo e fica rodeado de jardins , localizado 3 km do Santuário Swayambhunath Stupa e a 4 km dos templos na Praça Darbaar .Com uma decoração elegante os quartos são muito espaçosos e confortáveis .

Comme toujours, sans grande surprise ni grand charme et évidemment impersonnel.Et l'hiver il y fait froid..... Les chambres qui ne donnent pas sur la cour ne semblent pas avoir de chauffage: vous mettez la clim à 25° et ca souffle du froid. En décembre , c'est moyen. Comme en plus la fenetre ne fermait pas (courant d'air de 2cm), on finit par vous donner un radiateur d'appoint mais là c'est LAs Vegas tellement ca vous illumine la chambre.Mais bizarrement, si vous ralez tres fort on vous trouve une chambre qui est chauffée....Et en plus il est à une bonne demi heure du centre

Despite being an old property, Soaltee is a well mantained hotel located within 3 k.m. of the city centre. Best part about the hotel is its well mannered and helpfull staff. This place is best suited for travellors looking for a serene surrounding.

Bad customer services when we arrive to the hotel the reception give us the key and didn’t show us where is our room and didn’t send some body to show us the room or the room facility also the AC in the room it’s not cooling when we call the operation he suggested us to open the room and its 5 star hotel the mention the facility air condition when the send the techunition he didn’t fix the cooling problem and all the night the room was hot and the AC is not cooling also they make more then one wedding party and the all places of the hotel a lot of notice for the guest so not recommend it

El Hotel Crowne Plaza Katmandu-Soaltee. Es un hotel con habitaciones confortable y bonitas aunque no modernas. Son de estilo clásico pero confortable. Tiene wifi gratis. Las zonas comunes y jardines son muy bonitos. El buffet es muy correcto y te ofrece diferentes posibilidades de cocina internacional. Lo aconsejo.

The soaltee Kathmandu is a regular haunt of mine ( 4/5 times a year ) and the reason for that is of course the casino but even above that is the hospitality of the staff of the hotel. They pamper me like a spoilt Lord and the love, affection and comfort Mr Srijan  Sharma and Mr Deepak Pandey bestow on me makes me feel like I might have to increase the frequency of my visits. It's a home away from home for me !

We came to the Soaltee Crown Plaza on the recommendation of friends in India, and were delighted with our stay. The rooms were comfortable, the breakfasts excellent, and the grounds peaceful after the bustle and crowds on the streets. The crowning glory, however, was the gracious service from everyone we encountered, from the moment we checked in. We were especially impressed by the concierge who provided excellent insider tips on restaurants and sights to see. His advice was top-notch and greatly added to the pleasure of a visit to his city.

this property is grown up with me...lol..i am staying at this property since i was just 1 year old. i never felt to change the property for my next stay at kathmandu. i love the food, rooms and amenities offered here every time i stayed.
ロビーや庭はとても良かったです。朝食のビュッフェも美味しかったです。カトマンズでは珍しく浴槽がありました。ただ、設備は古く、部屋もとても素晴らしいという程のものではありません。スタッフの対応は良かったです。ホテルに入り手前の入り口にはガードマンがいます。安全であるとは思います。窓からの景色はいまいちでした。これなら、もう少し別のホテルに泊まっても良いかなと思います。
カトマンズの空港からほど近い場所にあります。玄関の花、庭の植物、とても綺麗でした。フロントのソファやテーブル、ランプも芸術品のような素敵な物ばかりで高級感が溢れていました。

仕事で数回滞在しました。スタッフはとてもフレンドリーで非常に心地よかったです。空港からは渋滞もあるので１時間くらいかかりますが、また利用したいホテルです。レストランも滞在中はほぼ毎日利用しましたが、満足です！カジノもあり、気軽に楽しめます。スパ（オイルマッサージ）も利用しましたが、高級ホテルのような豪華さは一切ありませんでしたが、安くて仕事の疲れを取るには効果的でした。ホテルの敷地内にブティックが数店あり、その中にストール屋さんがあるのですが、安くてなかなかの質でおススメです。同僚も大量に購入していました。いいお土産にもなるかと思います。お店の方も親切で、大量にあるカラーバリエーションの中から、あれこれと私たちの好きそうな色のストールを出してくれました。

I used to stay in this hotel. Before the earthquake, this is a very nice, upscale hotel.This time, my friend needs to change their room two times. First one because the door cannot be closed properly. The reception gave another room, but the bathroom floor flooded because apparently the sewage is blocked.I am very upset because I have recommended this hotel. Really the property needs to be renovated.Service and food outlets are still great as usual. Only the property needs upgrade long overdue. Please.

I have stayed in this property many times. Last time when I visited in 2015 September there was some renovation work going on due to damages caused by the earthquake. In fact the main entrance lobby was also closed that time. However this time I found the hotel in its usual shape and glory. The hotel is great in terms of rooms size, utilities, services; difficult to find any negatives here. The breakfast spread and the food quality here is excellent. There is a Casino also inside the hotel compound where you can visit without any entry fee.

The Soaltee Crowne Plaza isn't going to win any prizes for architectural distinction. It sits behind security gates in the west of Kathmandu, and occupies two undistinguished brick buildings. Such views of the city as there are don't set the heart beating faster. As a base for seeing Kathmandu, however, it does very well. The foyer is spacious and light. The staff are attentive. The rooms conform to standard international hotel norms, although why you would need a window between the bathroom and the rest of the room is beyond me. The buffet breakfast won't have your jaw dropping with amazement, but is very adequate. And when you get back here after ten days in Bhutan, suddenly the hotel deserves every one of the four stars I'm going to give it. On touring holidays comfort and reliability are worth a good deal, and the Soaltee delivers.

It's a nice hotel to stay and relax back. We loved the friendly atmosphere and the staff always welcome us with Namaste greetings. Rooms are clean and well maintained. I recommend this hotel who visit to Kathmandu.

旅の一日目と七日目に、二回泊まりました。一日目に泊まった部屋は北側で、窓のカーテンもなく、暖房も効かず(実は暖房機能はなかった)、寒くて寝られませんでした。七日目の時も、部屋に入った時寒いので、ポーターさんに暖房をチェックしてもらったところ、時間がたてば暖かくなると言われました。ところがいつまでたっても暖かくならないので、フロントに交渉して、南側の部屋に替えてもらいました。後で他のツアー仲間に聞いたら、部屋のエアコンは冷房機能だけで、暖房はないとのことでした。部屋の暖かさは昼間の日当たりによるものでした。私のように寒さに弱い人は初めから南側の部屋を希望したほうが良いです。
カトマンズ中心部からは少し離れていますが、それ以外の点ではOKレベルのホテル。クラウンプラザと言っても、現代的な建物ではなく、ネパールらしいレンガ造りの建物です。ホテルのスタッフは皆笑顔で親切です。

Otele 10 kişi 5 farklı oda tutarak geldik. İlk odadan böcek çıktı, başka odaya gönderildiler, oradan da böcek çıktı. İkinci ve tek başına kalan kişinin odası saç kılları ile doluydu. Bizim odamız 3 kişilik olması gerekirken 2 kişilik ve pisti. 3. Yatak yarım saat bekledikten sonra gelmedi. Başka odaya (upgrade) aldılar ve yatak gene gelmedi. Havlu ve tuvalet kağıdı bitince, normal rutinde yenilemedikleri gibi istendiğinde, geç getirip bahşiş istiyorlar. Her şey bir yana son gece "renovasyon" yapmaya karar verip, gece yarısı çekiç seslerini hoş görmemizi beklediler. Bitti hanımefendi dendikten 30 dakika sonra başlarında durunca bitti. Bunu hiç bir yer için söylemedim ama bu oteli gerçekten de tavsiye etmem.

el hotel se encuentra en la zona comercial donde podemos encontrar una buena cantidad de souvenir y ropa propia de la región en especial para damas. El inglés practicado por estos habitantes es británico lo que en particualr es de mi preferencia

The grounds and pool are very nice and well maintained. My room was in the old section and nothing special. But if you're going to be out and about during the day, the bed will provide you with a restful sleep. Breakfast buffet was ok, but some of my food was cold.

Was in town for little over 24 hours. Was greeted at the door by the duty manager upon getting of the hotel car.The service was OK, but they manage to forget my wake up call. Luckily i had a back up alarm clock. The breakfast was very average but there is definitely room for improvement in this aspect. I had tried the Indian restaurant for dinner and the service and food was good. Not sure if i would stay here on my next trip around as there are other hotels that i would also like to try.

I stayed at this lovely property from 8th to 11th nov to attend an international confrence ,i stayed at second floor with Lawn & hills view.The room amenities were its best.The food was awesome,i have not missed the Indian taste.Breakfast was very well served with lot of options to choose from...I prefer to stay here only in future..

I stayed at this hotel for 3 nights in Nov 2016.PRO's:Breakfast selections was very good and tasty.Staff were friendly and helpful.Indian restaurant was very good food and good service.CONS's:Room was very dated, I would imagine they have not been updated since the hotel was first built many many years ago.Bathroom was old and looked dirty/tatty - in real need of updating.Shower was in the bath.Chinese restaurant was very quiet, yet the service was incredibly slow, it took over one hour from our starter for them to bring out the main.The food overall was average at best, would not recommend trying this restaurant.Overall - I would not stay at this hotel again the price the hotel is too dated.

Muy lindo hotel, confortable, habitaciones muy cuidadas, heladera, cafetera, amenitis, un excelente desayuno, muy rico y abundante, importante porque la oferta gastronomica de la ciudad es muy pobre  y el restaurante del hotel muy caro. No hablan español, pero el personal es muy amable. Hermosa piscina y parques, montón de negocios en los alrededores con precios accesibles.

Hotel is quite average given it should be a more high-end hotel. However, you don't have too many choices here in Kathmandu. First room had power sockets busted. Second room had the light dials missing. Food was quite average as well. Nothing to shout about overall.

Para os padrões locais o hotel é considerado o melhor, porém não vá esperando um 5 estrelas padrão internacional.  O staff é ótimo , fazem de tudo para agradar , mas o hotel sofre com a estrutura velha , cheiro de mofo , falta de manutenção em algumas áreas e quartos antigos . O café da manhã é bem variado mas com poucas opções para nós ocidentais . Possui uma casa de câmbio e um bar ao lado da recepção e  piscina ao ar livre . Mesmo assim tivemos uma ótima estadia considerando-se as condições de pobreza da cidade.

We had a very good experience of warm Nepali hospitality in five stars of Nepal with big yards,nice staffs, we had good time in casino of soltee crown plaza. Over all good hotel to stay in Nepal should visit.

I stayed in Kathmandu at Soaltee for 3 nights. The hotel has all the tag marks of a good luxury hotel. They are in a good location, have a big property, have very good restaurants and a casino within the campus and very warm staff. The only issue is that the property is very old and hence you will have to make do with old world luxury with old fittings and infra in the room as well as the rest of the property.Location (3/5)They are away from the hustle and bustle of thamel, but this means you are a 3km (500 nepal rupees cab fare) away from any good restaurant or spa or pub. Taxis are easy to get both ways so not a deal breaker.Rooms (4/5)Very comfortable rooms with good views overlooking the garden. Good sleep quality and house keeping service. Apart from TV all other fittings are very old.Service (5/5)The staff overall is warm and efficient. Water bottles ordered on the phone gets delivered within 3-5 mins of the call. Check in and check out was one of the fastest I have seen on my travels.Food (5/5)They had a Chinese, Indian and Italian restaurant in the property. We tried Kakori, and the food and service were both mind-blowing. While it was on the expensive side, it was totally worth the money. Do try the galauti kebabs when here !Overall I enjoyed my stay and would like to stay here again when back in KTM.

Muy buen hotel, con habitaciones cómodas, colchones y almohadas perfectas. Cafetera y nevera en habitación, con botellas de agua suficientes , te reponen todo lo necesario. Posee variedad de servicios que no utilizamos por falta de tiempo.. Desayuno buffet muy completo y abundante. Wifi gratis.

A very old property and very well maintained . Staff is very courteous. Got a very walm welcome . Food is also nice . Would like to visit this place again for the best hospitality. Was an awesome stay all together.

Siamo rimasti in questo hotel per tre notti, la camera ha un arredamento vecchio, il bagno di medie dimensioni aveva la vasca con un tappeto antiscivolo tutto ingiallito e lo specchio rovinato, durante la giornata avvenivano continui stacchi di energia elettrica (attenzione alla posizione della camera, vi consiglio di chiederla distante dal gruppo elettrogeno poiché molto rumoroso)Non è garantito il buffet per cena (noi abbiamo cenato 2 volte su 3 con buffet), in alternativa al buffet non è permessa alcuna scelta di pietanza, l'unica scelta è pesce o pollo...ma come è fatto? che tipo di pesce? Contorno, riso? Lo scoprirete appena verrà servito il piatto!!!Per questo il nostro giudizio su un hotel 5 stelle è mediocre.

A 50 years old hotel so product wise is old and requires renovation for rooms and public areas especially elevators . However service levels are good and staff are friendly at reception and breakfast . Breakfast is varied and good . Gym hall too small and only few machines available . Swiming pool is not temperature controlled .wifi free .location not that great considering you need taxi away by 20 min from Thamil the main hub area for restaurants clubs and bars but is closeby to airport . Works best for business and is safer than other hotels . A casino is available in the hotel proximity as well .

Excellent hotel....nice pool....sumptuous breakfast..... Stayed there for two nights......well maintained......Has a gift shop inside ,you can purchase souvenirs at a very good price.... mahjong casino is in vicinity....excellent casino..... Wonderful enjoyment....great party atmosphere.......avoid second floor rooms.....

I stayed there for three nights with my family. The hotel is built long time ago but it's lobby, outside and restaurants are amazing. We had several housekeeping issues such as damp smell in the room, some toilet flushing issues, no iron in the room but they were taken care of by the staff. The front desk staff, concierge staff, house keeping people were extremely helpful. I would particularly mention one front desk staff Krishna who helped us tremendously on multiple issues. Hotel had three restaurants covering continental, Indian and Italian cuisine. Hotel offers free wifi which had certainly strong signals but we did not have wifi on our 3rd floor room and we eventually had to change the room. This hotel needs renovations of bathrooms replacing old fixtures, door knobs, making sure iron is available in every room and floors higher than 2 have wifi coverage. I would certainly stay in this hotel again and recommend my family and friends.

Ottimo hotel situato vicino al centro di Kathmandu ma in una zona che lo isola dal caoticissimo e rumorosissimo traffico della città. Stanze grandi e pulite con bagno spazioso. Camere curate nell'arredamento e dotate di cassaforte. Wi-Fi a pagamento ma dal costo accessibile e ben funzionante anche nelle camere. Ottimo il ristorante sia per quanto riguarda la colazione che la cena. Grande varietà di pietanze, cibo sia locale che internazionale e ottima scelta di dolci. Personale molto gentile ed efficiente. Consigliatissimo!

The Soaltee Crown Plaza is one of Kathmandu's first luxury Hotels, originally part of the Indian based Oberoi group. They have done a nice job of maintaining the property and have a helpful staff.The downside, from my perspective is the out of town location. It is quiet and away from the traffic- but without a car or a taxi you are limited if you want to visit Thamel for shopping or evening activities.Once you walk outside of the long driveway you are in a local business area, and taxis are easily available-- just not as convenient.Breakfast is excellent, rooms spacious and quality is as expected.

Kathmandu ist staubig, abgasgeschwängert und natürlich arm. Wenn man das bedenkt, ist das Hotel wahscheinlich ein Highlight. Nur hat es seine besten Jahre definitv gesehen. Dafür machen die äusserst freundlichen Mitarbeiter das meiste wieder wett.

Kathmandu is a small valley town. I was there a few days ago and thought i should add a review for others who would like to visit it. At the moment the city has a lot of roads under construction thus traffic jams are a must so traveling time should be calculated accordingly. Places to visit are the Monkey Temple or Swayambhunath, Patan, Durbar Marg and Durbar Square, Narayanhiti Palace, National Museum, Boudhanath temple, Bhaktapur and the Garden of Dreams near the market place Thamil. Thamil is also great for traditional shopping like local handicrafts. Lunch or dinner at the Garden of Dreams is a must its a beautiful and serene place which was built by an Australian couple. Locals and tourists can be seen relaxing at various spots there, its popularly known by the locals as 'Lovers Point'. The people/locals/residents are very helpful and nice. Haggling or bargaining is a must as the local vendors exaggerate prices for tourists. The hotel Crowne Plaza Soaltee is a beautiful estate. The service is also good however it is an expensive hotel and there are other cheaper options available like Annapurna- Its location is in the heart of the city center so if you want to be close to the city center its the place to be. The mountain flight is a must however i was unable to take it due to bad weather and the Everest base camp should also be visited. Most of the temples were damaged or demolished due to the earthquake but still the surviving ones are worth seeing. The architecture and wood work is amazing. Internet is slow in Kathmandu no matter where you are at the hotel or otherwise. There are some modern malls also like the World Trade Center and LABIM malls. The local food must be tried its very different and also a bit spicy. Its good to get a local guide but if you don't that's fine as most people speak English or Hindi.

As usual the Crowne Plaza is a good bet! Amazing rooms, great staff, the hotel restaurant is really good too.Best part is the bar downstairs where to relax while having a drink and chatting with friends. Indefinitely recommend it, also for its position, out of the big traffic, tjat guarantees silence and peace.

Though this hotel is situated a little bit far from the city's main attraction, it's really a nice hotel to stay and enjoy with the family members. Acres of nice green area with a beautiful pool and it's surrounding area. well behaved staffs. Well appointed roon and bathroom amenities.

Hotel luxuoso e longe do centro caótico de Katmandu, o que dá muita segurança e conforto.Os quartos amplos e aconchegantes, com chaleiras elétricas para fazer chá ou café, garrafas de água.O café da manhã com muitas opções, apesar de muitas das comidas serem típicas e desconhecidas.Staff muito gentil.Lojinha do hotel sensacional, pois tinham todos os tipos de souvenirs, que as vezes difíceis de serem encontrados na cidade, e a preços baixíssimos.

Un sogno divenuto realtà, il primo giorno nel lontano aprile del 2010, appena arrivati a Kathmandu, abbiamo usufruito della splendida piscina dell'Hotel Crown Plaza prima di addentrarci nella visita della fiabesca piazza di Kathmandu.Intorno alla piscina un ambiente immerso nel verde con scenografie di campane e cascate. Tutto molto rilassante, come anche rilassante è stato il soggiorno presso l'Hotel Crown Plaza,camere belle,spaziose e pulitissime, personale più che disponibile, lo abbiamo riscontrato in particolar modo nella preparazione dei piatti a pranzo o a cena quando cercavano di accontentarci con pietanze più vicine al gusto europeo e non piccanti come è loro tradizione. Ottima la colazione, ci sono ritornato anni dopo  quando sono andato in Tibet riscontrando la stessa gentilezza e disponibilità.

We stayed at the hotel for 3 days while my husband presented at the #nextgrowthconclave.  It was a great venue for a conference and the hotel staff helped to ensure it went well. On check in we were given a room in the older wing those rooms definitely  need updating. We were later transferred to a much nicer room on the executive Lounge floor in the new wing. Breakfast buffet was good as were the other meals we had at the hotel. The hotel itself is located in a secluded compound away from the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu. Traffic getting to and from the hotel is horrendous so factor that in to your planning.

Beş üzeri mükemmel bir otel. Çalışan personelin güler yüzü ve sıcaklı harika, odaları temiz ve çok iyi. Gerek yerel gerekse dünya mutfağından yemeklerin sergilendiği mutfağı mükemmel, sunum harika. Mimari olarak, bahçesiyle etkileyici.

I think people may have different opinions but if you are not one of those people travelling constantly to luxury hotels, you'll be more than happy with this one. It is what I would consider a luxury hotel, at least compared to the other ones I've seen. Room was clean, staff is extremely nice and most speak English. There are four restaurants and a swimming pool. If I wanted to find something negative I would say that the complex is so big that there are sometimes really large groups which makes it more difficult to relax. They also host a lot of events which may be noisy if your window faces the area where they hold them (but I assume you can request another room then). In my case all the events that took place ended relatively early so it wasn't really a disagreament. I would recommend staying there if you can get a good deal on the room. Another thing to note is that it is slightly isolated from the center so it is difficult to walk anywhere. Taxis are required to move around.

I Stayed in your hotel for an international event. Everything was well organized. Great service during the stay at the restaurants.The food was great . The room was clean and the staff very polite and helpfull.

First of all, I have platinum membership at IHG hotel group,I booked for 2 nights in this hotel and I decided to leave from first day , because:1. As my membership benefits I deserve free upgrade to next type of my booking and I got it but the window can not open that make my wife nervous because she don't like the smoke smell so i ask the reception to change my room with open-window but they give me the room same as my booking without any upgrade but the window can open.2. The socket in my room was outside from the wall and it was so dangerous ,this need to fix it as soon as possible if they want to save the guest life.3. In the morning ,when I was having my breakfast ,a waiter moving nearby my table and he take my plate without asking me I finished my food or not ,this is not acceptable in 5-star hotel!Because of these I decide to check out ,and I want to meet the duty manager Mr.Umesh Shrestha, he is really a gentleman, kindly ,respectful , and very helpful ,because of him I decide to stay 5days more ,total for 1week stay He gave me:1. Upgrade to club floor room 2. Nice gifts for apologize 3. The restaurant staff changed to better attitude and with full respect 4. He promise me to fix the socket as soon as possible 5. Today I receive another special gift ,a nice cake for Muslim festival (Eid Adha) I just want to say thanks a million for Mr.Umesh Shrestha for make my stay more comfortable and beautiful like my home Highly recommend to everyone who is looking for best hotel with quiet and peace.*big and clean room.*amazing view.*nice food.*all staff helpful with big smile.*great bed & pillow.I love to be here now Have a nice stay.‎في البداية انا املك عضوية بلاتينيوم في مجموعة فنادق IHG ‎حجزت بالفندق لمدة يومين وقررت أني أغادر بعد اليوم الاول والسبب ‎١- حسب مميزات عضويتي استحق ترقية مجانية الى غرفة اعلى من الغرفة اللي حجزتها وبالفعل أخذت الترقية ولكن الغرفة ما تقدر تفتح النافذة وزوجتي تتضايق من الدخان وطلبت منهم يغيرون الغرفة وغيروها ولكن بدون الترقية اللي استحقها ‎٢- فيش الكهرباء كان خارج من الجدار وخطر جدا جدا في حال لمس الأسلاك وطلبت منهم يغيروه اذا كانوا مهتمين بالحفاظ على ارواح النزلاء ‎٣- في الصباح وانا في المطعم أفطر وجاء واحد جرسون وأخذ الطبق من على طاولتي بدون ما يسألني اذا خلصت او لا وهذا الشي غير مقبول ابدا في فندق ٥ نجوم‎ولهذه الأسباب قررت أغادر وطلبت مقابلة المدير وجاني واحد اسمه اوميش Umesh Shrestha‎بصراحه هذا الرجل خدوم جدا ومحترم وفاهم عمله ويتكلم شوي عربي بحكم إقامته ٩ سنوات بالبحرين ‎بسبب هذا الرجل وأخلاقه مددت اقامتي ٥ ايام والمجموع اسبوع كامل ‎هذا الرجل أعطاني:‎١- ترقية مجانية الى غرفة كلوب وهذه من أفخم الغرف الموجودة ويوجد شطاف في دورة المياه.‎٢- هدية اعتذار عبارة عن كيك وشوكولاته ومكسرات.‎٣- موظفين المطعم تغيرت معاملتهم للافضل والأحسن ‎٤- وعدني يغير فيش الكهرباء ‎٥- يوم العيد ارسلي هدية كيكة مكتوب عليها عيد مبارك بصراحه قمة في الذوق ‎انا ودي اشكره لانه  قدم لي الكثير وصارت اقامتي احلى وأريح ‎انصح جميع الاخوان يتعاملون معاه شخصيا وراح انزل صور فيها كرته ورقمه ‎الفندق مريح وهادي ‎الغرف كبيرة ونظيفة ‎المنظر رائع من الغرفة ‎الاكل ممتاز ‎الموظفين محترمين وخدومين ومبتسمين دائما ‎السرير مريح والمخدات اريح ‎فعلا حبيت المكان بعد ما قابلت هذا المدير ‎تمنياتي لكم بإقامة سعيدة

I have been staying in this hotel for last five years, whenever I travel to Kathmandu for work.  Crowne Plaza Soaltee is spread over vast area and is maintained beautifully.  One can have a good morning walk on the path maintained around hotel, no need to go out outside on public road.There are two Casinos in the premises, if one wants to try luck.  These Casinos are strictly for foreigners.The hotel has three good restaurents serving Indian, Chinese and continental food.  Staff is courteous and prompt.Presently, the hotel is undergoing refurbishing, hence one wing is not allotted to guests.Should you wish to visit Kathmandu for fun or relaxation, this is the hotel to book your stay.

The hotel location is not too far away from the main market area. The hotel is well equipped with amenities and the staff is really cordial and helpful. There is variety and quality of food available. One problem is the elevator which stops at times, however it was informed by the staff that they are working on.. There is a seating area ahead of the reception which is the best asset of the hotel.. For the 9 days we stayed there, we spent quite a lot of time there relaxing and enjoying the weather... Lovely place...

Hotel bonito, con todas las comodidades y servicio excelente. Las habitaciones sin lujos pero sin faltarles nada. Gran variedad de opciones de restauración dentro del mismo hotel. Muy recomendable para turistas visitando la ciudad.

Fairly good hotel but was disappointed as I expected much more. It's a huge hotel with phenomenal area and landscaped garden. The rooms are good but many not very well maintained. Gym a disappointment and spa is a great disaster! After a tiring day this is a must but was frustrating to see the ambience and a very inefficient masseur. The banquets are good. So overall a very good place to conduct meetings or functions but I would stay somewhere else!

Was there for a 2 day stay. Tis nice, calm, quiet, safe place with good boundary wall securing the place and hotel zone. Staff are very good and try to help in every way possible. The hotels in the place are well equipped and clean. I could see many marriage functions happening in their hall..so it must be a well trusted place as well here eh ?Ok now,,they have to fix the walls a bit. I could hear my next door neighbour coughing, meaning he could possible hear me watching tv as well i guess or my alarm ringing. That must have been a convenience. Also the furniture is really old.They had some shops at the ground floor. Nice, but slightly expensive than outside the hotel. But i guess that is normal of sorts in such place. Has a bar right in front, but i wouldnt know anything cos i wasnt drinking from the place.Anyways..nice place. Would surely stay there again, possibly when i come to visit with my wife.

Let me start off by saying that I believe that on another occasion in another part of this big hotel, things might have been a lot better. We met with a large group of friends (500 of us) arriving at the hotel mainly over a period of 2 days. Reception was clearly not prepared and did a really lousy job at trying to get everybody checked in as fast as possible. Personally I had 3 people staying in line before me, which should not have been so bad, especially taking into account that everybody was pre-registered and that all dues were paid in advance. Novertheless, I had to wait 25 minutes. 3 counters, 4 hotel employees who could actually check you in, and at least 6 trainees that tried to make copies of passports and were getting in the each others way. After checking your payment, we were transferred to another person who checked your passport, then off to a person who was supposed to block an amount on your creditcard but actually charged it, to finally get the the person who gave you your key card. What a mess!My room was situated on the ground floor. The water in the toilet reached 2 cm under the toilet seat. I called reception who sent a plumber right away. He showed me a trick to get the water to a normal level. It consisted in having to flush 3 times, each time you would use the toilet. Afraid every single time everything might just overspill during the process... I had to wait 3 hours and call reception twice to get my Wifi connection going.The AC worked perfectly well. The closet doors didn't fit in the wall perfectly and were very difficult to open or close. The room had a good view on the front lawn of the hotel.Second night I woke up to set foot on a completely wet carpet. Water sipped from under my door (no idea where it came from, but it was a very rainy night). Again, service arrived quickly, and used tens of towels to try dry everything. Eventually, the next night, everything got back to normal, except for a bad stench in the room, that lingered on until I left. At no time did anybody suggest I should get another room.When I wanted to extend my stay for one more night, I was offered a price that was 40 dollars more expensive then a reservation I was able to make through Booking.com on the same day. Only after seriously complaining and asking for the manager, did they agree to do something for me.As we were in a group, some meals were included, others were not. We had badges, and each time we went to a restaurant that was not in charge of serving us our included meals, we were stopped. Each time we had to explain that we understood this, and that we would pay separately for our food. Apparently very difficult to grasp...The wake-up service worked fine. The conference rooms were well equipped but the AC took time to kick in.The party halls were very nice.The hotel bars were not prepared for the number of guests and run out of soft drinks, run out of ice, and even run out of some alcohol also resulting in long waiting times.In general the staff was not very friendly. It seemed like they were stressed out by the large number of active guests. It showed. It was not very professional. Again: although I'm sure that under other circumstances things would have been much better, this was a really bad stay. Won't be back here!
