Il est situé à deux pas d'un Casino, vous vous rendez dans le centre ville en tuk tuk ou en taxi, il y a un grand parc, avec des boutique en arrivant. les chambres sont grandes et confortable, les petit déjeuner le matin est très bien, surtout si vous aimez les options végétariennes, il y a du choix. Le personnel, comme d'habitude au Népal est charmant et disponible. A refaire !

Non vicinissimo all'aereoporto, considerato il traffico di Katmandu alle 4 del pomeriggio ci vuole un ora per fare 4 km, tenetene conto, decentrato rispetto a Thamel e Durban Square, il Wi-Fi non l abbiamo pagato ed era decente e sicuramente  migliore di altri posti si riesce anche a usare FaceTime, se potete fatevi dare la camera nella zona nuova le camere sono migliori e non hanno moquette, ottima colazione e cosa importante la piscina, un hotel che si avvicina ai nostri standard e anche ai nostri prezzi

It is a nice hotel. The room feels a bit dated. Rooms are clean and comfortable. Bed is comfy. You get 2 bottle water per person. Breakfast en lunch buffer is extensive and for everyone taste there is something to find. Without traffic it is about 30 minutes from the airport or patan durbar square (main cultural attraction). The surrounding of the hotel to a hit during the earthquake.

A great property. Love the ambience. Like any other hotel I have visited food quality is not constant. Its extraordinary at times but average otherwise. Don't no about the rooms, visited only for parties. Overall a great venue if u are lucky in terms of food quality.

Its amazing how all the staff treat their customers. So friendly and helpful. The rooms are good and WiFi sufficient, the gym decent and 3 good restaurants within the hotel. Satellite TV and the housekeepers do impeccable job toa maintain room clean.Location is  also good.

So my first trip to Nepal,  was kind of overwhelmed in getting here from the airport, so much mess and destruction everywhere,  but once inside a different world. Very friendly staff,  helpful with great English,  free wifi,  rooms are old and  dated but comfortable,  seems like there is a new wing,  with newer rooms,  but I didn't stay there. very nice grounds nice gardens and a very large swimming pool,  no shade though in the pool area. I'm told that this is the best hotel in Kathmandu and it is most probably correct.  Several restaurants in the hotel grounds and a casino for those who like this stuff. Cost was also very surprising,  my travel agent booked me the room for $110... One issue is that there was no breakfast included but there are ways around that. Don't count on getting out for a walk,  really nothing around here..

I am a member of "Club Soaltee" where members get to use hotel facilities like tennis courts and swimming pool. Renovations two years back put two very large generators just beside the tennis court and incredably with the very large exhaust pipes pointing straight at courts. With load shedding more than 14 hours per day that means very little time can be had on the courts without choking on exhaust. Complaints have fallen on deaf ears. And since last summer our weekends at the beautiful pool are also spoiled due the hotel's smoke stack, located in the rear of the building, smoke wafting in and out of the pool and garden area. Again complaints seem to fall on deaf ears with staff simply shrugging shoulders and saying "ke garne" or what to do?

I attended a cardiology conference BIT 2016 in conference hall for 1 day. The arrangement was excellent . Vice President of Nepal inaugurated the meeting. Central hub of the town called Thamel 20 minutes away from the hotel. Staffs are very helpful.

Buenas instalaciones y bastante personal pero todo un tanto decadente, las instalaciones mal indicadas (gim, piscina, spa, etc.) y el personal atento pero poco eficiente (excepto el del restaurante que es bastante agradable y servicial). Las habitaciones buen tamaño pero equipadas con desgana, había jabones, albornoz y zapatillas solo para una persona siendo dos. Intentaron ponernos en una abitacion junto a las torres de ventilación y logramos que nos cambiaran pero en una habitación de dos camas. En cuanto a la tranquilidad decir que hay mucho jaleo fruto de los congresos y reuniones de empresas, obras de alrededor y el casino.

Just completed a three nights stay at this hotel as a delegate to a conference held at the hotel.The journey from airport to hotel was about half hour, the journey from hotel to airport...on a Sunday morning...took over an hour; through chaotic streets.The hotel is over a large area. Several well maintained greens. Furniture indicated it was probably constructed in the 80s when heavy wood and brass were much used just hotel furnishings. That's absolutely fine, but very disappointed with housekeeping:1. My minibar fridge had moulds growing!2. Cigarette ash and crumbs of food under my bed, very easily visible from the sofa.3. One of the towels had brown stains.4. Bed post and table tops were not dusted properly.5. Don't think top of sofa back had ever been dusted!!6. Sachets of tea/coffee/sugar in the room were kept in haphazard manner.I mainly had room service food. Food quality was ok; not much sign of quality, but I got the impression they tried their best with the limited supply of quality ingredients or imported goods.The staff were warm and friendly. Whoever attended to me...from reception to bell desk to room service people...were helpful. They seemed to really try, that's more than many brands more luxurious than Crowne Plaza.I understand options are limited in Kathmandu, so one might not have much of a choice. If one has "appropriate" expectations from this property, one will be just fine.

We stayed here for three nights and it was truly enjoyable. Very friendly staff at every touch point — from the friendly doorman to the super quick porters and the express check in. This courteous and warm service continued for in room dining, house keeping as well as the restaurant staff.The rooms are clean, airy with good views of the hills surrounding the Kathmandu valley. The hotel is set on a large campus which felt very secure and spacious.And the complimentary wifi service was quick and available throughout the hotel.

Not only is the staff at the hotel helpful and friendly, but the staff in the Garden Terrace was extremely memorable. Great attention to detail and open to satisfying the guest any way possible. I even had the chance to trade recipes with the executive and main chefs at the restaurant. Ask Rajeev or Yuba Raj for the "Patatas Revolconas" if you want to try a spicy Spanish dish.

The service is wonderful and everyone is very attentive and helpful. They even will remember you by name and always greet you with your name. It is quite nice here. It is far out from the city so it isn't necessarily in the best location, but if you are wanting something further away from all the chaos then this is a great location. But traffic is pretty bad in the mornings and evenings around the area. Also, the masseuse is wonderful.

In kathmandu, this is one of the hotel I always prefer to stay on my business trips. Very helpful and friendly staff,excellent service and restaurant. A big casino is in the hotel itself, though I did not have the opportunity to visit it. On my recent trip I stayed in the newly made rooms, they are nice and has a modern look to it. Overall, a great place to stay.

Simplemente hermoso hotel, me encantaron sus habitaciones muy cómodas,limpias,la atención de todo el personal fabulosaaaa,el restaurant ofreció riquísima comida tanto el desayuno como la cena con variedad de platillos internacionales y muy buen sazón ,,,gracias x hacer de mi estancia algo ricoooo y fabuloso

Very courteous staff and a beautiful property with a great casino..Breakfast was awesome with a great service. Rooms were modernly done up. Excellent pillow options. The Indian speciality restraunt is very good.

Upscale modern hotel, great mountain view and vibrant gardens surrounding the open verandas, friendly wait staff, helpful concierges.Traffic in Kathmandu is killer and polluted, make sure to get yourself a mask if strolling within the city center or king's palace.

出張で2泊。空港へは無料迎車のサービスあり。自動車は新しく、街なかの渋滞も快適でした。部屋は清潔で空調もしっかり効いて快適です。シャワーだけですが給湯も問題なし。ホテルスタッフもとても親切で、レストランの紹介や車の手配やネクタイの調達までしてくれました。 携帯のSIMカードもロビー横のキオスクで購入、店員のおじさんが5分で交換してくれて大変助かりました。私は自動車での移動だけだったので、立地の不便さも感じませんでした。自動車は値段もリーズナブルでした。隣接するカジノは小ぶりですが、BJやポーカー、ルーレットと一揃えあり、カジノ内のステージでは美女のベリーダンスをやっていて、中々楽しかったです。次回の出張も多分ここを予約すると思います。

Quartos amplos e confortáveis, atendimento com muita cortesia, piscina, sauna, restaurantes, lojas.Café da manhã de ótima qualidade, fartamente oferecido.Serviço de câmbio para turistas hóspedes, o que facilita a vida para pequenas despesas realizadas nos passeios.Indico e recomendo !

Nicely built hotel with separate entry for banquet guests. There is one big casino in the hotel which is famous amongst the tourists. Hotel is IHG member and has all the facilities for a comfortable stay. Tip: opt for the rooms in the newly made wing, they are spacious and better looking.

Okay, so this is a Crowne Plaza and a hotel with a history in Kathmandu, but compared to a boutique cheapy I stayed in afterward, I wasn't very impressed. The meeting facilities were adequate and the food is good, but there ware a couple of things that really disappointed for the price.The in-room wifi was okay, when it worked. It frequently didn't work. It would drop out and not come back on for hours, or it would drop in and out making work impossible and browsing a frustrating experience.The other thing was the noise. I was just unlucky with the room, I guess, but considering I was one of the first at the conference to book in, they should have given me a better room and left mine empty or at least the last assigned. It was right above the diesel generator and since the power frequently went out it would start and stop often. It was uncomfortably loud.To be fair I was approached by hotel staff each morning at breakfast and asked how everything was. When I complained about the noise they suggested I could go to reception and asked for a different room. I had already unpacked for a week stay and didn't want to be bothered re-packing to relocate. I regretted that more and more as the week progressed.Finally, this hotel is a fair way from anything. It is a big compound that has a few shops, but no convenience store. So it was quite a walk to go to the shop for snacks or anything.On the plus side, my room was one that has been renovated recently and the bathroom was good. Great shower actually. The room was not large, but big enough. The bed was comfortable.

Stayed here for work in July 2016 for three weeks. The hotel is situated in a rather isolated location although only about a 15 min taxi ride from Thamel provided reasonable traffic. The hotel sits on a huge property with its neatly presented landscaped gardens. A very refreshing experience given the dustiness of Kathmandu proper.Rooms:Aged rooms but very generous in size. Newly refurbished bathrooms with good lighting. Large windows, sofa and a desk all within the room. Slightly weird that the sofa is located in the opposite direction of the TV and the desk is also facing away from the TV. InternetPoor wifi signal in my room which made it very difficult to have Skype calls back home or for work. Wifi seemed to work fine in the lobby with a strong signal.Gym:Probably one of the WORST gyms I have frequented at all IHG hotels. It's small, poorly equipped, no ventilation, poorly lit and worst of all, wooden floor which makes equipment such as bench slide. Quite dangerous really. Please please improve the gym given how pricey the hotel rates are. There's also a sauna and outdoor pool I believe but didn't test it outLocationNot much around but then again, it wasn't that far by taxi to anywhere in Kathmandu unless there's traffic. Dining option outside of the hotel is very limited and mainly just local Nepali food.BreakfastLimited choice but the staff working at the restaurant was so nice and efficient. Really appreciate the morning coffee as well as the take away coffee that was generous prepared for me every morning.Overall, a suitable hotel for a long business trip. However rating downgraded due to the extremely poor gym facility - hugely disappointing. Fantastic staff though who were always willing to help.

We stayed here at the beginning our trek and at the end of the trek. This hotel is not near the Tamil shopping center and I was quite fine with that . Tamil is a very busy, dusty and somewhat dirty area and I was only too happy to stay away from there. This hotel is in a quiet, more upmarket residential area so it is quite peaceful and you don't hear the relentless traffic. It is an older hotel and the older part is quite old, some of the sockets are still the very old ones and the new ones in our room did not work. Rooms are not that big but sufficient. Bathroom is ok , nothing fancy here at least in the older wing we stayed. They were starting a major renovations when we left so some upgrades are happening. Gardens were nice and the swimming pool was welcome relief. We were very grateful of the many restaurants that were on the premises since we did not want to tackle the traffic after a long day of sightseeing .

Was supposed to stay at the Crowne Plaza for three nights but left after one due to number of issues.I need internet access to get my work done. The hotels DNS was misconfigured at some point and the connection worked so-so after designated Google's open ones.I had DND hanging on the door and was disturbed twice.Was upgraded to an Executive floor based on the Spire Elite status with IHG. Not sure what the "executive" was.Did like the fruit, nuts, chocolates and cookies left.This is not up to Crowne Plaza standards. It is at best a Holiday Inn. Fair assessment would be three stars and I deducted one for the issues I had.

Crowne Plaza Soaltee is the best choice when it comes to Hotels in Kathmandu! It is like a huge villa surrounded by restaurants, a casino, pool, a garden to walk in! Its beautiful at night, and the staff is so friendly that you feel at home. The rooms are good, spacious and clean.Might be less modern than other Crowne Plaza around the world but it suits the Nepalian spirit!!I would recommend CP Soaltee for business and family trips :-)

Its a lovely property with sprawling greenery around it. Fabulous entrance and serene sitting area just before the main lobby. Lovely to just unwind. Superb Chinese restaurant, China Garden, with excellent staff, great food. Went out of their way to cater to our special requests and suggest variations. Kakori, Indian restaurant was good too. Breakfast spread could be better. As for the hotel service, unfortunately disappointed. The front office staff needs to be more receptive and warm. They could just not handle the crowd and appeared lost. And most disappointing was we actually had someone try to enter our room at night. Room service and housekeeping disappointing, could not cater to the  needs. Paid WiFi that was not great at all. For IHG standards, disappointing service levels.

Our stay at Soaltee from 18/22 june was a superb experience with family.The ambience at the hotel is excellent, food and the choice of restaurants are plenty.When it comes to stay in Kathmandu Soaltee is the best choice.Well maintained swimming pool and the garden makes it more beautiful.Saloon and Spa are reasonably priced.Great experience overall.

Me faltó tiempo para conocer Katmandú, por eso tengo que volver!!! El hotel está genial, el trato maravilloso!!! la comida muy rica.Al llegar desde la India, Katmandú me pareció un remanso de paz y tranquilidad, aunque no supe lo que era eso hasta llegar más cerca de la cordillera del Himalaya. Sin duda un país que me dejó un buen sabor de boca y al que volveré.

The Soaltee Crowne Plaza Kathmandu is a lovely hotel, just not centrally located. However, a short taxi ride of about 10 to 15 minutes for a few Nepalese rupees (US$) will get you to the action, i.e, shopping and restaurant areas.The staff and service was excellent and the staff went out of their way to make you welcome and see to your every need. The food was good with a decent variety of food sections, i.e. Asian, and western style delicacies. The internet connection was very good and fast, which was a delight for a change. The TV selection in English for our room was surprisingly good for Kathmandu.The only problem was the room itself. The beds for the three of us were single beds and most uncomfortable. Very hard and uncomfortable. The room seemed crammed and needed a bit upgrading. At the end of the day we’ll stay at the Soaltee Crowne Plaza Kathmandu our next visit to Kathmandu, albeit with a better, larger and more comfortable room and beds.

All over hotel has large area but walking all over it can be most tiring thing. Excellent casino but it takes effort to walk from hotel to there. The hotel should get some kind of shuttle from casino to hotel.Free wifi is also a needed facility.

This time we had a gambling holiday where day in and day out we were at the hotel casino only. 5 stars to casino for the maintainence of class and cleanliness.Hotel suprisingly serves excellent Punjabi food,  although the cost is on a very high side but it's worth it.The pool side is excellent and the lawns are huge. Room quality is also good.The only drawback with this hotel is that there is no game zone for kids.

Stayed in this property from three days during a business trip. Booking was indrest through some local travel agent, property is really nice with big campus, lobby, garden, restaurant. Room are of good size and with ok amenities, breakfast was good with a full spread and lot of options. Negatives:- not in the central location, check in was slow it took around 20 minutes, pest control seemed improper as noticed small cockroach in the room was reported to house keeping, in one of the room window opening was not smooth, some renovation work was going on due to which not of noise disturbance was there during day time. Overall a satisfactory stay

a special note of thanks to the team at Soaltee Crowne Plaza, esp. the Duty Manager Srijin Sharma, entire front office & staff of the Garden Terrace restaurant, made our stay great with their warm hospitality. Would love to come back

Having been travelling in Sikkim and staying in some lovely heritage hotels, it was a bit of a shock coming to this international hotel. Its main raison d'être seems to be as a wedding venue and the wedding band rehearsing all afternoon didn't make for a restful experience. The deluxe room was fine and well-appointed and the buffet breakfast was good. The check-in took ages and the woman who was on duty was very offhand. When I complained a much more friendly man offered a free drink in the bar which was a nice gesture. The pros of this hotel are that it has green space and is away from the pollution of the city. The cons are that if you are staying on a B & B basis there is nowhere around to eat out and you either have to take a cab through the horrendous traffic or eat in at the expensive restaurants. If you like these sort of international enclaves, fine, but I wouldn't be returning.

The hotel is a sort of closed compound in the city of Kathmandu with it's own collection of shops restaurants and other services. The shops are actually reasonably priced and the breakfast is fine.Service is OK, a little aloof but overall helpful. There's a money exchange that gives good rates.The elevators are old and will not work at random times. The rooms are fine, a bit oddly laid out with a weird window from the bathroom that looks into the room but is glassed off. I found a roach in the bathroom but otherwise the room was clean. The biggest pain is that the internet is very expensive 900 for one day that's about 9 dollars. Also if you buy internet for your room that doesn't transfer to the business lounge where you have to buy it again. Overall a nice and "fancy" hotel but there's little cracks in the facade that bring down the score for me.

Well my stay at this hotel wasnt so great. Hotel looks good.. rooms are amazing but the prob was i found too many insects on bed and on floor too and the light of this hotel goes on and off after quite some interval.The hotel is about 20 mins drive away from the city. Taxis are readily availible at gates and yu can exchange currencies from hotel itself and rates the provide are more or less same from outside.

i have been to kathmandu atleast six times and stayed in the same hotel . The hotel is renovated and now they have new rooms with better amenities. one of the best food is served in the place with great service and very friendly staff. The rooms are excellent and the property is huge so we have lots of greens and places to explore. The Place has best casino in asia Mahjong. The mountain view room on higher levels are amazing.

It's a good hotel to stay in with a nice view and with very quite environment, no noise of traffic so no pollution as well and full of privacy. I enjoyed staying here, the only problem is bit far from the city or shopping malls, other wise is a very good place to relax and if you like gambling then it is the best place to stay in Kathmandu is it has Mahjong Casino, one of the biggest in Asia, the only thing I didn't like is, you have to pay for WiFi, it should have been free...

Taking into consideration what happened to Kathmandu one year ago, this is maybe the best place you can stay. Personnel are very kind and helpful and they will do anything to make you satisfied and happy. For example, I just returned from the city and wanted to buy some fruit in a local shop (where you must pay in cash) but I still had to pay my room service. So the reception gentleman suggested that I go and buy fruit and then when I return, to give him all Nepali money and pay the rest by my card. Since I do not know when I am going to be back in Nepal again, this was extremely convenient for me since I did not want to stay with much Nepali money. :D Small thing but meant a lot to me.

To make it clear the staff are super nice !! Now got to the room open sheets full of bugs :/ I called reception took 30 mins to come! Not to even change my room just to change the mattress!! Very bad experience!!!

Buon albergo, anche se sotto standard europeo, posizionato bene anche in funzione dell'aeroporto internazionale, dotato di camere sufficientemente confortevoli. Carissimo il WIFI e non giustificato in quanto per i turisti è l'unico mezzo per comunicare con amici e familiari.

The hotel is adequate, although probably on the lowest tier of 5 star hotels.  The location of the hotel is not particularly good and a taxi is required to go almost anywhere.  My real difficulty with this property is that the hotel guests are treated as if they are just in the way of the uber wealthy Nepalis who hold their parties here.  Both nights I was here there were huge wedding parties who overwhelmed the property and were extremely noisy late in to the night.  Requesting relief from hotel management yielded no results.  I will not stay at this property again.

I have stayed several times in this hotel and what blows my mind every time is the kindness of the employees. The service is amazing they anticipate your needs before you even think or dare asking. And of course the food is excellent !! Well done Crown Plaza staff !!

El exterior del hotel es tipo complejo ajardinada, con casino incluido. Tranquilo. La comida en general mala.La habitación que nos dieron tenia vistas a las torres de ventilación o eso parecía, porque a ventana estaba tan sucia que apenas se veia el exterior.Me dijeron que allí se hospedan la gente importante. No se, nosotros íbamos en un circuito de Special Tours que pagamos la categoria lujo, la más cara. Y de lujo nada. Además esta muy apartado.

Decent place to stay, for me the location was a little out of the way, but it was nice. Small beds. Executive Lounge is nice, but they don't tell you if you have access or not, so you may have to ask as they will not tell. I would stay there again, mainly because I travel with IHG.

As toalhas de banho estavam sujas, as cortinas de banho manchadas e o comando da tv por baixo dos lençóis. O staff 5 estrelas, sempre disponível O pequeno almoço é ok Para uma cidade tão pobre o hotel está muito bom

قمت بالإقامة فيه ليلة واحدة ثم انتقلت إلى فندق آخر وذلك بسبب عدم وجود شطاف في دورة المياه.الفندق جيد وهادئ ويتميز بإطلالة على حديقة جميلة لم يكن هناك ازدحام كثيرا ويقع وسط المدينة وحوالي نصف ساعة من المطار

We came here last year with my friends.really a nice place.actually we came here to do a short video with my friends as we were departing apart.all the staffs were so nice.they greet u nicley even i  the elevator.food was nice.hoping to vist here once again

Visited Nepal for the 1st time and stayed at this property. The grounds are immense, and well kept. The hotel building itself is slightly old, but i guess that's the charm about the place. Rooms were clean.Only couple of minor complaints were the spotty and slow wi-fi and the low pressure of the showers.Otherwise, service delivery was fantastic. The Nepalese are a very hospitable people.Would definitely return and stay here.

Приходилось бывать в этом отеле дважды: до и после землятресения в Катманду. Надо сказать, что несмотря на топливный кризис, а также повреждения, полученные в результате землятресения, отель быстро восстанавливается. В момент моего второго визита, все ещё велись ремонтные работы, надеюсь, они скоро завершатся. Что касается комнат, просторные и уютные, по приезде вам предоставляется фруктовая тарелка и вода. В отеле есть бассейн и тренажёрный зал, а также спа-салон и несколько магазинов. Что касается цен, для Непала недёшево, но вполне приемлемо, уровень обслуживания, несмотря ни на что, остаётся высоким. Также посетила маникюрно-парикмахерский салон. Видно, что ситуация с клиентурой оставляет желать лучшего, я была единственной посетительницей. От отеля можно взять такси, примерно 700 рупий и 15-20 минут до Тамеля (это если без траффика). До аэропорта минут 40-50. В общем, все понравилось, особенно улыбчивый и приветливый персонал, встречающий вас "Намасте" и лёгким поклоном, несмотря ни на какие бедствия.

This is a hotel that needs some TLC!  Stayed for three nights, first visit to Nepal. Contrary to what another person has written, wifi IS free. The whole hotel though needs a thorough renovation. Due to the fuel and food crisis, only 2 of 4 restaurants open, but the coffee shop has a good varied menu. The room had everything you need, but it just feels a little run down. Bouncy bed....not good, and bouncy pillows too, even worse!  Cleanliness could be addressed -someone had used the mugs for tea, and they had not been cleaned, merely turned upside down again - not good!However, the staff were all very pleasant, and eager to please which makes up for a lot!

Stayed here during the fuel crisis in Nepal. But the quality and high standards of this hotel did not let me realise the crisis. Everything was upto the mark.The food is delicious, unlike 5 stars (which is bland). The amenities are world class.Enjoyed my stay.

You wont believe that you are in that busy city Kathmandu after reaching this hotel. Superb place with nicely maintained garden. It has all the facilities. Busy with tourists and provide great service. A few minutes drive to main city area where all attractions located.

Thia hotel is very good. Very good service and excellent breakfast.   Highly recommended.  We started for 2 nites and although Nepal was going thru major power and fuel issues.   This hotel managed to provide power and very importantly the hot water thru out the day.

I didn't stay here, but spending 5 days here having a meeting. The meeting facilities were very good and the staff were also very helpful. I can say that this place is fantastic, combining of modern and classic touch. I am looking forward to be here as staying guest. The Garden Terrace restaurant serves a fantastic menu, the chef took pride in their creation by approaching the guest and ask their personal opinion about the food served.

Huge grounds in good location close to local  shops.....3 restaurants in the complex we ate at the Indian which was great.....we had room service from the Chinese which was also good.....and good value as it is difficult to get out of a night there with no street lights....so this was a great place to stay the hotel service and staff are first rate....

カトマンズの中心部から南西に歩くこと 4〜5 km ほどの場所にある IHG 系ホテル。Google 先生に尋ねるとホテル通用門からの侵入を推薦されるので注意が必要。Ganeshman Singh Path を通って Soltee Mod の T 字路から入ると良い。この通りからの入口がまた分かりづらいので注意が必要。本ホテルの看板すぐそばにあるホテルは別ホテルである。さて、IHG ホテルであるからステータスを持っている人は恩恵を被ることができる。SPIRE ステータスの場合、カクテルタイムに軽食が提供される。朝食付きプランで予約していようとしていまいと、朝食が提供される。逆に、SPIRE ステータス保有者で朝食付きプランを選択してしまうととんだ無駄になってしまうのでこれまた注意が必要である。ホテルのサービスは非常にクオリティが高い。スタッフがみな高い意識でホスピタリティを提供しようとするのが伝わってくる。僕が宿泊したのは金曜日だったのだが、結婚式が催されていたようで、夕方からけたたましく、しかしわくわくするような音楽が大音響で生演奏され、ちょっとしたこの地方の風俗を体験できた気がした。部屋のクオリティはハイアット・リージェンシー・カトマンズにどうしても劣ってしまうのだが (ハイアットだとバスタブまであるが本ホテルはシャワーのみである) ビジネスユースであればさほど不便を感じないし、仕事をするのに十分な機能が提供されている。もよりの観光施設としてはスワヤンブナートやダルバール広場が近い。

My stay from 28 dec 2015 to 04 jan 2016 was a memorable one.The hotel had organsed a new years bash which was quite enjoyable and vallue for money.The service and the staff courtesy was excellent.Specially would like to thank Ms Bijayata who went out of the way to help me.

Went there for a review meeting. Beautiful place and amazing breakfast buffet. Great place to stay for conferences, with family, friends etc. Slightly pricey though. Very friendly staff. And shops and local  eating joints in vicinity.

its great hotel. stuff are nice and friendly. there are few restaurant in the same complex with great food, it was really comfortable stay in this hotel, the only bad thing is that it's far from center

For not giving up and trying to keep up with the company standards under such dire circumstances  Nepal has to deal with after the earthquake and the oil shortage.The whole town is in shambles but you wouldn't know from inside this well maintained property. Rooms are clean and charming but plumbing is slow but this is understandable.The outdoor pool was damaged and one of the restaurants was closed due to oil shortage.Inside the main hotel the Chinese restaurant serves delicious food and breakfast which is served  in a different area is pretty good and adequate.The hotel is located in a good neighborhood and the property is guarded 24/7. For people who enjoy gambling there is even a casino next to the hotel that is if you can tolerate the additional smoke ! If you visit Kathmandu this hotel in my opinion is the only decent option right now..

We stayed here for three nights whilst on a tour of India and Nepal. Our stay was greatly enhanced by the friendliness of all the staff. Despite the trying situation of the Earthquake and blockade the hotel functions seemlessly. As our first room was opposite the hotel generator, which was being used more than normal we were moved across the corridor with no fuss at all. We had already been upgraded to a club room which was very kind of the hotel. The staff are well trained , helpful, friendly and delightful. The food in the restaurant was first class, from burgers to curry to pizza...we tried them all....the taste was great. We will certainly come back when we are next in Kathmandu.

We had a great time at the casino and it was more fun since its within the hotel premises. We really enjoyed our stay at the hotel. I believe the hotel has been recently renovated although the bathroom seemed a little dated.The food and service is good.

Un hotel asiatico de lujo, tradicional. Para destacar: si te gusta la comida india puedes disfrutar de varias opciones en el buffet, y tambien con opciones internacionales. En este tipo de paises agradezco mucho la tranquilidad, y este lugar me brindo la calma que necesitaba.

Over 10 years ago, I stayed here and really nothing has changed.The 5th floor has been renovated, the rest of the hotel is slowly falling apart.I was in Suite 334, the furnishing and decor long overdue for renovation.What the hotel lacks in appearance is made up by very good and friendly services, especially the front office and IT management.They should remove their ridiculous wifi charges.

You need to understand the context in which this review is set.  At the time of the review, Nepal was/is under a virtual blockade in the south of the country due to an ongoing political issue surround the proposed constitution.  Fuel for cooking, heating and transport is scarce and supplies are very limited.  I entered the country aware of this and was very prepared for a challenging few days, even staying at a hotel of this standard.  I was amazed at how little impact the outside situation had on my stay at the hotel.  Although all the speciality restaurants are closed, the remaining main restaurant is open and the food was excellent.  The staff are doing an amazing job given the situation for the average citizen of Kathmandu.  Be aware that power is limited in Nepal and especially so at the moment, so be prepared for several short blackouts during which the generator kicks in.  Although the rooms are basic, they are spacious and comfortable.  WiFi isn't exceptional but adequate.  Given everything that is going on, the hotel is doing a great job keeping up to a standard  that is often missed in the west.  A special thanks to the staff who were very friendly and couldn't do enough to help.  I encourage readers to visit Nepal and support this wonderful country - and stay at this property!

Très bon hotel de catégorie supérieure et surtout au calme ; un atout majeur dans Kathmandou très agité et pollué. Le personnel est charmant les chambres très confortables et la literie parfaite. Seules les salles de bain sont un peu "datées" et auraient besoin d'une sérieuse rénovation. Nous avons apprécié de rentrer le soir à l'hôtel, voire dîner sur place, tant la ville est agitée ! Les problèmes d'essence en raison de l'embargo par l'Inde de l'approvisionnement en pétrole, n'arrangeant pas la situation bien évidement. Bouchons cauchemardesques devant les pompes à essence. En conséquence augmentation des prix du taxi !Ravis néanmoins de notre séjour, les sites touristiques étant pour la plupart en bon état suite au tremblement de terre d'avril 2015.

Well, if you want to eat good food, this is not the place. Secondly the money you pay for room is just not the value you get... room amenities are so pathetic. so is the quality of room. Service is 3/5.... so make sure before you make your bookings.

I was there for NRNA Global conference for four days. Great venue for conference but car park didn't seem big enough. Food was great, vide selection in buffet dishes and few nice desserts. Well staffed for big occasion, and they were helpful and brilliant.

Это не 5ка. Отель дотягивает до уверенной 3ки. Мебель старенькая, платный! средненький wi fi, дорогущие завтраки. Рестораны на территории не стоят своих денег. За пределами отеля естественно ничего нет, надо брать такси. Из положительного, чистота, площадь отеля, удобная постель, душь в номерах с душем.

I stayed in this hotel- which is meant to be one of the best in Kathmandu as part of a tour around Nepal. The rooms were nice, if a bit dated, but the hotel overall had lovely grounds and great restaurants- the Chinese restaurant was definitely our favourite for dinner and the buffet breakfast was the best that we had in Nepal.  One could walk out of the hotel and turn right into the little town, but there wasn't much to see, other than the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu.  The location is not great- it's quite far from all of the main sites and as we were there during the fuel crisis, it was quite expensive to travel around.  If you like luxury and want to be closer to local sites, I think that the Hyatt is placed in a better location.  The staff gave very good service and it was a pleasure to stay in this hotel, but there was no free wi-fi- you could get it by paying.

Un hermoso hotel, decorado con excelente gusto, cómodo y tranquilo. Un lugar relajado, rodeado de parques verdes, para descansar luego de recorrer las ruidosas y polvorientas calles de la ciudad, que resulta abrumado y mágica.

Staying at the Soaltee was very nice. The room was very nice. A very nice bathroom with beautiful shower and good hot water. The service staff were wonderfully attentive without being intrusive. The staff genuinely seemed pleased to have you there. The buffet breakfast was outstanding, both in terms of selection and quality. One of the managers asked me if I would like some juice after I sat with my breakfast plate one day. I said yes, please, some orange juice. She took a while to return and when she did she had two glasses of OJ. She apologized and said they had run out of OJ and she had the staff squeeze some fresh for me! I ate outside most days, and I'm not sure how they did it, but there were no birds trying to steal food. A thoroughly pleasant stay. It may be the first time I have felt that I was leaving friends when I finished my last breakfast there.

The hotel lives up to its name. The hotel premises are beautiful with a scenery of the mountains. Approx. 30 min from the airport. 15 min walking distance from most of the key tourist destinations in the city. Wifi was available, cordial staff and got complimentary cute pasteries everyday!

We stayed in this hotel for one night only but would have loved to stay for more.  It is a wonderful revelation as you drive through Kathmandu and then turn into a gated area where the hotel is situated.  It was lovely and more than the 4* it is stated to be.The rooms were lovely and big and furnished tastefully.  The hotel staff were really helpful and we were given free wifi as we were only staying one night which was an added bonus.  We could not go out that night to any restaurants because of the petrol crisis so decided to stay and eat in the in-house Chinese restaurant.  We did not want to do this but were so glad we did!!  This is the best Chinese meal we have ever had, eating things we had never had before as well.  The prices are about the same as London, it is not the cheapest place, but well worth the money.  I would highly recommend this restaurant.All in all this is a beautiful hotel to visit and I would highly recommend this if you are visiting Nepal.

Stayed 3 nights as part of one of the few tour groups still including Nepal on their itineraries & was glad of the opportunity, brief though it was. The Crowne Plaza Soaltee was an oasis in the midst of the human tragedy being played out in the streets of the city as it recovers from April's earthquake and deals with the recent fuel crisis. While the property may show a little wear and tear, it more than compensates by delivering a seamless guest experience which has not been replicated in the course of our month-long travels in the region. Staff members were professional, efficient, and friendly and Muna, Guest Relations, went above & beyond. The Chinese restaurant was expensive but the food was memorable. Tasty dhosas at breakfast. Not much to do in the area outside the grounds, just a few dusty souvenir shops along with others selling snacks and surpringly, reasonably priced imported wines.

20-30 minutes from the airport. Large complex with nice, friendly staff. But the charges are towards the higher side. WiFi is available, but expensive. Breakfast is OK. They have some good restaurants in the complex. But one leaves with the feeling that they more than what it is worth

One of the good hotels in Kathmandu,  good service,  good food and good rooms.  recent bollywood movie of akshay kumar have also been shot here in this hotel. Perfect location near shops and restaurants, overall good facilties for the price. Overall would recommend!!!

I stayed in July and August and the Soaltee works magic to continue excellent, hospitable service and a great menu in spite of earthquake damage and the fuel shortage in October, when I visited for a meal. The beauty salon downstairs does a beautiful and long-lasting pedicure - but get your hair cut elsewhere.Gorgeous, manicured grounds.

The night we checked in, it was past midnight, and it turned out that we had to change our room immediately as the AC was not working properly and the room was stiflingly hot. Others in our party had to order extra blankets, as their room was very cold. The hotel staff resettled us quickly without fuss or delay. The room had its plusses though there were some quirks. The plusses - quiet location, nice size room and bathroom, nice view, reasonably fast wifi (paid), good lighting, desktop extension cord with outlets that fit most international plugs, and English language movie and news channels on the TV.  The quirks - the toilet bowl filled almost to the rim when flushing, and looked like it would overflow each time you flushed. It didn't, and as it turned out, they all worked that way. The room had an iron an ironing board, but they were connected to each other, which made it particularly cumbersome to get out of the closet to use and move to the nearest outlet across the room.  The iron proceeded to leak all over the dress I was trying to press, so I had to abandon that effort and wear something else. The dated wall-mounted hairdryer in the bathroom looked like something you'd find at a garage sale.  There was also bedside lighting switch set up that looked like it dated back to the mod 60s, though I must say it got the job of controlling the many lights in the room done. And lastly, the mattress is a tad too firm for me. Despite any of this, this hotel was a comfortable place to stay. There were periodic power outages while we were there due to outside issues, but the hotel generators kicked in relatively quickly to remedy the interruptions. The food in the restaurant was really good, and the hotel staff were delightfully helpful and responsive. The grounds on the property are lovely and maintained by women in traditional uniforms. The shops in the basement were all very reasonably priced and provided a comfortable, stress less shopping experience. Not the fanciest place to stay in Kathmandu, but a very pleasant option.

Our check in and out were seamless. From start to finish we were treated like special guests. Our room was very comfortable with plenty of towels and amenities for all three of us. The breakfast buffet was very well presented and had a wide variety of choices. It is a lovely facility with a very friendly staff. Only downside, the restaurants don't open until 7:30. We were hard pressed to wait that long and that is just the trouble of travel sometimes. We didn't starve and planned for the late dinner from there on.

Nothing special in this average hotel.  Was a fine hotel in past perhaps but generally run down now.  Renovated rooms are nice.  Rooms not renovated are really outdated and in need of repair.  Staff are generally cold, with some nice exceptions.  Food buffet for breakfast is very good and meals otherwise are good also.  Entrance cracked during earthquake taking forever to repair.  Construction on back restaurant veranda where could be very pleasant makes too noisy to use.  Location not great as nothing around.  Gym in basement is minimal and needs updating.  Functions like weddings and receptions seem to keep this place alive and hard to deal with taxis and move around these events when happen.

Stayed at the Hyatt and Crown Plaza on this trip to Kathmandu.  Definitely better rooms and service at Crown Plaza.  Everyone greets you with a smile and Namaste.  Down to earth and sincerely friendly from the door staff to front counter to the restaurant to the club lounge to the house keeping lady ... Everyone was helpful and treat you like a valued guest,  Rooms are spacious, clean and bright and the plug-in's were high so you can charge your devices on the desk or night table.  Nice good quality soap and shampoo and even set of toiletry items like tooth brush, shaver etc.  Little things that make it stand out from other 5 star hotels.  I am very impressed and would definitely stay there again next time I am back!

Good property and such locations will assist boosting up the local economy especially after the devastation of earthquake. They have a good pick up facility from airport. The staff is very friendly and handles every guest in detail.

Rooms are small like all Crown Plaza but staff at Restaurants, front desk, housekeeping, concierge - all very professional and pleasant.  Breakfast very good variety, buffet dinner, the excellent Alfresco Italian restaurant - one of my favorites not to be missed for those who like Italian food.

Hotel Soaltee Crowne Plaza is located at the heart of Kathmandu city  and yet has a lot of space inside with trees. It is probably one of the oldest Luxury hotels of Kathmandu and undoubtedly the best in terms of facilities and space.The rooms are spacious with comfortable bed and with all necessary accessories. The furnitures inside the room looks dated though they look classic. The rooms have WiFi with good signal strength. They have 3-4 restaurants and one of them serve good Indian food. The breakfast is complementary and has very good spread. The hospitality of the staffs are worth mentioning. Starting from reception to Housekeeping and in Restaurants; everywhere you will find the smiling faces willing to help you eagerly.They have newly opened casino in a separate building with live dance and song show, which i could not visit due to paucity of time.The pool and main entrance was closed due to some repair.

My husband and I stayed at the Crowne Plaza on 8th September for 3 days.  We were originally booked into another hotel which was still damaged from the earthquake, but this was a brilliant upgrade.  The hotel was indeed spectacular.  The only sad part was their pool had been damaged, naming where we were to Kathmandu, 'Nopool'.  However, we were too busy seeing the sights in our short time.  The hotel is set in 12 acres of grounds and only a cheap taxi drive away from Durbar Square.  The staff were all just brilliant.

I was staying with my friends in nepal but we went to visit the casino. we had an early dinner there, the chef went out of his way to prepare some dishes with less spices as we had a year old baby with us. after that we played at the casino. very beautifully done up casino with fantastic staff it is a very big hotel that the casino is located in but again at the entrance there are 5 to 6 huge steps but no slope for accessibility of a wheelchair but in and around hotel it was wheelchair accessible there was a lift to go up to the casino and that was a big relief. yes the main attraction at the casino was d bollywood dances that were going on a stage in one corner of the casino. it was nice to watch the nepalese dance on bollywood music.

After arriving into Kathmandu, with my luggage still sitting in Doha, I made my way to an AirBnB that I had booked. Exhausted and desperately needing a shower, I decided to nap first, but just as I collapsed onto the bed, I saw bugs crawling on the sheets. I knew I could not stay there another minute, let alone two weeks. Realizing I needed to upscale, I chose Crown Plaza Soaltee. The warmth of their greeting upon my arrival was unrivaled. Muna, the Duty Manager, was a godsend. Everything I needed, Muna provided for me. First and foremost, I needed my luggage. Muna said that the Crown Plaza airport representative could collect it from the airport and bring it to my room on their next run to the airport. I needed a SIM card and Muna said the gift store could provide me with one. Muna even copied my passport, which is required to obtain a SIM card. As part of the hotel policy, the Crown Plaza Soaltee provides single women with rooms closest to the elevator and they do not release the room number to anyone. Having traveled to many cities in many countries, I have stayed at many hotels. I can honestly say that the Soaltee, mostly due to Muna, offers the best customer service that I have ever received.

Stayed at this hotel for two weeks and my experience was good. It has everything a good and up to date hotel should have. People are really helpful and genuine. Attends to your needs and tries to provide a solution immediately. Wi-Fi is absolutely terrible, but I think that is to do with the country's infrastructure and not the hotels. Breakfast buffet and the other meals at the hotel is really nice. Comparatively pricy but I think its worth it.

This is my 4th time in Crowne Plaza and it's my first after the massive earthquake. The hotel seems to be undamaged by the earthquake looks good as ever. This hotel is situated little isolated in Kathmandu opposed to many other star hotels. But it is with a beautiful large landscape one might enjoy during the summer. For some reason all the time I haves stayed in the ground floor which is good. The rooms are old but in good condition with all the facilities. Room sizes are average. If you want to have a good view of the garden  better take 5th or 4th floors. 20s and 30s are away from the lift and staircase so if you like quick access to the lobby and restaurants better avoid those. There was a beautiful pool but not it is under renovations. Breakfast is served in one of the large restaurants with a good choice of Nepali, Indian, Chinese and continental stuff. I ended up with overeating of spicy stuff and every day had good gym sessions. The small gym is free for guests and situated in the basement. You may distracted a little with the Casino of the hotel which is also good to have an experience of Nepali Casinos.

Let me begin my review with the positives -1. Very warm and friendly staff2. Rooms are spacious and are maintained neat & tidy3. Bathrooms are very clean4. There are 4 restaurants in this property and all of them are good! Especially in the one which serves buffet breakfast, you tell the staff your food preferences on day 1 and they will remember it during your entire stay duration and no need to repeat it :)5. Room service is really quick and efficientOn the flip side -1. After a couple of hours delay in landing at Kathmandu [not blaming the hotel for this ;) ], the courteous hotel staff with your name board calls the driver and your approx. 45 min. to 1 hour journey to the hotel begins! Within a few minutes, you realize that on a hot, sunny, smoky (due to vehicle pollution) afternoon, the taxi AC's won't be switch ON as hotel as instructed their drivers so. Even after insisting that it is getting really nauseating, the driver still not turn it ON and then you call up the hotel and literally explain it a few times (coz they will keep transferring the call, for reasons better known to them) then the driver would obey their command! I haven't faced it in any other part of the world. May be it is a norm in Kathmandu and people who frequently travel to Kathmandu are accustomed to this. But, I wasn't :(. Hotel was kind enough to waive off the airport pick-up bill and also upgraded me to a next higher level room type.2. As if my tryst with the cab wasn't enough, in the upgraded room allotted to me on the club floor, within half an hour of check-in water started dripping near the wardrobe and I had to get myself changed to another room. Later on I learnt it was due to some issue with the air conditioner that the water was dripping. Isn't it the hotels responsibility to look after these aspects before allotting rooms to guests?3. On the last nights of my 3N stay at about 4:30 AM some strange nose (as if someone is hammering or driving a screw) started and it was growing louder and louder to disturb the sleep. After I switched ON the lights and started searching for the source of the noise it gradually stopped. After the initial fantastic experiences, I didn't even bother to report this to the hotel staff.To sum up it was a one-off experience . . .!General Information:Due to the after effects of the earthquake many places in Kathmandu are still undergoing redevelopment works and this hotel is also in such a phase. I saw that the pool wasn't yet available for use and some construction work happening almost round the clock.

Make sure you get the breakfast buffet included in your room you won't want to miss it. Excellent stuff clean rooms with good beds and decor  depicting classic Nepal. We are scheduled for a three night stay at the end of our trip and I'm really looking forward to it.

I have been to hotel for couple of time for wedding parties but never stayed in the hotel. This time i spent couple of days and I enjoyed every bit of it. People are very nice, caring and helpful. The rooms are fine, clean and comfortable with good sleep. Food is usually good but the cook needs to be trained how to cook spaghetti and pasta though. There is room to improve quality of filtered coffee as they lack special aroma.

Absolutely enjoyed this property. Despite some minor cosmetic works due to the April 2015 earthquake that effected most of Kathmandu, the hotel was in good nostalgic shape. The decor and furniture could be improved but the hotel itself gives a soft reminder that you are in Nepal (I like that). The staff did a phenomenal job to recognize my IHG status upon check-in and during my stay. Welcome drink. Personalized souvenir gift and welcome letter from the property. Complimentary dessert during turn-down service. Room furniture decor is a little dated but acceptable. Buffet dinner was good. Breakfast buffet was good.Staff speaks English and communicated sufficiently.

Ottimo hotel che si avvicina agli standard occidentali cui siamo abituati.Un'oasi di pace nella caotica e bellissima Kathmandu. Sembra quasi di essere fuori della capitale del Nepal.Buona la pulizia, gentile il personale.Unica pecca è il costo troppo altro del wi-fi. NOn puoi far pagare il wi-fi quando l'hotel ha dei prezzi alti e soprattutto non puoi farlo pagare così tanto.Anche il ristorante a buffet non mi è molto piaciuto. Si mangia meglio da altre parte della città, ma comunque vario e pulito.

We stayed here for 3 nights to bring in the new year. We really liked the property & the openness around it with its huge gardens but found the rooms to be old & smelly, asking for some serious renovation. We were in the old wing of the hotel. Askfor a room in the new wing as they are more spacious & much nicer. The breakfast was quite elaborate & the in-house Chinese restaurant is a must try. From our earlier visits to Kathmandu, we have found this hotel better than most others in this category & would certainly recommend it to others. Just ask for a room in the new wing.

Güzel güler yüzlü bir karşılamayla , odalarımızı çok hızlı olarak verdiler . Odada ihtiyacınız olabilecek tüm ekipmanlar mevcut . Odalar yeterli büyüklükte . Çevrede ve otel alt katında değişik hediyelik eşyalar bulunabiliyor. Tüm çalışanlar çok güler yüzlü . Güzel bir kahvaltısı vardı ve bizi memnun eden akşam yemekleriyle karnımız doyurduk .Biz bu otelden memnun kaldık tavsiye ederim.

Excellent ambience, clean rooms, clean lobby, great bar, best restaurants, clean toilets, beautiful sprawling garden and great services. Soaltee has the best Italian Restaurant in Nepal. Has excellent Chinese restaurant and the Terrace Garden serves the finest continental meal around. I have never tasted "Fish and Chips" so good in any restaurants in Nepal !!!

This is a modern looking hotel with all services you need. The food was good and room service was slow but delicious. I visited when occupancy seemed high so the staff was not the most attentive and I have high expectations from a 5 star. Other than that the room and amenities were all good.

This hotel has been my home for the last 2 months, and it's a toss up between the fantastic staff and the great buffet (breakfast and dinner) as to its best asset (and I don't even usually like buffets). The wide selection of Indian and Nepali food was fantastic. For a while I loved the pool, but earthquake damage put this out of action for most of my time there which was too bad because it was beautiful and clean. Whilst there were many aftershocks in Kathmandu the hotel appeared to 'stand up' to these without adverse effects. On the downside, the hotel only has one non smoking floor and doesn't seem to be able to stop people smoking even on this floor. Current building works start at 6.00 am(!!!). And it's not the best location/proximity to Thamel and Patan areas. However taxis are cheap and plentiful (best to walk to the street outside for cheaper rates.) Spa is good in terms of service, but just functional in terms of decor/atmosphere (i also felt a bit nervous being on the basement during a period of many aftershocks).

Been there for dinner. Had couple of drinks and had pizza baked on fire oven. It was amazing. My colleagues had non veg dishes and they also enjoyed it. Staff hospitality was top of the world. Great ambience,  great food , reasonable prices.

Like many other humanitarian workers after the earthquake, I stayed in this hotel, and I was very happy with the service and standard.Absolute wonderful: The completely vegetarian dinner buffet! OMG, how often do you see that? Bliss!!!Huge disappointment: The spa! It had the look and feel of a bunker. In a hotel of this standard, you would expect a very different look and professionalism of the place. The massage was OK, but not great, and the staff and rooms need a big make-over and up-styling.

I visited Nepal few days back for business purposes. I had a terrible exprience with Soaltee Crowne Plaza Kathmandu.. Cockroaches were everywhere. I had to change the room. Room service was terrible. Asked for bottles of water and it was never delivered to my room. I booked my hotel along with my flights,so they knew what time I was flying out of Nepal. I asked if I could checked out bit later, as most of the rooms in the hotel were unoccupied, they asked me to pay extra dollars, which I did. Never again with this hotel.

This hotel is a little hidden gem. Due to its large gardens the main building itself is quite secluded from the main road you could not hear any city noises so we had a very peaceful stay. In term of getting around and sightseeing you're relatively well located. The "Monkey Temple" is a short 5/10 min drive up the hill and a great sight to see as you get great views of the entire valley. Plenty of trips could be arranged by the hotel if you do not have anything previously planned. The rooms are clean, spacious and comfortable. Opening the shutters in the morning and seeing the outline of the mountains in the distance is quite something! You have to double look as you could mistake them for the outline of clouds! The breakfast food was great but very locally orientated so may not be to most people's taste! There are live stations though so the chefs are happy to make your eggs etc to your taste. They serve some western staples though such as pancakes etc. What threw me off a lot during our stay in Nepal is the time zone it is in! They are GMT + 5:45! The 45min takes some getting used to if doing conference calls

Stayed at Crown Plaza Soaltee several times over some business trips.Constant level of service and smiling staff in one of the oldest hotels in town.Rooms are clean and functional for the use I made of them - sleeping and catching up on work emails. Possibly some are a bit more tired than others but when in need of a clean room, a hot shower and a safe environment you can't really fault them.Best part of every stay is to have drink at the lobby bar and having a chat with the bar manager Mr. Gautham - having worked there for 26 years he always has an interesting anecdote or story to tell.I like to go back and enjoy every stay.

We were stayed here for 3 days.Hotel rooms are spacious and clean.Staffs are polite.They big halls , sitting capacity of 500 peoples.Food is good.Newly they have started casino.Its really good and fun.

I arrived and my team humanitarian relief in the second week of last May, this hotel which did not chose, despite its proximity near to the Nepal Red Cross headquarters and workshop of the International Federation of work where their contact ; The faces were scared and apprehensive .. but the faces of friends from various humanitarian organizations was a lot of optimism, was a simple clean hotel to some extent, was built in the sixties of the last century, was a normal type who does not find it something unexpected! .. in that wretched city, that hotel is the headquarters of luxury; but even i stayed for about a month I was wondering how it relates to the five stars !? After the first quake crashed the main entrance gate and became a reception area far from the entrance of the hotel, and after the May 12 earthquake confusion was happened, we leave our rooms for a few days; despite the Ground vibrations backlash chase us, the front lawn was shelter for our tents & our friends (by the way the rooms overlooking the garden are best suited), We can't enjoy the swimming pool, which cracked by the earthquake, The smell of paint and inconvenience permeated the place during the day, during the rehabilitation of the legacy of vibrations process, the beautiful restaurant (Despite its small place) a haven for us; because of the good health list of the delicious food, I do not forget the real smile of its employees, which was encouraging us to continue, as well as Mr. elegant manager of restaurant who cares about the details of his customers . he was a real gentleman . eased anticipation almost at the end of the first week of June where we left! ..

I have been to this hotel back in 2014. Loved every thing about this hotel. Very nice and well maintained hotel. Restaurant, pool, wifi almost every thing was perfect except one lift. Well trained staffs and very professional.

Yes, the hotel is a bit tired in the rooms and there is a strange smell of detergent but who cares when the food is so good?! I visited the bar where I enjoyed a delicious mocktail, the Kakori restaurant where the pickle tray was out of this world and the international restaurant where the aloo gobi definitely went in my top 5 indian meals ever! Great photo opportunities in the hotel grounds too.

Un tipico hotel asiatico de lujo, aunque ya en cierta decadencia. Si te gusta la comida india (como a mi) puedes disfrutar de varias opciones en el buffet, pero si no te gusta hacen buena pasta, pizza, hamburguesas, y otras cosas.En este tipo de paises agradezco mucho la tranquilidad y la verdad es que el entorno no es ruidoso, las ventanas aislan bastante bien y tienen buenas contraventanas para la luz, en definitiva pude dormir muy bien.

we were there for an educational trip. a five star property by area, building, maintenance, landscapes..butit could have been much better.food, beverages, services, room maintenance, staff all just above average and definitely not what we expect from a world class hotel. a casino is also in the premises and it is good

Nice and well maintained property.. The casino and other amenities are good in the property.. will recommend for friends and relatives.. The staffs are friendly and service quality is good.. restaurants is mind blowing and we had a good time..pool was on maintenance so we missed it...

We were at the hotel when the earthquake hit and had to sleep on mattresses outside for three nights. No electricity or running water the staff had the outside bathroom spotless and had a kitchen outside to feed us. Just can't say enough about what they did for us during this triadic earthquake.  I cannot tell you about the location and restaurants. All I can say I will go back

Stayed In April 2015. Very spacious rooms and great hospitality. Having a casino In the compound is a huge plus. Great options in terms of restaurants and cuisines. We're ab, to arrange good day trips.

great grounds, large room little bit of an older hotel but a great spot. window from bedroom to bathroom. a little odd, good safe in room, shower not great, towels good.  pool was drained , terrific shops in hotel good variety and prices, WIFI at a cost. restaurant goodgrounds really lovely it was too bad the pool was drained. mind you we were  so busy likely no time for swimming. but it would have looked nicer

Well maintained property but the interior is aged with time. Furniture is not in good condition and need to be replaced. There is a possibility that it is renovated in new wing. As I stayed in old wing. Indian food was not tasty and appealing. In peak hours service was slow in restaurant. They give you twin bed by default if you check in single and when you ask for queen/king size bed, they will say all rooms are full. But, if you really need it, use some pressure technique and you will get it.

We had the opportunity to stay at the Soaltee for two nights. Then tragedy struck and we experienced the 7.8 earthquake which devastated Kathmandu. Once we got back to the hotel we found it damaged in such a way that we could not safely stay in our rooms.  The stay worked tirelessly when I'm sure many did not know about the safety of their own families.  They took mattresses, blankets, sheets and pillows out of rooms for us to sleep on that night outside and somehow put together a delicious hot meal.  Their service continued until we left two days later. I hope this wonderful hotel can open soon and this city can recover.

ออกมาเดินเล่นรอบรร.สวยดี มีสระว่ายน้ำและสวนดอกไม้พนักงานบริการดี ทางเข้ารร.ไกลจากถนนใหญ่หน่อย ต้องเดินเข้าซอย ถ้าจะออกมาหาของกิน เดินไกลมากค่ะ ตอนกลางคืนเปลี่ยวหน่อย แถวนั้นไม่ค่อยมีอะไรทาน ไกลจากตลาดเยอะ

crown plaza is one of the finest and a marvellous hotel in nepals kathmandu city. it has everything one needs and wants in luxury. the hotel staffs are very good and the hotel itself is very big .rules and regulations are commendable which are not always seen in hotels these days as they compromise on it many times. the hotels has everything one can think of , from casino to shopping arcade to any other need which can be fulfilled in the hotel itself.

I happen to stay here once again, I checked in late night & found staff very helpful ....i would say improved service than before .....the only thing I do not like was rooms do not have free wifi ...you need to buy package ....I bought one ,...which didn't work & I had to call duty manager again & again ...finally Ms. Monica being very helpful comforted me by saying ..it will be free for you sir!Food was good except biryani.....rooms are spacious & had very peaceful sleep & once again I recommend this hotel.I Pray for all Nepali's in this our of crisis.....

Ottimo hotel situato in un immenso giardino pieno di verde .Personale molto efficiente .Le camere avute in due diversi soggiorni erano tutte molto comode ben arredate e silenziose .Pulizia ottima .Volendo essere pignoli leggermente meglio come grandezza ed arredamento la camera nell'ala più recente .Il ristorante dell'albergo è ben fornito ed il buffet offre di tutto anche per chi non ama i sapori forti dei cibi orientali.Comunque sempre all'interno del complesso alberghiero vi è anche un ristorante italiano abbastanza buono.

Hotel bastante normalito, habitaciones sin nada en especial, los complementos del baño pobres, el buffet del desayuno aceptable.En resumen un lugar normal en el que si viene de negocios puedes quedarte a precios razonables y sin grandes lujos.

A good class hotel in spacious ground, and spacious lobby area.   Staff helpful, friendly and easy to find an English speaker.  We even found one person who spoke Italian.  Breakfast was good with a wide choice.Just outside there were a number of little shops selling tourist items like T-shirts etc at a reasonableprice.The interior of the shops were quite dark so take any goods you want to buy, outside, in the good light, to check for faults.I walked out, past the little tourist shops, to find a busy main road,  lined with tiny ill kept shops, not really a pleasant, inviting, part of the city.  It seems that this hotel is a pleasant oasis in an uninteresting area of town.We had dinner at an Italian restaurant within the hotel grounds.  The food was OK,  the wine was too expensive and the beer was $10.00 per bottle.

Me gusto mucho este hotel por su entorno boscoso y el buen servicio que tiene. Las habitaciones sin ser lujosas son limpias y adecuadas. Tiene un buen centro comercial abajo con precios iguales a los de la calle pero productos de mejor calidad.

We found this hotel very comfortable, the personnel of the hotel is extremely helpful and friendly! You can find easily someone that can speak English. The breakfast buffet couldn't be better, it has everything you would like to eat, you will find every traditional breakfast from the region as well as western breakfast, we also had dinner there and they have a good variety of plates in the menu. Outside the hotel there is a variety of shops that sell pashminas, handcrafted items and jewelry. There are also two restaurants close to the hotels. Internet is paid.

Visited Kathmandu after about 17 years. This time was for attending a marriage in my family. we stayed in this hotel as all programs were here itself. No doubt very nice and good property.  The arrangements were also very fantastic. all well managed. but food was a minus. as a Delhite i am found of good food. this hotel stands no were.

Beautiful hotel and courteous staff..food is good many options to pick from..especially breakfast..it has two wings ...ask for old wing park facing rooms fro better view ..else views are not good from the other rooms. .quite far from airport ..

Hassle free & prompt check-in and checkout. Caring staff. Good quality food served in Italian and Chinese restaurants. The staff of hotels are very good. Sofa in the room very poor and totally uncomfortable Bed mattress is equally bad

Used the property everytime I have been in Nepal in the recent times and found it to be a great place to stay but not so great place for food. But its proximity to few good indian restaurants like yellow chilli by sanjeev kapoor etc. that issue is also by and large sorted. Their service is pretty good and that scores pretty highly. They need to revamp their aging transport facility and work on food and this can be the best place in Kathmandu.

Quiet place tucked away from the hustle and bustle of the city, excellent ambience and perfect for outdoor corporate activities especially on a pleasant evening in Kathmandu! Have stayed there before and staff are courteous and helpful.

Staffs are very friendly and amazing view of the hills from most of the rooms. Breakfast has really wide options. Food is very good backed up by excellent service. One can go to Casino at leisure time. Internet tariff is on higher side and it is separately chargeable which is a set back in present days.

Un buon albergo, anche se sotto standard europeo, posizionato bene anche in funzione dell'aeroporto internazionale, dotato di camere sufficientemente confortevoli. Di pari livello il ristorante anche se molto caro rispetto agli standard locali.Carissimo il WIFI e non giustificato, visto che in tutti i bar e ristoranti è gratuito.

Nous avons passé 2 nuits dans cet hôtel et tout était parfait.Chambres confortables restauration aux petits soins .....accueil compétent...boutiques diverses et de qualité....en étant difficile on peut trouver cet établissement un peu excentré mais cela n'a pas été un problème pour nous.

Nepal'e turla giderken hiç tahmin edemediğimiz komforda bir oteldi. Bahçesi, lobizi personeli ve odaları gayet temiz ve güzeldi.  hem öğlen ve akşam yemeklerini , hem sabah kahvaltısını otelde aldık, hiç de sıkıntı yaşamadık, keyif aldık.

O título da avaliação diz respeito à localização do hotel. Afastado do centro de atrações parecia que Kathmandu era um oásis de paz e ficaríamos com uma sensação equivocada da cidade. Só depois que nosso guia nos levou ao centro da cidade foi possível ter uma ideia melhor da cidade. Dizendo isto vamos ao hotel. Quarto amplo, boas opções de restaurante, tem 3. Pessoal do hotel bem-educado. Tive um problema, tive que ligar para a agência de viagem local e a ajuda foi preciosa.

Very friendly staff, amazing view from the rooms to mountains, exchange rates very good at reception, tasty breakfast.Internet, wi-fi slow, with interruptions.Location: close to grocery market, pashmina, sweets and souvenir shops. Overall a nice experience!

Nice hotel An OK locationGood presentationFull staff coordinationGood veiwAmazing foodGood presentationAmazing breakfast (Better than some international hotels)I have been there for 2 nights and will be there for 1 more night nice place to go and stay in KathmanduA little less convenience from the city but worth it!

We stayed at Crowne Plaza for 2 nights in March as a family of 5. My first impression of Crown Plaza Soaltee was a disturbed one because it was absolutely swamped when we arrived, as many as 3 events were being held in the hotel on the same day. I was lucky to catch the customer relationship manager, because the reception desk was totally crowded, and he ensured a quick check-in so we were able to retire the tranquility of our rooms. I had recalled reading review where rooms in the new wing were better, but based on the chaos downstairs, did not make any such requests. As a result, the rooms in the old wing while quite comfortable looked a bit tired. Another thing I was disappointed by was the lack of water jets in the toilet (toilet paper only). Most modern hotels have now adopted the practice of keeping both. Yet another downside is the hotel booked cab, which costs a bomb compared to the usual taxi you can negotiate outside. The hotel management must look at this aspect closely, it is liable to be frowned upon by guests. On the positives though, service is very good by the staff, and they will always do their best to help you out. The hotel is located away from the usual hustle and bustle and spread out over a large area. The casino is a fairly good one, and can be visited if one has an interest. Breakfast buffet has a huge spread, and the two restaurants within the hotel area, Al Fresco and Kakori, provide exceptional quality food, and they were definitely the high points of our stay.

Had a two day stay at Crowne Plaza, Soaltee, Kathmandu. The initial disappointment of breakfast and wi-fi not being included in the travel package was soon overcome by the courteous behaviour of the hotel staff. A old-time lift and hotel room was evenly balanced out by comfortable beds, spacious washrooms, admirable breakfast spread and prompt room service. The concierge was helpful in sight seeing bookings and the fitness Center though small was compact. The drawbacks were the location which was 15 min from the city centre. However one of the few functional casinos 'mahjong' being in the campus was an added advantage for the pleasure-hunters.

This very lovely with gorgeous landscaping (and a mah jong casino!) is situated a bit outside the very polluted center of Kathmandu so we could not complain about the air quality.  We ate at the Chinese restaurant the first night and it was good, but not spicy.  The shopping opportunities were numerous in the basement as well as right outside the hotel gates.  The only thing that was inconvenient was the elevator that kept breaking down.

Rooms conditions are average. But bathrooms need more renovation specially shower area. Elevator does not have open and close button, people need to wait until it open and close. Although food are expensive, it delicious, specially recommend to taste traditional Nepalese drinks which serve from clay pot.  Hotel location not good for travelers who planning to eat out (not inside of the hotel) There are only few restaurants around the hotel

Booked 2 rooms for 3 nights. Like previous reviewer mentioned some rooms are renovated and we got them but with broken doors & handles. The window would not lock and the safety locker is not bolted so did not feel safe to keep our valuables! Rooms are clean but not sound proof. The grounds are beautifully kept with lots of flowers, trees and walk paths. Sitting in the open front lobby in the entrance was pleasant. The food can vary. Breakfast had plenty of choices but still not appealing. One night out of 3 they had buffet which was very good choice and delicious. After that they had Punjabi dhabba style buffet which was waste of time. Staff serving did not have a clue what food they were serving and it was tasteless food anyway. Veg and non-veg were displayed next to each other in a very dim lighting which we did mention in our feedback. The only way to tell the difference was they had actual goats head on display which put us all off eating our dinner and it was not cheap. Your best bet would be to order sandwiches but no guarantee in that too. On our arrival night we ordered sandwiches and veg burger which was freshly made as it should be but same food on the 3rd night was dry and hard! Swimming pool was out of order and their spa felt like entering a hospital bathroom. (on ladies side) Over all if you just want a clean room to sleep then this hotel will do!

Mostly it's renovated. But some floors still need to be fixed, the look n feel over 20 years old. Food is good as they have plenty of restaurants. Staff is friendly. Casino is currently operational. Good place to stay would be the club rooms.

We stayed at this lovely hotel for five nights and really enjoyed it. The grounds are extensive and well kept. We ate in the main part of the hotel and  found the food and  service good. We also heard good reports about the other hotel restaurants from other guests.. My overriding memory though will be of the lovely people who work in this hotel. Housekeeping, restaurant, bar, door staff were consistently cheerful friendly and efficient. What a pleasure to meet you. Thank you. This is a great base to visit Kathmandu from. Traveller Rating  Based on 815 reviews

Believe to one is the best in Kathmandu. It has very good property, but lack the maintenance. The swimming pool was closed. The rooms are spacious, but carpet smell will dampen your mood. The lifts are not working properly (very slow and also sometimes stop working!). Nice spots are Restaurant and Casino.

Hotel recintato e sorvegliato H24. Camere comode ma non tutte uguali nell'arredo. Ha campo da tennis, negozi, fitness, sala ricevimenti e hi-fi a pagamento.  Molto grande la hall con angolo bar e cambio valuta. Camera fornita di ogni comfort: ferro da stiro, frigo bar, bollitore per thè e caffè, cassaforte, divano, scrivania, TV senza canale italiano. Bagno sia con vasca che doccia ....asciugacapelli e fornitura di: rasoio, shampo, bagnoschiuma, spazzolino e dentifricio, cuffia, creme corpo, accappatoio spugna. Giornalmente fornitura gratis di n° 2 bottiglie di acqua minerale. Ottima la cucina anche internazionale. L'hotel ha diverse tipologie di camera ..anche fumatori. Personale gentile e professionale. Giardino curato. Buona la pulizia. Unico handicap è che ogni tanto va via la luce e bisogna attendere qualche secondo affinchè entra in funzione il gruppo di continuità. Nello stesso grande cortile dell'Hotel c'è il Casinò e una sciccosa e ampia  sala  dove è facile vedere i ricevimenti dei matrimoni nepalesi. CONSIGLIATO!

Das Crowne Plaza hat uns in mancher Hinsicht enttäuscht.
