Die Zimmer sind ok, teilweise wohl auch schon renoviert - wir waren im alten Flügel, das ging auch.Aber wenn man draußen sitzen möchte, findet man nur die ziemlich aushäusige Terrasse des Gardenrestaurants oder die unbequemen Stühle neben der Hotelanfahrt.Der Swimmingpool war nicht eingelassen, daher auch keine Liegen etc. Bei 25 Grad Außentemperatur tagsüber wäre das sonst ein netter Platz zum relaxen nach dem Trubel der Stadt.Eine nette Bar? Fehlanzeige. Das düstre Eck gegenüber der Rezeption lädt nicht gerade zum Verweilen.Inzwischen sind wir in Kathmandu ein bisschen herumgekommen: Beim nächsten Mal würden wir eine andre Wahl treffen

Restaurant like kakori serves best food, over all stay is very good courteous staff with some old style furnishings as the hotel is old location of the hotel is best heart of the city, stay at the main wing and take the front rooms the view will be goodtry all the restaurants the food is awsome

The Soaltee is a nice old hotel that probably has a lot of stories to tell if you could only suss them out, with some lovely old Nepali art. Not quite as convenient to Thamel as the Annapurna and a little higher brow but the service was great, food very ample with several different restaurants, nice large garden and green areas, and outdoor seating. Room was well-appointed. Quite busy with lots of tourists. THere is so much to see and do in Kathmandu! Every vista is an eyeful and the cacophony an earful! Enjoy!!

This was my 2nd stay in this Hotel after 10 years. Enjoyable stay, Good food particularly grill/tandoori dishes.Clean Rooms with quick customer service. Staff very courteous. Now rooms require refurbishment, electronic key, surveillance, digital locker are the need of the hour.Casino next door adds to its charm.

Stayed for 3 days 8 to 11 March.Beautiful property where u can pass enormous time.but had bad experience of service.Breakfast was mostly continental.complaint regarding bathroom not addressed to.wanted to meet manager in this regard but declined by front desk.I think Indians should avoid this hotel.Hyatt is better property on these rates.

Stayed at Soaltee Crowne Plaza with family, last week for four days. International brand  hotel with huge grounds and the usual amenities. Lobby is impressive and buzzing with activity. Rooms are comfortable, housekeeping courteous and efficient, room service quick and quality of food is fairly good. Breakfast is adequate . Plenty of shops in and around the hotel. Didn't shop so can't comment on prices and quality.  There are three restaurants... China Garden, Kakori and Al fresco. Had dinner in China Garden and Kakori. Both were very good, especially Kakori. Gorged on kebabs and stuffed kulchas.Did a fair bit of sight seeing. Pashupatinath Temple , a must for all Hindus. The Boudha Stupa is a must do. Imposing stupa, encircled with scores of shops and cafes. Browsed through the shops looking for Pashminas and learnt a good deal about the Buddhist Thangkas. Buy one if you can afford it!  I didn't, but did buy a few water pashmina stoles for gifts. Highly recommend that one tries Roadhouse Cafe.... Excellent pizzas, salads, sandwiches and pastas....Bhaktpur, the old capital, is the Nepal ,familiarized by India's Bollywood. Many Indian films have been shot there and the guides  never fail to to mention it. Lots of historic buildings, old architecture ,temples , shops , Thangkas, pashminas, and a pottery village as well. Spent an  interesting couple of hours there. Recommend one takes a guide.Went to Nagarkot in the mountains from Bhaktpur. Way way way up. Had lunch at the Himalyan Resort which is right on top. No motor able road beyond this resort. Food was OK but views of the snow capped Himalyan range are scenic.Also went to Gokarna forest and golf resort. Good views and fun to try one's hand at putting. The food and service at the restaurant is quite mediocre. Did the Tibetan Village and the World Peace Pagoda  too. Amongst other things , would recommend Fire and Ice in Thamel for great food . Do make  reservations. It is very popular. Garden of Dreams is worth a visit too. Shopped at The Cashmere Outlet. Excellent quality woollens.

this hotel is great place to be though little far but have all one wants for the holiday. Great places to eat like AlFresco - italian, Kakori - Indian, China garden - best for chinese meal in kathmandu

è il miglior albergo di Kathmandu. ovviamente stiamo ragionando su un target nepalese (tra l'induismo e gli indiani) e su quello bisogno attenersi.il mangiare a buffet (standard del luogo) soddisfa qualunque esigenza con una media qualità (sul vegetariano anche elevata), le camere sono grandi e confortevoli (qualche problema con i carica batteria che comunque vengono risolti), il wifi è a pagamento.

I stayed at this hotel in Feb 2015 for 3 nights. The rooms are very spacious and beautifully made. The only thing bad about the room was that the television didn't have a good cable connection. Besides this my experience with the hotel was very good. The breakfast was the best part.

This hotel is everything you'd expect from a large chain hotel. The rooms are clean, the service is good, the food is good. It is not centrally located if you want to explore, but the grounds are a lovely respite from the crowds and pollution of the city.

This was my second stay in this property. And this time it was more grand and buzzing.Was here to attend a family wedding and everything about this place is superb. The hotel lobby the staff the interiors the ambience the banquet the food the room decor. Everything is perfect. Thanks for the hospitality & keep up the good work guys !!

We spent a few days at this hotel in January 2015. The rooms and hotel amenities seem to be a bit weared, but very clean and working well. Nice buffet breakfast with wide selection of both Asian and European cuisine. A strong point of the hotel is very friendly and helpful staff. They addressed all the requests quickly and with no hassle.The weaker side is the location – a few kilometers from Kathmandu city center and most of the attractions (maybe apart from Monkey Temple). It is a good place to have a rest from noisy and dusty downtown, but at the same time almost nowhere to go out for a walk. For international standards it is probably an average or slightly-below average Crown Plaza, but in Kathmandu it may be one of the best places to stay.

Siamo stati due volte, nel corso del nostro viaggio in Nepal, la prima volta ci hanno dato una camera dal lato opposto del generatore di energia.Camera spaziosa, pulita, con bagno adeguato con vano doccia. Sono scarsi gli accessori come Shampoo e bagno schiuma, nonostante la camera sia per due persone, in bagno abbiamo trovato soltanto una confezione sufficenti per una parsona.Il cibo al ristorante a buffet buono, con la possibilità di avere preparato ( sul momento ) della pasta o un secondo di qualità accettabili per un italiano.Colazione abbondante!La seconda volta che siamo stati ospiti dell'albergo abbiamo avuto le camere proprio sopra il generatore di corrente e fino al suo spegnimento ( alle 21.00 ) non è possibile riposrarsi in camera per il rumore. Bagno non adeguato con vasca da bagno e senza piatto doccia, asciugmani che sembravano umidi, solito problema con le confezioni di shampoo e di bagno schiuma.Controllate sempre il conto al check-out sbagliano molto frequentemente l'importo degli extra da pagare.Nel complesso personale gentile e disponibile alla risoluzione dei problemi.

O hotel tem todos os serviços que um turista precisa. Bons restaurantes, notadamente um italiano que superou as espectadoras. Piscina e massagem estão à disposição. Café da manhã saboroso. Só o quarto que, embora de bom tamanho, poderia ser mais moderno. Pessoal muito atenciosos. Área do hotel enorme.

Kathmandu è una città sporca e caotica che nasconde dei tesori meravigliosi.Questo albergo permette di vivere la città in maniera elegantemente occidentale senza privarsi della sensazione di essere in oriente.Pulito, soprattutto la parte nuova.Cortese il personale, ottimo il ristorante.Unico "difetto" il wi fi a pagamento...vivamente consigliato, sia il Nepal che l'albergo.

We stayed during February 2015. Although the hotel is classified as a 5 Star, its a 4 Star by global standards. Please stay in the New Wing. The Casino had just started as we were informed. The food at the Italian Restaurant is passe. At the Chinese restaurant (China Garden), Mr. Tej, the Steward was extremely polite and helpful. He realised that we were not enjoying the starter and immediately changed the same. The buffet breakfast spread is quite decent. Overall a pleasant stay.

el hall de entrada y la recepción es muy bonito , las habitaciones necesitarían una reforma , internet muy caro y muy lento , el personal amable y servicial ,si volviera a Kathmandu creo que optaría por otro hotel..

we were here for three night as part of a tour of india and nepal. this hotel is outstanding. our from had a great view of the monkey temple up on the hill overlooking katmandu. Breakfast buffets were outstanding with omeletes and roti topping the list. There were three restaurants besides the main one, Chinese, Indian and Italian. We are in the Italian twice and the Indian once. Great food. My wife recommends the trout in the Italian. Service was exceptional.

We stayed here for three nights and found the grounds, staff, rooms and amenities to be great.  They have three restaurants plus a coffee shop where the buffet breakfast is served.  We ate at the Chinese and Italian restaurants and enjoyed both.  Did not try the Indian because we had just been in India for two weeks.  They have a number of shops in the basement along with several shops just pass the gate when you enter the property.  They all seemed to be very reasonable according to my wife.  They host a lot of marriages celebrations which are quite colorful.

Excellent accommodation, staff exceptionally courteous and helpful, recent renovation of rooms. Indian restaurant is perhaps the best in Kathmandu, breakfast buffet tremendous. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend.

This hotel is quite nice.  Well kept up and well maintained.  A few service glitches though.  We were originally checked into a smoking room without asking if that was ok -- it was not.  One morning all elevators in our wing were not working, and management seemed not to know about this -- seemed odd.  Our main complaint was over the A/C.  For two days we complained that the A/C was not cooling the room.  For two days we were repeatedly told that someone had fixed it, that it was being worked on, and would be checked.  Finally with a manger in our room, I asked if we had any control over the A/C and he FINALLY admitted that the A/C is centrally controlled, and the room thermostats have no impact on the room temperature!  It seems a lot of wasted time could have been saved if we had been told up front that the thermostats in the room are for show only.

I was here for a 3 day workshop.  The hotel is not exactly close to the market and tourist attractions,  but staff were very helpful at arranging taxis, etc.  Rooms are clean and comfortable, breakfast was great and the grounds are lovely.

In Kathmandu, the crown plaza soaltee is very nice place to stay. I stayed there for 4 days. The casino is also started. The hotel is centrally located and is like a resort.The hotel is having good restaurant.

I stayed here in January 2015 for almost a week. Going by Kathmandu standards, which are quite low, this is the best hotel you can find in Kathmandu. The city is still under 70s Hippie Trail hangover and has very little to offer in terms of comfort stay. This hotel however exceeds your expectations in terms of comfort, service and facilities. Room service: good but can improve, takes minimum 15 mins to get you anything say a water bottle or a cup of coffeeBreakfast: Brilliant, has plenty of variety and number of options. Indians will be disappointed since the food is more or less the same. Coffee surprisingly is quite expensive however the bar is not. Make your choice then:)

Recently concluded and mice confernce event in kathmandu Event was professsionally managed,, staff is extremely cooperative ,casino is attached to the Hotel,also the Chinese restaurant and iltalian restaurant serves best authentic cuisine

We were pleased with the hotel in general. The reception looked like a five star hotel, however the rooms looked a bit old although there was no problem with cleanliness and the amenities. We were at the top floor where there was always a strong smell of food. When I asked my friends who stayed at lower floors, they told me that  there was no smell in the lower floors.The food in the restaurant was good and the variety acceptable.The staff were friendly and helpful. The business center was nice and useful.However wifi is charged everywhere in the hotel and is not cheap.Not in the downtown area but taxis from Thamel are easy to find and only 3-4 dollars.

It was our first trip to Nepal and we liked Crowne Plaza. Good hotel, good service and comfortable stay. We liked the food at the indian speciality restaurant Kakori. The buffet food at coffee shop other than the breakfast was not so good. Wifi was expensive. They should have free wifi. There was a group in the hotel who were very rowdy and made out night sleepless due to the noise. Next day on our request our room was shifted which was good gesture by the hotel.The cab services and the city tour was good. It was overall a pleasant experience.

Soaltee crown plaza is the best 5 star hotel in Kathmandu, It has got the biggest awiming pool among all the 5 star hotels in kathmandu. The Casino is also one of the best in kathmandu. The best part about soaltee is its breakfast in the hotel itself.Overall the best place to stay in Kathmandu.

I stayed in this hotel from 28 Jan to 1 Feb. Its one of the good hotels in Kathmandu. The staffs are very warm and welcoming. The location of the hotel is good and the services are very very good. The rooms are ok but comparing with other 5 stars hotels of Nepal, they are very good. The buffet breakfast was also good. Thanks to all the ever smiling staffs from security to reception to housekeeping for making my stay very pleasant. The only negative thing is it doesnt have free wi-fi. I will definitely stay at Soaltee Crown Plaza the next time i am in Kathmandu.
飯店面積非常的大, 但進出的路太狹窄, 我們這次遇到下雨竟然就因為積水花了很多時間才離開飯店, 飯店的餐廳很棒. 最好的地方是房間很大, 目前看的出來部分區域正在翻新(其實也真的需要翻新, 因為設備有些老舊), 飯店人員十分親切, 早餐的餐廳非常漂亮.

prima di partire mi era stata data la certezza del gluten free, all arrivo pero' ho capito che, non solo nessuno sapeva niente del mio problema, delle e mail dell agenzia,  ma addirittura mi hanno risposto "e che cos è il glutine?",qsto la prima sera! poi abbiamo abbandonato l hotel per ritornarci l ultima notte, secondo programma, e anche li si perdono in un bicchiere d acqua,ci obbligano a mangiare cinese in nepal,senza alcuna possibilita di scelta, portando anche nuddles e pesce fritto, dicendomi d averlo fatto con la farina di mais, e nn sanno se è un prodotto idoneao certificato per noi, e per di piu qndo domando se l olio di frittura era pulito e privo di contaminazioni mi rispondono di no, e un cameriere vestito di scuro, con un classico cappelli nepalese mi risponde: "ma lui pero'  puo mangiare sia il pesce che i nuddles" (cioè il mio compagno!al che mi sono davvero infastidita,come se nn esistessi, non solo la l inefficenza della prima sera, anche la maleducazione dell ultima. ho chiesto, essendo il ristorante vuoto, di avere magari lo stesso pesce, ma grigliato, o cucinato in qlle altro modo, anche un alternativa da menu da pagare la differenza,ma la risposta è stata un NO secco! questo era un 5 stelle!qsto signore mi ha detto se volevo frutta o gelato, ma non avevo neanche iniziato la cena,insomma non ho mangiato niente, mi ha fatto passare la fame, ci siamo alzati e ce ne siamo andati. la camera carina, ma sopra al generatore, un  casino incredibile, senza riscaldamento, ho telefonato in reception 4 volte.

We loved our stay at this excellent hotel while in Nepal. Its Chinese restaurant was excellent, as was its breakfast buffet. And, the shopping arcade in the basement was terrific. Located only a short walk from local shopping, it was very convenient. We heart that the international heads of state would be staying at this hotel a week after we enjoyed it, and security was quite evident.We'd return to it if we visit Kathmandhu again.

I was very impressed with this hotel and highly recommend it to those visiting Kathmandu, Nepal. Service is outstanding! Check-in is quick and painless! Outstanding dinner buffet and the breakfast buffet was even better! Beds were comfortable with fresh linens. Very secure and security is a must for me when traveling abroad. Many thanks to all the staff at the Crowne Plaza Kathmandu-Soaltee.

Hotel ini termasuk salah satu hotel mewah di Kathmandu. Sangat bagus, dengan kolam renang, dan pilihan sarapan pagi yang beragam dan berselera. Sayangnya, harganya cukup mahal untuk kantong ketat, kamar standar berharga mencapai 1 juta/kamar. Meski mewah dan kelihatan elegan, jalan menuju hotel ini jalan sempit yang berlubang-lubang, dan letaknya cukup jauh dari pusat keramaian. Namun, banyak taksi yang parkir dan siap mengantar ke tujuan dengan harga yang bisa ditawar.

Warmth just flows freely at this hotel. To start with, we were welcomed very very warmly by the GM of the hotel and the rest of the HODs. Knowing that we were there for an important busness meeting, their presence and their curiosity to know as to how they could make our experince count just set us at ease. The rooms were nice warm and clean. The food laid out at the Buffet was a great combination of the indian, continental and local. The meeting room was well done up with all equipment that we asked for. The team was totally floored by the tea break lay out. We did dine at their oriental restaurant and must say, the food tasted awesome. But a special mention goes to the tireless, ever smiling staff that met and greeted us with such warmth at all times of the day and night. Kudos to the managemnet team to keep the team so motivated. In a nutshell, When in Kathmandu, Choose Soaltee Crowne Plaza.

Wonderful hotel with grace, charm and dignity. Fine rooms with great sleep and wonderful breakfast buffet and superb dinner. Stayed here for three nights as part of a Gate 1 tour.  Be careful about the on-site ATM - it will charge you 400 rupees as a transaction fee for money above your bank charge. Again - no free wi-fi (when will these chain hotels stop gouging its guests!). Not even free in the business center!

This hotel provides good services, place, and location for professional meetings in Nepal. Staff provides high quality fast services. Internet speed is also very good. Other kind of facilities necessary for the conference/meeting are also provided in good quality. they have enough space in the backyard for outdoor arrangement of food/buffet or any other kind of activity. Food is of good quality, just the drinking water could be a problem because they does not provide sealed bottled water to guests. This hotel provides the highest quality in Kathmandu whereas actual quality is like a usual 3 start hotel in any other country.

Perhaps Crowne Plaza Soiltee is one the few most beautiful hotels in Kathmandu. The overall setting is quite scenic having lash green surrounding the property. It has a quality of semi resort having partial open and semi open outdoor spaces. Being a five star rated property, Crowne Plaza Soiltee should be considered as one of the top choices when looking for hotels in Kathmandu. Starting from its reception are, though not that grand in appearance, the restaurants, Bars and all other public facilities are well set with the amenities and services. My stay in this hotel was focused on a seminar and international meet of architects, that's why I found that the Banquet Halls are quite well designed and grand in true sense flanked by outdoor plaza on one side and reception garden on the other side. This hotel is perfectly designed considering the tranquility of guests on the other hand allowing the temporary guests at the public areas completely separate though connected with the Guest Room blocks.The restaurant is well decorated with the mix of traditional and contemporary decor and significantly large in  size. I had a chance to use two restaurants one is I guess all day dining where the breakfast is being severed and another a specialty Chinese cuisine.There are two guest room blocks and it is apparent through their retrofit that they were built in two different times.The best part of this property is that it has a separate Casino Block set apart from the Hotel Proper within the premises and has Cabaret, Live Music and free servings of foods, all sorts of drinks if one participates in gambling. It is a mind blowing experience being in Mahajong, the  Casino.  The rooms are moderately large and fitted with all sorts of FF&E with a in room Toilet. The only observation I have staying in this hotel that it needs a massive renovation to be trendy and fresh one as the ageing is quite apparent in its decor.No doubt that Crowne Plaza Soiltee is a real scale Star Rated hotel and should the travelers who intends to visit Kathmandu for the first time take a chance to stay their.

This is a hotel which I prefer to stay whenever I am in Kathmandu. Usually I am allotted a room in the new block but it was in the old block this time. I was not completely satisfied with this as all the furniture are very old. The toilet a bet cramped in fact the shower mat itself was might be 25 years old.The service of the staff is good and its the loyal faithful staff for years together.

Very comfortable stay at the hotel; felt like a home away from home. Enjoyed every minute of our stay, thanks to the wonderful staff and management. The food prepared by chef Yuvraj was excellent  Location wise also it is easily accessible to key tourist sights. Booking cabs for sight seeing was done quickly. We were impressed by these people within the staff - Tara Jung Thapa,Muna Bhandari, Sachin Pradhan, Bijayta Puri, MahadevSim Khada(kakori),and not to forget the never tiring Hari Kandel  (some names we are forgetting but they made a huge impression with their high service standardS too). I guess Mr Nalin Mendiratta has not taught the word NO to his team hats off to you sir , thank you for making our New Years just the way we wanted . - Ashish Joneja stayed here from 31-12-14 to 040115 .

Inserito in un piccolo parco, lontano dal centro, promette quiete e servizi adeguati. L'impressione però é che non si sforzino molto nel migliorare la buona qualità offerta; peccato adagiarsi sul successo. Camere pulite e bagno all'altezza, con buoni prodotti e biancheria. Colazione abbondante ed attenta alle abitudini degli ospiti; ristorante con servizio veloce e competente. Ritornerò.

The rooms are old and worn out. Not at all value for money. We were having breakfast in the outdoor area of the restaurant and suddenly a cat jumps on our table and starts eating from our plate. None of the restaurant staff bothered. After having to find a table inside by myself with the manager was standing near by all this while, we see one of the waiters picking up glasses of cold coffee lying on our outside table and shifting them to our inside table. The worst Crowne Plaza you will ever stay in! The words Customer Service are non-existent to the entire management.Also, do not go up to the Concierge and ask for any recommendations as they will only send you to places they get commission from! Soaltee has truly gone to the dumps!

I liked the hotel ambience, even though the interiors were quite old.. This has a nice lawn and a beautiful garden area to walk around.. If you are looking for a quiet holiday, then this is a nice place. If you want to visit places, then this will not be the right hotel, as attractions are quite far away from the hotel. The traffic during working hours is horrible, so please do not venture out during working hours.. Its also far away from the shopping areas... The food at the hotel is quite nice.. Lounge is too small, can accommodate only 3 groups.. If more than 3 groups, sitting place will not be available..
ハイグレートホテルとは言い難いが、施設、庭とも広く、セキュリティー、施設とも遜色が無いと感じた。ツアー全員にジユースのウエルカムドリンクがあり、バスタブ一杯のお湯も短時間に入り湯量も充分で、透明なお湯で有った、日本人のツアー客が泊まると、お湯が出なくなるとよく言われるが、その様な事は起こらず満足。ツインの部屋なのにスリッパが一つしか無いのは不思議に感じた。

Due to flight problems going on in India, we landed in Kathmandu at 2:00 AM basically a night or I would say a morning before. We called Soltee to check if they could give us rooms and they immediately sent a car to pick us up and were very happy to have us checked in. The staff with all sincerity made every possible effort to really ensure that we have a wonderful stay. Right from housekeeping, butlers, staff at the restaurant, and staff at the spa everyone is smiling, welcoming and the service is upto the mark. Spread over 12 acres of land the hotel right from the entry is a small city in itself.  Vibrant gardens, open veranda, greenery, decor, hospitality, cleanliness, and maintenance everything is awesome. Its location is also perfect: 4km from the palaces and temples of Durbar Square in the city centre, 6km from Pashupatinath Temple and 3km to Swayambhunath Stupa shrine. Tribhuvan International Airport is 8km away.The hotel staff narrates with pride the story of hosting visits by Queen Elizabeth II, Princess Diana and numerous other heads of state. Talking about the food, in addition to its speciality restaurants - Al Fresco, China Garden and Kakori; the hotel serves the best breakfast across all the hotels in Nepal.I have visited Nepal on several occasions but haven’t stayed at Soltee before and I think I won’t stay anywhere else now that I have been here. 100 % recommended! It’s the property and the staff which makes the whole stay so wonderful.

The staff and amenities make this hotel successful in a somewhat difficult city atmosphere.  The restaurants are great.  The buffet was very well catered to all guests and the pizza was spot on in the Italian restaurant. In addition, the shops below the hotel are a deal and provide some interesting and affordable gifts for friends and family. One improvement could be made with the shades in the bathroom.  A solid wall should separate the bedroom and bath.  Overall, a good experience though.

I've spent four nights here between December, 2014 and January, 2015. The hotel is located right outside the city center, in a very silent area. It has four restaurants (Italian, Chinese, Indian and International cuisine), a good wi-fi connection, nice looking hall and welcoming personnel. The hotel is very clean everywhere. The restaurant Garden View offers tasty food (veg and non-veg) in a very cosy environment. Quality of rooms can vary a lot, from nice and flawless to noisy and "problematic" (e.g. window right in front of AC equipment, hairdryer badly repared with sellotape, it litterally split in two pieces while using it...). Overall a pleasant experience and probably the best hotel in Kathmandu.

Ho soggiornato 3 notti in questa strutture.le camere sono ampie, molto pulite e ben arredate. Il menù e' vario e curato. Ci sono vari ristoranti fra i quali uno italiano e uno cinese. Piacevole la presenza di una piccola palestra e centro estetico. Il wifi e' a pagamento.il personale e' gentilissimo. Servizio ottimo sotto tutti i profili.

I travel nearly every month around the world and stay in different hotel chains.  In my recent trip to Nepal, my company selected Soaltee Crowne Plaza and I was glad they did.  The service was outstanding -- the best experience I have had in years.  I had not prepared for this trip and found myself with some extra time on my hands.  The guest relations executive, Muna Bhandari, helped prioritize my interests, arranged a driver, and even bargained to help me obtain a better rate.  She had excellent recommendations throughout my stay and helped me make the most of my short time in Nepal.  The other hotel staff were also courteous and accomodating, from the reception to the cleaning crew and attendants.   The hotel facilities were great, but I will return to Soaltee on my next trip to Kathmandu because of the hotel staff.

It was my official trip to Kathmandu and arrangements were not done by me, so was not sure about the hotel. But from my arrival to departure everything was smooth and perfect . Front office is very helpful , the service staff is very good . Hotel is grand and well maintained,perfectly meets its standards.

Kathmandu being the launch pad for anywhere one wants to go in Nepal so I stayed here for two days at the end of my trip . rooms are huge with very good amenities .but the view form my room (i.e from the whole third floor) was pathetic, there was a concrete floor in front of the window blocking the view from the room, I informed the reception about this but no alternatives were offered even though, I was told that there is another building.Food in garden terrace restaurant was just average.Staff and the hospitality was also not up to the mark.

My husband had a business visit in 2013june.  Me and my daughter accompanied him. The hotel was really beautiful and the room was very spacious. Ambience was very inviting with good maintenance. We loved the Indian restaurant and Italian restaurant there. The food was delicious. And the overall stay was very very comfortable and present. Staff was very friendly indeed. Overall a week long stay was very good and comfortable. Will certainly stay at same place in our next visit.

We stayed here for two nights to acclimate before moving onto a tour of Nepal. It was perfect, a nice place to relax, unwind and take it easy before the whirlwind tour began and then a familiar place to return to 10 days later.  The rooms were small but pleasant, food was fresh and good, grounds were beautiful. People were friendly. (all over Nepal)  There were some stores along the road that were easy to walk,  I felt very secure after driving here from the airport!  If I ever go back, I would stay there again.

The service was warm and attentive, the rooms comfortable and the buffet excellent. The grounds were also very quiet in the midst of noisy Kathmandu. The only negative was that you had to pay for WiFi which is not what you normally expect from a hotel of this calibre. All in all, highly recommended.

Buen hotel, aunque las habitaciones que nos tocaron daban a un patio trasero con máquinas de aire acondicionado. Lo mejor del hotel es la gran finca donde se encuentra, con jardines, restaurantes y una piscina. Recomendable darse un baño al atardecer, después de las fatigas dl recorrido diario.No tomar gin-tonic en el bar: muy caro y sin hielo, por razones de seguridad microbiological.

Hôtel très luxueux, où les équipages des compagnies aériennes descendent. Belle chambre avec un grand lit, belle salle de bain, mais par contre, un seul peignoir pour deux !Self service très bien avec pas mal de choix, aussi bien pour les repas que pour les petits déjeuners.Un restaurant italien existe, mais il faut passer dehors pour y aller, et quand il pleut, la réception n’est pas capable de trouver des parapluies !!Télévision avec TV5.Par contre wifi payant et très cher, environ 1.200 Rps pour 6 heures, scandaleux pour un hôtel de ce standing où il devrait être gratuit ! Et en plus ce wifi n’est pas stable, beaucoup de coupures intempestives.

Een perfect hotel om te verblijven en uit te rusten in een druk, chaotisch maar mooi Kathmandu.Mooie ruime kamers met goede voorzieningen. Vriendelijk en behulpzaam personeel. Het ontbijt is prima. Een van de betere hotels in Kathmandu.

A very comfortable hotel surrounded by well landscaped grounds and swimming pool.  Close to the city, but separated from it by walls all around the hotel and grounds, which gives a good feeling of security.   Great restaurants inside the hotel, and an excellent breakfast buffet, including plenty of fresh fruit and juices.Tours can be arranged from the hotel to attractions in Kathmandu (lots of historical and religious building) and beyond into the Himalayas and nearby mountains.  Flights over Mt Everest from Kathmandu airport are available.   The monsoon season brings rain July to October, so best to avoid that time.

I would really appreciate this Hotel in a number of ways...The best Hotel in Kathmandu...The biggest property with the hotel in Kathmandu...All the facilities available in the Hotel...Hospitality is excellent...Restaurants and Banquets too good...Rooms and Services are Superb...And can enjoy Casino...I would like to visit again to this property...

Möglicherweise das beste Hotel in Kathmandu. War nur eine Nacht dort, aber Service, Essen und die Ruhe waren prima. Ausstattung des Zimmers 5* würdig. Büffets waren reichlich und für jeden etwas dabei. WiFi kostet leider extra.

Abbiamo soggiornato 3 notti in questo hotel e l'abbiamo trovato pulito, con camere ampie e ben arredato. Buona sia la prima colazione che la cena, con un ampio buffet. Personale cordiale e attento ad ogni esigenza. Inoltre l'albergo è dotato di generatore elettrico, indispensabile poiché a Katmandu spesso tolgono la corrente. Insomma veramente un buon albergo, non gli ho dato il massimo solo perché la nostra stanza affacciava proprio sul  generatore e la notte si sentiva abbastanza ed inoltre il materasso ed i cuscini non sono proprio il massimo. Comunque lo consiglio vivamente.

The property is very good. The service is average, even to the nepali standards. Good spread for breakfast. No views worth mentioning. Stayed there for 2 days and I was happy that I didn't have to stay inside the hotel.

I stayed there for a week. it was pleasant, the service was excellent, however i found it pricy.The room was clean with a nice view over the garden and the pool. The power goes off from time to time however it very normal in Nepal. Internet speed was average.

I've stayed at this hotel on a business trip and enjoyed the facilities. A bit far from Thamel, but good service nevertheless. The swimming pool can be cleaned more frequently. That said, breakfast buffet was good and so were the staff!

I stayed here for three days in November 2014. Very comfortable room. The gardens were a welcome respite from the frenetic street life of Kathmandu and include tennis court and pool. The breakfast buffet is expansive and sets you up for the day. Enjoyed an excellent dinner in the Italian restaurant in the garden. Very busy hotel - when I was there I bumped into the Nepalese Prime Minister attending a conference on Mountain Peoples - but still possible to find quiet spots. The shops in the basement area are of high quality. Good location too - close to the spiritual Swayambunath Temple and the lively fruit and veg market. recommended.

Absolut tolles Hotel. Ich hab dort nur eine Nacht verbracht (wegen Flugverspätung), und wurde sehr freundlich bedient. Abendessen und Frühstück: für jeden ist etwas dabei. Von nepalesischen Gerichen bis hin zu europäischen Köstlichkeiten. Empfehlenswert, vor allem wenn man abseits des Trubels übernachten möchte.

Very pleasant gardens and rooms. The Italian restaurant is not quite there yet but the staff were very enthusiastic. On the other hand the Chinese restaurant was superb if a little pricey. Would not hesitate to return should the occasion arise.

Beautiful, and excellent service, the best hotel in Kathmandu, Nepal , it has many restaurants, different kind of food, nice stores, and comfortable rooms.  You can select your pillow, have all kind of toiletries, even nice mirrors.  I had a different experience since their were lots of important people coming to a Conference, and there was lots of security the second time I went to.  Love the stores inside, and around, and the beautiful flowers, and landscape.

A very international hotel with guest and conferences from all over the world. The employees are extremely helpful and very customer service oriented to help you. Large gardens and conference center on the grounds around the hotel. 4 restaurants to treat any dining option.The China Garden was a delightful treat with a large menu. Try the duck main entree or the lettuce dumpling, you will not be disappointed. While we only stayed overnight but will return in 10 days and plan to eat their again.Here are a few employees who have made our stay enjoyable: Bijayata Puri, Guest Relations Executive; Hari Sharan Kanddel ans Nitya Bhandari and several others who I will mName on our return stay in 10 days.A hotel that you will enjoy.Michel & Avis Bourne

very nice hotel to stay ........i stayed in the hotel for 2 days rooms are spacious ...breakfast is good and have plenty of options to eat.....Very good quality for less money. It was simply Great stay. very good service, attentive staffs and much more.....I would definitely would come & stay with family.

Comme tous les hôtels de la chaîne, aucune surprise désagréable! Personnel charmant et à disposition. Activités proposées par agences. Calme (situé à l'extérieur du tumulte de la ville). Chambre confortable. Choix de restaurants. Prix attractif.

Stayed in Hotel Soaltee crown plaza from 13-17 Nov. 2014 on a business trip. I had a very nice and comfortable stay. The staff at the Hotel are co operative and helpful. Really had no issue at all.The breakfast spread is good with variety of dishes. I had a get together party  of 100 people for business . Everything was arranged so well by the hotel staff that I did not realise it was another country. Food at the hotel is very good .The room and bathroom are clean and well maintained although the hotel is old.Needed a soft pillow , which was immediately arranged by housekeeping staff.Overall good Hotel to stay in Kathmandu  for a safe stay.

Después de un agotador día de salir por la ciudad y llegar a un hotel con habitaciones limpias, cómodas, y bien servicio de alimentos, no tiene precioLo mejor del hotel son los alimentos, el buffet del desayuno es delicioso! Los jardines esta hermosos y es un lugar tranquilo dentro de una ciudad ruidosa Las

I stayed there for a meeting just for two days in November. The room was arranged by the conference. The room was clean, and breakfast was good with plenty of choice. Wifi facilities were good with support for several devices.Staff were friendly and my wakeup call requests were all taken care of.Being a large complex, it was confusing to find the right building at times. Had no time to explore the area because the meting continued till late evening with social events.But I got the feeling that it was away from the city centre.

Comfortable, quiet room.  Excellent breakfast with good service.  The adjoining gardens were lovely and we enjoyed strolling and relaxing outdoors.  Unfortunately, their China Garden restaurant was just awful.

Siamo stati varie notti in questo hotel inutilmente pretenzioso. Le camere che ci hanno dato erano piccole ed i bagni vecchi. Pulizia nella norma. Il menù a buffet banale e sempre lo stesso. Il personale è gentile ma tutto finisce qui. Peccato

during my stay was shocked to receive such a treatment from the front office staff, and the food and beverage department is just awful. ordered for goan fish curry and found the fish was not fresh, was really disappointed with my experience.

Lo primero que destaca, además de la amabilidad de la gente, es la tranquilidad que se encuentra en el hotel fuera del típico bullicio de la ciudad. Aunque necesitaría alguna reforma, mas de decoración que otra cosa en las habitaciones, su estado es bastante presentable.Variedad de restaurantes dentro del complejo para todos los gustos con comida internacional. Cualquiera de ellos ofrece una buena calidad. Los precios relativamente altos teniendo en cuenta donde estamos.

Hotel correto. Bem cheio ,mas com serviço atencioso. Quartos melhores ficam no prédio novo. Excelente café da manhã .Com inúmeras opções de pratos ,frutas e sucos. Bons restaurantes no hotel . Principalmente o restaurante italiano.

The Crowne Plaza Soaltee.This is a grand hotel with many rooms. In Kathmandu  There is a huge lobby.  The staff is competent.  However, while we were waiting in the clearly marked “No Smoking” lounge an Arab in full regalia sat down and lit a cigar at a table clearly marked “No Smoking” and the staff brought him an ashtray!  Food in the buffet dining room is always divided between vegetarian and non vegetarian or local and western.  The food is of good quality.  Wifi access is by fee only and is pretty expensive.  There is no “free zone” in the lobby as in many hotels.  A local beer is more than 250% than can be obtained in local restaurants.  This is gouging.  I have no idea of room costs here as we were assigned by our tour, however, wifi policies would tell me to not return.If you do come however, accept a room whose numbers run from 01 to 37, preceded by the floor number.  Eg, 416 is room 16 on the 4th floor.  These rooms are in the newer wing and are better equipped electrically for recharging.  Other room numbers higher than these are in an older wing, which, according to us, smelt of damp, plus one definitely needed an adapter.

After long day with exciting activities in Kathmandu and considering the dusty atmosphere you will be in real need for an isolated clean environment in which you can clean up removing the day's dust and charging up for the next day new adventure. The facilities are good with wide outdoor  garden and nice pool surrounded with wooden pergolas for lovely evenings. shuttles and taxis are available all the time.CheersAhmed Mihanni

Stayed a total of 3 nights in 2 different rooms. This hotel is not remotely up to par for a 5-star Crowne Plaza.Location: Away from noisy street, nice gardens.Rooms: Very cold (the housekeeping staff leaves the A/C on with the thermostat set at 15°C), no heat even though the outside temperature drops to 14°C at night (I was told it doesn't get turned on until the end of November). Very old furniture. Light switches difficult to find. Comfortable bed. Room amenities include coffee maker and laptop-size safe. There is an iron but its plug is not compatible with any of the electrical outlets in the room. One of the rooms had an unpleasant smell of cigarette smoke, apparently coming from the ventilation system.Bathroom: The shower in one of the two rooms (on the 5th floor) had very low water pressure, the other one (3rd floor) was good. Toiletries half empty and not replenished. No hair dryer.Staff: Housekeeping leaves some to be desired (coffee and toiletries not replenished).Gym: Open 0600-2100 (did not use).Breakfast: Ok, but not great.Internet: WiFi charges (about $5 for one hour or $15 for 24 hours) are exorbitant by Nepalese standards. WiFi was once down for 15 minutes.

We went for a 4 day break as my husband travels here at least every month with work and I was curious about the Country.The hotel was situated in a nice quiet area in beautiful gardens and nice courtyards.The service from start to finish was impeccable, beit doormen, reception staff, house staff, bar staff, restaurant staff. They were polite, happy and very helpful.My only disappointment was that there was NO diet coke. They had ran out a few days before, but even though I asked on the first night and was there for 4 they never restocked. This was a problem as its the only thing I drink (I am a diabetic)..Other than that...perfect.

Ungerade Zi-Nr. zeigen in den Hinterhof und sind laut (Umluftanlage)Bald jedes kleinere Hotel und Restaurant bietet kostenloses WIFI, nur in diesem hochpreisigen Hotel kostet die Stde 4 USD. Das ist einfach poblig !!Sehr gutes Buffet

Hotel ubicado dentro de barrio residencial, lo que da gran tranquilidad. Es antiguo, por lo que se entienden algunas instalaciones. Sin embargo, se nota que lo están remodelado y excelente. Los restaurants son realmente exquisitos. Absolutamente recomendable.

The hotel is well located in the middle of the city with reasonably easy access to the airport (notwithstanding the traffic!). The hotel is rather elderly but still works well given the room refurbs that have been done. Service is good.

The Hotel is not new, but very well maintained. The so called Executive Rooms even have a brand new modern bathroom in it. We stayed for 10 nights in total. Breakfast is very good and there is something for every taste (staff extremely friendly and helpful). We tried all 3 restaurants and would rate them as follows:Chinese: very good (be aware of the huge portions)Indian: goodItalian: standard (not bad, but also not particularly good)Room for improvement: Internet, laundry and business center services are very costly. The staff at checkout (and probably their back office) could be better organized. (Things got forgotten, and lag of alignment with travel agent resulted in embarrassing situations more than once)Overall: The overall very good impression supersedes the trouble with the weaknesses

We spent a total of 5 nights at the Soaltee over two visits to Katmandu.  It is not a 5 start hotel with swish modern design and decor, but it is a high standard hotel that retains the charm of its heydey.   The hotel has 4 restaurants - one for casual dining and breakfast buffet.  The others themed on Asian, Indian and Italian.   Strangely, no Nepalese restaurant, but Nepalese food is on the Indian menu at the Indian restaurant.   The breakfast buffet was good without being anything special - good range of Indian, Asian and Western dishes.  The Indian restaurant was excellent, as was the Asian.  Both are reasonably priced.Location is a short walk from the main produce market - which makes a very interesting excursion.  Otherwise, it is a car trip to all the standard attractions.  With traffic, everything  took at least 20 minutes.They have a great pool area and surrounding gardens.  Looked particularly good at night with all the Diwali lights.Our rooms were reasonably sized - not as spacious as some, but enough room for a 2-seater sofa.  No balcony.  Air conditioning worked fine.  TV had a good choice of channels - including many English language. Bathroom was a good size and very clean. On our first stay we were given a room on the back side of the newer wing.  It had a very noisy generator operating close by.  A word to the duty manager and were were immediately shifted to another room (in the old wing) which was equally comfortable but completely quiet.  Had a similar experience on the second stay, but that time we found the bed too hard for our liking.  They again shifted us to a room with a softer bed.  All done with no argument or fuss.  We got a good sleep each night.Cannot comment on the internet other than to say it was not free - quite expensive actually.  The Business Centre was also chargeable.Service was excellent through all areas of the hotel.  Restaurant, housekeeping and reception - always friendly, always smiling and always helpful.  After 5 nights, we almost felt at home at the Soaltee.  Relaxed and comfortable.Overall, we were enjoyed our stays at the Soaltee.   We would have no issues returning.

Compared to two other  Kathmandu hotels we have stayed in, this was the best. The location was surprisingly quiet. We were given an extremely large room with very large bed, good lighting, separate seating area and large modern bathroom. The staff were very attentive.We ate in the Indian restaurant and a had an excellent meal with very good service.There was a good choice available for breakfast.There was a pretty garden with a nice pool / pool area - my only negative comment would be that the water in the pool was freezing. It would have been nicer if it had been heated just a  little.

We arrived here on the morning of the 18th (October) and were welcomed by extremely pleasant staff, check-in was smooth (I'd highly recommend booking before arrival, I'd made a booking through Kayak.com, as rack rates can be hard on the pocket!). After a couple of hours I took a little tour of the hotel and its grounds. The well-manicured gardens were lovely and the hotel is generally well kept with a modern yet classic appeal. The gym was nothing to write home about, had all basic necessities and looked better in the pictures, but pool area was good. Our room, a standard double room, had a city view  set against the backdrop of the many surrounding hills and was all right, with all basic necessities.     The location of the hotel is great, few minutes from the town but a little far from popular tourist spots such as Thamel and Durbar square. Come dinner time, had the urge to sample Nepalese cuisine so we headed to the Kakori restaurant at the hotel. Honestly, the food was  OK. Nothing less, but the ambiance and extremely pleasant staff made the experience a whole lot better. As we were off to Nagarkot the next day, had breakfast before starting our journey. I have to say, this was by far my favourite meal at the hotel with a sumptuous array of choices. All in all, this hotel was really good and I enjoyed every bit of my stay even though it was so short. I'd definitely recommend it to tourists seeking a comfortable stay.

We stayed on two occasions on our way to and from Bhutan October 2014.  As we had a driver the location was not a problem and the hotel provided a wonderful base to explore Kathmandu.  The rooms were spacious and well appointed and I slept incredibly well (unusual for me!).  Our first room had lovely views across the gardens while the second was at the back but to be honest I don't spend a lot of time staring out of windows and the comfort was more important.  I love to have a bath as well as a shower and was not disappointed.One waitress in the Garden Terrace gave us excellent service and recommended meals for us as we could not make a decision.  I am only sorry that we did not take her name to provide feedback at the time.  she will know who she is as we especially wanted to eat goat and she recommended  a very tasty curry.The Chinese restaurant had the best menu I have ever encountered and the quality of the food was exceptional.  I only wish it was on my local doorstep.I am not sure that I will have the opportunity to return to Nepal but I would stay here if I did.  As we had organised trips with hotel pick up the location was not of concern and I found all the traffic and sights just added to the experience of being in Nepal.

Safe, clean, quiet, and comfortable.... this was really all I needed for this trip and the Crowne Plaza delivered.  The rooms are large, well appointed and comfortable, especially after having just traveled to remote regions of Nepal and staying in some very basic accommodation.  I'd come back as well as recommend this place to friends. The gardens and outdoor areas are very relaxing and peaceful. Safe travels!

Wir waren im Rahmen unserer individuellen Rundreise insgesamt fünf Nächte in diesem schönen Hotel. Schon der Deluxe Room ist sehr gut eingerichtet. Minibar, Safe, TV (mit Deutscher Welle) vorhanden. Das Zimmer wird zweimal am Tag gereinigt. Tolles Frühstücksbuffet (Egg-Corner, Europäisch, Asiatisch), man kann auch draußen sitzen. Wir waren auch Abends zweimal dort essen. Indisch, Italienisch und im Hauptrestaurant gibt es ein sehr gutes Buffet (ca. 21 $). Schöner großer Pool wo man mal wirklich Bahnen ziehen kann. Moderner Fitnessraum und Saunabereich sind ebenfalls kostenlos. Sehr gutes Hotelpersonal. Das Hotel liegt ca. 3 KM von der Innenstadt entfernt. Mit dem Taxi ab 300 Rupies (mit dem Taxis v. Hotel ca. 400 Rupies). Auch Patan ist für ein wenig mehr mit dem Taxi erreichbar. Außerhalb des Hotels gibt es an der Straße gerade nicht viel interessantes - da sollte man dann schon in die Innenstadt fahren.

Siamo appena tornati da Kathmandu e siamo stati al Crowne 5 giorni  due  prima di partire per il Bhutan e altri  tre alla fine del viaggio.Dall'Italia, sulla base delle informazioni lette, ho chiesto 4 camere affacciate sul giardino, che non ci hanno dato e a fin viaggio le abbiamo ottenute solo dopo nostre svariate lamentele.Le camere a parte le ultime affacciate appunto sul giardino  con vetri apribili, avevano un forte odore di chiuso e muffa, ma soprattutto non erano pulite, ho dovuto chiamare la reception due volte per farmi cambiare un letto vistosamente sporco. Peccato perché l'albergo è in una buona posizione, lontano dal rumore della città ma comunque raggiungibile in breve tempo. Appena fuori ci sono negozi  carini e con cose molto belle. L'albergo ha un esterno molto comodo e di grande impatto, ma le camere non sono assolutamente da albergo 4/5 stelle, neppure i bagni. Personalmente non andrò più e non consiglio il Crowne Plaza di Kathmandu.

Have been staying at this property several years in a row.Ambience is good, restaurants very good - the Alfresco Italian and coffee shop for breakfast and dinner - good variety, staff very attentive.  Front desk, concierge, housekeeping and telephone operator, all very professional and courteous.   Rooms are regular size, quite tight if you need an extra folding bed.  ground floor rooms on the old side are usually smoking rooms. Stayed on 4th floor, non-smoking room and only comment is rooms need better maintenance - medium size live roach found in drawer there the hair dryer is kept, 2nd night small roach walking close to the bar and one dead one. Shops on the street facing hotel have very good prices.

Très bel hôtel dans une magnifique ville.Les chambres sont correctes. La notre avec vue sur des machines de tri pour l'eau.Le buffet est varié et très bon que ce soit le petit déjeuner / déjeuner / diner !La piscine un peu fraîches mais très agréable.Tres bon séjour, je recommande cet hôtel !

Stayed on 3 occasions in 3wk period. Large hotel, but not high rise set in nice grounds but with little to see in the immediate vicinity.  Staff very attentive and approachable from the moment you enter the grounds.  Many guests are 1 or 2 night only so reception is busy but delays are rare. Furnishings are good. Had 3 different rooms, all similar with the only problem being the noise from an unknown source in room 250 which is too near the lifts. Rooms are good size, well furnished and the bathrooms are good. Views are limited and the windows in all our rooms were very dirty.Bar area is dismal but outside the reception is a good sitting area which would be better if the taxi and coaches switched off their engines when dropping off.  Ridiculous WIFI charges so went to nearby GRAND HOTEL for lunch where WIFI is free.Dined in all the evening Restaurants and found the Indian to be the best food although the others were ok. Breakfast good choice but only opens at 6.30am and could do with opening earlier.

We were "bumped" off our Dragon Air flight from KTM-HK and the airline put us up for 24 hours till the next flight at this hotel.  It is a beautiful, modern hotel and while our visit was under inauspicious circumstances, we made the most of our time at the hotel, having a relaxing day on site.  The hotel grounds and pool are lovely, the buffet style restaurant has great food and the staff are helpful and engaged!  I would have given the hotel 5 out of 5 except for its location which is a ways out from downtown Kathmandu - not walking distance to anywhere interesting close by.

One of the best hotel in Nepal. We are stay 1 night but excellent service Millions smile of staff. Nice room very clean. Thank you so much ms sabina dangol you make our trip momeryball  my wife is really happy with service food everything is superb. Morning breakfast is unforgettable. Thank you so much all staff we are 100% sure come back ....

Estamos aquí por nuestra luna de miel y desde que lo saben han sido fantásticos con nosotros regalándonos tartas y postres. Son muy serviciales y todos muy agradables, desde luego tras nuestra experiencia en tibet donde el hotel era horroroso y el servicio pésimo esto nos parece lo mejor de lo mejor.Las habitaciones son amplias y aunque es cierto que el hotel no es lo más moderno del mundo para Khatmandu nos parece una maravilla. La piscina también vale la pena usarla si hace buen tiempo ya que es muy agradableSi te haces miembro de Crowne Plaza no sólo te dan más servicio durante el desayuno, etc sino que además el internet es gratis así que lo recomiendo si vienes aquí

Spent two nights at the Crown Plaza plus a discounted day room only. Lovely hotel with all the amenities including the Italian themed Alfresco restaurant.Great breakfast, nice bar area, pool complex, and outdoor seating area at front entrance.Charge for wifi.Excellent place to stay in Kathmandu

Μειναμε 3 νυχτες αρχες Σεπ 2014 Ευχαριστο περιβαλλον Δωματια ευρυχωρα καθαρα και με ανοιγομενα παραθυρα Το προσωπικο πολύ εξυπηρετικο Ο Μπουφες πρωινου και δειπνου πλούσιος σε ποικιλια ,αλλα θα προτιμουσα και την επιλογή Εθνικης κουζινας γιατι όλα ηταν καυτερα Το μειον του Ξενοδοχείου η Χρεωση του Internet Θα το επισκεπτομουν ξανα ευχαριστως

If you want a more peaceful location with green space, this is a decent option, though distance from town (and terrible traffic) means it is less convenient for sight-seeing. The pool area and outside bar are pleasant places to relax and the bar staff are very friendly and helpful. The indian restaurant food is good but breakfast isn't great, serving, for example, cheap breads and sugary drinks rather than fresh juice. Rooms on lower floors facing the back have poor views - basically they look out at some kind of the generator shed.  This makes a very loud noise for long hours, waking me up at 5am one day. Rooms are fine though the bathrooms are quite tired. Water in the toilet is near the top of the bowl and every time you flush you watch in trepidation, expecting it to flood. Overall this is fine, maybe one of the better options, but don't expect it to be top-notch.

Definitely a wonderful paradise in the magical Nepal. Although isolated, offers the best service and the managers will go beyond their duties to please the guests. It's not every day we can relax at the same hotel where a Queen (Elizabeth II) and a Princess (Diana) stayed. Superb breakfast, pleasant view and friendly staff as a whole. A place to rest and enjoy tranquility!

Very good location for a place like Kathmandu, where everything is nearby and far at the same time. The hotel remains in very good condition and the you have all the facilities you expect in a 4/5*. Special mention for the garden and pool are which is a very pleasant area to walk on. Staff is great, always ready to help with a smile and they really listen to you when you express a complain or concern, helping you according to the possibilities. Breakfast is excellent and food choice is diverse. There are some minuses regarding some brief interruptions on electrical power and noises at times in the morning but overall is a great place to spend some time in.

I had been on a business trip to Kathmandu and stayed at Soaltee on 8-9 Sep. Expectations ran high but it soon crash landed. Wifi not included in package, whereas we asked for it during booking. Its good that the manager Mr. Sachin was kind enough to provide it complimentary, but it was either too slow or it stopped intermittently. Room service is very lethargic, call for any room service and you will spend 2-3 more reminders before anybody knocks your door. But the most shocking part was hotel's cab service. The cars are perhaps older than me. Although they are well maintained, but riding a 30 year old car with no AC and almost non-existing headlights, it was a horrible experience. The driver also had no idea of where we wanted to go. The room was silent, cozy and comfortable with effective AC and a fairly good view. We had breakfast which was not bad, but again service was not satisfactory. Overall it was an average experience staying here. Well, the driver recommended to stay at either Hyatt or Dwarika hotels in our next visit. I should perhaps try that suggestion.

Città bellissima, hotel all'altezza.Il Crowne Plaza ha tutto quello che si può desiderare: pulizia e organizzazione, camere spaziose arredate con gusto e dotate di ogni comfort, personale cordiale e sempre molto disponibile, giardino con piscina e patio con servizio bar, ottima qualità nella ristorazione.Inoltre, l'hotel ha un potente generatore di emergenza che ripristina in pochi istanti la fornitura di corrente alla struttura, aspetto non trascurabile visti i frequentissimi blackout a Kathmandu.Unica nota di demerito: l'hotel non ha il wifi, mette a disposizione una business room con alcuni computer e cavi per la connessione in ogni stanza, ma entrambi questi servizi sono a pagamento (circa 3$ per 30 minuti).Resta, in ogni caso, il miglior hotel in cui io sia stato durante la mia vacanza in Nepal e Tibet e lo consiglio caldamente.

Um hotel excelente, muito confortável, sofisticado, ótimo serviço, tem padrão internacional com sofisticação local, vários restaurantes de qualidade no hotel, combina perfeitamente com a exótica Kathmandu e seus arredores e completa a tranquilidade da estadia.

i have viseted in july. Very nice, great staff, super clean and awesome food. I had an awesome stay, even though it was short. I did eat dinner on site and had some very tasty food. They also had some very nice shops underneath the hotel.

Todavía estoy en el hotel. Lo único que tiene 5 estrellas es el precio porque me parece sobrestimado. El personal es muy atento y esta llenó de buenas intenciones, solo eso. Poco expeditivo. Internet caro y lento comparado con otros hoteles de cadena 400 x 1 hora, 600 x 6 hs y 1200 por día hablando en rupias nepalies. Internet muy lento. No me buscaron del aeropuerto a pesar de que estaba solicitado. No tienen botellitas de bebidas espirituosas en el minibar. Habitación que me toco es anticuada. La ubicación inconveniente. Hay cortes de luz espontáneos y no hay luz de emergencia en la habitación hasta que se activa el generador. La limonada de bienvenida es agua sucia, no la prueben. Llegue a las 17,30 hs al hotel y a las 6,15 fui al travel desk para organizar mi estadía y me pidieron volver al día siguiente porque había cerrado. No entiendo como Crown plaza mantiene el nombre de la marca en Nepal. Resta puntos. Asimismo las cinco estrellas con suerte las pueden encontrar de noche y les aseguró que desde acá no se ven. Muy malo hasta ahora pero no creo que cambie. Está en declive.

It's location is bit far from the airport and city centre... Otherwise gotta good service and taxis needs to improve... If you need a good and luxuries vehcile then you better mention it to the hotel admin in advance... Otherwise it's bumpy ride most of the time you get in one of those old Toyota low floor sedan.. Best thing is book a good high ground clearance good suspension vehcile for ur entire stay... So that you can have it whenever you go out... Nothing more.... Regards Harry

I stayed at Soaltee, kathmandu last month during my business trip. I felt the comfort of my home there! Entire staff was very courteous, helpful and supportive. Special mention of Vijayata (front desk), Srishti (Sales) and Coffee house Manager, who have helped all the ways to make our stay comfortable and enjoyeable. Thanks for the excellent service!! :)

Once the best property in Kathmandu, the room size is good, but tired  with smelly carpets, passages and musty rooms. The furniture is timeworn and the bathrooms show age as well. Maybe we got their old rooms, but it was not very pleasant once inside the rooms. Also, there was ongoing construction noises during the day and the place was full of tour groups bound for Himalayas. Not the perfect peaceful stay for us. Having said, the grounds are immaculate, the restaurants fantastic (we tried Chinese & Indian), the service is really good (as across Nepal) and the pool area is lovely. Breakfast spread also very good.If the rooms were nicer, I would highly recommend this property. But we did not enjoy the smelly indoors and shifted to the Hyatt for the latter half of our stay.

Nice & comfortable stay with compliments came as a surprise. The staff was also very customer centric.The trip to Kathmandu wouldn't have been interesting if i had not been to this hotels.Food is good & breakfast Buffet has too many options.Overall very nice n enjoyable experience,

I stayed here for 3 nights and this not the first time. The hotel and the location are excellent. The staff is courteous , friendly and attentive. My room was very clean and quite big.  In all restaurants of the hotel the food is especially tasteful.

Good and comfortable stay. We stayed on the third floor. But view from our room was not good.we were 7 adults and 2 kids.as there was a event going on there was a shamiana that was put up which blocked the window view.Welcome fruits were missing from 2 of the rooms. Which were provided to us when v asked for it. Overall it was a decent room. One thing that I want to highlight is that at night when I asked for infant milk I was told that it's chargeable and when I told that no hotel charge baby milk.The person on intercom said that I will give it complementary for the first time and next time you need to purchase it.The food quality was good especially the Chinese.

Very nice hotel with great rooms in the new wing. The restaurants are authentic specially their Indian, Chinese and coffee shop serve delicious food. The staff is courteous and ever helping. It's easily accessible to all main sites within 15-20 mins. Must plan ahead of time to get to airport though as traffic through the city is a nightmare.

Excellent customer care by front lobby desk employees Bijayata Puri and Sanju Sitaula. Excellent food buffet. Excellent cleanliness. Highly recommend this hotel for all needs. I was there with a group headed for Kailash Yatra.
The goodBe here for a quiet stay, wide lawns and great food. Try the Italian,  had great trout there.The not so goodTad expensive compared to the other 5 stars, it is worth it if you want the above.

Very well preserved building with lovely decor and staff are very friendly and attentive.  Great Chinese and Italian restaurants.  You are made to feel special the moment you enter the gates of the hotel.

El hotel en sí es bastante lujoso, aunque diría que se ha quedado estancado en los 90. El mobiliario de las habitaciones se nota antigüo (la consola de control de la luz parecía sacada de alguna serie retro estilo los Angeles de Charlie). Aun así las habitaciones estaban muy limpias y cuidadas.El servicio de desayuno y cena perfecto, personal muy servicial. Suelen tener un plato occidental y pasta para la cena lo cual es de agradecer después de tantos días en la India y Nepal.De nuevo WIFI de pago y caro (teniendo en cuenta que había cortes de luz frecuentes con lo que la WIFI tardaba bastante en recuperarse).Un poco alejado del aeropuerto y la zona turística, pero teniendo como en nuestro caso el transporte contratado de antemano, no suspuso mayor problema.

Check in for a 1 night stay and was very impressed with the excellent service accorded to me as IHG Platinum member. Everyone from check in to the restaurant address me by name. My table at breakfast, lunch and dinner had a IHG VIP guest placed on it and I presume the staff was told of my presence. One staff stood out was a Ms Manu at the Front Desk who help me with my wifi and also my travel arrangements. She recommended me on the sights to see and places to shop in the city.Worth returning and a charming place that is old but regal in feel

My family and I stayed here for 2 nights after visiting Chitwan National Park and Trekking around Pokhara.  This Crowne Plaza is about 40+ years old and is nested in a peaceful location.  They have a nice small pool with a Terrace and excellent restaurants.  We tried both the Chinese and Indian restaurants during our stay there.They have very helpful staff that seek to impress on their hospitality.  I am have stayed in many IHG group hotels and this is by far the best in terms of hospitality.

We stayed here for 1 night. Has an excellent chinese and indian restaurant. The morning buffet breakfast was also lavish. Only complaint we got an old room in the main wing building which had no bath tub and really old furnishing. Apparently they do have newly furbished rooms. So when you check in do ask for a renovated room. 5 Star rating for an excellent hotel.

I have been staying in this hotel for the past 15 years or so, under various names throughout that time. If you want to get a sense of local atmosphere this is the place to stay. There are better hotels in Kathmandu, but once inside the front door you could be anywhere (and you will pay more). Soaltee has a good location to town and several restaurants. The Indian and the Chinese are excellent. Rooms are being renovated so be sure to get a renovated room away from any renovation work. The hotel used to have a Casino but it was not open on our last visit and I'm not sure if that is permanent. There is a lovely pool and large lawn to walk around. The staff are friendly and helpful. It's easy to enjoy a stay here.

We arrived Kathmandu late evening and requested the hotel to arrange for our pickup which was for an extra cost (25 usd). Staff: The hotel staff were friendly and during check in the Duty Manager came personally to welcome us.Being a IHG member you receive free wifi access in the room and a late check out option.Food: We ordered the Nepali dishes like nepali chicken curry, nepali mutton dry dish and some other dishes from the menu.  We enjoyed the food, it was delicious and a great start to the Nepali cuisine experience. The buffet breakfast was good as well and had a good variety available. Transport: The hotel does not have any shuttle service to the market area Thamel or any place for that matter. I would highly recommend the hotel to consider starting a shuttle service to the market area. We took a taxi from the hotel (they have taxis parked at the crowne plaza vicinity which have temp crowne plaza permits). They charge approx 1000 Nepali rupees to go and come back. If you decide to take time more than an hour they would charge a waiting fee or you can just take a regular cab from the market area Thamel. Sinxe it was our 1st day in Nepal we decided to ask the taxi to wait for us.Hotel: The property is nice, beautiful pool, there is a casino and a few nice restaurants.  The rooms however definitely need a renovation,  the sofa had stains and the dull colour of the sofa and curtains did not help either. The rooms definitely does not live up to the Crowne Plaza standard compared to some other parts of the world.

I was visiting this hotel after28 years! Its still the best in Kathmandu, great rooms good service, polite staff although now it is surrounded by the city. In many ways not so great as in 86 when it was out of the city. Yet it is the place to stay in Kathmandu

Was travelling with my wife and 1 year old daughter. Soaltee is one of the good star hotels in Nepal.Pros:- Great Pool area- Breakfast Buffet was good- High service standards (except for one incident)- Great lawns- Choice of restaurants - Chinese, Italian and India, apart from the coffe shop. We tried the Chinese, it was good- Room service is goodCons:- Far from Thamel area (main mkt and night life). Trip to Thamel costs NR 300 one side- It's an old property. Don't compare this property to other new and swanky Crown Plaza's.- Dinner buffet at the coffee shop was pricey and didn't have great variety2 incidents that I would like to mention:- My daughter fell ill with very high fever. At 3 am in the night we had to ruch her to the hospital. The hotel staff was very helpful in arranging the cab, calling the hospital and giving heads up to the duty doctor and sending a hotel guard with us. We really appreciate such high stds.- The lady taking room service orders was exceptionally rude in taking orders. She even answered back to my wife in a rude manner saying she is very busy taking orders, hence can't be polite - never heard such excuse from any one at any hotel. Next day we raised this concern with the F&B Manager of the hotel, hopefully, she won't repeat it with other guests.To end, I would like to say, if u don't mind the location must stay here.

泊まっていたホテルが、ゴキブリだらけなのでチェックアウトしてここのホテルを予約しました。前日の夜にネットでの予約です。REWARDSメンバーなのでサイトより予約をしましたが、喫煙室を予約したのに禁煙室だったところ以外は問題ありませんでした。日本人なので浴槽があったほうがよいと思い、喫煙から禁煙に変えたとのことです。チェックイン時にはフロントでなく専用カウンターにてウエルカムドリンクを飲み座りながらのチェックインで連れの現地職員にもドリンクを出してくれました。宿泊した部屋は、浴槽はなくシャワールームだけでしたが、特に不便は感じませんでした。他のホテルなどは排水溝から嫌なにおいが上がってくるのですが、特に感じませんでした。仕事で言っているので、ホテルに戻ってきた場合はデスクワークが必須ですが、ここは自家発電なのでたまに一瞬停電になることがありますが、１分もしないうちに電気がつきます。WI-FIもホテル内どこでも利用でき不自由のないホテルです。ただ、周りにはほとんど何もないのと門からホテル入口までかなり遠いので飲み物などの買い出しはちょっとした移動距離になります。空港からも遠く、最近渋滞がひどいのでタイ国際航空を利用するときは11：30くらいには出ないと危険です。

Very high levels of service - kudos to the training department. CPHKS has it nailed- the human touch and the personalised service are what give this prestigious property its soul.- It is an old hotel, sprawled over lavish grounds, undergoing part by part renovation.- unfortunately due to my busy KTM schedules, only spent time at the Bar having football dinner, and a meal at the very ethnic Kakori. wasn't able to swim or gym.- Check-in was overall quick and efficient. So was checkout. And enjoyed all the namasteying and the small exchanges from the staff during my five day stay.- I loved the executive room, with its attention to detail and the amenities, and its splendid view.. No request was small, insignificant or silly for the staff, whether room service or housekeeping. This hotel gives a whole new dimension to the phrase 'atithi devo bhav'!

We just came back from our first trip to the Nepalese capital of Kathmandu where we stayed at the Crowne Plaza Soaltee. The 5 days experience was made all the more memorable by the ever smiling and ever helpful staff members. A very special mention to be made of Kashi and Narayan who worked at the main bar, Tek and Naresh at the Nepalese/Indian restaurant Kakori where the food was just exquisite and the service so quick  and efficient, the attention to detail and the selection suggestions made the meal that much better. Also Saumitra and Bijay from the housekeeping department who used to turn down the rooms in the evening were just amazing - it really is the people and the personal touch that make a difference! Whether we wanted a pair of scissors and tape, disposable cups, immediate repair and maintenance of a fused bulb for e.g. - every member of staff made sure that these requests were accommodated to the best of their ability and at the quickest possible time. I also want to thank Ms. Mona Bhandari who was probably our main point of contact at the hotel who ensured that our stay was great and that we were looked after. We felt so comfortable as a result of experiencing true warmth and natural Nepalese hospitality. An overview of the hotel : It is indeed a great hotel both for business/corporate or if you're going on a holiday. The foyer of the hotel with the unique chairs is a refreshing touch. Rooms are spacious, well equipped good facilities and nice decor/design - it does have everything that you need. They have a great spread of restaurant outlets to choose from. It might seem a bit far from the town (Thamel), main CBD but I feel that the hotel has so many plus points and benefits, with the diverse range of services that they offer, this is not a very significant point.

İ stayed at this hotel with a group of friends.The hotel has a very big and nice garden.İt is a few miles  away from the centre of Kathmandu but with cheap taxi rates,it is not a problem to get to the centre.The rooms are nicely decorated with moderate size.However,they could be improved with a bit of renovation.The staff are all very friendly and helpful.My room was on the side where there was noise coming from the air conditioning system and they changed my room when i complained.İt is very relaxing after a visit to the crowded streets of Kathmandu.İ would recommend this hotel both for business and leisure.

Si bien parece que es el mejor hotel de la ciudad no tiene la calidad a la que nos tiene acostumbrados esta cadena en sus hoteles. El lobby es de tamaño y apariencia estándar, el elevador muy antiguo, se cierra tan rápido y con tanta fuerza que nos golpeó en varias ocasiones. La habitación tiene la calidad de un hotel de tres estrellas, pequeña, mobiliario antiguo. El buffet bueno, el mesero que nos atendió por las noches fue muy amable pues habla español y siempre se esforzó por atendernos muy bien así que por ese mesero y el resto del personal en todo el hotel que fue  tan amable es que el hotel se gana un punto más. Sugiero a la camarera que antes de abrir la puerta toque y espere a que le contesten ya que toco una vez y abrió la puerta completa estando yo adentro sin ropa, lo cual me pareció una falta de respeto.

Being a frequent traveller to Nepal, I have tried various hotels from 7star to budget hotels in various parts of Kathmandu, few good things which I like bout this property were 1. Excellent rooms.2. Excellent Ambiance in all restaurants and in lobby.3. Greenery all around the hotel.4. Very cooperative staff.5. Awesome Indian food at kakori and coffee shop.6. Excellent internet connectivity in entire hotel.Restaurant Kakori served best Mughal food, as Lucknow being a place were you get best Mughal food, Kakori being a place very close to Lucknow 35 km. hence Kakori being most appropriate  name for it, and chef is also from Lucknow, if you get same taste in Nepal, then what else you require.I stayed for 9 days. And entire hotel made me feel like home special mention for few people Ms. Shristi Shresta, Ms. Muna Bhandari, and Chef of Kakori.Excellent place for cooperates.ThanksMohit Arya

I stay for 3 nights on 13, 14, 17-Jun-2014.Here, the first impression was not the last one. A dirty & non-AC vehicle arrived to pick us up from Kathmandu airport. I thought I made a bad choice by choosing this hotel. The ambience, maintenance, service, food and variety was excellent. It's classy affair.Very neat rooms and linen. Excellent quality of toileteries were provided. Complimentary room upgrade and wi-fi. Suggestions: add a few more Indian dishes to you room service menu. Start providing complimentary pick / drop to Thamel.I appreciate the personalised service provided by Front Office Mgr - Deepak Pandey and team.

Avions la chambre 469 donnant sur les toits, donc sans grand intérêt.Accueil agreable -hôtel stndard où descendent tous les équipages. Loin de l'aéroport Chambre et salle de bain spacieuses, mais sans âme.Grand hall avec boutiques  , restaurants bar, terrasse extérieure où l'on peut grignoter des sandwichs "indiens" pas mauvaisLe serveur du bar très sympa.Par contre, excellent buffet le soir, ainsi que pour le petit-déjeuner

It was my first visit to Kathmandu. I picked this hotel for my stay for business reasons. The hotel lived up to its stellar reputation of classic, personalised service and the food was truly outstanding........I tried out their Italian restaurant, Indian cuisine and Chinese restaurant. All above par and that's hard to achieve.The front desk staff were friendly and very accommodating for simple needs. They seem to anticipate my needs very well.........I look forward to my return later this year. Keep it up !!!
