I remember visiting this property 20 years ago and it felt like it was in the middle of nowhere. Well times have changed but thankfully enough the size of the property has not changed. It is an awesome property with lush green lawns, mountain views from the valley city, Kathmandu. A good size pool. The food is just as you would get at a property such as this.. so let us not waste words. The service is very good and staff exceptionally warm and attentive. I love their sitting by the porch, at any time of the day..sit and enjoy the Gurkha beer and unwind from the hustle n bustle, you will encounter as you leave the property..thankfully due to the size of this property, you will not hear any traffic or sounds.. The property in under renovation, upgrading..so if you happen to be in Kathmandu in 2015..this is the place to be..

While you try to figure out how would the place be looking at the surroundings and roads you take to reach this place. Once you have entered you will be amazed by the view of it , a very well done hotel staff is really nice but a little slow " who cares when you are on leisure " the Spa is average swimming pool is good morning breakfast is very good. Recommend this place for few days stay.

i went for a official trip from my company for a week's stay.... my stay was awsome with this hotel, karori resturant is a must try for everybody....services are excellent, neat, clean, lush green environment all around, people at the front office are friendly and cooperative specially Ms Bijayata puri used to take feedback everday and tried to impove each day...great care and hospitality...i recommend everyone to this hotel....thanks

Just returned from a 3 nights trip to Kathmandu. Just an all round great hotel. The staff are absolutely top notch and are always there to serve you with a smile. Food is great if not excellent. The bar is pretty nice too. They have a Valet desk which also serves as a taxi desk, and is quite reasonable compared to other 5 star hotels. The room furniture, carpet and bathroom fixtures are a tad bit old but in decent working condition. Had a view of the pool from my room window. The only downer is the fact the hotel is a bit far from Durbar Marg and Thamel, but not a problem because taxis are easily available. overall, a great hotel.

The CP Soaltee is a tad tired. The furniture and furnishings are showing their age. However, this is still a good hotel by world standards, and an excellent hotel by Nepali standards. The grounds are beautiful: an island of tranquility in a noisy, chaotic city. The breakfast buffet is superb, and the Chinese restaurant downstairs serves delicious fare. The shops downstairs sell reasonably priced merchandise, but for the real bargains, just stroll out the front gate, and there are the cheapie stores! I would like to thank Ms. Muna Bhandari, Guest Relations Executive for all her kindnesses (cookies, and free internet, because I am an IHG Rewards Club member. I was part of a group, so no IHG points, but that is standard practice.

This is a 5 star property in kathmandu. Also it's a chain of crowne plaza hotels so, I thought this hotel would be very high class hotel but it was completely opposite.Pros:Check in: They were able to provide me early check in and they also changed our room from rear side view to garden view room.Room view: They have a nice garden and swimming pool view room if u take last even number rooms.Garden: There is a big garden in the hotel.Cons:They have more respect for people who come in large number in a group of 30-50 people, delegates but no respect for the families and speciallt Indians.Bed: Extra bed for 3rd person was very uncomfortable.Bathroom : There is something wrong with their tubs. There was a water logging problem in the bathrooms. Size of the bathroom is not large. There was also something wrong with the showers.Room Service: Room service is damn pathetic and if u want something then u have to remind them 2-3 times then also there is no surity whether they provide the thing u asked them or not. Also even if they get it they might take 2-3 hours or may be they don't provide u anything. They don't have talcum powder, oil, swing kit, etc. Don't depend for basic things as in which u expect in 5 star hotel.Food: I had a 3night/4days stay (in the 1st week of june) in hotel with breakfast  in Garden terrace restaurant everyday. In all 3 days there was something wrong with the food. Food quality in the restaurant is very poor. They don't change the menu for vegetarians and may be for non-vegetarians also sometimes. The food is very unhygienic and stale. Juices are not chilled.Linen: They don't change the linen themselves until u put a change my linen card.Maintenance: Maintenance people are always reaching but they will never reach u. So,  dont expect anything from them.Locker: They don't have fixed locker in the room. So don't keep ur valuable items in the lockers as can be moved from one place to another easily.Wifi: You have to pay 500 nepali rupees for an hour. Wifi is not complimentary.Location: It is far away from the main city and for 1 non AC Taxi u have to pay 300nepali rupee for 3 km.Check out: They won't pick your luggage from the hotel. So please take ur luggage yourself. Don't depend on them. You might miss ur flight if u do so.No Activities for kids: They don't have any activities for small kids.Conclusion: It doesn't seems to be a 5 star property. It's just a 3 star hotel according to me.

With a huge compound this is one place where I would prefer to stay in a crowded and polluted city like Kathmandu. For older people the rooms near the elevator is preferred as walking to the flanks 35 rooms away several times in a day will be tiring. The rooms are good with more or less Indian taste. The hotel has WIFI but its not free..ha ha. The service is good and the Indian food served is good too.

we were there for three night and enjoyed our stay. hotel is very well organised and very courteous staff, good food specially breakfast was excellent.only negative was house keeping which was not up-to the hotel standardwould stay there if return this city

Es un hotel muy grande, lleno de lujo y pisos brillosos y detalles finos. Muy beuna la habitación, comimos en dos de los restaurants del hotel, muy bueno aunq caro para nuestro bolsillo. La ubicación no es mala, la limpieza excelente.

The lobby area is unattractive, the noise levels due to construction are high, too many mosquitoes in the hallway that enter the room, the food quality can be greatly improved. You can get better value for money at other places in Kathmandu.

I stayed in Soaltee for 4 nights with family and it was a fabulous holiday.The hotel is very well organised and has perfect staff. Right from airport transfers to check-in; right from food to sight-seeing..everything was lovely. The property is beautiful and well maintained. The swimming pool is awesome. On checking in there was some renovation sound coming from top floor; reoprted the same to reception and within twenty minutes they changed us to a beautiful room. The staff is warm, cordial and receptive to your feedbacks.The food especially at the Chinese resturant was marvellous. Its very neat, clean and well-organised. Some suggestions too....firstly it would be great if they start with some kids club or activities; another would be that there should be exhaust in the washrooms and lastly if they can organise some cultural programme for guests it would be highly appreciated. Overall a memorable and beautiful stay.

stayed at Soaltee from 21st to 23rd May 2014, had a great time, the breakfast was excellent, the food at pool side restaurant was very good. little disappointed as the  Casino was not working due to some Govt regulation. The spa is so so bot enjoyed the Sauna and Steam.

Peaceful, clean, beautiful gardens, excellent food. Awesome hotel staff. My stay in this hotel was very pleasant. I enjoyed walking around the gardens. Loved to stay in this Hotel. No more things to say just  I recommend it.

In the mid 80's this property was called Soaltee Oberoi Hotel and Casino. The clientele was mainly North Indian businessmen.Those days, the preferred currencies were the US$ followed by the INDIAN RUPEE(in the casino, anyway)Now the guests are from a wide variety around the world.This hotel is also the HOME-away- Home for night-stopping AIRLINE crews of the foremostMIDDLE EAST airlines.The most attentive,friendly, and courteous staff combined with the expansive grounds andexquisite food served throught the hotel,would take a lot to beat.

This is simple a very very poor Hotel, and not worth the trip.Im surprised Crowne would let this hold its brand.   Rooms are old and Urgently need a Revamp.Internet is very slow.Food quality in Restaurant is simply terrible. The Staff are NOT well trained, and this is expensive Hotel for what it is. US$4.00 for a coke at the Bar, in Nepal is Criminal.TV is Limited channels. Nepalese are wonderful people, and what a shame this Hotel, could not invest in a real make over. Forget the restaurant - You may as well out side on the road.

Nel cuore di una città caotica come Kathmandu, questo hotel rappresenta un'oasi  inaspettata di tranquillità e di benessere.Vi ho soggiornato per 4 giorni con altre 9 persone e tutti sono stati soddisfatti delle camere spaziose, pulite e dotate di ogni comfort.Anche la ristorazione è stata di buona qualità, con varietà di pietanze non solo di cucina internazionale.Era un piacere rientrare in hotel dopo una giornata di spostamenti ed escursioni.

I spent five nights here for an international conference (which also took place in the hotel). The room was fine, a good size, with a desk, sofa, twin beds, an excess of pillows and cushions... The windows could do with a good clean though, I could barely see through them! The soaps were nice, though despite having a sign saying they cared for the environment etc I still got a new soap everyday - I think most guests can cope with using the same bar of soap more than one day in a row!There was good wifi and also a LAN cable in the room. I got it free, perhaps as part of the conference, I don't know if guests usually have to pay.The breakfast selection was varied though I didn't rate the danishes and breads very highly, and the toaster machine was useless. I would recommend the cooked dishes - pancakes, omelettes, south Asian breakfasts.... when we had to leave early one morning they provided us with a breakfast box with a few rolls and boiled eggs and juice in.The grounds are nice. The swimming pool is lovely, though opening at 8am is rather late. I usually got in around 7:45am, I think it could be open from 7:30am at least. The gym is in a basement, has a couple of treadmills and cross trainers, bikes and weights. I would suggest walking around the grounds outside or using the wide expanse of grass or tennis courts instead of being in a dark basement...The staff were helpful and very friendly and polite. Basically this hotel is what you'd expect from a major international chain, in nice grounds and a calm setting.

We stayed at this hotel as it was a good base to explore Kathmandu and was not too far from the airport.We had  booked the club facilities, but at the time of our stay those rooms were being refurbished, so we were given an executive room elsewhere in the hotel.  During our stay we had to have the club facilities in the Rodi bar area as the Club was being refurbished.This meant the plates of food we were given were limited as normally there would be more choice and it would be self service.However we met some lovely people and enjoyed watching the T20 cricket semifinals with a range of nationalities in the Bar area.We ate at 3 restaurants the Garden Terrace, China Garden and the Alfresco, the food and service was excellent and great value for money.For the Shopaholics there are some great shops selling local crafts and Pasminas at very reasonable prices on the lower floor.The extensive gardens are well maintained by the gardeners who all appear to be women as shown in the photograph.The pool area is superb, but the fitness centre is very small and the equipment is limited.

As others have said, this hotel is a wonderful retreat from the crowds of Kathmandu. The rooms  are clean and comfortable and the service is truly outstanding. I arrived at around 10am and check-in time is not until 14.00. Most hotels would just offer to put your bag in storage. Here I was given a welcome drink and asked to wait in the bar. Within 20 minutes the duty manager came over with the key to my room and told me to make sure to include a check-in time with my next booking so that I would not have to wait. That marked a great start to a great stay. For service I would give the hotel 5 stars. My only problem is that the also do a lot of functions and they had set up a marquee for some kind of function on the lawn right outside my room one night. It was loud! When you check in, ask to have a room away from any outdoor functions and you will enjoy a wonderful, peaceful stay in a great hotel. It may be a little out of the way, but taxis are cheap and plentiful and the hotel has a number of excellent restaurants.

Spacious room and friendly staff. Salon ladies are really giving and accomodating. The terrace staff gives just the right attention. Grounds are lovely.onyl salon could do with a facelift and give ita great feel of a salon.

The staff was wonderful.  The rooms are very clean & comfortable, grounds are beautiful.I enjoyed relaxing on the front deck, after a busy day.The location was perfect.  There is also an ATM machine on the grounds, which came in handy.

Stayed for 3 days with my elderly mom and brother. Located 30mins away from Airport (by car through traffic of Kathmandu). Completely isolated from dust, pollution and noise of the Streets of Kathmandu. Beautiful garden and pool. Chinese, Indian and Italian restaurant. We liked the Chinese but most praised is the Indian. People are extremely friendly very helpful and always smiling. Breakfast includes variety of choices from traditional English to traditional Indian style. Very good value for money and pleasant experience of staying.

Having stayed here for 5 days we became very grateful to the peace and calm that this hotel offers from the hustle and bustle which Kathmandu gives you. Rooms are basic but are very tidy and clean. Would stay here again.The housekeeping staff and also the breakfast staff were very friendly, always wiling to help. The front desk staff could learn something from them, you're no more important than anyone else because you wear a suit.Hotel taxis were a very affordable way to travel around Kathmandu and the drivers were always willing to share their passion for their city. Some can offer you a tour of Kathmandu at a fraction of the price which an organized tour can, you're getting a tour with a local. It was money well spent.We ate at the Indian restaurant, we didn't find it to expensive given the quality of the food.

we have stayed for 4 night with group of 12 people, rooms are OK nothing special greet swimming pool are, good food expensive, WIFI chargeable for 5 star hotel :)they should make it free, very slow access any how even if you buy iti would not stay again unless they make it free :)expensive compared to other 5 star hotels

As long as you like rock hard beds this is a great place to stay. The people who work in the hotel could not be more kind and helpful. Breakfast is a buffet and awesome. Everything about this hotel is great with the exception of the beds. We asked for an extra comforter to place under the sheet which help slightly. Best is to bring a thermarest to place under sheet..

This time ,it was my second visit to this hotel,may be after a decade.A lot of Improvements and positive changes.I stayed in this hotel this time for three nights and four days.The INFRASTRUCTURE facilities are rated as excellent.The infrastructure includes a large  and very clean premises,a number of spacious restaurants,facilities for meeting rooms,conference rooms,Banquet halls etc.Lobby is very good and it allows to feel comfortable.Maintenance is highlight of the hotel.Round the clock maintenance.ROOMS are fairly big though room I stayed is not with much decor.But I liked it because it was comfortable and good outside view from my room .Complimentary welcome fruit basket is welcome.I appreciate the welcome gesture of the hotel.Rooms are very clean and amenities are appreciated.Service by HOUSE KEEPING is good.House keeping ensures clenliness and change of Towels from time to time.The only time I was disappointed was due to delay in serving me drinking water in the morning at around 06.15 a.m The two complimentary two small bottles were found empty.This could be because house keeping staff are expected to report may be at around 07.00 am.ROOM SERVICE is prompt.Food is reasonably tasty.I availed room service for two dinners.BREAKFAST venue is very spacious.It was spread over such a way that requires a quick tour to find out the food preparations and how they have been arranged.Otherwise there is every chance of missing some food items which may be of our taste.Very good and all kinds of cuisine are available.Hotel is a place to walk around.I coulnd not explore and enjoy all facilities because of association with the conference for two full days.I recommend this hotel to those who wants safety and security.Hotel makes you feel that it is home outside home..Coceirge performs their duty satisfactorily.Front Desk can be oriented to provide guidelines to the tourist about the city of Kathmandu.Right now they know how to perform their front desk duties only.I am happy with my stay.

The room given to me was stinking......I had to change 3 rooms to get normal room. Even the room i got was old. The room staff is stupid and not understand english. In room dining staff is also very slow and took me 10 minutes to make them understand my order. Only good person was at the bar.The location is also very far from main areas.

Ensconced within the hustle of Kathmandu is the Soaltee Crowne Plaza Hotel and it is indeed a refuge for those unaccustomed to the intensity of daily life of Kathmandu. Indeed it proved such a welcome respite that our party spent the rest of our first day tucked away in its warm embrace.The Soaltee Crowne Plaza is a sprawling establishment. Check-in was slightly delayed due to the need to make arrangements for our party of three but amply made up by the complimentary latte & cappucino at the Rodi Bar. Lunch at the Garden Terrace proved delightful with attentive service and possibly most heart warmingly, respectful. The food wasn't bad either.Rooms are generally quiet except that we found that being in room with an adjoining door wasn't particularly soundproof and voices, coughs and clock alarms could be easily heard, and logically, vice versa.Overall though the hotel is a great place to put up with a host of facilities available although it was much too cold to use the swimming pool, plus it being some distance away from the building proper.The only complaint is be the need for the hotel to charge for the use of internet which in this day and age most hotels are offering free of charge, or at least available in the lobby area.

This is a 3 star at best.  The grounds are well manicured, the staff were pleasant and the rooms are comfortable but that's where it ends.  We had to call 3 times to get towels delivered.  How can they clean your room but forget the towels?   The food at breakfast was average at best but lacked any appeal.  The restaurants were pricey for so-so food.  One of the lobby toilets was backed up, and from the smell, it didn't just occur.  They explained their high internet charges ($16 per day) was because it comes from Singapore but EVERY other place we went to in town was free.

ツアーで利用して最初の日と最後の日に各１泊づつしました。最初の日は裏側(奇数側)に宿泊しました。アメニティーやバスルーム等は問題ありませんでしたが、裏には貯水槽が３つ置いてありホテルの陰と目隠しのための木で景観は暗く、貯水槽の音がとてもうるさいです。部屋の布団は薄く寒いです。室内に予備の毛布はおいておらず他の方が書いているように２泊ともスリッパは１組しかありません。ツアーだったので最終日の１泊は最初１階の奇数側を割り当てられましたが表の偶数側を希望し、変更してもらいました。１階の表側になりましたがロビー前の人が往来しており部屋の中が丸見えの状態でした。とても中で着替えられない状態で再びフロントでかけあいましたが奇数以外部屋がないとしつこくいわれました。ＢＭＷの接待で使っており部屋がいっぱいといわれました。更にくいさがって言うと３０分待てばあくといわれました。チェックインが早い時間だったので空いていないはずはなくネパールの現地旅行社の人に怒ると５分で用意されました。他の日本人ツアー客も全員奇数側の裏の暗い部屋を案内されていました。フロントの背の高いキルギス系のようなアジア系の男性はかなり感じが悪いです。同じ値段を払っているなら必ず表の山側を希望してください。景観が全く違うし陽の当たりが違うので満足度が全く違います。朝食をとるレストランで夕食もとりましたがカレー系が多く日本人の口に合うのはのびたスパゲティーだけでした。周辺はとても歩いて観光に行ける場所ではありません。お土産物店が数軒あります。

Glad to have spent three nights here. Every staff member we had interaction with was pleasant and courteous, especially the friendly and helpful young woman at the customer service desk in the lobby. Room 367 and bath was comfortable and functional. Room service was quick and delicious. We also dined at the Italian restaurant (Alfredo's) on site, and I enjoyed the best pizza of the last decade there! Daily breakfast buffet at the hotel was enormous and tasty. Internet was purchased by the hour and was fast. If we ever needed extra free bottled water, shampoo, etc. it was delivered within minutes by smiling housekeeping staff. My only complaint is that the outside room windows needed washing. Thanks again for a fine stay!

Estuvimos 3 días alojados en el hotel,creo que no corresponde a una categoría de 5 estrellas pero una vez conocido el Nepal uno se conforma y le parece incluso maravilloso.El buffet es bueno, wifi de pago, agradable restaurante italiano donde disfrutamos de una agradable cena. el Inconveniente del hotel es las bodas y fiestas que celebran en las instalaciones del casino que esta en el hotel. En los 3 días que estuve alojada hubo una fiesta con música hasta la 1.30 y otra boda con el mismo tipo de música. Me pareció agotador, teniendo en cuenta que nos solíamos levantar a las 6,30. Sinceramente no volvería a este hotel

We were just in Kathmandu, which we enjoyed immensely. Our stay was at the Crowne Plaza Soaltee. This is a fine hotel, with great service and attentive staff. They bent over backward to be helpful.Would stay again in that part of the world.

Stayed at Crowne Plaza Soaltee from 13 to 16 Feb 2014. It was an excellent stay with my fiance. As this was our first trip to Nepal, We didn't know what to expect. The taxi ride to the hotel was somewhat chaotic and the road conditions were pretty bad. So we thought the hotel might be not so nice. When we arrived at the gate, the security did a screen on the taxi and us. Then we drove up the driveway and we finally arrived at the front of the lobby. It was clean and the layout was spacious. The lawn was well manicured and clean. Checking in was a breeze as it was pre-booked thru tripadvisor. We were ushered to a nice and clean room on the 4th floor. Had an issue with the room safe deposit box and was quickly resolved by Mr. Kedar Dahal, In fact, he was the person that makes our trip so special with his assistance and advice on where to go and how to go about it. He assisted us with almost all our requests big and small. If there is a reason to return to Kathmandu, he is one of them. The lobby was quite nice as well as the front porch smoking area.The food at the Garden Terrace was ok only though the service was excellent. We were able to book the hotel's cab throughout the stay visiting many places of interest, shopping and even all the way the Nagarkot. The only grouse we had was the internet connectivity in our room. They however cancelled the charges for our internet usages. Kudos to them. Will strongly recommend our friends and associates to stay in this lovely hotel with pleasant & hospitable staffs. Thank you Crowne Plaza Soaltee. We shall return and very soon too!

ネパールは計画停電の時間が長いと聞いています。その中で、停電時も自家発電機能ですぐ切り替わり電気も問題なく使用できます。部屋のアメニティも一応あるが、スリッパはなぜか1組。ツアーで利用して、初日と4日後の最終日に利用したが2泊とも別の部屋なのにスリッパは1組だったので不思議でした。湯もたっぷりでました。　時間によって制限があるかもしれません。朝食を利用しましたが、いろいろ種類もあって、ネパールという事を考えたら十分供給されていると思いました。ホテル内はセキュリティーもしっかりしているみたいで、喧騒の町とは別世界です。

We stayed at Soaltee for 3 nights. The rooms are comfortable, clean and with good amenities.The staff in each part of the hotel is great and go out of their way to make your stay comfortable. The food is also good (breakfast and the stuff at the Indian restaurant - Kakori). We had earlier stayed in the hotel before more than a decade and equally enjoyed both our stays at the hotel. Would love to stay here again!

Stayed here 2 nights to explore Kathmandu. Very pleasant hotel which was surprisingly good - a lot of effort has been put into ensuring comfort, cleanliness and extensive facilities. It felt like a very good quality western hotel but there were plenty of contented guests from all over the world. We ate at the Chinese restaurant and it was just fabulous. The lemon grass soup was delicious. Gym was more than adequate.We walked outside the gate to catch a local taxi for shopping in Thamel but paid about $30 the next day for a whole day tour using the hotel taxi and our books as guides.Love to stay here again.

I had the ex prince to stay in many hotels in nepal during my trips to this country and last 2 trips I stayed in crown plaza , honestly I found it very good and up to the accepted standard for such hotels the room was very good the food and restaurants and the staff also I found them good specially the staff I like the way they acts and smile , I had the experience with one lady ( Muna bhadour) she helped me many times in many situations I think she was acting and reflecting the hotel image which is good  Actually I'm sure will recommend this hotel to others .
ネパールでの最後の宿泊地であり、今まで利用した中で一番良いホテルだと聞き期待して行きました。敷地も広く、エントランス、ロビーも豪華で、要人が利用する一流のホテルのようでした。泊まった部屋からの景観が悪く、窓を閉めざるを得なかった。部屋のインテリアは良かったのに残念です。照明も暗いし、スリッパもなかった。朝早い出発で弁当利用でしたが、美味しくなかった。

The intent of our trip was a walk down memory lane, so that was successful. The hotel still has its old charm & I must commend staff efforts who made our short stay more enjoyable. Room standards can certainly be better for the price, with better amenities-gym, spa, internet, etc.That said--we will return.

Arrived on a flight late at night, hotel had sent a car to pick us up, quick trip to the hotel.  Prompt, very friendly checkin.  We were extended free internet for being Priority Club members even though we were not elite level.  Rooms were adequate - beds OK, not special.  Both of our rooms were far too hot.  The next day, we asked for help in getting the room temp lowered, an employee came within minutes, but he was not able to fix the problem, and he was unable to open the windows.  Baths were small but adequate.  Breakfast included with our room, fairly good variety and good quality.  Would stay here again, but would hope to get rooms with less heat problems.  Price was a bargain.

We stayed at the Soaltee  for 12 days.  Whilst the hotel grounds are just lovely, in my opinion the hotel is tired.  The staff were incredibly friendly but the service was exceptionally poor- in particular- there was never any soap or toilet paper in the lobby toilets and one had to ask staff members countless times to attend to it and the toilets were always dirty; the rooms were not actually cleaned by the housekeeping staff; the bathroom was not cleaned unless we asked; a mistake was made with our account and our credit card was double charged - when I pointed it out to the night staff I got told that it was absolutely impossible and I was wrong- next morning though, when I drew the matter to the attention of the accounts department it was sorted but not with good grace; I lost count of the amount of times I asked for coffee at breakfast; the massage area in the beauty spa was not clean.On a good note, New Years Eve Bollywood entertainment was excellent as was the buffet and the Chinese restaurant within the main hotel is certainly a cut above everything else the hotel had to offer.  The concierge was very good regarding arranging taxi service.  The shops down stairs are also well priced and offer good quality products at very reasonable prices

Had a brief stay at Soaltee ,though have stayed here earlier too,but fortunately got better carpetless rooms,and better clean room.Staff was courteous and welcoming.Special mention on Guest relation officer Muna Bhandari,who made the stay a comfortable by proactive attitude and also made correction in slightly overpriced bill which I couldn't notice.The only problem I faced was lack of cooling in AC as I was told that during winters only Heating services are activated,nothing to complain it was just personal issue :)

The Terrasses Resort and Spa is a fantastic place! As soon as you pass the (very nice wooden) gates, you feel how special the whole place is. The views on the Himalayas are as good as it gets and you can have them from the restaurant, reception, the huge jacuzzi, the pool, your yoga mat and of course the room. And being terraced makes it that you can feel secluded even when the resort is full.Everything is well thought and carefully designed and implemented, from furniture to excellent mattress and pillows to the quality of the air in the room and the bath amenities.The staff, under the management of Suman Shrestha, is professional and friendly and everyone goes the extra mile. It's not uncommon to run into the owners, who - very low key - helped me understand (at my request) how they managed to build the resort in a environmental friendly way. The long massage I had in the spa was amazing, the hikes organised by the resort guide were exactly what we looked for and the yoga instructor understood well who we were and adapted easily and the sunset cocktails on the helipad were a delight! Finally the food in the restaurant was excellent! We will definitely come back. Thanks to all of you for making our stay so special!

This place is more than what I expected. Firstly I would say location is just gifted…from sun set view to Kathmandu valley  and mountains. Food is one of the best and like homemade style. Hospitality is 5*. It’s not classic or contemporary type resort, it’s quite modern built. I came here in dinner and breakfast package. Plz do not order any extra starter in dinner, it already serves more than enough food (from starter to dessert) for you. Plz try this place, it’s just amazing. 🙏🙏🙏

We spent 2 nights at this gorgeous resort and I could not recommend it enough. Mostly if you want to experience more than the usual Nepalese activities (trekking, hiking the Himalayas) this resort in the mountains of Kathmandu valley area is a hidden gem. Because of its location on top of a hill surrounded by forest and fresh, crisp air, it feels very serene, calming and the views are breathtaking. The resort is kept very clean and beautifully looked after. The Spa treatment was so relaxing and the view from the Spa room overlooking the mountains adds so much to the whole treatment experience. We had a very warm welcome by the resort team. Everyone taking care of us was attentive, friendly and very knowledgable about the resort and the area. I thought that was a huge plus, because I was curious about so many things, the resort, the surroundings, Nepal in general ,and they were happy to answer these questions. I particularly remember Robin being very friendly and helpful, but every single team member was a complete professional. Can’t wait to be back.

Service was really poor with few employees to accommodate the 100s of guests! While we were eating we’d expect water with glass on table however we had to ask for water to those busiest employees cause they have few of them on that shift . The property is in right location however the room or service wouldn’t do justice for the amount of price we paid.  I Don’t think its managers and leaders know what they are doing  cause how can you have 3-4 employees when they have 100s of  guests in that property. The services they provided was very basic and you could get better services in basic hotel which may cost 2500 rupees. This property really need skillful managers who know how to run the great property. Really disappointed by the services they provide .

Must visit. The location is beautiful, the service is attentive, and the rooms are kept impeccably clean.  The Terraces Resort is a must-visit for those seeking a tranquil escape. Surrounded by stunning scenery, guests can enjoy attentive service and spotless accommodations. It offers great value for a rejuvenating getaway. Enjoyed the stay

Great service, great location with beautiful view. Friendly staff. We would love to visit again. Food was so good. We had a Nepali thai set and server suggested us to have chicken bbq with massed potato, taste was authentic.Our room had view of city it looks amazing at day and also with the city light at night it looks amazing.

Beautiful property set atop a hill with idyllic scenes. Room was very well curated and comfortable with a well stocked bar that was all complementary- couldn’t get better! Waking upto the majestic mountains that can be viewed from the balcony was a treat. Bathroom was spacious and luxurious and well stocked too. Food was out of this world for us. So was the service provided by ever smiling and courteous staff always eager to help and pander to your needs. From swimming to jacuzzi to spa and hiking and bicycle tours, and many other activities, there's just so much to do here. Had a wonderful time at view point to watch sunset with hot tea and snacks with cold breeze almost blowing us away was surreal. And view of the pool area and of the city below at night was breathtaking. A must visit place so close to the capital to relax and unwind.  🙏

The perfect luxurious getaway with a personal touch. I stayed here for two nights ( initially came for one ) with my sister and my 9 month old.  Firstly, I was blown away by the warm wooden and modern aesthetics that run’s through the entire property. Secondly, I was so happy that there are slopes to access the main areas ( note the swimming pool area only can be accessed by steps ) so not only is it predominantly accessible for wheelchairs but also my baby’s stroller. I had my hands free and allowed him to take naps while we enjoyed our meals.  Lastly the lovely members of staff on the grounds. Always smiling and warm, especially the front desk members, restaurant staff and housekeeping. A huge thank you to the GM Mr. Suman Shrestha and Mr. Tenzing David for going the extra mile to make our stay memorable. We will definitely be back to see the mountains!!- lastly do go to the Sundowner event they have to watch the sunset from their helipad. 5 mins walk with such cute set up such as bonfire, complimentary refreshments and snacks. Blankets are also provided.

Jacuzzi was dope. And Mr. Rabin was very very very very helpful. He should be fronted more to serve the guests. Suite room should include basic stuffs like hair dryer, tooth brush sets and all. There should be special setting for couple dinner. I didn’t get any.

All services are amazing including the room, food, staffs. The approach to the resort is a bit issue specially from laminar. Otherwise everything is perfect. The prices should be a bit reasonable so that more and more people can enjoy this property.

The stay was very comforting. From the view to the food (special mention to the food, it was really good). The rooms were comfortable, except there were a little malfunctioning in the bathroom. The hand shower and the jet spray were malfunctioning. We hope it’s looked into. Otherwise it was a wonderful stay overall

The resort has stunning views of the Himalayas and the city lights are just breath-taking every evening. The architecture is contemporary and certainly oozes luxury.Food was really fresh and organic with most of the herbs and vegetables coming from the farm on the property. Loved that the menu is completely local and has no imported ingredients.

We had a fantastic time at the Terraces Resort & Spa. The staff were extremely attentive, taking the time to make personal introductions to us and ensure our visit was a special as possible. You couldn’t ask for better views, with the snow-capped peaks of the Himalayas visible every morning from the view points in the hotel grounds and from some of the private balconies. This works very nicely with the relaxing atmosphere the spa facilities provide.Additionally, there were lots of great meal options, especially for vegans and for gluten free guests which was important for my partner and Chef Deepak was very helpful in assisting us with all of our meals.Overall, I would highly recommend this resort for anyone visiting Nepal looking for a serene and relaxing experience.Shirish

An excellent local establishment of international standard. Location on a hilltop provides great views of Kathmandu as well as the Himalayas. Rooms are spacious and well appointed. Good buffet variety featuring a good mix of western, Nepali and Indian cuisine. Staff are attentive, warm and accommodating. Some minor items for improvement. Overall, a great wellness sanctuary and retreat from the busy capital.

The Terraces Resort and Spa has quickly become one of my favourite spots in Kathmandu! Beautiful decor, stunning vistas of the Valley, and a mean Lemongrass Collins cocktail are some of the features well worth the visit to this amazing evergreen mountaintop 'oasis' just an hour from Lalitpur. Loved it so much I'll be back for a third time! The Dashain programme was fantastic as it had family friendly activities such as a barbecue, bonfire and kite flying at the helipad at dusk; movie night (they even provided  popcorn!🍿 ); quiz and karaoke night, art and dance classes for the kiddies. We also enjoyed the jacuzzi and spa facilities (shout out to the shiatsu therapist, I'm a forever convert!) And the lovely hospitality of the staff.We will definitely be back! 🙏🏾🍹

I visited the resort couple of days back, i was there for 2 nights for our business meeting and staff refreshment. The hospitality provided by the resort was excellent, view was mesmerising and the environment was familiar and peaceful, best hour of the spot was the evening. Though i enjoyed every minute. The city lights, from the lights i realized not just New York Kathmandu also never sleeps. Cycling, jacuzzi, swimming, sauna, spa and the foods were outstanding. Staff was extremely helpful and polite. Special thanks to securities and ladies on reception.

We recently stayed at the wonderful “terraces hotel” that surpassed our expectations.  The rooms were cosy, comfortable, and really nicely decorated. The room terrace was really lovely and provided a pleasant retreat. The staff were attentive and always ready to assist, making the experience even more enjoyable. They even went the extra mile for my birthday decorating the room and leaving a cake for arrival. The food was delicious, and the sundowners at the helipad offered stunning views of the sunset. We were even lucky to get Mountain View’s during our stay. Overall, it was a fantastic stay that thoroughly enjoyed.

Such a magical place!  Incredibly tasty food made with local ingredients, the warmest staff you could imagine (from the manager on down to the drivers and porters), beautiful views, thoughtful touches.  Even had our own personal trail guide for the three days and showed us the local nature.  Could not recommend this place more!

Our 2nights stay at this property was superb with great hospitality by the team THE TERRACES…The property is situated on mountain with excellent views and greenery giving a great atmosphere to enjoy your vacations.The sitting arrangement around swimming pool is superb where you can sit as a group.Preparation of food by THE CHEF… Mr Deepak Mishra and his team was simply great. He catered us with all the delicious dishes as per our taste.Jacuzzi, Steam ,Sauna all the services either at restaurant, recreation room , all were well managed by the whole staff very efficiently.Mr Roshan Maharjan was great at his services.The property is located on outskirts and is complete in itself.Many games for kids too.

I stayed at Terraces with my family, and it was an exceptional experience. The poolside area was perfect for relaxing and enjoying quality family time. The food was delicious and the service was top-notch, with attentive staff who made sure we had everything we needed. Our rooms offered a breathtaking view of Kathmandu, adding a wonderful touch to our stay. We were particularly impressed with how the hotel accommodated my grandmother’s specific food requirements, ensuring she had a delightful dining experience. Overall, Terraces exceeded our expectations in every way. Highly recommended!

Rough drive to the top of a mountain to find an oasis of luxury. Despite the cold weather early February, we enjoyed the spectacular views of the Himalaya and the warmth of the  staff. The well catered  sundowner (see picture) from the helipad was a extra surprise.

Had a great experience here. They have highly experienced and attentive staff. Food was definitely the highlight. Ambience was very calming with great views. Try going there when the sky is clear for best views. The city lights view from the resort at night is spectacular. Great spot for couples and family getaway. Highly recommend renting a van from the resort to go uphill as the road can get pretty rough. Overall a good and relaxing experience!

The Terraces has been an amazing and unique stay for myself and my partner. We need to really give a big shout out to Basanta and Rabin, two rockstars of The Terraces, always giving their all, putting their best foot forward, being so warm and hospitable and providing excellent services throughout our stay here. A special mention and credit to the chef, Deepak for always dishing out such top quality and SPECTACULAR FOOD! 😍 Such a treat and we have been truly spoiled by all the staff of the Terraces! 🤗 Thank you and Namaste!! PS: We will definitely be recommending this lovely and luxurious hotel to families and friends!

Had a great stay. Nice hotel, beautiful views, good food. Enjoyed the pool and hot tub, yoga session in the morning, and short walk to sunset view point in the evening with complimentary snacks/beverages provided. Reasonable price with breakfast and dinner included in our package.

We had a wonderful relaxing stay at the Terraces. The hotel offers a great room with European standards, many complementary activities such as Yoga, Hiking and sunset watching. The hotal is located in the middle of nature with a breathtaking view. Basanta, employee from the reception was amazing in helping with the various needs and transfer. We also enjoyed chatting with the GM of the hotel. We would definitely come back when in Nepal. Thank you to all the stuff.

The location is superb, providing serene views that create a tranquil ambiance. Everything about the hotel, from the rooms to the amenities, exceeded expectations. Impeccable service further enhanced the overall experience, with staff members going above and beyond to ensure guests' comfort. A stay here guarantees a perfect blend of luxury and natural beauty.

Excellent hospitality!!!All the staffs especially Mr. Rabin has been really kind and welcoming.Great food with great view. The sunset and the evening stay in their private helipad space gives a different vibe.Highly recommended!!

The ‘trek’ up the mountain to The Terraces Resort is well worth the effort. The property is meticulously maintained, with a contemporary zen architecture. However, the absolute best part is the team of friendly staff who are eager to serve - with special recognition to Rubisha (front desk) who was particularly helpful and accommodating.

The resort is very beautifully made, gives off a very relaxing, zen vibe. The rooms are spacious and the terrace outside our room was huge. No noise from nature , it was a peaceful sleep. We loved the yoga class. We were doing yoga facing the white himalays as the backdrop.  We loved the recreation room, we played Carom board and snooker. We also did jacuzzi and sauna. The sauna machine doesn’t seem to be working well, and the jacuzzi could be a bit warmer. The food (both dinner and breakfast buffet) was delicious . Great selection of indian, western and nepali dishes. The masala tea was yummy. The complementary drinks and sunset activity at the helipad was memorable. Overall, we had a good experience and we would highly recommend it to others. If you are looking to treat yourself and your loved ones, go for this resort.

Enjoyed every moment at the Terraces Resort and Spa. View of mountains from resort is mesmerizing... Chef Deepak Mishra , Suman acharya ( food and beverage ) and general manager made our anniversary special  by decorating our dinner table and made special anniversary  cake for us. All the staff out there were kind and humble ... Never ever seen such nice hospitality

**Resort Review:**From the moment we stepped into the resort, we were enveloped in a world of exemplary hospitality. Sapana, in particular, went above and beyond, offering us a comprehensive guide of the facilities that truly enhanced our stay. Every staff member treated us with genuine warmth and professionalism. And the food! It was nothing short of a culinary masterpiece. Bold claim as it might be, I'd say it was some of the best in the world. Our experience here was nothing short of magical. Highly recommended!

Best place for a quick getaway. It gives you a wholesome Nepal experience in 24 hrs. The breathtaking mountain ranges are visible in all their splendour, quick hiking trails to be explored, mountain biking tracks nearby, a great spa with some exotic sound healing sessions, a mod infinity pool with a jacuzzi and sauna, glittery night view of the valley. Adventure, peace, lounging to perfect beats … it’s all there. When you  Are short on time but want it all… this is it

Great stay, beautiful facilities, and warm and kind staff. I look forward to coming back again soon. Thanks so much for everything! We will certainly be back again soon. The food is extremely good and the views of the Kathmandu valley are stunning at night.

Too expensive for normal Nepalese people.....It is just made for tourists. Please reduce the price.The great view is not seen from every room as said in google.... Other are considerable but the price is too much for normal people... If the price will be down, then more people will come and your business will be better.

Better than resorts in Nagarkot & Bhaktapur. Stand alone property in the area which makes it less chaotic and offers nature's best. Fine service, amenities, jacuzzi, spa, sauna, pool and bar. Courteous staff. Roads are good and clean till 3 km before the resort which makes it lil difficult in the rainy season but other than that it's a peaceful experience.

The hotel is way overpriced given the services and facilities, although the staff try. The road is poor. There was detox water on arrival, but no glasses. The AC remote in our room did not work, so the temperature could not be regulated at night,  and food was just average. There are better options in Dhulikhel and Nagarkot at half the price.

We had the best time in our family gathering. We were visiting from USA whereas some family joined locally. They catered to personal needs lots of vegetarian options so my mom was happy. Kids had great time as tons of activities such as swimming, gym, cycling. Most scenic and organic view most importantly the best staffs. We recommend this place to everyone.

The architecture of this property is to marvel at; the property is nestled within the natural landscape that provides a tranquil atmosphere, which helps you calm down from the hustle and bustle of the ‘Du. The service is top-notch with friendly people that balance the right mix of being friendly and giving space when needed. Plus, the early morning yoga, jacuzzi, poolside bar, and spa is there to pamper you in your vacay!

The resort is beautiful, clean, peaceful with friendly and cheerful staffs. Not very far from kathmandu, it offers a lot of activities like cycling and hiking. We were there during dashai and also had a chance to enjoy kite flying (A special tailored program for the occasion). The resort is kids friendly.  The road to the resort is a bit rough (adventurous).   à la carte menus were not upto the mark. Overall, a great experience, and a place we would like to revisit.

Liked · The venue is simply amazing! The people, the location, the food, the schedule. You start your morning with yoga, then doughnuts at the local kitchen, and tracking after that. You can do a massage with an exceptional mountain view and finish your day with a jacuzzi and a glass of wine savouring delicious food at the restaurant—best regards to Deepak, an amazing chef. The yoga instructors were also great. BTW forgot to mention the sunset program at the viewpoint next to the hotel - music, beverages and amazing scenery. 11 out of 10! Thank you for the great 4 days! I will be back!

What a view from the Terraces!!! I stayed 3 nights and was almost engaged in all the activity at here like bicycle tours, village tours, etc.Spacious room area and modern amenities.  Spa and swimming pool.

This place is amazing and the view to the Himalaya was out of this world. The staff was very helpful and considerate and they make you feel home. They offer some activities such as sunset gathering, where gusts can gather around the fire and have stars gazing

This lovely place is for the ones who are looking for a quiet and refreshing time. And believe me you would not want to go back!!Food wise Breakfast was super, dinner buffet could get better and some items could be added to the a la carte menu.The extra activities make the memories richer. Lovely and lively ambience! Great hospitality!

Wow! Amazing hospitality and the resort itself is so beautiful. Situated right across the mountains, the view is heavenly. We celebrated our marriage anniversary there and the staff went above and beyond to make our day memorable. The restaurant food is also extremely delicious and the menu is well curated by a talented chef who made sure the attention to detail was 100/100. The hotel management is top notch and will go above and beyond as well. Thanks for such a wonderful time! We will come back again

Just loved EVERYTHING about this place! We spent only two nights which felt wayyy too short. The staff was maybe the frendliest I have ever seen anywhere - everyone was involded, including the management, to make sure guests had good time.Food was excellent, we tried it all, breakfast, lunch and dinner. Facilities are also great for peaceful getaway, pool area with jazuzzi, poolbar etc has the most amazing view and great vibe. And this place even has saunas and a gym. Big plus!Overall just 10+ experience, will be back for sure!

Excellent location with beautiful view. Very good service and friendly staff. Highly recommended! You can do various activities including watching sunset, hiking, swimming and spa. Not very far from Kathmandu city. A perfect place for weekend activities or family vacation.

I enjoyed my stay here a lot! The view is amazing, very calm, people can easily relax here and escape from busy and noisy city.Staff is extremly kind and helpful.The other highlight of my stay was the morning joga session, I highly recommend to try it!:)

What a fabulous place for weekend fun and activities, it gives you complete relaxation and peace in your mind and soul. I liked the local kitchen, singing bowl healing therapy. Sunrise and sundown both can enjoy, 180 degree Mountain Views and near by green hills.

We had an amazing time at Terraces, the territory is beautiful with both poolside area and forest side. Lots of activities to do including sound healing, yoga, hike and spa. Beautiful rooms with great interiors and views, very nice and positive people working in Terraces. It’s a haven for relaxing and reconnecting with nature, we especially loved sunset on the helipad. Highly recommend to anyone visiting Nepal and will definitely be coming back again!

Top notch attention to guest services. Amiable staffs who make you feel welcome and made the stay pleasant and happy. Peaceful and quiet. Lots of greenery all around. Food is also good. We enjoyed the many activities they had to offer.

I stayed one night in this resort and it’s totally worth it.. i find it one of the finest resort in Nepal. Every penny you spend is absolutely worth it.. I would like to specially thank Robin from front office for his very much amazed hospitality, management should be proud of having him. I would also like to thanks Roshan from pool bar. Thank-you and will definitely be back💕💕

Facilities are good with mountain and valley views, specious room also with some views, used facilities like yoga, steam and saunna, poolside bar. Acess road is horrible to reach, had a short trek to Lakuri. Ovearll good resort but with very much overpriced. Not sure if it is for locals?

After 3 weeks of hiking and mountaineering, our four day stay at the terraces was the perfect way to close out our Nepal holiday. The room was so comfortable, the grounds and view beautiful and the staff were so unbelievably friendly and attentive the whole time. Would recommend to anyone looking to unwind for a few days before departing Nepal.

Fantastic view, well maintained resort in lap of Himalayas. Must visit as it is 1 hour from Kathmandu. Staff were very welcoming and helped us with our smallest issue during our stay. Food is really good, chef Deepak Mishra made special food for our 3 year old. Sundowners at Helipad is amazing.

Amazing experience! Everyone from the front desk to the servers were very attentive and the food was amazing. The kids had a great time swimming in the infinity pool and hanging out in the jacuzzi. The rooms are very spacious and modern. I highly recommend this place. Can’t wait to come back!

Wonderful place to visit with friends and family, the facilities provided is just awesome. Awesome view of Kathmandu, lalitpur and bhaktapur. Lots of fun activities to do, trekking , cycling and yoga was the most enjoyable part.

The resort is located approximately 5-6km from the main road. The vibe is elegant and the staffs are really good. We booked the standard room which was great than expected. Other amenities like gym, pool, spa were also great. There's also a viewpoint to watch the sunset. Food was also great. The resort is a must visit.

Absolutely amazing hospitality, great location, beautiful space to do yoga and just treat the stay like a retreat. The staff make sure that you get a personal touch for everything possible! I was amazed at the generosity of the staff. Must must must stay!

I have never met a chef who cares as much as Chef Deepak Mishra. He made us feel like we were fine dining, but at home, and someone we have known for years was cooking for us. If it wasn't for his personal touch and care, Terrace would be just another fancy hillside resort.

I went to The Terraces in January 2014 with a number of others. I had heard that it was a lovely hotel, but it beat all my expectations. The staff was remarkably hospitable and gracious. The food was excellent, the rooms spacious, comfortable, and spotless. But the views took my breadth away. It is not often that the Himalaya  reveal themselves especially in the winter as fog and smog often conceal them. But they burst out in the horizon, immense, and majestic. For those who are into yoga, the hotel's instructor is wonderful and so are the spa services. I would go again in a heartbeat.

What a delightful stay at the terraces resort and spa. Me and my family went there to celebrate my brother’s birthday and we enjoyed every moment. Staff went beyond the expectation and organised a small surprise for my brother for his birthday which was really heart warming. The resort itself is very beautiful and we received exquisite treatment. Special thanks to Mr. Tenzing Sherpa, Mr. Rabin khadka and Mr. Prem Manandhar for their excellent hospitality. Hats off to all the great activities that were available. The real highlight was the amazing food among which sel roti in Nepali kitchen was outstanding- like really! what a concept ❤️. We would definitely recommend this place 5/5 and looking forward to come back again.  Cheers 🥂

Spent one night at the terrace. It provided the most Beautiful and breathtaking views. Rooms were spacious and clean and has a massive balcony that overlooks the beautiful snow peaks range. The staffs were super friendly, kind and accommodating. Would appreciate better presentation and taste when it comes to food and plating though. Looking forward to visiting again!

We had an amazing time during our stay here. The hospitality was just brilliant and  out standing. Would definitely love to come back again . Spa was 10/10 . The spectacular view of mountain range. The charming smiles of all the staff members were very heart warming 👍🏼

Rooms and facilities were excellent… private balcony was like an icing, good place yo relax and chill. Unfortunately, we did not get a glimpse of mountain range or the sun set because of weather… but we hear its breathtaking. Breakfast was good and included variety of choices… however comparatively dinner was nothing to write about.

Awesome experience, great view, delicious food, must to visit sunset and sunrise.Staff is very friendly and on toes to serve Rosha made us very comfortable. Chef Deepak made sure our taste buds were satisfied to next level. Brilliant experience overall.

Airy retreat from the hustle and congestion of the city. A true opportunity to refresh and rejuvenate in its vast openness, welcoming service and thoughtful experiences.We had a wonderful time even though it was brief . Would highly recommend.

Kindness, attentive at all times, quiet place with wonderful views, spa and incredible massages.Recommended to disconnect and charge with energy.Quality price very well, it is worth having an experience like this, it is what in the end we are going to take from this trip called life.

This is a magical place. We celebrated our wedding anniversary there and we had a wonderful time.The rooms are perfect, the pool, sauna, steam, yoga and massage were fantastic and the cocktails were delicious.We will definitely be going again.Thank you to all the staff who were so kind and looked after us so well.

It's a very modern, minimalist designed resort. The lobby is very welcoming. The deck outside has a serene look and has a great view of the Himalayas.I was with my family and close friends and we really enjoyed our stay.The staff are courteous and friendly.The ambience is amazing and the room was large, spacious and really comfortable with super clean bathroom.We were upgraded and I'm very grateful for that.The pool area has a great view of Kathmandu valley.Really enjoyed the Karaoke and the spa as well as the hot jacuzzi.It's not too far from Kathmandu yet it feels like a completely different world.Hopefully I'll be back again.

Travelled with family, really beautiful and well organised hotel, on the top of the mountain with 360 degree view of mountains, hotel staff, facilities and the room are really good, kids play zone and the activities are really good. Weekend and vacation to spend here is really worth it. Hope to be a guest again in future soon..

Great place with a great view,service and atmosphere! We really enjoyed our stay and wish to stay longer!The perfect location far from the noisy center, like small and green paradise with fantastic voices on Himalayans!

I don’t know where to start, because this property will steal your heart from the very beginning. Beautiful property about an hour ride from Kathmandu, is a beautiful sanctuary drenched in comfort and luxury. I cannot commend the staff enough. Starting from Prem to Devesh to the girl at the reception, I think her name started with an R, sorry I don’t remember.We were there for a conference and stayed for a day. The staff helped in everything that we asked help for. Amazing food, great hospitality and beautiful view.You can just let go of your anxieties and come relax here. I’m definitely going to visit again, for a holiday.

Amazing place, with views that takes your breath away. Excellent service and amazing food. Try the chicken momo! The room will be missed and I hope very much to come back. All the opportnities for leisure, activities accompanied with the ability to just relax was amazing.

Best place in Nepal to b in.Best view ...Bestessssst of the Food Besssssssstessssst of the HospitalityHad a very relaxing and Nature loving stay here. Hotel property is having all the facalities and u ll just feel lyk staying here for every.

Very very good location and staff is very friendly. The yoga sessions were the best. Enjoyed our family stay here to the fullest The sound healing session was amazing too. The sundowner experience was good too….Was great place to visit. Anagha

Best part about the stay was hospitality. All the staff has bright smile on their face 24/7. Like it lifts your mood up instantly. From food to rooms there’s no single complains. About the view lets not even talk about it. Those of you whos contemplating may this review be your shot!

By far the best service and staff I have ever experienced in a hotel. The view of the hotel as well the pool and spa treatments are outstanding :)The Dinner was fantastic! BIG FLAVOURS :)Also the sundowner at the heli pad were absolutely amazing. WE would love to come back.

Amazing views, amazing service, amazing experience. Food was exceptional, the best sichuan pork I've ever had. Massages were magical and value. Staff were very friendly and helpful and always had a smile on their faces. A must do in Nepal!!

Excellent service with breathtaking scenery. We enjoyed their sun down setting, so calm and peaceful. It’s one of the best on its kind within short distance from kathmandu valley. Beautiful bar area, well maintained pool. Would highly recommend.

Loved our stay at The Terraces. Very comfortable and well appointed rooms. This is probably the best resort-style property in Nepal at the moment. Great swimming pool and jacuzzi. Excellent pool side bar with live music on a Friday night (April 2022).  Menu variety could be improved but for its location its not bad. Overall highly recommended as a great getaway out of Kathmandu.

Beautiful scenery and hotel. Rooms were great, clean with amazing balconies. Staff do everything to help you in any way they can. Food was brilliant and the pool overlooking the valley was beautiful too.

Hospitality was amazing! Best service I have ever received. All the staff are so helpful and caring. The view was unique and pretty. The massages are a must do, I have never felt more relaxed. The dinner was spectacular, so fresh. Overall, amazing resort and a must to visit.

The views are breathtaking, the resort itself serene and beautiful. The rooms are comfortable and luxurious. Loved the spa experience and yoga. We enjoyed our guided hikes through the hills very much. The service, everyone on staff, are just perfection. They are all so kind and go out of their way to make you comfortable. Highly recommended!

Great service, great view, great stay! Loved every attention to details and deep kindness. The hotel is new and still learning as a group, but the staff is experienced and very positively spirited. Thank you.

Good food, great place and loved the ambience. We were there for an official trip and the arrangements were perfect. The view from the room with terrace was lovely.Further, the view point had great views and we all enjoyed a lot. Planning to go again with family.

Though it was a weekend visit, felt like staying there for more n to return again. Everything was perfect and impeccable. From rooms, to food, hospitality and services. Every travel-lovers should visit this place.. You'll get more than expected...Great work... keep up your standards... Hope to see you soon again..

The best place to relax. Best view of the Himalayas.Night view of Kathmandu city. I recommend to all. Service at the highest level. The staff is very kind and polite. Thank you very much to the general manager.))))))

You can quickly reach there from the heart of the capital city, Kathmandu. Experience calmness with a great mountain range view . Evening sundown is one of the best parts of this place.  And there are lots of activities available , which make you stay worthy

The resort is beautifully located, it’s a peaceful place and very nice constructed and decorated, beautiful views. The staff is very friendly and I liked all the activities such as yoga and hiking. I will def try to come back and spend more time.

Excellent service and care all round. Wonderful food and drinks. Grounds are very well kept and everyone is very friendly. Special thanks to Sujan, Rabin, Binod and Dil. They all provided wonderful customer service every meal and time we saw them.

Excellent place . Luxury resort . Superv view of snow front view mountain and full city view with the airport view too. Should stay for atleast two days. Food is good . In dinner staters to be added and in map of road good road map to be shown or told at the time of booking . Had a pleasant stay and all staff members are good.

We had a fantastic stay over my son’s birthday. The hotel decorated our suite with birthday banners, made a cake for him, and helped with so many things. This place is a little gem just in less than one hour’s distance from downtown KTM. Highly recommend it!!

Best facilities and services. Definitely on my top list.The staffs were very friendly and caring. Rooms very very clean and well facilitied. The views were breathing.Kids room, cycling and sundowner were very thoughtful and fun. We enjoyed our stay.

The customer service from the staff was incredible. From the moment we walked in the door, the staff was so accommodating. The terraces is definitely a place to go for a relaxing and beautiful experience. The resort has so much to offer and the  food was also incredible.

The hotel is lovely in a stunning setting. There is an awful road leading up to it tho, my kidneys really got a work out they did not need so once you are up there, you have no where to go until you check out and then there is the dreaded road to face again. But if you are looking for a place to just relax and enjoy for a couple of days, this is it. I was very comfortable and enjoyed all the little extras they provide. Breakfast was very good too, lots to chose from.

We had very relaxing stay!!loved staff’s hospitality and the view was great, breakfast was awesome!Sun down sunset and early morning sunrise with view of himalayas. I  would definitely recommend this place and come back in future, thanks terrace

Very peaceful, comforting and relaxing stay here. Loved the ambience, amenities and the resort setup as a whole. Surrounded with nature, extra activities and a complete prioritized luxury with very satisfying hospitality. I would love to be here again and again.

The personal is very kind and service was amazing. Food and drinks were great. The yoga class spot is very nice. Also the massage service very much recommended.The views at the Kathmandu Valley are breathtaking.Everything is really clean and the attention at all times is very appreciated

Amazing service, great views, spectacular food. The staff was so nice and accommodating. The views are obviously insane. The one thing that blew me away however was the food. Usually at resorts food is good but not great. At terrace however the food was, not joking, some of the best food I’ve had. Authentic Nepali food as well as intercontinental. Was so delicious. Not surprised they use locally grown produce. If you’re staying in Kathmandu you should definetly come here!

One of the most beautiful experience we had in Nepal. Breathtaking scenery, delectable cuisine, exceptional customer service, and, of course, a splendid room with mountain views. Kids friendly with a separate play room for them.

This is my 2nd time here , loved the ambience , food , hospitality.  I stayed in Suite 2. Sab se best room in this resort. It comes with Jacuzzi and price is very reasonable Always wonderful time here. Will be back again.

The hotel and the staff are simply wonderful. The ambiance, the food, and the views of theMountains are a sight to behold. The hotel has a pick up from the bottom on the hill. All in all , a wonderful stay. We will definitely be back and hope you will visit this beautiful hotel.

Wonderful stay! Staff is very kind and helpful. Location is beautiful as well as the rooms. The beds are the greatest - especially after a couple of days in the mountains. They provide nice activities such as yoga. Swimming pool is not heathed so a bit cold.

Fantastic experience. Everything special about this place. We were here for our anniversary celebration and it was completely worth it. massage with Sharmila ji at the spa was the highlight of our stay. We recommend everyone to visit this place.

Just gorgeous. Such a serene and upscale experience with phenomenal amenities. Highly recommend taking an escape from the Kathmandu bustle here.  Beautiful views, good food, amazing service - enjoy the pool, spa & yoga -  all around 5 star experience

A breathtaking experience. Wonderful property in a peaceful surrounding which has been beautifully crafted with all the amenities needed for a relaxing stay. The hospitality was really commendable be it with the detailed overview of the property by Basanta, sundowner...dinner planning with Satish and lavious breakfast with dynamic Roshan. And so many more which you would know once you visit this place.

I suggest people to visit this Resort to have great experience. We were lucky to see all mountains range also to see clear view of Kathmandu, Bhaktapur and Patan.excellent food Staffs are friendly and well dressed. I will definitely visit here in my next visit to Nepal.

Exquisite views, the attention to little details, nice food and splendid architecture. Terraces has my heart. Plus, the hospitality warm and homey. You'll really feel luxury when you step into terraces.

Amazon Experience! Very relaxing! Bharat and the Wohle Team were extremely friendly and Kind. Food was Amazing, everything was very clean and the view is out of this world. We really recommend comming here for a relaxing retreat! 5 stars out 5

Amazing place and beautiful views.  The GM Suman, the front desk Manager Basanta, chef Manish. and the entire team were great.  The views and the location is hard to beat.  Highly recommend a visit.  We would love to come back for sure.  Memorable trip.

We really enjoyed the stay at this Hotel. Everyone was really kind and helpful. The view is amazing over the Kathmandu Valley. We really recommend this hotel in Nepal. It also arranges nice tours. Wether with helicopter or with car.Thank you

Fantastic stay at The terraces! Ambika at the Spa was very nice and good! Pritika was very cute and had such a beautiful smile! All the staf was perfect! What a marvelous days we had! The wellness was  just perfect!!! We hope to be back one day .. to see the mountains!

Beautiful hotel, staff are very good can’t do enough for you, especially Rabin, bikash, anil. Went on a hike in the morning with rasbinda which was lovely, and we even had a dog follow us the whole way which made my day! Lovely food and spa also.

Best decision we made  was to celebrate our anniversary at terrace resort. Such a warm hospitality and each and every members are so sweet and co-operative. And the view from resort is mesmerising, can’t get over it ever. Best part was the sundowner and spa and local kitchen.. hope to visit soon again❤️❤️

Excellent atmosphere with superb hospitality. 5star rated .Complementary  Sauna , steam bath are something you shouldn’t miss during your stay . Evening party at  poolside bar , is OMG so cool . Wake up with jaw dropping Himalayas view at north is something lifelong unforgettable.

Very pleasant ambience, nice hospitality, the staffs were very polite and responsive. dining experience was excellent. Highly recommended for a weekend gateway with families and friends . Driving with the Google map led us to offloading experience too..

Fantastic hotel, incredible view. Very nice rooms with lot of space, free minibar. Beautifull hotel, very nice staff - Bharat in reception was very helpfull. And nice tour guide for trekking with a lot of knowledge. Rajendra - tourguide did very good trekking. Staff very very nice.👍🙏

Words cannot describe the beauty and serenity of this place. The mountains, the raw beauty, the gardens, the rooms, the food and staff are unmatched! I feel so lucky to have spent a few amazing days at this incredible resort. I recommend this place to everyone who is seeking a piece of heaven. A big thank you to the staff for making my stay so memorable and comfortable.

We had an excellent stay. Nice view of natural beauty around from the view point. Very comfortable room with balcony. Great food, swimming pool, kid's play area,  sauna, gym, yoga pavilion, spa. Very welcoming staff. Great place for trekking too!

Staff were extremely nice and helpful, espcially Sujan, Sahadev, Roshaan, and Dil. Thank you to them for an amzing experience. The food was great, the pool was great, and the massage was great. Truly, a memorable vacation that I will never forget.

Very attentive staff.. beautiful resort... very near from kathmandu and Patan. The food was awesome and the view from the resort was to die for. Lots of hiking trails short and long ones. Amazing spa experience and facilities. The infinity pool was beautiful. Will be back

loved the food and friendly staff, will definitely plan to visit again. Sunset view was beautiful and it was a refreshing stay away from the busy city only an hour away. The room was cosy and comfortable.

Beautiful hotel with incredible view! Excellent yoga session with a Nepali teatcher. Good food. Room beautiful with terrasse view on the valley. Nice people. Good breakfast. The only bad thing is the road to come in this paridise

Indeed , a nice place to visit again and again . One day is not sufficient for sure .. Must visit place. Rabin jee was very kind person . Hospitality was very good . I will be visiting this place again for sure .

An epic range of mountains and jaw opening. Warm greetings and lovely welcoming for staffs here.I really would like to thank them from core of heart for showing beautiful sunset view, lovely warm morning with amazing mountain ranges.

Great resort with excellent views and even better hospitality! Great place to watch both sunset and sunrise. The sun downer experience was a great touch to the entire experience. Food could be improved. Some food options were great others not so much.

The stay was amazing, a true 5 star experience in Nepal. The food was very good and hospitality was excellent.We felt so close to nature and yoga training was a new and good experience for my wife. All in all, it was great!!!

vice to customer. 10 starts our stay. We had a great experience in nature escape, SPA, restaurant, all hotel services and specially all hotel staff, they were simple incredibly nice. Thank you. We defenitively recommend this place

Great service, great food and overall a lovely getaway from Kathmandu, given its a short distance away. The facilities are great and the staff are very helpful and pleasant. Would definitely recommend this for anyone looking for a quick getaway from the city.

It was wonderful staying here. Every staffs are so kind and professional. Food was delicious. Swimming pool and jacuzzi were amazing. We took Yoga and meditation class in the morning with beautiful view outside. Omg. We will be definitely coming back!!

Very welcoming staffs. Nice ambience, environment and natural beauty. great sundown experience. Excellent rooms and services. View of mountains and kathmandu valley was lovely. overall great experience.

The resort is absolutely flawless. I felt so valed and appreciated. The service is exceptional. The food is exceptional. Spa is also exceptional. I only visited for the day and it was very hard to leave. Considering to take my mum and come back next October just to stay at this resort. Thankyou so much. Absolutely incredible experience.

Lovely place, the sun downer experience was awesome. Did some early morning bird photography and the bird sighting was great. The food and the jacuzzi were both awesome. Highly recommended. The downside was the road we took when going towards the resort but the alternate route was good when we returned back to ktm.

the resort has very nice view , amazing SPA ,excellent  staff , every thing in the room is complimentary, very clean , the food are good international , tum yam soup is the best 😍the manger suman  he takes care of their gust in very. good way. thank you

Clean room and excellent service..very good communication from staff..tasty food..good view of kathmandu valley ..fresh environments.perfect music..enjoyed steam and sauna ..went toThe view point for sun set where hot drinks and some snacks were served by the staff as a complimentary.

Hotel is amazing with great views, great rooms and wonderful staff. At the breakfast, Roshan was amazing to help us and because of him we had an amazing breakfast and a great talk. At check in, we had an amazing experience by Bharat who helped us check in, as well as helping us set up a great hike nearby. Finally Basante was also great in the evening times when he told us about the history and landscapes of Nepal, as well as helping us set up a yoga class in the morning. Thanks to these staff members we had a wonderful experience, with great views, weather, and peace.

It's blissful up there at 2000 Meters. Surrounded by lush green forest and beautiful hills, The Terraces is a blend of heartwarming ambience, elegance, luxury and the cheerful hospitality. A big thank you to Anamikaji, Bharatji, Basantji and all the other staff that made me and my daughter stay here a beautiful experience. Will come again!

Amazing staff with incredible views, we were welcomed warmly by Bharat & all the staff we engaged with were awesome which  was a sidenote to the most  incredible views. Enjoyed relaxing spa treatments with forest views, beautiful food & drinks with attentive staff.

It’s simply beautiful , it actually feels like you in the mountains in betwee. The clouds  ,,, and the resort feels luxurious and still in nature … very friendly staff at the restaurant and reception special mention to Bharat  and the whole team .

मैले गएको ५ तारे होटेल मध्ये मा यहाको ब्यवस्थापन र शाकाहारी लाई गरेको सेबा तथा कर्मचारी हरु को ब्यबहार सारै मन पऱ्यो । यहाको प्राकृतिक शौन्दर्य र बाताबरण ले मन लाई सारै आनन्दीत तुल्यायो । मैले दिनुपर्ने नं मा १० मा १० दिन्छु फेरी पनी पनी आउने ईच्छा व्यक्त गर्छु ।

The hotel is incredible, such a view over all of Kathmandu is not to be missed!The staff are incredibly friendly and courteous and read every wish from our lips.There are some Things to do on the mountain or relax by the pool with stunning views.The approach is steep and narrow, but it is very worth it!

We stayed 3D/2N in this mountain oasis out of the bustling Kathmandu at the end of our 3 weeks trip in Nepal and it felt rejuvenating ! The rooms are spacious with a private balcony, beds are super comfy, the breakfast and dinner buffet were delicious, staff is really helpful and lovely.
