Great for kids and a sit in the sun (if there is any)The Chimney Restaurant is interesting but be prepared to pay top dollar for the extensive menu, unique ambiance and good service (provided they are not too busy). I like this place. The Coffee Shop is run of the mill and fine for a light meal, if a bit restricted.Its an old tradition to stay here - the place is a bit of a legend - its not a bad hotel at all, if you are prepared to pay a bit more for the exec floor rooms. However, while the Y&Y is famous worldwide, there are now better hotels in Kathmandu.

A hotel nestled close to Thamel.  It's not modern looking like most 5-star hotel but decently furnished.  It has its own shopping area on the ground floor.  Restaurant serve buffet but the food spread not very fantastic.  The garden is well-kept.

We stayed 8 nights in yak and yeti, enjoyed it but it was very pricey according to its service. İt was like a 4 star hotel. The rooms looks old and dusty. I like the garden very much. The breakfast was insufficient but it was ok.

There was no proper chair in the room to sit . It had one small chair with no back support . It was not possible to use laptops for a while  or watch Tv .The house keeping should provide Two sets of bath towels and wash towel . The breakfast was not great . Otherwise I would say hotel services were very good . I will recommend .

Yak and Yeti is located within 10 mins walk of thamel. the hotel is well maintained and the rooms are comfortable. One of the reasons for choosing this hotel is that it has interconected rooms which we could take as we wanted 2 rooms. we stayed here for a night and then went to pokhara and came back for 2 nights... the first time around we got interconnected rooms.. but the second time around, inspite of knowing our preference we were told there are no interconnected rooms available. so we asked for the next best ie adjoining rooms or rooms facing one another. we were told by the lady who was doing our check in that no sch rooms are available and they alloted us two rooms which were at either end of the corridor. I refused and asked to speak to senior. Surprisingly the senior person got us two adjoining rooms. I dont understand why the lady could not have done the same. Other than this, the hotel was very good. the food is excellent, i would says its more an Indian restaurant... we ended up going to different places in thamel for drinks and dinner... the hotel is a 10 min walk or you can get cabs easily. Overall a good place to stay...

It was my first time in here. But I was very disappointed. Rooms were in very poor condition, carpet very smelly & dirty. Washroom very gross. All stained with years old shower cortain & broken shower. Dirty toilet bowl, very smelly. Though very were upgraded to business club but it was of no use. I didn't get the upgrade & business club as we had to pay for our drinks in happy hours. Breakfast was average. It was birthday so we requested for cake in our room which was fully charge on our room bill. After our account was settled a guest service person came to us asking how was our stay & we were talking & it came up as that all birthday cakes r alway on hotel complementary to all there guests. Still they never reverse our charge for cake. Last but not least towels & napkins very old.

Massively overrated and over priced, tired hotel.  30 minute check in, vacuuming outside bedroom at 8am, low quality products, dated room and bathroom that were both very sparse.  Thin bedcovers, even in cold months.  This being said, the staff in The Pub, were charming and friendly as were the staff in The Chimney (which is a great, retro restaurant).  Much better hotels available for the price and cheaper throughout Kathmandu, best avoided unless you secure a very good discounted deal.

This Resort is located at the river and our cabin/bungalow had a small balcony with great view at the river. We stayed here two nights at the end of 2019. The cabin is nice and spacious.  Wi-Fi  is good in the Reception area and the restaurant but VERY unreliable in the cabin. The cabin has no fridge but there is a kettle to make coffee and tea. Complimentary bottled water is provided. The hotel has an outdoor unheated swimming pool and a very nice terrace where you can have your meal when weather permits. Staff in the hotel is very friendly and helpful. Lunch buffet was excellent, dinner buffet very good and breakfast buffet was good.Our only point of criticism is the following: after a late afternoon boat tour we were offered snacks and a drink at the riverbank, watching the sunset. When checking out we found that the drink (a glass of white wine) costs more than € 10! It would have been appropriate to mention that costs will be involved when we accepted the offer for a drink.

We loved Barahi Jungle Lodge!  From the moment we stepped out of our taxi we felt we had been delivered to a magical place where our wishes were anticipated and fulfilled and where the staff was genuinely kind, enthusiastic and gracious.The rooms were well appointed and had a Four Seasons/Ritz Carlton feel to them with high quality furniture, superb bathroom, and great accessories/extras in the room.  The River view from our balcony was wonderful.The food was of the best quality and exceeded expectations.  The staff quickly accommodated our plant-based diet and took the time to explain the options available to us each meal that were meat/egg/dairy free.  Thank you!The keep and River tours were dazzling.  We saw a great diversity of wildlife including three endangered species: many one horned rhinos, a Great Horn Bill (bird), and the ultra rare sighting of a Bengal Tiger.  In a word:  stunning.Our guide and driver/boats man were all excellent and were genuinely committed to securing the best viewings for us.My wife enjoyed a great massage in the beautiful spa and we particularly enjoyed the nightly cultural shows.Finally, the common areas (pool, library, restaurant, bar, walkways) were all impeccably maintained and super comfortable.What a wonderful place.  They hire most of their employees from the vicinity of Chitwan and that helps create an atmosphere of comraderie and pride that is not easily replaceable.What more can you ask for than a place that is great in every respect and whose mission includes supporting the local economy and the preservation of the Chitwan National Park?We loved it and we will return.  It was worth the trip across the globe to get to!

Barahi Jungle Lodge was a spectacular experience and it is definitely one of those properties which is what it is because of it’s staff. Right from the checkin, till checkout, we were looked after by the staff of Barahi like family. The check in was smooth, quick and hassle free. The cottage was super clean, had an amazing view and the warm water bags placed thoughtfully by the staff on those cold winter nights were much appreciated. The bed was huge, comfortable and quality of sleep was top notch. We were assigned a personalised naturalist who took care of all of our activities. The meals were enjoyable and the food was always fresh and delicious. The staff always attended to the fire and never let us feel chilly while having dinner under the stars on all of our nights there. Little details like these sets Barahi Jungle lodge, apart.The property itself is a forest-like 12 acres lovingly tended to, by its myriad gardeners. We were told the trees and plants were hand picked by the naturalists and these attract a variety of birds and smaller species of wildlife while the larger, slightly dangerous ones are kept out by the fence. The rustic decor, use of local resources for building the lodge, sustainable initiatives, no use of plastic, farm to table food, local employment, support to local communities and a common tip box were all things that we really really liked and are highly commendable.Coming to the staff- there are so many people to mention about! Every member of the staff in the lodge does his or her job brilliantly well. Mr. Prakash (GM) greeted us and showed us around the property, enthusiastically took us around to show the beautiful plants and by the time we left, had become a good friend. Tej (F&B manager) always ensured that we were well fed and enquired after every meal about the taste and satisfaction. Hari, our naturalist was funny, witty and ensured that we were never bored while doing all of our activities at the lodge. He was also very pro active about capturing the special moments for us and is a good photographer. Special mention to Subhash and Gobinda who sat down with us, planned our activities and ensured that we had a great time. Sharmila (from the restaurant) was always ready with a smile while serving our food and paid attention to every little detail during our meals. It takes a very special property for us to cancel existing plans and extend our stay and Barahi just was one of those! Thank you, Mr. Prakash, Tej, Hari and Gobinda for the surprise bush dinner on our last evening there- it was truly a unique experience! For a magnificent jungle lodge experience, Barahi is definitely the property to stay at, when in Chitwan. It sets an exceptionally high standard, far above the other lodges around. Highly recommend Barahi and rest assured, will be returning to it when in Chitwan the next time.

Everything about this place was 1st rate.. There were so many nice touches. I loved that it was environmentally conscious , even little details like having water air filtered in glass bottles in your rooms  And shampoo and conditioner and soap in ceramic bottles. Is no plastic anywhere to throw out. The beds were comfortable and very clean. It was very attractively decorated and well lit. There was a beautiful dining room and the food was delicious and plentiful with good choices. It looked out into the park, as did every room that you would stay in. They had a excellent spa where I got an outstanding Ayurvedic treatment.  The gift shop had some beautiful items and some of the profits went to an environmental organization. I enjoyed the excursions and the naturalists were informative and  very pleasant to be around. They have little surprises like sunset receptions on the banks of the river. I was lucky enough to see rhinoceros, crocodiles, crocodiles, spotted deer and 2 species of monkeys. They also had nice entertainments in the evenings, including dance performances by local cultural groups. The general manager joined in to entertain us  with a member of our group who is a musician with the general manager, I believe his name was Prakash,  Playing the tablas.

Chitwan is a must visit if you are in Kathmandu and Barahi Jungle Resort is THE place to stay.  The pics on their website do NOT do it justice.  It’s an absolute zen experience!  The resort sits on the river bank directly across from the national park giving direct access for Jeep jungle safari and river boat safari (no need to leave the resort property for any excursions). The decor mirrors the natural and serene setting without missing a beat on luxury.  Accommodations are individual stand alone cabins along the river bank with lots of natural stone and wood elements.  Make sure to try the provided soaps.  The staff are delightful and attentive (but not pushy). Every guest group is matched with a naturalist who helps you plan your excursions.  We highly recommend Karan - his keen eye and encyclopaedic knowledge of the various plant, bird, reptile and animals coupled with his passion for photography and obvious love and enthusiasm of the Park made him the ideal guide.  We saw rhinos; various deer species; monkeys; multiple rare birds and even a LEOPARD perched in a tree.  The sunset river safari with drinks and appetizers served on the river bank among rhino footprints to toast the sunset is a must as is the jungle breakfast.  There is not one thing I could criticize or improve on my experience here.  Absolute gem !!

My experience at Bahari Jungle Lodge during my G Adventure trip was nothing short of exceptional. From the moment I arrived, I was warmly welcomed by the general manager, Prakash, whose genuine hospitality set the tone for my entire stay. He took the time to chat with me on a personal level and personally escorted me to my room, ensuring I felt comfortable and at home.Gobinda, our nature guide, was a wealth of knowledge about the surrounding flora and fauna. He led us on a captivating tour of the lodge grounds, pointing out various trees and fruits and identifying the diverse birdlife, including woodpeckers and parrots. Our boat ride down the river was a highlight, where we were fortunate enough to spot a rhino and soak in the stunning sunset while enjoying delicious snacks provided by the attentive staff.Speaking of the staff, Sanjana and Ram went above and beyond to cater to my every need during mealtimes. Their warmth and hospitality made dining a delight, and each meal was a culinary adventure with delicious and varied offerings.The evening entertainment, featuring traditional dances by both the Kumal and Tharu people, was a beautiful cultural immersion. The next day's jungle safari with Gobinda was equally memorable, as we encountered over 10 rhinos, various deer species, crocodiles, monkeys, and peacocks. Gobinda's expertise and enthusiasm made the experience truly unforgettable.Throughout my stay, Bindiya, the guest relations officer, ensured that my wife and I were well taken care of, always checking in to ensure our comfort and satisfaction. And Prakash's regular visits to ensure everything was up to par were a testament to the lodge's commitment to excellence.In addition to providing exceptional hospitality and immersive experiences, Bahari Jungle Lodge also stands out for its dedication to sustainability. From the use of eco-friendly practices to the preservation of the surrounding environment, the lodge demonstrates a deep respect for nature.Throughout my stay, I was impressed by their efforts to minimize their ecological footprint. The lodge's commitment to sustainability was evident in various aspects of their operations, from the use of renewable energy sources to the implementation of waste reduction initiatives.Furthermore, Bahari Jungle Lodge actively engages with the local community to promote conservation efforts and support sustainable livelihoods. Whether through eco-friendly excursions, local sourcing of ingredients for meals, or employment opportunities for community members, the lodge prioritizes responsible tourism practices.Their commitment to sustainability not only enhances the guest experience but also ensures that future generations can continue to enjoy the beauty of the Chitwan National Park region. It's inspiring to see a hospitality establishment so deeply invested in preserving the environment and supporting the local community.In summary, Bahari Jungle Lodge exceeded all expectations, providing an unforgettable blend of adventure, hospitality, and cultural immersion. I cannot recommend this experience highly enough.

Before booking here we read reviews and knew to expect great service but when we arrived and experienced this place for ourselves, our expectations were greatly exceeded. The attention to detail is spectacular and the service is far and away the best I’ve ever experienced. There are so many pleasant surprises and I truly couldn’t imagine having stayed at a better place. Karan was our naturalist and guide for the weekend and he was AMAZING- friendly, engaging, attentive, and a wonderful naturalist and photographer. We super lucked out with him as our guide! I can’t say enough about Barahi and I highly recommend it to anyone who is considering visiting Chitwan.

We have just finished a 3 night stay here. It was magical. The hotel and grounds are very pretty - the rooms in keeping with the jungle lodge theme, but with every comfort. Spotlessly clean. In good weather, meals can be taken on the large patio area overlooking the river, so you can watch the crocodiles sunbathing! All staff are kind and attentive, but special mention should go to our Nature Expert, Hari, who was assigned to look after us us from the moment we arrived at the airport, to our departure. The activities he organised for us included bird watching, village walk, river and jeep safaris. I will never forget watching a rhinoceros and her baby crossing the river just yards in front of us! Food was plentiful and varied, and there were little surprises for us along the way, to keep us fed and watered. We we very sad to leave and would love to return!

We booked a deluxe room for three nights “all-inclusive” at Barahi Jungle Lodge, arriving on March 23 by a short flight from Kathmandu to Bharatpur. The distance between the two cities is 150 km, just 20 minutes by flight. Sidebar: don’t trust online maps: a couple we met traveled the very same route by car and spent almost 8 hours on the road.  We were picked up by lodge staff at Bharatpur airport. The lodge is located approximately 1h from the airport. Our stay was full of emotions and memorable, staff and management were, simply said, amazing. We were treated like family members, like old friends meeting again after a long time. The lodge is managed and run with passion, each day there will be a surprise of some kind (we won’t spoil it here). Food was abundant, rich and tasty, even as we had breakfast in the jungle on an early morning tour. Our cottage (nr. 27) was clean, simply but tastefully furnished and comfortable. It offered a direct view toward the river and the jungle. Daily activities and tour are interesting and well managed. We had a Boat Safari, two Jungle Safari and two Walking Safari during which we saw many Indian Rhinos (some with babies), Elephants, Monkeys, Deers, Wild Boars, Crocodiles and Gavials and many many birds among which huge Hornbills and an army of loud male Peacocks. Unfortunately the shy Tiger did not show, although another group had better chance and spot it during our stay. We left enriched in experience and full of gratitude toward the staff for this beautiful experience in the nature and the soul of the Chitwan National Park.

We were welcome at the property with a bunch of staff with wide smiles and happy faces, the property is beautiful and eco friendly with beautiful infinity pool overlooking the Rapti river . The rooms are amazing cozy and comfortable. The food served is superb and made with love by the chef you can tell.The staff is courteous and polite and always willing to help anyone. Jitu Da was our guide throughout the stay he is very friendly and very informative he made the safaris lot more fun we got to see a loot of animals on the safaris but the cherry on the top was we spotted a bunch of Rhino’s near a watering hole while on the walking safari . Highly recommended place to stay when in Nepal (Chitwan). You and your family will never be disappointed. I would like to take this opportunity to thank the entire Barahi Jungle lodge team to take such great care of us lot .

Barahi Jungle Lodge was a great experience, not only because of the wildlife experience but also because of the exceptional service we received from the entire staff at Barahi. Thank you so much Prakash for making our stay so memorable. The room was decorated with "Happy Honeymoon" as we arrived, and truly we were made to extra feel special up until our departure. The surprise Bush Dinner with bonfire was the best highlight of the trip for us where the staff sang and danced with us and got us a cake and champagne too! The bush dinner was delicious too. The Boat Safari & Lunch by Riverside was a unique experience too. The jungle shared jeep safari at Chitwan National Park was nice and informative, and although we weren't lucky enough to witness a tiger, we observed the sounds of a leopard at hunt with a deer and watched rhino's, deers, and peacocks. It was great to have breakfast in the jungle. Our tour guide made the safari extra special. Our room was river facing and had a nice balcony. The Tharu cultural dance was also fun to be a part of.There is definitely a lot of room for improvement in the spa where the service could have been much better and in the restaurant too as we had ordered for a pesto pizza but they sent a tomato based pizza. Yet overall the experience was a wonderful one and we would be delighted to return back for another holiday. We definitely recommend Barahi Jungle Lodge.We also stayed at Barahi Sarangkot Mountain Lodge before Chitwan, and would like to thank Roshan and Pawan for making the entire experience so wonderful and providing a fantastic road trip from Sarangkot to Chitwan. Also Thank you Pradeep for managing our booking from India so flawlessly.

Barahi Jungle lodge was really in the midst of the Forest, where you can see the birds & animals like Rhinoceros at close. They had sent a van to pickup from the Airport ( it's a paid service) with a guide who was explaining all the sights which were on the wayside. They were so helpful, you only had to give your baggage tags to them and they did the needful. Oh what a service they provided.On reaching the hotel we were greeted with love by presenting a auspicious Dhruv leaves favourite of Lord Ganesha , and a refreshing welcome drink 🍷.My words cannot Praise/ express the hospitality of this Resort.The whole team under the guidance of Mr Prakash ( GM) were all out to give you the experience of your Life.After Lunch they took us to a River Cruise which was so serene & beautiful, on the way we could spot Crocodiles, & Alligators, and many different species of the birds.At Sun set point they had put up Tents for all the guests and served delicious Popcorn/ Momos/ Tandoori items . Oh what a blast we had.In the evening we had lovely cultural programme of Tharu Folk Dances.And then another surprise we came across was Dinner with Bon Fire in the Bushes. Oh what an experience!.There were surprise after surprisesEarly in the morning we were taken for a Jungle Safari, where we saw Deers, Elephants, Rhinos, Wild Boar & Monkeys, but Alas we could see only the Tigers 👣.After going about in the Forest, they stopped near the river and served us a sumptuous Break fast in the jungle. Oh the resort Management was full of surprises for the guests.At lunchtime they took orders of what we wanted to have. A Nepali Thali or anything else. Wow we were just going with the flow amidst the Greenery we could order your Drinks or  Cocktail 🍹🍹. The Service was always with a smile.At Dinner time again there was a surprise element which just Blew away our Minds. The whole Presidential Suite was lit up with Lantern 🏮 on the Pool side and Barbeque items and food was served with 💕 Lots of Love.My words cannot express the hospitality they gave. Hats off to all, here especially we would like to thank Mr. Rajib who made our day special by taking us around on a Walking Jungle Trial. Really this is the Resort you would love to visit again & again.

Went with my wife her parents and mine as a surprise trip when we came to Nepal. The rooms were extremely clean and felt homely. The staff made sure that we were happy with everything all the time which was well appreciated. We did the boat ride and saw Rhino which was lucky we also went on a Jeep safari with breakfast in the safari which is not normally done but they met our needs.At the end of the day despite the price it was very worth it or I would say it was cheap for the service, food and activities. So if anyone thinks its expensive they can go elsewhere.Thank you very much to our guide Sagar with his vast knowledge of the safari and answered all our questions and guided us well throughout our stay.

Beautiful accommodations and extraordinary staff made or two night stay memorable. The caliber of the staff is noteworthy, from the Naturalists to the management and all the customer facing staff that we encountered, everyone is committed and passionate about exceeding every expectation we could have possibly hoped to experience.Arriving at the end  of the Monsoon season we weren’t sure how that would affect our chances of seeing wildlife. We chose to do a Sundowner Jeep Safari our first day, several hours after arriving from Kathmandu. Our naturalist Gobinda was really wonderful and we learned a lot as we also had some incredible sightings of rhinos, spotted deer, a variety of birds and plants and his English was excellent for explaining every detail. We had him for entire stay, for which we felt very fortunate.On the way back we were treated to drinks and delicious BBQ along the riverbank as we watched the sun go down on our first day.The cultural shows every evening were great too, as were the quality of food, beverages and service. As an unexpected surprise they put together a beautiful and romantic dinner setting for us to celebrate an anniversary. It was beyond fabulous! Memories for a lifetime, without a doubt, these people are great stewards for eco friendly tourism in this region. They are knowledgeable and professional and personable. We are so happy to have chosen Barahi for our trip to Chitwan. Tej, Krishna, and Gobinda particularly went out of their way to ensure we had a fantastic experience.We also did another Jeep safari to a different location next afternoon and on our last morning a pre dawn boat safari where we saw crocodiles (Mugger and endangered Gharyal) as well as rhinos, birds, monkeys and incredibly rare Gangetic dolphins jumping near our quiet canoe. The boatmen and Gobinda said they had only seen them a couple times in their careers. We wouldn’t hesitate to recommend this place for all ages. Truly a remarkable place to experience the beauty and wilderness of Chitwan.

I and my wife recently stayed at the Barahi Jungle Lodge in Meghauli, Nepal and we absolutely loved it. The lodge is set in a beautiful and peaceful location, surrounded by lush greenery and wildlife. The highlight of our stay was the jungle safari that we went on. The lodge's experienced guides took us deep into the jungle where we saw a wide variety of wildlife including elephants, many birds, and one-horned rhinos. It was an exhilarating experience that we will never forget. We also had our lunch in the middle of the Jungle.The food at the lodge was delicious, with a range of international and local dishes on offer. We particularly enjoyed the traditional Nepalese food and local dance performed by Kumal Group.The staff at the Barahi Jungle Lodge were incredibly friendly and went out of their way to make our stay comfortable and memorable. We highly recommend this lodge to anyone looking for a peaceful and unforgettable experience in the heart of the jungle.

The Barahi jungle Lodge’s property, the hospitality, the food - everything makes a trip to this place worth the while. The entire staff at BJL made our visit special and helped take care of our every need.We stayed in Room 27 which had a really good view of the Rapti river and jungle. The rooms are spacious and beautiful. When you walk in to property you can feel that a lot of thought has been given to every aspect.All amenities and facilities in the room were also top notchWe spent an entire  half day at their property enjoying the cafe turtle and tiger den bar and a morning jungle safari followed by the river safari This is a must visit property in Chitwan.The staff is simply outstanding and always have a smile on their face and they attend to your every need. We had the package that included all 3 meals - Food is very good and of top quality so you won't regret it. Chef Kumar goes extra mile in preparing the meal and it’s served with alot of love. They make sure that every single meal you have is of a different cuisine, which is really amazing. If you are celebrating an occasion then they will go even more out of their way to make it special. We had a amazing setup arranged for our 10th wedding anniversary celebration. The staff including our naturalist Mr. Jitu surprised us with a celebration song sung in Nepalese language. The whole jungle safari experience was just fantastic with our naturalist Mr. Jitu showing us around followed by the breakfast inside the jungle was an experience in itself. The river boat safari was followed by sundowner setup where we could watch the sunset and enjoy our BBQ with drinks.  The arrangement done in the middle of the forest again was So peaceful and beautiful. One can sit enjoy looking at the river and forest across with Deers and rhino coming to water bank while u sit across enjoy watching the sunset and this beautiful stunning view. They also include cultural dances of Kumar and Tharu clan. All the staff was fantastic and I think that made all the difference. From the reception, to the chef, serving staff and the naturalists - everyone just took care of us Highly recommend BJL in ChitwanSpecial thanks to Astha for organising this so beautiful.

Our stay at Barahi Jungle Lodge was fantastic from the moment we were met at the airport to our arrival at the resort All the staff throughout our stay were welcoming, knowledgeable, very professional and friendly too making sure that we were so well looked after the whole time. The grounds were  beautifully maintained while honouring the jungle environment and the lodges were fantastic with great attention to detail and design The pillows were indeed like fluffy clouds to rest upon! We stayed for four nights, loved all the food and would highly recommend a stay, it’s such a treat! Thank you all once again

Barahi Lodges are on the bank of the Rapti River overlooking the beautiful Chitwan jungle and hills. They are whitewashed buildings with thatched roofs so very much in keeping with the surroundings, unlike some other safari properties which look very 'out-of-place'. The food is very good and rooms are very comfortable with air con and tv, if you like those things. We would be happy to do without those. Barahi has a lovely pool and there are beautiful trees everywhere that attract the birds.

Fantastic holiday. From the moment we arrived we were treated like royalty. Delicious food, comfortable stylish lodges and lots of pleasant surprises meant the holiday exceeded expectations. The staff were very attentive (especially Rajesh), who went out of their way to ensure we had a great holiday. We went on boat, jeep and walking safaris which were led by knowledgeable naturalists, where we saw lots of different animals and birds, and viewed beautiful sunrises and sunsets. Thank you to the team for a brilliant holiday.

We stayed here for 2 nights last month in April. The property is located right near to Chitwan National Park and easily accessible. The rooms were spacious and comes with river and jungle view. The entire Barahi property is well thought of and the eco friendly. The staff at this property are so welcoming and always smiling. The food is good here and the chef made sure that my mother who eats only Jain Food is well taken care. They have free Tea and Coffee served to all the guests throughout the day. The safari package is also upto the mark and Jeeps are in good condition. Really enjoyed our river safari along with Sundowner, very different experience altogether. The lady ( I forgot the name , starts with A ) who was assigned to us to take us around have a wonderful knowledge about the various species of birds and animals. Also our first day evening candle light dinner was a big surprise where they arranged right under the trees which was very private and personalized.Thank you for everything. I will recommend to all my friends in India to definitely visit Barahi Jungle Lodge Chitwan for the experience and money spent.

Though my review is delayed almost by an year, but my memories of this beautiful property is lof yesterday only. As it was a first trip with my ‘sonshine’ and was still recovering from post-delivery issues, I was sceptical about the place, weather, covid fear of holiday in another country, etc. So, I shoot bunch of questions to them and got a detailed and satisfactory response from their sales manager – Nishchal Rai. We stayed for 3 nights and each day’s experience was something that I cherish today as well. Their homely touch for example giving a call to inform that “evening cultural folk is about to start, and we are waiting for you”. They actually waited for us for about 15 minutes. These small gestures outshine even 5-star properties. We enjoyed their boating experience, sundowner, amazing food, coffee, everything! Though everything was the best, but I would like to tell about our major highlight from the stay @Barahi. During one of the conversations with the staff we talked about our marriage anniversary which was on a day after checking out from the property but unfortunately, we couldn’t extend our stay due to personal reasons. We never knew that staff must have noticed such small detail of our conversation and they planned a BEAUTIFUL SURPRISE! A special dinner under the tree was set with beautiful fairy lights all around along with oil lamps. When we entered the space, we were greeted with nepali song with music, beautiful table set up for cake cutting, appetizers, dinner and last but not the least a beautiful white cot for my little one. This was very thoughtful. The whole ambience was romantic, quaint and calm. Exactly the way I like it and this was a lifetime experience for me and my husband.I thoroughly recommend this place to anyone and everyone. I am definitely going to visit this place again. A special shout out to Mr. Prakash – GM, Subash, Krishna and the complete team. Out of world hospitality!

Amazing place to stay and like the eco friendly environment.Staffs are just awesome and one time I am not hyper but the staff talk to me very nicely and I feel guilty and apologise.I will defiantly come back and stay. Just few things need to improve that they need to tidy the swimming pool as it is outdoor but still need to maintain.

My wife and I came to the Jungle Lodge for part of our honeymoon, and what a trip it was! We stayed in the one suite on property, and there was plenty of room for the two of us. You could definitely have four people stay there comfortably if you are interested. The private pool and view of the river was great, as we would see crocodiles sun bathing almost every morning.We went on multiple safaris, including on the river and in the jungle. All the guides were knowledgeable and helpful, but Govinda stood out in particular. He was the nicest man, and always wanted us to have the best time and checked in on us to make sure that we were. Some of the rhinoceroses we saw in the jungle took our breath away. The only thing we missed out on was seeing a tiger, but hopefully next time!The food at the resort was very good, but our favorite dinner experience was when they came to the suite on our last night and served us nearby the pool. The appetizers were delicious and the service was great! Make sure to go watch the culture dances before dinner to see a great show… They wanted us to have a special trip because it was our honeymoon, and it definitely did not disappoint. Thanks to all the staff for making our time in Nepal so memorable!

Wonderful stay in Barahi lodge in Chitwan. Service with a smile. Each and every member of staff whom we met was truly wonderful. And we got the most beautiful send off too. Truly humbled by the sublime Nepali hospitality. A very big thank you to Prakash (the GM), Krishna (Mr Panditji), Sudikshya, alongside Tej and Babu Ram in the restaurant. And Jai Ram (Mr Rhino 🦏).The rooms were modern and clean. Quite a few insects but that’s only to expected in the jungle. The rooms are sprayed too with natural insect spray. Its an eco friendly lodge.The Nepali food was out of this world and so very touched that the Resident Manager of the Barahi Hotel in Pokhara had called on ahead to notify the Lodge of our favourite food.Staying in the quieter side of the jungle is so much lovelier than the noisier busier side. Well worth it. Privileged to see so many rhinos and deer, as well as a crocodile and gharial too.Loved the keep safari, jungle walk, visit to the gharial breeding centre and the village too.Thank you to everyone for making our stay perfect.

Everything about this place is just wow! the property is beautiful and has great facilities. The staff are genuinely nice and helpful. Everyone gets their own Naturalist/guide for the safari/walk/boat, we were assigned Mr.Krishna and he was  beyond brilliant. The staff go out of their way to make sure they cater to your needs. Definitely going back to stay for longer.Best experience!

We had a very special 3 night stay here which we will never forget. All the staff work really hard to make you welcome and to make your stay as memorable as possible. Lots of surprises. Amazing food. The location is just across the river from the National Park where the jeep and walking safaris with knowledgeable and enthusiastic guides were a real highlight. Our lodge was spacious and full of charm. A really special place to stay on holiday. Lots of of nice thoughtful touches. Thoroughly recommend.

Very nice, private and secluded. Each hut is artfully finished and very relaxing.  Curved walls, ceiling transitions, very comfy beds. Plenty of hot water that is solar with secondary assist (propane). Meals are buffet however staff provides table service for soup, drinks, any special needs.  Cuisine includes Indian food as well as western and Nepali selections.  Even a picky eater can find something to eat and it is all very good and well prepared.  Any issues with the rooms are quickly resolved thanks to great management and staff.  We stayed at the far end of the resort, and on request, the staff will dispatch an electric golf cart to bring you to the main building. We enjoyed the walk anyway to burn some calories and get in our steps for the day. Park excursions are very good, a short canoe ride across the river to the 4X4 safari vehicle. On the excursions, we saw many asian rhinos in their natural environment along with monkeys, crocodiles, etc. Guides are well trained naturalists and know the names of all the birds and other wildlife you may encounter.  We were one of two guests who had an outside tour guide from Kathmandu to escort us from our hotel in the city throughout our stay and back to the city prior to departure from Nepal.

Exceptional......overwhelmed and breathtaking views. Rejuvenate yoir senses when you enter in Barahi Jungle Lodge....seems itself like a mini jungle in a jungle. Food was outstanding, very courteous staff, very attentive seems like works 24X7 to fulfill their guest needs and expectations.  Mr. Prakash (GM) is very humble, generous and kind hearted always ready to make your stay comfortable.  Really worthwhile.....

The Barahi Jungle Lodge, is by far one of the best resorts I've stayed at. The superb property coupled with the staffs genuine warmth and hospitality make for a winning combination.The rooms are spacious airy and offer superb views of the river.The property in covered in a dense foliage and waking up to bird song every morning, was a treat.The naturalists assigned to the guests are warm, knowledgeable and have a true passion for wildlife and the forest.Another highlight of the stay was the food, though the hotel does not boast of an extensive repertoire of dishes, what it does offer, is filling, delicious and almost always served piping hot, and enjoying such a meal beneath the open sky is an experience unto itself.If you plan to visit chitwan national park, then a stay at the Barahi Jungle Lodge is a must.Special mention to Mr. Prakash Chand and his team, for making each and every guest feel at home, from the warm towels and chilled welcome drinks that welcome weary travellers into the resort, to the smiling faces that stay to see you off, till they disappear in the rearview mirror, as you leave with pretty Nepali print scarves and a wealth of memories.

We had a great time with the family exploring Chitwan National park and the excellent hospitality BJL offered. We felt pampered every second we spent there. Definitely plan to come here once a year with my family. This is the best time to visit this place as the traffic is very thin, you get best services and they really need your help. I thank everyone at BJL who made our stay memorable.

Had gone with my family and booked 3 rooms. What I can say about this property , no words can match it. Spacious rooms with a lovely decor, a very rustic luxury and forest feeling like Africa. Great work by the service staffs. Lovely swimming pool in front of the lake. Breathtaking experience during evening when the lanterns come all over the property followed by very nice cultural shows by the locals. Excellent food, great breakfast spread. Thanks to the chef. Now coming to Safari, the sun downer was just an amazing experience , watching the rhinos and having scrumptious snacks. Had booked a morning safari and Mr Govinda was really nice and friendly. Spotted a lot of animals , different birds, crocodile , Rhino and baby rhino, deer and to top it all spotted a TIGER near the Machan ( exactly where we had our breakfast). We were celebrating our sisters 40th bday and surprisingly all the staff prepared a private space for us and they joined our celebration and singing songs in their local language, making it grand. Great hospitality, Mr Prakashji was just great and his entire team. Sadly don’t remember much names , the receptionist with an always smiling face Ms Shikha I think. Had an unbelievable experience and shall surely visit again. It’s a MUST STAY.

The Bahari Jungle Lodge is a wonderful place to stay. The best place we have ever stayed in fact. We were looked after so well, and with such amazing kind and attentive staff. The food was really good and there was so much to eat! We ate in beautiful candlelit places and breakfast on safari was a really nice touch. Our lodge was very comfortable with a good shower and it was nice that it was so private. Our guide for the safaris was Sagar, he was really good and knowledgeable. We saw one horned rhino's, deer, monkeys, a wild boar etc.  Not the illusive tiger but we didn't really expect to, shame we didn't see crocodiles but this was more than made up for by the real treat of staying at the Jungle Lodge. I was sad to leave. Thank you again to everyone there for being made so welcome and looking after us so well.

As part of a small group tour, we had the pleasure of staying at Barahi jungle lodge for 2 nights. The 5 star service started on arrival with all the staff greeting us off our coach. We were then offered a cooling towel and local drink that was very refreshing and given a run down on the lodge and its amenities. We could choose to walk to our cabin or be driven in an eco-friendly electric buggy. The accommodation was first class and of a design reminiscent of the Flintsones. I wished I could build a house like my cabin.Govinda was our allocated guide for our stay, and he, along with the rest of the staff, made for a stress free time.Food was sensational, hot, fresh, tasty with plenty of variety, vegetarians were well catered for. Service terrific. We did river cruise, land safari and a walk through the local village during our stay the very knowledgeable Govinda telling all about the wildlife and pointing out where they were, and was able to answer the many questions we had.I would highly recommend Barahi jungle lodge to anyone that is interested in Nepalese wilderness experience.

My friends and I had a spectacular 3 days at Barahi Jungle Lodge! It was the highlight of our trip in Nepal. The staff at the lodge is extremely professional and welcoming. The attention to detail was spectacular - from ensuring gas lanterns were out in our yard every evening, warm towels greeting us every time we returned, to lighting fires for our dinners each night, we were blown away. The food at the lodge was great, including the lunch the lodge packed out for lunch in the bush!We arranged a boat safari, full day jeep safari and jungle walk. Our naturalist Govinda Thanait, who was there with us everyday, was a highlight. He was so knowledgeable, passionate and fun! His care and knowledge of Chitwan flora and fauna was immense - we saw many rhinos, multiple tigers, alligators, birds and more (much in part due to Govinda's knowledge). Shoutout to our driver Sunil who effortlessly navigated the jungle and the roads of Nepal!

Excellent property,with amazing staff and ambience. Chef Manoj went out of his way to delight us with his exotic dishes.Krishna as usual is the best nature guide. The jungle breakfast is a must.The restaurant staff Sarita was very prompt and efficient.All in all, a mind blowing experience.The independent cottages are made up with local materials with modern amenities like WiFi,hot shower,private terrace overlooking the river Rapti.Pool and spa is awesome.Village tour on cycle, Jeep Safari, boat ride are mesmerising. If you have a walking problem,pick rooms that are close to the lobby.

From the moment we arrived we were made to feel so welcome and that nothing was too much trouble. Delicious food, friendly knowledgeable staff and the best sunrise morning safari including a delicious jungle breakfast. The accommodation was outstanding with verandas to gaze over the reserve whilst listening to the birds and sounds drifting across the river from the national park. The only bad thing was…. Having to leave.

Wonderful safari lodge. Fantastic service from reception to departure. Our lodge was superb, overlooking the river, across from the Chitwan National Park. On arrival, we had lunch on the hotel patio by the pool and had our first sight of rhinos coming to graze at the riverbank directly opposite the lodge. We had our own safari guide assigned to us for the duration of our stay, who arranged our various safaris - by canoe, walking, and jeep. Great safaris with lovely little surprises like sunset drinks and snacks ( though barbecue meal is probably more accurate) by the river and sunset coffee and cakes at the end of the jeep safari. Lovely other touches throughout our stay, like jungle dinner by campfire. The staff were amazing - arranged for dinner to be brought to our room one night because my fiancee was not feeling well; letting us drive the tuk-tuk (used to transport guests to their lodges) just because we jokingly said we'd like to. Food was lovely and more than plentiful during our stay. Would recommend the Barahi unreservedly.

Amazing hotel. Top quality experience across the board; immaculate grounds, spotlessly clean rooms, great choice of cuisine and fabulous staff who made our stay very special (Prakesh, Tej and Sagar get special mention).We enjoyed and recommend the sunset boat trip, all day safari (both worth every rupee) and free cultural dance show each evening.

We, a family of four along with our pet, stayed at Barahi Jungle Lodge to celebrate my dad's and my birthday in September 2021. The A1 property over-looking the Rapti river, has everything you want and even more. We were spell bound by the hospitality and the love of the entire staff and crew at the resort. The attention to detail, the food, breakfast at jungle safari, spa and everything was spic and span.  They even gave so much of love to our pet–I have stayed at multiple five star properties around the world, but the warmth and experience was totally class-apart. No complains only love.Thank you so much Barahi, for the special treatment and celebrating our birthday with so much love :) We will be back soon!

Great luxury lodge in Chitwan. The whole place just works. The decor is fantastic and all eco friendly. The staff are welcoming and knowledgeable. The naturalist who was with us was brilliant and very knowledgeable on birds which was great for our group. The food is fantastic and any food allergies/ dietary requirements are dealt with. Amazing stay. One comment - there are hardly any Tharu houses left now. It would be better to do a second boat ride instead of a village walk as it's not a real village walk. Highly recommended.

Amazing time at Barahi Jungle Lodge! The jungle like theme of the rooms is great. They are also kept really clean, and the ambience is very cozy and great not only for couples, but families too. The food is also wonderful as well, and very delicious.But perhaps the best part was the hospitality itself! Tej dai, Sagar dai, Dhan dai, Nekshan dai, Kabita didi, and so many others were very kind, and welcoming.We also went on a Safari trip with Sagar dai and Dhan dai, and it was a lot of fun! While we didn’t see any tigers this time around, we got to see some Rhinos, Peacock, and a lot of spotted deer. Sagar dai and Dhan dai are especially knowledgeable  about the many different types of animals/plants around Sauraha/Chitwan, so it was a great learning experience as well. We also took a break by a river (I forgot the name or it) to enjoy some tea and cake. That was very nice!At night, 7:30 PM, we got to witness the traditional Kumal tribe dance. It was a performance hosted by Barahi Jungle Lodge, and that was a lot of fun too as we all got to dance with the performers at the end.But perhaps the best part was how Tej dai and Sagar dai surprised both my newlywed wife and I with a celebratory cake, and a full ensemble of the hotel staff singing Nepali celebratory songs as a congratulation for us getting married.My wife and I danced as they sang and celebrated, it was so much fun and filled us with great joy. We will never forget that. It was such a sweet and memorable moment of our stay.Thank you so much Barahi Jungle Lodge, and especially to Tej dai and Sagar dai for your kindness and thoughtfulness.We will certainly be back!!! Sincerely,Geoffrey

This place is very special.  The location is incredible and the hotel design and layout is interesting and absolutely unique.  What really sets it apart though is the team of people who host your stay.  From the moment we were picked up at the airport to the time we were dropped off, everyone went to so much effort to make sure we had an enjoyable, comfortable and special experience.  We have never experienced attention to detail quite like it!.   Our visit was a busy one - we took boat safaris, jeep safaris and a jungle walk as well as an excursion outside the resort with our fabulous guide, Rajesh.  We saw an amazing plethora of wildlife and got up close to these creatures in their natural habitat with great care taken at every step.  Each safari is a luxury experience in itself.   The food was exceptionally good and plentiful with meals taken both in and out of the lodge.   The team worked so hard to deliver various surprises each day which were simply amazing.  Thank you all so much for a wonderful stay, memories of which will last forever.  We would love to return some day.  If you have a reasonable sense of adventure, an open mind and you love being spoiled rotten, then you should book a stay here.  You will not regret it.

We stayed in Barahi Jungle Resort, Nepal from 23rd Apr till 26th Apr and this was the best decision in the entire journey of our Nepal. If someone loves nature and don't like to compromise on food then they should definitely visit this place. I would like to highlight few extraordinary things about this resort:- Staff Courtesy, customer centric actions, welcoming, humble, maintenance of property, delicious food, closest to jungle, best experience of jungle ride, and last but not the least best General Manager ever met in hospitality industry(Mr. Prakash Chand). We will surely visit this property again whenever we will go to Nepal and will 100% recommend to everyone to visit this resort.

Amazing jungle resort and top class personalized service not seen anywhere in any 5 star hotels across the world. Bush dinner, rhino safari, river boat cruise are must activities. They give you a full time dedicated guide during your stay. The food is also great and Nepali mutton curry and chicken momos were the best. Their GM Prakash also takes care of all guests with personalized service.

We stayed for 2 nights which included a canoe trip and a jeep safari. The trip was part of a tour of Nepal organised by "Nature Trails". We were made to feel rather special from the moment we arrived with an introduction by the manager and a personal guide. Our guide was a young man call Rajib. His knowledge of the local wildlife was invaluable and his English excellent. The room was lovely and the food fantastic but the thing that stands out at Barahi are the wonderful staff. The jeep safari was incredible and a memory we will cherish for many years. The canoe tripwhich ended up with a view of the sunset and a small bbq and drinks was beautiful. My personal highlight was a walk with the guide along the river and back through the village. We are both wildlife nutcases and with the birds, butterflies, spectacular plants and loads of other stuff, we really didn't know where to look next. If I were to go again, I'd prefer a little more time to roam the area along the river and around the village. 2 nights isn't really enough and for any other wildlife nutcases, I'd suggest 4 nights, taking in 2 jeep safaris. Again, I would like to extend our special thankst o Rajib for being a thoroughly nice bloke who helped us with everything and madeour stay so very special.

Our family of six stayed at Barahi Jungle Lodge March 24th-26th and we lifetime of experience. Great hospitality, beautiful place, good food and great adventure all in one package. Loved the Boat safari and sundown barbecue by the Rapati river. Early morning jungle safari and picnic breakfast was awesome. Had fun watching exotic birds and animals. Our guide and naturalist Sagar was very friendly and entertaining. Kitchen team, Sagar and Prakash the manager surprised us with private outdoor dinner with lanterns and great ambiance. We loved taking a dip in the pool in the afternoons and played badminton and biked around the village for fun. Will definitely recommend to anyone looking for an adventure mix with luxury. Thank you so much team Barahi Jungle Logde for making our stay memorable:>

Once in a lifetime experience. They curate your stay with free and paid activities and provide all the food and entertainment. Govinda was our tour guide and he was incredible. We had a personalized experience with great safari sights, views, weather and especially food! I will definitely be taking my family here and I highly recommend this accommodation to anyone who enjoys being pampered!

This is a fantastic lodge headed by Mr Prakash Chand. We stayed from 23rd April to 26th April 2022 here and what an experience we had. The staffs were really courteous and right from day 1 and the final day, we shared some excellent moment over here. How a manager creates value is what has been our key observation here. I saw the way all the guests were taken care was simply brilliant. Amazing administration, fantastic food and lovely people! Truly fantastic experience! Highly recommended place in my view if you want to take your kids for a jungle safari there. We had some great memories of this place. Keep it up!

I arrived at the lodge not feeling well and I want to commend the team at the lodge, especially the GM, Rakesh for doing everything possible to make me feel comfortable including helping me get a seat on a plane that was sold out - Amazing. The lodge and staff are lovely, Rajesh was great as a naturalist and I appreciated their care.  Thank you.

We stayed here as part of a tour. I would highly recommend the hotel. The room and room service was great. The bogeys had a great selection of good. The nightly cultural dances were nice to watch I got a massage and my masseuse was fantastic

Fabulous location and superb lodges (rooms), with every amenity you need. Very quirky decor which I loved! The staff were very friendly and knowledgeable, especially the wildlife Guides. Much appreciated the river boat trip, the jungle walk and the jeep safari. Lots of nice treats and surprises made us feel very special. Would love to return one day.

BJL has a beautiful setting along the banks of the river on the edge of Chitwan National Park. Our lodge was very stylish and well equipped, with river views. All of the staff were incredibly friendly and helpful - they all worked together and knew exactly what every guest should be doing at any given moment. The jungle safaris/boat trips/treks were excellent, with fantastic naturalists. Our main naturalist, Govinder, had an exceptional knowledge of the wildlife and national park, and we really enjoyed getting to know him. BJL personalise your itinerary for your stay based on your preferences and interests which was really beneficial. We will definitely be back!

We went there as a Nepali German couple with a German friend and were thrilled, not only by the location itself but especially by the full day safari that we did. With our young and enthusiastic guide Rajesh we - light a candle - saw a tiger crossing the river. That was definitively the highlight not only if our stay but also of our total journey through Nepal. We also encountered a rhino literally face to face as it wanted to protect its baby as well many other species representing the abundant wildlife in Chitwan National Park. Thank you to Rajesh, the very competent driver/car mechanic and the whole team of the lodge.We will come back.

Every one of this precious staff were extremely attentive to our needs and wishes and went far and beyond any possible expectation.They surprised us in was that we will always treasure! We’re keeping it a secret so you can be surprised too!The food was delicious. Excellent chef!The bed was absolutely comfortable.The safaris were amazing.The staff is sweet, kind and gentle.From our hearts to yours, THANK YOU, for making our stay magical and memorable.

Me and my girlfriend travelled here and stayed for a leisurely trip over 5 days. We never tired of the food as there’s enough variety. Even with the main jungle being closed for the monsoons there were enough activities to do. The naturalist Rajib was very knowledgable about animals (didn’t know dogs don’t have sweat glands) and we got to spend a lot of time with him. Went to a safari, an elephant bathing session and saw a hatching plans for crocodiles. Really easy to get here from Delhi. The manager mr Prakash is coincidentally from Delhi and very very helpful in ensuring all of his guests have a great time. The spa is excellent as well and the masseuse Sujata was very good. Highly recommended. Oh and definitely pack swimming gear. Great pool.

This trip to Chitwan was the best so far at Barahi Jungle Lodge. Such a pleasant and lively resort. This is our third time back and we can’t wait for the next!   We are most appreciative of the lovely staff! They accommodated our family of 9 very well as they were so friendly and matches our excited energy. The food was absolutely delicious and the service was unmatched. It was also our anniversary trip and was surprised with decorated beds and a  wonderful  cake celebration with champagne joined by the stuff and cultural dance group! A special thanks to our safari guide, Alina  who accompanied us to all the activities such as river ride, village walk, elephant feeding and safari jeep ride. There, we were luck to be able to see a Tiger which hadn’t been spotted for a month!

Faultless. The resort itself is exceptional. All the staff were outstanding and the food was delicious. Such a beautiful setting and exciting to take a trip across the river to the jungle. The pool is great and the room was excellent. The resort is clearly well cared for and they pay attention to details. We are vegetarian and the food was exceptional every time with a wide variety. That’s not easy as one of us is a bit fussy. What sets it apart is the service level from all staff. They know what we wanted before we knew. There is no waiting and they have it all planned. Returning from safari with a boat waiting and a cool towel as soon as you step off on the other side. This is luxury but again it’s details that are often clumsy and overlooked - not at Barahi Jungle Lodge. It was our honeymoon and the resort seemed to go to a lot of extra effort for us but I suspect it was routine for all guests. Either way it was a very special experience and one we will cherish forever. I’ve not even mentioned the safari yet but what a great setting, we saw so much and had some amazing encounters with the Rhinos. Our first day tipped down with rain and the tracks in the jungles became rivers. It lasted couple of hours and really added to the experience as we saw both rain and shine. The highlight for us was Govinda our naturalist who shows a level of professional dedication which is truly exceptional, not to mention his expertise and experience in the jungle. Barahi are extremely lucky to have him and so were we.We look forward to returning in the near future.

The property is beautiful and enhanced by the people and service provided!It was a once in a lifetime experience with a comfortable stay and curated activities Tek was our naturalist who went out of his way to give us a special experience with the boat and jeep safaris.  We were pampered with the service, drinks, food, spa and activities, which made our stay that much more incredible.  I am definitely going back and will recommend the place to my family and friends.

We had an excellent stay at the Barahi jungle lodge in late October. Exceptional staff including Manager Prakash (sp?) who was constantly interacting with guests and solving issues as they came up! The evening shows were fantastic and our special dinners were above and beyond! We really enjoyed the canoe ride down the river to see a special sunset. The jungle safari was very good too. We saw several rhinos and deer and crocodiles. Highly recommended.Naushad Jamani

We've stayed at Barahi several times in the past and always have an exceptional experience.  They is the best resort in  the Chitwan area and offers amazing safaris, special dinners, cultural shows and other great tours.  The meals are fresh and wonderful thanks to Tej and his great team.  Safaris to see rhinos and tigers and much more and fun and informative with great guidance from Krishna.  The bush dinner is one of a kind.  Spa treatments were great.  WIFI was generally good.  Rooms are very comfortable and have river views.  The resort also supports philanthropic efforts in the community.   You can't do better!!!!

We experienced an incredible time at this wonderful resort.  So private yet modern, extremely eco-sensitive, service well beyond wildest expectations, and of course magnificent views, jungle safaris and food.  Could not have been better.

The rooms are modern as well as rustic(in a good comfortable way). Great location, can view river and jungle from the room balcony. The service and staffs were excellent. Naturalist Guide Dai was so helpful and knowledgeable. My 9-year-old enjoyed and learn a lot about the flora and fauna.Boat safari ending in barbecue/sundowner at Golaghat was magical.Jeep safari with picnic breakfast in the jungle was a lifetime experience.Thank you for a great jungle experience.

We just returned from a week's trip to Nepal & stayed in Chitwan for 2 nights. Glad I chose Barahi Jungle Lodge. Beautiful location, friendly staff & exceptional service. What was also inspiring was BJL's focus on nature, conservation & sustainability. Eco-huts were tastefully designed, awesome food & well planned program for guests.  Big shout out to Subash & his dedicated staff for doing an amazing job. Astha Thapa helped a lot with the bookings, clarifications & transport. Got a friendly welcome & upgrade on arrival. Alina, Subiksha & Govind made our jungle safari memorable with their knowledge & tracking skils.  Would love to visit again. Cheers!

One of the best stay, full of amazing experience. Though, our visit was a short one, the ambience and warmth of the hotel staff will definitely want you to visit again extending your stay a bit more. You feel you are surrounded by your own, taking care and putting your comfort first won our hearts. We loved it. Thanks for the amazing surprise!!!

Hello, we stayed there for 2 days,The place is awesome, the staff was so humble and cordial so as to make us feel homely.  The food was sumptuous and delicious.  Kids with us also enjoyed the food , stay and jungle safari. The village route was also a different experience.  The naturalistic Mr Govinda was so friendly with us and kids as if he knows us for long time.  Overall we loved the place and ambience.  Would recommend to stay there and enjoy the hospitality.

We stayed at the lodge for two night in March. The temperature was moderate. Staffs are full of hospitality and the room was quite clean. Scenery from the lodge was also wonderful. Activities like jeep safari, boating, village visit and cultural dance were well managed and we had pleasant time there. You may see rhino through the safari. Foods are also good, but not excellent. Hope we stay at the lodge in the next time as well. Beautiful property with marvellous  service!  Kudos to the team for providing an excellent experience and the best hospitality. Their safari’s are well planned, we enjoyed the boat and land safari both. They pleasantly surprised us during the activities which made it quite exciting and we looked forward to it. We also had a milestone birthday in the family that they celebrated with us in the most unique way. The welcome and farewell gestures were warm and personalised. My husband and I stayed at Barahi Jungle Lodge, Chitwan National Park from 28 September 2023 to 30 September 2023 (we checked out in the morning) and it was certainly an enjoyable experience. We were at Barahi Jungle Lodge with our daughters aged 10 and 5. The staff took amazing efforts to make our stay comfortable and luxurious at the same time. The river itself was full of birds and other wildlife. I made it a point to walk around the lodge grounds in the morning and evening to see what birds I could find, and there were many! I would certainly recommend staying at the Barahi for your visit.

A wonderful experience at this peaceful oasis in Chitwan. Perfect location for safari tours with excellent guides and drivers. We stayed in the suite, which is well worth extra, particularly for a family as you get your own pool and space to unwind. The staff were attentive and friendly, and the food was good quality. Arrived at the resort with my family and we were immediately impressed by the hospitality showed by the staff and the amazing architectural design of the entire premise. We had an amazing time here. What an adventure, early morning Safari with breakfast in a look out tower, safari cruise with sitting and watching the sunset at the end. The staff did everything to make our stay special. The accommodations were great, eco friendly, well worth the visit

We wanted something special about our 15th anniversay which happened to be on 28th April 2023 and oh boy it was special all thanks to Hotel Barahi Lodge. Special thanks to Alina. The late evening anniversary celebration organized by the staffs was so out of the book and so overwhelming, me and my wife along other family members just loved the reception. This place was amazing. My friend and I stayed here for 3 days and wish we had stayed an extra day. The service they provide is excellent and we loved everything about our stay. Loved every bit of it.

We were here for 2 days and had an AMAZING experience. The place is situated by the river so the view was incredible. In the morning you get to see the mists and the fog by the river, it was absolutely breathtaking. The boat tour and jeep safari was so much fun. We saw tons of animals: rhinos, monkeys, deers, elephants and lots of peacocks. The service was incredible as well. The staff were so attentive and welcoming. They made us felt so welcome and everyone really provided amazing service.The lodge itself was beautiful as well and had amazing decor. It made us felt very relaxed and truly felt that we left our regular city lives. I highly recommend this lodge!!!

Amazing Staff but Overpriced Drinks, Food and Services. The Jungle Safari was ok but the SPA/Massage was amazing. The pool was average as it was only 4 ft at its depth. Stayed for 2 nights, the first night was very crowded with loud music till late but the second day was very quiet and relaxing.

The property is amazing and the service is outstanding. Safari is short and sweet.  Saw lots of rhinos. Jungle walk is an adrenaline rush. Food is outstanding. It was so peaceful to arrive in Barahi Jungle  Lodge from the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu. Our young boys enjoyed all meals.  Our three days naturalist and guide, Anisha was very knowlegeable and really took good care of us. we will recommend this lodge to our friends.

I went to Barahi Jungle Lodge with my son and daughter. It was a once in a lifetime experience. Right from the pickup at the airport to the jungle safaris and sundowner everything seemed magical. Very good services, the place looks like in pictures (the beautiful ones). There are lots of nice hotels, with rooms as good as these and similar amenities. However what really makes this place unique is the genuine charm and positivity of the staff. Nothing is to much trouble.Add this to pretty good food and a three minute boat ride into the national park, and you are onto a winner.

Our short trip with family and amazing experience. Though 7-8 yrs old lodge but we found it is intact. Lovely lodge with a wonderful restaurant. Overall experience at Barahi was fabulous. Ranging from cleanliness of rooms to hospitality by each n every staff was top notch. The staff goes above n beyond their means to make you very comfortable at the property.

Great place on the river, with lots of safari options - jeep, walking, river.Lovely self contained huts, clean and well appointed.Staff can't do enough for you and very knowledgeable. Our guide Sagar was an absolute ledgend, took us on jeep  walking and boat safaris, saw lots of Rhino's. Kept trying for tiger's, but they were a little shy. However Sagar was still ace couldn't do enough for us whilst there.

Vacation with a two year old isn’t easy AT ALL but the  team  at BJL  didn’t  fail to make our stay there as comfortable as being at home . No one can do hospitality  better than  the Barahi Jungle Lodge .You have my  heart ❤️Can’t wait to plan our next again !

One of the best hospitality I’ve come across. Excellent and supportive staff headed by Mr. Tej Thanait, special mention to him for being super attentive and helpful. Very well maintained property and I’d definitely recommend this property if you want to experience Nepalese hospitality at its best.

We enjoyed our stay very much. Everything was great. The room was very beautiful and lovely. The Jeepsafari was top with a very good guide and driver. The walking Safari outstanding.Private Dinner at the first evening was a wonderful surprise. Thanks for all.

Had a great time at Barahi Jungle lodge. A fantastic place to relax and unwind with your partner or with the family. Great Hospitality lFriendly staff Wonderful location Vast amenitiesAnd an amazing experience. Can't wait to visit again.

We found this jungle resort a real surprise. The whole facility is very private. On arrival a thorough briefing of what to expect was run over, staff were introduced and a special contact person was allocated to us for anytime we needed help etc. A cool face cloth was always given out on return from any excursion. The accommodation was in individual huts with an interior theme of the jungle or 'the Flinstones'. Air conditioned and also with fans, bathroom & toilet in each. The view from all the  rooms are overlooking the river toward the national park.The large pool was especially well received as a swim in it cooled us down.Helping to bath the elephant was a real treat, 'Queen Goddess😍' was such a gentle elephant.A early start at 6.45 am took us on a-jungle walk with several of the resort naturalists in the local national park, where the animals are protected, led us near where a male tiger was calling for a female tiger. A mother rhinoceros and her baby splashed into the river only feet away from us and even closer when she came out of the water as we quietly watched. When she sensed us there she took off the other way. The naturalists gave us a briefing the night before on all the animals we might come across and also what to do in a situation if we encountered these animals. We felt safe at all times.Several surprise excursions were amazing:A trip to the local cultural centre, a visit to a local  house to see how the village people live, lunch  on the river bank, and a sunset to die for later that evening after a paddle down the river with staff.  We thoroughly recommend this resort.

From the outstanding friendly service from every single staff member to the beautifully quaint cabin-style rooms to the service and guidance of the naturalists to the incredible food, there is nothing about this property that disappointed!  You will be greeted by friendly staff, a welcome drink and a hot towel, shown to your clean, private stone cabin room (via golf cart if you wish, if it's too hot to walk), and fed wonderful meals until you can't manage another bite.  There is a huge, beautiful pool area, and many activities to participate in, particularly the elephant, jeep and river safaris which take you into the surrounding terrain for viewing of the park animals in their natural habitat.  We were lucky enough to see many rhinos, deer, and peacocks, as well as a crocodile (alligator?) lounging on the river shore.  Apparently tiger sightings are pretty rare, but we did see a fresh tiger paw print in the mud, so they are definitely in the area!The food was absolutely incredible, and the staff will prepare pretty much whatever you want to eat.  We stuck with Nepali food because we love it so much (momos to die for in this place), but it seemed that they would do their best to accommodate any request.Two notes on the nature-viewing aspects of the trip, which I nonetheless loved.  First, I find I was deeply conflicted about the use of elephants at the property and in the general area.  While they seem well-cared for, it is always troubling to me to encounter wild animals which have been imprisoned for service to humans.  Second, while most of the national park seemed very clean, we walked through a portion that is apparently used by the locals to travel to and from the nearby river, and even though we were in a protected area, there was STILL signs of the litter that is endemic to Nepal.  For the good of the tourism industry, there really needs to be some public education in Nepal about proper disposal of trash.  I found myself wishing I'd brought a garbage bag along so I could pick the litter up myself as we walked through the grass and trees.I would most definitely recommend this beautiful hotel and its outstanding staff.

We stayed there 2 nights and only word I can say is 'JUST PERFECT'. Nice property, very kind and friendly staff and well organised activities. Very clean and calm surrounding. Rooms are very neat and clean.Food was awesome and they serve with love what ever you order. We enjoyed elephant safari, boating and jeep safari. Thanks Barahi and all staff again for making our stay so fantastic. Even we opted for drop to pokhara. Vehicle was good and driver was nice.Our kids are so happy that they want to come back again. will definitely be back...... Thanks again to all the staff for our unforgettable vacation.!!!!!

We have visited this resort on 14th May 2016, the rooms are excellent and hospitality I don't think so u will find anywhere else, Jeep safari n breakfast in jungle was best experience in life, Elephant ride, Elephant bath was excellent. the bar after boat safari in the middle of river was unforgettable experience. In short it's 100 out of 100 worth visit.

I got back from my stay at Barahi last night. It was a "fantastic experience". They really take hospitality to a different level and cater to nature/wild-life enthusiasts!! The management of this property does a spectacular job at "execution". Right from the minute we arrived at the property to the time we left, the entire experience was planned & executed to perfection. Most importantly they were flexible to the needs & interests of our family. We were traveling with my 8yr old son & 4yr old daughter. Obviously the interests and needs of both our children are not the same. We were assigned a "naturalist"/guide (jitu-ji) who was with our family the whole time. After a few hours, jitu-ji became part of the family and my kids started bombarding him with all sorts of questions :-) Every activity was planned meticulously and executed to perfection. Of course when you are on the safari you take what the animals "give". We got lucky and got a healthy sighting of many animals. We also had an adventurous experience of spotting a wild elephant which is "rare". Kudos to our guide, who handled the situation very well which meant we got out of it un-harmed.The hospitality in terms of service, staff, rooms, food was just "out-of-the-world". I can imagine the effort that goes behind delivering such high-quality service. The room assignment was excellent keeping in mind our family needs. Their huts are very clean which was a important criteria for us. They would "keep it up" constantly to compensate for our messy kids. Our schedule of activities & changes to it were known to all the departments which meant house-keeping did not disturb us if we were taking a nap at odd-times!!The food was excellent!! I loved the fact they don't have buffet. It was like B&B where they would take order for your next meal based on your preference. During my 3 day stay I loved & enjoyed every single meal. The chef made sure we got to taste the wide repertoire he was capable of (Indian, chinese, continental, american etc..). All the staff we interacted with were very friendly and became part of our family. We felt so comfortable leaving our kids to run around on property because we knew there is always someone watching.I had to "work" one night (sadly enough) and the staff made arrangements for me so I could be comfortable. Someone waited on me beyond their work timings to ensure I got fresh-ground coffee at midnight!! The internet connection was impressive given how remote the location was.To summarize, we relaxed in the pool, learned about wild life, local culture/dance, ate a lot of yummy food and we are ready to go back :-) I think Barahi is a best "kept secret" in Chitwan!!

Great property! everything from checkin to check out was perfect...Professional staffs…recommended for wildlife activities as well as leisure! Fell in love as soon as we arrived there…the boat safari was awesome!

Awesome view, amazing ambience and the friendliest staff ever. Hospitality at its best. You gonna fall in love with the place over and over again. Must come !!The food, the environment, the valley behind is a sight-soother. The poolside is a bliss.Kudos!
