She offered wonderful suggestions about activities best suited for us, took such good care of every detail, guided us for each activity, then personally made sure every single piece of our stay went perfectly - often working later than her normal hours to take care of things for us. She was extremely knowledgeable about the wildlife, nature, the lodge, the local people, culture and customs, Honestly, we hated to leave mostly because of her dedicated efforts on our behalf.  Miss Joshi was thoroughly incredible. We made sure we spoke directly to the hotel manager to rave about her professionalism that exceeded all of our expectations.  Also worth a special mention were these other terrific staff members who also impressed us with their great service: Saki - Naturalist; Tez - Food and Beverage Manager; Hari - Naturalist; Junge - Naturalist and Dhanprasad - a Jeep Safari Driver.Every employee genuinely cared how their guests felt about the Lodge's service and went above and beyond to provide exemplary treatment.  They seem to enjoy their jobs and have a desire to ensure customers stay content and satisfied with every part of their stay.Staff couldn't do enough for us and every activity we had was a lot of fun, but the highlight was getting up close and personal with the elephants during the feeding/wash experience and also the elephant ride safari - completely amazing and once-in-a-lifetime experiences.  The jeep drives were very good - seeing rhinos, elephants, monkeys, crocodiles - although we regretted never seeing the elusive tiger in person. The nature and wildlife briefings were informative and helpful.  We liked the canoe ride and nature walks, bird watching and picnics in the jungle.  The cart visit to the village and cultural performance were fascinating and we learned a lot about the proud native culture.The stand-alone rooms are cozy round houses that are clean and atmospheric, creatively designed with a decor that is typical to this type of setting.  We came away with a most positive experience from this stay as everyone made us feel like family - something we won't forget. I've passed along our feedback to others who relish travel to special places that offer extraordinary service like the Barahi Jungle Lodge.  I simply could not speak more highly of this place and everyone who spoiled us.

If you are able to include Chitwan in your itinerary, then you must stay here! We were thrilled with every minute we spent at Barahi Jungle Lodge. The wildlife activities are an incredible experience, and at the lodge everything from the food to the staff to the facilities themselves were completely beyond our expectations. Last but certainly not least, we became fast friends with our naturalist, Anuja. Incredibly knowledgeable, caring, and kind, she really made our experience better than we could have ever asked for. I am so happy we got to end our trip to Nepal here, it will certainly be a top lifetime memory!

The Best Hotel on The World Thanks a lot everything Room is Best food is Best and everybody so friendly  When you come This hotel you can fell you are in paradiseSee you soon I will Miss jungle safari river safari and all Best Regards Erez Egilmez

Luxury Lodge with a lot of amazing activities that are suitable for copuples, families and freinds.The staff were very friendly and provided us with outstanding services, specially "Krishna Giri" who gave us an exciting Elephant safari, Elephant bathing, Jungle walk and Boat trip and "Subas Gurung" who arrange for us breakfast and BBQ near the river. The general manager "Varun Kumar" was very polite and give us an amazing offer for upgrading our room to suite. The dining options was very organized with four main choices: Nepalese, Indian, Continental and Chinese. It was one of the best experiance that I had in Nepal, I definitly will go again.Note: It's better to take a flight to reach Chitwan.

The place is wonderful, activities are awesome and people are amazing.I would have left  a feedback letter in their feedback box, but then I thought that it would have been better to share my impressions in public. So, here I am.We stayed in Barahi Jungle Lodge only for two nights and two days and, unfortunately, during the monsoon season. Me and my boyfriend have been surprised by the magic that sourrounds this place and please believe me, it is not a set phrase, it is real.So, to be brief, since we are still in the lobby and tomorrow morning our clock will wake us up super early, we would sincerely thank the Manager, for his humility, intelligence, love for perfection and harmony and about all thank to his ability to sourround this place by special people. Thanks to our guide, who cares about us like if we were part of his family and when each excursion ended he was happy to see us happy.Thank to the people in the Restaurant, who gives us so many attentions, they knows about our tastes after only one meal with them. They were super professional, always ready to make our meal perfect without be invasive. All this people always smile and seems to love you at first sight. For all of this, thank you.

We were family of 4 with 2 kids ( age 8 and 13) from Kathmandu. Stayed for 2 nights in July 2017. Little stiff on your wallet but it is well worth the stay. Great food. Rooms are very good. loved the fresh coffee and extra chips etc. for the kids in the room. Service is great. Kids loved the food and swimming pool. General Manager Varun is very helpful and he gave us a great sundowner surprise.. Thank you Varun. Staff are very nice and well trained. In overall, Jeetu Dai who is a naturalist and a guide is very helpful and he is there to prepare your schedule as per your need. Jeetu Dai took care of us really well and we really enjoyed his company. Thank you Jeetu Dai for your hospitality.. Thank you Varun and the entire team of BJL.. we will be back soon. If you are looking for a quite place to relax and enjoy good food with great service, do not miss this place.

This had to be the best adventure I have had for a long time... serenity, green jungle everywhere, beautiful animals and birds, amazing staff snd facilities I spent three nights here and was treated like royalty. The staff are focused on all your needs, are exceptionally respectful, friendly, knowledgeable and professional My guide/company, Govindar was superb...he was there when I needed him and  respected my privacy. He is careful about your safety and is able to help and arrange all activities with absolutely no fuss!!... a great guy. The food is fabulous and the menu varied. This place is a hidden gem in a beautiful part of Nepal. It is organised and well managed by Mr Varun Kumar who is respected by the staffThanks for an amazing holiday.

Recommended for nature and wild life lovers..travel to beautiful country Nepal. A place where service with ever smiling n ready to serve everything in their stride staff. A place which u can call home with amazing location, ambience, nature around u. Please do visit when u visit Nepal. Should be on your bucket list. Amish Patani

I visited bharatpur for 5 days and staying in this lodge was an ultimate experience. Though it is in the middle of jungle but every possible means was available. A big swimming pool with excellent ambience and surrounded by river. Inside resort cottages were well maintained along with delicious food and drinks. It has friendly and cooperating staff as well. Had an amazing experience staying here.Vibha Dua

This was our second stay at Barahi and it just keeps getting better.  The room is extremely comfortable with a great bed, wonderful shower and excellent air conditioning.  Some other family stayed in the family lodge and thought they had died and gone to heaven!  It is virtually a 2 bedroom apartment with it's own pool and outdoor space.  The shower in the master is beyond belief.  Our naturalist - Krishna - provided a magnificent jeep jungle safari and exposure to the resort's elephants (we bathed them in the river) and provided great information about the jungle and the local community.  He was our constant support for our three days there.  Tej provided a spectacular dinner at the family lodge (fit for a king) and then did the same for a "dinner in the bush" and provided great food for our diverse requirements.  Our massage therapist - Regina - gave my wife and I one of our best massages ever!  Every experience here is the best you can imagine!  Barrage is also eco oriented and very supportive of the local community.  We can't wait to return.

I spent few days at the Barahi Jungle Lodge at the end of a business trip. These few days turned out to be an enchantement. The resort is a beautiful gem hidden along the river Rapti. It is an extremely serene place decorated with nice and pastel taste. What made the stay the most delightful was the kindness and smile of all the staff, starting with Mr Varun Kumar the manager. Jeti and Krishna were absolutely amazing and helpful but it woul be wrong to name only few as all employees were perfectly assisting and caring with extreme patience whenever we were late for the activities.The nature is peaceful around the resorts and all activities are worth it, from the boat safari to the elephant or the jeep one. It really helps to release stress of our every life and become zen and relaxed again. Finally, all is organized in full respect of the nature and of the animals creating a nice harmony.I can only recommend visitors to Nepal to stop at the lodges and enjoy the good time there.From France, Simon

I stayed at the Bahari Jungle Lodge for 2 nights as part of a guided tour of Nepal.  This hotel was lovely.  The rooms are actually huts that are beautifully decorated and provide all the comforts of home.  The WiFi is free and works well, but you must be in the reception area to use it.  This is fine because it works on the covered porch, by the pool, in the dining room and in the library so there are plenty of places to make yourself comfortable.  The food is delicious and the portions are very generous, and there are many items to choose from.  I also did 3 of their excursions:  the jeep safari, the boat trip, and the village walk.  All 3 were excellent.  The guides/naturalists were great.  Also, at night, they have programs.  I especially enjoyed the dance program put on by the local villagers.  I had an excellent stay.

The room was excellent with huge tub and comfy bed. Food was just ok could be better for the price of resort. Staff and service is excellent. Knowledgeable guides available to those who want them. If not into Safaris and boat tours a nice quiet place to relax with a nice pool.

On our trip through Nepal we spent two nights at Barahi Jungle Lodge - and as Dwarika's and Tiger Mountain Pokhara Lodge also this stay was truely amazing. After a warm welcome and short briefing of the upcoming days we were introduced to Subash, our personal naturalist who made this stay as amazing at it was. The venue is nicely located at the border of the national park with small houses for guests that provide you with the privacy you wish. The activities guided by the naturalist give you a very good opportunity to get to know the wildlife in Chitwan - an experience that made me more curious about wildlife. Without telling too much, apart from all the interesting outdoor activities,the nice hotel staff has some surprises for you.When you are on a trip through Nepal do not miss to got to Barahi Jungle Lodge. Stay at least three nights (or more) to perfectly enjoy this wonderful place on earth.

The property is located just on the banks of the river and your room opens right out to the river. The grounds of the lodge are amazing, extremely picturesque. As mentioned by previous travellers, it is quite a bumpy road in and out of the lodge but worth the ride. The activities are extremely well thought out and executed. The staff, our naturalist (Jitu) and the general manager, all went out of their way to ensure we had a great stay at the lodge. I highly recommend this lodge to anyone who is considering going!

Great peaceful location..beautiful jungle environment inside roads...big perfect dinning hall and inside  huts unique enviroment materials..bamboo,stones,locally grinded coffee beans powder..Perfect activites with guide ..close encounte to the peaceful jungle and animals..definitely single rhinos

This was our 4th trip to The Chitwan National Park area and our first to Barahi.  We took our children and grandchildren; ages 4 - 10.  What an experience!  The staff, accommodations, food and service were wonderful.  Best of all we saw the Bengal tiger TWICE!!!!!!  We had only seen it one other time on our previous trips.  Children's programs were great and so personal.  I would recommend our main guide Saki to  anyone.  We highly recommend this place and commend the staff on this treasure!

I have to say I was incredibly surprised to see how beautiful this property actually was!  The rocky 7 hour car journey from Kathmandu was certainly a challenge but once they fix that road the tourists will definitely flock in thousands to Chitwan.  We were lucky to be upgraded to their Suite Villa which gave us our own private pool and outdoor fire place (along with a friendly crocodile in the garden) and a spacious two room villa.  The service from the team was truly impeccable and their mantra of 'anything is possible' were really not just words.  They did everything they could to make the stay memorable and our guide, Krishna, was just a fountain of knowledge and willing to share as much as he could.  I would thoroughly recommend this property to any traveler wanting to see Chitwan in luxury!

This is a wonderful jungle lodge facility right on the banks of the Rapti river. They took every opportunity to make our stay enjoyable. They have a staff naturalist who accompanied us on our elephant rides, jeep safari, river trip, and walks. He was very knowledgeable, and friendly and his love of the animals and plants was very evident. Food, accommodations, grounds, facilities,,,everything was first class. The four of us all thought this was a great place and would return.

We travelled to Nepal in last week of Dec 2016, doing the Kathmandu-Chitwan-Pokhara-Kathmandu trip. We booked ourselves into Barahi Jungle Lodge for 2 Nights.Our trip from Kathmandu to Chitwan was interrupted at Mughling where we were stopped at a roadblock for 4.5 hours due to roadworks ahead of Mughling (The village where the Kathmandu road branches towards either Chitwan or Pokhara). After whiling the hours chewing peanuts and crisps hawked by street pedlars, we got underway. The road from Mughling to Barahi was horrific, in fact i would not call it a road but a jungle track. After crawling at 10 to 15 km/hour for the next 3 or so hours, we reached Barahi, having lost our way several times since the roads are not well marked and Barahi Jungle Lodge signs are not displayed clearly along the way. So our trip from Kathmandu to Barahi ended up lasting 12 hours, and in the words of my 11 yo son "Was the back breaking 12 hours journey worth it? ABSOLUTELY"The staff at the lodge were really great, caring and attentive. The warmth of the Barahi people was unbelievable, and we really missed them all the moment we checked out. While my memory with names is really bad, i can still name Mr Tej (F&B in-charge) who constantly kept in touch to know of our food preferences for the upcoming meals, Ms Krishna who was always around to help us with anything we needed, our Naturalist Mr Saket, and of course the friendly and caring Mr Kumar, Manager of the Lodge.The Lodge was very comfortable, beautifully appointed, and spotless (We booked two interconnected cottages, no 25 and 26), and the fun activities (Elephant safari, jungle walk, boat ride, sunset view etc) were absolutely amazing and we did come face to face with several wild animals and birds.We declined the jeep safari due to the suffering of the 12 hour road trip as well as the upcoming road trip to Pokhara, but we would recommend it for those who intend to fly in and out of chitwan.Meal times were great, eating outdoors near the fireplace at night, and on the patio for breakfast and lunch and weather was great. Woek up to a drizzle with thunderstorms on the first morning, and while we were watching the drizzle on the river, we were lucky enough to spot a small jackal trot by on the path on the lodge property, running parallel to the river.Overall assessment : Amazing staff, pampered feeling, beautiful lodge and surrounding forests and rivers, regret booking only 2 nights. Was worth every bit of the money we paid for the stay, and we highly recommend a stay of at least 3 Nights at Barahi Jungle Lodge, if not more. We do hope we can go there again in the near future. To avoid getting stuck in roadworks which don't seem to be likely to complete by the scheduled date (April 2017) stated on the signs along the way, its recommended to fly into Chitwan airport. To avoid getting miserably lost (As we did, repeatedly), its recommended to have the Lodge arrange for airport pickup and drop. You do not want to waste time on the inner village roads when you could be enjoying yourself at the Lodge.

This is a place for those of you who like widlife, nature etc. The lodge is totally pivoted around exploring Chitwan. So all tours are accompanied by a knowledgeable guide. We were on a package which did not include the jeep safari, so we had to pay additional to get that on the agenda (expensive!). The rooms are pretty nice and functional. Breakfast and meals are served in the dining hall and we found the food quite to our liking. Alcohol can be a bit pricey, but then the resort is in the middle of nowhere. The access roads are bad. Travelling from Pokhara by road, like we did, is bearable (5 hours). But exercise caution before attempting the Kathmandu Chitwan drive -  a fellow visitor spent 10 hours in the car. Take a flight!

We stayed at the Barahi Lodge on Dec 29th and 30th as part of our ten day trip through Nepal.  This was the highlight of our trip.  This lodge is truly top class, with great accommodations, excursions and most of all, fantastic staff who couldn’t do enough to make your stay special.  We arrived tired and hungry from a long bumpy ride and manager Verun Kumar welcomed us and had the kitchen prepare delicious chicken momo! That started things off right…Accommodations – hotel itself is quite charming, with décor to suit the environment.  Rooms are new, with great décor, hot showers (with bath) and satellite TV with lots of channels.  One very minor comment: would be good to have more bath amenities.  (Hair Conditioner)Excursions – we were assigned a charming and knowledgeable guide (Saki) who escorted us on several excursions.   Stand out was the elephant safari to see the rhinos - truly special!  Boat ride was also relaxing, especially the end where we were taken to a spot to watch the sunset and greeted by hotel staff, with appetizers and sundowners.  Cuisine– the food was excellent.  All meals were served buffet style and there was lots of variety of mostly Asian cuisine. (Breakfast was the exception with more western selections). Service – the best we experienced in Nepal.  The wait staff was attentive, prompt and always smiling.  I had the best massage ever at the spa – at a very reasonable price!Anything to improve?  Hard to fault this lodge but one thing that was a bit of an inconvenience:  internet was spotty.  We found this to be the case in all of Nepal, even at the 5 star hotels in Kathmandu.  At Barahi, when it did go down the team scrambled to fix it. All and all, highly recommend this lodge if you’re in Nepal and looking for an unique, enjoyable, first class experience.

What a wonderful  time we had at Barahi Jungle Lodge.We stayed two nights at the resort. A beautiful resort with friendly and  knowledgeable staff.Rooms were  unique in design and were luxurious and overall it was definitely worth the price.

One of the best rooms I have stayed in.  Beautiful jungle theme...very comfortable bed....excellent food in restaurant. Very friendly staff.  The very best service....you will love it !,Safari was so much fun in the jungle ..saw rhino monkeys and many species of deerGreat time there

The massage road (bump, bump, bump) to the lodge is an adventure all its own but once you arrive at Barahi you will be warmly welcomed into a most stunning setting.  The location on the river, the lodge, the rooms, the food, the staff, the activities...all wonderful without exception.  This is a really beautiful lodge with a fabulous design and very quirky decor which is adorable.  Everything is coordinated with you for your comfort and absolute pleasure.  Chitwan is a beautiful Park and driving through it in the early morning mist in the open air jeep spotting wildlife was lovely.  Sunset drinks on the river edge after a late afternoon boat safari was a beautiful way to end the day.  It's really a ten out of five experience!

Nice stay years back, situated in great atmosphere. Was delighted with rooms which is maintained with top quality furnishing local made specially. Amazing banquet hall and all day dining with lavish buffet.

I have been to many jungle lodges around India, and this Lodge in Nepal is far better than any I have been to.  Everything about this place is outstanding. The location is outstanding, the Lodge design is outstanding, the staff is outstanding, the food is outstanding and the Jungle in front is outstanding.  Spent 3 nights there, utilised every minute, and wanted to stay back for more. Jeep safari, Boat safari, Elephant safari, Elephant feeding, walking safari, Village visit on bullock cart, Massages, there is so much to do.  Very friendly and courteous staff, who are at attention to cater to your every whim. Bush dinner for two on our anniversary was dreamy.  Resident elephants and their safari is the icing on the cake.  Came across 16 rhinos in 2 days, 6 of them while on foot, a true adrenaline rush !

From the moment we arrived at Barahi Jungle Lodge (for our two night stay) we were impressed with the professionalism and friendliness of the staff as well as the sheer beauty of the place. The place is only 3-4 years old and has been constructed so beautifully and with attention to the smallest of details (something I am not used to after spending two years in India). Probably one of the nicest rooms I have ever stayed in, our villa overlooked the river, and our balcony allowed us privacy amidst nature. The shower was also one of the best (pressure wise, heat wise) I have ever had the pleasure of standing under. We were introduced to our "main men" upon our arrival who were Subash - our humble and knowledgeable naturalist/guide for safaris/nature activities and Tej - the lovely food and beverage manager who made sure we were sufficiently sated with meals and drinks at every step. The program of activities was just right for our two day stay. We went on 3 safaris - one sunset on elephant, one early morning by jeep and one sunset by canoe. We saw about 6-7 rhinos (including baby rhino), plenty of deer, monkeys, a jungle cat, crocodiles and lots of bird life. We also spent an hour or two getting to know the elephants - feeding and bathing them, which was a once in a lifetime experience. Subash was informative, extremely knowledgable and environmentally minded - we were suitably impressed - he really is an asset to this place. The food and drinks were just as impressive. Beautiful three course meals which were part of our inclusive package as well as a lovely poolside bar with attentive staff (special mention to Tej and Avinash). We had two surprises - one was sunset wines which had been set up for us after our canoe safari at the merging of the Rapti and Narayani Rivers. The next was a surprise "bush dinner", so instead of eating in the dining room, they had organised a candle lit area outdoors to enjoy a local three course meal under the stars on our last night. Really special! The cultural show was really fun and showcased the local Tharu Dance forms. After a few wines (and only then! ;-)) we were ready to get up an participate at the end where everyone seemed to let go and embrace the culture.One of the things I liked most about this place was their commitment to training and hiring people from the local villages (90% of staff are local). This means that they are not only knowledgeable, but they are invested in and passionate about the place. This comes across in everything they do! I am having massive with drawls from leaving this place! I hope to get back there one day and reunite with all the lovely people we met.

The short visit we made was only two Days but above expectations. During this period the very professional and friendly staff gave experiences via: 1 - Riding on an elephant in the first afternoon in the jungle as well as along the shore of the river. Rhinos were visible2 - Jungle Safari with a Jeep where Rhinos, Deer, Wild Boar, birds and a Crocodile was seen. Included also a nice breakfast "out there".3 - Feeding, Learning about and get to know an Elephant at the site4 - River tour including the sunset by the river and snacks/drinks5 - Cultural dances from local people6 - A wonderful dinner with all other guests gathered - as by the sunsetJust remember to go there by domestic flights unless you have time to experience the local roads...

Where the GM (Varun Kumar) personally greets each guest on arrival and assigns a personal Naturalist to each group, Where each and every staff member is smiling, courteous and well trained, Where every room is classy and the facilities top class, one can hardly go wrong in opting for Barahi Jungle Lodhe - managed by Pugdundee tours and travels - as an ideal holiday destination.Getting there ia not easy since it is far away from the hoi polloi and the last 32 kms on bad and bumpy roads can test the best of us. Set in Meghauli village, once you're in the premises you just don't want to leave. The food is excellent and the bar is well stocked. We opted for a package which included all meals and activities. The only downside was that we did not get to visit the Core Zone. Elephant Safari and Jeep Safari in the Buffer Zones and we got to see the Great Indian One Horned Rhinocerous, Barking Deer, Swamp Deer and many birds. The Naturalist Govinda was knowledgeable and energetic. I would recommend this place to each one of my friends and family. You cannot go wrong if you visit this place. We travellevd by train from Howrah to Raxaul in Norther Bihar (Horrible journey and horrible town) and a vehicle took us to Meghauli and brought us back. The other (more expensive) option is to Fly to Kathmandu and then Fly to Bharatpur which is one hour away from Barahi. It's best to ask the resort to collect you from the airport.Finally - Check and go in wintere when jeep safaris are allowed into the Core Zone.

Our 3 nights 4 days package was full of activities viz. Elephant ride, Elephant bathing, Canoeing on Rapti river, Nature walk (so exciting inside the jungle infested with dangerous animals like rhinos, bears, tigers etc.), Bird watching, Bullock ride (to Tharu museum and typical Tharu hut), Jeep safari (where we were fortunate to encounter a tiger) and the Tharu cultural program.  Little time were left for swimming in an enormous and well design swimming pool just in front of open Bar stocked with standard foreign/local brands.  We spent 3 nights in the luxurious Hut No. 32 overlooking the Rapti river from where you see gazelle grazing and crocodiles basking on the beach on the other side. Our guide for the whole activities was Mr. Jeetendra (alias Jeetu Dai) who was humble and experienced. Rest of the staff were friendly but professional and the four types of served cuisine were tasty and splendid.  We were impressed and thoroughly enjoyed the ambiance, Barahi Jungle Lodge has to offer. Look forward to visit again.

Real tough ride to the hotel.Horrible road that leads to the hotel. 2 hour ride felt like 6 hour travel time.Check in was swift, smooth.What a jungle resort...! Better than brilliant resorts! Great management, such nice hospitality!Loved every bit of the holiday apart from the road, which the hotel has no control over!

Fantastic is the word I can say to this place, in every way. The rooms neat and clean, ala cart menu exceptional, the attendant Miss Vinita knowledgeable guide of the forest animals, birds and plants. I will give kudos to this resort, a must place to visit. Only setback is the approach road to the resort.

I was there in the 1st week of September. Overall hospitality of the hotel was excellent. Every rooms of a hotel faced toward a river and had a balcony. Rooms were very clean and there was 24 hours service. Staffs were very polite and helpful. Room i was allotted to didn't have a bathtub but staffs were kind enough to change that immediately as per my need. Western food was very good but typical Nepali food was not as expected. Swimming pool was bit small (in terms of depth). Only thing i didn't like was drink price which was very expensive. But this small flaw was overlooked by the great hospitality i have received when i was there. I rate this hotel excellent and feel that once everyone must visit this hotel.

It took us just over an hour and thirty minutes to reach Barahi Jungle Lodge from Bharatpur Airport and while the transfer journey wasn't too pleasant, everything changed as we reached the premises.The lodge occupied a large amount of land which is in contrast to many other resorts and lodges operating in and around Chitwan. The rooms come in an individual cottage style and make the best use of natural materials from wood and stones. Apart from the shower pipes and the toilet, you will hardly find man-made natural. There is a TV in the room, perfect to catch up on what's happening around the world in the evening once you're done with the activities.I loved the verandah from the room as that looks out into the green and across the river! If you're lucky you might even be able to spot a rhino from there. The most amazing thing I liked about Barahi Jungle Lodge was the large swimming pool and how it looked out into the river. It was amazing! We even saw a rhino across the river from the pool. The food was top-notch, staff were very courteous and helpful, wifi is available around the dining area and the bar also offers shisha! The staff informed us that a spa is coming soon. During our jungle walk on the other side of the river we nearly walked into an Asian black bear! Thankfully it ran in the other direction.

We flew here from KTM on Yeti, was a really quick and easy flight.Once at location was picked up by the hotel van, had a 1 hour 30 minute ride to hotel as it had rained and the road was fairly messed up. When we entered the lodge however it was just like you entered into another world. Just spellbound with the place.The reception and team overall are just super, food was awesome and the rooms were just fabulous with all the key amenities to spoil you in the middle of the jungle. The lodge had private agendas for each party that came here, so no requirement to follow the general flow. Everything was personalised. The lovely villas overlook the river and if your lucky you can spot wild life across the river.The pool is really nice an overlooks the river as well.We took a elephant safari and whilst am not a big fan of doing this the experience was crazy. The jeeps are not allowed into the park as it's the rainy season hence elephant, we went in to super thick jungle and saw countless deer , few Rhinos and wild boar, and the vast savanna coming out of the thick jungle was just amazing. Getting back to the airport was a breeze as the road was dry.This is a must visit for Nepal, make sure you pick the correct season however, we were lucky as no rain.The lodge is fairly new so every thing was in great shape! Staff are top notch!

We absolutely love everything about this Hotel. Easy, fast and friendly the whole place is spotlessly clean and it has a very modern chic look. Our room was perfect, it contain all you need Breakfast offers all you need to start your need to start your day and be ready to explore the city. All staff are very friendly and Reception is occupied 24H. The location of the Hotel is perfect.We will return for Sure!

Pork and chicken was really good but need to work on pizza it was average 🫶 The view is really nice and place is really hygienic. The approach from the waiter is really nice 😊 Overall me and my friends love the food place and service altogether ❤️

Was awesome fabulous in so many respects! Where to start?How about the the “rooms,” which weren’t really rooms at all but spacious hand sculpted deluxe dome cabins featuring recessed accent lights,  throughly modern bathrooms with a spacious , a viewing porch overlooking the river, super comfortable bed, reasonable dependable electricity and a backup generator that dutifully clicked on in occasional grid interruptions.The staff and service were over the moon accommodating knowledgeable courteous.  From top quality delicious full course meals and scrumptious deserts in the dinning room to guided jungle jeep tours  and wildlife viewing floats down the river to torchlit indigenous folk dance performances and cocktails every night on the spacious subtropical grounds… a great, luxuriant experience!Wildlife everywhere! Rhinos along the river and in the jungle. Deer. Monkeys. And reports of a tiger sighting a couple hours before in the same spot where we enjoyed our full service picnic! Abundant bird species - songbirds, stunningly colored and wild peacocks all over.Cannot speak more highly of this amazing property, staff, service and experience!

As a travel company owner, I've experienced Barahi stay and safari with my clients for a second time in May 2024 (our first time was in March 2023). And both of these experiences were just excellent. Barahi truly deserve their 5*. Fantastic hotel (rooms, facilities, everything really), perfect, super professional service and stunning nature and wildlife just in front of the hotel is really making this place very special. And we can't wait to stay in Barahi again. Thank you Barahi!

We came here for 3 nights in May on our first visit to Nepal and after trekking in Annapurna. It is such a beautiful and calm oasis - a fabulous place to enjoy all Chitwan has to offer.The hospitality and service were second to none. The staff were all attentive, friendly, always smiling and seemed to anticipate every need - we felt very well looked after, with Nepali hospitality that felt genuine and welcoming. We also loved the commitment to the environment, sustainability and the local area, so important.We had booked a package with 5 activities and our guide Rajesh was superb- very knowledgeable and went the extra mile to ensure we enjoyed all the activities.  It felt like being out with a very knowledgeable friend. We had a sundowner boat trip, a walking safari, 2 jeep safaris and a village tour, which we chose to do on bicycles - a great way of seeing village life and meeting locals. We saw so much wildlife and birds and the scenery in the park is spectacular. We were blown away. Huge thanks to Rajesh and the other guides and driver, Govinder, who made the activities so special and memorable.The food was excellent and plentiful and we enjoyed a variety of dishes. The candlelit "bush dinner" on our first night was very special. Sadly we didn't make it to the spa - too much else to do! Would highly recommend Barahi and hope to make it back one day.

A true jungle lodge with an experience that will leave you awestruck with every moment of your stay. Credit goes to the Barahians(staff I would like to call as), who puts their warm hearty service with hours of hardwork with smile and selfless dedication, to give a great experience to all the Guests staying at the Camp. At check-in we met the Operations Manager-Subhas and his colleague Pooja, who explained us the Camp facilities and services and managed to get a early check-in on a busy Holi(festival of colours) weekend.  From there on every step of our stay was well curated by teams in various departments.Our dining experiences were well planned by F&B Manager-Tej and  superbly executed by well trained team including Ram Kumar, Sanjana, Sima and many more. Every evening was a special private  dinner with emphasis on Privacy and Food of our choice. First dinner was in secluded area surrounding  just trees and oil lit lanterns. Second dinner was by the River side on full moon night and lanterns. Food and service were exceptionally good and we were immensely pampered. Our Naturalist, Rajesh is an excellent host took us on River Boat ride on first day and Jungle Jeep Safari on the second day, giving us insights of Jungle. His in-depth knowledge of birds, trees and mammals(Elephant, Rhino, Variery of deer) gave us a thorough educational tour and with his awareness of Jungle, we happened to sight 22 Rhinos(Male/Female/Baby), 4 types of Deer(Spotted/Hug/Barking/Sambal), many variety of migratory birds and a Sloth bear. Spa in this oasis is an added attraction and our therapist Sujata was very good with her pressure points and technique. We are Ned’s up taking 4 treatments.Camp is highly recommended for relaxation, rejuvenation and rebounding with friends and families. I thank each one of the member for making us feel special and we take back loads of memories back with us into our busy lives.

I have visited Barahi jungle Lodge with my friend`s group. It is really fantastic Resort with best location, huge area, well management, very co-operative staff & best food.I had feel that i was inside the jungle with 100% safe. I have seen almost room of the resort. All rooms are super & with balcony also.Definitely, i will visit again with my family.Thanks All Barahi management team.

What a special place! My husband - a keen bird watcher - & I had 3 wonderful nights here from Tues 20th Feb to Fri 23rd 2024. We had looked carefully for a lodge with a riverside setting, attractive accommodation, a pool & the option of guided bird watching as well as boat trips & game drives. There was no contest, having read some concerning reviews of a few other places. We were delighted with the whole Bahari experience. Having been lucky enough to do a lot of east & southeast African safari trips we are quite fussy, & the Jungle Lodge was exceptional. Staff were delightful, welcoming, helpful & attentive, as we found at Bahari's Sarangkot Mountain Lodge a few days later. The welcome & briefing - with a freshing drink & hot towels - set the scene well. We were introduced to our nature guide Jitu, who was excellent throughout our stay. Having worked out that he had a keen birder to guide - & that for us any wildlife is a bonus - he was happy to adapt our programme to seek maximal birds in different habitats & at varied times or day. We had a pre-arranged package which included 5 activities. This proves much better value than booking B&B & adding activities individually. Ask in advance so a package to suit can be planned. We had a boat trip with sundowner drink & hot BBQ snacks, a half day jeep safari with bush breakfast, a walking safari, a village tour & one repeat of jeep or boat. When Jitu realised we were keen for birds he suggested we drop the village tour & we wer lucky to end up with 2 half day jeep safaris, & 2 boat trips - one evening, one morning for each. We saw more that way - rhino (great views, close) about 5 times, plenty of langur monkeys & macaques, spotted & hog deer (many spotted), wild boar & even jungle cat (rarer then tiger -  real bonus.) Bird species totalled about 120.I think many tourists come without binoculars, & aim - expect, even- to see the hard-to-spot big animals eg tiger. Forget that! Rarities are rare! You should see rhino - they are the Chitwan highlight - but don't expect a zoo. Enjoy the setting, relish the changing light & sunset, & ensure you take binoculars! You will miss so much without them. The hotel itself needs praise. Beautiful, rustic rooms with a small balcony, spacious shower room with bath, huge comfortable bed, an easy chair. Lovely colours & quirky decorative touches too. Food - they seriously feed you here! We had a full board packaged & nearly burst, on delicious breakfast pastries/fruit/cooked, fresh Nepali or Chinese or Continental lunches, & varied evening meals too. All delicious Cocktails were worth enjoying & less pricey than other alcohol apart from loc beers.The spa was lush!! I had a fantastic full body massage - be aware that this means attention to areas not usually covered (with consent) in a western style massage. Unexpected but was floating by the end!Pool - cool but enjoyable in Feb vet early in the tourist season after winter) for a 10-15 min daily dip. The adult end is nearer the bar, while the ankle-deep children's end is the other end. It looks bigger than it is for swimming but makes a beautiful area around which tables are set discretely for dining.The evening cultural dancing show (two variations) was fun with a drink & was well done.The highlight for me at Chitwan Jungle Lodge was crossing the river each time we went for a game walk or jeep drive. Those few minutes being punted across to the Lodge's jeeps was magical every time. In summary, a gorgeous place. Higher end prices but the package - pre arranged by email - was good value. The quality of the setting, food etc made it all excellent. Come!

This experience was unforgettable. The staff was super accomodating and went above and beyond for us, Rajesh, Our Guide, helped us coordinate a surprise party and have an unforgettable jungle experience! We saw so many animals and when we come back, we hope to see a tiger!!! Many thanks to him and Barahi!!!

Hotel first class both facilities and the people - every single member of staff (all levels) went out of their way to make my experience the best it could possibly be. Food amazing / delicious. Every night I was taken to a different part of the complex for a special dining experience. The safari experience was exceptional ( boat, walking, jeep) guides were so knowledgeable and helpful. The Barahi approach is let's wait in key areas and see what turns up - so no trillion jeeps chasing one solitary animal - this approach reaped dividends - I saw 20+ rhino's, Wild boars, deer, monkeys,  crocodiles, umpteen different bird species - was up close to a tiger prey kill  and also a sloth bear. So sad to leave am sure I left a little bit of my soul in Chiwan/Barahi Lidge - would highly recommend

Everything was purrfection from arrival to departure. Beautiful bungalows, warm welcome, wonderful, kind staff and the best guide and driver ( Govinda and Pushpa )Lovely dining, menu options, great breakfast buffet. Truly a magical place! Many activities to choose from of course jungle safaris are the best on the lookout daily for animals ( we were quite lucky to actually see a tiger but too quick for a picture, many birds, deer, sloth bear, monkeys and rhinos. No elephant this time. Do at least one full day to experience a lunch in the wild. Sunrise/sunset breakfast/dinner river boat ride amazing! Don't forget to visit the spa for some after bumpy jeep ride relaxation and enjoy an evening with local dancers from nearby villages.

Its wonderful experience at Barahi Jungle lodge..!! The unmatched hospitality by the Resort..!! The whole staf take cares of all your small needs and your taste and accordingly provide their service,which is exceptional and unmatched..! A must do experince in lifetime to feel the luxury and hospitality of chitwan.!!l The staff is always wear a smile and ready to help you in everything and even when we checkout from resort they all are present to see off us with the huge smile and happiness.!!! The big salute to the staff for service.!

The experience at Barahi Jungle Lodge is nothing short of spectacular. There is so much attention to detail - we travelled as a wider family with a 3 and a half year old and there was absolutely nothing we needed that was not provided for us (and then some). The jungle safaris and boat rides provided us with once in a lifetime opportunities to see wildlife (some of it very rare), including multiple sightings of greater one horned rhinos (bathing in the river, a mother and child, grazing in the deep jungle), as well as five sightings of the ultra rare gharial crocodile. The lodge organised lamp lit dinners on the banks of the Rapti river at sunset, at sunrise, and in the jungle (all whilst managing to discourage the mosquitoes!). Also to note the effort the lodge goes to including the community around in the staff they hire and train, and the food they source.It was amazing, and we’d love to come back, after all, we still have tigers and sloth bears to find!

Firstly I’m sooo glad I picked this resort to stay! BARAHI is something else altogether. It felt like home and staff is my extended family. They take care of you from the start of your trip till you end your trip. They cater to all your needs. Quite literally. We tried all the services they had to offer, from safaris (boat and jeep) spa, activities and special dinner. Everything was wonderful! Top notch service. 1) the highlight of this resort has to be staff. Extremely polite, always smiling and helpful. The staff at the restaurant, front office, house keeping - everyone were extremely skilled and quick.       Special mentions to my absolute favourite staffs - Alina and Krishna they are a vibe and they are awesome.Special thanks to the manager - Mr.Prakash. To lead a team like that and run a resort so successfully is quite charming. I noticed he takes care of every guests like his own, he would constantly go talk to them and instantly gets whatever demands of theirs up and about. He was extremely kind and super fun with us! Loved him!2) the amenities and spa are simply wonderful. Everything is great! 3) the rooms were super clean and nice. House keeping did a great job. We didn’t even had to ask for water, they’d come and fill it and constantly kept our rooms clean and fresh. 4) however the WiFi and hot water in the bathroom were average. I assume it was just a one time thing because everything else was exceptional. Can’t wait to come back.💖

Pick-up from Bharatpur Airport was on time, no hassle.Gopinda introduced himself as our guide over the next couple of days.We were planning to do the half day Jeep Safari the following day but Gopinda said we should do the safari that afternoon as the weather forecast for the following day was not too good. So, off on the safari we went.Weather was cool & fairly sunny. Pretty soon after we crossed the river on a small boat & jumped into the jeep we spotted a mother & baby Rhino in the distance.The safari lasted over 4 hours (half day safari option), didn't manage to see any of the wild elephants, Tigers or Leopard. We saw plenty of other wildlife though...Domestic Elephants, Wild Boar, Sloth Bear (briefly) Deer & then more Rhino's. Our Guide Gopinda who organised the safari is very knowledgeable about the Chitwan National ParkWe had an early evening meal at the hotel which was also very tasty, followed by one of the cultural shows, great entertainment.The room we had was very comfy, love the eco friendly approach.Next morning was as Gopinda said, weather was cool & raining, not much but enough for us just to chill out by the pool.Afternoon was clear enough for a river safari, small boat again, cruised down the river, more wildlife spotted.At the end of the cruise on the bank of the river there was a BBQ & drinks set-up. Food again was very tasty, chicken, fish, bbq pineapple.Check-out the following morning was a drama, as the Monsoon rains started!!!Luckily before midday, Gopinda found out that Bharatpur Airport which had been closed all morning had reopened. We were able to catch our flight back to Kathmandu thanks to Gopinda again...he sorted out our boarding passes in the mayhem of cancelled & delayed flights!

This is an absolutely perfect place to stay when visiting Chitwan National Park! All of the staff at the hotel are outstanding and made us feel so welcome. The grounds are beautiful, with so many different kinds of trees and flowers - it was like staying in a botanic garden. The rooms are lovely and spotlessly clean. We really enjoyed the view from the balcony. We did an early morning jeep safari, which included a wonderful breakfast along the  river, and an evening safari. We saw so many different types of animals, a highlight being the many rhinos. Our guide was excellent and very knowledgeable about the animals within the park. Definitely a once in a lifetime experience. The food at the hotel was delicious. And we also really enjoyed the cultural shows each evening. Overall our only regret is that we couldn’t have stayed longer!

When we arrived, we were greeted by Krishna, given a welcome drink, and nicely crafted grass used for worship resembling that we will be treated like Gods and Goddesses and that was true, we felt so special. It is an ecological resort. I enjoyed observing each and every piece of furniture, which was chosen, designed and placed perfectly. We would go outside leaving the power off, yet when we come back, the room was always cool because of the building material. The staff were super friendly, the food was super delicious and the evening shows were super entertaining. We took a jeep safari trip to the national park, it was unforgettable, we were also lucky to spot a tiger very close by as well as other animals. The guide Sager was very professional and provided useful information as well as the driver Sunil who was brave and friendly. Staying at the hotel was a joy by itself, having breakfast while observing an elephant and afternoon tea while watching a crocodile in the lake, being visited by a jackal on my balcony., surrounded by birds and butterflies, the whole thing was exceptional. We took the bicycle around the area and it was the best bike ride I have ever had between villages and scenic farms. Above all that, we had a surprise dinner in an unforgettable setting, it was like a sky full of stars, and everything was just perfect. I sincerely thank each staff for such a lifetime experience.

What a wonderful stay! The accommodations were lovely and there is a beautiful pool to rest at between safaris. The buffet was ok, but the real food hightlights for us were the snacks after the evening river safari, breakfast during the morning safari and the bush dinner with local style food. The safaris are what make this place even better. Sagar, our guide, and Govinda, our driver, were really great and made sure we saw as much as possible during our game drives in the park. We were very close to rhinos and a wild elephant, saw sloth bears, wild buffalo, several types of deer, Rhesus monkeys, langur monkeys, wild boar, crocodiles, mongoose, jackals, and numerous beautiful birds! We did a morning and evening jungle safari as well as as an evening river safari. I cannot recommend this place enough if you are going to Chitwan National Park.

The lodge was truly amazing- superb location- wonderful staff- and the safari was really something very special - we saw rhinos ! Thanks again for having us and looking after our entire group- we will be back next year with more friends thanks again

I am just finishing a two day visit to this lodge. I couldn’t have asked for a more comfortable and pampered experience. All the staff are very accommodating and appear to be genuinely interested in your happiness and well-being. But the main staff member that was assigned to me was Rajesh and he did an absolutely spectacular job. On my first day, I didn’t arrive until the afternoon, and so my first outing was on the boat. There was another family of four with us in the boat, but they seemed to be much more interested in each other, and taking photos/videos - nonstop – and completely ignored anything that Rajesh was trying to tell them about the environment. Selfishly, this worked for me because I ended up getting what amounted  to a private experience. Each night that I was at the lodge, they had what they called a cultural experience where members of local ethnic communities come and perform their dances. The next morning started at 7 AM with a Jungle Walk. Sudixcha (sp? ) joined us for this walk and while Rajesh was the main “man” describing what I was seeing,Sudixcha - as well as being very easy on the eyes – was very knowledgeable, and added to the whole walk. While I was very happy to have her along, I gather it is lodge policy that there is always two guides on these jungle walks to“ protect“ the client from the animals. – should that be necessary. That afternoon it was just Rajesh and myself on a jungle jeep tour. But the driver of the jeep adds immensely to the experience, as he seems to be able to spot animals first. Unfortunately, we didn’t see any tigers, but we did see lots of rhinos, deer, peacocks, monkeys, wild chickens, etc., not to mention a couple of elephants.   And words fail me when it comes to describing the spectacular settings that the staff put together for the evening meals. You have to experience them to believe them. And I am pretty sure that you will really, really like the“ rooms”. In my opinion, they are quite unique - in a totally positive way.   I highly recommend a stay at this lodge. And, if you can get Rajesh as your guide, you can’t go wrong.

Had an amazing experience.... Hospitality is too good....I strongly recommend my friends ....food is authentic ...staffs are well trained.....jeep safari, boat safari sunset view memorable....if ur planning Chitwan Barahi is the best place

It’s the best place with good hospitality,food and trees. If you are going there, don’t hesitate, go for it. Bed and bathroom is cute❤️  Swimming pool is cool.Jeep Safari,sundowner and the cultural dances were also cool.  I bet you won’t regret going Barahi Jungle lodge. We will visit again. Thank you for the lifetime experience.

WOW, excellent everything from start to finish.  I couldn't have chosen a better place to celebrate my honeymoon!  They took care that every detail was perfect and magical, the whole team is extremely friendly and helpful.  we did 2 incredible safaris with Saagar a very professional guide, he helped us a lot in everything.  They even helped us on our return to kathmandu and still outside the hotel they continued to take care of every detail woow. I will remember this stay with much love and as the best place I have ever stayed.  We will surely return to celebrate an anniversary!!The food, the attention, the facilities, the ethics.  everything is perfect in this place.Ps. For us, the most important point to choose this place was the congruence and ecological responsibility with which they are managed by not collaborating with animal exploitation.  because they do not offer any service with elephants, this is very important and the best differentiator.

All around cool place. Picture walking to your hut while a jackel crosses your path!!! A “five star” jungle experience!!!The staff just can’t do enough for you. I think we had someone assigned to watch over our every need. Wish I would have wrote down his name because he was wonderful. They take their guests on jungle tours to include cocktails or breakfast in the jungle. We saw dozens of rhinos, deer & crocodiles. Unfortunately we were there during monsoon season so we were unable to get to the side of the jungle where tigers can be spotted.Though you’ll want to spend all of your time in the jungle, save a day for relaxation. The pool is huge & beautiful!!! Meals are served in the main dining room. Most days there was a buffet but they’ll make you anything you want. Can’t say enough about the restaurant staff. We met the manager while we were there & he wanted to know how we enjoyed the food. He said that they received poor reviews. Well, there wasn’t one thing we didn’t like!!! Our hors d’ourves in the jungle were plain but wonderful. We were in the jungle!!! Breakfast was great. Lunch & dinner were a “10”! Their buffets had tons of salads, soups, dishes & desserts to choose from. I think we sampled 90% of everything & maybe didn’t like one or two items.Rooms are in private stucco huts scattered around the property. Rooms far away from the main area are not for the faint of heart. It’s dark & spooky at night & there are animals that roam. However, all the walkways have some lighting & all rooms come with a flashlight. The grounds are immaculate & amazing.

Please tell us this open and all activity open here  between 10-17 june please tell me urgent .. we are planning to come there but how will be weather thr and is rain moderate or heavy in June please tell me ..

The lodge boosts local Tharu influenced architecture with a very cozy, homely atmosphere. It is a wonderful eco-guided place on the majestic Rapti river. We opted for the jungle safari package and which was worth every paisa. We saw sloth bears, rhinos, wild boar and chicken, zillions of deer, monkeys and birds. The leisurly sunset boat ride down to the confluence of another river was crowned with "snacks" (read grilled fish, chicken, momos, popocorn etc.) and chilled wine.There is an abundance of activities for families (bee farming, bike rides, village walks) and the spa is one of the best in Nepal. The entire lodge has a very comforting and suprising sense to fine detail in the layouts of the rooms and of the common areas.Cleanliness is outstanding but the real hit in this lodge is the extraordinary sense of service. The staff, mainly local recruits, are superbly trained, kind, attentive and ... always smiling. I noticed that everyone was wearing their masks without fault nor exception and a board describes the daily body temperature of every single person working on the premise.Oh yes, the food! A rich variety of dishes and fares (European, Chinese, Indian, Italian) with 100 % local produce and always 4 courses. Simply D-E-L-I-S-H 👌💥.Special thanks and appreciation to the awsome GM Prakash Chand who went out his way to accommodate, advise and make our stay memorable.An absolutely wonderful stay ✨🙏#chitwan #ecolodge #fivestarservice #visitnepal

I have stayed in different resorts in different countries but none of them comes closer to the hospitality this place offers you.In my three days of stay here every person, I encountered here treated us with such warmth and friendliness that it didn't feel like that we are in an unknown place.The check-in process was super smooth and informational. It was followed by the property tour, the itinerary, diet information, etc. All super professional yet informal.The room and the view are the best you can expect. It is located on the banks of Rapti. You get the view of the river from your room. The room decor and design are rustic. You will get the feel of a hut without missing any of the modern amenities.The food is great. They have 4-5 different cuisine options, each one having a good amount of spread. We tried the Nepalj Thali most of the time and it was mind-blowing every time.Experiences are what is the main selling point I feel for this resort. From the moment you step your foot on the property to the moment you exit, every activity is so meticulously planned. You do a lot of things here without getting bored or tired at all -  Jeep Safari, Nature Walk, Boat Ride.We stayed here for 2 nights and it was worth every minute.Thank you everyone on the team for making this stay a wonderful one.

The management really helped make our stay very comfortable and enjoyable despite the Dashain rush. I was on a very restrictive diet during my stay and they did their best to make sure I have ample options. Surprisingly, the buffet itself was quite elaborate that I didn't need to trouble them much. My father in law is generally quite fussy about food but he loved every meal. The jungle package is very inclusive and the all day tea-coffee counter is a great touch. Loved my stay overall! Thank you.

We visited Barahi Jungle Lodge in October and our stay was truly outstanding with excellent service you could ever ask for. Staff’s were extremely friendly and welcoming. Personalized service is something that delighted us the most. We stayed two nights with full of activities from safari to boat ride with sunset cruise. Our guide Rajiv was excellent and possess amazing knowledge to explain us wildlife and nature. He was accompanying us throughout stay and paid attention to details. Kudos to him. We were blessed enough to receive a surprise personalized dinner. Truly amazing. General Manager and other managers were greeting us all the time comforted us though-out our stay. Special thank goes to General Manager, Activity Manager and F&B Manager.  F&B team was excellent and polite. Female F&B staff who served us was excellent. Unfortunately we couldn’t remember her name. Overall stay was excellent.

My family & I stayed here for three nights and wow is this place luxurious...and for really good value too! We went on two jeep safaris (encountering rhinos within 8 meters from us!), a walking safari (informative & thrilling) and a boat safari (with a beautiful sunset & sundowners). We loved our personal naturist who coordinated all of our activities, informing us of all the flora & fauna and kept us in good humor. In between the activities we caught some sun by the pool, played badminton and treated ourselves to treatments in the spa. The rooms had everything you could need, with super soft beds and detailed decor. The food was delicious and the kitchen team prepared such a variety of food, accommodating to our dietary requirements (a vegan, a pescarterian, a vegetarian and two meat eaters). The service at Bahari Jungle Lodge is brilliant and we couldn’t ask for anything more :) /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////Mi familia y yo nos alojamos aquí por tres noches y ¡este lugar es lujoso... y por una muy buena relación calidad-precio también! Fuimos en dos safaris en jeep (¡encontrábamos rinocerontes a 8 metros de nosotros!), un safari a pie (informativo y emocionante) y un safari en barco (con una hermosa puesta de sol). Nos encantó nuestro naturista personal que coordinó todas nuestras actividades, nos informó de toda la flora y fauna y nos mantuvo en buen humor. Entre las actividades, tomamos el sol en la piscina, jugamos al bádminton y nos tratamos con tratamientos en el spa. Las habitaciones tenían todo lo que puedas necesitar, con camas súper suaves y una decoración detallada. La comida era deliciosa y el equipo de la cocina preparó una variedad de comida, que se ajustaba a nuestras necesidades dietéticas (una vegana, una pescarteriana, un vegetariano y dos comedores de carne). El servicio en Bahari Jungle Lodge es genial y no podríamos pedir nada más :)

I can't really add anything to what has already been said about the comfort of the lodge and the dedication of the staff. It is an excellent place to stay: we booked 4 nights and ended up staying for 6.With regards to wildlife, it is worth noting that there are very few lodges in this part of Chitwan so, when you go into the park itself (a short journey over the river), you meet very few vehicles and visitors.The lodge assigns you your own naturalist guide who is with you on all the trips and there is a talk about the park on alternate evenings. Our guide, Rajib, was very knowledgeable and enthusiastic, with regards to both animals and birds.We booked on a bed and breakfast basis so we could choose the exact activities we wanted to do. Some of the choices include: a half or whole day in Chitwan National Park either on foot or by jeep;  a morning or evening boat trip on the river; an elephant ride in the community forest (the elephants belong to the local community);  a visit to the local village.  One afternoon, we just borrowed bicycles and cycled round the local villages.A great stay!

I even dont know where to start from. It place itself, the staffs, activities, service or what not. The staffs are extremely supportive and makes you feel at home and makes.sure the job is done. The naturalists knows what they are doing and always listening. Special thanks to tej ji and sagar. I can definately say this has been my best holiday trip inside Nepal.

Thank you Bahari Jungle Lodge, management staff and out guide Govinda Thanait... (the man with the golden smile). we were greeted warmly at the reception, were welcomed to our lovely room and shown beautiful countryside. we were privileged to see the endangered one horned rhino and juvenile (atop an elephant and from very comfortable jeeps). we were not hurried on any trips and we felt the guides and other staff were only happy if we were having a great time. i would highly recommend this resort. Thank you guys

We had three very enjoyable and action packed days at Barahi and much enjoyed being pampered by the staff. All the things that should be good were very good - particularly the rooms and the bathrooms. Food was excellent and the whole Lodge runs very much like clockwork, with the added advantage that the numerous staff are very charming and helpful. Our half day elephant safari was surely one of the highlights, enabling us to get in very close proximity to various rhinos. In addition, we thoroughly enjoyed our “elephant shower” - you’ve got to do that yourself to discover what it entails - but highly recommended. The pool was equally a hit and we took advantage of it several times.  Even though the Lodge is perfectly situated right on the bank of river Rapti, affording great game spotting opportunities, we never had any problems with mosquitos.

If you are visiting Chitwan National park you must stay here! Beautiful setting right on the river. From our balcony we watched crocodiles basking in the sun and 2 deer passed right by our room! Our early morning boat ride in the fog was magical and we had close encounters on our jeep safaris! The food and accommodation were superb. Can't fault it.

My wife and I just returned from a wonderful trip to Nepal.  The first part was the most physically challenging thing I've ever done - trekking in the Himalayas.  The second was relaxing and sight-seeing at this delightful resort on the outskirts of Chitwan National Park. We did a jeep safari, a boat safari and a village walk and still had time for poolside relaxation.  Our guide for the safaris and walk was Hari, a naturalist who has lived in the area his entire life.  Hari was knowledgeable and dedicated and made sure we left with a lot more knowledge that when we arrived.  He was most attentive to our needs and made the stay terrific.

From the minute we arrived at Barahi Jungle Lodge (after being picked up from the airport in a wonderfully air conditioned 4x4), we were treated exceptionally well. All the management staff welcomed us, gave us special grass as a gift for our recent wedding (it was our honeymoon) and gave us a welcome talk to tell us all about the lodge and the national park. You are also allocated a naturalist for your entire stay, whose job it is to make sure you have everything you need and gets you booked onto and escorts you on any excursions you book.The room was delightful. Very comfortable, clean and serenely decorated. Lovely views from the balcony over the river. The bathroom was also beautiful.The food at the restaurant was very good quality with a great selection of drinks and cocktails. The pool area was also lovely.Jitu, our naturalist, was great. He led our private boat safari where we saw a rhino in the river and crocodiles. As well as a very unexpected but welcome BBQ and drinks on the bank of the river. He also led our jeep safari the next day where we saw more rhinos, monkeys, birds and deer.A thoroughly enjoyable and unforgettable stay. We can't recommend Barahi enough!

What a fabulous place in the middle of nowhere!Everything either meets your highest expectations or exceeds them. The staff are superb. Nothing is too much trouble and you feel the staff really care about their guestsOn arrival we were introduced to our personal naturalist, Garvinda. He was knowledgeable, personable and genuinely great to be with. He accompanied us on an elephant ride, a boat safari and a jeep safari and looked after our every need . Had we wished to we could also have gone for a village walk and a second boat and jeep safari and there was a dance presentation by local villagersOur suite (number 35) was beautifully appointed with comfortable furnishings and a lovely private pool and terrace. The huge bed gave us three perfect nights sleep.The food, which was included in our package was excellent quality and in plentiful supply. The head waiter, Tej, was always there to ensure that we were happy and to change anything with which we were not entirely happy ( few and far between) Drinks were expensive but in this environment that is only to be expected,Our breakfast waitress, Sarmila, has the most infectious smile, guaranteed to put you in a good mood for the dayWe thoroughly enjoyed our stay and recommend Barahi Jungle Lodge without hesitation

Wow what can I say! The service of staff was world class. They are always greet you with a huge smile and rooms are continually cleaned. Buffet dinners were delicious with a good range of food. Great view of river and across to national park. Even spotted crocodiles on the river bank.

This is a lovely place. It’s focus is the wildlife of the Chitwan Park, and we were allocated our personal naturalist on arrival. Anu was superb. Every time we arrived at reception she would materialise; she made sure that we made full use of the opportunities for activities that this place offers. Which are very numerous. I particularly enjoyed our jungle walk, and the evening visit to a local village house, where we were feted with rice wine, and offered local food. The accommodation is as you would expect for a jungle lodge, and very comfortable. Food is freshly prepared and tasty. Highly recommended!

Barahi is an amazing oasis in the jungle.  From the moment I arrived the team were welcoming and helpful.  Jitu was my main contact, and he was very knowledgeable and created a memorable trip.  Seeing wild rhinos was a highlight.  The early morning canoe trip is a must.  Thank you for creating an amazing resort

Its simply amazing!!Reaching there is slightly a concern, however once you are there, you are in different world. Varun - GM makes sure that every single detail is well taken care of. Jungle theme, pool, next to Rapti location, good guides, boat safari, elephant safari and best amongst all is Elephant bathing. Food - Limited options but whatever they do is goodHighly recommended!!

I have nothing new to say but just repeat what has been said in almost all of the reviews. An extraordinary place which has been built so consciously to support not only the ecosystem but empowers the locals at the same time, without compromising on anything. Luxury without guilt. I spent almost a week there with my four year old and we had never felt so connected with not just nature but with ourselves too. it was love at first sight. The interiors are breathtaking and everything is so simple yet exotic. I appreciate that they use no plastic and have a proper waste management system as well coz these factors are game changer for me. Jungle safari, boat ride, village tour everything adds a different flavour to your soul. I am glad that my little one could see animals in their natural habitat, free and happy and not in zoos in captivity. We got to see a Leopard too up and close and it was breathtaking, literally. This could only happen because of the sharp skills of our Naturalist Anuja as she recognised the signals of deers and alerted us that something majestic is around. And how can I not mention the elephants, beautiful souls full of life and love. Tulsi and rani stole my daughters heart and she still misses them. Staff is super helpful and kind. Food is healthy and delicious. They have a common area with lots of games for children that kept my little one busy and happy. I can like write a book about the charm this place and it wont be enough. I will be visiting very soon though, if that matters.

The beautiful concept and then the helpful/charming/smiling people. Loved every bit of the stay and hope that get a chance to visit the place with our group again.Nature at its best but only if there could be activities for our tiny ones so that they could play by themselves.

There are no words to describe the beauty of this place and the quality of this resort. But beyond this beauty that leaves you speechless, there is the incredible friendliness of the director Mr Varun and all his team, who, upon your arrival, welcomes you as a member of the Barahi family. Everything is done to make you feel at home, the attentions of every moment, surprises, gifts, all with a lot of generosity. We arrived by helicopter from Kathmandu and departed by road by jeep. It was our privilege to be upgraded to a deluxe villa and an outdoor birthday dinner was offered. The resort is ideally located at the confluence of the Rapti and Narayani rivers, we saw an incredible amount of animals of all kinds during jeep, boat and elephant safaris. Thank you 1,000 times to Mr Varun and his team, you are the magicians of this place, without you, none of this would be possible. A big thank you also to Anu, our naturalist who accompanied us with a smile during these 3 dreamy days.

We stayed at this lodge for three days in April, and had a wonderful time.The lodges were extremely comfortable, and all the staff so friendly and helpful.We were there with our 14 year old, and our 9 year old  - it was really exciting for us all to go on the various safaris and to meet the elephants. We even saw a tiger!!Our whole stay at this lodge was a big highlight of our trip to Nepal,  and we would thoroughly recommend it.

This is a superb place to stay within the Chitwan National Park.  From the moment you arrive in this oasis, you are treated as something special.  There are daily activities to suit all needs from safari drives to boat rides nd nature walks.  The rooms are well appointed and the staff are fantastic.  The pool is great.  Well worth staying and highly recommended.

thank you so much barahi jungle lodge for such a wonderful experience. I just can't express how much I am in love with this place. hats off for food, service, cleanliness and the amazing jungle tour. highly recommended destination. definitely coming back to stay more days.

We stayed at Barahi Lodge for 3 nights and it was superb. It is situated across the East Rapti river from Chitwan National Park.On arrival we were greeted by the manager and introduced to Karan, a local Naturalist and guide who would accompany us on all our trip to find and see the wildlife in the park.The rooms are each individual pods on a raised base that allows wonderful views of the sunrise over the jungle. The rooms are superbly finished and innovatively decorated. There are a number of ways to explore the national park, referred to at the lodge as Safaris. The four safaris we tried were :-A 2 hour boat ride down the river - a small punt with our guide and a boatman A half day walking safari in the jungle with our guide and another member of staffA half day driving safari with a driver and our guideA 2 hour safari on elephants with our guide and the elephant handlerWe took the boat safari twice, once in the evening & once in the early morning. on both occasions we arrived at the end of the trip to find a mobile kitchen set up to supply time appropriate food & drinks (breakfast and sundowner drinks & snacks).We saw Rhino on every safari we did and also saw Wild Elephant, Deer, Monkeys, Buffalo, Hogs, many breeds of bird, Jackal, one Snake & one Tortoise as well as signs of Bears & Tigers.Food was excellent and attention to detail in customer care was exceptional.If ever I visit Nepal again I will include Barahi Lodge in the trip.

Our journey in Nepal started in Chitwan to explore wildlife in the natural reserve. The Barahi Jungle Lodge offered us a wonderful mix of ecologically friendly and comfortable hospitality. The staff in the Lodge was competent in all domains: strong customer orientation (always there to serve and help but not overly pushy), clean and up to date accomodation and very knowledgable about the fauna and flora in the area. Especially the 'naturalists' were very good in their job as hosts for people who wanted to learn more about this magnificent area. We never felt trapped as tourists, rather welcomed by friendly, warm and competent people. The 'safaris' organised by the lodge felt the same way: not overly touristic but great balance of adventure, comfort and exploration. I would definitely consider going back there.

My husband and I recently stayed at Barahi Jungle Lodge and we had the most amazing experience. This was my second time staying at Barahi and both times I came away glad to have chosen this place for our stay. The staff are most welcoming and extremely courteous and friendly. They assign you a naturalist who accompanies you on your activities. The naturalists are very knowledgeable about the wild life in Chitwan National Park.  The jungle safari, the boat ride on the river Rapti ending in a sunset BBQ were all awesome experiences that we will treasure. The food is amazing. As returning guests we were even treated to a surprise candle-lit bush dinner which was awesome . Fantastic experience overall and highly recommended.

We spent 3 nights at Bihar jungle lodge and luxuriated and relaxed with wonderful Guided boat safari and alfresco breakfast/ evening canapes and drinks by the river. Jeep safari, elephant safari and showering with the elephants in the river.  Wonderful naturalist guide and lovely swims in the pool.  Can't recommend highly enough.

We had the immense pleasure to stay at the Barahi Jungle Lodge for 4 days and I wished I never have to leave. When you arrive, the welcome ceremony is heartwarming and the rooms are very comfortable and clean. Also the food is delicious! You have a choice between Nepalese, Continental, Chinese or Indian for every course and also the service is very friendly. For activities we did an elephant safari, boat safari, jeep safari, jungle dinner, scenic sundown dinner, biking through the local village, jungle walk and elephant feeding/bathing. All were organized very well 👍🏼 In the lodge there is also a beautiful and large swimming pool, a spa, laundry service, good wifi and a nice library. In a nutshell, this lodge is a beautiful and luxurious paradise!!!

I've been around and have a become one of those 'been there, done that' people.  This place is special because they have achieved excellence that transcends uni-dimensional KPIs such as luxury, customer service, food, etc. into a holistic experience which simply puts you at another level of ease and tranquility.  It could only have borne out of a vision backed by a deep insight into what it is that ultimately makes a guest happy, in a deeper way...beyond the welcome drinks, smiling staff at your beck and call, and fancy food and drinks. Stay there and you will know what I mean.

We stayed at the Barahi Jungle lodge for three days. We were welcomed as royals and everything was extremly professional.
