An impeccable welcome! Rooms in style and attentive staff.Mount Everest presents itself to you in all its majesty!You will not regret every piece of your money.Do not hesitate !

I posted a review late and the date I visited was not an option, so I listed it as 2022, but I actually visited in 2017. For me, it was the best hotel. First of all, the view was great. And the food was delicious. There was a warm shower and room, and the staff were all hospitable, kind, and comfortable. My visit here is a memory I will cherish forever, and I often talk about it with the friends I went with. It was hard to climb up to this hotel, but it was a quick helicopter ride back. It takes quite a while to get to this hotel, so it's not easy to get there, but I would like to go again.

Fishtail lodge is the most breathtaking getaway, but the staff is where the true beauty lies.  I have traveled the world and experiences great locations but this location has given me memories for a lifetime.  Working in hospitality for 20 years I have never had such genuine service… Prakash initiated our first dining experience and it was so remarkable we never left the resort to go anywhere else!  At dinner time he arranged us a special table with candle and gorgeous view, I felt so VIP. I’ve spent my career creating experiences for other people and rarely get to experience it on my behalf!  The chef even came to visit our table to check in on our meal, I’m glad I had the opportunity to give him compliments because the quality of food was the best I’ve had in Nepal.  We were also visited by the wonderful Ganesh, who arranges the excursions. He was so friendly and no pressure, I could tell he works hard every day to make the guests’ trip complete.  And even though we backed out of paragliding last minute he was very understanding. Because we were having such a relaxing time we didn’t want to leave, so enjoyed an hour and half at the spa!  The girls were wonderful and really put the cherry on top of our opportunity to relax!  The groundskeepers and housekeepers were always smiling and greeting us, I could tell they really enjoyed their job.  We were so content on site we sat at “our table” every morning and evening… Surendra and Hasta Bir delivered exceptional service and it was not just that, they truly became our friends.  I’ve never had my expectations exceeded in such a magnificent manner.  Training service for 20 years I wish I could have staff like them to help teach back to others. You have authentic people at Fishtail and I send all the praise to them and hope they get the recognition they deserve.  Sagun at reception was so delightful and helpful, she really ensured we had everything we needed. After working in Kathmandu for 4 months this was the perfect place to center myself… and enjoy my first days of marriage with my husband. I hope we have the chance to return and hang out with this outstanding staff again… oh and also the view, which is secondary to the experience. Thank you Fishtail!

Fishtail Lodge is located at lakeside with picturesque view .The Lodge has very calm and peace environment with beautiful Fewa lake view and greeny around. It has covered very big area. We came here by a boat.The staffs here are very friendly and kind.They made sure me very enjoying our lunch and we're comfortable. We had grilled fish,biryani,dragon chicken, Bolognese sphagetti. The food were okay I would rate 7/10.We enjoyed our time.

Excellent resort: The two of us stayed one night at the resort before we wonton do our trekking tour. The resort is in a beautiful well manicured park like setting  and has well appointed, comfortable and clean rooms with all amenities. The place is certainly appropriate for a longer stay. The location is across from Pokhara separated by a small arm of the lake. The hotel offers complementary boat service to cross the lake any time of day or night. We ate Dinner and Breakfast in the restaurant  and were completely satisfied with the range of foods offered and the quality.

The rooms and the structure are very nice, even if they show the sign of the years. The resort is on an island, which has a certain charm but it is necessary to take into account the movement on the mainland with a rope raft. Having been there in February, not a high season, breakfast was not served buffet style, so with a fairly limited choice of food. For this reason, I only give three stars.

We ended our tour with a bbq dinner at Fishtail lodge.The GM Mr Arun Pradhan was very hospitable to accommodate us and customize our dinner for us. One of our friends was celebrating his 21st birthday and it was a big deal for him as in the US it marks the legal age for drinking. He loved the dinner and the surprise birthday cake that was given. Sitting outside beside the lake  enjoying the bbq and bonfire was definately the highlight of the tour. We were also given a tour of the place and enjoying the sound of the nature. Thank you to the staff of fishtail for a lovely evening.

Main reason for the rating is the location and views. I was very lucky with my room (it did come at a cost) with subbing views of the lake and the mountains.Reason for not giving it a higher score is that the hotel is very dated, seems to have been massive at a time and it hasn’t kept up to date with many thingsBathroom wasn’t nice for a £200+ stay and something as basic as no light in my night table .. I had to stand up to switch off the lightsStaff were very nice on arrival but on departure they couldn’t have been less helpful. Receptionist was not helpful when the card reader wasn’t working and she kept blaming it on my card - it was their problem in the end. Finally when I was leaving (went back to pick bags), receptionist was rude, and wouldn’t help. There is a lovely person helping tourists with bookings (sorted my bus tickets to Kathmandu) and he booked me a cab for a fraction of what the receptionist wanted me to pay

Fantastic! Other than a couple of very minor issues with the room (not all electric outlets worked and some scuff marks on the wall) - everything was ideal. I spent three nights here in November on a short vacation with a friend. The room was clean, the shower was hot, the food was delicious, the views were incredible, and the service was top notch. From the airport pickup, to the complimentary fresh juice on arrival, the help in booking experiences, the kindness and friendliness of the guards, servers, and managers - it was great service from start to finish. What amazed me right in the beginning was that my friend and I arrived at the hotel around 8:30 am because of our flight time. We didn't expect to be able to check-in until at least noon. But they let us check in at 9 am! And, they let me check out at 2 pm, and store my bags for as long as I needed, before leaving in the evening. The breakfast views were incredible. Truly incredible. Every morning, I spent about two hours eating a very slow and delicious breakfast, while reading and starting at the mountains. Even when there was cloud cover, the view of the lake was also gorgeous.My friend and I rented kayaks from the hotel, which was fun, being able to take off from and come directly back from the hotel. The ferry shuttle was available 24/7, and made coming back late and leaving early feel safe. Highly recommend!

It's a wonderful & memorable stay experience in the beautiful hotel.  As I didnot have any advance reservation. I had walk up to the hotel front desk. There Ms Helen Thapa & Sugan sen thakuri had reserved a garden view room even the hotel is almost soldout. I was personally attended by Ms Kaushal Kumar Singh under his supervision Mr. Gyam Thakuri had made my check in. Ms Sagun herself assist me to the room as well as she click my beautiful pics to make my stay memorable. My lauggage was well manage by Mr. Thakur Shrestha. In housekeeping Ms Indu Khadka, Surendra Thapa, Jitendra Thapa had taken proper care of me and my perferrences. As the hotel property is on island hence the entry and exist by boat and it is a unique experience. Mr Kalash Mishra & shrijana gurung drive me to the hotel by boat. The hotel resturant name is deck by the lake. It is open dinning area with the beautiful view of lake chef Bir singh had pepare a very delicious lunch for me. Ms Ganga & Mr Surendra thapa had served it. Their mint sauce is fresh and very delicious.  I had enjoy my lunch. Mr  Sanjeev Nepali had made my checkout very fast and hassel free. Mr Mitra Ghatri Bahadur had take me to the boat ride and drop me to the otherside.

Far from the maddening crowd, 'Fish Tail Lodge', Pokhara, Nepal. 'Fish Tail Lodge' is a resort located at wooded foothill of Phewa Lake peninsula which is accessible only by small ferry boats/ shuttle boats. Car parks are at mainland. Viewing the calm water of Phewa Lake is amazing.Hospitality and professionalism shown by the staffs are outstanding.Comfort and amenities are awesome

What a wonderful place. I am truly dumbfounded by the negative reviews. The lodge is located on an island in a lake. The reception and dining area are wonderful. Our room was fantastic with a queen bed, air conditioner, hot water in the shower and bottles of filtered water on the desk.The grounds are spectacular with a wide variety of plants and birds - including parrots!We had a wonderful lunch and a great breakfast buffet.

I was  in Pokhara for a few days work and stayed at the Fish Tail Lodge. The lodge is in a perfect location with a lush forest as a backdrop and views across the lake to the snow-capped Himalayas. The lodge itself is set in beautiful gardens. The rooms are well appointed, well maintained (even the older “heritage” rooms and immaculately clean. The breakfast is excellent and the staff professional and well trained. The General Manager, Roshan, ensured we had the best rooms in the lodge.  Sagun, the Guest Relation Officer, went out of her way to make sure we were comfortable and even arranged a surprise cake for my birthday. Fish Tail has to be one of (if not THE) best accommodation in Pokhara.

Fish tail lodge is an absolute must go while staying  at Pokhara. The short boat ride across the peninsula anytime during day or night is available by ringing a bell. The staff are very accommodating. There customer service and rooms are very high standard. This Lodge was the most serene place to stay in Pokhara.  We first saw about Fish tail lodge once we landed at Pokhara airport. We rang to check the availability and offers.  'Sagun Sen Thakuri' was the lady that we spoke with. She was very accommodating to our needs and offered us one of the best lodge in the premises. She even went extra mile by arranging us a free transport to our next destination. Thank you Sagun and all the staff at Fish Tail Lodge for a wonderful service. It was an unforgettable experience. I look forward to coming to stay there during my next time visit to Pokhara. Many thanksSHL

We were guests to this beautiful property to celebrate our 40th wedding anniversary.It’s a 50 years plus well maintained landscaped property with excellent layout of cottages. Entry to and from the lodge is through a floating pontoon on the lake, operated by the lodge security. We had the best time of our life. The staff is very cordial and hospitable. Front office executive Ms Sagun and Travel Desk officer Mr Ganesh were very helpful. The location is superb, bang on the Fewa lake, with stunning views. The breakfast spread is very large and room service and staff are very good.

My wife and I were recently married in Kathmandu. We wanted to take a moment to reflect on and enjoy Nepal's natural beauty. Fish Tail Lodge did not disappoint!!! From the moment we arrived the staff's smiling faces ( From Behind their masks) made us feel invited and welcomed. Our cottage was cozy and clean. The food and service was the best we had in Nepal. My wife works in hospitality, so believe me when I say our stay was incredible! Sagun Shahid, Ganesh and especially Prakash, Surendra Thapa, and Hasta bir treated us like family and were atenttative to all of our needs our entire stay!!! Fish Tail Lodge is amazing and a real jewel in Pokhara!

Best place to land up in Pokhara.This was a great experience for us as it was our 5th anniversary and on top of it Ms Sagun Thakuri, guest relationship manager made it worth it by giving us the surprise on our special occasion.It was not a planned booking, we checked in there and just randomly informed her that it was our anniversary and she make sure that every minute in our stay was worth it.I would like to thank all the staff for being humble while in the stay.The price is worth it and is recommended to everyone.

Fishtail Lodge in Pokhara, Nepal, offers an unparalleled experience in hospitality, and Mr. Bidur's exceptional service during our meals elevated our stay to new heights. The warm welcome and personalized attention created a memorable atmosphere.From the moment we stepped into the lodge, the staff's dedication to guest satisfaction was evident. Mr. Bidur, in particular, stood out with his attentive and friendly demeanor. His recommendations and knowledge of local cuisine added an extra layer to our dining experience.The dining service was seamless, and Mr. Bidur's attention to detail ensured that every need was met. The genuine enthusiasm for making guests feel comfortable was palpable, creating an inviting and friendly environment. The staff's commitment to going above and beyond truly set Fishtail Lodge apart.The culinary offerings were a delightful reflection of Nepali flavors, and Mr. Bidur's guidance enhanced our gastronomic journey. Whether it was explaining the ingredients or accommodating special requests, his professionalism shone through.Fishtail Lodge, with its breathtaking location and a team exemplifying hospitality led by individuals like Mr. Bidur, is a gem in Pokhara. Our experience was a perfect blend of scenic beauty and outstanding service, making it a destination we would eagerly return to.

With respect to the processing of personal data, the principles of lawfulness and transparency are completely fundamental. I have been to this property for fine dining with a friend. In this case, we have concluded that the CCTV cameras filmed more of the restaurant's premises than necessary and covered guest seating areas in the restaurant. Restaurant guests have a legitimate expectation of not being filmed while they are dining there. In places used for relaxation, recreation and social gatherings, the privacy of guests must therefore be accorded considerable weight.

If you are in Pokhra, fishtail lodge is the place to be. The lodge is located in the heart of Fewa Lake with breathtaking views of Lake as well as snow covered peaks. When you reach the property just 3 km away from airport a cute boat would reach to pick you up with warm greetings as the the property is IN THE LAKE itself.  We were greeted with a warm welcom at the reception by Shagun for a fast check-in, she ensured we had comfortable stay during the entire period. The hotel staff is warm, courteous and polite. A big shout out to the spa facility available at the lodge. The rooms have spectacular views.A unique experience indeed.

Whoever chose Fish Tail Lodge as “One of 1000 Places to Visit Before You Die“ was certainly right. This little gem of a resort not only offers stunning views of the Himalayas, but is an experience in itself. The staff from the reception desk to the dining room are among the most gracious and humble people you’ll ever meet and made us feel welcome throughout our stay. The views from the lodge patio deck overlooking the lake are just stunning. And the rooms, though not overly luxurious, and a little tired, nevertheless were very comfortable and had a certain charm of an age from the past that you simply don’t find in today’s modern hotels. The weather in December was surprisingly warm making our stay feel like a true vacation. We highly recommend this location and would certainly return

We stayed at Fish Tail Lodge on December 23rd & 24 th 2019.The location of this hotel is magical, situated on a lake overlooking the Annapurna Range of the Himalayas. Excellent service and excellent food. The rooms are quaint and comfortable.

We stayer two nights and had all our meals in the hotel. The unique location is certainly a huge asset for this facility.The staff was very friendly and helpful at all times. All requests where fulfilled promtly and to our satisfaction.The rooms are not very modern, but our standard room was large, very clean and comfortable.The pool has a decent size and is clean.The service in the SPA area was great and we had two massages which we enjoyed.The extensive menue at the restaurant provided a large selection of meals both local and international. Though there was a good selection of cocktails at the bar, there where only three wines available, one of the white wines was sold out on the first night. As well as soda water (but that happend also at other places, except in Kathmandu).Though we were unable to spot the mountains from the hotel, it provided us with a great two last nights after out trekking trip.

Its an experience everyone must atleast have once in their lifetime. There is a lot to share from scenic views of lake and snow capped Annapurna range. The lush green mountains on all the side makes the place a pitch perfect location if you want to escape from your Carbon filled city life.Its  a very hospitable place and services are of top notch. Hotel staffs are very helpful and courteous in their behaviour to go along with the great food and ambience. I certainly had  a gala time drinking tea on the deck with lake view infront, swimming in the pool with mountains in my background, sipping coffee in my balcony having Annapurna snow capped range in front, beautiful garden areas. It was all possible because of the lady incharge Ms. Shagun (thanks a ton) who allowed us to stay despite our low budget situation. A big thankyou to the whole team of Fishtail lodge and thankyou for making our stay pleasant.

Excellent location, warmth by the staff, good food ! The day we reached, there was road blockage on main street for some function. The staff came down, greeted and guided us to the lodge. Every time you need to cross the lake in a boat or raft, pulled by extremely cordial people. The rooms are comfortable and one can get an excellent snow clad mountain view, right in front of room or lawn or breakfast table. They will happily coordinate for any activity that you want to do.

My husband and I stayed here 3 nights while visiting Pokhara during a Nepal visit.  It’s the best of two worlds.  Highly recommend!The setting is near the bustling Lakeside District but requires a very short pontoon shuttle to get to this tranquil place on the opposite lakeshore.  Boat rental is close by to explore the lake on the water.  Built in 1965, it has been maintained beautifully with gorgeous gardens in which the clean and well-appointed cottages are situated.  If clouds aren’t persistent, you can see the Annapurnas from the property.  This morning I’m enjoying a cappuccino on the restaurant patio with their white caps looming on horizon.  The breakfast buffet offers ample delicious choices (Western, Nepali and Indian) with option for customized egg preparation.As we’ve found throughout Nepal, the staff have been so attentive and welcoming—from the pontoon ‘driver’, the reception, and the restaurant staff.   We ventured out for a few meals while site seeing, but ended up preferring the hotel restaurant with its wide selection.  We especially liked the Indian dishes, particularly Bhatti Ka Murgh and the perfectly spicy Chhoila.  These were exceptional.A few shout outs to Surendra and Prakash for letting us linger over dinners and answering our cultural questions.  Very gracious.

I really like the service of Fishtail lodge. They have such a cooperative staff as well maintained property with best views of Annapurna mountain range and fewa lake. Room,Swimming pool , Fitness center are well maintained with best service. Rajiv Deepika tejendra they were always there for providing me best service.

We loved the hotel’s aspect of transportation as it is on the other side of the Fewa lake and bound at the back by Ranibon Jungle.A 24 hour ferry service is on which has a zero carbon footprint as is run by a pull rope technique operated by a single operator.The rooms are like villas are in the midst of a beautiful garden that are well tended and as I write this review can hear the birdsong and the stucco rhythm of the slate roof being mended.Beautiful staff like Ms Sagun and breathtaking surroundings.

Whats more iconic than the hotel design is the Amazing service from the entire hotel team.. amazing vibes .. breathtaking views of the lake and the mountains, and finally super tasty food! special thanks to Sagoon and Krishna for their outstanding hospitalitywe are definitely coming back here  and recommending the experience to our friends.

The view is amazing and the pool within the resort is so nice and relaxing. I think the most value is the breakfast they have in the mornings. It’s so good and the staff here is amazing and caring. The rooms are clean and nice and the air conditioning is a must! For the price we paid, the value we got is amazing. The dinner was also delicious. My sister had the pork chop while I ate the biryani and the cocktails here were good where they didn’t skimp on the alcohol. I would advise staying in the rooms that are shaped as a circle. If you come here ask for Gyan, he was very attentive to our needs.

It was a wonderful stay , the property had everything under one roof, hospitality was at its best, the hotel management went out of the way to cater to us. Though we reached the hotel at 4 PM they served us with a smile. The lunch was really outstanding & the ambience outside the restaurant was mind-blowing at one side you had the beautiful lake & otherside you had the Snow capped Mountain Fish Tail the 8th tallest peak.There is a myth around this mountain that Lord Shiva and Parvati still visit this abode.🙏I would specially mention here Ms Shagun the guest relations manager for making our stay comfortable by giving our family Rooms close to one another.Whole team was there to assist you at every stage.They have a great Travel Desk handled by Mr Ganesh who will help you to plan your sight seeing & adventures.Oh l will surely come back in the near future as I fell in Love with the Resort.Room tips you should book Mountain facing Rooms.on 1 st floor.

We have travelled to Fish Tail Lodge several times in the past and always have a great time. It was so good to see they have been able to maintain the beauty and peacefulness of the property and the great level of service after the pandemic. Laxmi has been very helpful with the pre-arrival arrangements such as airport pick-up. The security staff moving you back and forth between the property and the "main land" never seem to get tired of pulling the boat for you. Bidur and Ganga put all their enthusiasm in giving you the best service in the restaurant.When you travel to Pokhara this is really THE place to stay. We will be back!

Dirty and dated.  Beds are decades old and bed linen quality atrocious.  We were upgraded to suite but this was not much better Wine is twice the price of similar quality hotelsThis is a 2/3 star hotel and needs a complete refurbishment.  We checked out early Togo back to Barahi which is exceptional

We had gone for our Honeymoon in 1972 and this was a revisit after 50 years, which was an absolutely fantastic trip, starting from a very warm welcome to the upgrade to an executive deluxe cottage with a bottle of wine and an anniversary cake.Excellent hospitality,great food, super services, especially how the staff was able to understand our needs, adjust to our special requests. One service staff Ganga was outstanding in her manner of service.We also visited the Spa and had a great massage,where i would specially mention Saraswati who is very well trained and provides a relaxing massage.The lodge has expanded,but regained it's wonderful beauty and charm.

Situated  inside picturesque Pokhra Lake with back drop of lush green mountains , it is must visitproerty for Nepal lovers . They share their profit for noble cause  cardiac care in Nepal .   You will need a 24x 7 raft/boat service operated free by Fish Tail Lodge  to enter the property . The staff , front office,restaurant managers are extremely polite,caring and efficient . We visited here to celebrate our 31 St marriage anniversary .The hotel staffs made it a memorable one .      Thank you Fish Tail Lodge !

One of the best locations to stay in Pokhran. It was exiting to cross the lake on a small pontoon barge. The rooms and the ambience was superb. Managed by people who are extremely courteous and give you a very happy feeling

The hotel is located away from the city noise on a quiet island. The abundant bird songs in the mornings provide a calming treat. Staff are ever so friendly and helpful here, almost like family. The morning breakfast when we gathered to start our day was a much anticipated event. However after being here for the third time I feel that the room facility needs an upgrade to sustain guests expectations.

If anyone happens to visit Pokhra , Nepal then dont miss to stay at Fish tail Lodge. It is an excellent property with neat and clean rooms. Above all the staff is very courteous. Right from check in , where Mr.  Ganaraj pandit and Mr. Durga Baral will extend a very warm welcome to Mr. Acharya"s  hospitality in restaurant , can leave anyone spell bound.Above all a very kind gesture from Mr. Arun pradhan( GM) sending flowers and preety card to our room , when the hotel staff came to know about ill health of my wife.Keep going Team Fish tail lodge

We stayed in one of the Heritage Rooms with a wonderful view of the lake and mountains.  The room was completely peaceful and quiet with a very comfortable bed.  We enjoyed several meals in the dining hall, at all hours.  Everything was fresh-cooked and delicious.  Prakash took special care of us for these meals.  Overall the service was excellent and the staff is very warm and welcoming.  We also used the spa and fitness room plus took a tandem kayak trip on the lake.  All of these experiences were very enjoyable and satisfying.  Fishtail Lodge offers a high-quality and special vacation experience!

Fishtale lodge is very unique. It is situated in an island where you start your stay by taking a manual ferry moved by the captain who pulled the string from the island. The location is not only surrounded with water but with thick forest as well, so if nature makes you happy, this is the place for you. It is also full with loving, happy and eager to help staff, like Mr. Gyan and Ms. Himani. The flowers are extraordinary, you can feel the hard work of the staff taking care of this and the creative design of the master harder, whom I did not had a chance to meet but worth mentioning because of his dedication and love to his plants. I had the chance to have breakfast in the beautiful table by the lake, the view was amazing, I recommended this to anyone visiting Pokhara.

Easy to get there. Walk to Street 2, you'll see Fish Tail lodge signpost. Walk along the small road path, and will end up at staircase leading to a bell. Generally you don't have to ring the bell, as the boat will be available to take you across to Fish Tail Lodge. Place is so quiet and clean. Love the outdoor seating area. Peaceful and serene. Appertizers Prawns, Paneer, Chicken are so good. We only had these 3 starters and no room for main course. Their signature cocktail is very good. But if you want their Apple Pie for dessert, pls order once you're seated as it takes an hour to make!

Fish Tail Lodge in Pokhara offers a tranquil lakeside escape. With picturesque views, comfortable rooms, and top-notch service, it seamlessly combines nature and luxury for an unforgettable retreat. Thank you for all the help from Sagun, Sandhya,Helen and Gana Raj Pandit.

I stayed at Fish tail Lodge for a night with my sister. We arrived earlier than check in time. All staffs were very efficient and they made the best effort to get the room ready soon and let us check in earlier.  Staffs ( Sandhya, Gana Raj , Sagun, gam bajadur ) are the true asset to this Lodge.   I can not remember names of all staff but each and every staff greeted us with the warmest smile. We had a standard room , it was a decent size and well kept The food was delicious . We sat outside overlooking the beautiful lake and himalayas. The kindness and warmth reflected by all staffs truly made us feel like home . I highly recommed everyone to come and visit this beautiful lodge if you are staying in Pokhara.

Paradise is a myth but “fish tail lodge” is real. An absolute natural beauty with majestic mountain & breathtaking lake view from the hotel almost from every angle is a treat for your eye.The staffs are super nice and professional . Very helpful , you will feel welcomed and we met a very sweet staff “Sagun shahi” who was not reluctant to go extra miles to guide and help us. She was very informative and humble . Incase u just have a day in pokhara to spend, fishtail lodge would be it ! Literally located right between the lake and the forests . Unbelievable property!

The place is peaceful and service was good. Location near lake side is a plus as evening walks there is good. Room was cozy and included all basic requirements: personal locker, refrigerator etc.We were impressed. Definitely staying there again.

This hotel has perfect view of lake and mountains full of greenary with an unique transportation crossing the lake by boat. All the staffs are very helpful and co operative. Special thanks to Ms Sagun who is very charming all the time and amazing service. Thanks to Thakur also who helped and cared our luggage .

Amazing Experience. I do not know where to begin. The view was breathtaking, The staff was so kind. The lodge in itself is beautiful, super clean. You can spot a vast variety of flora and fauna on the property. The facilities are top-notch, the overall stay experience is serene, to say the least.Special thanks to Sagoon, Ganga, Krishna and Ganesh for the exceptional hospitality and arranging a special welcome for us, thus, making our stay extra memorable. Not to mention, the amazing team of Chefs, support staff and super diligent raft-men/boatmen for their industriousness and the attitude of always serving you with a smile.Hope to visit again sometime.

The grounds of this hotel are lush and the location is so nice and secluded. The way on the boat to the hotel is also a nice experience. The staff are nice and friendly. The patio for the rooms are also a great touch to relax and  listen to the birds. However the rooms are slightly outdated and the shower wasn't very powerful and the bed was slightly hard. So I think the price is slightly high for the outdated rooms.

This was my first visit to pokhara and we stayed at this hotel it was wonderful and at that moment i realized that it was so quite and peaceful and i was lost with the nature the place , environment everything was wonderful the hotel where we stayed was amazing . The service and the hospitality of the staff they treated us like a family i felt like i was at home and one there was staff dai who was my favourite dai he was so polite and friendly he's name was Bidur. He helped with so many different things. He was amazing !! Literally everything was outstanding peaceful and quiet. I would highly recommend this place we can see the beautiful view of mountains and fewa lake it's quite an experience everyone was friendly and polite. This was totally worth it!!! Thank you for your Service !

Fishtail lodge is a beautiful place with wonderful and very helpful staff. Sagun and himani were very helpful. The breakfast was also delicious and travel desk had a lot of options to explore and Ganesh was very helpful. The bell desk (Mr Raju) was also polite.

I visited this lodge last week. I was dumbfounded by the negative reviews on online. As soon as i entered the property, i was greeted with warm welcome with smile and a glass of drink. The welcome drink- fruit punch was so refreshing made by bar tender Mr Krishna Bhandari. Every staffs were so attentive and caution not to cause me any problem. I was guided and helped in every thing. Everything was made easier for me. I was treated with outmust respect.Thank you Sagun Gi for making me comfortable in here. And thank you Ms. Sandhya and Ms. Helen for taking care of my every needs.Thank you Mr. Bishnu for safely picking us up and drop off.I'll definitely recommend all the travellers out there and will come back soon.

The venue was clean, tidy and had a very good range of food options at the restaurant. All of the staff were very attentive and helpful (especially Sagun; the Front Office Executive.)The pool area and gardens are a bonus in warm weather and I recommend the standard  rooms near the pool if its not busy.

Perfect ambience for a peaceful stay and beautiful view of mountains and Fewa Lake from cafeteria. The chanting birds in the morning makes you feel like you are meditating...biggest thanks goes to Sagun ji from guest relations who was so kind and welcoming...and himani ji from reception for her sweet attitude.

The hotel is set in beautiful grounds and is in ,a very relaxing location, slightly away from the main tourist areas.  Rooms are comfortable with modern bathrooms, but the decor is a little tired.  On a clear day there are wonderful reflections of the Himalayas in Lake Phewa that can be viewed from the hotel terrace with a cool glass of Gurkha beer in hand.

We booked a night to stay here to recover from a strenuous trek and what a pleasant surprise it was. The lodge has a beautiful history, it is incredibly well maintained and has an amazing view. Our room was incredible and we had gorgeous view of the lake and the mountain range. The stay was made even more pleasant by the staff who were extremely friendly,  accommodating and attentive. Couldn’t have selected a better place to recover. Cannot wait to come back here again for a longer stay. Highly recommended.

The location is stunning, and I thoroughly enjoyed dining on the deck by the lake. The cuisine was excellent, and the service was exceptional, with the Guest Relations Personnel sharing the backstory of the FishTail Lodge. However, the gym facilities require attention as most of the equipment was barely operational. Despite this, I'm in love with this place and already planning my next trip here.

Fishtail lodge place is very nice but outside the room wifi service should be maintain properly. Food was very delicious. Room service is also good.All staff behavior was very good.At the time of arrival the welcome was heartly and receptionist himani was very nice behavior and impressive.

The hotel is breathtakingly beautiful, the accommodations are wonderful but the most impressive was the staff.  The front desk employees were always helpful and gracious; the man who provided information regarding exploring the area, signing up for an ultralight flight, and any other questions was well-informed, respectful and also remarkably gracious.  The restaurant staff was equally wonderful, particularly Svendra  and his staff, Zanisha, Ganga, Krishna and Lamichhane.  We have never enjoyed a hotel experience as much as we did at Fish Tail. Great place with an excellent view of the lakeside and mountains, specifically Mt. Fishtail.I spent about 5 days at this hotel and enjoyed every bit of it. The staffs were very hospitable and the surrounding area was peaceful. The food here was also amazing.I encourage others to visit fishtail lodge by Annapurna.

The staff at fishtail lodge went above and beyond to ensure my family’s stay and time in Pokhara, Nepal were unforgettable. Ms Sagun, the lady at the front desk, walked us to our room and greeted us with a smile every single time. Mr Rajiv was also an exceptional staff member who was patient and empathetic towards my family. I definitely plan to come back and stay again!

A lovely place, remote and private, with everything you could imagine. The food is a delicacy, the mood, the cleanliness, the neighbors might get a little noisy in the hallways, a little bummer but otherwise the place is a dream. It's on the other side of the river with 24hours water taxi and taxi services. The pool is amazing, the service is amazing, the office of activities is extremely on-point and helpful. I could go on for hours but I'll let you go and explore it for yourself!

Precioso entorno y áreas comunes Las habitaciones necesitan una reforma Ser modernizadas Nos gusto mucho este lugar Hicimos paragliding extraordinario y visitamos  Day 3: Day trip to Kalabang and Half day Pokhara city tour (B)Today we visit Kalabang, a more natural and quiet setting to watch Himalayan sunrises. The quaint tower offers an alternative to the frenzied viewpoint at Sarangkot, with an unparalleled panorama of the Annapurna Range. Across the valley, the buildings of Sarangkot appear like Lego, and the waters of Fewa Tal stretch out into the surrounding hills. Depending on the season, the line between sky, lake and clouds blurAfter the Kalabang excursion you will have half day pokhara city tour. Sightseeing start form Bindhyabasini temple and it is the center of religious activity in the Bazar. It was built to honor the goddess Bhagawati. Gupteshower cave is known for its exceptional natural limestone formations and Devi’s Fall – the most famous waterfall in Pokhar

What a wonderful place to stay for my first time in Nepal, and South Asia. The staff was incredibly warm, welcoming, and very accommodating with any requests we had. It's a lovely place full of natural beauty.  One should spend long holidays here to enjoy the scenery and beauty of this place . It was really nice to be here with the team of Fishtail. I found the service and food excellent. Fully enjoyed the service and accommodation. This hotel is having very ambient environmemt as it is very serene and pleasant cottages for the accomodation. The property is extremely picturesque offering great views of the Annapurna range, Phewa lake and a beautiful garden. The lodge staff was very friendly, Shagun was very sweet to take lots of family pictures for us. One downside is that the bathrooms are little tiny, otherwise an excellent property.

We are here for 3 nights and I just had to write a review after my first nights sleep and breakfast FABULOUS!  Surendra and all the team at the Fishtail are incredibly attentive.  Nothing is too much trouble.  A lovely cake, chocolates and drinks on arrival in our room. Beds were turned down and curtains pulled clean towels and room tidy whilst we went for a walk. Beautiful place and extremely courteous and helpful  staff, keeping well the name and fame of Fishtail lodge. Ms Sagun Thakuri the Front Office Executive and Ms Deepika from Guest Relations are specifically to be appreciated for providing all help and  guidance. Would look forward to visit again.

Great experience at the Fish Tail lodge! Spent the last week there and have been pampered by staff, enjoyed excellent meals (try the Ginger Prawns) and lovely views and serenity. It is perfectly located in a quiet corner of the lake but close enough to town by a short walk or taxi.

This hotel gave us a very different experience, the entry to the hotel is like a movie one where we need to hop a boat and cross it to reach on the island. Its one of the best hotels in the town. If anyone wants to have a true experience of lakeside then stay on this property. It was very peaceful and greenery. The veg food served was good in taste and was like homemade. We stayed for 2 nights here, the overall experience was excellent.

A perfect combination of hospitality and location. This property is located on the Fewa Lake and having dence forest attached to it. A grand look of Valley from the room and very close clouds makes it place like heaven.

Had a Fantastic experience at Fishtail Lodge. The location itself was out of this world away from the usual lake side crowd. The room was spacious, clean, and staffs were exceptionally friendly and attentive, making sure every need was met promptly. On site restaurant was a plus that served great variety of cuisines. I wanted to stay at Fishtail hotel when i heard about it for the first time. This time, I got chance to stay at Fishtail hotel during my official trip to Pokhara. I found the place really amazing. This hotel is superb and perfectly located in an island once side full of green forest other with lake. Tranquility and peace surrounds the lodge.Located by the lakeside makes it s location unique to Pokhara,away from the hustle and bustle of the city.Stayed for 3 nights and service from the raft transport ,concierge . F and B service and the entire serving staff was excellent.

We stayed at the fishtail lodge for two nights. The service was great with every staff greeting and welcoming. The food was good. Their beetroot salad and momos were quite tasty. The location of the property is excellent with a good view of lake the snow peaked range. The hospitality of the staff is excellent and they are very cooperative. The food in the restaurant is good and special thanks to Chef Aga Thammar Murthuza for looking after us well.Looking forward to visiting again.

The hotel is located at the edge of Pokhara city and therefore relatively quiet and with good air. It has a beautiful garden full of flowers attracting many birds. The Spa is great and the terrace at the lakeside offers great views of the Annapurna mountains. The rooms are well equipped.

Well worth a visit to this sanctuary., full-service resort.  Gorgeous accommodations in and out.   Amazing birds and flowers.  Sagun, Dipika, Surendra, Mr Ganerog and Mr Top the raft man all provided top notch service and made me feel so at ease and welcomed.   A very lengthy menu and wine list.

Everything was beautiful and well done at this hotel.. The setting was perfect. The grounds were very well maintained and Planted with flowers and Bushes. It had gorgeous views of the Annapurna Mountain range  From all over the resort and from each room you got at least a partial view. The service was great and friendly. They had a wonderful breakfast.. Everything was cleanThe service was great and friendly. They had a wonderful breakfast.. Everything was clean, the staff was helpful.   They have an excellent breakfast with a wide assortment of choices.  They have a boat that took you across the lake every day and even that was a lovely experience.

The room was the one of the best room in Nepal. The Food was excellent. The staff was also good.Sagun Shahi Gyan Bdr Gam Bdr and Sandhya were really helpful and caring to fullfill all our needs during our stay.

On 15th August 1991, me and my wife met the first time just by chance in this hotel, and since that day we are together. Hospitality of your hotel is fantastic, and your chef Mr. Sunil Chaudhary food's are awesome. Service & Management are good . Rooms are well maintained and spacious.  Mr Ganaraj Pandit, Ms Sagun and Mr Krishna Lammichhane are too helpful,  caring and courteous. We will come back again in near future.

We stayed two nights at the Fishtail Lodge and it was excellent. The access by boat is fun and an experience in itself. The gardens are superb and the rooms are well equipped. The breakfast is excellent. One downside is the price of drinks which is absolutely ridiculous.

We went to Fishtail Lodge on 12-15 May to celebrate with Friends. We were group of 4, Service here provided was excellent especially Ishwor who served us breakfast and Room Service was really great. I recommend everyone to visit Fishtail Lodge if you want to enjoy in pokhara ( place of peace and lakes with nature).

Fantastic property with beautiful location. Rooms are well equipped & very clean . It’s a beautiful place to spent quality time, very relaxing and tranquil. The ambience and location of this resort is mind blowing. The staff here are super friendly and pay attention to every need of their customers. Special thanks to Bidur for providing us with a wonderful dining experience on our first day at Pokhara.

A beautiful property to experience nature. Situated on Fewa Lake you get amazing view of the lake and the forest. You can hear the sounds of variety of birds throughout the day. Impecable and flawless services and hospitality. Right from check-in to check-out, every thing was superb and highly commendable. Beautiful location, very helpful and supportive staffs. Very nice hotel & beautiful property with amazing view. Breakfast was too delicious. Ms Sagun  & Ms Himani was too good & helpful . all the staffs are very attentive and respective to the guests. I found the best service among the world. I wish to come back again.

Fishtail Lodge has generous and kind staff, fantastic food, is in a beautiful setting and has a great onsite travel service.  Our first three days of our anniversary trip started here and our stay was extraordinary.  The grounds are beautiful as well l as the site showcases exceptional views from our room and the outdoor dining area.   You will be totally charmed by the staff who are attentive and generous with their time.   A fabulous place to decompress as well from 30 hours of travel and enter into Nepali culture.

We were looking for a quite place surrounded by nature, and found it as soon as we got off the cute little raft boat. It is  a beautiful oasis on the side of the lake. It was amazing experience in Fishtail resort..... The staffs, food and the hospitality was beyond the par . I had a happy, secure and heart warming stay. Much much recommended for everyone Ambience was goodBrings Close to nature. A quiet and peaceful area that rejuvenate the inner soul.

Excellent property.....Excellent hospitality....Extremely supportive Sagun shahi....Beautiful place with full of greenaries.  Boat service is unique and exciting.  Food is very good, we tried nepali thali and enjoyed the typical taste of Nepal.

My family and I had wonderful time at Fishtail Lodge in Pokhara. Our kids enjoyed the safe and spacious compound and the cultural Deshain swings in the Lodge. Had an amazing time with nature and beautiful environment with Good view and excellent service  specially Thanks to Mr Bidur and Rest. Manager Krishna Prasad Lamichhane who cared us specially. Very beautiful place and sunrise was beautiful as the lake . I  enjoyed raft service . Food and the service was excellent definitely recommend my childern to come here its really a paradise to stay clam and peaceful Room was cute and like the style Ms himani and ganaraj was very sweet and helpful

The lodge has a beautiful view of the mountain and the lake.An extremely good spot to view the mountain from the lodge.The food caters to all ethic group and have a wide selection.Great customer service from especially from Bidur surendra .They were extremely attentive and helpful.

It was as usual a very pleasant experience and the property is fabulous and scenery is breathtaking... The property itself is a site to behold ... Our stay was facilitated by Mr. REHAN... Bestest place to stay in pokhara. Wonderful view awesome food. Staffs are very friendly specially Krishna bhandari and Bidur. They always arranged for the taste of food we asked for. Property is situated on phewa lake. Everything is nearby.

Fish Tail lodge has got the most beautiful location in Pokhara beside Pehwa lake. Staff is very nice and cooperative. They Have excellent food. Rooms were clean. Must Stay here if you are visiting Pokhara.

This hotel is beautifully located between the lake and green forest. The view of mountains is marvelous from the deck where we enjoyed our dinning there. All the staffs are very caring and helpful. Fish is one of the best hotel in pokhara our stay here was very good with a nice surrounding. Food was awesome we enjoyed it.Rooms were also clean. Staff were very helpful and informative specially Mr Ganaraj and Ms dipika

Food was awesome so us service. Rooms stay was comfortable and staff was courteous. We are really enthralled to stay at fishtail lodge. Location of lodge was also good. We wish Fishtail lodge a very best for maintaining their service level.

We had great time staying at this beautiful resort. Staff are very friendly and professional. The food was very delicious made by the chef. Mr. Gyan, shandhya and Raju Gurung were helpful to us. It’s very peaceful location. One of the best place in town.

Excellent service and very pleasant employees.My kids loved the swimming pool and the guys who was in that area. The front office, Dipika and Buddhiman were fantastic !! The rooms could use another pair of slippers, but it’s the only thing that I wish I had more of.

From the first step into lodge, special warm welcoming by Ms Sagun Shahi and Gyan Bahadur, and Mr Thakur Shrestha with cold towel as welcoming cremory, and the amazing mocktail that you never drink before in your life by Mr Ashok, the view and the lake was amazing. Great place! Very calm and serene! The place is on the lake and the hotel takes you to their place by boat. You can also rent a boat for an hour and go around the lake. our experience of Staying at this hotel is really wonderful. From breakfast to swimming pool to room service, every facility was truly amazing. The hotel staffs are very helpful. The beauty of nature can be captured from the hotel. The hotel location and view from the hotel is just mind-blowing.

Very kind bumble welcoming and cooperative staff. Plus the hotel is very comfortable. Situated between the lakes with the perfect weather makes it an amazing property.Ms Himani and ganaraj is best staff they are very polite and helpful which made us feel like a home

Gone to Kathmandu and Pokhra for relaxing after a busy schedule. The hotel was excellent with nice supportive staff and reception staff was good who guided us to visit various places. Food and variety of food is good specially Nepali Thali.

Property is really nice. It’s by the the side of lake and it has a very calm and pleasing environment. Staffs and hospitality is very nice. Food is exquisite. Rooms are nice. Garden are well maintained. Overall experience is quite excellent. You’ll feel relaxed here if you stay.

Fishtail Lodge was so comfortable and beautiful.  From the manned ferry to the outdoor lakeside dining, it was a wonderful stay.  We’d like to give a special shout-out to our waiter, Surrendra. It was one of the best stays we had as a family. The location is just wonderful . Don't go by the pictures if they don't appear good but in actual it's a beautiful place. It's our first time. One of our best times ever. Service is very good. Highly recommended !If you want to try for peace location but still not far from the main lake side area then this is the best place to be in.

The ambiance is very nice overall. The service was exceptional. There were complementary water, coffe and tea. Room and bathroom was very clean. Everyone was very friendly and helpful. The view of the mountains is great from this resort. It’s a really good place if you want to be somewhere quiet and peaceful.

The best views in all of Pokhara! Amazing staff who are very courteous and helpful! Raju of housekeeping was so helpful! The restaurant staff are amazing!! The unique way in which we were towed to the resort was very cute. We also tried our arm strength rowing ourselves in and out of the resort

Very helpful and friendly staff. Felt like home away from home.Excellent food!! Very good and serene property!! Loved my stay!!!I am definitely going to recommend this property to my friends and family.Staff us very friendly! Himani & Ganaraj thanks!

Hospitality is very nice. I was with my friends we enjoyed. Mainly the view was very nice the food and everything was so good. We loved it.. Himani and Gyan was very humble and nice with us. Cleanliness was very good. Everything was too good. Excellent

We stayed at the resort for 2 days during our honeymoon trip. We had a lovely time spending there. Everything from staff behavior, food, room, service, ambience is top notch. This is a great place for tourists who love to keep away from the hustles of city life and want to spend quality time with their loved ones. Would definitely re-visit this place if I get a chance.

This hotel is surrounded with full of nature, it is the best part of the hotel. All the views from hotel and ambience is really attractive and beautiful. All the staffs are very polite and courteous. Special thanks to ama Sagun and Sanjiv for warm welcome.

This was a great place to use as a base while visiting Pokhara.I met some really interesting people at this hotel including a tour guide called Zack.I intend to use this hotel again in 2024 and will write a new review after that visit. I recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a good base to stay while  in Pokhara.

There are too many mosquitoes in the room. Also there is water clogging in the entrance when it rains so our shoes get wet. Should not be suggested for anyone. Food variety also very less. Bathroom is also very small. Property should be renovated.

The stay was amazing. We had a great experience. Scenic beauty is good with butterflies. Mr. Rajeev and Sandhya is such a lovely person. We will definitely come back again. It is really a beautiful place with beautiful garden. I just love it. Home away from home.

We stayed rooms 16 and 17. When Prince Charles, now King, and Jimmy Carter stayed in. And Emperor of Japan. The views are stunning. We saw little peaks of Annapurna. It was little cloudy, but if the day were rainy or sunny without the fog. You can see it at the lodge. The staff were very helpful and friendly. We had massage/spa there. Perfect after all those cities we traveled. The atmosphere is very calm and relaxing. The place is listed in “1000 places to see before you die” and it is very true.

Hotel is very good, with beautiful view of mountains and lake from the deck area. All the staffs here are very helpful. We had a great time at swimming pool . Food is also excellent. We will come back again.

The view looks very beautiful from here. The food was also nice. I like the hospitality too. Everyone should visit this place. The employee of this lodge are sweet. The environment here is peaceful , one time visit place

Fishtail lodge is the one !!! These beautiful property located in the lake is by far one of the most beautiful place i’ve ever been in life. The ambience and hospitality is top notch. All the staff are professional and courteous . I will definetly come back again .

Best location.staff are very coperative.Amazing food.Excellent ambience.as per tariff, the room could be slightly bigger, The lakeside dininning was one of the best experiences  I had.Unfortunately  due to bad weather we could not see the mountains..we had only one small glimpse of Fish Tail, and Annapurna  Annapurna  south from our room balcony..It is the best possible place to view mountains from your room or balcony, obviously  in a clear day..

service was really good.Mr.Bidur service was superb.restaurant atmosphere was beautiful.coming back again and recommended to all the people in the world.lake view was fabulous very nice family environment. thank you for the great service

We visited Pokhara from Lumbini during our recent trip to Nepal.  Frankly, we were quite unprepared for the scenic setting of the hotel.  Every one from the staff was very courteous, friendly and helpful at all times.  The dining area offers a view of the Annapurna Range of the Himalayas.  One can opt to sit outside the dining hall to enjoy the food and the ambiance.   Boat ride in the Phewa Lake is very relaxing!!!

Amazing Lodge..with clear view of the Fewa Lake and the range of mountains (if you are lucky to catch clear skys)...A calm place to be in if you want to spend your time away from the cacophony of the horns....Friendly staff...Restaurant was excellent too...since I am a Nepali the menu looked expensive at first but then when I tasted the food....it was worth every penny...The hotel treated every morning with a sumptuous breakfast.....Rooms were comfy...Has a swimming pool and a gymnasium should you want to sweat! will visit again. Ferry ride across the lake was awesome...A bit towards the end of the lake...but good exercise if you want to walk to the town........

The fishtail lodge is an amazing resort with a good team behind it. The staff looked happy to serve and take care of their guests. I was staying with family for 2 nights and the hospitality was great. Right from the General Manager to the person manning the boats.. (yes you need to travel by a boat to reach the resort) was on hand to ensure the stay was nice. Breakfast at the resort had a good selection of dishes . The rooms were well appointed and helped me to unwind.I would love to go back to the resort on my future trips to Pokhara.Thanks once again

Super experience and the view is awesome, the rooms are big and very clean. Huge property, the staffs are very polite and courteous. the only connectivity to the hotel is either a boat or a hand pulled raft kind of a thing. A must visit place. I totally loved my stay here.

My parents stayed here in the 1970's as part of a cultural tour, it was always on my list. From the moment you arrive its like stepping back 50+ years a rope drawn ferry to a island with incredible views across the lake to Annapurna and Fishtail.  I have stayed since the 90's many times, what makes this hotel is its locations, the history but mostly the staff of which many have been there for over 20 years.  Its experience not to miss and forgot one of the best hotel managers in my experience in Asia  Pradeep Rana goes beyond service to make your trip memorable    TIP.  enjoy sundown on the resturant terrace and book the staff to wake you early if Sun up has a view at 5am. Nothing beats a boat trip across Fewa Lake to see the highest mountains on our planet !

Was on a solo trip to explore Nepal. I was just browsing through various hotels and I came across Fish Tail lodge. I fall in love with the location . The whole staff is courteous. loved the fish tikka they have prepared for me. I was in spa every morning. explored local area and cuisines. It was raining whole time so stayed indoor and enjoyed the view from room and read book. Met Fiona and she is a excellent host.  It has an excellent bar and restaurant with an excellent breakfast. Kudos !!

I love the toilet and shower after trekking the Mountain of Annapurna Base Camp and visiting basic toilets and Bathrooms in this cold winter.It is a lovely feel and the food is of good standard although I did not like the boating to the Hotel every time I want to go out.I wished there is a Chinese Bridge built over and I can pull or push my lugguage across the lake easily.

A beautiful property inside the lake, a dream location ,beautifully designed,maintained,good size rooms.Landscape is too beautiful,food amazing ,complimentary breakfast has beautiful choice. courteous  staff to add great meamories to your stay

The setting in the lake is beautiful. The approach to it on a punt - atmospheric. Views from the Lodge of the Fish Tail Peak - superb.Check-in was courteous and efficient - BUT - it was raining and there were no umbrellas in the Reception area (nor indeed in the room).The room itself - comfortable - BUT:- there was no tea or coffee making equipment (no jug or kettle) available in the room - tea/coffee has to be ordered from room service. Wifi in the bar/lounge area only, was patchy at best.The room was comfortable but - it smelled strongly of furniture polish or linseed oil. During our two night stay we were provided with just one bottle of drinking water (sure, it's readily available for purchase everywhere - BUT!) There is no hairdryer in the room (normal kit in any 4* establishment). Toilet paper was not replaced when the room was serviced - call housekeeping - but it should be routine to check the supply when servicing the room!Food and service in the Dining Room were quite good. Checkout - OK.As it was when we were there - a good 3* Resort - but with some 'tuning up' it could be a lovely 4* Resort.

The fishtail lodge is a really beautiful place and it blends seamlessly with the surrounding forests and the lake. If you appreciate unobtrusive place that is in perfect harmony with nature, you will love this place.If you are looking for a place to party, fishtail lodge is not the right place for you. You won’t find loud music and fancy lights. If you absolutely need large suits with fancy bathrooms, you won’t find it here. However, if you love peace and quiet and if you appreciate the serenity and beauty of nature, you will love it. If you enjoy a good night’s sleep and love the morning air, you will enjoy your stay.If you appreciate old school hospitality, you will love it here. Every member of the staff seemed to be genuinely happy to serve. I remember a server named Ganga Thapa who was really amazing during my first morning breakfast. That kind of service and warmth makes you feel like royalty and you learn to appreciate traditional Nepalese hospitality.I will be going back to Fishtail Lodge many more times in the future, both during solo trips and family vacations. Besides the natural beauty and exceptional hospitality, there is one more thing that will make me want to go back there whenever I can. This place is really convenient if you love kayaking in the Fewa lake. I had brought my own kayak and they stored it right next to the lake and helped me launch and retrieve it many times during my stay. I was able to kayak just before sunrise and really enjoyed the morning air.

Lovely, quiet hotel on Fewa Lake.Stayed 2 nights in a very large, comfortable room in the 2 story building. No lift available. Nice balcony overlooking other accomodations, large field.The pontoon raft that you must use to cross the lake is cool, takes only a few minutes. After you take the pontoon raft back, Hotel is a short walk to Lakeside Rd where there's a ton of restaurants, bars, shops.All staff was wonderful, helpful and friendly. Breakfast buffet was ample and varied. Did not eat other meals or sit at the bar.Wish I could have stayed longer, next time.

Fish Tail Lodge was booked for us through a tour company and it did NOT disappoint!  Very peaceful and serene.  Located on a lake with a view of the Himalayas that was absolutely breathtaking.  To access the hotel you take a boat or small pontoon boat, literally less than 5 minutes, I personally loved this!  The grounds of this hotel are AMAZING!  The staff was very friendly and extremely helpful.  We had a ground floor room that was perfect, it had a beautiful view of the grounds / Annapurna Range/ Fewa Lake and also had air conditioning (it was quite hot and humid during August).  The beds were comfortable and the room itself was very clean (not to mention the hotel  grounds were impeccable).  If wifi is a concern, it was accessible all over the property.  We ate breakfast, lunch and dinner in their restaurant and thought the food was great!  The shops were only a short walk away and the airport is maybe a 10 minute drive.  We were also informed by our guide that the Fish Tail Lodge was owned by the King of Nepal!  I HIGHLY recommend Fish Tail Lodge and see why it made the cut on “1000 Places to See Before You Die” by Patricia Schultz!

We stayed at the picturesque Fishtail Lodge right on the Lake Phewa in Pokhara in north cantral Nepal..Unfortunately, the check-in was horrendous. We had booked well in advance. There were very few occupants on 20.05.19. Despite this , one Mr. Pandit in the Front Office had us guided to a cottage type room towards the back of the resort.The room was gloomy with dark wood panelling and red curtains, no desk/table, no chair. Our complaint was received with a lot of grumbling and disbelief.To cut a long story of woe short, we decided to cancel our booking and move to another hotel. This move on our part brought the Guest Relations Manager to sort out the problem. She showed us a room in a new block, (lying totally vacant) . We immediately accepted as the room on the 1st floor was spacious, airy, with a wide balcony furnished withtwo garden chairs with a table,a desk two comfortablr  chairs in the room - a nice room with all the regulation furniture and fixtures.It took about 1hr for us to get a good room! this was unacceptable as was the behaviour of the sullen and hostile Mr PanditAfter this, our stay at the resort was blissful. The staff was extremely helpful, thw service in housekeeping, restaurant, bar , poolside and the room was excellentAll in all, we had a wonderful time ,despite the trauma of the check-in brought about by Mr Pandit

Nepal offers many things and after a long 5 day trek we decided to stay for a night in Fish Tail Lodge. A beautiful setting hidden away on the edge of the forest with spectacular views of the lake and the mountains.  You have to travel on a small ‘boat platform’ to get to reception and this novelty is a perfect way to start your stay. Accommodation is very quaint and colonial and in a totally relaxing environment. There is one main restaurant and food/service was very attentive. Would happily relax here again and would thoroughly recommend.

Fish Tail Lodge in Pokhara is one of my favourite when I visit Pokhara for business and family. Getting to the hotel reception via the rope boat adds already the wilderness and naturalness to your stay. Breakfast is excellent and the scenic vie of Mount Machhapuchhre (Fish Tail) and Annapurna is majestic if the wheather permits.

What a beautiful setting.  Not only was the view of the Himalayas breathtaking,the lake setting and gardens are mythic.  Just walking the gardens in the twilight was transformative.  The staff was kind and thorough, the room and bathroom comfortable and spacious. Being pulled by barge over the lake to our hotel was special.  An extraordinary location.Thanks to the entire staff for an exquisite stay.

Great experience at Fish Tail Lodge .The staff was amazing,friendly and like family. The place is beautiful. Location of the lodge is at foot of the hill in middle of nature.Just enjoyed my 5 days stay at Fish Tail Lodge.

We stayed two nights at this hotel. It was very nice relaxing experience. The views are beautiful, and the entrance is quite unique. Friendly staff and great view of Pokhara by the lake.The negative points would be the food, which was not good at all. and the old rooms which needs refurbished.

Naturally peaceful and private. No pollution Great hospitality and food. Good massages. But room need to be improved and cleaned. 50 years old hotel, certainly need to improve the interior to make it more cozy. Close to shops and restaurants. They are all within walking distances.

My friend and I arrived at the Fish Tail lodge after a hard week of work in Kathmandu. It is a lovely, serene oasis in the midst of the lake  near the Annapurna circuit in Nepal. The people in general in Nepal are lovely and there is something special about Nepal overall. But we have rarely found ourselves as rested and relaxed and spiritually calm as at the Fishtail in Pokhara. The vistas are beautiful, the lodging attractive and the service is very good and caring. And there is something special about where it is located--the vibrations are good. I've  otherwise only felt that special connection to "place/earth"  in Delphi,Greece and Sedona, Arizona. And it is as if the Fish Tail knows this and honors it with its care and service.  I'd like to give a special shout out to Fiona (Noonan?) who was special guest representative there.  She is a lovely person who embodies and exudes the special spirit of the place. Her greetings and solicitous nature are genuine, and she helped us in so many ways. There was no request too small --she followed up on everything.  She is Australian, yet manages to capture the essence of Nepal and channel the lovely Nepali way, while maintaining her 'western ways as well that made these two yanks most comfortable and grateful for her presence. (Margot M)

We had visited this place last week and had a wonderful stay. We were so amaze with the quality of staff you have maintain and we would specially thank M&s sanju Sharma she is really gems to the property. Thanks to all staff.

Lovely hotel and gardens on the lake with stunning views of the Himalayas. Staff is exceptional - specifically the beautiful and professional Sanjay and Fiona, public relations manager. Courtesy and friendliness abound making this a must stay on a Nepal itinerary.

We stayed here twice in the last two weeks, pre and post trekking and we were welcomed back the second time like old friends. We even had the same room on our return. The setting is perfect offering peace and quiet from the streets of Pokhara and set in lush grounds with a lovely pool. Fabulous outdoor spaces to enjoy the lake and mountain views.The service is outstanding and the hotel is very clean. When it was built late 1970's/80 it would have been top of its class and Heads of State and Royalty have stayed here. However the 20 years of political turmoil that followed has meant there has been limited investment in furnishings  (bathrooms in particular) which has resulted in a charming authenticity. I would certainly stay here again.

Located on Lake Phewa, you have to take a short 30 second platform boat ride across the lake to reach the hotel.  The boat is manually powered, with the boat captain pulling the platform boat to the landing dock by hand using a long rope. The hotel has beautifully manicured grounds with a peaceful outdoor seating area, just outside the restaurant that overlooks the lake.  Unfortunately the weather was quite hazy during our stay and we couldn't see the mountains at all, which was quite disappointing.  The rooms are spacious and clean.  The bathroom was clean.  We had a issue with drainage of the tub / shower and housekeeping came twice to fix it after which it worked well.  The breakfast buffet was good, with a wide selection of food.  The hotel is walking distance to the main street, where the shops and restaurants are.  Overall, a nice, mid-range hotel.

We could not fault this hotel, we stayed for 3 nights during our tour of Nepal. It is very beautiful and calm, situated on the bank of the Fhewa Lake with wonderful views towards the mountain ranges. We had a room on the 1st floor of the Palmcourt block with small balcony overlooking the garden......nice room and bathroom, very clean. Breakfast and dinner good although like most hotels were almost UK prices.

It was like coming to heaven to Fishtail Resort after a very exhausting trek. We were met by very serviceminded, gracious staff and they actually really saw what condition we were in and didn't know what good they could do for us to make us feel better. Our garden facing room was lovely, modern with everything you can ask for.  We have travelled all over the world and are used to nice hotel, and Fishtail resort is really a pearl here in Pokhara.  Food is very good and all the staff is nice and always smiling. A very special thank to Fiona who made our stay a really memorable one, always there for all guests.  Thanks you from Wenche and Hans from Oslo/Norway

If you want to value-add your experience while you are in Pokhara and have a story to tell on return then this is a good place to choose.  This is not one of the usual look-alike multi-storey modern hotels in Pokhara (or anywhere else in the world).  This place has a unique Pokhara feeling to it blessed by its character, setting and a rich history. It's more than a stay, it's a peaceful and relaxing experience with a story to go back with. Let's be honest - how often do you actually remember your hotel stay let alone talk to others about why it's so unique?The hotel maintains its unique offering with its limited (exclusive) number of rooms. The place is easily accessible and not too far from the main strip on Lakeside. The short (less than 5 min) boat ride to the lodge prepares you for a peaceful and calm stay away from the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu, and the tourist mecca area of Pokhara. Royal History: Most of the rooms have hosted Royals and dignitaries from around the world including the UK and Japan. During our stay, we (the bride and groom), were given the privileged "Prince Charles Room" (Prince Charles had stayed there in the past and has the best view at the lodge in my opinion). This place has an authentic character backed by a rich history, nice garden area, and staff who seem to understand their clientele's needs very well. They understand why their guests choose them and work hard to maintain their brand. The brand being peaceful, calm, historic, experience-rich and customer focused. Food: The head chef and his team are exceptionally good. Given the royal history of this place, I'm not surprised that the menu receives a special attention. Western, Indian or Nepali, they can do it all, do it well and make you gain a few extra kilos while you are there. My mouth still waters thinking about the best-tasting bacon I've ever had in Nepal! We got married at Fish Tail Lodge! We (family and friends) stayed at Fish Tail for several days and got married at Fish Tail and the Barahi temple in the middle of the lake.  Management and staff at FTL went out of their way to make sure that we were looked after.  Apparently, this was the first wedding at Fish Tail that took Janti (Groom party) from Fist Tail to Barahi Temple on boats and the staff at Fish Tail did everything they could to look after us and our guests.  We wanted a peaceful, elegant, enjoyable and memorable wedding without too many people and noise. We wanted a place where people cared about us and what we wanted for ourselves and our guests. We couldn't think of a better setting in Nepal.Note: Before visiting the place we were not sure given some negative feedback on Trip Advisor. Especially about the decor and the dated feeling.  My wife and family visited the place and all concerns were overridden with confidence. The rooms are dated but I think it adds to what the place has to offer. Afterall, why would you go to an island like resort and expect another copy/paste hotel design... Management told me that they are working on some rennovations. I am looking forward to visiting in the future and seeing how they combine modern luxuries while maintaing their unique value prop!

Located on a peninsula, accessible by small shuttle float. The staff is warm, welcoming and very helpful. The service in the restaurant is impeccable, every little request was promptly taken care of. The food was delicious and beautifully presented (we ate mostly a la carte), except at breakfast when there was a big irresistible buffet. On warm days we ate on the terrace with breathtaking views of the mountains and the lake. This is a true oasis and yet minutes away from vibrant Pokhara and its lakeside shopping.

You can wake up to the beauty of the Himalayas and breathe clean mountain air. The staff are very helpful and friendly . There is nothing to whine about regarding the hotel or the area or ambience.  Food is slightly on the expensive side. The breakfast spread could be better.  Getting to the hotel itself and out in the raft is an added bonus.

We were aware tin advance hat the hotel has been around for many years and were accepting of this. We found an absolutely charming place. The room, a standard one, was better than we had been expecting and met all of our needs. Superb location with a delightful approach to the hotel across the end of the lake with a boatman demonstrating admirably his skills with the rope. But what made this an extremely memorable stay was the genuine friendliness of every single member of staff that we met, covering a wide range of ages. Clearly hotel management must know how to train staff members and staff members respond accordingly. I cannot remember so many totally natural and rewarding exchanges with staff at any other hotel recently.

It was an evening of 10th of December 2017. We reached Pokhara at around 2:30PM. The lodge is on a peninsula across Fewa Lake. The first surprise-Shuttle-floats! My wife and I came down through the stairs and there it was. The gentle boat women (they are also men who row the boat) pulled the rope all the way to the Fish Tail Lodge. It has a capacity of 12 people (there are life jackets). They also have small boats to take guests to the boat. After completion of the front desk paperwork we walked through the stone walkways between the beautiful gardens with colorful flowers to our lakeside “HERITAGE ROOM”. I remember the number -19.It is a room with the view of mountain and lake. You can see the snow covered mountains with full wall glass window. You will enjoy the view of the mountains sitting at the terrace in front of the room while you take a sip of tea. There was double bed, Air Conditioner (with both heating and air cooling system). It was equipped with cable TV, a small refrigerator (minibur), Electronic Safe, tea coffee maker. Wifi is available but you need to pay for that (USD 9 or 10 per day at the time of our stay). Complementary bottled water supplied at the room. There is hot water supply in the bathroom. But I found the bathroom space relatively small. The shower curtain could not protect most of the floor from becoming wet when you take a shower. So you should be cautious of the wet floor.  The restaurant has got lake view tables (i did not count but may be 10 or 15). Also there is an open place under sky where you can have your food. We had our breakfast under the winter blue sky with an amazing view of the snow covered mountain peaks. We had buffet lunch and dinner. There were varieties of food. We liked the food. The staffs were really gentle and serve well. There is a bar in the restaurant (but cannot write about it as none of us consume alcohol).The nights are amazing. It is quiet and peaceful. Night sky is full of Stars (if it is not cloudy of course). Take a walk along the lakeside, look at the mountains-you will be amazed with the dots of lights in the distant hill (they are lights from houses). You would not be able to take your eyes off from reflection the colored light (from the lakeside markets and hotels with) in the lake.It is a place where you can spend your holiday in peace in the lodge. You can just relax, not worry about the chaotic world and enjoy the mountains, lake and blue sky. Other things will be taken care of the Fist Tail Lodge employees.

This is an older resort, with bungalow like rooms on the property. The views are magnificent! You're looking at Annapurna range across the lake filled with small boats. It's calming and serene. The restaurant breakfast buffet is abundant, and their menu is varied. Loved getting to and from the hotel via raft. Bit expensive for the location (there's an abundance of hotels in Pokhara), but it's worth the splurge. FYI: the pool is coooooold.

My second stay here 5 years apart and it still has its excellent service and beautiful views and delicious food. We ate off the menu and compliments to the chefs. The fresh fish fry is recommended.
