It is a haven of peace and tranquility.The Annapurna mountain range is clearly visible.The rooms are centred around the grounds and are beautifully appointed, clean and comfortable.The restaurant overlooks the lake and the food is good with very attentive staff.Highly recommend!

Amazing place, very comfortable and very beautiful. so comfortable and enjoyable, that we almost didn't move out of the place for two days.Pool was very nice and enjoyable for family and kids.food was awesome with sufficient choices. absolutely loved birds churruping everyday morning. very peaceful and comforting.

It was a wise decision to go for Fishtail lodge as a short stay in Pokhara after searching through all other recommendations. Very good lush green resort, with balcony opening to mountain forests, view of early morning Annapurna range snow capped peaks. Limited buffet veg options but good at Ala-carte. Very hospitable staff and nice room service.Only hiccup was a boat ride (complementary) everytime you need to go out of resort , difficult for old people or people with knee /leg pain. Immediate rescue was a big standing boat (a floating platform) available 24 hours.The boating point for long hours boating including 10 minutes halt at bahari temple is also there. 5-8 minutes walkable (after crossing lake) is lakeside main market wherefrom you can hire local cab. Food in fishtail lodge was better than outside sophisticated looking restaurants. It is better to book helicopter ride/paragliding/ ultraflights either from hotel concierges or direct airport( which are cheaper but harder to get because of pre booking) .We booked through a tour agent in market and despite reassurances he could not get us on heli ride. Such a disappointment of missing it. We went to airport and directly booked for Fishtail ultra flight (30 mins) and what an amazing experience. They do give good discounts depending upon quantity and day’s rush.Room tip - deluxe room with mountain view. Though otherwise also one can come out and view mountains all around . Very impressive, relaxing and completely in sync with nature.

Was taken here at the end of business trip across Nepal and was promised the best was kept until last... we’ll it certainly was.Starting off with a boat from mainland to get to the hotel you know it’s going to be exclusive...rooms are better than I was expecting (have stayed in these across Asia and they not been to this standard). Staff super friendly and personal, restaurant and bar great, pool and spa area again beautiful with the mountain backdrops.I could honestly picture coming here for a couple of days of complete relax. It’s perfect. And when the clouds clear to reveal the Annapurna range it’s like your in another world.Cross the lake to mainland and all the shops, bars and restaurants in walking distance... would love to return, thank you

First time to visit Nepal and this hotel made the experience so amazing. The team are all smiles when I arrive and they’ve been helpful all throughout my stay. I love how the hotel is situated in the middle of the water and surrounded by mountains. The room was comfortable and everything was so relaxing. Breakfast was heaven.This is the perfect place to disconnect. If you go to Nepal, you must stay here.

Crossing a lake on a raft, while tiny drops of rain mask the green background, makes a perfect day to write a poetry. That's also how you wait to see what lies ahead when you take that few steps to the Fish Tail Lodge. And you are filled with wonderful awe, when you realize your mornings would be filled with sweet chirping of birds and beautiful mountain or lake view while you drink your morning tea on one of the lounge chair outside your room.Fish Tail Lodge was a wonderful stay, coupled with delicious food at Circle restaurant.

Nice rooms and lots of greeneryPolite and very pleasant staff Little ferry crossing and boating facilities very pleasant and relaxing.Close to all the lakeside shopping and restaurants where we had some great meals.Would go back again if we revisited Nepal

I was with my wife and few foreign friends. The location, people, service was simply amazing. Would definitely be there every time visiting Pokhara and will give strong recommendation to all to stay and have wonderful hospitality experience in this beautiful lodge.

We had a fantastic time at Fish Tail . I was there with my friends who had come all the way from Qatar , Oman &  Abhudhabi . The management and the staff of this hotel gave the very best. The best part of the stay was -the breakfast by the deck with beautiful view of the lake ,  Nepali Royal Thali lunch @Circle Restaurant of the hotel , pool time with chilled beer  , relaxed time at spa, very clean and comfortable room and never the less the hospitality  ... we enjoyed every moment spent at Fishtail . Would like to thank each and every staff for making stay wonderful ! The hotel has a travel desk which arranged our paragliding trip, Chitwan tour .Just THE BEST !

Must Visit Fishtail Lodge It means We covers everything  of Pokhra beauty  of Nature .With Very Good atmospheres at Fishtail Lodge .Great Service and Support from Shri.Kironbhai and all his staff for Making Our Trip for 10 nights Grand Sucess With Variety of  Best Jain food served by Fish tail Near by surrounded Feva Tal and Fishtail  Ice Mountain...

My husband & I stayed here for 4 nights recently. Set on the waters edge of the Fewa lake only accessible by punt, this hotel has a beautiful setting, the grounds are gorgeous, there’s a great pool. The rooms, big, comfortable & nicely decorated with your own little courtyard area to sit & relax, the staff are friendly & helpful. We both had a massage at the spa... amazing! Well worth having after trekking! And great views of the mountains. It’s only a very short walk into the main shops & restaurants of town. Will definitely go back. Highly recommend

Great location beautiful gardens and great staff comfortable rooms, an excellent breakfast selection as well, If you can afford to stay do it, from the ride on the punt across the lake the experience starts

My rating is based on the world class location. Gazing at the snow covered high Himalayas, is staggering (if you are lucky with the weather !!) The staff are unfailingly kind and helpful, the food is usually reasonable and the rooms, although dated, are comfortable enough (in fact good by Nepal standards) The Spa was good and the gardens lovely.Another benefit is the proximity to the lake for rowing trips and the lakeside shopping and restaurants.

Our first stay at the Fish Tail lodge and everything was just perfect. Serene and tranquil setting with quaint shaped rooms and great bathroom amenities. Loved the fireplace in the main dining area- a very colonial feel. All the staff are very helpful especially the General Manager, Arun who treats you like his house guests and looks after you genuinely. The scenic breakfast setting, birds chirping and the privacy provided by the employees was just perfect- thank you for our best 24 hours and we are coming back very soon

The lodge is on the far side of the lake away from the noise and bustle of the town, yet only a 10-15 minute walk to the shops where you’ll find a range of artifices and food. Lovely hotel rooms, clean & comfortable. 2 levels of dining available( buffet & alacarte). Food was really lovely. Staff were friendly and helpful. Access via hand pulled ferry was a novelty. Great birdlife around as well. This is a great access point for everything to do with Everest ie trekking, flights museums. Also home to a peace pagoda( stupa) high on the hill - spectacular views)

This place will wow you when you first arrive. You have to take a floating pier to cross the river over to the lodge. Once you arrive, all you see is fresh tropical flowers, lushness, and an incredible view of the lake with mountains in the background. It's an amazing sight! We had a room with views of the lake and the mountain, definitely worth the small extra money per night to wake up to that view. The rooms are pretty basic, nothing fancy and the bathrooms a little tight, but things are clean and all you really do in the room is sleep. However, the fact that we could sleep at night because it was so quiet was a very welcome thing after having come from Kathmandu.Staff was helpful and nice. We had a nice massage which was very reasonably priced. Breakfast was fine. We ate out for all other meals.

A great place midst the pokhara city. Courteous staff and pleasant place. A place to be preferred who would like to be surrounded by the nature. Food is great. We had an amazing stay and would definitely like to come again.

Reception and staff went overboard to make us feel welcomePalm court rooms had a good outlook and had some of the best towels on our tripGardens are immaculate and the views of the lake and mountains are incredible In the restaurant Prakash and Devilal went out of their way to be of service and kept the huge log fire going whilst we had pre/post dinner drinks around itWonderful experience in Pokhara

Lovely locale; memories  which we will ever cherish. It's a great feel to take a boat ride to reach the hotel in the lake. When you walk in the lawns you can have glimpse of the  white clad mountain rage. You can have choice of cuisine from Indian to west.

Great place to stay, and you could sense the history of the hotel! After enjoying the grounds, you can ferry across to the mainland and walk about the town. We went parasailing and had an excellent lunch on a side street. Beautiful and fun few days!!

Location is perfect, being situated on the other side of lake and by the forest side. Which keeps you away from the din of the city. If the day is clear wide range of mountains can be seen. Have not stayed but observed while going to receive guests.

A very unique accommodation.  You have to take a boat to get to it from Pokhara!  Rooms are large and very clean.  The hotel grounds are beautiful and well cared for.  The on-site restaurant is top notch.  Great staff and friendly service.

My mom and I stayed at this hotel on our recent trip to Pokhara, Nepal. The hotel was idyllic, and the staff members were very helpful. It was also nice being within walking distance to Lakeside Rd and all of its dining and shopping options.

Fish Tail Lodge is an incredible hotel! The staff are so kind, the food is amazing and the view! You can’t get that view of Annapurna from any other hotel in Pokhara. If you book one of their Heritage rooms you might be able to get a view of Annapurna directly out the front of your room. It is honestly so surreal and so beautiful. You also feel a sense of privacy and luxury as you can only reach the lodge via a private barge which is operated 24 hours a day by the lovely staff. They also have the most beautiful fire place in the lodge - it’s very nice to curl up next to after a long day with a book and glass of red!A big thank you to Devilal and Fiona Noonan for making our stay so wonderful and memorable! We are already planning our next visit to Fish Tail!

Fish Tail Lodge was a wonderful place to rest and recover after our trek. Our room was clean, comfortable and cozy. The food at the breakfast buffet was delicious and offered a variety to suit any diet or preference. Using a raft to transport guests out to the lodge from the shoreline was a novel experience that we enjoyed. It also gave a feeling of calm and security in the oasis across the lake. The staff were kind and welcoming, and in true Nepal fashion their friendliness really made our experience even better. Fabulous views of the mountains paired with a quiet escape make this a perfect choice for any type of traveler visiting Pokhara!

A perfect place after returning from a trek or just travelling to Pokhara. Good food, excellent rooms, quiet, friendly staff... and fabulous views of the mountains (if you are lucky). In the perfect location. Could you ask for more?

We were there just for a night. But we enjoyed our stay at this peaceful and beautiful property across Fewa Lake. Great Customer Service, Great Food. Lush Green Garden. The weather did not permit us to witness Mountain from this property. Overall we had a great stay here at Fish Tail Lodge.

We were at Fishtail lodge prior to our Kailash parikrama. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. Fiona in guest services went out of her way to make us feel welcomed!. Ganga, the server in restaurant was one of the most hardworking people I have met. Also Dharilal Adhikari made our dinner memorable and was very friendly. The travel services guy, Ganesh was very helpful and helped us plan all our outings.Overall, the place is full of wonderful people and I highly recommend it!

We stayed 2 nights. To get to the resort you have to take a raft on a rope. The grounds are beautiful and the views of the mountains are just as beautiful.The resort is unique. Dinner and breakfast were good, but not great. We opted to go into town for dinner the second night, which was a good choice. Our room was in one of the rectangle buildings. The room was a bit small, but had a porch that we enjoyed relaxing at dusk. I would recommend it for a delightful stay.

There are two sides to Pokhara: The busy side with all the noise, shops, restaurants, markets; and the other side with Fish Tail Lodge and a view of the mountains.  Come here and relax in the serenity.  To be honest, it ifeels like a colonial relic, but it's also completely unique, well maintained, interesting / different, and relaxing.  Pay the bit extra (you've already come this far!) and do something you will remember for the rest of your life.

After a 6 day trek in the mountains, Fish Tail Lodge was the perfect retreat - but still within a short walk from Lakeside and all the restaurants and shops. The service was excellent - especially Fiona - she is amazing.  The room was spotless and the restaurant was excellent.  Being on the edge of Lake Phewa is the perfect way to experience Pokhara.

I've stay there 2 time in May 2018 for altogether 5 days.I've love the unique location away from the main road on the other side of the lake, the really nice staff and the incredible garden.On the cons side, the restaurant which offer a great ( included i tge room price ) buffet have a very over priced lunch/dinner menu which is really not competitive with all great restaurants located in lakeside.Also the policy regarding the smoking people is not matching my expectations as a non smoker and have sometime spoiled my pleasure of relaxing in the garden with lake view.Keep improving this few points and I'll definitely come again. I've already recommended this place to relatives who have visit and enjoy too....

A great little hotel in Pokhara, great location,staff very helpful and friendly especially Fiona. Wonderful views of Fishtail Peak and unusual way to cross the lake to the hotel! Best place to stay in Pokhara

You get to this hotel via a hand pulled raft. The rooms are nice we had a deck with 2 chairs so you could sit outside which was nice. The breakfast by lake was a highlight. Only stay two days but got some washing done very quickly which was good. Resterant okay.

We stayed 2 nights at this hotel, end of October - Very pretty area, quiet (you access it crossing the lake) a bit far from center (15m/20m walk). Yet, found this hotel overpriced and especially the food was disappointing (very poor breakfast and way overpriced)

worst experience in this hotel this hotel not for Indian citizen actually y i said that because we stay in this hotel 31st dec  2016  they charge us rs 11000 per with and rs 5000 per person for dinner but room is not that quality which i paid there is not thing in the room regarding food there is not thing for indian food only nan is there when i complain regarding food there management told that we have lot of tourist form other part of the world but i saw there is 70% guest is indian  when i told management about this they are not responding i went other place for food after paying rs 5000 per person for food and service is very worst after that next morning 9.30 am house keeping came and told me we have lot of room to clean so pls check out early because they have to go home early i told that we checkout before 12: oo noon housekeeping request that they have other guest in this room after that i angry and told what is your check out time then they told me that the check out time is 12:00 noon ...... now you people think you want to stay in is lodge or not i never stay i this lodge actually this is lodge ... never stay this hotel sorry lodge..............

From the moment we stepped onto the barge we knew our stay would be special!! The bargeman expertly coiled the dripping rope onto the deck as we glided silently away from the busy town into the tranquil tropical oasis that is Fishtail Lodge. Colourful gardens with birds and squirrels surround the hotel buildings which have a maintained thier slightly 'Old World' charm. Our room was simple, but emaculatly clean and spacious and best of all, we could step out our door onto the lakeside garden each morning to watch the sun turning the snows of the Annapurna peaks and the mightily Fishtail Mountain pink, the whole panorama, reflected in the still waters of the lake. Just beautiful!!!! It's only a short taxi ride or easy, interesting walk to the noisy, bustling  shops and cafes of Lakeside.Add to this, very friendly and helpful staff and good food, our 3 day stay last November was just a special as when I last stayed in 1997. I hope to be back soon!

What an exquisite view we had from our room!!!  As we stepped out of the door the entire Annapurna massif greeted us. Being late October the views were crystal clear and frankly beyond description. The room by itself was more than adequate. Yes, maybe the property needs a bit of upgrade but the views we had made up for the minor discomforts we may have gone through. The dining room served a functional breakfast and reasonable meal, but maybe it has seen better days. Overall its an experience I would wholeheartedly recommend. Get your priorities right though -  concentrate on the peaks not on the shower stall.

This is best property in pokhara to stay ever. it has cottages and you can see ever sun rise from the property. food was ultimate and they will take you to hotel with their house boats. it was ultimate experience. staff is very friendly.

Instantly loved the place upon arrival from Kathmandu, from check-in to departure. The drive from Kathmandu to Pokhara was long and absolutely scenic. The room and amenities at FTL did not disappoint. Food was excellent, the staff were ever willing to assist. My mom loved the garden with it's flourishing flowers. Excellent massage therapy as well for the tired traveler. Absolutely well worth the effort!! Keep up the excellent work FTL!

Excellent location. The way in on a barge was a novel experience. Check-in was smooth. Very helpful and smiling staff. The food was simply outstanding. The 'maitre'd' on the couple of days we were there was really really helpful and accommodating. He took good care of us, especially our 9 year old daughter. Helpful at the same time non-intrusive..a unique skill. Unfortunately, I have forgotten his name. The rooms were clean and housekeeping was perfect. All in all, a very relaxing and pleasant experience.

Fish Tail Lodge is located in the Lakeside district of Pokhara and is accessible via a small boat pulled by ropes that creates a great first impression and a wonderful ambiance. Once on the Fish Tail Lodge island, one is immediately impressed by the beauty of the property. It is extremely well maintained. The staff is wonderful. Extremely friendly and helpful. The facility and the rooms are beautiful. Well beyond expectations. The food in the restaurant is very good. Great views of the Annapurna range and a relaxing vibe complete what was our very best stay in Nepal and we stayed in a lot of places over the course of our two week journey throughout the country.

We loved every bit of the lodge. The ambience, the staff, the lake, the cottages and food and other entertainment facilities were excellent. The only drawback that we faced was that they provide only one password for wifi at rooms and only one device can use that. For a smart business hub like FTL, it is a minor setback.

I went to Pokhara for the trek to Annapurna Base Camp in Oct 2016. We were a group of 16 friends. We flew in to Pokhara and spent one night at this gorgeous place across the Lake Phewa. You need to reach the resort by crossing a small snout of lake in a ferry. Really feels exotic. Very clean, green, quite place at the foot of a thickly wooded hill. The views from the resort are unbelievable. You see big Himalayan giants like Dhaulagiri, Annapurna from here. Hospitality was at its best. Very tasty cuisine. All in all a very rewarding staying experience. Highly recommended if anyone visiting Pokhara.

fine  ambience good hospitality rooms bit small but fantastic location lovelly place for relaxation , a home away from home , the natural beuaty is there food is good lovelly breakfast, to dine out over looking the lake give a great feeling

It was super clean and luxurious. Breakfast was amazing,  weather was clear so it was nice to sit outside eating breakfast while watching Annapura and fistail mountain. Has very peacefull vibe. Super clean

Location, location, location! Not to mention beautiful gardens, great service, delicious food :) This delightful lodge is set lakeside in gorgeous gardens with views to the Himalayas. There would be hotels in town with newer furnishings and more splendor but the rooms at Fish Tail are very appealing, pleasant and comfortable with A/C, tea making and your own garden setting. A very short walk into town if you can tear yourself away and close to boating on the lake. In the restaurant there are plenty of interesting options but after three weeks of enjoying Indian and Nepalese food we were pleased to also find choices that were more like home. Free Wi-Fi made keeping in touch simple. Having travelled widely we rate Fish Tail Lodge as one of the best places at which we have stayed.

nice and clean, quiet, beautiful, good food, great service....Free Wifi at the restaurant The best place to stay in Pokhara.Also close to the shopping areaIn October the wheather was excellentand the view is the best!

Our family group looked forward to staying at Fishtail but it fell short of our expectations. The staff on duty at breakfast and during the day, didn't appear to care and adopted an indifferent attitude. The service was slow, but we first had to find a member of staff which wasn't always easy.In contrast the service in the evenings was better.The food was average at best.I would certainly not recommend this hotel.

We stayed here as family for 2 nights and I must say it was a great experience which I can relish forever.Location is great -only way to reach is through a ferry which runs 24X7 through security.You will live in just beside the lake from bustling city and having amazing views.The service is best quality and always they are there to help the guests.You can see the Fishtail mountain and Dhoulagiri from the room itself.They has buffet breakfast having wide variety-which will give you good start.Our Nepal trip would have been incomplete if we have missed this place.Few things which I would like them to implement:(1)There needs to be Direction from Main road as it is difficult to spot the off street road to reach the ferry ghat for hotel transfer specially during night-would suggest to have hoarding in the main Road.(2)Please have one library and daily Mountain film shows during evening(have one film on Pokhra and Mountains if possible)-that would really add valuesCons:(1)Washrooms are too small-though it can't be changed now.:-(Overall it's a must stay for Pokhara.Also make sure you do Sunrise tour for Sarangkot -hotel arranges the same through travel helpdesk.

I was in Fishtail exactly a year ago, and I have been so bowled over by the place that it took me this long to sit down and write about it. Memories of Fishtail pulled me along for over a year, which explains the pure awesomeness that lies here!Starting from reaching the place to the finest detail in their buffet dinners, Fishtail gives the best experience that one can ask for. If you are the kind of person that enjoys attention to the finer details, you MUST go here! It will completely change your perception of hospitality. A shout out to each one among the staff there! A very hospitable bunch of people. I hope you have a great time as much as I did!

Fantastic first impression when you catch the little boat over to the hotel (it's manned 24/7).A bit off the main street (I recommend getting a taxi if you want to go to into town for dinner as it's up hill, then you can roll home!) but a great setting on an 'island' in the lake. You'll be woken up by eagles over head and great view of life on the water.It was hot when we were there so also nice to cool off in the pool (although we were the only ones using it). Rooms were well furnished, if a bit dark. We ate in the restaurant and all of our meals were lovely. Wifi available for free in the restaurant and bar area but you had to pay for it in the rooms.Literally 5 minutes from the airport and the hotel has a car to take you. We left the hotel an hour early for our flight and they actually put us on an earlier plane as it had spare seats, so we were up in the air within 15 minutes of leaving the hotel room!).

Friendly staff and atmosphere, we stayed in deluxe room which was nice and clean in ground floor with garden view. Location was perfect. Breakfast was good but they should increase variety. No Internet facilities and Drinking Water in rooms,  Overall nice stay at Fish Tail Lodge.

Fish tail lodge was stunning place. So greenery by beautiful garden  and Fewa lakes around the property. We feel so fresh and comfy with friendly staff and 5 star services from hotel people that make us really impress and fall in love with fish tail lodge. Room was great with classy decorated. The strength thing of this hotel is room services in the night till morning. Breakfast and dinner was perfect without any complain. We were enjoyed every moment when we stay at fish tail lodge. This is the best romantic hotel ever in Pokhara !!

Spent two nights here and it was really good experience. Quiet and away from city noise, very peacefull place. Good breakfast and whole main building was very different and location at the lakeside was amazing! Garden was nice and had lots of space and good privacy.

This is truly a gem - accessible only by ferry, this beautiful resort is a haven with spectacular views of the Himalayas and walking distance to the heart of Pokhara.  The food was fantastic and the service was excellent.

All that is said about the Fish Tail Lodge is true, set by the Fewa lake, the Hotel allows you an experience that you might reel under for years to come. The rooms maybe smaller than an average hotel room but is complete with all the key essentials for a perfect stay . One has to get to the Hotel by boat, which run 24 hours, thus commencing a close to nature experience. The staff are hands on, polite and very helpful. You are literally on Fewa Lake, thus you have tons of activities in your backyard. From boating to climbing nearby mountains , to visiting the World Peace Pagoda. Its all right there. For a night out out or some shopping, all you have to do is take a walk from opposite the Hotel to the street lined with bars, local food joints and souvenier shops.The views from my room were breathtaking would highly recommend you make this your preferred Hotel when in POkhara.

One of my all-time favourite resort is this beautiful property in the Nepali hamlet Pokhra. The cottage type hotel is located in beautiful surrounding in an island in the Lake Pichola . The most interesting part is the access to the lake which is done by a hand pulled raft. Once in the resort, you will find cottage style living rooms scattered within bed of flowers. There is a beautiful landscaped garden around the resort with swings, hammocks for ideal relaxation. Rooms are large well decorated with modern style baths. The restaurant of the hotel serves multi cuisine menu and we loved the Indian spread. Breakfast at the hotel was also well very good. You will love this hotel for sure.

The moment you arrive you will go speechless. There is nothing to describe the beauty of the nature surrounding this hotel. The staff are nice and the service is really fast. When you book ask for the garden view chalets (on booking.com they call it a standard room).

Worth if you are looking for best lake and mountain view and quite place to relax. Staff were very friendly to us despite being local. I would suggest room next to lake and mountain view. Breakfast was excellent.

The room rate is expensive than other hotels in Pokhara but it is a royal retreat. To reach to the hotel's property, you need to cross a small river. There are hotel staffs who are ready for the free boat service. It took only 1 min.. So this hotel seems to be located on a small island away from city center. But it is not far from down town. Just 5min by tuk tuk.  Each room is a independent luxuary bungalow. It is old but still remained in good condition. The food is the best in Pokhara. Very calm and peaceful.

No doubt this is a beautiful property next to a hill which can be a great experience during other seasons, but we wont recommend during the rains.The lake looks like a big muddy puddle and there is the occational risk of snakes which does not help one relax- we could witness one caught - a deadly king cobra.The other problem with off season is lack of guest leads to too many attendants on call and a glut of food supplies which makes it difficult for them to keep fresh every time. On 2 occations we had to point out not-so-fresh food. Finally for a price to experience ratio, this is not a good choice as they dont really lower off season prices.For a small family with 2 children, we were charged for 2 seperate rooms instead of giving us a suite.

Fish tail lodge is like one of the most scenic get aways one can stay in. With mountains on one side, this well placed hotel provides a serene state of mind. While people look for places to disconnect, for a few days! Id suggest this place! The hotel rooms were nice and clean. The employees are really welcoming. My stay in this hotel was comfortable! Id suggest a must stay while in pokhara.

It has been long since i visited there but this property deserves a review.From the room i was staying in, to the food, to the management, to the other facilities... everything was perfect. The staff was very polite and helpful. The USP about the this resort is that it is situated across a water body and crossing it in a small boat every time was fun.The food was good and very hygenic. Their swimming pool was also very well maintained and clean. If in pohkra, i would love to go to this place.

I stayed at the Fish Tail for one night during a recent business trip. The Location of this place is quite exquisite as well as near to the night life in Pokhara ( Actually one can walk down About 2 km) The only way to enter or exit the hotel is on a boat, so there is always someone to take you back. Few things which need improvement is (1) Lights, the rooms are very dark, 2). No free Wifi. The staff is very friendly and helpful. They have nice garden and sitting area as well as a pool, which I could not use. The breakfast is quite good and you can sit outside near the lake as well. Be aware of the mosquitoes, though they provide a lot of anti repellents

My stay in Fish Tail was just excellent. Few things missing, which they need to add is1. Free Wi-Fi in Rooms2. Traditional shop in the Lodge3. Secured Parking on the other side of the lake, where you need to park the car to come to the lodge

i had a heritage room right beautiful view of fewa lake. i've never been in hotel like this. very beautiful entrance by boating amazed me much. love the staff working there. breakfast was awesome. the environment near was so peaceful and relaxing. i really love this place. if ever i come back in pokhara, i'll definitely stay in this hotel.

We visited this resort on the last leg of a wonderful trip to Nepal. It is located at the edge of the lake and will need to take a flat bottom boat for two minutes to get to the lodge.  It is a beautiful resort with individual buildings for rooms. The food in the restaurant was excellent and it was overall a very quiet and pleasant stay. We use this is a kick off to take him open cockpit airplane flight to see the mountains early one morning and we had beautiful weather  and could see the mountains readily. Overall, an excellent resort.

Beautiful place to go for a relaxing vacation from the mountain views, to the beautiful water... this place screams nature. The staff and service we received was phenomenal. Highly recommend this place!

Good but not excellent.Compared to similar hotels in the area, is perfect choice though. The only issue is not too new/clean bathroom :( otherwise good service, good food, very polite staff and No. 1 awesome view.

Beautiful setting, approached by rope-operated pontoon across the lake.  Unfortunately there was a mist obscuring the mountains which, we were told, are spectacular when the weather is clear.  The gardens are good for bird watching but sadly there’s no nature trails through the wooded hillside behind the hotel grounds.  Buffet breakfast with a good choice of dishes; breakfast eggs are cooked to order.  For some unexplained reason, dinner on the 1st night for our tour group was a set meal, which was enjoyed by some but not to everyone’s taste.  On our 2nd night we were given a choice of dishes to accommodate everyone.  Comfortable spacious rooms.  Our room had air con, TV, safe, fridge, complimentary bottled water and coffee/tea making facilities.  Electrics (220v) UK-style 13A sockets seemed to be unaffected by the country’s programmed power cuts.  Free wifi is available in the restaurant area, although hotel router connection to the Internet was intermittent at times.

Went for a weekend out of bustling Kathmandu. We stayed at the garden room. The room itself isnt amazing but clean and the view to the garden is so calming and just beautiful. We woke up early to go for morning walk before breakfast. Breakfast is ok. Massage was great and swim pool great too. Would go back.

One of the best experience ever staying in this lodge. Very close to nature, excellent service with good food. My parents, wife and son also enjoyed the stay a lot. No better place in pokhara compare to this place.i am sure!!

We were all a little sick and decided to check into Fish Tail in order we could get some comfort and good service whilst recuperating. Checked into a family room which was very adequate to our needs. Overall the service was excellent, be it at reception, travel desk, room service or restaurant. The rooms themselves are a little dated but otherwise a very pleasant stay. Views of the Annapurna range from the garden were amazing.

I have stayed in few places in Pokhara, but there is no place like Fish tail. The location is absolutely beautiful secluded, serene and close to nature. The view is breathtaking, with views of the lake and mountains at the backdrop. The access is by boat, which makes it even unique. The cottages and rooms and the landscaping are so tastefully set up. The staff are very courteous and especially the GM Mr. Pradeep Rana, who is a fantastic host. If you haven't stayed at Fishtail Lodge then please go back to Pokhara and soak it all up!

One would need to experience in real the fresh, great and exotic feeling as one gets to the jetty of the property. A calm, serene drift across the water is one of the most refreshing and welcoming entries to a property that I have experienced. As you make yourself comfortable in what is a little sticky process of checking in to the room, you overlook the stiffness of staff and settle down to the luxury of the place and ambience, overwhelmed by the looming mountains. I feel one should necessarily plan on an early morning reverie in solitude gazing at the whites, which surely could make a happy mind philosophical and grateful, and one of the most blissful experiences one could savour. Fish Tail Lodge is a very well maintained property. I sure can understand the multitude of visitors from different regions they may be serving, which makes them appear to be a little reserved or cautious, almost bordering on being unfriendly. But I guess they have their reasons. It is one of the best properties undoubtedly and the best travelers should opt this first for their first visit.

I was there on,y one night and found it very comfortable.  I stayed in a room in the 2 story building.  They also,  have garden setting one level rooms that looked very charming.  This was early spring so the spring flowers were in full bloom, especially the lupine.  The restaurant that night and next morning only served Chinese food. I don' think is usual.  The setting is picturesque being across the river for town. A very short boat ride brings you to the lush garden setting

When ever I travel I stay at this place. Thanks to the management of the hotel they are keeping the hotel neat and clean. Specially garden, lace view side, swimming pool and dinning area. The services are good as usual. Looking forward to visit the hotel soon.

Nine of our family members (age ranged from 12 o 70 years) stayed at the lodge for two nights. All of the members enjoyed the stay very much. Though the rooms are smaller than expected, they were well maintained and appropriately air-conditioned even in the middle of winter with dire fuel challenges. The ambiance of the lodge is breathe taking. One has to use the row ferry to come to the lodge from the mainland Pokhara. From there to the balcony of the room, the area is full of beautiful and well cared plants. That alone gives a sense of serenity when you check in and settle in the room.We have used all the facilities provided from the restaurant to the spa. Every service was thoughtful and personalized. We recommend the place for all categories of traveler.

we stayed for 3 nights .. the location is fantastic with a great view of the Phewa lake and the annapoorna hills. Reaching the hotel is dreamy, as the only access is through boat. they have 24 hr boat access which is very useful. The restaurant is excellent with good coffee and Great buffet breakfast. We had the traditional Nepali thali which is excellent. The staffs are lovely and the room was clean every time we came in. they have a thoughtful travel desk here they can help u in all terms. For us, it's d Perfect place in Pokhra for a blissful stay

location is excellent. it is connected to lake. rooms are clean as 3 star , food is good too. friendly staff. good location with lush green hills also view of fish tail peak early. one can take rowing boat ride too and fishing too.

Tucked away across a narrow part of Phewa lake and only accessible by the boat that you can see in many pictures. The boat staff were there for 24 hours a day so getting across the water was never a problem and added to the romance of the place. Also added to the security, not that there were any concerns anywhere we went in Nepal.Once over the water shops and restaurants were less than a 5 minute walk away and the centre of lakeside in Pokhara less than 15 minutes stroll.The rooms were very nice and just as detailed on website with everything you needed including a good shower and a comfortable bed. A very quiet resort for a good nights sleep on the 5 nights we stayed.The restaurant served an excellent breakfast which like all meals could be taken outside when weather permits and having breakfast one morning whilst looking at Fishtail Mountain and the others was something we will never forget. Evening meals good to and reasonably priced .Staff all lovely and couldn't do enough to help us.Travel desk staff on site also very helpful in arranging trips etc.Collect and return from airport (5 minutes away) for a very small fee.Wifi free in communal areas.Perfect!

I stayed at this property a night with my family. Staffs are very helpful. It's surrounding by beauty of the nature. while living there, feeling calm and peace by the nature. We don't have any comments about this property. Only a small thing, they do not provide free WiFi in the room. They have free WiFi at the restaurant and reception area. Internet service is very important for everyone in these days. I hope Fishtail management will give provide it free in the guest rooms.

We were traveling with my boyfriend in Nepal in March of this year, and we started our journey by staying one night in Kathmandu, and then moved on to Pokhara, lovely lovely city, and a perfect location to stay in. The location is quite romantic, you get to the lodge on a raft operated by the hotel staff. The rooms are clean, quite comfortable and offers an amazing view of the fish tail mountain, hence the name of the lodge. I must admit that it was one of our highlights of our journey in Nepal. If I ever visit Nepal, I would definitely stay at this location again.

Went to Nepal on a medical mission and figured I had to get to the mountains since I had traveled around the world.  Did a five day trek and my agent booked my stay here for the night after my trek.The Fish Tail Lodge was luxurious yet managed to have a warm, comfortable low key atmosphere.  Very quiet and peaceful.  The grounds/gardens were beautifully manicured with some amazing flowers and butterflies. My room was very clean and the bed was comfortable. I might have stayed in it more but it was so nice to sit in the chairs in front of the room and enjoy the garden that I was drawn outside.All of the staff were attentive without being overbearing.  They were there to help as much as I needed them.  Had dinner in the restaurant and the food was excellent.  The chef was even willing to make me a special order of saag. A small request but an example of the care you can expect here.If you want to shop, there are tons of small shops within walking distance.  Touristy yes but you can still bargain with them.When I return, I will stay here again.

The pictures do not do this lodge any justice.  From the moment we arrived every staff member was friendly and very helpful.  The landscaping is unbelievable and you truly feel like you're in a paradise.  It's meticulously clean inside the rooms and even outside.  The breakfast and food was amazing.  One morning we sat outside and the sun was bothering my wife.  A staff member must have noticed and brought us our own table umbrella without me even asking.  We were in Pokhara for for a week and also stayed in the Hotel Travel Inn as well as the Temple Tree Resort.  Those hotels were also nice, but they were nothing compared to this.  I HIGHLY recommend this Lodge!

We spent 5 days at this wonderful hotel - 3 days before our trek and 2 days after. Our kids enjoyed the pool and the garden and we enjoyed the quietness and the world class view.Breakfast was good and could be enjoyed outside looking at the mountains.

After a week or so in noisy and dusty Kathmandu we went to Pokhara. It was a wonderful spot, situated on an island (at least we arrived by boat), it was peaceful and meditative. We saw no tigers, neither mosquitoes, and we were well taken care of. The spa was great, perfect after trekkeing. Remember to sit on the right hand side flying in from Kathmandu to get the wiew of the mountains. We got to see the Fishtail from the hotel,and  its amazing!

We stayed at this beautiful lodge for a week in March 2015 and both felt it was the perfect location.  The rooms are very comfortable and the bathrooms very clean with hot powerful showers.The stand out aspect of this lodge is the kindness of the staff and their unrelenting willingness to try and achieve everything you ask of them.  From the bar staff's amazing Bloody Mary's to the excellent chef's food (look out for the brilliant Dargon Chicken...) they made the week very special.  We will certainly be coming back again soon and would now not stay anywhere else!

Fish Tail Lodge is so peaceful and tranquil. As soon as you step onto the canoe or boat to the lodge you start to feel the calming quiet of the lake and the mountains. My brother and I stayed here for 3 nights and were so impressed by how lovely and beautiful the entire compound was. We felt like we were on a retreat. Our room was a great size. Our beds comfortable. The TV had endless channels, which kept us entertained after a long day of hiking from early morning. The staff were so helpful and went the extra mile for us when a hike we wanted to do didn't work out in our schedule. The BBQ dinner we had was amazing. The chicken was cooked to perfection and we couldn't get enough. Fish tail is definitely one of the more upmarket hotels in Pokhara and rightly so, it's in such a beautiful location surrounded by the still Phewa Lake and hills of jungle. We are definitely coming back.

It was experience in Pokhara like never before. It was my 5th visit to beautiful city with lakes and mountains. I used roam around the lakeside and go upto Sarangkot and Peace Stupa for the view but Fishtail lodge gave a different experience. View of complete range of Machapuchhere, Annapurna and Dhaulagiri from the Lodge deck was so splendid that you would not feel like leaving the lodge and get into mundane of lakeside. Accommodation was world class with friendly staffs. Now I know why it has been listed in 1000 places to see before you die. .. Now I plan to be there once in a year for complete recreational.

This is a remarkable place - taking a small boat or raft across to the property is just the start of a wonderful experience.  The bungalows are comfortable, and classy, with sitting areas and terrific views - landscaping just beautiful.  The location is terrific - easy access to the Peace Temple, activities on the lake....and the most incredible views of the Annapurna range.  The staff are friendly and helpful, helping design activities.  Good food, reasonable prices - quiet, relaxing and incredible charm.Cannot wait to return.

We stayed here for 2 nights in December and found this property nestled between hills on one side and the lake on the other. You have to take a small boat ride to reach the property. Its the best place to stay in Pokhara.Their restaurant is also nicely done with some great Indian food.Highly recommended..

My Wife and I Stayed at the Fishtail Lodge for one night before we started our Annapurna Base Camp trek. We enjoyed it so much that we finished the trek one day early so that we could spend two nights instead of one at the end.Firstly you have to cross the lake on a pontoon, which is pulled by a rope by one of the staff, so there is a feeling of peace as soon as you arrive. the rooms are comfortable with all the amenities you would want. The grounds are well kept and the pool great and usually very quite.The breakfast was very good and plenty of it before you set off on your daily walks.The very best things were the staff who were friendly and helpful from the maids up to the management. and the views, every morning we were greeted with with views of mountains of seven thousand metres plus,, which vanished into the clouds by the afternoon.If I was luck enough to go back to Nepal, I would not hesitate in going back to this stunningly located hotel.

We spent Christmas Eve and Christmas Day 2014 in Fish Tail.  I had stayed there in 2010 and although I considered trying somewhere else was happy I chose to return.  While the buildings themselves are looking a little tired, the lodge is extremely well run.  Christmas Eve saw a great buffet and music, and management went to a lot of trouble to make the evening special.  The staff were friendly, the gardens and vista are just stunning, and the accommodation itself fine.

I chose to stay in Fishtail Lodge after reading raving reviews by previous guests and it didn't disappoint! Hotel guests have to take either a 5-minute raft or boat ride across Fewa Lake to the lodge and I thought that made it even more special. The service provided was very hospitable, especially at the reception during check-in and check-out. The hotel premises are beautifully maintained and our room was very comfortable, with a nice deck to lounge at. Would have loved to stay for a few more days at Fishtail Lodge and will definitely return in future!

The FishTail Lodge in Pokhara has a magical setting across the lake at the foot of the Annapurna Range of the Himalyas.  The bedrooms are not luxurious but comfortable and clean, the garden is magnificent as is the glorious setting of this hotel.  The staff are extremely welcoming and efficient.  This is a gem of a hotel if you wish to see the Himalayas without climbing.  However within the next few years it will need refurbishments as it is just beginning to feel a little jaded.

We went to Pokhara January 2014 and stayed in Fish Tail Lodge for 3 days. The lodge scores 100 just having it in a place surrounded by hills, green trees, flowers and the unique way to get to the place by pulling ropes while standing on a floating ferry. Rooms are antique looking and clean, loved their restaurants and food.

Fish tail Lodge has a very special idyllic location that is quite stunning particularly overlooking phewa lake and early morning sun over Fish Tail mountain and the Annapurna range. A unique place for breakfast. Arrival across the lake to the secluded hotel and grounds is very memorable. Yet it is so close and accessible to Pokhara lakeside area with numerous restaurants, bars and shops. Staff were very attentive in the restaurant. Pool and Spa were also very good. We visited mid September as part of a private tour arranged with Mytrip2nepal and it was great. Our tour company did an excellent job and I recommend them for anyone considering travelling to Nepal.

Without doubt, the best physical property in Pokhara is Fishtail Lodge.  To get there, you walk down to the lake, climb on a small raft, and are pulled across the water to the hotel by the raftsman.  Climbing up, you come upon spectacularly beautiful  grounds lined with fragrant, multicolored flowers and lovely trees.  There is a nice pool and rowboats and kayaks are also available.  On good days, the Annapurna range is reflected in the lake making you feel as though you had arrived in paradise.Fishtail has played host to many dignitaries over the years, and there is a series of rooms named after their occupants.  Those rooms are lovely and look out on the lake, but often have many people walking by along the shore, so be prepared.  My favorite set of rooms, the ones I like best for our Myths and Mountains clients, are the ones on the second floor of the long building near the pool.  You have a lovely porch and people are not walking by your window.The rooms themselves are a bit dated and small and bathrooms are not the There is talk of redoing rooms and if that happens, this could be a 5-star property.The dining room has been recently redone and is lovely, looking out on the lake.  You can also choose to dine al fresco, if the weather is good.  The buffet offers a wide variety of local and western food, and you can also order a la carte.The location of the hotel is wonderful for those who like to boat or wander.  Crossing back on the raft, you can wander the shops that line the lake or dine out.  The hotel has boats or kayaks available, or you can hire a boatman to row you along the lake.  Best is to take a boat either at sunrise or sunset, when the Annapurna range lines the horizon.  It is also fun to paddle out to the small island in the middle of the lake, where there is a temple to Vishnu  in his incarnation as a boar.  Here you can also find the "sacred carp," big fish floating near the island and begging for food.No, it is not the cheapest place to stay, but it is the prettiest!

A great location and an even better approach to the resort via the Fewa lake. Ideally located from all places of interest in Pokhara. Tastefully done rooms. Warm hearted service along with exceptional food quality in the in-house restaurant. Worth the price & time.

Visited Pokara for a weekend getaway and loved this hotel! Besides the break-taking view, which was best around 8 am--our sunrise view at Sarangkot overlook was clouded in--the ayruvedic massage was outstanding and the boat crossings were fun. Upgraded room seemed to only have the advantage of being rectangular instead of pie-wedge shaped and the luxury of privacy (no transiting walking paths with Chinese tourists photographing you). Staff are pleasant/helpful. Rooms super clean. Bath looked new. Breakfast was standard. Booking through Yeti Travel was much cheaper than through TA-affiated websites.

Recently renovated.  This lodge is located on Phewa lake and the rooms and gardens are very well looked after.  There is a big open fireplace in the lounge area near the restaurant.  Excellent food and service in the restaurant.  Did not stay this time round but saw the newly renovated rooms and they have been tastefully decorated.  Had lunch at the restaurant which overlooks the lake.

We checked into this beautiful hotel recently. Lovely ambience on the natural lake Fewa taal. No complaints with the property overall however if the management paid attention to smaller details, this holiday of ours would have left an everlasting impression on us. First and foremost, we booked 2 dbls and one single well in advance. Yet upon check in we were told that sorry we only have 3 twins available!! Now this is the basic. Why werewe not told in advance? Next was the welcome drink. We finished our check in formalities and yet the welcome drinks were nt ready. They were asking us to wait for the drinks!! That too after a five and a half hour road journey! Definitely not done. Lastly after we entered our rooms we found that there was no room service menu? I think even the smallest lodges have this basic item placed in the rooms and definitely not expected from this fine hotel. Now we come to the breakfast. Extremely well laid out. However the refills of the items took forever to come. And ofcourse the staff forgot that they need to serve tea/coffee to the guests at breakfast table. It seemed as if they were too tired catering to an 80%occupancy. Looking into such small details would enhance the overall image of the property. Hope the management looks into this and we do hope to have a better experience the next time.

A relaxing atmosphere, bit away from the hustle bustle of the city hence tranquility is the best description. Helpful staff and spacious rooms. Garden is well manicured. It may appear pricey compared to other pokhara hotels but I find it worth the spending.

I cannot recommend this hotel highly enough. It really has a special atmosphere and vibe. Probably because it is away from all the traffic and crowds carved out of the forest across a sidearm of the lake. The only way in and out is via the pontoon. It was apparently built by the Raj's and all the great and good have stayed here- especially in the rooms that have a view of the mountains. Early morning and evenings are very special meditating on the landscape. Rooms are comfortable but not flashy- it all has a 1960's feel which I think is when it was built- but we loved that.  Gardens are outstanding- spa gave a great massage-Staff extremely helpful.  A place to just chill but also easy access to the lakeside shopping and walking , boating etc. I could have stayed another week- no probs!

You open your eyes in the morning, you will see the magnificent Fishtail Mountain and the Annapurna Range with its snow peaked mountain glistening in the sun set amidst the clear blue skies. I couldn't ask for more. It's was relaxing staying here.Located in the Phewa Lake, one has to take a pontoon to go back and forth of the hotel which makes this hotel unique. The boat man as I called them are so friendly and courteous and so are the all the hotel staff.Do ask for the rooms that were stayed by some dignitaries/ royalties as those rooms offers you the best view - the lake and the mountains.When you visit Pokhara, you must stay here.

Came here for short meeting after a hectic day. The heartwarming welcome, natural campus blended with luxry and the excellent homely service of staffs (especially Bidur Ji, Krishna Lamichane Ji,  Prakash Ji) and delicious food helped to rejuvenate.

I have enjoyed our stay for 3 nights in May 2014.property is very good & services provided by the hotel is very very good I strongly recommend to stay here if plan to visit Pokhara . Fairy service is very unique style and we enjoyed our stay as special thanks to Miss Himani and  Ganaraj
Ambiance is very good, staff is very polite and helpful,  must visit place atleast once in a lifetime. Great experience..

We spent 2 nights staying at this lovely resort and would have loved to stay for longer.  It is a very friendly place to stay, starting right from the instant you walk to the Landing spot for the wee pontoon ride to the island the accommodation is on.  The staff steering this are complete gentlemen and clearly enjoy the work they do, always a smile on their faces.  Reception and staff show you to a chair with a cool drink and you let them sort out the  formalities before being taken for a short walk via the immaculate gardens to your accommodation.  These gardens are must for a good photo shoot.Our accommodation was beautiful, with a small balcony overlooking the gardens.  We had all the amenities from super soft fluffy towels, tea and coffee facilities, unlimited water in refillable bottles (although you may request plastic if preferred) etc.  The Bathroom is spotless and has an over bath shower, with a curtain -  which usually I am not a fan of, but this one works perfectly and stays in place and doesn’t come into contact when showering at all and no leaks into the bathroom either. Breakfast is one of the complete highlights and this is a combination of the food selection but mainly the outdoor seating with the top-rated views of the lake – out of this world and perfect start to your day.We sat by the pool one evening after sunset and the pool had closed and this was so peaceful and relaxing.The only slight negative for me (and this wouldn’t affect most guests anyway) was the Fitness Centre is quite small and doesn’t have any powered equipment such a Treadmills – which is what I use as part of a regular training routine)The bar is a great place to spend a bit of time in the evening.  The staff are keen to advise on drinks based on your preferences and will chat with you happily.Overall, we had a fantastic stay here.  It is a place of extreme beauty, well known for the fact that many famous people and dignitaries have used or still use on a regular basis – speaks for itself!  The staff are well trained and the treatment given to guests can only show how much they love their jobs and want to do the best they can.PERFECT

We stayed in 12,10,9  for 3 nights. Beautiful  property.  All staff is very cooperative.Food was very good. Staff is very good. Chef. Mr. Govind. Mr. Bidur,prakash,thapa. Ms.Susmita. I am in Hotel industry  for the last 29 years . Value for money.

Everything was excellent, the room service was good the fiid here was very good we met some of the staff members,name Gyan Bahadur, Himani, Rajiv and others who were very homie friendly, The swiming pool was very good the atmosphere around was good. The hotel's service is very good, the food is also great, the room is clean, unique, and very comfortable.All the staffs are very helpful and courteous. I would specially mention Ms Sagun Ms Himani Mr Gam Mr Dilli Mr Krishna Thapa and Mr Krishna Lammichhane.

We came here for a vacation. It has been an incredible experience staying here with Fishtail lodge. The place is cleannnn, incredibly beautiful, staff is extremely friendly and food tasty. I’ll return

Very nice location with beautiful garden .very good hospitality specially the dinner last night was very good .Staff cooperation very good specially Ms himani and Manish from front office .Ms jenisha and tej Kumar from resturant were nice ,prakash .Birthday celebration was awesome with cake which fishtail team provided us

We had a quick stay at the fishtail lodge,I must say the place was super clean, it was kept as real as it could be.You may all be surprised to see the dignitaries who has stayed in this beautiful property. We had a peaceful morning and the brekkie by the lake with the best view.

We are happy to saty  in this beautiful resort.service and food was amezing.special thanks to mr Bidur mr surendra and Manish who care a lot me and my family.we are so happy about good environmentGarden was  supper. Thanks alot fishtail lodge family

It was love at first sight for us... from the boat trip over the lake, towards lodge...we were mesmerised by the beauty and were at awe at the serenity of such scenic place. Room was very good and service was excellent all were helpful and caring .Food was very good and the location was very good.amazing view from deck thank you miss himani ,gyan and dilli for service .Room boy badal

Dipika helped in check out and was really helpful while the guy was very humble to ask for tea or coffee for breakfast. Nice vibe and great stay. Price was affordable and the cleanliness is perfect. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

An amazing peaceful oasis with the perfect location. Extremely friendly and service minded staff. Super clean, well maintained, great restaurant. We had the standard rooms, which were spacious and perfect for our needs. We have stayed in 5 nice hotels in Nepal during our trip, and this place is by far the best one so far!

Our family stayed at the Fishtail Lodge for a wedding in October 2022. We discovered the hotel to be not only an ideal venue for a wedding, but also an outstanding resort in general.The staff are extraordinarily accommodating, from the front office/reception, to the restaurant staff, to housekeeping, to travel/excursions, to spa/massage, to security, everyone treated us as valued guests, providing exception service, helpful suggestions and many smiles.Our event included a full Hindu ceremony, and it was coordinated seamlessly. The food and bar was managed professionally and tastefully. Our rooms were clean and fully equipped, including  hair dryers, irons and ironing boards, and a full complement of personal care items.The hotel is situated near the southern end of Lake Fewa, in the city of Pokhara. But unlike every other hotel in Pokhara, Fishtail Lodge is separated from the town by a small body of water. This creates a sense of peace and tranquility (visitors take a 10-minute hand-powered ferry to reach the resort). The ferry is manned 24 hours per day. From the ferry, the rest of Pokhara is a short stroll away.We treated ourselves to massages in the resort’s spa. Massage packages are available in a variety of lengths and styles. The prices are moderate by US standards and the staff are highly skilled. Next to the spa is a well maintained outdoor pool and chaise lounges with cocktail bar.The Lodge maintains a travel desk, which is available to help guests with onward travel, including airline confirmations. The staff also can organize a variety of off-site excursions at additional cost. We booked kayaks, a manually-paddled boat ride, a hot air balloon expedition, and paragliding.Wi-Fi service is available throughout the resort, including the well-landscaped grounds. The restaurant offers a substantial buffet breakfast, as well as buffets and a la carte service for lunch and dinner (room service is also available). Items are both Nepali and European. There are many vegetarian options. However, the real joy of this resort is the view of the Annapurna Range from the grounds. Fortunate guests can, weather permitting, take their morning coffee or evening cocktail in full view of the peak of Fishtail Mountain and several other peaks. The variety of birds on the grounds is notable. The landscaping staff keep the grounds well-maintained and clean.This was a memorable visit for us, and I highly recommend the Fishtail Lodge for the discerning traveler.
