The staff here are amazing, nothing is too much trouble. The rooms are immaculate, very well appointed and modern. The restaurant has the best food we had in Pokhara, with a great balcony to watch the world go by. We're coming back for sure.

I was on a photo workshop in Nepal and the workshop leader booked us in the Glacier Hotel & Spa while we were in Pokahara.  It's an excellent hotel with only a few flaws.  Those flaws are so minor that I feel I'd be consider being unreasonably picky to point them out.  The rooms are spacious, very well lit and comfortable.  The hotel staff are VERY eager to please.  The hotel is opposite a lake which many people use for sightseeing.  The Annapurna Range can be seen from the lake (on a clear day).  I'd definitely recommend this hotel to anyone staying in Pokhara!

I helped organize a conference in Pokhara in October 2016 and we had approximately 15 guests staying at the Glacier Boutique hotel. The rooms are beautiful and very uniquely decorated/furnished. The attached restaurant has excellent food, as does the bakery/coffee shop that is housed right outside the hotel. It is a bit further from town than most of the other hotels, but other than that it's amazing and very comfortable. The GM was also very accommodating to our group - would definitely recommend!

We stayed at Glacier Hotel for 3 nights. It has a good location near lakeside.After other hotels we have stayed in during our trip (to places like Dharan and Gorkha), this hotel felt like luxury and was worth the money although it is considerably more expensive than other hotels in the area.The staff were all super friendly and the owner was around most mornings to check everything was ok.Showers were hot.On our last night there we went out and met with friends for drinks. We chatted for so long we left it too late to order food!! When we got back to the hotel and despite the kitchen being long closed, the staff were only too helpful and arranged for some fries and momos to be sent up to the room.Breakfasts were top notch, best scrambled egg I tasted in Nepal!We tended to go out elsewhere for food, but the food I did see being prepared looked really lovely and presented exquisitely. We will definitely be staying at Glacier next time we visit Pokhara.The only downside was the temperamental wifi which should be improved for the price you pay for the room.Well done to all the staff at Glacier.

The design of this place is excellent. I love the colours and the sea-side inspired decor. The staff is very nice. The place is cozy, very comfortable, pristinely clean and a great place to relax. It feels like a home away from home. Also, the restaurant is exceptional.

Great location, Friendly staff, Newer hotel, Super Clean room, Good size bathroom, view, Free airport pickup, Fast Wifi, ... I say all the good things you expect from great hotel, except for theres no room service when you feel lazy:(  Great value!! Highly recommend!!

Great hotel,service was good staff was also good view from my room was awesone  .I had lamb rack in harbour restaurant ,it was so yummy and delicious. I had enjoyed my meal during my trip in nepal. Overall very good stay

Stopped by after collecting my tickets for a trip to Jomsom. I sat on the top deck with a coffee and omelette. The quality of the food and staff was outstanding. I will come back for sure. The menu was affordable and the restaurant was very very clean.

I was so pleasantly surprised at how beautiful the Glacier Hotel was. From the moment we landed in the airport (unfortunately our plane was 3 hours late, and the hotel driver still waited for us the entire time!), we were treated with respect. The rooms are impeccably gorgeous, the restaurants are incredible (one of the salads I had there is one the best I've ever had in my life), and the view from the rooftop is amazing. The value for what you get is almost unheard of. They also have their own boating station set up which is much nicer and quieter than the main one on Fewa Lake 10-15 minutes away. This is convenient and much easier.Stay here-- you will absolutely not regret it.

We stayed here for a few days, it's the dearest and the best. The rooms are beautiful even if some finishes are not to 5 star standard. The staff were great, helpful  and happy to help. The restaurant needed some heat, take a jacket.

I cannot recommend this hotel enough. The rooms are amazing and spotless, breakfast at the Harbor restaurant (part of hotel) amazing, the staff, especially the guys at reception can't do enough for you! I stayed in pokhara five nights and can assure this hotel does not compare to any other! Also location is amazing. Right in front of lake and centre of town!

We were here one year ago and had a fantastic vacation.  The hotel was so clean and well maintained and the staff were GREAT!! They always went out of their way to help and be friendly.  They even upgraded us the last couple days of our time.  The bathtub was so nice!  The views are great.  We like the location, which is at the end of town, so it is quiet, but close enough to walk places too.  Great breakfast too!!  Look forward to our return next month!

The Glacier hotel is a great place in Pokhara. Right next to the lake. Central location, on the main road with several shops, bars and restaurants around and a very short walk to the center of Pokhara. The rooms are Splendid, beds are super comfortable, water is hot, heaters work well, the decor of the whole hotel makes it clear that attention to the very small details was taken into consideration whilst furnishing and decorating the place. The restaurant on the ground Floor 'Harbor' is excellent, the service was amazing and the food was the best we've had in Nepal. Breakfast was varied and the restaurant staff are very friendly and professional. The owner was always hanging out around the place mingling with customers asking them about their experience. We were there for new Year and they organized a free trip to a mountain top to watch the sunrise on the 1st of Jan, 2017 - we couldn't make it as it was too early to wake up after NY party but it was a nice touch as the owner sent a private letter to each room inviting everyone and he joined the tour. The most annoying thing about this place is the WIFI. This is coming from a person who doesn't usually give much importance to Wifi and doesn't mind 'not being connected' however - if the place advertises that they don't have wifi it would be better coz then you'd know what to expect. You can never connect, then if you accidentally got lucky, if you move from one page to the other - you would need to re-enter the password and username - every time. It's very frustrating if you need to plan your next move, look at reviews for day trips, flights or anything really. I am aware that the internet connection across all Nepal is not that great but we had better wifi in bars and in other hotels in Pokhara and Kathmandu. For a hotel that costs you about 120$ a night - this is unacceptable. The reception staff's reply was that 'the doors are too thick' :) The other thing that was a let down was the half day tour organized by the hotel, they informed us that a full day trip is 90$ and a half day tour is 50$ - when we asked to alter the tour meaning 'removed 3 of the spots they recommended and asked to visit one other spot instead' they charged us 70$. I didn't think it was fair but well we didn't argue. The half day trip was a disaster, the car broke down and we had to wait for another car to come. After driving for about 1.5 hrs it turned out that the road was blocked and had to drive for 2 hrs straight back again... basically the day was a waste of time sitting in a car and seeing only a pagoda and a bridge in the span of 6 hours for 70$ - when i tried to explain to the receptionist that it wasn't a fair price she gave me an attitude and said she will check with her manager - then they still charged me the same price plus extra fees as i paid by debit card instead of cash.

After trekking to EBC we decided to splurge and relax at this hotel for 4 nights.The spa in the room was a selling point for us after trekking for 2 weeks and it did not disappoint. The room was modern, clean and the spa was just what we needed.The hotel provides a great breakfast and is confidently located in the lakeside area close to many restaurants and cafes.The staff and service were excellent. Whilst we were there the hotel held a large wedding reception for the managers nephew. We were very kindly invited to the wedding by the friendly manager and he ensured our stay was very enjoyable.

I sent my parents to Pokhara to get away from the Kathmandu smog for a few days to celebrate my mum's birthday. I was so grateful to the staff for helping me organise the trip. Not only did they pick them up and drop them off at the airport early, they were kind enough to provide a lovely upgrade. What really made the trip special was the delicious birthday cake baked especially for my mum to make her feel extra spoilt. It was a great time to visit as the majority of tourist have left in January- but the mountains are at their most visible from town. Many thanks again to the team- I look forward to coming to stay ASAP!

staff are very slow i waited more than an hour to get a cup of tea in my room   but the rooms are good and i  can see a good view of  a lake from therethe prices of a room is not suitable as per the services i got from there

The room was fabulous, 'spa' style. We had a junior suite on the 6th floor. The bed was one of the most comfy I have ever slept in. The staff could not do enough to make our stay memorable.Note though: the photos make it look like it is on a lake. There is a very busy street between the hotel  and the lake and busy side streets either side of it. If you are looking for the best hotel in the city this is it. If you are looking for rural setting this is NOT for you.

We checked in on 27 Dec 2016 and stayed 3 nights. We have an email confirmation from reservations that a Honeymoon Suite is booked for us. Surprised to be put into a 4th floor room (Classified as Family Suite)...(although larger than the regular room) while assumption was that honeymoon suite is something special (And larger, which is what we wanted for a family stay). We're not on a budget holiday so we wanted something special and willing to pay but according to the hotel this is what we shall get. Very evasive answers and are told that there is no room higher than 6th floor. But shocked to see a room on 7th floor this morning (the elusive honeymoon suite perhaps?). Rates and room descriptions are ambiguous, for example, the Glacier website does not list any Family Suite while the room we were given was classified as Family Suite.Hotel is very new and very comfortable and the stay was enjoyable, and the location is very good. Bang opposite the boating area on FEWA lake, and very close to various Café where you can eat for a change (We loved the Black & White Café next door)Some small things that could be looked at: bedside lamp that is for show (not connected and no power outlet to connect it), waste basket that's huge but a tiny garbage bag in it that makes it difficult to throw trash in the bag, amenities for 2 in the bathroom for a family of 4, a safe that was locked when we checked in and not useable till the end of our stay in-spite of the review and feedback given on 2nd day of our stay.The food that we ordered from the Harbor bar was good, but the Hotel could do well to keep the menu and telephone directory in the room, taking the guess work out of the ordering process. The Harbor bar menu is limited but what we ordered in the room was good. The breakfast buffet has a limited spread but is fairly good, just lay off the doughnuts (Needs a chisel and hammer to break into pieces, unless you possess exceptionally strong teeth) and the pineapple (Absolutely raw).Wifi is unavailable in the room despite the room that we stayed in being bang in front of the floor router. For connectivity, we had to either sit at reception or at the Harbor café. Which may be good, since you are there to enjoy yourself, not to catch up on work.Although power went off several times, the Genset come on quickly so we were not bothered until the last night, when the power failed around 11 PM. When the Genset kicked in, the Aircon and TV's power circuit tripped. The cheerful reception staff came to assist very quickly with a small screwdriver but had no clue as to where the electrical DB was and indeed, how to use the screwdriver. It was left to me, to locate the electrical BOX on the staircase landing, pry it open with the screwdriver since he did not possess the BOX key, and switch the breaker back on. That done, our room Aircon compressor failed, resulting in no heating. The reception staff came to assist very quickly yet again, but it was apparent he had no clue about how to react. just randomly clicked buttons on the AC remote and when it reaped no rewards, offered to shift us to another room. Since kids were already asleep, we declined and spent the night without heat.The dapper Mr Rajendra, owner of the Hotel, is always around to discuss, and in fact received our feedback graciously, and the situation improved subsequently. We were offered an additional room adjoining ours as well as a sunrise trip to comp us for the negative points, both of which we declined.24 hours room service advertised but in fact, the Harbor restaurant and bar, from where the food comes to the room, closes at 10 PMSo, the hotel, which could have earned itself 4 stars, ends up with 3 stars in our review for the negative aspects which we have informed above. Nonetheless, we recommend the Hotel to you as negative issues are minor in nature which Mr Rajendra could look at resolving for a better guest experience.

One of the best place to stay at pokhara, here food was delicious, Service was outstanding, staffs was well trained and professional, Room was very clean and well design with full amenities. Phewa Lakefront view best boutique in best location. Would definitely recommend to all traveller to stay such a great Place. will visit soon.

My friends were always wanting to have a rest, due to their previous heavy work loads, BUT I didn't want to just sit in my room when there was ""life out there""...I had a short walk around the corner to the Glacier Hotel, which by the way is very attractive, built of smooth river rocks and cemented together with white mortar.  They have a lovely little coffee shop (expresso) in a breezeway, decorated with swinging bouganvillia..Free wifi is given to you on a small slip of paper every time you go, and I went oftenFrom my vantage point I witnessed a wedding procession one day, noisy and colourful, and a protest drive through by very very noisy bikes and loud hailers.  Maybe if I was to return to Nepal, I might book accommodation here...

It was our Favourite stay in pokhara even compared to a 5 stars hotel ( fishtail lodge). This is a newly renovated hotel with chic and trendy rooms and impeccable service. I honestly think this is the best hotel in pokhara with amazing shower and bed. Food is great and needless to say the location is perfect. OH! And the balcony has the view to the lake!.. :) you will not regret staying there ! It's absolutely value for money !

Being that we are locals and live in our own little piece of organic paradise; it is rare that we wander far ~ that said, we can not say enough about the pure bliss celebrating two separate occasions Valentines Day earlier this year & Christmas ~ where we actually extended our stay an extra night!  From the amazingly comfortable beds, to the slopped soaker bathtubs, professional staff and delicious food ~ you can not go wrong choosing to check in here! Thank you for helping us create precious memories as we will most definitely be back. We highly recommend any traveler ..especially if your seeking a well deserved rest from a long trek in the mountains, having traveled on a budget wanting to splash out, ringing in a celebration or simply a little be of luxury!

We stayed at Glacier Hotel and Spa on Christmas night and it absolutely did not disappoint! We were treated with exceptional service from everyone, from the receptionist to room service. The room was spacious, exceptionally comfortable and immaculate. We were promptly arranged a driver for early in the morning, but not before we had an amazing buffet breakfast that was ready exactly on 7am, as was promised. I would recommend this accommodation to anyone travelling to Pokhara

Such a beautiful place and staff were so friendly and helpful. They looked after everything for us! The facilities were amazing and food at the adjoining restaurant was even better. We couldn't have asked for a better place to stay during our time in Pokhora.

We stayed but just one night as we had to go back to Kathmandu the next day but would have stayed here much longer. The hotel is a cut above everywhere else we stayed at in Nepal. The room design is appealing, modern and comfortable. The amenities are plenty and can be seen in the photos, of which the in room safe was the only one we saw in Nepal. The hotel is well maintained and the staff is friendly and informative. We stayed on the fifth floor which we accessed via the elevator. What we really noticed here was the attention to details; the plugs and light switches by the bedside, the full mini fridge, the stainless steel electric kettle, the toiletries on the counter, the ceiling fan and ac/heater, the small balcony off the room(I thought it was just a window behind the light white curtain), the list goes on... If you come to Pokhara definitely stay here, we can't wait to come back!

The perfect treat after a long trek in the Annapurnas. Or maybe just for some everyday luxury on your travels. New and fancy hotel with a central and beautiful location. The beds are super comfortable, rooms are nice and clean, and every room comes with a private little terrace. There are also big, common rooftop terraces. From here I'm pretty sure you'll have one of Pokhara's best views. Huge snowcapped mountains on one side and the beautiful Phewa Lake on the opposite side. The sunset from the rooftop is a must if you stay here!😍The staff are very friendly, helpful and service orientated. Full house from me! Definitely worth a visit 🏔🏔🌄Nytt og flott hotell rett ved Phewa Lake, Pokhara. Rommene er store, lekre og rene. Sengene er sykt deilige og alle rom er utstyrt med sin egen lille, private terrasse. Foruten det er det også 3 store, felles takterrasser. Disse byr trolig på Pokhara's beste utsikt. På den ene siden ser du opp på snødekkede 6000-8000 meters fjell, og på motsatt side har du Phewa Lake og frodige grønne skoger. Soloppgang fra takterrassen er et must! 🌇🏔☀

We stayed in a lovely room on the 5th floor. After travelling around India for 2 weeks this hotel was a godsend. Lovely smiling helpful staff, comfortable bedding clean bathroom and great relaxing eating areas. The manager is friendly and onsite. There are fantastic  views from the terraces of the Himalayas and the lake. Lakeside is the perfect location for exploring Pokhara.  A highlight of our entire India/Nepal trip was an early morning trip to watch the sunrise over the Himalayas (organised by the manager) truly breathtaking. We would definitely recommend staying in this hotel

My wife and I stayed in the Junior Suite on the 6th Floor of Glacier Hotel at Pokhara for 2 days. The room was very cosy and the rustic look was very warm and welcoming. Adjacent to the room, the 6th floor had a very spacious terrace from where we could see spectacular views of the Fewa Lake as well as the Fishtail Mountain.The staff was extremely courteous, accorded us a warm welcome and had a very positive vibe throughout their interactions with us. The room decor was wonderful and it was very comfortable too. The bathroom was immaculately clean and decent-sized too.There were certain things that needed improvement (which I why it hasn't received 5 stars from me). Firstly, there needs to be an In-Room Dining Menu in the room. When I asked the Front Office staff about it, they said I could directly call the restaurant and check what's available. That's just not right!And secondly, I saw no signage or even a brochure of a spa within the Hotel, which was weird for a property that has Spa in its name! We never bothered to check about it with the staff as we weren't intending to get any treatment / massage during our stay. But I would believe a property with a prominent Spa would keep its brochure and spa menu in every room.These two points aside, there was no cause for any complaint during our stay at Glacier. It's location was perfect... on the best road in Pokhara. On both the evenings, we went for nice long walks along the Lake Road and just enjoyed the buzz around. Also, right across the hotel is one of those spots on the lake from where you can rent a boat. At the end, we were disappointed that our stay at Pokhara and Glacier Hotel had come to an end. I can't pay a higher compliment than that.

We had a fabulous stay at the Glacier Hotel!  After two nights in Kathmandu, we ventured to Pokhara with our two year-old in tow, for the spectacular views of the Himalayas. Based on recommendations from colleagues, we booked two nights at this wonderful hotel and it exceeded our expectations! We reserved the junior suite and were immediately upgraded to the Honeymoon Suite upon arrival. The hotel was new, lovely decorated and the suite was terrific; very clean, spacious and charming with new furnishings. The views were spectacular, both from our room and from the outside terrace. The hotel is directly overlooking Phewa Lake and the opposite direction has great views of Annapurna. Also, The hotel staff was extremely friendly and gracious and provided excellent service and were very helpful and responsive all of our requests. For example, we were able to arrange the hotel transport to take us to the World Peace Pagoda (for a good price!), since we had limited time before heading to the airport. We also loved the breakfast and the downstairs restaurant facing the street which had great food, nice wines and a nice selection of local beers. The Manager/Owner was also kind and greeted us and spoke to us on a few occasions. Aside from the views, the location in the town was perfect; although we were not there to trek, we took boat rides on Phewa Lake, just across the street, and we walked around town to some of the cute shops, cafes and restaurants, just minutes away. I would definitely recommend this hotel and we would certainly stay there again!

After weeks of trekking this place was nothing less than paradise. Bathtub, warm water, amazing room service of smiling staff was just some of the stuff that made this place just perfect. Not to speak of the delicious morning buffet which is included. The only proper place to stay in Pokhara!!

We had two nights stay in the Glacier hotel with breakfast included. The hotel room is big and has some really nice and soft beds. The staff is very friendly and helpful. There is a lot of good choices on the breakfast buffet and the coffee is really good as well. At the end of the day a really good hotel worth it cost

I you like a comfortable stay in Phokara, this is the right choice! Nice room, good breakfast and some very friendly and helpsome staff. The hotel is located very good down to the lakeside street. Overall a good experience!

What better way to end a trek with your significant other than in the jacuzzi of the Glacier honeymoon suite? We spent an amazing afternoon and night on the 7th floor of the Glacier and would definitely recommend it. We had had the chance to meet the owner to whom we had told it was our anniversary... So a cake was waiting for us in the suite. Talk about customer service!Ok, some pros and cons:Pros: -the bed is so big and comfy- the jacuzzi was awesome to relax sore muscles-the huge private terrasse with great view- breakfast buffet was great and coffee was amazing Cons-water temperature hard to gage and rain shower not really working-bath was leaking so a lot of water in the bathroom ( but was drained quite quickly)- airport shuttle was not very clear as we were under the impression that it was provided but then were asked to pay once at airportSo overall, a big YES from our end to the Glacier and a big thanks to the staff and owner for their warm reception.

lovely hotel in pokhara - perfect place to base yourself for trekking.   rooms are clean, big, new and it has hot showers all day (unlike many others in the area that rely on solar).  Good restaurant and in a central location on Lakeside.

Place is really nice and comfort, staff very friendly and helpful.Clean luxury new place with perfect location and stunning view by Fewa lake.Owner is most decent and generous man in Nepal. He did the place with patient and great taste. Recommend the place for awesome vacation in Pokhara.

My husband and I stayed 2 days at Hotel Glacier & Spa in November 2016, after a 10-day trek around the Annapurnas. This hotel was perfect for relaxing with a cappuccino on their terasse, and very well located to walk around Pokhara.Rooms were large, clean and very recently renovated. Hotel staff was extra friendly and helpful and offered free transport to/from airport. Highly recommend this hotel for a relaxing time in Pokhara!

I stayed at the Glacier Hotel & Spa twice during my trip to Nepal - the nights before and after my trek in the Annapurna Region. Both times were fabulous! The location is ideal - in the heart of Pokhara and overlooking Lake Fewa, the staff were wonderful (particularly the woman at the front desk, who was polite, friendly and helpful on all occasions) and the rooms clean, well attended to and quite luxurious.I'd highly recommend spending the extra $$ to stay at Glacier Hotel & Spa - particularly if you have just come back from a trek and want somewhere comfortable and relaxing to come back to. I'll definitely stay here again next time I'm in Pokhara!

We (3 people) came back into Pokhara after a trek to find this utterly charming hotel. Great facility's, very well prepared food and extremely comfortable beds. The service simply could not have been better.

I was staying in Glacier Hotel 1st week of November 2016.  Glacier is new boutique hotel, located at lake waterfront.  In the morning you enjoy your breakfast with superb view of the lake from hotel terrace. Excellent service, clean and well decorated rooms.  Location is probably the best in Pokhara, with plenty of restaurants around.   I definitely will stay there again, if return to Pokhara and would recommend this hotel to all visitors who wants to have Western-like level of comfort and service

Stayed for 6 nights.It’s a Beautiful hotel, booked a suite which had a huge balcony.Totally loved our room, the décor , clean & spaciousFantastic locations with superb viewsFood was excellent here.All staff are so very friendly , helpful and attentive.The team surprised us with a 25th wedding anniversary cake , which was delicious.We had a complimentary taxi ride to the World Peace Pagoda.In my opinion this is the best hotel in this area , when we return we will be staying here again

This hotel was such a great choice.  The food was delicious, the rooms clean, modern and comfortable and the service was outstanding.  I would definitely stay here again.  Order the lamb chops for dinner, so good and a great deal. Yum!

After been out trekking it's so nice to come back to a great comfortable clean room with amazing views of the lake and surrounds. Would definitely recommend this hotel to all travelers in the area. Can't wait to visit again

After trekking the Annapurna range this hotel was by far the best and most comfortable I have stayed in with excellent rooms and facilities it was a great place to rest up with incredible views of the mountains and lakes I'd highly recommend this hotel to anyone staying in pokhara

Great place to stay! All round good service and friendly staff who are very helpful. in a great part of town. Will definitely stay here again. Amazing views of the lake and mountains. I would call it the best place to stay in pokhara.

We had a room before our trekking and after. I must say this was the best. We had everything we needed with a western comfort and luxury. The staff is helpfull and will do everything to give you a pleasant stay. We could see the lake and the mountains from our room. It is beautifull! We would love to come back.

My girlfriend and I have had an excellent stay in this hotel. We've stayed here for two nights. The staff was always ready to help and comply to all your wishes. We've had a room on the top floor which contained a very comfortable double-bed, ac, flatscreen tv, a hot shower and bathtub. The balcony next to the room had an amazing view over the city of Pokhara and its beautiful lake. A perfect place to watch the sunset at.

The hotel is modern, clean, very good location. staff is very friendly and helpful. Whether you stay there or not, you must try their restaurant-- top notch, probably the best food we tried in Nepal..

Great location, great service, great friendly staff, good restaurant, lovely and uniquely designed rooms. Very comfortable. The staff is very knowledgeable of attractions. Also available from hotel is a morning drive to catch the Dhampus sunrise. Also, this hotel has a lift. A lot of hotels in Nepal only have stairs to reach your floor. The hotel is a short drive from the airport. From the outdoor restaurant you can sit and watch all the diverse culture from around the world walking about. Close to many shops and restaurants. A beautiful area and a great hotel.

First, the location: in the main commercial/touristic street of the city, in walking distance to everything, restaurants, shops, lake, etc...Second, the hotel itself: large rooms with all amenities, restaurant and bar onsite, staff extremely helpful.Third, the rooftop: as if you need another reason to stay there. The view of the Himalayas from this hotel's rooftop is priceless.Overall I recommend this hotel with no hesitation.

The rooms are very basic - cement with a bit of paint but cold feeling. Bed was very soft, room was clean, view of lake and a bit of mountains from side window, just not sure why there are so many fantastic reviews. Many hotels have as good or better views and cost much less. Restaurant is ok but nothing to rave about, especially breakfast where nearby there are several very good coffee and breakfast places. I was not impressed.

We have never been to Nepal...never to Pokhara and had no idea what to expect.  A friend recommended we check it out.  I chose this hotel entirely based on all the trip advisor write ups.  It had nothing to do with cost as this is a very reasonable prices placed when compared to many places in hotel or when comparing to equivalent level of accommodation.  We decided not to stay too far out of town and the location was perfect.  We were here during Diwali and even the music was acceptable and turned off at a time that allowed for a great night of sleep.   We were in a junior suite on the 6th floor... Was lovely and as everyone said had good water pressure and hot water and air con if you need.  Sushmita at the front desk greeted us and helped arrange a car for the two days we were there.  The car wasn't the "deal" as we paid 50 usd per day for a car that when we were going up hill to look at views I prayed wouldn't break down or get a flat tire.... It didn't ... So all in all a wonderful experience and well worth it.I highly recommend this place to stay!

The hotel has an unusual rock face design on the Pokhara Lakeside. Inside it tries to keep the theme up but with a cold feeling stone and concrete design. However, the room is pretty normal, and its design begins to feel too cold. The bed is soft. The restaurant is ok, but nothing special. Compared to the many options available in Pokhara this is not worth dishing out the amount of money they ask for. If had been a lower price I would have given it 4 stars.

Nice and very clean rooms. Seemed to be one of the best places in town. Very good breakfast. The staff went out of their way to organise us soya milk for breakfast, but failed after trying hard.The restaurant is nice, a bit expensive and offers mainly Western foods.One big minus was that the spa is not yet ready and no spa services were on offer regardless of the name of the hotel.Very nice staff. Offered free airport transport as well.

When we checked in we were greeted with necklaces made out of real flowers, damp face towels and a glass of freshly made watermelon juice.   The room we stayed in was beautifully decorate, very big and extremely comfortable. The bed was so big that I couldn't touch any corners of it with my arms and legs stretched out! The shower and bath were both excellent and a rare luxury after trekking for two weeks. They were very clean with a flushing sit-down toilet (anyone who has trekked or spent a long time in Nepal will appreciate this). We didn't try the spa facilities so can't comment on them. The staff overall were extremely friendly and we really got a sense that they cared enough to go the extra mile to help us out and were always very smiley and attentive.Breakfast was really good with loads of choice - continental, cooked, cereals and fruit, sweet treats, real coffee to order and the best omelettes I've had in Nepal. The only negative thing I would say is that the wifi isn't very good, which was annoying since we were trying to do work and research - but then again we haven't found anywhere in Pokhara where it's good! Overall - great.

We spent 3 nights at the Glacier Hotel and enjoyed our stay...we were in a smartly decorated, room on the 6th floor facing the mountains.  The view of Mount Fish Tail in the morning was stunning!  It could be called understated elegance and has a  Mediterranean feel to the design.......There is a large terrace on both the 6th and 7th floor looking out onto the lake.......it appears to need some more comfortable seating areas to encourage guests to enjoy it as there is just table with a few chairs there now....The staff was kind enough to recognize our 34th wedding anniversary with a beautiful bouquet of fresh flowers, a delicious little cake and flower art on the bed.......There are only 3 rooms on the 6th floor...ours had a little sitting area, fridge, huge bed, TV with many English channels including movies and a rain shower head in the bathroom.Buffet Breakfasts were very good especially the lattes and other coffee drinks......the barista lady has her foam perfected, very creamy and thick......the espresso drinks are wonderful...... The only suggestion  the management may want to consider is the use of a top sheet on the bed separating the guests from the fluffy white comforters..The wifi seemed to be constantly dropping although I have noticed this is a problem all over Nepal....The hot and cold water in the sink and shower were also difficult to regulate...All in all the staff is exceptional, and get a A plus for customer service.....everyone from the owner to the manager to housekeeping to restaurant staff and bellboys went above and beyond to make us feel welcomed and actually pampered......The bed was comfortable and we slept well. The elevator zips you up and down quickly.....The location is excellent, we had our clothes washed right around the corner....6 kilos for $6.00.This is the best choice for upscale accommodations in Pokhara and was reasonably priced for what we got.....highly recommended!

The location is great - across the street from the lake with shops, restaurants, coffee houses, massage places, etc. nearby.  Our room - #2101 was directly over the kitchen.  Their is on the first floor and restaurant on floor 1.  The oven must have been directly under the bed, as the floor was very hot.  All day and night until around 10pm I heard a bell ring.  The bll was used for the waiters to come collect the food in the kitchen.The food was good, drinks ok.  The wifi was poor.  Did not work well in the room, and in the lobby and restaurants it would kick you off every 45-60 minutes.  When I complained, they said it was for security reasons. After driving 6 hours across country on bumpy roads, I was looking forward to using the spa.  That is the main reason for booking at this hotel.  We were told the spa was closed for renovations.

We arrived to this hotel after having a bad experience in another hotel the night before. We were just narrating our bad experience at the reception and the lady very kindly listened. They then offered to pick up our luggage from the previous hotel and upgraded our room! Lovely room, big bath tub (just what we needed after a long trek) and a very well appointed hotel. The service and the people are wonderful, smiling and ever ready to help you with any need. We felt truly relaxed after staying a night here. Highly recommended if you're willing to spend behind a great experience after spending a long time in tea houses on the trek.

Sadly did not stay here, but we ate here consistently and it never failed , they also make great cocktails.Staff are pleasant and attentive, cannot recommend this more highly.Food was a total breath of fresh air.

I had walked down to the lake early in the morning,disatisfied with my original hotel in so many ways after only one night. I turned and thought that looks nice, so I wandered over and asked to see a room. Questions was the hot water hot? Yes sir! Does the net work? Yes sir! I boooked in for that night and stayed 7 days (2 more than planned!) Everything was great and when the clouds cleared my host Rajendra took us up to Darmush to see the dawn hit the Anapurna range. Fabulous! But truly on a clear day go up to the roof and still see the range beautifully. I di that for the next 3 mornings ... This is the best hotel in Lakeside... do it!

Beautiful hotel with top class facilities. Room was beautifully designed, comfortable and staff was extremely friendly and helpful. Good food served at breakfast and also for dinner - generous portions and good flavor. Rooftop view is gorgeous on a clear day. Slightly more pricey than the surrounding hotels but worth every penny for a comfortable stay. Wifi quality can be better though.

The best place to stay in Pokhara after a long trek.  Softest beds in all of Nepal, as far as I am concerned.  Best shower in Nepal.  Best on site restaurant.  They greet you with watermellon juice at check in.  Oh yeah, and it's right next to the lake.

Beautiful and well designed, friendly staffsVery comfortable and clean, beautiful roof top with lake and mountain view, if you like to enjoy the view of the mountain with a glass of wine definitely take your wine to rooftop and enjoy the view from the perfect location.Indeed we loved this hotel, we stayed four nights in pokhara but unfortunately just two night in Glacier, the first two night we book another hotel because when I read the review about Glacier, I noticed a negative review about the hotel and the manager ( which we find out it was not true after we visit the hotel)so we decided to choose another hotel for just two night and decide to stay at same hotel for rest of our trip or pick another hotel while we are in the town, and soon we walk in the street the Glacier hotel catch our eyes so we walked in and fall in love with design and ambiance, the staffs are super nice we even met Rajender the owner of the hotel who's very friendly and professional and they gave us a tour of the hotel and I was so disappointed why we didn't picked this hotel in the first place.If you looking for clean, comfortable, perfect location and luxury hotel in pokhara definitely Glacier is the right choose.

We had a wonderful time while we stayed at Pokhara. The owner and his staff were very friendly and helpful.We had booked a Deluxe room, but the owner upgrade our room to one of the nicest suit on six floor.Thank you so much Rajenda (owner)  for the wonderful hospitality.Peyman

The Glacier Hotel was, as expected, clean and conveniently located. The Harbor restaurant was of great quality and so nice to have connected to the hotel.  Two things about this hotel clearly exceeded expectations.  The first is the staff, who were all so friendly, helpful and professional.  They helped organize activities and answered every question I had.  I cannot recommend them highly enough.  The second was the extremely comfortable bed, which was a treat to come back to at the end of a long day out. If you are looking to splurge a little on a hotel in Pokhara, this place offers great value for money.

The staff were really exceptional. It was a great welcome and they were always very attentive. The rooms are beautiful and rustic with stone walls and natural wood. Amazing bath, comfortable bed, and a brilliant spot from which to explore Pokhara. Brilliant bar, fantastic cocktails. It's the quiet end of Lakeside but only actually a five minute walk from everything else so perfect. Compared to a lot of the accommodation around, this is a really touch of class and luxury. More for a holidayer than a backpacker - unless you're after a major treat!

Had an amazing experience with the Glacier hotel.I made a reservation 2 weeks before as a surprise for my partners' birthday, and they were thinking out of the box for me.For a good price they would make his birthday even more special, included a 5 course diner.When we arrived, they made this day amazingly special; welcome smoothie, relaxing check in, with kind staff.They told us our room was upgraded to the Bridal suite, which was beautiful!!! There was red wine, a birthday cake, beautiful decorated bed, a jacuzzi, balloons, great view and balcony.The diner was also perfect. A Special corner was set for us, again with balloons, candles and decorations. The chef was especially making our courses and was constantly checking on us if everything was fine, together with the manager! Food was incredibly good.Seriously the best stay I've ever had, they made this day so much better than we even wished for..

Lovely atmosphere and staff, very helpful and accommodating. The food and drink are exceptional I would highly recommend this place to anyone travelling to pokhara.The staff were not only happy to advise us with regards to food but also great helping us plan our trips around the Annapurna range

Great staff, beautiful decoration, very reasonably priced and so clean.  Very much a western standard of hotel. Would recommend to anyone... In our opinion the nicest venue in Pokhara. The bar/restaurant is also well worth a visit. Prepare to be blown away

We stayed here for a while and loved the high quality of our experience.  Beautiful decor and comfort away from home.  I can highly recommend this stylish abode to fellow luxury lovers.  Everything went perfect and the staff was exceedingly helpful towards us and everyone had a wonderful attitude.  Exceptional.

My second time in Glacier. Was amazed by the staff, all super helpful and friendly. The whole setup is magical, from handcrafted dinner plates to modern Samsung tvs. The rooms are wonderful decorated. Overall this hotels has standards of a 5star hotel.My room was on the 6 th floor, with a big nice terrace for just 3 rooms and amazing views of mountains and the lake.Don't miss the restaurant!!! The food served there is exceptional good. Mr. Rajendra, the owner will be there to make your stay memorable and unique! Thank you so much!

The hotel staff is not only the greatest but also the facilities of the hotel are amazing. The hotel was newly built and all the rooms are well designed and very clean. Having traveled to many top hotels this definitely exceeded my expectations. This hotel is highly recommended. Having spent over 2 weeks in multiple cities of Nepal and being a big foodie, the restaurant at Glacier Hotel has the best food in Pokhara and maybe even all of Kathmandu.

I  was fortunate enough to be given the opportunity to stay here for some weeks  .. whilst on holiday in Pokhara.The warmth of all the staff and owner Rajendra ... who did everything to make my stay a pleasure. ... made this hotel very memorable.The decor of the room ... quietness at night ..  very comfortable bed ... beautiful breakfasts and good food at dinner  .. made me feel like it was my own home.   I  am a Caterer/chef and found the food of a high standard.You are greeted upon entering by Rada ... beautiful young Hostess .. and many other smiling faces.  Rajendra is often sitting in the entrance cafe keeping an eye on things .. making sure everything is operating smoothlyand being available to his guests for any of their needs or questions.The a/c is silent ... fridge in room ... fan whirring quietly  .. no noise to distract you from a good sleep.  Their are 2 open terraces on high floors and a rooftop to see the Himalayas looming over Pokhara in all their splendor. All in all  .. the absolute best choice for a discerning guest wishing all the comforts of home.  Highly recommended.

There are many hotels in Pokhara but this one stands out! Don't be fooled by views at other hotels because of the backpacker circuit. THIS is a luxury hotel with a fabulous restaurant. The rooms are modern, lots of room with light, airy colors and very clean! A nice assortment of toiletries was lovely. There are lots of places to relax either on the street level, balcony level at restaurant or on some of the balconies depending on your room. The staff is very kind and eager to help with anything you may need wether for your room or tour information and bookings.It is no surprise that the restaurant is #1 on TripAdvisor. It is excellent! We ate nearly every meal there because....why leave!The owner is there everyday and makes sure he has met everyone that stays there. He designed the hotel and has every reason to be proud of what he has created.Well done and thank you for a lovely holiday!

We had a perfect stay at The Glacier Hotel in the beautiful city of Pokhara. The hotel is deffinetely the best place to stay in the city with all the amenities you might wish and very good service. The rooms are extremely comfortable and you can spend a great time in the restaurant in its terrace with beautiful views to the main street and the river. The food and experience was just what we needed after 4 days of hiking in the amazing Himalaya mountains. Loved it!!!

The hotel room is extremely clean and very stylish, best bed I've slept on Nepal by far. Amazing service and clean, hot shower, and a brilliant TV. Watermelon juice on arrival with a smile, service was professional but also friendly and fun. I didn't use the jacuzzi bath but it looked legit!

We ate in the restaurant before we stayed and the chicken was probably the best I've ever had. The rooms were finished to a high standard and the beds were extremely comfortable. Staff were very friendly and I would definitely recommend a stay here!

Pretty good hotel. Three of us in one room and it wasn't crowded at all. Beds were super comfy and the shower was amazing.  Staff were both professional but a good laugh. There was a sweet Nepalese number waiting for us at the door who was very welcoming to us. Would recommend.

Had a wonderful time at Hotel Glacier. Unbelievable location on Phewa Lake. Extremely friendly and helpful staff, led by owner Rajendra. And some of the best rooms I've seen on my travels. Absolutely 5 star. Couldn't find anywhere nicer. Would absolutely recommend. No place better in Pokhara.

My friend and I stayed here for a weekend and enjoyed every moment. The Hotel is beautifully designed with a lot of natural light, and lovely indoor/outdoor dining with views onto the lake. The rooms were spacious with immaculately clean bathrooms and comfortable beds. It was rainy season when we were here but the air-conditioning was a relief from the humidity outside. Everything was thoughtfully provided with well stocked mini bar, good supply of clean towels and toiletries, and flat screen TV. The service was also exceptional, and staff were friendly, polite and happy to assist in any way they could. The hotel was only a short walk to the main tourist strip and just opposite the lake. We would recommend the buffet breakfast to start your day - the coffee was great and their was a fresh selection of fruit, cereal, breads and omelettes. It is definitely everything you would expect a boutique hotel to be.

We stayed at the Glacier Hotel for 2 nights at the end of our trip and it was more than worth it! The hotel is unlike anything in Lakeside and stands out for it's beauty and high standard service. The design is stunning throughout the hotel and features all the handmade touches a boutique hotel should. The rooms are lovely and spacious, and have all the comforts you could possibly need. The bed was luxurious and really comfortable. Bathrooms have high end fittings and perfect hot water. Room have a great ambiance with a range of options for climate control. Great wifi. Mini bar, large flat screen TV and desk also really came in handy. The service was of the highest standard,  the staff are wonderful. We really felt looked after on our stay =) The Harbor restaurant and bar downstairs was also a big highlight, the food and service were sensational. Highly recommend The Glacier, easily the best place to stay in Pokhara.

We had such a nice and lovely time during our stay  in Pokhara. Food is really good, Place is very clean and staffs are  friendly, peaceful  atmosphere, Just in perfect location in front of beautiful lake in the Pokhara city. I highly recommend to my friends for your conformable and easy stay.

Our stay at the Glacier Hotel and Spa in Pokhara was easily the highlight of our trip to Nepal. The luxurious hotel offers beautiful views of the Phewa lake which lays right outside its doors. The Glacier Hotel and Spa is the perfect location to spend your time in while in Pokhara. With the help of Rajendra and his helpful staff we arranged a number of activities and treks to the nearby Annapurna mountains. The rooms are tastefully decorated and come with air conditioning which gives welcome respite from the hot midday sun.

This place is absolutely the best in Pokhara. Great rooms, amazing staff, wonderful location, what more could you ask for? It's not too far of a walk from the main lakeside area either. If you're looking for a hotel that caters to a higher end experience then this is the place to go.

My friends and I are just finishing our stay here and it has been great!  The décor throughout the hotel and restaurant are tremendous and the staff have been incredibly helpful and friendly.  Here's a picture of one of the two rooms my friends and I shared.

Lovely hotel right by the lakeside. The rooms are really nice with very comfortable beds and AC in all rooms. The staff are nice and friendly and very helpful. The owner Rajendran helped us out with booking treks and local info about Pokhara. Would recommend to anyone visiting Nepal.

During a trip in Nepal with friends we stayed at glacier hotel and spa in Pokhera for two nights. From the moment we arrived the service was impeccable. The hotel is located in the heart of pokhara with amazing views across the lake and the rest of the town. The rooms are spotless, beautifully designed and the bathroom and showers are out of this world ! Perfect to relax in after a few days spent trekking. I would highly recommend this hotel for anyone going to pokhara.

This hotel sits facing the lake and is the most modern and welcoming hotel myself and friends came across. The bed rooms are exquisite and the service is very warm and welcoming. There is a wide selection of food available in the restaurant to suit all types of guests. The view from the top floor is stunning (see pictures). The staff were the most accommodating I've had in years of travelling. I would highly recommend staying here.

I was not staying here for a night, but I had been there to take a coffee which is in the basement of Hotel. The Restaurant set off is fantastic, & staffs are very helpful. The restaurant In-charge Sandesh was awesome guy. We got the fabulous taste of coffee. The restaurant location & view from there is lovely which is in the side of FEWA Lake. We enjoyed with hotel staffs & beautiful views of lake & forest.

My two best mates from professional school and I had planned a trekking trip to Nepal and were approached by Rajendir while reviewing our trek over breakfast at his restaurant The Harbor.  He was kind and helpful with organizing our approach to the Himalayas and suggested that we stay in his hotel after our trek.  On our return to Pokhara, exhausted and weathered, we were treated to cool cucumber-lemon infused towels and freshly pressed watermelon juice.  Our room, like the rest of the hotel, was modelled after a nautical Mediterranean theme with elements of Balinese woodwork.  Rajendir personally designed the hotel and oversaw the inclusion of stonework from his property into the vertical pillars and walls of the main supports.  A careful student of interior design, Rajendir clearly has an eye for tasteful mixing of eastern and western design elements that infuse his hotel with an artistic and classic style.  It is, as far as we have seen, the most beautiful hotel in Pokhara.  It is also directly across from an emerald-hued lake that lends the town it's name. In short, we had a wonderful stay in a wondrous hotel.  Highly recommended!

Our stay here met every single one of our needs with comfy beds, air con and the most incredible restaurant attached!Every member of staff was amazing and they made a beautiful birthday cake for my friend!Breakfast was included in our stay which was an added luxury and the welcoming fresh watermelon juice and cold towel was a bonus! Beautiful views, wonderful food and an altogether incredible experience!

The glacier hotel was a very beautiful and peaceful lodging in Pokhara. Rajendra was incredibly helpful with our trekking plans. Highly recommended! Great views of surrounding mountains and lake from the rooftop patio.

Great place for a getaway and secret gem of pokhara!! Glacier boutique (in house restaurant - the harbor) has the best food and customer service in Pokhara. Staff are very well trained, friendly, professional and prompt.  I saved a lot more money staying at Glacier than I would have if I stayed at Temple Tree. I loved Temple Tree, but after staying in both hotels I'd choose glacier because of the personal attention and value. Your dollar goes a long way at glacier. Those who have stayed here would strongly agree with everything I said above. Talk to both reservations before booking and you will see that Glacier will give you the better deal.This place is good to stay for business, a honeymoon, and  while traveling with friends or family. I stayed here for 3 nights and 4 days. Before booking my stay at Glacier, I was considering to stay at Temple Tree because I stayed there a few nights previously and it was excellent. However, if I come to Pokhara again I will always stay at glacier boutique. The only difference between the two hotels is the pool and spa. Glacier does not have a pool and they are in the process of building a spa. If you really want to swim you can pay 600 rupees to use the pool at temple tree.The attention to detail in all my meals and mindfulness did not go unnoticed. The interior design was also something I couldn't stop raving about to my friends and family. You have to see for yourself and you will be in awe. There is nothing else like this in pokhara. Book your stay at glacier and set your expectation very high because you will not be disappointed. You will receive consistently friendly treatment, free Wi-Fi, free fresh breakfast, quality shampoos, toothbrush, razor and shave gel, free pick up and drop off at airport, free newspapers, freshly made watermelon juice upon arrival. I can go on. Before leaving to the airport they printed my boarding pass for me. So many things were taken care of for me which gave me a chance to relax and truly enjoy Pokhara.I felt very sad on my last morning at Glacier because I will miss the hospitality and delicious food.

brand new bathrooms! fresh linens! flourless chocolate cake, which I had everyday!!fantastic staff & service!!! great location, water views, shops, everything is at your finger tips! the hotel restaurant is amazing with vegetarian options!! we had a wonderful experience!

Stayed here recently for two nights . First and foremost the rooms are  really beautiful , the beds lovely and soft and great a/c. I felt so comfortable here , like a home from home . Friendly staff who pay huge attention to detail . Couldn't recommend this place enough . I'll be back for sure !

This has being the highlight of my stay in pokhara. First we came here for breakfast a couple of mornings, then decided to move over. From the moment we checked in!! The staff couldn't do enough for you. So friendly, welcoming and great for information.The decor is spectacular, bed like sleeping on a marshmallow are 12 days of trekking , it certainly was a treat. Room service was great.On the 6th floor we could have cocktails in the evening while overlooking the whole of pokhara. The best views in town.Will definitely love to come back and stay again. Unforgettable Thanks Rajendra

Great boutique hotel. The hotel deserves the price I paid for. Nice room, clean and spacious. Staff is welcoming and nice. Restaurant is good. The owner is a the general manager and his presence is a goodwill for guest. I arranged for us a daily trip. Nice surprice in a wanderful place. I really recomend this hotel. Grazie/thanks Gracier team to be so nice and kind as all Nepal people are

Very pleased with the service I received at glacier hotel. The room was very generous in side and immaculate. Fully air conditioned and very quiet so a good night sleep was insured. I would highly recommend.

The staff, the room, the views all surpassed my expectations. Location is perfect. Cannot imagine a better stay great restaurant beside it and a special mention to the staff who could not do enough for me!

Everything about the Glacier Hotel surpassed my expectations.  The building itself was so beautiful, made of stone and with peaceful fountains near the entryway.  The food was exquisite, and breakfast was included.  The poached eggs were quite possibly the best that I've had in my life!  The service was so wonderful - the staff there was incredibly friendly and made me feel valued and recognized.  I really loved that they had room service and I was able to get fresh baked pie delivered to my room every night.   :)  We had initially planned on staying 2 nights but kept extending our stay (all the way to 8 nights!) because it was such an incredible place to be and it was so reasonably priced!

Lovely rooms, excellent location and really upmarket. All for a super price. I checked out other hotels during our week stay and this one is the best. Big rooms and well decorated. Each floor only has a couple of rooms and there is a terrace on each floor where you can see the mountains. This place is really upmarket, better than anywhere I have yet to find in Kathmandu.

My girlfriend and I stayed here for 2 nights and were blown away by the proffessional and attentative staff and the beautiful room. Very clean, great wifi, epic air con, dreamy bed and luxurious spa with a window overlooking the city. Go to the restaurant downstairs and try the pork belly it was incredible!

My partner and I stayed in a double AC room and our experience was awesome. The room was beautifully decorated with a hot shower and tv. Felt like royalty as the staff are extremely helpful, polite and attentive. Disappointed I couldn't stay longer. Will be back! 😊

Although a short stay, this is a beautiful hotel in a perfect location, right across from Lake Fewa in downtown Pokhara. The bed is SO comfortable and the room I stayed in was quite big. Everything was exceptionally clean and there was a beautiful view of the town from the room (I was on the 6th floor). Above all though was the customer service - everyone was so thoughtful and considerate throughout my time there. Don't forget to eat the steamed momos from the restaurant and take advantage of the free airport shuttle. Thank you, Glacier Hotel for such an incredible stay!

I stayed in mid of June this year. The location of the property is great. The rooms and other facilities are clean and nicely done. The staffs are well trained and very accommodating. I surely recommend to stay in this and can't wait to come back to beautiful Pokhara.

We checked into this property by chance. We were in Nepal last week and were returning from Kathmandu. We were actually supposed to check in at Hotel Barahi but it being late in night and a rainy weather, we could not find the place. We landed up at Hotel Glacier and were immediately mesmerized by the looks of the property. We took no time in deciding and checking into the rooms . The rooms and tastefully designed and have all the amenities that are required in a luxury property.The staff is very courteous and warm. The breakfast choice is truly great and the lids enjoyed their meals. Overall i must say that this is a great place to stay and spend time together when one is in Pokhara.

This Hotel is situated next to Fewa lake. Rooms are spacious, neat and clean. There are every facilities available in the room. Food is delicious. They have bar and cafeteria too. Wifi is bit slow. Services and staff are fabulous. I stayed in this property for 3 nights. I recommend room on 5th floor right side which has lake and mountain view.

located a bit further away from the main center in lakeside! but this hotel is in lakeside, just a few walk able distance from the center. However, the amenities near the hotels are perfect too. The rooms are beautiful, and the service is exceptional. Overall, a good stay, good food and good and friendly staff.

This hotel simply provided one of the best services ever. And I had just stayed at Burj Khalifa and other 5 star hotels in South of France and London just this past month. It's not just good service but genuine kindness that makes you feel at home. Every single staff is always greeting with a smile, and asking how they can make my stay better. I left the hotel (with a free airport drop off) with a smile and a business card from the hotel manager himself who cared for my stay from the start. He gave us a free room upgrade since the spa facilities were closed due to maintenance. I got to enjoy the in-room jacuzzi tub after the long Annapurna trekking trip, and enjoy the city view from the room and rooftop terraces. Breakfast was so delicious and had a superb presentation which made our mornings. The location is seriously the best you will find. You can see the lake, mountains and the city from the top floor rooms. It's located centrally by all the shops in the lakeside but still tucked away enough to avoid the loudest noise in the lake side. The restaurant at the hotel is no. 1 on Tripadvisor and the next door restaurant Cafe Concerto is no.2. You really don't have to walk that far. Now, despite the amazing service there's still room for improvement for facilities. Inevitability due to the hotel's proximity to the nature, there's a lot of bugs. The windows should close without gaps to keep the bugs out. One of my shower heads (out of 2) didn't work properly so that was sad. Wifi is good for Pokhara but could be more stable. We also found out comically that the hotel charges absurd amount of money for laundry when they actually give it to a small vendor next door that takes 1 kg for 50 rupees. We found out while enjoying the view from our balcony, that we noticed our clothes hanging from a rooftop of a laundry vendor next door. So I would advise you to just go there and do laundry there. Attaching photos. Despite some hiccups I would highly highly recommend this place. I would definitely go back!

I wish I could write a more positive review for this restaurant; it is a new, ambitious concept for the Pokhara area. Unfortunately considering the menu prices, service and food don't match. I've been here twice and have left disappointed both times. My first meal I ordered a fish which arrived in foil with no seasoning. The second meal again lacked flavor and zest, and service had to be flagged down for water and for the check. There are better places in Pokhara where you can get "more bang for your buck" and sit in a better seating environment than right off the street.

After a very long bus journey and a battle with all the taxi drivers after arriving in pokhara we made our way to the lake. After getting dropped off down the road from glacier hotel we made our way to the harbor restaurant to get out bearings. After eating a delicious meal we realised that it was a hotel as well so decided to book a night before our 8 day trek (best idea ever)Everything about the hotel was great. The really helpful hotel staff so happy to give advice or a hand, to the incredible food we had from room service (we thought we'd utilize the room as much as possible) my girlfriend had carbonara and she absolutely loved it, the pasta is all made in house and you can taste it. I had mutton ribs with mash potato and salad, and the meat was done to perfection rather than overcooked like most places. We also had a huge breakfast in bed as well which was top notch!  The bed is so comfortable! Great big duvet which you can use thanks to the air con. I'm actually still in it now I don't really want to leave. (maybe to have a bath)All round ideal pre of post trek hotel or Just somewhere to completely relax 100% returning!

My boyfriend and I happened to drive past in our taxi after arriving in Pokhara and we immediately asked the driver to pull over as it looked lovely. We were greeted by incredibly friendly and kind waiters and chose a tab,e at the front near the road to get a good view of the lake on the other side. It started to rain not long after we sat down and the staff were very attentive in moving our things for us to ensure that they didn't get wet. The food was great, I ordered the Greek Salad and my boyfriend had the Bandel dish, both of which were perfect. We also ordered some Bloody Marys which were the nicest I've had in a very long time! I would highly recommend this place!

I stayed for 3 nights at the Glacier after doing a week-long trek.  It felt incredibly comfortable and luxurious after teahouse trekking!  The rooms were clean and comfortable, and I basically had the 6th floor balcony all to myself.  The breakfast every morning was delicious, and I couldn't get enough of the fresh watermelon juice.  The location is excellent.  The hotel staff went above and beyond to help me sort out onward travel logistics and make local recommendations.  Highly recommend!

We wanted a place for afternoon tea and by chance spotted the Glacier Hotel. We sat outside and enjoyed tea and a delicious slice of Lemon Meringue pie and watched the world go by. It was so good we returned for more pie after our 5 day trek!!

I stayed at the Glacier Hotel in Pokhara for a week. The location at Lakeside is excellent (central and convenient). The room was very comfortable and well kept; I like the modern aquatic theme. Good range of Western and local choices on the restaurant menu. All staff in the hotel are friendly and attentive.The only issue I had was that the wi-fi in my room (4th floor, farthest from the lift) was weak. However, wi-fi in the public areas was fine.

We stayed at the Hotel Glacier (and Spa) on Lakeside, Pokhara for 5 nights with our 12 month-old, having previously stayed in other places a few days before. We ate here every day at their 'Harbor' restaurant and cafe' as the food is such high quality (they have an Aussie and Nepalese chef) but found the prices to be the same as that of other simple cafés in the same vicinity. The rooms are arguably the best in Pokhara; after three previous trips to Nepal as single people, we needed somewhere with a few luxuries now that we were travelling with a young baby. The rooms are huge, with excellent AC, plus fans, good TV channels (not that you would want to watch too much in Nepal!), huge, comfy beds with soft pillows and mattress's. No expenses have been spared on the high quality decor of the rooms. Wifi is excellent. We had our own HUGE terrace (and whole floor- yes, we felt like Maharajas'!). The staff are sweet, friendly and speak perfect English. They arranged a trip for us pretty cheaply, something that was easier with baby and they offer a lovely car with AC pick-up to and from the airport though we just used this on the way out. The rooms have large, whirlpool baths, great rain showers, constant hot water and high, lofty ceilings. The hotel is in a lovely position directly in front of the lake itself, but still quiet, and the area is busy but on the slightly prettier side of Fewa Lake-perfect.I've travelled a lot over the course of 16 years and this hotel is one of the best I've ever stayed in. The sweeping views from the terrace eating breakfast are so beautiful and serene. We were treated like royalty and our baby was held whilst we ate breakfast. The staff couldn't do enough for us. Compared to simpler guesthouses within the area, for a smaller amount more, the benefits we found at the Glacier were quite significant. The owner has clearly invested an extraordinary amount of time and love to make this hotel easily the best in Pokhara. You must see the rooms to believe them! My parents want to come out next year so they can stay here. A lovely place, best position in Pokhara, pretty amazing digs if you want a treat after a trek and definitely somewhere I wish I had discovered earlier! 10/10.

I am impressed by the nice deco and spectacular view of the hotel. Free breakfast can be ordered by alacart menu. Steady electricity supply and high speed wifi.  Excellent locations surrounded by restaurants and spas. Highly recommended for those coming here for relaxation.

situated by the lake,this hotel has beautifully decorated rooms.The rooms are well furnished and very clean.The staff are very friendly and helpful.We were able to store unwanted luggage at the hotel at no cost whilst we trekked in the Hymalayas.Hire a boat and driver across from the hotel (these are managed by the hotel so make sure you mention your a guest for a discount) to travel over to the landing area for the walk up to the peace Stuppa.

We moved to this hotel after a bad experience in another hotel in Pokhara (Hotel Dahlia). Our stay here was fantastic. The staff were so accommodating and helpful. The rooms are great, hot water & wifi every day. The food was fantastic- they have a spotless kitchen with a choice of Nepalese, Indian and European dishes. The breakfast was superb. The cherry on the cake was the last day: our flight to Kathmandu was cancelled due to poor visibility (this happens A LOT) so we had to take a car to Kathmandu (6 hours). Our hotel picked us up from the airport, organised an air conditioned van for all of us (10 people) and packed us free lunch boxes! There is nothing that they cannot do to make your life easier. Superb stay, superb hotel & staff. Will certainly come back next time we are in Nepal.

We stayed at the newly built glacier hotel and spa for 3 nights total. The staff is very friendly and helpful at all times. We got a great deal and an upgrade on top of it. So we enjoyed our stay in a suite. There was plenty of room, a beautiful interior and 3 (!!) balconies. As a resident in Nepal, I have never experienced that much (and quickly accessible) hot water with such a pressure!:) So to enjoy the whirlpool in our bathroom was very pleasant.Unfortunately the wifi didn't work for most of the stay in our room, but in the lobby only. Also the staff was almost too attentive for my taste, others might like it though. The hotel is not a 100% finished, as the Spa section is not there yet. But as I said, we got a great deal (it is on the higher price class but also a luxurious hotel) and the staff immediately recommended us other places to go for Spa treatments.Coming from a country where breakfast means much, we loved having the first meal of the day (included) at the restaurant of the hotel. Different than in many places, you get even the cappuccino, fresh fruit juice and many things on order included. So no extra charges on the breakfast!The staff was ready to try to help us with anything that came up or we might need. Thank you to all the team for an incredible stay.If you happen to travel to Pokhara (which is a must if you see Nepal), visit Hotel Glacier.

This is a fabulous centrally located, but quiet, hotel.  Our room was of very high quality and beautifully interior designed.  The cuisine was also of a very high standard, and nothing was too much trouble for the staff.  You are assured of a very warm welcome at this hotel.  We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and will definitely return when next in Pokhara.

What an amazing experience it was to stay in the Glacier. You can enjoy the view of the lake while sitting at the restaurant in front of the hotel. The well trained and professional staff of the Glacier is serving you organic coffee with a smile. I had the best Irish coffee ever in the Harbour restaurant. The rooms are tasteful and simplistic and you can relax in the jacuzzi after hiking or shopping. You can't go wrong here!!!

After five weeks in India and Nepal we stayed in Glacier.It's the most beautiful hotel on the lakeside in Pokhara and we decided to stay there for one night. Too bad we didn't decide on this earlier because it was the best night we had. As a former hotel manager it's always great to experience other hospitality hotspots, and this is certainly one. The staff is perfectly trained and very warm and friendly. The rooms are wonderful decorated with an unbelievable comfortabel and large bed (very important since I'm a tall Dutch guy). The service is the very best and something you don't often see in Nepal (or India). We had a great time in Glacier and would certainly advice this hotel. Don't forget to try the breakfast, dinner, cocktails ;-) and the amazing chocolate pie..

We love to travel and with our backgrounds in hospitality we like to check out the best hotels. Actually we were looking for some good food in Pokhara (Nepal) and ended up at the Harbor restaurant. The most amazing and unexpected flavors were delighted. I couldn't resist checking out the hotel rooms at Glacier Hotel & Spa. We ended up staying in the hotel, which was such a relaxing experience. The bed is absolutely worth it (it's hard to get out in the morning). Don't miss breakfast, you'll love it. The staff is very helpful, friendly and experienced, they are there when needed.

We originally booked for two nights and had to extend our stay because we just couldn't leave, because we felt so comfortable and welcomed. we loved staying here, All the staff were so kind, and always felt like i was returning home to family after a long day of activities. The breakfast was my highlight very day, with the best masala tea. If i were to visit Pohkara again i would defiantly stay here again.

Located at the fringe of the popular tourist town of Lakeside, the Glacier Hotel is pleasantly situated beyond the bustle but within easy walking distance of the various restaurants and bars on the main strip.The rooms are very clean, especially by Nepal's standards, many of which offer views of both the Himalayas and a beautiful lagoon-like area of the lake. The restaurant and bar serves delicious western breakfast in the morning, accompanied by fine coffee drinks and plenty of smiles from the wait staff. Actually, the hotel exudes a family-run hospitality without the slightest compromise in service.Laundry service was punctual and careful, the rooms were cleaned daily, and the outdoor restaurant was amendable to late afternoon coffee and a good novel.The manager was professional and courteous. It was an absolute pleasure to stay here.

This hotel is exquisite! A real gem! The arts, decorations, cleanness, service and attention put into making your stay the best one makes this hotel remakable! We stayed on the 7th floor and had our own private balcony and jacuzzi. The views from our room and on balcony were stunning! We were very thankful to the owner and staff of the hotel who made our stay a memorable one!

After having spent a wonderful week in the Annapurna Sanctuary, we showed up at the front door of this marvelous establishment to be greeted like royalty by the owner himself (a compassionate and well traveled individual himself). We were dirty, cold and smelt terrible. Within a few minutes we found ourselves pampered in thr Glacier luxury that was well deserved. For anyone that wishes to celebrate their success in trekking Nepal, you deserve nothing less than the Glacier Hotel and Spa.

My wife and I stayed in this nice hotel for three days and we have to express our full satisfaction with the service provided. The freshness and enthusiasm shown by all the staff really conquered us. Since the very first moment when they took care of asigning us the right room in accordance with our requirements until we checked out, we received from them all types of complements."If costumers are not satisfied then, what are we doing here?" argued me Sunil, one  of the Managers, who was so helpful with us that even offered himself to drive us to the bus station because the driver of the hotel was busy in that moment.The hotel is in an excellent location in first line and with a great view to the lake and easy access to the lake side. It is a new building, less than one year old. The rooms and bed sheets are very clean."The Harbour" is the name of their restaurant, which is highly recommendable. In our opinion one of the best you can find around.Our congratulation to all the staff, specially to the Personal and the Restaurant Managers.

Really a Hidden gem Glacier Hotel Deserve the Rating beautiful clean airy rooms magnificent Views of the Annapurna close to all the action yet peaceful to sleep in the Nights lovely little lake front nice courtyards we loved the siting Area on the roof terrace delicious yummy Breakfast most of all The staffs & the location Made this property a jewel & unbeatable to Any.

Looksenvironmentservice food qualityand cleanness Organic coffee is great flavour And family entertainment staffThat is excellent point of view hospitality industry from there glacier hotel lakeside Pokhara Nepal .

Spent two nights with my partner in this hotel.  This hotel was pretty much awesome, if your budget allows.Pros:  location!! Quieter and nicer than awful north lake side, directly across from phewa boat rental (do that too). Room impeccable and warm, nicely designed with natural wood finishes, plush pillows, clean sheets. Service was good, staff friendly.  GM knew my name (but not creepy) and the lady at desk helped with directions.  Good supply of hot water and power- most reliable wifi of trip.  Really just a relaxing, happy hotel.No cons.  Enormous carbon footprint??Note: though it wasn't our proper honeymoon we got the honeymoon suite for 165$.  Get this room.
