It was a steal considering a) the private "balcony" was larger than our house and b) that price gets you nothing more than a seedy motel room in the states.  Here, it got us secluded lake views, secluded happy hour, and basically our own flat.  (Did the staff snicker about LGTB guests? Maybe.). Got yummy chocolate cake- restaurant seemed pricey but crowded.Luxurious, just stay here.

Needed a break from my trek and wanted some real food.  Stopped in earlier and looked and menu and came back.  Fresh squeezed OJ rivals that of Valencia, Spain.  Had the pumpkin soup - very good.  Had the Sukuti (dried buffalo) tossed in onion and tomatoe with Bibb lettuce and some pearl onions and cornichons- loved it - wish in could take some with me.  Am now having stupa of boar.  Very good.  You can't go wrong and the prices are very reasonable.  I spent the afternoon eating and looking out at Phewa Lake, sitting on a comfortable couch - relaxing.   Don't miss this.  Worth a stop.  Service and attentiveness excellent.

Overall the hotel was satisfactory; smily staffs, service was somehow good, but the bugs inside the room was really bad, it might be due the fact that the hotel location in front of the lake but still the could have managed it better

I injured my legs while trekking, and needed a good place to rest and recover. After a little research, I found this hotel. It is rather expensive, but considering that the place needs to run generator for electricity and gas boilers for hot water, I think we can understand the price. The people here carried all my luggages from begining to end, and even gave me a free ride to the airport. A remarkable hotel indeed.

I stumbled upon the Glacier Hotel on a stroll my first day in Pokhara. My first impression was that it looked like a century building from my home country (Canada) built of stone and timber. An aesthetically beautiful building. After trekking I decided to stay there. Staff are incredibly communicative and helpful. The hotel managers and staff pay incredible attention to detail and customer comfort. This is run as a five star hotel although they do not claim this. The rooms are incredible. The menu/food if you're a fish lover is extensive and well-prepared. Thank you to Raj and all his staff for an incredible stay.  Hope to see you again!

5th time to Nepal, and this is by far the best hotel I have stayed in. Rooms, interior finishes and especially the service from young, keen and very hospitable staff make this a must-return hotel for me. I understand this is the new wing which only opened up a few months ago - 7 floors of rooms, two restaurants and a soon-to-open spa.They have a generator which kicks in when the power grid fails (often) and had no problems charging phones and cameras etc. A powerpack, however, is always a good idea for travelling in Nepal.The huge terraces on the 6th and 7th floors give great views of the lake and the hustle and bustle of Lakeside road below. Funny to see the surrounding hotels which all suggested amazing views of Lake Phewa but they were set back from the lake shore.Food-wise - absolutely all spot-on. Their mixed Momos, the Nepali Thali and the amazing breakfast (make sure you include it in your deal) were seriously good. And the masala tea is spicy enough to make you just want to sit there and people watch all afternoon.Look out for the owner and his very capable F&B manager, Mahesh. These chaps and their teams will make your stay effortless - and fun! Sadly when I was there the weather was foggy so the pictures of the lake don't do it justice. The hotel has a neat elevator which goes up to the 6th floor and then a simple walk up to the 7th floor Honeymoon Suite and the terraces of the 7th floor and rooftop which gives the best views of the town and mountains - weather permitting! It's still a bit of work in progress for some finishing touches but all in all, the location, rooms, views and above all, the staff make this a winner in Pokhara in my opinion.

From start to end of our 5-day stay, service staff were warm, friendly, sincere & helpful - from the reception, concierge, restaurant to housekeeping. The rooms were incredibly comfortable, tastefully designed with good bedding, which was a warm welcome after some cold nights out. Breakfast was also mostly of excellent quality and gave a hearty start to our days there. We ended up staying an extra night because our family loved the experience so much. Great views from the verandas too!

Thank you for your kind and generous hospitality. My partner became quite sick in Pokhara. The staff were exceptional (Kumar and Sunil), taking her to the hospital and going out of their way to help. We ended up staying a week at the Glacier Hotel. The food is the best in town with an Aussie chef who caters for all tastes. Coffee is strong and tasty. Rooms are spacious and clean with western style toilets and 24 hour hot water.Situated on Damside, this end of town is quieter than the bustle of central Pokhara. Expensive for Nepal but affordable and well worth the comfort by western standards. Highly recommended. In April 2016 the owner assures me the new spa and sauna will be  completed. Looking forward to coming back.

The new building of Glacier Hotel is impressive, with a mediterannean feel, large rooms and very good service. The only minus (hence the four dots) is due to small issues such as a feel of some unfinished stuff in the otherwise very impressive rooms, such as (in our room) the ledge on one of the windows, or the internet which is dropping out  a bit too often. However the beds, mattresses, pillows are very comfortable. I would stay here again.

My wife and I stayed here over the New Year period for 3 nights and it was great. It's a lovely hotel and the staff were brilliant. In the mornings we had a delightful breakfast sitting at a table outside in the sunshine. I stayed at other hotels in Nepal but this was the best. Highly recommended.

We've just completed a six night stay at the Glacier hotel with our three kids.  It was super relaxing and just what we needed.  The big new rooms and restaurants at this hotel put it near the top of the list in Pokhara.  The staff are so friendly and bend over backwards to make sure your stay is as good as it possibly can be.  Nothing is too much trouble.  The restaurant is really great, and breakfast each morning was superb.  We also had dinner there twice and loved it.  It is very difficult, if not impossible to find fault with the Glacier Hotel.  You would not regret a stay at the Glacier, it really is great.

The 4 nights I spent there completely spoilt me. This hotel made me feel like I was somewhere in foreignland rather than in a country filled with unfathomable crisis. The decor, service, food and all that a boutique hotel offered was met, up and beyond. The bed was so cosy that my body begged not to leave. And the portion of the food was so generous, much more generous that what they actually costed. I think we ended up tasting all their food items on the menu and I have nothing to complain about. Lastly the owner and hotels staffs of all depatments made our stay extra special with their warm and friendly chitchats. And after all these after leaving the hotel, it still is burning like a candle in my heart!

새로 지은 호텔로 최고의 시설과 서비스가 제공되고 이습니다.배낭여행보다는 휴식과 비지니스로 오신 분들께 추천해 드릴께요.The new hotel. l would like to recommend for everyone. The best hotel in Pokhara.Everything was clean and hotel boss is really kind. Also manager and your staff are very kind.Building Design and interior were the stylistic and pretty. it's furniture and items for Nepal more luxurious.I thought. Design themes is the lake pewa and machapuchare.You can see wonderful the Himalayas and lake pewa.Wi-Fi Hot shower, electric, 24 hours possible. Relax and to work perfect~^^Breakfast is delicious and all the food is the best. Hotel gave great care.You come here~!!There are best comfort and service, delicious food.Will be the best gift for you.❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️Jeju island Anna's Cholatse From Anna ^^

Having spent four fantastic nights at this Boutique Hotel, it is very clear that there is no other Hotel that comes near to the Glacier. The stylish exterior, designer interior, large plush bedrooms and well thought out public spaces, all exudes understated luxury and taste. It could easily rival some of the best Boutique Hotels in Europe, let alone anything in Pokhara. The dedication of the staff, the excellence of the chef and the approachable management make for a very relaxed atmosphere where you are secure in the knowledge that nothing would be too much trouble for them, to ensure you enjoyed your stay to the full. It is quite simply head and shoulders above the rest.

What a delight! Wasn't quite sure if the hotel would meet my expectations but it did, and it exceeded them, (other than the spa being open -it's under refurbishment)Great service: Every morning welcomed with a smile and conversation about our experiences the day before and our plans that day, offering helpful tips on treks, transport and timings.Rooms: Lovely lake view, immaculate and fresh fruit and cookies every day, plus beautifully fluffy towels changed every day. Great comfy beds. Aromatherapy oils in the bathroom, and good laundry service. Recommend sitting on roof terrance if you want to get away from hustle and bustle of main street.Location: 10 minute from airport.; 5 minute from bus station. Free airport taxi pick up and drop off. Driver available 24/7 for any other activities you want to do.  Location perfect. You can walk into town, along lake, up to the Stuppa, walk up to Sarangok all from the hotel. Just a wonderful stay over Xmas. Looking forward to going back for a longer stay in the future.

The newly refurbished Glacier Hotel and Spa, with its Mediterranean themed rock &, rendered walls, stonewashed wood, and natural fibre decor offers comfort that is rare to find in Nepal. In fact, I have stayed at a number of resorts on the Great Barrier Reef, and found the decor in this hotel even better than some of the top resorts! The rooms are large and well appointed, with touches like a comfortable seater, tv, individualised decoration and modern art.  Even rarer - a heater and hair dryer! Absolute luxury in Nepal, making the room so comfortable and washing hair bearable  in the cold of winter. The bed was a dream and the doona beautiful.  The views out to the lake from upstairs courtyards are stunning, and remind you just why you have come to Pokhara.  The food in Hotel Glacier is in a class of its own, with a very highly skilled Australian chef producing tasty and high class dishes.  We had the English breakfast and the trekkers breakfasts.  Both wonderful and complete meals that leave you satisfied for most of the day.Service is outstanding, with members of staff eager to please and very responsive. The hotel is located in a quiet part of Lakeside so you don't get the noise of bars or night clubs.  Walls are thick and well insulated.  All in all, quite an extraordinary class of hotel - accommodation,food and service. Outstanding.

It is the one of the best hotel so far i have stayed in nepal food was 10 out of 10 and services provided was far better than international hotel in London. Decoration in room was on point and thank you for managing director for dropping us to the place. I would definitely stay here again and again my mrs loved it.  Bhisma thapa from chitwan uk

Looking for a little luxury after several weeks trekking, coupled with a family Christmas holiday. The room was newly furbished (as is the rest of the hotel), service was excellent and the food was the best we had eaten in our two-week stay. Definitely returning for our next holiday in 2016.

We have stayed in a newly renovated section of the hotel and the room was excellent! The staff is highly trained and attentive. Our best words go to the kitchen staff. Food was amazing, we even asked to see the chef to say how we appreciate his art of cooking.

We stayed in the hotel for a few days after the Annapurna Circuit needing a few days of R&R. The food was wonderful and the room service was very fast. We ate at the hotel most of the time. The breakfasts were large and momos were delish. The rooms have wifi and hot water so we thoroughly enjoyed the tub. The hotel is very convenient for shopping and restaurants (in a nice area) yet far enough away from the noise. The lake is right across the street which you can see from every floor and the mountains on the other. The best part of the hotel is the staff. They went out of their way to make sure we had everything we needed and helped plan my surprise birthday breakfast and cake. We will definitely be back!

Very good dinner and fancy ambiance for Pokhera. We were looking for a good meal in the middle of the fuel crisis and we decided to splurge here. We had the chicken wing, Greek salad, and French fries for appetizers and my husband had the beef dish with mash potatoes. It was very good and the fresh herbs were a real treat. The restaurant manager was exceptional.  We had considered switching our stay to the Glacier because our hotel didn't have the amenities that were advertised because of the fuel crisis. Needless to say the Glacier does and has gone to great lengths to ensure that their guests have amenities that other hotels at this time simply can not afford. India has created quite a crisis in Nepal that is not being covered properly in the media. Do your research before visiting. I love this country. It's probably one of my favorites and Pokhera is a quiet gem.

I stayed here after 12 days trekking the Annapurna Circuit. It was the perfect slice of luxury after my rugged days on the trail. The management responded quickly to my email inquiry about rates and reservations, and welcomed me warmly despite my dusty appearance upon arrival. The hotel has all the amenities of a city boutique hotel anywhere in the world, great hot water, comfy bed, and fun view of all the street traffic around the lake. My breakfast, included with the room, was truly amazing - even if you don't stay here, come have an omelette. The staff were attentive and friendly. I'm so glad I decided to indulge a bit and stay here after my trek!

My stay at the Glacier Hotel was absolutely terrific. This may be my single favorite hotel experience I have ever had. At the very least it made enough of an impact on me to write my first tripadvisor review to sing its praises. The staff was genuine, helpful, and friendly. It was a very welcoming atmosphere with professional and respectful service. The hotel owner was on site most mornings and evenings making sure his customers were satisfied and comfortable. He was also categorically helpful on giving us information and direction in Pokhara.Our room was beautiful and easily the most comfortable place we stayed while travelling through Nepal. The rooms are clean and very well lit as a good base line, but they are also very tastefully done with wood decor, hand molded walls and brick veneer. The balcony from our room offered a striking view of the Annapurna Range as well as the Pokhara lakeside. With thick walls to cancel out any outside noise and a bed to melt into, the Glacier Hotel offers some very well rested nights. And the food.... outstanding. One of the most notable things to mention about the Glacier Hotel is the food! Competitively priced with the surrounding area, but leagues better. Beautiful dishes with a great presentation and generous portions. Every meal we had there (which was quite a few) was delicious and memorable.Even if you decide not to stay at the Glacier Hotel, you should absolutely go out of your way to eat there. All in all you get an amazing deal whether you are enjoying the accommodation, or simply having a meal on the balcony overlooking the street. It is a wonderful place.

we had lunch and coffee here during our stay in Pokhara, and wish we had stayed here instead of Fish Tail Lodge which is more expensive and rather tired. The service was good and the whole feel very pleasant and relaxing.

A great professional and very friendly staff, always helpfull with information. They did much more then we expected. The room with the view on the phewa lake was more than big enough and also very clean. We had free wifi on every place of the hotel. The breakfast was more than a buffet. Everything (fresh toast, eggs, cakes,...) we asked was fresh made even the fruitjuce and was served at the table. The restaurant "harbor" has an unique menu with all kind of food over the whole world and ofcourse nepal. The australian cook makes from a small dish a great plate. At the bar and front terras you can order delicious cocktails with roasted nuts or excellent coffee/tea with homemade cake. In a crisis time of fuel we didn't feel it in the hotel. If we had a problem they solved it.

My daughter and I had already booked into a nearby hotel but stopped off for lunch at the Glacier and were very impressed. Asking for a tariff, the lovely Rishma insisted on showing us one of the rooms. We were so impressed that we booked a room there and then and kicked the original hotel into touch even though we'd already paid. The food was first class and the staff, all of them couldn't do enough for us. The full English breakfast was superb but ridiculously huge-even the two of us couldn't have finished it! The room was excellent, TV, fresh fruit, tea and coffee making facilities, flowers, mini bar and safe, even a small balcony and spotlessly clean. Well done to all concerned.

I recently went to see Hotel Glacier in Pokhara as I was interested as a travel writer to see this new boutique Hotel. Although I didn't actually stay there the Hotel MD Rajendra very kindly showed me around the rooms and they are so amazing! The very cool underwater theme is inspired by the fact that the hotel overlooks the beautiful Fewa Lake in Lakeside. I had lunch in the Harbour Restaurant and it was more than incredible. They have an Australian chef who has perfected a honey roasted pork belly and the gluten free chocolate dream cake is beyond words!The price for the hotel varies but I can guarantee that you will get value for your money here, a very unique addition to Pokhara.

I had a great time at the Glacier Hotel.  This is a well appointed, clean, new well located hotel on the lakeside in Pokhara.  I have been to the lake a dozen times, and the Glacier is the best.  The professional staff went beyond the call of duty to ensure a lovely, homey stay.

Went  here with a group of ten, food was very good. Large variety of cuisine, including local food. Service was very good, met the owner and he gave us a lift home. Can't ask for more than that. A few parts of the hotel are still being completed.

I loved my stay at this hotel by the lake. The room was sumptuous with a heavenly king size bed and wonderfully luxurious mattress. The room which was very spacious also had a large bath and mini fridge and bar. Just what I needed after my 17 day Annapurna trek. Spectacular views from my room of Phewa Lake and the mountains. Great service from the friendly staff with that special Nepali touch!

Wonderful staff from check-in through housekeeping to the restaurant team.We stayed in the suit on the top floor with everything you could want and even a private terrace with great views of the lake while having our breakfast. This was our first trip to Pokhara so we decided to spend more on our hotel than we would normally and we were not disappointed. The bed was enormous and the shower was an excellent size too. The suite was clean and had enough space to be very comfortable. We sat in the Harbor restaurant on the Hotel ground several afternoons enjoying good service and fine food. The location was perfect for us and we could explore Lakeside very easily. Very highly recommended!!!

I stayed here a couple of weeks ago and meant to write this review much earlier. It is a beautifully appointed hotel and the staff were exceptionally freindly and helpful. I stayed here for 3 nights - my husband surprised me and arrived early so they let him into the room to wait for me. It was the day after my birthday and as a surprise they made me a cake - which we had by candlelight with the managers and the architect on the rooftop as the sun was setting - it was such a lovely touch and perfectly sums up this place. It's very new and we got a good deal and is head and shoulders above anywhere in Pokhara if you fancy a bit of luxury but don't want to blow a hole in your pocket. I really would recommend this place - I hope it does well, it deserves to and seeing the sun from our balcony rising over the Himalayas was a lovely way to leave. We had to leave early on Sunday morning and they let us have breakfast early. Rishma was very professional and the chef is Australian who makes some wicked bread among other things. When I come back, I will definitely stay here.

The hotel is stunningly beautiful and comfortable. I would say it was the best place during my travels so far. I have spoiled myself with the Executive Suite the space was far greater than anything else I experienced in Nepal. The welcome from the staff was so warm and friendly and I felt immediately relaxed and well looked after. First morning breakfast was fantastic and dinner was keeping the promises for the breakfast. The location is absolutely stunning next to the lake. This hotel was recommended to me by a friend who stays at the best places throughout the world and it delivered. I would go back in a minute.

I have been in Pokhara several times and stayed at different hotels... Hotel Glacier it's the best one from what i saw till now.Located near the lake, friendly and highly trained staff, very good rooms, delicious breakfast, good coffee...It has everything that good hotel need and actually this hotel was at much more higher level than many hotels i stayed in Europe.

We arrived at Pokhara airport to be met by the hotel transportation. After a ten minute ride, we arrived at Hotel Glacier in the heart of lakeside Pokhara. The staff was there to greet us with whatever we desired. This continued for the next 6 days. Our beautiful room on the top floor (highly recommend it) had a spectacular view from the terrace. The bed is very comfortable, spacious bathroom and excellent amenities including wall chargers for 110 and 220, a TV with many channels and complimentary treats. The breakfasts are equal to none with delicious pastries and fresh juices to compliment the eggs, omlettes or even french toast. Was not expecting a complete western breakfast experience. We had a special treat when the hotel prepared a dinner for us on our terrace which was excellent.The service is second to none. The staff really does want to make sure your stay is a memorable one. We had a fantastic time in Pokhara and will absolutely stay at the Hotel Glacier. Having just opened, they really wanted our honest feedback which showed a true desire to improve which is hard to do. They have it figured out already.

The genuine staff welcomes all guests with a smile and do their upmost to meet all needs. They have high security at all hours, amazing rooms with balconies, hot shower, and reserve energy such as gas for cooking, electricity and wifi. The hotel's connection with local agencies and service providers will guarantee all unique ideas met.  I wanted to go to Sarangkot to watch the sunrise so the hotel staff sought a driver to pick me up at 5am, woke me up at 430 am with a staff member and then gave me the correct rate.  I highly recommend this luxury hotel to all who seek comfort in a foreign land.  Their free breakfast is amazing!!  A+++++++

They have an owner who does everything to provide the upmost accommodation, separate restaurant managers and a separate hotel manager.  Each branches excel in their services.  Whether it is the barista, restaurant waiter or the cleaning staff: each greet and work with a genuine smile. Nepal had an energy issue, but this hotel stands out from the rest because they stock up in reserve energy, such as gas or cooking and hot water and electricity.  I am having my wedding there tomorrow and the restaurant manager was very informative and helped organize the event to the Tee. I can confidently assure you that they will feel like you are family and that you will have the the upmost care that you seek in a foreign place. A+++++++++

Hotel Glacier is a great new hotel right on Lakeside in Pokhara. I was just back from a 7 day trek and had decided to treat myself to a few nights luxury and the Glacier hotel was perfect. Well equipped modern rooms with all the mod cons. The rooms were very clean and tidy. And the mattress was exactly what my back needed after 7 gruelling days trekking. Great restaurant with a fantastic Aussie chef. A lovely stay, I will be back.

Brilliant service and delicious food. I had the English breakfast which was plentiful and full of flavour. They have an Australian chef who bakes every morning, we got a bowl of complimentary pastries just after we ordered. Great coffee too 😆😆😋😋

I think there are two major types of five star hotels, the large business hotel. Wall to wall marble. And then there is the small, more intimate boutique hotel. The Hotel Glacier is in this last category. Loved it. Spectacular location, wonderful service from reception to doorman, excellent food especially breakfast, gorgeous terrace seating area. Rooms are very clean with a super comfortable bed, and quiet. It was the best hotel experience I had among the last years of travelling in Asia. I will definitely stay again at Glaciar Hotel.

This stunning newly designed hotel is a gem in Pokhara. The rooms are beautiful. If you are traveling with kids ask for the family room. Restaurant is fantastic. Coffee place offers a delicious Gluten Free chocolate cake. Staff is super friendly especially the Australian Chef Lindsey and Guest Relations manager Ms. Rishma Lama.

This is the most beautiful hotel I've ever seen in whole Nepal. The room is very high class, comfortable and in a unique natural stone & wood design. Everybody of the staff is very friendly and helpful. The Hotel restaurant & bar at Glacier Hotel has the best food and coffee you can imagine. Specially the cakes and deserts are super yummy. The location is also really great. It is literally a few feet away from the lake with the green forest on the other side what makes the view from the terrace just great. There are lots of nice shops and restaurants within close walking distance and you are directly at the spot. Thanks Glacier Hotel for the great hospitality and we will see us again.

Just back from Hotel Glacier and the service staff is wonderful very cheerful and helpful. Took the advice of another review on TripAdvisor to check in. The rooms have a beautiful view with lots of space and the beds are extremely comfortable. Loved the Harbor restaurant breakfast with lots of food to choose from. The location is great next to the Lake with all the shops and other restaurants. Center Point can be reached within a 5 minutes walk. I'm staying a lot in Hotel in Pokhara and Glacier is far my absolutely favorite.

We booked a Jeep Tour from Pokhara to Muktinath (3-day-package) and appreciated the trip very much. It was well organised, and thanks to our friendly guide Sunil and especially our competent and courteous driver Surat it has been a great experience which allowed us to fully enjoy the beautiful mountain-countryside. We were particularly impressed by the skillfulness of our driver, who managed the difficult roads and sometimes difficult situations with remarkable calm, far-sightedness and regard towards us and others, making us feel safe and in good hands throughout all the journey. Should we ever come back to Nepal and the mountain region, we will surely book another trip with this company.

We stayed in this lovely hotel for 5 weeks. The staff made our stay so comfortable, helping us whenever they could with free transportation, bookings and information. The rooms are clean, spaceous and well-equiped. We were very glad to profit from free Wifi 24h and lights in the room and the bathroom during load-shedding which is very special for Lakeside in Pokhara. At the reception you can find day and night a security guard so we had no fear to leave our laptops and valuables in the room. The new wing of the hotel is as good as completed and we wish the family running the hotel the greatest success!

Last November my friend and I stayed in Hotel Glacier Pokhara for a couple of nights. We enjoyed our stay so much. Our room was clean and spacious with comfortable beds and a tastful interiour. The staf was so friendly and helpful!The owner Rajendra Dhakal showed us the new wing that was still under construction but nearly finnished. The building is made of natural stone with wooden accomplishment. Old and local crafts were used for the tasteful details in and around the building. I was impressed and cannot wait to visit again! I wish the owner and the staff all the succes for the future! Thanks for our lovely stay!

The Hotel Glacier was recommended by some friends I met durring trekking in the Himalayas. And it was just what I was looking for after that time without any luxury. Great rooms and very nice service. Be sure that they will take good care of your Needs!

Had a great stay in Glacier, luxery room, nice staff. Everything you wish for will be done. Thank you so much Rajendra Dakhal for our lovely stay.Great view off mountains and lakeside, great local art.

This is my second stay at Hotel Glacier and it felt like I had returned to stay with friends. Pokhara is one of my favourite places and this was my 5th visit. Four years ago my son and I stayed here however this time I was travelling on my own. Hotel Glacier is a lovely hotel in a good location a little distance away from the busy part of Lakeside. The hotel has views of the lake and the mountains depending on where your room is located. The owner Rajendra Dhakal is currently extending the hotel. The new wing has been built in heritage style using natural stone and wood. The views in the new wing are absolutely amazing from the roof top and all the rooms have views of the lake and/or the mountains.  I had a lovely room overlooking the lake in the old part being the original hotel Glacier with wooden panelling on the walls. The room was clean and the bed comfortable. The owner Rajendra is a most gracious host and will go out of his way to ensure your stay is memorable. He took me to see the sunrise over the mountains one morning in his SUV to a isolated village about an hour's drive from Pokhara. Sunrise over the Himalayas was the highlight of my trip. It is amazing to see the sun touch the peaks and then slowly work its way down the snow clad mountains. Rajenda is leading the way for tourism in Pokhara and I wish him every success for the future and look forward to staying at Hotel Glacier again one day, in the new wing of course, which opens for business in December I believe. Travelling on my own it was lovely to be so well looked after.

We enjoyed the friendly, family like atmosphere in this wonderful hotel. The staff were very helpful specially with our 1 year old son. The location is exceptional close to nice restaurants and a big park to hang out. We would like to thank you for an unforgettable stay !!! We will be back soon!

The bed was really comfortable and the service truly amazing. My wife and me stayed here for our last night in Pokhara before we went back to germany. The comfort was exactly what we needed. I can highly recommand this Hotel.

I absolutely love my time at hotel Glacier! Got room 312. Spectacular! I have come to work for 5 days and the atmosphere of the room is so inspiring. For anyone wishing to get inspired while staying in Pokhara this is your place. The new hotel right out the door is amazing. Can’t wait to open!

Me and my teenage son visited the Glacier Hotel for seven nights and we had a totally awesome stay with many great memories. It was not only the incredible location and lake view, but also the hotel with a terrific service. Our room was huge with a super comfortable bed. The breakfast very good in a very pleasant surrounding facing the lake. Thanks and see you again!

Wonderful property, amazing customer service, good food! 5/5 . Would recommend any one looking to stay in luxury within the jungles of Chitwan. If someone is looking for property inside the jungle, Kasara is the place!

We had a two night stay. The resort is peaceful andf pretty. I wasn't a big fan of the indoor/outdoor shower but it was fine. The bedroom has air con/heat and a kettle if provided to make tea and coffee.We were on a meals package and the staff made extra efforts as we were vegetarian, after a eproviding tasy vegetarian Nepalese food. There wasn't a great deal of variety but this is to be expected when the resort has few guests.Staff were all friendly and helpful.The included activities in the national park were good and we saw rhino twice. We thought the guides were good and the information provided in the slide show was excellent.

Very much enjoyed our stay here, the hotel is absolutely stunning and of a very high standard of all the facilities, decoration, cleanliness, and food, the bedrooms and bathrooms are designed and decorated to a very high standard, With a stunning central entrance hall which leads in one direction to bedroom and the other to the bathroom, staff were super friendly and helpful, drinks were great food amazing and the grounds and pool area were stunning and very well kept. I used the spa for a massage and it was very good. The area around the resort is very special and unlike any other safari we have done before, which was just wonderful, the staff went out of their way to make sure we had an enjoyable trip, Highly recommend this place, it is the best place we stayed at during our trip to Nepal, and would come back in a heartbeat.

Overly priced compared to hotel standardsRoom needs upgrade , poor lighting , and it gets boring once all your outdoor activities are done moreover no tv on regular villas, its best to stay for 2 days max. Internet on villa keeps showing no signal on wifi and gets a bit slow if you r not in the main dining and pool area. Curtain are light focused so at night if your light is on your room may be visible.Its a buffet restaurant and food is very good and the staff is very friendly and take a great care of you specialy the lady at restaurant. Very poor airport drop off , overly priced and we used it twice and both time their TATA truck got broken down and we walked the first time and got local auto next time middle of the way. They were using a vehicle with no lights at night time to have us dropped off and no air to throw at windshield and the way driver had difficulty on that foggy weather , my wife got too scared. I suggest you use a local transport or book one from other agencies to be safe n save a lot of money. Don’t get overwhelmed by viweing some youtube vlogs do your research before and i think its great to book hotel around sauraha region than this side of the region.

We just checked out after a two night stay at Kasara in room A3. Really a private and restful place to recharge your spirits.The resort this time of year is not very busy, but there were enough other guests that we didn't feel too isolated.The food (both ala carte and buffet) was really flavorful. My wife is quite particular about food and has some dietary restrictions, but they were very accommodating to that.We went on a nature walk the first day and a jeep safari the second day.  Both were well worthwhile.  Saw several rhinos during our time there! The grounds near the resort are also full of deer and other wildlife.  WiFi connection was very good and relatively fast.  The power was good by Nepal standards and there were only a couple brief outages. The in-room air conditioner provided adequate heating, but do bring some heavy jackets to wear at dinner and evening outings.They no longer keep any elephants at the property and are working on eliminating plastics (which seems like a good direction to me).The naturalist Surat was with us for nearly all the activities, and his commentary was very informative.  Thanks to all the staff there for a great visit to Chitwan National Park!

We were more than 20 people for a retreat. But the resort staffs didn't disappoint us.From the time we checked in we were very impressed, there was temperature checking machine and auto hand sanitizer. The staffs greeted us at the gate and gave us a warm welcome made us feel like we were back home not in a new place. All the keys were ready and we had swift check in. During the stay all staffs were very helpful and attentive. They looked like they were always ready to help and we felt comfortable to ask if we needed any help.The food waskn another level. I enjoyed every single meal be it breakfast, lunch or dinner. We were really impressed with the course meal and different cousine that were served to us. The extra activities we did were so entertaining. The canoeing, jungle walk and specially the ghadiyal breeding center was the best thing we could ask for. As the check in was swift so was the check out. We were farewelled by reception team and manager personally. We were very touched with their hospitality and care and would love to be back very soon. The rooms, overall environment and swimming pool was more than anyone could ask for. Thank you all team Kasara ❤️

We took our little ones to the Kasara Resort on a 2 nights, 3 days jungle package. Baby slept in our room, while our 4 yo and 8 yo were super excited to be sleeping in their own little cottage.We felt very comfortable and welcome in the dining room. It was a good experience to have attentive service, plus the kitchen served us a variety of dishes for breakfast, lunch and dinner - most importantly, the kids ate very well. We took a brief jungle walk with our kids, cycled around the village area, swam in the pool (not river), rode a canoe to the crocodile breeding center, said hello to the elephants, and enjoyed a wonderful cultural dance on our last night. Babu dai was our dedicated naturalist. He was very knowledgeable, enthusiastic, and sweet. He added a lot to our memorable experience. Some unfortunate downsides - the outdoor bathroom does get cold, big windows looking out to private space that let in too much light and too early, no TV (I understand why), but the kids were a little disappointed, and no kiddie pool unless you've booked the villa - the main pool is almost 6 ft so little kids not welcome. However, because there was an available villa, we were allowed to use their private pool, and that made us all happy. Nonetheless, thank you Kasara for a wonderful time!

This is a place of serious pros and cons. Pros, the activities are incredible, the morning safari was a highlight of our entire trip to Nepal and we saw some amazing animals. On the other hand, the rooms are not as advertised, the bathrooms are outside and open to the elements meaning you encounter all manner of critters especially at night. We came out one morning and discovered teeth and claw marks in our soap. The level of basicness is not clear for a hotel marketing themselves as 'simple luxury'. The rooms themselves are tired and a bit battered not sealed against mosquitoes or other creatures (we discovered a lizard on one of our bags). The food is below average compared to the standard across Nepal. Lastly the communication between staff is ultimately what made us decide to leave a day early. We were told one thing by reception staff and another thing entirely by the tour guides. We didn't stay as part of an inclusive package and were told we'd be able to book whatever activities we liked but it transpired that we could only go on activities already in place for those staying on the package basis. Whenever we went and asked a question at reception we were given a vague 'we'll let you know' answer, often you don't find out what you're doing the following day until the previous night which makes it difficult to plan when you're having to get up before dawn for tours. We also felt that because we weren't paying for a package we were treated differently to the guests who were. We weren't offered coffee at breakfast, we weren't told about morning yoga and the guides didn't offer to take our picture on tours when they did with the other guests multiple times. On the whole the tours made up for the lacking facilities of the hotel but be prepared that communication isn't great and the rooms are by no means new.

Kasara is lovely hotel. Even if it's listed as a 5* hotel it's actually more a 4*, as I wouldn't expect to have broken closing system on bedroom windows and having to fiddle with sockets to make them work. We also didn't find the rooms very functional: the bathroom is accessed via an outside space which isn't great particularly when you go to the toilets at night and it's 12 degrees... it felt like camping which isn't something we had signed up for. The outside shower is a great idea but again when it's cold it's not really comfortable. Everything else was great: staff were very professional and friendly, food was really tasty and staff, including Raj and his team, were very attentive. Our package was for two days but I dont think that's enough as we didn't really have time to enjoy the pool. Overall I'd give 6 stars to the staff if I could but 4 is for the rooms, which are quite basic and  not 5* (very comfortable beds though!)

Kasara resort was the perfect environment to recuperate and relax after three weeks of tough trekking. The staff were friendly, attentive and very professional. Meal times were a highlight of the day thanks to wonderful, fresh food and fantastic service. It was great to enjoy a well-made cocktail at sunset and reminisce on the days activities. Really enjoyed the jeep safari and canoe ride, as well as the free bike hire to explore the local town area and surrounding lakes. Rooms were clean, well serviced and comfortable. The attention to eco-friendly design, with the avoidance of plastic bottles and solar heated showers, was appreciated. Shout out to all the restaurant and kitchen staff and to Rohit, also special mention about our fantastic naturalist Gautam, and our successful early morning jeep safari.

I recently visited at Kasara Jungle Resort to celebrate our annual retreat program  with my colleague which was on 4th Oct  to 6th Oct. I most say that it was an amazing experience. Layout and decorations were beautiful and they had prepared Indian cuisine which is my favorite. Food was so delicious that i still remember it’s aroma and taste. F & B staffs were kind, helpful,Attentive and  knowledgeable . Every experience that I encounter there was so great that I can’t even describe it in words. I really recommend everyone to visit Kasara Jungle Resort to make best memories and experiences.

We had a great experience at Hotel Kasara. The staff kindly gave us a family suite, which was a big part of our wonderful time there. The hotel was well-maintained, surrounded by nature, making us feel like we were in the middle of the jungle. The rooms were in good condition and the showers worked well. Overall, the hotel was clean and had a simple but luxurious atmosphere.The food was good, with a limited menu but tasty dishes. It had a perfect balance between spicy and original flavors. We recommend trying the chicken timmur and snails, which a seven-year-old particularly enjoyed. The staff's service was exceptional, always attentive and anticipating our needs.Our guide Suresh was the best we've had in Nepal, with a great sense of humor that made our trip enjoyable. We left very happy and will definitely return.

I have really enjoyed my stay at Kasara Chitwan! I flew down after travelling and trekking solo for 2.5weeks and was so well taken care of - the room is dreamy and has an open bathroom/shower, food is delicious (especially their local/Chinese/Indian lunch and dinner menus) and the service is splendid - everyone in the Kasara team is so kind and welcoming, and made sure I was happy and all my needs were met at all times. Kasara has a full schedule of activities available, with jeep, canoe and walking safaris, and the option to organise sundowner experiences. The activities manager is very hands-on and happy to arrange other activities if that is of interest as well. I really liked that we had time to decompress in between activities, as got to enjoy the pool area which is beautiful and very relaxing. All in all, very satisfied with my stay and gutted I could not stay longer! Would recommend and would return

Stayed 3 nights in gorgeous villa. Great jeep safari, didn’t see rhino the first time but they let us go again the next day and we saw two. Food was excellent and exceeded expectations. Staff were extremely attentive and went out of their way to attend to any question or need. Pool area was very pretty and nice to sit at, always a cabana free. Rooms were very pretty, with private water pool at entryway sitting area, spacious bedroom and indoor/outdoor bathroom where you can see the beautiful trees. You do see some bugs but we thought it was actually quite minimal compared to what we were expecting, even though we didn’t use a ton of bug spray.We had a lovely stay at Kasara and would recommend it to anyone wanting a relaxing 2-3 days at a beautiful jungle resort. It was a great way to round out our trip to Nepal after our hiking trek!Especially appreciated staff Raj and Rojit for their service , always smiling and eager to help

We had an awesome stay. The accomodation and the hospitality was great.We still remember  Mr. Babu dai putting his effort to make our experience and stay more memorable. The ambience had it all that we needed to escape from the busy life schedules.Thank you all the kasara family for the great hospitality and the great memories.The pictures can speak the rest the fun time we had.

Great stay, got to see rhinos! Raj was an excellent host and took care of us so much with our food. Menu could be improved and selection of non veg for breakfast. Our last dinner was fantastic, we had Arab dinner and it was the best we had for the entire stay. Rooms are nice and clean, it is monsoon season so if it rains the walkway gets slippery. Will go back here when it’s dry season. Lots of water so a lot of mosquitoes but they are prepared with insect repellant for the room and complimentary insect repellant cream everyday!

Just a few minutes walk from the Western Chitwan Highway, This place has a very cozy atmosphere and spacious room, with great hospitality, tasty foods including local mangoes. Just a risk is that , due to lots of bushes outside of the rooms, snake or flybite can occur.Highly recommended place to visit.

We recently took a family package trip to Kasara resort. The resort is beautiful, set in lush greenery... There are individual huts and villas, so everyone gets an individual hut. We absolutely loved the open sky bathroom concept. Food was scrumptious. No meals were repeated in our 2 nights, 3 days stay. And, any special need from our side was accommodated within the meal plan. We had a kid and senior citizen with us with specific meal needs and we never had to worry about it.The excursions and tours were well guided. Our naturalist Madan ji was very knowledgeable and great at spotting wildlife...and his knowledge on local flora and fauna was immense.. Warm tea in the jungle as a part of our keep safari was such a wonderful add-on.We had a small glitch with the water issue, but it was immediately sorted..Memorable stay, would absolutely recommend it!

Special shout out to our guide Babu (Naturalist) and the restaurant manager (Gayatri) -- they made sure that all our needs were met and constantly checked-in with us. One of the best service we've received in Nepal. The resort is great and the team makes it so much more welcoming :)

We stayed two nights with 4 adults and 3 kids and had an absolutely amazing time. The customer service was fantastic  (Raj was great at making sure everything was perfect) and our guide with all our outtings (Madan) was very informative and friendly and great with the kids constantly asking questions. We came during Holi and were greated with color if we wanted and were brought to the local village to experience the festivities. The resort itself is very peaceful with bungalows tucked away and made to feel private. When Madan took us on the jeep tour into Chitwan, we were able to see plenty of rhinos including two that were very close. It was the highlight of my entire vacation. I do think this resort is more geared towards adults, BUT they were really really great with the kids. One even had a birthday while there and they baked her a special cake without us asking. This customer service is top notch.

This is an extremely luxurious hotel with an amazing staff. The room was so comfy and clean, it catered for everything we needed. The rooms are luxurious and well set out. The air conditioning is good. The staff were amazing and so helpful. The food was outstanding. It had food from every corner of the world, and you would never go hungry eating their food. The ambiance was also perfect with views of the pool and garden outside, which were so relaxing. I had such a pleasant stay and am truly thankful for all the warm hospitality extended by the entire team at the Hotel.

On arrival we were given a timetable of activities, which we understand is needed to ensure that things happen on time.  What we did not expect was to receive a call at 7-15 telling us we were expected in the dining room, having been told dinner would be served from 7-9pm  Nor did we expect to be given times for breakfast and lunch.Least of all did we expect everything to shut down by 8pm.  We felt we were on a school trip not a holiday.The rooms are tired and basic and the food was very average apart from our last meal (which again was at a set time not of our choosing).Positives were a knowledgeable naturalist and an enjoyable canoe ride followed by sundowners by the river.

Wow! This is a wonderful place to relax and enjoy the beautiful natural surroundings.  The staff has your every need covered.  They were so helpful and friendly and were always ready to answer our many questions about the surrounding jungle areas and animals.  The rooms were spotless and comfortable with nice rainfall showers.  The food was delicious and we never missed the daily happy hours.  They had a wonderful spa if you're in need of a massage.   Also, some fantastic hammocks set up by the pool for vegging out and being lazy.  The jeep safari and jungle walk are a must - we saw monkeys, owls, peacocks, crocs, and rhinos. I would not hesitate to stay here again if I am ever lucky enough to return to Nepal!

Kasara Resort is perfect for one who enjoys the peaceful environment. They have Yoga hall which me and my little son used for Yoga and meditation. I love the design of the cottage with an open air bathroom, feels like we are back in nature.  This place is perfect for who embraces nature and enjoy exploring and learning about wildlife. My little son learned about 7 different insects’ species during the stay! The food was amazing, and you can see that they have worked on menu varieties ,  and the highlight was the Lebanese falafel. Team were professional and helped me in several occasion with my little toddler. Thank you and we will definitely return.

I have stayed in many hotels around Chitwan National Park for my job as tour leader. Kasara Resort is my favourite, it has unique room's design, morden amenities with traditional looks and comfortable bed. It's in peaceful location with great ambiance. They serve wide variety of foods and drinks. Naturalist guides Krishna, Suresh and Babu are excellent in their knowledge. The safari jeep they use is very comfortable. Resort manager Santosh kunwar is very friendly, helpful and attentive to the guests needs.Highly recommended if you are looking for comfortable Hotel in Chitwan.

The restaurant is extremely good!! Love the pasta. We were so appreciative to stay somewhere where the staff made us feel like we were guests in their home. With a rotating set menu for each meal, Raj and the kitchen staff were more than happy to accommodate our requests for more food, or even to make items that had been on yesterday’s menu! This great personal service also carried over into all aspects of the hotel - our safari experience, while planned, allowed us to make decisions about what to do and where to spend time so we could go through at our own pace. Overall I would highly recommend based on the great service and care of the staff here. Finally I’d recommend arriving around 1-2 to make sure you can do some of the afternoon activities.

My group of two couples had a wonderful time at Kasara. The resort itself is beautiful and all the staff are very welcoming and accommodating. We weren’t the only group of guests but they always made us feel as if we were with their flexibility and service. The food was great - the dishes are not complicated or extravagant but they show that great food does not have to be.  We loved the rotating menu and especially the local food. Our jungle excursions were great fun - the guides were kind and informative and we were able to spot a number of animals.

This was a true nature oasis. We arrived after a long road trip from Pokhara and were met by a great hospitality and a great place.Waking up in the morning is a bliss, all you hear is birds, how wonderful.The hotel is amazing, the rooms which are more like little houses are very interesting. To one side is a beautiful bedroom and to the other big and kind of open air bathroom. You shower with the sky view (under the stars). The two parts of the little house are separated by a middle part which is open air and has small decorative pool. Because it is all open there are a lot of mosquitoes.It didn’t bother us, we kept the bedroom door closed all the time and checked for mosquitoes before going to bed. The hotel also provides mosquitoes repellent cream.Other parts of the hotel are a lovely pool, kept very clean and the sun beds were very comfortable and clean.The bar area is great as it has nice views over the national park nature and we enjoyed sitting there after a day activities, sipping our cocktail and drinking Nepalese beer.The restorant is. Ice, food provided for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Buffet style. The food was plentiful and tasty.The staff are very friendly, attentive.Everyone who works here is very polite and smiling. Our naturist Madan was great, very calm and knowledgeable. We went canoeing and jeep safari and were lucky to see lots of wildlife and local greenery. Raj the restaurant manager was very friendly and always checked if we are OK. He even arranged a Nepalese thali for my husband one night as he didn’t want to eat continental buffet.Everything was amazing, especially the piece and quite of the place and the songs of the birds you wake up to.Thank you Casara, we had a lovely lovely time.

We stayed at Kasara for the Wellness Experience “Chaitanya” for a splendid 3-night, 4-day. The wellness journey began with invigorating yoga sessions guided by yoga instructor Ramesh. For a yoga novice like myself the sessions were a perfect blend of challenge and comfort.The accommodation at the resort was a treat in itself. Our deluxe villa, a home away from home, offered us privacy and comfort. The attentive and accommodating staff at Kasara Resort ensured that our every need was met, making our stay all the more enjoyable. The best part of the retreat was definitely the food, from delectable traditional Nepali cuisine to mouthwatering Mediterranean dishes, the food was nothing short of exceptional!The retreat included Jeep Safari led by a well-informed naturalist, Canoe ride along the Rapti river with Alligators & Crocodiles along the banks and Jungle Walks by the Chitwan National Park was very relaxing with a sense of serenity and harmony with nature. In our free time we went Cycling through the picturesque village of Kasara with breathtaking scenery.All in all, my stay at Kasara Resort was a delightful blend of relaxation, adventure, and gastronomic indulgence. Kasara Resort is not just a place to stay; it's an experience that resonates long after you leave.

Our stay at Kasara Jungle Resort was nothing short of exceptional! The hospitality provided was truly amazing, and the staff's dedication to making guests feel welcome was evident throughout our stay. The food was not only delicious but also showcased the local flavors and culinary expertise. Additionally, the variety of activities offered added an extra layer of enjoyment to our experience. From wildlife encounters to adventure, there was never a dull moment. I can't recommend this resort enough for a well-rounded and memorable retreat.

My family and I had an amazing, unbelievably memorable stay at Kasara. The staff is wonderful, the food is so great, and the activities were exhilarating: I will never forget being so close to a rhino on a mini safari led by one of the Kasara guides, nor canoeing past a crocodile. Absolutely incredible, and the resort itself is so beautiful and peaceful.

My recent stay at Kasara Chitwan was nothing short of extraordinary. The serene ambiance provided a peaceful retreat, making it an ideal escape from the hustle and bustle. The resort's commitment to tranquility was complemented by exceptional staff service, ensuring a seamless and enjoyable experience. The culinary offerings were a delight, with a diverse menu that showcased the region's flavors. The highlight, undoubtedly, was the thrilling jungle safari experience. Kasara Chitwan seamlessly combines comfort, culinary excellence, and adventure, making it a top choice for those seeking a quiet getaway with the best of both worlds.

Kasara Forest Resort in Chitwan, Nepal, is an absolute gem! We stayed in one of their cozy villas and were treated to delightful buffet meals for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. The setting truly gives you that immersive jungle vibe, and it's a fantastic experience.What stood out was the exceptional service from Raj, who went above and beyond to make our stay special. Even when one item, Ghongi, was not initially available, Raj ensured we got to savor it. This kind of dedication and service truly make this resort stand out.The resort is well-managed and offers a range of exciting activities to keep you engaged. If you're looking for a unique jungle experience with impeccable service, Kasara Forest Resort is the place to be!

The resort is very comfortable with nice rooms, good food, attentive staff, and proximity to Chitwan Jungle Park. Staff like Raj was very accommodating in the dining area, Gautam and Madan are good naturalists both for jungle drives/walks and showing slides.The lights in the rooms were too dim.

This is a really wonderful resort, the staff are caring, polite and exceptional in every way and the food is absolutely out of this world, a really good selection of food choices well laid out and the outdoor evenings are fantastic. The activities available are interesting and the game drives are well organised with very well informed naturalists that lead them. All in all a gorgeous place to stay for a few days.

The only thing missing was a TV but maybe poor reception and with activities every day no time!. Trips to Chitwan National Park, boat rides on the Rafti River, free breakfast, lunch and dinner and a cultural show   made the two days very enjoyable. The restaurant manager went around talking to people and making them feel welcome and arranged for a laptop for me to send emails. At first asking at the office was not so good as the man stayed looking over my shoulder and said no social media like Facebook but yahoo was allowed but I could not get it.

Very nice and peaceful hotel, with beautiful large rooms and very good services. All the staff is great, from rangers to waiters: I'd like to thank you everyone for their kindness, they were very attentive and they provided me some delicious vegan dishes. Thanks to Rohin and to his colleagues for the perfect service, you are a great team!Silvia

Very friendly staff and beautiful resort. Good food and plenty to do around. Mr Raj will take good care of you regarding your food and drinks preference and the guides are all well experienced.If you don't have a car then kasara travels has bus which goes from Kathmandu to kasara resort.

This is a pretty place with extremely wonderful staff, they are always ready to help and with a smile. The food is yum, especially the Nepali thali. The rooms / villa is neat and clean. The drawback / Usp could be the creepy crawlies like lizard, leeches and frogs in the open bathrooms. If one is comfortable with nature and insects in the bathroom it is great, if not then it will be scary. They do come and throw them out immediately. Lizard in the dining room could also be a put off for many. The jungle safari was too good, the naturalist mr Chowdhary knew his job well, Surinder drove well. Mr Nandu was also good in the first safari. In all we saw 7 Rhinos, monkeys, monitor lizard, deers and many birds. The picnic breakfast and iced tea in the middle of the jungle was quite an experience. A memorable trip

Kasara resort is a nice place to spend your vacation in Chitwan. Rooms and bathrooms are nice with required amenities.  There's a very nice swimming pool and lots of greeneries around. We saw bunch of deers from the resort itself. Staffs are friendly and the meals there are just delicious. Its really wonderful there to sit around bonfire in the evening and enjoy drinks. We enjoyed all the activities there like boating, jeep safari, Tharu dance and cycling.Babu, the main staff there who took us for all those activities, was a very nice and helpful person.

Beautiful resort at the border of the Jungle. The food is amazing, the service is perfect. Raj, the food manager, is always ready to explain plates and give advice. The naturalistic guide, Sujan, used to swim in the river as a child, he is born and lives at the jungle border, you can feel the passion and love for the animals and wildlife that he has and he explains everything with a perfect english.We loved our stay, see you soon Kasara!

The staff was extremely courteous, and helpful. They have their own Jeep for Jeep Safari. Canoeing through them was also great as the guide was extremely knowledgeable. Tharu dance was an excellent way to end the day.  The resort gives the feeling of a jungle stay, however, has all modern amenities. The food was also good. Overall loved every bit of it.

What an absolutely wonderful experience. Raj and the entire Kasara staff took such good care of my family and I,  that we didn't want to leave. Our tour guide Sujan was so knowledgeable and excited about the jeep safari just as much as we were. The food was really good also and the drinks were on point.  I tried the spa which was also enjoyable. They did a special sundowner for us and we felt so special. We got to watch the sun go down on the river with drinks and afternoon snacks. The canoe ride is an absolute must too, so serene and calming. I'll definitely do this again and would recommend that anyone visiting Chitwan, stay at Kasara Resort.

A haven for relaxation and reconnection! Seeking a getaway to unwind and recharge, we discovered paradise at Kasara Chitwan.  The unique design elements and focus on tranquility created a space where we could truly relax.  Whether lounging by the pool surrounded by palm trees or exploring nature, the resort perfectly balances relaxation and rejuvenation.

My Nepal Diary will always have a special place for Chitwan. The cherry in the cake was the Kasara Resort and it's dutiful and helpful staffs. Mr. Raj along with this team excelled in in smooth management and amazing experience of the stay. The location, food and villas contributed enough in making the memories for the lifetime

This hotel is great! It has been a marvelous experience! The food is good, the pool is really pleasant! The entire staff is very nice, always caring for what you may need! Our safari guides are knowledgeable and really share their passion for wildlife! The food is also really good! They have great variety and Raj and his team are very nice!

The property is really beautiful with  nice rooms, very well located  close to the national park  the staff was very friendly and greeted us well. they helped us arrange all activities by providing all details and per booked everything before we reached. Really happy with the service. thank you all

First thing is that, The managers and the team members were soooo good❤️ The way they gesture us is soo nice❤️ The room is so private and the facilities are outstanding ❤️ And the dinner was also very very very good ! I really loved the Kasara resort! I swear it is the best place to hangout with your friends and family also❤️

They had joined two single beds to make a queen size , so in the middle it was hard . Uncomfortable. They should avoid make shift bed. Water pressure in shower would have helped . For summers it's fantastic since shower area is outdoor . Other wise for small hiccup, loved the property

I made a reservation with Santosh Gurung, and he was very enthusiastic about making the trip memorable. However, I had to check out early due to an allergy. The property is located in a jungle area, and if you're someone who enjoys nature, I would highly recommend it. Everyone was very welcoming, and the food was decent. However, the rooms could use an upgrade.

We are just back to Kathmandu from a wonderful four days at Kasara resort. The facilities are wonderful, the rooms are incredibly comfy, the food is great (they are very good at catering for vegan diets) and the staff could not be nicer or more helpful. We did several safaris and our guides were friendly and incredibly knowledgeable. We also did a cycle ride through Tharu villages which was also wonderful. We enjoyed every minute and will definitely be back.

This is a relaxing resort near Chitwan National Park. The rooms are clean and spacious; however, the ensuite restroom and shower are separated from the room and quite cold in the winter. The staff was warm and welcoming. The forest guide was excellent and very knowledgeable. The food was always good and servers attentive. We were treated to a cultural dance on our final night and thoroughly enjoyed it.

The hopeless service I have ever experience and you should never visit interms of food quality. In the restaurant lot of flies were there and staff didnt took any kind of action as I have requested so many staffs. But the staffs are least bothered.And all the services of the hotel are too bad the staff are very ill mannered when guest complain then only they assist them. The staff are not responsible for anything. Even at the time of conyeing they didn't sent for the pick up. So We are just checking out.

We had a wonderful time at Kasara. The hotel is a wonderful place. The grounds are a amazing, the pools are cool and the staff is great. The tours into the village and the safari into the chitwan national forest are great and very interesting. Thank you  Suresh, Raj and Mahesh for a wonderful time.

Lovely place.  Rooms are a little strange   Quite plain.  Concrete floors and personally I didn’t like the open water features.  Or crossing the landing by them to visit the bathroom !  Weird sitting area in between. Where as I’d rather have a veranda. Sit outside under the trees.   Food was really good   At times a fixed menu when they were quieter. Buffet when busier. Which is practical.  Fantastic pool. Deep all the way. So not suitable for children Lovely sunbathing beds. Nice to relax there between the morning and evening safari.    No tiger.  But we did see a rhino.  Same one both days

I had a lovely stay at the Kasara; the team was very friendly and accommodating specially Baburam dai, he is a really sweet and wonderful person. The amenities were outstanding. The room was excellent, spotless, and ideal for a nature enthusiast. And, of course, YES! The time I spent in the pool will always be cherished 😊.Thank you so much I will not hesitate to visit again.

My partner and I stayed in one of the villas at Kasara Resort to explore Chitwan for two days. The included breakfast, lunch, and dinner was top notch. There were friendly staff from culinary specialists to front desk personnel.  With spacious rooms and amazing amenities, it was hard to leave the room! The private pool was clean and well maintained. Our naturalist guide, Sujan, was extraordinarilyknowledgeable on the flora and fauna within the national forest. I will definitely be staying here again on my next trip to Chitwan

Every employee at the resort was kind, respectful and quick in delivering on the request. The activities were fun and well-planned also thanks to Gutham who made our stay memorable. Special thanks also to Raj who handled the every-day F&B moments in the best possible way. Thanks to the Kasara family!!!

The Entrance was fine with a warm welcome. The management team was very friendly and supporting staff were nice, easy going. Surrounding environment is natural and so beautiful.Enjoyed the whole time of great hospitality. Response during food time was intimidating. Tastes of some items like "Sabodaana Ko Khir", "Lauka ko Halwa" were amazing and would be a great memory. Enjoyed activities like Jungle Safari and Canoeing. Cultural dance with snacks was great

We really enjoyed our visit to Chitwan National Park and our stay at Kasara resort.  We were assigned a naturalist - Babu took care of us for our visit. He was our guide in the park and educated us the evening before on the animals, flora and fauna in the park.  We learned so much from him.  He was an amazing host and guide!  The resort was beautiful, clean and peaceful.

Good room layout but could do with an upgrade. Room lighting is poor. Bathroom is open to sky which may be ok in summer but is questionable off season. Dinner and breakfast are buffet style and normal hotel fare with lots of quantity. Good illy coffee bar. Dining room is unheated so dress up if there off season. Staff wear down jackets and hats to serve. Activities are well organised with excellent and knowledgeable rangers. Very helpful staff and welcoming friendly house cat. House captive elephant may l upset.

Loved the food and ambience. Swimming pool was awesome. Good Hospitality and services by staff. I liked the way they did the business without hurting the environment and ecosystem.Give it a try. You will not regret.🤘

My wife and I were very excited about our trip to Kasara resort and expected a luxurious stay there.. we loved the vibe and the aesthetics when we saw the place. We did face a little bit of issue in the room and were disappointed but Mr. Raj, the manager immediately met us, heard our issues and provided a solution. He went an extra mile just to make sure that our next day was comfortable and luxurious. The way he showed empathy towards us is an exemplary act shown by him. Because of him we now praise and talk highly about your resort to our friends and family. Thank you for an amazing and unforgettable stay.Specially thanking to Mr.Raj khadka sirAlso sagar and madan were amazing guide..the activities were more fun because of their efforts .. all staff members were polite , good and comfortable Kudos to your team

Hospitality is great. Staff behavior and corteuosness is nice. Property is jungle themed. They are renovating few area which may make it better. They provided us pool in private villa which made our experience great while swimming with kids.

The room service was great, felt so close to nature relaxed and the food was great. Great place to escape from daily living and reconnect to nature. Beautiful ambiance and great atmosphere. Good place for business as well. All in all had a wonderful time.

We had one of the greatest experience ❤️ loved everything from food, room, staffs and all. A small complaint would be swimming pool as it was too deep for children . Other than that you made our vacation a wonderful memory.  Special thanks to Madan ji, Raj ji and our canoeing guide Sujan ji for the wonderful hospitality.

Best resort in chitwan . We had a great time in kasara. Away from the noise of city all we could hear was the birds chirping . The villa was awesome with private pool . Nice place to enjoy with your family and friends.

The ideal place to connect with nature is Kasara Resort.I had a great time for four days at Kasara Resort. Beautiful architecture and a serene setting also support Tharu culture and the Tharu community.Thank you for making my trip memorable.

Great Experience at the resort, Very well maintained property. We’ll organised team in general. Most importantly the friendliest staff members, Raj the restaurant manager was very kind and accommodated is to his best everyday in our stay. Do visit for the of nature.

This 2 Days trip to Chitwan in Kasara Resort is our best trip so far. All the staff were really kind and and friendly from reception to Restaurant to housekeeping. I’m very happy that I choose Kasara Resort.  We had the most adventurous trip in the jungle with Sagar brother and Binod brother. Food was amazing. Definitely 💯 .Whole ambiance was very refreshing and quiet. Rooms were nice and cozy (will definitely give a mini Bali vibes). I would definitely recommend my friends in future. Me and my husband, we would love to visit in near future as well. Big Thankyou to all Kasara Family.

From the warm hospitality to the impeccable service, every moment felt like a retreat. The wildlife encounters and jungle safaris were unforgettable experiences. Highly recommend for anyone seeking tranquillity and adventure in the heart of nature."

We loved this resort. You feel like you are living in nature with all of the greenery and bird songs outside.  The rooms are spaced well,with privacy and simple elegance.  The outdoor shower in the bathroom was wonderful.  The meals were amazing.  The long pool was refreshing.  And the staff were all so welcoming and helpful.  Bikes are available.This is the perfect place to relax and plan your safaris into Chitwan National park!

A do-visit resort ! The staffs are amazing. Raj dai, the manager always ready to help if you need something. Our safari guides Mahesh dai and Suzan dai were very fun and friendly. Really glad we met them. Food was exceptional, a huge variety to choose from and fastt service. Overall a very lux and tropical kinda experience. Will definitely revisit !

We were very well looked after .The atmosphere was calming and it all felt so natural, the aesthetics of the place were amazing. The pool was fun and felt cool to swim in. Or was it the temp of the water ? We were very well looked after by  Mr. Raj . All the excursions were delightful and the experienced guides were marvellous. Subash our guide was very enthusiastic and knowledgeable. Loved his attitude. We were fortunate enough to spot a tiger during our safari.Thank you so much for this beautiful experience.

Our stay at Kasara,Chitwan was wonderful. I would really like to thank the hotel staff especially housekeeping. They were all extremely kind and professional and made our stay very enjoyable. We stayed in a room with an incredible view of the garden. It was impeccably clean and well maintained. The breakfast service was delicious and full of variety. The hotel itself is beautiful inside and out.Highly recommended😀

Staff is great, personally accomadating for everybody's tastes and likes. Raj was exceptional with hospitality so we're the rest of the kitchen staff. Very kind and polite. Activities outside of park were seamless and well organized.  The guides were experienced.  The only problem we had was that there was no hot water.  For a 4 star luxury resort I expect hot water.

Excellent place. Great service. Peace of mind ensured. We loved the place and the surroundings, especially the food and Chitwan National Park. Thanks to Alish, Prem, Sagar, Abhishek, Ujjwal and Rohit. Keep it up team.

We had great safaris with our guide Gautam. He put together a personalised programme for us over two days. After the jungle activities we relaxed at the pool. Thanks to the service team including Rohit for your attentive and friendly service.

We are a family of 6 adults traveling together.  Kasara is a little slice of heaven in the jungle.    The food was fantastic.  The staff were incredible - Raj was so helpful and made sure we were well taken care of.  The activities were really fun -Suresh was knowledgeable and taught us many things about the park and the birds and animals we encountered.

All staff were very hospitable and thank you for the service. One of the pleasant stay. We will definitely come back again. Everyone must visit the property once. Rooms were amazing. Thanks to everyone.

Our stay was memorable, villas are spacious, well furnished and maintained. Food was average for bakery items and sandwiches or else other snacks were good. Having a indoor pond had a drawback of breeding mosquitoes, and there were many insects in open bathroom as well. Staffs and their response was great.

We had a wonderful stay in Kasara. Peace, Serene, Ambience what one could ask for more than this beauty. So close to nature. Good food, excellent Hospitality, well behavior staffs. Highly recommended for nice getaway.

Great and mesmerising experiences. The naturalist Mr Babu is extremely knowledgeable about floras and faunas. He is enthusiastic in delivering his knowledge. Kasara resort location is nice. Staff were very friendly and great dining.

I had a wonderful weekend at Kasara Resort with my family. All staff was very polite and courteous. The room was huge, the food was delicious, and the cleanliness was exceptional. I highly recommend it. The pool at the private villa was fantastic. Thank you for the excellent service, Mr. Santosh sir, and the entire Kasara team.

Once I entered the property, all my doubts went away. The beauty and hospitality captivated me. All the staff including the safari's naturalist were all amazing, so the food. I had a wonderful time and would like to visit again. Thank you Kasara

A lovely place to stay with attentive service and clean facilities. Our naturalist showed us such an amazingly diverse range of animals, birds and fish.We were even fortunate enough to spot a tiger coming out of the water while on the elephant safari. I real once in a lifetime experience.

A great resort at the doorstep on Chitwan. Kasara is the perfect blend of rustic and luxury. Extremally friendly staff, great wildlife guides, and a seriously cool room. Very much recommend to anyone wanting to visit Chitwan National Park.

This resort was a paradise for food lovers and nature lover! The meals were exquisite, and the room was so cozy and comfortable. The environment was just perfect, surrounded by beautiful scenery. I highly recommend this resort for a relaxing and delicious getaway!

Excellent experience in Nepal.Very kind people, especially Raj and Abhishek for their service, and Madan our guide. Thank you for your kindness and hospitality, always here for your guests.
