Absolutely everything was perfect - the planning (management is very responsive via e-mail) and even helped us get tickets from Kathmandu, the travel - they picked us up at the airport, the cabana (amazing!!!!), the food (the restaurant staff learned our peculiar preferences in just a day), the pool is large enough to swim for exercise, the jungle trips were all exciting and well planned (we went by foot, bike, elephant, jeep, boat).  A lot of personal attention, but not invasive.  A special shout out to our guide Babu who took the best care of us and showed us a lot of marvels of the jungle - I am convinced he can speak to wild animals.  We stayed 9 days and were never bored.  Thank you thank you thank you.  A really well managed place.

Amazing place with a perfect mix of luxury and natural beauty. Our safari excursions with Babu were top notch and we saw plenty of rhinos and crocs. Our cabin was lovely and we loved the outdoor shower. Definitely coming back.

Visited Nepal and our family took a 3 day trip to Kasara. What an adventure! Staff greeted us at our cars once we pulled into the resort. Upon checking in, the staff offered us cool cloths for our face, cold lemongrass tea, and chocolate cake. The resort is beautiful and set on the skirts of Chitwan National Park. We upgraded to the villas and all safari's, transportation, and meals were included for a very fair price. Our first evening, was a elephant safari. We has a wonderful guide (Kamal) who was very knowledgable and was happy to share his knowledge. There was evening entertainment - Nepalese dancing and animal information slide shows. The spa was relaxing as my entire family had facials and massages. I want to give special thanks to the wait staff. My spa day started before the breakfast buffet. My favorite waiter recognized me walking and came up to me asking if I wanted anything for breakfast. He recognized I was not there that morning for breakfast and wanted to make sure I was taken care of. The staff made us feel really special and went well above and beyond. We left a nice tip for the staff when we left and they deserved every penny.

Its just a paradise.. Although this is my second review for Kasara but still feels fresh to review upon it. Everything and everyone is perfect. Thank you so much to Gauri Jee for her warm hospitality and special birthday retreat. It was amazing to see so much of attention towards the guest in just a simple request. Again, STRONGLY RECOMMENDED

We loved this place...in the middle of rural Nepal on the outskirts of Chitwan National Park...the service was excellent, the food superb and tasty, the sounds of the birds and the superior rooms, suites were simply magical. We could hear birds all the time, we loved the simple architecture and the amazing light streaming in from every angle! the guides were knowledgeable and all the activities were truly an experience...from the safari, to the elephant bathing, to the cultural program. A superb place...I shall be back!

This is my second visit to Kasara, but the first was for work so doesn't really count!The best thing about Kasara is that they treat you like family. Gauri and her team consult with you every evening to plan your activities for the next day, but they don't pressure at all. If you want to be lazy, that's cool too! The resort and rooms are gorgeous, all perfectly integrated into nature and vice versa. The entry to each villa is like a small oasis perfect for napping or reading.For your naturalist/guide, request Babu. He is from the area and very knowledgable about the flora and fauna as well as local culture. Plus he's very flexible, adapting to my family's mercurial desires with no problem. The food is unfailingly good, with lots of veg options, but plenty of meat & fish for the carnivores. Fresh fruit juices are to die for! (Watermelon & guava my favorites)

Peaceful, tranquil location. Beautiful, elegant, simple resort design. Delicious food, great service. Memorable treks into Chitwan, where we saw rhinos, deer, elephants, wild boar, crocodiles.. Our naturalist Babu was helpful and informative, with a great wealth of knowledge about the park and its inhabitants. But the best part was falling asleep at night to the sounds of the forest -- amazing. What a great escape from the every day! We loved our visit and look forward to returning again soon.

We stayed at the Kasara for two nights during our visit to Nepal. Kasara is a peaceful, 5 star resort that offers outstanding service from the moment you check in until you leave. The rooms are unique and comfortable, the food outstanding and wine and bar choices adequate. Our naturalist, Jeet, was excellent! From the elephant and jeep safaris to the river canoeing and jungle walk - his knowledge and expertise was the best. We really felt like our stay was customized to our desires and cannot recommend this place enough! Everyone we met there went out of their way to make sure our stay was the best possible. The area itself is beautiful and not to be missed. Thank you Kasara for making our visit one we will never forget.

The one night I spent in Chitwan at Kasara Resort was the highlight of an outstanding Nepalese adventure.  A friend from Pokhara got married and invited a group of us on an overnight safari adventure.  We took a five hour bus ride, winding our way through the Nepalese plateau into the jungle and Chitwan.  The bus trip ended somewhat suddenly, as Kasara Resort is not much to look at from the outside.  But once in?  It was terrific.The facilities are top notch.  A clean, modern lobby and gleaming outdoor pool greeted us, The decor is both modern and evocative of safari adventures.  We each had our own hut, albeit with secure doors and walls.  The shower is an "outdoor shower" in the sense that the bathroom is walled but not roofed in its connection to the bedroom, but the hot water was excellent and the privacy absolute.   The highlight, though, was not the decor, but the adventures.  We fit two into our overnight trip.  After freshening up after our arrival, we proceeded to take a sunset canoe ride in the adjacent river, with our excellent guide Kamal pointing out wildlife in both our canoes and ashore at a crocodile sanctuary.  As fun as this adventure was, though, it paled in comparison to the sunrise elephant safari the next morning.  Our group mounted gentle adult female elephants (four per elephant) and headed off into the morning mist.  While we failed to spot the elusive tiger, we did find a rhino after fording the river on the backs of our pachyderms.  It was an amazing and unforgettable experience. In short, I had an amazing time, and I could not recommend Kasara Resort highly enough.

We did not stop smiling for the 3 days  we were staying at the Kasara resort and it is an experience not to be missed.  It is a very beautiful resort - food excellent, staff helpful and all the jungle experiences were amazing.

What a surprise to find ourselves in an architect designed, cool, contemporary oasis. Kamal, the resident naturalist did a great job looking after us and imparting information on wild-life, plants and cultural life of the district. We had organised for us a trip into the reserve on elephant back, a visit to the crocodile breeding centre, a trip down the river in a dug out canoe, a chance to wash elephants in the river and have them wash us in return and a fascinating trip around local countryside and villages on ox drawn carts.

Thanks to Mrs. Gauri. Our trip was well planned and managed. We throughly enjoyed the trip. Perfect food. well considered for Veggies like us. Great feeling with a customized and personal  cannoy, elephant safari and Jeep Safari were really memorable Would like to visit again for sure.

Travelled solo  21 - 23 September  and really didn't want to leave.  My first impression was the fragrance of lemon grass which is growing all around the resort and the welcoming lemon grass drink is one of the most refreshing I've ever had.  What a surprise awaited on opening the door to my room.  A wooden bridge over a lily filled pond ending in a small relaxing area.  To the right an extremely well appointed bedroom   (bed so comfortable) and to the left an almost open air bathroom.  It rained heavily one night and it was quite fun being in the bathroom with the rain coming down (didn't get wet). Resort  very quiet when I was there and I felt as if I owned the resort.   Open air dining room and upstairs bar/tv room very comfortable; food excellent and best of all two one-horned rhinos came grazing very close to the dining room (and I didn't have my camera there).  All the staff at the resort were wonderful and I should single out the General Manager, the Restaurant Supervisor and my wildlife guide (Kamal Adhikari).  So much to do and see around the resort, but my favourite thing was going down the river in flat bottomed boat, walking through the jungle and visiting the crocodile farm. Lucky to be  there at feeding time and to see the wonderful job that is being done in breeding and raising the crocs . Then elephant rides (with birdwatching and rino sighting); elephant bathing and meeting some of the local ladies.  I later found out that this resort is owned by the same company as Gokarna Forest Resort in Kathmandu.  No wonder it was such a pleasant experience and I would like to congratulate the owners on their attention to detail and on employing such good and caring staff at their Resorts.  Yes I would certainly try to rush back to  Kasara for a longer stay.

Having been on a roller coaster tour of other towns in Nepal, it was a welcome break from the hustle and bustle. The resort is extremely comfortable, with an ideal setting if you not only want to sample the national park, but also chill by the pool in the sun. Our lodge was beautiful. Nature was brought inside with an open air bathroom and quaint pool in the seating area. The bedroom was comfort and airy. The grounds are well maintained, with trees and foliage adding to the calm and serene environment.We did lots of activities, such as jeep safari, elephant safari and canoeing. We were blessed with perfect weather and got to see many different wild animals including rhino, deer, wild boar and birds. The trips were well organised and our guide was knowledgable and made the experience much more enjoyable!We chilled by the pool for a day and soaked up the sun. The meals were varied, tasty and well presented. There were a few options to choose from, but the availability of things such as fresh juice were limited, which is my only suggestion to improve. Overall we were looked after and made to feel comfortable and welcome. I highly recommend staying here! Thank you to all the staff for looking after us!

Short stay but remarkable memories. From the beginning to till the end, it was just perfect. Concept of the resort is a distinct and loved it. Amenities of the room were excellent. Food were more than delicious. Staff were just like a nearby friends. Thanks to Bikesh, Leela, Gauri, Shankar and all the team to make our stay like home away home. Really glad to have our stay over here. Definitely visit here again. Thumbs Up!!!!

Excellent service from very friendly and knowledgable staff members. Especially liked the lodging ammenities with the concept of open spaces. Wonderful to have a shower and do your thing under the open skies.

We were so glad we made the decision to breakup our Nepal stay with a visit to Chitwan National Park. After an African safari in 2013, we were so happy to experience a jungle safari for comparison. The Kasara Resort is all inclusive.  In addition to the room and board it includes a set itinerary for 2 nights or 3 nights stay. If you have the time opt for the three night stay to get the full experience. We enjoyed a canoe ride, a nature walk, an elephant safari then an all day safari on an open air jeep which included visits to several viewing platforms.  All were first rate.  We spotted rhinos, crocodiles, wild boars, sloth bears and many many more animals.  The only elusive animal we did not see was the royal bengal tiger which only 20% of the visitors to the park are lucky enough to see.The resort itself was beautiful.  Each suite had an outdoor seating area at the entry, an enclosed bedroom and an outdoor bathroom. My only warning would be the mosquitos in the dining area, but hey, you are in the jungle and that is part of nature.  We did find that if you sat under a moving fan, there were less insects!  Glad I had a chance to stay at this beautiful resort.

Kasara is a stunningly beautiful resort located at the edge of the Chitwan National Park in southern Nepal. The accommodation, food and facilities are of the very best standard with separate spacious bungalows for each guest.The staff are wonderful and will care for you like family. The safari guide Kamal will take you on elephant and jeep safaris to spot wildlife in the park. One of our highlights was elephant washing where you go to the river with your elephant and get washed along with the elephant with spray from its trunk. After this the elephant lies down in the shallow water and gurgles while you massage it with a smooth round stone.

I cannot stress the amazing nature of the staff at Kasara.  Within minutes of our arrival Nepal was hit with a 7.9 earthquake.  Since we live in Kathmandu, we were immediately concerned with verifying our loved ones were ok.  Second, we were concerned with getting home.  The staff spent an extensive period of time on the phone trying to get us a flight home, even looking for a helicopter if necessary, and ultimately arranging a car to take us.  In all my travels I have not seen such a response to an urgent situation.  Even though we had to cut our trip short, the facilities are top notch and gorgeous.  I highly recommend.

The staffs in kasara are all so friendly that it was like they were my long known friends.. The manager gauri di, I still remember how she got drunk when the guests insisted her to drink wine with them..as she couldn't refuse.. Hehe, just I will never forget the time I spent here..

Its always been my dream to visit this resort once as I have heard and seen in website with really nice exterior, interiors, swimming pools and private villas. When we got chance (including my wife and son) to visit this resort the first feeling was WOW! and no doubt when we reach there, not only the resort itself, all staffs greeted us with warm welcome and with nice hospitality. They have take all care of us specially my 1 yr old son. It was during Valentine's Day so we got really special treat and facilities. I highly recommend all my friends and associates to visit once in your life time to Kasara Resort.  You will love it, enjoy it and feel very near to nature...

Kasara is like an oasis in the jungle. Your room is almost like it's own cottage. Though I think it's attached to another behind, you would never know it. It's very private and when you enter you cross a small wooden bridge over a small pond. This courtyard area is open to the sky. There are then doors to your right and left, one being your bedroon, which is fully enclosed and the other being the bathroom, which is partially open to the sky. it was almost like showering outside, but with full privacy. You could see the sky and trees. On the short drive from the resort to the park, you pass through small villages where all the kids come out and wave and yell 'bye'. The locals were really friendly and the staff at the resort were great. Everyone from the restaurant wait staff, to the chef, to the front desk and cleaning people, you were greeted with a smile and a 'namaste'. Of course, the guides that take you to the park are superb, knowledgeable and friendly. great experience.

i cannot say enough good things about Kasara and our naturalist Kamal Adhikari.   They treated us perfectly  from start to finish.  A very enjoyable, interesting visit...We learned a lot about wildlife...through many venues..jungle walks, jungle safari, canoe, elephant visits...  Thank you Kamal!

A different experience altogether. Since its very new, operational for less than 2 years, the cleanliness, maintenance etc is very nice. Very good ambience, well planned. Hospitality is at a new level, good food. Best place to stay in Kasara. Rooms are a new experience in itself. Equipped with all amenities like Conference room, Swimming pool etc. They arranged for traditional Tharu dane program for our group in the evening, it was very awesome. They have very uniquely designed Jeeps for Safari in Chitwan National park. Incredible experience. Ek baar toh jana banta hai.

The Hotel:We stayed at the property for two nights. The property is isolated but lovely and the schedule of activities is well thought out.  The staff went out of their way to help and be considerate of our needs.  Regrettably I would never go there in the winter months unless you could be insured of warm weather.  Everything except the sleeping area of your bungalow is outside and NOT heated. To get to the bathroom, in 1 degree Celsius weather is horrible when in the middle of the night the toilet seat is frozen....and forget taking a shower even though the water is warm.  The dining facilities had too few heat lamps that just weren't adequate for the chilly breakfasts and dinners.Nepalese food can be wonderful, whether vegetarian or not. This food was repetitive and bland at best. (someone told them that tourists want spaghetti and lasagna).The fire pit was lovely and much appreciated.The hotel never told us before hand that one shouldn't wear pink, red, or white...make sure you don't!StaffExcellent.  our flight was late, the staff checked on that for us. Rather than just staying at the "airport" they arranged an extra elephant ride at no cost.Our  naturalist Babu (as mentioned in other reviews) was spectacular. His  knowledge and patience and attention was exemplary.   The driver Surendra helped point out many things and was great! Together they were a perfect team.We had the best service (not food) in the dining hall. Both Gayatri aand Sumina were just perfectly attentive, memorized our needs and were superb for any five star institution.

Wow! What an incredible adventure. So many activities to do that allow you to see the real Nepal. The experience is high quality, genuine and raw. The Elephant Safari was an absolute highlight. Incredible! We had Babu as our tour guide and he was amazing.... Kasara Resort is lucky to have him on their team. The food was great and much better than I expected. Plenty of activities to fill the days, and a warm fire with sitting area at night (bring your own wine if you like!). Three nights here is perfect, maybe two if you're short on time. Also recommend maybe bringing some toys/crayons for the children/local school, although absolutely not expected of you. The locals enjoy having you in their neighbourhood and have a genuine friendliness about them. An incredible experience and highly worth the visit.Only negative: poor Wifi signal and connection.

My family spend 3 Nights at Kasara Resort, and we have nothing but great memories. The Resort itself is situated right beside the nature reserve, perfectly situated to take in all the sights and sounds.The staff were delightful and accommodation, more than happy to see to it that we were all well taken care of.Would definitely make an effort to make a trip back in the future!

Beautiful stylish resort (even if the open bathrooms, including toilette, may not help to keep away mosquitos). Since the government closed all the resorts in the national parks it is considered one of the best. Service is good, but not so attentive as you may expect from such an hotel.Activities includes jeep safari, walking and elephant safari. The elephant safari is a truly fantastic experience, but not expect to see many animals...sign of a tiger is rare and if you are lucky, this will be only for very few seconds

Lovely property in Chitwan.  The staff were so helpful and pleasant, always ready to help with any request.  Rooms were very nice, with the washrooms open to the sky.  The elephant ride through the jungle was great along with the ride through one of the villages.  Fabulous dugout canoe ride down the river with a visit to the crocodile breeding farm and sanctuary were all well worth it.

Perfect jungle getaway... Kasara was amazingly pleasant experience, The staff were polite and very personal. Overall a totally great place to relax and wonder with nature. I recommended, You should definitely try the elephant shower.

This place is like a breath of fresh air in the Chitwan area, not only is the resort designed in a very unique and modern way it is in sync with nature also. What sets this place different from the other resorts in the area is its staff service, food and the activities that they have planned for the guests.I had gone with my children and they enjoyed all the activities thoroughly especially the jeep ride in the heart of the jungle, our guide Kamal was excellent in spotting big game. The elephant ride was a little disappointing as we were unable to spot much of the wildlife, however was still a lot of fun. Elephant bathing was fun, the resort has its own Elephant stable with 5 elephants.Over all a great fun trip...

I want to commend their staffs for being so sincerely kind, friendly and accommodating to me. Most of the staffs are from the local villages and it was really nice to feel that each of them welcomes me with sincerity. I can feel their excitement when they share their ways of life in their villages. Hat-off to their management team for being so hands-on. They always see to it that everyone is having a great time.

We spent quiet New Year's Eve with family at Kasara. Loved their open jeep for jungle safari, small details and attentive staffs. Rooms are interesting but I'm not sure how feasible they are for summers. Clean and nice restaurant and lovely pool. Will definitely visit again. Recommended for couples.

2 nights and 3 days at Kasara Resort was an amazing experience. The resort has a unique architectural design, the rooms are basic yet makes you feel something extra ordinary, the food is great, the pool looks awesome and the staffs are very nice and friendly; all in all definitely a place worth visiting.

A newly built resort.  Excellent amenities.  The bungalow was spacious, beds comfortable.  Reception by staff and surroundings top notch.  Since the bathroom is open to the sky (loved seeing the stars at night), it is a very unique touch.  But if you're afraid of spiders or geicos it may not be for you -but that's part of the experience.  Educational and wildlife programs are very interesting and I especially enjoyed the sunrise canoe ride on the river.  I am lucky to have experienced such a unique hotel.

I couldn't have imagined a place like this...in the jungle! Beautiful rooms, great bathroom where you can see the stars while enjoying a shower, great staff who help you...The elephant ride was great, we could see a rhino, cocofriles from a boat...really great. After all the activities it's great to relax in the pool! Great!

Kasara is a lovely resort adjoining Chitwan National Park.  The approachable and friendly staff planned an awesome itinerary for us with an elephant ride, river cruise and jeep Safari.  The park itself is breath-taking and the resort is comfortable, airy and relaxed. Loved the little courtyard with pool adjoining our room and the outdoor bathrooms.   Had an excellent massage at their spa.  Our five year old son loved interacting with the staff and felt very at home at the resort.Our guide Baburam was very well informed and clearly loved his job!   Thank you to Gauri for handling all our travel arrangements so efficiently and to Yadav for an excellent perspective on life in Nepal.  It is the little gestures that make a place special and memorable and that is what we remember Kasara for.  Highly recommended for a holiday with kids!

This is  a superb resort;it was part of our two week holiday having travelled down from PokharaThe accommodation is light and airy,beautifully designed and very comfortable. The staff in the resort are attentive and very helpful. We had an elelphant safari ride to see the rhinos and the following day drifted down the river with our guides. Their knowledge and expertise were impressive.The swimming pool is situated just next to the dining and bar area. Th

We were there for our Annual Retreat, management couldn't have choosen a better place. Quite, peaceful, spacious, luxurious are few of the traits i would associate Kasara with. The jeep ride was comparatively superior and if you are canoeing, time it just before the sunset, you will experience a beautiful sunset over the Rafti river.Good food, friendly staff and modern yet simple rooms with uniquely architect restrooms were some of the highlights whilst our stay in Kasara Resort.

A perfect place for family, honeymooners.  The resort has great combination of simple, unique luxury and locality. I have stayed other resorts in Chitwan and haven't expected there is a resort like Kasara... Its a five star resort in terms tidiness, space, services and foods.

A warm and personalized welcome started an awesome 2 night stay at this oasis and the room was as beautiful as promised on their website. The food was absolutely delicious and the chef put a lot of effort to make the meals as variable as possible. Even though the weather posed a challenge, the warmth and hospitality of the entire staff more than made up for it. Starting from the reception, to the guides and the dining area staff, everyone had a ready smile and cheerful attitude that made our stay a memorable one. It will be a pleasure to return for another break as soon as the loose ends are tied at the resort and the remaining construction is over.

We had an incredible stay at Kasara with friends. When we arrived, we had the pleasant surprise of being upgraded to the family villa. The resort is very beautiful, the swimming pool is exceptional and the beds around it allow you to really relax. We were on the full board option and all the meals were excellent. We really loved the safari organized very early in the morning and the breakfast taken in the jungle. We will come back with pleasure.

Very nice establishment with a caring team, close to the Chitwan National Park. The hotel organizes park tours/safaris as well as canoe trips. We were able to see 3 rhinos, lots of deer, deer, crocodiles and multiple birds. Very good restaurant also at the hotel. Do not hesitate.

A treasure in the Nepalese jungle with perfectly furnished rooms with attention to every single detail. Excellent breakfasts and dinners and very kind staff. They organize various trips including those by jeep or on foot in the jungle and the animal encounters are unique!

Magnificent resort to rest after a trek: comfortable bungalows, varied and excellent food, smiling and dedicated staff etc... The resort is isolated and close to a still authentic village. Don't hesitate to borrow a bike to explore the surrounding roads and paths. But, if you have any strength left and you appreciate nature and the jungle in particular, you will be spoiled. I had the chance to spend 3 days in the company of Madan, an experienced and passionate guide. I can only recommend it to you. Let yourself be carried away by his enthusiasm and skills. I would have happily stayed a few more days....

We spent 2 fantastic days with perfect service.This lodge is exceptional, with magnificent accommodation, a sumptuous swimming pool and attentive staff.The activities are incredible, canoeing, walking in the jungle, safari...

We stayed in the lodge for 2 nights as part of a tour of Nepal. We were given a very friendly welcome in this great hotel complex, the room with a shower, partly outdoors, was very clean. We ate every meal in the restaurant, the cuisine is varied and very tasty.The staff and the service were above average, we felt absolutely comfortable at all times because everyone was very friendly.

We booked for 3 nights and ended up staying for 4.  A big thanks to Binny and the team for a memorable NYE stay. Food overall was great and well presented, only suggestion is to change the menu for lunches for people who stay over a certain duration.  The NYE dinner was amazing – so much variety and well presented.  So lovely to see silver service again – nice touch.  My husband was very impressed with the Japanese food – Sushi was great.  For outside dining (especially for December/January) be prepared for a cold night – bring warm clothes. Thankyou Robin for looking after us in the restaurant – always remembered what we liked to drink.  Alcohol is expensive and we found even house wine over priced.Getting to the lodge - The trip from Kathmandu to Chitwan (dependant on time of year) can be hit/miss ie. air flights get delayed or cancelled due to weather – especially in December, so have a ‘plan b’ if the flights get changed.  The road from the local airport to lodge is mainly open road so have your transfers booked through the lodge for a more comfortable ride.Safaris – Thanks Asbin for your knowledge and insights into the animals in Chitwan whilst on our drives.  We saw deer, tigers, rhino, peacocks, monkeys, crocs and while bore and lots of birds.  We have done many African safaris – so this was a first Nepalese safari, especially seeing the tiger so close.  To see animals in Chitwan, you need to be patient and do more than one safari.  Safaris are quite expensive (in comparison to others we have done) and additional to room fee, so suggest you budget accordingly. Would not suggest early morning safaris due to the fog - doesnt start to lift until about 11am.Accommodation – we had a one-bedroom villa on the river front, which was well presented, quiet and also close to the main lodge. During December, it can get cold, so air cons warm up the room and bathroom.  I would highly recommend a visit to this lodge but be prepared for the air or road trip – not always easy in Nepal to get to places due to traffic or weather.

This hotel is utter perfection. But the staff are what really brings it to life.We stayed here for a few magical days. But really that wasn’t long enough to do this special place justice. This small boutique hotel is nestled on the edge of the park. All of the rooms have incredible views. They are clean and beautifully decked out. We were lucky enough to receive a room upgrade (thank you). Upon arrival all the staff come to greet you. Nothing is too much trouble for them. We went on game drives, where we were lucky enough to see a rhino & baby and even a tiger. These naturalists really know the park and are experts in their field. Every evening the team prepared a special meal for us in various locations across the hotel. It was my husbands birthday while we were there and they utterly spoiled him with decorations (thanks Prabita)and even a cake. Sadly our trip was cut short due to the corona issues at home. And the staff yet again were amazing. They supported us in the best ways possible, holding and rearranging flights. They went above and beyond for us and we are truly grateful. (We made the flight- thank you)!!!We are lucky enough to have travelled to many parts of the world. But never in my life have I cried as I departed. The kindness of the staff here are a credit to the Taj brand. I hope these special employees are supported through these difficult times ahead so many more people (including us again) get enjoy their hospitality in this breathtaking place.

I went with family members and the three of us stayed in two high floor rooms in the main resort building. Rooms were fantastic and well designed in every way. Property is beautiful and serene. But the best part was the courteous and caring staff. Our server Sanjay made every meal a memorable experience and the chef is a star. The operations manager Prayatna was hospitable and competent. Our guide for the boat and jeep safari was well informed and we saw a tiger (along with rhinos, crocodiles, three kinds of deer, etc.)! The Tharu cultural show with dinner was fun. I look forward to going back again with more family and friends!

One of the best experiences. Location and views are amazing with blissful sound of river Rapti. The staff is very courteous and they make every effort to turn the stay personalised and special. The way their head chef Hitendra put all efforts to make every meal tasteful & worth remembering is beyond expectations. Have never seen someone dedicating so much personal attention to the preferences of every guest. Their other staff (Sanjay, Chitra) and naturalist Pradeep also were extraordinary.

The property, the hospitality, the food - everything makes a trip to this place worth the while.The manager Kamal and our Steward Sanjay made our visit special and helped take care of our every needWe stayed in Villa 11 which had a really good view of the river. (Villas 3, 6, 11 and 15 have an unobstructed view of the river)We spent an entire day at their property enjoying the room and a morning jungle safari. This is a must visit property at Nepal. It was undoubtedly my favourite part of my Nepal trip

One name - SANJAY!When we arrived the Taj, the hospitality we received during their busy Christmas week was out of this world.  The location of the Meghauli Serai is just picturesque !!!! The property is beautiful and you can tell they take great care of their property and are proud of it!Now to the star of our stay! - SANJAY!!!! From the moment we met him to the day we left, Sanjay took such great care of us!!!!! He made sure nothing was missed.  I have a very limited choice of foods due to some severe sensitivities and he was well aware of these before we even got there and made sure I had everything I could eat.  He Truly was a gem and planned an amazing surprise for us on our first night for dinner.  It was truly an amazing experience and the food was just amazing in taste and quality and cooked and served with heart and pride.  We enjoyed our conversations with him as well. We had a great safari experience with Buddhi and Santosh they did everything they could to help us find a tiger but luck was not on our side with that.  Regardless we saw some amazing game and thoroughly enjoyed it. Amit the Manager there was also a great resource and had some good conversations with him as well.  Only suggestion for the hotel would be  - outside our villa we had sewer smell at times but once we walked past the room number we couldn't smell it, so maybe just figure out a way to disguise that.  One more suggestion would be some aromatherapy oil burners in the bathroom, it would really add a nice refreshing touch.  Lemongrass would be great to help keep bugs away as well.You will NOT go wrong if you book them.

What a hotel amazing.Where do you start, the spa not well advertised but the best massages ever with amazing tranquil views.The staff literally cannot do enough to make your stay special.The attention to detail unparalleled, even simple things most hotels leave 2 toilet rolls so if you run out you have to ask for more here 4 available at all times it’s tiny touches like this that really distinguish the hotel.Man our naturalist guide, wow what a man, what a guide what a legend, we had 2 boys not the quietest on a boat or jungle safari and he managed to keep them safe despite their best efforts to the contrary and still provided an exception series of experiences.  Man is hugely knowledgeable of the animals in the area, we saw it all.  Couldn’t have been better amazing.Only down side it is an expensive stay but once in a lifetime experience.

First the goods…The people, wonderful hospitality and service beyond comparison. Names that will be remembered, Anjan who was soft spoken calm and always a step ahead, (couldn’t get his snap) Sanjay the Tharu expert who brought us authenticity and service from the heart of Chitwan, Chitra always giving us a little more special care especially when one travels with kids, and even on the morning of the auspicious Dashain. With a smile. The team and staff are top rate and authentic in their efforts. This is the core team. The Naturalist was quite knowledgeable and we had wonderful sighting of One horned rhinos and spotted deer. The Spa too was on par & amazing. The cultural Tharu night was exotic and a great experience.  A complete wholesome experience.The Taj Safari ( Meghauli Serai) , well the design, sights & beauty was befitting a world famous group. But in some areas we saw the chinks. Maybe a little behind on the high standards they offer in other locations . If you are willing to look the other way on some fails and soak in the human experience it’s a great experience

I am a regular traveller to Chitwan and stayed in most of the premium properties but my experience at Taj is like no one, it was felt like each one of the hotel staff knows us for a long time in an hour of checking in. Sanjay is a very humble guy and gives us the wonderful tour of the property with a surprise in the evening dinner by creating my company's name with stones and Pabita is a pleasing girl to serve most of our meals. Prayatna again carries a humble behaviour. The chef Mr Bogati was always there to extend a special dish and was knowing our preferences after serving first meal. The natularlist accompanied us to the Jungle Safari tried to give us best out of his knowledge. We are fortunate to have such a nice property in our country. The best part is most of the staffs are local people and with no high hotel management education they are perfectly trained. The traditional welcome and good byes touches the heart.The villa, we stayed in is beautifully made.

My wife and I traveled from the US and stayed at this location from March 28th - 30th 2023.The location and ameneties at the hotel were excellent. Even better was the service and friendliness of the staff at the hotel.On our arrival, we were very warmly greeted by the team. Pramod and Rupa were the management staff who helped us with our checkin, stay and giving us the tour of the property. Chitra, with his ever smiling face, served us our meals during our stay. Head Chef Hitender ensured that the meals were delicious and prepared with care. Buddhi was our knowledgeable guide who took us on a boat ride, jeep safari, and jungle walk. Santosh was our driver who brought us from the airport to the hotel took us on a jeep safari. We were able to see a Bengal Tiger, Rhinocerous, Deer and many other wildlife during our safari through Chitwan National Forest.We were also treated to a traditional dinner and dance event on the second night of our stay.A very special Thanks to the entire team ay Meghauli Sarai in making our stay enjoyable and memorable!

One word explains all - PERFECT!!  Experience at the hotel and safari was just awesome. It is luxury in wild!!Breathtaking setting, delicious food, cultured &  helpful staff. Everyone makes you feel welcome. All room types have their own privacy. Villas have river view and the rooms have a lake view where you see lotus blooming.We did 2 safaris - one in the National Park, spotted rhinos, leopards, deers and many birds. Second was boat ride- spotted different kinds of avian fauna and crocodiles. And later we were taken to a wild spot to see the sunset. IT WAS AMAZING!! Another aspect that needs mention here is that they have a different meal menu everyday. It is a full course meal. The chef puts lot of effort in each preparation. It's not buffet style routine stuff that you find in other 5 star properties. And if you are not ok with the menu, you can ask for a change. There are spa services. That was excellent too. Overall a complete and beautiful experience. Do not miss it!

The best way to experience Chitwan is to stay at ‘ taj meghuli serai ‘ . It’s right on the river that flows along the forest. Many of the rooms are looking at the river.Chittwan is not to be missed in Nepal , this 900 sq km  forest Sanctuary along the river is well preserved, untouched. The forest is very dense , tall trees , 100’s of birds spices. Rinos , the majestic tiger and all other animals. The jungle safari starts by just getting down from the hotel lobby  on the boat and crossing over . A jungle safari vehicle is waiting on the other side  with expert trained naturalist  to take you inside the forest. There is a  river cruise on a small boat to look out for animals is also planned the next day.The food served here is one of the best. The local foods cooked authentically is the treat of this treasure hunt. Highly recommended to try. Many of staff are all  the surrounding villages. Excellent environment in the campus ‘ the large lotus ponds is a visual treat ‘ . The walking paths with array of local trees and grasses is relaxing , couple of visits at the spa all put together makes it a rejuvenating experience.Can land outside the hotel lobby by chopper from Pokhra in 25 minutes .Would like to mention few names of their team  Pratyna , Laxmi  , Ashbin , sanjay and all others there demonstrate  the sincere hospitality culture of Nepal  making  your stay charming and memorable.Tiger  spotting is not very frequent, though there is a large number of tigers. We did spot briefly.

Meghauli Serai Taj Safari was an awesome memory with a luxurious stay.It lies near the banks of the Rapti river and near Chitwan National Park. The temperature during the day was really hot and humid. We explored the outdoors during the evening and nighttime. The Tharu tribe was the center of everything in the hotel. We ate tharu dish and 4+ other dishes around the globe during our stay. The room was super luxurious which included the ever-fabulous bathroom with a dunge dhara(stone tap) showering space.We also had a private pool. We did not go Jungle safari but I personally spotted some deer and unique birds to the other side of the banks of Rapti. Next time I will try out the elephant safari. I really loved the room suite. The staff was really respectful and helpful. If you are looking for a relaxed chilling luxury I would definitely recommend this Hotel.

Without doubt one of the favorite Resort/Hotel I stayed last February! Upon arrival we were warmly welcomed by all staff to the hotel manager – Ms. Camil and Bimal did a sweet check-in ritual. The staff was extremely friendly, the restaurant staff Chitra and Anja are such delight, everyone has a warm smile and very flexible on my little requests (appreciate this!) and the restaurant manager deserves a special thanks. We had two great evenings here, which obviously also added up to the experience. As I call it magical evenings by the river and the cultural evening!   The first day we did a jeep safari which was guided by Man. He and along with one more guide (sorry forgot the name) have such a warm personality and highly motivated guide (recommendable!). I truly enjoyed walking safari on day 2 - the four of us through the lush jungle. The scenery was beautiful and it was a relief to walk in such a quiet and peaceful environment. The surprise warm flower bath with personal note arranged by Ms Camil and her team on the end was so thoughtful and a great way to end our last night at this place!  Note, this is not the best weather when we were at the property, but the atmosphere and the personal touch is so special that it really felt like home to me. All mad respect for the management and the whole team who does a wonderful job here! a true model of excellent hospitality from the heart. Top class and Unparalleled!

I cannot say enough about the level of service at this resort.  We have travelled the world and have stayed in some of the most unique resorts. Taj chitwan will stand out from the others: We were treated with utmost care from the time we checked in and our family of five made special memories here.  The food staff went out their way to accommodate to our dietary needs and this was definitely the best culinary experience we had in Nepal.  We truly appreciate and thank the full taj team and want to give a special recognition to Pramod, the chefs hitendra and Kapil, The servers Pabita, chitra and Sanjay. The nature guides Pradeep and Santosh. Sandeep at the front desk. We are humbled by their service and would recommend to book this unique Hotel  if you are reading this review.  The Vilas were fantastic. The view from the Vilas is amazing. We saw a lot of animals but alas no tiger…this time! A word of acknowledgment for the general manager Binny who helped our daughters with their flight issues. Thank you for caring so much❤️

it's about 45 min. from the airport along a road lined with colorful houses, beautiful fields, etc. The resort is in a quiet and tranquil location; faces the river. Each unit has a small and private pool. Rooms is large with a very big bathroom. Overall pretty modern mixed with local antiques and art work.Breakfast buffet is not particularly extensive and not really western taste oriented (which is understandable) however, you can special order things.Huge swimming pool with lots of lounge chairs - in the shade or sun.Most exciting were the small boat trips over to the island where we were met by guides (max of 6 to a vehicle) who drove us through the jungle (absolutely wonderful). Never saw a tiger, but quite a few rhinos which was incredibly exciting (one crossed the river and took its time). overall lovely scenery. Our guide, Asbin, was very informative and spoke very good English.

Such a very welcoming place, starting from arriving till you leave, they have Helisite, with sunset you can feed the elephant inside the resort, one the events we had a caltural dance and it was very nice, telling the story behind the villages. I highly recomind the safari as the guide was well informative. Food is good, they have choices of vegetarian food.

Wonderful experience.  Welcoming staff, large and comfortable rooms, and health food from their organic garden. Access to the Chitwan Park was extremely easy - full of rhinos, monkeys, bears and deer. Unfortunately did not see any tigers…next time!

Perfect place to stay, superb service, excellent food, above 5 star, cannot go wrong. Very well organized park Safari trips,  enjoyed boat ride, elephant ride, nice view of river, dining right on the river bank.Will come back...

We went to Meghauli Serai for our honeymoon early December 2021. It was such a wonderful experience with perfect weather conditions. We would like to say a massive thank you to Sanjay Dai. We really enjoyed his personality, dinner decorations (special honeymoon dinner), surprise cake (hidden in plain sight) and little pranks. Most of all, introducing us to Tharu culture. We had a very pleasant pick-up/drop-off from Bharatpur airport. We stayed in a villa with private pool. It was perfect for us. We also did a boat safari and Jeep Safari during our stay (we were very lucky to see Momma and Baby Rhino up-close) and various types of deer. Our safari guide Santosh bhai was very knowledgeable and knew his animals/birds really well. Thank you to him as well.Overall, its a hotel I would highly recommend and would go back again, maybe for our Anniversary :)

After a back breaking journey of 7 hours from Kathmandu through bad road and traffic jam we landed at this property and it was definitely worth the trouble.  I am a big fan of Taj properties and the hotel met all my expectations.  The villas are wonderful,  spacious, clean with huge a bathroom. Food was good.  Service was great with all staff always attentive to guest's need.  Best part of the hotel is it's location.  The flowing water of the Rapti river and the Chitwan national park at the other end is truly amazing.  We went on a safari ride of about four hours, spotted few animals.  The evening boat ride with watching the sunset on the river bank with tea and snacks was very enjoyable. Thanks to the entire team of Meghauli Serai for making our stay so memorable. Special thanks to Aakruti, Sandeep, Sanjay, Mr Amit and tour guide Asbin. We would love to stay again at this hotel.

Our stay at Meghauli Serai was pretty awesome. From Airport pickup till airport drop, everything was taken care by their team without any issues. Very good food, thanks to Chef Lekhraj and Steward Anjan. The best part was everything was looked after, 0 error's on the management.We took Elephant safari and boat ride, both were great. We had fun with our little one's. Overall, great staff, great property and excellent management.Keep up the good work.

A truly wonderful & special way to explore Chitwan.  The property itself is beautifully laid out with villas looking directly out over the Rapti River and into the Chitwan Reserve.  But what really made the stay so special was the staff and their incredible Nepali hospitality.  From the amazing Naturalists to the wonderful F&B staff.  A call out in particular to Sanjay - who went out of his way to make our meals (& coffees) exceptional - and Santosh whose passion for his home and habitat really made our safari very meaningful.

This was a really fantastic short visit, three nights. From the welcome at the airport through the elephant safari, elephant bathing, boat rides and fantastic sunsets, with delicious food, comfortable clean rooms and,most importantly friendly,  efficient and smiling staff, to the farewell it was fabulous. Nothing lacking here, except a tiger. All the more reason to come back.

The resort is very comfortable with a staff that is incredibly nice and helpful all along the way. Our safari guide, Buddhi, was knowledgeable and engaging at all times. His excitement to show us the amazing wild animals of Chitwan was infectious! We loved every minute of it.

This lovely safari hide-away is located by the river, all lodges have a terrace with views into nature. The lodge organises safaris by jeep and boat, we saw rhinos, crocs and elefant, numerous birds, and took a sundowner by the river. Lodges are confortable, indoor and outdoor shower, great bathrooms. Great food and wonderful friendly service everywhere. Wonderful place!

Beautiful hotel, amazing experience of hospitality and feeling of a taylor made service. Views on the river and rinos on the other side are magic. Food was amazing and we decided to take a class from the chef what was organized in a perfetct way. Our guide/naturalist Buddi organized us a perfect experience in the safary and sunset. Thank you!

I would absolutely suggest anyone reading this and looking for a peaceful stay in Chitwan to book this without a doubt. The hospitality and warmth we received at Meghauli Serai was beyond comparable. Their manager Vishal took person care of us while coordinating exact time of our arrival for first of many surprises they had planned. Sanjay and Pabita took our meals too seriously and made sure not just our bellies but our hearts were full as well. Buddhi took us for the safari with more than half a dozen Rhinos. I would 100/100 recommend a stay here as it is more than just a stay, it is an experience. They plan surprises all throughout your stay and no time here seemed enough. Hope you get to experience what we did.

The property is super pretty. the staffs are very nice and they offer awesome dinner with the tharu dance. they also provide extra activities like jungle safari elephant rides etc. having a small pool to ourself in that awesome villa was a treat for me. A bit expensive but the breakfast option and dinner in tharu style with the dances was super nice. went there for a day but felt like a week long vacation. I was super fresh and relaxed after I visited the property.

We had an absolutely amazing stay at the Taj! The amenities and rooms are unbeatable, the food is absolutely delicious, and the staff members are amazing. A special shoutout to Sanjay for making our stay extra special! The hotel offers incredible opportunities to see wildlife, including walking, jeep, and boat safaris, and we could even see elephants and rhinos from the pool. I couldn't recommend this hotel enough. A truly unforgettable experience!

Thank you to the taj safari meghauli serai staff for contribution they have given in making my trip awesome. Everything thing in the hotel is fabulous from welcome to the river , food, service and what not. I am definitely gonna visit nepal again just to stay here. Special thanks to the sous chef at the restaurant who prepared delicious goodies for us.

Unbelievable, mind blowing… words fail me to write my experience about this fantastic property.. The rooms, property, food and service.. unbelievable.. please cancel all your programs and head to Taj Meghauli Sarai.. Kiren , Chef and their team went all out to give us a heavenly experience.. 10 star out of 5

Friendly and cooperative staff members, food was amazing and  Loved the safari experience. The ambience is very peaceful with a lovely view.They also have some fun activities to do during leisure time ...must try

My husband, son and I stayed at this lovely property for this year’s dashain holidays. It was serene and thoroughly relaxing from Kathmandu’s bustle. We stayed in the standard room area and were very happy with the bedroom and balcony. The common pool is heavenly and you get a wonderful view of Rapti River. The staff were hospitable and took great care of us. The resident manager Camelle, restaurant staff Chakra and Arjun our tour guide made our stay wonderful! It was my first time at this property but I definitely hope to return back soon! P.S: Tharu Dinner is highly recommended!

Everything about the vacation - the food, the service, the accommodations - was absolutely amazing! We stayed in a Rapti Pool Villa and highly recommend it. There is a beautiful view of the river from the private plunge pool. Everything about the room and the stay was five star!

The bathrooms were very clean. The service was amazing and the staff really made us fell like we were at home special a staff member, Sanjay. The food was amazing. We got to try so many cuisines like Chinese. The hi- tea in the jungle was a different experience The safaris were great. The rooms were very clean and we got a beautiful scenery. Overall everything was great and I would definitely recommend.

Everything was good.It was great experience thanks a lot for lighting the fire spice during the cutting of the birthday,s cake.Best for jungle safari.Thanks for Mr amit and Sanjay mahato's & kitchen teams as wellalso they have mini golf course.

The Taj was so beautiful and serene. The staff took amazing care of us and Sanjay was beyond thoughtful and truly made our stay special. Breakfast every morning was so delicious along with all the other endless meals. The safari was great and really informative.

Excellent location, splendid service, great room ( we stayed at the Rapti Villa), good food with special mentions to the local dishes.The activities like boat ride and jungle safari are even better. This being the monsoons, was not a damper at all.  Fully recommend this property to all, families too.Special mention to Mr. Chitra, our personal butler, he was super kind, and hospitable. Made our trip so worth it!

I visited Chitwan after 2 decades and what made this trip extra special is Taj and the amazing staff. This resort is absolutely beautiful and serene. Sanjay, my most favorite staff was extremely hospitable and friendly.

Very beautiful property and had a very lovely stay. The general manage Mr Benny and his team took really good care of us. The boat safari was an excellent experience. The property is very well looked after and the staff was very helpful.

Amazing service, truly the entirety of the staff made it an amazing experience. Sanjay with the dining is one of a kind and was able to accommodate me very well. I am gluten free and had no issues with plenty of options. Salina was also such a doll-- incredibly thankful for her and all the staff.

We could not have had a more welcoming, wonderful experience. From the rooms to the staff everything was great. Our guide for our entire stay Buddhi was extremely kind and knowledgeable. We saw 5 Rhinos and one Bengal Tiger while on a safari tour, multiple Crocodile and a Rhino on the canoe tour. Our last evenings dinner with local dancers was fantastic. With our bartenders  Robin & Rabin and our waiter Sanjay we couldn’t have asked for more. We highly recommend staying here.

Great service,  beautiful location and funny activities. I and my family had a blast. Highly recommended for family with young children and also couple. Nice escape from Kathmandu. A bit expensive, but worth.

One of the best experiences in my life.  The resort is located in the national park full of animals.  The service, the food, the hospitality is on the highest level!  Special thanks to our naturalist who made our stay expectations!

Thank you for the incredible hospitality! The attentive service and warm atmosphere made our stay truly memorable. We appreciate the attention to detail and friendly staff, My son had an amazing time with the entire team.Looking forward to returning in the future.

Truly an incredible experience. The hospitality was top tier! We loved our safaris - saw rhinos, crocodiles, bears, monkeys. Santosh was an amazing guide, so knowledgeable and kind. And Chitra was a phenomenal host - took such great care of us! So accommodating - for us Americans it was unforgettable!

We loved our experience there.  It was so beautiful.  The hosts were so kind, full of love and with beautiful hearts! The space was beautiful.  So well taken care of.  We knew we were in the right place when we saw the blue lotus pond next to our accommodations.

One of best landmark in Megauli very close to Chitwan National Park . On the bank of rapti River . It can  be a turning point to boost  for luxury tourism in  in Nepal . Jeep safari and boating down to golaghat to see a sunset trip .  its a best hilights of this place .

loveddddd the villa room. we went for a night but the hangover of the place lasted for weeks. we loved the vibe and the view form the room pool was amazing. will definitely be back. we love the cultural dance and food also. the breakfast was very good too. worth all the money we spend here.

We were at villas.everything is fabulous.Specially private pool.Staff were familiar.We were at our honeymoon and they gave us surprised party end of the day.we had very good time.In future we will also planing to visit again.

Within hours of my arrival,  I fell from a stoop outside my room door.  I fractured the 5th metatarsal bone in my foot, broke two fingers and severe bruising from my hip.   All because of an unnecessary dangerous step at the hotel room door.  I have tried repeatedly to get the Taj Group to have their insurance company  pay for the bills.  They have not returned my emails and completely ignored my requests for financial recovery on this.  Four months into this and I am now on a bone stimulator to try to heal the break.The hotel has dug in their heals to not help.  The stoop outside the door should have been marked with some type of caution tape and signage inside and outside the room door. This would have alerted me to the dangerously small  step.   They didn’t even offer to put me in a lower floor, after the break,  So I had to climb the 3 flights of stairs each time to my room.   No elevators in this hotel.  Complete negligence on their part and I would not recommend this resort due to its negligence.  Taj Hotels thinks they can hide in India while having a worldwide presence.  I cant imagine if you stayed in any of their hotels around the world; and if any accident might happen to the guest, they would ignore you.  What a shame.   You are taking your life in your own hands, staying with any Taj Hotel.The elephant ride for $40 is a rip.  You are wandering on elephant back for 45 minutes, through areas that the local villagers are working the river banks and no chance to see a Rhino with all that human presence out there.  You have no choice but to eat at the hotel with expensive prices on food.  All their excursions are overpriced.  Steer away from this resort unless you have a fat wallet.Best part.  The staff were outstanding and only saving grace for this place.Katherine Whitley

We (2 adults + 2 children) stayed 3 nights at Meghauli Serai. After a terrible 12 hrs trip from Kathmandu to Chitwan we were absolutely blown away by this reort from the moment we walked in!This hotel is extraordinary in every way. From the moment you arrive the service is topnotch. The whole staff is absolutely high skilled!! The staff is amazing and will go over the top to make sure that you are having a more than pleasant stay.A special thank to Sanjay who made our stay unforgettable. I also must, must, must make mention of the food. The food was unbelievable! The chef is incredible and all the meals have been pieces of art.Not to forget Man, our naturalist. He was so knowledgeable and we were infected by his enthousiasm. He made our trips absolutely unforgettable!The views from the main lodge is breathtakaking! We stayed in the Rapti Villas, two of them. They are next to the river bank and they are decorated with great taste, combining traditional crafts with modern deco. The Villas were stunning, a bathroom with bath, two sinks and two showers as well as a private pool.I have also to mention the main pool. An absolutely stunning infinity pool with a breathtaking view!!The whole experience was one I will never forget, the little touches and individual attention was second to none. An experience to remember for a lifetime! The hospitality was outstanding, the resort itself is breathtaking.Special thanks again to Sanjay and to Man.

The property sports a modern international look. The lobby faces a awesome view of swimming pool surrounded by natural greenery, lake, mountains and jungle. This is a relatively small property and we were a group of about 20 and occupying majority of the hotel rooms including the suite villa. What we loved:1. Affectionate welcoming on arrival and caring team2. Neat rooms, nice house keeping  & thoughtful turn down service at night3. Well arranged boat,  jeep and elephant safaris4. Traditional evening entertainment 5. Swimming pool What didn't rise to our expectations:1. Buffet spread: Would rate it very average even while complimenting the chef to have provided Jain style food. (Had stayed at Pavillion Himalayas in Pokhara and food was surely a notch more interesting)2. Spa: Very average therapists (understand it's a jungle lodge and not positioned as a luxury resort). Surprisingly the spa doesn't have a steam room. 3. No personal buttler service for the top end villa. The kitchen was bare skeleton and the well laid out dining table didn't have a dining option. 4. The jungle: Our country India has much more beautiful flora, fauna. Other non hotel related aspects that turned us off:1. Warm weather & hot sun. This place isn't like Pokhara and Kathmandu. Summers are harsh.2. Connectivity. All our four internal flights in Nepal were dotted with inordinate delays. Nepal is hopeless in terms of infrastructure especially outside of Kathmandu. Traveling to this property from Pokhara or Kathmandu by road isn't that convenient as well.My views on Nepal as a holiday destination:Nepal is best for pilgrimage tourism & mountain hiking. For any other purpose why at all choose Nepal as destination? There surely are better options in India & other countries.

We stayed for three nights at this amazing hotel. Very clean and and amazing food.I am coaliac and the whole team made sure every thing is gluten free. They even got gluten free muffins for me.One important thing I wantedTo say about the elephant safari though .. we made the big mistake and booked it this morning. Despite the fact that we are against any sort of animal cruelty we got persuaded by other guests to book this safari and not the Jeep one as apparently you get closer to Animals etc. We decided last minute to change fromJeep to elephant .  There was nothing wrong with the safari itself and elephants looked like they are kept well and happy ( as far as I can tell- I don’t have any comparisons ) but I am sitting here at breakfast regretting my decision. In hindsight I shouldn’t have booked it and I would like to suggest that you don’t either. You can see the wild animals fromThe boat and jeep just as good as fromThe top of the elephant and most importantly you don’t support it. Sadly I made this mistake unfortunately but wanted to leave this comment so that maybe you don’t go for it when you are here.

We stayed here for 3 nights on the Safari package. The whole experience was amazing. The staff was friendly and accommodating. The hotel is lovely, the food was really good and the Safari was well delivered. The kids enjoyed every minute.Truly exceptional!! Highly recommended!

I would like to thank Mr Atul Pandey and all at Taj Meghauli Serai Chitwan for a truly comfortable and the most enjoyable safari holiday for my family.We landed in Kathmandu and took a flight to Bharatpur. The Domestic airport is walking 400 meters from the International. The fight to Bharatpur is 20 min from Khatmandu. The drive from Bharatpur to Taj Meghauli Serai Chitwan is approx. 1 hour plus. The road journey can also be taken but due to road conditions and repairs it may take 6 to 9 hours for the trip from Khatmandu to Chitwan. We stayed here for 4 nights .We took the Presidential Pool Villa which was spectacular in every aspect. Situated right on the river front with a huge living room with dining area, kitchen, room for your personal help, huge private pool, a deck right in front of the river and your private spa room. For bigger families it also has an interconnecting adjoining villa.There are various Safaris which can be taken. The half day safari, full day safari, canoe safari, walking safari and the elephant safari.We took a half day and the full day safari for 2 days exploring different parts of the jungle. Our Naturalist VARUN was just superb, his whole hearted efforts with a lot of enthusiasm to explore the jungle to have sightings was tremendous. His knowledge was immense on all species of birds and wildlife. We saw many Rhinos at close range, lots of different species of birds and extremely lucky to see the all elusive tiger in Chitwan. The tiger sighting was all due to the efforts of VARUN who took different routes in the jungle and never lost hope of making us see one. The Safari starts at 6.45 am where we go across the river by canoe to our jeep. Breakfasts are very good and served in scenic locations in the jungle. As we had a full day we were provided with lunch too. The full day safari ends at 5.30 pm. The jungle is very scenic and in most parts very private, you would not see any other vehicle most of the time. Sightings may be difficult due to the tall grass all the way and would have to be very lucky for predator sightings though it has the huge number of tiger and leopard population.The canoe safari was also very enjoyable. We saw many Ghadhial (crocodile) on the banks of the river. It is a 2 hour canoe journey with an evening snack organised at the end of it in a very scenic location.The elephant safari is fun as we go through the core area and rivers. You may not see Rhinos or other animals except the deer. It is well organised and overall enjoyable.The food was amazing and the chef was kind to make the food we liked.Overall a truly memorable, exciting and enjoyable stay at Taj Meghauli Serai Chitwan with the Taj hospitality and comfort. Thank you Mr Atul Pandey and all the staff with special thanks to Varun.

Though initially i was going to give a three or two star rating to the property due to my terrible experience with the ill-informed and ill-prepared front-desk staff at the hotel, who visibly did not have a clue of what was happening when faced with the first real influx of guests at the hotel since the property opened......but having given it a good second thought, i felt it would not do justice to take away the credit from the remaining staff at the hotel, who are EXCEPTIONAL....especially the chef and the F&B staff....they were simply amazing and the different settings put up by them for every meal left you wanting more. The in-house museli with baileys infused porridge at breakfast...it could not give a better beginning to your day. The mahouts with their elephants....who are phenomenally trained....the elephant bathing session....where we thought we were going to partake in bathing the elephants, only to realise that it was the other way around.....was a remarkable and un-forgettable experience. The jungle walk with their extremely knowledgable naturalists....who ensured to get our adrenaline pumping when experiencing a rhino 10mts away, it could not get more thrilling while knowing you were in the best and safest pair of hands. The location and setting of the property is un-paralleled and the staff go out of their way to make your experience better.....if there was a place on earth where i could truly say "your wish is their command".....it would be Meghauli Serai

I would confidently say no one can bit the hospitality of Taj Meghauli. The property itself is amazingly set with nature and all the ideas and concepts in this property is very unique. The best part is the hospitality and a special care from all the personal!!! Special thanks to the camp host Mr. Roshan , Restaurent  Manager Mr. Kamal and all the management to the staff!! Thank you for arranging a Big Surprise to my husband on his 31st Birthday 🎂 and full of entertainment provided to my little baby Rohan!!! Finally thanks for creating a Wow moment to my retired Dad & Mum❤️❤️Thank you won’t be suffice but really appreciate from the bottom of our heart!!!I would definitely recommend this property to all my friends and family as well as whoever will go through this comment!!! You will not regret staying in this wonderful property!!!!!

There is no better place to stay than the Taj property in Chitwan. Just go there and let them take care of you. The staff is simply outstanding. They will attend to your every need. We had the package that included all 3 meals - I highly recommend that as there is nothing around. Food is very good and of top quality so you won't regret it. They make sure that every single meal you have is of a different cuisine, which is really amazing. If you are celebrating an occasion then they will go even more out of their way to make it special. We had a fantastic birthday and anniversary celebration. Once you go there you can decide on what activities you want to do and they organise and arrange for everything. The river boat cruise followed by high tea is lovely. So peaceful and beautiful. They also include cultural activities and the like so you get to experience everything when you are staying there. The spa is also very good. The rooms are spacious and have a view of the river. They also have an outdoor shower which is super nice. All amenities and facilities in the room were also top notch.  All the staff was fantastic and I think that made all the difference. From the reception, to the chef, serving staff and the naturalists - everyone just took care of you. Highly recommend the Taj in Chitwan.

After a 7 hour drive from Kathmandu we arrived at Meghauli Serai. It was a tough journey. But as soon as we went through the gates of the property everything was forgotten. Staff welcomed us at reception clapping and singing. A soon as we arrived  we got an upgrade to a villa with private pool. The staff was AMAZING. In the afternoon we did a boat safari with at the end drinks and snacks to see the sunset. In the evening locals came out to perform some local dances while we had dinner outside. Unfortunately the next day it was raining heavily and we had to turn back from our jeep safari. Special thanks to Sanjay for his explanation of the culture and the local foods. Treatinging us to local foods. Very delicious. Sanjay is a wonderful host, very proud of his legacy. Lekhraj, the cook, amazing what he can do with food. Very impressed. Also want to thank Chitra, Roshan, Camelle and Asbin the naturalist. We highly recommend this property from Taj. Lots of privacy. Beautiful setting.Don't be fooled by the way to get there.

Absolutely stunning resort in midst of buffer zone of chitwan national park.The best part of this resort; it’s location, the staff, the Taj hospitality.Special thanks to1. Roshan - who took care of our family as the best Host. He made sure that our stay here was fantastic. He knows his work like a pro and shout out to him for making our stay memorable 2. Kamal- who gave us the experience of our lifetime , celebrated my wife’s birthday with one of best experience.3. Sanjay- Our f&b service guide, served us with utmost passion and warmth. Thanks to him for teaching us how to make different type of teas.4. Lekhraj- Our chef - He ensured that we were fed the way we wanted . Super cool guy and would definitely want to eat his food.Would definitely visit us here again.Resort is beautiful and definitely needs your visit here.

First, Chitwan National Park is not to be missed if you're in Nepal, and this hotel (sometimes referred to as the Taj) was unique and wonderful. Although the room was small-ish and the bathroom was roomy but laid out oddly, those were minor. The staff were phenomenal, catering to our needs--almost anticipating them. The guide associated with the hotel, who took us on a jungle walk and 4-hour jeep ride was probably the best game preserve guide we've had (including those at Kruger in South Africa and Chobe in Botswana). Great food, great staff, great experience.

We’ve done a lot of safaris and especially like the lodges on the rivers. This lodge is one of the most spectacular river settings we have seen. The Rapti River is quite big and beautiful. Clear with a strong current and you have to take a canoe to the other side for game drives. You also take guided canoe tours down the river and end up doing a sundowner where a second river joins it. You can see the bottom of the river and float along seeing crocidiles, rhinos and some of the most largest concentration of birds possible. We were surprised as to how tropical it is here at the Chitwan National Park which was just a 30 minute flight from Kathmandu but it’s at an elevation of just 400 feet and a latitude about the same as Palm Beach Florida. The park is pure jungle, incredible trees and again magnificent birds everywhere! Only way to get into the jungle itself is by elephant Safari. The room we had was a villa on the river with a plunge pool. Huge bathroom with a big tub and two showers, one outdoors. There is a large infinity pool at the lodge looking over the river. Food and staff were terrific. Our butler Sanjay was always always there for anything we needed. I can’t say enough about our guide Arjun, he was awesome. Extremely knowledgeable and with an unusual but entertaining sense of humor. We had a wonderful time and adventure here!

Absolutely beautiful place and setting right on the banks of the Rapti River.  Great, spacious and comfortable accommodations with great food.  Staff couldn't be more attentive and sweet.  My specific shout outs to Roshan, Buddhi and Natalie.  The safari choices are plentiful and fantastic.

We were 2 families all together 9 people.  All adults. When making the booking we did not realize how amazing is the place.  Isolated on the river bank with amazing view wherever you go. We stayed there for 2 nights and took advantage of all activities.  Boat ride was great. Elephant ride in the morning was amazing. 2 hours in the jungle. Big wow. We even manage to see the rhinos. All followed by bathing with the elephants, an experience we never had before. In the afternoon we had the safari ride. Not too many animals but still great.Service was amazing. All tried to assist. There was nothing we asked for and didn't get.We didnt book the villas and were happy with the choice as our rooms where at the 3 floor with amazing view.Food was ok. We probably has enough with local food.Overall this is a great and laxurious resort where you can spend at least 2 nights or more both to relax and or enjoy the jungle around. Very highly recommended

Why should Taj hotels associate with such a property which has nothing to do with its brand apart from the staff name tag? This is a big mystery.We spent 3 days (main 2 bedroom villa and 2 other rooms) and spent more than 17,000 US dollars for accommodation and food for 7 of us.For this price we had to beg on the last day to have one flower in the main suite as well as a fruit basket. Every night all the pool equipment and beds were piled up on our veranda so we couldn't go out in the morning upon waking up.We had ordered menus more than 2 months in advance but none of the products were available. The chef was expecting to make grilled salmon steaks with frozen sliced smoked salmon!!!The property is beautiful though, the staff very friendly and effecient. The property has 2 GM but both of them were inexistant when it came to solving problem. I can only remember them waiving to us when our helicopter landed or when we came back from safari.Definitely not worth the price.

how great was this? let me count the ways! the rooms (villas) are pure luxury, with views over the river into the national park. the food is amazing. the service is impeccable. the park guides are knowledgeable.  the elephant safaris are unique. enough said!

After 4 days of a somewhat arduous trek around Pokhara, we decided to indulge in a jungle safari experience at Taj's property in a beautiful setting, Meghauli Serai. The beauty and serenity of the surrounding was only surpassed by the warm, caring hospitality of every single member of the hotel. Our wonderful experience started with their warm welcome and continued throughout our stay, thanks to Roshan and his team, including Sanjay, Varun, Alpha and others. The Chef consistently laid out an amazing variety of local fare. Our jungle safari experience was enriched by the knowledge and guidance of Nikita and Ajindra. Taj should be commended for blending it's professional service with local personnel. We look forward to returning.

I stayed at Meghauli Serai this May and have to say that it was an amazing experience! But let's start from the beginning...Upon arrival after a strenuous 6h car ride over bumpy (dirt) roads from Pokhara I was greeted by the staff warmly and received a quick introduction to the lodge. I was led to my room which was outstanding - it had all the facilities one would desire and had a panoramic view of the river. Internet was available throughout the lodge but the WiFi was rather unstable (something the lodge probably could work on) and the internet connection was extremely slow (probably something that would be quite hard to improve due to the extremely remote location of the lodge).I then spent my three nights at the lodge eating amazing food, relaxing in the gorgeous swimming pool and participating in several jungle activities:- Food: Upon arrival, the chef discussed my culinary preferences and restrictions which were then followed for every meal. The meals were served in a very appealing restaurant by very knowledgable and professional staff. Everything was extremely tasty.
