Special thanks to Sanjay at the Restaurant, Nikita, Arpita & Pradip the naturalists and all other staff whose name I cannot recall. It is a beautiful property, very serene and calm and relaxing, and above all it is the amazing hospitality being provided by the staff that has made all the difference. We stayed in a villa, with the river view and our own plunge pool. The staff are always alert, and inform you if any animals come around the riverside. So we were able to spot the 1 horned Rhino about three times in a single day, the spotted deers, crocodile and many sightings of the elephants that cater to the tourists. The ride to reach the resort is a little bad due to the road conditions, but it seems they are making the road and very soon that also wouldn't be a hindrance. But after entering the resort you are treated like royalty and the staff go way beyond their usual duties to make your stay comfortable and enjoyable. The food was excellent and versatile. We enjoyed the Tharu cultural village setting for dinner and the kids loved the Spaghetti made by the chef. We loved the place and are definitely going to visit again and again. And also, how can I forget to mention the naturalists, that explain to you about the wildlife and are so knowledgeable. Especial thanks to Nikita, who has to answer my child's questions about the wildlife non-stop for about 45 mins or so. Everything was amazing and we loved it.

We just spent 3 nights at this beautiful taj property. I loved every moment. The staff are very friendly and accommodating. We stayed in the basic room and it was beautiful and comfortable. I am sure the villas are stunning. On safari we saw many rhino, crocodile, wild hog and mongoose. Along with countless beautiful birds. While we did not see any tigers, we were close (the jungle is very thick which makes spotting them hard) we got to hear the warning calls from the deer and see the footprints. It was so nice just to know they were there. The food is lovely and there is much of it. Mostly traditional type food but there was a pasta one of the days we were there.I loved our stay and would be thrilled to return one day. A note on the local airport. It is very basic and runs more like a bus stop. We were meant to be on a 2:50 flight but for some reason we were put on a much later one. Leave plenty of connection time if you are flying on (like 5 hours).Also, take warm clothes during the winter months, it's very cold out on the morning game drives.

I was there for a short break when i was back to chitwan. I found this place amazing in terms of location, green  environment, friendly staff and delicious foods. Everything is so cool. Hope to celebrate Christmas and new year together. Thank you Meghauli Serai team

Stayed in a villa room at this gorgeous property. Villas are the intermediate level of accommodation, priced between the Presidential suite,  in its own building, and perhaps 16 rooms contained within another building set back on the other side of the entry drive from the National Park boundary. It is not the easiest place to locate, and the roads leading to the property are in need of some serious repair. Still, well worth the effort and discomfort that may be associated with getting there. The building housing reception contains a sunken lounge and adjacent restaurant, which does a great breakfast. Outlook is across a lovely large infinity pool to the grasslands and waterways that make up much of the National Park. The villa rooms, of which there are around 12, are set off a pebble path, with large stands of grasses and native vegetation bringing a sense of isolation and adventure. Each villa has its own pool, approximately 1.2 metres deep, together with a small terrace. The main room contained a king size bed, with mosquito netting, some casual furniture and a functional desk. The bathroom was huge; separate clawfoot bath tub, shower cubicle with rainhead, and an open air shower and daybed. Staff were uniformly excellent, and enhanced the overall experience through their obvious interest in doing a great job. Well done all; a very special place. Probably best for a 2-3 day stay; not a lot else to do in the near vicinity, apart from visiting the Park...and enjoying the property. It also offers some local dance entertainment, which is worth taking in.

Stayed here during the 3Rd week of October enjoyed being so close to nature lovely pool by the garden also with some huts including little dip in pool I stayed on the two stored building which was really nice looking over the water pond well kept natural vegetations nice big veranda to sit on very relaxing after fighting for the terrible road from MUgling Narayanghat ( No dough this is the worst road in the world as per my travel experience ) than another tub half paved road it was well worth facing all these hardships once you reached to this resort you got all these relief staff were outstanding great service Okey food ( especially the Thakali thali was worst of my life time Nepali set expensive 2500 plus plus with bellow the average taste) well this place is not for the food its for the Jungle & the nature this is well understood I have no complaint on this resort handsup to the investor thou I tip one thing I wanna mention is PLS keep the bathroom kit I.E. Shaving kit tooth kit etc. Which makes a lot difference in these kind a up scale hotel as I did not carried all Jst for a night gateway & disappointed not to have them . My best wishes to Meghauli serai I would have no hesitation to stay here again with my friends families & my clients

Fantastic experience, beautiful location, amazing service. Our only bugbear was that the river cruise, which was promised as a chance to see river wildlife ending with a spectualar sunset view, turned out to be a trip in the blazing mid-afternoon heat and being told that no animals were around because it was too hot at that time of day and then being driven home well before sunset!! But nevertheless it was still an amazing stay.

You can feel the gentle breeze of jungle Chitwan National park & running Rapti river  just south of you from your room in this Meghauli Serai stay. quite & calm to spend life beautiful moments here with your loved one. 3 years ago when i was here in Meghauli it was started building the place  by CG now its is running in its full swing manage by Taj groups. the separate home with own swimming pool is really thrilled one.  enjoyed  some precious time on 20th & 21st Sept.

Arriving at kathmandu airport we ventured straight to Nagarkot .. great choice of Hotel Mystic Moutain. Views fantastic and close to watch tower for sunrise next morning.room very clean and comfortable away from the hstle and bustle of Kathmandu and great for walks and visiting nearby historical sites of Patan and Bhaktapuryou pay nepalese 1000 to enter town and the n if you want a guide extra roughly usd 15when Nealese offer tours it usually only a driver you have to always pay extra to get into sights and get a guide be prepared we werent and didnt understand how Nepalses tours work. always plus plus....

We were a party of 4 adults and trekked about 14kms before reaching Mystic Mountain. On our trek we passed town and several other hotels, and from observation the location of Mystic Mountain is certainly one of the best.  The scenery, from every room, reception and common areas, provides views of the Himalayan ranges and even Everest from afar.  Bring binoculars.  We were very lucky to get great weather and a clear day followed by a beautiful sunrise.  Buffet dinner at the hotel's restaurant was really the only choice at night time and food was average but had to do.  The pool was being renovated (not that it mattered because we weren't going for a dip in the sub zero temperatures) while the rooms are clean but relatively dated.  No bathtub but a decent strong shower and, thankfully, good hot water.  The only beef we had with the hotel was our freezing cold rooms at night as, for some reason, we had the heater on full blast but our rooms were still freezing leading me to believe that cold air was leaking in from somewhere.  We asked for an extra heater but none were available.  Otherwise service was generally good, Wifi was satisfactory and there were some English channels on tv as well.  A good choice for a Nagarkot stay.

Me and my team were in hotel mystic mountain for one night. Firstly, we were mesmerized with the structure and the location of the hotel. our room was  fine but bed sheet in one o f our 3 single bed room was stained and amenity in our washroom was only for single person. next, while we were in the lobby waiting for our check in process we were served with welcome drinks which was excellent but the server return rolling the tray in the air. Managers and supervisors were provided with masks which was nice to see but for some for them, it was located in the chin or under the lips. one of the manager was nice with us asking all our comfort and corrected the soiled dishes which was laying in front of our door since long time. In the morning we were passing by staircases one of the employee was also passing but no greeting is heard. While having break fast I intentionally tried to bother server by requesting to bring food form buffet to table, answer was okay sir, but action was never done. I was ready with tips in my hand if he came with food. During our check out time we simply went to front desk to settle our bill after that there were no one to say thank you  or say bye  or visit again.All this shows  hotelier there are lack in professionalism.  we are not valued may be its because they thought we are domestic tourists but they forget we are contributing in their operation, revenue  and in  tourism. How long people will visit there for structure and natural beauty if the staff are not in real hospitable manner?? strict training and following of professionalism is indeed needed.I'm sure once again I will visit this place and I wish these small thing being taken care. I wrote all this because I also belongs to same industry and I have experience both as service provider and service consumer. Please take all this in positive way and try to fulfill all those gaps for all guests who visited there. I love hospitality and our hotel industry also our culture for guests.

We enjoyed our 2 nights stay, with 2 adults and 2 kids (7&9) in a triple room including breakfast and diner for 135.000 NPR per night. Rooms are spacious, food is very good and facilities like pool and bar are pleasent. The fitness is ok-ish. Staff is friendly. Pool was cold, but we all enjoyed a 20min swim after a nice hike.They provide the illusion that all is 'Corona safe', but outside the fact that there simply arent that many guests these days, more than some sanitation stations, there is not much done actually. For example, they have 71 rooms of which only 4 were occupied duing the 2 days we were there. But instead of alternating the use of the rooms and keeping used rooms empty for at least one or two days, they kept on re-using the same rooms for new guests all over. Also, would have been nice not to have neighbours, but they put all four occupied rooms exactly next to each other.... Guess the convinience for them is more important than the actual safety /experience of their guests.

The resort is absolutely beautiful, high end furnishings and spectacular views! The rooms were very spacious, every room has a great view of the Himalayas when the weather cooperates.   The restaurant is also pretty good, but pretty pricey, given customers don't have much choice  to leave and eat elsewhere.  All hotel staff were very helpful, polite, and friendly, although I felt some of them lacked some language skills compared to Kathmandu hotel staff.   The only reason I didn't give this resort a '5" is that the spa needs much attention and upgrades.  While the masseuse staff was pretty good, the facilities don't meet up to standards of the rest of the hotel.  Very basic and shabby.   The robes are too small and thin, the shower facilities are outdated, and I only got cold water at the  shower when I used it.  And there is no privacy. To get to the showers, you have to walk outsides in front of other balconies, and other male staff walking around.

I stayed in one of the rooms and it was very nice. I saw the mountains and the food was really good. What I really appreciated was that on the way up the mountain my car broke down. I called MM to ask for a taxi and not only did they send a taxi, but one of the staff, Moona, came out with another staff member on a scooter just to check on me and wait with me until the taxi came to pick me up. Also while I stayed for the weekend the shuttle driver would drive by my car to check make sure it was still there and safe. Moona and the rest of the staff were so nice and careful to take care of me. I really love staying at MM and will keep coming back thanks to the staff and the extra care.

Where can I start? Rarely am I suprised by the staff service as I was with Mystic Mountains Team, This is the best hotel by far in Nagarkot. Have been to many 4 and 5 stars around the world, but the dining experience and service like this one makes you forget everthing else. Photos are unfiltered and unedited. At the price, you will hardly find a hotel like this in the world. I am visiting again!!!Do read my entire review below: Service: With all other amenities, views etc aside, it is the service that makes a hotel class! Mystic mountains entire staff seemed very warm and polite. You would expect this at a 4 star or above. The operations exec. head, Mr Bharat Badal conveyed the true sense of luxury hospitality. From check in to check out, the staff were very courteous and receptive throughout the stay. Special standouts were Divya from the restaurant Bijay from the reception and two other staff from the dining and cafe. If I had any issue, they were very attentive and very efficient even if it was a minor one.Dining:What can i say? Like my summary, the dining experience was class! Even at a Corona hit time like this, the head Chef was careful to details with the cuisine and honestly, I have not been treated a t a 4 star with this variety of food!  Dining was fabulous, they could improve some european cuisine. Head chef has worked years at a 900 seater cruise ship in the mediterranean, he knows his game!Breakfast was good, could be improved with the fresh food, fish and deli items.The dining, cafe all are huge and comfortable with open views of the himalayas.Accommodation:This hotel is located at one of the quiet streets of Nagarkot. This means you get to view the himalayas undisturbed from your room, dining, cafe, bar etc. Most of the rooms come with a balcony, some have balconies that are as big as a flat with hammock and what not. (see pictures). The amenities are plenty and they provide you with any extra items you would need. The only improvement I would see is to improve their mattress. (i am very picky though) and their heating.From all the rooms the view is not blocked!Facilities:From swimming pool to jacuzzi, spa, sauna, gym, basketball court, they have plenty!Suggestion:  add up a mini garden with world flower varieties, appetizer and apero bar in front of cafeThey are adding up a mini golf with himalayas view, rock climbing and a live fish pond and what not!

The hotel is located a little bit outside Nagarkot "town" (the town itself has nothing to offer), built on a hill slope. The views of the mountains are spectacular - you can see the whole himalaya range, including the Everest (far away). Rooms are large and comfortable, with AC/heater, cable TV (TV screen too small to watch from your bed), hot water (not in afternoon), balcony, internet. All rooms seem to have mountain views. Decorations are a bit tacky, but that is personal taste, I guess. Staff was friendly and helpful. Although only few guests were there (covid times), all seem to be given rooms near the stairs (not spread out in the hotel), which was a pity. Food was decent (our package included BF and dinner) - Nepali style food but varied enough. The main drawback is that the walls are very thin and you can hear everything in adjacent rooms or rooms above you. (and some guests cannot stop themselves from playing loud Nepali music on their balcony when watching the sunrise in the morning, which spoils the whole experience for everyone else of course - but that is not the hotel's fault).  Easy to go for a hike in the area around the hotel, but you will be walking mainly on dusty roads (no traffic) rather than on trails in the forest. In short: this is one of the two top hotels currently in Nagarkot, and a good place to stay for up to two nights.

It is quite a difficult journey from Kathmandu to the hotel,and I was really glad we had a driver as the road is in a terrible condition The hotel is located on the side of a hill directly facing the Himalaya range .For most of the time we were there,all but one or two mountains were covered in cloud but when the cloud lifted for short periods,the view of the full range was unforgettable The hotel has an excellent decking area to have a coffee and look at the sceneryThe rooms are small but very clean and comfortable And again are all facing the mountains Meals were buffet service and were satisfactory rather than good.It is not the fault of the hotel but the manners of some of the guests at the buffet left a lot to be desired,pushing to get in front as if they thought that the food was going to run out.Other than that we enjoyed our visit to this hotel

The view from the hotel on a clear day is breathtaking, that was the only highlight of the trip.Dinner/breakfast: they have variety of foods to choose from but nothing that special, it was just basic as if something is missing.Accommodation: as per their website they have mentioned all their rooms faces the view of the himalayas, but unfortunately the room we had was underground and it was the worst room for the price we paid.Staffs: Friendly and approachable.

The hotel building is amazing and something of a surprise when you first arrive down the unpaved road. It looks beautiful set into the hill, and the rooms and indoors are also just as well designed and appointed. My room was not huge but thoughtfully designed to have all the different functional spaces you would want. Everything worked well and was comfortable.I came for a couple of nights after trekking to relax and use the spa. The spa is a little underwhelming especially when compared to the rest of the hotel - they could have made more effort with the ambience and decoration, and added a relaxation area. It's more a couple of treatment rooms and a separate small block with steam and sauna that you can arrange to use, so don't expect a European style spa experience. But also, don't let this put you off as the treatments were very good and they're certainly not European prices!The food in the restaurant for lunch/dinner was excellent (I ate a la carte), with good sauces, presentation and attention to detail and different meats and vegetables available to what I had elsewhere in Nepal. Breakfast buffet was decent. Service throughout the hotel was excellent and there were some nice extra touches such as welcome fruit and biscuits delivered to the room. The hotel is known for its views but unfortunately it was very cloudy when I was there in March, but still a lovely place to spend some time. My only niggles are that the shower wasn't hot on a couple of occasions, which was disappointing in a hotel at this price. And I found it odd and inconvenient that prices are all quoted net of VAT - there's some mental arithmetic needed to add the 13% VAT and 10% service to work out what the actual price is. It seems unnecessary. Recommended overall for a getaway from the city and some luxury.

I dont want to be harsh .I am only reveiwing the restaurant.I would definitely suggest the place not to cater day guest, if we get treated as a nuisance. Anyone who would want to visit here or use the restaurant as a day guest .  I suggest not to go there. I can totally understand the dinner rush at 4pm which was the time we asked if restaurant was open for non stay guest. The staff said yes . We were asked to stay on the outside deck or use the upper bar area as the dinning hall will be used for the in house guest. So opted for the bar area. The orders after given was told that due to the dinner rush would take time . So we asked anything that could be prepared faster we would take that . Only to see the food served next to our table earlier and even after waiting for more than 1hr 30 min and only after telling the staff about our fries and nuggets order not gotten served, we got nuggets. Cancelled the fries .I don't know, but earlier a server had brought fries and nuggets only to serve another table who came and sat for 15 min and we were waiting more or less 2 hrs.Usha and the staff in the bar were kind and polite. I felt some staff were brushing us off and only focused on in house guest (amazing for the stay in guest) .I feel in house guest were given a good service(which is great)  but maybe just ppl for day trip, lunch ,bruch or using restaurant can opt other places. Not worth going all the way there .

Our stay at Mystic Mountain Hotel is pure joy and comfort. The moment we arrive, we are in awe to see the breathtaking view  of the mountain valley at the hotel lobby. At that moment, we already know our week here will be as magical as the scenery.The hotel is located up in the mountain, which means that the ride from Kathmandu to here is along the hill, not a paved road. It however isn’t an issue for us coz we get to enjoy the view and the amazing driving skill of the driver taking us there. A few things have definitely made our time special. There are hikes around the hotel that we managed to do 3 hikes on different days. They all offer beautiful view overlooking the mountains and allow us to see how the local community lives.The food at their restaurants is tasty and has a good variety. There is also a great balance between veg and non-veg options which we truly appreciate. Instead of ordering a la carte for dinner, we always opt for their buffet option that never disappoints. Their breakfast is equally delicious too. For other meals, my husband loves their veg burger for lunch, while I love their fish and chips. Their laundry price is reasonable too. This allows hotel guests to use their service more, which is a big plus for me.The accommodation we booked is a 2-storey suite that has a spectacular view from our patio. Watching the sun rising above a sea of clouds is mystical. The interior of the suite is lovely and offers all the comfort we need eg comfortable King size bed. Lastly, the staff here makes all the difference to our stay. Amrit, who looks after housekeeping and works closely with his team, responds to our needs quickly. He makes sure everything is okay in our room whenever we run into him.Dhana from housekeeping has the friendliest smile who always leaves our room spotlessly clean. Apil is the most helpful front desk manager. He is on duty day and night whom we find very polite and approachable.Ishwor helps us book a car to take us to Nagarkot from the hotel. He is very friendly and knowledgable. We get to hike around the area and see another beautiful part of the mountain and the locals living there.Ram is the F&B manager who works in different restaurants. He is professional and has wonderful memory; he remembers the dish I ordered at the Cliff Hanging Cafe! From the first night we have dinner at their restaurant till the last day of our stay, Niroj is always there to take care of us, and is one of the most attentive staff at the restaurant. If it wasn’t for the people at Mystic Mountain Hotel, it wouldn’t have been such an incredible trip for us.

Hotel Mystic Mountain is located in such a spectacular place where the views of the hills and mountains are absolutely beautiful. I have never given a 5-star review to any place before and this particular hotel is the first one to get it. I called the hotel and booked my accommodation for five days. Rs13,500 a night with buffet breakfast and dinner included. What a deal it is. I requested hotel transportation to and from the airport for Rs.9,000. Again it is a good deal. When we got to the hotel, we were welcomed by friendly staff. We were amazed by the incredible view from the hotel lobby. The check-in process was a breeze. The hotel staff was extremely friendly. Our room was clean and had the perfect view of the hills and mountains (Although the clouds obstructed the mountain view). Our room was next to the restaurant and we were concerned about the noise but it wasn't an issue. The hotel called us multiple times to see if we wanted to switch rooms but we were satisfied with the room we were in. Breakfast and dinner buffets were extensive with a variety of options and something for everyone. We were always greeted by the staff. My wife and I were talking about how well the hotel is run as we found waiters to custodians greeting us with a smile. You know the employees are happy and like it there went they go out of their way to have a conversation with the hotel guest. We were so happy to experience this. Mr. Ram Prasad Dahal, who is the food and beverage manager always checked in with us. He was often seen going around the table and asking guests about their experience and what he could do to make their stay better. Additionally, he gave us information on what types of activities we could do to keep ourselves occupied. We ended up going on a hike per Mr. Dahal's recommendation and loved it. There were multiple staff that we don't remember their names that always asked us about our stay and how we were doing. Due to personal reasons, we ended up staying there for 3 days as opposed to 5 but this is a place we will definitely visit soon. We loved our stay here. We didn't get to try the swimming pool, or jacuzzi, or take photos around the property. We will most certainly do that next time. Thank you everyone at the hotel for making our stay a fantastic one. We will see you again. Sanjaya and Sweta

We stayed at Mystic Mountain for one night, the day that we reached Nepal, and it was an amazing start to our trip! The views are absolutely gorgeous, and we were lucky to have clear skies in the evening. In the night, the stars seemed to melt into the lights of the valley, and it felt like a dream! Unfortunately, we missed seeing the sunrise due to very thick fog. But even despite that, we had a very nice morning. The food was delicious and the restaurant was happy to customize their dishes for us too. The breakfast spread was also great. Since I was was traveling with my parents, and we decided to stay in a triple sharing room. The room was very spacious, and had a great view. While traveling during the colder months, I’d recommend asking for a few extra blankets, as the room gets very cold. I wish we would have stayed an extra day and enjoyed the hotel some more - I’d really recommend it!! Pro tip: call the hotel for the best prices. They price match and sometimes have further discounts!

We had an excellent  stay at the hotel. Everyone in our group (from infant to grandparents) had fun.It’s beautifully nestled into the hills of Nagarkot and very well maintained. You get beautiful views from everywhere in the hotel.I was surprised by the level of details and customer service provided by Mr. Umesh and team from the moment we entered the hotel premises. Checkout and check in were easy. Staff were friendly and very helpful. Rooms were clean and equipped with every thing you might need for the stay. We brought our own but Crib and babysitting services are available for extra charge. Food was delicious. They had a good variety and everything was exceptional. Minor inconveniences: Not stroller/ wheelchair friendly. There’s a small elevator from lobby to room but most of the premise is accessible by stairs. Power kept going in and out at night. The mini fridge did not keep baby milk cold throughout the night. The drinks in there weren’t cold either. Internet connectivity is slightly tricky. Speeds are great but they have some dead spots.

Hugely disappointed with your customer service, we had a gift voucher and we were told to pay certain additional amount for new year eve stay but the hotel made us pay double the amount. Plus even during the booking the sales didn’t cooperate well. We hard hard time booking the room in hotel plus they gave us a room in ground floor and in last corner. Lesson learned: never buy a gift voucher or else they’re gonna treat you as if you guys are staying there for free. Thanks for embarrassing, disappointing and ruining our honeymoon.

The place was worth all the money. I visited this place with my friends last week and it really did meet up with my expectations. The rooms were neat and clean and had a really nice view. We have some special request before we checked in and the lady on the reception (Miss Shruti i guess if I remember the name correctly) was very helpful with our request. The breakfast options were good as well. Would definitely recommend to everyone who wants to take time off their busy schedule and enjoy a gate away and would definitely visit again.

I had been here last Friday with family. It was my first time and I couldn't resist myself to drop a review. The hospitality, immaculate rooms, chilled breeze, live music, varieties and excellence of cuisines and peaceful environment really amazed me and made my stay exceptional. For me, the hotel was definitely worth visiting to have some refreshments from my hectic life.

My husband & I stayed here for 2 nights celebrating our anniversary during the weekday as it gets super crowded in the weekends. The rooms were amazing with a private balcony & a breathtaking view. We went during the month of November, and it was pretty cold in the evenings. The most top rated experience was sitting in the hot jacuzzi with the view of the himalayan range in front. Nothing beats that ! Loved eating breakfast in in the outdoors. Every area of the hotel and room gives you the best view so you won't miss out even if you don't go for an executive suite. The food was average and has a huge scope for improvement. There are no heaters as such but only ACs where you can increase temperature. which was alright for the month we went in. There aren't outdoor heater stands at the facility nor any elevators.  But this plae left us with memories that we will remember forever. The night skies, sunsets, dawn, sunrises were all worth remembering !

We recently stayed at the Mystic Mountain Hotel, and while the misty weather obscured the stunning mountain views, the hotel's charm and exceptional service made up for it. The room was clean and cozy, with a peaceful balcony perfect for relaxation.The spa experience was enjoyable, although it would be improved by providing briefs and fresh towels. The food was delicious, with a decent variety for both breakfast and dinner.Special praise goes to DB Tamang, whose extraordinary service and attention to detail truly made our stay unforgettable. His warm and welcoming demeanour set the tone for a wonderful dining experience. He took the time to understand our preferences, expertly clarifying whether we wanted appetizers served first or with the main course, and whether we preferred our hot tea with or after our meal. His thoughtful recommendations for local attractions in Kathmandu were also invaluable.DB Tamang's exceptional service extended beyond the dining room. He demonstrated a genuine interest in ensuring our stay was comfortable and enjoyable, always ready with a smile and a willingness to assist. His dedication to providing outstanding service is a true asset to the hotel.Manager Umesh Khadak ensured our laundry was returned promptly, and a special thank you to the staff member who braved the rain to collect it late in the evening.While the weather didn't cooperate, the hotel's tranquil atmosphere and outstanding staff, particularly DB Tamang, made our stay truly enjoyable. We highly recommend the Mystic Mountain Hotel for a relaxing getaway, especially during the recommended months of October/November and March/April for clearer views.

My recent stay at "Hotel Mystic Mountain" with my brother was pleasant overall. The hotel's serene surroundings and modern interior provided a peaceful atmosphere. The staff were exceptionally friendly and helpful, even upgrading our room to one with a clear mountain view at no extra charge.They offers a stunning natural backdrop, surrounded by lush greenery and towering mountains. The eco-friendly ambiance provides a serene retreat, especially when enjoying the morning views from the balcony. It's a peaceful haven for nature lovers seeking beauty and tranquility.The rooms were clean and well-equipped with modern amenities, although the provided slippers were subpar. However, we encountered some difficulty charging our devices due to loose or inappropriate power sockets. Additionally, larger TV screens would have enhanced the viewing experience.The food quality was excellent, with generous portions served at every meal, including the complimentary breakfast. The breathtaking views from the rooms added to the overall charm of the hotel.While the hotel's interior is stunning, navigating its numerous corridors can be daunting. Clear signage or mini-maps in every lobby would greatly enhance guest experience.In conclusion, while there were some minor issues with room amenities and navigation, our experience at "Hotel Mystic Mountain" was enjoyable, thanks to its tranquil ambiance, attentive staff, and delicious food offerings.

My wife and I spent 2 nights at Mystic Mountain to get out of Kathmandu and it was an enjoyable overall experience. The staff was extremely accommodating and professional (it truly felt like a 5-star resort in this sense) and the architecture and surrounding landscapes were incredible. We did make the mistake of arriving on Saturday, when it felt like every amenity was over capacity (pool, restaurant, bar) and the loud shouts and neighboring music made it hard to enjoy the peace and quiet of the scenery from our room. (It felt like a party hotel rather than a mountainside resort). In addition, the staff seemed to struggle to keep up with cleaning and maintenance...we passed the same spare mattresses and empty beer bottles in the hallways for the duration of our stay. The food was delicious, but I did unfortunately get sick from my dinner the night before we left, meaning I spent my last full day in Kathmandu recovering from this. It may be best for tourists to avoid meat even here - it ended up being my only food issue during 4 weeks in Nepal in India. (the bumpiness of the washed out road leading from the resort didn't help!)

Our recent stay at Hotel Mystic Mountain in Nagarkot was average at best. While the hotel itself has some appealing features, it fell short in several areas compared to other hotels in the vicinity.Firstly, the location is quite remote, and the road leading to the hotel is off-road, making the journey there somewhat challenging. This might be a consideration for those looking for easy access.Regarding the accommodation, the rooms were decent but nothing extraordinary. The overall ambiance of the hotel was pleasant, but it didn’t stand out in terms of decor or comfort.One significant drawback was the pricing. We found the rates to be overpriced for the quality and services provided. Given the cost, we expected a higher standard of amenities and a more memorable experience.In summary, while Hotel Mystic Mountain offers an acceptable stay in Nagarkot, it doesn’t offer the best value for money. The off-road access and overpriced rates are notable downsides. For the price, there may be better options available in the area.

My partner and I decided to book a nights stay spontaneously before leaving Npl. This was the best decisions we made. As a native Nepali this was my first time in Nagarkot and the stay here made it so worthwhile visiting. The 3 main aspects that made our stay so special were: - The architecture/ interior: the layout and design here is truly spectacular. The modern yet traditional feel of the hotel blends quite seamlessly with the green mountain side where it’s located. You can see a great level of attention is paid to the landscaping. Throughout of the hotel there are green areas with native and exotic plants that are well maintained by the staff. Our room had a great layout; clean spacious bathroom and plenty of storage in the cupboards. It’s also worth mentioning that we had the best sleep of this trip on the extremely comfortable bed! - The staff: upon arrival we were greeted by the staff and made to feel so welcomed. The reception staff were lovely and provided us with lots of information about the facilities. Everywhere we went staff members were present to help us. Special mention to Manish.K bhai from the restaurant who was so attentive to us during dinner and breakfast and went out of his way to make sure we were comfortable. The view: The hotel takes full advantage of its beautiful location and the scenic view of the Himalaya can be seen from all areas of the hotel. Our bedroom had a balcony where we enjoyed the sunrise illuminating the mountains, one of the most magical, memorable moments. The pool/ jacuzzi also offers this view where we spent most of our day lounging in the sun enjoying the view. The only recommendation I have is to have images explaining/ naming the different mountains that can be see from the hotel (especially in the bedrooom). We were shown a picture by Manish bhai during breakfast who explained all the mountains we could see. We also saw Everest for the first time, thank you bhai for this we were really grateful. Overall, our stay was truly special and would recommend anyone considering Hotel Mystic Mountain during their travels to Nepal/ Nagarkot.

We recently visited the place, and had called a couple of days earlier to tell them that we were day guests looking for spa services, over the phone they said that it would be available for us. When we reached the place they said that their spa/pool and jacuzzi were closed, more like they were only available to in house guests and not day guests. I asked if it would be available if I were to purchase a room for the night even though we wouldn't stay and they said NO straight up. They asked me who I called and I said the number at the reception. My girlfriend was fuming, we had taken 2 hours to get there, I quickly rearranged our plans for another place and salvaged the situation. I don't know why they were selectively unaccommodating towards us. It was the most unprofessional, unaccommodating, judgmental, fueled with unexplained animosity filled experience that we had come across in any hospitality related business.

I recently stayed here on 7h of August with my wife. In terms of services, The staffs were very  friendly and attentive, the rooms were clean and well-maintained, and the amenities were top-notch. The views from the hotel were stunning, and the food at the on-site restaurant was delicious.However, there were a couple of drawbacks that slightly impacted our stay. The bathroom in our room was surprisingly small, making it difficult to move around, especially when taking a shower. It felt cramped. Another issue was the road leading to the hotel, which was unpaved and in poor condition. This not only made the journey a bit uncomfortable but also led to a lack of car service options in the area. Due to the limited availability, the few services that were available charged exorbitant rates, taking advantage of the situation. We paid only 1300 NRS when reaching to the hotel. But when we checked out from the hotel , we did online car service where they demand very huge money for just 45 mins drive . In my lifetime experience , I paid 2300 NRS for 45 mins drive . Despite these issues, the overall experience  was very positive, and I would recommend it to others with the hope that these minor issues will be addressed in the future.

First things first, #Bijay Rayamajhi, never thought we would bump into each other after spending years of childhood together. Very helpful lad who is ready to serve you with anything with a million dollar smile on his face. If you are there, don’t forget to see this dashing young man.Secondly, the service was very good. My mom who never eats outside except home, was very satisfied with the MASALA TEA that was served. Great place to hangout with family and friends. The hotel had-such a beautiful ambiance and environment, one could easily feel like residing in the Heavens. Although the weather was bit cloudy and undercast we were little lucky enough to catch some nice view  of the Mountains.Overall, very impressed with the hotel staffs and its service. Hope to see you soon when you guys upgrade to a 5-Star. Good Luck!!!🎊😊

We went for a lunch and everything was worth it. The staffs were helpful and to the point. The view from the restaurant is the selling point. lovely place to click pictures. The chocolate milkshake was a thin and lacked favor but the waiters were kind enough to take it back and fix it. Overall a nice experience

It's best hotel to stay in  Nagarkot   for viewing  Sunrise &  entire himalayas range east & north side . Local village & jungle walk  give fully satisfying  of staying in ghis hote. It's very clean friendly staff feel really hospitality   delicious food  with  best view from reastaurant makes fully intertain  local culture programme me . I will  cocomended  to my friend or  any body  if you like to stay in Nagarko nepal . The best hotel is the mystic.

From the moment we arrived, we were greeted warmly by the staff. I and my friends spent a wonderful day in this place. This hotel has to offer a lot of activities like swimming, rock climbing, basketball, table tennis and many more. The view here was spectacular and the food here was mouth-watering which was an authentic Thakali meal. Plus, the room here was very comfortable with AC and all the services. It was a fruitful day spent with all my friends. I recommend this hotel for all the travelers desiring the comfort and the hospitality of the personals/staff of this hotel.

Mystic Mountain was my first official trip over the weekend. The hotel services were outstanding. The mission was successfully completed just because of all staff wonderful cooperation especially warm welcome during checking from Room Management Team Apil ji along with operational management team such as Bharat ji, Arjun ji, Mona ji, Karki ji etc.  Restaurant management Chef Padam ji and team for mouth watering super healthy food along with all the restaurant staff for their nice hospitality. At last but not least specially thanks to Amita ji for your wonderful coordination to hotel team. We really appreciated for everything. Dear Mona Waiba for your friendly behavior.  You made our life easy. See you again and again. 😊 😊  Love this hotel.

I recently stayed at Hotel Mystic Mountain in Nagarkot, Nepal and it was a truly memorable experience. The hotel is located in a picturesque location, surrounded by lush greenery and offering stunning views of the Himalayas.The rooms at the hotel are comfortable and well-appointed, with all the necessary amenities to make your stay comfortable. The staff are incredibly friendly and attentive, going out of their way to make your stay as pleasant as possible

Nagarkot is at heights, sort of hill station neat Kathmandu. The way to the hotel is quite bumpy, last 500 m is not proper roads. Nagarkot is famous of sunrise and sunset points. Hotels offer a great view for the sunrise. All rooms are facing east hence people can enjoy the sunrise from their balcony. Hotel common food area is bit small during peak hour service goes south. Overall had a decent stay

I have been coming regularly to Mystic Mountain since its opening in 2017, both on business trips and privately. Every stay has been very good. The staff is friendly and competent. The hotel is clean with airy rooms offering a fantastic view onto the mountain range of the Himalayas and the food is fantastic. If you need a space for workshops and seminars MM offers good facilities with appropriate people for technical back-up. I can recommend this place to everybody who loves Nepal and its mountains or is in need of a good facility for a professional in-house event. Already when checking in you will encounter the hospitality, friendliness and professional efficiency of the staff. Especially thanks to Mona and the reception team for making me feel welcome whenever I arrive after the slightly bumpy trip up to Nagarkot.

We visited Mystic Mountain for the first time and the experience was so good at all. It was so amazing and fun around. The environment is so good that you can visit around with your loved ones friends family. The food here is outstanding and all the staff are so polite and humble the respect they provide you is damn good.

Unforgettable Stay at Hotel Mystic MountainThe service at Hotel Mystic Mountain is exceptionally good, the team knows exactly how to make the stay for their guests unforgettable. The food is delicious, awesome live music, the rooms are spacious and neatly clean, the spa area welcomes you to relax and forget about everyday life and the view from the hotel is simply stunning. I would definitely recommend The Hotel Mystic Mountain if you are planning a trip to Nagarkot

We thoroughly enjoyed staying here for a couple of days . A very peaceful,   seren and relaxing experience  to the mind  & soul, clubbed with breathtaking views of valley and himalayan ranges.  Ideal choice for hiking lovers . The resort offers luxury of enjoying stunning views of sunrise and Himalayan ranges ( incl Mt Everest )  from the comfort of its rooms (on a clear day) . However we could see only Gauri Shankar peak because of cloudy weather due to monsoon season. Rooms are cosy & clean with a balcony with good housekeeping .  Staff was very friendly  and courteous , special appreciations to  Umesh ( management) and Ashish ( restaurant).Veg food was unexpectedly delicious . Would like to suggest the management to install two telescopes on the cafe terrace as an added attraction .

I planned the trip in the very last minute know very well I will be taken care at the property and the wonderful management. Inspite of the hotel being very full Mr Apil went out of the to accommodate us and do everything to ensure I have a room , I don't miss room 412 (my favourite one) where I usually stay and I am more than comfortable. The hotel management and team goes beyond conventional means to make the guests feel comfortable and at home which is why everytime we make a plan in Nepal for a weekend getaway, the hospitality at Mystic Mountains prevents us from making any other plans.

We are so glad we chose Hotel Mystic Mountain for our stay in Nagarkot. The staff were excellent from the moment we got there. They really left no room for complaints during our visit and promptly took care of all our requests.Magnificent spread for dinner and breakfast as well with dishes catered towards eastern and western palates. All dishes were truly exceptional with my personal favourite being the Szechuan Pork they served for dinner.The room was really spacious with all the amenities you would require for your stay. The view of the surrounding hills and the mountain range from our window was to die for. Special thanks to Mr Subash for arranging our stay and being extremely accommodating during the booking process. Thanks again to the entire team at Mystic Mountain for making our stay truly memorable.

The staff and service was excellent. The views also great.  Despite the ongoing pandemic the hotel was quite busy. The room was spacious n bright n adequate but the sound proofing terrible. You could hear the next room... people in the corridor and the constant moving of furniture above on the outside patio.  If you're looking for a quieter place I would recommend an alternative place.

This hotel was a blast for our group. Our one-night stay was incredibly enjoyable. If the sky is clear, you can enjoy a stunning panorama of mountain ranges as you walk into the reception area. Additionally, the personnel was outstanding, and the rooms were spotless and quite comfy. The dinner buffet was also greatly aided by Dinesh Pathak, who routinely dropped by to check on us and restock our nourishment. The meals provided were quite tasty. Also, had fun playing sports like basketball, badminton and table tennis with the team.

We stayed just for one night. We booked a Deluxe room, but got an upgrade to a Super Deluxe, which was a nice surprise. The room was big, clean and very comfortable. The view on the mountains from the room is spectacular. In the morning, you can watch the sunrise from the balcony and do not have to leave the room.During our stay there was a company party for an insurance company, so it was quite busy on the hotel premises. However, all was very well organized by the staff, so no major disturbances for us.The breakfast was fantastic, with a big variety. Also from the breakfast room you have a spectacular view. The staff was always friendly and helpful.

Far above the usual Nepal lodgings, this rates as a luxury resort in comparison. Outstanding hospitality and service in all areas, they even opened our door before we arrived at the room when we mistakenly left the room key inside.The kids enjoyed the heated pool greatly, and the buffet breakfast and dinner were good with many choices.Of course you are here for the view of the Himalayas, which can be seen from the balcony outside your room.

This was my third time visiting Mystic Mountain and this time too I had an amazing time. My family too enjoyed everything - rooms, view, food, location, Jacuzzi everything. The staff are very helpful especially in the restaurant. Seeing me with an infant, they offered to help in any way possible. Also the staff in the front desk are very cheerful and ready to answer any query. The driver dai who came to pick us up too was very friendly. Our overall experience was very good. And can't wait to visit again for the fourth time!

This place is extremely hyped and the reviews don’t give a clear picture. Sure- the location is good and many rooms have beautiful views and the front office staff are efficient. But that’s where the positives end . A place which is so isolated from the city / center has to have good food and that’s where they fail. The breakfast was quite awful with unripe fruits , barely any variety and an overworked chef who had to make dosas and omelettes for too many guests.. There was not a single floor manager to take care of the chaos and the very limited menu was over in the first 1 hour and took ages to replenish even partially. Even something as basic as pooris wasn’t made right. It wasn’t any better at dinner where the chef had the audacity to serve noodles at 10 pm which were cooked in the morning. It wasn’t corrected even after we complained. Second annoying thing is a random wake up call at 6 am for a 11 am checkout . No idea what the purpose was. During May you don’t get a view of the hills and I’m sure there are several other options at a better price

We stated here for one night but the room towels were very old and very rough.Lots of construction work , no jacuzy nor swimming pool under construction , compared to stay at club himalaya last year this hotel needs a lot to catch up though both of them have almost similar vibes from room scenic view to restaurants.Was amazed to see pad thai noodles at breakfast but was not a pad thai from any bite , though the rest of breakfast buffet was good.

Bed is comfortable for a couple and the bedsheets are clean.Decorations in the room are elegant.Hotel staffs are friendly and helpful.We used the swimming pool and jacuzzi to our fullest satisfaction.Heated swimming pool would be nice too have for winters.The location of the hotel is nice with great view.As improvements the shower cabin in the room could be more comfortable, as while showering water flows out of the cabin.A/c and technical equipment could be maintained more frequently.Not every tv channels are working.Tipp: bring your own slippers!

Good: Mountain views, but you can see similar views from the View Tower or any average hotel in Nagarkot. Ugly: As soon as we entered the rooms, it smelt of mold with visible mold in the shower. After every usage, the shower overflowed, wetting the entire bathroom, must be drainage issues as there are no doors that separate shower with rest of the bathroom. Glasses, beer/wine bottles and plates used by previous nights’ guests that used the same room were left outside for hours after our checkin. Most of the staff members attitude was as if they are doing us a favor, not sure if they hate patronizing to Nepali guests but for a 4-star hotel and having been to numerous hotels around Nepal, this was the worst. Staff looked undertrained and clearly under lot of frustration. We helped ourselves to tea, coffee, silverware, water for one of the breakfast seatings as we were totally ignored.Summary: Do yourselves a favor and avoid!

Hospitality was excellent, staff and every staff were well mannered. Overall beauty and structure was excellent. On my room; I found out that most of the furniture need to be repaired. Inside bathroom, need to place comb, hair serum and saving tools in addition.

I like the room way they decorated specially for us 🥰🥰🥰🥰 we also love the food and service they provided . It was very special and sweet .  The best part was the view of the nagarkot from our room.it was the most beautiful experience. Thank you so much 🥰🥰🥰🥰

Good hotel but lacks the finishing touch. Great location does make up for the bumpy ride to reach here but the overall experience is just a bit below the bulls eye. No qualms with anything but efficiency needs to be improved. Also, the veg options, specially during buffets are extremely limited.

Stayed there one night after a long trek and I got everything I needed - good size room with a bathroom to match and a balcony. The buffet dinner was very tasty and the service was very good, providing advice on dishes I was not familiar with. The bar had a good selection of alcohols, including local whiskeys. Reception very efficient and professional

The pillows were fullest and bed are comfortable and sooo relaxing. The  pool was soo clean with chill water. Our kids had soo fun and ........................... and food were soo good and hygienic. Will be coming back third time  soon.

We stayed in rooms 301, and 302 which basically had the best view. The hospitality provided by the staff members was satisfying and friendly. Staff members were unbelievably pampering and available at all times which made the overall visit quite amusing. I suggest visiting Nagarkot around summer, which can benefit from a wonderful view of the mountains in a clear blue sky as well as the greenery is mind soothing.

Went there for a quick lunch at their in house restaurant. Must say the food is good and wasn’t disappointed because we wanted to try a mix of continental for main course and Nepalese styled Pork Chilli 🌶️ for starters (was recommended by server). .

Nestle amidst the majestic peaks of Nepal, this mountain hotel offers an enchanting retreat. The view from the room is simply breathtaking. The accommodation is spotlessly clean, and the services provided are excellent. There’re wide varieties of sumptuous food and the staff, polite and courteous. A true sanctuary of comfort and serenity, leaving a lasting desire to return.

Best of the best Hotel. I love everything about this hotel. The food were good, staffs were very hospitable, swimming in the infinity pool above the cloud was like a failytale moment for me, can't wait to be back. Sitting beside the Buddha was very peaceful.

This place is such a beauty. I always adore being there. It has a lot to offer and a must visit destination.  It has a mesmerising view of a valley and the mountains.  The hospitality they offer is really praiseworthy  . They have a hell lot of food to offer, and everything tastes so very good. If you are lucky enough you get a surprise upgrade on your reservations too, I was the one this time . Thank you so much Sunita Dhonju for everything you did to make my stay a memorable one 💖

Location 1-2 hours outside of Kathmandu depends on traffic. Located in the hillside forest area. An amazing view! Also amazing rooms, but the rooms are a little on the smaller side. Staff is great and rooms are clean!!! Definitely a western style hotel with a Nepal flare. The food was amazing !!!

Very nice hotel with extremely friendly staff. Beautiful rooms with a fantastic view of the Himalayan Mountains, would come back here anytime. Translation: "In the beautiful panorama restaurant, we found a large buffet. The selection of drinks leaves nothing to be desired. The dishes were all very tasty, sometimes a bit spicy for the European palate - just ask the staff. The dessert buffet and live cooking events were professionally and attractively executed. Overall, the ambiance is very comfortable, and you feel at ease immediately. The training area and the bar section are highly recommended as well. The Swedish massage in the small spa was very relaxing and pleasant. Highly recommended. The price-performance ratio is absolutely justified.

The stay at the hotel was out of the world experience. Would definitely suggest if one is going for a relaxing trip. Hospitality & food was exceptionally good. Staffs were very very cordial & ever smiling. Yubraj adhikari in house keeping was helpful in solving one of our problems. All in all a lovely place to rejuvenate & relax. The rooms are very spacious & neat & clean. So would definitely suggest everyone.

We always wanted to be on family vacation out of Kathmandu City. In the midst heat dusk away from Kathmandu, we went to the breezing soothing weather of Nagarkot. Fortunately, the weather was perfect for the weekend. The location, rooms, swimming pool, jacuzzi and food buffet dinner/breakfast  was just perfect. My family enjoyed it thoroughly and was mesmerised of the setting of the Hotel location and its facilities. The hotel staffs were friendly and approachable. I particularly enjoyed 8 Km morning jungle hike to the nearest viewing tower which was spectacular. Surprisingly, it was just two of us probably we are more fitter and keener.

“Without doubt one of the favorite hotels I stayed during my time in Nagarkot.Upon arrival we were warmly welcomed by the staff. The staff was extremely friendly (appreciate this!) and deserves a special thanks. We had one great evenings here. Note, this is not a 4/5-star hotel or so, but the atmosphere is so special that it really felt like home to me. All respect for the team who does a great job here; a true sample of excellent hospitality!”

Great hotel with fantastic view at a good location. Loved the ambience and vibe. Breakfast & Dinner Buffet served during the stay was very good with unlimited food options. Nice rooms with balcony, and nice service too.

Rooms felts very cold and heater is not very strong. Food is very delicious with a good variety but the rest of the hotel feels very cold especially at night. Lobby area and hall ways were cold and the room floor was cold to walk on. Soft and comfortable beds as well as clean toilets

We  had stayed for a night  at this hotel. Stepping through the lobby, I was immediately struck by the beautiful and friendly reception area where we were welcomed with a nice welcome drink. The staff throughout the hotel were very professional, friendly and extremely helpful. We were there for our wedding anniversary celebration and our room was so well decorated. Buffet dinner and breakfasts were amazing. The location of the hotel is great. The room was very spacious and well equipped with all essentials and fantastic view. I have no hesitation in recommending this hotel to the tourists who want to go to Nagarkot. A very especial thanks to operation manager Mr. Subash Khadka for arranging everything for our big team (our friends who were there for our anniversary celebration).Will be back to this place soon..!!!

Best staff with best view.The place was very beautiful with Mountain View and swimming pool and gym hall was so amazing, staff was very helpful and they know how to host the guest. And how to make guest happy. Room was very comfortable and clean .

The road leading to this hidden beauty might be a little troublesome but trust me, once you reach there, you'll forget about all the troubles you faced on the way! Firstly the associates were very courteous and always ready to help. The room itself was very cozy and pretty. Oh! The bed was super comfortable - much needed after a bumpy ride! We devoured the buffet dinner and breakfast. We were amazed by the offerings they had! From live stations to desserts to drinks to continental affairs, both the dinner and breakfast menus were very extensive. We spent a very lovely time at their jacuzzi overlooking the little settlements beneath. Overall it was a very memorable trip and we can't wait to get there again! Thank you Umesh ji, Manisha and Amita ma'am for all that you did for us.

I loved my Myic Mountain Experience. I have traveled to many corners of Nepal and Kathmandu Valley. Mystic Mountain id undoubtly the best of the resort I have every stayed. Food is great, staffs are the sweetest and mostly hospitable. Hotel structutre is undoubtly the unique and view is stunning. undoubtedly the best reort in Nepal. I definitely  be back.

Hotel Mystic Mountain is a beautiful property with great architecture and design which caught my attention. That said the room we stayed in was huge and spacious with two balconies. We had the perfect view of sunrise from our room and enjoyed the warm sunlight too. The buffet was filled with plenty of dishes for every palette and we enjoyed the dinner and breakfast thoroughly and returned home with a happy heart and stomach.

Beautiful location of hotel. Beautiful layout of building so you get great views of the mountains if clear. Only reason I gave it a 4 was that our room was freezing cold. They did come and fix the heater but coming in the winter the rooms should be warm!

We have a problem with our room and the front service manager Umesh reach out and help to solve our problem with patience and professionalism. Truly appreciate him to make our stay a very pleasant ones!One suggestion is the lighting in the corridors at night is too dark. As there are a lot of steps on a hilly hotel, it’s very easy to trip and fall!

We stayed here for one night. It was our first stop coming from India. Experience at the front office was great. We asked if we can get an upgrage, and they showd us one room which was a little small but had a huge balcony, which we wanted. They showed us both the rooms and the girl who showd us waited patiently with smile on her face till the time we finalized the room. Resort overall is great. It has multiple seating areas, restaurants both open and indoor, gym and a nice infinity swimming pool. Also there is one small kids playing area as well. Food was great. We had all the meals in hotel only and all were nice. Buffet breakfast was also great with good variety. Entire staff was polite, helpful and fast be it front office, restaurant, room service or housekeeping. Overall, we loved our stay.

Everything was just about perfect. Good food, friendly and helpful staff, great views, comfortable room. Pool was refreshing and clean as was the hotel in general. I found a quiet spot to do some birdwatching and a member of staff, completely off his own bat, asked if I’d like a coffee and he brought one totally free

We had come here to celebrate Birthday, and they had done very nice decorations as per our request, the birthday girl was totally surprised and happy with the decoration and service. We had a lovely time with the family at the jacuzzi and the rooms. Sunrise was splendid. The services, like lift and restaurant timings should be improved, especially for breakfast, it should be till 10:30 , as this is holiday resort, and people come here to relax

Mystical ExperienceHotel is full of life.  As a frequent business travellers, we were really grateful to experience the great hospitality and professionalism of hotel Mystic Mountain team. Having stayed at numerous properties around the country, this one easily ranks among the best. I enjoyed Friday night live music, jacuzzi and infinity swimming pool.

Excellent Service from checkin to checkout. Staffs were professional. No complains. Views from the room are top notch. Please stay here if u want to…………… all the activities are nearby. You will not be dissapointed . Exceptional communication food abd drinks on time

Our first impression was really good! As we were travelling from pokhara so we reached Thaml early like 5.30am.  Then we started our journey directly towards Hotel Mystic Mountain. We were about to check in 2pm but as we travelled the whole night they gave us our room early at 12.45pm. That was really a good sign of a 4 star hotel! And the view, the room everything reached our expectations! We enjoyed fully for our 1night stay! And the service boy Ashok Nama was really good in terms of service! He took some good pictures of us! The breakfast was average! But the view and overall experience was good!

This is an absolute gem! If you love luxury totally remote in the mountains with mountain view then this is it!The service is incredible, people genuinely ask how the stay is and try to do everything possible. Major thanks to Ram Kumar Parajuli and Bhumika and many more for guiding me and explaining everything i wanted to know.This place gives you : relaxation (massage options, sauna, jacuzzi, swimming pool) but also hikes nearby and the view tower for amazing sunset or sunrise.I came on a motorcycle which gives it a more adventurous experience!Welcomed with pleasure! Thank you for everything

The location is out of this world. The staff is extremely respectful, knowledgeable and helpful in every way. For the price, every little detail needs to be taken into consideration which rendered the entire experience average in my opinion.A little more variety in dinner options would certainly not be remiss. The constant on and off electricity was a nuisance as well. We were checked into our room 15 minutes after the mentioned check in time for clean up to be completed. Even after that we found a written comment card of the previous occupant still present when got there. The clean up process was therefore unreliable for us.Nevertheless, the rooms were excellent. Sunrise in Nagarkot from the balcony of one's bedroom is not something one would see everywhere. Quality of everything from bed linen to pillows was extremely luxurious. Standards are set high but for the price certainly some improvements could be made. Would love to stay here again !

View from hotel is mesmerizing. If you don't want to dive into cool swimming pool, you can get into jacuzzi next to swimming pool. Staffs are very friendly and they accommodated our needs.Hotel Mystic Mountain is a great choice to spend relaxing time with your family.

Mr Khadka is my hero! I want to say THANK YOU to him, our taxi driver couldn't find the way for like an hour and Mr,( he is the head of the front desk service) was leading our driver ( who doesn't speak english ) on the phone so patiently and saved us )) ! We felt so welcomed and taken care! thank you soooooo very much !!!

beautiful hotel in a heart of nature. My familybenjiyed staying in Mystic mountain. swimming pool was fabulous, there was hot jacuzzi near the pool and it was we'll maintained and heated. We exteded our stay as onenight was not enough for my family. staffs were very helpful. It is recommendedto booknatleasta week in dvance for weekend as they are always booked.Thank you for giving us a wonderful memory

The road to the hotel is under construction since 8 !!! years and there is no fun in it but if you're once there in the hotel the very friendly staff is doing everything to make you feel relaxed. The GM is supporting every wish you have. Thanks very much for the nice stay!

The views are stunning, early morning sunrise is highly recommended.Staff are lovely and the food is delish. I was really impressed with the buffet dinner and breakfast.It's a wonderful place for refelection. I wish I'd had the time to stay for longer.

Very nice and staff were very helpful . Gives you a taste of Nepal mountains . Loved my 2 nights there and enjoyed a nice break from everything .A walk in nature just gives you the perfect energy to go back to everyday life . The views from the room balcony are just amazing .i would definitely go back for more pure oxygen and natural beauty.Its closeness to Kathmandu 1:15 min by car makes it easy to go there.

One of my friend recommend me mystic mountain.I was their for a lunch with my family but the First impression was too bad.We went to the cafe and was looking for sitting area and ask for one of the service staff for sitting arrangement.He informed me he will be back in a minute, waited for long but nobody took care of us. I was so pissed of by the service that was expected.After sometime one of the tall gentleman came with big smile and greet us and asked us how may I assit you?I explained him everything and he appolgize from entire team addressing him as Operation Manager named subash. He arranged us at the top terrace from where we  can see the better view. He was very humble ,courtisous and polite with all time smiling.He was the example of true hospitality professional with great personality and positivity.I felt like rating zero but I rated 5 star only because of this gentleman Subash. Even at the time of leaving from the hotel he appolgizes us and bid a warm farewell.If you are at Mystic mountain meet this gentleman he will make  your day.

One of the best place for family, couples & friends. The place is cozy and warm with beautiful and helpful staff.I recommend to those who want to feel the nature, sunrise and the beautiful horizon of mountains.  I would like to thank The MYSTIC MOUNTAIN for making our stay beautiful and memorable.

Stayed at Mountain Mystic in Nagarkot and was thoroughly impressed. The hotel offers mesmerizing sunrise views and stunning vistas of the snow-capped Himalayas, making for a truly unforgettable experience. The food was exceptional, featuring a variety of delicious options. Additionally, the staff were incredibly friendly and went out of their way to ensure a comfortable stay.

The hospitality was par excellence right from our pick up from Kathmandu to our airport drop. The hotel rooms, hotel build area, view  and especially staff and food was too too good. Will definitely visit  again.

Wonderful environment, clean, quiet and peaceful, with great food and friendly staff. Bed and pillows are comfortable enough for a sound sleep. Room window and balcony, restaurant, café all face the spectacular scenery, but it also depends on the weather.

Dinner and breakfast is very delicious.Environment is very peaceful and calmAnd scenery is very mesmerizing. The room is very cozy. I had a very great stay here. In the morning while we were having breakfast we were very lucky that we got to see mountains very clearly.I had a great stay here Thank you 😊

Friendly staff. Food is generally ok. Service is really fast. Rooms initially offered were very small. The bathroom stench  of order. They changed the rooms. But still the same issue. I think high time for refurbishment.  The view from the hotel is really beautiful!!

Bumpy road to get up here from Kathmandu but well worth the trip. Fabulous location to see the Himalayas in the distance, though they are sometimes hidden by clouds, so don't 'expect' to see them. We were lucky to see the sunset and sunrise on them one evening and one morning out of the three days we stayed here. The hotel rooms were very comfortable and the views spectacular (even the thunderstorm which went on for hours!). Hotel staff were all very friendly and service was great. The dining room menu was varied and buffet breakfast very good. There are no local restaurants nearby so it was good to have the wide choice.

Excellent food and service. Good ambience and rooms are very cozy. Special thanks for complimentary cake and staffs who were very friendly and helpful in need. Highly appreciated.Reshma Ashwin Shrestha

We went this Hotel  with group friends.We stayed for 1 night, and arrival experience was outstanding with welcome drinks.What a superb place to stay all room have a privet balcony with a beautiful mountain and swimming pool view. It was worth it.best way to spend some time with nature.It was so much relaxing and refreshing. Place is good for friend, family and couple.Staff were very friendly and could not do enough for you. They were all polite, respectful.Restaurant and bar was also fantasticBuffet Breakfast was very delicious with many options and best way to start the mornings. I will highly recommend Hotel Mystic mountain to everyone.

Was a great place to see the mountains. Staff was friendly and food was good.I would recommend this place to anyone who wants to be away from the City and enjoy the weather and scenic view from the hotel.The view is beautiful with mountains and hills.

Hotel is very well located in between the nature. Road to hotel might not be smooth but the amount you spend here is worth every penny. I love the lavishness they serve in buffet breakfast and dinner. Mountain view can be enjoyed from every part of the hotel. You can also enjoy from your private balcony.Will definitely comeback. Staffs are too sweet and helpful.

One of the worst services I have ever experienced.. The service staff were useless. Nowhere to be seen. Had to deliver the bill. While the servers were laughing inside.Food is dry AF. EVERYTHING WAS BAD. It's the worst food i have ever had. Better to have Street food.. it gives better service and food.The Sizzler was dry, MOMOS was no better. Such service with the food.. If you are planning to visit.. please don't... The only good thing they have is the view..2/10.

We had planned and booked a weekend trip to this hotel which was confirmed too. But got cancelled on the morning of the trip saying it was a technical problem by the manager, which wasn't. Our booked rooms were given away. So, our experience was bad without entering that hotel. Be careful while making an reservation.. don't trust them..

Love the ambience at this hotel! So vibie! The stay was very relaxing. Also, the staff were very accommodating and extremely nice people in general. Breakfast was really good too as they have a wide variety of options. Would definitely come back here again! ❤️

The room services, clealiness and accomodate services were great. We reallg enjoyed our time here. Great location and place. Foods were tasty. Overall we loved the hotel. We will come back again for sure. We recommend people to come here when they visit in Nagarkot, Nepal. Thanks.😃😃❤️

We had an excellent stay in this place of rest, very warm welcome, good food. Perfect place to start our adventure in Nepal.The bedding is perfect. Very comfortable after a long journey of 7000 km.Exceptional!

Great views of the valley. Enjoyed the cool mountain breeze. Food and beverages taste delicious. Saw an awesome sunrise but couldn't see the Himalayas due to dense fog. Staff was very courteous. Overall a memorable experience.

Hotel Mystic Mountain was a wonderful stay - they were attentive and extremely hospitable. Mr Umesh Khadkar was especially great, helping me with my InDrive and ensuring we had a pleasant stay at the hotel. Thank you to all the staff and manager Mr Bharat.

Very comfortable room, I was upgraded on arrival 👌🏼 the service was amazing and the views were phenomenal throughout the resort. Umesh the manager as his team took great care of me and welcomed me from check in to check out. The live singer in the lounge was superb and the Himalayan massage was wonderful! Highly recommend a stay at Mystic Mountain during your visit to Nepal - you willnot be disappointed!!

Views from room and hotel were amazing. Hotel services, staffs were outstanding-approachable, friendly & cheerful! Me & my family thoroughly enjoyed the stay and we are planning to revisit again in summer this year. Thank you for the wonderful mystic experience 🙏🏼 see you soon!

Me and my friend went to Mystic mountain  and we are from Somalia, Mystic mountain was a great experience. Staff very very friendly and helpful and then view is just amazing. Mr Umesh Khadka was the person showing us around, he was very polite and helpful!!

A perfect place to be with family. We all thoroughly enjoyed. Clean rooms, very hygenic and well spread buffet and enough open space. All staffs are very polite, helpful  and knowledable. location is the best part to see mountain ranges and also for the sunrise

We group of friend recently visited to one of the best hotel (Mystic mountain) where we experienced best service and food. Breath taking view of himalayas and natural beauty. Staffs are very helpful and special thanks to Ms Ganga who gave us enough information.

Very comfortable accommodations, excellent service! The design of the hotel and rooms were so nice &thoughtful and everything was nice and clean. The accommodations exceeded our expectations. We were very pleased with the food— especially the mustangi aloo, asparagus soup, veg. pakodaThe only downside was that the view was obscured by the smog.

Beautiful place to be away from crowed city. It is just 0ne our driving from Kathmandu. Where you can enjoy delicious food and panoramic view of mountain. Helpful staff are always ready to assist you. Special thanks to front office staffs who show us property around.

Lovely hotel with majestic view of the mountains.  Very nice relaxing getaway after trekking.  Really enjoyed our stay, however I will say, it would be nearly perfect if they would not allow children.  They run around the place like maniacs with no restraint from their parents.  It would be nice to have dinner without an iPad/gaming system blaring as the background ambiance.  Just my opinion.

Wonderful view. Excellent service. Service staffs really deserve the credit. Room was decorated as requested and removed in timely manner. Included dinner and breakfast had lots of tasty options. Loved the food both at the buffet and their cafe. Would definitely visit again soon

Perfectly located, Absolutely outstanding hotel. Helpful, friendly staff Shruti Shrestha who did everything in her hands to make sure we have the best time. The stay was very pleasant and comfortable. Wonderful experience, superb hospitality.

Apart from the rain it was a pleasant stay. Rain didn’t stop me from getting into the pool. Dinner and breakfast was served with excellent presentation and didn’t disappoint us at all. Can’t say about my partner but It was touch of heaven for my tongue. Mamma Mia. Room 405 was one of those room where you feel like you went to different time zone.
