We visited the Hotel Misty Mountain for a family vacation. The service is brilliant. We had a car breakdown on the way to the hotel and the hotel provided a car to rescue us. The food, hospitality and service was world class and the staff were super friendly.A special mention to Bijay who is a consummate professional. The hotel itself is beautiful with the most breathtaking morning views.

The views from this hotel are gorgeous! It is well worth waking early to see the sunrise. The pool is lovely. My room had air conditioning although I found the room a bit musty smelling. The shower also leaked a bit. The breakfast was delicious although lacked complimentary coffee.

Hustling and bustling in crowded kathmandu. It was such a  nice gateway to Nagarkot with  beautiful mountain views, outstanding service and great food.  Spacious clean  room and all the staffs were friendly and helpful. Definitely coming back again. Thanks.

My stay here has been nothing but wonderful. Superb service, superb food and the ambience? Better than I expected. The staff is wonderful, from the wait staff, front desk to ancillary personnel, they go out of their way to make your stay comfortable. I will definitely want to come back. My friends are already saying how beautiful my pictures are.

Excellent hotel. Panaromic view of mountains from hotel room. Luxury to experience sunrise from room balcony. Mesmerising view of mountains from the hotel and the room. Lot of good spots to click scenic photos that will create lifetime memories. Staff is very co-operative and service is top-notch. We reached late at around 8PM and checked out at 9AM. Suggest do keep good time at hand to be spent at the hotel and to enjoy beautiful surroundings.

We reached Nagarkot from Kathmandu Airport on the way back from Pokhara. The hotel sent their car for the pick up and I visited Bhaktapur en route. On arrival, they offered me a room upgrade at no extra cost. Utam Lama had stayed in touch altogether. The room was big enough to accommodate all 3 members. The hotel has great sunrise views and is quite good to stay for a couple of days.

Was there for a couple of nights and was amazed with the location, the property, the view, the service as well the food. Waking up to a view directly from my bed (Room No. 503) as seen in the pic attached was breathtaking.

We stayed for 2 nights and it was our 2nd visit. Well maintained. Mesmerizing sunset and sunrise view, hotel ambience was very good, service and food 10/10. The road was widen bit compare to last vist. Smoothly arrived at hotel  😊!!  I will recommend it to all to visit Hotel Mystic Mountain once.

Hotel Mystic Mountain is a gem for those seeking a peaceful and rejuvenating getaway. Its idyllic location, comfortable accommodations, delicious dining, and exceptional service make it a standout choice. I look forward to returning and reliving the tranquil escape this hotel provided. I highly recommend Hotel Mystic Mountain.

Perfect hospitality, worth the price paid. Scenic view of mountains. Friendly staffs specially Miss Shruti Shrestha, such a gentle and humble human being.I would rate this place a must visit if u are in kathamndu.

We had a wonderful time at Mystic. Its a perfect destination to getaway from Kathmandu. We had aa lot of fun. It was perfect combination music, drink and ambiance hotel offers. Front desk Staffs are very helpful and cheerful all the time.

Great  location for mountain and sunrise view.  Warm hospitality of professional staffs. Delicious food and enough variety. Welcoming staffs always helpful.  Clear and peaceful atmosphere with sound of singing birds.

Great hotel with good food and ambience and a wonderful view of the himalayas. The rooms had balconcy which was perfect to watch the sunrise. The rooms was a bit pricey than other hotels in Nagarkot. But will definitely stay there again due to the hospitality of the staffs and the amazing view.

I visited last month for my weekend trip and it was a perfect place to be at. From the amazing serene view to a classic cuisine, the hotel is great to be at with your family, friends and even for officials. Would love to visit again:))

Room Not up to date.. not up-to-date clean, very tiny room for Deluxe catagory ( high rate for tiny room) Fungi in Menu book in room. (Pic attached) Lights not fixed (pic attached) Net door broken and one part of the net was missing so could not use net door of balcony. Layer of dust behind toilet seat. Only Food and recreation activity was satisfying.

Arrogant and unprofessional staffs, worst service and equally worse food. If there was a option i would have given a zero or even a minus rating. Beside location nothing was there so i would not  recommend this hotel at all.

Very good new facilies.   Every employee was extremely kind and professional. My wife and I enjoyed beautiful sunrise from the balcony of my room and it was great. Also we enjoyed the view of Himalyan mountains including Everest and many other ones which are more than 7,000m high.  Drinking some beers from the restaurant and bar with amazing view will be a grest memory to us.   Very good price for hotel facility and quality of service. Thank you everybody working at the Mtstic Hotel.

Stayed 4 nights at mystic mountain and it was incredible. The room was clean and all facilities were available. Sunrise from my balcony was amazing. Food excellent, staff were so friendly, helpful and just the best I have seen, definitely world class. Hope to visit again very soon.Kind regards Cheryl hickey

It was a great great experience.Ambience was really very peaceful and beautiful. Room was very clean, well managed and the view from the room looks like your are above the clouds (sunset and sunrise) ❤️.Staff,especially Roshini Thakuri was very kind,helpful and friendly to us.Helped alot. Thanks to the entire team,we will visit again soon...

We are associated with one of the renowned company in Nepal. As we have done our Dealers meet in Mystic mountain, we received very good service from the hotel team. Late-night service and overall team coordination from the hotel team were really amazing.  Special thanks to Mr. Bharat Baral (Hotel team leader )

It was an awesome experience, beautiful range of mountain was just in front of us. The view was very beautiful. Room comes with spacious balcony and can stay all day watching view. I recommend everyone who are seeking to stay in peaceful and natural environment.

The whole experience was awesome, from the welcome to checkout, the staffs were really helpful and polite. We went as a family and did experience once in a life time experience. The scenic view from the room was breathtaking. Dinner and breakfast had plenty to choose from and was included. Definitely recommend as one of the best in Nagarkot or KTM.

It was a well spent weekend at Hotel mystic mountain, nagarkot. The hotel is at a very good location overseeing the Himalaya range. Very helpful staff and 5 star service. Nothing to complain about. Food here was very good, having various options for vegetarian and kids too.

Now, when handed over, the house keeping had left the balcony open for the smell to be vanished and unfortunately, for all the mosquitoes and insects right above the bed !!!!!! Now, when the senior manager called says - PLS COPE UP FOR THE NIGHT !!! After half an hour of discussion at the reception, where we had been told all rooms were occupied, suddenly a room pops out of no where from an online cancellation!!! Heights of irresponsibility!!! Highly dissatisfied!!!! Not recommended at all !!!! It's not about the property anymore, but the Service & Hospitality here at  Hotel Mystic Mountain sucks big big time!!!! Let me start by saying this was booked for our final night in Nepal after 2 weeks of Kathmandu, Bandipur, pokhara, trekking and exploring a simply magical country.We couldn't wait to finish our trip with an evening up in the clouds in luxury.What a disappointment. The room was filthy, stains, scuff marks, mould everywhere. Nowhere to hang your towel after use (every single hotel in the world has hooks, and asks to only put your towel on the ground if you dont want to reuse it - saving water / washing etc).Arrived after a long journey from Pokhara via plane and private car transfer from Kathmandu airport, starved and hot we made our way to the pool for a snack and drink. Only to be informed the food on the poolside menu "wasnt available at the pool".When we had finally figured out their complicated dining arrangements we sat down to the most expensive and bland momo we had tasted in all of Nepal.Went to Nagarkot for dinner, got better service and nicer food from a street vendor.Return to room to shower and go to bed, discovered extensive mould and filth in room. Took photos, showed to manager, he looked shocked but said nothing and did nothing to rectify.Note, we stayed in guest houses / lodges in the mountains of the Himalayas which would struggle to get a single star, and yet they provided cleaner accommodation, better service and tastier food at a fraction of the price.Go and stay at Hotel Mulberry, or get yourself to Pokhara and visit Pavilions if you want to see what a genuinely luxurious, clean, well serviced hotel can achieve (and donate 70% of profits to local charities and schools!!)

I had booked a suite for this past weekend with my fiance through my office. Her friend decided to come at the last minute and booked through trip advisor. Once we got there, they allocated us our rooms, 206 and 207. I found it a bit strange and being a bit confused by a suite being right next to a deluxe room, so, i asked the front desk attendent, who was accompaning us if she was sure that our room was a suite and she assured me that it was. Once we got to our room, we saw that it had twin beds. I politely asked if there was one with a double bed and she blatently says to me that i can just join it. After she looked at our bewildered faces, she then asks, if i wanted her to call the housekeeping to join the beds. I asked her if there was another suite with a double bed, and she told me that all other suites were "occupied" and some were under construction. Mind you i quote the being occupied part. I will come to later. Since our rooms were next to each other, i said why not. The front desk attendent left and while waiting for the housekeeping to come, we went out to our terraces from both rooms and that saw it was adjoined. This was kinda creepy, as technically, there was no privacy and that people from the other rooms could just climb into ours! The balcony was only seperated by a 4 foot open steel fence. When i compared the 2 rooms. It was almost identical. The deluxe was maybe just a few square feet smaller than our so called suite. I was just not satisfied and i asked the house keeping guy, who was well spoken and all 'suited' up to call the reception and ask if the executive suite was available, because the girk earlier had told me there weren't any other suites. Note that i've quoted suited. When he called the reception, they said they would let us know soon. They called back after 5 minutes saying that the executive suites(they have 2) was available. Happy and relieved, we followed him up to our 'executive suite' Room 502. When we got there, the room was maybe 100 square feet bigger than the last one, by NO MEANS an executive suite. Baffled, i asked the house keeper again if he was sure that this is their executive suite. He assured me that it was. I asked him to show me the other one and he said it was under maintenance. I was really shocked and pissed now! I wanted to go to the reception and confront them about this, but, my fiance pleaded with me not to as it would ruin the night. She asked me only to talk about while checking out. I don't mean to brag, but i've stayed in executive suites before, and in no way, shape or form, was this an executive suite! I mean the place has a 6th floor. And i know those are the executive suites. During checkout, i asked the front desk, why they made such a mess of my booking. The guy simply replies, room 207 is a junior suite too and for the mistake of the executive suite, please forgive us as the staff are still in training and these things happen. So casually!!! I own a resort too and there is no way in hell that something like this should/would happen. He then tells me, why did you ask housekeeping? You should have directly come to us. With a look saying, 'of course something like this will happen if you ask them'. The guy suited up well spoken comes here. He looked like he was the house keeping in-charge. Thats why i asked him to call and ask. What is more doubtful is that, when i called the night before asking what type of room was 502, and i said this is no way an executive suite! The girl then paused and asked another girl what she should say. She then tells me that its a junior suite. That was really suspicious!!! Just 30 mins ago, they told me that all suites are occupied or under maintence and that this was the executive suite! And now that i've sternly told them that this isnt an executive suite, they tell me its a junior suite! Are they actually serious!!! The front desk should not have to pause and ask another person what type of room should i say it is. This is totally unacceptable!!! For someone who've never been to this hotel or someone who dosent know what a deluxe, suite or an executive suite looks like, they would have conned them for sure! I dont know if this is a scam that they do or just a big mistake, but totally UNACCEPTABLE!!! When i asked how room 207 and 502 could both be suites? They simply said that it is. Even if so, there is a world of difference between the 2 rooms. If you stay in a suite, dont stay in room 207. Its small as hell! Ok! Enough of the negative things. I really wanted to give this place a good review. Because, it has so much potential and the place is just super nice. All the other staff were all super cordial. Everyone greeted us. The food was excellent, except for dessert.The pool is serene, overlooking the Himalayas and you get an awesome sunrise from every room! Breath taking views while eating too!! But why Mystic Mountain??? Why did you guys have to screw up like this!!! Another thing is the tennis court. Who would ever come and play here??? Waste of space i say. As much as i love the place, i am rating it this low! These things cannot happen and should not happen!!! And for that reason, i will have to report this thing to HAN. I am a member of HAN and my father, the PP. We work on things like this not happening and I hope that this never happens again. I am not sure what the actual deal was, but i sincerely hope that the management gets to the bottom of this. I want to come visit again this summer. Just because i really like the place. I hope, really hope i can give you all a 5 star rating then. Because i believe everyone should get a second chance. But other people wont be so kind!!!
