This is the hotel to stay at.I have stayed at mystic mountain hotel and this is a gem.I call this is a smiling hotel!I never stoped smiling from the time i arrived until i left.Good hospitality,Lovely staff and spotless and a great location.Can't wait to visit again...

The location is excellent.  It is a relaxing place away from the noise of Tourist locations but easy access to touring. The views are amazing and the staffs were professional and very polite especially Ms. Mona.

It was great staying there. The view from the room was breathtaking. Room service was amazing, all the staffs were friendly and hotel service was simply amazing. Will definitely stay there in next visit.....

Beautiful property with outstanding service and hospitality.Booking  was  really easy  no hassle and paper work,thanks to Mr Sachin Dangol.A must visit place,looking forward to vist for the third time...

Mystic Mountain (MM)-servives were mystically good! I really appreciated their staffs services "greeting to good bye" specially Moona's personable manners- how she made us comfortable in every step- from checking in to checking-out. She was always there to greet us,to ask for our needs and our comforts. Thank you Moona,UR a gem of the MM. If you love mountain views, wake up with sunrise and sunset, have good food with exellent services, you must visit the MM in Nagarkote,Nepal and spend few nights- you would not regreted.

Watched sunrise over the Himalayas. Beautiful, panoramic views of several 20,000 foot high mountain peaks. Food was great. Staff very accommodating. Road is a little rough getting to the hotel. Lovely experience.

We had an absolutely great time at the Mystic Mountain hotel! Great staff, wonderful Location, really awsome Continental breakfast and beautiful clean rooms. The guest relation officer Moona Waiba was kindly assisting us with any questions or further requests and made us feel very welcome and well taken care of! We would definetely recommend staying in this Great Hotel if you are looking for a wonderful luxury time apart from the smog and stress of Kathmandu. It really is a place to relax and regain your Energy :))

This is the second time I have been here with family and enjoyed both the times. Once in June and the recent in December. We got a good glimpse of the Himalayas this time.The pool was and Jacuzzi was under construction so a bit noisy. We got upgraded to a junior suite but I preferred to stay on the room with the big terrace. Dinner seemed a bit degraded than my last visit but Breakfast was awesome. The staff mentioned they were adding more activities to do which would be a plus for the establishment.

An excellent location and probably the best view one can ever have during morning tea time. The car route is pretty difficult and it's best to avoid late evening drive. Service was par excellence. Breakfast was sumptuous and with a wide choice

This hotel is in Nagarkot, about one hour drive from Khatmandu.They are laying new road. It's one of the beautiful places in the world where we can see Sunrise from the hotel, but we need to go Sunset spot, about 10minutes drive from Hotel. Its good hotel, but little expensive. Place is really nice to spend time with family and friends

We were received with a warm welcome at the reception, and to our surprise, we both got our rooms upgraded. What a wonderful gesture. Our rooms have a large balcony, with the beautiful view of the mountains. We sat on the hanging chair looking at the sunset as well as sunrise in the morning.The room was clean and the bed was very comfortable too. The breakfast was just incredible, plentiful of selection. Just wonderful.We also had dinner at the restaurant and the food & service were just wonderful.If I were to go back to Nagarkot, this is the place to stay... definitely.

Mystic Mountain is on the hill side from where you can see the entire range of Himalaya mountains in case the sky is clear. The hotel is big with about 71 rooms. Everything in the hotel was good except the road to Nagarkot from Kathmandu. The roads are really bad with a lot of dust. Coming on to the food part, the food was very average. Could have been better given the hotel standards. Lastly I felt that the hotel should arrange for pick and drop to the sunset view point without any cost ( it costed us NPR 1500 to and fro to the sunset point). This is what any good top rated hotel would do.

After doing the Poon Hill walk we stayed here (after of course travelling back to Kathmandu).  It was a knock out. Just didn’t expect a place like this here. It took some travel and it’s a bit rough but It is up there with the best. Very remote and that’s what makes it so different. Restaurant is great. Rooms are very good with stunning views. I think all rooms have a view.

Enduring the hair-raising ride to the hotel was well worth it once you arrived. The room was clean, with all the amenities, with a balcony with spectacular views of the mountains and the surrounding valleys. The weather in November was great. Our stay was fun and relaxing.

A really lovely hotel. I had a very nice stay and wished I had an extra day or two. Great staff, large room and the views are off the chart.  I can't say enough about Mystic Mountain and if I ever get to Nepal again, I will make a beeline for this place in spite of the awful road getting there.

We enjoyed our stay there in October. Wish I could stay longer. I wasn't 100% sure about the reviews but yes, excellent service, view and people. It took a while to get there but definitely worth to visit!

Me & my husband spent a night here and honestly it was a wonderful experience for both of us!! Good food, great service overall - completed all our request as requested. Sunrise & sunset view was breathing taking from our room. Interior design are instagram worthy 😉👍🏼👍🏼👍🏼❤️❤️❤️

This is one of the best hotels I have ever visited. The rooms are large and spacious. The view of the Himalayas are breathtakingly beautiful. The only downside to this otherwise fantastic room hotel is that it takes a minimum of 2&half hours to reach from the city of Kathmandu. The staff are very friendly and the food is amazing. If you're ever visiting Nepal. This place must be on your list to just relax and take in the beauty that is Nepal.

With amazing views this hotel is a lovely spot The road is a little bit poor, but its so worth it. The nature and magic views. My first MoMo:s in Nepal and I loved it. The staff is so service minded, friendly. The massage was fantastic. IF you want peace and quiet and enjoy nature, this place is perfect for that. The view from your room is breath taking. I will be back.

We enjoyed our stay & had exceptionally good service at this Hotel,. The hotel is extremely well located on the top of the beautiful hills of Nagarkot with breathtaking views of Himalays and sunrise. The peaceful atmosphere and amazing hospitality make everybody fall in love with this hotel. Clarity of sunrise from the terrace was spectacular.  Also, amazing breakfast buffet made my day. All the staffs are excellent, friendly and efficient. I would like to highlight Moona Waiba’s (Sr.GRO) performance, extremely friendly and kind. The room we stayed in was very clean, comfortable and had all the amenities needed for a great stay.The atmospheres made my stay more delightful with all those nature around that area. This hotel has a great ambience and resourceful management to make sure your time is spent well between those magical hillsWe'll definitely be back at Hotel Mystic Mountain.

Hotel Mystic Mountain is a lovely hotel that has wonderful views of the Himalayan if the weather is cooperative. In order to get to the hotel you have to travel on terrible unpaved roads but once you arrive the hotel is very nice. It was clean and had wonderful wifi (free).  They also had a flat screen tv.  Make sure you get a room that is in the middle of the floor because when you go out to view the mountains you can see the entire range from your balcony.  The idea of the hotel is to wake up at around 5:30 am and hope that the sky is devoid of clouds. We were very lucky that the clouds let us view the mountain range and took very nice pictures. Breakfast was the usual fare Asian, Nepali etc. It was clean and bottled water was provided. The water was purified but you never drink the tap water in Nepal.  Even the native Nepali said that it is not good to drink the tap water. When we drove back to Katmandu, we took a shorter route which was somewhat paved.  When I questioned why we took the other way up they said that is the way to go to the hotel. It was a terrible road and after the monsoon season even worse.

All the rooms face the mountains so you're in good shape.  There's a bit of walking from many rooms to the registration and dining areas, but everything is well tended.  The biggest issue would be difficulty for wheel chair dependent people, but I suspect they have rooms that can be reached by ramps.  Mine required several sets of short stairs.

Stayed here for one night. It’s a bit of a bumpy road getting there but so worth it!! Views are amazing, from the rooms, restaurant, skybar, swimming pool... basically the back of the hotel is mainly glass making the most of the magnificent outlook. Would have loved to have stayed another night but had already made plans. Thoroughly recommend this hotel. Staff were very friendly and helpful and food was good too. Fabulous! Fabulous!!

Mystic Mountains has lived upto it's name in each and every way. The design of the hotel, the warm ambiance and personal care taken by the staff all go to ensure that your stay is as comfortable as you would expect it to be. The contemporary interiors,the beautiful French windows, decks and sit-outs, all with the purpose of getting the best of the grand views of the valley and mountains,the thoughtful little additions keeping the client's need in mind,(like providing flip flops/chappals with every room),providing a delicious spread in the restaurant, and a wide variety of food and drink to choose from, all go to make this hotel number 1 in my choice of stay at Nagarkot.

it was an amazing stay which we will always remember. we are really missing our time there. the staff are really helpful. The restaurant manger the housekeeping manger and the front disk staff. we would love to come again

Visited Mystic Resort recently warm welcome from the reception. Had a few drinks & Snaks in Sky Lounge Bar. Pork Chiliy was the best. Staff are friendly helpful. Renuka Gurung the bartender behind the bar with the smile on face all the time. Dinner buffet was great with international food. Maneger Rohith Sharma visited the every tbl that make sure all the guests are happy wichs fabulous & great to see in nepal.,showing the standard of the Resort. Good luck for the team. Highly Recommend Resort Everyone who coming to nepal must visit the place. Thank You TeamSee you on next year...

I and my friend were looking for a quick getaway that was long overdue for us. It was a perfect day to go to Nagarkot as we had a teej holiday and got to celebrate in a grand way. Hotel Mystic Mountain was our first stay at Nagarkot and this hotel has the best that Nagarkot has to offer. First of all we were are absolute awe at the view it offers. The layer of hills that the hotel overlooks is absolutely majestic. The shape of the hotel building is another exceptional feature that we loved. All the photographs came wonderful and we can't help but keep flaunting our stay on our social media. We had an unforgetable luxury experience as the hoel rooms are very cozy and private balconies offered a view to the hills. The employees are very attentive and friendly. The swimming pool has an breathtaking vew to the hills and we couldnt help but keep taking photographs. We also used the jacuzzi which was a new experience for us. The room service is very quick, We loved the breakfast and dinner menu which has a great variety of food choices. Since my frriend forgot her swimming costume the souvenir shop at the hotel came handy. I also liked that the bathroom had hair dryer that helped to fix my hair. My friend also made a video for her youtube channel as it was totally worth it. We made amazing memories together. This is a great value for money.

We booked for a room with large private balcony, it was a nice room, Heavenly feeling mountain view.best place for  stress relief, it is a forest area, the best sunrise and Himalayan view. Breakfast was also very good, Very helpful and Friendly staffs, overall recommended for peace seekers and honeymooners.. Worth for the price!

We visited there with our big group 32 pax with 13 rooms reservation on 21 Sep 2019. Hotel property and view form the hotel is awesome . Staffs are nice and helpful . But I had very bad experience of slow check in service . We reached there by 3 Pm and we were checked in at the same time . But they gave us room almost 45 minutes late . I asked the check in guy about the problem . He said check out time is 12 noon and check in time at 2 Pm . But even at 3 Pm they dont have there room ready for us. Hope this type of service they should improve in future .

The name already gives you a lot information, Beautiful location, good foods, but few staffs don't seems to be professional, they get confused as they were new. regarding this minor me and family had really memorable stay at the hotel.  Highly recommended.

We visited this heavenly place twice through the same stay as one night was not enough.This hotel has mesmerizing scenery, nice gym, and an outdoor kids playing area. The staff was very helpful , and the food was amazing; ( HALAL food is available upon request) and we loved their vegetarian momos. What made my stay even more magnificent was the outdoor yoga class I took in the misty great weather.  I send my regards to the professional yoga instructor to whom i'm very thankful (sorry I can't  recall his kind name) .Namaste 🙏

From the moment we walked into the entrance we were energised with the views of the beautiful kathmandu valley below us and the clouds almost at the same level with us. It is such a great place for relaxation. When u get into the room and go to the balcony u leave all ur problems behind and admire the beauty of the place. It is great for families as well as it was one of  the very few places in Nepal where u can find children play area including trampolines seesaw and slides. I would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Nepal and for me I think its a must when visiting. We ended up staying another night after 6 days from the first night coz we all fell in love with the place.Staff were amazing as well especially the pool bartender/pool boy "krishna" he was very friendly giving us alot of advices and made us just feel like home. Thanks mystic mountain for making our holiday extra specil

Beautiful location with superb view. Very clean and loved the room with balcony. Food was lovely. Highly recommended. Excellent service. Thumbsup to the staff and management. Enjoyed our stay. Will visit again.

The couple of days we stayed at the hotel was nothing short of ultimate bliss and relaxation. No words can aptly describe the serenity of the mountain views from the massive balcony of our room, or the super delicious food (we gained at least 2 kilos), or the awesome service we received from staff who was always willing to go the extra mile. Only a couple really minor "issues" (really nit picking here) - unavailability of Ginger Ale despite being on the menu, and super high price for using  Sauna and Steam room.

This was the last destination on our trip to Nepal, and it was perfect. The perfect cherry on the sundae that was our trip. Where do I start!?!? Customer server 5*  View 5*  Food 5*  Hotel staff 5*  Room 5*. Honestly I don’t think I can complain about anything. Our room had the most beautiful balcony overlooking the mountains and Himalayan range which we got to witness! The whole hotel grounds has a majestic view and it was just great to see everything directly from your room. The front lady Moona was a dream and did everything in her power to make our stay so pleasant and she succeeded exceedingly. Breakfast was great, with a variety of food options! What I found so great(among other things) was the fact that they actually call you to remind you to come for breakfast Incase you overslept or something (which was the case a lot for us) and that saved us on missing out on breakfast!!! The restaurants had impeccable food and view, the waiters were attentive, nice and quite swift! Especially Som Raj who was a dear and quite communicative waiter, ask for him when you get there :)All in all, the staff; managers included made our stay great and totally worth it. Highly recommended on your trip to Nepal.

The hotel is really beautiful with an amazing view. The rooms were comfortable with a clean bathroom. Every room has a balcony facing the valley. The swimming pool is not very big but has an open view of the valley. It is a perfect place to relax and spend a weekend.

Most friendly and helpful Director & Sales of Marketing, Satish Shrestha, so lovely and great first impression of the hotel. Couldn't have been more sweet, giving me directions to a function I was attending along with a helpful map, ensuring parking in the car park and facilitating an early check in. If nothing else had gone right with hotel this gentleman ensured I would have left with a good impression. Fortunately everything about the hotel was exceptional, and I don't give praise lightly. It was clean, stylish, roomy with excellent service in both bar and resturant where we had our snacks, dinner & breakfast. Food was beyond good and great value for money and service in both places attentive and efficient. Room itself was well equipped and comfortable. The hotel's structure, a fabulous architected one with a great placement of a swimming pool & Jacuzi right infront of the ranges of hills and mountains. I could go on but suffice it to say I was very pleased with my stay, and although short and sweet this time, I hope to be back for a longer visit in the future.

Excellent service and friendly staffs made my stay in the hotel very enjoyable. The hotel provided me with a room that had a beautiful view of the mountains. The hotel is located in a peaceful location which is very good for anyone who is looking for a relaxing moment away from home. I would greatly recommend this hotel for anyone who visits Nepal.

My husband and I stayed here for two nights Saturday through Monday. If you are planning a visit and want some quiet and relaxation, I would suggest you skip a weekend stay. If you are a rambunctious family, you’ll fare just fine on a weekend. Had we only stayed on Saturday this would be a very different review. On our first day here the hotel was loud and overcrowded. We had lunch in the restaurant which was pricey but had good food. We then headed to the hot tub which had about 6 children under the age of 4 in it. So basically me, my husband and toddlers and kindergarteners all packed in. We stayed in the hot tub for about 5 mins. Headed to the pool but it was overflowing with people. Back to the room we went. The room was quite spacious and had a huge balcony with an amazing view of the valley. Our room was our refuge that day.By Sunday the crowd had checked out so we had a lovely rest of our stay. Breakfast buffet was yummy. The waitstaff was friendly. The hotel was quiet and mellow. Very conducive to sitting around outdoors, taking a long walk and enjoying the view and hospitality.

probably one of the Best Hotel in Nagarkot, rooms facing towards the majestic mountains were just great, had a yummy lunch gazing on mountains, rooms were very clean, bed were very comfortable, very friendly staff and good value for money

Excellent service of hotel/restaurant staff, impeccable attention to details, and guests preferences. Excellent tea selection with buffet, staff friendly and welcoming.Beautiful sunrise views fm room balcony, and sunset view fm restaurant was nice.

Hotel is very beautiful above the cloud.  We were very lucky to have a gorgeous Mountain View in the month of June. Hotel is well maintained to their highest level. I am very thankful to all the staff for making my stay wonderful. Highly recommended.

Hotel Mystic Mountain is situated atop Nagarkot hill. It took about 2hrs to get to the hotel from Kathmandu city.The journey there was rather bumpy as many roads weren’t made, and the view wasn’t too great until the last 1/2 hour or so of the journey; but once we got to the hotel, it didn’t take us long to realize the trip was worth every bump or pot hole that we encountered. The hotel was situated atop a hill, with outstanding views of Kathmandu valley below, whilst overlooking the vast Himalayan Mountains. Our first impression of the hotel was very good.The entrance was lovely, the staff at the reception were ever so welcoming and courteous. Welcome drinks were served whilst check-in formalities were completed. The architecture, the decor, the ambience of the entire hotel as a whole was beautiful; it was a mix of modern contemporary meets rustic elegance! The rooms were spacious,clean, and decorated perfectly. It appeared as if each room had a uniqueness to it. ( We booked 2 rooms, and they were both different while maintaining a quaint beauty to it ) Best of all, all rooms had a splendid view of the mountains!The bathroom, though small , was designed nicely. Complimentary toiletries were provided. There was a blind that covered a window between the bathroom and the room which could have been cleaner; but other than that, everything was clean and well maintained. We absolutely loved that we got to have a room with a spacious balcony, set up with a lawn. It was lovely relaxing and unwinding outside during the evening.We opted to try the dinner buffet the night we checked in. It was so nice that we went ahead with the breakfast and lunch buffet the next day! We were not disappointed!!! Food was delicious, and once again, the staff at the restaurant were extremely kind and pleasant; catering to our every need.There was a cafe with outdoor seating which again had a spectacular view for a backdrop! As the sunset; and the wind became chilly, heaters were brought out into the open. We were traveling with a baby, and the staff was so nice as to move one of the heaters closer to us ; which was very much appreciated. Its little things like this that make the property an outstanding example of excellent hospitality!!  The hotel is perfect for people, be it couples or families. It has ;-A small play area on the grounds where kids can have fun.-A badminton area.-A BEAUTIFUL and well maintained infinity pool overlooking the mountain range! -A bar/sky lounge.-Various spots around the hotel set up with tables, chairs or sofas, calling for people to unwind and relax.-Spa services ( The foot massage here was THE ONLY thing that was a bit disappointing. It would probably be a good idea for the masseuse to ask the client if they preferred a gentler approach or not )  -A gym for those who want to get in some exercise.-Great high speed internet The hotel also provides services such as hiking and cycling, although we didn’t avail them. All in all, out stay at this gem of a place was absolutely lovely! We stayed just a day, and left wishing we could’ve stayed a few more.The staff of the hotel deserve an extra shout out;and an award for their hospitality and wonderful demeanor. There was never a request they wouldn’t accommodate; and that too, always with a friendly smile! Highly recommend a visit to this fantastic oasis tucked away up in the hills. It may be a 4 star hotel, but easily racks up 5 stars for comfort and service. ( We have stayed at quite a few hotels in and around Kathmandu but nothing has quite compared to our stay here. The service is unparalleled, and for us, was far better than what we have experienced at some of the bigger names situated in the city and its outskirts )

Having visited about 70 countries and few hundreds of hotels, I can give one of the highest notes to Mystic Mountain Hotel in Nagarkot. Few important pieces of information:1/Shopping: the Hotel is located in the middle of nowhere with marvelous view. Local gift shop is not worth mentioning, offering few really pathetic items at abstract prices. Nevertheless, if you want to buy some beer or sweets, avoiding hefty minibar charges, you can climb like maybe 80m to the left from the main entrance, to some little shop for locals. Simple snack and beverages are available there, at very reasonable prices,2/Gym: I do not know, what the person reviewing below meant by “not maintained gym”, but from the perspective of a daily visitor to such places, I find it very clean, well maintained and acceptably equipped for such a remote place. They have non-Olympic bar with about 80kg of weights, few sets of barbells up to 15kg and few machines, which give you possibility to train all muscle groups of your body. Few cardio/aerobic devices as well. Motivating view on the Mountains included ;)3/Food: buffet Lunch (18$) and Dinner (25$) offer very good value for money. Breakfast is very good. Only advice I could give to the Management is equipping the Omelette station with two frying pans instead of one. This would make the workflow much better.

Grand sweeping vistas of the Himalayan range from your bed, balcony, restaurant, lobby, pool... Basically from anywhere in the hotel. It's designed for viewing sunrises and it delivers. The food at the restaurant is good. The stuff are also generally helpful. I think all of the rooms have a similar sunrise view, your only distinction would be the amenities within the room for choosing more expensive or cheaper rooms

The place, the view and the service were absolutely amazing.They have good food too. they even have place for kids to play. Only wish the pool was bigger. Definitely going back for the same experience.

I stayed around 6 days at Mystic Mountain Hotel. It was an amazing stay, the place is beautiful, nature and views are incredible, the room is comfortable with large terrace. The food is generally good and the staff were very nice which made the stay even more enjoyable. I would definately stay at this hotel again.

It is unbelievable how we manage to stay in such a wonderful hotel up in the Himalayas. Food in restaurant is excellent, Masala tea is wonderful. Amazing view from the restaurant and each of the room. We can see the sunrise energy morning in our own room from the balcony, such a tranquillity and blessing.

The hotel indeed deserves the name "Mystic Mountain". Located at the hilly Nagarkot area, this hotel allows the fresh breeze to welcome its guests. Great place to relax and unwind. It is best to travel in an SUV or MUV while driving up to the hotel and downhill.

Mystic mountain has an amazing view of the Himalayan range from their room as well as their restaurant's. The road to the hotel is pretty bad since the full road to nagarkot is completely broken. We spend the 2 days nestled in the hotel itself.  We got an upgrade to a bigger balcony room where you could just spend hours gazing at the mountains. The food is pretty amazing too,all cuisines Including Nepali,Italian,Asian. Their breakfast spread is pretty good with a different menu each day. Service is excellent,special call out to the managers in the restaurant. Their spa services are not bad either,with 2 small heated rooms and skilled masseuse . It. Was too.cold to use the pool, but it's a small cute pool facing the valley. Overall a great stay. You can't go for much sight seeing unless you decide to hike,since the tourist spots are min 30mins away by roads which aren't too comfortable

We celebrated our 1st year Anniversary in Mystic mountain. We had very relaxing, wonderful stay together. The best time we have had with so close and clear mountain view. We were very happy with the services provided to us.

One of the best hotel which we stayed during our trip to Nepal on March 2019.Clean and comfortable bed.Spacious rooms with balcony.Breakfast was awesome.The view of sunrise from the balcony was amazing.

It is undoubtedly one of the best hotels in Nagarkot if you are looking for a feast for the eyes. It is so well situated that any other hotel with better service would still pale in comparison. The service is decent and the staff is helpful.

Beautiful view of mountains. Outstanding customer service. Rooms were fine, upholstery on room furnitures need better cleaning. Would have given five stars if it had not been for terrible road to get there. Hoteliers probably should put pressure on the city officials to work on the road, given that Nagarkot is a hot spot for tourist.

This hotel is in an outstanding location facing the mountains well clear of Kathmandu smog.  The road to it is in very poor condition which makes for an interesting arrival. The design of the hotel is very modern and rather sophisticated but extremely attractive. The hotel and gardens were very clean and tidy and the maids did an excellent cleaning job in the rooms. In our room 306 the bathroom was connected to the bedroom with a clear window. There was a thin blind but this was see through particularly with a light on in the bathroom.  Maybe I am old fashioned but I like privacy when using the toilet. We had lunch on both days of our stay on one of the many hotel balconies.  On both occasions some of the food arrived completely cold. We accepted this the first day but sent it back the second day where it was replaced. This was a fault of the kitchen rather than the waiters. Breakfast and dinner were buffet style with a large selection of well presented and tasty food. All the staff were delightful and really went out of the way to help. They were enthusiastic for us to enjoy our stay.

This hotel is so sublimely situated, so beautifully designed and so well-run that I feel a bit mean saying anything even slightly negative about it.My only problem was with a very noise family in a nearby room, but I got a very sympathetic hearing from the staff about it and an offer to move rooms if that proved necessary which it didn't as the people left before I did.  I had to conclude though that, visually pleasing as the room and floor layout is, it's not conducive to peace and quiet within the rooms.  You can hear people walking in nearby corridors and stairways and the incidental noises of human activity seem amplified.  The breakfast buffet is generous and varied, and I could even get an Aussie chardonnay with my dinner, reasonably priced.  The local dishes on the menu were delicious and cheap and probably better for you than the western-style stuff some tourists seem to want.  A request for a jug of cold milk to make english-style tea in my room was promptly granted.  Wifi was excellent too.

My husband and I finally got the time to have our honeymoon and decided to visit Nepal, and for our wedding anniversary we decided to stay at Hotel Mystic Mountain and we could not be happier for that decision! The team at the hotel try to make the best for our honeymoon to the point that they provided us with the best room in the whole hotel! We had our own terrace (with an amazing view of the Himalayas), private sauna and jacuzzi and a little cake to celebrate. The view from the hotel is the best in all Nagarkot! They are in the highest point and there are moments when you feel that you are sleeping in the clouds! The restaurant has an spectacular view and really delicious! And all the waiters were very attentive and trying to serve you as fast as possible! If you have the opportunity to stay here, do not hesitate, you really won’t regret it.

Very classy hotel with an amazing view and unique decor. Serene oasis away from hectic Kathmandu. Staff friendly and attentive. Good view of valley below even when mountains are behind clouds. Food in restarant good.

Hotel Mystic Mountain is perfect weekend resort. Me and my family members had an amazing time. We were served yummy bbq snacks and lavish dinner. Rooms were spacious and comfortable offering great view of mountain and sunrise. Since it was cold we couldn't use pool.

Hotel is well located right infront of Himalaya. Road to the hotel is very interesting, full of jungle view and mountain view. Rooms are very spacious. We also received free cake for our anniversary.  We had an amazing time.

Had a shorttrip to Mystic to play snow and we had  an amazing time. Very good food and friendly staffs. This place is naturally blessed and   their service is beyond the expectation in such a region. Will be back again.

Incredible stay at Hotel Mystic Mountain. From the moment we arrived we felt welcomed, relaxed and completely spoiled by the staff here. The views from our balcony were so incredibly breathtaking. They provide blankets and chairs on your balcony so you can wake up and go watch the sunrise over the Himilayas. The food was delicious and we felt that the wait staff was so kind and provided great service. One morning I asked for diet coke (which they don't carry a lot of) and they didn't have any so my waiter arranged for someone to run down the road to get some (the last one available) and serve me. We also took a walk to the lookout which took us Canadians who aren't used to that many hills about an hour. We found that the view from the hotel and the walk to be better than the views from the lookout tower. We decided to get massages which were very affordable and professional. Great service. We didn't want to leave! Such a beautiful spot!Thank you to all the staff at Hotel Mystic Mountain!

Hotel is located about three KM from the small town of Nagarkot. we selected this hotel due to its excellent location. Our room have 214  have great view of mountains, sun rise and set both were great from room. Above all staff was excellent, true hospitality industry  professions!!!!! . Hotel bar traditional live music was excellent . Only lacking part was breakfast not much of a choice compare to level of the resort .

Beautiful hotel, beautiful views! The staff is amazing. It is a perfect retreat to watch the mountains and get great view of the Himalayas. I was alone in Nagarkot after two weeks in Kathmandu with friends. It was cloudy but every now and then, there was a gorgeous moment where the clouds separated and you could see the mountains clearly. The drive up is quite a bumpy road but honestly not too surprising. The food at the restaurant is alright but they call you when you don’t appear for breakfast which i really appreciated! The rooms are so beautiful and just so comfortable. The only thing I’d recommend is the hotel should provide the bigger size bottles complimentary each day instead of the little ones. With the altitude, it is important that we are super hydrated!

In October last year I had the pleasure of going to nagarkot and staying at the mystic mountain. What a property we got to stay!!!! It had some of the most breathtaking views that I've seen till date. It was so peaceful and calm while the staff were fabulous. Our check in and check out was handled by moona who was sweet and accommodating when we requested a room with a better view.It's the best place to stay in nagarkot while having some of the most expansive and beautiful views. Food could be improved but you can do so much in that setting.

New resort, clean, nice rooms, lot's of terraces and outdoor space. The staff is very accomodating, they don't know what good they can do for you. We felt very welcome. Perfect starting point for trekking and the views are nothing short of amazing.

Foods and rooms are awesome. I went with 25 subordinates (including clients from US) for an official visit. Our formal program and informal team building activities were successful. We did not have many issues but had lots of fun.

Got opportunity to spend few hours in this great property and was delighted with the experience.Service staffs seemed to be well trained and and anticipating your every need.Food served to us were well presented but needs improvement in terms of taste however menu was great with the offerings.

There is no doubt in my mind - we are coming back here. Also no doubt that one should stay here only if you are in Nagarkot. Many thanks to Mr. Apil and Mr. Sharma for a fantastic service and professionalism. Love the hotel staff who are always smiling and ready to serve. My wife had a very special birthday thanks to the above gentlemen for making it even more special.

Excellent views from each and all rooms, there is no compromise in room and bathrooms amenities. Excellent and unbelievable service, always ready to serve and help you in restaurant and bar and wonderful restaurant and bar with spectacular views, words are not enough to explain and no doubt would like to recommend all groups.

Lovely and aesthetically beautiful hotel. Good hospitality. Lovely rooms. Amazing view of the mountain and sunrise at the comfort of your room. Food choices are okeyish but it wasnt hot throughtout the service time which was a bit of a disappointment.

High above Nagarkot the hotel has panoramic mountain views and of the terraced valley below. The staff were very welcoming and attentive to our needs. Our room was very comfortable with heat/cold air con, instant hot water, modern western bathroom, good room wifi, good bed, perfect balcony overlooking views. The restaurant had a wide variety of meal choices. Live Nepalese music in bar and heard in restaurant was wonderful.

I was at this hotel for a wedding short time ago. We had a wonderful time. The location is outstanding. I was able to see wonderful ⛅ and snow tipped Himalayan mountains from the balcony.The service was very good; staff were courteous and very helpful.

On my several trips to Nepal from Delhi has visited many places being frequent traveler due to Meditation Trip. I had heard so much about this place and being Vajrayana Philosophy lover tranquility always call me. My recent trip to this place was full of experience being connected to Nature and its force. Not only that this place served amazing food with so much of variation that they take care of you well. On the Day of the arrival there new theme week Interactive Live counter was Teppayanki with so much of variations to die for Veg to Meat lover. Even though buffet was so lavish, I simply enjoyed their live counters that they offered. I will certainly will be back with such a good vibration in this place and friendly service

This hotel was simply heaven on the earth. From noisy Kathmandu you appear in Mystic Mountain and all your mind rests. The hotel is all equipped with everything you can wish. The pool with the view, the restaurant with the view, from balconies and room you can see the Himalayas too if it is not hidden in clouds. Especially early mornings are very magic. Rooms were super. Staff was very attentive and polite. I wish I can come back at this hotel. You can experience the real nirvana in this place.

A haven hidden up the hills! This place is a rare find. I only stayed there for 1 night but recommend it if you want a peaceful getaway from the polluted and crowded Ktm! Woke up at 6:30 to see the breathtaking sunrise from my balcony.. Amazing!!

This hotel is a good pit stop to make if you are travelling through Nagargot! The landscape is fantastic! The room was spacious, it had a A/C, warm water and it was clean. The only thing that could be better is the breakfast (which was OK but nothing special). The hotel should also be clear about that the pool is not heated.

I have got chance to visit this hotel with my family and we simply love the stay. Nice rooms with beautiful views. Very nice staffs with good hospitality and also they offer very nice food and breakfast. If got chance, we would love to visit again to this hotel.

It is a 3* hotel by western standards. Food a bit pricey and doesn't get taste buds excited, but it is as good as it gets in Nagarkot. Hotel looks fancy at first glance, but once you'll look closer, you can see mold, holes, and cracks. Breakfast is OK, various types of food (Asian, porridge, pastry) but only 2 types of fruits available. Omlette was good.

The hotel is at the top of the mountain, with good view and good service. The food at the restaurant is quite decent and hotel facilities are sufficient. The room is quite spacious and with a large balcony. We could see the sunrise and mountain from the room. Hot water at the bathroom is the best in Kathmandu. Highly recommended.

It is a tortuous journey by road from Kathmandu to this hotel which in a way added to the experience.The hotel is satisfactory but a little tired,in need of redecorating and refurbishmentOn the positive,the rooms,although not large have a balcony,and look onto the mountains of the Himalayas.The views at times when the clouds clear are unforgettable.We did a short trek to the Sunrise View Point,where there's a coffee shop.Information from the hotel to get there was no really clear and I'm sure we took the long way.As there is no real alternative locally,we ate in the restaurant in the hotel which was buffet,very ordinary and not good value.A drink in the bar which was empty was double the price for beer and wine in Kathmandu.I'm really glad we visited but without the views would never return

Lovely hotel with top service from all the staff but a special mention for one of the waiters called son whom made sure we were always well looked after.  Hotel has great views and is a good location to hike to the highest point in narakgot. We were given an upgrade which was a nice touch from the management.  Food from the al a carte menu was great for dinner and we enjoyed the breakfast in the mornings.

Spend a night in this resort. Very nice ambience and location. The view is spectacular. The rooms are very small (especially the bathroom) compared to its competitors but clean. Restaurant, pool and playground for children are the main attractions. We were lucky to see Himalayas in the morning. Nepal is beautiful.

We came here with group of friends. It was undeniably the best hotel in nagarkot. Being a new hotel we always wanted to check out the hotel services and we found out that hotel was beyond my imagination. Cool breeze, mountain,  clouds and hotel food and  services added special feeling to our visit. I would definitely come back for the night stay. Loved every bit of the hotel.

As soon as I walked in the staff was very welcoming and the view was so beautiful and magical, the room was very neat and clean and the view from balcony was heavenly, our buffet dinner was delicious with various cuisines, staff was very attentive, overall our stay was very pleasant, I highly recommend this place if you want peaceful atmosphere with breathtaking view.

My wife and I stayed just one evening in Room 405 which has a huge balcony facing a breath taking view of the diving valley and soaring mountains with clouds sometimes lingering between valleys and hills.  Unique hotel design, most professional staff, wide high quality breakfast and dinner buffet.  We wished we could have stayed longer.  The winding narrow damaged road is quite a contrast to a gem that is seemingly tucked secretly away on a side of a steep tall hill (about 2000 metres above sea level).

Went their with my friends to spend a chilled weekend and we had a great time. The rooms were clean and cozy, and the service pretty good. Also, I might add the nothing beats the view of the Himalaya from up there. Also very happy with the improvements they've made since the last time I visited back in march. The staff seems more friendly, food tatses way better and overall their's a really great vibe going on now . Kudos to the mystic team and thank you for a wonderful stay.

Few hours of ride from Ktm and away from the bustle of streets and town. the hotel serves a really nice food. Very modern with clean and comfortable rooms and bathrooms. A gratifying balcony depending on the room type which gives a striking view of the valley and the far away mountains on a clear day.The swimming pool was expectation VS reality because it was smaller than i imagined,  other spa, gym were fine for me. The rooms are air conditioned and relaxing.overall it was a great experience and would like to recommend others as well for a beautiful time with your friends, family ,partner .

A  place above the cloud, it has Excellent atmosphere, Rooms with Balcony from where we can see amazing mountain views of Delicious food and friendly ambience. A perfect spot for experiencing true Nepal. Must visit for everyone at least once. We had a wonderful stay. Rooms are spotless clean and fresh. Swimming pool is amazing too.

This hotel is just around a year old. I really liked the design of this place, has a resort vibe. It also sits at the top of the mountain overlooking Nagarkot. The rooms were spacious and clean. The reception and hotel as a whole is modern and minimalistic. The only shortcoming was that the swimming pool was too cold. The inclusive breakfast was good and also the dinner buffet which cost $1800 nrps was delicious. Staying here just for 1 night was definitely too short.

Hotel is located in mountains, 1.3 hours to drive from Kathmandu, a paradise relive from hectic city. View and location is really amazing that we can not consider as a merit of hotel.( Well, may be for choosing right place)  even the hotel is new, already lots of things to renovate. Marks, spots, broken glass... ectRooms are spacious  with  Balcony and comfy bed.No bathrobes.No Blankets- that you will need for sure, to sit outside during evening.Cleanness is average- Restaurant glass doors were blared form fingerprints, that must be there for weeks- as hotel is not that much occupied.Swimming pool is not heated, so almost no chance to get in- it's cold.Breakfast was Average, with a bit old croissants.A la carte is-ok, overpriced, because no other option to eat.  Internet- bad, but better not to communicate with outside world and just enjoy nature:)Overall: Great location, very relaxing but overpriced. Details such as: clean doors, blankets, bathrobes and good food- would make my stay better.

The hotel is situated in a quiter location in Nagarkot. The views of hills and the Himalayas beyond are stunning. The hotel has paid attention to make its architecture stand out from other similar standard hotels, which gives it an edge over the others. Its quite a photogenic property. The foods we were served just about met our expectations, although there are rooms for improvement. But when your breath has already been taken away by the location, food does not really matter I guess. The swimming pool however is very small for the size of the hotel. It could have done with a bigger and wider infinity kind of pool instead of surrounding a small pool with a huge landscaped garden. Who would pay attention to the manicured garden when the nature in its full glory is right in front of you?

Just a short distance from Khatmandu and away from the bustle of Nagarkot town is located this really nice property. A little difficult to access without a vehicle. The hotel is very modern with clean and comfortable  rooms and bathrooms.  A nice small or big balcony depending on the room type give a spectacular view of the valley and the far away mountains which includes Everest on a clear day.There is a nice swimming pool, a hot  jacuzzi, spa, gym, racket sports etc.There is a safe available in the room including a kettle and hair dryer. The rooms are air conditioned but we didn't feel the need for it.

Spent 2 nights at this hotel, and all i can say is it is breathtaking ! The hotel is located on a remote mountain top, and over looks amazing breathtaking views. I don't know how many hours we spent sitting on the room balcony and just zoning out. I went there with my 2 boys (9 & 6) and my wife, and it was the best decision i made in the trip. The food quality was great, and there was enough options to keep our appetites busy throughout our stay. This is a postcard hotel with a very appropriate name. As the hotel is far from the main town, you are limited to just using the hotel facilities, but i guess staying in a remote place like this you can expect that. The staff were all accommodating to all our requests and always dealt our requirements with a smile. The Spa was the only thing that maybe was not up to the mark, as i believe if that also overlooked a view, it would have been the toping on the cake. Instead it was very small, and felt cramped.   I would definitely be recommending this place to anyone traveling to nepal, who wants to get away from the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu.  BTW normally when i book a hotel looking at online photos, it is most likely not going to be close to what you see on the photos. But this was one hotel that gives more than what you see on the photos.

An hour and half drive from Kathmandu, mystic is quietly nestled in between green lush landscape. The rooms facing the mountain have fantastic views, on cloudy mornings it’s just as if u are in the clouds. The restaurant offers great menu, a little pricey than the restaurants in Kathmandu. But I was happy to pay for the view and serenity. The jacuzzi is small and compact. Could get crowded if kids enter, we had to deal with some noisy kids since the pool was not working. The pool has an infinity touch, but we could not enjoy as it was under maintenance. We booked ourselves at the spa, but the massage was just average. The ladies are not well trained. In all, we had a great stay and definitely recommending it to everyone planning a trip to Nepal.

We really enjoyed our stay here. After a long journey trecking in the jungle we needed somewhere relaxing to spend our last few days in Nepal and this was perfect. It is about an hour and a half drive from Kathmandu airport but worth the trip. Situated in the mountains this hotel is real luxury. We were upgraded on arrival which is always appreciated. The bed was the most comfortable bed I stayed in during my trip to Nepal. After a great nights sleep we spent the next day in the Spa which is very average but the massage and facial were nice. I would strongly recommend that management spend a bit of money developing the spa area though. Luckily i played music off my phone during my time there as other wise it would have been deadly silent which isn't ideal when there is a lot of noise outside and not very relaxing. The restaurant and pool area are great! even though the pool is absolutely freezing i still dived in so i could get a great picture for Instagram! unfortunately the weather this time of year means you cant see much of a view however it did clear for a short period of time so we could see the mountains and valleys below us. A lovely and clearly very popular hotel.

We were here for a short stay and these are the highlights :- beautiful view from almost every room- courteous and helpful staff- clean rooms with enough toiletries provided- Has spa, souvenir room, swimming pool, kids play area, trampoline- offers bike riding on rent- hotel is near to different hiking tracks One of the best hotels in nepal and anyone who loves mountains, this is a place to be.The road trip to this hotel is a bit bumpy so people with back issues is not recommended to take. The ride takes 1 hour and 30 mins from Kathmandu and is situated in on a height of 1800+ m above the sea level.

The hotel location and ambiance is breathtaking. The staffs are warm and very hospitable. We arrived at around 12 midnight but they made sure that we got our welcome drinks and they made dinner for us. All staffs have greeted us every time we pass by but one staff, Moona, stood out from the rest. Keep up the good work.

I went for a holiday vacation with my cousin to celebrate my birthday relaxing in Nagarkot. From the time that we checked in till we checked out, the staffs have shown us courtesy and superb service especially Moona Waiba. The whole experience was memorable. Keep up the good work!

I think this property is one of the best in Nagarkot,but i find the service and food not very good.  I hope the hotel Management would focus more on the service and the taste of the food. Rather than that, i think this hotel is very good.

It was nice environment but services are expensive than rest of Nepal. Resturent staffs was amazing but rest don't know english well to communicate with foreign clients.Swimming rules should be inuded with booking procedure & all staffs should be litterate with their own rules. They shouldn't discuss anything loudly about one guest's in front of other guests which they do.Overall it was good stay by architectural structures.

The place was just outstanding it was really something that I did not expect but was just stunning when I saw the view out of the balcony and from the hotel. The front desk person Moona was very nice to help me and making the stay even better by ensuring that I have the morning breakfast all packed in box ahead of time. I would surely recommend everyone to visit that hotel for a relaxing time.

The location alone would have been enough for me to rate this hotel highly . However the rooms were very good too. The balconies of some of the rooms are exceptionally large , more like terraces . The food was seven and the service friendly . However the star of the show is being able wake up to the views of the valley below and the snow capped peaks in the distance . We were there in July so it was pretty cloudy but the view was still stunning .

What an remarkable location!  The view is absolutely excellent!  Even the way the hotel is designed, remarkable!  Couldn't have found a better location for watching the sunrise for this hotel!And, we were also extremely pleased of the service!  The staff were very professional, and well behaved!  Food was also excellent.  The rooms were very clean, in spite of being set amidst a mountain jungle.  Overall, we couldn't find much fault to this resort!  We hope all other resorts would follow their professionalism!

Out of this world place. Hotel is modern, nicely decorated with every little corner optimised. Huge terraces and lovely Japanese Zen gardens everywhere. Food is great. Breakfast has a wide spread. Wish we could stay there longer.

A new, nicely built hotel in the perfect location, especially for those lucky enough to see the Himalayas (at 5am in the morning!). However the pool is simply not big enough for the hotel capacity which is a shame... especially as the staff and views are absolutely amazing!

It is probably the best hotel in Nagarkot that you can find. It is relatively new. More or less everything was very good. Staff are extremely friendly and helpful. Views from the hotel are amazing and you can see Himalayas. Rooms are spacious with massive balconies. There are few things that can be improved though:- More options in the buffets for westerns- Cleaning service of rooms- Recreation area needs towels, waterOn the other hand we truly enjoyed our stay in the hotel.

The design of the hotel and the bedrooms were amazing.  The staff were super helpful, polite and friendly. Excellent rooms and excellent facilities. Foods were excellent. Front desk service was excellent with good recommendations, useful information and check-in and check-out were flawless. Would highly recommend and would like to go again and stay with the family at least for two nights.

Location is beautiful, they really did a good job in building the hotel on such a lovely location BUT - Cleanness of rooms can be much better. There were still insects in the room - Pool is not ready to swim in which was a pity as the pool is really lovely - A lot of noise during the night. Our room was next to the elevator and every time somebody is using the elevator, you could hear it. Please ask another room when you have room 412 because you wont find any peace!!! When I mentioned this at the reception they didn't care and didn't even apologized. Restaurant/ Food is Ok but needed to wait for over 30min for our egss because it was too busy. So it could be better in words of organisation.

We spent the day at Hotel Mystic Mountain for an incredibly relaxing escape from the hustle and bustle of Kathmandu!We visited on a Saturday and they have a deal whereby you pay 3,000 rupees per person for access to the swimming pool and facilities and also a 3 hour bbq from 12-3 with a complimentary house beverage. The food was delicious and we had a great selection of meats from the bbq which were cooked with Nepalese spices. They also had a Mongolian noodle section which were all made fresh and brought to you. The highlight of the hotel is the infinity swimming pool which over looks the mountains and padi fields and on a clear day you can see Mt Everest. We visited in June which is monsoon season but it only rained for 5 minutes during our stay but because of the weather it felt like we were up in the clouds.We hired a driver to take us from the Kathmandu Guest House in Thamel to drive us to Nargarkot and up to the hotel. We paid our driver 6,000 rupees and he waited for us before driving us back to Thamel. The drive was approximately 1hour 45 each way on mountainous terrain but it was worth every second. I would absolutely love to return to this hotel for a few nights to fully unwind and relax but would highly recommend a day trip here if you don’t have the time to stay.

The USP of this property is its location. Situated at the top of a hill, it’s not uncommon for the hotel to be entirely engulfed by clouds creating a serene environment. Staff was really courteous too.Food can do with a lot of improvement though, especially the non vegetarian dishes.

We checked into the hotel on a Saturday which was probably the busiest day for the hotel. The food taste was nothing to be happy about, neither the a-la-carte nor the buffet spread. Especially the dinner was pathetic. We had 4 rooms out of which the bathrooms in two of them 303 and 304 were stinking really bad and even after repeated complaints wasn't sorted. Room no. 301 and 302 have better views.

Our stay here was by far one of the best we’ve had in so many places we’ve travelled to. Hotel is located around 42km away from TIA airport. The ride there was the most bumpiest ride we’ve ever had as the  path was totally ruined. But once we got to the hotel it was HEAVEN. Amazed how the owner had imagined putting such luxury in the mountains so high!! Everything was just so perfect; the architecture to exterior decor and interior!! Nothing I could criticize. We arrived at the hotel and was welcomed by the owner we believed and with drinks overlooking the breath taking view of the terraces and the mountains.Our room was too beautiful that I even forgot to take a picture of it!! One thing I can rate 100% on was the food we ordered during our stay.We had in room dining, food at the bar, and on our last eve we tried their restaurant. trust me WE LOVED EVERYTHING.  It was recommended by my Nepal colleagues  in Dubai to try a dish called Mo mo, and boy I ordered 2 the same day!! I had a chicken steamed one, and at night the fried veg, all soooo yummy! On our last evening we saved our stomach for the buffet they offered but since we weren’t so fond of the menu we had ala carte instead.We ordered the duck and grilled pork. HIGHLY recommended!!!!!It was quite funny tho in end when we ordered the sizzling brownie dessert on the menu. Literally came to us with a brownie sat on a sizzling plate which obviously burnt the cake and was quite disgusting. Staff said that it was new on the menu which explained it all :D But they managed to change it to their delicious brownie with vanilla ice cream which was as well very gooood. They chef was told to be from Nepal and we were sooo shocked what a perfection he was. As we could quote, the beauty, friendliness of staff, and food over powered the service we got in between, that’s why we still gave it a 5 star rating. We had a slight bump when I almost drank the complimentary water in the room that was somehow a bit sealed and had been drunken from. We called the reception to explained to asked for more water to be delivered but 2 hours later even waking up from a nap no one had come, so I had to call again.. 2nd was after ordering room service later that day, we had placed the food outside with the foil so that bugs wouldn’t attack it. But it stayed they there until the next day.. someone had even opened it and checked and left the foil lifted for flies to get inside the room. The thing was a lady came to us in the eve to deliver some fruits and did not bother to collect the food/nor ask the FNB staff. :/We and my partner are very particular in service as we were one ourselves. These tiny details actually could have been prevented that kind of put the the hotel down in a way. OTHER than that our stay was indeed so pleasant that we highly recommend it to everyone! ****MUST do in Nargakot is to book their paragliding for only 80USD per pax :)) Thank you Mystic Mountain for the memorable stay ESPECIALLY to everyone from the restaurant and the rest of F&B Department.

I with my spouse stayed in this resort 19th to 22nd May 2018. Good restaurant with testy breakfast.  Well maintained property and helpful staffs. Rooms above 3rd floors are good for village scene with mystical terrain.

This is a hotel with a great view. We were lucky to have a clear sky and see the snowy mountains. The room was great, a good bed and a hot shower. We had a big balcony, so we could enjoy the view also in private. The breakfast was good, a lot of choice. Also the spa was really relaxing. The pool was very welcome on the hot days we stayed.

Yes this is vary good hotel -a big property and well maintained -almost rooms are good and mountain view -especially the suite room -room no. 601-603 very nice -having big balcony There are children and adult swimming pool. Good food This is a new property And there are also many good hotels -club Himalaya -country villa and many

We stayed here as a family for 1 night and liked the experience here. The view in the mornings were very good even though it got cloudy later. The food restaurant was quite overpriced when compared to the portion size.

I and my team had the pleasure of staying at Hotel Mystic Mountain for 4 weeks while working in the area.  A fantastic location, the ideal place to relax and enjoy the amazing views. The staff at the hotel made our stay extremely enjoyable, nothing was to much trouble and everything that we wanted was catered for. Moona the receptionist was super helpful, she even arrange for a birthday cake to be delivered to one of my team on his birthday, thank you Moona. Amazing stay, thank you to all the staff at Mystic mountain.

The hotel is located in such a wonderful place that one can actually be inspired to be a "Mystic". When I was there, I could simply experience a heavenly feeling. Fresh air, greenery and mountains along with gym, swimming pool and Jacuzzi made my stay ravishing.

Stayed in d hotel with family in April on a vacation with family. Though the approach road is very tiresome, once u r in d property , u forget all d hardship u go thro to reach it.  Beautiful location   The scene in d morning is awesome   We felt as if we r staying in d clouds  though d place is upmarket, few things need to be sorted out.  Like very limited option for vegetarians like us.  The prices are high as compared to d services provided. Spa need to have a male trained masseur n a steam room.  Room service need to be brushed upon.  Overall a nice experience with few positives n negatives   Pool was also not functional when we visited d property

After an exhausting 2 hours bus trip from Kathmandu on a chaotic road, after having passed so many low-levels homestays and hotels, reaching Mystic Mountain is just incredible.The hotel is very nice, facing the mountains (if you are lucky enough to see them), very comfortable, with a very nice pool (although I didn't dare to taste the water).Great rooms as well.A great place to stay if you want to enjoy sunset & sunrise over Himalayas

Really enjoyed our visit to Mystic Mountain resort. The drive was rather bumpy but once we arrived we were transported by the tranquility of the resort. The staff are really lovely, the food is actually very good (and artistically presented...try the momos), and the views are, well... just stunning. Make sure you wake up for sunrise, it's one of the best I've ever experienced. We took a walk outside the resort and stumbled upon a small, humble family impacted by the recent Earthquake. They had a few animals and were making the best of a bad situation. And they were so typically hospitable, asking us to stay for a meal when they obviously had so little.We were there in December and couldn't make use of the beautiful pool but can imagine it'd be a pretty special swim during the warmer months. Well done Msytic Mountain- the thoughtful attention to small details, and the nice infusion of Nepali elements into the hotel decor are really well done. I look forward to visiting again.

While the trip from Kathmandu is 90 mins of bone-breaking, juddering, dust-laden chaos, non-Buddhists would say its the destination that matters rather than the journey. Getting there is everything. The hotel is top-notch in design and delivery. Amazing chefs, crazy views (even when hazy and cloudy), highly attentive staff from top to bottom. Slightly pricey, but this is definitely a place to stay for a long weekend to just chill. I was really impressed at the attention-to-detail of the construction work and the high end decor. An unqualified positive review!

We had a great stay at Kantipur House! The building itself is really, really beautiful & chic. It is adapted to old nepali Houses and gives you the opportunity to live in a traditional way. Beneath that the garden is an oasis of calm in the dusty, crowded Kathmandu. We really support the principle of sustainability the hotel lives (no plastic, water saving, etc.) and enjoyed the delicious bio food. The staff was absolutely pleasant and suave. When I was ill because of eating street food I received a great, caring special treatment with home remedies & medicine. Furthermore we enjoyed the yoga classes in the morning that are a costless service. Thank you very much Kantipur House & staff for everything!

I stayed here for three night to rest and relax after trekking. I really liked the peaceful atmosphere. The hotel ist outside of Nagarkot in a very quiet place. I really liked the vegetarian food there.

Way of traveling to hotel was exciting (the view) but the road was horrible. However, reaching destination we were so amazed that forgot everything and enjoyed the view for a longer period of time just fulfilled our travel to Nepal. Amenities & Service level is world class; never felt something else could be require more. The view from the room/hotel is a eye-feast ....nothing can be comparable than. If u want to stay calm & quiet for few days mystic mountain hotel is the place for u. Best wishes to all & would love to visit again.

We had organized an International Level Meeting at the Hotel. People who came to attend were happily surprised at the sight of the Hotel after such a long trip from Kathmandu. It was wonderful and the plus was the enchanting Hotel, the beautiful scenario and of course the ever ready to help staff.We did not just have a meeting in the Meeting hall, but made use of the surrounding area, went for jungle walk, cycling, which helped the participants bond better. The most exciting part, was during our stay for a week, the Food, was always different but very tasty. The Chef would even take requests and make us food that we would request him to make. So, all in all, a blissful experience and a truly a wonderful get away from the everyday hustle bustle of life.

I wanted to see the Himalaya mountains especially Mount Everest.  The view would have been phenomenal but it was misty at MysticMountain on my arrival.  The morning sunrise and view of the Himalaya mountains was awesome.  The new hotel has many amenities and food is good.  Staff is eager to please.  Beautiful infinity pool available but too cold for me to use.  My one night stay was worth the money!

Newest hotel near Nagarkot. Contemporary building is placed by terraces on slope of mountain. All rooms has a panoramic view on valley and mountains of Himalaya. Don`t forget to wake up at 5-45 am, don`t miss the opportunity to see beautiful sunrise! The view is unforgettable! It is cold at the evening at November, but air conditioning make room warm. Interiors is good, quality of hotel is higher, that middle level of Nepal 4-5 star hotels. When we was there, swimming pool and elevator didn`t function, but now, I suppose, everything should work. Buffet for dinner, not bad but not very good, 30 $ per person, plus taxes, otherwise you can book from menu. Excellent place to see sunrise at mountains!

The entire trip was excellent and the service, the rooms, the food and the staff were amazing. Loved every bit of the entire stay. The view from the hotel is exceptional and would surely suggest a stay here at Mystic Mountain,

Nestled amidst the dense greenery of Nagarkot, Hotel Mystic Mountain just like its name has the tranquil surrounding and peaceful ambient. The hotel situated on top of quaint villages and terraced ﬁelds, rising above the misty clouds that surround the hills round.Overlooking the valley beyond, Mystic Mountain has the perfect mixture of modern luxury and healing nature. Guests will be able to enjoy best of amenities and services on the nature's lap. The Hotel gives the perfect blend of luxurious service to be pampered with also to get closer to the nature through nature walks, hiking and other adventurous activities.

We staying here for 4 days after trekking. It was very peaceful and relaxing. If you want to go somewhere to chill this is the place. Service was great. Food was delicious. Best hot chocolate I have ever tasted. Room service available. We were lucky enough to have the most amazing view of the snow peaked Himalayas (due to good weather) which is not always the case. The drive to & from this resort is a little rough, so make sure you have a good driver with a decent care. 4WD would be much more comfortable but not necessary - the roads are shocking.

To begin with, the room is very neat & clean, spacious, well-designed & comfortable. All the rooms have a mountain facing balcony and the view is just stunning. We could enjoy the sunrise from our balcony.Secondly, the restaurant is excellent as well, both in terms of food & service. And also it comes with the mountain view. Travellers should note that, it is difficult to go out of the hotel for food, so it's very important to have a good restaurant in this hotel, and they won't disappoint you. It's a bit pricey, but worth every penny. Thirdly, the view! The hotel offers a breathtaking view of Himalayas from every corner of this place. You can gaze into those mountains and yet won't get enough of it.Last but not the least, the hotel staffs and the manager, very friendly, helpful and accommodating to every need. They provided complimentary cake & room decoration for our second anniversary.We just loved everything about this hotel. Cheers!

I stayed there for one night, checked in on the 14th of Jan and left the morning after. I wish stayed there longer, i really didnt want to leave but i had to catch my flight back the day after. I hope to come back very soon.

Mystic Mountain is an amazing Hotel. My room had a balcony over-looking the Himalayas, this Hotel is Nicely located on top of the mountain.The hotel facilities were great and food was amazing. The staff on duty were very friendly and are professional. I recommend hotel Mystic Mountain to everyone travelling to Kathmandu.

Went there with family for new year and had a great time. Thought both dinner and breakfast buffets were good, in fact was bit surprised. It was unexpected given the past experiences with other hotels in Nagarkot. Rooms were good and modern, I think kids enjoyed it more.

Love the hotel and the staffs are friendly. Pretty new. The rooms with balcony have a fantastic view of the mountains and you can view the sunrises. Nice hotel restaurant with a very good view and the food served is fairly good.Will come up here again once the road up has improved.

No expenses were spared to create this hotel right along the slopes of Nagarkot. Every furnishing and corner were exceptionally welcoming and exquisite! The swimming pool overlook the picturesque mountain and was so tempting to jump in even in the winter cold temperatures.We had a craving for chapati and the friendly staff, to our surprise, brought us some during our dinner!Well Done!

Great hotel with incredible view to the Himalaya’s mountains, great service, great food, nice to be away of the crowd and have some relax!!!! You can have yoga classes, spa services, jacuzzi, pool, tennis and a nice bar!

Made the right decision of going here based on suggestion from a friend in Kathmandu. Around 2.5 hours drive (depending on traffic) from Kathmandu, and a must visit for nature lovers. This hotel is best located in Nagarkot with an amazing view of Himalayas range coupled with a superb sunrise (if you are lucky) experience. Food is nice, staff well mannered and it also offers indoor and outdoor exertion like table tennis, cycling etc. I stayed there overnight and throughly enjoyed it !

This was such a beautiful place - and a great way to spend our last night here in Nepal. I really would have liked a week here - so peaceful and such beauty.The downside - the awful roads to get there!! Be prepared for lots of bumps and holes in the road - it’s pretty taxing on the body. So worth it when you get there - the scenery is breathtaking.The hotel staff are lovely - also the food. Nothing to complain about, we really enjoyed this hotel -  we had a room with a huge balcony. Would love to spend more time here.. The peace is to die for.

Hotel is Amazing with many activities like jacuzzi, ping pong, tennis, cycling and hiking. I could see beautiful mountains from my private balcony. Hotel is best located with peaceful ambiance. Staffs were super friendly and professional. I recommend hotel to everyone.

My guide booked this hotel as an alternative to Club Himalaya that they usually used.  He had not used the hotel before, but wanted me to check it out as it is much newer.  I was happy to try it out as long as the view was good, and on his first glance, he thought the view as as good, or better. The hotel is a beautiful place- very alpine with many sharp angled roofs.  The entrance was very classy with a lobby with a wall of windows and an amazing distracting view.  The main part of the hotel with restaurant, cafe, lobby, and lower gym and pool, and some rooms, are connected with an elevator which was nice.  There is an another building attached by a roofed walkway and it is in this building that I stayed. The room was very new, large, and luxurious looking.  The bathroom was spacious, tiled, with granite. I loved the window seat couch where I could admire the view, and there was also a large balcony.  My room was on the edge of the walkway between buildings, so in the evenings there was a lot of noise from the guests, but while sleeping, the place was peaceful.  The staff were plenty, smiley, and friendly.  The view is really so spectacular, that I spent the entire day just looking out at it.  The cafe being my favorite spot for complete viewing.  The front desk has a mountain map- or you can google it- and yes, there is the tip top of Everest there!Only 2 complaints- I had the heater running non-stop since my arrival and it could not keep up with the cold.  I asked the front desk for a portable heater and someone came and changed the controls on the heater and it was warmer- though I preferred to wear a coat while in the room and slept with a jacket on.  I think it's simply that the room is so large, ceilings so tall, and this room was surrounded on 3 sides by open air, so it was just difficult to heat with one wall heater. The other big one was the cost of dinner.  3000 rupees ($30 USD) for a buffet dinner.  I asked if there was an a la carte menu, and the answer was no.  The cafe was closed for a special event- I'm not sure if that is an alternative in the evening.  I'm not a big fan of buffet, and I certainly was not hungry enough to get my money's worth, and the food was good- but not outstanding. I understand that the other hotels in town are also expensive, but I am not sure if this much.  As a comparison, at the hotel I also paid 600 rupees for an Everest beer- which was twice the size that I could drink, and I think 300 rupees for a cappuccino.  I hope my money went to a good place.

A perfect escape from hustle and bustle of ktm city... Beautiful location ...totally in love with the place. The view of mountains from room was mesmerizing.  The stay was memorable. Very peaceful. A must stay while at Nagarkot. ❤️❤️❤️

Best place to relax and enjoy with friends..The place where you can forget all your problems and enjoy every moments...The place, interiors, staffs all were friendly and were cooperative...Highly recommended..

This place is gem hidden in the upper reaches of Nagarkot. it is on the same road that leads to the view tower. You can see the entire view of the Himalayan mountain range from his hotel. Be sure to ask the hotel for a mountain profile. We stayed in room 401, and it had one of the best views possible. To appreciate the entire spectacle of the sunrise, be sure to wake up at least half an hour before sunrise. one by one the peaks light up and it is simply gorgeous. The hotel has an outdoor hot water Jacuzzi, which is pretty nice especially if you can get in it when the sun is nice and bright on you. It takes about 2 hours to heat up the water in December before you can get it.The sky lounge is nice and cosy. The restaurant offers some great views.If you can, spare atleast a night and stay at this place. :)

We stayed in this lovely hotel for one night recently. The hotel is set in a truly beautiful setting, in a very elevated hilltop location. The hotel is relatively new, and has some wonderful aspects about it, but... there are elements that frankly feel like it hasn’t quite ‘grown into’ its aspirations yet. The reception staff were excellent, as were the cleaning staff. But bar and restaurant staff were a mixture of good and bad though. At first glance the fixtures and fittings are stylish and stunning, however the more you look in detail, the more you see things are just not quite ‘finished’ yet. Small silly things, such as lose taps, missing mastic/trims here and there, dirty windows, that sort of thing. And more staff training is required for some of the staff - it felt a bit like the hotel opened for the first time yesterday, with some staff not really totally knowing their job yet. Frustrating really as they are all minor things that would be easy to fix and maintain, to make this a really wonderful hotel. In many ways the location overcomes the small niggles. But the owners have clearly spent a fortune developing this hotel and designing it in such a stylish way, it does seem such a shame to be let down at the final hurdle, with such silly minor things.
