Despite the niggles we have scored the hotel as four stars, because it really is a superb location and a really stylish, clean, welcoming hotel. But a shame because it really ought to be easily a five star rating :)

We checked in after a long drive. From the start we had a no to almost everything. The food was good but they did not treat our guide well. He was unable to join us for Dinner as per instructions given by Management. Did not like the discrimination . Location was good.

Nice hotel to spend a night with. Foods are very good though the cost seems bit higher than expected as compared with other hotels in Nagarkot. Secondly, the pool is bit smaller against number of rooms. It was so crowded when we visited. Besides two small issues, it was worth visiting place.

Having come from the bustling city of Kathmandu arriving at Hotel Mystic Mountain was like stepping into a Spa. My husband and I took a taxi from Kathmandu to Changu-Narayan and hiked from the temple up to Hotel Mystic Mountain. After hours of walking through the mountains we were relieved to find that the hotel was absolutely amazing. A lovely cabin-style hotel with wooden accents and huge glass windows giving you the perfect view of the Himalayan range was just the first thing that impressed us. Their staff were very helpful, friendly and accommodating. They greeted us with a nice cup of warm tea and upgraded our room from a standard to a deluxe room (without us asking for it!). The room was amazing - clean, fresh sheets, comfortable huge bed with decent pillows and a duvet that make you sleep in more than you should. The best part was the glass windows and balcony that allowed you to step out into the crisp morning air and take in the beauty of the Himalayan sunrise every morning. Absolutely breathtaking. If you ever do make it to Nagarkot, staying here is a must!

I really liked the location of the hotel, food was excellent, rooms are big and facing the mountains which makes the sunrise perfect from the room.But Staffs need to be more friendly specially at the lobby. The rest is best.Wish you all the best.

The hotel has a good view of mountains and if you are lucky(clear weather), you might get a glimpse of the Mt. Everest as well. The hotel itself is a bit away from the center of nagarkot so calm and peaceful environment is guaranteed. I live the hot jacuzzi they have facing the mountains :).  The service was good, check in and check out was smooth. The food could be better. So far this is the best Hotel in Nagarkot at the moment. I would definitely recommend this Hotel.

We had the great pleasure to stay 2 nights in this beautiful resort. First of all we would like to thank the hotel management for greeting us with an upgrade. It was greatly appreciated - But beyond that, the whole experience was highly enjoyable : very pro and friendly staff, nice buffet for the breakfast. Surely the hotel is not easy to reach, but it makes it even better ! In the room (312) the bed was super comfortable, and the view is breathtaking. We woke up every day at 5.00 to admire the fantastic sun rise on the Himalayan Mountains making the most of our private terrace. The room is delicately furnished with modern but stylish design in accordance with the natural environment. The infinite pool is a great addition (even though it might be a good option to transform it in a heated pool - suggestion :-) ) Between 2 intense trips in Kathmandu, I totally recommend this resort for relaxation and complete peace of mind. We hope to be back one day.

It was very special being above the clouds in middle of the jungle. Hotel was clean and neat. It looks very fresh and new. It probably should be the best hotel of Nagarkot with modern architecture and and jaw dropping view from private balcony and restaurant. Staffs were very friendly and helpful. Since it was very cold we couldn't use swimming pool but jacuzzi experience was pleasant. Amazing experience.

Amazing Hotel - there are no words to describe the sheer elegance of the hotel. It is absolutely beautiful and All the staff are very welcoming and friendly. Dhiraj the hotel Manager is very hands on with his role and accommodating. the view from hotel, pool and rooms are fantastic and the services in general are great - HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.

Its a paradise.  You feel blissed in everystep at Nagarkot Mystic Mountain.  View from my balcony was like paradise.  Mountains from room looks so big and they are right infront of you. Rooms are clean and luxurious. Many choices in buffet meal.  Food tastes really good.  Try momos they have best of it.

Beautiful location nice layout and awesome mix with climate.You feel like in heaven from early morning till dawn. Catchy clouds seems passing by you.Need to improve room hygiene smells washroom tunnel and better if we have outdoor shower tap after swimming. Heard a lot about this new resort at Nagarkot from friends circle. Was looking for a right time to visit  and always changed my mind cause of road condition, from what I heard about it. Gathered my courage last week to visit this place and hit the road bit late after kids school got over. By now, I really do not want to remember about my dark night driving experience to this place due to road condition being on the process of expansion, which changed my excitement into frustration and even started thinking, why Nagarkot? Why not other destination? But this did not remain for long, in fact, this self asked silent question turned into impression towards myself for making right choice to go to Nagarkot, once I reach at Mystic Mountain.  Night beauty of the resort was simply the best with beautiful architect being lighten up every single corner and interior was designed very carefully. My first impression was really wow, amazing, marvelous….Reception staffs were spot-on for quick check in with welcome drink offered on arrival and rooms were as good as any 5 star property, specious and equipped with safety box, mini bar and most important is every single room has its own balcony facing towards 360 degree of Himalayan range, what do any one expect beyond this.  Buffet dinner spread in the evening was good considering the fact of being resort, was amazed to see cheese selection. Morning breakfast spread was really good with live egg station, and I have not noticed this practice in other resorts. I personally suggest to add pan cake station if possible to add more value on it, after noticing good mix of children and teens  during breakfast.   Sky view bar is a nice and cozy place to enjoy your pre dinner drinks and u can continue after dinner as well. Live music during weekend, traditional duo with Sarangi and Tabala gives you perfect company for your drink. I cannot express early morning beauty from my balcony; sun was coming up slowly, throwing its beautiful rays to snow capped mountains which were smiling towards me and Nagarkot. Once the sun is fully up, u got to see the beauty of Himalaya and the valley in front of you.  I asked myself, is it real? If it is, why not every day and not from everywhere? I wish to start my day with this…but reality is different…underneath village walk was an amazing experience to see the complete different life style of the villagers. I love to see them all with better life style during my next visit. In terms of facilities within the resort, I have not experienced much except table tennis with my boys and my son enjoyed Jacuzzi…I love to be back soon to use pool n gym, both are overlooking to the Himalaya. Will rather wait till they operate Spa, as per the management, this will be done soon. Service was implacable starting from my check in, check out, dining experience and room stay, specially Mona at reception and Arjun at dining hall are the star in the resort. It’s a must place to visit and hats off to the person behind this dream project, you got it right, you created a gems on the hill, but you have to maintain it and keep it fresh all the time. If not, beauty of the resort will be slowly disappear among other new and old properties around it.

Best Hotel As Far As I know. Staffs are very friendly .. The best party was the sun rise and mountains. Rooms were prefect,service was good, food were lovely,and the front was the best. I will visit  this hotel again............

I would really like to give this place more stars but if I did, it would be based on the location and view rather than the hotel itself.... The pros - amazing view. Stunning.- The rooms - really can't fault them. Good views. Large. Nice bathrooms , large balcony, comfy beds. - The restaurant was OK. Not amazing but lots of choice and tasty. The down side - the reason I have given this place a mediocre rating is mainly the little things that could so easily be improved , that would make the experience of staying here much, much better. To say that the hotel only opened in July, some of the communal areas already look quite shabby - particularly the pool area and pool bar and the patio outside the coffee shop. We went to Nagarkot for the views - with all that glass, it'd be so much nicer to be able to see the views through it rather than focussing on the dimensions that have been penned onto the glass - I'm sure this could be wiped off. As could the bird poop! The hotel is still having work finished - if you are there in the day time and want peace and quiet, currently expect some noise from drilling/ hammering as rooms are completed. Finally, we found the staff to be a bit indifferent and not very friendly. It was Tihar, (festival) and so can imagine that the staff would prefer to be at home. Nevertheless , the staff seemed a little standoffish -  and we felt we didn't really have a pleasant welcome, apart from Moona (I hope I have got that right) who was lovely. It really has the potential to be somewhere really really special but needs some attention to detail addressing to achieve what it would appear it is trying to -i.e. be a top - end hotel and the best offering in Nagarkot.

There are 2 bars and got to enjoy local entertainers that night. Would go back when given the chance again.

We went to visit the city of Nagarkot and decided to eat at the hotel for its beautiful views, then it started to rain and at the same hotel we were provided with a private driver who would take us back to Kathmandu city very quickly, we will come back safe!

To be fair, the hotel is good for a Nepalese hotel, the location certainly offers a great view, unfortunately we had bad weather during our stay. Unfortunately, there is nothing you can do about that. The food on the menu is very good, and the service staff is very friendly and helpful. The gym is pretty dirty and the pool isn't that inviting in real life either.Now for the bitter end of our stay. (Hence 1 point deduction) After checking out, the manager said there was a problem with our room, the glass plate on the desk was damaged. On site I explained to him that it had already broken - and that's really true, which then led to a long, unpleasant discussion. The blind in the bathroom, the hairdryer holder and probably other things were damaged in the room (from the start, of course) - as is quite normal in Southeast Asia, even in 5-star hotels. So I didn't take any notice of it.Now it was about the glass plate, which wasn't damaged, I was supposed to pay something for it (certainly not much), which of course I didn't do. Hence my warning: check the room before moving in and report the damage to reception so that you don't fall into the trap.

I was here with a group for two nights stay at the right time of the year, got to see the amazing and breathtaking view of the himalayas. We also enjoed the buffet breakfast and dinner with varieties of dishes and live counters with options for vegeterians as well. Would like to thank the staffs for their wonderful service during our stay here, will come again soon.

Had a great stay at Pokhara Grande.  The only one 5 star hotel in Pokhara. Staff were very friendly,  pool side bar was great. Breakfast buffet, live omlette station, lunch and dinner ala carte options were grear.I highly recommend Pokhara Grande.

Its been several years I have been using the services of Pokhara Grande they have never failed to amaze me with their wonderful services, specially the smiles of reception ladies. This time the view of Himalayas took my breath. Will surely be back again soon. Thank you team!

last week, i was in pokhara grande for a wedding party. We all family had a really great time.The service staff were really good, no matter how busy they were, they did their work very nicely. Will come again for another functions.

I was here with my family for a vacation.Well I must say it is a really good hotel for family with kids because the property is big & the room is spacious.Everything was good but the food is bit disappointing, I didn’t felt the food was tasty & mouth watering. Besides food everything is good. The front office team is excellent, Ms. Shirish & Ms.Tenzin are perfect for the guest relations who are always ready to help their guest. Whenever we will come to Pokhara we will definitely visit again.

I was here for my conference,the programme went nice & it was successful.During my stay I felt all the facilities of the hotel was quite good & all the staffs of the hotel were always attentive.But however I felt the internet is bit poor & slow so management should do sth about it.overall it was a nice experience.

Excellent comfort and hospitality. Great service from a wonderful group of staff. Pool area is inviting, clean and well maintained. Check in was smooth and efficient. Consistently excellent. Would definitely book there again.

I was with my friends for a good vacation. The weather was not that good those days but in the morning as i opened the window the view of the mountain was awesome. So, for the mountain lovers & people who love natural beauty this hotel mountain view rooms would be a great place to stay. Besides the room, the staffs are also very nice. Would definitely visit next time.

Fabulous stayI was extremely happy with my stay. The team I met at the  reception were genuinely friendly and helpful, the food was fabulous, the service exceptional, the beds comfy and the facilities more than adequate.The decor and ambiance topped the evening off perfectly. A most comfortable stay!
Pokhara Grande is a real gem! Excellent in every way; service, rooms, restaurant & all.. Thank you Ms.Tenzing Yeshi, Guest Service Manager for her great hospitality👍.. Great weekend with my family🎉🎉

The hotel has an awesome history and is located very close to the airport. They've mainly two buildings - one old and the other new. It's better to choose the new one, as the old is really old. The standards, even in the new, are below what you'd expect from a 5* property in Kathmandu, but they're not bad. People are amazing and they're always ready to be of assistance and always with a smile in their face. Food is decent, but nothing extraordinary and you'd get bored, if you stay for long time. They need to look at adding some variety.

Amazing hotel the views from the room and the pool area.the room are nice and clean.warm showers and everything you need in a bathroom.the bed is unbelievably comfortable had a great night sleep.the food and b/f wear superb,the staff wear favorite part super friendly reception and sales staff.the restaurant manager and me Kaushal (Owiner of this hotel) wear also great,let us have b/f even though we was late one member of staff (can’t remember her name )helped get medicine from the hotel as I was felling ill.she was very lovely.fantastic hotel,highly recommended for couples and family.Ram

The Hotel is well located in Pokhara though not in the lake area. It’s well spread and there’s a lot of privacy as it has only ground and one floor. The foods also good at the 2 restaurants that serve the same menu. It has a spa and service is going. Though this Hotel is also old and some of it requires renovation.

Hotel Pokhara Grande is one of the best Luxury hotel in the Town. They are located within 10 minutes ride from lakeside. They offer best hospitality and what i love about this hotel is peaceful environment and big space. This place is best for organising events adn conference too since they have more than 5 well equipped seminar halls.

Stayed here for 2 nights. The rooms are very good being spacious with large beds and very comfortable.There are facilities for making hot drinks in the rooms and the bathrooms are good.The main restaurant is good although they appear to serve the cuisine of the largest number of current guests, on our 2 nights, one night Chinese and one night Indian. The food was good but we’d have preferred Nepalese.Breakfast was good with some good choices and some delicious Masala Chai.We had a room with a view of The Himalayas (just) above the trees.Good hotel.

Stayed here for 2 nights as part of an organised tour with Lumle holidays.A member of staff collected us from the airport, 5 minutes away so a perfect start for us, a lovely welcome with a drink and escort to the room explaining what facilities were available as we walked.Nice gardens, Outdoor pool and sunbeds to relax, well equipped gym area and outside bar.There is someone there to book trips should you wish, we booked a taxi through the hotel to take us to the Gorkha memorial museum and suspension bridge return and he was great for local knowledge and stories.The breakfast had so much choice and we had a nice meal there in the evening, All of the staff we encountered were friendly, helpful and a special thanks to the security staff member who took us to the roof for a fantastic view of the sunrise on 7th nov!Theres a small row of stalls to stock up on water/snacks opposite hotel too.

We booked a 5 day trek at the hotel and had a fabulous experience.  Bhuwan was our guide and he was excellent.  He looked after everything along the way and was very attentive to all of our needs along the way.  He knows his way around the mountains and had a great relations with the guest house staff along the way.  He provided us with lots of information and was very good company and was very respectful.  I have no hesitation in recommending him and the travel agency at the hotel.  They organized a great itinerary on very short notice and everything went perfectly.  It was well orchestrated with all transportation, accommodation and food.The hotel staff was fabulous as well.  They took great care to ensure our every expectations were fulfilled. The view suites provide wonderful views of the Himalayas.My wife and I were really happy with our trip to Pokhara and into the Himalayas.Our thanks to Bhuwan, our guide, the hotel management and staff and the wonderful people at the travel desk.  They all really went out of their way to make our experience a joy.Bruce and Monika Redekop - Vancovuer, Canada

Rooms, garden are excellent and so is the food. Amazing mountain view. All staff members are polite and will behaved. Specially front  desk (Shirish) always had smiles and helped us with every arrangement. Overall a lovely experience and lovely people.

Before and after trekking a stay at the Pokhara Grande is a relaxing and worthwhile experience. The staff are well spoken and very helpful. The breakfast is excellent and the rooms large and, well appointed and comfortable.

Great place to return to after some trekking!Lovely staff and rooms, and it was a real pleasure to come back to civilisation after the hills.Located near the airport and to local shops if souvenirs are needed.

Amazing Mountain View.Hotel staffs are very friendly and cooperative Lavish breakfast with live station is very fascinating Ideal for a vacation getaway, business trip.Highly recommended property in Pokhara.

Hotel Pokhara Grande is one of the famous hotel in Pokhara city. Vast area and atmosophere is very nice and hotel is kept clean and neat. Staff members are polite and well behaved. Rooms are big with all facilities and well maintained.

We arrived here as part of an organised tour. I find large hotels impersonal, but this place is the exceptional. The staff all remember you and provide an excellent personal service. The rooms and grounds are excellent, and so is the food. Breakfast is a huge choice and I particularly liked the dosa, masala omelette, and overnight soaked oats. Evening meals were also of the highest quality. My wife also had reflexology in the spa, and loved it. Special mention to the restaurant staff (Ambika, Sanjay, and trainee Tsering), front dest (Shirish) and the fantastic security doormen. If you are going to Pokhara, stay at the Grande.

The experience about staying in Pokhara is very good. The environment of the hotel is very peaceful and pleasant. The staff of Pokhara grand is very helpful and courteous.The service is fast and reliable. The best hotel experience i had experienced in Pokhara. Will be always be staying in Pokhara grande whenever been in Pokhara and recommend other to stay in Pokhara grande. Thank you Pokhara grande for great service

Stayed at the Pokhara Grande in October 2019 and had an amazing time. Room had a wonderful view of the mountains and the meal offerings both restaurant and room service were delicious. Conveniently located, the hotel also provided a good range of tours and day trips that made the whole experience memorable. Special mention to Shirish and Tenzin from the front desk who both always had ready smiles and helped us with every arrangement, even helping us order takeaways from outside the hotel (Hot and Spicy delivered an amazing Briyani and chicken wings right to the lobby) when we got tired of the food after a few days. Ashim, who brought us on several day trips also deserves a mention. Didn't manage to use the pool or spa during our stay but the hotel was immaculately kept. Overall a lovely experience and lovely people. Highly recommended.

I have stayed at this hotel several times and every time has been amazing!!! They have wonderful staffs be at the dining area or at the reception.. greets with great smiles all the time. Will be back with my family very soon and i would surely recommend this hotel to everyone looking for the best place to stay in Pokhara. Thumbs up Team Hotel Pokhara Grande.

Had the opportunity to stay at Hotel Pokhara Grande yet again and this time on business. Must say the experience was pleasant and the hotel had not lost it's charm. The team were welcoming and helpful as ever and definitely their warmth and friendly approach made my stay all the more wonderful. In terms of room amenities - everything that one could ask for was provided. Well stocked mini bar and clean, comfortable beds. No complaints at all. Infact a very special mention must be made of certain team members such as Bishnu, Laxmi and Nita (at poolside bar) who made us feel so much at home and comfortable. Yes we loved the poolside bar and we feel that area shuld be really developed for the benefit of both guests and the hotel as we woul dlove to sit and sip by it and the hotel would definitely garner more revenue!!

When we entered the hotel lobby, staffs greeted us with welcome drink!!had a very spacious lobby and  from our room,we could get a beautiful view of the mountains.Rooms were very spacious and our toddler son could run around and move freely!!Staffs were all very attentive and friendly.I would highly recommend this hotel and will surely visit again in future.

The hotel served what it work for, the complete hospitality. I had very good experience and memories thanks to everyone and especially the front office team. Keep up the good work. Hope to see everyone soon again. Cheers.

We loved this beautiful hotel with the mountain view. It has great food and the spa ladies are so very pleasant and attentive. I had reflexology and trekkers massage after our trek to the Australian base camp and was so worth it! Staff were always polite and very professional and the rooms were just perfect for us and we will come again as we definitely recommend it to anyone . Very much a 5 star hotel! Thank you everyone.

As everyone knows that Pokhara is the best and most beautiful and peace city of Nepal where Nepalese and every tourists had made this place a destination to be visited and me myself being a resident of Pokhara I have stayed and booked many hotels for different Purposes. And finally I found this hotel HOTEL POKHARA GRANDE so beautiful and the staffs were really respectful. The price of hotel was affordable and I enjoyed my 3 nights stay with very beautiful views of mountains... most beautiful part was that I had a good and best time spending my couple of hours in the swimming pool with drinks and music.OMG! really I would like to visit this hotel back soon with same expectations.. whole staffs were so friendly, helpful, happy and every services were so fast and good. Those 3 nights stay was so unforgettable. The treatment towards the clients was excellent.. I guess these are the whole things what you expect from every hotel where ever and whenever we decided to visit a new places... so i kindly recommend this hotel to everyone who are planning to visit Pokhara in future. You will find everything what you want... and I’m sure no one will regret by staying in this hotel! And yes, I will be back soon in my next vacation 😊. Thank you HOTEL POKHARA GRANDE

Pokhara grande has the best staffs of all hotels in pokhara, we love their food specially breakfast buffet. Its always nice being back to this place for a wonderful stay with great hospitality. Will be back again soon! Thank you team and keep up good work.

I'm fortunate enough to have stayed at the Hotel Pokhara Grande many times recently and I highly recommend it in all aspects: food, service, facilities, location, staff, internet and general attractiveness." Hospitality is Excellent!" You can quote me.

The overall experience in the hotel was great. The breakfast buffet in the morning gave a great head start for the day. Staff were friendly and the room service and atmosphere in the hotel was delicate. The views from the room was good, but we went there off-season, so the mountain views were not there. Would recommend you to go around October-December for mountain view from the hotel. Bit disappointed with the WiFi Speed since it took its time to download/ watch videos. But other than that everything’s 5*.

This hotel offers a great stay in Pokhara. A real 5 star with excellent views and is like a resort with a vast area and open space. They have restaurant that offers great food and if requested dish out specific food to cater your needs. Rooms are comfortable and the local is convenient too.

We had a lovely stay at the Pokhara Grande. I travel often for work and vacation and this is easily the most hospitable place I have ever stayed! The staff was attentive to our every need from shuttles to and from the airport or to town, to lovely cookies and chocolates in our room, to answering my questions on how to turn the lights off! The rooms were very nice, clean, and comfortable. Shirish is an absolute delight and she showed us our room and continued to check in with us throughout our stay. I can not recommend this place enough! Stay here if you are looking for the perfect retreat! The view from our room was fabulous!!! Thank you for making our time in Pokhara relaxing! We can’t wait to return!

Pokhara Grande is one of the finest hotels we have ever stayed in. The staff extends help. Need a car to Lakeside Central? The car arrived in minutes during this off-season week. The point: although it is the slow season in August, the staff worked hard and quickly. Ms. Shirish at the guest relation helped us feel acclimated the minute we arrived with advice about how to reach our room and even how to feel comfortable in this climate. Shirish also showed the city map, its various locations, how and when to arrive. When I pointed to a different town on the paper, Shirisha was kind-hearted about it. That goes to the heart of the hotel staff: they are patient, generous with their time, and big-hearted. If you are an American like us, Pokhara Grande is a vacation extraordinaire because of the people. If you are a famous person, you probably will not need a lot of security here in Pokhara and certainly not in Pokhara Grande.  Shirish was a true professional to help us navigate any problem, so please treat her well, everyone, including hotel management. The hotel restaurant offers a variety of delicious food to suite your palate. From Indian curries to honey on your pancakes at breakfast, Pokhara Grande restaurant is fine dining. Ambika, the manager, helps everyone coordinate what to bring and when. Sanjay treated us like family. Service is like a British castle dinner with about four people overseeing our arrangements. I will add again it was off season, but it shows that when a restaurant is not a full capacity, the staff that cares goes the extra steps. This restaurant team thoroughly covered our needs and anticipated in advance what we needed like when I needed more tea. The table was set with abundant silverware like a fancy wedding.  The spa director, Soma, introduced herself and her staff to indicate that at any time my wife and I could get a massage. We can plan on that next time as this time was too brief.When I saw Pokhara Grande hotel sign, I snapped three photos, the first three of my entire tour of Nepal. The place has character including the sign. The sign reminds me of the big Hollywood sign in Los Angeles. What the Pokhara Grande sign lacks in that size, it makes up for it burning an impervious red to the clouds and weather. When you enter the compound, the security guard opens the gate with a welcome, “Namaste”. How could anyone go wrong here? You have arrived.

Generally speaking the hotel is good, some concerns related to the accommodation, such as:The WiFi signal is weak (from the room) and the speed is slow. We have considered the BB basis, however the breakfast was not considering different cuisines ( very few options ). The last but not the least, AC is not installed in all areas within the facility( e.g. lobby & restaurant ). In general, the service was pretty good, and it’s  clean and comfortable in addition to the good location.

Me and my wife stayed here during our vacation on 2017.Service was really nice and the staffs are really friendly .Best place to stay and spend your holiday.Our guide recommend this place to stay and it was and nice experience to stay here. Thankyou !

We had a wonderful time a PGH.  The staff are wonderful, they can not do enough for us.  I learned this is because they are very happy with their General Manager whom I had the pleasure of meeting.  Mr Khawas, had years of experience in the Middle East in  luxury Hotels before returning to Nepal to Manage the PGH.Each morning we enjoyed a delicious breakfast buffet before spending hours by the swimming pool relaxing in the beautiful garden.I can genuinely say it was hard to leave, our home away from home.

Me and my boyfriend stayed for 3 days and 2 night. Although it was a short stay, it was a magical one. All the staff members are so friendly and thoughtful. I asked them to organize a last minute surprise for my boyfriend to celebrate our 2nd year anniversary and they did such a fabulous job decorating the bed. They even provided us with a cake! The room is meticulously cleaned and the bath is superb. There are a lot of amenities such a spa, swimming pool and gym so you can just stay at the hotel during rainy days. Overall, you just won’t regret a stay here!

super professional, friendly and respectful staffs, delicious foods, pleasant environment, super comfortable and spacious rooms, safe place for couples.I will definitely stay in this hotel the next time I visit Pokhara.Most specially I would like to thank Mr. Sakar Adhikari for arranging everything also thanks to all Pokhara grande family for making my trip so memorable.

neat and clean spacious rooms. breakfast buffet was fine. nothing out of the ordinary. they have multiple restaurants to suffice your taste buds. one of the highly recommended options in pokhara.they do offer free shuttle service to pokhara lake and other tourist spots.

A very vast and beautiful hotel filled with professional and generous staff. The decor was very quaint and cleanly kept, and staff made sure to help immediately as soon as I walked through the door. I want to show particular praise to the kitchen staff for a delicious lunch as well as keeping service on time and never delaying any needs I had, whether it was food or beverages. I would implore all who eat and stay here to try their sandwiches. I also want to thank Samjhana in particular for her professionalism and gracious cortuesy during the visit.

I always love staying at pokhara grande, rooms are great with view of annapurna range and hotel staff are absolutely incredible especially thanks to tenjin samjhana anjali roji and all the pokhara grande family☺️

Me and my wife chose Hotel Pokhara Grande as our wedding reception venue. The hotel was spot on. The location was perfect with easy accessibility for transportation. The hotel staff made our wedding planning process so easy and smooth, that we didn't have a hint of stress going into the wedding! Tenzin (Guest Service Manager) went above and beyond to make us and our guest a memorable one. we absolutely recommend this venue to a friend.

Stayed at this property for a 4 night 5 days to attend a conference organized by Nepal Scouts. I found house keeping service team and trainee at the restaurant were good to us and friendly and always ready to help us but the reception, travel desk and other executive level employee were not so friendly.

This was my 3rd visit to Pokhara and 2nd time staying at the Pokhara Grand Hotel. Both times it was for planning and conducting a large scale (~240 participants) disaster response exercise. I simply cannot emphasize enough how outstanding the management and staff were from day 1! The General Manager (Mr. Roshan Khawas) and every member of the team he aligned with us in support of our exercise were professional, courteous and exceptionally attentive to all our needs, even untimely issues that popped up! They went out of their way to ensure it was immediately resolved and all participants were always made to feel welcomed and had a positively lasting experience.If you’re looking for a place that immediately greets you at the door with a warm smile and welcoming tika, only to be followed by countless more genuine smiles, I highly recommend the Pokhara Grand!Thank you again for everything Roshan and Team! VIP

Wonderful place to be here, very closed to lake side excellent service spl at front desk, love the spicy foods and excellent view, will sure to recommend to my friends, will visit again by summer, keep it up,

I was in Pokhara Grand for an official visit. It is five star hotel located just behind Pokhara Domestic  Airport. It was nice stay here with all Friendly staff and very cool environment. If you like to go for swimming or gym its all free and also have Spa centre.. Over all it was memorable stay in Pokhara Grande.

We recently had a work conference here for 4 days. The grounds were well kept, the conference rooms tidy, the pool deep and refreshing, the staff were friendly and the food was good (perhaps a little too good!). The only complaint is that I found the mattress too firm, which was only partially remedied with an extra duvet placed on the bed. Collegues reported more comfortable beds. There was also limited pool towels for the group (admittedly a large group).

I stayed in Pokhara Grande for 2 days the experience was best staff is very friendly and professional ,food quality is as good as Indian when you come here you dnt miss your country.Beauty view from hotel if the climate is clear  I met Miss roji, anjali, tenzin at reception for the 1st time and they where very helpful and professional if u are traveling to nepal pokhara prkhara grand is the best option for stay....😊😊

I've been here at Pokhara Grande several times with my clients and every visit has been wonderful. The staff here are particularly helpful and caring which I haven't found in any other hotels in Pokhara. I will be back again very soon and thank you for one more wonderful stay. Thumps up to reception people specially!!!

Visited Pokhara with family in the month of May 2019. The airport's just 5 min from the hotel. The hotel rooms are very clean and the staff is very courteous , polite and professional.  Mr Ashok took great care of us especially since we were travelling with kids and parents.  The traveldesk at the hotel organised our tours and sightseeing at Pokhara. MR Tripathi was too good in creating our itenerary considering the weather in pokhara which can be unpredictable.  The travel desk is not expensive at all. Highly recommend to stay at the Pokhara Grande and use their travel desk for sightseeing and adventure sports. Ask for Mr Ashok the hotel and Mr Tripathi at the travel desk.

I stayed at Pokhara Grande and I am beyond satisfied with the service and the hospitable staff here. There is nothing in this hotel that could have been better, they do not compromise when it comes to their guests. Always got more than i asked through out my stay. My special thanks to Samjana Gurung and Tenzin for making my stay a wonderful one. I found new friends in these lovely ladies. They were always ready to help.I highly recommend this hotel for the people who do not want to compromise in service. I will definitely come back again.

I stay in Pokhara Grande Hotel. from the moment we arrived, we were welcomed and we felt at home. Reception staff is very friendly and nice specially Indira, Rozi and Tenzin  The Hotel is very beautiful and well kept.  The rooms clean and comfortablel.  The pool was wonderful and a nice way to relax after a day of adventuring.  We dined in the restaurant and the staff was awesome and attentive. Thank you!  We highly recommended this Hotel.

Following the tips for the hotel, I asked for a high floor with a view of the mountain, and was rewarded with the most beautiful scenery early in the morning with the sunrise and the fishtail peak. Staff at the hotel were always very courteous and helpful. The garden was beautiful with colorful flowers. Very good and varied breakfast.

Just before 2 days I was checkout from hotel pokhara grande.Cant believe that the how can be a any hotel giving such a lovely experience with a high tempo of hospitality..1) Food - tempting food with live counter(a need of foodie) 2)Service- service from welcome guy to restaurant staff, Reception to housekeeping all of them are so lovely in behaviour.3) swimming pool with great view, well maintain fitness club & many moreYou must visit this hotel once when you visit pokhara Thank you :)

We were 2 couples and a 3 year old kid.  Overall the hotel is very good and the breakfast spread was very nice but there are some areas which require significant improvements:1. AC did not work in room 237 for 2 nights of our stay and it was suffocating in the room. We do complained after 1st night but the AC started working again in the morning.  Again the same problem the 2nd night.  Imagine this with a 3 year old.  The hotel staff gave a fan on the 2nd night.  But not a good experience and not expected from such renowned hotel.2. Poor chair quality in the room.  Does not suit a hotel which boasts of 5 star facilities.3. No children play area.

I am a frequent guest at Pokhara Grand, usually bringing students for swimming lessons and a relaxed hotel stay outside of their villages. The staff is always great and remember me on every visit.Rooms are a large size, comfortable, clean and the includes breakfast is more than we could ask for.The swimming pool is my biggest draw. Its perhaps the cleanest pool in Pokhara and goes up to 8ft deep. A perfect place to lounge and teach some of the locals the basics of swimming.The hotel is situated just outside of Lakeside, just a short taxi ride from the center. There are free daily shuttles that will go to and from the airport, ad well as to and from Lakeside.Comfort, quality, and excellent service. The best I have had in Pokhara so far. :)

This was my first time in Pokhara & i was recommended  by everyone to stay here.   I was a bit skeptical at first but I understand why all my friends insisted on me staying here.  From the moment i walked in,  I felt comfortable & in peace.     The front desk staff Yeshi & Roji greeted me with their genuine smile.   Checkin was fast & easy.  Rooms were spacious & super clean.     The in house restaurant has really good food!    Loved it!

No matter how much you visit this place, you will always have a smile and sweet memories with you while bidding farewell!!! Everytime I visit this place I see all the staffs' passion n dedication towards costumer satisfaction!!! They all are really humble n helpful. Welcome to Pokhara Grande people. You won't regret your stay here!!!

Just had a very relaxing 3 nights in a second floor room (350). Weather excellent so we enjoyed fantastic views of the mountains. Staff very friendly despite the other activities going on in the hotel- weddings, conferences etc. We enjoyed the Nepali/Indian dishes in the restaurant (other options available). Spacious rooms and good pool. Binita gave an excellent Nepali massage in the Oasis Spa although I wouldn’t describe the spa as “elegant and serene”. Free WiFi  but annoying as kept having to log back in.

So pleased to have chosen this hotel for our 5 nights stopover. Have been to Pokhara before, so wanted a hotel away from the hussle-bussle!! It is close to the Airport  and 5 minute drive from Fewa lake. We specifically  chose a top floor room with a view...and 'What A View' we got. For two consecutive days, blue skies and clear mountains  views...almost at touching distance!! Couple of days of heavy rain and hailstones. But expected at end of March. Hotel has a lovely garden and pool to relax too. All the staff were wonderful and welcoming. Namely, the lovely Sabita, Chinta and Luxmi who served us. Also, Ambika, Anjli, Bisnu and Muna Rana Korila. Sachit and Roji at reception promised us a great view and what a view it was!! Sadly, Sanjay who was so charming,  we felt was doing so for a big tip! Hopefully,  we are wrong. The service was great, but feel the rooms need updating for a 5* rating. Lighting is a bit dim in the rooms. Only negative  experience was that the hotel would not accept any notes with writing, tears or scruffy, for money exchange. However, was more than happy to give us scruffy Napali notes!! Apparently,  Bank policy!!! A big thank you to all the staff for making are stay so enjoyable.

After roughing it on our trek we were delighted to find this oasis in Pokhara: beautiful gardens, pool, fitness center, nice rooms, very lovely staff, and the splendid view from the room made this the perfect choice for our family. The food was great too and the hotel was the same price as a lakeside one without any of these luxuries.

We stayed there for two nights. There were 20 rooms on ground floor in one section wnd another 20 rooms.  Ther were same no. of rooms on first floor and other rooms in seperat building with suits. The room keys were standard not having card key. The room was of adequate size The dining rooms were on ground and also on first floor with breakfast, lunch and dinner arrangements.                                                                                             The room had attached toilet with seperate bath area having bathtub, all the facilities were available in the room . All other facilities like telephoen, freze, tea kettle for making tea, I feel it is one of the good hotels in Pokhara.

Pros:- Spacious grounds, with swimming pool. Quiet area. Near airport (no problem with overflying planes) - Large rooms (easy to add a third bed), well equipped and very clean- Friendly staff- Everything works: AC, hot water, TV (cable), fridge, coffee/tea maker,...- Decent breakfast. Eggs made to order. Some changes in the buffet every day. Both Western and Asian dishes- Nice views of the himalayasCons: - some 5 km away from the lakeside, where all the shops and action are- Internet slowConclusion: good higher-end hotel, providing everything you would expect in a 4-5 star hotel. The location can be a plus or a minus, depending on whether you prefer to be closer to the action or rather be a bit outside town in a more peaceful environment.

We stayed for one night prior to our trek. We had a breathtaking view of the Annapurna range from our room. It was a spacious and comfortable room. My only complaint was that I was woken up in the middle of the night by banging noises from workmen who were setting up a marquee right under our window! It went on until daybreak! Otherwise I couldn’t fault the overall service. The staff was friendly and attentive.

I returned to The Pokhara Grand again because the staff is exceptional - especially Tham Raj Khadka & housekeeping staff - everyone was so helpful. I stayed here last year after traveling in Asia for over 2 months and I extended my stay for 5 extra days because of the wonderful experience. I brought my wife this year for 7 days The view from our room 🏔

Stayed in hotel for one day on business trip....Excellent property... Good ambiance. Check in-Check out was very smooth. Frost desk team Sakar, Tenzin, Samjhana, Roji were very cooperative to help you out.. Other staff were also very helpful...Could not enjoy spa as was under renovation at that time... Breakfast was good & had plenty of choices. Can enjoy good view of snow covered Himalaya from roof top.Overall good experiance...

This hotel is very best to all the people who wants to visit Nepal. Firstly,  they provide warm welcoming to the guest. The rooms are very neat and clean. The staff's are also very friendly. Delicious food available here.

The upstairs bit where the buffet is was a bit nicer The location was not the best as it was not a touristy area at all outside of the hotel it was just dirt road and the locals area The pool wasn’t very nice and didn’t look the cleanest, I saw others use it but, I personally opted not to when I saw the water quality The one thing I would say is the staff were lovely, Specifically Anjali from the front desk who was very friendly and helpful Overall this place is listed as 5 star, I probably have my expectations too high as there is clearly a difference between Australian 5 star and Nepalese 5 star as this was probably a 2-3 star in Aus

The pool and fitness care taker have no manners to talk and also the availability of wifi for each room two person and some rooms inground floor are not modernise not worthed for 5 star and still not good worse experience i request hotel management to look over it

Hotel is one if the best hotels in pokhara. staff is really professional and very cooperative. they gave me free drop to the airport also. one lady at reception (Nandini ) is very helpful and very humble. Thanks

I liked pokhara grande and the behavior of the staffs..customer handling was the best i thing i liked about..Pokhara is the only place besides Kathmandu where i love to be but now because of warm hospitality from pokhara grande i will love to be there more

We stayed here for 4 nights. It is a good hotel but is rather remote from the central lakeside area, and although the hotel provides a free shuttle this is very infrequent, so you are probably going to find yourself taking taxis is you stay here. They are not expensive though, and you should pay only 250 NPR to lakeside. Just cut the haggling, tell the driver that is what you will pay and they are almost certain to accept your price. The hotel staff are very helpful and friendly, and there is a nice pool. The hotel was full when we stayed so we didn't get a mountain view room, which was a disappointment, but the rooms are fine. Nice enough breakfast buffet. If I ever find myself back in Pokhara I would probably elect to stay by the lakeside though all things considered.

The hotel is located a bit far from the touristic and happening lakeside but the standard of services on offer for the price charged is actually quite decent and commendable. Rooms are standard, breakfast is good and they have a swimming pool if you want to cool off in the summer heat. It's a good location to unwind and relax.

We stay at this hotel as part of a tour of India and Nepal. We stayed for 2 nights. This hotel is a a good clean hotel with the accommodation block set out over 3 levels. Rooms are to a good standard with all the usual expected facilities. I.e safe hair dryer, tea and coffee making facilities, a/c etc. We used the restaurant for breakfast only which offered a reasonable selection, including an egg station cooking omelettes and fried eggs. The rest of the selection is typical Nepalese though there was a small selection of bland Danish pastries. They have a really nice soldier on guard at the accommodation block who salutes you when you enter and leave. Whilst we stayed we did experience a number of power cuts though not the hotels fault.We eat out on the 2 nights we stayed in the lakeside area which can be walked in about 30 mins. There is a multitude of restaurants which we chose from TA (Rosemaries Kitchen). Taxis to the lakeside cost around 500 Nepalese rupies. About £3.50. There is a small pool and and spa facility which we did not use.No real complaints.

The hotel itself is very clean and well appointed. Room is large and a fantastic view of the mountains from your window. Shower was not very hot for some reason. The Hotel buffet dinner was very average. In addition to average food was a large tour group who were very rude. Same thing at breakfast. The hotel is a 400 rupee ride from town on average.

We stayed for a couple of nights. The rooms are nice, even better if u take mountain view rooms.The best thing about breakfast was the Nepali Tea.Also,the hotel charges extra for sauna/steam which is quite unusual for a 5 star. Staff were courteous and helpful.

Magnificently decorated individual rooms, beautiful public areas, all added to our pleasure. The experience was pure professionalism and personal.  The staff were both personally engaging and professional at the same time.  The facilities were impeccable and was more positive filled with the flavor of ‘Pokhara’ than we could have imagined.  A truly spectacular experience for our whole Team.

It was a pleasant surprise to be greeted by Sasha on Thursday morning at our hotel. She sold us immediately with her infectious smile. She was positive, cheerful and helpful from the outset.  What impressed me most about Sasha on our tour was that it felt like we were just hanging out with a friend. At no point did we feel like foreigners in a distant land but more like friends, getting to know each other along the way. I would highly recommend Sasha for any tours or sightseeing as she conveys all the warmth and hospitality desired to make anyone feel at ease.Thank you Sasha for such a great experience and I am both proud and humbled to call you my friend.

One of the best place in Pokhara to get relax and make a mood in your holiday. Staffs were good though. If you are visiting pokhara then do not forget to visit this hotel. If you loved it then you can book..

good service and the attractive garden and pool at side good food and rooms we went there for the visit and lunch and it was so good .every thing is very good  i would advice this hotel to every person  who want  peace and good service

We had 2 nights here while visiting Pokhara. The best feature of the hotel is it’s wonderful staff-always pleasant and most helpful. A little way from the Lakeside hustle and bustle but to us that was a good thing and you can get a shuttle into the centre easily. Rooms are very clean

To start with the whole ambience of the hotel is Relaxed, with very nice and helping staff as well as great service. Staff is eager to serve and very cordial. Our suite was having views of Himalayas and the morning view itself was Full paisa vasool :). The rooms are large and clean. They can though improve on the dining experience with a better Menu.

Ideally located near to the lake and museum.Facilities are good.The rooms are neat and clean.The lobby is spacious and the staff very helpful.The location is nice and the stay was very good.Airport also very close by..

The view of the mountains from the hotel makes up for a lot of things. I liked the room, i liked the surroundings. The only thing that spoiled the experiences for me was the guest in the next room who had a loud party. The room i was in had a connecting door with it, and though locled the sound and the cigarette smoke came to my room.The staff was super helpful, the replaced the kettle in my room when it did not work and even spoke to my neigbour and asked him to keep it down. Just goes to show some people can pay for and a hotel room but cant pay for good manners.

Three nights at this resort, but we had a decent experience but with mixed feelings. Let us summarise or experience;1 (worst) to 5 (best)--------------------------------Check-in & departure: 4 (duty manager Mr Deepu) was super helpful and friendly, went out of his way to make us welcome)Friendliness of staff: 4 Room: 3 (aged & very basic)Bathroom: 3 (could be cleaner)Restaurant service: 3.5 (Except for Ms Chinta & Ms Ambika, rest of the service crew was poor. Restaurant manager was very unprofessional, once suggested we ate leftovers after a large group (about 200 pax) competed all the food)Food quality: 3 buffet 4 a-larcarte Location: 3 (several other hotels are located walking distance from the main tourist attraction..ie the lake side)Facilities: 3Resort ambiance: 3 (not cosy but you will get a nice Nepalis feel)Overall Experience: 3Note to management: your staff Deepu, Chinta and Ambika are really super helpful and friendly. Your restaurant manager should get a *1 star rating*, for suffering us too eat left over some food from the buffet that was left in small plates, absolutely ridiculous and insult. Even worst, to mix your few tourist guests to eat together with a larger college group of over 200 students... We had to stand in sure for 20 mins just to get our food.Get your F&B manger to relook at his service SOP! Otherwise, a decent stay and thank you.

I had a very wonderful stay in Pokhara grand hotel, Special thanks to Rosi ( Reception staff), Prerna Gurang, Laxmi and Meeta ( Dining staff) , People are really awesome, great hospitality. Very beautiful hotel well maintained hotel. House keeping staff is very amazing to made hotel such a beautiful place to stay. Rooms are really spacious.I really had a wonderful stay in new building. View is really awesome.Thanks!Mrs Gupta.

My husband and I spent a wonderful weekend at Pokhara Grande. The rooms were clean and very spacious. Breakfast at the multi cuisine restaurant was amazing. The other food items from the menu such as dumplings and chicken fried rice were very tasty too. We experienced a top notch service by the hotel staff as well and so our weekend at Pokhara Grande was simply wonderful. Would highly recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Pokhara!

Great work by Tenzin in guest relations. Her leadership and all of the staff were excellent, supportive, and kind. Will definitely stay here again. Front desk was good and thoughtful. Room was clean as well.

Place was crowded . The toilets were dirty . There was a wedding going on and there was a brawl with glasses being smashed . We were shown alternate rooms . Most bathrooms were dirty.They promised to call in housekeeping but we were not impressed with their service nor their management

We stayed here after trekking for two weeks and had an amazing stay! It was our honeymoon and they were kind enough to decorate our room with flowers and give us a mountain view which was stunning! The room was large and very clean. Service was 5 star - whether we needed to store our bags, jump on the free shuttle or arrange activities everyone was very helpful. The morning breakfast buffet was delicious. We also really enjoyed sitting by the pool and gardens. A great escape from the noise of lakeside hotels and exceptional value.

It was a delightful stay at Pokhara grande.Room is specious,neat and clean well decorated with nice towel art. View out of window was amazing. Service level and staff's attitude was remarkable. Keep it up ..Highly recommended for everyone

Large hotel set in substantial grounds with gardens and swimming pool. Located somewhat away from the main 'Lakeside' shop and restaurant area, hence a taxi/tuk tuk needed to get there. However the plus side is that the setting is tranquil and spacious.Be aware that the main 3 floor accommodation block has no lifts, so best to ask for a ground floor room if you have mobility issues. The mountain facing rooms have an excellent view of the Annapurna range behind Pokhara - a beautiful sight in early morning or late afternoon.Room was spacious and hot water plentiful. Staff were friendly and attentive (perhaps sometimes overly so in the restaurant!). Laxmi (?) is worthy of particular mention for her warm smile and friendly manner. Bar benefits from 20% off between 6pm & 8pm - and you can take a drink through to the restaurant with you. Free wi-fi via a code provided by reception but we didn't find it very reliable and used the lobby wi-fi instead.Food, both breakfast (the usual buffet) and evening (buffet or a la carte) were good. Please, please however replace the toaster used at breakfast - even after 3 'passes' the toast is barely brown!Would definitely stay again.

First of all let me say why I only gave it 4/5 they don't have a lift, which is no big deal for most people but if you've been trekking, are old, injured disabled etc it's not great. Granted you can ask reception and someone will come and help immediately.Now on to the good stuff and there's lots of it. This hotel has amazing views of the Himalayas if you are lucky enough to get a mountain view room and the sky is clear. It's clean, well maintained and great to serve as a base before a Trek. It's very close to Pokhara airport too. The staff are exceptional and I mean exceptional. They were very very helpful for my wife and I, very knowledgeable and friendly and a real credit to this hotel. The hotel is close enough to Lakeside for some last minute trekking shopping and some great food places and around 300-500 rupees in a cab depending on where you catch it from. Really pleased we stayed here and enjoyed this hotel and Pokhara much more than Kathmandu, likely because it's quieter. Would definitely stay here again if we came back.

This hotel was a very nice surprise. Very clean and quiet. The breakfast was great. Tenzin was fantastic. She was very friendly, knowledgeable and always smiling and willing to help with any questions or concerns that you might have. Would highly recommend this hotel

Stayed for 2 days at pokhara grande.Awesome experience as far as the location ,restaurants,bar,view of the himalayas from the room.Pokhara in itself is worth a 4 day stay.spa needs to be improved upon.

As a facility the Pokhara grande is a high three star hotel but it’s service sets it apart. The staff are amazing, friendly and nothing to too daunting for them to do for you. Definitely worth staying there

Lovely views of Fishtail Mountain and others and good base for Annapurna RangeOrdinary rooms are in a separate block from main hotel and on 3 floors. There is security guard 24 hours. Rooms are spacious, clean and comfortable.Note there is NO lift. Ask a for a pool view room. Internet is not available 24 hours.The airport is close but noise was not a problem.Pool and gym are well kept although gym was a bit warm!The two restaurants are respectively Indian and Oriental buffet themed. If you want the a la carte it's the same in both!!Restaurant service is patchy, particularly at breakfast if it's busy with coach parties etc. Supplies of food and drinks can run low!!Service and food at the poolside bar however was excellent.You will need transport to get to centre of Pokhara or the lake

Beautiful location, just by sitting in your room one can see the snow-clad mountain range through the window (mountain view rooms of new block). Rooms are spacious with all amenities and comfortable bed. Lovely complimentary breakfast with wide range of tasty and fresh foods. All staff are courteous and helpful. Only drawback is that there is no lift.

It was a family trip for the festive season and the hotel did greet us well. Good rooms and prompt service along with a central location and a pool. The minus points were the lack of a good breakfast and dinner spread. Also there were no intra hotel activities like indoor games or a pool table to indulge the guests in That little EXTRA fun. All seen though this place is amongst some of the better places to stay in Pokhara. Needs some brushing up ... Have added the pics from the rooftop below.. Cheers...

Good response .Happy to visit again. I m highly satisfied with all staffs .Receptionist Sajani is so friendly . I wish her all the best for her future . Thank you for the warm hospitality. Will be back soon.

Hotel is good, lovely staff very helpful. The travel desk are fantastic at organising trips for you. They offer great value trips in the Pokhara area . Hotel is not in centre , only 5 min away by taxi.

We stayed here two nights and a memorable visit.The Hotel particularly was really good - what with mountain view rooms; the great Himalayas sight was memorable one. Almost a tranquil atmosphere.Food is great - although breakfast can be improved.The city is like Far from the Madding Crowd and the Hotel adds to it.Very good and hospitable staff. Krishna

Good ambience with great choices of foods and staff are attentive too.  Rooms are satisfactory. Staff will make you feel honoured . But poor management. I still rate it as a great hotel in pokhara but quite old one.

My stay at the Pokhara Grande Hotel was marked by the friendliness of the staff. They have great attention to detail and really do everything to make you feel welcome and assure a pleasant stay. Especially Miss Indira at reception and Mr Kirti Tripathi from the travel desk have been a tremendous help to me in organizing my trip back to Kathmandu on a day when flights were cancelled because of bad weather. Very calm, efficient and always with a smile, they both made sure that I got back to Kathmandu in time for my flight home.

Stayed here on two separate occasions as part of the same tour, in two two night blocks. Hotel standard very high indeed, and staff cannot be faulted. Room very good but had to change as air con in first room akin to a mouse blowing through a straw, but once moved all good. Pool area very good indeed, facilities follow suit with most staff speaking good English. It was evident this hotel doesn't see as many Western guests as they do Chinese and this is evidenced in the menu. Finding something that wasn't Chinese did prove difficult and one on occasion we didn't eat at all as nothing appealed. That said still a very good hotel with excellent facilities and worthy of a high end establishment.

I GLMF Tr.Binod Agrawal the Immediate Past Chairman of Round Table 15 Nepal,Past National Treasure of Round Table Nepal and the 18th National Agm committee members would like to thank the hotel management n entire staff family for supporting us by providing tremendous hospitality.Our program was for three days from 31st August to 3rd September n on an average we had 105 rooms with more than 220 members with full board in house program.We all the tablers enjoyed a lot with stay,fooding,pool party, games, n many more from early morning to mid night .I appreciate the hotel staffs specially service n kitchen sectors , who worked for more than 18 hours with continuous smile.I remember few names HARI dai the head Chef, Tenzin,Samjhana JI, Sanjay JI,Deep dai,Indrakala didi,Sabita koirala bahini, Chinta ,Sonam n all.I admire all but cannot remember name to mention here for their continuous support.Would like to thank you Mr Pancham Lama CEO all the way coming from ktm for staying with us during our event .But due to one senior management staff we were bit disappointed as it was  verbal agreement but later they realized n hope they will never repeat it.Lastly like to say EXCELLENT IN EVERY EXPECTS HATS OFF WILL BE MEMORABLE ALL THE BEST POKHARA GRAND TEAM

While traveling on business and pleasure for the past 10+ years, I've stayed at world class hotels around the world. I can say with all honesty that I've never had a more pleasant stay as I did at the Pokhara Grande. Yes, the location is convenient but the hotel and staff are fantastic. I cannot say enough good things about the hotel staff. They're very professional, courteous and provide the service with a smile always. Special thanks to Miss Yeshi and Samjana. The rooms were clean and comfortable, the restaurants superb. In general the entire hotel is maintained to perfection. If anybody wants a first class experience in Pokhara, I can recommend the Pokhara Grande.

been there with family in the month of August, 2017 for 2 days, our rooms were allotted on the 3rd floor and surprisingly there was no lift, shocked because i was travelling with my infant child and it was very hard to use stairs when you have a baby stroller, secondly they issue wi-fi coupon which valid for only 24 hours and on next day again you have to collect the coupon from the reception and wi-fi speed was poor and much below the expectation, when you portray your self as 5 star hotel, food taste was terrible when you pay 1100 NPR (Nepal Rupee) excluding 23% tax which comes to 1353 NPR per person then you expect some thing from the dinner which i was disappointed after paying 5950 NPR for 4 person we were hungry...when we check-out from the hotel it takes more then 30 min to bring our language from our room, only good thing in the hotel was swimming pool...

The stay in pokhara grande is very nice. The food and service is nice. The staff on  reception greets the customer and interact  nicely with the customer... great place to be in pokhara.. hoping to be back soon..

I visited the Pokhara Grand Hotel on two separate weekends, along with a handful of students to practice swimming at their pool. Service was excellent from beginning to end.We were greeted with smiles and welcome beverages as we entered the premises. Our rooms were clean, comfortable, and spacious. The breakfast buffet was tasty and filling. During the day, they also offered complimentary transportation to Lakeside. The pool was perfect. It spanned from 4 to 8 feet deep and was well maintained. The students loved it as well!

This is the biggest hotel at Pokhara. Rooms are good spreaded in few wings, new rooms are great! Meals also have good choice of spread. Staffs are attentive, helpful & very polite. Conference facilities are also available. Overall enjoyable!

Room was very nice.Overall service was good from the staff.For western travelers, while this hotel is 4-star in Nepal, it is equated to a 3-star in terms of room quality, facilities, and amenities. Breakfast is included and has good choices.Pool was clean. Check-in was fast. Good security presence.Only issue that I had was that we used the Spa booking at 8pm time. When finished, came out and asked for bill but the Spa said they already submitted the bill (without me ever looking at it).  I assumed it was for the quoted price of Rs. 3600 per person. So I gave the therapists Rs 1000 each (for two people massages)...a 30%tip.  Next day at checkout, not only the VAT was added on top of Rs. 7200, but a tip of 10%.  I had no idea spa would automatically be charged a tip...not something customary in other countries. Its based on service received and at least I should have been shown the bill before submission.When I told front desk about my payment of 30%tip already, the person kept saying the spa is not theirs and they have no control of it to which I kept saying yes it is theirs if its in their premises and they are responsible for it, if they are presenting me the bill for the first time since the spa never showed me the bill. I felt bad that after leaving 30% tip, they are arguing to make it 40%. After back and forth, they called manager and removed the tip. So thanks to the hotel finalky for removing the extra charged tip and correcting the issue, but I recommend everyone check spa bill before tipping and that to expect that whether you get good service or not, you will be charged a tip.  That is equivalent if saying that your spa is not Rs 3600 per person, but rather Rs 3960.  I think automatically adding 10% charge on spa bill makes people who want to leave more than that think twice. Anyway, giving 4-star because hotel corrected the issues.

This was our first visit to Nepal, and at Pokhara as well, and we will be definitely coming back here again. Pokhara Grande has made our overall experience even better and our stay over here was top class. The staffs of this hotel is exceptionally friendly, with great manners and great hospitality. I am not sure of many of their names but to name a few Ms. Indira, Ms. Tenjin, Mr. Sushil are few of the most kind employees that we have came across. If any of you are looking for a recommendation, without any hesitation you may book your stay at PG. Their breakfast quality is great with lots of choices. There is definitely something for everybody to satisfy their tastebuds. There is free wifi, swimming pool and gym facilities for all of their guests, plus they offer free pass to their night club for all the residents of the hotel. Their rooms are undoubtedly beautifully designed and spacious. I personally would choose this hotel for my future visits to Pokhara. PG is centrally located, and fooding options are also great around the area. If you want to experience an A1 stay please do choose PG to serve you. A big shout out to the PG family, and my sincere thank you to all the kind and beautiful employees of PG for your unforgettable hospitality!

PG is one of the original hotels of Pokhara, near the airport, Dam Site, and Lakeside, but the management and polite, hardworking staff are constantly updating and improving everything. Service, decoration, menu, security, garden, pool and spa are all lovely and pleasant. The staff are especially helpful, friendly and very professional, so if any problem comes up they will help you sort it out. You can stay here with a lot of confidence and all modern amenities, enjoy!

I have really enjoyed my pleasant stay here with my family. Nice hotel at a great location with a relaxing view, you will enjoy the fresh scenery of the hotel view. The staff are friendly, provided very good service and facilities are great.I would really recommend my families and friends for their visit in Nepal.Looking forward my stay here again soon.

The hotel is not five star category, it's 3.5 to 4 star category Hotel. Staff was ok with lack of services, they doesn't know how to give services to guests. Same was with restaurant, no trained professional staff was there. All were ladies in restaurant and they doesn't know how to talk with guests and give services. Breakfast was with lack of variety.      Housekeeping staff opened your room with 3 knockings in 10 sec. They doesn't bother what are you doing in your room or sleeping or in undressed manner or in washrooms. Complained to hotel staff at reception and GM of hotel, he said that it's  our hotel policy and we give services If housekeeping staff knock on door 3 times in 5-10 sec. he has right to open the door with master key. GM. Of hotel, in doing something in this matter, just counted that we had upgraded your deluxe Room In to suite.

The resort is located very near to airport. So it saves your time in commuting. The resort is little outdated and needs some maintenance. The for quality for breakfast was pretty low, not expected from such resorts. I would suggest to take an accommodation near lakeside , which has better options for food and shopping both.

Very good hotel, with clean room, well organized service and very trained and kind stuff.  We were accompanied by mister Tham Raj, executive housekeeper, to the shop outside of the hotel although I think that local people is friendly but anyway he wanted to be sure that we are well and safe.The food is only thing that could be improved, the choice is small and mostly asian food, some continetal choice would be nice, as well.All in all it is very good hotel.

All our friends from Nepal said the Pokhara Grande was the best hotel in Pokhara.  They were correct.  We enjoyed our 2-night stay.  The highlights were the staff, breakfast, and view.  The staff were friendly and helpful.  The two security guards saluted us whenever we walked by and said "Namaste".  The waitress in the restaurant had learned a few words of Chinese and would practice with my wife each more.  We did the massage in the spa, too.  The breakfast was good with Nepalese food, western food, and fresh fruit.  The view from the window was amazing.  We could see the snow-capped Himalayas.  The hotel has a large, enclosed courtyard, too.  A taxi to the waterfront is US$3-4.

I had a very good time with Inland Fishery Development seminar group from Korea. The hotel provided us perfect service which we required for residencial conference. The conference hall was fully air-conditioned with well furnished. Excellent service and good food. Special thanks to General Manager Mr. Roshan Khawas for perfect management and also thanks to Travel Desk Manager Mr. Kirti Tripathi for excellent transportation and activities management during the free time.

Don't forget to view the Himalaya range from the roof top. staffs are very helpful and well informative travel desk with reasonable price. we booked ultralight flight for 30 min. The rate was better than the company rate.

I highly recommend this hotel for its overlooking beautiful mountain view, which is really breathtaking and relaxing. The facilities are great such as the good spa,  health club, and pool. They have good staff who are friendly and they provide professional service. For those travellers planning to visit Nepal, this hotel is highly recommended and you will definitely enjoy and love your stay there!

We stayed at this beautiful and elegant place in May 2017. Perfect place to stay in Pokhara. Very close to airport, beautiful rooms overlooking mountain range on clear day. Fairly big swimming pool to relax after a great day. Courteous staff and good food.Tried using their massage service but did not find it that good.

The view from the hotel room was to die for . We stayed on 3 rd floor during a recent visit . Very friendly staff . Pradeep at the fron desk was very helpful and efficient . Also other ladies at the front who even provided us for some medication when my friend fell sick at night . Without their assistance we would be in a very bad situation . So just wanted to thank all the team for our fantastic experience . Very good Wifi even up in the rooms .Special mention for the travel agent desk who were very friendly and we used their package for paragliding and also day tour with Sasha , lovely young lady tour guide . All in all would definitely recommend staying in the hotel . If you don't want to climb stairs , then ask for ground floor rooms .

I stayed at pokhara grande for 1 night, its was amazing experience, talking about food, view, property its beyond expectation.Hotel service is up to the mark with friendly staff."Must stay hotel at pokhara"

Went by road from Lucknow {U.P.} to Pokhara, reached around 10:30 p.m. The staff was courteous and helpful, ambience is great and away from hustle bustle of the lakeside hotels. Preferred by the tour operators as is closest to the nearest airport. Food served was good though lacked variety for Vegetarians. Rooms are nice and cozy, the ground staff are simply awesome. Now, since we've travelled a lot, this property too needs corrections. Huge parking space, neat, nice and clean hotel, panoramic view of mountains, a pool too. But then again, what lacks is the Indian Vegetarian food. Wifi goes for a toss there are rains. Also, it works for 24 hrs. only, you need to ask for it again after 24 hrs of stay.

We liked the lobby very much as it was big with a nice view. Rooms are nice and free wifi is available. Staff are friendly. There are two separate buildings with an open space in between. Umbrellas were provided by the hotel as it was raining now and then.

The property is huge and widely spread. It's like a mini resort. Within the campus it has, Swimming, Pool, Gym which kids and everyone will love it. It also has a disco thek with a live music. Huge garden lawn for kids to spend their day time played no games and have fun. Nice Hotel.

A bit far from Lakeside, but the ambience of the hotel and the mountain view was totally worth! Went their with a 1.5 year old, who loved running around. The staff was very helpful, food was good. Best part- u can see the fishtail lying on your bed !

It is one of the best hotel in Pokhara, a large hotel with almost all the facilities a 5 Star hotel can offer. They have two hotel buildings and a nice walkway. They have a good and spacious lobby, good restaurants, a nice pool and good views. The rooms are very spacious, the washroom is also very good with the required amenities. The service is wonderful, whatever we asked, they did it in pretty good time. The food was good. However, in comparison to the breakfast, their buffet lunch and dinner had very limited menu which was little surprising for a 5 star hotel. We in Bangladesh have very good menu for buffet lunch or dinner in the topnotch hotels. Apart from that, everything else was good.

Most cordial and cooperative staff at restaurant, very good vegetarian food .They are ever ready to satisfy your request for food of your veg. choice. Even khichdi- kadhi (CURRY) was served to us, on our request

I would just like to thank Hotel Pokhara Grande and our guide Sasha for a great time trekking on their Royal Hiking trip. The trip is perfectly timed if you don't have a lot of time, but would still like to go hiking in the mountains and experience how the people live up in the mountains. A big thanks to Hotel Pokhara Grande and our guide Sasha. Best regards

Rooms are nice, spacious and well furnished.  The dining area and service was very good.  Food choices were varied and good.  My husband enjoyed his massage at the spa.  Lobby area is open and relaxing.  The staff is very courteous and helpful. The club was fun, music good as was the service.  We would definitely stay here again.

Its been 3 years we are working with Pokhara Grande, since the first year they knew what our requirement was and they got ace setting for us, beside that the hospitality they provide is a quality one, the staff are supportive, the environmental is beautiful and the property is spacious.

I stayed at the hotel for two nights in the eve of Nepali New Year 2074 along with my friends of Kathmandu Standards motorcycle club in the package of Enfield Poker Run.The first impression was made by the beautiful ladies at the welcome gate with tika and khada which made me feel welcomed.
