The room was marvelous with a magnificent interiors. The breakfast buffet was awesome and had a varieties of delicacies to be served. I enjoyed it a lot because there were options for vegetarians as well(I being a vegetarian). The snacks and dinner was flawless aswell.I was assisted by FO member Tenzin Yeshi when i had some inquiries and she was helping me with a beautiful smile on her faceAll in all it was a wonderful experience staying at Pokhara Grande hoping to check- in there on my next visit to Pokhara.I would like to give a big thumbs up to the whole team of Pokhara Grande.

I was recommended by my friend to stay in this hotel. My whole stay was very pleasant. I arrived early and they gave me a corner in their cafe area and treated me to a tea there whilst I worked on my emails. One evening I came over to the bar to order a drink and some light snacks. I could not find any light snacks for my liking. They offered me snacks from what they can find in the kitchen FOC.The entire experience with pokhara grande was amazing. They treated me well and gave me a nice room facing the mountain as per my request. Offered a fruit basket and always ready to make my stay an experience to come back for more. One slight comment - their spa service is poor. The lady who did my massage stopped the hot stones a few times. She was so in a hurry to go home. When I was done. I took the robe to go back to the room to so I won't stain my own clothes with the massage oils. The bathrobe had no strings to secure the robe on me. I asked for one and  they told me they have only ONE robe and therefore sorry no strings. Can you imagine????!!!! It's mind blowing! Don't go that spa if you can help it.

Mind boggling experience to say the least. my room no was #348 facing the garden and the mountains. I thoroughly enjoyed making myself a cup of coffee to start the day. And the rain shower is so refreshing.

Rooms are excellent,services are fabulous,foods are delicious, perfect mountain view from the lobby, staffs are very cooperatives. Spa is also very perfectly.club is so beautiful with live band and DJ every nights.

Stayed here for 2 nights with my girlfriend. Room Was lovely and clean and the service was top quality. Breakfast wasn't great but overall was very good. Done the Nepal Village tour through the hotel which was excellent and Sasha Thapa was our quide and couldn't have asked for better. 5 star.

After a 10 day trek through the Annapurnas, the Pokhara Grande offered my wife and I a place to relax. It's a classy place, especially in comparison to the normal places we stay at Lakeside. While it's 10 minutes from Lakeside, it's only 400 rupee taxi ride. The foyer is expansive, the staff helpful with excellent English, and the rooms large and well-appointed - and they have an 'evening service' where they tidy up the room. The restaurant is excellent; however, it does get crowded with groups. Best to wait until they've grazed and headed off before entering. While my wife enjoyed the Chinese food buffet, I wanted Indian and the helpful staff supplied a couple of nice dishes. It was also my birthday - and they gave me a cake. A very nice touch.

Being a Nepali I have travelled half the country and stayed in countless hotels, homestays and lodges. Whenever I stay at any place I look for few things and those few things are good hosts, good ambiance and good location. Let me begin with the hosts or the staffs of Pokhara Grande, I found them very hospitable. They were in constant touch with me to arrange the pickup and they arranged the pickup on time. When I arrived at the hotel, I was greeted with a million dollar smile. It was a hassle free check in and all I needed to do was give my identification. Furthermore, since I was on my honeymoon trip, my room was decorated beautifully with flowers. To my surprise, they arranged a vanilla cake with a beautiful message. I couldnt have asked for anything else. The ambiance was equally beautiful and quiet and away from all the hustle and bustle. I slept like a baby every night and without any disturbance. The location is around 20 minutes walking distance from the lakeside but that did not matter much to me as I had arranged city tour and I had my own vehicle. The only thing that I had issue with was the internet connection as I found it very sluggish. Other than that, the breakfast, dinner and every bit of my stay was a wonder. I would for sure make Pokhara Grande my first choice hotel from now on.

It's unusual to find a city hotel, right next to the airport, that feels like a secluded mountain resort. Exquisite gardens, well-trained staff, nice pool, great breakfast, comfy rooms and killer views of the famous Fishtail.

We had wonderful time at Pokhara Grande,the rooms were very clean, staffs are very friendly .  we booked a day hiking from the travel desk . They arranged very helpful guide, Sasa, she was very knowledgeable. we love to do some more hikings but we had only 2 days time.

Clean modern rooms, great staff, convenient to the airport, beautiful gardens and pool, and amazing views of Fishtail! Though I left the room safe open, as requested, when we checked out, I had forgotten that my checkbook was still inside. No problem. We got it back without any problem -- aside from my embarrassment!

We had a wonderful stay @Hotel Grande onValentine's Day. The service was very good and our room was with a good size and was well appointed with all the necessary amenities in place. Food was up to its best, did enjoyed wonderful snacks and breakfast in the morning. To summarise the hotel in one sentence would be- AMAZING.. We would definitely love to visit in the coming days.

Pokhara Grande Hotel as a very nice 5* hotel and expansive gardens, well appointed  rooms and thoughtful Service. Excellent, soft spoken staff always ready to please you.The early morning (5:30am) drive to village of SARANGKOT, a 40 minute mountain drive view point, to reach 1590 M (approx 4,500 feet) to view the Sunrise was a Treat! We were able to see the peaks of Machhu Puchhu (Fishtail) Mountain at 8000 meters (approx 25,000 feet) as well as ANNAPURNA Mountain range. This was Highlight of visit to POKHARA. Nepal.

From the moment we enquired to stay at the Pokhara Grande, we knew we had made the right decision to book in for the remainder of our holiday. We received a warm welcome and were allocated a lovely comfortable room with excellent mountain views. We are a family of four with two young girls and have nothing but praise and thanks for all the staff who have taken us to their hearts! We have been here for two weeks now and have only a few days left. It will be hard to leave! Breakfast each morning is varied and well cooked with an endless supply of coffee or tea. There is a pool which we tried but sadly it was not warm enough yet for us! Better to come later in the year for that. We really cannot fault this hotel and we will always remember our wonderful experience here. We feel we came as guests and will leave as good friends!Thank you all so much for taking such excellent care of us and especially for the love you have shown to our children. There are too many staff members tomention. Thank you all so much! Dhanyabhad x

Stayed recently at Pokhara Grande and my stay was an excellent. Food was very delicious and good service. Room was very spacious, good swimming pool, nice gym and good spa. I highly recommend this property as no. 1 property in Pokhara.

I really enjoyed staying in pokhara Grande Hotel which is located in the nearby David fales.i had continental cuisines and that of topical thakali food. In the bar I had some of cocktails and mugtails.No one should miss to stay in this Hotel and have a multiple cuisines. Mountain view room is the best room to see Himalaya. It's hospitality is the fusions of European and that of nepali.

Had a perfect wonderful stay at the hotel,bar was opened 24 hours,superb breakfast and everything was perfect. Thanks to all the staffs of the hotel. Will definitely recommend for a visit. Thank Pokhara Grande.

Stayed in Pokhara Grande for a night with 4 other friends and 2 toddlers. I have nothing to say but a big thank you to all the staff for making our stay an unforgettable  experience. A very cheerful concierge, reception was fast and efficient, good selection of breakfast, 24/7 bar service , anything u need, no fuss at all! Special mention to the amazing lady Samjhana Gurung for great hospitality, a beautiful smile 24/7 ( I am sure it's really hard with the nature of the job) and ever so polite manners. POKHARA Grande you nailed it  xx

This hotel is well kept. The staff is courteous and the food is great. Love staying here when in Pokhara. The hotel is also not too far from the Lake and is just 2 minutes away from the airport. Overall a pleasant stay and great value for money. Must Stay!

Nice hotel with friendly & helpful staffs. Exellent food, love the Chinese fried rice and noodles! Very near to the airport, lake side and other tourist spots. Very convenient! Room is clean and nice. Walk out from the hotel lobby, you can see the snow mountain. Great view!

The hotel is not to far from lakeside and not to close too making it easy to either get a quiet time or with a lot of music. The property had around 140rooms divided into various blocks. Food is really good there and so is the service of the staff. WiFi not being free ia the biggest issues because every roadside cafe offers free WiFi.

A very comfortable and clean hotel with friendly, welcoming and helpful staff. The hotel travel desk  was also very helpful and well informed. The only downside is that it is a taxi ride to Lakeside.  Would recommend all the same!

An amazing Property at this beautiful place. Hospitality at its best and great Food at their restaurant which is a rare combination now days. Our stay from 12-14th February was exquisite at this property which has greenery all around. Their suites are spacious and a must visit.

Pokhara is a well-known and well-establish tourist destination. The city itself is very beautiful with so much of natural gifts.During all our official trip to Pokhara, we stay at Pokhara Grande. Location-wise, its notable that this hotel is close to the airport and accessible to much of the tourist destinations in Pokhara. I personally love staying here due to its great ambiance and professional, smart and friendly staff members.

Pretty ordinary hotel. Our room was in a separate building to the main lobby which means in winter you have to walk in the cold to get to and from your room. There is also no elevator or free wifi in your room. There is also no individual heating or cooling, just central heating during the winter months which made the room unbearably hot to get a good nights sleep. I don't really think that's acceptable in this day and age in a supposed five star property. Hotel is close to the airport but not much else around the area. Rooms are of a good size. Wouldn't particularly recommend.

The best place to stay in Pokhara.. Well I am a regular guest at Pokhara Grande and everytime I stay here I always feel at home. Lovely staff, delicious food, great view!!! Nice rooms- cosy and clean, very friendly people specially Samjhana and Tenzin. If you want to find a place like home just come here..

This hotel is so good comparing to other 4 or 5 stars hotels in Pokhara! The location is excellent. The staffs are so kind and friendly it shows that they have right people in management especially the reception, there are several dishes in the breakfast buffet that changes everyday. The rooms are very spacious and will furnished and the prices are very suitable. If you're planning to stay somewhere in Pokhara I strongly suggest you stay in this hotel your family and your self will be very very happy.

Recently visited this hotel twice for business and leisure. It suits wonderfully for both purposes. Great service, quality of rooms and views of the mountains... look forward to more visits in the future

The manager to be sophisticated welcoming and still  homage to Nepal in wonderful ways.cozy bar the very pretty pool area and spa. The steam baths are amazing here went to totally refresh. It's a steam sauna which we love it's so relaxing and mellow you out after a day . I highly recommend this hotel where every thing is perfect. The food is delicious here the room were spectacular,and the ambiance of the courtyard just serene. Never in my life I have seen staff are very friendly and incredibly helpful so dedicate to the craft of service,everyone from chef to the server,manager turndown service you name. It was extremely accommodation and friendly in particular,general manager showed us the hotel .the multi-cuisine restaurant in housed adjacent to the main lobby area. we stayed for 2 days and really could have stayed longer, food is delicious we couldn't imagine staying anywhere else in pokhara.RoomStunning,room incredible design and comfort,everything just where you want it.big comfy beds,beautiful lighting ,steaming full force showers, fluffy towels exactly where the need to be........couches,desks.....a true home away from home,where you can spend time working in your room and simply enjoy the warm luxury.BarTight wine list to please all palates without overblowing the list,ample liquor cabinet,after dinner when it's 2c outside.Perfectly wonderful hotel for a holiday the hotel is in a great location and is good value quality/money. Breakfast was lovely a buffet  selection of cereals,pastries etc.I highly recommend this hotel everything was perfect the room was comfortable and clean with friendly environment and professional.Specially thanks to Mr. Dayaram,Kathmandu Grande sales team awesome  and the management for making our trip so special!!!!!! We will be back❤️ Ram

During the last visit in pokhara with my husband from Australia, we stayed in hotel grande. Spot on service. The front of the house were very welcoming. Well done team. The rooms were adequate and reasonable for the price you pay. Very neat and the housekeeping staffs were very helpful and seems to have decent knowledge about the touristic things in the city. Thank you again for making our stay enjoyable and memorable. We shall 100% be back, the next time we visit Nepal.

We stayed at this lovely hotel on 3 separate occasions, Excellent service from Front office managers specially Samjhana and Tenzin She was knowledgeable, very polite and went above and beyond to help us exceeding our expectations. They made sure that we get best service during our stay in the hotel. Full of energy and service with smile, who would not be happy to be treated like God. Location was superb, food was excellent, and highly professional staff service made us come back again and again. Definitely recommend this to all.Kesh RanaFrance.

Fantastic place to stay . Great friendly service from all staff .ideal location not far from airport,not far from the lake. The best view from the best suite . We have stayed in a Few hotels in Nepal but this was by far the best ... we will definitely be back in the near future  5 star service from 5 star staff

Stayed there  recently for three nights and had a very relaxing stay. Got a room with mountain view on the third floor and enjoyed the spectacular  view of fishtail and Annapurna range.staff were very friendly and specially Manager Roshan was very friendly and kind to us in many ways. i strongly recommend this place to stay and get refreshed.

Stayed there recently for 3 nights and had a very relaxing stay. Got for a room with mountain view on the second floor and enjoyed excellent view of the Annapurna range. Staff were very friendly and in particular Ms Tenzin, front desk manager, was very courteous and helpful. Room service was great and the food was very tasty in general. Buffet breakfast was reasonable but not lavish - they could have added some more options. Used the hotel travel desk quite a bit and found them very friendly and reasonably priced (in particular the travel desk manager)

Traveling in Nepal is always associated with low budget hotels and poor service. That's why I was so impressed to find such a gem like Pokhara Grande. From the first minutes, when a doorman opened the doors of our car, we realized we were at the right place, where the quality of service is taken seriously. Friendly and helpful staff, welcome drinks, escorting to the room and follow-up calls made us feel special and valuable. I must admit that the entire property is sparkling clean and well maintained. A stupa in the garden by the swimming pool is a beautiful addition to the property. Our room was very cozy and beds were extra comfortable. A special thanks to the staff for going an extra mile in arranging our breakfast and ensuring it was served even before the restaurant's opening time.Though Pokhara Grande is a big hotel, somehow you feel like at home there and this, without any doubt, is thanks to a great service and wonderful staff!

It was a great experience. Best quality service you can get around pokhara..Best location for mountain view. Dont forget to wake up little eary for breath taking mountain range in the morning. The changig colours of mountains with the fall of sunlight .. wow.. wow wow.. best part, food is really delicious..

Without even leaving your room you can get the most amazing views of the mountains . The staff are so thoughtful and helpful making you feel completely at home. I love the garden with the small stupa and swimming pool . And the food is delicious , I love coming to Pokhara Grande.

We stayed here for 2 nights.All the hotel staff were helpful polite and friendly. Our room was roomy and clean. The restaurant was adequate as I only had breakfast there it was good.I saw the Annapurna Range from the hotel roof amazing. We were made most welcome, thank you.

when you go to pokhara , plz visit pokhara grande and stay there, feel Super Service, Hospitality,Supportive, Comfy beds, Spacious room and  Nice view with big garden.i used hotel's Seminar hall and Parking free of cost. so don't mised this  great opptunity @ hotel grand service.

The hotel has nice big rooms and also has one of the best view of Annapurna range. The breakfast is fair enough as well. The house keeping was poor at responding. We were there in a big group and that is why they might be super occupied, but I did not received any of the things I requested. The toiletries needs some fix as well. The beds are comfortable though. Internet works fine. The location is not very appropriate as you need to take a taxi or other means of transportation to go to lake side.

Fantastic location and amazing hospitality.Sanjay at the restaurant deserves a special mention .... amazing person.As much as rooms go, opt for the mountain facing one .... and do not miss the sunrise ....

Ask for a room with view of the Annapurna mountain range, and hope for good weather! Best in the hotel is the tour and activity desk Grande Holiday. Great service - if you need a guide for hiking the area or trips in the city then ask for Saraswati Thapa, a wonderful young lady that is very knowlegable of the area and nepali culture. Tours with her are fun and educational.

Stayed for 2 nights there, the hotel is nice and quiet. The room is big and clean. The staffs are very helpful and the service is superb ! I will definitely stay here again the next time I come to Pokhara again !

Positive:- Cleanliness- Super Service- Hospitality - Supportive- Comfy beds- Spacious room- Nice view with big garden(Best for nature lover & kids)- Food was ok.Negative:- Hot water supply available only for certain time.- free wifi available only at lobby

We arrived at the Grande after being in a 3rd. grade backpacking hotel in the back blocks . And we're quite distraught when we finally arrived in the lobby of the Grande where we were met by Ms. Samjhana who was very understanding and showed is around and was able to book us in. The room was fantastic with a panoramic view of the Annapurna range. The service and friendliness was outstanding.For a senior couple it was like spending 4 days in heavenly peace. Thank you all, but especially Samjhana

Stayed two nights here. Large rambling hotel, with clean comfortable rooms and two restaurants. Staff are very attentive and helpful, arranging taxis for us to go into town.Really nice food (we ate in the downstairs restaurant) and generous breakfasts.Beware! The hotel is popular with large Chinese tour groups and they can tend to take over everything (rather noisily!) However this shouldn't detract from the fact that this is a very good hotel.

We were there as part of a Riviera tour to India and Nepal. The food was good, rooms spacious and clean, the housekeeping generally was excellent. We were particularly impressed with a local tour we made via the desk in the hotel.We were met by a local guide called sacha who took us up into the mountains to visit a village and a particular house and family in it. We were looked after very well and got to see the way of life. After the trip my wife asked Sacha if there was anywhere she could try on a Sari. Sacha then took us to her home to meet her family and try on one of her mum's saris. They also fed us with delicious curry and omelettes. We were not asked for any money, and their hospitality was superb. I persuaded Sacha to take a gift from us.I would really recommend the hotel, the company providing the local trips and most importantly the local guide Sacha.

I enjoyed my stay for two nights at this hotel with my Group, all the staff are very cooperative, very helpful and attentive. We loved the food and so much varieties at lunch, dinner and breakfast. Very friendly atmosphere, nice rooms, would love to come here again!

We had a great stay in Pokhara Grande after a trekking tour. Had some sunny days at the pool. Rooms, pool, garden and other areas were very clean. We felt so comfortable. Staff is very nice and helpful. We really enjoyed our stay. I definitely recommend the hotel.

The hotel is housed in a rather large property. The rooms were a part of a separate, slightly newly constructed block. But much of the hotel's amenities were old and dated. The swimming pool, for example, was large but seemed rather ill-maintained. The breakfast buffet was good. In-room dining was a case of some hits and a few misses. Stick to Nepali/Indian food and you shan't regret. The travel desk is manned by a rather helpful chap who offered us decent rates for various activities.

The personnel in the hotel is very friendly and helpful! We came on a honey moon trip and received a delicious surprise of the personnel of the hotel... The rooms are very comfortable, the swimming pool so nice with the nice weather and we have an amazing view on the himalayas from the hotel room. The personnel definitely makes the difference, and based upon our experience we would certainly recommend this hotel!

We had a lovely room with beautiful view of the mountains. We received beyond excellent service from Tenzin who is the guest relations officer, she provided with everything we needed.We were very comfortable and the hotel food is great along with other staff who also were very courteous.The hotel provided us with great doctor as well. We will definietly recommmend this hotel to anyone.

What a wonderful location. On a clear morning see the sunrise over Fishtail and the Annapurna Range.Comfortable rooms, good cuisine, decent conference and banqueting facilities, smart and very helpful staff.

We are really glad that Pokhara Grande incorporated our request to improve some of their service and products as per our feedback. Our CPS event would not have been successful without the immense support of Pokhara Grande. Everyone parred the standard. Great team work!!!!

We recently organized 4 days retreat cum workshop at Pokhara Grande. I must say what a grand success it was. It was all possible with the support, devotion, professionalism and hard work from Pokhara Grande family. There was not a single moment where we felt unattended and deceived. Whole event went as planned and as promised by Pokhara Grande family. Great location, really pleasant and clean rooms, but the thing that makes this such a good place to stay and organize a event are the staff. All of the people are incredibly helpful and generous with their time and advice.Not to forget about the food, it was amazingly delicious. So, in overall, we had a great and memorable time in Pokhara Grande and It is undoubtedly a first choice to organize an event or to stay in Pokhara in coming days.

Stayed 4 days on office retreat and was a pleasant and comfortable stay. From prompt email response to smaller details the hotel had provided to accommodate the request was wonderful. From the management to minor staff, everyone was trying their best to accommodate our requests. My some feedbacks for better improvement- Pool needs bit of upgrade. Day lockers advised for in-house guests.- Safety Lockers in room a must.- Toiletries needs to be changed and replenished daily.- My room minibar rack door had broken on hinges.  - Bathroom sink was stained.As an avid traveler moreover satisfied in the stay overall. Was amazed and thankful to management for arranging vehicle to-from lakeside even after midnight. Keep up the good service and keep on your best efforts, Pokhara Grande will definitely be THE best business in town.

The Hotel Grande Pokhara, best around the Pokhara. It is nearest from Pokhara Airport.The Accommodation and overall management of hotel was excellent.Can view the natural beauty from the hotel.The hotel have sufficient area for roaming.

The hotel was in an excellent location with easy access to areas of interest. The hotel guest room was finished to a high specification and extremely comfortable and clean. The staff were excellent being both efficient and curteous. The concierge staff did a great job for us when checking out.P.s :- Best Food.....will return soon.

We stayed here 2 nights, 3 days apart, they stored our luggage while we hiked and came back.  Excellent food and service.  Good location, close to the airport.  Airport transfer available on request.  Beautiful ambiance.

The view was amazing from the room and service was excellent. The location was very convenient and peaceful. The lunch and dinner was very delicious. The pool was very clean. The lake is in a walking distance. The people around the neighborhood are very helpful and kind.

Wonderful stay at pokhara grande. The hotel is beautiful. The ground and hotel decoration is requisite. The food is fresh and delicious and staff were very courteous and friendly. The rooms are lovely with comfortable beds and very clean. Special  thanks to mr Naresh Mahat. He made us feel so welcome from the Minute .Highly recommend a stay here.we stay in room 248.special thank you mr Kaushal Silwal.

A/C, pool, comfy beds, yummy food and drinks and the BEST staff ever!!! I recently checked out of a 2+ week stay at the Pokhara Grande and don't remember when I've had a better hotel experience while traveling.  The staff is beyond friendly and courteous and helped me with small details that came up on my trip.  The awesome women behind the reception counter smiled and greeted me every time I walked by and actually became friends during my stay.. They were interested in my experience there in Pokhara and I was sad to say good bye. I will 4 of these women VERY much! The travel and trip desk at the hotel is amazing.  I did many of the experiences that they offer and each was more amazing than the one before.  The guides they arranged for me to trek with were perfect and knew the countryside 100%.  The prices were very fair and they were SO accommodating.  With Cars/ drivers arranged and trekking trips planned, the desk at the hotel is the perfect "fun" concierge. The rooms are very nicely appointed, the food and the restaurant staff were perfect and I was sad to say goodbye to my special server at bfast as well as the full bfast buffet (included in the room rate) When you enter and leave the property, the very courteous security staff will salute you each time.  That was a first for me. If you visit Pokhara, stay here.  You absolutely won't regret it!!   I'll be back in March!

It was an amazing experience staying at Pokhara Grande. ..superb Staff..especially dinning section...who took care of our smallest needs...Than once again..vl love to come again...they arranged for special delicious veg food everytime...we were there for 5 days....and they tried to serve something different everyday....they arranged for a special c u again eggless cake on the last day...vch touched our hearts..

Hi All, I am just about to finish my latest stay in Nepal and I thought you would appreciate some feedback about the hotels I stayed in. I arrived in Pokhara from Kathmandu by car, for those of you that have taken that particular drive, you know that it is not for the faint of heart! LOLAs always my destination in Pokhara was the Pokhara Grand Hotel. My reservation was confirmed while I was in the U.S., but they were kind enough to contact me when I arrived in country to let me know that they would be ready to receive me whenever I arrived. So there was no fear of getting there too soon and there be no available room for 2 to 5 hours later.When I arrived I felt that the staff were genuinely happy to see me and wasted no time in processing me in and showing me to my room. Because I have visited the Pokhara Grand Hotel so many times in the past, they even remembered by room preference and informed me that the room was available if I wanted to spend my time there. Because of the commanding view of the Himalayan Mountains from “my room” I excepted the offer and most mornings was greeted with one of the best views Nepal has to offer!In addition to the world class service the staff provided me during my stay, I noticed an upgrade to the equipment in the hotel’s fitness center. What I found interesting was the fact that while most hotels in Pokhara don’t have fitness center, the Pokhara Grand Hotel has added a Universal Machine that should appeal to both the novice and serious athlete. They have also added western style dumbbell. For those of you that don’t know, these dumbbells offer a wider space between the weights, so those of us with larger hands can get a better grip! They even have a staff member ready to give you a work-out towel or act as a spotter on the weight bench. So if you are looking for the right place to work off the travel tension, the stress of the day or want to sustain your fitness level while on vacation, this is the hotel for you.I could go on about the quality of their food, the quickness of their room service or the 24 hour security offered at the Pokhara Grand Hotel, but this is just the level of quality I have come to expect from everyone here.24 hour Security, Family Friendly, Clean Room, Clean Sheets, Clean Hot Water, Good Food, Friendly Attentive Staff, what more could a weary traveler to Nepal ask for? As the saying goes, “You get what you pay for”. What are you paying for? Are you getting it? Check out the Pokhara Grand Hotel, you will not be disappointed!

I went on a wrong time shortly after earthquake, guests were very few, still they managed to provide good service. View from the room is amazing. Lake side is a bit far but airport is too near then. A nice place to stay or arrange any sort of conferences. Good food, good service and good rooms.

Nice place, nice hotel with friendly staffs. food is delicious. With nice swimming pool. Great spa service. My wife and myself enjoy the stay very much. If I back in pokhara again, i should stay in this hotel again..

Just returned from a stay at the Pokhara Grande which was a relief after the jungle camp.  OK you can only get hot water a couple of hours in the morning and again at night but this is to be expected in Nepal,  The hotel had all the facilities one could want with great bar snacks and a nice pool.  I would recommend a stay at this hotel,  It is a short taxi ride to Lakeside where all the shops and restaurants are and where you can get a boat on Phewa Lake.

A good resort type property with swimming pool & spa. With direct view of mountains this provides a wholesome experience. Very courteous staff and a well organised desk for travel and short trip including adventure tours is a big plus. Kids would love this for the wonderful lawn and a good room size. Excellent dining and quiet surrounding for the ones looking for peace. Clean room, lobby and common area is definitely a plus.On the negative, a bit away from the lake side ( the main tourist hub) while it is closer to the airport. Food and room service is somewhat expensive.

Having traveled India staying in so called 5 star hotels what a relief to find this little gem! Spotless room and grounds beautiful clean lovely smelling linen and towels. Attentive staff , good food and a brilliant car service which when you are two blondes is good to feel safe traveling to lakeside. Even limited hot water was no problem. Room service excellent large portions ! I could get used to being saluted ! Pool attendance excellent as all staff ! Had wonderful view of mountains from our room flowers on bed at night nice ! Oh and joy air con . Quiet!! Can recommend highly enough! Sue . Hemsby Norfolk

After SAARC summit in Pokhara Grande, I want to find out what are the reasons this important event being host in this hotel which I never heard of, so I decided to bring my wife and kids for a 3 days 2 nights trip to experience PG.The overall stay was great! the room was nice and clean, the services were excellent. The only down side is the location which is not so closed to lakeside (10 mins drive). Anyway I had a great private time with family to enjoy the pool and gym facility, the food here was actually pretty good. By the way, they have a very big conference room and few medium and small size meeting rooms which also be a good destination for company trip.

Stay here for 4 days 3 nights. The room is nice, service is excellent, spa is good, nice swimming pool. Most important the food here is awesome, really like the muffin and banana cake for breakfast. Next time I will bring my whole family here once again.

This was a very nice hotel with good service and amenities. As expected in Nepal, the service was great, with friendly helpful staff making sure we got whatever we needed. Breakfast buffet with good but not as lavish as we've seen in other Nepalese hotels.

This being our maiden trip to pokhara, we didn't know what to expect. But the moment we landed in pokhara airport ( we took a flight on Buddha air from Kathmandu) , the very beautiful mountainous surroundings told us that we were in for lots of beautiful moments. First the hotel... Pokhara grande was a lovely hotel with very amiable staff. Special mention goes to Anita who made sure our stay there was comfortable and was very accommodating. The facilities were good. And it's a very very safe hotel. With good security. For our next trip to pokhara, pokhara grande will definitely be our choice.

Stayed here two nights on Riviera Tour of Nepal. Our room was in modern block which was situated via a walk through the gardens. Nice comfortable clean room. Meals served in main bit of hotel in upstairs restaurant, good buffet breakfast and order menu for lunch and dinner. Staff all very polite pleasant and helpful. Small swimming pool with sunbeds. From roof accessed via main block you get fantastic view of the mountains. Only disappointment was free wi fi which was so slow it didn't work, on asking at reception was informed if opt for paid version it's faster!!

Stayed here for four nights.. The rooms are good. The services are efficient and the staff is friendly, cooperative, friendly and helpful.  Electic load shedding was awful but understandable and hence acceptable. Breakfast quality needs improvement but the service of the staff was excellent. Nothing to complain, all for praise only

Very nice hotel. Nice and clean. Rooms are good and food delicious. Great garden as well as swimming pool. Staffs are very polite. Nice environment and next to airport too. In my next visit I will definitely stay in this hotel.

Once through the guarded gate you enter through an open, airy lobby with an adjacent travel/activities desk. This is well worth checking out. I tried the Avia Aero Club which offers micro light flights from the nearby airport. You can pay for 15, 30 or 60 minutes flight. My advice is to go for either the shortest or longest. The shortest gives you the experience, the longest gets you close to the mountain range.The bedroom was very comfortable and spacious. An extensive range of satellite TV is on offer. There were some oldish fittings in the bathroom. There is a small but attractive pool with a good area for relaxing. We stayed in the extension, accessed by walking past the pool. There is an extremely smartly dressed soldier on guard twenty four hours a day. As you approach the door is opened and you are treated to an immaculate salute. Not having served in the military, what is the correct response??? This happens every time you pass by. Overall I would rate this as a happy hotel - happy to been there and they are happy to have you.

I stayed here as part of a package holiday and the two nights I stayed the hotel was virtually empty because of the fuel restrictions in Nepal and the fact that the earthquake had put a lot of tourists off. The hotel was lovely the staff very helpful at organising extra activities. The restaurant was poor. The food was bland and the choices very limited. I think maybe the restrictions on food by India did not help matters here. It's very close to the Lakeside area where the shops are varied and very cheap for mountain clothes. I really enjoyed my stay in Pokhara and feel sorry for the tourist industry there.

Hi All,Just finished my latest stay in Nepal (33 days) and I thought you guys would like to get an update on a great hotel in Pokhara, Nepal the Pokhara Grand. Because Nepal is experiencing a major fuel shortage, rather than fly, it was cheaper for my companions and I to drive from Kathmandu to Pokhara.  Pokhara Grand Hotel: It is difficult to describe the mental release you feel when you arrive at this hotel. I don’t know why, but as we pulled up to the lobby area, the tension of the drive from Kathmandu, the 21 hours from ATL to Dubai and then into Kathmandu all seemed to fall away. I felt more like returning home than checking into a hotel! Although I last saw the staff of the Pokhara Grand back in May, (In the mists’ of that devastating earthquake!) I felt that familiar ease that comes from being around people that want to be around you!As I stated earlier, Nepal was going through a major furl crises during this visit, fortunately the shortage did not affect me during my stay at the Pokhara Grand. The Room Service: The Pokhara Grand offered 5 Star quality food on their room service menu. The selections were easy to understand and were as good as I remembered from previous visits. My room was cleaned daily and any personal items left tossed around the room were collected and neatly stacked or folded.Laundry Service: There are “cheaper” hotels that do not offer laundry services and for some that do, you can never be sure of where or what kind of water they washed your unmentionables in.   Yes, some places will tell you that the new smell in your “just washed cloths” is just the way things smell in Nepal. NOT TRUE! All my laundry was returned ironed, folded and smelling fresh. Oh, and I never had to do battle for a missing sock, what I turned in I got back!Gym: Some of us like to stay in shape when on vacation. So far I have not encountered a larger gym in Pokhara than the one I used at the Pokhara Grand. They have free weights, recumbent bikes and yes treadmills. They also have enough space that you are not spending most of your time bumping into fellow fat-burners. The gym opens daily at 06:00 hrs.’ and is a great way to work off the lingering effects of jet-lag! The hotel offers me free WI FI and its staff were available to help with any connection problems.I travel a lot and there is a certain standard I have come to expect, A.K.A. You get what you paid for!•	You will never see me wandering Pokhara all my positions on my back because it’s not safe to leave my valuables in my hotel room. The Pokhara Grand Has trained security personnel on duty 24/7 and there are security cameras in the halls of all floors to insure security and to notify the hotel staff of any problems in any area of the buildings.•	When it’s time to do to sleep, I like the Pokhara Grand’s stand-alone location. Because the hotel sits on its’ own plot of land and is not flanked or boxed in by other hotels, you can enjoy a good night’s sleep, not rowdy tourist partying the night away! Additionally, I feel that this “stand-alone feature was also a benefit during the earthquake earlier this year. There was no debris from adjacent to fall on the hotel or its guest. This is was my third visit to Pokhara and my third stay at the Pokhara Grand! I intend to return in May of 2016. I highly recommend this hotel to those of you that want to experience all that Pokhara has to offer and at the end of the day come back to the only truly luxury hotel in Pokhara, Nepal. This hotel offers a safe and secure place to sleep, a clean room, clean sheets, hot water and hot chow! Or, you can be one of those lost souls that wander around Lake Side, (popular tourist trap filled with overpriced shops, bars and hotels) with those large, ridiculous looking backpacks carrying all your possessions to your next night’s lodging!Finally: I am sharing my experiences at the Pokhara Grand with you so that you won’t have to waste your time looking for your next hotel in Nepal. A hotel away from all the tourist traps and offers a good product at a fair price! I have found the staff to be professionals with a clear understanding as to how to keep their guest happy and thus ensuring return business. This trip I was in Nepal for 33 days, I spent 28 of those in Pokhara at the Pokhara Grand. This really is an excellent hotel!

We had 2 nights after a week off tracking in the mountains. The hotel have all you need to relax. perfect and clean rooms. The staff was very nice ( Specially restaurant staff her name is Sabita) nice and make me happy .  And the food was OK .

This is a lovely hotel set within pretty gardens, about 10 minutes drive from the Lakeside area where all the restaurants and shops are located. The reception area is magnificent and the hotel is well looked after. Our room was very comfortable and the views of the mountains stunning!!! Hot water was limited for certain hours during the day due to the current fuel crisis. Free wifi was good .The food was slightly limited and disappointing again due to the fuel crisis.The staff were very helpful and very apologetic for the shortages in the hotel due to the fuel crisis.

The hotel is situated in a quiet area of Pokhara 10 min drive or 30 min walk to Lakeside the area where shops, restaurants and bars are located.We stayed in room 348 an extremely comfortable room with the most amazing view of the snow capped Annapurna mountain range. The bed was super comfortable and the room facilities were good.The staff were excellent, informative, curteous and had good hotel service skills. We reported a broken room safe within 10 mins it had been repaired.There is a small outdoor pool with only a few sun beds, a cosy bar serving good cocktails, a spa and large restaurant. The buffet breakfast and dinner were limited but well presented.Free WiFi is available in public areas but reception is slow.We had a wonderful stay and would have no hesitation in recommending this hotel to others.

The staff are simply the best I have met. They went out of their way in helping us, especially since we have a active 4.5 year old. Pool is decent and the internet speed good. Only areas to improve is the breakfast range (not buffet presumably due to low turnout owing to recent Nepal earthquake) and not converting left over Nepalese currency to US $ or other currency. Definitely recommend the hotel to families.

The hotel is just 1 KM away from the airport, has beatiful location, work guest service, helpful staff. I was recommended by Ms. Riya who is the Manager (Corporate Sales) and it was a worth recommendation. I rooms, restaurant, gym all were excellent.Must go place for everyone

The restaurant is the best part of the hotel. The menu is short but the food is tasty and price reasonable.Don't try the spa. It is truely a dissapointment! The prices are rip off level but the service sucs!

Stayed in the Pokhara Grande for 5 nights - loved it! Awesome staff! One of the best hotels in Nepal. Clean bathrooms!! Beautiful views. The hotel is situated slightly away from town centre, peaceful and quiet. The staff organises a taxi in minutes!

We stayed in the hotel for 3 nights. Room was clean and neat, hotel has decent and cordial staff. Rooms were spacious and there is enough space around the hotel for a morning walk. Garden around the hotel is very pleasant and I liked the entire setup. Only issue that we faced was the air conditioner which never worked. With the weather so hot during day time, it isn't so easy to stay without air conditioner and added to our misery the rooms doesn't have fan.

We drove to Pokhara from Lucknow in 2014 and stayed in Pokhara Grande.  The hotel is plush and offers breathtaking views of the fish tail mountain. The swimming pool is small but well maintained.  The kids had a whale of a time in the pool area.  The shops in the hotel offer good memorabilia. The rooms are cosy and have all the amenities.  The tariff includes morning breakfast. You can pamper your body at the spa too. Good Hotel to stay

My son and I decided to visit Nepal on the advice of a friend who runs a hospital system in Western Nepal. Most travelers to Pokhara cancelled their plans to stay in Pokhara because of the April earthquake. It's been 2 months since most hotels, guides, drivers and villagers have seen tourists. The locals hope the lack of tourists is an off season issue, not a problem come the popular October through January high season. We have not had any problems traveling from Kathmandu to Pokhara. The Pokhara Grande Hotel has been very attentive to our time here, from the housekeeping staff to the waitstaff in the dining room to the front desk.The Travel Desk arranged a guide and driver for 3 days of hiking. Though my son is young and fit, I needed more help in finishing the daily hikes. The guide called the driver when I had had enough walking, driving us to the spectacular views and safely back to the hotel.When I had a health issue, the driver took my son, a doctor, to a local teaching hospital where he secured medications for me.It was a good choice to stay at the Pokhara Grande. It's open for business and happy to help you make your stay a great experience.

This was my fourth trip to Nepal and my second stay at this hotel. I spent my first two visits in Kathmandu.I recommend this hotel to families, couples or even friends wanting to experience Pokhara and adventures its surrounding countryside. Although the prices of the hotel rooms were higher than most hotels in the area, you get what you paid for, (more on that later). My room was clean, without that third-world stale smell! Fresh fruit and free water was in my room when I arrived. The room had an air conditioner as oppose to a fan and the unit was quit and easy to operate. The towels smelled fresh and so did the water, (hardcore travelers will understand). Room service always arrived prior to their estimated time, and there was no requirement nor expiation of a tip! Breakfast was buffy style. The dishes were varied, offering both Western and local foods. The customer service in the restaurant, like that of the rest of the hotel was more like that of a five star hotel in the U.S. or the U.K.!I was in the Pokhara Grand on 25 April 2015 when the earthquake struck the country. Hotel personnel were quick to evacuate the buildings and then conduct a door-to-door search looking for stray guest. Their staff were professional, calm and none of the guest sustained injured because of the quake nor the aftershocks.I chose the Pokhara Grand for two major reasons: 1. While in Pokhara, I wanted to stay in a safe and secure hotel that offered enough security to allow me to leave my valuables in my room without the fear of thief. The hotel has no fewer than four security personnel on duty at all times. Additionally, I intend to return to Nepal in the fall and plan to stay in Pokhara. Thanks to the high level of security and excellent customer service, I will be bringing my wife on that visit.  2. As I mentioned earlier, the rooms were priced above some of the older hotels in the city. However, during the earthquake, The Pokhara Grand’s solid construction and the fact that it did not have old buildings surrounding it contributed to its guest not suffering the same fate as some of the patrons of the hotels that dot most of the city streets in the Lake Side area. I am not saying that there is anything wrong with a room that cost only $35.USD, but as I said, “You get what you pay for.” Sometimes it IS worth spending the extra money to know that you and your family are going to be safe.For this visit, I was at the Pokhara Grand for 30 days. I would recommend this hotel to anyone who does not have time to worry about  being safe in their own rooms, who knows that all of the hotel staff are trained professionals and that the food will always be prepared any way you want it. I would also recommend this hotel because it offers the best overall value for business personnel conducting business in the Pokhara area.I give the Pokhara Grand an EXCELLENT!Herman

Hotel was in  beautiful city Pokhara. The room was big and very comfortable bed as well nice bathroom. View from the room was excellent which you can see direct fewa lake.Food at restaurant also excellent with great service staffs.

1st impressions of Pokhara are not great , but all the good stuff is at the lakeside and this hotel is well situated to reach there. One can walk but taxi is only 300 nrs , under normal circs ideal... However we were handed the opportunity to walk due a bandha ( general strike ) so no traffic at all. V. Pleasant walk ( about 1 hr) and shops , bars restaurants plentiful and most open for tourists.Hotel room was large and fine, wonderful views of mountains in morning,as well as airport and mini Stupa in hotel grounds .Drinks prices were the highest anywhere we encountered in India or Nepal but no problem as it is fine to go out in Nepal and prices on lakeside are very good. Restaurant is a bit cafe like , which is fine for breakfast but a bit naff at night.Hotel have a bizarre insistence on signing for EVERY drink, they missed off a wine from our bill and came to room at 11pm for signature despite the do not disturb sign,having already called by phone when we said we,d sort it in morning- most odd.Well located for Annapurna sunrise and some nice walks outside .The town grew on us more than the hotel.Wi-fi is 750nrs a day but at least it works.

We checked in late night so thought that the hotel seems to be an average property. But when we woke up in the morning the view from our window was breathtaking. Awesome rooms, nice restaurant, courteous staff and above all its location was worth staying. The travel desk organizes all the important sightseeing. I suggest people that please do not prebook your sightseeing as most of the travel agent provides you the basic sightseeing which is kind of avoidable except Fewa Lake and Mahadev Caves and Devi's fall. We almost spent the whole day doing 4-5 points. Next day early morning we went for sunrise point at Sarangkot through the hotel travel desk and it was worth every penny. I have never seen such a beautiful sunrise and shades changing mountains of Himalayan range i.e. Mt.Fishtail and Mt.Annapurna. the best sunrise I have ever seen in my life. Don't miss it.Further the paragliding is said to be one of the world best. We were short of time so missed it but if you plan it well you can enjoy all the major activities fully. The only minus of this hotel was they don't have free wifi.
This hotel is so horrible.Rooms are OKRestaurant is really bad,Taste is horriblePresentation is horribleQuality is very very poorOver chargedSays free WiFi and they ask for 750 Nepali rupees a day.

The hotel is amazing and is one of the best hotels in Pokhara. You will find this hotel sold out most of times as this is the only 5 star/4 star superior hotel in Pokhara however the only drawback is the location. Lakeside is around 20 min of walk or can hire a taxi which will cost 300 rupee. Many options available on Lakeside such as Lake side resort and Lake view resort. The accessibility of everything is nearby if you choose other hotels as mentioned above. Reat if you are not concerned about location, this is an amazing hotel to stay !!!

i reached hotel at about 9:00pm at night were tired from long journey got our keys and i got the best feeling seeing the Hotel Room. friendly and helpful working staffs, enjoyed the buffet breakfast early morning.i liked the hotel

We have been home 2 weeks after an amazing trip to India and Nepal. We stayed 2 nights at this hotel at the end of the holiday. Unfortunately my wife was taken ill on the morning we were due to leave having collapsed in the restaurant after breakfast. The staff were immediately on the case, making her comfortable and a doctor was called who arrived promptly. My wife was then taken to hospital in the hotel Mini-Bus and one of the hotels senior staff (Muna Rana Koirala) stayed with us in hospital while my wife was being treated. After 3 hours we returned to the hotel where our room was still made available to us and food and drinks were sent up while we awaited the time to leave for our rearranged flight back to Kathmandu. The Hotel organised a car to take us to the airport. The Hotel staff were all very kind, helpful and attentive ( my wifes condition was nothing to do with the hotel food or conditions I must add) and could have done nothing more for us. Great service and friendliness during what was a very stressful time. Thank you all at the Pokhara Grande!

Hotel is a bit far away from center and lake side so need to take a taxi to go out. Staff is nice, rooms are very good (clean, large and confortable) with some of them a nice view on the mountains. Restaurant is not that good, looks more like a cantine, very noisy and food is not great. Hotel is cold and hot water for information is only available in the morning and evening (not during day time)

This is hardly a five star hotel, but having said that you don't exactly pay 5-star prices so can't complain too much. The best thing is the amazing view of the Annapurna range with Fishtail mountain right there in the centre. Waking up to that view was the main reason we enjoyed our stay here. Wi fi was free and you have two coupons for two devices per room. It worked fine, but then wi fi is free and available everywhere in Pokhara. The front office staff were exceptionally polite and helpful and all the days we were there, we had a complimentary drop off to the Lakeside. The travel desk again was very helpful and we were very happy with the trips we organised through them. Breakfast was ok but this is not exactly a place you would want to have any other meals: A ten minute drive to lakeside and you have many to choose from.

I had stayed in the hotel with my friends. No free wifi in room? The hotel says free wifi only in hotel bar, When I tried to get free wifi in the bar the waiters said please ask in hotel's front office, I asked there. The front office said to ask in the bar. When I asked again in the bar, the waiters said that 'we dont know the password, only our manager knows'. later one lady came and typed wifi password on my divice. Quite bad system. before that we had payed NRS 750 for 24 hours and got wifi password in room. but for only one divice. When we shut down divice A to use divece B, We should wait 10 minuts. another bad system in 5 star hotel. WHY NOT FREE WIFI ? Another bad is noise from another room. There is single door between 2 rooms. every noise share to each others. Otherwise, hotel is good. big bed and rooms. service is excellent. free breakfast. 10 min (by taxi) far from lake side.

Pokhara Grande is just a brilliant hotel - courteous staff; clean, comfortable and well maintained rooms; and delicious breakfasts! The most memorable are the beautiful views of the Annapurna Range from our mountain facing room! Imagine waking up each day to viewing those spectacular snow-capped mountains! Its truly a class apart within an affordable price! The hotel has a very good location - it is away from the hustle-bustle of the lake side and hence, allows for nice, quiet time if that's what you are looking for!Highly recommended!!

I paid for my stay on Expedia, however when leaving was told that this had not been done and i had to pay again.. unable to confirm at the time i accepted this and paid. I was happy to leave the double payment as a credit but after 4 months decided to ask for a refund.. this has still not happened despite emails saying it has been done.. NOT GOOD ENOUGH

I happened to visit Pokhara Grande twice during 2 annual conferences of our organisation. One of the most beautiful properties in Pokhara. Ideal for business conferences. Courteous staff. Himalaya view rooms- plan a visit in November for best view. Adventure sports counter at hotel reception for adrenaline junkies. Average room service.Give your pockets a small hole and they will make sure you remember them!

We stayed here as a part of our channel partner conference. Amazing location and well laid out. entering the premises gives you a real hotel feel. the food spread is awesome. the swimming pool is great. the lush green lawns and the spread out vast lobby gives you lot of calmness.the best thing about the hotel which I simply love is the awesome views from the terrace of the Himalayas- the famed Fish Tail peak and Annapurna ranges. also since the hotel is in the approach landing path of aircrafts, expect lot of high decibel noises as planes of different sizes simply whizz past you. you can simply hang out on the terrace top viewing the Himalayas. There is a well equipped and well informed travel desk which takes care of your needs for aerial adventures for which Pokhara is famous for. however the internet is not available for free and is quite expensive. The hotel due to its popularity is usually full for the most of the year and hence you need to book early to avoid any last minute disappointments.

Good Hotel property. Excellent food, remarkable service, stunning views of the annapoorna ranges. a bit far from the lake, 30-45 mins walk or need to take a cab. very good pool and health club facilities. very relaxing atmosphere with very good spread of newari, indian and chinese cuisine.

After our trek, I practically kissed the ground of the lobby at arrival.  Yes, I'm a hotel snob.  Dealing with teahouses and nightmare inducing bathrooms for 5 days was more than I can handle.  Pokhara Grande was like heaven on earth.  The staff was very responsive and friendly.  Definitely will recommend to friends.

I stayed at pokhara grande for 12 days as I could not go on my ABC trek because I broke my fifth metatarsal. I have to say I was so disappointed about it however my stay at pokhara grande was so enjoyable I was made so welcome and was cared for so well that when the time came to leave I felt I was leaving my family. I highly recommend this hotel.

We had a suite , as a free up grade which was a nice surprise as it wasn't requested. It was very big, clean and tidy .. The TV's were old and small, but bed was huge and very good . Staff kept the room very well stocked with water and lots of towels. It's a fairly typical large hotel , lacked atmosphere and I would say plenty of room for improvement by the management .. Bar was very badly stocked and it took 20mins to get served, food was expensive and not great, it was much better to eat out . Overall I would say there would be much better smaller hotels to chose from in Pokhara !!

This to me was the best hotel for comfort and luxury that we stayed in in Nepal. Our room was larger than my apartment in England ! Decent TV stations too with varied movie channels in English  :)The service though was not as good as anywhere else we stayed. Food and drink orders were very slow and often wrong apart from at breakfast when it's buffet self service and they only have to bring your coffee. There is a pool and spa here also so great for relaxing after a long days walking and sightseeing

the hotel is set in large well manicured grounds close to the airport, but a fair distance from the lake. we stayed 2 nights in a suite and had a large lounge room and a separate large bedroom both with a tv.  the bed had comfortable bedding and nice luxury touches.  food in the hotel was ok, not exceptional, but nothing to complain about. pool was clean but a little cold. there was only free WIFI in the bar area which was a bit of a pain but the signal was quite strong. like much of Nepal the hotel was prone to regular power cuts.

I had a nice experience at this hotel when I stayed for 2 nights in the last week.We received a warm welcome at the reception.The rooms are large and neat,clean and comfortable.The staff was very co-operative to provide you any information that we needed.The food quality was excellent.As we are vegetarians we however had a limited choice.The spread of breakfast can be improved.Our overall experience was more than satisfactory and I will surely recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Pokhra.

Pokhara Grande was the first place that we had stayed in after reaching Nepal.It was a nice place to stay and the food was also very good.We enjoyed our stay there as the stay was comfortable and pleasant.

Pokhara Grande is located away from the rather touristy lakeside area but this is only a short distance away if you want to sightsee or eat there.Well appointed, clean and comfortable. Views of Annapurna range. Very good food. Very good service from staff.We enjoyed our stay here and would recommend it to anyone.

The location of the hotel offers an excellent view of Annapurna snow ladden mountain range. Hotel is very nice, stay was excellent. The food quality is not at all matching the hotel standard of 4/5 star. The indian food and even the continental one was not so great. the main reason, as it appears is lack of training and skills.

Stayed here for 4 nights. Overall a good property, clean and comfortable. However the location is not very desirable as it is quite far from the lakeside where all the restaurants and shopping is located. Absolutely no restaurants or eateries close to this hotel. USP of this hotel are the stunning views of the Annapurna range from your room. Buffet breakfast could also be improved.Anita, the customer service manager was very hospitable and organized a cake for our wedding anniversary. Hotel also gave us a complimentary drop to the airport. No free wifi in rooms, only in lobby area.

Peaceful and calming place to rest after adrenaline activities in Pokhara. All round pleasant experience stay at the hotel.Laundry service's awesome! Restaurant buffet selection can be improved thou as there's not much variety to choose from at between meals.

Stayed in the second week of Aug 2014, for 2 nights. This is a large modern property with great views of the Annapurna Ranges.While most people tend to think that Pokhara is all about the lake, that is far from the truth.This hotel aims at catering primarily to groups for large Corporate events, and other large groups and succeeds in providing all that is needed for this purpose.Plans are afloat to make it plusher.More activities could be offered to counter the distance from the lake.

One of my best 2 nights I stayed in Hotel Pokhara Grande.Nice, helpful and happy staff. Welcome drink upon arrival. Smiling faces everywhere.Heavy rain, but they provide umbrella to reach to our room through the garden. Guards do help to open the gates and the umbrella. Nice rooms with a beautiful garden view. Swimming pool is closed. Spa is available. Many shops as well. Breakfast is fine. Wifi is free in the lobby but expensive in the rooms. 750 rupees per day. They did 15% discount to us.Overall it's a great experience. Highly recommended.

Pokhara being the heart of the country everybody expect to stay in nice place for their holiday. So I feel pokhara grade has reached my whole expectation. The rooms, resturant, gift shop every thing inside the hotels was nice. The service given to me was nice. They invite me to there hotel with great hospitality and love.

Good Hotel, friendly service, very good Hotel restaurant, relaxing swimming pool and good massage.  Only the wifi in the rooms had to be paid extra for, and way too much!  Wifi in Lobby and Resto for free, making it Possible not to order the room wifi .  The mixed spring rolls we advise!

The rooms are great, but do stay in the main building, the annex does not seem to be quite finished, beds are comfy. Bathroom is quite spascious and clean. f you do get a superiour room you will get cookies, eat them! they are to die for!! And if you are to eat at the hotel do so in the bar area, even though it might seem deserted and they have cricket on the telly, but the bar food is great, can hihgly recommend the chicken burger, (do put on the green chilie sauce) if you fancy western style food. Breakfast is good, and I do recomend the omelett with the geenchilie and fresh herbs

Peaceful location and value for money.The hotel has a got a swimming pool & spa facilities.The Hotel can arrange a taxi for you to the market.Nicely located in the mountains.The Hotel has restaurant and a bar to offer. In room service facility is available and TV has a wide range of channels which include many Indian channels,few nepali local channels and HBO.If I go back to Pokhara would like to stay in this hotel again.

I stayed in the hotel for 2 nights with my wife & kid. The room, services, food , ambience, hotel staff ... all seemed to be perfect.. The food was finger licking & exceptional..I tried asking a favor to coof something for my 1 year old kid and these guys were on their toes.. Nice peaceful location in midst of the mountains, very close to Fewa lake...The museums, waterfall & boating in the lake really made our trip. Looked 2 nights were not enough to enjoy the beauty of this place...

A great peaceful relaxing hotel amongst the mountains. Friendly staff, decent breakfast and a travel desk tht takes care of your iternarary trekking or lake owing or visiting Budha Stupa!Take a room that gives a view of the mountains from your window. On a clear day you can see the Fish tail mountain in its snow capped glory!!Also a relaxing bar with awesome bartender to end it all after a great day in this beautiful mountain region.

Myself and my wife visited pokhara this month and we stayed at this hotel. The rooms are excellent and the service good. Food was really good too. The hotel staff went to great pains to make us feel at home.

Large rooms and hot showers. Large cool pool. Good buffet breakfast, free drop off to Lakeside and to airport or bus station. Upper floors have amazing views of mountains. Two negatives: far from lakeside, really too far to walk, and it was noisy with tour groups. The poor layout of the hotel allows for sound to travel easily.  However the hotel helped us change rooms due to the noise. They were responsive to our emails as we were trying to book.  They have a generator and good a/c. The real star at this place is their travel desk manager, Kirti! He booked our a/c bus for us, and got us a discount price at our next hotel (Riverside Springs Resort). He was at the bus pick up in the morning making sure we were on and in our requested seats.  He called us at the next hotel to make sure every thing was fine. This guy is every traveler's dream come true.Best bathrooms we had in Nepal. Ceiling shower head, hot water, great water pressure, laundry line.

Stayed at grand between the 30th of May and 4th of June, this hotel has by far the best staff, from the driver (Sam) who picked us up at the KTM airport and drove us to Pokhara, paid for all our finger food and lunch(with his own money and not that he had to do it or we asked for it, but just that all people are genuinely just so nice in this place)  , and all in all was just so lovable. We had a little issue with the vehicle sent to pick us up from the airport though, considering the roads from KTM to Pokhara are non existent, we expected a jeep or an SUV, however, we were sent a little tiny toy called the "tata Indica" which helped us bend our bodies in ways we didn't know it bent. Other than that cab drive, everything else, and I mean EVERYTHING was splendid. With a heart full of love to Anita ( the very pretty girl who helped us book our rooms and arrange transport and did everything else for us ) and everyone else behind the reception. One more little thing, make it a point to be very very clear when you ask for anything from the reception after 10pm in the evening once the manager has left or just try an avoid it altogether as a guy working the  night tends to be a little rude and unhappy about us waking him. But when I go back next year to Nepal I certainly will spend all my time in this hotel and travel from there to wherever I have to go. Big hugs to Sam, Anita, the other tall very fair girl at the help desk, the cashier and finally the concierge.

the hotel staff is friendly and helpful, the rooms were very nice, big and clean. but certain flaws were there like the room phone was usually not working during the evening coz of bad weather, we made a request of providing breakfast in the room to which they agreed and said that it was being done specially for us but at the time of billing they charged for it in the form of room service tax which was certainly not fair. hot water does not run all the time. we used the laundry there only to find out that our clothes had been damaged. overall it is good but miscellaneous charges are too many. so its better to clear everything beforehand. they have airport pick n drop n provide taxi once a day for dropping. but lil far off from the main market. nice but expensive

From the moment I walked into the hotel the staff were fantastic! They were professional, friendly and extremely helpful. I booked this room on short notice after falling ill and having to leave my tour group. I was feeling pretty miserable by the time I arrived, but the staff here made my stay an absolute pleasure. They checked me in early, extended my hot water time so I didn't have to rush, and delivered a welcome gift of fruit & chocolates. I requested a quite room, and that's exactly what I got. The hotel is away from the main tourist strip and set in a high walled garden. This means you can get away from most of the bustle and noise of the city.My room was very clean and the huge bed was extremely comfortable. Had all the facilities you would expect in a good hotel. Nice pool/garden, good breakfast and more great staff in the restaurant.I could not have picked a better place to rest and relax after a long trip. Would highly recommend it.

Pokhara Grande had very welcoming and friendly staff, very easy to talk to. The rooms are very clean and were serviced several times a day. Gorgeous view of the pool, a stupa, and the Annapurna Mountain range. The food was very good, nice buffet breakfasts and great entrees. They have a nice bar/lounge area.  We were very happy with our stay there.

Outdated front lobby but our rooms were nice, neat and clean. Back up generator and hot water 5am-10am and 5pm-10pm daily. Aircon and mini bar and good staff. The location is not great its about 7 min and 200rps from lakeside BUT it is very quiet due to this. I would stay at this hotel again.

Second visit to this Hotel and made even better when the hotel had organised an airport pickup for me which was a big surprise. Fantastic setting with the best views of the Annapurna Mountains. Lovely people and great service. Everyone was happy and friendly and i had a fantastic stay.i would recommend this hotel to everyone.mike

Stayed with family. Excellent pool, clean rooms , friendly and helpful staff. Arrived early in the morning , let into rooms , decent breakfast , even used the manager's computer as the business centre not operational. Very helpful travel desk

From the outside and from the reception we thought this was going to be another really good hotel. We were all put in the annexe which is the newest part of the hotel, unfortunately whilst it may be the newest part but the rooms were far from new.The food was good and the staff very helpful.Unfortunately no safe in the room but they do have free safety deposit boxes in reception.No free internet here but 24 hours is only about £4.When we were preparing to leave we got word that the airport at Kathmandu was closed and hence our flight was on hold. The Grande were very helpful, letting us have the keys back for our rooms if we wanted them and putting up with 2 full travel groups from different countries sitting round the reception for a couple of hours.

We stayed at Pokhara Grand for the last two nights of a ten day stay in Pokhara.  The new wing of the hotel has large rooms and nice clean furniture, the complimentary breakfast has omelet station and great food.  The Indian food for lunch and dinner is among the best food we had in Nepal.  The physical hotel and staff in general are similar to an US East Coast or Midwest golf club.  The staff is always willing to help, we had lunch outside sitting by the pool and received excellent service.  The bar inside the hotel is comfortable and possesses the old golf club character of a men's locker room.  I am guessing the location of the hotel has something to do with the incredible views of the white capped Himalayan mountains.  Best internet speeds that we found in Pokhara.  Big thanks to the staff for making the stay extra special.

Good overall. Not the most central location, about 20 mins walk or 300 rupee taxi ride to the town centre lakeside area, but excellent in other respects tho the swimming pool is small with only a few sun loungers. Hotel tour desk had a round town sights tour which was v poor imho, was told it was 4 hrs approx but mine was only 2 and a quarter.

This a fairly standard hotel. Staff are mostly helpful and friendly. Rooms are comfortable. Hotel offers good prices for extra activities like tours and microlights. Located just inside the Damside area and only about a 10 minute walk from Lakeside. Lack of hot water in the showers is annoying, they do warn you during check in. Power cuts do not affect the rooms. During my stay the pool was closed for cleaning which took 4 days. Spa is a bit pricey but some good treatments. Food is average, nothing special. Did find dining room staff a bit pushy to eat up quickly. Ate outside the hotel most of the time. Overall a good place to set up so you can explore Pokhara. Very relaxing

travel desk was amazing,Mr.kirti was very helpfull all times, he booked our air tickets from kathmandu to pokhra and vice versa and email us E tickets when we were in India only and had taken payment on arrival in hotel .this cant be done by anyone else in india or any other country in world. Everyone take payment before issuing air tickets. free pick up and drop up from the hotel to airport and vice versa. Once in a day complimentary drop up to the lake road. On arrival staff was very welcoming. The room was Clean and comfartable ,however shower was not good as the water was dropping everywhere else except on us.The Indian food was quiet limited and OK only. Its was all about Pokhara which is a special place so the hotel did its job for us.will surely visit again if got a chance to come pokhara again.

The hotel is old and ok.The good:1- Friendly and helpful staff 2- Cleanliness3- Variety of TV channels4- Security staffed wellThe bad:1- Limited hot water (availability only between 6am to 11am and 5pm to 11pm)2- Shower head was poorly designed and sprayed everything except on you (Made it extremely difficult to shower)3- Breakfast was HORRIBLE (2-3 stars standard)4- Night shift staff didn't speak proper English5- Obscurely located

We spent 3 nights at the Pokhara Grande and thoroughly enjoyed our stay. It’s a fabulous hotel with a friendly, homely and relaxed atmosphere. We were especially impressed with the hotel staff who are polite, friendly and very professional. My son celebrated his 13th birthday whilst we were staying at the hotel and the management and dining room staff surprised him with a birthday cake at breakfast time plus another birthday cake delivered to our room later in the day. This kind gesture made my son’s 13th  very special. Our room was on the 3rd floor and we had a fabulous view of the Annapurna mountain range. The rooms are also big and comfortable.  There is a nice swimming pool and the grounds are spacious too. We had no problem connecting to the wi-fi which is free if one makes an online booking. The hotel is also located a short drive from lake Fewa and other interesting sights. I would most definitely recommend the Pokhara Grande, it’s a great place to stay.

Amazing view of the HimalayasIt rained heavily the day we checked in, we couldn't go elsewhere but enjoyed couple of drinks in the hotel's bar which I found pretty much cozy. Staff were friendly and always to avail. But what took our breath away was the view of Annapurna Range the next morning. Simply Amazing! Shame we couldn't extend our stay since we had our plane to catch.

We stayed at the Grande for 2 nights. The staff are very friendly and helpful. The hotel itself is clean but a bit tired. Hotwater in the rooms is limited to mornings and evenings, although during our stay, we went 24 hours without any even warm water. Also, there was no safe in the room.  Our room was in the annex which is very quiet - the rooms at the front of the hotel can get noisy. The food at the morning and evening buffet is limited but there's an excellent choice on the a la carte menu. We have to mention Dipak, the restaurant manager, who is first class and very welcoming. Like alot of the hotels in India and Nepal there is no free wifi in the lobby. If you have a clear morning don't forget to go to the roof in the main building for tremendous views of the mountains. You might also see planes landing at the nearby airport.

Returning from the Annapurna trek, this was a pleasant way to unwind and wash away the grime. Reception staff were extremely helpful and made our stay enjoyable. Going by the standards of deluxe/luxury hotels in Nepal, this is definitely above average. Food however, as other reviewers suggest too, is positively better at lakeside restaurants so eat there in any case. Our quest for good coffee at any 4/5 star in Nepal remains unfulfilled to date and we still carry our own grounds and percolator...

This hotel was clean and comfortable. Most staff were very welcoming. The food was quiet limited and OK.
