There are far better places to eat in Pokhara like the Moon Dance restaurant a short 300 rupee taxi ride. The spa was nothing special and a bit tatty - again it was OK. Its was all about Pokhara which is a special place so the hotel did its job for us.

Over priced hotel with very bad staff. Hot water has limited timing, after  which they send hot water buckets to the room. The restaurant staff really needs to be hospitable. Overall quite a dissappointment.

Overall an enjoyable experience. Pokhara is a special place and in a lot of ways the accommodation is secondary. However the Grande is a fine hotel manned by staffof a high quality where nothing was left to chance. I need to mention Anita and Tamzinof the hotel staff both of whom where exceptional. The rooms where excellent.Bearing the above in mind the one thing that could be improved on would be the menu.To attract diners coming from all parts of the world a more diverse approach is needed.Many thanks for a great vacation.

The Pokhara Grande Hotel is a really great place to stay in Pokhara. The Staff were really helpful and very friendly. The location was great just 5 mins from the airport and close to all the leisure activities. It is also with easy reach of the WaterFront Side with a numerous eating places, wonderful shopping and all round pleasant place. The Pohkara Grand, i fully recommend, you will thoroughly enjoy your stay and the beautiful mountain views.

Had a room on the second floor of the building passed the swimming pool. Room was clean, compared to the crowne plaza in soaltee kathmandu. Which was over priced. Had breakfast on both days but buffet breakfast was luke warm. Also the selection not great. I'm going to the hotel lakefront in lakeside when I return in a month. Staff are very helpful and friendly. Overall 3 stars

The  Grande Pokhara has big rooms compare to others. The beds were very comfortable and clean. Even though we stayed at the renovated rooms on the second building - the furniture was not new. What made this place special is the staff. We were assisted by one receptionist, Anita, she was an outstanding person at this hotel, who helped us with all our questions and concerns. I would definitely ask for her if you had any problems. Hot water supplied between 5.00-10.00 am and 5.00-10.00pm.Additionally if you book thru a travel agent you have to pay for the internet extra. Hotels provide free internet for online booking.Though a big disadvantage of The Grande Pokhara is its location, it is near the airport which you could say is good, but there is nothing to do outside the hotel, no tourist attractions at all, and  honestly you couldn't say there is much to do at the hotel.

This hotel is impressive from the outside and in its large reception area.  Its situation is not central and although it is not a long walk to Devi's Falls you really need a taxi to get to and from the lake area especially at night. I was told immediately after checking in that there would be no hot water between 1000 and 1700, also the free wifi advertised was not free and the internet was expensive (far cheaper local place just down the road).  My room was comfortable enough but there were nasty stains on the wall and in the lavatory. Also both the TV and the remote control were broken.  I didn't want to watch the TV, nor use hot water in the daytime which was just as well. Breakfast was fine and the staff generally were pleasant and offered me a complimentary taxi when I checked out. Overall, OK but not worth the money or the stars.

Everything starting from location to staff to food to service is excellent. Since it is was our 10th wedding anniversary, we were upgraded to suite and the service was excellent. The staff really made all possible efforts to make it very special for us and they indeed made the special day extra special. Highly recommend to stay at Hotel Pokhara Grande whenever you go to Pokhara, Nepal. This is the best hotel to stay overlooking the mountain ranges.

From the moment we arrived at this hotel we were greeted with friendly smiles.  Anita at reception checked us in and even showed us to our room.  We were very fortunate to be on level 3 which gave us the most magical views of the Himalayas.  Our room was very spacious, clean and had every comfort required.  From the helpful tour desk to the friendly staff at the restaurant, reception and every other staff member we were always greeted with a smiling Namaste!  Thank you for making our stay in Pokhara so special.  We booked through Agoda so internet was included in our stay.  Would highly recommend staying here.

Spent 2 nights here at end of group tour. Spacious interior and good room size, but in different building from main reception. Breakfast choices good but some queuing for hot food. Smallish pool but only 4 loungers-we asked but that was all available. The mountain views more than compensate for the noise from the nearby airport. This is a lovely hotel and was much appreciated after a couple of weeks trekking in the Annapurna region. Our dinner was delicious. When they found out that we were vegan an what that was, they tried extremely hard to accommodate us and they succeeded. We are extremely well. We would love to come again

The hotel location is fabulous & staff are very friendly.  Room was very clean and we can enjoy natural beauty from our room balcony. The Food provided in dinner was so delicious and also in breakfast verity of food and also they are very delicious & healthy.

The stay was peace within the nature. The food was amazingly delicious. The staffs were friendly and well organized. Beautiful pool. Ample area to wander around. The hills and the mountains surrounding the place make it even beautiful!!!

This is a resort to go to if you want alone time together, if you want a trip with family or friends. Rupakot Resort, because of its location atop a hillside, away from markets and the hustle bustle of cities, offers the solitude, the time to look within yourself, to admire nature's splendors.. whether the Himalayan range, the mountains and hills dotted with homesteads, or the lakes in Pokhara and Lekhnath valleys below. Or watch the stars, the sunsets, and sunrise creeping down from the Annapurna himals! The premises with it's stone walled buildings, the abundance of fruit and flowering trees and shrubs , with stone pathways and stairs is charming. Birds, bees butterflies abound.The food is wholesome with home-made fares (a necessity too due it's secluded location). Everything we tasted was fresh and tasty. They have their own organic garden and also rear cows and buffaloes for dairy needs.The staff are super helpful, friendly and courteous. The way we (my husband and myself) were treated with so much attention and love for our 50th anniversary treat made us feel right at home!The paw-shaped pools have different depth levels, and are situated just above the spa amenities.  A gym is being constructed nearby and there's a play area for the little ones too. There's a helipad in the premises too.. shuttle service to the airport and city.Wake up with the birds cooing and chirping. And even if you don't get to see the majestic Himalaya (ours was clouded and rained out) the view of the world below you, the clouds creeping up the hillside, playing hide and seek with the view is mesmerising! And if you are lucky, then chat with the owner and learn about his journey from these mountains to Europe and back to build this paradise atop Rupakot.

Thank you entire team for the wonderful hospitality.Food was amazing and yes,ofcourse ambience was more than beautiful.The best part of the resort is you can see the entire view of Pokhara through Rupakot Resort.Reshu K.C./Bishal Raj Karki

I went solo and I stayed there for 2 days and that was the best experience that I have ever had I was connected with nature and I explored farm also and rupakot resort is the best resort at this price and I recommend you also to go with your family and loved ones and enjoy your time with nature and don't forget your swimming costume 😅 the swimming experience was really great❤️

Relax, Chill out and Unwind…..These were our goals for Holidaying at Pokhara and I am thankful to Rupakot Resort for letting us achieve even more. Our Check in was smooth (Thanks to Manisha) and created good first impression. family-run so feels homely, eco-friendly touches, scenic, breathtaking views, quiet & relaxing, great facilities & pool area, staff very welcoming, polite, genuine, helpful,, wonderful place highly recommended

This resort is located at the top of the hill. It is a very beautiful resort. I had originally reviewed this place before the pandemic but so much had changed in Nepal during this period that I was a little fearful that this place may have lost it’s charm. I was wrong! This place has retained its original charm and has survived the pandemic unscathed! It is still the best place in Nepal to enjoy nature, peace and tranquillity.In the last two years, many places in Nepal have changed forever. Beautiful natural trekking routes had been converted into ugly dirt roads. Bus loads of partiers have turned peaceful traditional villages like Ghandruk into non- stop rowdy-noisy-drunk party towns. Despite all this I was really delighted when I revisited Rupakot Resort. Not everything in Nepal has changed. I was glad to see familiar faces in the reception who welcomed me back to the resort with genuine hospitality. I was there for much needed rest and relaxation after 8 days of trekking the south Annapurna circuit. All the staff worked really hard to make me feel at home. I enjoyed a cold plunge in the beautiful pool surrounded by the views of snow capped mountains. It was followed by an awesome private sauna session. It was a private sauna room with original Finnish equipment, a great viewing window, two bottles of cold filtered water, plenty of clean towels and an attached bathroom. The cold plunge followed by the hot sauna melted my pain from the hiking . It was only topped by the 2 hour massage session at the spa. By the evening, I was truly refreshed and renewed.Dinner was really great. I love that they source all their meats and vegetables locally. Unlike other upscale places in Nepal, they don’t fly in their pork chops frozen from other countries. I also learned that they mostly train and employ people from the local villages as much as possible. This resort is apparently vital to the livelihood of the village it is situated in. No wonder the staff seemed very happy and eager to serve.The room and bed were very comfortable and had a luxurious touch. The views from the room were amazing both at sunset and sunrise.  I was really happy I stayed at Rupakot Resort one more time. I will definitely be visiting them again and again.I truly hope that this place will stay true to its mission and retain its charm forever. I hope the management will resist the pressure to lower prices or offer too much discount to attract the wrong kind of crowd. I hope it will remain a peaceful and tranquil place. I am willing to pay higher price for that and you should too. Some things in this world are worth paying and protecting.

We visited this resort in the middle of November 2022It was myself and my mother who is in her 80’sI can start by saying this was a ten out of ten experience.We are both very well travelled and have stayed all over the world.We were looking for a real break, so that is why we booked a whole week in this resort.Our day consisted of an early opening of the curtains at 7am in order to see the amazing views of the mountain ranges. 5 out of 7 days it was clear and stunning.We would then make our way down to a great breakfast buffet.Here we had offered freshly made omelettes, Nepalese cusinese, sausages, bacon fresh fruit croissant made on-site teas coffee latte cappuccino hot chocolate and fresh healthy green juice.The service was amazing.After breakfast which we had outside on the terrace admiring the view of the mountains but also 2 lakes below and general scenery we would set up for a day by the infinity swimming pool, looking out across the view again. The pool is fresh verging on cold but perfect for cooling off as during our week the temp was 25 degrees full sun so ideal.4pm was massage time for me each day. This was truly amazing. Selena spent 90 minutes each day. She was so professional and so proficient, I think the best masseuse I’ve experienced.The evening meal was a real treat some days we went a la carte other days a full on buffet.Other guests enjoyed a fire pit in the gardens with pre dinner drinks.Again the staff were amazing.It is hard to describe how good the staff are. Everyone is welcoming and they all want to ensure that your stay is perfect.This is a newish build and there are new elements being built to add even more offering.The quality of the build, furniture and fitting is top quality, nothing has been skimped on.You do need to realise that this resort is 1 1/4 hours out of Pokhara (a hotel transfer bus operates to a timetable) again with amazingly friendly staff.It is on a remote mountain top so peace and quiet with no local distractions.Your room with a view is high above the restaurant so you do need to be able to walk up 57 steps. There is a sloped route available too.To sum it up.Amazing viewsAmazing staffAmazing buildAmazing SpaJust amazing.I already looking forward to a return trip next year.

Visited on mid August, perfect weather clarity, luckily no rains, after finishing all our activities we had decided to stay at RUPAKOT resort before returning back home. I’d rate ‘Food - 7/10 Ambience - 10/10 Service - 10/10Rooms - 10/10. One of the best top-rated places to be in Pokhara. If you visit here you will definitely love to come back for more.One visit is not enough. The food was super and the hotel premises was big to explore. The staff treated us so well. It's totally worth the price and we would love to come for more to stay here.I love it!

Our room was excellent with mountain view with balcony. We did sauna and yoga. All staffs are very well with super servicing practices. Nice swimming pool and restaurant is also cool place to enjoy with partner.

We only tried the Main restaurant and stayed on site for a few hours. They charge an entry fee to the venue which can be used for the F and B outlet payments inside. It is a beautiful location, bit of a drive fromthe city to get to. A bit pricey for the quality and quantity of food served. Polite f and b servers though. Its a one off venue!

It’s no doubt an expensive resort compared to others in Nepal, but I found the property, services and hospitality totally worth it. I felt that I was listened to and our needs were attended to from the moment I called to make the reservation. The resort was accommodating of our need for extra bed, early checkin as well as late checkout. The staff were extremely pleasant and attentive. For example, the restaurant staff even made effort to comfort my 18month old son so that I could be spared some time to eat my meal. Mr. Yam at the pool made sure that we had pool towels and slippers when we decided to spend time at the pool after we checked out. The rooms were very clean and comfortable. The premise was meticulously maintained.  The swimming pool was not crowded at all when we visited. We had great view of Rupa and  Begnas lakes and the Pokhara valley below. Even during monsoon, we were lucky to get glimpses of the Himalaya (Annapurna range and Machhapuchhre) in the Morning, however, the clouds soon covered them as the day started to warm up.In late August, when we traveled, there were swarms of flea beetles outdoors that tended to fly over our head and land on us causing somewhat of a nuisance in the evening and morning, however, I presume this to be a temporary and seasonal issue. Contrary to that, a surprising observation was that there were no houseflies even when we were served food outdoors. We also did not see mosquito activity. There was  frequent disruption of power which is a well known national problem in Nepal. The backup power was, however, restored within seconds.In summary, Rupakot Resort has done an excellent job in creating a luxurious experience. We will definitely recommend the resort to friends and family and will visit again for a longer stay when we are in Pokhara next time.

This is the best hotel I have ever had experienced. The location seems to be out of the globe and decoration , rooms are magnificent. Staffs are so friendly and food is just awesome. Pool is very beautiful . I went with my family and enjoyed a lot . They are highly professional and great.

I spent a week of vacation at the resort and had nothing but the best experience. Every little detail was perfect, from the resort amenities to the staff. Great accommodation, clean room, friendly staffs. We had the honeymoon package. We were amazed by the room decoration and the bottle of wine was the piece of cake. Buffet breakfast was decent. We really appreciate the effort of staffs from rupakot to make our stay comfortable and enjoyable.

This review is specially directed towards massage therapist Salina Gurung.  At first ,we were in dilemma whether or not we should do it. Honest review of Rupakot hotel after 2 nights.I normally don’t write reviews but this one definitely warrants awareness of the poor quality of this hotel.Firstly, this hotel is high up in the hills about 50-60 mins from lakeside Pokhara. There’s only a few shuttle services each day and yes they will pick you up from the airport. Make sure that you book a shuttle time before jumping on the shuttle. We were never advised by staff nor educated about the process until we were rudely kicked off the shuttle during one afternoon. Probably one of our worst experiences so far.We complained to management about their process and they accepted fault, apologised and organised another shuttle in 15 mins. There are only a few shuttle services each day and the last one will pick you up from lakeside at 4pm. If you haven’t had dinner by then, expect to pay an expensive dinner at the hotel restaurant as there will be nothing walking distance.Check in was fine, then a long walk up multiple flights of stairs to your room. The room was clean, we arrived on Valentine’s Day so they dressed the room with balloons and we got few roses, small cake and fresh fruit.Took a shower that evening and to my shock, the hot water only comes on after leaving the tap running for at least 15 mins. The shower head had near no pressure so each time we had to squat in the tub and use the hand shower instead. Imagine paying premium and having to sit for a shower. We addressed this to reception the next day and they said they would send maintenance, however nothing was done. 2nd day same issues no decent shower.The room had cable tv but due to the poor WIFI reception, it would drop out and freeze every 5 mins so watching a movie was out of the question.Facitilies - This hotel has no exercise area, no gym either. It does have a pool but no heating, so there was no one swimming in the freezing pool.Restaurant - The food is average, quite expensive and they will charge you for everything. The continental breakfast was lacklustre, having only basic menu items. They will serve you black coffee, but if you want a latte or a cappuccino, they will bill you plus all the taxes for it. (I have never had to pay for coffee during a buffet breakfast in any hotel).Overall experience - The staff were always friendly and courteous, never in your face and spoke good English. That’s probably the only good thing about this hotel. Everything else was very average and left a sour taste for us. We wouldn’t come back and would not recommend to others.

The staff were friendly throughout and welcoming. The views are one to stay for! Rooms and balcony views (amazing!) are things that truly made the stay worthwhile for me.My only complaint was the quality of food vs the price. The prices are on par with 5-star restaurants but the quality was so-so. I think if they invest more to up the food game, for example by hiring a better chief chef or by offering some unique items, I would be happy with the price. But if you are happy with standard dinner fare (which they offer as part of some packages), then maybe this is not your pet peeve.

The place is amazing and we could see beautiful scenery from the panorama view point. The food varieties and hospitality was great / quick. We had a wonderful experience in yoga sessions as well. Recommended.

This is our second stay at this amazing resort and can only praise it’s for all the following:Location 5*Staff 5*Food 5*Facilities 5*Highly recommended indeed we will be back. rupakot resort 🔆what scenery, what service, what a place 😳😍to top this,the aglio e olio peperoncino was one of the best i ever tastedhave had the spaghetti all around the world and found this one perfect (al dente, four whole dried red peppers tossed in with confidence, the extra extra virgin oil generous, the garlic golden yellow)our two servers at the restaurant (Asmita & Rom)would be one of the true reasons to go back not to mention the aglio e olio peperoncino (hope the chef is still around when i do)my better half mangala enjoying the breakfast at this scenic resortthe land of the eight lakes 🙏

Very few hotels in the world have such a beautiful scenes with two lakes and the mountain range from a room. Staffs very friendly. Food is awesome. Better to stay at north side rooms to get maximum view of Mountains and Lakes. Because it is Located at remote area, no shops and restaurants nearby.

Mesmerizing view from the rooms, especially sunset. Excellent service and staffs, more than exceeded our expectations. Food was also excellent, kudos to chef. It was one of the best places I stayed in, truely a great experience.

It is one hour away from Pokhara Airport but the shuttle service provided by resort made our journey shorter. Very comfortable bed with a wide room, buffet dinner, and breakfast with a variety of dishes.  Friendly waiters and waitresses were available all the time. Bishal was very amiable. When we ordered coffee, they charged extra. The resort is located in  one of the perfect location , with amazing views of the lake and the Himalayas . The sunrise and sunset from the resort overlooking the Himalayas , hills , lakes and the city is something to die for  . The rooms are well arranged , food is great is you go with the menu , the staffs are super-hospitable . Great way to relax by the pool while sipping the beer and enjoying the views .  I have already stayed twice and enjoyed every bit of it . The stay in Rupakot is totally worth every penny .

An absolutely stunning place with breathtaking views. The staff are very friendly and welcoming and great hospitality. Food was great 💜Absolutely amazing place with great hospitality service . Great food , Great ambiance , friendly staff, reasonable price

The location is spectacular. Amazing views of mountains and rupa and begnas lakes in the valley far below. The staff are polite and friendly. The food so so. There aren't really any bad aspects as such but the hotel lacks character and ambience. Its not the quaint boutique hotel we were hoping for.The new construction taking place will no doubt be a further attraction for conferences and large groups.

Rupakot Resort has friendly, caring staff who go out of the way to be sure you are comfortable and cared for. The evening buffet was delicious as well as the items we ordered directly from the menu. We enjoyed swimming in the pool and took a short drive to Begnas Lake one day. Another day we hiked down to the village below which was great exercise! The well-planned layout of the cottage style rooms gives most a great view of the mountains or the Pokhara Valley. There are plans to open a swing park in 2021 which would give families some fun options. Nearby is also a view tower.

Visited Rupakot resort for 2 nights last week post covid lockdown along with my sister. Even during this time they have maintained the highest level of service, cleanliness and hygienic. All the staff were excellent and food was superb. Would like to mention Asmita as she was on spilt shift and interacted with us more. We stayed in room 805, which has an amazing view. Unfortunately due to the weather we could not see mountains during our entire stay in Pokhara... Will definitely come back for the Mountain View. We also enjoyed a short hike, which I would highly recommend or else you can still be at hotel & just enjoy the view and spa. Thank you to the entire team at Rupakot Resort for making our stay pleasant. This place not only has an amazing view but also excellent service and food.

What i had expected and what i have got was 10 times better. We really really enjoyed our stay. Location, view , food , staff and everything were simply amazing. We had the quality stay. Not a single time where we didn’t enjoyed.

Since the resort also welcomes day time visitors, we as a family visited the Resort. The Resort charges NPR 500 for each visitor, but that acts as a food voucher. So, technically they are warranting you spend atleast NPR 500 while you are there. First the location - Unless you own / hire a vehicle it is quite difficult to get there. Hiring a cab from Pokhara to get there costs you about NPR 2000. The Resort has also started shuttle service from different stops in Pokhara. We didn't use that, so can't comment on that. Once you get there, you will absolutely appreciate why it was built there. It offers a panoramic views of Annapurna range, Begnas and Rupa lake, as well as most parts of Pokhara. High Five for the views it offers.Now, on the dining part - The restaurant has pretty spread menu, but the prices are sky rocket high. A single plate of goat biryani costs about NPR 1300 (~USD$12), a simple pan pizza costs similar. The prices are exorbitantly high by Nepalese standard. A popular Nepalese snack - Chicken momo costs about NPR 800. The good thing is - their menu price includes all applicable charges.We had ordered - goat biryani, pan pizza, paneer tikka, a pot of coffee and few more starters. Taste wise, i would say above average. Service - not professional. I had expected more professional service after paying so high for the food.

Rooms and restaurant with magnificent view overlooking the mountain range. Spacious and clean rooms. Excellent service from the staffs who would go the extra mile as well. Thou the location is an hr away from the lakeside, the journey is worth it. Will def visit if I’m ever in Pokhara again.

This place got it right!! From the very 1st minute, the staff was lovey, friendly and effective. The views are stunning. The spa does it right. The price is amazing value for what you get, specially considering the experience I have of at least 3 other hotels in Nepal. Hospitality and attention to detail was refreshing. Room was spacious and super clean. It smelled of flowers when we arrived. Great massage. Easy pick up from airport. If you contact them they send u a car. Restaurant offered delicious locally grown food. I have nothing to complain about and they were expanding and under construction. I didn’t hear any of it and barely saw the construction. I can’t praise this place enough. I’d love to go back when the pools are up and running again.

It is indeed a great resort for spending a few days away from the hustles. I stayed for 4 days and it was memorable. It is one hour away from Pokhara airport, but they have a nice shuttle bus. Both sunrise and sunset can be seen and give amazing views of the mountain range.The room was great with balcony and all the facilities.As this is not a busy season, buffet dinner and breakfast were cancelled on multiple days. That was perfect for me. But the breakfast was poor on this day. Else food was great and service was great too.

Luxury Heritage Resort with panoramic view of Pokhara valley, Begnas Lake and Rupa Lake along with Fishtail Mountain range, professional team members with fingers licking test of food, thank you Rom Gharti bhai for everything you provided us during our Anniversary Visit. Breakfast has Indian food options. Morning and evening views of sunrise and sunset is the highlight of this resort.  I would say this is one of the must to be visited resort while in Nepal.  5 Star. 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

Booking:- 28th Dec to 29th Dec 2019, Deluxe room in MAP.Location:- Couldn’t be better than this. Amazing view of the snow mountain far away from the buzzing town. The view of both the lakes ‘Rupa’ and ‘Begnas’ are mind-blowing. Awesome 5*.Amenities:- Great swimming pool facing the snow-capped mountains. Very specious and well maintained lawns, garden area, view deck. Overall it’s well managed and great in such a remote location. Simply 5*.Cleanliness:- Old property but well maintained and clean. Again 5*.Staff:- Nice and good but nothing exceptional like the other resort during my Nepal stay. For the whole team 4*.Rooms:- Speechless view from the room. Front of the room has a glass door with balcony and astonishing view of sun-rise and sun-set. No need to go out at all. Rooms furnished with all modern amenities, fruit basket, teak coffee maker and good collection of alcoholic beverages. Though the rooms reflect the ageing of the resort but were quite clean and good. Awesome 5*.Food:- Extra ordinary. Ala-carte menu provided for lunch was fantastic. Set menu provided for dinner on MAP was also equivalently good. Lots of choice for breakfast, even with fruits and vegetables counter. Outstanding 5*.One of the best resort near Pokhra. Very comfortable and relaxing stay. Overall 5*.

The location was great but the level of service expected was low. The food menu was limited. Food quality was very basic( tasteless ) but price was very high. Breakfast was included but coffee need to buy! WhAt a joke... Room was spacious and clean

Amazing Arial view and 360 Degree panaromic  view of Annapurna Mountain gives you the coolest form of peace in mind. Clean room service, separate cottage, Annapurna facing restaurant, charming birds surrounding you is totally different than any other resorts around 1100 meter specially Rupa and Fewa lakes are more than beautiful for ever. The Swimming pool also a unique one there, other luxury acilities also.

First visit to Rupakot resort. Found really nice and beautiful. Loved the food and surrounding and as well as the services. Not forgetting to mention Mr Roman Gharti's hospitality. Keep the good work and be consistent with the good services you all are having. Wish you all new year and prosperous year.

Dear Team Rupakot,We want to thank you all for making our recent stay so memorable.  We wish to extend a special thanks to Ms. Shanti who took care of us right from check in to check out and also helped us plan the tours and enjoy the best offerings of Pokhara. I wish to do a special mention of Ms.Ashmita & Ms.Saru from the f&b who took good care of all our needs during our stay and we're exemplary in their service.A special thanks for arranging the beautiful birth day set up in my room, it was indeed a pleasent surprise.We wish to thank the Chef Vicky and his team for the amazing breakfast,lunches and dinners they prepared for us.I wish to thank all the members of team Rupakot and the above mentioned members for ensuring that we take back only fond memories.WRMahesh

Writing this from the beautiful Panorama restaurant at the Rupakot resort, overlooking breathtaking and spectacular views of the Annapurna mountains and lakes in Pokhra. You have to be in this place to believe the natural beauty, and views that you are unable to look away from.Special shout out to exec chef Vicky and his team at the Panorama restaurant, who dished out some lip smacking, finger licking delicious meals for us. The staff at the restaurant were fantastic and went the extra mile to look after us. Roman is one of the staff at the Panorama restaurant who are a great example of Asian hospitality; and how to make guests feel extra special. A shout out to Monica as well who served us at the restaurant.Overall an incredible and memorable experience that I would recommend for anyone, and come back to every time.

If you are looking for amazing views, 5 star services and mouth watering dining options then you must visit this resort. From Pokhara Airport it will take 1 hour taxi drive. Taxi will cost you around 1500-2000 NPR (One way). Roads are amazing and will straight drop you infront of the resort reception. Reception staffs are highly professional and will ensure quick check in with a refreshing welcome drink.Deluxe double room with balcony are the best options of this resort. You can try room 104/404 for stunning mountain views. Rooms are decorated with all 5 star facilities. From your balcony and a view point infront of these rooms will ensure you lifetime experience to watch mountains and Pokhara valley views from the top.Restaurant staffs specially Ms. Juny, are excellent in terms of all service aspects. Executive chef Mr. Thapa will personally takecare of your requirements and will take your reviews about food and services.Swimming pool, spa, panaromic view points all are excellent.

They gave us the nicest views overseeing The Himalayas.It was a really unique experience.The restaurant is very special especially the outside terrace Food, service and Yoga class was amazing. Special thanks to Dinesh Mainali who made go through the real Yoga experience.I would highly recommend it.

Wonderful resort with amazing views. It is worth checking out! The food at the restaurant here is also quite nice. Yoga teacher, Dinesh Mainali, was very friendly and greeted me and took me for a tour around the resort when I arrived. Yoga classes are complimentary when you stay at the hotel. We only stayed for one night but did a 2 hour yoga class from 5:30-7:30pm before dinner and a 6-6:30an class the next day as we were time poor & needed to catch a bus. Dinesh delivered a great yoga class and fit many different styles into a smooth and flowing class. Definitely stay at this resort and try out the yoga as well.

My friend and I stayed at this hotel for one night, and we had wonderful time. Not only fantastic mountain view from our room, but also the hiking from the property guided by friendly and knowledgeable Narayan was one of highlights of our time in Nepal. It was an easy access comparing to lakeside in Pokhara, but we had quality of time in quiet surrounding.

A life changing experience where I met some of the most wonderful people in the world. This trip was the most special trip in my life as the experience I had will forever remain one of the best in my life. Up in that resort I was able to make dear friends and look at the heavenly Bokhara from the middle of the mountain everyday.

My wife and I stayed at this property for one night.The restaurant menu was varied and unusual. Chef Thapa provided a very good international cuisine of high standards.  Only issue we had was with the front office in this delightful scenic property was the attitude and unhelpfulness of the front office. They need more training in interpersonal customer care methods.it was a very pleasant stay and once the front office construction is finished will be a delightful property with stunning views of the Annapurna range in the morning.

one of the best place where you can see beauty of nature.  People were rally nice, food was great. highly recommended place to be. Me and my family was there for 2 days but wasn't enough for us. we wish to stay longer in future and get most out of it ...

Stayed for 3 nights with my wife and our 2 year old daughter.Got referred to this place by a Nepalese colleague of mine, and I am just so grateful to him.Location wise, this is simply amazing - situated at the top of a mountain just before the Pokhara valley. The surrounding areas are mostly flat lands, and the Rupa lake of course. Naturally the view from any point in the resort is amazing.And we also got to the see the Annapurna range one beautiful morning!Of course, being built on and around a mountain top means that there are plenty of steps and steep roads everywhere. Families going with young children and elderlies need to consider this. At first we were a bit concerned about our 2-year old running around. But, there are good and adequate safety measures; and there is always someone keeping a lookout.That brings to the service of this place. All the staff are extremely nice and helpful. They are always around, providing fast services. The restaurant is also great - offering great food, both local and international cuisines.A special shout out to the head chef Mr. Vicky Kumar Thapa. He made us welcome like we were family, and always kept an eye out for our various requirements - even for our baby. Thank you Vicky Dada.There are various lookout points very thoughtfully designed. You don't need to worry about good photo opportunities - they are everywhere.All in all, its a great place to relax and just chill out for several days. The pools are also really nice and offer something for all age groups.Would highly recommend this resort.

This resort situated above Rupa Lake is amazing. Peaceful.  Tranquil. The kitchen supplied from its own organic garden. Several short hikes available in the surrounding hills and valleys.  We visited three diverse villages clustered just above the resort. Ask for Narayan as your hiking guide. Knowledgeable, personable, conversational!  And, ask him about his hobby:  dancing!  He’ll share some fun videos with you. And, their spa!  After a day of hiking. Yes!I’ll definitely plan to be back.

My all over stay at rupakot was unexpected or all I can say it exceeded my expectations . Food at the hotel was quite good but the chef Vicky thaapa served us whatever we wish to have it. Breakfast spread was average but the chef made the good breakfast for us specially. Especially the view from the hotel and from the room was like cannot be expressed in the words. From the front desk Miss Shanti gave us the room with view of Himalayan ranges and Annapurna range . Hotel was so peaceful and full of silent. I completely enjoyed at the resort.

The view from my room was excellent. We were lucky to get a very clear weather throughout our stay. The staff was very helpful and courteous. Our guide Mr Narayan was very knowledgeable and helpful. The food was very delicious. The breakfast variety can be improved.

Just came back from this resort where me and my wife spent 3 nights. An amazing resort high up in the mountains however the serenity of the place  was spoilt by the noise of the local holiday makers who would come from Kathmandu and other local places  and had no consideration for the other guests who wanted to enjoy the tranquillity of the resort.They had no sense of hygiene and would often use the same plates they were using for refills and would pick up food from the buffet after licking their fingers. There was building work going on however this did not impact the holiday in a big way but it was an inconvenience.There was no dedicated smoking areas and so as non smokers we felt very uncomfortable around so many people smoking. They had hand sanitising gel but it was not easily noticed and this was pointed out to management.Being vegetarians Vicky the executive chef was amazing and did his best to accomodate he was great.Has potential but they need to understand what the european visitors require, hygiene and tranquillity. This felt like a typical british seaside vacation.

We had a really great time at the resort. We specially enjoyed the yoga session by the yoga instructor who was a pro at it. We loved his techniques of yoga. I just wish the yoga was done outdoors in the beautiful nature. Nevertheless, Thank you guruji. We will surely recommend this place to other friends and family.

Rupakot is a rare find in the valley of Pokhara. Perched up a hill, there are stunning views of the Himalayan ranges at sunrise and throughout on a clear the day.Food is very nice and the Executive Chef Vicky Thapa takes personal care that every item is served with impeccable perfection. The solitude and calm of the place coupled with magnificent views and cool climate makes Rupakot a perfect getaway destination from city life into nature and tranquility.

Incredible view and location. What a magical area. Food was amazing. Walks around the resort beautiful. Service across all departments was exceptional. Yoga was the highlight for me. Dinish the yoga instructor was highly skilled and knowledgeable and went above and beyond to share his skills and to be accomodating to ensure we had a fun, relaxing experience.

If you are nature lover, Rupakot resort is must visit place and log it in your list. This resort is around 16 Kms from pokhara Airport, route is k and takes around 35-40 mins to reach on hills wher the resort is situated.Mountain view from the room, swimming pool and restaurant is awesome , specially in early morning before sunrise.  Lake view from poolside and restaurant are so sceneric  that you can spend hrs there.If weather is clear sunset will make your evening more romantic.This resort is not having any lifts all rooms to be approached by ramp or stairs, slightly tough but you will love it as plants are all around youI really appreciate resort team to keep it so clean and even heights and walk , they are prompt for any serviceOne important thing to mention is restaurant food under the lead of chef Vickey Thapa, you just tell him your taste and rest will be history, lovely food specially Nepali mutton delicacy JHANACO, dont miss if you are thereEnjoy

Beautiful and comfortable installations, good food in general, breath taking view and friendly staff. Perfect for relaxation and romantic scapes.Perfect location, quiet adn great for morning walks. Great relation price/value

It's a really beautiful Resort. The view was amazing so was the food. We want to visit again. We like the hospitality of the resort. Resort was well managed and clean. I can say the yoga session was the best.

Amazing view, relaxing yoga session and great service!Complimentary yoga session 🔥(Highly recommended)Swimming pool with breathtaking view!Food could’ve been better.Food rating: 1/5Overall rating: 3.5/5

About an hour drive from the main bazaar Pokhara you get this resort. No road turning access for big buses! Beautiful cottage type houses... best thing is a view of Himalayas from your room Balcony provided clear weather! A gem for a hide from your busy days!!

Amazing views, great food, nice pool, nice rooms but dirty bed linens and quilt. We didn't notice earlier because they were covered with clean clothes. In the morning we noticed they were very dirty. Didn't complain but did inform the reception during checkout.Otherwise, the place is really a paradise.

The view from the resort is breathtaking! My husband and I stayed in a beautiful room for two nights and had a lovely stay. The spa however is not recommended, the massage was rushed, the room very basic with no ambience and no water offered after the massage. The friendly staff at the hotel and beautiful location made up for it though.

Arriving at Rupakot under a clear sky with a full moon lighting up my first glimpse of the Himlayas was an experience I won’t forget in a long, long time. Similarly the sunrise over the mountains and lakes from my balcony (make sure you get a room in building B if you can) was an unbelievable way to begin my birthday. I received an exceptionally warm welcome from the hotel owner and his family and very much enjoyed making the most of the clean and spacious infinity pool with the best view. The breakfast buffet was extensive and staff very polite. There are some short walks around the resort that are pleasant. This is THE place to come to after a few hectic weeks in Kathmandu for a much needed break. A deep breath of fresh air and gazing around the panoramic views and all your troubles will be left behind...

My family and I stayed in a room here recently (805 & 806) and it was very peaceful and the view was so pretty! This is our second time and would love to come more. The entrance of the hotel could be better decorated but doesn’t bother me much

I recently went to Rupakot Resort with my girlfriends and it easily became a memorable trip. We were picked up at the Pokhara Airport by a resort employee, it was a good 40 min drive up as we got to see the localities and nature. Once we reached the resort, I was amazed by the scenic beauty of Rupakot. You are on top of a hill with aerial views of the lakes and valley settlements down below. For me views from almost anywhere in the resort grounds did justice. The rooms were spacious w/ balcony seating where I further enjoyed the fresh air and views. The staffs were all so friendly and the food was delicious (breakfast being my favorite). If you are someone that loves to explore, you can walk to nearby temples and villages (about 20-35 mins hike). I hiked to the Khot Temple and next time I come back, I plan to hike to the nearby village.  I'm looking forward to visiting Rupakot Resort again in the near future.

Great ambience, amazing view, hospitality at its best and the food was just too good, my stay here was really great than expected.Best place to relax and avoid crowd..If you plan to visit Nepal than Rupakot is a must go place.

We stayed there recently, it is located on the hill about half an hour drive from Pokhara. We stayed in room no 804, it was big and clean and was facing both towards the lakes and the Himalayas. Due to the bad weather we could not see the Himalayas, however the views of the mountains and two lakes were amazing. Would have been better if the the sky was clearer, should have checked the weather before making the booking. We needed information on our forward  hiking trip and we found Ms Lamichane at the reception very knowledgeable, helpful and very responsive. Would definitely come back again during our next trip to Pokhara.

We went there after some trekking in the Annapurna region and we first noticed the nice view over the Annapurna range. The rooms are big and clean with a western bathroom. If you like to use the room service for breakfast in bed please be advised they will charge you 30% yes 30% extra on it. The WiFi connection is a bit bumpy and not very permanent. If you like to have a nice view you can also come there for a day trip only - get a coffee enjoy the view and than back to Pokhara.

A good resort at a heart of Pokhara. A place with great hospitality,food and peaceful environment. I liked this place for its food with an adorable price.Rooms were clean and very comfortable. I liked this place a lot.

We started the new year at this scenic resort.Excellent location though you don't expect that view while driving from the airport. Good quality rooms, nice circular restaurant & good variety of food.perfect place to relax though we saw a wedding going on too ...small group of guests of course & a helicopter pick n drop (helipad & area around got very dusty while landing & take off) so multiple options for enjoying the Annapurna range of mountains

pros- excellent location. quite out of the city (one hour drive). and its totally worth it, esp for the view of the annapurna range of mountains. great view from the restaurant and our rooms. the staff are super friendly and always willing to help. i stayed here only for the view,, big rooms, bathroom and balcony with the lake and mountain view.  cons- the road leading to this place is a nightmare, more so after it gets dark. the food in restaurant is good, although a bit pricey, plus since its quite far from the city in the hills, away from anything, you don't have any other option. had wifi connection trouble once, thankfully that got fixed soon.

Rupakot resort elevates all who visit it. In one way, the literal height and scenic location is sublime. In another way, the complimentary yoga class was spiritually uplifting and supremely relaxing. Definitely very happy with the yoga instructor, Dinesh.

The road from the entrance of the resort to parking place is ridicules. Staffs are very friendly . Rooms are little bit cold. But i have very bad experience , we have left our belongings in the wardrobe and we didn’t get it back.

We visited rupakot resort , it was very nice , service was good,  scenery was beautiful espically the view from our balcony we were able to see the Annapurna mountain range and the 3 rd tallest mountain the world the fish tail mountain ( machhapuchare mountain). The yoga instructor guru mainali was very friendly energetic and knowledgeable , in a short period of time he showed us a lot of yoga poses and exercises , you must meet him

Getting to this resort is a bit of a challenge. It is located off of the road to Kathmandu and then straight up, up, up the side of a mountain. We actually had to get out of the taxi at one point so they could make it around one of the corners climbing higher and higher. The view must be spectacular. For us it was a wall of grey fog :((( which may have accounted for the fact that there were about 5 guests total at the resort. The staff were very sweet, the rooms were nice though a bit cold, the food only passable, and the spa really the worst. One of our party had to walk out of the treatment is was so bad and then had to argue with the cashier about payment. So, a mixed review...must be offset when you can see the mountains.

Amazing looks of property facing 360° view of surrounded himalayas, mountains and lakes. Addition to this wonderful and amazing hospitality from highly qualified team. No second thought from any angle, just amazing.

Amazing resort to stay.  If you are planning around pokhara for a week stay, definitely check one night out in this resort. Fantastic environment and mountainous view from every angle. You wont be disappoint.Pros: Clean, peace, friendly, beautiful, good restuarent and......Can see many mountains. Manu other good things.Cons: As this is still new takes time to develop with time. wifi is the things to be considered.Overall, 5/5 for me staying in this resort.  Also got cheaper by direct contacting with them for booking.

I loved everything about this resort- the location is a God-send, arguably the best vantage point in all of Pokhara for 360 views of the mountains as well as the valley/lakes. The service was absolutely great, in spite of the limitations in Nepal such as occasional power cuts (the resort's generators restore power within 1 minute). I was able to tour Pokhara for a day using a car, driver, and guide provided by the resort at reasonable cost. The Spa and massage service were impressive- you should definitely try them. The restaurant has such awesome panoramic views, both inside and along the outside seating area...and the menu and quality of the food was outstanding. Last but not least, the owner is a very affable and impressive Nepalese man- born at the site of the resort, at a time when this hilltop site had no electricity, running water, or functional road to town...he later spent two decades in Europe, then returned home to develop the property into what it has become- definitely an inspiring story and a source of pride to the local community. He went out of his way to make me and other guests feel welcome, and apparently plans are underway to expand the resort and introduce presidential suites, etc. so this is one place to watch for. The slight downside is of course the windy and seemingly dangerous road to the hilltop...but when I visited they had just finished the first phase of tarred pavement, so hopefully this will be a non-issue moving forward. Overall, I give the Rupakot Resort the highest possible recommendation for anyone wishing to spend a few days in Pokhara. Go see it for yourself!

I stayed at the Rupakot Resort during the low season - Month of December 2018.Check in was convenient and the staff was accommodating. we got a nice room as per my request. All rooms have got a balcony to see the beautiful view, spacious room, and a warm ambiance. the property itself is beautiful and well-kept esp. the landscape.The staff and the Hotel Interns were very friendly and attention to detail.the water pressure for the shower and rain shower was very bad and it was always high and low and if the swimming is heated then it will be much better overlooking the Alps.B, Thapa

The setting is amazing..two lakes on one side, and the Annapurna range on the other.  Service rendered by the staff is impeccable. A la carte food is good and affordable. The downside are the poor water pressure, no English TV channels, and the rather poor breakfast in terms of quality and choice.

An expansive property with a vantage viewpoint . Experience nature and look down at the lesser tourists lakes of Pokhara. The sunset gives you the most amazing view of the Annapurna range. The staff are polite and service is good. An infinity pool and pretty good food. A perfect artists retreat.

After a comfortable drive (the road to the resort is in good shape now), I arrive at t place of peace and rest, with a breath taking view on the Annapurna range while having breakfast.Rooms with a view on the Himalaya.Many facilities: a swimming pool in the shape of the foot of the Yeti, Spa center, yoga department, excellent restaurant and much more.I really enjoyed my stay at Rupakot Resort very much.

Rupakot Resort is a brandnew Resort Hotel on top of a hill with Wonderful mountain views and a view down at two lakes. Perfect pool. Perfect Food. Perfect views. The Rooms are spacious and well equipped.

We had decided to stay in this hotel for 1 night, At the time of booking they had agreed to give us best view rooms and best service. When we arrived there, we notices that our room definitely did not had the best view! when we complain the same, they insisted it was best view room when we could easily see other rooms having best views and the resort was almost empty. After few minutes discussion, we were allocated in other room which had view of both the lakes, swimming pool and the mountains. When we reached the hotel, to our surprise we found that there was NO ROOM SERVICE!!!! And any room service would charge 30% extra!!! If you are hungry then you have to walk down to restaurant which was about 10 mins downhill walk from the room. So if you have in mind that you are going there to relax..then just dont go!!! And they will not serve extra glasses or even ice to have your drink in the room!! And there is a fridge in the room which was not working!Another bad part about this resort was its restaurant. Food and drink was just EXCRUCIATINGLY EXPENSIVE!!! And in top of that, food was sub par and service was slow. We ordered normal tea, momo, sizzler and pizza. Tea was so terrible that we had to return it, momo was sour, size of the sizzler was so small and it was the worst pizza that I had in my whole life!!!! We could not even finish our food. We were so dissapointed with our lunch that we decided to skip dinner. In the evening we walked outside the hotel premises and found a small tea shop (just opposite to guard room). That tea shop actually prepared good food and we had noodles and momo that were better that restaurant food.There was hot tub in the room and we decided to relieve our stress but to our surprise hot water finished after filling 1/2 of the tub. When we called the housekeeping they informed us that every room had hot water geaser of capacity of only 15 liters and if we want more water, we have to wait till it get heated!!!! Now imagine, resort of that capacity in which you are paying that much saying that...We had not other option and we waited about 30 mins..But still water was ice cold. We again had to call the housekeeping. They assured us to look at it. Few minutes later there was knock on the door and one clueless maintenance guy standing at out door, who didn't knew what went wrong but insisted that we didnt knew how to open hot water tap!!!! With no other option available, we had to take shower with cold water at 11pm at the night. After all those complains also, they did not take a proper look at it and in the morning when we tried to freshen up...hot water was still not there. When i called reception and raised my voice..then only they told us that geaser in our rooms were not working. they offered us keys of another room and we had to take a bath in another room!!Breakfast was strictly average only with not many options available. View was good and staffs were friendly!! There are no activity to entertain the guest (like badminton/table tennis/snooker/bone-fire) or no children's playing area. After watching view for few minutes then you will get bored as there is nothing to do!!Overall, you can skip to spend a night in this place and can go there to have a lunch only, and while having lunch, be prepared to have worst food of your life!!Not worth it for the price you pay!

Slow service and sub par food. Rooms and resort is nice and people are quite friendly but seem unaware to people waiting for service and just chatting around the bar. Could be because it's quiet season... but in some cases there were even more employees then restaurant guests and still slow service

Rupakot resort is one of the best resort in this area. The owner is mr puspa adhikari most nice and helpful person. Nice food and scenery view mountain.I highely recommend everyone.nice voew of mountain and two lake Begnas and rupa

Rupakot is situated on top of hill. View from here is amazing. Open from all sides. Famous lakes of Pokhara and some mountain peaks can be seen at its best. As far as property is concerned it is average only. Not as per international standards. Double beds are smaller than average and mattress is also hard. Rooms could be much better. Restaurant is also very ordinary. Breakfast needs improvement. Staffs are nice and friendly people but suggest more of training. Food quality is so so. Internet speed in rooms are pathetic. Most annoying part is they charge 30% extra for room service!!

So after hearing all the hype about the place, I visited the resort with my girlfriend for the view and lunch.The place did live up to the expectation. It was a hazy day (but there wasnt anything anyone could do about that- just not the best day to visit).Now, the negative- we ordered chicken momos as one of the starters. The meat was sour! Never in my life have I had or heard of sour meat. Having my doubts, I asked the waiter to check with the kitchen of something was wrong with the batch of the chicken used. The waiter came back promptly saying that it was fresh chicken.Then I sent one momo back to the cook to taste and tell me if that tasted normal. To my surprise the waiter comes back (not the cook or the manager) and replies that it is normal. If sour chicken momo is normal then I have been having them wrong my entire life!! (Unless rupakot resorts secret ingredient is vinegar, they're way if handling the situation was extremely horrible!!).So although I recommend the place for the views- I cannot say the same about their quality of food! Definitely stay away from their restaurant!!!!

Rupakot resorts is the place in heaven before reaching Pokhara. This is located between two lakes which means view are amazing .Staff and of course you will sometime able to meet owner they both are very friendly and helpful. The room sizes are big with good size bathroom. We went with my husband and daughter all of us really enjoyed amazing swimming pool as well.

The hotel is high up so we need car to go there. There were 10 of us in the van. We had difficulty driving up the slope cos it was steep and muddy and Rocky too. But we managed to finally make it there.The room is very dusty but overall cleanStaff was helpful when I reported problem with my ACDinner and breakfast was ok.The view there is beautiful. That's the highlight of the hotel.

Hotel is great and the rooms have views that are beyond this world. We stayed there in September 2018 and can definitely recommend this hotel to everyone who likes nature. All food is organic and comes from own hotel's garden.

All the big hype, “ a place to be “ is just an overrated statement. The staff are not at the best behaviour, and treat you like an burden to them. The food was just ok !! The construction was only focused on creating buildings and in no way seemed to promote greenery or nature. The location though was awesome, and views are just outstanding.

Good resort, facilities, staff, views. Road is a bit adventurous hope it will be better next time. Rooms are good. One of th best places to stay in pokhara. Couldn't get th snow mountain views as it was raining nd cloudy. November might be a good time to visit next time.

Experience was just wow..!!everything was fantastic,view,food,staff.but,there road is not that much accessible,hope it will be better for next time.Last but not least Yoga was amazing,thanks to Yoga Guru Dinesh Mainali.Keep it Up

It is a fairly long uphill drive on a gravel road to get there from Pokhara Lakeside, but once you are up there the views will make you forget everything. The infinity pool is good, but the views from the pool is like no other. In a clear day, you can see the majestic Annapurna Range and many other mountains from the resort and the pool. Even on a cloudy day, the view of the surrounding hills, the Begnas and Rupa Lakes, and the villages in the valley is magical. The price is reasonable for a 4 or 5 star property. It was still undergoing construction when we went there in Summer 2018 and this place can only get better. The staff were always willing to help, and the food at the Panorama Restaurant was good. I had never been to a place this beautiful where the value comes from the views, food, and the pool. I hope they add an indoor pool for the winter.

The only major reason to visit Rupakot is for the view. Beside that everything is pretty normal. Definitely not impressed with Food specially breakfast, Rooms are clean and comfortable and if you get a room overlooking the two beautiful lake thats a bonus.Its worth visiting only if the weather is clear beside that theres nothing impressive.

If you are tired of Hustle and bustle of pokhara city. You are looking for the perfect place. It is around 90 minutes drive from Lakeside, Pokhara and located right on top of rupakot from where you can get a view of begnas lake, rupa lake and other small lakes. Very peaceful place and the food and staffs are awesome.

I took my kids here who were in Nepal for holiday from England. They had wonderful time, I also enjoyed thoroughly. Rooms are all high quality, great service...it’s like a paradise. I would definitely come back here.

Be mentally prepared that what you order can't be available at Resturant . Exactly the same scenario had happened with us . The food items what we orderd werent being served as the kitchen department says it cant be made . Is it what did we pay for ?

Everything is fine but the hospitality at kitchen  department is worst .The item on the menu aren't available .When we tried to order something , the waiter said yes it can be available but certainly he comes back with note of sorry sir particular receipe cant be made .

What an amazing little piece of heaven this place is! Rupakot Resort is located on the top of a mountain top, looking over terraced landscapes and three rivers. Exquisite scenery of the Himalayas on a clear day. Staff were warm and friendly, always with a smile. A personal yoga session is available for free. The instructor, Dinesh, is very knowledgeable about yoga. His gentle manner made me feel at ease immediately. Dinesh tailored the session to my needs and checked in frequently about them. He explained the reasoning behind many postures and showed me how to warm the body up for a yoga session. I can’t recommend him highly enough! If you go, make sure to set up a session. He is flexible regarding times.Food was excellent. Lots of vegetarian choices. Carrot pudding is to die for.Expensive to travel to From Pokhara Airport however. Must negotiate price. Taxis were asking 35-50 usd; was able to talk them down to 20!

Visited Rupakot Resort just a few days after the hustle and bustle of my marriage. The sheer beauty of the location and the beautifully maintained property took off all the wear and tear of the festivities in no time. The staff is extremely well trained and efficient and very very helpful. The food offered by Panorama Restaurant is amazing. I would recommend the Paneer Tawa Masala and Dal Makhani as must haves. I would recommend to family and friends most definitely!!

Excellent view! The food and hospitality of the staff was perfect. It would have been better if the resort provided shuttle service. The price offered for one way service was too expensive. Also, the room had a lot of bugs. Apart from that, it is worth the money. Must visit atleast once.

Amazing place with a great view of 3 lakes & mountains.Amazing,well maintained infinity pool. One of the best resorts in Nepal. Great hospitality/friendly staff. Few drawbacks : Bar prices are bit expensive.Extra 30 percent charge for room service is in my opinion very expensive.Would definitely recommend it to friends & family. Had a great time there.

We met him at begnas.His yoga routine was good to me.I think, It's especially good to my spine.The asana? Was Not very easy, and not very hard at all.And when I finished follow his guide,I felt my body lighter than before.I like massage, It makes my muscles, joints, blood vessel, and immunity. but I think yoga is more deeply effect on my body.Besides...most of all I think it's good for mental health.So I recommend yoga, and yoga instructor at this resort. (His name maybe dinesh.)I hope everyone be happy.🙏요가를 네팔에서 어쩌다보니 배우게 됐었네요. ㅎ그냥 체조수준으로 밖에 따라 할 수 없었지만 1주 2주 계속하다보니 확실히 좀 유연해져가더군요.뭐라할까요.저는 돈을 많이 내고 이걸 배워야 할까라는 생각도 했는데 유익한 활동을 돈 많이 내고 배우면 낸 돈이 생각나서라도 좀 더 열심히 하게 되고 끝나고도 혼자 해보게 되는 것 같습니다.피로가 풀리는 느낌 가벼워지는 느낌은 마사지 받는것 보다 낫다고 느꼈구요. 열심히 하기 나름이겠지만..무엇보다 정신적 안정도 느낍니다.저는 머릿속이 복잡함을 느끼곤 하는데 요가가 살짝 힘들다가 중간중간 푹 쉬라는, 완전히 쉬라는 안내를 하십니다. 이때 몸도 정신도 쉰다는 느낌을 받았습니다.아무튼 요가를 추천드리며ㅎ 여기 계신 선생님 지도도 추천드리는 바입니다.모두의 행복을 바라며.🙏

We found that the resort is very nice with stunning view of Himalaya. It located top of Rupa mountain which gives panorama view.  The room is clean & have everything we need. My son enjoyed their swimming pool a lot. I love Yoga class as the teacher is professional. We did trekking with Narai (hotel guide) who knows a lot about hiking & plants. It was a great time there.

I like Rupakot because it is a very peaceful place. Rupakot Resort has lovely hilltop location facing Annapurna range in between two beautiful lakes Beganas. and Rupa. Food was good but surprisingly very Expensive.  Another impressive thing is room had fabulous views of the mountains from the balcony and views of the foothills and lakes from both the room and balcony.

We stayed here for my birthday. It was going to be the luxury part of our trip in Nepal. The photos and blurb on their website makes the place sound amazing. And it is. The views where fantastic. We travelled at a time of the year when the Annapurna range was not as visible due to weather conditions so you cannot be disappointed by that. The view of the valley is still stunning. The staff where wonderful. They helped my partner organise a special table for my birthday dinner and they made a cake and decorated the table with flowers and candles. The food was a nice break from a week of eating strong Nepali food. So we found the simple tastes refreshing. I would not say bland but rather 'home cooked'. We had brought the package deal which included all meals - which was lavish in quantity. Worth the money. The rooms while a little worn and needing a refresh where spacious with great bathrooms. I would not rate them five stars primarily due to the wear and tear. Little things such as the screen doors not opening easily. We had to lift them up so they moved on their tracks. The fridge door would only open if the fridge was angled because of a magnetic clip holding the cupboard door shut. Outside on the balcony the eaves where cracking and plaster was missing in places.But to be honest you don't come to a place as remote and high up in a mountain range that's part of the Himalayas and except perfection. The reason for the three star review was the lack of facilities. We wanted to indulge in a massage. No luck, one wasn't on premises. The front counter advised they would contact the local one. We never heard back. There is no map on the local walks, no indication on how to do the bike riding. No bikes insight. No indication on how to do the activities they mention. Wi-Fi was good. Limited two devices but adequate. Overall a great stay and I would return, probably not as a luxury part of a trip however.

An unplanned trip to Rupakot Resort. The way to the resort was amazing with lots of mesmerising views... Very peaceful and pleasant place to escape the hustle of the city. everything looked clean and nice and what a beautiful swimming pool with a view. Ordered ourselves a Pizza and 2 cocktails ( espresso Martini  and caipirinha ). Restaurant didn't seem to be busy but had to wait for service. The Pizza was amazingly delicious.  Caipirinha tasted one of the best I ever had but the espresso martini was very awful. Still I Will visit this place again when I will be back in Nepal..

This review is not on the resort itself, as I have not yet had he opportunity to stay the night over . It is only a review on the level and quality of the yoga classes at the resort. Having during several occasions participated in yoga classes, now offered by a very experienced teacher at the resort (Dinesh) -  all yoga lovers can look forward to staying at the resort. So if your interest is both to enjoy the natural surroundings, views, as well as to take in the opportunity of a high quality and well tailored yoga class, this is the place. Newcomers are welcome too, and the classes are adjusted to all levels.

We have been in Nepal for three weeks and this was supposed to be our indulgent treat. It doesn't provide what it advertises. Rooms are excellent but that is  as far as goes. The food certainly doesn't match the description of world class cuisine. It was very poor and the service was not much better. We did complain and there was a marked improvement. They seemed to be trying out different methods as breakfast was served in three different ways. There was no spa facility available. The pool looked good but was freezing cold and there was no bird watching, walking etc offered. They really need to get their act together.

I loved Rupakot Resort. It's a very peaceful place. Food was surprisingly very good which I did not except here. Customer Service was good too. I really liked the views and cleanliness of this property. However, I think the food, beverages and rooms are very overpriced.

I was in Rupakot resort attending my cousins wedding last month. The Venue was perfect for a wedding , simply breathtaking views and fantastic service . Since I am a vegetarian . I ordered vegetarian momos and it was so yum .Also the buffet breakfast served was good . I would recommend this place to everyone for a gateaway from the busy city life style. It’s a place where u can relax and also be in a meditative state .

This is a hilltop resort an hours drive up a steep, nearly 4-wheel drive road from Pokhara. It looks over the Bagnas Lake Valley with the Annapurna peaks directly north (visible only 1 day out of our three there).  It’s pricey by Nepal standards and it’s not a luxury resort. The rooms are large and plain, looking a bit worn. There are private balconies to enjoy the stunning view of the valley and surrounding hills. You aren’t guaranteed a Himalaya view due to clouds and haze.  We could hear our neighbors talking through the walls. The pool is cold water, but lovely. There is a restaurant serving basic continental, Indian, Chinese and Nepali fare (reflecting their guests), with an adequate breakfast buffet. We took the day sightseeing package to Pokhara at a pricey $150 USD (again very expensive for Nepal). We did have a lovely day in town and saw all the tourist sites. Our guide was brand new so still learning basic facts and English, but we enjoyed the enthusiasm of the driver and our guide. There are hikes to take around the area, including an easy walk up the hill to a small temple with a cafe. Up a side hill from the temple are small shrines littered with offerings that provide an interesting glimpse into the religious culture.  If you aren’t interested in the tourist areas around Pokhara and just plan to lay by the pool and take some day hikes, this is a good place. We did find it a bit noisy from the other guests playing loud music and watching movies on their phones (we were the only Westerners there).  If you are more interested in the touristy part of Pokhara, this isn’t a good choice. I do also think it is over priced for its state of wear.  Also, the road became quite a dangerous mess and nearly washed out from hard rains one day—it’s not scheduled to be finished until Sept so I can’t imagine how it’s going to stay passable during the monsoon rains this summer.

This hotel has a lovely hilltop location facing the Annapura range and overlooking two lakes.  Our room (404) had fabulous views of the mountains from the balcony and views of the foothills and lakes from both the room and balcony.  The room size was fine and the beds okay.  More attention needs to be paid to cleaning - previous guests' rubbish was under the bed.  Wifi was a bit of an issue but the location is rather isolated.  Currently there is not too much to do at the resort other than relax and enjoy the views, but that alone is enough reason to stay here.  There is a spa but no therapist at the moment and the pools are cool (or cold) but it is pleasant to lie out on the beds and read.  The restaurant food is rather tasteless and the menu vast (less choice and better quality would be our suggestion), and the buffet breakfast was basic, the coffee instant but omelettes are cooked to order.  The exception was the French fries, which were exactly as we like them.  Staff are nice, but there is an obvious need for training (very inconsistent quality of service, some staff were great but many needed training) and for better systems – just one example, two identical invoices at check-out (one signed and the other not) had to be sent to the restaurant to resolve.  There currently is road work but once finished this will make it much better to drive here.  There is a lovely small temple a short stroll away (with small café with a very friendly owner at the base) which we visited along with six cows/buffalo.  Relax, switch off and enjoy the views.

Went with my family and stayed here for 4 nights . It’s the dream project of Mr. PR Adhikari who spent his life in Belgium and now back to his roots to serve his own people . He is gentleman and we had a good time interacting with him .The unique thing about this place is the fabulous views when one can see the Rupa lake, Begnes lake and The Annapurna range in one go. The views of the Annapurna range from the balcony of your rooms is divine experience. The butterflies and the chirping birds add to this divinity . The sounds of the insects and beetles at night with the soothing music of the blowing wind is beyond explaining. The staff is very polite ,well mannered and is always with smiley faces. The food is good . Although basic but delicious and nutritious. The approach is bit difficult as road is under construction but nice things come to you with bit of difficulty. I wish the management to keep it up. In times to come this resort will become an Icon in itself.

Spent a night with my family in the third week of February. It was amazing view due to clear weather. Very nice location but had very bad experience due to poor customer service from staff members and poor standard of foods. It seemed like staff members were not properly trained on how to treat hotel guests as expected. Dining hall and swimming pool was closed which were never communicated prior to our arrival. Overall it wasn't good value for the money and no apologies from the management even after expressing our bad experience. Service with smile is the best policy and to get this result, staff must get proper training with good salary package.

Highly recommended for the views we saw in pictures. But highly suggest to visit this place during the season when there’ll be clearer view of the mountains & lakes. We visited during the Holi season (this season’s not recommended). ‘Coz you won’t be able to take full advantage of the heavenly scenario.As being Nepali tourist, we highly felt that our Basic Daal-Bhat-Tarkari (Nepali Khana Set) is extremely super expensive. After adding 13%Vat & 10% Service Charge it becomes tremendously higher (1400+). Don’t know why the foods are so very much expensive & still doesn’t satisfy your taste buds??It’s a win-win situation both way to the resort. ‘Coz once we enter the resort we have to either way eat at the resort restaurant or stay hungry.And the room service charge is 30% extra??We are extremely satisfied in the room we stayed but at the same time extremely disappointed to eat such an expensive Nepali Khana. We ordered veg thali khana set (even the pickle served’re not homemade), also dislike Veg Sizzling Momo. But Lachha Paratha’s good.Breakfast portion is ok.Swimming pool is still under construction.Suggestion: Everything’s perfect except those super expensive food costs. Please revise your basic food costs (at least Nepali Khana Set: Veg & Non-veg, & few others which we need to eat basically).Or there should be different price for Nepalese Citizens (Nepali tourists).Regards,Anuja.

We arrived from the airport and awaited a 45 minute drive to the hotel. We checked in and proceeded to go for lunch. The dining hall was a construction site as well as the pool. We asked the reception and they then notified us that it would be closed for our four night stay and that we could order room service for every meal of our stay. Annoyed we ordered room service. After half an hour our food arrived carried by two people in flip flops and wrapped in cling film. We immediately checked out and told the receptionist that this was unacceptable for a hotel priced in this category. She then checked us out and charged us for the food, airport pickup and the drive to our new hotel. We were shocked at the lack of knowledge of hospitality and when I requested to speak to a manager she said that there wasn’t anyone I could speak to. Thoroughly disappointing.

Location of resort is very good.. nice view of all three lakes of pokhara as well mountain.. room are very large enough and excellent wifi connection... they will charge extra 30% for room service so its better to walk to restaurant to get food... restaurant is very expensive compared to any other similar properties in nepal ... but the location is great i think they have advantage from location... friendly staff ask any help needed...

In this hotel usually started to use of energy specially bio gas (mithan gas) I don't know nowadays use or not! But leaknath district one of the 5 star hotel use of source of bio energy plant to cooking the food.

Rupakot Resort is set on 10 hectares and nearly 1 hour drive from Pokhara Lakeside and airport.
