Splendid view of Begnas, Rupa and Fewa lakes, couple of hiking routes, an infinity pool, a world-class spa, Panorama restaurant, exotic bar and much more to explore. It’s a haven where your room will seem woven subtly into the landscape directly connecting to Annapurna Himalaya range. Where you’ll enjoy a true sense of space and uninterrupted views of the serene lakes from your private spacious veranda . Giving the taste of Nepali rural life, this is a luxury resort where you’ll discover an outstanding level of service with ultimate comfort.

The place is great. Clean and spacious room. Balcony with the wonderful view of mountains and lakes. A little checking of the room amenities has to be done quite often to confirm everything is at its place. Switches and stuff like that. Overall, great experience. Didn't want to leave this place at all.

One star only because the location is great, otherwise I’d give zero stars. You can get great views which you cannot get anywhere. The resort has clean rooms and is nicely maintained. What makes your stay worst there is their Worst hospitality. Front desk is rude, waiters are rude; they sure need some training. Advice to Rupakot staffs - Please learn to respect Nepali tourists. They are your guests too. Advice to Rupakot management - Please train your staffs. Hotel management degrees mean nothing if they don’t know how to do their job.

Rupakot Resort is the best place to be in Pokhara. Excellent Scenic beauty, amazing views, luxurious rooms, good service, peaceful, good food....One of the Best property i have ever seen. Wonderful experience ever.

As i reach there  the views from the resort was amazing. i was just feeling that i am gliding in space. I did not take any service  from there because we were there only to meet some one there  with my group from Belgium. location and the views of whole pokhara valley and mountains were stunning.

The road is a windy, dusty one that leads you to the top of a hill with stunning views. The downside? Service is slow and food leaves much to be desired. For the price, I wouldn't stay here. For a day visit, there are other places in the area that offer more value and hospitality.

Beautiful relaxing resort overlooking the Annapurna range from our balcony - great place to watch sunrise & sunset from. The restaurant offered nice food but the treat was the managers willingness to share his knowledge of these mountains and his obvious love of this area. Great place to escape to - pool area very nice. Very relaxing. Thank you for our wonderful stay here.

A must to be place.Had a great escape out from city chaos n amazed by the mesmerizing view of the snow peaked mountains down to the begnas n rupa lakes overviewing the beautiful glittering pokhara city.

It is a beautiful resort located on hill top, overlooking the Pokhara valley. The magnificence of Annapurna range revealing finer details of glaciers is mesmerising. One can spend hours studying and admiring each and every peak of this and adjoining ranges. The secret of real Annapurna mountain and location can be heard from the knowledgeable manager. On the other side the twin lakes and adjoining hamlets offer the coolest glimpses of everyday life. The rooms are spacious, well furnished and maintained. The restaurant serves delicious food. Smokers be aware. No smoking in the room or be ready to shell out Rs 10000 fine!!!! This is one of the reasons for the freshness of the ambience.

The resort is peaceful and it has a great view. Very suited for families or for those who wants to be away from the busy life. The restaurant needs to be revamped. Most of the items are not available due to shortage of staff.

Stayed at the Rupakot resort for a night in October 2017. Good resort whose USP is the breathtaking view of the Himalayas that the rooms offer. Even though you have to endure a bumpy ride for almost an hour before you reach the place, the courteous welcome given at the reception makes up for the discomfort of the journey.  Nice spacious room and toilets, very good staff, good food.  However, the AC provided at the room was not commensurate with the size of the room, the effect of the AC was not very good. I think the management should either replace them with ACs with more capacity or alternately install pedestal fans to avoid causing discomfort to guests.  It was very warm when I visited this resort last week (12th/13th October). Overall a good experience, specially for Himalaya lovers.

Rupakot was chosen as the venue to spend one night as part of our silver wedding Anniversary. Why chose Rupakot?  The view! This place has the most amazing views of the Annapurna mountain range. After spending 1 week trekking in Nepal this place provided the best views of the lot. The room was very comfortable with everything you need. The view from the room was simply breathtaking.  Food at the resort is very nice and well presented. The staff will bend to your every request and are very attentive. What I liked was the knowledge of the mountains they have, really interesting when the point out which is which. Found the pool to be a bit chilly but overall I have no complaints what so ever. I would however only suggest that this is a quiet resort and perhaps a maximum of 3 days stay would suffice. I certainly could not have stayed longer. Stay here you will not be disappointed.

If you are looking for a place to getaway from everything, this is the place. It is about 45 mins drive from the city with the last 5 km along dirt road, driving at the edge of the hills.We stayed there during off-peak season, so there were no spa services available. However, the sauna and steam room is available to be used.  The welcome we received was wonderful. The staff was friendly. The female receptionist Avinesh? has been very helpful. She guided us on a small hike and took us to a small dive at the end of the hike, where we experienced authentic Nepalese food and tasted the local moonshine.The room at the hotel is a good size, with a good size bathroom. The air condition can be a bit cranky. However, the view is fantastic.Because it was offseason, there is also a limit of the menu. As it is kinda isolated, there is no nearby shops. They do offer yoga and mediation activities.Overall, if you want peace and quiet, this is the place, But if you are planning some activities such as paragliding, maybe a hotel in the city would be better.

I came to this resort because it was recommended to me, as a resort that could be one of the best in Nepal. After I came back I was not sure if there would be another place that could be compared to this one. I felt like this place had all the qualities I was looking for: Astonishing nature, tranquility, luxury and friendly staff. This place is so unique, I will definately come back.

I stayed at the resort for about a week and I absolutely loved it. The view is incredible and the facilities are great as well. As a quite sceptic foodie I must say I was very pleased by the food at the resort. A luxurious setting in a natural area where you can relax and put your mind at ease. I will definitely go back!

We stayed at Rupakot Resort on July 4th 2017 and we had an awesome experience. Receptionist were courteous and friendly and they greeted us with a welcome drink which is fresh made lemonade. Then they showed us rooms. We fascinated by the view from each room. Had yummy khaja and then dinner at night. They had plenty of options on the menu. We had a very good night sleep and woke up to the majestic views in the morning. Breakfast variety of options and good portion too. I see some previous reviewers are saying less options on the menu but I didn't feel like that it had less options. I loved everything about the Resort and thinking of coming back soon.

Pros: great views thats about it.Cons: the swimming pool water was murky, they somehow messed up with the amount of chemicals to put in. One of the reasons we chose this resort was because of the pool but the marketing manager at their Ktm office failed to inform of their pool chemical blunder, the mgmt had I dont care attitude when this issue was brought to them. Its basically a tourist trap once you have pre paid for the services. Its overpriced! If its the view you want theres plenty of options at Pokhara for half the price.

The place is amazing with no doubts. People say the roads are bad but I would say its worth it. When you reach up there you will literally just fall in love with the place the view the rooms, the pool. For me the stay was amazing and because it is in the upper hills lets you do a bit of exercise which i like personally.The morning view is absolutely stunning. The thing that made it a little awkward for me was when we checked in we asked the guy who showed us the room about the buffet dinner and the pricing he told us that the pricing is done only after they see whats on the plate which was a bit odd for me but i thought maybe that s how it is supposed to be later at the time of dinner we found out that it was nothing of that sort and we ended up ordering from Alacarte Menu. Information should be passed on very clearly. They are still doing their construction and Im very sure they will excel in this as the property itself is ahhmazzing! Also a suggestion if grooming could be looked after at the reception it would be a plus point for the hotel. Lastly only if we could improvise the breakfast menu as it has very limited menu. But I will still recommend this hotel to everyone as its worth every penny.

The location is amazing! It is already the first choice for holidays for most of the travellers. However, I recommend the visitors to visit only after the road to Rupakot Resort is fully constructed. Hope the construction will be completed in couple of years. Any one who is adventurous could take the full privilege of the road as well. Having said all the above, the service has to be improved!!

As a Tourist•  A beautiful and quiet place where you can truly re-energize and rejuvenate. Place most suitable for those undertaking/organizing activities, programs related to wellness, well-being, spirituality……•  Spacious, clean rooms with good amenities and fantastic view.•  Good Food; taste enhanced due to the view from Panorama, the hanging garden  overlooking at two beautiful lakes (Rupa and Begnas) and of course, the way its prepared and served by the staff. •  Well-groomed staff with human element – liked the most!!! Where there are good people, service is unquestionable ☺As a Nepali •  A Nepali who has so much zeal about development in rural Nepal. Personally I found his upcoming project of “Old Village” fascinating!!!•  Exemplary for those Nepali who dream about great life and ample opportunities abroad and leave Nepal for the same pursuit not realising the potential Nepal has. •  Our role as Nepali – support this initiative in every possible way as the establishment of Resort, no doubt has business motive, yet has created a lot of possibilities for people in the surrounding areas; job creation, supply of drinking water, access road………has direct effect on the overall development of Rupakot VDC.•  We need more of such initiatives in other rural Nepal and we need many more such individuals who believe in inculcating self-reliance than making fellow-citizens more dependent through charity works!!!•  Looks like access to education is still a challenge in that area – hope to see some initiatives in this area too!!!

I stayed at the Rupakot resort on June 7th with my two boys ages 10 and 12. We had a great time there. It is truly a world class resort with exceptionally warm and friendly staff. We greatly enjoyed the infinity pool. We could clearly see the Annapurna range while soaking in the pool water. The view from the pool was truly breathtaking. It almost felt like we were in a natural lake surrounded by mountains.We liked the fact that most of the property was off-limit to day visitors. Unlike other resorts and hotels in Nepal, they don't allow anyone to use the pool for a fee. It is exclusively for the staying guests. We were able to enjoy the pool with serenity and we soaked in the view for hours without a screaming crowd. I hope they won't give in to the temptation to make more money and keep the pool for in-house guests only.The rooms were very comfortable with all the modern amenities you expect in a world class resort. It is amazing to find such modern comfort in such a remote natural place in a country like Nepal. The view from the balcony felt surreal and heavenly. You have to be there to experience it.Overall, we were really happy to experience Rupakot resort. We will definitely go back and stay there next time we are in Nepal.

I booked a private taxi from Pokhara Lakeside to Rupakot resort for lunch. It is approx.26 km 1 hr.15 mins drive. Road condition is pretty bad.The food at restaurant is tasty, menu is not very variety but it is worth to enjoy tasty food with good view.I ordered Nicoise Salad, Spaghetti Bolognese, Chowmien, 2 bottles of Gorkha beer, it costs about 40USDPrice is not too bad, the food portion is neither big nor small.I received Nachos salsa as complimentary snack. Credit card is accepted without surcharge.I got a chance to inspect hotel room.The room is good but not exact 5-star hotel international standard. The hotel provides sauna, spa and yoga room. Private car cost 50$ to pick-up and drop-off. There is a construction close to the hotel (June 2017) so you may expect some noises.It is resort you should come to enjoy its facility during your stay, but if you expect to stay in the resort and hang out in city at daytime. It will be too trouble for driving up and down with the 2-3 km long muddy road.Or else u love adventure drive.

This resort is built on top of a hill overlooking two lakes - Begnas and Rupa Lake. The view is simply stunning and the mountain range can also be seen from here. The facility has a nice swimming pool and a good restaurant with really tasty food. The rooms are simple but good standard, very clean and functional and staff are very helpful. The garden is still in the growing phase, but lots of flowers. We would love to see more trees around as it does seem a little bare without much shade, but I guess it takes time to grow trees. We would certainly recommend this facility to anyone for a nice break. Location is quite remote, which is an advantage if you're looking for peace and quiet, but make sure to bring with you all personal items needed for your stay.

We , the team from Responsible Trek , were here to see the property. The service exceed our expectation . The room were really big with exception view of mountains and lakes . During the clear day you can get view of Mt Annapurna and Mt Machapuchhre . The swimming pool at the highest point of pokhara is at another level . The best things about Rupakot resort is it's very eco friendly and Food there's was best I've had after really really long . Subarna ( waiter ) was really kind and professional  and made sure we were alright from breakfast till the dinner . Highly recommended for those who are looking for peace and good view and ofcourse good food on top of hills . preferbale for family ,kids and of all age group ! Worth every penny !! Definetly coming back with my family and friends !!

Very nice hotel with clean rooms and great view, probably one of the best in Pokhara. This hotel is almost 50 mins (drive) away from Pokhara downtown. Considering overall infrastructure and service, hotel needs to work on quality of food. I would not say bad food but definitely roam for improvement for hotel like this.

At about an hour drive from pokhara lakeside this is a quite new resort on a hilltop with fantastic views. Beautiful and spacious rooms with all amenities. As this is a recent place the trees an flowers in the garden are still small. Impeccable service in the restaurant.

We stayed about a week in this fabulous resort and enjoyed a lot - majestic view, luxury room, landscape, all greenery and good food. All rooms have excellent view of mountain, landscape and lakes. You will not be willing to leave the place once you reach there. Access road from Pokhara to there is not that great, especially 5-6 KM, but it can also be taken as adventure.

The resort is located on top of a hill which offers us a breathtaking view of the surrounding valleys, lake, river & mountains. views are similar from all room due to the beautiful planning of the resort. the food was also good.

Majestic view.... Peace .... Luxury !! Far from day to day city chaos. 360° view of lifetime.... Beauty of nature. Find yourself back from this busy virtual world !! Superb location, excellent management who cater your needs while you stay . Environment you can cherish every moment. Come with friends, family, solo or even foes..... Come to nature and oneself. I enjoyed every moment and time visited here. Highly recommended...... Enjoy !!

Rupacot has fantastic views of the Annapurna range, and is a stunning place to stay.  But apart from that there is little to do.  Front office merely checked us into our room - which we had to change because of an electrical fault - and did not give us a list of activities that they could arrange.  Only when we checked out early did they bother to tell us what we could do.  Which wasn't much outside a trek and bird watching.The road to the resort was terrible - under construction - and I arrived completely shaken from head to foot.  Indeed on the return journey there was a landslide, which I had to scale to get to a car on the other side.  Ruined to rest I was hoping to have.Management was lax. Shame because it could be a fantastic place for rest and relaxtion.

This place is magical and the service is outstanding. The owner was so hospitable and took personal interest in everything . The Chef , Lekhnath was splendid, he would cook for us and take care of us in every possible way. We had to say what we wanted and he would take Care of the palette and spice things up accordingly.The place itself is outstanding, the majestic view of the mountains. The rooms with balconies , hot water flowing 24x7. This place is true value for money, a must stay for everyone !

A magical place close to the heaven that is Rupakot. The hotel is wonderful in fine gardens 1200 meters above sea level. The rooms are very comfortable all with fine actually stunning views and oh so comfortable beds. All fixtures, fittings and furniture are of good quality. The food is plentiful and delicious served with great care by the very attentive staff watched by a very good Chef.All staff are so very lovely and eager to please. Had a great day today especially walking with some of them to a nearby village where the elders invited us in for tea. This was followed by a good massage professionally delivered. Thank you to all.

My wife and I had a great stay out here last night. Really surprised but delighted by the style of service given- extremely professional. Amenities and facilities are top class for such a remote area. Will definitely be back when there is a clear forecast.

Had difficulty in reaching the place due road construction .. but once there you tend to forget all your trouble. Awesome view from the resort as well as from the room. Full mountain range and the lakes below as well as some view of pokhara city too. Looking forward to go again.

Though the road was bumpy ride which took us an hour from the prithvi highway; rupakot experience was magnificient. Scenic view of himalayan range just in front of your eyes and two lakes just beneath your foot steps is rare and lovely combination I guess. The staffs were decent, helpful and co-operative. The rooms were good but reception is far poor compared to the rooms. I hope they have better and bigger idea for the reception area.

It is a bumpy ride to Rupakot Resort. But the view once you reach your destination, more than makes up for it. Located on the top of a hill, the view of the mountains is jaw-dropping to say the least. The resort is  well made with new buildings and spacious rooms. It provides a perfect break from the hustle and bustle of the cities. The infinity swimming pool provides an unforgettable view of the mountains above and the lakes below.However, a downside during our stay was the lamentable food at the resort. The kitchen was seriously understaffed and considering there were so few guests at the resort during that time, that is really inexcusable. Over 70% of the items in the menu was not available and when the food arrived (after a lengthy wait), there really was not much to write home about. Considering there isn't any other eating options around the area, this really was a big let down.Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend the resort. Hopefully, serious improvements can be made in the food department.

Heaven on earth! The first thing that comes to my mind when I think abt Rupakot Resort. It all started off really well, perfect meet and greet, friendly and fast check in etc etc and  the overall ambience was just wow until we came to dinner time ..The menu looked very promising so we ordered both starters and mains at the same time considering we had kids almost beyond bedtime. The sets of starters came after a 30 mins wait, great presentation and tasted good too. There was no sign of food after that for a really long time. To cut it short,  an hour and 45 minutes, 2 enquiries and 3 complaints later, our mains arrived. We were all quite frustrated to be precise so dint enjoy the food like we would have if it had arrived on time. Anyway we decided to put this forward during checkout as the manager was no where to be seen when asked. We called it a night and the next morning we had a real opportunity  to explore nature at its best. The view is just beyond stunning and the amount of effort that's gone on the making of the resort is just so evident .The breakfast was a treat to both your eyes and tummy. Fabulous 5 star American breakfast like even the bread was resort baked and the sausages were prepared from scratch ..This was certainly the best American breakfast I ve ever had . During checkout, we raised the issue from the night before and after a little bit of a discussion with the manager, was sorted our with no fuss  ( not that we  asked for a heavy discount or something major). But the best thing was it was resolved and we left as happy and satisfied customers hence I am here to write a review. Well done to everyone and hope for the best. Good luck xx

An amazing resort in an amazing location from where we can see lakes, mountains, forest, typical nepalese village culture and so on. Rooms are wide with a view balcony, foods are delicious, staffs are full of hospitality. It was really a  memorable place.

It really is a heaven on Earth and is a must go for the ones searching for calm and peaceful environment with breathtaking views. One of the very few resorts in Nepal with such a mesmerizing and jawdropping surrounding. There is no other places to have your food like in the hanging garden enjoying the hills and mountains above whereas beautiful lakes below. The hotel staffs were really friendly making our stay more comfortable. Loved the food as well! Just had a little trouble getting up there but happy to hear than the road is being black topped soon. Will surely return ! A must go place for everybody !!

I was very surprised how one can make a dream come true making such a beautiful resort in such a place. when I knew the story of the resort construction and the future plans of extending property and the rural village programms it was a true inspiration  to me.we were with the family to spend our New year holiday. Our time spent there became one of our best moment in our life as the below things were ireplacable experience one can get:*The property itself*The breathe taking views of himalayas city and lakes.*The resort had very hospitable staff, always eager to serve thought they were not so much professional as the downtown properties.* They didn't have room service as the buildings were far from restaurant but served in special case like elderly people sick and babies.. which was good.And other more things were so much which has touched our heart. one must visit this place.

The only best part of this resort was the amazing view we get from the top. Location is very good. Disappointed with the food and service. No room service. Everything you need is to be bought from the restaurant itself.

Amazing View- Yes!Customer Service Experience- Really needs tremendous improvement!!One needs to be patient to be there...from oversight of bookings to giving rooms with zero view...frustrating after 1plus hour journey up the current dangerous road condition. Thankfully the view was great..if not...high priced rooms with very basic room amenities + disappointing check in experience

What a place!!! Amazing view amidst all the modern comfort and the beautiful positive aura of Nepal...What a vision!!! Of a young boy who was born here, went to Belgium, made it big and returns back to give back to his own place and people...Truly a heaven!!! Not to be missed!!! Just one hour from Pokhara, this place is a confluence of 5 elements, Sun : Air : Space : Hills & Mountains : Two LakesAll the elements in one...A perfect spot for experiencing true Nepal...Walk around the villages adds further towards enhancing the flavours of this great nation...

I had a family suite and stayed there for three nights a month ago. Sitting out on patio and watching the sun rays covering Himalayas in the morning as well as in the evening was probably one of the most beautiful view i had ever seen in my life. Yes indeed the view right from my room was hypnotic. The blanket of mist on the valley just felt like we are sitting above the cloud in the morning. Resort room was very modern with all amenities. Since we had a kid, hotel staffs were so kind to make few trips from restaurant to our room brining baby food, hot water etc. I couldn’t ask more than what they have provided. Top notch customer service exceeded my expectation. Reflection of mount fishtail on their swimming pool reminded me of the reflection of the same in Fewa lake.  One other things i was captivated was all organic food served from their own garden. YES i meant from resort’s own GARDEN. Resort premises is very nice with great swimming pool. View of the pokhara valley along with curved Himalayas view from the patio of restaurant is nothing less than one has ever expected.With all that said, my stay at Rupakot resort was exceptionally pleasant.  I am planning to visit the resort in the future with my family and friends.

The location is  isolated as it's basically on top of a hill. If you are looking for a peaceful  get away from the busy city life, this would be the perfect place.There's swimming pool and restaurant and a gorgeous view to accompany you. The service was great, but the food tasted delicious but is a bit over priced.Also, one thing this resort needs to work on is the wifi, the connection didn't work out for me at all.

I had the best time in Rupakot. I went there with my family in july during summer. It was amazing. The view was unbelievable and the staff were so nice. The hospitality was great and the food even better. The best meal I've had in Nepal by far! I cannot wait to return.

Located 22 KM apart from central Pokhara and even serving us excellently! The location is absolutely brilliant, above the clouds and next to the mountains.The room was comfortable and the food was delicious. The staffs were sedulous as well as friendly too. The outstanding view of the mountains and lakes along with the clouds had taken my breath. The sunrise and the sunset view was amazing.Standing over the hanging garden involuntarily creates the imagination of flying over the Rupa Lake. The new made vitality pool will make my coming visit more fruitful.

Although the roads are not so good but when you will reach the destination at the top it will be the most beautiful feeling. The morning and evening view from the resort is great.If you want to hike they also have that facility.Manage your time to experience rupakot resort once :)

After travelling around 200 KM from Kathmandu (5.5 Kilometer rough road from Lekhnath) we reached Rupakot Resort. After some formalities we got the room with tremendous view of Lake and Mountain.  Room was nice with all modern amenities.  Food was delicious, Staff was very helpful and friendly,Only disappointment that there was very less number of staff, only one lady handles whole restaurant. Maybe it happened because of Dashain Holiday.Overall nice and relax stay at RUPAKOT RESORT.

Went to this Resort after seeing a lot of photos every where in FB and IG. I asked my brothers to company me to a breakfast to this place after hearing alot of this place. First of all the place is hard to find, the Resort people have not put enough directions on the way, they have kept signs to reach there only when 5.5km of off-road left. On the gate we were not greeted well, the guard did not make us feel welcome, the first thing he asked was "Do you have bookings?",which was a surprise question to us, there was no Nameste or a smiling face. When we reached the parking lot, there was a person who came to greet us though, but after talking to him we felt that if we need to come here, we need to come as a in house guest and not for formal visits. As we had already reached the resort and told we were there for breakfast they could not say NO and allowed us for breakfast. While eating breakfast we looked around the resort to see the fine garden, the beautiful building and infrastructure they had built and forgot the previous incidents. The breakfast was OK, same as we get in other buffet breakfast around town. After breakfast we decided to stroll around the place but we were once again not allowed as reason told were that the area was just for In house guest,and formal visits were allowed only till the restaurant and bar area. The whole experience was in vain. The last time I visited Himalayan Front the people were very greeting, and asked us please to enjoy the hotels infrastructure, and we were very disappointed with this place. My advice is to please put some information about not allowing causal visitors because people might be disappointed after reaching this place after a small struggle.  Please try to solve this issue

We were very well received at this hilltop resort. The infrastructure and the pool is well maintained and everything is clean. Only the view of the Anapurna on a clear day is already worth going there!

Family visit at Rupakot resort during Dashain was amazing trip and my kid also got very much happy. This reference was given by Mr. Bhaskar with special package. View of mountain was supub and will come back again in next year. Rooms were very spaces and clean. Swimmingpool was very nice and we reallg enjoyed alot.

We had a drive of 30mins from Pokhara and had reached at tremendous resort. Very relaxed resort with all amenities. The best part is View of Annapurna Mountain and 5 Lake.... Swimming is very nice with the buzz of beers.

Amazing view which will blow anyone's mind the view of the mountain and the lakes with excellent personal service, excellent " architecture, excellent cuisine, I think it is the best Resort in Pokhara so far its a must visit place a resort which has a infinity pool . All rooms have direct mountain view and are very spacious. Rooms with minibar. Free internet.  Very friendly and helpful staff !!!This one is a must visit place .

I went there on Monday afternoon with my cousin who drove all the way from butwal.. Having been there before, I told him how good their food was and the view from the resort was outstanding..It isn't easy to get up there.. we drove all the way up off road.. to lastly realise they weren't taking any guests because they were full.. I did check their website before making our way up. There wasn't any information about it..They weren't picking up my calls either..!!

I found this five star category resort is located on the top of Rupakot village about 22 KM East from Pokhara spreading in 25 acres of land. The resort is a combination of nature, luxury and heritage.

It was my first visit at Luxury Rupakot Resort just two days ago and just 22 kilometers near Pokhara. I came with two guests. We enjoyed the natural spring water pool and the stunning views! This is a place for nature lovers. I will come back middle of October for a couple of days to find out more for my German tour operator COLIBRI TRAVEL BERLIN!

Super place as like a heaven as we had heard. Its located very top and can see the beautiful mountain and also the lakes. The amazing part is the smimming pool which was not accepted.  Rooms are very good and service is wow. If you are traveling then you must visit and stay there.

This place was highly recommended by my friends. And finally got chance to visit in September 2016. This place is really a paradise and its hard to find such place in the entire planet. The Property itself is a unique in its kind. The most exciting and breathtaking thing is the panoramic  mountain range, views of lakes, infinity swimming pool and the nature around. Falling in love with delicious foods prepared by finest hands, enjoying the natural beauty, sitting at the hanging restaurant is a rare feelings one can get here; which is near to impossible at other places. To explain this place with words will be less and incomplete, "Seeing is Believing" is what i can say about this place indeed.

Rupakot Resort is one of the most beautiful places in Nepal, a paradise on earth.The view on the Himalayas, the two lakes and forests is just breathtaking.The staff is incredibly friendly and helpful, a pleasure to be there.The food is excellent and delicious, there is also plenty of choice for all tastes.The rooms are classy and equipped with the latest technology.The pool is a pleasure to swim in, with mountain views, incredibly beautiful.My respect for the project Pushpa Raj Adhikari who realised  his dream  on the top of a mountain.Congratulations and good luck, Catherine Maes

Its once in a life time opportunity to see such a beautiful property. A must visit resort before you die! Best Himalayan view, extremely luxurious, artisan handcrafted construction, the top of the line safety and security and the best own grown food.

I didn't stay there but took a very bumpy motorcycle ride with my wife to the resort for lunch. Amazing view . The scenery and service made up for the less than comfortable ride up there. Not a place to miss out if you in Pokhara area

It's good experience to visit this resort as I'm seeing it from Begnas lake just below it.It has spacious property and plenty of facilities & amenities required for a luxurious resort.And above all, a picturesque sceneries everywhere from below with 2 lakes to above series of Himalayan mountain peaks. All these will steal your heart n stay in your memory for long period of time.Love to come back here soon in around October for photography plus stay.

I have the pleasure of having stayed at Rupakot Resort with my friends by early May, this year, which is a resort at the mountain top in Nepal close to 2000  meters high, with all its silence and darkness at night, which is undoubtedly an ideal place for meditation and being away from city hurries, whilst you could still enjoy modern facilities provided within this resort. Whilst enjoying a bird view of Rupa Lake underneath, one may even have a distinct look of the Himalayas with the right moment of the season and good climate, . 有幸在本年五月初與友人一起留宿於尼泊爾的一座坐落於近乎2000 meters 高之 Rupakot Resort。那裡入夜後所擁有的寧靜及漆黑無疑是予人冥想及遠離繁囂之好地方；卻又同時可享有此渡假村所提供的現代化設備。除了居高臨下盡攬 Rupa Lake 之美景，更可在合適的季節及天氣狀況下遠眺喜馬拉雅山呢！

After staying at Rupakot Resort in Nov 2015, i can absolutely see why this resort is rated number one in pokhara and its vicinity. Rupakot resort offers everything one needs. Most prominently sitting on the top of a mountain, over looking Begnas and  Rupa lake with breathtaking views of pokhara valley and curvature scene of Himalayan range is just a few to name. I say there are a few places on earth which can cater everything a person can imagine and one of them is Rupakot Resort.  I stayed here back in November 2015 with my wife and our little daughter. We were graciously greeted by the owner of the Resort. Great hospitality!!! We spent a lot of time enjoying delicious food, amazing hospitality of all the staffs and of course breathtaking view of Pokhara valley and Himalaya Range. The peace, quite and ambiance of the resort is unbeatable. Service from hotel staffs must be commended. From resort manager, who is the funniest, the most gracious person to concierge, one can not walk by without a smile. I can’t say enough positive about our experience at Rupakot resort, and we hope to visit again next year!!  Thank you for your such a great service!! DipenUSA

I had booked at this hotel via booking.com. I informed hotel about my change in flight but didn't receive any confirmation. I tried calling at hotel number but it was not picked when I arrived Pokhara the next day so I tried to reach resort on my own but the way was too rough and the taxi charged me Rs. 1200 and I was dropped at Begnas Resort.That trip to Pokhara was one of my worst experience. I asked the gardener at the Resort and he took me to the Rupakot Resort. The view was amazing and I regret that I couldn't got chance to stay at this wonderful Resort. Though, I planned to have lunch at Rupakot Resort. It was wonderful as well. But I felt its not being run by a team of professionals. I asked for a night stayed there.One of my friend from Belgium had referred me this hotel. I checked hotel website and found hotel too fascinating. But, the people who has been running it seems unprofessional with no communication at all.

The view from the site was straight out of the fairly tales- I have no words to describe the beauty and the serenity I experienced. One has to go and experience it oneself. The location is out of the world and the staffs & service just compliments the unparalleled beauty of the place.

Rupakot resort proved to be heaven on earth. No doubt, the scenic beauty of machhapuchre range, lakes and Pokhara valley view and tranquil environment gave peace to my heart. Accommodation, Organic foods and hospitality of resort staff made me felt royal.

My husband and I decided to celebrate our wedding anniversary there and we felt we made the right choice of hotel. The location and view are breathtaking, the staff is very welcoming, friendly and helpful and the rooms and facilities are clean and inviting. We were particularly impressed by the food. It was authentic and tasty. The complex including the spa, swimming pool and sauna will soon be ready and we hope to go back to enjoy these new facilities.

Rupakot does not deserve 1 star I would have given it a zero star rating if I could. We booked for 14 nights to relax and enjoy but ended up being stressed and disappointed. Rupakot does not have proper water and electricity supply. Everyday at 10am until 6pm the power of our room got turned off which meant no electricity plus no water supply in the bathroom and we were told we need to call up reception every time they turn off the power so we did but they would turn on the power in our room for only 30mins and then turn it off again. On our 7th, 8th and 9th day they started turning off the power during the nights from 10pm to 6am as well. We could not use the  bathroom during the night as there was no water supply and they did not provide any torch or candles in the room. We had to ask for the candles and received 2 tiny tealights in our room. There is no one at the reception to answer your calls during the night so if you need anything you need to have a local sim to call the staff. When we complained about the inadequate power supply to the manager and even the owner their excuse was the generator heated up, the government turned the power off or the generator was being refilled with diesel. We asked our Nepalese travel agent through whom we booked Rupakot to speak to them and later we got to know they told him the electricity pole fell down during a storm but they never mentioned this to us. Do note this…every time they would have a different excuse. The storm took place on the 7th day of our stay but from the very 1st day we noticed they turn off the power from 10am till 6pm. Only a very few rooms are occupied and most people stay only for 1 night and it is likely they are trying to save money by not running the in house power generators.The food is pretty average and the restaurant is crawling with insects and I hope they do not give me the excuse that you are on top of a mountain and in the middle of a forest so there would be no power and insects would crawl over you. We have been to Six Senses Yao Noi which is a jungle resort, Cocoa Island Maldives which is in the middle of the indian ocean and Datai Langkawi surrounded by rainforests. All those fine hotels had superb 5 star facilities and were very close to wild life and no the insects did not fancy crawling over their guests. On our 9th day we booked a private car from the resort to take us 1st to rupa lake and then to begnas lake. We booked the car for 2pm so that by the time we get to begnas the temperature would be nice and cool for a boat ride. The manager called us up and said it would be too windy for a boat ride if we start our journey at 2pm it would be best to leave at 1pm. We agreed but little did we know the hotel planned to put other guests in our car and also the owner had plans to travel with us as he had some work to do in Pokhara and for this the 1pm time was fixed. After a very bumpy 6km ride we got down from the mountain dropped the other guests and then the car dropped us at begnas and said the owner will be taking the car to Pokhara for 3hrs and left us we at begnas lake in the scorching heat to take a boat ride. Please note again we were paying for this entire trip and the car was being used by others. By this time we had enough we immediately got back to the hotel and called our travel agent he booked us a room for 5 nights at Fish Tail lodge and we were very happy to check out of Rupakot.  Fish tail lodge had 24hrs water and electricity supply and so do the other hotels (Gokarna forest resort, Hyatt regency, Shangri-la Village Pokhara).  I will never recommend Rupakot to anyone. I have stayed in many 4 to 5 star hotels and resorts throughout Asia, Africa, Europe and America and this is the worst resort we have ever stayed in. In short Rupakot offers 3 star facilities and for the price of a 5 star.(Rupakot- 6km bumpy ride to the top and 12km away from Pokhara)

On our way back from "Dhaulagiri Sanctuary Trek exploration,"  three of us ( Amrit Bhadgaole a reputed journalist from Nagarik Daily, Pawan Shakya the Director of Himalayan Map house and I ) visited Rupakot resort on second week of March 2016. The employee of the resort heartily welcomed us. We had delicious dinner at Panorama restaurant with excellent view of Rupa and Begnas lake and twinkling Pokhara valley. Towards the north long stretch view of Annapurna ranges including Mt. Fishtail. Sunset and sunrise was awe-inspiring. The room are exceptionally luxurious and at least two view out of four ( lakes, himalayan range, sunrise and sunset) could be seen from every room.The Resort is unique and exceptionally beautiful and perfectly matches with its slogan: Nature, Luxury & Heritage.We had a nice holiday at your luxurious resort and had wonderful conversation with great visionary and confident owner Mr. Pushpa Raj Adhikari family.Thanks for friendly and great hospitality at Rupakot Resort.

The view from the room was stunning. The area around the tranquil and features! Owner of the hotel is the hospitable man! The restaurant met all our desires! At the dawn of a beautiful view of the mountains!

Me and my friend stayed to the Rupakot Resort for a night, we reached there by 4:00 PM because we did not wanted to miss the beautiful sunset view from the view point of this resort. The resort is amazingly made constructed with a wonderful architecture on the top of a hill. The resort is surrounded by beautiful Mount Fishtail, Mount Annapurna , Mount Manaslu; just beneath the mountain and the hilly ranges you find two lakes Rupa and Begnas lakes beauty at its best. Rupakot Resort is a must visit resort while you happen to be in Nepal. I enjoyed every bit of it, delicious food, amazing scenery and a luxury stay.

The greatest attraction to Nepal is tourism. This beautiful country has the most hospitable and charming peoples, amazing attractions, culture, history and wildlife to enjoy as a tourist. The owners of this Rupakot Resort have cut down every tree in what is an area of outstanding beauty. It is just mind-boggling that anyone can think that this is the right thing to do.That aside, the Rupakot Resort has good accommodation. The rooms are a generous size with balconies and they are well finished off. The rooms were clean, the beds comfortable and well-laid out with nice décor. The bathrooms have a bath and a shower and again are spacious and well finished off.The restaurant and bar offer the most incredible views over the Begnas and Rupa Lakes, as well as, the majestic Himalayan Mountains, it is breathtakingly beautiful. The beer was cold and the food was served hot and tasty enough. The service was generally good and the staffs were very friendly and helpful.Rupakot Resort is a 45 minute drive from Lakeside (15.6 miles / 25 km’s) and the airport is a little closer (14.1 miles or 22.6km’s). A wonderful drive, brilliant scenery as you climb higher and higher. The gravel road was in good condition and if you love the outdoors and nature the surrounding countryside is great to explore.The problem with this resort development is that they are going to be building for many years. We were advised of the future construction and that I believe is going to have an impact on anyone’s stay for the foreseeable future.It is a great pity that Nepal does not have more stringent environmental rules to stop this unnecessary felling of indigenous flora and fauna. In my humble opinion this a lost opportunity of what should have been a remarkable development. When I first saw this scar atop the mountain, I was reminded of a great Cree Indian Prophecy:Only when the last tree has been cut downOnly when the last river has been poisonedOnly when the last fish has been caughtOnly then will you find that money cannot be eaten.If I was the owner, I would start planting trees to try and restore some of what has been lost.

My husband and I stayed at Rupakot Hotel for one night on our way to Pokhara.  We wish we could have had more time there!  The hotel is located at the top of a mountain and has the most beautiful views of the Annapurna Mountain range.  Sunrise and sunset was stunning.  The road up to the hotel was rocky, but well worth it when you get to the top.  The rooms are clean and spacious.  Service was excellent and we couldn't have been more pleased.  Thank you for a lovely stay!

Oh my gosh, i stayed at the resort for two nights and left wanting to stay more. Im defs coming back again, and this time with all my girl friends. It is actually the most spectacular getaway and i cannot thank the staff enough for everything. Great hospitality, i was very impressed! :)

i found Rupakot Resort to be very amazing for the true nature lover. The view was covered with clouds but right after the lunch the cloud faded surprisingly and the view was just WOW!!! i didnt liked the road ways to reach there... but i found the hotel to be in a very unique location..

This resort is in one of the most amazing locations you could ever imagine, the views of the Annapurnas are truly splendid and the added bonus of the views of Rupa and Begnas lakes makes it even better. Service is good and attentive!  I am sure when pool and spa areas are finished this will be on of the top resort to stay at in Nepal.

The resort is located in a very very peace location.The views are superb and very awesome.Kind staff,The foods were very tasty.Spacious rooms,clean,neat and tidy.The rooms had all the amenities that it needed.If you would like to stay at a peace place then this is the very right choice.The views are so good that i have no word to explain it.Definitely visiting again.Thank you Rupakot Resort.

I stayed at this resort for 3 days in the month of December. It was a great experience spending time watching mountains, lakes, sunrise and sunset views, and Pokhara valley. The luxurious accommodation and overwhelming service added value to our stay. The food is also very nice. My family enjoyed a lot in the surrounding. We will definitely go back there.

It was a great experience to spend a couple of days at the Rupakot resort.  The rooms are very nice and it was marvellous when opening my eyes in the morning to see the sun coming up and giving the mountains a beautiful orange colour.The staff is very kind and helpful. A large choice of food is available at the buffet.

Great hotel, super friendly staff, excellent meal and breakfast, the view from the rooms is incredible, I recommend 100% the value for money is also very good, breakfast included in the room price. Valet service that picks you up at the airport or in the city center is also a big plus!
