The room are exceptionally luxurious and at least two view out of four ( lakes, himalayan range, sunrise and sunset) could be seen from every room.The Resort is unique and exceptionally beautiful and perfectly matches with its slogan: Nature, Luxury & Heritage.We had a nice holiday at your luxurious resort and had wonderful conversation with great visionary and confident owner Mr. Pushpa Raj Adhikari family.Thanks for friendly and great hospitality at Rupakot Resort.

The view from the room was stunning. The area around the tranquil and features! Owner of the hotel is the hospitable man! The restaurant met all our desires! At the dawn of a beautiful view of the mountains!

Me and my friend stayed to the Rupakot Resort for a night, we reached there by 4:00 PM because we did not wanted to miss the beautiful sunset view from the view point of this resort. The resort is amazingly made constructed with a wonderful architecture on the top of a hill. The resort is surrounded by beautiful Mount Fishtail, Mount Annapurna , Mount Manaslu; just beneath the mountain and the hilly ranges you find two lakes Rupa and Begnas lakes beauty at its best. Rupakot Resort is a must visit resort while you happen to be in Nepal. I enjoyed every bit of it, delicious food, amazing scenery and a luxury stay.

The greatest attraction to Nepal is tourism. This beautiful country has the most hospitable and charming peoples, amazing attractions, culture, history and wildlife to enjoy as a tourist. The owners of this Rupakot Resort have cut down every tree in what is an area of outstanding beauty. It is just mind-boggling that anyone can think that this is the right thing to do.That aside, the Rupakot Resort has good accommodation. The rooms are a generous size with balconies and they are well finished off. The rooms were clean, the beds comfortable and well-laid out with nice décor. The bathrooms have a bath and a shower and again are spacious and well finished off.The restaurant and bar offer the most incredible views over the Begnas and Rupa Lakes, as well as, the majestic Himalayan Mountains, it is breathtakingly beautiful. The beer was cold and the food was served hot and tasty enough. The service was generally good and the staffs were very friendly and helpful.Rupakot Resort is a 45 minute drive from Lakeside (15.6 miles / 25 km’s) and the airport is a little closer (14.1 miles or 22.6km’s). A wonderful drive, brilliant scenery as you climb higher and higher. The gravel road was in good condition and if you love the outdoors and nature the surrounding countryside is great to explore.The problem with this resort development is that they are going to be building for many years. We were advised of the future construction and that I believe is going to have an impact on anyone’s stay for the foreseeable future.It is a great pity that Nepal does not have more stringent environmental rules to stop this unnecessary felling of indigenous flora and fauna. In my humble opinion this a lost opportunity of what should have been a remarkable development. When I first saw this scar atop the mountain, I was reminded of a great Cree Indian Prophecy:Only when the last tree has been cut downOnly when the last river has been poisonedOnly when the last fish has been caughtOnly then will you find that money cannot be eaten.If I was the owner, I would start planting trees to try and restore some of what has been lost.

My husband and I stayed at Rupakot Hotel for one night on our way to Pokhara.  We wish we could have had more time there!  The hotel is located at the top of a mountain and has the most beautiful views of the Annapurna Mountain range.  Sunrise and sunset was stunning.  The road up to the hotel was rocky, but well worth it when you get to the top.  The rooms are clean and spacious.  Service was excellent and we couldn't have been more pleased.  Thank you for a lovely stay!

Oh my gosh, i stayed at the resort for two nights and left wanting to stay more. Im defs coming back again, and this time with all my girl friends. It is actually the most spectacular getaway and i cannot thank the staff enough for everything. Great hospitality, i was very impressed! :)

i found Rupakot Resort to be very amazing for the true nature lover. The view was covered with clouds but right after the lunch the cloud faded surprisingly and the view was just WOW!!! i didnt liked the road ways to reach there... but i found the hotel to be in a very unique location..

This resort is in one of the most amazing locations you could ever imagine, the views of the Annapurnas are truly splendid and the added bonus of the views of Rupa and Begnas lakes makes it even better. Service is good and attentive!  I am sure when pool and spa areas are finished this will be on of the top resort to stay at in Nepal.

The resort is located in a very very peace location.The views are superb and very awesome.Kind staff,The foods were very tasty.Spacious rooms,clean,neat and tidy.The rooms had all the amenities that it needed.If you would like to stay at a peace place then this is the very right choice.The views are so good that i have no word to explain it.Definitely visiting again.Thank you Rupakot Resort.

I stayed at this resort for 3 days in the month of December. It was a great experience spending time watching mountains, lakes, sunrise and sunset views, and Pokhara valley. The luxurious accommodation and overwhelming service added value to our stay. The food is also very nice. My family enjoyed a lot in the surrounding. We will definitely go back there.

It was a great experience to spend a couple of days at the Rupakot resort.  The rooms are very nice and it was marvellous when opening my eyes in the morning to see the sun coming up and giving the mountains a beautiful orange colour.The staff is very kind and helpful. A large choice of food is available at the buffet.

Highly recommend it. Can’t go wrong with this place. Breathtaking view right from your room and infinity pool overlooking the beautiful mountain. Convenient location - 5 mins walk from the cable car station. Easy way to go and come back from the city. Very nice, clean and beautiful facility. The staffs delivered excellent service. Very well managed. They know what they are doing.

I choose the hotel for my honeymoon. Me and  my wife really loved soo much the way every staff make it more special. And to be honest i really love everything about this hotel. anazing view from balcony,food is yummy, rooms are clean and spacious and excellent hospitiality.i highly recommend this place and would love to visit again.

The hospitality provided was exceptional, and I thoroughly enjoyed every aspect of my experience. The staff was courteous and professional, and their positive demeanor contributed to the overall pleasant atmosphere. The views were wonderful too.

The best experience we had together . Highly recommended.And we wud like to thank the entire team  for making our honeymoon special with warm welcome,cakes and many more. Totally appreciated the efforts. Will visit again……………………………………….

This was one of the best resorts that I have ever stayed at. Everything was on point including the location, the views, the food, the rooms, the pool, the staff, etc. I cannot say enough good things about this place. The staff was extremely helpful when my sister got sick. They made special dishes for her and took me down to Pokhara to get medicine as there were no pharmacies in Sarangkot. I would highly recommend this place!

We had a good stay in Sarangkot. The main disappointment was the haze (not the hotel's fault of course) - we missed the spectacular view and clean air! The welcome was warm, staff really friendly. Ambience, location of the lounge was great. I bet it is even better during the less polluted months.  It's a small establishment, so do not expect 5* hotel standard, although they are really trying. Room was good, but with the strong winds in the evening one part of our balcony simply fell off (yikes!). Breakfast was great outside, but the range rather limited and food not served at the same time (so, some trays were empty). Nevertheless, it was really nice stay, would definitely come back if am visiting Nepal again.

Best food best view and best room services with best location. The mountain looked amazing. Hoping to stay again and have phenomenal experience. Staffs  were kind and helpful. You can reach there by private vehicles or through cable car too.

The most luxurious and best quality value for money hotel we have stayed in Nepal so far the view is spectacular, the food is excellent, and we truly appreciated the upgrade from the already wonderful regular rooms to the suite on our last night. If you have a chance to go, it is highly recommended.

This is amazing hotel with great food, stunning views and really kind and attentive staff. Treat yourself! Spa was also amazing!! Thank you for an amazing experience! Beds are super comfortable to and don’t forget to wear ale up early for the sunrise experience

It was such a great stay, the view from the room is absolutely phenomenal and the service was fantastic. The restaurant inside the hotel served some really delicious food. The zip line is right next door, unfortunately I didn’t get to do it due to the rain. Will definitely be back during the nicer weather season!

All the staff here are very resourceful and friendly. Kalpana ji and Sanju ji made sure we were taken care throughout the stay. They even gave us surprise and special treatment and lots of surprises!!! So, I would recommend for couples to visit this place for any occasions and celebrations. They went above and beyond for providing high level of hospitality.

I really love the service and the environment over here. Me and my partner would like to visit here again all the staffs are so well mannered. I would love to send my parents here as well. This hotel have the best vibe, the swimming pool, the food and everything here are best

The Nepalese people are known for their legendary hospitality but we experienced it first hand at Sarangkot Mountain Lodge. Front office, restaurant staff, housekeeping as well as the managers- all have been exceptional! Any visit to Nepal would be incomplete without a visit to Sarangkot Mountain Lodge

Sarangkot Mountain Lodge was a wonderful experience.. We got a warm welcome in traditional Nepali style.. We came for family trip and it has a lot to enjoy right from mesmerising views to food, pool and world class hospitality.. The staff was very courteous and ready to help in just a word from you (specially Mr. Kamal and Ms. Kalpana).. The food was too yummy as compared to what we expect from mountain lodges.. The infinity pool was a nice experience.. The lodge has multiple in house sports to involve kids.. The view of clouds under your feet is mesmerising.. The spa was relaxing.. We missed Sunrise & Sunset due to cloudy conditions.. In short a ‘not to miss’ destination if you are in Pokhra.

Memorable stay, one of the best location in Sarongkot. The hotel staff is extremely warm, friendly & professional. Roshan, Raj, Sudip & the other crew members are excellent. Food at the restaurant is excellent & economical. Highly recommended

They have given Best services and hospitality. They provided everything we need in time . Swimming pool is also great . Food are very tasty and excellent with great taste . Also the view from balcony is magnificent. Pickup service were also very good .

This place is amazing love the view beautiful rooms and excellent staff they are really sweet and friendly . Also the food is fantastic would definetely recommend. There are adventure sports near by so you dont have to go far awayLike paragliding,ziplining,bunjee jumping etc

The Sarangkot Mountain Lodge was a perfect getaway perched high above Pokhara overlooking the valley. Though we visited during the off-season when it’s mostly cloudy, we still caught some spectacular views of the Annapurna mountain range from our balcony. The staff is very professional, friendly, and caring and helped us arrange day trekking and other activities. The restaurant offers a wide variety of dishes and everything we ordered was delicious. HIGHLY recommend staying here if you’re visiting the area!

The resort is very nice. Breakfast spread is too good. The welcome is hot warming. The only drawback I can see is that it is on a hilltop and you will be requiring a vehicle every time you need to come down to Pokhara City for shopping. The view of sunrise from the hotel balcony is breathtaking if you are the lucky one with regards to climate. I would suggest one day stay in this resort and remaining days at the resort located in Pokhara  at foothills near lake.

We had a great experience at the lodge! The staff were amazing, especially Nabin Mandal who went out of his way numerous times to ensure we had the best accommodations possible. The location of the property is amazing with access to stunning views and short trips to key adventure sports such as paragliding and zip-lining. All-in-all this is a must stay at hotel for anyone visiting Pokhara.

A magnificent experience - top of the line service - excellent rooms - very very comfortable - very courteous staff. Food is also very good with a menu for everyone. The views from the room was beautiful - snow capped peaks in the distance. Overall a memorable stay - will be back for sure.

The highlight of our dine was the unexpected surprise arranged by the staff. They organized a private dinner , complete with a personalized menu featuring local delicacies. The attention to detail was remarkable, from the beautifully set table to the warm and friendly service. It was an experience that surpassed all our expectations and added a magical touch to our trip.

We had a comfortable stay in proximities of majestic Himalaya.The hotel is beautifully placed on the lap of mountains. It’s endeavour towards ‘go green’ is highly appreciated.A warm welcome, smiling staffs and ethnic decoration will be remembered for long.

5. Amazing location, facilities and people. They made our XXV wedding Anniversary. Kamal (manager) and nos Team made that day so special with lot of details and surprises.The room was very nice and they arranged it for the occasion very niceGreat place to see sunset and sunrise with the Everest chain

Dear Sagarkot Mountain Lodge Teamfrom the very warm welcome from your operation staff, to the delicous food (and the cutest cake ever) served to us by your kitchen team, with the complete hospitality from your junior and senior reception and hosting staff, and the loveliest spa experience i’ve had, i would like to thank them all from the bottom of my heart. Words fall short for the immense gratitude i have for your team, who has worked endlessly for our 3 night stay here, and has been courteous every step of the way. To the people i haven’t interacted with, i hope to see you on my next visit here.a special thank you for hosting one of the best birthdays my grandma has had.Warm regards and extreme gratitudedarsh parikh & Family

We stayed at 5 hotels during our 9 day trip to Nepal and this was undeniably the best in terms of the rooms and the service. The property offers great views of the valley and hills from all rooms. All rooms are very aesthetically done up with great design elements and so many small add  ons which will  delight you. For example they had some amazing freshly ground coffee powder with a French press kept in the room To top it all the service is impeccable - all the staff will acknowledge you whenever they meet you and will go out of their way to make your experience count. I’m so grateful to the Manager who go my daughter a mini foot spa  just because we could not get a room with a tub . These are the gestures that count. Special mention to Sudip who’s available 24*7 and to the kitchen staff who ensure that the varied tastes of customers are catered to always

The property is only five years old. The staff are extremely helpful, kind and mindful of the specific requirements that each person has.The food is good, not expensive, medium to large portions.There is a swimming pool, bar, board games and a small library.The property gives a spectacular view of the Annapurna mountain range from the balcony in the room and from the roof top.It is located close to the zip line and paragliding facilities.The Annapurna cable car is located within a few minutes of walking and one can easily reach Pokhara town as well as the Phewa lake.This is a great place to stay and I highly recommend it.

Amazing weekend. Such a beautiful aesthetically pleasing hotel with incredibly friendly staff. From the welcome song, to special birthday celebrations including room upgrade and decorations, and a gorgeous roof top pool with a view. Dinner and breakfast were delicious with a large range of food from which to choose. We’ve travelled to many places, but have never experienced this level of high quality professional service. Thank you Sarangkot mountain lodge staff for a truly wonderful experience.

The staff right from the watchman, the manager and the hospitality staff are extremely humble and polite. Each of them are eager to help. Special thanks to Naveen, Raj and Roshan who have catered to our food requirements at the fullest. Thank you for such a memorable visit. We would surely love to visit again, in near future.

Amazing experience and would highly recommend to anyone who wants to treat themselves. The management and staff are very kind and helpful and also prepared a few surprises for one of our birthdays. There is a rooftop pool with stunning views of the Annapurna range. The pool is not heated but we were there in May when the weather is hot so it was very much bearable, during the winter you might struggle to go in. You can also just chill on one of the deck chairs by the pool and soak in the views if cold water isn't your thing. A little more shade for the sunbeds would be fantastic! The breakfast buffet is very tasty and filling and you can get a fresh omelette made for yourself, delicious. There are short walks nearby at the top of Sarangkot if you want to leave the hotel during the day. There is also paragliding and a zip line nearby but we didn't try. This hotel gives a great opportunity to really treat yourself in Nepal. Thoroughly enjoyed our stay and will certainly be back. The staff and scenery are the dual aces!!

Nice place and great location and awesome view staff was very helpful and prompt food was yummy specially breakfast with view must visit resort. Chef was good and raj  tujan and staff was nice place is next to zipline we had great time enjoy lot

A spectacular view from my room window of the peaks.  Even if the weather did not fully cooperate,  the lodge is a relaxing breath of fresh air with an excellent spa.  Had impecable service by Raj and Himal in the dining room along with tasty meals. A quick zip ride down to the valley, a walk along the lake, then a return up the mountain in the cable car was a great introduction to the area. Hope to be back for some trekking in the future.

A beautiful resort with exceptional service. Special  thanks to Sudip, Roshan and Anchal who were always ready to serve with a smiling face. Were lucky enough to catch a glimpse of the sunrise over the snow capped mountains on 2 mornings, inspite of it not being favourable weather.

Excellent service Warm welcome Morning buffet breakfast lots of variety .. diffrent kinds of fresh juiceStunning view from our balcony whole Annapurna rangeBeautiful 🌅🌅🌅 The staff are amazing great customer serviceOverall hospitality is excellent

Everything was perfect during my 2 night stay:- pick up from Annapurna Cable Car- heartily welcome with music / singing upon arrival- super friendly & helpfull staff making it a pleasant stay for all guest- very clean rooms & public spaces- good food- relaxing spa- beyond staffs influence: the stunning view of the sun rise above Annapurna range- next to zipline- close by to the start of paragliding- …Can fully recommend this hotel when planning to visit Pokhara / Sarangkot!

Amazing stay, the photos don’t do it justice. The location, views and restaurant were all amazing. The staff were the highlight, very attentive and great customer service. Sudip at reception and Raj in the restaurant made our stay incredible.

This mountain lodge is high on top of a mountain and offers stunning views of the Himalaya mountains as shown in the pictures.  All of the rooms have balconies that face the beautiful mountains.  The air is clean and crisp and offer a nice refreshing break from the crowded cities like Kathmandu.  The restaurant offers a great selection of food, and the staff goes above and beyond to make your stay very memorable.  Lots of great activities in the local area including hiking, paragliding, a spa, an infinity pool and bar on the roof, and the world's tallest and longest zip line.  A short walk down the street leads you to the Annapurna Cable Car which takes you down to the beautiful Phewa lake area and lots of great dining options.  We also recommend walking to the viewing tower at the end of the mountain for spectacular views of the entire area.  A special thanks to T.R. Hibek at the hotel restaurant who let us try many delicious Nepal dishes.

The overall stay was very good. Everyone were very nice and welcoming.. We really enjoyed our stay. The view from our room was great. The food was really good and most importantely staffs were genuinely seem to be very happy to be working there. We will definetely come back next tim.

The location, the view, the Hotel, the food & above all - the Hospitality..is at par! We totally enjoyed our stay at the lodge. All the staff is extremely polite & helpful. One of Our best hotel in Nepal. Due to bad weather.. we could not get the actual view of mountains.. but we will come back for sure for the view at Sarangkot Mountain Lodge.

Beautiful boutique hotel in great location.  Staff is so wonderful,  appreciative and welcoming.  Love the arrival ceremony.  Clean rooms,  outstanding food.  The massage is a must - one of the best I've ever had.   Can't say enough great things about this hotel and the entire team.

Top notch hotel with outstanding service. Thanks to such a lovely team for making our stay memorable. The room comes with beautiful balcony and stunning view. I would recommend this hotel to couples for their special occasion. Food was 10/10 for the variety they have.
Lovely calm spa hotel high above the bustle of Pokhara. Staff was attentive and  gracious.  Thoroughly enjoyed our stay after trekking to ABC

A great retreat from the bustle of town. Month-long trip in Nepal closing with a Mardi Himal trek. I spent a few days in Pokhara, but wanted to head to a place to chill for a bit. From all the photos, SML has magnificent views of the surrounding hills and snow-capped mountains. Unfortunately, the smokey haze from burnings in May obscured the views. However, the staff here made me feel so welcomed that I nearly forgot about the lack of views. Everyone from the front desk, restaurant, bar (hats off for trying to make my old-fashioned), and spa (you must try) was fantastic.

The stay is very excellent. The food is very tasty and the service provided by Mr. Navin was extremely good. He is very courteous. Thanks for all the services. All the staff of the hotel is very courteous. The welcome was very impressive and much more than our expectations.

It was an amazing stay with an staff that is welcoming all the way from the very moment the guest arrive.Although the weather conditions weren't favorable, the staff did their best to make the stay such a memorable experience and I certainly will recommend it
Thank you for the great honeymoon package. Excellect food, great hospitality and ambience. Staff Nabin was helpful and presented excellent hospitality.

An amazing hotel with FABULOUS staff. The minute you step in, you will realise that you are in a most warm hotel that has great hospitality. Due to someIssues with our bookings via 3rd party, we contacted the person in charge - Kamal who presented great management skills and came out with a solution to our problem. As a group of 6 traveling, Kamal & his team took ownership and rectified the situation to ensure that we had a great time in Pokhara living up to the brand of Barahi! . The hotel is an amazing cozy setup, which gives you a very warm feeling. The view is fantastic, with great breakfast setup as well.Highly recommend this hotel as it has not only amazing hospitality, but the property is also beautifully done up with amazing view! Not forgetting the food - lovely. To the team - Thank you! I’m definitely coming back in near future!
The staffs (Sankalpa and Sabina) in rooftop bar are very kind and the prices are reasonable. Domestic gin with tonic water is perfect, and don’t miss the special version of pina colada here😜

The bartender Sankalpa and Sabina makes us fantasy piña colada, and i had really wonderful conversation especially with Sankalpa. He's young but he shared many insights on politics and economy of Nepal. There's not much to do in the resort, but having a conversation with Sankalpa is a must to know more about Nepal!

Clean and modern hotel. The staff was all very lovely and friendly. The hotel was located in a perfect location, including for paragliding. Our family enjoyed our stay of three nights as a family of four with kids 10 and 12. We had a great stay.

Great hospitality thoroughly enjoyed our stay. I would recommend everyone to stay at Sarangkot mountain lodge and enjoy the sunrise and the mountains. Staff were very friendly and helpful too. Overall we had a great time and we would love to visit soon.

The ambience, the staffs and the whole team specially Sankalpa Man Baishyat, Sabina Roka ji from the restaurant and Sudip Adhikari ji from the front office are the guys no one ones to miss, their hospitality and friendliness is awsomeeee. Cheers to  the whole team. God bless

My favourite place in Pokhara. Nothing short than excellent and exceeding any expectation you may have in regards to hospitality. Just imagine yourself above Pokhara on 1.534 m in a lodge where everyone from arrival until departure does just anything to fulfill your personal wellbeing. Remembering food allergies, making sure all small details for your personal requirments are fulfilled. I have travelled the world and never before experienced such a warmth in hospitality. I will definetly come back.Ms. Sunjai and her team go outside the normal hospitality. They just want you to feel home. Thank you for your amazing hospitality. Sarangkot Mountain Lodge is definetly one of my favourite places around the world.

I have no words to describe how amazing our stay was here. A side to Nepal that I never knew existed and it has made our trip from Australia absolutely amazing. I will never forgot the experience. From the security that blows the whistle when you arrive to the younger staff at the bar and restaurants, cleaners/operational staff  and management. Their service was exceptional and so respectful. This is now my favourite place in the world and I look forward to bringing the rest of my family here to experience what we have just experienced. A special thanks also to Bikram from sales department for taking great care of us.

I had a great stay at SML. We were greeted with warm hospitality. The staff were very welcoming and friendly. Room was spacious and we loved the architecture. Loved the food. Our visit was brief but we had a wonderful time. Looking forward to visiting here in the near future. Thanks for having us SML.

We decided to stay at the Sarangkot Mountain Lodge rather than in Pohora, and it was the best decision we could have made. It was easy to get to Pokhura via the cable car, but so good to be able to escape back to the lodge and the mountain air. The lodge is in a perfect location overlooking the mountains, which were spectacular. The rooms were great, the food exceptional, and the staff amazing.  They organised excursions for us, and the steepest zip line in the world is right next door, if you are so inclined. We would highly recommend basing yourself here when visiting the area, and we will definitely be back!

Awesome dinner and breakfast along with roof top pool. Great mountain views. Worth visiting very much. Highly recommended !! If you are coming to Pokhara, it would only take 20 minutes in Taxi to Sarangkot to this mountain lodge. Sunrise and sunset not to be missed!!

Wow! We had an excellent stay at the lodge. It’s quiet, comfortable and the staff is extremely kind and friendly. The view is breathtaking and it’s very relaxing there. The food is great and the chef is very accommodating. Absolutely loved our stay and will definitely recommend.

It was one of my best experience at a hotel/lodge. The staff were extremely friendly and caring. They made sure we are well taken care of. The hotel ambiance was amazing. I would highly recommend to stay with them. I will definitely go back again if I find myself in Pokhara

Service was irreproachable and food excellent especially our dinner (mutton curry and trout). I would highly recommend.Trekker’s massage was also very good for the body after ABC at a reasonable price.One of the best hotel experiences I’ve had.

A great retreat from Pokhara city and with a fantastic view of the Anapurna Mountain Range (if you're lucky enough to see it. Be sure to wake up at 6am to catch the sun rising from the East). The staff were very warm and friendly, even going beyong the extra mile to check on us from time to time.

Great property for a mesmerising experience to witness the sunrise unveiling the Annapurna range. Very friendly staff, Kalpana, Roshan, Himal, and team. Comfortable rooms, clean and peaceful property. Great food and ambience. Must do!

Best Hospitality.. Amazing property to get life time experience. Food is very delicious and as per our requirement. The infinity pool is the best part. The staff is so much polite and caring that it will make you feel on next level. If you do not stay here in pokhra you will miss this experience.

everything was amazing- the rooms, the location, the facilities and most importantly the staff! very welcoming and hospitable. even the food was really nice- we are jain the chef prepared jain food for us keeping all our restrictions in mind!

I had the best experience ever! Everything offered was fantastic from the food to the rooms! I would love to mention how the staff is truly wonderful and welcoming. Felt very homely, watching the sunrise from our room was an amazing experience.

We came here for my girlfriend’s birthday to rest and relax after doing the Annapurna Circuit. I mentioned to the staff that it was my girlfriend’s birthday and they were incredible in putting together a memorable day for us both. They decorated our room in flowers and balloons, provided us a private candlelit dinner and went above and beyond in every way. Massive thank you to the whole team at Sarangkot Mountain Lodge!

Very nice stay and good hospitality. Loved view, accommodations, and a nice hike right from the hotel. Wish the pool was heated (essentially unusable in the off season) and there was a loud group who played their own music throughout the pool deck / hotel (wish the staff did something about it). The food / drinks are also pretty overpriced for what you get so would advise eating in Pokhara when you can.

We found this hotel online and was absolutely in love with it. The balcony in the room provides the best view of Annapurna mountain range on a good weather day. Hotel staff are all lovely and extremely accommodating. Food is awesome in the restaurant and the room is one of the best I’ve seen! Highly recommend!

This resort is perfect for views of the mountains and relaxation. The staff is very welcoming and helpful. We took a hiking tour with their staff and enjoyed many things up in the mountains and down in the city. They are very accommodating and we ate breakfast overlooking the mountains each morning! The experience is unmatched and it was very special being in such a serene and spectacular place!

"Resham Firiri, Resham Firiri," a beautiful Nepali folk song with a nice rhythm of the madal welcomed us at the entrance. The first gesture was surprising in itself. Following that, a cool glass of Laliguras juice took away the heat of the sunny day. A gentleman escorted us to the room we had booked. The amenities were perfect, and the room setup we had requested exceeded our expectations. It was beautifully decorated, and Sanu loved it  I could see the happiness on her face, which made me equally delighted. The room had all the necessary facilities, including a private balcony with a beautiful view. It was worth every penny we paid. The room was neat, clean, and full of necessary amenities. I cannot fully describe the ambiance of the hotel, which sits atop Sarangkot. It's surrounded by nature and a peaceful environment that made us wish we could stay longer. The view from the rooftop was even more breathtaking. The view of mountains and hills in the evening was breathtaking, accompanied by the soothing sounds of birds and the peaceful embrace of nature.The dinner we ordered was incredibly delicious, thanks to those who prepared it with such passion. However, the hotel crew surprised us once more with a candlelit dinner setup. Sanu was overjoyed, and seeing her happiness made me even happier. But the surprises didn't end there. After we finished our meal, the hotel staff surprised us yet again with a delicious cake and a beautiful song. Can't forget that song and will be in our mind for a lifetime :). We were left speechless, just admiring their joyful faces. A heartfelt thanks to all the wonderful people who made this happen. They truly made our day and night unforgettable. I can't single out anyone, as everyone we encountered during our stay was exceptionally nice, friendly, and helpful. Thanks to all once again. This moment is beyond precious to me, beyond what words can express.

The best hospitality and service in Nepal by far, been to a lot of places but   Not a single place comes even close to the level of service and customer care they proved, especially Mr Nabin who served us dinner had amazing customer service skills and was very polite and attended us with utmost respect  ❤️❤️ will visit again if we get the chance

We had a beat time in this hotel .wee booked a sweet room and it’s really beautiful with the view. We  are so amazed by their welcome setup and surprised  it really make our stay memorable and definitely we will come back Thanks to Nabin, suresh and Receptionist lady. Thankyou all teams.

The staff at Sarangkot Mountain Lodge went above and beyond to make our stay memorable and special even if it was only for one night. The rooms and lobbies were clean, and the breakfast was delicious. The view from the pool and our room was breathtaking!!

The Crew is very nice and very hospitable. Highly recommend Sarangkot mountain lodge. One of the best experiences I have had in Asia. Food is nice and decent. The Himalayan Mountain View from every room is icing on the cake. Thank you for your service.

Best places to spend the night away from city with beautiful scenary of city and mountains. The management teams and staff are very friendlier than expected. Thanks to them for making our stay more fantastic. Will visit again in future for sure 😉

Great location. Luxurious rooms. Great service.  Fantastic staff! Would love to come back here. Stayed here after being to EBC and needed to wind down with family.  We found a perfect location in Sarangkot mountain lodge! Beautiful views of both sunrise and sunset.

Very very nice hotel. Thanks to Anchal and navita from the bar for their service! My husband and I chose to come to Nepal for our honeymoon and choosing this hotel was the best choice for us. They prepared a honeymoon surprise dinner and various welcome songs and dances for us, which all made the trip worthwhile. And the beauty of the place cannot be replicated because of the bahari group of hotels that we chose to add to our trip to Nepal非常非常nice的酒店。感谢 Anchal和酒吧的navita的服务！我和我的先生选择来到尼泊尔进行蜜月旅行，而选择了这家酒店是我们最正确的选择。他们为我们准备了蜜月惊喜晚餐和各种欢迎的歌舞，这一切都让我们觉得此行是值得的。并且在这里的美景也是无法复制的，因为bahari集团酒店的选择，让我们为尼泊尔的旅行加分！

When writing a review I try to include important things like cleanliness, restaurant food, shower water pressure ease of access etc. This hotel scores high marks on all these points and more.BUT the Mountain View’s and wonderful staff will be what we take home in our memories.Thank you all for your personal attention and assistance. We fully enjoyed our stay.

The hotel is beautiful, with spectacular views. They served delicious food with a comprehensive menu. I had the Thuka(?) soup, which was very flavorful and filling. Although, what really sets the place apart is the staff. They are lovely, very attentive and invested in the quality of each guests stay.

Absolutely stunning experience. We visited the place as a group (University Group) and we were just happy. Starting from a warm welcome song to beautifully decorated rooms to breakfast to the mesmerizing Himalayan view, everything was just perfect. Some faculty and students said they didn’t want to leave.

When stunning Stunning scenery and perfect attentive service this is really special location. The staff is the best I encountered at any hotel. The rooms are spacious. And, be sure to not miss the breakfast. Thank you for making our trip to Pokhara truly memorable.

The hotel is located in an unimaginable place, the view is great. It cannot be explained in words. It's just come and enjoy the landscape.The hotel meets all the quality of service and impeccable installation. Room with sunrise view of the Himalayas, super comfortable bed. And the bathroom is very nice, the water comes out very hot!!! Ideal for relaxing the body after a walk

My wife and I spent three nights at Sarangkot Mountain lodge (before and after our mountain trek), and we absolutely loved it. The staff were amazing (Sudip took very good care of us), the restaurant served delicious food at reasonable prices, and masseuse Rajita was truly one of the best. The views from the room were unforgettable. We cannot speak highly enough of this hotel, and we hope to return soon.

Very good hotel and excellent location We celebrated our anniversary and hotel did great job of decorating the room and also special dining area also decorated Good service and very friendly staff Nice rooms and good staff and location for sunset and sunrise

Impeccable cleanliness and maintenance.. Rooms were spotless and well maintained with good ambience.. The hotel's cleanliness surpassed my expectations." Comfortable Accommodations:  Breakfast was really nice.. enjoyed alot.. hope to come again.

The hospitality was amazing…. The best …the staff were very friendly…. The effort they put to give us the best service was amazing..Thankyou for making our stay memorable. Keep up the good work ❣️room was also great… …experience till date… …………definately gonna come back!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

The staff at Sarangkot Mountain Lodge went above and beyond for my friend’s 30th birthday - pulled out all the stops to make it as special as possible! The room was beautifully decorated, staff were so friendly and attentive, we even had a private dinner set up to celebrate her in the evening. We are so grateful for all the thought that went into our stay here! The food was delicious and a beautiful setting - thank you so much SML!

Amazing hotel with best views of the Annapurna. Rooms very clean and nice. Good food at the restaurant. Mr. Deepa was our waitress and gave us an excellent service. All the hotel staff always made sure we are fine. They also gave us useful advice about activities around the hotel. The hike they suggested was amazing ! Thank you 🙏

As with Barahi Jungle Lodge, the Mountain Lodge was beautifully situated, super comfortable, tastefully decorated & had outstanding service. The staff are all delightful, & go out of their way to help (eg calling our own local taxi man to meet us at the bottom of the cable car - we had limited common language so that helped a lot.) Rooms are lovely. The balcony & mountain view (all rooms) were fabulous & we loved watching the sunrise there with the excellent ground coffee provided on the courtesy tray. The shower room was lush with a really nice rainforest (& hand held) shower.The menu was varied - local & international options - & all was good. Alcoholic drinks are (as in other high end hotels) expensive but cocktails were great & creatively made & presented.The spa was lovely. I had a 45 min foot massage after a day hike, which was a tonic for sore feet & aching legs.This horel was a great base for relaxation & doing the Australian Camp day hike. Arriving in time for lunch on day 1 & leaving after coffee in day 3 allowed for activity, rest, the viewing tower (after our own sunrise views on the balcony) & a spa treatment. Highly recommend the Mountain Lodge. The Barahi chain is doing a great job at hospitality. Thank you all!

Wake up in the morning for watching the sunrise. It's really beautiful. After trekking in the mountain, poon-hill, taking a rest in this hotel is really a good choice. I would like to come back again whenever I visit sarangkot angina. The service of the hotel is also great!

“The staff was great and friendly. The staff was were very helpful and answered all our questions. The room was clean and bright, and the room service was always on time. Amazing view from the room and Will be coming back! Thank you so much.” Chandra

Stunning venue…looking straight on to the mighty Fishtail mountain and Annapurna mountain range. Amazingly helpful staff who couldn’t do enough to make our stay as pleasant as possible. True rolemodels in hospitality and customer service. They are a credit to the hotel.The architecture is gorgeous! Rustic, charming and fits with the environment.Book it; you won’t regret it.

This is an absolutely fantastic hotel!  They upgraded us to an amazing suite.  The staff is extremely nice and courteous.  The views from all of the rooms and from the restaurant porch are exceptional.  There is also a great hiking trail that leaves directly from the hotel to several nice viewpoints.  Highly recommended.

Best experience ever ….Me and My Hubby Enjoyed every beat of music and songFelt special when they surprised with beautiful song and traditional musical instruments And foods were delish too with varieties of optionsOverall it was Marvellous stay we ever had 😊

We had a superb stay in this amazing lodge. All the staff are friendly. Rooms are very comfortable. I came here with my 3 other friends and had amazing time.We intentionally chose this resort as we had pre arranged a day trekking to Australian Camp. Excellent services. Cozy atmosphere. Amazing view from the room. The lodge is also aesthetically designed.A highly recommended place to stay in Sarangkot area.

The best experience weve had in Nepal. Being a newly wed couple, we had a suit room. The staff were super knowledgeable and polite. The hospitality was off the charts. good service and good loction，people in sml are all very nice.and i am very enjioy the trip，manager give us very detailed service，help us book travel arrangements，and one of my friends sick，they provide good care，give us medicine and help us clean the dirty room，in a word i am very enioy and thankful.

The most amazing experience we have had! The hospitality blew us away…as much as the spectacular views. Room was very comfortable…loved the shower, abundant hot water and cozy bed. Sunrises from the balcony were spectacular. Would not hesitate to recommend this hotel wholeheartedly. The most surprising was the grand musical welcome. Food was very fresh and tasty

Top notch, fantastic and excellent service!!Stayed here for 2 nights and i was actually sad to leave this place. Me and my wife were here in january and the views from the rooms are stunning..mount machhapuchre feels like its in your backyard.The food is delicious and exceeds expectations.. their mulled wine is delicious and certainky warmed me up..all in all a fantastic place to get away for a weekend..ps lots of hiking trails nearby.Not forgetting their breakfast..it was hearty and kept us full for 5 hours.Coming here whenever im in pokhara🤘

Our stay at Sarangkot Mountain Lodge was the perfect end to our Nepal holiday .Kamalji and his team had a glorious welcome for us with dholak and singing on a cold January evening. The rooms were on the high floor, and we were upgraded to interconnecting rooms - perfect for travelling with my teenage daughter. Rooms were clean ,comfortable, and well stocked .perfect view of the morning sunrise from both balconies was the highlight of the stay.Breakfast and dinner were excellent with great variety and personalised service .I wish we had more time in Pokhara.I recommend Sarangkot Mountain Lodge for your Pokhara stay.

We could not recommend the Sarangkot Mountain Lodge enough. You will receive the most incredible welcome complete with a scarf, drumming, and singing. Where else are you treated to saffron tea and a hot hand towel when you first arrive? The sunrise view is worth every expense as seeing Fishtail and Annapurna with a pink morning glow is a once-in-a-lifetime experience. The beauty of the hotel room will take your breath away and every detail is thought out down to the handmade paper wrapping the fragrant hand soap. The buffet breakfast is phenomenal and complete with Momos and freshly squeezed juice. We also enjoyed two suppers in the spacious dining room and every dish from local fish to chicken lollipop were fresh and flavorful. And the level of service at the Sarankot Mountain Lodge is unparalleled. What sets the concierge Sudip and the rest of the staff apart is their kindness and high level of initiative. When Sudip noticed that my boyfriend and I liked the saffron tea, he proactively offered us a second cup. When we went to watch our first sunset from the entryway, one of the staff members brought us cozy cushioned chairs. And when I asked Sudip for recommendations on nearby Pokhara, he gave them both orally and then also wrote them out for easy reference. The Sarangkot Mountain Lodge is a a one-of-a-kind jewel.

Everything is wow, no complaints, coming again in next holidays.Love the nature and the traditional musical vibes , can’t ignore the swimming pool and bar.Excellent friendly staff.5/5 rated hotel experience, surely attracting me to see it soon again.Recommend to everyone.🙏🙏🙏

a warm pool will be nice for winter, the shower space needs a door to prevent water from flowing everywhere in the toilet. Food options could be improved with other cuisine. Otherwise it was absolutely present stay. Excellent customer service.

One of the best location I’ve stopped by so far!  Amazing amazing view of the snow mountains in Nepal straight from your room 🤍🤍 the rest is a plus amazing energy and food! A fabulous hotel with rooms looking over to the Himalayas.  Great food and super selection at breakfast.  An amazing infinity pool on the roof - not heated but we went in anyway - looking from the pool across the valley to the mountains was a great experience.

One of the nicest and warmest hotel I have visited ever…. Staff was very comforting, food was delicious plus mesmerising view of Annapurna range and fish tail was just wow…my stay was very smooth and relaxing… definitely recommending this place to my friends and family…

Beautiful location, with a picturesque view of the snow-clad mountains of the Annapurna ranges. Warm hospitality, Traditional welcome,Rooftop swimming pool and bar and whatnot.Must visit in a lifetime. Easy pickup and drop from the Airport. All rooms face snow-clad peaks.

The warmest hospitality I ever witnessed . Everything about the property is so special and moreover the staffs are so welcoming .They made special arrangements for my parent’s anniversary. This was my second stay last time they made my husbands bday special by organizing a surprise dinner date The sunrise view from the hotel is worth million dollars They serve scrumptious breakfasts.InLove with this property  .

We had a comfortable and beautiful stay. Foods were healthy, fresh and organic and definitely worth it. I would wholeheartedly like to recommend the lodge to new visitors.We enjoyed to our fullest. ☺️

The nicest property, very humble staff and insane views. They made us feel so welcomed during our new year trip, we enjoyed the views immensely and did not feel like leaving the property at all. Love!

The staff was amazing, specially a staff member, Sudeep Aryal. We got to see a beautiful sunrise. The  food was amazing, there was veg and non veg options, there were a lot of cuisines which we could pick out from. They even made food which was not the menu but the cleanliness and the smell of the hotel was not that good. Overall  it was a great experience. A must visit place to enjoy a beautiful sunrise.
Excellent food and wonderful place. Special thanks to Mr Himal and Raj for the excellent hospitality at the restaurant. Nice place and definitely will be back again. 非常喜欢这里的一切， 幽静舒适，服务友好亲切，一个难忘的圣诞节。

Extended my stay here primarily because my experience went well above baseline. Incredibly hospitable people managing the property, from manager to staff - couldn't find an exception. Right from the welcome at the door with friendly staff welcoming you with folk song to the candle light dinner, the decorated comfy room and the breath taking view of the himalayas, just loved the ambience and vibes of this place. Woke up with the majestic snow caped peaks 🏔shimmering at us ❤️ Heavenly experience 😇 This is by far the most scenic property in the vicinity to view the most spectacular  Sarangkot Sunrise and the Annapurna range from the convenience of your balcony 🥂

Great location. Excellent mountain view from the room balcony. Also wonderful for sunrise view. Very friendly and helpful staff. Extremely relaxing atmosphere. Highly recommended for holidays. We enjoyed our stay very much.

Sarankot Mountain Lodge offers unparalleled Himalayan views and incredible service. I stayed at the hotel for over a week. Loved the hotel! Great rooms with stunning views, and yes waking up at 6am to see the sunrise is worth it;). Service was excellent, the staff truly makes you feel at home. A special thank you to Sudip and Hira!

Just had an unforgettable 2 night stay here. Everything was excellent and we were made to feel extremely special with the hotels surprise arrangements for our silver wedding anniversary which we so appreciated. The beautiful room, the amazing views, the gorgeous pool and the delicious food are just some of the highlights but there are too many to mention. Also the staff were so friendly from our lovely welcome, to every other interaction we had with them. Would definitely recommend.

An absolutely fabulous place to stay. The views from our bed were awesome. Whilst the room and bathroom weren't huge,  they had everything you could want and were extremely comfortable.  The staff were welcoming and attentive. The dining experience on the terrace facing the Annapurna Range was exquisite. A brilliant stay near Pokhara.  Do glad we chose here and not in Pokhara.  Thanks yo all.

Outstanding location with magnificent views of the Himalayan mountains. Heart warming welcome with music and singing accompanied with fresh ginger tea. Delicious food, welcoming professional friendly staff and a view out of this world.

This has been our favorite hotel in Nepal so far. We chose to stay an extra night. We love the views, the restaurant, the spa, and the employees. The food was delicious. Everyone at the hotel is so pleasant and helpful.

Sarangkot Mountain Lodge was an excellent choice to begin our 2 week vacation in Nepal: Spectacular views; delicious food; friendly, welcoming staff; very clean and comfortable; free rides to/from the Annapurna Cable car to Pokhara. A beautiful lodge high in the mountains. Wonderful hill top bar, great spa …had a great message. excellent food. Wonderful staff. Rooms are very comfortable. An infinity pool. Will definitely visit again.

Absolutely wonderful view on the Himalaya's moutains, calm, very clean & peacful.On top of that, the staff is really dedicated to the client wellbeing and enjoyement during their stay.They organised a wonderful surprise for my wife's birthday. Fantastic views of the surrounding area and unmatched service. The in-house hike they offer is very peaceful and will take you to multiple shrines. Great food and the infinity pool gives a stellar view of the mountain range. Definitely recommend for the price.

Room has great view of the Annapurna range and perfect for sunrise view. The staffs were very hospitable and food was also great. Only need to put a towel ring for the hand towels in the bathroom, otherwise no complains about the room. Smart tv also was a plus with kids.

My experience at this Pokhara hotel was exceptional, thanks to its warm Nepalese hospitality and impeccable service. The rooms were clean and well-maintained, each offering stunning morning views from the balcony. The variety and deliciousness of the food added to the charm of our stay. Highly recommend this hotel for its serene ambiance and excellent staff.

During my recent stay in sarangkot mountain lodge,I had the privilege of experiencing a truly exceptional hotel. This establishment's prime location offered  the majestic machhapuchhre range, making every sunrise and sunset a breathtaking spectacle. The rooms were not only comfortable but also impeccably maintained, creating a warm and inviting ambiance that instantly felt like home. Amazing place to stay! The staff are incredibly helpful and friendly. The views are stunning and I’d recommend anyone in Pokhara to stay at least one night here for the sunrise experience! We will never forget our memories made here!

Warm traditional welcome when chexked in. Well located and wonderful Annapurna range of mountains view from room balcony. Rooms are enough spaced for double occupancies and have all amenities needed.We are vegetarian and they prepared vegetarian dishes as per our choice. Food was tasty.

Sarangkot Mountain Lodge is a wonderful hotel on the Sarangkot hills. Our room had a clear view of the entire mountain range.  The size of the room was good enough for a couple, came with all amenities.  Breakfast was good.  Dinner menu,  though not very elaborate,  had all food types.  The staff of the hotel are very caring,  helpful and take care of guests very well. They welcome all guests in the traditional Nepali way with singing and playing small musical instruments. The best part of the hotel is the views of Annapurna mountain range. The view of Sunrise and Sunset is truly magical.  I loved my stay at this hotel.

This was hands down one of the best stay stay in all of the stays we have had in the world. The hotel was super clean, luxurious and comfortable. The hotel staff was the nicest and most welcoming. Our family had the balcony view of the Annapurna range which was unmatched to any other hotel views. Our family has become a fan of Barahi hotel group as all of our stays have been great, this one being the most favorite.

I highly recommend this hotel… just for everything!!!! The comfort, the view, the amazing staff everywhere, the massages, the hospitality. I was even sick one day becee areuse my stomach was not used to eat spicy as it is in Nepal and the hotel manager itself made sure that I’d be well and gave me recommendation of what to eat, giving me a rehydratation solution. The waiters were so caring to make sure I would good with zero spice!!! It’s part of the barahi hotel chain. I highly recommend all of them!!!

Beautiful view of the mountains 🏔️, staffing extremely gentle and friendly! The hotel is super beautiful and the food tastes amazing! It was an amazing stay and the staff were really friendly. Beautiful morning views of Annapurna and excellent food. The only odd flavor as an American was sweetness in the salsa they had. The sekuti, thali, momo, and other food was delicious.

Beautiful hotel with very kind and attentive staff. If you are looking for luxury in Nepal, this is the place to stay. Set in a serene location on Sarangkot mountain, this lodge is a getaway paradise where you can enjoy the views of the Himalayan ranges, sunrise and sunset. The staff is excellent and took care of all our requests in an expedient manner. The restaurant and pool side bar are also great. And last but not the least the rooms are spacious and have great views from the balcony.

What an awesome gem in the hills above Pokara. It was pouring when we arrived, but the staff greeted us by singing to us as we entered. Everything about this hotel reeked of special! I can't believe someone gave this 2 stars. It was awesome!!!!

The views, the cocktails and the food are amazing there, however what made my experience amazing was the staff  !  They were so helpful and cheerful. Wonderful place to stay when visiting Pokhara. High above the bustle of the city with clean air and amazing views of Fish Tail mountain and the Annapurna range. One of the best resort experiences I've had! The good was 10 out 10. The service amazing g and its so close to fun activities like zip lining and the cable car. You can take the trail directly from the resort. I can't say enough about the staff. I had an amazing time and was sad to leave.

This place exceeded my expectations. I always wanted to propose to my girlfriend in a special setting. I worked with “Astha” from this lodge to plan out a beautiful and most memorable proposal setup. The best hotel we stayed in during our 2 weeks in Nepal. Amazing views of the mountains.  Rooftop pool was also enjoyable. Small touches in the room including a French press. Amazing rooms, view, food, and staff! I lead yoga & wellness retreats and we have been staying in Pokhara and did an overnight excursion here and it was the best! Everything was top notch, we will be back again!

5! Amazing experience. Stayed here for 2 days to relax after 10days trekk and was great. Amanzing structure, staff, cleanliness, food and view. Me and my husband really enjoyed. Cable car is close by so you can easily get a ride to enjoy the lakeside

We have stayed in the hotel for 2 nights for celebrating my boyfriend’s birthday.The service was more than perfect, everything was more than expected Wait for the moment that we could come back! Even though the weather weren’t the best we enjoyed every moment of staying in this perfect hotel!

The place is magical. It has the highest Infinity Pool in Pokhara. The views are spectacular. The staff is super friendly and professional. The food is incredible, and we had unlimited momos and other stuff for breakfast almost everyday. Overall a 10/10 experience.

I like fabulous hospitality offered and good food. Thank you. I will like visit to again and again.I enjoy the  Panasonic view of Annapurna range and pokhara valley. The staff in hotel are very kind and nice.

This is my third stay here. I simply love this property and moreover the hospitality of the staffs.
