An awsm place….super food and breath taking views ..if u one want to go to pokhra thn shd stay here ONLY… helpful staff.. and good services.. the best part is infinity swimming pool.The good part is u can see sunrise from your bed only… chef made super gujju food for us Thanks for d wonderful services

Amazing experience! They surprise us with a honeymoon package. As you can see from the pictures below! They even played a beautiful romantic song for us during the dinner. Unforgettable experience we can never get in Singapore. Thank you Sarangkot Mountain Lodge for the excellent service!

If I had an option I would rate this hotel 10 out of 10.We celebrated our mom's 75th birthday here. The entire team of this property did everything they could to make us feel special and comfortable.Sanju and the entire team are the best and the bestest.Hospitality is something other hotels should learn from this team of Sarangot mountain lodge.The property is situated on top of a hill with a infinity pool.Rooms are excellent and very well maintained.Service is better than any other 7star property.Cable car ride to Pokhara town is on walkable distance and the hotel provides shuttle service too.Some adventure activities are just next to the hotel.The hotel provides a 3 hr hiking thing and it's just an amazing hike.Overall the experience of staying in this property was just too good.Thank you to the entire team for making our holiday so memorable and beautiful.Will visit again soon to enjoy the hospitality of this hotel.

Awesome hotel. Peaceful and amazing mountain view. Great service from staff. Highly recommend. Cost was about $200 for room. Decently priced restaurant. Food was great. They have pickup service from Annapurna cable car station.

We came to the hotel for a drink and to see the view but felt so at home and at peace that we decided to book a stay for the night! From the moment we arrived to the moment we left the service and attention to detail was impeccable. Such a pleasure to stay there and the most spectacular and special views of the mountains I have ever seen. It looked like a painting in the evening. The rooms are also delightful - so clean and nicely decorated!

Awesome experience while stayed in SML , breathtaking views ,delicious food . Warm hospitality, very friendly and courteous staff. Must stay at least a night if you visit pokhara. A lots of activities to do like exotc spa, cycling,  mountain trekking if you like adrenaline rush then must go for zip line flyer next to SML one of the world's longest zip line. Must dip in infnity pool located at top with a panoramic view of Annapurna snow clad peaks

The hospitality was amazing. The staff were excellent. We missed on the views due to the weather. It’s a great stay for one night. Please be prepared and have insect repellent on you. The surrounding bush area means that mosquitoes and bugs are not uncommon.

I just got back from K2 mountain expedition in Pakistan and was seeking for refreshment and it was the best decision to visit here.. Totally relaxing staycation. I am energized for my regular life and for next expedition plans.

Combination of luxury plus sweetest hospitality..despite of rain, it was a heart-warming stay. Was hoping for mountain view, but monsoon couldnt let it happen. So warmed up in room, enjoyed biryani and sweet wine, had lavish dinner and breakfast and  recharged self. Will come again!

Extremely good hospitality. Had a great time with my wife there. An escape from the busy crowded cities. The nature, hospitality, peace and calmness is what you can expect, planning to come again and experience mountain ranges.

The best place to go if you are in pokhara…they are so culturally rich and they will make your day wonderful…..once you stay here trust me the heart feels so heavy tool leave and there service and staffs make you feel so welcomed…a 10/10 recommendation❤️

This is an exceptional property to holiday in. The rooms are beautiful with a balcony that provides 180degree view of the Annapoorna mountain ranges.. the staff are very helpful and always available. The views from this property are simply breathtaking!!!! They have a rooftop infinity pool and the experience is marvelous, the only problem is the pool isn’t temperature controlled. Alongside the pool they have a lovely bar with bartenders that make really good drinks.. everything about this place is magical.. the only downside is that the electricity trips but they do have an invertor. Highly recommend this property. Oh yes and they have really good brewed coffee provided in the rooms. Special mention to Ms. Sanju & Mr.Pawan who went out of the way to ensure our stay was memorable.

One of the best stays in Nepal. The views from the rooms are awesome, the food is great and the staff is super accommodating.We stayed for 4 nights and came back home refreshed and relaxed. Highly recommended.

The stay at SML is one of the most amazing one till date. The service of each and every staff is so so amazing special mention to Kalpana, Sudip, Sudip, Monica, Hira made us feel home. What a wonderful experience:) Etched in my memory! Highly recommend for service, ambience, amenities, activities everything. Thank you so much 😊

It was a very wonderful experience.place was amazing with great view.Those mountains looks so beautiful.staffs are so friendly& soft spoken .kamal was quite friendly.Food was so delicious . Very peaceful environment.highly recommended this place.

Our stay at this hotel was an absolute dream come true! From the moment we arrived, we were swept away by the sheer beauty and luxury that surrounded us. The highlight of our stay was undoubtedly the infinity pool, perfectly perched to offer panoramic views of the majestic Annapurna range. Gazing at the snow-capped peaks while lounging in the pool was unforgettable. The hotel went above and beyond to celebrate our engagement. We were treated to a private dinner on the veranda, where the ambiance was nothing short of magical. The thoughtful staff even decorated a cake to wish us an happy engagement, creating a warm and celebratory atmosphere that we'll forever cherish.The rooms were not only comfortable but meticulously maintained, reflecting the hotel's commitment to ensuring an exceptional guest experience. We were pleasantly surprised to discover the convenience of the cable car just a short 5-minute stroll away from the hotel. This gave us the opportunity to explore the lakeside area of Pokhara. Furthermore for those seeking an extra thrill, the zip line right beside the hotel was so much fun! It offers a Birds Eye view of the valley and the company drove us to lakeside from the landing point. Our time at this hotel was a true escape from reality. The blend of natural beauty, luxurious amenities, and attentive service created an unforgettable experience that we'll forever hold close to our hearts. A heartfelt thank you to the entire team for making our engagement celebration so exceptional. We can't wait to return to this slice of paradise in the future!With gratitude,Dave and Amber

Beautiful Ambience. Excellent food quality and service. All staff were very friendly and welcoming. Food, swimming and spa, everything we can ask for.Feedback: Facial doesn't have variety as per skin requirements. It could include more options for various guest needs. Apart from that, it was a very pleasant stay.

I’m traveling a lot and I visited too many places and hotels, but honestly this place is amazing in every detail. Here we celebrated my husband's birthday and it was one of the best holidays in our lifes. The highest service and nice stuff: very kind and friendly people! I didn’t make a deal, but they prepared too many pretty surprises: first meeting with congratulations, special tasty cake, decorations in our room after dinner. A room was clean and beautiful, everything around too. We passed our time in swimming pool with very good music. Same memories about their kitchen, amazing tasty food and high service. No doubts, we’ll be back! My husband is very happy and it’s the most important thing for me. Great team, great time.

Amazing hotel, amazing staff and amazing food. The view from the room was very beautiful. Activities like hiking in the jungle with a guide from the hotel itself is available. World record zipline is just next to the hotel a 10 second walk only. The best hotel I tried in nepal. Highly recommened.

Our stay at the Sarangkot mountain lodge for 2 nights was very memorable. We celebrated our milestone anniversary and the entire staff made it extra special by decorating our room , playing traditional nepali music and arranged a dinner table for us.Mr Powan and the entire staff provided us with excellent service. Looking forward to another trip to this lodge.

Arrived on the Tuesday lunchtime, the Hotel arranged the early check-in.Lunch at the rooftop bar was great. Pool swim was cold but very enjoyable in the afternoon sun.BBQ dinner arranged on the terrace, very tasty.5am wake up to see the sunrise, didn't happen as it was cloudy, but the clouds almost disappeared. Enough so we could see the snow topped Annapurna Mountains in the distance...spectacular views.

One of the best hotels in Nepal. Top notch service and extremely courteous staff. Right from views to the infinity swimming pool to food - everything is awesome. The theme, colours and decor blends well with the surroundings. You can take a stroll in either direction with beautiful views or take a cable ride or Zipline to Pokhara. Or you can just choose to stay on the room and enjoy the views. It was my birthday and the staff made it extra special by arranging a lovely candlelight dinner with cake. Special mention to Mr. Suman who was our server during my celebration and Mr. Kamal ( property manager) who arranged for everything. Thank you for making our trip to Nepal so memorable!!

Excellent place to stay for family vacation. Rooms with mountain views are exemplary good . Food served in the restaurant was excellent. Nice and lavish breakfast buffet spread. Mr. Suman in the restaurant served us with the delicious and hot dinner & breakfast. Overall nice and friendly environment in the hotel. All the staffs of Sarangkot Mountain Lodge are well trained , polite and supportive. Highly recommended to stay for family vacation.

Hotel is good, restaurant caters for many tastes with special kid’s menu. Rooms nice but the reason for staying are the views. The property is perched on top of the mountain with the land falling away both sides to the valleys below and amazing views of snow covered mountains in the distance. Try to arrive via the new cable car ride and a gentle stroll from the top to the hotel, much more fun than a taxi!

The room is so beautiful and the place so serene! Sunrise and sunset views from your rooms everyday! Feel on top of the world literally while staying at the top of the mountain at Sarangkot Mountain Lodge. It is nothing short of 5stars. Staff so warm and welcoming and helpful at every point even if we are stuck on a mini trek somewhere. With a pool on the top swim with the views of nature and serenity. Must experience place.

One of the finest service i've ever experienced so far. All the staffs are so warm and welcoming. Food is ok and the view is amazing from my room 308. Would love to visit again and again on my next trip for sure.

Awesome property at great location!  Property offers nice pool on the top level. Its close to cable car and zip line. Staff is very cooperative and food is great.. great views around the property, one can see himalayan range from the balcony.

Best luxury hotel experience in Nepal! The amenities and room are amazing. The staff are so helpful and accommodating! And the best part in the food! Definitely try the Indian dishes at the restaurant, probably one of my favorite meals in Nepal

Wow! The hotel exceeded my expectations. By far the best hotel in Pokhara. Stunning views, nice infinity pool, great breakfast. Truly a 5 star hotel with the best staff and service you can think of. A 3 hour hike kicks off right by the hotel and the hotel offers guides at a very reasonable price. Nice massages, right next to a fun zip line, a really cool helipad. You can take the cable car to head to the lake. Best hotel for a relaxing vacation to unwind.
Nice place to visit.all staff is good, service is supper starclean placeoverall experience is goodmust recommend other to visit there once good customer service and other great benefits aa well happy

This beautiful cozy mountain lodge is located on top of Pokhara city with stunning view of Himalayan mountains and the lake. The welcoming ceremony for the guests gives you immediately a sense of peace and family. The Rooms are very nice and comfortable with all necessary, I loved the balcony and the view! Good wifi throughout all the hotel. The staff is very attentive to dietary requirements and they had arranged for us special menus for dinner and breakfast, I really appreciate. We were celebrating a birthday and they also prepared a wonderful cake considering our dietary requirements (vegan, gluten free, no diary), and a nice birthday set up in the room upon our arrival. The hotel is few steps away the cable car that you can take to get to the city , and it’s close to Zipline and other sports activities. A note to improve , very slow service but in general in all Nepal I had very long waiting at the restaurants . We were not happy with the Spa services , therapists not good and not able to do deep tissue massage.

The lodge was in very pleasing location. The scenery was serene. The service was amazing. Room was good. Breakfast was delicious. Overall, the most fascinating thing about lodge is the mountain view and the service. It was worthy.

I had a best experience in this resort. They have best view with comfortable room and beds. The location is a bit far but the view make it forget every thing. Food and drinks are awesome. The overall service from management and other staff are best.

Cloudy weather couldn’t see the mountain range but the friendliest staff members made our stay wonderful!  Cozy room, amazing hallways and pool. One of the best places to stay in Pokhara, very well worth the price. Highly recommended!

The hotel location is superb. Majestic mountain view. The ambience of the rooms , the bathroom is clean, the room amenities is abundant. The super friendly staff and good food. The breakfast is lavish. There is android tv with netflix and YouTube so the kid is also happy.

A very beautiful located hotel with a million dollars View. Hotel is clean and the ambience reminded me of my trip to Austria. Very happy with everything including the food.The staffs are very kind, helpful & friendly. Due to flight cancellation, we had to travel by road from Khatmandu and arrived at the hotel past midnight and the kitchen was closed. Being very thoughtful the hotel forwarded us the menu while we were still on road. They got the kitchen staff on standby and prepared dinner for us and served soon after we arrived. Never have we received such service at any other place though out my life travelling. The cocktails at the bar was one of my favourite as the mix was superb. My eppreciation to all staffs of this hotel and my special thank you to Sudip who was going out of his way to accommodate us. We felt very great with their warm welcome & see off. Thank you Sarangkot Mountain Lodge

Ambience was excellent, hospitality from the receptionist Miss Kalpana was wonderful. Don't remember the Manager name but he too was nice and welcoming. Morning breakfast was delicious. Roof top swimming view was mesmerizing but i recommend the pool must be heated.

Best hotel in town. Incredible view, food, showers, beds, people. Wish we stayed longer. We never got to use the pool or catch the zip line which is right next door. Came with a group of 20 people and everyone loved it.

Superb decor, gorgeous looking place, fantastic mountain views, great food.The manager is do hands on and efficient, the staff charming, helpful, all in all worth  spending a couple off days to chill .lots off activities too zip lining right next door, cable car , para gliding ! Exciting times .

This place was a DREAM!! Absolutely excellent experience from beginning to end! The food, the people, the facilities, everything was perfect! You really feel like you’re on top of the world and the stuff make you feel like you’re kings and queens!

Super wonderful stay! The staff are amazing!The views are the best! Food is dynamite! Overall it was amazing. Love the cold pool. Character of the rooms too! I would highly recommend. Location is up the mountain near hikes and cable car!

Wonderful hotel. Superb views of Fish tail mountain and Annapurna mountain ranges. You get amazing views from your room of snow capped mountains and Pokhara city below. The  view that you get from your bath tub of the snow capped mountains was an amazing experience.  The food is also good. Do try their Nepali cuisine. And definitely like to mention their very friendly staff. Pawan, Roshan, Kalpana. They provided us with very good information when best to view the snow capped mountains and information about local area. Overall we had a great time and would highly recommend it!

Excellent location to get a relaxing view and experience Annapoorna Range. Comfortable room with all the rooms facing the mountain. Nice infinity pool and open restaurant for excellent views. Walkable distance to Sarangkot View point where you get the best and full view of Annapoorna, even better than from the hotel. Walkable distance to Annapoorna cable car using which one can go to Pokhara lakeside, very quickly. The hotel provides complimentary drop and pickup to/from Cable car /Viewpoint. The staff are very courteous and helpful. Ms Kalpana and her team mate ms Shrishti and their manager provided excellent support along with all the restaurant staff. Once when cars were not be available, they even arranged staff members to pickup from cable car in their personal bikes! And once the manager himself drove us to the cable car. Thanks a lot!!

My stay at Sarangkot Mountain Lodge was stellar. It was just what I needed after a busy week traveling in Kathmandu and in Chitwan national park. The staff was incredible; thank you Pawan and Shristi for making my stay so special! Definitely a place I would like to come back to. Soooo relaxing

The best experience that anyone could get was provided by the staff with beautiful view right in-front of the balcony and bathtub. The rooms were very well decorated with a lots of complementary snacks.

The stay was awesome. We were group of 6 people and enjoyed our trip to the finest. Staff were very polite and we received excellent hospitality. Definitely recommend staying here when you are in pokhara. 😊😊

A beautiful hotel in an amazing setting. Fabulous views of the snow capped mountains from your balcony. Attentive and accommodating staff. Food was tasty and a good selection. Wonderful hot showers in your spacious room. I would highly recommend to stay here.

Excellent views and beautiful place to watch sunrise and mountains. Had an amazing stay here. Staff are welcoming and friendly. The hotel is clean and provides all amenities. I would recommend to friends and family. Great location for stunning views.

An amazing sanctuary to watch sunrise and sunsets from comfortable rooms.The staff are very helpful and friendly The rooms are clean and warmThe food is delicious and well priced Would like to visit again

Excellent customer service and amenities. Staff were welcoming, were knowledgeable about local attractions, hikes, POIs, and overall very accomodating to any requests. Asked if we could join a bonfire as there was a couple sat next to it, instead they offered us a seperate, private bonfire all together !!!  Food and drinks were amazing. The view from the rooms would've been surreal if the weather was nice but overall a fantastic stay.

Wonderful climb up and up to this mountain top hotel, above Pokhara. After some rain, and the mist clearing, we had wonderful views across the Annapurna range. Very friendly staff - lovely bar snd restaurant. Rooms were modern but, like the hotel itself, in keeping with the mountain location.Pokhara Lakefront worth a visit and a nice cable car ride down the mountain or zip wire for adventurous!

We were here for just 1 night, but we felt like we should have stayed here for longer. The level of hospitality, care and love we received from all the staffs are of next level. Amazing views, delicious food and great hospitality we are coming back again.

Very nice stay. The property was well maintained and a delightful experience. The location away from the town of Pokhara had its advantages and disadvantages. It was peaceful and had beautiful views but the cost of travelling to town either by taxi or cable car got to be expensive after 4 days. The staff is very attentive and eager to please. Spa and guiding services were very good. Highly recommended. We would definitely come back.

Had a great time with our daughter..the staff were really welcoming and polite, food were excellent.Upgraded our deluxe room to suite where the view from the bathtub was epic.Thoroughly enjoyed our stay. 👍

Wow - sunrise can be seen in pyjamas at the balcony! The Himalayas is just at the doorstep. Enough to justify the five-star experience!Not to say the infinity pool reflecting the snowy mountains; rooftop restaurant serving cuisines of all kinds; breakfast with the backdrop of the Himalayas…Transportation-wise, it took around 30-40 mins via some local roads to the town and the airport. Tranquil ambience yet not too difficult to reach.

It was such a memorable stay at Sarangkot mountain Lodge with my siblings. We really enjoyed the beautiful mountain view, great hospitality, amazing staffs(especial thanks to Roshan for arranging everything so well and Sudip for an incredible FnB experience). The rooms were lovely, relaxing and peaceful environment away from the crowds. Definitely gonna be back.

The Sarangot mountain lodge is a newer hotel, it finished construction I believe right before COVID, so I feel like this is a relatively lesser known hotel in Nepal, but I could see this hotel rising in star rankings in the coming years. A couple summary highlights: the service is so generous, the interior decoration is extremely relaxing and tasteful, the Nepali and Indian cuisine is phenomenal, and you really cannot beat waking up to that view over fishtail and the Annapurna. I’ll get to the couple of points which could be improved because they are far outnumbered by the positive points. First, there’s no mini fridge in the rooms. Second, there’s no gym. Third. I wouldn’t spend money again on one of the more expensive or firmer massages at the spa because the massages are all similar and seem to be more geared towards relaxation as opposed to relieving muscle tightness. The fourth thing, and maybe it was just our room, but there was a mildewy smell in the bathroom, which might have been due to poor ventilation in our room, but the smell was always improved after the room got cleaned. Which, speaking of, the cleaning staff was incredible! They fully mopped the rooms and brought refreshments and even put our towels into cute little designs on the beds. All of the staff was amazing, but I must keep special props to Monica, who went above and beyond with her thoughtfulness, professionalism, and eye for detail. She planned multiple surprise romantic dinners for us at the hotel and always made sure our needs were met beyond the regular call to duty, including tea if we got sick or remembering our favorite orders. She always made sure we were being taken care of. Speaking of our needs… I must recommend a few of the dishes. The handi dum chicken biryani is a must have. We also loved the kathi seethi soup, the pancakes, and there was a chicken curry dish that was just phenomenal too. The presentation of each dish was just so adorable. There’s tons to do at this hotel, they even have a trekking guide on staff, and the location is RIGHT next to the zip line and cable car into Pokhara. So it’s just a 10/10 location. Peaceful, yet plenty to enjoy while you’re there.

Absolutely loved the Sarangkot mountain lodge! We went here after a 7 day trek to poon hill, and it was a wonderful place to relax after the trek. The hotel is ideally located for wonderful views of the Annapurna mountain range. The hotel itself is brand new, and the facilities provided are great. The infinity pool on the top floor is incredible, although we didn’t use it as it was winter time and the pool is not heated. Each room in the lodge had a balcony which allows for nice private viewing of the mountains with your morning tea. The rooms are thoughtfully designed, giving a modern mountain cottage vibe.  The food at the lodge is great and in generous portions (especially for the complimentary breakfast). A particular shout out to the chicken biryani which is hands down the best I’ve ever had. I will dream about this chicken biryani for years to come. The staff are incredibly kind and professional, always ready to help the moment you walk into the door. We were received by the front desk staff with some wonderful saffron tea and kata scarfs. We loved how the house keeping would leave us little origami towel art each morning (in addition to keeping the rooms spotless!). We also had the great pleasure of having Monica as our server. Monica went above and beyond to make sure that all our meals were extra special, including organizing a unprompted romantic candle lit meal for my partner and I. Her professionalism and attention to detail made our stay extra special, and we can’t thank her enough! We would recommend this hotel to anyone in the are!

Great hotel in the town, great hospitality, amazing service, outstanding rooms, great location and overall great value for money. It was my first time staying in the hotel and they made sure about everything. Literally felt like home. Thank you guys.

I had a wonderful experience at the Sarangkot mountain lodge. Every staff member I encountered, from the Annapurna cable car where they pick us to the check- in to the cleaning staff were delightful and eager to help! Thank you! Will recommend to my colleagues!

I'm stunned with the beauty of Sarangkot Mountain Lodge & the Himalayan views of Fishtail, Southern Annapurna from every parts ( rooms, restaurant, pool )of the hotel. Had a delightful experience. Foods, amenities, services & staffs all are over the top.Must try their hiking & spa. Thanks to the whole team ( mainly Mr.Roshan, Uttam, khemraj, Ms.kalpana names as far as i remb.) , for making my stay smooth & memorable.

I had a wonderful stay at Sarangkot Mountain Lodge with my wife. We were extremely happy to be greeted with a welcome song. Room and food was top notch. On the same day we had a great hiking trip with Mr Khem Raj.also we had 1hr. spa which was so relaxing. The dinner with bone fire was a dreamy experience including outstanding service from Mr.Uttam & the team. The view from each corner of the hotel was very beautiful.Overall i had a quality time specially thanks to Mr. Roshan for the best hospitality. I would love to return with my whole family again 😊.  Best regards Nabin

Usually, tourists would stick to the lakeside for accommodation in Pokhara, so I was not too sure what to expect at Sarangkot Mountain Lodge.But boy o boy! This location is a clear winner when it comes to the fabulous location, hospitality, and service.We were so well taken care of that words fall short to describe it.This is a recently built 30-room hotel with fantastic views of the mountain.From the sales team of the property, to the front office staff, to the guest relations staff and to the F&B service staff, all were very hospitable and took great care of us. I am also sure that the ones behind the scenes also had a lot to contribute. We were in a suite that overlooked the popular Fish Tail mountain and the Annapurna 4, 5, and 7. Room was neat and well maintained. It had a hand made tub by the window, which overlooked the snow clad mountains. The sunrise from the rooftop infinity poolside is just awesome. The hotel is in close proximity to a zip line, paragliding take off site, Annapurna Cable Car, Sarangkot Observatory et al.The staff have thorough knowledge of Sarangkot and can communicate very well.The food was good too. A visit to this place is highly recommended!SML, keep making your guests happy! You are ace at it!

We stayed here with our baby and toddler. The view from the rooms and the pool might just be one of the best hotel views in the world. Make sure to stay in the dry season and at least for 2 nights incase 1 night is cloudy. They also arranged a complimentary cake and room decoration for my husband's 40th birthday which was above and beyond.

Wonderful and relaxing experience; beautiful scenic views; nice spa and great food. We caught World Cup finals between a Argentina and France which was screened live on a large screen.  Staff was very kind to arrange for dinner while watching the match live. Room was great, facilities were excellent.

Amazing hospitality from the staff and they even went above and beyond for our honeymoon. Loved every second of my stay here! Definitely recommend staying here if you want to see the views of the mountain. Thank you to all the staff!

Redefined hospitality with unbelievable view. Well trained warm people. Brilliant place.. Will be back again and again. Chef Narendra, Monica, kalpana, Pawan and entire team. They knows what they are doing. Love Ashis k Das Director The Wanderers

This is an outstanding place. Staff was always very happy to take care of us, even to the smallest request. The view at the lodge were stunning. Words cannot describe. We stayed at the suite, with amazing views of the Annapurna and Machapuchare peaks. Totally recommend it.

We stayed here for a night and we highly recommend for someone who is looking for a relaxing getaway.. the view is magnificent can be seen from all the rooms. The terrace pool is really nice but only suitable for warm weather.

Had an amazing stay at the sarangkot mountain lodge. The views are breath taking from every corner. Each and every staff member were also very friendly and kind. They have a complimentary shuttle from the hotel to the cable car station which is an added bonus. Kalpana was super helpful to us. We will be back again for sure and will recommend it to everyone.

This place is the best for everyone . Honestly I can't put in words how great their hospitality is and the  best. Visit at least once then you will know. I can't put in words really  how great  the staffs are here and best location to view mountain and nature,s beauty Omg the food so yummy !!!

Great business facilities, friendly, supportive and professional staff from enquiry to event. Incredible location too, with majestic views of the Annapurna. Our business partners loved the experience!! Highly recommended

It's a great value for m9ney experience. Everything about this hotel was fabulous, right from the staff, location, interior design, food to the location. The facility  some amazing views. The cleanliness was top notch. They had extremely friendly, cooperative and helpful staff. I will highly recommend this hotel.

What an extraordinary place! I was staying in Pokhara for a few days after a work trip to Kathmandu and decided to venture up the mountain to this lodge to try to catch a sunset/sunrise over the mountains. So happy I did! Great accommodations, staff, views over the Annapurna, hikes. You must visit this place! Thanks to the manager, staff and Khem - the guide.

Excellent location for Mountain View and more importantly excellent hospitality by the entire staff, especially the resident Manager Roshan Ji. The candle lit dinner arrangements in the open with camp fire was surely a highlight. Would recommend everyone to atleast stay a night here when visiting Pokhara

This is a fantastic resort. All amenities of five star. Service is Top Class and Courteous staff. Food is excellent . The view from the room is awesome. We had excellent time here. You can also do some biking and small trek. Recommended for Visit with families as well freinds.

Beautiful location, very friendly staff, beautiful hiking spots around. All the rooms have a view of the Annapurna peaks and it's really quite stunning. Would highly recommend for the location and the service.

Excellent Hospitality,Beautiful scenic viewA must must visit if you’re in Sarangkot or in Pokhara for that matter.The food is truly amazing, whether you want local or international.Special thanks to Pawan Sir for taking such good care :)Shall visit again soon:D

It was a beautiful stay and we enjoyed our time there. The vegetarian food ( Indian) is amazing. The veg thakali is so amazing we ate all. The view is to die for.The most important is staff is extremely courteous.Would definitely visit again.

From the time of check in till we depart , we were absolutely treated as king and queen . Team went out of their way to make our stay comfortable . We loved the concept of NO PLASTIC Zone . We highly recommend sarangkot mountain lodge and will definitely be back soon

Have stayed a night in this wonderful property . All our expectations were exceeded interms of rooms , facilities , food and activities . Enjoied hiking offered and beautiful sunrise and infinity pool . All staffs were great . Will definitely come back and highly recommended .

OverviewNot value for money @ US280/night3 Star at best western standardStaff are great most speak some EnglishLodge owner has not invested in refinement to gain higher Star ratingView is great (if there is no cloud)PositivesStaff are great. Nim the security guard is happy and helpful. Pawan the manager was very helpful and speaks good English. View from our balcony was great although standing room only. No hand rail so careful with kids. King bed comfortable but the sheets didn’t fit. My feet slept on the mattress material. Sheets were also stained. Bath was nice, hot and shape suited my bodyWifi was fairly reliable for us and relatively fast. The design of the lodge is ok but the  finish is not refined. NegativesPool unheated therefore too cold to swim in also unsafe for childrenStaff seem under pressure from the owner Roshan Sapkota. Staff are very polite and always busy but cannot meet expectations of the owner. I would say the lodge is under staffed. Mr Roshan Sapkota owns five hotels. FoodBreakfast is included but don’t expect a 4 or 5 Star western breakfast. The breakfast for Nepalese may have been great. I guess we assumed that when we paid US280 we expected something pretty special for breakfast. I had; poached eggs-pale and no flavor not recommended Mr Roshan Sapkota would do well to use free range eggschicken sausages-minced is oknoodles-goodtoast and jam-not recommended bread crumbly and tasteless. Jam is rubbish made with coloring, water, gelatin and sugar. cappuccino-is goodfruit-orange no flavor, banana good, pineapple no flavorYoghurt goodDrinking water tea and coffee limited in the room and no fresh milk for drinks in the roomWe were in room 202

I have just returned from a week – long trek in the Annapurnas.  The night before our journey began, we stayed at this extraordinary first-class hotel. Pictures cannot do justice to the beauty of the setting and of the hotel itself. I have been in only one other hotel in my life that satisfied visually, physically and spiritually the way this one did. The rooms are extremely comfortable and well appointed; The food is excellent, the pool overlooks some of the Annapurnas most famous peaks; and the sunset from the roof is second to none. The hotel is hard to get to: a four-wheel-drive is required to handle the steep inclines leading to the entrance. But so much beauty awaits!

We stayed at the Sarangkhot Mountain Lodge for a night before heading out on a trek. We wish we had stayed there for a week!It is so beautiful- from every detail in the room to the amazing infinity pool overlooking the Annapurnas. The service is fantastic and attentive. The food was some of the best we had in Nepal - great breakfast!The only downside is that you are kind of stuck there once you arrive since Sarangkhot is not really a town. But what an incredible place to be stuck! So quiet and relaxing. You are literally above the clouds. I highly recommend this lodge and know that you will truly enjoy it.

Exceptional service.  all the team members at the property were friendly and nice. They were attentive towards the needs and alway there to assist. Best view from the room. Amazing stay. Beautiful location.

Incredible lodge with outstanding view of the mountains and luxury service. The hotel staff are friendly and welcoming and truly care for all your wishes. The room are spacious and beautifully decorated and the mountain-facing barh is breathtaking. The hotel also facilitates great guided treks and hikes and arranged perfect trek plam for us with an experienced guide. When there is good visibility there is no better view in Pokhara region than the infinity pool at the top of the hotel.

It was a great experience staying in such lovely and stunning Sarangkot Mountain view and lodge!!Couldn’t  ask for more for their hospitality ! Thanks so much! All the views from Bar, Restaurant and poolside are amazingly spectacular !

Enjoyed our short stay very much. Magnificent location, welcoming staff and mesmerizing views. There's ziplining and paragliding nearby for those seeking some adventure as well. Great experience overall. Can't wait to return.

Great destination, amazing view, peaceful atmosphere. Big portion meals good value for money. Nice cocktails. Amazing costumer service!! They even made cocktails on request. Would defonately come back again.Only issue was noise guests but that's not the hotels issue.

Thankyou Sarangkot for a very relaxing stay for our engagement celebration! The food was lovely and amazing views. The rpom was sp relaxing and felt like a spa!Very clean and comfortable. Staff always at five stars!

I booked for a night and extended to 3 nights. Great ambiance, charming decor and exemplary hospitality. This boutique hotel is a must visit in Sarangkot. The views from rooftop pool bar and every balcony is breathtaking!

the hsopitality was very good... enjoy every moment and had fun... food was awesome...and had a nice view from room....very much happy with the service.will come again for holiday.its perfect place for beautifull nature...

Loved the quaint property in sarangkot. Stayed only for one night but wished we could live for longer. The place is very luxurious but has a very camp like feel and it’s remarkably easy to strike up conversations with other guests. Didn’t have to pay for my drinks all night long (other than the hangover in the morning). The vendi fry is a must try. Special shout out to Prabhat for a lovely hike and for Uttam for taking care of us over lunch and dinner. The manager Roshan provides a special touch to all activities. Thanks everyone for making our day so memorable.

Yes, it was best hospitality that I had ever had before. Everyone was kind and polite. I really liked the service. Food was good. The interior decorations were unique. The overall view from here was just wow amazing. One of the best place in Pokhara. I really wish to visit again and again. Room no: 201

Nice place ,very cozy and great view with snow caped mountains, food was also great and very personalized service from all staff. Very romantic place to go with your better half. Infinity pool view is great too.

The topmost property in town. We didn't face any difficulty and didn't encounter even a single problem. The staffs make the stay even more comfortable and memorable and the view from any room is so mesmerizing.

Definitely one of the best stays in Nepal and the views are outstanding.  Staff was very helpful and the amenities were above average.Most recent upgrades to the hotel really made the stay feel like a fine hotel you would find in Europe or the United States.

Just loved the place and staff but make sure to visit on right time to enjoy the nature to maximum. Exceptionally polite staffs and good services. Nature friendly design and amenities. Neat room with viewing terrace. Wholesome breakfast will make you happy. Recommended to visit on clear season.

Had gone with my family in June 2022 and had booked 2 suite rooms. Spacious rooms with a balcony and an amazing view of the mountains. The breakfast spread was really nice , Great food.  Thakkali was just wow. Courteous staff. Breathtaking experience from the infinity pool, one of a kind. The drinks were too good. VERY BAD EXPERIENCE WITH SPA though , the 3 girls sitting were very unprofessional. Would definitely recommend and shall surely visit again.

Nice location on top of pokhara where you can see the city itself and also the different mountain range. Quiet ambiance, professional and friendly service. The roof top swimming pool  and bar is a plus !! They also have different adventure options with an additional charge.

Excellent location, great property with infinity pool, courteous and extremely helpful staff. Even the food was excellent. Special thanks to the staff who took care of minute details (Jain food) and prepared food accordingly. We had a great time in this property.

If your visit to Nepal is  for leisure then Pokhra is a nice  choice of a hill town retreat with ample choice of adventure sports.Excellent location and view.The Sarangkot mountain lodge is perched on a beautiful Scenic hill. This lodge over looks  the valley town of Pokhra on one side and the Annapurna mountain ranges on the other side. Can enjoy views of the  majestic ‘Fish tail ‘ peak.The lodge  can be driven up by car or by the cable car from the Main Street at Phokra valley town. The view of the Annapurna ranges are soulful , all rooms face them. The Restaurants at ground floor and roof top are great way to enjoy the mornings and evenings. Can walk and cycle  on the small roads full of   greens exotics trees and vegetation.Services  of all the good and reliable paragliding and adventure sports are offered at the reception by the hotel itself.The team is very friendly and makes your stay special.  Mr Roshan - the manager is very helpful and resourceful. All  the other staff are hardworking and dedicated, special mention of Agara for  his prompt service.Can take off from  the hotel by a chopper to the next destination, a thrilling experience.if planing to drive from khatmandu, check the roads as currently works are going on. Flying to Pokhra is a good option.

This resort will add value to your vacation. Location is simply the best, extremely polite staff and great customer care, amazing food, rooftop pool with stunning view and courtesy transportation are highlights of this lodge among other many great stuff.You will be delighted.

Every time I stayed here in Sarangkot Mountain Lodge,  never dissatisfied me and make me visit again and again. Being a nature lover, there could not be any place other than this. Beautiful scenery of annapurna range, lovey view of growing pokhara city. Apart from this hospitality of staffs was so good and always there when needed. Room was perfectly clean. Food was healthy and delicious. And lastly I can't stay without talking about the rooftop infinity pool which was just amazing.

We stay at Sarangkot mountain lodge for four night during the pokhara trip . They have room with great Mountain View’s plus room is very clean and comfortable bed . During our stay over there  all the management and staff is very nice especially thank-you Mr. Roshan and Mr. mahesh how was always helping to us .Breakfast was amazing food fresh and nice all the staff helpful ThAnkyou everyone  see you next trip.

The warm hospitality coupled with serene ambience and cozy rooms and friendly staffs always carrying smile is a short definition of this place. We had an amazing time here! Mr Roshan, the manager, who always had this pleasant smile ensured we had a wonderful stay. Must go place

We stayed for 2 nights at their not-so-sweet 'suite room'. On the first day, there was not enough warm/hot water, second day no water at all. Some plumbing issues – we were told.  Our son had to run around rooms to find a bathtub with running warm water - staff somehow made him happy! The 'bathtub with view' was built very close to the bed without proper ventilation – smells. We waited until 11:00 hrs for the swimming pool to be cleaned... but no luck! The food quality/varieties needs to be drastically improved. Better luck next time to us! The food was not that tasty either.

Me and my husband never experienced such great hospitality and customer service. Hotel is so clean, management is so well organized, food is so fresh and tasty. I would rate this hotel a 5/5 star. We will visit again for sure and highly recommend this place. The experience here is something we will never forget. The view from the balcony at night and day is just beautiful. You can see the beautiful Annapurna ranges including the fish tail mountain plus at night the stars and the moon. The pictures don’t justify what you see for yourself so I won’t post the pictures instead I would Recommend you come and see for yourself.

Just awesome and wow..mesmerise view and hospitality was too good.. overall we are too satisfied.. food was tasty and service was fast and healthy.. we are very glad to be part of this hotelDawn damn good loved it

We had a fab stay at this this beautiful place located on the top of Pokhara town. Roshan took immense care right from our food requirements (we are vegetarians and preferred Indian food) to our sight seeing etc. This place has soo much to offer. Paragliding, hiking, swimming pool, it’s just mesmerising to be around. I ended my trip with a spa treatment with Aarti and the experience was amazing. I will definitely visit this place again and spend a good time. 4-5 days atleast. Thank you to the entire team for such a memorable experience.

Hospitality and view is excellent.must visit place during pokhra visit.staff is very cooperative...it's feel like home here.quality of food is excellent.veiw from room is breathtaking.enjoyed completely during stay.

We stayed at Sarangkot Mountain Lodge for three nights during our trip to Nepal.  They have rooms with great mountain views--if the weather cooperates.  The rooms are spacious, quiet, and comfortable.  The balcony has only one tall bar-stool style seat--a bit odd.  We decided this must be for smokers.  Breakfast was a buffet with eggs on request.  Lunch and dinner utilized the same a la carte menu, which became limited by the end of our stay.  Wine is expensive: $40 per bottle.  You can eat inside or on the outside deck.  The staff is pleasant and willing to refill the water bottles in your room.A solid choice!

We are so lucky to have a sunrise 🌅  with a spectacular annaupurna mountain range and fishtail in front. Thank you Roshan Sapkota and SML family  for the wonderful & warm Hospitality. A must stay place in Pokhara, Food was amazing and the infinity pool is wonderfully located. A very reach with Hospitality.

The hotel is extremely good.The view from this hotel is amazing...one cnnot imagine to see the sunrise from the room.Mesmerising view excellent hospitality...my special thanks to Roshan and his team who went overboard to make our stay comfortable.Food was good but would appreciate if they can increase the spread for vegetarians.All in all its worth to stay here and experience the beauty of nature and this hotel.Highly recommend for families.

The Sarangkot Mountain Lodge in Saramgkot, Pokhara has a perfect location for mountain view as well as Phewa Lake. The members of the hotel are cordial, professional and hospitable. Room was clean and gives a sense of Nepal. The hiking, curtesy of the hotel, was refreshing. We enjoyed the cosy swimming pool overlooking the mountains. We wished we had more time.

Very pleasant, and warm welcome by staff. The ambiance and cleanliness is a 9/10. The best about Sarangkot Mountain Lodge is to witness beauty of Mountain in just a short glance. Will surely visit again.

This is the best stay of my entire trip in Nepal recently. Beautiful hotel with amazing views, we love their breakfast (I must say this is the finest quality we found so far), the dinner set, spa, swimming pool etc. it’s really worthwhile

Right from the airport pick up we knew how much attention and comfort property is giving to their guests. The property is very new and astonishing views of the mountains.Special thanks to roshan for looking after us especially that we were traveling with a new born. It takes 30 mins from the pokhara airport and the road is well maintained right up-to the resort. Advisable to take book the transfers from resort. Alternatively one can go to pokhara lake and take the cable car which comes up just 5 mins from the resort and they have a free shuttle to the cable car.The spa is well maintained with pretty reasonable rates and the therapist was very knowledgeable.It has infinity pool overlooking the mountains only if it was heated. The food is delicious and their local coffee is amazing.

Stayed at this location for a night and the service that I received from the whole management was really good. The room was clean and the bed was comfortable. Our room had a good view of Hemja and we were lucky enough to catch the morning sunrise  from the comfort of our bed. The pool was pretty good too. The view from the pool was outstanding. On a clear day, you should be able to see the mountains. Overall, our stay was pretty pleasant. We will definitely come back next time.

A most memorable 50th birthday made possible by the diligence and personal touches by the property manager Mr Karki’s wonderful team!  We had booked the suite and deluxe room for 4 days for our group of 5 of my parents (who are in their late 70s) and siblings, it was spacious, luxurious and with views to die for!. We just don’t have enough words of praise for the hospitality extended by Mr Karki and his staff, special callout to Uttam and staff for the variety and spread of food thoughtfully provided. For the entire stay, Prabin for seamlessly making things happen. Sangharsh, Agra and Sudip, thanks for making it feel like a home away from home.Thank you for a most spectacular birthday arrangement…we are already planning our next trip there!

Very nice hotel and breathtaking view to the Himalaya! Amazing hikes from the hotel to the hills, and views to the mountains! I definitely recommend this hotel! Thanks to the warmly and carefully stuffBest regards Jessica

Open top pool, food was good. The service from Kalpana’ receptionist was impressive. Nearby Zip line, Paragliding spot and magnificent view makes this hotel stay worthwhile. I would recommend this hotel if you are looking for an adventure and view.

Had a beautiful 3 nights stay here. The rooms and staff were lovely. Do try the suite for the amazing bathtub with a view of the hills and the mountains if you’re lucky. Thankyou to Kalpana and the team for the wonderful hospitality.

Great location. Quiet and peaceful away from the city...Mountain view room with zip line adjacent to it. Staff are friendly and helpful. Breakfast was good with a lot of choices..Hiking spots nearbyI plan to stay here again.

We witnessed one of the beautiful welcome experience with traditional folk song and instrument. We truly felt very welcomed. I highly recommend the hotel. Staffs are very helpful and friendly. The food was fantastic. We couldn’t thank Kalpana enough for her warm hospitality and cooperation throughout. Massive dhanyabad.

Sarangkot Mountain Lodge is the quintessential place to witness the giant Annapurna range views upon sunrise! It is worth waking up at 6am to witness the most spectacular visual treat the snow clad mountains produce. It is truly a wonder. If you visiting Pokhara, definitely visit Sarangkot atleast for one night. Even though we had 2 suitcases and a few handbags, we took the cable car from Pokhara to Sarangkot instead of booking a cab. It was effortless, quick, cheap and had the best travel view. Our stay at Sarngkot Mountain Lodge was not only a wonderful experience due to our amazing view facing room but also because of the incredible service provided to us by the entire staff. Thank you so much Roshan our stay so special! Also thank you to Pawan for such good service. We loved the welcome upon arrival with the delicious welcome tea and cultural music performed. The room was cozy, clean and hygienic. The food was absolutely delicious and the cocktails and Sheesha were great. The only thing we wished could have been different was the pool. The infinity pool was so tempting, but as it was cold we couldn't dare to jump in. It would be great if you could get the infinity pool heated. Our overall experience was fantastic and we would definitely revisit and recommend!

Escape the heat and noise of Pokhara… and rest in the clouds at Sarangkot Mountain Lodge. The rooms are very comfortable and the sky pool is awesome. We really enjoyed the quietness and breakfast of this wonderful Mountain Lodge. Take a chance and experience peace.

Wow! We are so overwhelmed to even mention how amazing the hospitality was during our 4 days stay. From the cultural welcome and greetings when we reached to the minute consideration of our food choices, the room and its housekeeping members, everything was just so perfect. We definitely enjoyed our stay and so grateful for the love and care we received from the manager Roshan Sapkota himself and ofcourse Sudeep and Sangarsh for being extra careful for our vegan food choices and everyone else. The respect the team had for their guests are so incredible. We could witness the preparation of holi for their guests and We could say its rare to see this level of hospitality to ensure the guests enjoy the festival and they are not away from home.  Our trekking guide ( Khem Dai), He was very entertaining and we enjoyed his company towards Kaskikot visit.We are really very fortunate to have experience by far the best service at your Hotel.From the view of mountains, the ambience and extra care, i would very much recommend Sarangkot Mountain Lodge for every kind of visit.Thank you

Very nice stay at Sarangkot Mountain lodge. Staff are very friendly. Mr. Roshan was very helpful. Ambience quite good. Love it very much and will recommend to other to stay here. And if you choose to go by cablecar then inform them beforehand for pickup service.

The staff is all very kind and gracious and the hotel itself is AMAZING. I was very impressed with the facilities. The bathroom was amazing, complete with a rain shower and nice hot water. Food was delicious and the view was great. I loved it very much and hope to come back

It wasn't our first experience there and hopefully won't be our last . The view of the mountain , swimming pool , bar , room with balcony and overall hospitality were beyond our expectations. Superb staffs , heavenly location and modern amenities along with various activities made our vacation even more memorable . We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves , and will definitely be back !!

we chose this hotel as it was secluded and away from the crowded lakeside. it had amazing views of the mountains and the town. it took about 40 mins to get there from the airport and lakeside is equally far away.prosoutstanding service provided to us by all the staff. Pravin and sangharsh and khem were few who were great but rest all were amazing too.the view from the room and the outdoor open air dining area were amazing.do try and have a dinner under the stars near the swimming pool. the indoor seating area near the bar is a great place for dinner.the masseuse was amazing between the 6 of us we had 8 spa sessions.the paragliding spots are near by so u can go straight to the take off spot and have lunch at lakeside when u land.the trekking  is amazing and khem raj knows the area well and has lot of stories to keep u entertained during the trek.the food was decent too some of the appetizers were great but the pizza could have been better. hope they can try to add some salads and healthier options.consthe biggest problem is you can hear your neighbors through the walls. I fail to understand how the company has made so many hotels failed to not put in thicker walls to give you privacy.the TV is a new smart TV and only has Netflix maybe they can subscribe to other ott platforms too.the food is slightly expensive and as there are no restaurants around maybe taking a breakfast and dinner package would be more economical.the bed, pillows and blanket are 3 star quality maybe a premium bedding and blankets would be much appreciated.overall it is a great hotel with amazing service. not sure if they can fix the soundproofing in the rooms but rest I am sure can easily be fixed.I would still recommend this place to my friends as the workers there make u feel very warm with their service.

Our experience, right from the booking stage to getting dropped at the airport, was excellent. Each and everybody we came in contact with tried really hard to please and were successful in making our four day stay really memorable.It's an ideal base for zip-lining (literally next door), para-gliding and casual trekking. The views from the hotel, especially the sunrise, are amazing.Thank you Pawan, Roshan, Uttam and Sudeep for making our stay so good. And Keshari for helping us with the booking.

A peaceful place with a great view and friendly staff who are always ready to help out. The bar is well stocked and the chefs are also incredible. If you are looking for an escape from the city, this is the place to be.

I really loved the place and ambiance over here. Staff are too cool and friendly. Loved the views of mountain. Love the rooms over there. Breakfast is awesome. All things are managed well. Will visit over here very soon again.

There’s good view through the room.Excellent service So love in with the service 😊There’s good comfort all over the building and the respect given ti us was too good then I’d expected . Too much loving with the service provided by them The food is too hygenic and delicious 😋.

What lovely place ,wonderful people..rooms are extremely nice clean, spacious..fantastic mountain views from your private balcony.Me and my English friend  had plan to stay 1 night here but ..we liked it very much and stayed two night.So we like to recommend you once you at sarangkot please visit and stay at sarangkot Mountain Lodge .Special Thanks to Mr. Pawan karki, Rosan sapkota .. uttarm vai at restaurant and all lovely staff and friendly environment. Thanks once again 🙏

Right from the time we checked in untill we depart , we had no issue . All staffs were Soo friendly and professional . Luckily weather was also great so we had absolutely fantastic time . We highly recommend and would definitely be back :)

Really good place .Service was great the first moment I came here to the time I left. Food was really good, I recommend getting their Spaghett. Biryani was quite good too thought the pizza could have been better and bigger. The food is a bit pricey but I definitely enjoyed my stay here.

As we enter the Lodge, we received a suprise welcome. We were presented with traditional scarf "khata" by the Manager Mr.Roshan Sapkota while other staff are playing a traditional local folk song on background. Later we were served with hot water with lemon and honey as it was very cold day. Thanks to the simple gesture which instantly changed our mood and helped to forget all our tiredness. We choose SML for our engagement venue. All staff have been extremely cooperative and thoughtful about our ceremony. A table with sofa beside the infinity pool was setup for our ceremony which was simply amazing. At the end of our ceremony, a freshly baked engagement cake was also presented from the staff. Thanks to the pastry chef for the wonderful flavor, not to mention the texture and freshness of the cake. Before dinner, Mr.Roshan insist us to have a campfire to wram up and relax our body. Our dinner was served while we were baking ourself beside the fire which makes the dinner more delicious. The room was decorated with flowers and balloon. All these were offered by the hotel without asking. For me, honestly, the lodge experience was more memorable than my engagement in some way. The hospitality and services were far beyond our expectations. Kudos to all the staff who have made our special day a more special and memorable day. We are looking forward to come back again for a longer stay.

We had wonderful family time in Sarankot Mountain Lodge. The welcome music  played by folk singers made us very happy, specially kids. The food was delicious. Moreover the friendly staff and their hospitality made us feel our decision to stay here was very good. The view of sunrise and the mountains was spectacular.

Can not put into words how beautiful this property and the staffs are! We came as a family of four. Perfect for any type of visit. The hike was awesome! You don’t have to give second thoughts on coming here. The food, ambience, staffs, everything literally is over the top! Thank you so much and definitely recommending every individual and coming back as soon as I get to Nepal.

1. Why I chose this hotel: Since I was not sure about any sudden changes for travel restrictions to Nepal, I booked the hotel last minute - 1 day before my departure to Nepal from U.A.E.I contacted directly to the hotel via phone mentioning that I am going to celebrate my birthday at Sarangkot mountain lodge. I was considering other hotel aswell, however, the other hotel did not pick up my phone nor responded to my email. The Sarangkot Mountain Lodge staff answered all my questions that I was concerned regarding restrictions, hygiene, PCR protocols, food and beverage menus, transportation and so on. That call made me already a very good impression of the hotel. Also, they immediately answered to my email for further inquiry. 2. Location:When we arrived to the hotel, I knew that I made a very good choice to stay with them. The hotel was located in the middle of mountain 35 min away from the airport. In the morning, sunrise with the the himalaya mountain view was already made this trip worth it. The little balcony from our room was good enough location to enjoy the view during sunrise and sunset. We did not go to Sarangkot View Point although it was super close to the hotel. 3. Room:I loved the room and the interior. It was very cozy atmosphere. I honestly think that the actual place looking better than the pictures. Coffee/tea was available with some cookies and fresh fruits. Room was super clean and thoroughly taken care. Hot water for shower was available with bathtub. Room temperature was just right for the cold January weather. I loved the fact that they use the reusable amenities for sustainability. Room service and housekeeping service was superb.4. Food and Beverage:We enjoyed various cuisine includes Italian, nepali, indian, Chinese. Also, they do have shisha and cocktails/wine/beer. Here is my little warning: The food portion for 1 person of any main menu is HUGE. I recommend you to have the first dish with your friend if you are 2. I personally loved Trekker's Bhojan which is nepali dish. Also, nepali beer and Gulab Jamun (nepali desert) was so nice. I'll miss them. On my bday dinner, they prepared the special diner outside sitting with fire place. Also, they offered us a special menu for the dinner. We chose several appetizers and those were super delicious. I would say, don't waste your choice for pasta or hakka noodles. There are so many good indian/nepali foods you will like.5. Staff:They were very attentive and caring. They tried to help us to meet our requests. The called the PCR test nurses to the hotel so we did not have to travel to the hospital. They welcomed us with a handwriting letter which I never seen from any other hotels (been traveled 80 countries so far). Also, when I came back from the hiking on my birthday, they made the special decoration in our room which made us laugh sooo much. I really had a good time there. Thank you so much for your service. I wish I can go back there again. 6. Overall, it was the best decision ever to stay in Sarangkot Mountatin Lodge. I wouldn't be bothered to travel to lake side next time. Because this place satisfied me in every demand I had. Highly recommend this place! You will going to love it.

My husband and me visited this hotel for 1 night stay . We had quite a pleasant experience . We were welcomed with a nice cake as they got to know about our honeymoon . The rooms are just stunning .  Would definitely recommend a mountain view room. It’s ecstatic to wake up next to mountains . The staff is just very courteous . They made an exception and made sure we had the wine we wanted. The food and menu is pretty good too . Loved our stay overall

Sarangkot mountain lodge was our second experience of the famed Barahi group of hotels in Nepal. The jungle lodge at Chitwan had already the set the bar very high and Sarangkot mountain lodge matched up to it. The property itself is a laid back, rustic style building with all rooms facing the beautiful Annapurna range. The room was very clean, the bed was huge, comfortable, warm and the view of the sunrise from the room was epic! The staff were all polite and attentive. Special mention about Roshan who was there for us right from the checkin,  till the checkout and even after (when he helped us with finding a stay for our last night before we returned home from Kathmandu). Thank you, Roshan for all the help, for being so patient and always ready with a smile. Pawan, Sudeep, Prabin and all of the others were also extremely helpful, courteous and always ready to help.The breakfast spread was nice and the food was good. The vegetarian Nepali Thali was the best that we had during our 2 weeks stay in Nepal. The staff was ever so helpful and happy even when we ordered room service. Thank you, Sarangkot mountain lodge for a beautiful experience and all the warm hospitality. We will definitely return not just for the amazing view but also for the people who make that view even better.

We were blown away by the view. Although it was raining on the day of arrival we got good views of mountains the next day. Food was ok but the room, ambiance and facilities were really great. Worth the money you spend, hope to come back in future as well.

Such a fabulous stay at Sarangkot Mountain Lodge . I loved the way they welcomed their guests as well as personalized service throughout our stay untill we depart . Really glad for choosing Sarangkot Mountain Lodge for our vacation . We’ll definitely be back and highly recommend this amazing property

The experience was very nice. The rooms are absolutely beautiful, the staff are very nice, food was great and the ambience is amazing. The wifi was very fast and quite stable. Overall, would highly recommend to visit there.

Wonderful place. Best getaway for anniversary and honeymoon!!! Me and my wife enjoyed a lot on our one year anniversary. Our room was decorated and the staff were so helpful. Great service. We loved the suite and the bathtub overlooking the himalaya!

It was mesmerizing experience from the time we checked in until we departed. We were truly touched by the level of personalized service. Thanks to Mr. Roshan  and wonderful team. We will definitely reccommend this beautiful property and will be back soon.. Thankyou❤

This is best hotel by far in Sarangkot with best view. You can see all the mountain ranges and sunrise from your room only. Service was nice and staffs were friendly. Food was good; lil bit expensive though. Covid protocol was well maintained and staffs were vaccinated.  There is an infinity pool with great view. All the basic amenities like tea/coffee maker, toiletries, safe deposit locker, etc available. However there is no minibar available. Breakfast is decent. P:S:- The hotel is worth the price only if weather is clear.

Sarangkot mountain lodge is worth the stay.Everything was more than amazing.We really enjoyed our stay.Thank you so much for the amazing hospitality.The resort was worth the view with most beautiful Himalaya ranges.Food were so delicious and the staff were so honest and dedicated towards guest.I hope this resort will shine forever.

Beautiful mountain veiw..excellent hospitality..food and breakfast was awesomely delicious..they suprised us with freshly baked cake with lovely message written on it. Loved the stay..wishing further to come here again

Wife and I spent a couple nights here, checked out wanting to stay forever if we could. At times, we felt the mountains were literally hugging us and asking us to stay longer. Great food, and hospitality at its finest. Kudos to all the staff who made our stay wonderful. I would have liked the heated swimming pool, 5 stars nonetheless.

Best ambience and hospitality.The breathtaking view from the hotel.It was a wholesome experience at sarangkot mountain lodge.Thank you all team for great service and making our stay very special.Must visit once.

Visited this place on the recommendation of my friend and turned out to be an absolute gem. Outstanding customer service, breathtaking views and endless memories even in one stay. Place to visit before you die.

My wife and I had an amazing stay at the property. The rooms overlook the magnificent mountain ranges and everyone at the property are very hospitable. Great food too. We’d highly  recommend this place.

Very good property in Sarangkot, Pokhara. We have no words for the splendid service of the F&B department. Special appreciation to Mr. Sangarsh Subedi from the F&B Department.Must visit in Pokhara. If you want to see the grandeur view of the majestic Machhapuchhre mountain sipping a nice cup of coffee from your hotel room then Sarangkot Mountain Lodge is the place to be. Highly recommended property in Sarangkot, Pokhara.

Enjoyed my 20th anniversary at sarangkot mountain lodge . We were really touched by personalized service from all team members . Special mention to Roshan , chef Manoj , Pawan , Pravin , Mahesh , Uttam , Sangharsha & Sudip for making it memorable . Apologies for not taking all names as it is the entire team . We'll definitely be back and highly recommend .

Lovely ambience, great view, lovely staff, felt very taken care of. Also efficient as other extra activities eg paragliding could be directly booked via hotel. Loved the fact that every little detail was taken care of especially the amenities. Wonderful experience. Would highly recommend.

Perfect place to visit,please do visit thank you.Love the hospitality love the ambiance Concept hotelRelaxing peace placeFood is super delicious I love the design of toilet View of mountain from my balcony is just out of this world

Thank you for your cooperation. Warmly good your service. Next time we will come and enjoy here also. This place is very beautiful and nice. We can say your good service in our place . A vey good morning and thanks again.

Great location, really pleasant and clean rooms, but the thing that makes this such a good place to stay are the staff. All of the people are incredibly helpful and generous with their time and advice.The room was well equipped and the service was excellent. From the balcony, we could view the sea and feel the cool breeze. The location of my room was absolutely perfect.And many thanks to prabin tamang sir See you again😊😊😊

From the moment we arrived we were looked after and made to feel at home. The lodge has a very relaxing and comforting feel, the views are outstanding. Even when the clouds come in, the rolling hills and mountains are incredible.The food was delicious and the amount offered for breakfast was very generous ! The hotel arranged transport for us and the driver was very polite and keen to share knowledge on the local area. Overall, I highly recommend this hotel and I will definitely be returning in the future

The hotel has been one of the best stay so far in Pokhara with the lovely panoramic views of the mountains. The lodging and fooding has been exceptionally friendly specially Mr. Uttam.   He has been very kind and always there when in need. He has a very good knowledge on the hospitality and he has been very welcoming. Thank you Uttam👍🏻 You made us feelMore comfortable during our stay.

One of the best resort I have been so far. Amazing hospitality with good food and not to forget the best Mountain View ever. The rooms are also very good with excellent room service from the hotel staffs.

It was great pleasure staying in sarangkot mountain lodge ,.. special thanks to Mr Roshan Sapkota ( manger ) for making our stay memorable . We'll be back soon for more mountains and sunrise again  good luck to wonderful team there .

My family and I - a party of 7 plus our driver - were well received by the Sarangkot Mountain Lodge. The staff was very friendly yet respectful and got us situated in great adjoining rooms and made sure that our driver was taken care of. The food there is amazing, as is the ambience.
