This place was awesome and staying is too much awesome..I and my family are enjoying staying with you guyz..Espaically thanks to Mr.prabin Jung Tamang .. He is too gentle and kind and much more thanks for the good service..Loved it ..Thank you: With regards,Ar. Ishwor kunwor

Excellent serviceAmazing breakfastMagnificent view from room.Good place to hike around the hotel near by.Internet facility in the rooms can be stronger As it is height there network connectivity issues at times which may be can be sorted in near future for the customer to experience the best service from the hotel.Dinner has options, however it can be catered to the taste buds of all customers, so Dinner can be improved in near futureMust visit place for everyone, not a place to miss

The room experience was excellent ,  awesome balcony, excellent hospitality and well managed and trained staff. If  there is little improvement in direction map from base of sarangkot ,the guest who come on their way will be guided property. We are satisfied by choosing SML.

Great location, equally awesome ambience. The woodwork looks wonderful. Excellent hospitality. Eloquent rooms with Machhapuchre just out of your window. It’s a lifetime experience to watch the sun rise and set so near to the peak sitting in your room. Wonderful

Hospitality, Food & View deserves a 5 star.Will come back again for another vacation when we come to Pokhara . The ambience is excellent.It's a peaceful area . The sunrise and the sunset from the hotel is good . The mountain view is Fabolous.The rooms are good .The staff  and other people here is very cooperative and understanding .This is a must stay hotel in  sarangkot

Excellent visit!!!! Extraordinary view, wonderful staff!! we really enjoyed the experience. The vibe in here is just amazing and we absolutely loved the designs and architecture. Definitely worth a revisit!

Outstanding location with friendly staff. Best location for Mountain View with infinity pool with a bar on the side. Room interior looks elegant, clean and neat. I would highly recommend to fix TV channels as there were no TV services during our stay. Additionally internet connection is very weak. It is highly recommend to look at TV as well as internet. Restaurant food is delicious and service is beyond expectations. Front office staffs are friendly and helpful. However their English speaking ability is not up to expectations. I would recommend the staff to communicate barter. Specially front of the house.

Had a good experience staying with my family. Staffs are really good. Food is great. Impressed with the hospitality. Beautiful view of the mountains and a spectacular sunrise. Wholesome experience....

Great food, gentle staffs, welcoming environment and unmatched customer service; what else would anyone ask for while on a vacation. A must try if you're around Sarangkot or Pokhara. Highly recommended!!!!!

Amazing experiences. Highly recommend.Staffs are friendly, cordial and services are prompt. There are swimming pool and roof top bar at 4th floor with amazing view.A must place to visit in Nepal. - Sonam & Doma

Second time at Sarangkot and this place is really great. Though we didn’t see the mountains clearly, the overall hospitality was amazing. We Highly recommend to travel during October -December and march-may.

We had a get together of approximately 42 friends. Stayed there for 2 nights. The view was simply exemplary from there.The food was excellent and so was the service. They said no for nothing.We all had an amazing time.Highly recommend this property.

This sarangkot mountain lodge has alured me in many aspects of its beautiful designs. The best part of this lodge is the way they presented simple things with great beauty. I was amazed the way they have decorated the rooms, lobby, restaurant in such a simple way which sooo calming to eyes.Hospitality over here feels like homely with utmost care and love, I just melted by their professionalism.Things kept over this lodge seems like they want to retain nature in its original form, that's the best part which make difference and eco friendly.Yummy food is soo tasty and for vegetarians they offer in such a way, you will just amazed.Wonderful place to be.Everyone must check to experience essence of sarangkot mountain lodge.But once you experience , I am sure you will be addicted.Thank you

We decided to Sarangkot Mountain Lodge for Lunch on 13th feb and upon enquiry they mentioned that they had a couples lunch package so we went for it. Hotel itself is around 30 mins scenic drive from lakeside, we enjoyed our drive overlooking phewa lake and that of paragliders. Upon reaching the hotel we received a warm welcome from the staff even though we were only there for lunch. They played a folk song and greeted us with a welcome gift and a drink. We were taken to our table by one of the friendly staff and gave us a quick tour of the hotel as well. We were really amazed by the table setup as we didn’t expect anything special. Our table was at the top floor near the pool. They explained to us our meal which was three course and the our server was super helpful and friendly. We choose Nepali food option for our lunch and food itself was amazing as well.Thank you team for the wonderful experience and warm welcome. We would def recommend Sarangkot Mountain Lodge and will be back for a stay soon.

This is the place where u go for Break. I'm in love with the small details that are used for the room. Which is, the room color which makes you feel  the warm homely ambiance. The service which I get from every staff (i don't want to include one single name) everyone is so welcoming. The personalized service they offer for you for your every comfort, makes you want to stay more. It was my break from work in February, I thoroughly enjoyed my stay. I would like to thank Mr. Baibhav Poudel for recommending Sarangkot mountain Lodge.

Excellent hospitality, service, ambience, location. We got to see an awesome sunrise with the himalayan peaks. The infinity swimming pool and bar area beautifully designed. Must not miss this place while visiting Pokhara, Nepal.

if you haven't tried the crushed pineapple cake here you haven't tried anything yetvery moist, subtle, the icing was extremely smooth, tasty, and the sweetness just enoughbeen around,but who would have thought one would find such bakery artistry high up here among the mountains five stars to the pastry chef

Very good ambience,interiors and hospitality. .very friendly and co operative staffs, especially Mr. Diwakar. .clients are on priority.  view is too much worthful to witness. .tasty food items,chicken barbeque especially. .must visit place !

Service was good in spite of less staff all thanks to Mr.Uttam Dhamala and all the staff members..room was clean and interior was different from other places..you guys made our stay memorable..thank you SARANGKOT MOUNTAIN LODGE

We stayed at the SARANGKOT MOUNTAIN LODGE for 3 nights in the end week of October 2020. It's a peaceful and quiet lodge with wide window views of snow mountain Macchapucchare Annapurna Himalayan range.With a 30 minute drive from fewa lake pokhara we reached a remote location on top of a sarangkot. We missed Television in the room but other room amenities, cleanliness, strong free wifi and good meals (I love continental food)!I would recommend this lodge to anyone who is looking for remoteness and yes to the nature lovers off course! as we had a great day hike to the near places and local villages.Staff are very humble and nice (especially the guy with black & white hair Mr. Chinta we call him salt and pepper, Vinod, jagannath). Fantastic lodge to stay in with a best view of the Annapurna Himalaya Range!!! we will come again . for sure!!!!!

Visited Sarangkot Mountain Lodge For 2 Nights In Oct 2020 to celebrate Dashain Festival (COVIDE -19). Even During This Time They Have Maintained The Highest Level Of Service, Cleanliness And Hygienic. All The Staff Were Excellent And Food Was Superb. We Stayed In Room 301, Which Has An Amazing View of Annapurna range. We Also Enjoyed A day Hike (KASKIKOT PALACE), Which I Would Highly Recommend Or Else You Can Still Be At Hotel & Just Enjoy The View And Bar(near infinity pool).Thank You To The Entire Team At #sarangkotmountainlodge For Making Our Stay Pleasant. This Place Not Only Has An Amazing View But Also Excellent Service And Food.*Special Thanks To Mr. Chinta Prasad Gautam And Binodjung Poudel*

It is one of the best places to see snow mountains in sarangkot, Pokhara. Nature at its best. Rooms needs improvement. Service specially at restaurant needs serious training and improvement. Zipline entry is at the Hotel compound.

Outstanding property overlooking beautiful range of mountains from Annapurna and Fishtail. Surprisingly with view Nepalese class of articture with contemporary Nepali theme decorated beautifully. Very hospitable team members. Mr. Jagganath who looks after operation is very hospitable and looks after every needs of guests with perfection. Team lead by Mr. Chinta Prasad Gautam is second to none. Despite ongoing challenge of Covid, a complete maintained protocol and safety measures looks so relevant. Best to all staff for amazing hospitality.

Very nice view on Annapurna from your balcony, new and luxurious hotel with comfortable rooms. Very very friendly owner and Staff will do everything to make you comfortable. Also a very nice rooftop bar with infinity pool. Recommanded to escape vivid Pokhara or to relax after a trekking!

This is a new hotel sitting on a mountain top with incredible views.  The design is wonderful and the rooms are spacious and very comfortable.  The service is very good and you will want for nothing.  While TVs and the spa are coming in the future there are lots of hiking opportunities along with zip lining and para gliding.  General Manager Harminder oversees his team and ensures a perfect visit.HIGHS-Beautiful design in room and public areas-Very comfortable bed and and pillows-Great rainfall shower-Beautiful bathroom -Exceptional food at restaurant-Great service throughoutLOWS-WIFI is sporadic

Despite the late hour, we walked in to chekout the rooms and tariffs. First impression of the property and building, wow! Rooms were pretty clean and decent to match but had no TV.  Has a infinity pool at the terrace. View is amazing. Love to visit again.

No words to define the service.. amazing view.. amazing support staff lead by the great  leader who are always ready so support customer. Take any room having excellent view of Annapurna range.. you can see the sun rise from your room terrace. they also arrange the paragliding for me at good rates.. food was just amazing..  surely come back again soon..

Great hotel with a convincing sustainability concept. Natural materials. Glass water bottles. No plastic. All rooms have a view. Very large selection at breakfast. Very professional and helpful management! Also (mostly) competent staff.

It was a great experience, and I was lucky enough to see the Fishtail Peak.The guy at the hotel front desk was great. When the weather was bad, it was hard to see the snow-capped mountains. Once the snow-capped mountains showed their tops, he immediately reminded us to see the snow-capped mountains.

Very nice place 🙏The staff is wonderful, always smiling, friendly and ready to help.In the morning for breakfast you can order any freshly squeezed juice (vegetable or fruit).There is a Momo station and the momos here are great!! The best I've tried in Nepal.Cappuccino with plant milk, which was important for me since I don’t drink cow’s milk.The room is clean. All in compliance with environmental requirements. No plastic bottles, no plastic bags. Everything is eco friendly ❤️Bed linen and towels are new, white, crispy with cleanliness.

A hotel located on a quiet hill. It was very high quality with a spectacular view and warm hospitality from the staff. It's one of the hotels I would like to visit again.It's in a small area of Sarangkot in Nepal, so I wonder what it's like, but the facilities were very comfortable. The food was also authentic.My morning cappuccino was brought to me decorated with art.When we arrived, all the staff came out to greet us.There is also a spa, and my companion said it felt great.

The room is very cute with a woody feel, and the balcony in the room is in a great location to view Annapurna.The staff are all very kind and quick to respond.The food at the restaurant is satisfying both in the morning and evening. It's a little expensive, but the service is included in the restaurant price, so I think it's totally worth it.If you want to keep your budget a little lower, you can walk to the restaurant.I was torn between the lakeside and this hotel in Sarangkot, but I was very satisfied with this hotel in Sarangkot. There is a cable car nearby, so it's easy to get to the lakeside. Taxis are good, but I recommend taking the cable car and enjoying the view.You can also ask about activities such as trekking at the front desk. Although I didn't specify in advance, they were kind enough to arrange a Japanese guide for me.Pokhara's lakeside is nice, but I highly recommend the laid-back Sarangkot!!!

I really liked the hotel, the staff, the view 😍, it was so nice, cozy, I didn’t want to leave. Before booking, I read the reviews, different ones, and did not regret at all that I chose it. Everything is natural, the decoration of the room, and what a cute robe. People specifically go to this mountain as an excursion, but in the hotel everything is yours, you can endlessly look at the views from the balcony. In general, from all over the hotel around. The only thing is to be patient, waiting for a taxi may take about an hour, or they will offer you a car from the hotel at twice the price. But this does not apply to the hotel; when booking, you must understand that it is high on the mountain. Thank you for the pleasant emotions 🤗🙏

Perfect location in nepalgunj. Hotel was very responsive to questions prior to our arrival time and even arranged vehicle to meet us at airport. At the hotel reception staff were welcoming,  friendly and helpful.  The room was wonderful big room with amazing views from windows, comfy bed clean linens, coffee maker, robes andsliper and  great daily housekeeping. Buffet breakfast was so tasty and we were very happy to see the hotel took all Covid precautions. Me ad my friend will definitely return and  can highly recommend!!!!

I wanted to avoid writing something bad in times of corona, but this place got me to.  We booked an upgrade room, but it was very small (too small), especially the tiny bathroom. The window was huge, but in the front there were endless pigeons, which covered the windowsill with a huge blanked of sh*t.The first time we had to call for maintenance was for the door lock, which didn't work and was replaced. The second time was for the A/C heating, as the room was completely cold. The third time would have been for the shower drain, which flooded the bathroom, but we just didn't want to. All this would not be too bad, but there are so many small things (Breakfast is not included, the food plates in front of the rooms were standing there both days of our stay) that are absolutely not OK for the hefty price of almost 100$ per night.We left after one night, and now we're trying to get the bill, but there is no answer via mail or booking platform.

Recently had opportunity to stay at Soalee hotel in Nepalganj. One of the best hotel to stay at which is not only taking excellent care of their customers but also thinking ahead of time and making it environmental friendly. This hotel does not require ranking as it surpasses many hotel standards that western countries have to save the environment. Each and everyone working for hotel is best at what they are doing and more importantly trying to provide best customer service and help. I encourage anyone who is planning to visit Nepalganj, go and experience it for yourself.

"The hotel is good value for money. The location is ideal for exploring the city, rooms are modern and clean, breakfast buffet is rich and good quality and given by f&b staff were highly appercitable.overall i am happy with thier service will stay in this property when i visit to nepalgunj.

The overall food delivery system, hallroom,breakfast was so delicious and hygiene we all like it. The all staff was so helpful and kind one staff Muna chand was so helpful and she guided us. The staff behaviour was so good .We all liked it.

My second visit i stayed for three nights with my family and again this hotel is unbelievable amazing in every way. We have stayed a lots of 5 star hotels but this really was one of the best   rooms was nicely designed and decor very neat and clean absolutely stunning. There were pool on first floor roof really nice. Staffs were very attentive here. Breakfast and dinner very tasty with many variety and high quality overall our stayed was very memoriable.

Venue Is Large, Service is super smoother, everyone cooperated with us in assistance the event. Food is tasty beautifully presented buffet we enjoy buffet dinner with large of variety. Scenery from the our room windows are awesome. Thankyou highly appreciated their hardwork for service of quality. Highly Recommended!!!!

First leed certified green building in Nepal as they brief us soaltee westend premier is the only leadership in energy and environmental (LEED) design hotel. Located at Nepalgunj. Best service best quality best hotel in town staffs are so friendly and helpful always ready to give you best service hotel design is up to the mark amazingly decorated. Got the opportunity to experience this luxury service.

Top floor with view of the swiming pool area, green hotel is a choice stay for its great location only 5-10min away from the domestic airport. Everything is perfectly desgined with well groomed staffs. Will be back soon

Firstly the location is very good near at airport amazing building structure evach and every staff very helpful and friendly. Food was delicious buffet breakfast was super tasty with slots of variety and luxurious decorated. Chef was very kind and good humour my 2 days stay was very memorable at Soaltee Hotel

This property is by far the best one in the city of Nepalgunj. Very clean, polished and well managed. The staff who work here knows the meaning of hospitality. They are very attentive, understand their guests needs and go that extra yard to get things done. I had an opportunity to meet up with the Resident Manager Mr. Prabin Singh and he ensured that my stay there was extremely pleasant. I will be visiting here again  in the near future and highly recommend my fellow travelers to go check it out!

Located in the vibrant city of Nepalgunj, Soaltee Westend Premier offers a unique blend of luxury and comfort in western Nepal. Nestled amidst the bustling streets of Nepalgunj, this hotel provides a tranquil oasis for travelers seeking both relaxation and convenience.The hotel's architecture and interiors reflect a modern aesthetic combined with local influences, creating a welcoming atmosphere from the moment you arrive. The lobby is elegantly designed, setting the tone for a sophisticated stay.Accommodations at Soaltee Westend Premier are spacious and well-appointed, featuring contemporary decor and amenities that cater to the needs of both leisure and business travelers. Each room offers a serene retreat with views of the cityscape or the hotel's landscaped gardens.Dining options showcase a variety of culinary experiences, from international flavors to authentic local dishes, served in stylish restaurants that emphasize quality and innovation.Service at Soaltee Westend Premier is exemplary, with a dedicated team that ensures personalized attention to every guest. Whether arranging local excursions, organizing events, or attending to special requests, the staff's professionalism and hospitality shine through.The hotel also boasts excellent leisure facilities, including a fitness center, spa, and outdoor pool, providing opportunities for relaxation and rejuvenation.Soaltee Westend Premier in Nepalgunj offers a luxurious and memorable stay for travelers seeking comfort, convenience, and exceptional service in western Nepal.

The hotel is very well located with peace place just 5 min far from domestic airport we had a suite room and bath tube shower place was big beds were comfortable the hotel is morden and efficient with high tech technology. Breakfast is plentiful and we'll handled lots of variety staff were friendly and helpful. I would stay here again

As a local of Nepalgunj I take pride in Soaltee's hospitality , food and services.With food so good there is not a single space of disappoinment with this property.I'll reccomend this place to the one who want a good dimming experience and a  safe place to stay.

Fantastically friendly and efficient service from obviously well trained staff. They couldn't do enough to make our stay more enjoyable. The restaurant has a good selection of menu choices and the food was tasty and the portions large.The rooms are comfortable, well appointed and tastefully decorated.The only downsides are the bathrooms are small and the Eco-friendly a/c system doesn't really cool the rooms down enough, I still had to use the ceiling fan, which isn't ideal for a light sleeper like me. My colleague said his room temperature was fine. Perhaps the fact that I had a corner room made a difference?But, I will stay here again next time I am in Nepalgunj.

Soaltee Hotel Nepalgunj is known for its convenient location, offering easy access to Nepalgunj Airport and the city's business and commercial centers. Guests often appreciate the comfortable rooms and the hospitality of the staff. The hotel is also noted for its good dining options, particularly its local cuisine offerings. As with any establishment, individual experiences may vary, so checking recent reviews for the most current feedback is advisable.

This is an excellent hotel in nepalgunj to stay. Comfortable rooms with all amenities are placed perfectly. The food was very tasty and done with care. The chef was very helpful and even prepared special meals for me and my friends.  We had very comfortable and relaxing stay in soaltee nepalgunj. Overall value for money place.

Rooms are in pathetic state which could be due to long term lockdown.Tea bags are there in the room but pay extra  for milk.Ask for ice and pay extraNo house keeping services , room temperature being controlled by the reception but how there is no answer.Washroom are so small that  you have to struggle to get inside and this is what they call an upgraded room.Room locker not functioning despite repeated requests.But since this is the only hotel in nepalganj of this category hence no alternative.

This was by far the nicest hotel I've stayed at in Nepal outside of Kathmandu (and better than a couple I've stayed at there). The was incredibly friendly and courteous. Their level of service was on par with what you experience in the Philippines. Their deposed king was visiting during my stay which caused some confusion and stress, but the staff handled it wonderfully. My only concern is that if you are a warm-bodied person like myself, make sure you request one of the rooms that are on the good air-conditioning system.

We enjoyed buffet lunch in sunrise restaurant at soaltee hotel nepalgunj this time they serve a large variety of cuisine. Mouthwatering taste very helpful staff very time ready to take care of you. Recommend!!

This was my second stay. Unlike previous stay, I was quite disappointed with their In-house Spa Service.In the evening they didn't attended and gave a very unprofessional reply that they aren't payed overtime so they won't take new clients thought I was there before their closing time. In the morning they said it would open at 10, However while I was there at 10:45, they said their staff hasn't arrived yet and asked me to come back in half an hour, I did but was disappointed again. They said they will call after their staff arrived but never did until 1 pm. Not expected such a miserable customer dealing with Soaltee.

Perfectly located great ambience clean and well maintained room. Food quality and quantity were good as well polite great trained staffs they know the guest handling perfectly. Always ready to provide whatever help needed. Not to forget amazing room view.

The Soaltee Nepalgunj. I just spent a night but find one of the best Hotel in region. People are so friendly and attentive you can feel much safer ever. They seems very professionals to serve you better than the best and make your time enjoyable. Thank you

This comes from a person who travels this city often but most hotels here doesn't have spa but Soaltee .Everytime you enter the hotel premise there will be one offering you a beverage. Staff here are friendly and I like the authenticity of Indian cuisine here.Overall I enjoy my staycation here.

Amazing hotel very modern, spacious room amazing greenery view, very large and comfortable bed, friendly And helpful staff, and a tasty breakfast. Overall this is great value in the nepalgunj city 10-15min far from nepalgunj airport. I would love to stay there again

I had an incredible time at this hotel. The room was a very comfortable and the attention to details In it's design made it a pleasure to stay. 🥰🥰 The restaurant service was top-notch and the diverse menu ensured there was something for everyone. Overall very satisfying hotel

Soaltee hotel is itself a brand in Kathmandu with excellent service or hospitality or food. But sadly same is not the case for Nepalgunj. It is just a average hotel with poor service and average food. It has nothing more to offer than other hotels in Nepalgunj. This hotel is slightly away from town but near to airport. Rooms are big with all basic amenities (tea/coffee, heating pot, hair dryer, locker, toothpaste/brush, shampoo, etc) available. There is a small swimming pool and gym room. There is also SPA and steam available.However, service of the hotel is very very slow. If you want to order lunch/dinner, then you have to do 1 hour before as service is that slow. Even your drink is served late. Breakfast is very average with minimum choice and no fruits. The main drawback of the room is its A/C. They have central A/C and you cannot control your room temperature on your own. So if you want to change your room temperature then you have to call to reception and many times answer is "we have set a standard room temperature which cannot be changed!!!!!!" in addition to this, A/C is very noisy. There is a SPA in a hotel which is actually good but when i did it, room temperature was so cold that i could not enjoy the SPA at all. And person at SPA do not understand Nepali!! The elevator of the hotel is also very noisy and its noise can be heard clearly in the room, which can bother the light sleepers. Water pressure in the shower is ok. The check in and check out is also very slow. If you are in hurry then you should check out atleast 1 hour before or risk to miss the flight like me (It took them 30 mins to check me out!)In summary, this is very average hotel where you cannot get feel of Soaltee. You wont regret if you give it a miss!

This beautiful resort is in the middle of nowhere - in the wilderness. But that's the beauty of the place! After a 30 min boat ride in a shikara you reach the resort amidst the lake, mountains and snow peaks. It is a fair climb up to the reception and rooms which is the beauty of the place. The resort is a peaceful, tranquil and an amazing place far from the crowds. Despite being so isolated it has all the trappings and comforts of a modern hotel. The staff is ever ready to help and go out of their way to make you comfortable or resolve any issue.During the day we went on small treks in the nearby forest and the villages around the lake - all excellently planned by the resort. They have a spa and yoga sessions to complete the experience.The highlight of our stay was the candlelight dinner and barbecue on the raft on the lake. It has to be experienced to be believed! This place is not for those who have problems climbing or dislike walking. Also for those who want to be in city centre with bars and restaurants around. But for anyone who is looking for some peace and quiet with breathtakingly beautiful views of the lake and snow peaks - it is a little bit of heaven on earth.

First time in Nepal 🇳🇵.  Spent eight days in crazy and vibrant Kathmandu at the yoga retreat. We were looking for a luxury and serene place to stay for the rest of our trip. With help of a local guide we found this magnificent Begnas Lake Resort! Breathtaking view, amazing location on the biggest lake of the Seven Lakes Valley near Pokhara town. There are about forty villas with a nice pool with filtered water from the lake (no chemicals added).The view from the restaurant is astonishing! Good menu, three choices of the breakfast included. We love the American breakfast 😋 You can choose to take a boat ride from the Pokhara side to the resort, gliding on the calm water, soaking under the  sun🌞.The Spa service are excellent, we love the Thai massage by Amrit ( must try! )  and the Ayurvedic massage. It was surreal to find this tranquil spot to rejuvenate our souls and bodies! We love the natural and harmonious feel of this place! It'll  be nice to recall this warm memories during long cold Colorado winter, hoping to come back here sometime soon. PS. Did I mention this place is spotless! Clean rooms and super professional stuff makes our stay a dream ✨️

We spent two incredible nights at Begnas Resort with our two kids (10 &7) after a six day trek. Our rooms were beautiful, comfortable and idyllically placed on the grounds. We enjoyed the food, pool and multiple floats in the lake on the resort-provided inner tubes. The food was delicious and the staff was incredibly kind (including making the common room available at 1am for a World Cup game!). One of the highlights of the trip was watching the hi jinx that the resident cow got up to  every day!

We arrived at the resort by boat ride along the calm water of Begnas Lake, so fun! We had a very nice bungalow overlooking the lake and since it was raining while we were there, we did not try the pool. However, we enjoyed the food very much, particularly their papaya (the sweetest I've ever tried) and the grilled fish. The breakfast menu was great, too.The rooms are clean, good service, and the staffs were very friendly, nature and ambiance were perfect! The only minus point was that the resort involves lots of stairs so maybe it is not elderly/wheelchair friendly.

My family and I stayed here for a few nighters leading up to New Year's Eve. This resort is very peaceful with stunning views, nice rooms and good service. A nice alternative to the busier Pokhora (but still near enough drive to vist for the day). The restaurant has a variety of foods, all the fish dishes were amazing! The bar is nice and cozy next to a big copper fireplace, perfect to play board games and drink tasty cocktails. We went across the lake by boat and when on a hike over the beautiful terraced hills to a viewpoint of the Himalayas (fairly easy we went without a guide).

Sitting in the trees on the hillside above the lake, the views are stunning. The rooms are large and clean with a fan and air-conditioning and a view over the lake.  Tea and coffee making facilities, fridge, TV and toiletries, hairdryer, but no shower gel.  The service was excellent and the food very good.  There are a lot of steps to  climb to get around the resort, so it is not suitable for anybody with mobility issues.  Take the boat transfer from Begnas Bazaar to the resort otherwise, if you arrive by car, there are almost 300 steps to reception.  There is nothing to do in and around the resort so we were glad we only stayed one night.  The swimming pool needed a clean, otherwise we might have used that. We were pleased we stayed there however just for the beauty and tranquility.

My husband booked a stay at Begnas Resort to celebrate a special occasion. My husband is Nepali and I am of Caucasian origin (white skin, blue eyes) and we live in Nepal. While booking over the phone my husband was given the room rate so he made the reservation – double room for him and his wife. Unfortunately he didn’t realize it would be relevant while making a reservation to mention that his wife is “white”. So we packed and took a long drive to get to the hotel, we had approximately the amount of cash with us to cover the charges as per the booking terms given over the phone several days earlier.Upon check-in my husband was informed that he has to pay a “tourist” rate for the room booked, which is three times higher than what was offered over the phone. As soon as we entered reception, the front desk staff took one glance at me and my husband was told to pay three times the rate, as apparently there is a “Nepali” rate and a “tourist” rate at the hotel.Explaining that we live here and that we are married and that I am certainly not a tourist by any means didn’t help at all. We even called for the manager of the hotel and tried to explain to him that treating me and my husband this way after a reservation has been made is outrageous. He just explained that the hotel has a policy of charging foreigners triple the rate of what Nepali people pay. We said that one of us is a Nepali, so why do they insist on charging us the foreign price, when booking was made based on the offered rate prior to arrival. But it turns out that to Begnas Resort my “foreign-ness” is far superior and it automatically overrides my husband’s “Nepali-ness”. Even presenting the copy of our Nepali-issued marriage certificate was not sufficient, so we had no choice but to write off our planned birthday celebration and take another long drive back home. It cannot be denied that the views and gardens are beautiful, but if you don’t appreciate double standards or subtle racial prejudice, you should reconsider staying here.

I booked to stay at Begnas for a week, but left after 2 days. The main reason for this was that I was the only guest in this fairly large hotel, and just felt uncomfortable. I assumed that I would not get any money back, and must admit that the hotel did offer to put me in a different hotel in Pokhara free of charge.  Because I did not know the hotel I preferred to go to a different one (recommended by a friend) on my own expense. Besides this I would like to point out a few details of my stay to justify my rating.I booked the yoga and meditation package. On the first day there was no yoga, because the teacher was still in Kathmandu. Don’t see how this is any excuse, as they knew I was coming but being my first day I just left the issue. The next morning I had the yoga session in a freezing room. I understand it was not summer, but for the price you pay I expect someone to switch the heater on before the class started. It is not possible to relax when you are FREEZING!  The next morning there was no power, due to loadshedding, which I understand as well, but the hotel has generators, but they ‘don’t switch them on for one guest’ I was told by the yoga teacher. In the rooms as well it was freezing, because they are built out of stone and never get sun in. It was definitely not just the weather, because in the place I stayed in after leaving Begnas it was not that cold. Although I realized that the hotel is 20km from Pokhara, I did not realize they would charge so much for the hotel transport to Pokhara. The local taxi is a fair bit cheaper but it is still around 15usd one way, so you need to keep this in mind if you plan some trips in the area. On a positive note the food is great, the staff is friendly, and the setting is beautiful. It really had some positive aspects, but I think what you get is not justified by the price.

Though the location is exotic with great view of lake & mountains, the resort is not only expensive but has hidden charges which usually we do not pen down while booking the hotel. We were two families travelling with two kids aged 8-9 years old and one kid 5 years old. For one family we agreed to pay for extra bed ( which included breakfast also) and agreed that for other kids breakfast would be included ( only verbally agreed). But on the breakfast table next morning, they did not serve breakfast until we agreed to pay ‘full’ charge for the 2 extra breakfast for the two kids ( aged 5 & 8). This came as a shock. Frankly my 5 year old kid did not eat the breakfast properly yet we ended up paying full charge. Despite proper booking, it took almost an hour for them to hand us over the room. This may generally be tolerated but when you have young children waiting for an hour in the lobby can be a problem. The swimming pool was infested with frogs and a layer of dirt sat on the floor of the pool. When we complained, the reply was that they do not use chlorine / chemical hence the frog comes and the staff added that the ‘foreigner’s like the frogs as it natural. There were other hidden charges like water served in the room ( usually most hotels in Nepal give few bottles as complimentary), extra charges if you want to pay by card. Wifi does not work properly / all the time and I did not find the staffs very friendly at all...may be because I was local ( from Kathmandu). Though a great location with abudance of solitude, I would not visit the place again and if somebody wants to go, I suggest please have all the charges etc penned down and agreed. Michael Siddhi

THIS HOTEL IS NOT PREPARED TO GIVE THE LEVEL OF SERVICE THEY CHARGE FOR. You will get only 2 hours of hot shower, few hours of electricity, and Internet only when the hotel wants to switch On the router. Be prepared to be ISOLATED and in the conditions of the VII Century. EXTREMELY OVERPRICED their restaurant and Spa rates are in EUROS!We went to Begnas Lake Resort to scape from the  craziness of Fewa Lake (Pokhara).When we arrive, the manager showed us around, and we decided we liked enough to spend a couple of relaxed days (even though we knew there is NOTHING AROUND, which means once you are there, you are better enjoy the views and room, because there is nothing else to do!)After talking with the manager, he offered the room at a price of 120$++ (total 150$ per night) which is a step above any accommodation in Nepal (mid range Hotel (3 starts) cost around 30-40$/night...In Agoda and other booking sites, and the best rate was at 90$.At that point, we made an offer to pay that rate, directly to them. The manager refused the offer, so we decided to book through Agoda (saving 60$...)Double Deluxe Room said the offer, at 90$. GREAT!so we booked... and they gave us the room. Our surprise when checkin-out,  they requested extra payment assuring that the booking that we did was only for 1 person, and the second person had to pay extra.... We couldn't understand because we booked a DOUBLE DELUXE ROOM, and that not include two people?After an hour of arguing and discussing with their staff, the manager and even Agoda, we decided to pay and go because they were really wasting our patience and time. But not finish yet, we spend another 45 minutes trying to make the payment via Credit Card. THIS HOTEL IS NOT PREPARED TO GIVE THE LEVEL OF SERVICE THEY CHARGE FOR.

This resort is one of the most beautiful places I have ever seen and I have definetly seen a lot. It is placed in an absolutely wonderful nature with a big see in the front and an impressive mountain panorama with cute natural stone apartments with nice bath rooms, warm shower, tv, very good beds, and a cute little terrace. Different to other hotels in the world there are no special food times. You can go and have breakfast, lunch and dinner the whole day to every time you like to. The restaurant has a fantastic view to the see and the mountains. A wonderful place to relax and to enjoy the delicious food and around the resort is a beautiful nature to explore by walking or biking. A particular note is the hotel staff. Every one of them is so helpful, foresighted and warmly and they really take care for every guest. Especially Rajesh Phuyal, the front office manager is very concerned about the guests. He is working very hard to make every person feel at home and in good hands all the time. Otherwise the nepali people are very interested in other cultures and people. So if you open a talk you can have a very nice exchange with them and you can get a lot of information about real nepali life. I was there for two weeks and the kindness, happiness and proudness (for their country) touched me so deep and reminded me of the real important things in life. I´ll never forget this time in this little paradise.

Begnas Lake Resort is definitely a hidden Gem for travellers looking at a serene retreat  in a beautiful natural environment. The garden is gorgeous with fruit trees and vegetables. My room was very comfortable with a great view on the lake and Anapurna. The service was excellent. I stayed for 20 days with  the Panchakarma retreat program. Reaching the resort by boat is unique and let the guest to immerse in the slow pace to the local area, with fantastic views of the Anapaurna. Upon arrival I met with Doctor Saleem who was very professionnel, giving good advices on my next 19 days diet and treatments. Santosh the Spa Therapist has been very professional with care and made my full ayurvedic treatment a smooth experience. On daily basis, the resort offers Yoga classes, one in the morning with Miltra  a very passionate teacher eager to share and teach his passion about the Hatha Yoga and breathing technics, in the afternoon Kabindra is also an energetic teacher adapting his classes to the guests level of fitness. I have been to a few retreats before and this is the first time I joined most of the yoga classes and felt a good benefit out of it. My room was comfortable and the housekeeping team was all the time following my treatment schedule at the spa to clean the room and provide me with hot water. Beautiful scenery from the restaurant with very attentive service. The vegetarian dishes are cooked fresh daily with most of organic products. I was even granted access to the kitchen to see how to prepare some local dishes such as Dhaal, masala tea, carrot puding etc.. Overall it, despite the current situtation in Nepal by not having fuel, gas and electricity it has been the most relaxing retreat I have attended in Asia. The Begnas Lake resor tis nicely set on the shore of the Begnas lake in a most serene environment. This resort is also a great achievement of sustainable development and social responsibilities. Most of the team members are from the surrounding villages with nice attitude and profesisonal skills. The resort is also looking after the reconstruction of the school in the village which was destroyed by the earthquake in 2015. I would like to thank Mr Arjun (General Manager) for his care at all time with the guests and for his achievement in training the local  team and providing to guests a memorable experience in remote Nepal. Certainly a resort to return to for body and mind rejuvenating journey.

Next time I am planning to go to Begnas lake with my family and there is no doubt I will be staying here. Small cottages surrounded by lush garden with a swimming pool just by the lake is a calming view in itself. Moreover it had its own organic vegetable patch and fresh water fish is an abundnace. I particularly enjoyed a slow ride on a boat all around the lake on mynownpace, checking each corner of a lake, and stopped ver at one of a lcal restaurant for fresh fish item lunch. The hotel staffs were courteous and met my needs at a beat of a heart. I also enjoyed ayurvedic massage which is another speciality of this hotel. They have in house doctor and offer ayurvedic treatment package as well. Overall a great and relaxing getaway for a solo traveller to a wholesome family.

Firstly there are two ways to get to this hotel, by car or by boat.    We took the boat option, this was the perfect choice, as you cross this beautiful lake you have a perfect view of the Annapurna Mountains - it's a 20 minute journey by boat so you get plenty of time to enjoy the view.We were me by the General manager at shoreside and taken to our rooms, upgraded to lakeside view cottages (thank you Mr Arjun).   The grounds at this hotel are beautiful, many people come for yoga and massage courses due to the tranquil setting.     However for the adventurous type they hire out mountain bikes and arrange hiking trips.   The bar and restaurant is located at the top of the hill and service in both was impeccable - nothing was too much trouble.   They even have there own fish farm in the lake, so you know it's definitely fresh.    Fruit and veg also grown in the grounds.Amazing views from the restaurant and bar area.    Drinks are slightly dearer here than Pokhara Town, however happy hour from 5-7 is two for one.   Our barman Sharad ensured we made the most of this he was very informative about the hotel and surrounding area.         It wasn't an issue for us but it is important to note that the grounds are built on a slope there are lots of steps so take your time and enjoy the surroundings on the way up.One morning we left early to see the sunrise and were given a superb packed breakfast to take with us.   After a long day in Pokhara paragliding, microlight flights etc this was the perfect place to unwind.      If you are looking for loud music or noise you are better off staying in Pokhara Lakeside, but if you want natural beauty and Nepalise hospitality then this is definitely the place to be.    It really is the staff that makes this place - well done Mr Arjun, you have a beautiful hotel and a great team, our only regret was that we couldn't stay longer.     Will definitely be back and would hesitate to recommend.

I have been coming to Nepal for 10 years bringing groups for yoga retreats and have visited many hotels in Nepal but often found certain elements lacking. Begnas Lake Resort is finally the place I have been searching for all this time, the location & ambience; the service of the genuine and sincere staff; the delicious, healthy and plentiful food and the helpfulness of the wonderful manager Arjun, made our group stay very special. I can't wait to come back next year :)

We should have guessed that we were in for a treat when we boarded the charming, canopied wooden boat on Begnas Lake, about 10 km from Pokhara.  For the next 30 minutes two young men paddled our boat across the tranquil waters, along the steep, wooded lakeshore, until we reached the landing point at Begnas Lake Resort.We were taken by surprise at the extent of the resort, which is made up of a number of attractive, stone and wood buildings strategically placed on terraces previously planted as rice paddies.  We were so taken with the stunning location and with the courtesy, warmth and professionalism of the entire staff, from the manager to the young ladies who cleaned the room.  The atmosphere was relaxed and unpressured, with very flexible timings for breakfast, lunch and dinner.  The food was delicious and beautifully presented; one of our favourites was the Begnas Lake grilled fish which was taken fresh each morning from the lake where several fish farms are located.  The lake was very clean and fine for swimming, although the hotel's spring-fed pool was delightful as well.Our room was very spacious and featured a lovely private balcony with a spectacular view of the lake and the hills.  We enjoyed rising early and sitting on the balcony reading, and watching and listening to the exotic birds that seemed to come by for a visit each day.  The gardens surrounding the buildings featured many local trees and flowering plants, and also included fruit trees, vegetables, and herbs that supplied the kitchen.   There are beautiful views of the surrounding hills, and on clear days we were able to see the mountains of the Annapurna Range.  It was delightful to take walks through the surrounding countryside, through villages and even to a coffee shop where a local family grows and processes its own coffee. We highly recommend this resort for people who want to relax and be well cared for to a very high standard.   (As the hotel is located on several levels because of its former use as terraced rice paddies, it is good to keep in mind that there are quite a few steps between the various cottages, the pool, and the reception/restaurant/bar area.)

I stayed here in September whilst visiting a local school. The views from my room were amazing and the staff were so friendly and attentive. I ate most nights in their restaurant and the food was lovely and well priced.

The resort is situated at a beautiful place and is perfect for getaway. However here are a few things i would like to mention.1. Crappy WiFi service. The Hotel staff blamed the weather for bad Wifi but we had no wifi since we checked in2. No swimming pool. - They said its under construction but while booking and on their website they show pictures of  a pool3. Apart from no WiFi suddenly our room phone got disconnected and we had to go up all the way to reception to order food4. Cable connection of the TV was pathetic and we couldn't watch anything

The last 3 nights of a 3 week holiday in Nepal and India.  The food and service fabulous. I happened on the ayuvedic spa and had full body foot and hand massage by a lovely lady called kumar. I have had massages all over the world and honestly say this rates as one of the best. Prices really reasonable. All staff were very helpful and friendly. The trecking to begnaskote was amazing thanx to the yoga teacher

This hotel was a wonderful experience of peace and tranquillity.  The views were outstanding; the staff simply couldn't do enough for you; the food and restaurant service was very good, with fish from the lake and food grown locally.  I would love to return to this hotel.  You can arrive by car and descend about 150 steps; or arrive by boat and ascend about 150 steps.  Good mobility is essential to stay here.   The cottages were simple but provided everything that one could need.  The swimming pool is chemical free and a delight.  This hotel is slightly off the beaten track, and will attract the right people who will have gratitude for the kindly staff, the amazing views, the wonderful walks and the beauty and peacefulness of this little paradise.

We loved this place. Great way to get away from it all and relax in a little paradise. Great location, great views, quiet, relaxing, good food.Not for people that like busy cities, restaurant options, night life, etc.

We stayed here at the beginning of March. Our journey to the hotel started with a canopy boat trip ride across the lake. I felt immediately relaxed surrounded by the calmness of the lake & the gentle paddling of the boatmen with the backdrop of the snowy Himalayas in the background. What an enchanting place with the hotel placed high on the hillside with small villas & private balconies cascading below. Very colonial   Serene & private. The food here was excellent with a very varied menu & with fresh produce. The staff could not do enough to make our stay as pleasant as possible. The manager was very professional informative & courteous. The Ayurvedic massage provided at the hotel was so relaxing just what was needed for a busy holiday Schedule. The rooms were also comfortable & quiet. I would definitely recommend this hotel.

Begnas Lake Resort was a beautiful way to spend a few days for yoga and relaxation and massages. We arrived by silent boat ride to this secluded resort and were greeted by very lovely staff and cool drinks. Our rooms were lovely with a patio looking over the lake and outdoor pool. The food was fantastic especially the masala tea, the momos, the pokaras, the croissants and cinnamon rolls.. The staff were very accommodating. The massages were great. We did yoga practice outdoors overlooking the lake - was lovely.  The downside was really the ayurvedic doctor who was a waste of time,, the beds and pillows were very hard.  Bring your own pillow and remake the bed with the comforter underneath for extra padding. There are lots of steps so be prepared for climbing up and down lots. The resort manager took us on a great walk to the local school and surrounding farms. Power shedding was a problem when we were there so we often had no power and the resort did not run the generator for our small group.  A great way to see the real Nepal.

Only 30 minutes from Pokhara you are invited to take a boat across the lake to the resort. A comfortable resort set in the hill, quiet, clean rooms, yoga,  delicious food, essy hiking nearby. Eat fish from the lake, go to the spa or relax by the pool. This is where you can really rejuvenate.

We arrived by taxi at the road access to the hotel without having completed any research and without having made a booking.  There is a few minutes' walk down wide, winding stone steps to the hotel reception but the bags were carried by hotel staff. If you book in advance, the hotel sends a boat across the lake to pick you up which is a beautiful experience in itself. The manager was most welcoming and showed us a number of rooms to choose from.  My room had a panoramic view across the lake to the hills and the mountains above. It was spacious and light with a beautiful bathroom which I would love to have at home! At night meals were served in front of a cosy fire in the dining room.  The staff went out of their way to ensure  a comfortable stay.  I will definitely stay there again when I return to Pokhara, just for a quiet, relaxing meditative stay.  The site is steep so you need to be able to climb stairs to enjoy the gardens and the pool which is so scenically situated on the lower level, closer to the lake.

I stayed for 8 nights here during a 2 week visit to Nepal and it was a magical and peaceful time. The hotel staff maintained the high level of top Nepali welcome and service, while the country reeled under the fuel blockage imposed by India. At a time when fuel was almost impossible to obtain except by black market prices and many hours of queueing, they got me and other visitors to and from our transfer points and around Pokhara Valley.The peaceful location means some challenges for access: either a 20 minute boat ride or a stiff (for a sixtysomething) walk up to the road. Wifi and power are harder to keep going at times of crisis. But the patient visitor will be rewarded with an experience of a very beautiful corner of Nepal, but at a good deal more comfort than you will normally find on the trail.I was on the Ayurvedic menu (I travelled with SpaDreams / FIT Reisen, so it was an inclusive package). This food was outstanding - tasty and light and healthy. The one night I broke out and had some fish cooked European style, it was also excellent.After I week at Begnas, I did the Parahawking Experience, and then went back to Begnas for a night. It would also be possible to do a jump as a day trip from Begnas. I highly recommend the Parahawking jump as a unique and once in a lifetime experience.Begnas is also great for the more modest boating, fishing and bird-watching operations, using the boatman local to the lake.

A wonderful resort in a beautiful location situated adjacent to the tranquil Begnas Lake about 30 minutes from Pokhara city. The Begnas Lake Resort offers lush green surroundings adjacent to a tranquil Lake Begnas and excellent views of the Mighty Annapurna Himalaya Range. The rooms are spacious and offers great views of the surroundings .. esp the Annapurna Himalaya range. Food is great, bar is good, staffteam are all professional and ready to serve from the heart !!

We are a group of three friends from Australia who chose Lake Begnas on recommendation. Arjun the Manager took such great care of us ensuring the stay was as perfect as the views. We loved the change of pace Lake Begnas offers from the business of normal Nepalese life. The rooms were comfortable, food great especially the Ayurvedic options. The Ayurvedic treatment a must try and travelling their by boat on Lake Begnas highly recommended. For a peaceful and total chill out we couldn't recommend this place highly enough. Thanks for organising our day to Katmandu Arjun. It was perfect! Thanks again.

The Begnas Lake Resort is a wonderful place! I enjoyed every single of my 20 days there! The service was excellent, the (ayurvedic) food was delicious, my room (no. 8) was on German 4-stars-level. I was allowed to watch my favourite dishes being prepared in the kitchen several times. You can swim either in the lake or the pool. Twice a day I took Yoga classes, which were very good and the two teachers were very nice indeed. Once I went on a hike (4,5 hours) with a guide from the hotel - it was for free! I will definately return next year!

This was my second visit to the Resort; this time for a week. Both times we arrived by boat from across the Lake, what a lovely way to arrive at this beautuful location. Both experiences were very enjoyable. The cabins are comfortable and well-appointed, the grounds are beautifully landscaped, the staff are extremely friendly and helpful and the menu in the restaurant is excellent. We booked for a Pancha Karma treatment package for a week, and had a lovely relaxing time. The package includes not only the treatment and accommodation, but 3 excellent vegetarian meals per day, and transportation to and from Begnas Lake (including airfare one-way from Kathmandu). There are hiking trails in the hills around the Resort, and the staff will arrange for tours into Pokhara and the surrounding area. An all around great experience!

This resort deserves every star out of the five I am awarding them. - Staff: from General Manager to housekeeping, everyone is dedicated to ensure their guests are having the best experience they could possibly have. Friendly, service minded, professional and thinking out of the box. Even though from a classical hotelmanagementg point of view some technical skills can be improved, the running courses will ensure this. - The kitchen / menu. The chef(s) can prepare every sinlge dish on the extensive menu very well. He was trained within top Sheraton hotels and his experience shows. All ingredients are organic, most of it grown on the property itself. Local farmers are incorporated in the produce-chain.- Accomodation. The rooms are well fitted, clean and comfortable. The beds sleep very well and in winter time hot water bottles are being put into your bed while you are enjoying dinner at the restaurant. Most rooms have airconditioning to ensure the right temperature in your room. There is a decent pool. - Location: The views are stunning from every viewpoint at the resort, all rooms are overlooking the lake and the mountainscenery is breathtaking.- Ayurvedic treatments: we did not stay here specifically for the ayurvedic treatments but as far as we can tell this also lives up to the standard you might expect. We consulted the doctor on arrival since we fell sick during(actually just after) one of our trekkings. Based on his and our judgement we took 4 days of treatment and we departed nearly fully recovered. Our massuers were trained properly and seemed experienced.This would complete 5 stars for each component. I would like to add that the management of the resort is envolved in local support of the school and other community aspects. The staff is reguralry trained, there's plenty of staff around and eeveryone seems to enjoy working here.

Namaste! If you had enough of the bustling Kathmandu, Begnas (200 km away) is the place to get away from it all. Set in the middle of the nature, with the majestic Himalayas reflecting in the lake's crystal clear waters, Begnas Lake Resort & Villas is the perfect place to unwind. The resort can be accessed either by car or coach over a 3 km asphalt road or by a 20-25 minute boat ride from Begnas Bazaar. We recommend the boat ride as it's very romantic! The resort has its own human-powered boats, ranging from 4 to 12-seaters (no motor boats are allowed on the lake). All materials used in the construction of the resort are natural and locally sourced: stone, slate, wood, bamboo and cane. Upon arrival we were greeted with fresh Guava juice, the fruits being sourced from the resort's garden. The members of the staff were smiling and we've felt the warmth of their welcome right from the start! As you would expect from such a place, lots of outdoor activities, from hiking to Thumbs up: the architecture of the resort smoothly blends in with the natural surroundings. Facing north, all rooms are spacious and built in ethnic Gurung style stone-houses on terraces, with fruit trees and flowering bushes in-between the cottages. Located in the main building, Jimire restaurant and its beautiful Sun terrace overlooking the lake wins you over right from the start. Don't forget to grab a local Gorkha beer at Kodo bar, next to the Reception and the restaurant; you can also opt for local liquors, wines and cocktails, as well as snacks.One of the best resorts I've stayed at so far. Set in the middle of nature, surrounded by gorgeous landscapes, with a professional and friendly staff, Begnas Lake Resort and Villas is a place I will definitely return to.

totally different from the anonymous hotels that are located in Pokhara. reacheable mounting a hill by car or having a romantic short journey on the lake.We stayed in a romantic cottage with a view of the lake. it was great relaxing or reading a book while outside the the afternoon monsoon arrived.massage service and good quality restaurant.

Very nice resort if you are reasonably active as we did feel a bit cut off from the world and to enjoy it to the full you really need to go off exploring. The staff including the general manager were extremely helpful and the food always good and well presented . Its not he cheapest hotel in Nepal by a long way but what price do you put on those fabulous views and the peace and tranquillity in lovely natural surroundings. Would cost twice as much in the UK like for like so just enjoy and worry about the cost when you get home. Enjoy.

It was our first visit to Nepal and we were looking for other city to visit apart from the capital city, Kathmandu. We found Pokhara as the second most visited city in Nepal through TripAdvisor. We then made a research on accommodations in Pokhara and found Begnas Lake Resort & Villa. Despite it's location of 12km away from Pokhara city centre and airport, choosing this resort was the best decision!Located at the hillside of Begnas Lake (2nd largest lake in Pokhara) and surrounded by lush flora and fauna with AMAZING, BEAUTIFUL and SCENIC view of the snow capped mountain range of Annapurna at the background, Begnas Lake Resort and Villa is a definitely a hidden gem! There are 2 ways to reach this resort. You can either drive to Begnas Bazaar and take a boat to the resort or you can drive all the way up to the main entrance of the resort. Begnas Lake Resort & Village may not have a grand or stylish entrance, but the minute you step down to the reception/club house area, you'll be simply mesmerised by what this resort has to offer, THE AMAZING VIEW!!! During our stay, we felt relaxed and at peace. You can simply do absolute nothing and yet have a great quality time. Our favourite place is the outdoor sitting area at the one and only restaurant and club house in the resort, sipping a cup or two of coffee and hot chocolate. You can never get bored by the view.. The staff are friendly and warm. Always smiling and provide great hospitality. We also managed to walk around the neighbouring villages and were greeted by the friendly villagers. We would highly recommend this Begnas Lake Resort & Villa if you are planning to visit Pokhara for an enjoyable relaxing experience! Thank you, Begnas Lake Resort & Villa for making our vacation in Nepal a memorable one! We were blessed to end 2013 and start 2014 at your resort!Warmest regards,Eddie & Christian :-)

One of the most beautiful resorts I have been to.  The Panchakarma treatments and the food specially made for your ayurvedic type were wonderful.  The hosts Pawan and Ewa are such beautiful soul. So is the doctor leading the treatments.   I would recommend it to everyone whether you just want to chill and go hiking or do some treatments.You won't find better personalized attention.  The cooking class in the end shows you how to make all the delicious food you had.

We expirienced a very good Ayurveda cure in Nepal at Begnas Lake. We were initially drawn to Nepal to not only experience the cure but also to explore the culture, people, and nature of the country. After a scenic flight and trekking, we arrived at the resort. The resort is situated at the beautiful clean Begnas Lake with a view of the Annapurna when the sky is clear. The young doctor, Dr. Niraj, was competent and discussed medication and procedures during daily consultations. The masseurs were well-trained and committed, as seen also during synchronized massages and shirodara. The owners of the resort were very friendly and approachable. They also care for dogs and donate some of the income to protect animals in Nepal. The atmosphere among the staff was positive. The food provided was delicious and varied, in line with the doctor's recommendations. The entire team of Bengnas Lake went above and beyond to fulfill our wishes. We would like to  express our gratitude for the wonderful, cleansing, grounding, and lovingly cared for time we had at the resort.

Come here for the views! This hotel is uniquely located and beautifully constructed. The air conditioning works in the rooms, which are like little cottages. The food here is delicious. Kudos to this hotel for offering excellent Nepal wines--not the ubiquitous and sickly sweet Australian Jacob's Creek. (No fault of the hotel: the cicadas sound like tinnitus which can be draining; the heat was to the extent that the pool was like a warm bath -- but then so was the lake water temperature.) There are many steps to climb at this boutique resort which was fine as I was in hiking mode in Nepal. The lack of wifi in the rooms is worth noting, and the little clay vessels holding the shampoo and conditioner I found difficult to handle when showering.

Dear travelers, I stayed several days with friends in the Begnas Lake Resort. Its a wonderful place with very nice, authentic employees who do their best for your well-being. We planned a calm week with Ayurvedic treatment, but it never went boring. Beside the daily message treatment, there are great opportunities for hiking (guides are provided from the hotel), visits in Pokhara, Boat trips, two daily yoga sessions. The food is excellent and all Ayurvedic - this week gave me a great refreshing! Accommodations are very cosy and I just love the tiny, natural bungalows!

I could not fault this stunning place nestled in the hillside surrounded by a jungle and a view of the Himalayas on a clear day.  All rooms overlook the lake which is breathtaking and safe to swim in at any time of day.  The natural world is most definitely dominant and all around and you we felt humbled to be inhaling it's beauty.  We experienced all the massage treatments and the yoga sessions plus we found a yoga guru up in the mountains who treated us to some hilltop yoga with a 360 degree view of the Himalayas.  Everything to love.

What a great stay with my wife.had my 70th birthday dinner.outstanding chef.Reception lady wonderfulHousekeeping staff always smiling and helpfulManager excellentWaiting staff very cheerfulGreat place.wIfe had a massage.great pool.also swam in the lake.did yogaExcellent location.great staff.great food.thanks for a great stay.will be back

A paradise like place, peaceful and beautiful.Very nice and pleasant people, great and professional Ayurveda treatment with personalized yoga. Surprisingly broad variety of vegy- dishes, that are very tasteful! Great walks and hikes plus swimming in the lake- what else....We had a really good time and are ready to attack 😀

Begnas Resort is a tranquil place to stay while visiting Nepal. What a wonderful view of the Himalayas. My Room was facing the Fish Tail peak and If you wake up early in the morning then you can have  breathtaking views. The food is also very delicious.They offer you boat transfer up to the Bus parking area. The staff is very co-operative they provide you hair dryer on demand.One must visit this place while visiting Nepal.

I had such a wonderful long weekend at Begnas, As soon as you start walking down the steps into the tropical forest you feel relaxed, then the lake appears with the Himalayas looking over them appears. Great service, great food, amazing views, boat trips and swimming in the lake! It felt like another world.

Stayed at the Resort for five nights, the room was spacious, immaculately clean with basic toiletries available.  The staff at this Resort are cordial and delighted to help address all concerns of their guests.  The food prepared was fresh, well presented, different variety with flavors and aroma - very inviting cuisine indeed, followed by their desserts and masala tea.  The view of the lake is spectacular from within your room as well as the porch of the dining area.  An ideal place to unwind, relax and rejuvenate.  Thank you Begnas Lake Resort for the hospitality extended to our group of 16 ladies who were there on a retreat  organised by Ashima Living.

This has been the highlight of our journey to Nepal. Lake Begnas Resort is an oase that we had the privilege to enjoy for 7 nights. The Manager of this place has managed to create a place where you are welcomed with open arms. The staff are serviceminded above expectations. All in all we can highly recommend this place to everybody who wants to enjoy friendly and openhearted atmosphere, great food, smiling yoga and lovely ayurvedic treatments in a beautiful surrounding. Beside that they grow their own vegetables and focus on sustainability. You should definately go here!!!

Preferably you get there by boat... The staff picks you up for a 30 minutes relaxing boat ride. The welcoming then was well organized including necessary information for the stay.Excellent cottage with all that you need and a very nice restaurant. After 270 steps you can also take a walk in the surroundings and better watch the Mountains, coffe plantations etc.

Stayed for a night there before continuing to Muktinath-Jharkot, Pleasing staff, great food and really really nice view. Facilities were well maintained. I recommend this Hotel for visitors coming to Pokhara while trying to stay out of the super touristy central Pokhara

This resort was a relaxing little oasis in the bustling country of Nepal.  Set in a jungle forest, bordered by the lake below and a dusty village road high above the best thing to do here is nothing.  The basics were all there: clean comfortable rooms, good food, pleasant staff.  Beyond the basics were gardens of fresh produce used in the kitchen; delightful spa staff with some very interesting techniques; peace and quiet enough to sit and watch butterflies; walking paths for exploring; an awesome deck for lake views; and the best outdoor yoga studio.

This resort is about 30 min drive from pokhara 's main tourist Hub lake side & a great escape from the hustle & bustle of the city ,  up in the Hill of sudari Danda above BEGNAS lake probably the best well kept resort for two decades despite the Maoist insurgency when nation were facing various issues .... For this I would like to handsup Begnas Resort for surviving on many of the nations critical moments & still maintaining the glory it is nothing easy to run a resort in a third world country like Nepal , where you hardly get any thing to Keep the reputation but I found Begnas resort among the one who have always served me with smile on every visit .      I been fortunate & lucky to fell this naturally beautiful peaceful retreat in many different years of the month & I always eagerly waiting for my next visit the views of the Annapurna Himalayan Range reflecting on the lake water citing with beer or fresh Garden fruit juice is unbeatable to any other places that I have been to in Nepal. The paddy fields on the other side is just stunning too. I enjoyed the fresh fish with garden well garnished herbs also so the food here is also really delicious set up on the tranquil forest just close enough to hear all the Bird seeing a song just close to nature as close as to the Heaven a real gem of the Hotels that you rarely find in NepAl most of all why this Resort makes difference is the Management Mr Arjun Parajuli General Manager is the Jewel of the Property....will definitely go again.

Such a spectacular country and lovely people. A short boat ride across the lake is the best way to approach this retreat, so peaceful and great views all around. The food was great and as always the Nepali staff were welcoming and professional.

After a few days of trekking this is very nice and peaceful place to recover from the sour muscles.All the rooms have a magnificent view over Begnas lake.It really is peaceful and quiet.Staff is very friendly. Especially the manager. If you have a problem, he will do anything within his power to help you.I would really like to thank him!And I cant forget our massage therapists. They are very good.

We spent 2 great days in this Resort. It is a Little bit expensive but it is also worth Money. The Hotel Looks like a Little village - very clean and lovely rooms. We even got upgraded. Thank you so much!

Beautiful hotel with small cottage like rooms and amazing views over Begnas lake. The staff is very helpful and the restaurant serves the best food I had in Nepal. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a quiet retreat in Pokhara. Mr. Arjun is also an amazing host.  He not only upgraded my room from a Deluxe to a Premier but also made the effort to be around every morning to greet the guests and almost every evening to ask about our stay.

I was there for two day. It is located in peaceful environment in between forest in edge of begnas lake. Surrounding atmosphere was like a tranquilizer. Enjoyable place with good hospitality from staffs.

From the time we landed at the resort by boat till the time we left by car ( as it was raining) We could not fault our stay. The view,the staff,the accommodation , the meals were all top class. It was so much more than we expected in Nepal . This is such great value for a first class resort .Thank you to everyone .

I booked this journey to find silence connected to the nature.I've found exactly what I was looking for.The Resort is very wise arranged with so much love to the details, the staff is extraordinary friendly, the standard is almost European. It was quite calm due to the site, there was no noise of people, at least due to the off season and the offer to activities, tours, guides, ... off the resort is various.I've found rest, friends and adventure.At the time I'll be back!

Begnas Resort is a truly a unique place within Nepal. I have not found another place that has its own character, builds from Nepali culture and heritage, and yet also has world class service. In other words, it is quite clear you are in Nepal while at Begnas Lake Resort, but you also have top class accommodation and service without many of the rough edges that I associate with other hotels and resorts in Nepal (i.e. at Nagarkot). The resort is quiet, surrounded by forests, with incredible views over Begnas Lake and the Himals around. There are excellent places to mountain bike and hike on the door step. The staff navigated the careful balance of being friendly, willing to chat but also respecting my privacy and need to concentrate (I was doing a writing retreat). I was deeply impressed with their professionalism and simultaneous ability to have some fun when it seemed appropriate. The food was outstanding and on the rare occasions I ordered something I did not like, they made sure that I was satisfied and did not want it exchanged for something else (I felt the fault was my own as the food matched the description in the menu). The accommodation was extremely comfortable and despite the very few guests, they made sure we had access to electricity when needed. For those familiar with Nepal, you will know this is an accomplishment in itself. I would absolutely return and enthusiastically recommend it to anyone who wants a relaxing, lovely place in Nepal (without feeling like you could be at any resort, anywhere in the world).

I had an awesome stay at Begnas thanks to the lovely staff, trips, food, yoga, ayurveda massages, views etc. Keep up the good work and attitude in making your guests feel at home away from home!Special thanks to Sharad!!!I hope to be back one day... :)

I had an awesome stay at Begnas thanks to the lovely staff, trips, food, yoga, ayurveda massages, views etc. Keep up the good work and attitude in making your guests feel at home away from home!Special thanks to Sharad!!!I hope to be back one day... :)

Spent three nights here November 2014. Woke each morning to bird song and no other noises. Fantastic view of the lake from the very spacious room. Food was really good, especially the lemon tart is top-top!  Staff service and kindness extra-ordinary and cleaning is top-class. Wifi worked all over the place with good spead - price: NR100 per 24 hours. Lots of stair cases, so not that good, if you have knee problems.

We spent two nights here recently. Arriving by boat across the lake was a delight but the return journey (after breakfast two days' later) gave us the most wonderful views of Fishtail and adjacent mountains across the lake. The resort is a series of bungalows, tiered/terraced down from the restaurant and bar to the lakeside itself. The food was good, the service friendly and efficient and there were great views of the lake, countryside and mountains from the restaurant terrace. The hotel organised a half day's walk in the local area,- beautiful landscapes and insight's into the lives of the rural economy. Co-incidentally, we spotted between 30 and 40 separate species of butterfly on this walk. My wife had a massage, reasonably priced. The local "Everest" beer was a bit expensive, unless you availed yourself of the pre-dinner "happy hour" session when it was half price. Best views from the higher bungalows; could be tough for visitors with accessibility problems; you could arrive by road instead of boat. A great little place to visit.

The Begnas Lake Resort is categorized as being in Pokhara but it is in fact in another world. Pokhara is a bustling large town with all the noise, dirt, mystique, commerce and appeal of a regional center and tourist hub in landlocked Nepal. Begnas Lake is a short distance but a good drive from Pokhara. It is perched on the side of a steep hill going up from the lake. If walking up and down lots of steps isn't for you neither is this hotel. It overlooks a gorgeous lake and when the sky clears (irregularly) the view of the Himalaya is breathtaking as is the reflection on the lake. The rooms are quite generous in size, well equipped and far more upscale than any other place we stayed in 16 nights in Nepal. The price is aligned with the level of quality.
